translations.translation: Allakh Taaladan zhardam surap, Any atyn aituu menen bereke tilep, Kuran okuunu Anyn aty menen bashtaimyn. <<Bismillakh...>> sozu Allakhtyn uch korkom ysymyn ozuno kamtygan: birinchisi, <<Allakh>> - syiynuuga chynygy tatyktuu Zat, bul ysym Allakh Taalanyn Ozuno gana tiesheluu zhana Andan bashka ech kimge yigarylbait. Ekinchisi, <<Ar-Rakhman>> - cheksiz yraiym Eesi zhana Oz zatynda yraiymduu. Uchunchusu, <<Ar-Rakhim>> - zhetkiliktuu yraiym Eesi zhana Oz yraiymy menen zharatkandarynyn kaalaganyna, alardyn ichinen yimanduu pendelerine yraiym kylat.

Uluktuk zhana toluktuk sypattardan turgan maktoonun bardyk turloru Aga gana taandyk zhana alar Andan bashkalarga ylaiyk kelbeit. Antkeni Al bardyk nerselerdin Rabbisi, Zharatuuchusu zhana Bashkaruuchusu. Al emi <<aalamdar>> dep Allakh Taaladan bashka bardyk nerselerge aitylat.
Bular murdagy aiattagy maktoodon kiiinki Allakh Taalaga karata aitylgan dan'azaloo sozdoru.

Kyiamat kundogu bardyk nerselerdin Padyshasy bolgon Allakh Taalaga karata aitylgan uluktoo. Antkeni al kundo ech kim ech nersege eelik kyla albait. <<Iaumud-din>> - surak beruu, syilyk zhana zhaza aluu kunu.

Biz ibadattyn zhana bash iiuunun bardyk turun Ozun'o gana arnaibyz. Saga ech nerseni sherik kylbaibyz. Bardyk ishteribizde Senden gana zhardam suraibyz. Zhakshylyktyn baary Senin kolun'da, Senden bashka zhardam beruuchu zhok.

Bizdi tuura zholgo bagyttap, oshol zholdo alyp zhur, aga bekem kyl zhana khidaiatabyzdy koboit. <<Sirot al-Mustakim>> - ech kandai burmalanuusu zhok achyk-aikyn zhol zhana al Allakh Mukhammadga tushurgon Islam dini.

Al zhol - Ozun' zhakshylyktaryn'dy berip, tuura zholgo bashtagan paigambarlar, chynchyldar, sheiitter, tuuralykty karmangan adamdar syiaktuu pendelerin'din zholu. Alar kandai gana sonun zholdoshtor! Akyikatty bilip turup, any eerchibegen, Senin kaaryn'a kalgan zhoottor syiaktuu zhana oshondoi ele akyikatty zhana tuura zholgo tushuunu talaptagyndai izdebegeni uchun akyikattan adashkan khristiandar syiaktuulardyn zholuna bashtaba.

(lm) <<Alif, laam, miim>> - bul Kurandyn kee bir surooloru bashtalgan tamgalardan. Alar zhekeche kelgende <<alim, ba, ta zh.b.>> syiaktuu ozuno ech kandai maanini kamtybagan alfavit tamgalary. Bulardyn daanyshman syry zhana maanisi bar, antkeni Kuranda daanyshmandyksyz ech nerse kelgen emes. Anyn negizgi daanyshman syrlarynan: alar bilgen zhana suilogondo koldongon tamgalardan turgan Kuran kitebi menen chakyryk tashtoogo isharat kylyngan. Oshonduktan bul suroodo kelgen syiaktuu bul tamgalardan kiiin kobuncho yiyk Kuran zhonundo soz bolot.
Bul uluu Kurandyn Allakh taraptan tushkonundo zhana anyn sozdorundo, maanisinde ech kandai shek-kumon zhok. Al - Allakhtyn sozu. Al takyba adamdardy Allakhka zhetkirgen zholgo bagyttait.

Alar kaiypka ishenishet. Al emi kaiyp bul - Allakh zhana Anyn elchisi kabar bergen akyret kunu syiaktuu zh.b. bizge korunbogon zhana sezuu organdary menen sezilbegen bardyk nerseler. Alar namazdaryn Allakh shariiatta korsotkondoi, sharttary, parzdary, vazhipteri zhana sunnottoru menen toluk atkaryshat. Alar Allakhtan soop umut kylyp, Allakh bergen yryskylarynan parz zeketterin zhana yktyiarduu sadakalaryn berishet. Oo, paigambar! Alar Allakh saga tushurgon vakhiige zhana senden murunku bardyk paigambarlarga tushkon nerselerge, alardy biri-birinen azhyratpastan yiman keltirishet, oshondoi ele akyretke zhana andagy syilyk zhana zhazaga chyn zhuroktorunon teren' ishenishet.

Alar kaiypka ishenishet. Al emi kaiyp bul - Allakh zhana Anyn elchisi kabar bergen akyret kunu syiaktuu zh.b. bizge korunbogon zhana sezuu organdary menen sezilbegen bardyk nerseler. Alar namazdaryn Allakh shariiatta korsotkondoi, sharttary, parzdary, vazhipteri zhana sunnottoru menen toluk atkaryshat. Alar Allakhtan soop umut kylyp, Allakh bergen yryskylarynan parz zeketterin zhana yktyiarduu sadakalaryn berishet. Oo, paigambar! Alar Allakh saga tushurgon vakhiige zhana senden murunku bardyk paigambarlarga tushkon nerselerge, alardy biri-birinen azhyratpastan yiman keltirishet, oshondoi ele akyretke zhana andagy syilyk zhana zhazaga chyn zhuroktorunon teren' ishenishet.
Myna ushul sypattarga ee adamdar tuura zholdo bolushat. Alar umut kylgan nerselerine ee boluu zhana korkkon nerselerinen kutuluu menen duinodo zhana akyrette zhen'ishke zhetishet.

Allakh ichki zhana syrtky korunushu taza bolgon takyba zhana yimanduu adamdardyn sypattaryn aitkandan kiiin, ichki zhana syrtky korunushu buzulgan kaapyrlardyn bir tobunun sypattaryn aityp, myndai dedi:
Tagdyryna yiman keltirbeit dep zhazylgandardy eskertsin'bi zhe eskertpeisin'bi, alarga baary bir. Alar adashuusun zhana karshylyk kyluusun ulanta berishet.

Antkeni Allakh alardyn zhuroktorundogu zhalgandyk uchun aga moor basyp, zhaap koigon. Alardyn kulaktaryna moor basyp koigon, alar akyikatty kabyl aluu zhana bash iiuu uchun ugushpait. Alardyn kozdoruno tosmo tartyp koigon, alar akyikatty achyk-aikyn bolso da korushpoit. Akyrette alar uchun chon' azap bar.

Allakh ichki zhana syrtky korunushu buzulgan kaapyrlardyn sypattaryn aitkandan kiiin, ichki korunushu buzulgan, birok adamdarga syrtynan taza korungon eki zhuzduulordun sypattaryn baiandap, myndai dedi:
Adamdardyn arasynda ozdorun musulmanbyz dep oilogon bir top bar. Alar kanyn zhana mal-mulkun saktap kalysh uchun tili menen biz musulmanbyz dep aityshat. Birok alar ichinde kaapyrlar.

Alar naadandyktary sebeptuu syrtynan yimanduu korunup, ichinen kaapyrlyk kyluu menen Allakhty zhana yimanduulardy aldap zhatabyz dep oiloshot. Akyikatta alar ozdorun gana aldap zhatyshat, birok munu sezishpeit. Antkeni Allakh syrdy da, zhashyruunda da bilet. Zhana Al yimanduularga alardyn sypattaryn zhana abaldaryn bildirdi.

Sebebi, alardyn zhuroktorundo shek-kumon bar. Allakh alardyn shektenuulorun andan beter koboittu. Antkeni zhaza ish-arakettin turuno zharasha bolot. Alar Allakhka, adamdarga zhalgan aityp zhana Mukhammad alyp kelgen nerselerdi zhalganga chygargandary uchun alarga tozoktun en' tupku katmarynda kyinoochu azap bar.
Eger alardy kaapyrlyk, kunoolor zh.b. nerseler menen zher betinde buzukuluk kylbagyla dep tyiyshsa, alar any chetke kagyp, ozdorun taza zhana tuuralyk eeleribiz dep esepteshet.
Akyikatta alar anyk buzukular, birok alar munu sezishpeit zhana kylyp zhatkan ishteri buzukuluk ekenin baamdashpait.

Eger alarga Mukhammaddyn sakhabalaryndai yiman keltirgile dep buirulsa, alar chetke kaguu zhana shyldyn'doo menen: <<Biz ushul kem akyldar syiaktuu yiman keltirebizbi?>> - dep zhoop berishet. Akyikatta alar ozdoru kem akyldar. Birok alar munu bilishpeit.

Al emi yimanduularga zholukkanda: <<Biz siler yiman keltirgen nersege ishendik>> - deshet. Alar munu yimanduulardan korkushkany uchun ele aityshat. Al emi yimanduulardan ketip, oz bashchylary menen zhalgyz kalganda, alardy eerchuudo turuktuulugun basa belgilep: <<Chyndygynda biz silerdin zholun'arda siler menen birgebiz, birok biz yimanduulardy shyldyn'doo zhana maskaraloo uchun syrtybyzdan alarga okshoshup koiobuz>> - deshet.

Alar yimanduulardy shyldyn'dagany uchun kylgan ishterine zharasha zhaza katary Allakh alardyn ozdorun shyldyn'dait. Ushul sebepten duinodo alarga musulmandardyn okumun zhurguzot, al emi akyrette kaapyrlyk zhana eki zhuzduuluktorunun zhazasyn beret. Oshondoi ele alar adashuusun zhana chekten chyguusun ulantyp, akyry ara zholdo dendaroo abalda kaluulary uchun alarga moonot beret.

Myna oshol sypattar menen sypattalgan eki zhuzduulor yimandy kaapyrlykka almashtyryshty. Alar Allakhka yiman keltiruudo zhogotuuga uchurugany zhana akyikat zholgo tushpogonu uchun alardyn bul soodasy paidasyz boldu.

Allakh eki zhuzduulorgo karata eki nerseni misal keltirdi: ot zhana suunun misaly. Alarga karata ottu misal kylgany, alar zharyk kyluu uchun ot zhakkan adamga okshosh, ot zharyk chachyp, al any paidalanam dep oilogondo al ochup kalat. Oshentip anyn zharygy ketip, andagy kuigon nerseler gana kaldy zhana al zherdegi adamdar dagy ech nerse korboi, ech kandai zhol tappai karan'gylyktarda kalyshty.
Alar duloi, akyikatty kabyl alyp ugushpait. Alar duduk, akyikatty suiloshpoit. Alar akyikatty koruudo sokur. Oshonduktan alar adashuularynan kaityshpait.

Al emi alarga karata suunu misaly kylgany, alar kabat-kabat karan'gylyktarga tolgon, kurkurogon zhana chagylganduu buluttardan noshorlop zhaagan zhamgyrda kalgandar syiaktuu. Al kaisy bir eldin ustuno tushup, alardy katuu korkunuch eeleit. Oshondo alar chagylgandyn sokkusunun katuu ununon ulam olumdon korkup manzhalarynyn uchun kulaktaryna tygyp alyshat. Allakh kaapyrlardy but taraptan orop alat, alar Any alsyrata alyshpait.

Chagylgan katuu zharkyragy menen alardyn kozun alyp koio zhazdait. Kachan chagylgan zhark etip zharyk chachkanda aldyga zhylyshat, zharyk chachpai kalganda karangylykta zhylbai turup kalyshat. Alar akyikattan zhuz burushkany uchun Allakh kaalasa butkul nerseni kamtygan Oz kudureti menen alardyn koruusun zhana uguusun kaitpai turgandai kylyp alyp koimok. Zhamgyr Kuranga misal, kundun kurkurogon unu tyiylgan ishterdi kamtygan nerselerge misal, chagylgandyn zharkyragy alarga keede chyndyk korunup turganyna misal kylyndy. Al emi chagylgandyn katuu sokkusunan ulam kulaktaryn zhabuusu, alardyn akyikattan zhuz burup, aga zhoop berbegendigine misal kylyndy. Eki zhuzduulor menen eki misalda aitylgan adamdardyn okshoshtugu - alardyn paida albaganynda. Ot tuuraluu misalda, ot zhakkan adam karan'gylyktan zhana kuiguzuudon bashka paida algan zhok. Al emi suu tuuraluu misalda, zhamgyrda kalgan adamdar, alardy kundun kurkuroosu, chagylgandyn zharkyroosu syiaktuu nerseler tynchyn alyp, korkunuchka salgan nerselerden bashka ech kandai paida alyshkan zhok. Oshol syiaktuu eki zhuzduulor da Islamdan kataaldyk menen merezdikten bashka ech nerseni korushpoit.

Allakh adamdardyn ichinen yimanduulardyn, kaapyrlardyn zhana eki zhuzduulordun turlorun aitkan kiiin, alardyn baarysyn zhalgyz Ozuno gana syiynuuga chakyryp, myndai dedi:
Oo, adamdar! Bashkaga emes, zhalgyz Rabbin'erge syiyngyla. Sebebi, siler Anyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiuularyn tashtap, Anyn azaby menen orton'orgo korgonuch kyluun'ar uchun silerdi zhana silerden murunku koomdordu zharatkan.

Al silerge zherdi tegiz zhaiyk kylyp koidu, asmandy anyn ustuno bekem kylyp kurup koidu, zhakshylyk kylyp zhamgyr zhaadyrdy, yrysky bolsun dep zherde ar turduu momo-zhemishterdi osturdu. Emi siler Allakhtan bashka Zharatuuchu zhok ekenin bilip turup, Aga bashka nerselerdi sherik kylbagyla, okshoshturbagyla.

Oo, adamdar! Eger kulubuz Mukhammadga tushurulgon Kurandan kumon sanasan'ar, anda en' kyska suroodoi bir suroo keltirip, aga karshy chyguuga chakyrabyz. Eger aityp zhatkan sozun'ordo chynchyl bolson'or, anda kolun'ardan kelgen koldoochularyn'ardy chakyrgyla.

Egerde andai kyla albasan'ar, (birok munu ech kachan kyla albaisyn'ar), anda azapka tatyktuu adamdar zhana alar syiyngan ar turluu tashtar menen kuigon, Allakh kaapyrlar uchun daiardagan tozokton saktangyla.

Zhogorudagy azap tuuraluu ubada kapyrlarga kylyndy. Oo, paigambar! Emi Allakhka yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandardy kubanychka bologon, khan sarailarynyn zhana bak-daraktarynyn aldynan daryialar agyp turgan beiishter menen suiunchulo. Alar andagy yrysky kylyngan taza momo-zhemishterden zhegen saiyn, alar duinodogu momo-zhemishterge aiabai okshoshtugunan: <<Bul bizge murda yrysky bolgon momolorgo okshosh eken>> - deshet. Alarga taanyp biluuloru uchun korunushu zhana atalyshy okshosh momo-zhemishter berilet, birok alardyn daamy zhana tatymy takyr bashka. Alar uchun beiishte kon'ulgo zhakpagan zhana tabiiatty zhiiirkentken nerselerden aruu zhubailar bar. Alar duinonun ubaktyluu zhyrgalchylygynan aiyrmalanyp, tugonbogon tuboluk bakytta bolushat.

Chyndygynda Allakh taala Ozu kaalagan nerseni misal kyluudan uialbait. Al chirkeidi, andan chon' zhe kichine nerseni da misal kylat. Adamdar ushuga karata kelgende eki turdo bolushat: yimanduular zhana kaapyrlar. Yimanduular misal keltiruunun artynda kandaidyr bir daanyshmandyk syr bar ekenine ishenishet zhana bilishet. Al emi kaapyrlar bolso Allakhtyn chirkei, chymyn, zhorgomush zh.b.u.s. maida zhanybarlardy emne sebepten misal kylyp zhatkanyn biri-birinen shyldyn'doo maksatta surashat. Oshondo Allakhtan myndai zhoop kelet: chyndygynda bul misaldarda adamdar uchun zhol korsotuulor, tuura zholdomolor zhana synoolor bar. Alardyn kee birleri bul misaldar tuuraluu oi zhugurtuudon bash tartyshkany uchun Allakh alardy adashtyrat zhana myndailar kop. Al emi kee birlerin andan ulgu sabak algany uchun tuura zholgo salat zhana myndailary da kop. Adashuuga tatyktuu bolgondor gana adashyshat. Alar eki zhuzduulor syiaktuu Allakhka bash iibestik kylgandar.

Zhalgyz Allakhka syiynuu zhana murunku paigambarlar kabar bergen Anyn elchisin eerchuu tuuraluu Allakh menen bolgon kelishimdi buzgandar, Allakhtyn aldyndagy kelishimdi chetke kakkandar - alarga Allakh bekemdegile dep buirugan tuugandyk mamile syiaktuu nerselerdi uzuu zhana kunoolordu kyluu menen zher betinde buzukuluktu zhaiuuga arakettenuu syiaktuu sypattar munozduu. Myna osholor duinodo da, akyrette da nasibi kem adamdar.

Ei, kaapyrlar! Silerdin abalyn'ar oto tan' kalyshtuu! Ozun'ordon Allakhtyn kuduretine dalilderdi korup turup, kantip Aga kaapyrlyk kylasyn'ar? Siler zhok nerse elen'er, Al silerdi zharatty, tiriltti, kiiin ekinchi iret olturot, andan son' ekinchi zhashoogo tiriltet, anan kylgan ishterin'erdin suragyn berish uchun Aga kaityp barasyn'ar.

Allakh siler uchun zher betindegi daryialardy, bak-daraktardy zhana bashka san zhetkis nerselerdi zharatty. Siler alardy paidalanyp zhatasyn'ar zhana silerge bash iidirilgen nerselerden yrakhat alyp zhatasyn'ar. Andan son' asmanga kotorulup, bir tegiz zheti kabat asmandy zharatty. Al ilimi menen bardyk nerseni Ozuno kamtyp algan.

Allakh taala perishtelerge kabar berip: <<Zher betinde Allakhka bash iiuu menen any guldotuu uchun biri-birine orun basar bolgon adamzatty zharatam>> dep aitty. Perishteler Rabbisinen: adamzat kiiin al zherde buzukuluk kylyp, kankorluk menen kan tokso, alardy emne sebepten orun basar kylyp zharatkanynyn daanyshman syryn bilgileri kelip surashty zhana aityshty: <<Biz Saga bash iiebiz, Saga maktoolordu aityp aruulaibyz, Senin uluktugun'du zhana toluktugun'du dan'azalaibyz zhana myndan tazhabaibyz>>. Oshondo Allakh alardyn suroosuna: <<Men alardy zharatuudagy siler bilbegen aikyn daanyshman syrlardy zhana alardy orun basar kyluudagy uluu maksattardy bilemin>> - dep zhoop berdi.

Oshondo Allakh taala Adam atanyn ordun bildiruu uchun aga zhan-zhanybarlar, zhansyz zattar syiaktuu butkul nerselerdin attaryn, aitylyshtaryn zhana maanilerin uirottu, kiiin al atalyshtardy perishtelerge korgozup: <<Eger siler bul makuluktan artyk zhana kadyrluubuz degen sozun'ordo chynchyl bolson'or, anda bulardyn attaryn Maga aityp bergilechi>> - dedi.

Alar kemchiligin moiunga alyshyp, artykchylykty Allakhka kaitaryp: <<Oo, Rabbibiz! Senin okumun'o zhana shariiatyn'a karshy chyguudan Seni aruulaibyz zhana uluktaibyz. Biz, Sen bizge bergen ilimden bashka ech nerseni bilbeibiz. Senden ech bir nerse zhashyruun bolbogon Biluuchusun' zhana tagdyryn', shariiatyn' menen ar bir ishti oz orduna koigon Daanyshmansyn'>> - deshti.

Oshondo Allakh taala Adamga: <<Alarga bul nerselerdin atalyshtaryn aityp ber>> - deit. Al alarga Rabbisi uirotkondoi aitkanda, Allakh perishtelerge aitty: <<Men silerge asmandar menen zherdegi zhashyruun nerselerdi, oshondoi ele siler achyk korgozgon abalyn'ardy zhana ichin'erden aitkan nerselerdi da bilem dep aitpadym bele!>> - deit.

Allakh Taala perishtelerdi Adamga syi-urmat sazhdasyn kyluunu buiruganyn, kiiin alar Allakhtyn buirugun atkaruuga shashylyp sazhda kylyshkanyn baiandady. Birok zhinderden bolgon Iblis gana kylgan zhok. Al Allakhtyn sazhda kyluuga bolgon buiruguna karshy chygyp, Adamga tekeberlik kylyp sazhda kylbady. Oshol sebeptuu Allakh taalaga kaapyrlyk kylgandardan boldu.

Biz aittyk: <<Ei, Adam! Aialyn' Khava ekoon'or beiishte zhashagyla zhana beiishtin kaisy zherinde bolbosun, buzulbagan zhagymduu zhana berekeluu tamak-ashtan zhegile. Birok Men silerge zhegenge tyiuu salgan bul darakka zhakyndabagyla, bolboso Men silerge buirugan nersege karshy chygyp, zalymdardan bolup kalasyn'ar>>.

Shaitan alardy azgyryp, kooz korgozo berdi, akyry Allakh tyigan daraktan alarga zhegizip, katalykka zhana kunoogo kiripter kyldy. Oshentip alardyn zhazasy katary Allakh alardy zhashagan zheri beiishten chygardy. Allakh alarga zhana shaitanga aitty: <<Zherge tushkulo! Siler biri-birin'erge dushmansyn'ar. Siler azhalyn'ar zhetkenche zhana kyiamat kaiym bolgoncho al zherde kalasyn'ar, turuktashyp zhashaisyn'ar zhana andagy zhakshylyktardy paidalanasyn'ar>>.

Oshentip Adam ata Allakh anyn diline salgan zhana alar menen duba kyl dep ilkham kylgan sozdordu aldy. Alar tuuraluu Allakhtyn bul sozundo aitylgan: (qala rabWana Zalamna 'anfusana wain lWam taGfir lana watarHamna lanakuwnanWa mina 'lkhasiriyna) <<Alar aityshty: Oo, Rabbibiz! Biz ozubuzgo zulumduk kyldyk. Emi Sen bizdi kechirip, yraiym kylbasan', biz anyk zhogotuuga uchuragandardan bolobuz>> (A'ram, 23-aiat). Oshondo Allakh anyn toobosun kabyl kyldy, any kechirdi. Chyndygynda Allakh taala pendelerinin toobolorun kop kabyl kyluuchu, alarga Yraiymduu.

Biz alarga: <<Baaryn'ar beiishten zherge tushkulo>> - dedik. Egerde silerge paigambarlarymdyn kol astynda tuura zhol kelip, kim any eerchise zhana elchilerime yiman keltirse, alarga akyrette korkunuch bolboit zhana duinodo zhogotkon nerseleri uchun okunboit.
Al emi kaapyrlyk kylyp, aiattarybyzdy zhalganga chygargandar, myna osholor tozokto tuboluk kaluuchular.

Oo, Allakhtyn paigambary Iakubdun urpaktary! Allakh silerge udaa-udaa bergen zhakshylyktaryn estep, shugur kylgyla. Oshondoi ele Maga zhana Menin elchilerime yiman keltirip, shariiatyma ylaiyk ish kyluu menen Menin kelishimimdi atkargyla. Eger any atkarsan'ar, Men dagy silerge bul duinodo zhakshy zhashoo zhana kyiamatta zhakshy syilyk beruu tuuraluu ubadamdy atkaram. Zhalgyz Menden gana korkkula zhana Menin kelishimimdi buzbagyla.

Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygy zhana Mukhammaddyn paigambarlygy tuuraluu burmalanganga cheiinki Tooratta aitylgandarga ylaiyk Men Mukhammadga tushurgon Kuranga yiman keltirgile. Aga kaapyrlyk kylgan birinchi top boluudan sak bolgula, Men tushurgon aiattarymdy kadyr-bark, mansap uchun arzybagan baaga satpagyla, Menin kaarymdan zhana azabymdan korkkula!

Paigambarlaryma tushurgon akyikatty ozun'or oilop chygargan zhalgan sozdor menen aralashtyrbagyla zhana kitepterin'erde Mukhammaddyn sypaty tuuraluu kelgen akyikatty bilip, anyk ishenip turup zhaap-zhashyrbagyla.

Namazdy parzdary, vazhipteri zhana sunnottoru menen toluk atkargyla, Allakh kolun'arda kylgan mal-mulkun'ordun zeketin chygargyla zhana Mukhammaddyn ummotundogu bash iigen adamdar menen birge Allakhka moiun sungula.

Bashkalardy yiman keltiruugo zhana zhakshylyk kyluuga buirup, birok ozun'ordu unutup andan zhuz burganyn'ar kandai zhaman! Siler Tooratty okup, Allakhtyn dinin eerchuu zhana Anyn elchilerine ishenuu menen andagy kelgen buiruktardy atkaryp zhatasyn'ar go. Akylyn'ardy ishtetsen'er bolboibu?!

Duinoluk zhana dinii bardyk ishterin'erde sabyrduuluk zhana namaz okuu menen zhardam suragyla. Bular silerdi Allakhka zhakyndatat, Any menen bailanyshtyrat, silerge zhardam beret, saktait zhana bashyn'arga tushkon zyiandy ketiret. Chyndygynda namaz Rabbisine moiun sungandardan bashkalar uchun oor zhana chon'.
Antkeni myna osholor kyiamat kunu Rabbisinin aldyna baryp, Aga zholugaryna zhana kylgan ishterinin syilygyn zhe zhazasyn aluu uchun Aga gana kaityp bararyna teren' ishenishet.

Oo, Allakhtyn paigambary Iakubdun urpaktary! Men silerge bergen duinoluk zhana dinii zhakshylyktarymdy estegile. Oshondoi ele silerge paigambarlyk menen padyshalykty berip, siler menen zamandash adamdardyn ustunon artyk kylganymdy estegile.

Ozun'or menen kyiamattagy azaptyn ortosuna buiruktardy atkaruunu zhana tyiuulardy tashtoonu tosmo kylgyla. Al kundo biroo biroogo paidasyn tiigize albait, zyiandan kutkaruu zhe paida keltiruudo Allakhtyn uruksatysyz ech kimdin shapaaty kabyl kylynbait zhana zher beti tolo altyn kun berse da kabyl kylynbait. Al kundo alarga ech kandai zhardamchy bolboit. Egerde shapaat kyluuchu da, kun da, zhardamchy da paida berbese, anda kutulmak kaida?!

Ei, Israil urpaktary! Biz bir kezde silerdi Faraondun zhan-zhokorloru korsotkon turluu azaptardan kutkarganybyzdy estegile. Antkeni alar silerdi kordosh zhana kemsintish maksatta tukumun'ardy kurutuu uchun uuldaryn'ardy olturushtu zhana chon'oigondo alarga kyzmat kylat dep kyzdaryn'ardy tiruu kaltyryshty. Silerdi Faraondun zhana anyn zhan-zhokorlorunun zombulugunan kutkaruu - Rabbin'er taraptan chon' synoo. Balkim shugur kylasyn'ar.

Zhana Biz siler uchun den'izdi ekige bolup, al arkyluu otushun'or uchun kurgak zhol kylyp, silerdi kutkarganybyzdy zhana dushmanyn'ar Faraondu zhana anyn zhan-zhokorlorun koz aldyn'arda den'izge chokturup zhibergenibizdi estegile.

Oshondoi ele bul zhakshylyktardyn ichinen nur zhana tuura zhol bolgon Tooratty toluk tushuruu uchun Musa menen kyrk tungo ubadalashkanybyzdy estegile. Kiiin siler oshol arada torpokko syiynyp kettin'er. Siler bul kylygyn'ar menen zalym boldun'ar.
Andan son' Biz silerdi toobo kylganyn'ardan kiiin kechirdik, balkim Allakhka zhakshylap syiynyp, Aga bash iiuu menen shugur kylyshat dep zhazalabadyk.
Zhana bul zhakshylyktardyn ichinen silerdi tuura zholgo tushsun degen umutto akyikat menen zhalgandy azhyratuuchu, tuura zhol menen adashuunu aiyrmaloochu Tooratty Musaga bergenibizdi estegile.

Dagy bul zhakshylyktardyn ichinen Allakh silerge torpokko syiynganyn'ardan kiiin toobo kyluuga mumkunchuluk bergenin estegile. Antkeni Musa silerge aitkan: <<Siler torpoktu kudai tutup syiynyp, ozun'orgo zulum kyldyn'ar. Emi Zharatuuchun'arga toobo kylgyla zhana Aga kaitkyla. Anuchun biri-birin'erdi olturgulo. Ushundai zhol menen toobo kyluu - tozokto tuboluk kaluuga alyp baruuchu kaapyrlyktan kaitpai zhurgondon zhakshyraak. Anan siler Allakhtyn iigiligi zhana zhardamy menen any atkardyn'ar, Al toobon'ordu kabyl kyldy. Antkeni Al toobolordu kop kabyl kyluuchu, pendelerine yraiymduu.

Zhana silerdin ata-babalaryn'ar Musaga taimanbastyk menen kairylyp: <<Biz Allakhty zhashyruusuz oz kozubuz menen kormoiuncho saga ishenbeibiz>> - dep aitkandaryn estegile. Oshondo kee birin'er bashkalardy karap turganda silerdi aloolongon ot zhalmagan sebeptuu olturuldun'or.
Kiiin silerdi Allakhtyn bergen bul zhakshylyktaryna shugur kylyshat dep olgonun'ordon kiiin tirilttik.

Dagy silerge kylgan zhakshylyktarybyzdan, zher betinde adashyp zhurgonun'ordo kundun ysygynan koloko bolsun dep buluttardy zhiberdik zhana silerge zhakshylyk katary bal syiaktuu tattuu suusunduktu, bodono syiaktuu eti daamduu kichinekei kanattuunu tushurduk. Biz silerge yrysky kylgan adal nerselerden zhegile dep aittyk. Alardyn bul zhakshylyktardy zhokko chygaryp, chetke kaguulary sebeptuu Bizdin ech nersebiz kemip ketpeit. Birok alar enchilengen sooptordu azaityp, zhazaga duushar kyluu menen ozdoruno zyian keltirishti.

Allakhtyn silerge bergen zhakshylyktaryn estegile, bir kezde Biz silerge aittyk: <<Kuduska kirgile, anyn kaalagan zherinen adal nerselerden kenen zhana yrakhattanuu menen zhegile. Aga kirgende Allakhka moiun sungan, ruku kylgan abalda bolgula zhana Allakhtan suranyp: <<Rabbibiz! Kunoolorubuzdu kechir (khittatun)>> - dep aitkyla. Oshondo Biz silerge zhoop berebiz zhana zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandardyn sooptorun koboitobuz.

Alardyn arasyndagy zalymdary kyimyl-araketti ozgortup, sozdu burmalap: <<Allakhtyn buirugun shyldyn'dagan abalda <<arpanyn dany>> (khintatun)>> - dep artyn salyp kirishti. Alar shariiattyn cheginen chygyp, buirukka karshy chygyshkandarynyn zhazasy katary Allakh alardyn zalymdaryna asmandan azap tushurdu.

Allakhtyn silerge bergen zhakshylyktaryn estegile, kachan siler erme choldo kalyp, katuu suusap turganyn'arda, Musa Rabbisine zhalynyp, silerge suu beruusun surandy. Oshondo Biz any taiagyn' menen tashty ur dep buiruduk. Any urganda uruularyn'ardyn sanyna ylaiyk andan on eki bulak atylyp, alardyn ar birinen suu chykty. Ortodo chyr-chatak bolboshu uchun ar bir uruuga iche turgan zheke zhaiyn korsotup berdik. Zhana Biz silerge: <<Silerge ech kandai meenetsiz zhana araketsiz zhetkirgen Allakhtyn yryskysynan zhep-ichkile zhana zher betinde buzukuluk kylbagyla>> - dedik.

Estegilechi, bir uchurda siler Rabbin'erdin zhakshylygyna yraazy bolboi, Allakh silerge tushurgon manna shirindigi menen bodonodon tazhaganyn'arda: <<Ozgorbogon bir turduu tamakka chydai albaibyz>> dep, Musadan bizge azyk katary zherde oskon zhashylchalar, uzun badyran', buurchak, zhasmyk dandary, piiaz syiaktuu osumduktordu chygaryp beruusun Allakhtan duba kylyp sura dep talap kyldyn'ar. Musa silerge ech kandai kyiynchylyksyz zhana mashakatsyz kelgen daamduu zhana berekeluu manna shirindigi menen bodononu bolor-bolbos nerselerge almashtyr degen otunuchun'ordu chetke kagyp: <<Bul zherdin kaalagan aiylyna tushkulo, anyn talaalarynan zhana bazarlarynan suraganyn'ardy tabasyn'ar>> - dedi. Alar napsi kaalooloruna eerchip, Allakh alarga tandagan nerselerden takai zhuz burushkandary sebeptuu alardy korduk, zhakyrchylyk zhana kaatchylyk basty. Zhana alar Allakhtyn dininen zhuz burup, Anyn aiat-belgilerine kaapyrlyk kylyp, zulumduk zhana dushmandyk menen Anyn paigambarlaryn olturushkonu uchun Allakhtyn kaaryna kalyshty. Munun baary alardyn Allakhka bash iibestik kylyp, Anyn chekterinen chykkandygy sebepten boldu.

Chyndygynda bul ummotton zhana Mukhammadga cheiinki murunku koomdordon, zhoottordon, khristiandardan, sabiilerden (Allakhka zhana akyret kununo yiman keltirgen kee bir paigambarlardyn tobu) kim yiman keltirse, alar uchun Rabbisinin aldynda syilyktar bar, alar akyrette bolo turgan nerselerden korkushpait zhana duinodo otkorup zhibergen nerseleri uchun okunushpoit.

Biz silerden Allakhka zhana Anyn elchilerine yiman keltiruu zhonundo bekem ubada alganybyzdy estegile. Biz silerge tushurgon Tooratty zhalkoolonboston zhana kosh kon'ul karabastan, oluttuu zhana tyryshchaaktyk menen aluun'ardy buirup, kelishimdi atkaruunu tashtaboo uchun eskertuu zhana korkutuu maksatta ustun'orgo toonu kotorup koiduk. Andagy aitylgandardy zhattagyla zhana al tuuraluu oi zhugurtkulo. Balkim ushundai kyluu menen Allakhtyn azabynan korkosun'ar.

Silerden bekem ubada alyndan kiiin zhuz burup zhana bash iibestik kylyp kettin'er. Egerde Allakh aikolduk kylyp silerdi kechirbegende zhana yraiym kylyp toobon'ordu kabyl kylbaganda, anda zhuz buruu zhana bash iibestik sebeptuu anyk ele zhogotuuga uchuragandardan bolmoksun'ar.

Siler murunku ata-babalaryn'ardyn kabaryn shek-kumonsuz bildin'er. Antkeni alar uloogo tyiuu salyngan ishenbi kunu chekten chygyshty. Alar munun ailasyn taap, zhuma kunu torlorun suuga tashtap, zhekshenbi kunu alyshat ele. Oshondo Allakh alardy aila-amaldarynyn zhazasy katary tashtandy maimyldarga ailantyp koidu.

Oshentip chekten chykkan bul aiyldy tegeregindegi aiyldarga sabak kyldyk zhana alardyn kylganyn kylyp zhazaga tatyktuu bolbosun dep alardan kiiinki kelgenderge da sabak kyldyk. Oshondoi ele any Allakhtyn zhazasynan zhana Anyn chekterinen chykkandarga bolgon och aluusunan korkkondor uchun eskertuu kyldyk.

Ata-babalaryn'ardyn Musa menen bolgon okuiasyn estegile. Al alarga Allakh bir ui soiuunu buiruganyn aitkanda, alar any tez atkaruunun orduna kyikymchyldyk kylyp: <<Sen bizdi shyldyn'dap zhatasyn'by?>> - deshti. Musa: <<Allakhka zhalaa zhaap, adamdardy shyldyn'doodon kudai saktasyn>> - dedi.

Alar Musaga: <<Rabbin'den bizge surap ber, soigula dep buirulgan uidun sypattaryn aityp bersin>> - deshti. Al alarga: <<Allakh aityp zhatat: <<Al ui kartan' da emes, zhash da emes, orto zhashtagy ui bolsun. Rabbin'erdin buirugun tezinen atkargyla>> - dedi.

Alar talashtaryn, kezhirlikterin toktotpoi Musaga: <<Bizge Rabbin'den anyn tusu kandai ekenin surap ber>> - deshti. Musa alarga aitty: <<Allakh aityp zhatat: <<Al karagandardyn baarysyn suktandyrgan sapsary ui>>.

Anan alar kezhirlikterin toktotposton myndai deshti: <<Rabbin'den bizge surap ber, uidun sypattaryn dagy kenenireek aityp bersin. Antkeni zhogoruda aitylgan sypattagy uilar kop bolgonduktan, alardyn arasynan tandai albai zhatabyz. Alardan soigula dep talap kylyngan uidu (Allakh kaalasa) tababyz dep basa belgileshti>>.

Musa alarga: <<Allakh aityp zhatat: <<Al ui zher aidoogo, sugatchylykka ishtetilip korduk korbogon, ech kandai aiyby zhok zhana sarydan bashka tustogu belgileri bolbogon sypatta bolush kerek>> - dedi. Oshondo alar: <<Myna emi uidu toluk anyktagan tak sypattama berdin'>> - deshti. Birok alar talash-tartyshtan, kezhirlikten ulam andai uidu soio albai turgan bolup, anan soiushtu.

Estegilechi, bir kezde ozun'ordon biroonu olturup koiup, any biri-birin'erge turttun'or. Ar biri adam olturdu degen zhalaadan ozun korgosh uchun bashkalardy aiyptap zhatyp orton'ordo chyr chygyp ketti. Allakh oshol beikunoo adamdy olturgongo bailanyshtuu zhashyrgan nersen'erdi achykka chygarat.

Anan Biz: <<Silerge soigula dep buirugan uidun bir bolugu menen oluktu urgula, oshondo olturgon adam kim ekenin aituu uchun Allakh any tiriltet>> - dedik. Alar oshondoi kylyshty, al any kim olturgonun aityp berdi. Allakh oshol oluktu tiriltken syiaktuu, kyiamat kunu da oluktordu tiriltet zhana silerge Oz kudurettuuluguno achyk-aikyn dalilderdi korsotot. Balkim al tuuraluu akyl zhugurtup, Allakhka chyndap yiman keltiresin'er.

Oshondo silerdin zhurogun'or bul zhetkiliktuu nasaattardan zhana aikyn aiat-belgilerden kiiin tashtai bolup katydy, andan dagy katuuraak bolup kaldy. Al bul abalynan ech kachan ozgorboit, al emi tashtar ozgorot. Antkeni kee bir tashtardan daryialar atylyp chygat, kee biri zharylyp, zher betinde akkan bulak suulary chygat, alardan adamdar zhana zhanybarlar paidalanat. Kee biri Allakhtan korkup, sestengeninen toolordun chokusunan kulait. A silerdin zhurogun'or andai emes. Allakh silerdin kylganyn'ardan beikapar emes, Al any bilet zhana zhakynda silerge anyn zhazasyn beret.

Oo, yimanduular! Zhoottordun chynygy abalyn zhana bash iibestikterin bilgenden kiiin, alar silerge ishenip, zhoop berishet dep umut kylyp zhatasyn'arby?! Alardyn aalymdarynyn bir tobu alarga tushkon Toorattagy Allakhtyn sozun ugup turup, andagy sozdordu zhana maanilerdi tushunup bilbegenden kiiin ozgortup zhiberishti. Alar ozdorunun kunoosunun oordugun bilishet.

Zhoottordun karama-karshylyktarynan zhana ailakerliginen, alardyn kee birleri yimanduularga zholuksa, Mukhammad paigambardyn chynchyldygyn, anyn paigambarchylygynyn tuuralygyn zhana aga Toorat dagy kubo ekendigin moiunga alyshat. Birok zhoottor biri-biri menen zhalgyz kalganda, mintip moiunga algandary uchun biri-birin aiyptashat. Antkeni musulmandar alardyn paigambarchylykty chyndyk ekenin moiunga algandaryn ozdoruno karshy dalil kylyshat.

Zhoottor ushundai maskara zholgo tushup zhatyshat, Allakh alardyn sozdoru menen ish-araketterinin kaisynysyn zhashyryp, kaisynysyn achykka chygaryp zhatkandaryn bilerin eles alyshpagan syiaktuu. Al zhakynda any achyk korsotup, shermendelerin chygarat.

Zhoottordun arasynda bir top bar, alar Tooratty okugandy ele bilishet, birok anyn maanisin tushunushpoit. Alarda uluularynan kalgan zhalgan ulamyshtardan bashka ech nerse zhok. Alar oshonu Allakh tushurgon Toorat dep oiloshot.

Tuura zholgo tushuunu zhana akyikatty bailyk zhe biilik syiaktuu duinodogu arzybagan baaga almashtyruu uchun oz koldoru menen kitep zhazyp alyp: <<Bul Allakhtan kelgen kitep>> - dep zhalgan aitkandardy kataal azap zhana kyiroo kutup turat. Alarga oz koldoru menen Allakhka karata zhazgan zhalgan zhalaalary uchun azap zhana kyiroo bolsun. Zhana munun artynan tapkan bailyk zhana biilik syiaktuu nerseleri uchun alarga kataal azap zhana kyiroo bolsun.

Alar zhalgan zhana tekeberlik abalda: <<Bizge tozok otu tiibeit, tozokko tushsok da ubaktyluu gana bolobuz>> - deshti. Oo, paigambar! Alarga ait: <<Siler buga Allakhtan anyk ubada aldyn'ar bele? Eger siler uchun oshondoi bolso, Allakh Oz ubadasyn buzbait. Zhe siler bilbei turup ele zhalgan zhana aldamchylyk zholdo Allakhtyn atynan suilop zhatasyn'arby?>>.

Abal alar oilogondoi emes. Chyndygynda Allakh kaapyrlyk kunoosun kylgan ar bir adamdy azaptait, any kunooloru but tarabynan kurchap alat zhana any tozokko kirgizip, al zhakta tuboluk kaltyruu menen zhazalait.
Al emi Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandardyn Allakh aldyndagy syilygy - beiishke kiruu zhana al zhakta tuboluk kaluu.

Ei, Israil urpaktary! Estegile, Biz silerden Allakhty zhalgyzdap, Andan bashka ech nersege syiynboogo, ata-enege, zhakyn tuugandarga, zhetimderge, muktazh kembagaldarga zhakshy soz suiloogo, oroi zhana katuu aitpastan zhakshylykka chakyryp, zhamandyktan tyiuuga, namazdy Biz buirugandai toluk atkaruuga zhana zeketti chyn kon'ulun'or menen tatyktuularga beruugo bekem ubada albadyk bele? Silerdin aran'ardan kee bir birlerin'erden bashkan'ar bul kelishimden kiiin silerden alyngan ubadany atkaruudan bash tartyp kettin'er.

Biz silerden Tooratta biri-birin'erdin kanyn'ardy toguunun zhana biri-birin'erdi oz zherinen kuup chyguunun aramdygy tuuraluu bekem ubada alganybyzdy estegile. Kiiin siler Biz al tuuraluu silerden algan kelishimdin tuuralygyna kubolukko otup, any moinun'arga aldyn'ar.

Andan son' siler bul kelishimdi buzup, biri-birin'erdi olturdun'or, ozun'ordon bolgon bir topko karshy dushmandardan zhardam surap, alardy oz zherinen zulumduk zhana dushmandyk menen kuup chyktyn'ar. Egerde alar dushmandardyn kolunda silerge tutkun bolup kelishse, alardy oz zherinen kuup chyguu silerge aram bolgonduguna karabastan, alardy tutkundan boshotuu uchun kun tologongo shashtyn'ar. Siler Tooratta kelgen tutkundardy kun tolop boshotuunun mildettigi tuuraluu kee bir nerselerge yiman keltirip, al emi andagy aitylgan kan tokpogulo, biri-birin'erdi kuup chykpagyla degen syiaktuu kee bir nerselerge kantip kaapyrlyk kylyp zhatasyn'ar? Silerdin aran'arda ushundai kylgan adam uchun bul duino zhashoosunda korduk menen tomondukton bashka zhaza zhok. Al emi akyrette bolso en' kataal azapka kaitarylat. Allakh silerdin kylganyn'ardan beikapar emes, Al any bilip turat zhana zhakynda silerge anyn zhazasyn beret.
Alar ubaktyluunu tuboluktuudon artyk korup, akyretti duino zhashoosuna almashtyrgandar. Oshonduktan alarga akyrette azap zhen'ildetilbeit zhana al kundo alarga ech kandai zhardamchy da bolboit.

Biz Musaga Tooratty berdik, anyn artynan paigambarlardy zhiberdik. Al emi Mariiamdyn uulu Isaga anyn chynchyldygyn bildirgen oluktu tiriltuu, tubasa sokur, ala zhana pes oorusu menen oorugandardy aiyktyruu syiaktuu achyk aikyn aiat-belgilerdi berdik zhana any Zhebreil perishte menen kubattadyk. Ei, Israil urpaktary! Silerge Allakh taraptan bir paigambar kaaloon'orgo tuura kelbegen nerseni alyp kelgen saiyn siler akyikatka tekeberlenip zhana Allakhtyn elchilerine boi kotoruu menen alardyn kee birlerin zhalganga chygaryp, kee birlerin olturo beresin'erbi?!

Zhoottordun Mukhammaddy eerchibeibiz degenge shyltoosu: <<Bizdin zhuroktorubuz kulpulangan, aitkandaryn'dyn ech biri aga zhetpeit zhana any tushunboit>> - degeni ele. Abal alar oilogondoi emes! Teskerisinche, Allakh alardy kaapyrlyktary uchun Oz yraiymynan alystatkan. Oshonduktan alar Allakh tushurgon nerselerdin az gana boluguno yiman keltirishet.

Kachan alarga Allakh taraptan zhalpy tuura negizderde Toorat menen Inzhilge shaikesh kelgen yiyk Kuran kelgende, alar al tushkongo cheiin: <<Biz zhakynda mushrikterdi zhen'ebiz, paigambar kelgen kezde bizge zhen'ish kelet, biz aga yiman keltirip, any eerchiibiz>> - dep aityshchu. Al emi alarga Kuran zhana Mukhammad, alar bilgen sypatta zhana alar bilgen akyikatta kelgende, aga kaapyrlyk kylyshty. Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyrlyk kylgandarga Allakhtyn kargyshy bolsun!

Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltiruudo alar oz baktysyn almashtyryp zhibergen nerse kandai zhaman! Alar Mukhammadga Kuran zhana paigambarlyk tushkonu uchun koro albastyk zhana zulumduk kylyp, Allakh tushurgon nersege kaapyrlyk kylyshty zhana paigambarlaryn zhalganga chygaryshty. Alar Mukhammadga kaapyrlyk kylyshkany zhana aga cheiin Tooratty burmalashkany sebeptuu Allakhtyn eselegen kaaryna tatyktuu bolushtu. Al emi kyiamat kunu Mukhammaddyn paigambarchylygyna kaapyrlyk kylgandarga kordoochu azap bar.

Al zhoottorgo: <<Allakh Oz elchisine tushurgon akyikatka zhana tuura zholgo yiman keltirgile>> - dep aitylsa, alar: <<Biz ozubuzdun paigambarlarga tushkon nersege yiman keltirebiz>> - dep, andan bashka Mukhammadga tushkon nersege kaapyrlyk kylyshat, bolboso bul Kuran alardagy Allakhtan kelgen nersege shaikesh kelet. Eger alar ozdoruno tushurulgongo chyndap ishenishse, anda Kuranga da yiman keltirishmek. Oo, paigambar! Alarga zhoop katary ait: <<Eger siler Allakhtyn paigambarlary alyp kelgen akyikatka chyndap yiman keltirgen bolson'or, emne uchun alardy olturdun'or?>>.

Silerge paigambaryn'ar Musa ozunun chynchyldygyn korsotkon achyk-aikyn aiat-belgiler menen keldi. Andan son' Musa Rabbisi menen ubadalashkan zherge ketkenden kiiin torpoktu kudai kylyp syiynyp aldyn'ar zhana Allakhka shirk kylyp zalym boldun'ar. Al emi Allakh zhalgyz Ozu gana syiynuuga tatyktuu.

Biz silerden Musany eerchuu zhana al Allakhtan alyp kelgen nerseni kabyl aluu tuuraluu bekem ubada alganybyzdy estegile. Biz silerdi korkutuu uchun ustun'orgo toonu kotorup koiduk zhana silerge: <<Biz Tooratta keltirgen nerselerdi oluttuu zhana tyryshchaaktyk menen algyla zhana kabyl aluu zhana moiun sunuu menen ukkula, bolboso ustun'orgo toonu kulatabyz>> - dep aitkanda, siler: <<Kulagybyz menen uktuk, birok ish zhuzundo bash iigen zhokpuz>> - dedin'er zhana kaapyrlygyn'ar sebeptuu torpokko syiynuu zhurogun'orgo oturuktashyp kaldy. Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Eger yimanduu bolson'or, silerdi Allakhka kaapyrlyk kyluuga buirup zhatkan bul yimanyn'ar kandai zhaman! Antkeni chynygy yimanda kaapyrlyk bolboit>>. Oo, paigambar! Bul silerdin yimanyn'ar buirup zhatkan nerse kandai zhaman - dep ait. Antkeni, chynygy yiman, aga ech bir kaapyrlyk aralashpait.

Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Ei, zhoottor! Egerde akyrette adamdardan beiishke siler gana kiresin'er degen sozun'or chyn bolso, anda bul darazhaga tezireek zhetish uchun zhana duino zhashoosunun tuishuktorunon zhana kaigylarynan es alysh uchun olumdu tilep, any suragylachy>>.

Alar ech kachan olumdu tileshpeit, antkeni zhashoosunda Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyshty, Anyn elchilerin zhalganga chygaryshty zhana Kitepterin burmalashty. Allakh alardan zhana bashkalardan bolgon zalymdardy Biluuchu. Zhakynda alardyn ar birine ish-araketterine zharasha zhazasyn beret.

Oo, paigambar! Duino zhashoosu kanchalyk kor zhana arzybagan bolso da, sen adamdardyn arasynan zhoottordun zhashoogo airykcha zhantalashkanyn korosun'. Alar kaira tiriluugo zhana surak beruugo ishengen Kitep eeleri bolushsa da, kaira tiriluugo zhana surak beruugo ishenbegen mushrikterden otup zhantalashyshat. Eger alardyn biroosu min' zhashka zhetuunu kaalasa da, anyn omurununun uzaktygy any Allakhtyn azabynan alystata albait. Allakh alardyn ish-araketterin Biluuchu, Koruuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda alardyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Oo, paigambar! Zhoottordon: <<Perishtelerdin arasynan Zhebreiil -bizdin dushman>> degenderge ait: <<Kim eger zhakshylykka chakyrgan zhana Allakh yimanduularga daiardagan zhyrgalchylykty suiunchulugon, oshondoi ele Toorat zhana Inzhil syiaktuu Allakhtyn murunku kitepterin tastyktagan Kurandy Allakhtyn uruksaty menen senin zhurogun'o alyp tushkon, myna ushundai sypattarga zhana kyzmatka ee bolgon Zhebreiilge dushmandyk kylsa, anda al adashuuchulardan>>.

Kimde-kim Allakhka, perishtelerine, elchilerine zhana eki zhakyn perishtesi Zhebreiil menen Mikailge dushmandyk kylsa, anda Allakh silerden zhana bashkalardan bolgon kaapyrlarga dushman. Al emi Allakh kimge dushman bolso, anda al anyk zhogotuuga uchurait.

Oo, paigambar! Biz saga paigambarchylyk zhana vakhii syiaktuu alyp kelgen nersede chynchyldygyn'dy korsotkon achyk aiat-belgilerdi tushurduk. Bul nerseler achyk-aikyn bolup tursa dagy, aga Allakhtyn dininen chykkandar gana kaapyrlyk kylyshat.

Zhoottordun zhaman adattarynan, kachan alar ozdoru ubada berishse, (anyn ichinde Tooratta Mukhammaddyn paigambarlygyn bildirgen nerselerge yiman keltiruu da bar), alardyn bir tobu any buzushat. Zhadagalsa al zhoottordun kopchulugu Allakh tushurgon nerselerge chyndap yiman keltirishpeit. Antkeni yiman ubadany atkaruuga turtku beret.

Kachan Mukhammad alarga Tooratta kelgen sypattarga ylaiyk Allakh taraptan elchi bolup kelgende, alardyn bir tobu andagy aitylgandardan zhuz burushtu, oshondoi ele aga maani berbesten, andagy kelgen akyikattan zhana tuura zholdon paida albagan naadanga okshop artyna tashtap koiushtu, aga kon'ul da burushpady.

Alar Allakhtyn dinin tashtap, anyn orduna shaitandardyn Sulaiman paigambardyn padyshalygy tuuraluu aitkan zhalgan sozdorun eerchip alyshty. Antkeni al ozunun padyshalygyn syikyr menen ornottu dep oiloshkon. Sulaiman zhoottor oilogondoi syikyrlyk menen alektenip kaapyrlyk kylgan emes. Birok shaitandar adamdarga syikyrlykty uirotkonu uchun kaapyr bolushtu. Alar adamdardy synoo uchun Iraktyn Vavilon shaaryndagy Kharut zhana Marut degen eki perishtege tushurulgon syikyrdy uirotushtu. Bul eki perishte kimge syikyrdy uirotposun, alardy andan eskertip: <<Chyndygynda biz adamdar uchun synoobuz. Andyktan syikyrdy uironuu menen kaapyr bolup kalbagyla>> - dep tushurdurup aityshat ele. Alardyn nasyikatyn ukpagandar alardan syikyrdy uironushtu. Anyn ichinde erkek menen aialdyn ortosunda zhek koruunu zharatyp, alardy azhyrashtyrgan turu da bar bolchu. Birok bul syikyrchylar Allakhtyn kaaloosu zhana uruksaty zhok ech kimge zyian keltire alyshpait. Alar ozdoruno zyian keltirgen zhana paida berbegen nerseni uironushtu. Al zhoottor Allakhtyn Kitebin syikyrga almashtyrgandar uchun akyrette ech kandai ulush da, nasip da bolbosun zhakshy bilishken. Alar Allakhtyn vakhiiin zhana shariiatyn syikyrlykka almashtyruu arkyluu oz zhandaryn satyp zhibergen nersesi kandai zhaman! Eger alar ozdoruno emne paida bererin bilishkende, myndai shermende ishke zhana anyk adashuuga baryshmak emes.

Eger zhoottor Allakhka chyndap yiman keltirishse zhana bash iibestigin tashtap, Aga moiun sunuu menen Andan korkushsa, anda alardyn tutungan zholunan da Allakhtyn syilygy zhakshyraak, eger alar ozdoruno paidaluu nerseni bilishken bolso.

Allakh taala yimanduulardy zhakshy sozdordu tandoogo bagyttap, alarga myndai dedi: <<Oo, yiman keltirgender! (ra`ina) <<Ra'ina (bizdin zhagdaiybyzga kon'ul bol)>> degen sozdu aitpagyla. Antkeni zhoottor any burmalap, paigambarga kairylganda, anyn <<zhen'il oiluu>> ('nZurna) degen buzuku maanisin maksat kylyshat. Oshonduktan Allakh bul zholdu zhabuu uchun ushul sozdu aituudan tyiyp, pendelerine anyn orduna <<unzurna (sozun'du tushunuubuz uchun bizdi kut)>> dep aituunu buirudu. Bul kooptonuunu zharatpagan maanini tuiuntkan soz. Al emi Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandar uchun kyinoochu azap bar.

Kaapyrlar kitep eeleri bolobu zhe mushrikter bolobu, alar silerge Rabbin'erden azby-koppu kandai zhakshylyk bolso da tushushun kaalashpait. Allakh paigambarlyk, vakhii zhana yiman syiaktuu nerselerdi Ozu kaalagan pendelerine gana beret. Allakh uluu zhakshylyk Eesi, pendeler ar bir zhakshylykty Andan gana alat. Paigambardyn zhiberilishi zhana kiteptin tushuusu - Anyn zhakshylyktarynan.

Allakh Taala Kurandagy kaisy bir aiattyn okumun zhokko chygarsa, zhe anyn sozdorun ochurup, adamdar any unutsa, anda ertebi-kechpi Allakh andan da paidaluusun zhe oshogo okshogonun alyp kelerin baiandait. Bul Allakhtyn ilimi zhana daanyshmandygy menen bolot. Oo, paigambar! Sen Allakh bardyk nersege kudurettuu ekenin bilesin'. Oshonduktan Al Ozu kaalaganyn kylat zhana Ozu kaalagandai okum chygarat.

Oo, paigambar! Sen Allakh asmandardyn zhana zherdin Padyshasy ekenin, kaalagandy okum kylaryn, pendelerin kaalagan nersege buirup, kaalagan nerseden tyiaryn, shariiatyna kaalaganyn bekitip, kaalaganyn zhokko chygararyn bilesin'. Silerge Allakhtan kiiin ishin'erdi bashkara turgan ech bir koldoochu zhok zhana silerdi zyiandan kutkargan zhardamchy da zhok. Allakh gana oshonun baarysyn zhongo saluuchu zhana aga kudurettuu.

Oo, musulmandar! Murda Musanyn koomu kaiasha zhana karshylyk iretinde oz paigambarynan: ('arina 'llWaha jahra@) <<Bizge Allakhty achyk korsot>> (nisa, 153) dep surashkany syiaktuu siler dagy paigambaryn'ardan oshentip suraganyn'ar tuura emes. Kimde-kim kaapyrlykty yimanga almashtyrsa, anda al tuura zhol bolgon ortoluk zhokton adashkan bolot.

Kopchuluk zhoottor zhana khristiandar ozdorundogu koro albastyktan ulam, silerdi yiman keltirgenin'erden kiiin murda kudailarga syiyngan kaapyr abalyn'arga kaitaruunu en'seshet. Alar munu paigambar Allakhtan alyp kelgen nerse akyikat ekeni anyk bolgondon kiiin kaalashat. Oo, yimanduular! Emi alarga Allakhtyn okumu kelgenge cheiin, alardyn kylgandaryn kechirgile, naadandyktaryna zhana zhan duinosundogu zhamandyktarga koz zhumup koigula. Allakhtyn bul buirugu zhana okumu keldi. Kaapyrga Islamdy kabyl aluuga zhe salyk toloogo zhe sogushuuga tandoo berildi. Chyndygynda Allakh bardyk nersege kudurettuu, siler Any alsyrata albaisyn'ar.

Allakh Taala musulmandardy kyiynchylyktarga sabyr kyluunu buirugandan kiiin, alarga dinge bekem boluunu zhana yimandaryn kuchotuunu buirup, myndai dedi:
Namazdy ozunun parzdary, vazhipteri zhana sunnottoru menen toluk atkargyla, tiesheluu adamdarga mal-mulkun'ordon zeket bergile. Zhashoodo kandai zhakshylyk ish kylsan'ar da, any olumdon aldyn ozun'or uchun kamylga katary kylgyla. Myna oshondo kyiamat kunu anyn soobun Rabbin'erdin aldynan tabasyn'ar, Al silerge anyn syilygyn beret. Chyndygynda Allakh emne kylyp zhatkanyn'ardy korup turat zhana ar birine kylgan ishterine zharasha syilygy beret.

Zhoottor menen khristiandardyn bardyk toptoru: <<Beiish alarga gana taandyk>> - deshet. Zhoottor: <<Beiishke zhoottor gana kiret>> - deshse, khristiandar: <<Beiishke khristiandar gana kiret>> - deshet. Bul alardyn kuru kyialdary zhana buzuku elesteri. Oo, paigambar! Alarga zhoop katary: <<Egerde aityp zhatkanyn'ar chyn bolso, oshol oilop zhatkan nersen'erge dalil alyp kelgilechi?!>> - dep ait.

Chyndygynda beiishke Allakhka chyn yklas menen bet algandar gana kiret. Al yklastuulugu menen birge paigambar alyp kelgendi eerchip, ibadatty zhakshy den'geelde atkarat. Al kaisy topton bolso da beiishke kiret, anyn soobu Rabbisinin aldynda, alar uchun kelechekte boluuchu akyrettegi nerselerden ech kandai korkunuch zhok zhana alar duinodo otkorup zhibergen nerseler uchun da okunushpoit.

Zhoottor: <<Khristiandar tuura emes dinde>> - deshse, khristiandar: <<Zhoottor tuura emes dinde>> - deshti. Alardyn baarysy Allakh tushurgon kitepterdi zhana andagy aitylgan bardyk paigambarlarga bolup-zharbastan yiman keltiruu tuuraluu buiruktu okushat. Alardyn bul kylgany bardyk paigambarlardy zhana alarga tushurulgon kitepterdi bilbesten turup zhalganga chygargan mushrikterdin sozuno okshosh. Myna ushul sebepten Allakh kyiamat kunu bardyk talashyp-tartyshkandardyn ortosunda Ozu pendelerine kabar berip: <<Zhen'ish - Allakh taala tushurgon bardyk nerselerge yiman keltiruu menen gana bolot>> - dep aitkan adilettuu okumu menen chechim chygarat.

Allakhtyn mechitterinde Anyn atyn eskeruudon, al zherde namaz okuudan, zikir kyluudan, Kuran okuudan tyigan zhana any talkalap zhe al zherde ibadat kyluuga tyiuu saluu menen anyn buzuluusuna zhana zyian tartuusuna bolushuncha araket kylgan adamdan otkon zalym adam zhok. Alardy buzuuga araket kylgandar, kaapyrlyktary zhana Allakhtyn mechitterinen tyigany uchun mechitke zhuroktoru titirep, korkkon abalda gana kirishet. Alar duino zhashoosunda musulmandardyn kolunan korduk korushot. Al emi adamdardy mechitten tyigany uchun alar uchun akyrette chon' azap bar.

Chygysh menen batyshtyn zhana alardyn ortosundagy biilik Allakhka gana taandyk, Al pendelerine Ozu kaalaganyn buiruit. Kaisy tarapka zhuzdonbogulo, Allakh taalaga bet algan bolosun'ar. Al silerdi Kuduska zhe Kaabaga zhuzdonuunu buirusa zhe siler kybyladan adashyp kalsan'ar zhe aga zhuzdonuu silerge oorchuluktu zharatsa, anda silerge ech kandai kunoo zhok. Antkeni bardyk taraptar Allakhka taandyk. Chyndygynda Allakh Oz yraiymy zhana zhen'ildetuusu menen bardyk makuluktardy kamtygan Kenen Zat, alardyn nietterin zhana ish-araketterin Biluuchu.

Zhoottor, khristiandar zhana mushrikter: <<Allakhtyn balasy bar>> - deshet. Allakh myndai nerseden aruu zhana yiyk, Al makuluktarga muktazh emes, chynynda balany aga muktazhdygy bar gana adam alat. Teskerisinche, asmandardagy zhana zherdegi biilik Aga gana taandyk. Bardyk makuluktar Anyn bash iigen kuldary. Al alardy Ozu kaalagandai bashkarat.

Allakh Taala asmandar menen zherdi zhana andagy bardyk nerselerdi murun bolbogondoi korunushto Zharatuuchu. Eger Al bir ishti tagdyr kylsa zhana any kaalasa, anda al ishke: (kun) <<Bol!>> dep gana aitat, al oshol zamat Allakh kaalagandai bolup kalat. Anyn buirugun zhana okumun ech kim kaitara albait.

Kitep eeleri menen mushrikterdin ilimsizderi akyikatka bash iibei: <<Emnege Allakh biz menen ortomchusuz suiloshpoit zhe bizge gana taandyk achyk belgini korsotpoit?>> - dep aityshat. Alar aitkan ushul syiaktuu ele sozdu murunku zhalganchy koomdor ar bashka zamanda zhana zherde zhashasa dagy oz paigambarlaryna aityshkan. Biz aiat-belgilerdi akyikatka ishengenderge achyktap berdik, al alarga achyk bolgon kezde alar shektenishpeit zhana kezhirlikteri da toskool bolboit.

Oo, paigambar! Yimanduularga beiishti suiunchulop, kaapyrlarga tozoktu eskertuun' uchun Biz seni shek-kumonsuz akyikat din menen zhiberdik. Sen achyk zhetkiruugo gana mildettuusun'. Allakh senden yiman keltirbegen tozok eeleri tuuraluu surabait.

Allakh paigambaryna eskertuu katary kairylyp: <<Zhoottor da, khristiandar da sen Islamdy tashtap, alardy eerchimeiinche senden yraazy bolushpait>> - dep aitty. (Oo, Mukhammad!) Chynygy tuura zhol - alar zhurgon zholdo emes, Allakhtyn kitebinde dep ait. Eger bul nerse achyk-aikyn akyikat kelgenden kiiin senden zhe seni eerchigenderdin biroosunon bolup ketse, sen Allakhtan zhardam da, koldoo da tappaisyn'. Akyikatty tashtap, zhalganchylardy eerchip ketuunun korkunuchunun baiany ushundai.

Yiyk Kuranda kitep eelerinin bir taipasy ozdoruno tushkon kol astyndagy kitepterdi chyndyk dep eerchip, andagylardy ish zhuzundo atkargandygy tuuraluu aityldy. Alar bul kitepterden Mukhammaddyn chynygy paigambar ekenin bildirgen belgilerdi tabyshat. Oshonduktan aga yiman keltiruugo shashylyshty. Al emi bashka taipasy kaapyrlyktarynda kalyp, zhogotuuga uchurashty.

Ei, Israil urpaktary! Men silerge bergen duino zhana dinii zhakshylyktarymdy estegile. Oshondoi ele silerge paigambarlyk menen padyshalykty berip, oz zamanyn'ardagy adamdardan artyk kylganymdy estegile.

Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp zhana tyiuularyn tashtap, ozun'or menen kyiamat kundogu azaptyn ortosuna tosmo kylgyla. Antkeni al kundo ech bir zhan bashkaga paida keltire albait, kanchalyk kop bolso da andan kun kabyl kylynbait, kanchalyk darazhasy biiik bolso da ech kimdin shapaaty paida berbeit zhana aga Allakhtan bashka ech bir zhardamchy bolboit.

Allakh Ibrakhimge okumdordu zhana mildetterdi buirup synagan kezin estechi. Al alardy talaptagydai toluk den'geelde atkardy. Oshondo Allakh Ibrakhim paigambarga: <<Men seni adamdarga ulgu kyldym, alar senin ish-araketterin'den zhana adep-akhlagyn'dan ulgu alyshat>> - dedi. Ibrakhim aitty: <<Oo, Rabbim! Menin urpagymdan da elder ulgu ala turgandai adamdardy chygar>>. Allakh aga zhoop berip: <<Dinde bashchylyk kyluu tuuraluu saga bergen ubadam, senin urpagyn'dan chykkan zalymdarga tiesheluu emes>> - dedi.

Allakh yiyk Uidu adamdardyn zhurogu aga bailanyp, kaira kaityp kele turgan zhai kylganyn, andan kancha ketishse da, kaira kaityp kelerin zhana alarga ech kandai zulumduk kylynbagan koopsuz zhai kylganyn estechi. Al adamdarga: <<Ibrakhim Kaabany kurganda ustuno turgan tashty namaz okuluuchu zhai kylgyla>> - dedi. Zhana Biz Ibrakhim menen anyn uulu Ismailge yiyk Uidu yplastardan zhana zhalgan kudailardan tazaloonu zhana al zherde tavaf, etikaf, namaz zhana bashka ibadattardy kyluunu kaalagandar uchun any daiardoonu buiruduk.

Oo, paigambar! Ibrakhim Rabbisine duba kylyp: <<Rabbim! Mekkeni ech kim zyian tartpagan koopsuz shaar kyl, anyn turgundaryna turduu momo-zhemishterden yrysky ber zhana any Saga zhana akyret kununo yiman keltirgender uchun ozgocho yrysky kyl>> - degen uchurun este. Oshondo Allakh aitty: <<Al emi alardan kim kaapyr bolso, anda Men alarga duinodo bir az yrysky berip zhyrgatam, kiiin akyrette any tozok azabyna mazhburlap kirgizem. Kyiamat kunu alar kaityp bargan zhai kandai zhaman!>>.

Oo, paigambar! Estechi, bir kezde Ibrakhim menen Ismail Kaabanyn paidubalyn turguzup zhatyp, zhalynyp-zhalbaruu menen myndai deshti: <<Rabbibiz! Bizdin ish-araketteribizdi, anyn ichinde ushul Uidun kurulushun kabyl kyl. Chyndygynda Sen bizdin dubalardy kabyl kyluuchusun', nietteribizdi zhana ish-araketteribizdi biluuchusun'.

Rabbibiz! Bizdi Ozun'dun buirugun'a moiun sunuuchu, Saga bash iiuuchu kyl. Biz Saga ech kimdi sherik kylbaibyz. Urpaktarybyzdan Saga moiun sunuuchu ummottordu chygar, Saga ibadat kyluu zholdorun bizge uirot zhana Saga moiun sunuuda ketirgen kemchilikteribizdi zhana kunoolorubuzdu kechir. Chyndygynda Sen toobo kylgan pendelerin'din toobosun kabyl kyluuchusun', alarga Yraiymduusun'.

Rabbibiz! Alarga Ismaildin urpaktarynan bir paigambar zhiber, al alarga Senin aiattaryn'dy okup bersin zhana alarga Kuran menen sunnottu uirotup, alardy shirkten zhana buzukuluktardan tazalasyn. Chyndygynda Sen ustomduk kyluuchu Kuchtuusun', ish-araketterin'de zhana okumdorun'do Daanyshmansyn'.

Naadandygy zhana akyikattyn orduna adashuunu tandagan tuura emes araketi menen ozuno zyian keltirgen zhana aga korduktu yraa korgon adamdar gana Ibrakhimdin dinin tashtap, bashka dinge otup ketishet. Biz any duinodo paigambar zhana dos (khalil) kylyp tandadyk, al emi akyrette bolso Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, en' zhogorku darazhalarga zhetken takyba adamdardan bolot.

Allakh any Islamga shashylgany uchun tandap aldy. Antkeni Rabbisi aga: <<Maga yklastuuluk menen ibadat kyl zhana bash iiuu menen Maga toluk beril>> - degende, al Rabbisine zhoop kylyp: <<Men pendelerdin zharatuuchusu, yrysky beruuchusu zhana alardyn ishterin bashkaruuchu Allakhka moiun sundum>> - dep aitty.

Ibrakhim uuldaryna: ('aslamtu lirabWi 'l`alamiyna) <<Men aalamdardyn Rabbisine moiun sundum>> - degen sozdu osuiat kyldy, Iakub dagy uuldaryna ushunu osuiat kylgan. Ekoosu ten' baldaryn chakyryp: <<Allakh silerge Islam dinin tandady. Emi siler syrtyn'ardan da, ichin'erden da musulman bolgon abalda olum kelgenge cheiin any bekem karmangyla>> - dep aityshty.

Zhe siler Iakubga olum kelgen kezde anyn aitkanyna kubo boldun'arby? Al baldarynan: <<Men olgondon kiiin kimge syiynasyn'ar?>> - dep surady. Alar anyn suroosuna myndai deshti: <<Biz senin kudaiyn' zhana ata-babalaryn' Ibrakhim, Ismail zhana Iskhaktyn kudaiyna syiynabyz, zhalgyz Aga moiun sunabyz zhana eerchiibiz>>.

Bul ummottor silerden murunku otup ketken koomdordon. Alar ozdoru kylgan ish-araketterine zhetishti, alardyn kylgan zhakshylyk-zhamandyk ishteri ozuloru uchun, al emi silerdin kylganyn'ar ozun'or uchun. Siler alardyn ish-araketteri uchun zhoop berbeisin'er, alar dagy silerdin ish-araketterin'er uchun zhoop berishpeit. Ech kim bashkanyn kunoosu uchun zhazalanbait. Teskerisinche, ar bir adam kylganyna zharasha syilyk alat. Oshonduktan silerdi murunkulardyn ish-araketteri ozun'ordun ish-araketin'erge karoodon alaksytyp koibosun. Antkeni adamga Allakhtyn yraiymynan kiiin anyn zhakshylyk ishterinen bashka ech nerse paida berbeit.

Zhoottor bul ummotko: <<Zhoot bolson'or tuura zholdu tabasyn'ar>> - deshti, al emi khristiandar: <<Khristian bolson'or tuura zholdu tabasyn'ar>> - deshti. Oo, paigambar! Alarga zhoop kylyp ait: <<Biz zhalgan dinderden akyikat dinge yktagan Ibrakhimdin dinin eerchiibiz. Al Allakhka sherik koshkondordon emes bolchu>>.

Oo, yimanduular! Bul zhalgan doomatty aitkan zhoottor menen khristiandarga aitkyn: <<Biz Allakhka zhana bizge tushkon Kuranga yiman keltirdik, Ibrakhimge zhana anyn uuldary Ismail, Iskhak, Iakubga tushkon nersege yiman keltirdik, Iakubdun urpagynan chykkan paigambarlarga tushkon nersege yiman keltirdik, Allakh Musaga bergen kitepke zhana Isaga bergen kitepke yiman keltirdik, Allakh bardyk paigambarlarga bergen kitepterge yiman keltirdik. Biz alardyn kee birine yiman keltirip, kee birine kaapyrlyk kylyp, alardyn ech birin bolboibuz. Teskerisinche, alardyn baaryna yiman keltirebiz. Biz Allakhtyn zhalgyz Ozuno moiun sunabyz zhana bagynabyz.

Egerde zhoottor, khristiandar zhana bashka kaapyrlar siler syiaktuu yiman keltirishse, alar Allakh yraazy bolgon tuura zholgo tushushmok. A eger paigambarlardyn baaryn zhe kee kee birin zhalganga chygaryp, yimandan zhuz burushsa, alar kelishpestikte zhana dushmandykta bolushat. Oo, paigambar, kapalanba! Chyndygynda Allakh alardyn zyianynan seni korgoogo zhetishtuu, Al seni alardyn zhamandygynan korgoit zhana alarga karshy saga zhardam beret. Al alardyn sozdorun Uguuchu, nietterin zhana ish-araketterin Biluuchu.

Allakh tabiiatyn'arga ylaiyk zharatkan Anyn dinin ichin'erden da, syrtyn'ardan da karmangyla. Allakhtyn dininen otkon zhakshy din zhok. Al adamdyn tabiiatyna top kelet, paidaluuga zhetkiret zhana zyiandan saktait. Zhana siler: <<Biz zhalgyz Allakhka gana syiynabyz, Aga ech kimdi sherik kylbaibyz>> - dep aitkyla.

Oo, paigambar! Alarga ait: <<Ei, kitep eeleri! Silerdin dinin'er baiyrky zhana kitebin'er murun tushkondukton, ozun'ordu Allakhka zhana Anyn dinine bizden dagy tatyktuubuz dep talashyp zhatasyn'arby? Chyndygynda bul silerge ech kandai paida alyp kelbeit. Antkeni Allakh - baarybyzdyn Rabbibiz, Any ozun'orgo zhekelep albagyla. Bizdin ish-araketteribiz ozubuzgo, siler al uchun suralbaisyn'ar, silerdin da ish-araketterin'er ozun'orgo, biz al uchun suralbaibyz. Ar biri kylgan ish-araketinin syilygyn zhe zhazasyn alat. Biz ibadatta zhana bash iiuudo Allakhka yklastuuluk kylyp, Aga ech nerseni sherik kylbaibyz>>.

Ei, kitep eeleri! Zhe siler: <<Ibrakhim, Ismail, Iskhak, Iakub zhana anyn urpaktarynan chykkan paigambarlar iudaizm zhe khristian dininde bolgon>> - deisin'erbi? Oo, paigambar! Alarga zhoop kylyp: <<Siler bilesin'erbi zhe Allakh bilebi?>> - ait. Egerde alar osholordun dininde bolgonbuz deshse, anda zhalgan aityshty. Antkeni alardyn zhiberiluusu zhana olumu Toorat menen Inzhil tushurulgongo cheiin bolgon. Ushundan ulam alardyn aitkandary Allakhka zhana Anyn elchilerine karata zhalgan zhalaa ekeni zhana alarga tushurulgon akyikatty zhashyryp zhatyshkany belgiluu bolot. Kitep eeleri kylgan syiaktuu Allakhtan kelgen anyk kuboluktu bilip turup zhashyrgan adamdan otkon zalym zhok. Allakh alardyn ish-araketterinen beikapar emes. Zhakynda alarga anyn zhazasyn beret.

Bular silerden murun otkon ummottor. Alar ozdoru kylgan ish-araketterine zhetishti, alardyn kylgandary ozuloru uchun, al emi silerdin kylganyn'ar ozun'or uchun. Siler alardyn ish-araketteri uchun zhoop berbeisin'er, alar dagy silerdin ish-araketterin'er uchun zhoop berishpeit. Ech kim bashkanyn kunoosu uchun zhazalanbait zhana al bashkalardyn ish-araketinen paida korboit. Teskerisinche, ar bir adam kylganyna zharasha syilygyn zhe zhazasyn alat.

Zhoottordun sabatsyzdary, zhen'il oiluulary zhana osholorgo okshogon eki zhuzduulor: <<Musulmandardy murda kybylasy bolgon Aksa mechitinen emne burdu?>> - dep aityshat. Oo, paigambar! Alarga zhoop kylyp ait: <<Chygysh menen batyshtyn zhana alardan bashka taraptardyn mulku Allakhka gana taandyk. Al pendelerinen kimdi kaalasa, Ozu kaalagan tarapka bagyttait. Zhana Al pendelerinen kimdi kaalasa, any ech kandai burmalanuusu zhana kyishaiuusu zhok tuz zholgo salat.

Siler kyiamatta paigambarlar oz ummottoruno Allakhtyn buirugun zhetkirgenderine kubo bolushun'ar uchun, oshondoi ele Mukhammad paigambar dagy aga zhiberilgen nerseni silerge zhetkirgendigine kubo bolushun'ar uchun silerge Ozubuz yraa korgon kybylany kylgan syiaktuu, silerdi bardyk ummottordun arasynan ishenimderde, ibadattarda zhana oz ara mamilelerde ortoluktu karmangan en' zhakshy ummot kyldyk. Biz kim Allakhtyn shariiatyna yraazy bolup, Aga bash iiip, paigambardy eerchiit ekenin zhana kim oz dininen bash tartyp, napsi kaaloosun eerchip, Allakh shariiat kylgan nersege moiun sunbai keterin anyk bilip zhana aga ylaiyk zhazasyn berish uchun sen murda zhuzdonup zhurgon kybylany (Aksa mechitin) ozgorttuk. Birinchi kybylanyn ozgoruusu Allakh Ozuno zhana pendelerine shariiat kylgan nerselerge yiman keltiruugo iigilik bergenderden bashkalaryna oor ish bolgon. Chyndygynda Al any uluu daanyshman syrlar sebeptuu gana shariiatka kirgizet. Allakh silerdin Aga bolgon yimanyn'ardy, anyn ichinde kybyla ozgorgongo cheiinki okugan namazdaryn'ardy tekke ketirbeit. Chyndygynda Allakh adamdarga Booruker, Meerimduu. Al alarga kyiynchylyk zharatpait zhana ish-araketterinin sooptorun da zhok kylbait.

Oo, paigambar! Sen kybylanyn ozun'o zhakkan tarapka ozgorushun kaalap, al tuuraluu vakhiidin tushuusun kutkondoi, asman tarapka zhuzun'du burganyn'dy zhana nazar salganyn'dy korduk. Emi Biz Aksa mechitinin orduna sen yraazy bolup, zhakshy korgon kybylaga (Allakhtyn yiyk Uiuno) zhuzun'du burabyz. Andyktan zhuzun'du yiyk Mekkedegi Allakhtyn yiyk Uiu tarapka bur. Oo, yimanduular! Kaisy zherde bolbogula, siler dagy namaz okuganda oshol tarapka zhuzun'ordu burgula. Kitep eeleri bolgon zhoottor menen khristiandar kybylanyn ozgoruusu alardyn Zharatuuchusu zhana ishterin kozomoldoochusu taraptan tushurulgon akyikat ekenin anyk bilishet, antkeni bul alardyn kitebinde tastyktalgan. Allakh akyikattan zhuz burgandardyn emne kylyp zhatkanynan beikapar emes. Teskerisinche, Al munu bilet zhana zhakynda alarga zhazasyn beret.

Oo, paigambar! Allakhka ant bolsun, sen kitep berilgen zhoottor menen khristiandarga kybylanyn ozgoruusu akyikat ekendigi tuuraluu aiat-belgiler zhana dalilder menen kelsen' da, alar sen alyp kelgen nersege bash iibei, akyikatty eerchuudon tekeberlik kylyp, senin kybylan'a zhuzdorun burushpait. Allakh seni alardyn kybylasynan burgandan kiiin, sen dagy al tarapty karaba. Alar ozdoru da biri-birinin kybylasyna karashpait. Antkeni alardyn ar biri ekinchi tarabyn kaapyr dep esepteshet. Saga shek-kumonu zhok akyikat ilim kelgenden kiiin kybyla zhana bashka shariiattar, okumdor maselesinde alardyn kaalooloruna eerchisen', myna oshondo sen da tuura zholdu tashtap, napsi kaaloosun eerchigen zalymdardan bolup kalasyn'. Bul kairyluu zhoottordu eerchuunun zhiiirkenichtuulugun korsotuu uchun paigambarga aityldy. Bolboso, Allakh paigambaryn andan Ozu saktagan. Bul bolgonu andan kiiinki ummotuno bolgon eskertuu.

Biz kitep bergen zhoottor menen khristiandardyn aalymdary oz baldaryn bashkalardan aiyrmalap bilishkendei Mukhammaddyn paigambarchylyk belgilerinen bolgon kybylanyn ozgoruu maselesin da zhakshy bilishet. Oshogo karabastan alardyn bir tobu al alyp kelgen akyikatty koro albastyktan ulam zhashyryshat. Alar munu chyndyk ekenin bilip turup zhasashat.
Oo, paigambar! Bul Rabbin' taraptan kelgen akyikat, anyn tuuralygyna shektenbe.

Ar bir ummottun fizikalyk zhe rukhanii bolobu, alardyn zhuzdongon taraby bar. Bularga ummottordun kybylasyndagy zhana Allakhtyn alarga kylgan shariiatyndagy aiyrmachylyktar da kiret. Egerde al Allakhtyn buirugu zhana shariiaty menen bolso, alar zhuzdongon taraptardyn ar turduu bolushunun zyiany zhok. Oo, yimanduular! Emi siler atkaruuga buirulgan zhakshylyk ishterde biri-birin'er menen zharyshkyla. Siler kaisy zherde bolson'or da Allakh kyiamat kunu silerdi kylgan ish-araketterin'erdin syilygyn berish uchun chogultat. Chyndygynda Allakh bardyk nersege kudurettuu. Silerdi toptoo zhana syilyk beruu Any alsyratpait.

Oo, paigambar! Sen zhana seni eerchigender, kaisy zherden chyksan' da, kaida bolson' da, namaz okuunu kaalasan', zhuzun'du Al'-Kharam mechiti tarapka bur. Bul saga Rabbin' taraptan vakhii kylyngan akyikat. Allakh silerdin kylgan nersen'erden beikapar emes. Teskerisinche, Al munu bilet zhana silerge anyn syilygyn beret.

Oo, paigambar! Kaisy zherden chyksan' da, kaida bolson' da, namaz okuunu kaalasan', zhuzun'du Al'-Kharam mechiti tarapka bur. Oo, yimanduular! Adamdar munu silerge karshy dalil kylbash uchun, siler dagy kaisy zherde bolbogula, namaz okuunu kaalagan kezde zhuzun'ordu oshol tarapka burgula. Birok alardyn arasynan zaalymdary gana bash iibestigin ulantyshat zhana en' alsyz dalilderdi silerge karshy koldonushat. Alardan korkpogula, Rabbin'erdin buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiuularyn tashtoo menen zhalgyz Andan korkkula. Allakh silerdi bardyk ummottordon aiyrmalap, zhakshylygyn toluk beruu uchun zhana silerdi adamdar uchun en' kasiettuu kybylyga bagyttoo uchun Kaabaga zhuzdonuunu shariiatka kirgizdi.

Oshol syiaktuu Biz silerge bashka dagy zhakshylykty berdik, silerge ozun'ordon chykkan elchini zhiberdik, al silerge aiattarybyzdy okup beret, silerge zhakshylyk ishterdi buiruu menen silerdi tazalait zhana zhaman kunoo ishterden tyiat, silerge Kuran menen sunnottu uirotot, oshondoi ele silerge dinii zhana duino ishterin'erge bailanyshtuu siler bilbegen nerselerdi uirotot.

Meni zhurogun'or zhana dene muchon'or menen estegile, oshondo Men dagy silerdi maktoo zhana saktoo menen esteimin. Antkeni syilyk ish-arakettin turuno zharasha bolot. Silerge bergen zhakshylyktarym uchun Maga shugur kylgyla zhana alardy chetke kagyp, silerge aram bolgon zholdo koldonup Maga kaapyrlyk kylbagyla.

Oo, yiman keltirgender! Maga bash iiip zhana buiruguma toluk moiun sunuu uchun sabyrduuluk zhana namaz okuu menen zhardam suragyla. Chyndygynda Allakh sabyrduular menen birge, Al alarga iigilik zhana zhardam beret.

Oo, yimanduular! Allakh zholundagy sogushta olturulgondor zhonundo: <<Alar bashkalar syiaktuu ele olgondor>> - dep aitpagyla. Alar Rabbisinin aldynda tiruu, birok siler alardyn tiruulugun tushuno albaisyn'ar. Al ozgocho zhashoo bolgonduktan, any Allakhtyn vakhiii arkyluu biluudon bashka zholu zhok.

Biz silerdi ar turduu kyiynchylyktar menen synaibyz; dushmanyn'ardan bolgon ancha-myncha korkunuch, tamak-ashtyn zhetishsizdiginen ach kaluu, mal-mulktun zhok bolup azaiuusu zhe aga zhetuunun mashakattuulugu, adamdardy zhok kylgan apaattar zhe Allakh zholundagy sheiittik sebeptuu zhandardyn azaiuusu, zherde oskon zher-zhemishterdin zhetishsizdigi menen synaibyz. Oo, paigambar! Myna ushundai kyiynchylyktarga sabyr kylgandardy duinodo zhana akyrette kubanychka salgan nerseler menen suiunchulo.

Alar bul kyiynchylyktardyn birine kabylgan kezde yraazy bolup zhana moiun sunup myndai deshet: <<Biz Allakhtyn mulkubuz, Al bizdi kaalagandai bashkarat zhana kyiamat kunu Aga gana kaityp barabyz. Al bizdi zharatty zhana turduu zhakshylyktardy berdi. Bizdin kaituubuz zhana ishibizdin akyry Aga gana barat>>.
Myna ushundai sypattagy adamdarga perishtelerdin en' uluu zhyinalyshynda Allakhtyn maktoosu aitylat, alarga yraiym tushot. Myna osholor akyikat zholgo tushkondor.

Kaabaga zhakyn Safa zhana Marva dep atalgan eki too - shariiattyn achyk belgilerinen. Azhylyk zhe umra ibadattaryn atkaruu uchun Kaabaga bargan adam uchun al ekoonun ortosunda zhelip churkoo kunoo emes. Myndagy kunoo emes degenden maksat - al ekoosunun ortosunda zhelip churkoo Islamga cheiinki karan'gy doordon kalgan ish degen ishenimden ulam kyzhalat bolgon musulmandar uchun tynchtanuu. Allakh taala munu azhylyk ibadattarynyn biri dep baiandady. Kimde-kim yktyiarduu turdo chyn yklastan mustakhab ibadattardy kylsa, Allakh aga yraazylygyn bildiret, andan kabyl kylat zhana aga syilygyn beret. Al zhakshylyk kylgandardy zhana syilykka tatyktuulardy Biluuchu.

Biz paigambardyn zhana al alyp kelgen nersenin chyndyk ekendigin bildirgen aiat-belgilerdi tushurup, any kitepterinen adamdarga achyk kylgandan kiiin da zhaap-zhashyrgan zhoottor, khristiandar zhana bashkalar Allakhtyn yraiymynan kuulat zhana perishteler, paigambarlar, adamdardyn baarysy Allakhtyn yraiymynan alys bolsun dep alarga karshy duba kylyshat.

Bul achyk aiat-belgilerdi zhaap-zhashyrganyna okunup Allakhka kaitkandar, ichki zhana syrtky ish-araketterin zhakshyrtkandar, akyikatty zhana tuura zholdu zhashyrganyn achyk aitkandar, myna osholordun gana Maga bash iiuugo kaituusun kabyl kylamym. Men toobo kylgan pendelerdin toobolorun kabyl kyluuchumun, alarga yraiymduumun.

Kaapyrlyk kylyp, aga toobo kylbastan kaapyr bolup olgondorgo Allakhtyn yraiymynan alystatuu menen Anyn kargyshy bolsun, alarga perishtelerdin zhana bardyk adamdardyn Allakhtyn yraiymynan alys bolsun degen kargysh dubasy bolsun.
Bul kargysh alardan ketpeit, alardyn azaby bir kun da zhen'ildetilbeit zhana kyiamat kunu alarga moonot da berilbeit.

Oo, adamdar! Chynygy kudaiyn'ar zatynda zhana sypattarynda Zhalgyz. Andan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok. Al cheksiz yraiymduuluk eesi bolgon Meerimduu, pendelerine Yraiymduu. Antkeni alarga sansyz zhakshylyktardy bergen.

Chyndygynda asmandar menen zherdin zhana alardagy keremettuu makuluktardyn zharalyshynda, kun menen tundun almashuusunda, tamak-ash, kiiim-keche, sooda-satyk syiaktuu zhana bashka adamdar muktazh bolgon paidaluu nerselerdi tashyp, den'iz suularynda suzup zhurgon kemelerde, eginder menen zhaiyttardy osturup, zherdi tiriltuu uchun Allakh asmandan tushurgon zhamgyr suusunda, al zherde tiruu zhandyktardy tarkatuusunda, shamaldardyn bir taraptan ekinchi tarapka ozgoruusundo, asman menen zherdin ortosunda moiun sunuuchu buluttarda, myna ushulardyn baarysynda dalilderge akyl zhugurtup tushungondor uchun Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygyna achyk-aikyn aiat-belgiler bar.

Ushundai achyk-aikyn aiat-belgilerge karabastan, adamdardyn arasynda Allakhtan bashka kudailardy tutungan, alardy Allakh taalaga ten'ep, Allakhty suigondoi suigon adamdar bar. Al emi yiman keltirgenderdin Allakhka bolgon suiuusu alardyn kudailaryna bolgon suiuusunon kuchtuurook. Antkeni alar Allakhka ech kimdi sherik kylyshpait, zhyrgalchylykta da, kyiynchylykta da Allakhty zhakshy korushot. Al emi tigiler kudailaryn zhyrgalchylyk uchurda gana zhakshy korushot, al emi kyiynchylykta Allakhka gana duba kylyshat. Egerde shirk zhana kunoo kylgan zaalymdar akyrette azapka kubo bolushkanyn korushkondo, butkul kuch-kubatka Allakh gana ee ekenin zhana bash iibestik kylgandarga Anyn azaby kataal ekenin bilishmek. Egerde alar munu korushkondo, Aga ech kimdi sherik kylyshmak emes.

Myna oshondo eerchitken bashchylar kyiamattagy korkunuchtardy zhana kyiynchylyktardy korgondo alardy eerchigen alsyzdardan bash tartyshat. Antkeni alar uchun kutuluuga ech kandai sebep da, chara da kalbait.

Alsyzdar zhana eerchigender: <<Attin', biz uchun duinogo bir zholu kaituu mumkun bolgondo, bashchylarybyz bizden bash tartkan syiaktuu biz dagy alardan bash tartmakpyz>> - deshet. Allakh alarga akyrette katuu azapty korsotkondoi, bashchylaryn zhalganda eerchuunun akybeti okunuchtor zhana kaigy-kapalar ekenin korsotot. Alar tozokton ech kachan chygyshpait.

Oo, adamdar! Zher betindegi zhanybarlardan, zher-zhemishterden zhana bak-daraktardan adal zholdo tabylganyn, ozu yplas emes taza bolgondorun zhegile zhana adashtyruuchu shaitandyn zholdoruna tushpogulo. Chyndygynda al silerge achyk turdo kastyk kylgan dushman. Akyl-estuu adam uchun aga zyian keltirgen zhana adashtyruuga araket kylgan dushmanyn eerchuu zhakshy emes.

Chyndygynda al silerdi zhamandyk ishterge zhana chon' kunoolorgo buiruit, oshondoi ele ishenimderde zhana shariiatta Allakhtan zhe Anyn elchilerinen kelgen ilimden kabarsyz abalda silerdi Allakhka karata zhalgan suiloogo buiruit.

Egerde al kaapyrlarga: <<Allakh tushurgon tuura zholgo zhana nurga eerchigile>> - dep aitylsa, alar karshy chygyp: <<Zhok, biz ata-babalarybyzdyn ishenimderin zhana kaada-salttaryn karmanabyz>> - deshti. Alardyn ata-babalary tuura zhol menen nurdan ech kandai tushunugu zhok bolup, Allakh yraazy bolgon akyikat zholgo tushposo da alardy eerchii berishebi?!

Ata-babalaryn eerchigen kaapyrlardyn misaly, malyna kyikyryp zhatkan koichuga okshosh, alar anyn unun ugat, birok emne degenin tushunushpoit. Alar akyikatty paida ala turgandai den'geelde uguuga kelgende duloi, any aituuga kelgende tilden kalgandai duduk zhana any koro albagan sokur. Oshol sebepten alar sen chakyryp zhatkan tuura zholdu tushunushpoit.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirgender zhana Anyn elchisine eerchigender! Allakh silerge yrysky kylyp bergen zhana adal kylgan taza nerselerden zhegile zhana Allakhtyn silerge bergen zhakshylyktaryna syrtyn'ardan da, ichin'erden da shugur keltirgile. Allakhka ibadat kyluu zhana Aga kunoo kyluudan alys boluu - Allakhka shugur keltiruugo zhatat, eger chyndap Aga gana syiynyp, Aga ech nerseni sherik kylbasan'ar.

Allakh silerge shariiat korsotkon zholdo muuzdalbai olgon maldyn etin, muuzdaganda agyp chykkan kandy, chochkonun etin, soigondo Allakhtyn aty atalbagan maldy aram kyldy. Eger adam bir nerse zhegenge argasyz bolup, andan muktazhdyksyz zhep asha chappasa zhana zarylchylyktyn cheginen ashyrbasa, al uchun ech kandai kunoo da, zhaza da bolboit. Chyndygynda Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerine Kechirimduu, alarga Yraiymduu. Bul aram nerselerdi argasyz abalda zhegendi kechiruusu da Anyn yraiymduulugunan.

Zhoottor zhana khristiandar syiaktuu Allakh tushurgon kitepterdi, andagy akyikatka dalil bolgon nerselerdi zhana Mukhammaddyn paigambarchylygyn zhashyrgandar zhana any zhaap-zhashyrgandary uchun anyn orduna arzybagan bashchylyk zhe kadyr-bark zhe bailyk syiaktuu nerselerdi baalap satyp algandar, alar akyikatta tozok menen azaptaluuga sebep bolgon nerselerdi gana zhep kursaktaryn toigozushat. Kyiamat kunu Allakh alar menen alarga zhakkandai den'geelde suiloshpoit, teskerisinche, alarga zhakpagandai den'geelde suiloshot. Al alardy tazalabait zhana maktoo da aitpait. Alar uchun kyinoochu azap bar.

Adamdar muktazh bolgon ilimdi zhaap-zhashyrgandar, alar ilimdi zhashyryp, Allakhtyn kechirimin Anyn azabyna almashtyruu menen adashuunu tuura zholgo almashtyrgandar. Alardyn tozokko kiruusuno sebep bolgon ishti zhasoogo kanchalyk chydamy zheter eken! Alar andagy azapka chydap koiobuz degendei beikapar zhurushot.

Ilimdi zhana tuura zholdu zhashyruunun zhazasy ushundai bolushunun sebebi Allakh ilakhii kitepterdi akyikat menen tushurgon. Bul bolso any zhashyrbai, achyk aituunu talap kylat. Allakhtyn kitepteri tuuraluu talashyp-tartyshyp, anyn bir boluguno ishenip, bir bolugun zhashyrgandar akyikattan alystap bolunup-zharyluuda zhana talashyp-tartyshuuda.

Allakh yraazy bolgon zhakshylyk - zhuzun'ordu zhon gana chygyshka zhe batyshka burup zhana al tuuraluu talashyp-tartyshuu emes, chynygy zhakshylyktyn baary - Allakhty zhalgyz kudai dep yiman keltirgen, kyiamat kununo, bardyk perishtelerge, tushurulgon bardyk kitepterge, bardyk paigambarlarga alardy bolup-zharbastan yiman keltirgen, mal-mulktu zhakshy korup, ozu kaalap tursa da any zhakyn tuugandaryna, balagatka zhetpei atasyn zhogotkondorgo, muktazhdarga, mekeninen zhana ui-bulosunon alysta zhurup, muktazhdyktan ulam adamdardan zhardam surashka argasyz bolgon beitaanysh zholoochularga sarptagan, mal-mulkun kuldardy kulchuluktan zhana tutkundan boshotuuga zhumshagan, namazdy Allakh buirugandai toluk den'geelde okugan, parz zeketti bergen, ortodo kelishken kelishimdi atkargan, zhakyrchylykka, kyiynchylykka zhana ooruga sabyr kylgan, sogush kuch alganda kachyp ketpegen adamdarda. Myna ushundai sypattarga ee bolgon adamdar - yimanynda zhana ish-araketterinde Allakhka chynchyl bolgondor zhana alar Allakh buirugan nerselerdi atkaryp, Anyn tyigandaryn tashtagan takybalar.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirgender zhana Anyn elchisine eerchigender! Bashkalardy ataiylap zhana dushmandyk kylyp olturgon adamdardyn maselesinde kishi olturgon adamdy kylmyshyna zharasha zhazaloo mildeti silerge zhuktoldu. Erkin adam uchun erkin adam, kul uchun kul, urgaachy uchun urgaachy olturulot. Eger olgon kishi olorunon murun kechirse, zhe olgon adamdyn tuugandary kun tolotuugo (kun - kishi olturuuchu kechirim algandygy uchun tolop beruuchu belgiluu olchomdogu aky) makul bolup kechirse, anda kechirgen tarap olturuuchunu keketpesten zhana aga zyian berbesten, zhakshylyk zholdo andan kundu talap kylsyn. Olturgon kishi da kundu kechiktirbesten zhana sozboston, zhakshylyk zholdo tolop bersin. Bul kechirim zhana kun toloo - Rabbin'erdin silerge kylgan zhen'ildigi zhana bul ummotko bolgon yraiymy. Al emi kim olturgon adamdy kechirip, kun tolotkondon kiiin aga kol salsa, anda aga Allakh taraptan kyinoochu azap bar.

Allakh silerge shariiat kylgan och aluuda siler uchun zhashoo bar, antkeni al kan toguunu zhana aran'ardagy dushmandykty toktotot. Munu Allakh taalanyn shariiatyna eerchip, Anyn buirugun atkaruu menen Andan korkkon akyl eeleri tushunushot.

Aran'ardan kimdir biroogo olumdun belgileri zhana sebepteri kelse zhana artynda kop bailyk kaltyrsa, anda ata-enesine zhana zhakyn tuugandaryna shariiat chektegendei muras mulktun uchton birinen ashpagan olchomun kereez kyluu parz kylyndy. Myndai kyluu Allakhtan korkkondor uchun anyk mildet. Bul okum muras aiattary tushkongo cheiin bolgon. Muras aiattary tushkondo muraskorlordun kimisine kancha ulush berileeri anyk aitylgan.

Kim kereezdi bilgenden kiiin any koboitup zhe azaityp zhe berbei koiuu menen ozgortso, al ozgortkondun kunoosu kereez kaltyrgan adamda emes, any ozgortkondordo bolot. Chyndygynda Allakh pendelerinin sozdorun Uguuchu, ish-araketterin Biluuchu, alardyn abalynyn ech birin otkorup zhiberbeit.

Kim kereez kaltyruuchunun akyikattan chettegenin zhe kereezde adiletsizdik kylganyn bilip kalyp, aga nasaat kyluu menen tuura emes kylganyn on'doso zhana kereezge karshy chykkandardy zharashtyrsa, aga ech kandai kunoo bolboit. Teskerisinche, al on'dogonu uchun soop alat. Chyndygynda Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerine Kechirimduu, alarga Yraiymduu.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirgender zhana Anyn elchisine eerchigender! Silerden murunku ummottorgo parz kylyngan syiaktuu silerge da orozo karmoo Rabbin'er tarabynan parz kylyndy. Balkim ozun'or menen Allakhtyn azabynyn ortosuna zhakshylyk ishterdi, alardyn ichinen en' ulugu bolgon orozonu kalkan kyluu menen Andan korkosun'ar.

Silerge parz kylyngan orozonu zhyl ichinde bir neche kun ele karmaisyn'ar. Silerden kim orozo karmaganda kyinala turgandai ooru menen oorusa zhe saparda bolso, aga oozun achuuga uruksat. Birok kiiin oozun achyp algan kundordun kazasyn karmoosu kerek. Orozo karmaganga kudureti zhetip, birok karmai albagandar fid'ia berishet. Al - orozo karmabagan ar bir kunu uchun kedeige tamak beruu. Eger orozodo kandai artykchylyktar bar ekenin bilsen'er, anda orozo karmaganyn'ar oozun'ardy achyp zhuruudon zhana fid'ia beruudon zhakshyraak. Myndai okum Allakh orozonu shariiatka kirgizgen algachky ubakta bolgon, kim kaalasa orozo karmagan, kim kaalasa oozun achyp, al uchun fid'ia bergen. Kiiin Allakh orozonu mildet kyldy zhana balagatka zhetip, kudureti zhetkenderge parz kyldy.

Ramazan aiy - kadyr tunu paigambarga Kuran tushup bashtagan ai. Allakh any adamdarga tuura zhol katary tushurdu, anda tuura zholdun zhana akyikat menen zhalgandy azhyratuunun achyk-aikyn dalilderi bar. Kimde-kim Ramazan aiyna zhetip, turuktuu zhashagan zherinde bolso zhana deni sak bolso, anda mildettuu turdo orozo tutsun. Al emi kim oorup, orozo karmoo aga kyiynchylykty zharatsa zhe saparda bolso, anda al oozun achsa bolot. Eger oozun achkan bolso, al uchun orozo karmabagan kundordun kazasyn tutuu mildet. Allakh shariiat kylgan nerseler arkyluu silerdi kyiynchylyktyn emes, zhen'ildiktin zholuna saluunu kaalait. Orozo aiynyn sanyn bashtan-aiak toluktagyla, Ramazan aiy butkondon kiiin zhana ait kunu silerge orozonu nasip kylgan zhana any toluk tutuuga zhardam bergen Allakhty uluktagyla. Balkim siler Allakh Ozu yraazy bolup bergen ushul dinge bagyttagany uchun shugur kylarsyn'ar.

Oo, paigambar! Eger pendelerim senden Menin zhakyndygym zhana alardyn dubalaryn kabyl kyluum zhonundo surashsa, Men alarga zhakynmyn, abaldaryn bilemin zhana dubalaryn ugamyn. Alar ortomchularga muktazh emes zhana undorun biiik kotoruugo da muktazhdyk zhok. Men chyn yklastan duba kylgandyn dubasyna zhoop beremin.
