Andyktan Maga zhana buiruktaryma moiun sunushsun zhana yimandaryna bekem turushsun. Chyndygynda bul Menin zhoop beruumo karai en' zhakshy zhol. Balkim alar munu menen din zhana duino ishterinde tuura zholgo tushushoor.

Orozo zhan'y parz bolgon uchurda, eger kishi tun ichinde uktap, anan tan' atkanga cheiin kaira oigonso, aga aialy menen zhakyndashuuga zhana tamak zhegenge tyiuu salyngan bolchu. Kiiin Allakh Taala bul okumdu zhokko chygardy zhana tan' atkanga cheiin myndai ishterdi atkaruunu yktyiarduu kyldy, ei, yimanduular, orozo aiynda tun ichinde aialyn'ar menen koshula bergile, alar silerge, siler alarga koshogo, tosmosun'ar, biri-birin'den paidalangyla, Allakh Taala taza-topuk uruk-urpak beruusun surangyla, tunu menen ichip-zhei bergile, kachan gana chynygy tan' bashtalyp zherge zharyk kire bashtaganda toktotkula. Anan kechinde kun batkancha orozo karmagyla. Mechitte etikafta otursan'ar aialyn'ar menen koshulbagyla, bul etikafty buzat. Bul okumdor Allakh Taalanyn aram menen adaldyn ortosuna koigon chegi aga zhakyndabagyla. Kim Allakhtyn chegine zhakyndasa, aramga kirip ketuu korkunuchu bar, Allakh Taala aiattaryn adamdar Anyn buirugun atkaryp, tyiuusunan tyiylyp saktanuu uchun achyk-aikyn baian kylat

Biri-birin'erdin mal-mulkun'ordu uuruluk, tartyp aluu zhana aldamchylyk syiaktuu shariiatka karshy kelgen zholdo albagyla. Zhana adamdardyn mal-mulkunun bir bolugun aluu uchun kunoogo aralashyp, anyn aiynan sottordun aldynda talashyp-tartyshpagyla. Allakh munu aram kylganyn bilesin'er. Kunoonun aram ekenin bilip turup any kyluu oto zhiiirkenichtuu zhana zhazasy kataal.

Oo, paigambar! Alar senden ailardyn zhan'yruusu zhana alardyn abaldarynyn ozgoruusu tuuraluu surashat. Alarga zhoop katary munun daanyshman syryn ait: <<Alar adamdar uchun belgilengen ubakyttar. Alar arkyluu azhylyk ailary, orozo aiy, zekette bir zhyldyn toluk butushu syiaktuu ibadattardyn ubaktylaryn bilishet, oshondoi ele kundardy zhana karyzdardy toloo moonottorun belgiloo syiaktuu oz ara mamilelerdegi ubakyttardy bilishet>>. Siler Islamga cheiinki dinsiz doordo oilogonun'ardai azhylyk zhe umra uchun ikhram kiigende uidun art zhagynan kirgenin'er zhakshylyk ish emes. Birok chynygy zhakshylyk - ichinen da, syrtynan da Allakhtan korkkon adamdyn zhakshylygy. Al emi uilorgo eshiginen kirgenin'er siler uchun en' zhen'ili zhana mashakat zharatpagany. Antkeni Allakh silerge oorchuluk zhana mashakat zharatkan nerselerdi zhuktogon emes. Ozun'or menen Allakhtyn azabynyn ortosuna zhakshylyk ishterdi korgonuch kylgyla. Balkim kaalagan nersen'erge zhetip, korkkon nersen'erden kutuluu menen iigilikke zheteersin'er.

Silerdi Allakhtyn dininen kaitaruu uchun silerge karshy sogushkan kaapyrlar menen Allakhtyn sozu biiik boluusu uchun sogushkula. Zhash baldardy, aialdardy zhana kary-kartan'dardy olturup zhe oluktordun denesin keskilep zhana ushul syiaktuu nerselerdi kyluu menen Allakhtyn chekterinen chykpagyla. Chyndygynda Allakh shariiatynda zhana okumdorundo Anyn chekterinen chykkandardy zhakshy korboit.

Alardy zholukkan zherde olturgulo zhana silerdi kuup chykkan Mekkeden alardy da kuup chykkyla. Yimanduu adamdy dininen tosup, kaapyrlykka kaitaruudan chykkan bulgunchuluk - olturuudon da chon'. Alar ozdoru Al'-Kharam mechitinde sogush bashtamaiyncha, siler anyn urmaty uchun al zherde sogush bashtabagyla. Eger alar Al'-Kharam mechitinde sogush bashtasa, anda alardy olturgulo. Al'-Kharam mechitinde kol salgandygy uchun alardy olturuu syiaktuu ushundai zhaza - kaapyrlardyn zhazasy bolot.

Egerde alar sogushkanyn zhana kaapyrlyktaryn toktotushsa, anda siler da alarga tiibegile. Chyndygynda Allakh toobo kylgandarga kechirimduu, alardy murdagy kunooloru uchun zhazalabait zhana alarga yraiymduu, alardy zhazaloogo shashylbait.

Kaapyrlardyn arasynda shirk kyluu, adamdardy Allakhtyn zholunan tosuu, kaapyrlyk kyluu zhok bolup zhana ustomduk kylgan din - Allakhtyn dini bolmoiuncha alar menen sogushkula. Eger alar kaapyrlyktarynan kaityp, Allakhtyn zholunan tosposo, anda alar menen sogushuunu toktotkula. Antkeni kaapyrlyk kylgan zhana Allakhtyn zholunan toskon zaalymdardan bashkalarga dushmandyk kylynbait.

Allakh silerge zhetinchi zhyly Al'-Kharamga kiruugo zhana umrany atkaruuga mumkunchuluk bergen yiyk ai - al altynchy zhyly mushrikter silerdi Al'-Kharamga kirgizbei koigon yiyk aidyn orduna berildi. Yiyk shaardyn, yiyk ailardyn zhana ikhramga kiruunun yiyktygy syiaktuu yiyk nerselerde dushmandyk kylgandardan och alynat. Bul nerselerde kim silerge dushmandyk kylsa, alarga kylgandaryna zharasha mamile kylgyla, andan ashyryp chekten chykpagyla. Chyndygynda Allakh Anyn cheginen chykkandardy zhakshy korboit. Allakh uruksat bergen nersede chekten chyguuga kelgende Andan korkkula. Bilgile, Allakh Oz koldoosu zhana iigiligi menen takybalar tarapta.

Allakhka bash iiuu uchun Anyn zholundagy sogushka zhana bashka nerselerge mal-mulk sarptagyla. Allakh zholunda sogushuunu zhana aga mal-mulk sarptoonu tashtoo menen zhe olumgo sebep bolo turgan nerselerge ozun'ordu duushar kyluu menen ozun'ordu ozun'or kyiroogo turtpogulo. Ibadatyn'ardy, mamilen'erdi zhana adep-akhlagyn'ardy zhakshyrtkyla. Chyndygynda Allakh bardyk ishterinde zhakshylyk kyluuchulardy zhakshy korot, alardyn soobun koboitot zhana alarga tuura zholgo tushuugo iigilik beret.

Azhylyk zhana umrany Allakh taalanyn Zhuzun kozdop toluk atkargyla. Eger ooru zhe dushman zholtoo bolup toluk atkara albai kalsan'ar, anda ikhramdan chyguun'ar uchun toodon zhe uidan zhe koidon kolun'ardan kelgenin kurmandykka chalgyla. Kurmandyk maldy soiuuga uruksat bolgon zhaiga zhetkenge cheiin chachyn'ardy kyrbagyla zhana kyskartpagyla. Egerde alardy Al'-Kharamga alyp kiruugo tyiuu salynsa, anda oshol tyiylgan zherinde kurmandykka chalsyn. Egerde Al'-Kharamga alyp kiruugo tyiuu bolboso, anda Kurman ait kunu zhe andan kiiinki tashrik kundoru Al'-Kharamdyn ichinde soisun. Silerdin aran'ardan kim ooruluu bolso zhe bashy bittep zh.b.u.s. nerseler menen chachynyn azabyn tartsa zhana ushundan ulam chachyn kyryp salsa, aga ech kandai kunoo bolboit. Al uchun myndan kutuuluu akysy - uch kun orozo karmait, zhe Al'-Kharamdagy kembagaldardan altoosun toiguzat, zhe bir koi soiup Al'-Kharamdagy kedeilerge tarkatyp beret. Egerde siler uchun korkunuch bolboso, aran'ardan kim azhylyk ailarynda umra kyluunu kaalasa zhana oshol zhyly azhylyk uchun ikhramga kirgenge cheiin ikhram uchurundagy tyiylgan nerselerdi paidalansa, anda al kolunan kelishinche bir koi zhe zheti adam birigip bir too zhe bir ui soisun. Egerde kurmandyk chaluuga kudureti zhetpese, anyn orduna azhylyk kundorunun uch kunundo orozo karmait zhana ui-bulosuno kaitkan kezde zheti kun orozo karmait, oshondo baary birigip on kun bolot. Mildettuu turdo kurmandyk chaluu menen birgelikte bul paidalanuu (tamattu azhylygyn atkaruu) zhe kurmandyk chaluuga kudureti zhetpegenderdin orozo tutuusu Al'-Kharamdyn eli menen aga zhakyn zhashagandardan bashkalarga tiiishtuu. Antkeni alarga tamattu azhylygyn kyluu zaryl emes. Alar Al'-Kharamda bolgonduktan azhylykka cheiin umradan paidalanyp zhalpy ele tavaf kylgany zhetishtuu bolot. Allakhtyn shariiatyn eerchip, chekterin uluktoo menen Andan korkkula. Bilgile, Allakhtyn buiruguna karshy chykkandarga Anyn zhazasy kataal.

Azhylyk ubagy belgiluu ailar, Shavval aiynan bashtalyp, Zulkhizhzha aiynyn onunchu kunu butot. Kim ushul ailarda azhylyk kyluunu ozuno mildet kylsa zhana ikhramga kirse, al uchun zhynystyk mamile zhana aga alyp bara turgan ishterdi kyluu aram bolot. Ubakyttyn zhana zherdin uluktugunan ulam kunoo kylyp Allakhka bash iibei ketuunun aramdygy anyn akysynda kuchtuurook bolot. Oshondoi ele achuulanuuga zhana dushmandykka alyp baruuchu talash-tartyshtar da al uchun aram. Kandai zhakshylyk kylsan'ar da, Allakh any bilet zhana anyn syilygyn beret. Azhylyk kyluuga zhardam suroo menen ozun'orgo kerektuu tamak-ash zhana suusunduktardy algyla. Bilgile, bardyk ishin'erde zhardam katary koldono turgandardyn en' zhakshysy - Allakh taalaga takybalyk kyluu. Oo, tunuk akyl eeleri! Buiruktarymdy atkaryp, tyigandarymdy tashtoo menen Menden korkkula.

Azhylyk maalynda sooda zhana bashka nerseler menen adal yrysky izdoo kunoo emes. Toguzunchu kunu Arafatta turganyn'ardan kiiin Zulkhizhzhanyn onunchu tunu Muzdalifany kozdoi zhonogonun'ordo, al zherdegi Al'-Mashar al'-Kharamda Allakhty aruuloo, kelme aituu, duba kyluu menen zikir kylgyla. Allakh silerdi dinii belgilerine zhana Anyn uiuno azhylyk kyluu zhorolgoloruno bagyttash uchun Any zikir kylgyla. Antkeni siler buga cheiin Anyn shariiatynan beikapar elen'er.

Andan son' siler Islamga cheiinki doordun adamdary Arafatta turbastan ele ketip kalyshkandai emes, Ibrakhimdi eerchigen adamdar kylgandai Arafattan tushkulo zhana Allakhtyn shariiatyn atkaruudagy ketirgen kemchilikterin'er uchun Andan kechirim suragyla. Chyndygynda Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerine Kechirimduu, alarga Yraiymduu.

Azhylyk ibadattaryn buturup, andan boshoson'or, Allakhty zikir kylgyla zhana ata-babalaryn'ar menen syimyktanyp, alardy maktagan syiaktuu Allakhty da kop maktagyla zhe Allakhty ata-babalaryn'ardy estegenden da koburook estegile. Antkeni siler paidalanyp zhatkan ar bir zhakshylyk Allakhtan. Adamdar ar turduu, alardyn arasynda bul duinogo gana ishengen mushrik kaapyrlar bar, alar Rabbisinen duino zhyrgalchylyktary zhana koozduktary bolgon den-sooluk, bailyk zhana bala-chaka gana surashat. Alar duinonu suiup, akyretten zhuz burgandyktan, Allakh Ozunun yimanduu pendeleri uchun daiardap koigon nerselerden nasipke ee bolushpait.

Adamdardyn dagy bir tobu Allakhka yiman keltirip, akyretke ishenishet. Alar Rabbisinen beiishke zhetkiruunu zhana tozok azabynan kutkaruunu surashkan syiaktuu bul duino zhyrgalchylygyn zhana andagy zhakshylyk ishterdi surashat.
Duino zhana akyret zhakshylyktaryn surap duba kylgandar bul duinodo zhasagan zhakshylyk ishteri uchun uluu syilyktarga ee bolushat. Allakh ish-araketterdin esebin tez aluuchu.

Sanaluu kundor bolgon Zulkhizhzhanyn 11-12-13-kundorundo Allakhty uluktoo zhana kelme sozdorun aituu menen estegile. Kim shashylysh turdo 12-kunu tash atkandan kiiin Minadan chygyp ketse, bul aga uruksat zhana al kunookor emes. Antkeni Allakh aga zhen'ildik kylgan. Al emi kim tash atuu uchun 13-kungo cheiin kalyp ketse, bul aga uruksat zhana al kunookor emes. Antkeni al en' toluk den'geelde atkardy zhana paigambardyn zholun zholdodu. Munun baary azhylyk uchurunda Allakhtan korkkon zhana Al buirugandai den'geelde atkargandar uchun. Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiuularyn tashtoo menen Andan korkkula zhana akyry Aga gana kaityp baraaryn'ardy anyk bilgile. Oshondo Al ish-araketterin'erdin syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Oo, paigambar! Adamdardyn arasynda suilogon sozdoru menen seni tan' kaltyrgan eki zhuzduu bar. Sen anyn kooz suilogonun korup, any chyn suilop, tuura nasaat berip zhatat dep oiloisun'. Birok anyn maksaty - oz zhanyn zhana mal-mulkun gana saktap kaluu. Allakh anyn zhurogundogu yiman menen zhakshylyktyn zhalgan ekenine kuboluk beret. Al musulmandarga katuu dushmandyk zhana kastyk kylat.

Al senden burulup, alystap ketkende, zher betin kunoolor arkyluu buzuu, eginderdi zhok kyluu zhana maldardy kyruu uchun bolushuncha araket kylat. Allakh zher betindegi buzukuluktu zhana any kylgandardy da zhakshy korboit.

Al emi oshol buzukuga nasaat iretinde: <<Allakhtyn chekterin syilap zhana tyigandaryn tashtap Andan kork>> - dep aitylsa, anyn tekeberligi zhana menmensinuusu any akyikatka kaituudan tostu zhana al kunoosun ulanta berdi. Emi anyn zhazasy tozokko kiruu uchun zhetishtuu. Al andagy adamdar uchun kandai zhaman turak-zhai!

Adamdardyn arasynda oz zhanyn satyp, any Rabbisine moiun sunuuga, Anyn zholunda sogushuuga zhana Anyn yraazylygyn tabuuga arnagan yimanduusu da bar. Allakh pendelerine cheksiz yraiymduu zhana alarga booruker.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirgender zhana Anyn elchisine eerchigender! Islamga tolugu menen kirgile zhana kitep eeleri kiteptin bir boluguno ishenip, bir boluguno kaapyr bolgonu syiaktuu, anyn ech bir nersesin tashtabagyla. Oshondoi ele shaitandyn zholdorun zholdobogula. Antkeni al silerge dushmandygyn achyk korsotkon anyk dushman.

Eger silerge ech kandai shek-kumonu zhok achyk-aikyn dalilder kelgenden kiiin katachylyk ketirip, chettep ketsen'er, anda bilgile, Allakh kudurettuulugundo zhana ustomduulugundo Kaarduu, bashkaruusunda zhana shariiatynda Daanyshman. Andyktan Andan korkkula zhana Any uluktagyla.

Shaitandyn zholdorun zholdop, akyikat zholdon taigandar kyiamat kunu Allakh Ozunun uluktuguna ylaiyktuu abalda alardyn ortosunda okum chygaruu uchun buluttardyn kolokosundo kelerin zhana perishteler da alardy tush taraptan tegerektep kelisheerin gana kutup zhatyshaby? Oshondo alarga Allakhtyn buirugu menen okum kylynat, al zhyiyntyktalat zhana bardyk makuluktardyn ishteri zhalgyz Aga kaitarylat.

Oo, paigambar! Israil urpaktarynan zheme katary sura: <<Allakh silerge Ozunun elchilerinin chynchyldygyna dalil bolgon kanchalagan aiat-belgilerdi baiandagan ele? Siler bolso alardy zhalganga chygaryp, bash tarttyn'ar>>. Kimde-kim Allakhtyn zhakshylygyn bilip, al achykka chykkandan kiiin any kaapyrlykka zhana zhalganga almashtyrsa, Allakhtyn zhalganchy kaapyrlarga zhazasy kataal.

Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandarga bul duino zhashoosu zhana andagy ubaktyluu yrakhattar menen zhyrgalchylyktar kooz korsotuldu. Alar Allakhka zhana akyret kununo yiman keltirgenderdi shyldyn'dashat. Al emi Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkondor akyrette al kaapyrlardan zhogoru bolushat. Antkeni Allakh alardy Adn beiishterine zhaigashtyrat. Allakh Ozu zharatkandardyn kaalagandaryna esepsiz zhana sanaksyz beret.

Adamdar tupku atasy Adamdyn dinine ylaiyk tuura zholdogu birdiktuu ummot bolgon. Akyry shaitan alardy adashtyryp, alardyn ortosunda yimanduu zhana kaapyr bolup pikir kelishpestik zharaldy. Myna ushul sebepten Allakh yimanduu zhana moiun sungan adamdarga Oz yraiymy menen daiardap koigon nerselerdi suiunchulosh uchun zhana kaapyrlarga ubada kylgan kataal azapty eskertish uchun elchilerdi zhiberdi. Zhana adamdar oz ara talashyp-tartyshkan nerselerde okum chygaruulary uchun Ozunun elchileri menen birge ech kandai shek-kumonu zhok akyikatty kamtygan kitepterdi tushurdu. Toorattyn ilimi berilgen zhoottor gana al Allakh taraptan tushkon akyikat ekendigine Anyn dalilderi kelgenden kiiin dagy zulumduktan ulam al tuuraluu talashyp-tartyshuunu toktotushpady. Allakh Ozunun uruksaty zhana kaaloosu menen yimanduularga tuura zholdu adashuudan aiyrmalap biluugo iigilik berdi. Allakh kimdi kaalasa, ech kandai burmalanuusu zhok tuura zholgo salat. Al - yiman zholu.

Oo, yimanduular! Zhe siler murunkulardyn synoolorundai synoolorgo kabylbastan ele beiishke kirebiz dep oiloisun'arby? Antkeni alar zhakyrchylykty zhana oorulardy bashtarynan kechirishken, alardy korkunuchtar titiretken, akyr aiagy alardy synoolor Allakhtyn zhardamyn shashtyruuga cheiin zhetkirip, elchi zhana any menen birge bolgon yimanduular: <<Allakhtyn zhardamy kachan kelet?>> - dep kalyshkan. Albette Allakhtyn zhardamy Aga yiman keltirip, tobokel kylgandarga zhakyn!

Oo, paigambar! Sakhabalaryn' senden turduu mal-mulktorun kaisy zholgo sarptap, kaida zhumshoo kerektigi tuuraluu surashat. Alarga zhoop katary ait: <<Adal zhana taza nerselerdi kairymduulukka zhumshasan'ar, anda ata-enen'erge, muktazhdygyna zharasha zhakyn tuugandaryn'arga, muktazh zhetimderge, bailygy zhok kedei-kembagaldarga, ui-bulosunon zhana mekeninen alysta zhurgon zholoochularga sarptagyla>>. Oo, yimanduular! Kandai gana zhakshylyk kylbagyla, meili az bolsun, meili kop bolsun, Allakh any Biluuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda silerge anyn syilygyn beret.

Oo, yimanduular! Allakh zholunda sogushuu tabiiatynan adamga zhagymsyz bolso da, al silerge parz kylyndy. Antkeni mynda mal-mulktu zhana zhandy kurman kyluu bar. Balkim siler Allakh zholunda sogushuu syiaktuu kee bir nerselerdi zhaman korushun'or mumkun, chynynda al siler uchun zhakshy zhana paidaluu chygar. Antkeni al ozuno uluu sooptor menen birge dushmandyn ustunon zhen'ishke zhetuunu zhana Allakhtyn sozun biiik kotoruunu kamtygan. Balkim siler Allakh zholundagy sogushka barbai koiuu syiaktuu kee bir nerselerdi zhakshy korushun'or mumkun, chynynda al siler uchun zhamandyk zhana balee chygar. Antkeni mynda zhen'iluu zhana dushmanga bash iiuu bar. Allakh ishterdin zhakshy-zhamanyn toluk bilet, a siler any bilbeisin'er. Andyktan Anyn buiruguna zhoop bergile. Antkeni anda siler uchun zhakshylyktar bar.

Oo, paigambar! Adamdar senden yiyk dep eseptelgen Zulkaada, Zulkhizhzha, Mukharram zhana Razhab ailarynda sogushuunun okumu zhonundo surashat. Alarga zhoop kylyp ait: <<Bul ailarda sogushuu - Allakhtyn aldynda chon' kunoo zhana kabyl alyngys. Oshol syiaktuu mushrikterdin Allakhtyn zholunan tosuu uchun kylgandary da oto zhaman ish. Yimanduulardy Al'-Kharam mechitinen tyiuu zhana adamdardy andan kuup chyguu Allakhtyn aldynda yiyk ailarda sogushuudan da chon'uraak. Al emi alardyn shirk kylgany olturuudon da chon'uraak. Oo, yimanduular! Mushrikter silerdi akyikat dinin'erden ozdorunun zhalgan dinine kaitaruunun zholun tabyshmaiyncha, siler menen zulumdukta sogushuunu ulanta berishet. Silerdin aran'ardan kim dininen kaityp, Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgan abalda olso, anyn zhakshylyk ishteri zhokko chygarylat zhana akyretke barganda tozokko kirip, anda tuboluk kalat>>.

Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirgender, Allakh zhana Anyn elchisi uchun oz mekenin tashtap kochkondor zhana Allakhtyn sozu biiik bolsun dep sogushkandar, myna osholor Allakhtyn yraiymyn zhana kechirimin koksogondor. Allakh pendelerinin kunoolorun Kechiruuchu, alarga Yraiymduu.

Oo, paigambar! Sakhabalaryn' senden adamdyn akylyn ketirgen mas kyluuchu ichimdikter tuuraluu zhana any ichuunun, satuunun zhana satyp aluunun okumu tuuraluu surashat. Oshondoi ele kumar oiununun okumu tuuraluu surashat (kumar oiundary - meldeshterdi otkoruu zholu arkyluu aga katyshkan eki taraptan baige katary alyngan akchalai karazhat). Alarga zhoop kylyp ait: <<Bul ekoosundo akyldy zhana mal-mulktu zhogotuu, dushmandykka zhana zhek koruuchulukko baruu syiaktuu adamdar uchun dinii zhana duinoluk zhaktan zyiandar bar. Oshondoi ele al ekoosundo akcha karazhat tabuu syiaktuu azyraak paidalary bar. Birok bulardyn zyiany zhana kunoosu paidasynan koburook. Kaisy bir nersenin zyianduulugu paidasynan kop bolso, akyly bar adam andan kachat. Allakhtyn bul tushundurmosundo mas kyluuchu ichimdikterdi aramga chygaruuga daiardoo maanisi kamtylgan. Oo, paigambar! Sakhabalaryn' senden mal-mulktorunon yktyiarduu zhana kairymduuluk turdo kancha bolugun sarptoo kerektigi tuuraluu da surashat. Alarga zhoop katary: <<Ozun'ordun muktazhdygyn'ardyn artkan mal-mulkun'ordu bergile>> - dep ait. (Bashtapky uchurda ushundai bolgon, kiiin Allakh belgiluu bir mal-mulktordon zhana belgilengen olchomdordo parz zeket beruunu shariiatka kirgizgen). Ushundai achyk-aikyn baiandoo menen Allakh silerge shariiat okumdorun tushurdurot. Balkim oi zhugurtoorsun'or.

Bul duinodo zhana akyrette silerge emne paidaluu ekenine oi zhugurtuun'or uchun ushular shariiat kylyndy. Oo, paigambar! Sakhabalaryn' senden zhetimderdi kepildikke aluu, alar menen bolgon mamilede kandai ish zhurguzuu kerektigin zhana alardy karzhyloodo, tamak-ashy zhana turak-zhaiy birge bolgondo alardyn mal-mulkun aralashtyrsa bolobu dep surashat. Alarga zhoop kylyp ait: <<Alardyn mal-mulkunon tolom aky albastan zhe aralashtyrbastan any zhongo saluu menen zhakshylyk kylganyn'ar -- siler uchun Allakhtyn aldynda zhakshyraak zhana soobu koburook. Bul alardyn mal-mulku uchun zhakshy, antkeni munu menen mal-mulktoru saktalat. Egerde siler turmush-tirichilikte, turak-zhaida zhana bashka nerselerde alardyn mal-mulkun ozun'ordukuno koshup sheriktesh bolson'or, munun ech kandai zhamandygy zhok. Antkeni alar dindesh bir tuuganyn'ar, al emi bir tuugandar biri-birine zhardam berishet zhana biri-birinin ishterine komoktoshot. Allakh zhetimderdin mal-mulkuno sheriktesh bolgon kamkorchulardyn kimisi zhamandykty, kimisi zhakshylykty kozdogonun zhakshy bilet. Egerde zhetimder maselesinde silerge kyiynchylyk zharatuunu kaalasa, anda kyiynchylyk zharatmak. Birok Al siler uchun alar menen bolgon mamileni zhen'ildetip koidu. Antkeni Anyn shariiaty zhen'ildikke negizdelgen. Chyndygynda Allakh ech bir nersege zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu, Oz zharatuusunda, bashkaruusunda zhana shariiatynda Daanyshman.

Oo, yimanduular! Allakhka shirk kylgan mushrik aialdar zhalgyz Allakhka yiman keltirip, Islam dinine kirmeiinche alarga uilonbogulo. Chyndygynda aikelderge syiyngan erkin aial suluulugu zhana bailygy menen silerge zhagyp tursa da, aga karaganda Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirgen kun aial zhakshyraak. Oshondoi ele musulman aialdardy mushrik erkekterge turmushka berbegile. Chyndygynda erkin mushrik silerge zhagyp tursa da, aga karaganda Allakhka yiman keltirgen kul zhakshyraak. Shirk menen sypattalgan erkekter zhana aialdar sozdoru zhana ish-araketteri menen tozokko alyp baruuchu nerselerge chakyryshat, al emi Allakh Ozunun uruksaty zhana zhakshylygy menen beiishke kiruugo zhana kunoolordun kechirilishine sebep bolgon zhakshylyk ishterge chakyrat zhana Ozunun aiat-belgilerin achyk baiandait. Balkim alar korsotkon nerselerden sabak alyp, alardy ish zhuzundo atkaryshat.

Oo, paigambar! Sakhabalaryn' senden etek kir (belgiluu bir ubakyttarda aialdyn zhatynynan chykkan kan) tuuraluu surashat? Alarga zhoop kylyp ait: <<Etek kir erkekke da, aialga da zyianduu. Oshonduktan al uchurda aialdar menen zhynystyk mamile kyluudan saktangyla zhana alardyn kany toktop, andan zhuunup tazalanmaiyncha alarga koshuluu maksatta zhakyndabagyla. Egerde etek kiri butup, andan tazalangan bolso, anda alar menen silerge uruksat berilgen zholdo adatta koshuluuchu zhagynan koshula bergile. Chyndygynda Allakh kunooloruno kop toobo kylgandardy zhana yplas nerselerden tazalangan adamdardy zhakshy korot>>.

Zher tushum bergen syiaktuu aialdaryn'ar da silerge bala-chaka torop bergen eginzaryn'ar. Al eginzarga (zhynys muchosuno) kaalagan taraptan, kaalagandai abalda aldy zhagyna gana koshulgula. Ozun'or uchun zhakshylyk ishterdi kamdagyla. Alardyn biri - erkek kishi aialy menen koshulganda Allakhka zhakyndoonu kozdoosu zhana taza urpakty umut kyluusu. Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiuularyn tashtap Andan korkkula. Munun ichinde Allakh silerge shariiat kylgan aialdardyn maseleleri da kamtylgan. Bilgile, kyiamat kunu Aga zholugasyn'ar, Anyn aldynda turasyn'ar, Al ish-araketterin'erdin syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret. Oo, paigambar! Yimanduular Rabbisine zholukkanda zhana Anyn asyl Zhuzun korgon kezde alardy kubanychka bologon tuboluk zhyrgalchylykty alarga suiunchulo.

Allakhtyn aty menen berilgen antty zhakshylyk kyluudan, takybalyktan zhana adamdardy zharashtyruudan tosuuchu dalil kylyp albagyla. Teskerisinche, eger zhakshylyk kylbaim dep ant bersen'er, anda zhakshylykty kylgyla zhana buzgan antyn'ardyn zhazasyn (kaffaratyn) otogulo. Allakh silerdin sozdorun'ordu ugat, ish-araketterin'erdi bilet zhana zhakynda anyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Aran'ardan kimdir biroo ech nerseni maksat kylbastan: <<Zhok, Allakhka kasam. Ooba, Allakhka kasam>> - dep aitkany syiaktuu konumush sozgo ailanyp kalgan anttar sebeptuu Allakh silerdi zhoopko tartpait zhana al uchun (kaffarat) zhazasyn otoboisun'or zhana zhazalanbaisyn'ar. Birok Al oshol anttardyn artynda kozdogon maksatyn'arga zharasha zhoopko tartat. Allakh pendelerinin kunoolorun Kechiruuchu, alardy zhazaloogo shashylbagan Toktoo.

Aialdary menen zhynystyk mamile kylbaim dep ant bergender, oshol ant bergen kundon bashtap tort aidan ashpagan moonot kutushot. Bul ant beruu (iila) dep atalat. Eger aialdary menen zhynystyk mamile kylbaibyz dep ant bergenden kiiin tort ai zhe andan az ubakyt ichinde kaira aialdary menen koshulup alsa, anda Allakh alardyn bul kylganyn kechiret zhana yraiym kylat. Antkeni bul ant kutuluu zhazasyn otoonu shariiatka kirgizdi.

Eger aialdary menen andan ary da zhynystyk mamile kylbastan zhana aga kaitpastan, talak beruunu niet kylyshsa, anda Allakh alardyn sozdorun, anyn ichinde talak sozun da Uguuchu, alardyn abaldaryn zhana maksattaryn Biluuchu. Zhakynda alarga anyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Azhyrashkan aialdar uch etek kir moonotundo kutushot, al arada bashkaga turmushka chygyshpait. Eger Allakhka zhana akyret kununo chyndap yiman keltirishken bolso, anda Allakh alardyn zhatynynda zharatkan nerseni zhashyrboosu kerek. Al emi alarga talak bergen kuiooloru kaira zharashuununun artynan yntymakty zhana talaktyn aiynan zharalgan nerselerdi zhok kyluunu kozdoso, anda kutuu (idda) moonotundo alar menen kaira zharashuuga toluk ukuktuu. Adamdardyn arasynda belgiluu bolgondoi aialdardyn da kuiooloru syiaktuu ukuktary zhana mildetteri bar. Al emi bashkaruu zhana talak maselesi zhaktan alganda erkekterdin darazhasy aialdardykynan zhogoru. Allakh ech nerse nersege zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu, shariiatynda zhana bashkaruusunda Daanyshman.

Kuioosu kaira zharashuuga eelik kylgan talak eki zholu gana bolot, bashkacha aitkanda bir zholu talak beret, kiiin kaira zharashat, bolboso dagy talak beret, kiiin kaira zharashat, myna oshol eki talaktan kiiin, zhe any oz kamkorduguna alyp yntymakta zhashait, zhe anyn aldyndagy mildetterin atkaryp, aga zhakshylyk kyluu menen uchunchu talagyn beret. Ei, kuioolor! Aialyn'arga tolop bergen kalyn'dan ech bir nerseni alganga bolboit. Birok aialy kuioosun syrtky kelbeti zhe munozu sebeptuu zhaktyrbasa zhana munun aiynan zhubailar biri-birine bolgon mildetterin atkara albaibyz dep oiloshso, anda bul ishti alar menen tuugandyk bailanyshy bar adamdarga zhe bashkalarga bildirishsin. Eger zhakyndary da alar biri-birine karata zhubailyk mildetterin atkara albait dep korkushsa, anda aial azhyrashuu uchun kuioosuno mal-mulk toloo arkyluu andan bashyn boshotup aluusunda ech kandai kunoo zhok. Bul shariiat okumdoru adal menen aramdy azhyratuuchu, andyktan alardyn cheginen chykpagyla. Kim adal menen aramdyn ortosundagy Allakhtyn chekterinen chyksa, myna osholor ozdorun kyiroogo uchuratkan zhana Allakhtyn kaary menen zhazasyna tush kylgan zaalymdar.

Egerde kuioosu aga uchunchu zholu talak berse, anda al aial zhalgan nikeni (takhlil) kozdoboston, oz kaaloosu menen tuura zholdo bashka erkekke turmushka chykmaiyncha zhana oshol nikede zhynystyk mamile kylmaiyncha, any menen zhan'ydan nikeleshuugo bolboit. Eger ekinchi kuioosu aga talak berse zhe kaza bolso, kiiin al birinchi kuioosu menen alardan talap kylyngan shariiat okumdorun atkarabyz degen oido zhan'ydan nike kyidyryp, kalyn' tolop murunku abalga kaityshsa, anda alar uchun kunoo bolboit. Bul shariiat okumdoru Allakh tarabynan Anyn okumdorun zhana chekterin bilgen adamdarga baiandalgan. Antkeni osholor gana andan paida alyshat.

Egerde aialyn'arga talak berip, alardyn kutuu (idda) moonotunun butushuno az kalsa, anda kutuu moonotu butkongo cheiin alardy zhakshylyk menen alyp kalgyla zhe koio bergile. Alardy Islamga cheiinki karan'gy doordo kylyngandai zyian beruu zhe zombuluk korsotuu maksatynda alyp kalbagyla. Kim alarga zyian keltiruu maksatynda ushundai kylsa, anda al ozun kunoogo zhana zhazaga duushar kyluu menen ozuno-ozu zulum kylgan bolot. Allakhtyn aiattaryn oiun tutuu zhana aga asyluu menen shyldyn' orduna koiup albagyla. Allakhtyn silerge kylgan zhakshylyktaryn estegile, alardyn en' ulugu - silerge tushurulgon Kuran zhana sunnot. Al munu silerdi shyktandyruu zhana sestendiruu uchun eskertet. Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiuularyn tashtoo menen Andan korkkula. Bilgile, Allakh baaryn Biluuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda silerge anyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Eger aialdaryn'arga uch zholudan az talak bersen'er zhana alardyn kutuu moonotu butso, anda oo kamkorchular (valiiler), eger alar zhan'ydan nikeleshuu arkyluu kuiooloruno kaituunu kaalashsa zhana alar menen oshogo yraazy bolushsa, andai uchurda alarga toskool bolbogula. Alarga toskool boluudan tyigan bul okum - silerdin aran'ardan Allakhka zhana akyret kununo yiman keltirgenderge eskertuu katary aitylat. Myna ushul nerse orton'ordo zhakshylykty koburook zhaiyltat, oshondoi ele abiiirin'erdi zhana ish-araketterin'erdi yplas nerselerden tazartat. Allakh ar bir ishtin akyikatyn zhana akybetin bilet, a siler munu bilbeisin'er.

Eneler baldaryn eki zhyl toluk emizishet. Bul eki zhylga chektoo - emizuu moonotun toluk kyluunu kaalagandar uchun. Bala emizuuchu azhyrashkan eneni shariiatka karshy kelbegen, el ichinde kalyptangan saltka ylaiyk karzhyloo zhana any kiiim-keche menen kamsyzdoo balanyn atasynyn mildeti. Allakh ech bir zhanga anyn mumkunchulugunon zhana kuduretinen ashykchany zhuktoboit. Ata-ene balasyn biri-birine zyian keltiruu maksatta kural katary koldonboosu kerek. Eger balanyn atasy zhok bolso zhana anyn mal-mulku da bolboso, anda anyn muraskoruna ataga tiesheluu mildetter zhuktolot. Egerde bala eki zhashka tolgongo cheiin ata-enesi oz ara ken'eship zhana balanyn kyzykchylygyna karap makuldashkandan kiiin any emchekten chygaruunu kaalashsa, bul alar uchun kunoo emes. A eger balan'arga enesinen bashka emizuuchu aialdy zhaldagyn'ar kelse zhana emizuuchu aial menen makuldashkan akysyn kemitpesten zhe kechiktirbesten zhakshylyk menen tolop tursan'ar, silerge kunoo bolboit. Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, Anyn tyiuularyn tashtoo menen Andan korkkula zhana bilgile, Allakh silerdin emne kylyp zhatkanyn'ardy korup turat. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda Al kylgan ish-araketterin'erdin syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Silerden kimdir biroo olup, artynda boiunda zhok aialdar kalsa, anda alar tort ai on kun kutuu (idda) moonotundo bolushat. Bul uchurda alar uchun kuioosunun uiunon chyguu, zhasanuu zhana turmushka chyguu tyiuu salynat. Al emi bul moonot butkondon kiiin alarga oshol mezgilde zhasoogo tyiuu salyngan ishterdi shariiatta zhana urp-adatta belgiluu bolgon zholdo kylysha turgan bolso, anda alardyn kamkorchularyna (valiilerine) kunoo bolboit. Allakh silerdin emne kylyp zhatkanyn'ardy Biluuchu. Silerdin syrtky zhana ichki korunushun'ordon ech bir nerse Aga zhashyruun emes. Kiiin silerge anyn zhazasyn zhe syilygyn beret.

Siler kuioosu olup zhe toluk talak tushup kutuu (idda) moonotundogu aialdarga zhuuchu tushuruu tuuraluu nietin'erdi achyk bildirbesten, misaly: <<Kutuu moonotun' butso, maga aityp koi>> - dep oz kaaloon'ordu kyiytyp aituun'arda ech kandai kunoo zhok. Oshondoi ele kutuu moonotu butkon aialdarga uilonuu tuuraluu kaaloon'ordu ichin'erge zhashyryp koison'or da kunoo emes. Allakh silerdin alarga bolgon kaaloon'ordun kuchtuulugunon ulam alardy esteerin'erdi bildi, oshol sebepten alarga achyk bildirbesten, kyiytyp aituun'arga uruksat berdi. Alardyn kutuu moonotundo alar menen uilonuu tuuraluu zhashyruun ubadalashuudan sak bolgula. Birok kyiytyp aitkan belgiluu sozdor bolso gana uruksat. Kutuu (idda) moonotu uchurunda nikege turbagyla. Bilgile, Allakh silerge uruksat bergen zhana tyigan nerselerdin kaisynysyn ichin'erge zhashyrganyn'ardy bilet. Andyktan Andan sak bolgula, Anyn buiruguna karshy chykpagyla. Bilgile, Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerine Kechirimduu, zhazaloogo shashylbagan Toktoo.

Nikege turgan aialyn'ar menen zhynystyk mamile kylganga cheiin zhana alarga belgilengen kalyn'dy beruu mildetin alganga cheiin azhyrashasan'ar, silerge kunoo emes. Egerde ushundai abalda alarga talak bersen'er, anda kalyn' beruugo mildettuu emessin'er. Birok bailygy kop bakubat zhashagan bolobu zhe bailygy az kyinalyp zhashagan bolobu, alarga mumkunchulukko zharasha alardy kubanta turgandai zhana syngan kon'ulun zhubata turgandai bir nerse beruu kerek. Bul belek ish-araketinde zhana mamilesinde zhakshylyk kyluuchulardyn moinundagy bekem mildet.

Egerde nikeleshken aialdaryn'ar menen zhynystyk mamile kylganga cheiin talak bersen'er zhana alarga belgiluu bir olchomdo kalyn' beruu mildetin moinun'arga alsan'ar, alarga atalgan kalyn'dyn zharymyn tolop bergile. Bolboso al aialdar akyl-estuuluk kylyp kechip koiushsun zhe erkekter aikolduk kylyp alarga kalyn'dy toluk berishsin. Biri-birin'erge bolgon ukuktarda kechirimduu bolgonun'ar Allakhtan korkuuga zhana Aga bash iiuugo zhakynyraak. Oo, adamdar! Biri-birin'erge kairymduu boluunu zhana oz ara ukuktarda kechirimduu boluunu toktotpogula. Chyndygynda Allakh silerdin kylganyn'ardy Koruuchu. Andyktan Allakhtyn syilygyna zhetish uchun zhakshylyk kyluuga araket kylgyla.
Namazdardy Allakh buirugandai toluk atkargyla, namazdardyn arasynan orton'ku asyr namazyna bekem bolgula zhana namazyn'arda Allakhka moiun sunuu zhana korkuu menen turgula.

Egerde siler dushmandan zhe ushul syiaktuu nerselerden korkkonun'ar sebeptuu namazdy talaptagydai okui albasan'ar, anda any zhoo basyp baratkan abalda zhe too, at zh.b. mingen abalda zhe silerge mumkun bolgon kandai abalda bolso da okugula. A eger silerden korkunuch ketse, anda Allakh silerge uirotkondoi Any zikir kylgyla, al emi alardyn biri - Allakhty namazda toluk zhana talaptagydai zikir kyluu. Oshondoi ele Al silerge nur zhana tuura zhol tuuraluu bilbegen nerselerin'erdi uirotkonu uchun Any zikir kylgyla.

Aran'ardan kimdir biroo kaitysh bolup, artynda aialdary kalsa, anda alardy bir zhyl boiu turak-zhai menen kamsyzdoo zhana alardy karzhyloo tuuraluu kereez kaltyryshsyn. Muraskorlorun'ar alardy aza-kaisynysyna ortoktosh bolup, markumdun urmaty uchun kuup chygyshpasyn. Eger alar bir zhyl buto elekte oz erki menen chygyp ketishse, silerge kunoo emes zhana alar uchun da zhasanyp, zhypar-zhyt sebingenderi kunoo emes. Allakh ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu, Oz bashkaruusunda, shariiatynda zhana tagdyrynda Daanyshman. Kurandy chechmelegen aalymdardyn kopchulugu bul aiattyn okumu Allakh taalanyn: (wa'lWadhiyna yutawafWawna minkum wayadharuwna 'azwaj yatarabWaSna bi'anfusihinWa 'arba`a@a 'ashhur wa`ashr) <<Silerdin aran'ardan aialdaryn (zhesir) kaltyryp, olup ketkenderdin (aialdary) oz aldyncha tort ai, on kun (idda) kutushot>> - degen sozu menen zhokko chygarylgan degen pikirde.

Talak berilgen aialdarga, alardyn talak sebeptuu syngan kon'ulun zhubatuu uchun kuioonun abalyn eske aluu menen zhakshylykka ylaiyk az bolobu zhe kop bolobu, alar uchun kiiim-keche, akcha zhana bashka nerselerdi paidalanuuga uruksat. Bul okum Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiuularyn tashtoo menen Andan korkkondordun moinundagy anyk mildet.

Oo, yimanduular! Zhogoruda aitylgan tushundurmo syiaktuu Allakh silerge Ozunun chekterin zhana okumdorun kamtygan aiattaryn achyk baiandait. Balkim alardyn ustundo oi zhugurtup zhana ish zhuzundo atkaryp, duino zhana akyret zhakshylyktaryna zhetesin'er.

Oo, paigambar! Kara tumoo zhe bashka nerseler sebeptuu olum korkunuchunan ulam ui-zhailaryn tashtap chygyp ketken kop sandagy adamdardyn kabary tuuraluu bilgen zhoksun'bu? Alar Israil urpaktarynan bolgon bir top. Allakh alarga: <<Olgulo>> - degende alar olushtu. Kiiin alarga biilik Allakhtyn gana kolunda ekenin zhana alar ozdoruno paida da, zyian da keltire albastygyn tushundurush uchun alardy kaira tiriltti. Chyndygynda Allakh adamdarga karata aikolduk zhana bereshendik eesi. Birok adamdardyn kopchulugu Anyn zhakshylyktaryna shugur kylyshpait.

Oo, yimanduular! Allakhtyn dinin koldoo zhana sozun biiik kotoruu maksatta Anyn dushmandary menen sogushkula. Bilgile, Allakh silerdin sozdorun'ordu Uguuchu, nietterin'erdi zhana ish-araketterin'erdi Biluuchu. Zhakynda silerge anyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Kim karyz beruuchunun ishin kylyp, mal-mulku aga eselep kaitysh uchun any Allakh zholunda zhakshy niet zhana chyn kon'ulu menen sarptait? Allakh yryskyny, den-sooluktu zhana bashka nerselerdi tar kylat zhana Oz daanyshmandygy zhana adilettuulugu menen bulardyn baaryn kenen kylat. Akyrette Anyn Ozuno gana kaitasyn'ar, anan Al ish-araketterin'erge zharasha syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Oo, paigambar! Musanyn doorunan kiiinki Israil urpaktarynyn kadyr-barktuu adamdary tuuraluu kabardy bilgen zhoksun'bu? Alar ozdorunun bir paigambaryna: <<Bizge bir padysha daiynda, any menen birge Allakh zholunda sogushaly>> - deshti. Paigambary alarga: <<Eger Allakh silerge sogushtu parz kylsa, siler sogushpai koiushun'ar da mumkunbu?>> - dedi. Alar anyn oiun chetke kagyp: <<Bizden munu talap kylgan sebepter bolup zhatsa, biz uchun Allakh zholunda sogushuuga dagy emne toskool bolmok ele? Dushmandarybyz bizdi oz zheribizden kuup chykty, bala-chakabyzdy tutkunga aldy, emi biz oz zheribizdi kaitaryp, tutkundarybyzdy boshotuu uchun sogushabyz>> - deshti. Kachan Allakh alarga sogushuunu parz kylganda, alar ubada kylgan nerseni atkarbai, az bolugunon bashkalary zhuz burup ketishti. Allakh Anyn buirugunan zhuz burgan zaalymdardy, kelishimdi buzgandardy Biluuchu. Zhakynda alarga munun zhazasyn beret.

Oshondo paigambary alarga: <<Anyn tuusunun astynda sogushuun'ar uchun Allakh silerge Taluttu padysha kylyp daiyndady>> - dedi. Alardyn kadyr-barktuulary bul tandoonu zhaktyrbai, aga karshy chygyp: <<Egerde al padyshalardyn tukumunan bolboso, padyshalykka koldonuu uchun aga kop bailyk berilbese zhana biz aga karaganda padyshalykka tatyktuu bolsok, al kantip bizge padysha bolsun?!>> - deshti. Paigambary alarga: <<Any silerge Allakh Ozu tandady zhana silerge karaganda anyn ilimin teren', denesin kuch-kubattuu kyldy. Allakh Oz daanyshmandygy zhana yraiymy menen kimge kaalasa padyshalykty beret. Allakhtyn zhakshylygy kenen, any Ozu kaalaganga beret zhana aga pendelerinen kimisi tatyktuu ekenin bilet>>.

Paigambary alarga: <<Any silerge padysha kylyp tandoosu chyndyk ekendiginin belgisi - Allakhtyn silerge Tabuttu (Israil urpaktary azdektegen sandyk, any tarttyryp zhiberishken) kaitaryp berishi, anda any koshtogon beipildik bar zhana Musanyn ui-bulosu menen Kharundun ui-bulosunon kalgan taiak, kee bir yiyk taktailar syiaktuu taberik buiumdar bar. Eger chyndap yimanduu bolson'or, mynda siler uchun achyk-aikyn belgiler bar>>.

Talut askerleri menen shaardan chykkanda alarga: <<Allakh silerdi bir daryia menen synait. Kim andan ichse, al menin zholumda emes zhana sogushta meni menen birge bolboit. Kim andan ichpese, al menin zholumda zhana sogushta meni menen birge bolot. Al emi kim chydabai kolu menen bir kochush suu suzup ichse, ech nerse emes>> - dedi. Askerlerdin kobu ichip alyshty, az gana bolugu katuu chan'kaganyna karabai chydap ichishken zhok. Talut zhana any menen birge bolgon yimanduular daryiadan otkondo, anyn kee bir zhookerleri: <<Bugun biz Zhalut zhana anyn askerlerine turushtuk bere albaibyz>> - deshti. Oshondo kyiamat kunu Allakhka zholugaaryna toluk ishengender: <<Kanchalagan az sandagy yimanduular tobu Allakhtyn uruksaty zhana zhardamy menen kop sandagy kaapyrlardyn tobunun ustunon zhen'ishke zhetishken. Zhen'ishke zhetuudo koptuk emes, yiman maaniluu>>. Allakh sabyrduu pendeleri menen birge, alardy koldoit zhana zhardam beret.

Kachan alar Zhalut menen anyn askerlerinin aldyna chykkanda, Allakhka kairylyp: <<Rabbibiz! Zhurogubuzgo sabyrduuluktu noshorlotup kui, dushman aldynda kachpashybyz zhana zhen'ilip kalbashybyz uchun kadamdarybyzdy bekem kyl zhana Oz kuduretin' zhana koldoon' menen kaapyr koomgo karshy bizge zhardam ber>> - dep duba kylyshty.

Allakhtyn kaaloosu menen alardy zhen'ishti zhana Daud alardyn bashchysy Zhaluttu olturdu. Allakh aga padyshalykty zhana paigambarlykty berdi, aga ilimdin kaalagan turlorunon uirotup, duinodo zhana akyrette paidasy tiigen nerselerdi aga toptodu. Egerde kee bir adamdar arkyluu bashkalardyn buzukulugun toktotuu - Allakhtyn tutungan zholu bolbogondo, anda zher beti buzukulardyn bashkaruusu menen buzulup ketmek. Birok Allakh bardyk makuluktarga zhakshylyk kyluuchu.

Bular Allakhtyn achyk-aikyn aiattary. Oo, paigambar! Biz any saga okup berebiz, alar ozuno akyikat kabarlardy zhana adilet okumdordu kamtygan zhana akyikatta sen aalamdardyn Rabbisinin elchilerinensin'.

Biz saga aityp otkon paigambarlardy vakhiide, zholun zholdoochularda zhana darazhalarda biri-birinen artyk kyldyk. Alardyn arasynda Musa syiaktuu Allakh taala tuzmo-tuz suiloshkondoru bar zhana alardyn arasynda Mukhammad syiaktuu biiik darazhalarga kotorgondoru bar, antkeni al butkul adamzatka zhiberildi, any menen paigambarchylyk toktodu zhana anyn ummotu bashka ummottordon artyk boldu. Oshondoi ele Biz Mariiamdyn uulu Isaga anyn paigambarlygyna dalil bolo turgan oluktordu tiriltuu, sokur menen pes oorularyn aiyktyruu syiaktuu achyk-aikyn keremetterdi berdik zhana any Allakh taalanyn buirugun atkaruuga kubattandyruu uchun Zhebreil arkyluu koldoduk. Allakh kaalasa, paigambarlardan kiiin kelgender alarga achyk-aikyn aiattar kelgenden kiiin biri-biri menen sogushmak emes, birok alar biri-birine karshy bolup bolunup ketishti. Alardyn kee birleri Allakhka yiman keltirishse, kee birleri Aga kaapyrlyk kylyshty. Eger Allakh alardyn sogushuularyn kaalabasa, alar sogushpait bolchu. Birok Allakh kaalaganyn kylat, kimdi kaalasa Ozunun yraiymy zhana aikoldugu menen yimanga bagyttait, kimdi kaalasa Ozunun adilettigi zhana daanyshmandygy menen adashtyrat.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirgender zhana Anyn elchisine eerchigender! Kyiamat kun kelgenge cheiin Biz silerge yrysky kylyp bergen ar kandai adal mal-mulktordon sarptagyla. Al ubakta adamga ishtep tapkan sooda da, kyiynchylykta paidasy tiigen dostuk da, zyiandy kaitara turgan zhe paida keltire turgan ortomchuluk da paidasyn tiigizbeit. Birok Allakh Ozu kaalagandarga zhana yraazy bolgondorgo uruksat bergenden kiiin gana paidasy tiet. Al emi kaapyrlar Allakh taalaga kaapyrlyk kylyshkandary sebeptuu chynygy zaalymdar.

Allakh - zhalgyz Andan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok. Al tuboluk Tiruu, anda ech kandai olum da, kemchilik da bolboit. Al Ozu zheke but baaryn karmap Turuuchu zhana zharatkandarynyn ech birine muktazh emes. Bardyk makuluktar Al sebeptuu karmalyp turat zhana alar bardyk abaldarynda Aga muktazh. Anyn kemchiliksiz tiruulugu zhana but baaryn karmap turgany sebeptuu Any urguloo da, uiku da albait. Asmandar menen zherdin mulku zhalgyz Aga taandyk. Anyn uruksaty zhana makuldugu bolmoiuncha ech kim Anyn aldynda shapaat kyluuga akysy zhok. Al zharatkandardyn ishterine bailanyshtuu bolup otkon zhana kelechekte bolo turgan nerselerdi bilet. Al emi alar Anyn iliminen Ozu kaalap bildirgen nerseni gana bile alyshat. Anyn Kursiii (Rabbinin eki tamanynyn ordu) asmandar menen zherdi ken'digine zhana chon'duguna karabastan ozuno kamtyp turat. Alardy saktap turuu Aga oorchuluk zhana mashakat zharatpait. Al Oz Zaty, kudureti zhana ustomdugu menen Biiik, Oz mulkundo zhana padyshalygynda Uluk.

Islam dinine kiruugo ech kim mazhburlanbait. Antkeni al achyk zhana akyikat din bolgonduktan, aga biroonu mazhburloonun kazheti zhok. Tuura zhol adashuudan anyk aiyrmalandy. Kim Allakhtan bashka syiyngan nerselerge kaapyrlyk kylyp, alardan bash tartsa zhana zhalgyz Allakhka yiman keltirse, anda al kyiamatta kutuluu uchun uzulbogon en' kuchtuu sebep menen dindi karmanyptyr. Allakh pendelerinin sozdorun Uguuchu, alardyn ish-araketterin Biluuchu. Zhakynda alarga syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Allakh Ozuno yiman keltirgenderge kam korot, alardyn zholun achat, alarga zhardam beret zhana alardy kaapyrlyktyn zhana naadandyktyn karan'gylygynan yiman zhana ilim nuruna chygarat. Al emi kaapyrlyk kylgandardyn kamkorchulary - alarga kaapyrlykty kooz korgozup, alardy yiman zhana ilim nurunan kaapyrlyk zhana naadandyk karan'gylyktaryna chygargan zhalgan kudailar zhana sherikter. Osholor tozokto tuboluk kaluuchu adamdar.

Allakh eki top tuuraluu aitkandan kiiin al eki topko misal keltirip myndai dedi:
Oo, paigambar! Allakhtyn zharatuuchulugu zhana syiynuuga tatyktuulugu tuuraluu Ibrakhim menen talashyp-tartyshkan zaalymdyn taimanbastygynan da tan' kalyshtuusun bilchu belen'? Anyn myndai kyluusuna Allakhtyn bergen padyshalygy sebep bolup, al chekten chykty. Ibrakhim aga Rabbisinin sypattaryn baiandap: <> - dedi. Zaalym kezhirlenip: <> - dedi. Ibrakhim aga andan da chon'uraak dalil keltirip: <> - dedi. Oshondo zaalym emne deerin bilbei toktop kaldy, dalildin kuchtuuluguno turushtuk bere albady. Allakh zaalymdarga zulumduktary zhana asha chapkandyktary sebeptuu Anyn zholuna tushuugo iigilik berbeit.

Zhe bolboso, chatyrlary kulagan, dubaldary uragan, zhashoochulary kyrylyp, een kalgan shaardyn zhanynan otup bara zhatkan adamdyn okuiasyn bilchu belen'? Al kishi tan' kalyp: <<Allakh bul shaardyn elin olgondon kiiin kantip tiriltet boldu eken?>> - dedi. Oshondo Allakh any zhuz zhylga olturup, anan kaira tiriltti zhana andan: <<Kancha zhyl oluk zhattyn'?>> - dep surady. Al: <<Bir kun zhe kundun bir az bolugundoi ubakyt zhattym okshoit>> - dep zhoop berdi. Al aga aitty: <<Zhok, sen toluk zhuz zhyl zhattyn'. Zhanyn'dagy tamak-ash menen suusunduktu karachy, alar ozgorboston oshol boidon turat, bolboso tamak-ash menen suusunduk bat ele buzulup ketet. Olgon eshegin'di karachy! Biz seni adamdarga Allakhtyn kaira tiriltuugo kudurettuu ekenin bildirgen achyk-aikyn belgi kylabyz. Eshegin'din maidalanyp, chachyrap ketken sooktorun karachy, Biz alardy kantip turguzup, biri-birine biriktiret ekenbiz, andan kiiin aga et kaptaibyz, anan any kaira tiriltebiz>>. Munu korgondon kiiin aga ishtin akyikaty belgiluu boldu zhana Allakhtyn kuduretin bildi. Al munu moiunga alyp: <<Men Allakhtyn bardyk nersege kudurettuu ekenin bildim>> - dedi.

Oo, paigambar! Estechi, bir kezde Ibrakhim: <<Oo, Rabbim! Oluktor kantip tirilerin oz kozum menen koroiunchu?>>!- degende, Allakh aga: <<Sen bul nersege ishengen emes belen'?>> - dedi. Ibrakhim aitty: <<Zhok, ishengem. Birok zhurogumdun tynchtanuusun arttyruu uchun>>. Oshondo Allakh aga buiruk kylyp aitty: <<Kanattuulardan tortoonu al, alardy ozun'o chogult zhana maidalap keskile. Andan son' ailanan'dagy toolordun ar birine alardyn bir bolugun koi, anan alardy chakyrsan', alar saga tirilgen abalda shashylyp kelishet. Oo, Ibrakhim! Bilip koi, Allakh Oz mulkundo Kudurettuu, buirugunda, shariiattynda zhana zharatuusunda Daanyshman>>.

Mal-mulkun Allakh zholunda sarptagan yimanduularga berilgen sooptun misaly, dyikan zhakshy zherge ekken dan syiaktuu. Andan zheti mashak onup chygat, ar bir mashakta zhuzdon dan bolot. Allakh pendelerinen kimge kaalasa sooptorun eseletip koboitup, alardyn syilygyn esepsiz beret. Allakhtyn bereshendigi zhana aikoldugu kenen zhana Al eselep beruugo kimder ylaiyk ekenin biluuchu.

Mal-mulktorun Allakhka moiun sunuu zhana Anyn yraazychylygy uchun sarptap, andan son' bergen nersesinin artynan anyn soobun ketire turgan soz zhe ish-araket menen adamdarga mildet kylbagandarga Rabbisinin aldynda sooptor bar, kelechekte alar uchun ech kandai korkunuch bolboit zhana alarga berilgen uluu zhakshylyktar sebeptuu otkon nerselerge kaigyryshpait.

Musulmandyn zhuroguno kubanych tartuulai turgandai zhyluu soz aituu zhana saga zhamandyk kylgandy kechiruu - sadaka algan adamga artynan mildet kylyp zyian bergen sadakaga karaganda zhakshyraak. Allakh pendelerine Beimuktazh, alardy zhazaloogo shashylbagan Toktoo.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirgender zhana Anyn elchisine eerchigender! Sadaka berilgen adamga mildet kyluu zhana zyian beruu menen sadakan'ardyn soobun zhok kylyp albagyla. Myna ushundai kylgan adam el korsun zhana maktasyn degen niet menen mal-mulktorun sarptagan adam syiaktuu. Al Allakhka, kyiamat kununo zhana andagy syilyk zhana zhazaga ishenbegen kaapyr. Munun misaly ustu topurak baskan zhylmakai tashka okshosh. Al tashka noshorlop zhamgyr zhaap, anyn topuraktaryn ketirip, any ech nersesi zhok zhylmakai kylyp koidu. Oshol syiaktuu ele el korsun uchun kylgan adamdardyn ish-araketterinin zhana korotkon mal-mulktorunun sooptoru zhok bolot, Allakhtyn aldynda alardyn ech nersesi kalbait. Allakh kaapyrlardy Ozu yraazy bolgon zhana alardyn ish-araketterine zhana sarptagan mal-mulktoruno paida keltirgen nerselerge bagyttabait.

Allakhtyn yraazylygyn kozdop zhana Anyn ubadasy chyndyk ekenine kon'uldoru mazhburloosuz tynch algan abalda mal-mulktorun sarptagan yimanduular - biiik zhana zhakshy zherdegi bakcha syiaktuu. Al zherge noshorlop zhamgyr zhaap, eselep momo-zhemishterdi beret. Eger aga zhamgyr noshorlop zhaabastan, az gana zhaai turgan bolso, al zhakshy zher boidon kala beret. Yklastuu adamdardyn sarptagan mal-mulktoru da ushul syiaktuu, Allakh any kabyl kylat zhana soobunun azdygyna karabastan eselep koboitot. Allakh silerdin emne kylyp zhatkanyn'ardy korup turat. Aga yklastuulardyn zhana el korsun uchun kylgandardyn abaly zhashyruun emes. Al zhakynda ar birine tatyktuu bolgon syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Andan son' Allakh taala mal-mulkun elge korunush uchun sarptagan adamdyn abalyn misal katary surottop, myndai dep aitty:
Silerden kimdir biroonun zhuzum zhana kurma bagy bar deili, anyn ichinde taza suu agyp turat zhana momo-zhemishterdin tur-turloru bar. Anyn eesi ulgaiyp, zhumush kylganga zhana akcha tapkanga zharabagan karygan chal bolup kaldy. Anyn zhumush kylganga zharai elek alsyz zhash baldary bar. Anyn karylygy zhana baldarynyn alsyzdygy sebeptuu al bagyna oto muktazh bolup turgan abalda aga katuu shamal kelip, ot tutanyp, al tolugu menen kuiup ketishin kimin'er kaalait elen'er? Mal-mulkun elge korunush uchun sarptagan adamdyn abaly da ushul kishige okshosh. Al kyiamat kunu zhakshylyktarga oto muktazh bolup turgan ubakta Allakhtyn aldyna ech bir zhakshylygy zhok barat. Myna ushundai baiandoo arkyluu Allakh silerge duinodo zhana akyrette paida keltire turgan nerselerdi tushundurot. Balkim al tuuraluu oi zhugurtosun'or.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirgender zhana Anyn elchisine eerchigender! Ishtep tapkan taza zhana adal mal-mulkton sarptagyla. Zhana Biz silerge zherden chygaryp bergen osumduktordon sarptagyla. Alardyn zhamanyn beruunu niet kylbagyla, eger silerge oshondoiun berse almak emessin'er, alsan'ar da kormoksongo salyp, any zhaktyrbait bolchun'ar. Emi ozun'orgo yraa korbogon nerseni kantip Allakhka yraa korup zhatasyn'ar?! Bilgile, Allakh silerdin bergenin'erge Beimuktazh zhana Al Zatynda, ish-araketterinde maktoogo tatyktuu.

Alarga taza nerselerdi sarptagyla dep buirugandan kiiin, alardy shaitandyn aila-amalynan zhana azgyryktarynan sak boluunu eskertip, myndai dedi:
Shaitan silerdi kedeilik menen korkutat, saran'dykka undoit zhana kunoo ishterdi kyluuga chakyrat. Al emi Allakh silerge kunoolorun'or uchun uluu kechirimdi zhana kenen yryskyny ubada kylat. Allakhtyn aikoldugu kenen zhana Al pendelerinin abaldaryn Biluuchu.

Al pendelerinen kimge kaalasa, sozdogu zhana ish-arakettegi tuuralykty beret. Kimge myndai nerse berilse, aga chyndap koptogon zhakshylyktar beriliptir. Allakhtyn nuru menen nurlangan zhana Anyn tuura zholuna tushkon kemchiliksiz akyl eeleri gana Anyn aiattarynan eskertme zhana ulgu alyshat.

Az bolobu, kop bolobu, Allakhtyn yraazylygyn kozdop emneni sarptasan'ar zhe silerge mildet kylynbasa da Allakhka bash iiip atkargan ishin'erge bekem bolson'or, albette Allakh munun baaryn bilet zhana Anyn aldynda alardyn ech biri zhok bolboit. Silerge zhakynda alar uchun en' chon' syilyktardy beret. Al emi ozdoruno mildet bolgon nerselerdi atkarbagan zhana Allakhtyn chekterinen chykkan zaalymdar uchun alardy kyiamat kunu azaptan kutkara turgan ech bir zhardamchy bolboit.

Egerde sadakany mal-mulk menen achyk korsotup bersen'er, al sadakan'ar kandai zhakshy sadaka. Eger any zhashyryp, kedei-kembagaldarga bersen'er, al korsotup bergenin'erge karaganda zhakshyraak. Antkeni al yklastuulukka zhakynyraagy. Yklastuulardyn sadakalarynda alardyn kunoolorun zhaap-zhashyruu zhana kechirim bar. Allakh silerdin emne kylyp zhatkanyn'ardan Kabardar. Silerdin abalyn'ardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.

Oo, paigambar! Chyndykty kabyl aluu, aga moiun sunuu zhana aga alyp baruu uchun alardy tuura zholgo saluuga mildettuu emessin'. Chyndygynda sen alardy akyikatka bagyttoogo zhana any menen taanyshtyruuga gana mildettuusun'. Al emi akyikatka zhana tuura zholgo karai iigilik beruu Allakhtyn gana kolunda. Al kimdi kaalasa tuura zholgo salat. Zhakshylykka kandai nerseni sarptasan'ar, anyn paidasy ozun'orgo kaitat. Antkeni Allakh aga muktazh emes. Andyktan sarptagan nersen'er Allakh uchun gana bolsun. Chynygy yimanduular Allakhtyn yraazylygyn kozdop sarptashat. Zhakshylykka sarptagan nersen'er az bolobu zhe kop bolobu, anyn syilygyn kemitpesten toluk alasyn'ar. Antkeni Allakh ech kimge zulum kylbait.

Anyn zholunda sarptoo tuuraluu aityp, yimanduulardy aga undogondon kiiin, any kaisy zherlerge sarptash kerektigin baiandap, myndai dep aitty:
Any yrysky tabuu uchun sapar kyluusuna Allakh zholundagy sogush toskoolduk zharatkan kedei-kembagaldarga bergile. Bilbegen adam alardy bai dep oiloit, antkeni alar suragandan tartynyshat. Baamchyl adam alardy turpatynan zhana kiiimderinen baikalgan muktazhdyk belgilerinen ele bilet. Alardyn bir ozgocholugu - alar adamdardyn zhanyn koiboi surai bergen bashka kedeilerge okshoboit. Mal-mulk zhana bashka nerselerden emneni sarptasan'ar da Allakh any zhakshy bilet zhana silerge anyn syilygyn zhakynda beret.

El korsun zhe uksun debesten, mal-mulktorun Allakhtyn yraazylygy uchun kunu-tunu, achyk zhana zhashyruun sarptagandar uchun kyiamat kunu Rabbisinin aldynda soop-syilyktar bar. Allakhtyn yraiymy zhana zhakshylygy menen alar uchun kelechekte bolo turgan ishterinde ech kandai korkunuch bolboit zhana alar duinodo bolup otkon nerseler uchun okunushpoit.

Allakh taala musulmandardyn ortosundagy kyzmattashtykty zhana tilekteshtikti kamtygandygy uchun Anyn zholuna mal-mulk sarptoogo undogondon kiiin, aga karshy kelgen sutkorluktan eskertip, myndai dedi:
Sutkorluk menen alektengender zhana any algandar kyiamat kunu kabyrlarynan zhin-shaitan tiigen adam syiaktuu tirilishet. Alar kabyrynan bir turup, bir zhygylyp talmasy karmagan adamdai turushat. Munun sebebi alar sutkorluktu adal dep esepteshti zhana sutkorluk menen Allakh adal kylgan soodadan tushkon paidalardy aiyrmalashkan zhok. Alar: <> - deshti. Allakh alarga zhoop berdi, alardyn salyshtyruusun chetke kakty zhana zhalgandaryn achykka chygardy. Oshondoi ele soodada zhalpy zhana zheke paidalar bolgonu uchun any adal kylganyn, al emi sutkorluk zulumduktu zhana adamdardyn mal-mulkun kaitarbastan zhalgan zholdo zheshti kamtygandygy uchun any aram kylganyn baiandady. Kimge Rabbisi taraptan sutkorluktan tyiuu zhana eskertuu kelse zhana al any tashtap, Allakhka toobo kylyp kaitsa, anda anyn murda sutkorluktan algan nerseleri uchun ech kandai kunoo zhok zhana andan kiiin kandai boloorun Allakh Ozu chechet. Al emi kimge Allakhtyn tyiuusu zhetip, dalil keltirilgenden kiiin da sutkorluk kylganyn toktotposo, al tozokko kiruugo zhana anda tuboluk kaluuga tatyktuu boldu. Myndagy tozokto tuboluk kalat degenden sutkorluktu adal dep zhegen adam zhe al zhakta uzakka kaluu maksat kylyngan. Antkeni tozokto tuboluk kaluu kaapyrlarga gana tiesheluu, al emi zhalgyz kudailuuluk (taukhid) ishenimin karmangandar tozokto tuboluk kalyshpait.

Allakh Ozunun zholuna mal-mulk sarptoonu zhana sutkorluk kyluunu aitkandan kiiin, al ekoonun syilygy menen zhazasynyn ortosundagy aiyrmachylykty baiandap, myndai dedi:
Allakh sutkorluktan tushkon mal-mulktu zhok kylat zhana any ketiret, zhe any koz korunoo zhogotuuga uchuratat, zhe bilgizbei berekesin alyp koiot. Al emi sadakalardy koboitot zhana alardyn soobun eselep osturot. Zhakshylyk on eseden zheti zhuz esege cheiin zhe andan da kop esege koboitulot zhana sadaka bergenderdin mal-mulkuno bereke beret. Allakh bash iibes kaapyrlardy, aramdy adal kylgandardy, zhamandyk zhana kunoo ishterdi tashtabagan adamdardy zhakshy korboit.

Allakhka yiman keltirgender, Anyn elchisine eerchigender, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandar, namazdy Allakh shariiatta korgozgondoi toluk atkargandar, tatyktuu adamdarga mal-mulkunon zeket bergender uchun Rabbisinin aldynda soop-syilyktar bar. Alar uchun kelechekte bolo turgan ishterinde ech kandai korkunuch bolboit zhana alar duinogo zhana anyn zhyrgalchylyktaryna bailanyshtuu otkorup zhibergen nerseleri uchun okunushpoit.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirgender zhana Anyn elchisine eerchigender! Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiuularyn tashtap Andan korkkula. Egerde siler Allakhka zhana Anyn sutkorluktan tyiuusuna chyndap yiman keltirsen'er, anda adamdardagy sutkorluktan kalgan mal-mulkun'ordu talap kylbagyla.

A eger silerge aitylgan buiruktu atkarbasan'ar, anda Allakh zhana Anyn elchisi taraptan sogush boloorun anyk tuiup bilgile. Eger Allakhka toobo kylyp, sutkorluktu tashtasan'ar, anda ustuno paida koshulbagan karyz mal-mulkun'or ozun'orgo tiesheluu bolot. Mal-mulkun'ordun ustuno ustok paiyz koshup aluu menen ech kimge zulum kylbaisyn'ar zhana andan kemitilip silerge da zulum kylynbait.

Eger siler karyzdy talap kylgan adam kuduretsiz bolup, karyzyn toloi albai zhatsa, anda al akcha tapkanga cheiin zhana karyzyn kutuluuga mumkunchuluk bolgongo cheiin surabai koio turgula. Karyzdy surabastan aga sadaka kylyp koigonun'ar zhe anyn bir bolugun kechip zhibergenin'er, ozun'or uchun zhakshy, eger bul kylgan ishin'erdin Allakh taalanyn aldyndagy artykchylygyn bilgen bolson'or.

Baaryn'ar Allakhka kaitaryla turgan zhana Anyn aldyna tura turgan kundun azabynan korkkula. Andan kiiin ar bir adamga zhakshylyk zhe zhamandyk ishterinin syilygy zhe zhazasy berilet. Alarga zhasagan zhakshylyktarynyn soobu azaitylyp zhe zhamandyktarynyn zhazasy koboitulup zulumduk kylynbait.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirgender zhana Anyn elchisine eerchigender! Egerde biri-birin'erge belgiluu bir moonotko cheiin karyz bersen'er, anda oshol karyzdy zhazgyla. Aran'ardan bir adam shariiatka ylaiyk chyndyk zhana kalystyk menen zhazsyn. Karyzdy zhazgan adam Allakh aga uirotkon nersege tuura kelgendei adilettuuluk menen zhazuudan bash tartpasyn. Karyzdy toloogo mildettuu adamdan tastyktoo katary al aitkandai zhazsyn zhana al Rabbisinen korksun, karyzdyn olchomunon, turunon zhana sapatynan ech nerseni kemitpesin. Eger karyz alyp zhatkan adam oidogudai ish zhurguzo albasa, zhe zhashtygy zhe akyl-esi kemdigi sebeptuu alsyz bolso, zhe duduk bolgondugu uchun aityp bere albasa, anda anyn orduna al uchun zhoopker kamkorchusu chyndyk zhana kalystyk menen aityp bersin. Oshondoi ele adilettuu zhana akyl-esi zhaiynda bolgon eki erkek kishini kubo boluuga chakyrgyla. Eger eki erkek kishi tabylbasa, anda siler dindarlygyna zhana amanatkoiluguno yraazy bolgon bir erkek kishi zhana eki aialdy kubo kylgyla. Antkeni aialdardyn biroosu unutup kalsa, ekinchisi anyn esine salat. Egerde alardan karyzga kubo boluuga chakyrylsa, kubolor andan bash tartyshpasyn. Eger alardy ushuga chakyrsa, alar uchun any atkaruu mildet. Karyzdy belgilengen moonotuno cheiin az bolobu, kop bolobu, any zhazuudan ech zerikpegile. Karyzdy zhazuu - Allakhtyn shariiaty boiuncha en' adilettuu, kubogo otuudo zhana any atkaruuda en' zhetkiliktuu zhana karyzdyn turu, olchomu zhana moonotu tuuraluu shektenuunu zhok kyluuga en' zhakyny. Eger orton'ordo sooda-satyk kelishimi bolup, tovar daiar zhana baasy belgiluu bolso, anda any zhazbai ele koison'or bolot, sebebi aga ech kandai zaryldyk zhok. Talashyp-tartyshuunu aldyn aluu uchun kubo boluuga chakyruu uruksat. Zhazgan zhana kubogo otkon adamdarga zyian keltiruugo bolboit. Oshondoi ele alar dagy zhazuunu zhana kubogo otuunu surangandarga zyian keltirbeshi kerek. Egerde zyian keltire turgan bolson'or, bul Allakhka moiun sunuudan bash tartuu bolup sanalat. Oo, yimanduular! Allakhtan korkkula, Anyn silerge buiruganyna bash iigile zhana tyigandaryn tashtagyla - Allakh silerge duinon'orgo zhana akyretin'erge paidaluunu uirotot. Allakh bardyk nerseni Biluuchu. Aga ech nerse zhashyruun emes.

Egerde saparda zhurup, karyz kagazyn zhazuuga adam tappasan'ar, anda karyzdar tarap karyzyn tologongo cheiin karyz beruuchunun ukuguna kepildik katary anyn eeligine kurooluk koiot. Eger biri-birin'erge ishensen'er, anda zhazuu, kubolonduruu zhana kuroogo koiuu zaryl emes. Bul uchurda karyz karyzkordun moinundagy amanat bolup, al any karyz beruuchugo tolop beruugo zhana bul amanattyn ech nersesin tanbastan Allakhtan korkuuga tiiish. Eger al tansa, kelishim mamilege kubo bolgon adam korsotmo bersin zhana any zhashyrbasyn. Al emi kim any zhashyrsa, anyn zhurogu buzuku zhurok. Allakh kylganyn'ardy Biluuchu. Aga ech bir nerse zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda Al silerge ish-araketterin'erdin syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Asmandar menen zherdegi nerseler zharatuuda, eelik kyluuda zhana bashkaruuda zhalgyz Allakhka taandyk. Zhurogun'ordogu nerseni achykka chygarsan'ar da, zhashyrsan'ar da, Allakh any bilet zhana silerge anyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret. Andan kiiin kimdi kaalasa zhakshylyk zhana yraiymduuluk menen kechiret, kimdi kaalasa adilettuuluk zhana daanyshmandyk menen azaptait. Allakh butkul nersege kudurettuu.

Mukhammad paigambar Rabbisi tarabynan tushurulgon bardyk nerselerge yiman keltirdi zhana yimanduular da yiman keltirishti. Alardyn baarysy Allakhka yiman keltirishti, oshondoi ele bardyk perishtelerine, paigambarlarga tushurgon bardyk kitepterine zhana alarga zhibergen bardyk elchilerine yiman keltirip: <<Biz Allakhtyn elchilerinen ech kimisin bolboibuz>> - deshti. Zhana alar aityshty: <<Bizge buiruganyn'dy zhana tyiganyn'dy uktuk. Zhana buiruganyn'dy atkaryp, tyiganyn'dy tashtoo menen Saga moiun sunduk. Oo, Rabbibiz! Bizdi kechirishin'di suranabyz. Bardyk ishteribizde bir gana Saga kaitabyz>>.

Allakh ech bir zhanga anyn mumkunchulugunon ashykcha nerseni zhuktoboit. Antkeni Allakhtyn dini zhen'ildikke negizdelgen, anda ech kandai kyiynchylyk zhok. Kim zhakshylyk kylsa, anyn syilygyn alat, andan ech nerse kemitilbeit. Kim zhamandyk kylsa, anyn zhazasyn tartat, any bashka biroo kotorboit. Paigambar zhana yimanduular aityshty: <<Oo, Rabbibiz! Kaisy bir ishte zhe sozdo atailabastan kata ketirsek zhe unutup kalsak bizdi azaptaba. Oo, Rabbibiz! Sen bizden murun zulumduktary sebeptuu zhazalagan zhoottorgo mildet kylgandai bizge oorchuluktu zharatkan zhana atkara albagan ishterdi mildet kylba, bizge kyiynchylykty zharatkan zhana kuchubuz zhetpegen buiruktardy zhana tyiuulardy zhuktobo, kunoolorubuzdu kech, bizdi kechir zhana bizge aikoldugun' menen yraiym kyl. Sen bizdin Komkorchubuzsun' zhana Koldoochubuzsun', kaapyrlar koomuna karshy bizge zhardam ber>>.

(lm) Alif, laam, miim. Bul birindegen tamgalar tuuraluu bakara suroosunun bashynda kelgen. Mynda arabdar ushul syiaktuu Kurandy alyp kele albastygyna isharattar bar. Bolboso Kuran bul suroonun bashynda kelgen zhana alar soz zhasoodo koldongon tamgalardan ele kuralgan.

Allakh - zhalgyz Andan bashka syiynynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok. Al tuboluk Tiruu, anda ech kandai olum da, kemchilik da bolboit. Al Ozu zheke but baaryn karmap Turuuchu zhana zharatkandarynyn ech birine muktazh emes. Bardyk makuluktar Al sebeptuu karmalyp turat zhana alar bardyk abaldarynda Aga muktazh.

Oo, paigambar! Al saga okuialarda zhana okumdordogu adilettikte murdagy ilakhii kitepterge ylaiyk kelgen Kurandy akyikat menen tushurdu zhana alardyn ortosunda ech kandai karama-karshylyk zhok. Oshondoi ele saga Kuran tushurulgongo cheiin Musaga Tooratty, Isaga Inzhildi tushurgon. Bul ilakhii kitepterdin baarysy adamdardyn dininin zhana duinosunun on'oluusuna tuura zhol zhana bagyt korsotuuchu. Al akyikatty zhalgandan, tuura zholdu adashuudan aiyrmalap korsotkon Furkandy (azhyratuuchu) tushurdu. Al emi Allakhtyn saga tushurgon aiattaryna kaapyrlyk kylgandar uchun katuu azap bar. Allakh - Aga ech bir nerse ustomduk kyla albagan kudurettuu zhana Anyn elchilerin zhalganga chygaryp, Anyn buiruguna karshy chykkandardan och aluuchu.

Oo, paigambar! Al saga okuialarda zhana okumdordogu adilettikte murdagy ilakhii kitepterge ylaiyk kelgen Kurandy akyikat menen tushurdu zhana alardyn ortosunda ech kandai karama-karshylyk zhok. Oshondoi ele saga Kuran tushurulgongo cheiin Musaga Tooratty, Isaga Inzhildi tushurgon. Bul ilakhii kitepterdin baarysy adamdardyn dininin zhana duinosunun on'oluusuna tuura zhol zhana bagyt korsotuuchu. Al akyikatty zhalgandan, tuura zholdu adashuudan aiyrmalap korsotkon Furkandy (azhyratuuchu) tushurdu. Al emi Allakhtyn saga tushurgon aiattaryna kaapyrlyk kylgandar uchun katuu azap bar. Allakh - Aga ech bir nerse ustomduk kyla albagan kudurettuu zhana Anyn elchilerin zhalganga chygaryp, Anyn buiruguna karshy chykkandardan och aluuchu.
Chyndygynda zherdegi zhana asmandagy ech bir nerse Allakhka zhashyruun emes. Anyn ilimi syrtky zhana ichki bardyk nerselerdi kamtygan.

Al silerdi enen'erdin kursagynda Ozu kaalagandai uul zhe kyz, zhakshy zhe zhaman, ak zhe kara kylyp ar kandai korunushto zharatty. Andan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok, Al zhen'ilbegen kudurettuu zhana Oz zharatuusunda, bashkaruusunda, shariiatynda Daanyshman.

Oo, paigambar! Al saga Kurandy tushurdu. Anda ech kandai budomugu zhok, maanisi aikyn aiattar bar. Alar kiteptin negizin zhana kopchulugun tuzot zhana talash-tartyshta negizgi taianych bulak bolup sanalat. Oshondoi ele anda bir neche maanini tuiuntkan aiattar da bar, alardyn maanisi kopchuluk adamdar uchun tushunuksuz. Al emi zhurogundo akyikattan chettegen adamdar maanisi aikyn aiattardy tashtap, yktymalduulugu bar budomuk aiattardy karmanyshat. Alar munu menen shek saluunu zharatyp, adamdardy adashtyruunu kozdoshot zhana munu menen alardy ozdorunun adashkan zholdoruna tuuralap, napsi kaalooloruna zharasha chechmeloogo araket zhasashat. Bul aiattardyn chynygy maanilerin zhana alardyn akyrky zhyiyntygyn Allakh gana bilet. Al emi ilimi teren'der zhana kuchtuulor: <<Biz Kurandyn baaryna yiman keltirdik, antkeni anyn baary Rabbibizden>> - dep aityshat zhana maanisi budomuk aiattardy andagy aikyn maanidegi aiattar menen chechmeleshet. Tuura akyl kalchagan adamdar gana ulgu, sabak alyshat.

Oshol teren' ilimduulor aityshat: <<Rabbibiz, bizdi akyikat zholgo salganyn'dan kiiin zhurogubuzdu andan burba, akyikattan chettep adashkandardyn bashyna tushkon nerseden sakta, Ozun' taraptan zhuroktorubuzdu tuura zholgo bagyttagan kenen yraiymdy tartuula zhana any menen bizdi adashuudan sakta. Oo, Rabbibiz! Chyndygynda Sen ech nerseni aiabagan Bereshensin'.
Rabbibiz, Sen ech kandai shek-kumonu zhok, sozsuz kele turgan kundo bardyk adamdardy surak aluu uchun Ozun'o chogultasyn'. Oo, Rabbibiz! Chyndygynda Sen ubadany buzbaisyn'>>.

Allakhka zhana Anyn elchilerine kaapyrlyk kylgandardy mal-mulktoru zhana bala-chakasy bul duinodo da, akyrette da kutkara albait. Myna ushundai sapattarga ee bolgondor kyiamat kunu kuiuuchu tozok otundary.

Bul kaapyrlardyn abaly Faraondun ui-bulosu zhana alardan murun Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyp, Anyn aiat-belgilerin zhalganga chygargandardyn abalyna okshosh. Allakh alardy kunooloru uchun zhazalady zhana alarga mal-mulku da, bala-chakasy da paida keltirgen zhok. Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandarga zhana Anyn aiat-belgilerin zhalganga chygargandarga Anyn zhazasy kataal.

Oo, paigambar! Ar kaisy dindegi kaapyrlarga ait: <<Zhakynda yimanduular silerdin ustun'ordon zhen'ishke zhetip, kaapyrlykta olosun'or. Allakh silerdi tozok otuna chogultat. Al siler uchun kandai zhaman zhai>>.

Badr kunu sogushuu uchun betteshken eki zhoodo siler uchun ornoktor zhana belgiler bar. Alardyn biri - yimanduular taipasy, alar Allakhtyn sozu biiik zhana kaapyrlardyn sozu tomon boluusu uchun sogushkan Allakhtyn elchisi zhana anyn sakhabalary. Al emi ekinchisi - kaapyrlar taipasy, alar el korsun uchun menmensinip, uruusuna berilgen abalda chykkan Mekke kaapyrlary. Yimanduular alardyn chyndap ele eki ese kop ekenin oz kozdoru menen korushtu. Oshondo Allakh dostoruna zhardam berdi. Allakh kimge kaalasa Oz zhen'ishi menen koldoo korsotot. Sany az bolso da zhen'ish yiman eeleri tarapta, sany kop bolso da zhen'iluu zhalgan eeleri tarapta ekenin biluuloru uchun mynda akyl eeleri uchun ulgulor zhana sabaktar bar.

Allakh taala adamdardy synoo uchun duino kumarlaryna bolgon suiuunu, misaly, aialdardy, uul baldardy, altyn-kumushton chogulgan kop bailyktardy, uirotulgon asyl zhylkylardy, too, ui, koi syiaktuu ui zhanybarlaryn, aidoo zherlerdi kooz kylyp korsotup koigondugun aitty. Bular az gana ubakyt paidalanylyp zhok bolo turgan duino zhashoosunun yrakhaty. Oshonduktan yimanduu adam bularga bailanbashy kerek. Al emi Allakhtyn aldynda kaityp baruuchu en' sonun zhai bar, al asmandar menen zherdin ken'digindei bolgon beiish.

Duino kumarlary ubaktyluu bolgonduktan, Allakh andan dagy zhakshyraak nersege undop myndai dedi:
Oo, paigambar! Alarga ait: <>. Allakhka ish zhuzundo moiun sunup zhana Aga bash iibestik kyluunu tashtap Andan korkkondor uchun khan sarailarynyn zhana baktarynyn astynan daryialar agyp turgan beiishter bar, alar al zhaida olboston zhana zhok bolboston tuboluk kalyshat zhana alar uchun zharaluusunda zhana kulk-munozundo bardyk zhamandyktardan taza bolgon aialdar bar. Ushunu menen birge alar uchun Allakhtan bolgon yraazylyk bar zhana Al alarga ech kachan achuulanbait. Allakh pendelerinin abaldaryn Koruuchu. Alardyn ech nersesi Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda alarga syilygyn beret.

Myna ushul beiish adamdary dubalarynda Rabbisine aityshat: <<Rabbibiz, biz Saga zhana Senin elchilerin'e tushurgon nerselerge yiman keltirdik, Senin shariiatyn'dy eerchidik. Emi bizdin kylgan kunoolorubuzdu kechir zhana bizdi tozok azabynan alystat>>.

Alar ibadattardy atkaruuda, kunoolordu tashtoodo zhana bashtaryna tushkon synoodo sabyr kyluuchular, sozdorundo zhana ish-araketterinde chynchyldar, Allakhka toluk moiun sungandar, mal-mulktorun Allakh zholuna sarptagandar, tundun akyrynda kechirim suragandar, antkeni bul uchurda dubanyn kabyl boluu yktymaly zhogoru zhana zhurok tuishuktordon alys bolot.

Allakh Ozunon bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok ekenine kuboluk berdi. Munun sebebi Al Ozunun syiynuuga tatyktuulugun korsotkon shariiattyk zhana aalamdyk aiat-belgilerdi belgiledi. Zhana buga perishteler kuboluk berishti. Oshondoi ele buga ilim eeleri da zhalgyz kudailuuluktu (taukhid) tushunduruu zhana aga chakyruu menen kuboluk berishti. Alar en' chon' kuboluk bolgon Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygyna (taukhid) zhana Anyn zharatkandarynda, shariiatynda adilettuuluktu ornotuusuna kuboluk berishti. Andan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok, Al ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu zhana Al zharatuusunda, bashkaruusunda zhana shariiatynda Daanyshman.

Akyikatta Allakhtyn aldynda kabyl bolo turgan din - Islam. Al - ibadat kyluu arkyluu Allakhtyn Ozuno gana moiun sunuu zhana kulchuluk kyluu menen Aga toluk beriluu, oshondoi ele akyrky paigambar Mukhammadga cheiinki bardyk paigambarlarga yiman keltiruu. Allakh any menen paigambarchylykty zhyiyntyktady zhana anyn shariiatynan bashkasy kabyl kylynbait. Zhoottor menen khristiandar ozdoruno kelgen ilim sebeptuu dalil keltirilgenden kiiin koro albastyktan zhana duinogo berilgendikten ulam dinderinde talashyp-tartyshyp, agymdarga zhana zhamaattarga bolunup ketishti. Kimde-kim Allakhtyn elchisine tushurgon aiattaryna kaapyrlyk kylsa, anda Allakh Ozuno kaapyrlyk kylgandardyn zhana Anyn elchilerin zhalganga chygargandardyn esebin tez beruuchu.

Oo, paigambar! Eger alar saga tushurulgon akyikat zhonundo seni menen talashyp-tartyshsa, anda alarga: <<Men zhana yimanduulardan meni eerchigender Allakh taalaga moiun sunduk>> - dep zhoop ber. Oo, paigambar! Kitep eelerine zhana mushrikterge ait: <<Men alyp kelgen nersege eerchip, Allakh taalaga chyn yklastan moiun sundun'arby?>>. Eger alar Allakhka moiun sunup, senin shariiatyn'dy eerchishse, anda alar tuura zholgo tushkon bolot. A eger Islamdan bash tartyshsa, anda sen zhiberilgen nerseni gana zhetkiruugo mildettuusun'. Al emi alardyn ishin Allakh chechet, Al pendelerin Koruuchu. Zhakynda ar birinin kylgan ish-araketine zharasha syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Allakhtyn alarga tushurgon dalilderine kaapyrlyk kylgandar zhana ukugu zhok turup zulumduk zhana dushmandyk menen paigambarlaryn olturgondor, oshondoi ele adamdardy zhakshylykka chakyryp, zhamandyktan tyiyp, alardy adilettuulukko chakyrgandardy olturgon kankor kaapyrlarga kyinoochu azapty suiunchulo.

Myndai sypattagy adamdardyn ish-araketteri zhokko chygarylat zhana Allakhka yiman keltirishpegeni uchun alardyn paidasyn duinodo da, akyrette da korushpoit. Alardy azaptan kutkara turgan ech bir zhardamchy bolboit.

Oo, paigambar! Allakh Toorat iliminin bir bolugun zhana senin paigambarlygyn'a dalil bolgon nerselerdi bergen zhoottordun abalyna karabaisyn'by? Alar oz ara talashyp-tartyshkan nerselerde okum chygaruu uchun Allakhtyn kitebi Tooratka kaituuga chakyrylat, anan alardyn aalymdary menen bashchylarynyn bir tobu anyn okumu alardyn napsi kaalooloruna tuura kelbegeni uchun andan zhuz burup kaityp ketishet. Egerde alar aga eerchiibiz dep oilogondoi bolgondo, anda alar adamdardyn ichinen any menen okum kyluuga en' shashylgandardan bolushmak.

Akyikattan mintip buruluunun zhana andan zhuz buruunun sebebi, alar kyiamat kunu bir neche kun ele tozokto bolup, kiiin beiishke kirebiz dep aityshat ele. Alardy bul ishenim aldap koidu. Alar munu zhalgan nerselerden oilop taap, Allakhka zhana Anyn dinine asylyshty.

Emi alardyn abaly zhana okunuchu kandai bolot? Biz alardy ech kandai shek-kumonu zhok kyiamat kunu chogultkanda en' zhaman bolot. Oshondo ar bir zhanga kylgan ishine zharasha syilygy zhe zhazasy berilet, anyn zhakshylyktary azaitylyp zhe kunooloru koboitulup zulumduk kylynbait.

Oo, paigambar! Rabbin'di maktoo zhana uluktoo menen mintip ait: <<Oo, Allakh! Sen duino zhana akyrettegi bardyk mulktun Padyshasysyn'. Zharatkandaryn'dyn kimisine kaalasan' mulk beresin', kimisinen kaalasan' tartyp alasyn', alardyn kaalaganyn ardaktuu kylasyn', kaalaganyn kor kylasyn'. Munun baary Senin daanyshmandygyn'dan zhana adilettuulugun'don. Bardyk zhakshylyk zhalgyz Senin kolun'da zhana Sen bardyk nersege kudurettuusun'.

Senin kudurettuulugun'dun korunushtorunon, Sen tundu kunduzgo kirgizip, kunduzdun ubaktysyn uzartasyn', kunduzdu tungo kirgizip, tundun ubaktysyn uzartasyn'. Kaapyrdan yimanduunu, uruktan osumduktordu chygargan syiaktuu olukton tiruunu chygarasyn' zhana yimanduudan kaapyrdy, zhumurtkadan zhozhonu chygargan syiaktuu tiruudon oluktu chygarasyn'. Zhana kimge kaalasan', eseptebesten zhana sanabastan kenen yrysky beresin'>>.

Oo, yimanduular! Yimanduulardyn orduna kaapyrlardy suiuktuu zhana zhardamchy dos kylyp albagyla. Kim ushundai kylsa, al Allakhtan bash tartty zhana Allakh da andan bash tartty. Birok siler alardyn biilik astynda bolup, ozun'or uchun korkson'or, anda alarga bolgon dushmandygyn'ardy zhashyruu menen sozun'ordo zhumshaktykty zhana ishin'erde sypaiylykty korsotup, alardyn zyianan saktansan'ar kunoo emes. Allakh silerdi Ozunon eskertet, andyktan Andan korkkula zhana kunoo kylyp Anyn kaaryna kalbagyla. Pendeler ish-araketterinin syilygyn zhe zhazasyn aluu uchun kyiamat kunu Allakhka gana kaityshat.

Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Kaapyrlar menen dostoshuu syiaktuu Allakh tyigan nerselerdi kokurogun'orgo zhashyrasyn'arby zhe achykka chygarasyn'arby, Allakh any bilet. Alardyn ech bir nersesi Aga zhashyruun emes. Al asmandardagy zhana zherdegi nerselerdi bilet. Allakh bardyk nersege kudurettuu, alardyn ech biri Any alsyrata albait>>.

Kyiamat kunu ar bir zhan kylgan zhakshy ishterine tush bolot, alar ech kemitilbesten alyp kelinet, al emi zhaman ishterdi kylgan adam, al ekoonun ortosunda uzak ubakyt bolso dep tileit. Birok tilegi kantip kabyl bolsun! Allakh silerdi Ozunon eskertet, andyktan kunoo kylyp Anyn kaaryna kalbagyla. Allakh pendelerine Booruker, oshonduktan alarga eskertet zhana korkutat.

Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Eger Allakhty chyndap suison'or, anda men alyp kelgen nersege ichin'erden zhana syrtyn'ardan eerchigile. Oshondo Allakhtyn suiuusuno zhetesin'er zhana Al kunoolorun'ordu kechiret. Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerine kechirimduu, alarga yraiymduu>>.

Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Buiruktardy atkaryp, tyiuulardy tashtoo menen Allakhka bash iigile zhana Anyn elchisine moiun sungula>>. Egerde alar myndan zhuz burushsa, anda Allakh Anyn buiruguna zhana elchisinin buiruguna karshy chykkan kaapyrlardy zhakshy korboit.

Chyndygynda Allakh Adam atany tandap, aga perishtelerdi sazhda kyldyrdy. Nukhtu tandap, any zher zhuzuno birinchi elchi kyldy. Ibrakhimdin ui-bulosun tandap, anyn urpaktaryna paigambarlykty kyldy. Oshondoi Imrandyn ui-bulosun da tandady. Ushulardyn baarysyn tandap, oz doorundagy adamdardan artyk kyldy.

Myna ushul atalgan paigambarlar zhana alardyn zholun zholdogon urpaktary - alar Allakhty zhalgyzdoodo zhana zhakshylyk ishterdi kyluuda birinin artynan biri kelgen urpaktar. Alar biri-birinen asyl sypattardy zhana artykchylyktardy muraska alyshkan. Allakh pendelerinin sozdorun Uguuchu, ish-araketterin Biluuchu. Oshol sebepten alardyn arasynan Ozu kaalagandaryn tandait.

Oo, paigambar! Estechi, bir kezde Imrandyn aialy (Mariiamdyn enesi) aitty: <<Oo, Rabbim! Men kursagymdagy balany Saga zhana Senin uiun'o kyzmat kyluusu uchun Senin Zhuzun'du kozdop butkul nerseden boshotuunu ozumo mildet kyldym. Munu menden kabyl kyl. Chyndygynda Sen dubamdy Uguuchusun', nietimdi Biluuchusun'>>.

Al uul toroim dep umut kylyp zhurup, aiy-kunu zhetip torogondo okunup: <<Oo, Rabbim! Men kyz torodum>> - dedi. Allakh anyn kim torogonun zhakshy bilet. Al umut kylyp kutkon uul kuch-kubat zhana turpat zhaktan aga berilgen kyzdai emes. Al: <<Men anyn atyn Mariiam koidum, any zhana anyn urpaktaryn yraiymyn'dan kuulgan shaitandan korgoonu Ozun'o tapshyrdym>> - dedi.

Allakh anyn nazirin zhakshy kabyl alyp, any tatyktuu tarbiialap chon'oittu, pendelerinin ichinen takyba adamdardyn zhuroktorun aga zhumshak kyldy zhana anyn zhoopkerchiligin Zakariiaga tapshyrdy. Zakariia anyn ibadat kylgan zhaiyna kirgen saiyn anyn aldynan zhen'il zhana taza yryskylardy korchu. Birde aga kairylyp: <<Oo, Mariiam! Bul yrysky saga kandai keldi?>> - dep suraganda, al aitty: <<Bul yrysky Allakhtan. Chyndygynda Allakh kimge kaalasa esepsiz kenen yrysky beret>>.

Myna oshondo Zakariia paigambar Imrandyn kyzy Mariiamdyn aldynan Allakhtyn yrysky beruudogu adattan tysh zholdorunda Al taraptan kelgen yryskyny korgondo, ozunun zhashy ulgaiyp, kempiri toroi turgan kuraktan otup kalganyna karabastan, Allakhtan bala umut kylyp, myndai dedi: <<Oo, Rabbim! Maga zhakshy bala ber. Chyndygynda Sen duba kylgandardyn dubasyn ugasyn' zhana aga zhoop beresin'>>.

Al syiynuuchu zhaida namazda turgan kezde perishteler chakyryk saldy zhana aga kairylyp myndai deshti: <<Allakh seni Iakh'ia degen uuldu bolot dep suiunchulop zhatat. Anyn ozgocholuktorunun biri - al Allakhtan bolgon sozdu (Mariiamdyn uulu Isany) tastyktait, antkeni al Allakhtan bolgon soz menen ozgocho zharatylyshta zharatylgan. Bul bala ilimde zhana ibadatta eline bashchy bolot, oz napsisin tyiat, kumarlardan, anyn ichinde aialdarga zhakyndoodon karmanat, ozun Rabbisine ibadat kyluuga arnait zhana oshondoi ele salikhterden bolgon paigambar bolot>>.

Perishteler Zakariiaga Iakh'ia tuuraluu suiunchulogondo al aitty: <<Oo, Rabbim! Men ozum kartaiyp, kempirim torobos bolso, anan men kantip balaluu bolmok elem?>>. Allakh anyn sozuno zhoop kylyp myndai dedi: <<Sen karylyk zhashka kelip, aialyn' torotton kalgan kezde Iakh'ianyn toroluusu!- Allakh adatka karshy kelgen nerselerden Ozu kaalaganyn zharatuusuna misal. Antkeni Allakh bardyk nersege kudurettuu, Oz daanyshmandygy zhana ilimi menen kaalaganyn kylat>>.

Zakariia: <<Oo, Rabbim! Aialym menden boiunda bolgon kezde belgi ber>> - dedi. Allakh aitty: <<Sen suragan belgin' - ech kandai kemchilikke kabylbastan adamdar menen uch kun, uch tun isharat menen gana suiloshup kalasyn'. Andyktan erten' menen zhana kechinde Allakhty kop zikir kyl zhana aruula>>.

Oo, paigambar! Estechi, bir kezde perishteler Mariiamga aitty: <<Allakh seni maktoogo tatyktuu sypattarga ee bolgonun' uchun tandady, seni kemchilikterden tazalady zhana zamanyn'dagy aalamdagy aialdardan tandap aldy.
Oo, Mariiam! Namazda uzakka tur, Rabbin'e sazhda kyl zhana Anyn takyba pendelerinen ruku kylgandar menen birge Aga ruku kyl>>.

Oo, paigambar! Zakariia menen Mariiam tuuraluu aitylgan bul kabar - Biz saga vakhii kyluuchu kaiyp kabarlarynan. Sen al aalymdar menen takyba adamdar Mariiamdy tarbiialoogo kim tatyktuu dep talashyp-tartyshyp zhatkanda zhanynda emes bolchun', alar akyry chuchu kulakka toktolup, kalemderin tashtashty, oshondo Zakariianyn kalemi utup chykty.

Oo, paigambar! Estechi, perishteler aityshty: <<Oo, Mariiam! Allakh saga atasyz zharaluuchu uuldu suiunchulop zhatat. Chyndygynda al Allakhtyn <<bol>> degen sozu menen gana ishke ashyp, Allakhtyn uruksaty menen oshol zamat bala bolot. Bul balanyn aty Al'-Masikh Isa ibn Mariiam.
