Anyn bul duinodo da, akyrette da ordu biiik zhana al Allakh taalaga zhakyndardan bolot>>.

Al tili chyga turgan ubakka cheiinki ymyrkai bala kezinde ele adamdarga suiloit, al emi kuch-kubatka tolup, er zhetilip chon'oigondo alarga kairylyp din zhana duino ishterinde paidaluu nerselerdi suiloit. Al sozdorundo zhana ish-araketterinde takyba adamdardan bolot.

Kuioogo chykpai turup ele balaluu boluuga tan' kalgan Mariiam: <<Maga bir dagy kishi adal zholdo da, aram zholdo da zholoboso, men kantip balaluu bolmok elem?!>> - dedi. Perishte aga aitty: <<Allakh saga atasyz uul zharatkany syiaktuu adatka karshy kelgen nerselerden Ozu kaalaganyn zharatat. Eger bir ishti kaalasa, aga <<bol>> deit, al oshol zamat ishke ashat. Any ech bir nerse alsyz kaltyra albait.
Al aga zhazuunu, tuuralykty, soz menen ish-arakette iigilikke zhetuunu uirotot, aga Musaga tushurgon Tooratty uirotot zhana aga zhakynda tushuro turgan Inzhildi uirotot.

Oshondoi ele any Israil urpaktaryna elchi kylat, al alarga aitat: <<Men silerge zhiberilgen Allakhtyn elchisimin zhana silerge paigambarlygymdyn chyndygyn bildirgen belgiler menen keldim, alar: men silerge ylaidan kush zhasap, aga uilosom, al Allakhtyn uruksaty menen tiruu kushka ailanat, tubasa sokurdu aiyktyram, al korup kalat, ala oorusuna chaldykkandardyn terisin kalybyna keltirem, olgon adamdy tiriltem. Ushulardyn baarysy Allakhtyn uruksaty menen bolot. Silerge tamak-ashtardan emneni zhep, emneni uiun'ordo katyp zhatkanyn'ardy aityp berem. Men silerge aitkan adam balasynyn kudureti zhetpegen myndai uluu ishter, eger siler yimandy kaalasan'ar zhana dalilderge ishensen'er, anda menin silerge Allakhtyn elchisi ekendigime achyk belgi bolot.

Oshondoi ele silerge maga cheiin tushurulgon Tooratty tastyktoo uchun keldim, silerge zhen'il bolsun uchun buga cheiin aram kylyngan kee bir nerselerdi adal kyluu uchun keldim zhana silerge aitkandarym chyndyk ekendigin korsotkon achyk dalilder menen keldim. Andyktan Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtoo menen Andan korkkula zhana men silerdi chakyrgan nersede maga bash iigile.

Antkeni Allakh menin da Rabbim, silerdin da Rabbin'er. Al zhalgyz Ozu gana bash iidiruugo zhana korkuuga tatyktuu. Andyktan Aga gana syiyngyla. Men silerdi Allakhka syiyngyla zhana Andan korkkula dep chakyrgan nerse - ech kandai burmalanuusu zhok tuura zhol>>.

Isa alardyn kaapyrlyktan kaitpastygyn bilgende, Israil urpaktaryna kairylyp: <<Allakhka daavat kyluuda kim maga zhardamchy bolot?>> - dedi. Any eerchigenderden takybalary: <<Biz Allakhtyn dinine zhardam berebiz. Biz Allakhka yiman keltirdik zhana seni eerchidik. Oo, Isa! Kubo bol, biz Allakhty zhalgyzdap, Aga moiun sunuu menen Any eerchiibiz>> - deshti.

Oshondoi ele shakirtteri aityshty: <<Rabbibiz, Biz Sen tushurgon Inzhilge yiman keltirdik zhana Isany eerchidik. Bizdi Saga zhana elchilerin'e yiman keltirip, akyikatka kubo bolgondor menen birge kyl>>.

Israil urpaktarynyn kaapyrlary ailakerlik kylyp Isany olturuugo araket zhasashty. Allakh da ailakerlik kylyp, alardy adashkan boiuncha kaltyrdy zhana bashka adamdy Isaga okshotup koidu. Allakh ailakerlerdin en' myktysy, antkeni dushmanga kylgan ailakerlikte Andan ech kim oto albait.

Allakhtyn alarga kylgan dagy bir ailakerligi, Al Isaga kairylyp: <<Oo, Isa! Men seni olturboston alyp ketem, denen'di zhana rukhun'du Ozumo kotorup ketem. Saga kaapyrlyk kylgandardyn yplastygynan seni tazalap, alardy senden alystatam. Al emi akyikat dinde (anyn ichinde Mukhammadga yiman keltiruu da bar) seni eerchigenderdi kyiamatka cheiin dalil zhana kadyr-bark menen saga kaapyrlyk kylgandardan zhogoru kylam. Andan kiiin kyiamatta zhalgyz Maga kaityp kelesin'er, oshondo siler oz ara talashyp-tartyshkan nerselerde akyikat menen okum chygaram.

Al emi saga zhana sen alyp kelgen akyikatka kaapyrlyk kylgandardy bul duinodo olturuu, tutkundoo, kordukka saluu zh.b. kataal azap menen, akyrette bolso tozok azaby menen azaptaimyn. Alardy azaptan kutkargan ech kandai zhardamchy bolboit>>.

Al emi saga zhana sen alyp kelgen akyikatka yiman keltirgenderge zhana namaz, zeket, orozo, tuugandyk mamileni bekemdoo zh.b. ushul syiaktuu zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandarga Allakh alardyn ish-araketterinin soobun kemitpesten toluk beret. Bul soz Isa paigambar ozu kush kabaryn bergen Mukhammad paigambar kelgenge cheiinki anyn zholdoochulary tuuraluu aityldy. Allakh zaalymdardy zhakshy korboit. Allakh taalaga shirk kyluu zhana Anyn elchilerin zhalganga chygaruu - en' chon' zulumduktardan.
Biz saga okup zhatkan Isa paigambardyn kabary - saga tushkon nersenin chyndyk ekendigin korsotkon achyk belgilerden. Al - takybalar uchun eskertme, ech kandai zhalgandy alyp kelbegen akyikat.

Allakhtyn Isany zharatuusunun misaly, Adamdy atasyz zhana enesiz topuraktan zharatkanyna ele okshosh. Chyndygynda Allakh aga <<bol>> dedi, al Allakh taala kaalagandai boldu. Emnege alar Adamdy atasyz zhana enesiz zharalganyna karabastan pende ekenin moiunga alyp, al emi Isanyn atasyz zharalganyn betke karmap any kudai dep oilop zhatyshat?!
Isa tuuraluu sheksiz chyndyk saga Rabbin' tarabynan tushurulgon. Andyktan shektengenderden zhana ekilengenderden bolbo. Teskerisinche, ozun' turgan akyikatka bekem bol.

Oo, paigambar! Eger Nazhran khristiandary saga Isa zhonundo anyk ilim kelgenden kiiin dele Isa Allakhtyn pendesi emes dep talasha berishse, alarga: <<Kelgile, bizdin zhana silerdin baldaryn'ardy, bizdin zhana silerdin aialdaryn'ardy zhana ozubuzdu kosho katyshuuga chakyryp, baarybyz chogulaly, anan Allakhka duba kylyp, bizdin zhana silerdin aran'ardagy zhalganchylarga kargyshyn'dy tushur dep suranaly>> - dep ait.

Biz Isa zhonundo saga aitkan bul nerse - ech kandai zhalgany zhok zhana shek-kumonsuz chyndyk kabar. Zhalgyz Allakhtan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok. Chyndygynda Allakh Oz mulkundo Kudurettuu zhana Oz bashkaruusunda, buirugunda, zharatuusunda Daanyshman.
Eger alar sen alyp kelgen nerseden zhuz burushsa zhana seni eerchishpese, anda bul alardyn buzukulugunan. Allakh zher betindegi buzukulardy zhakshy bilet zhana zhakynda alardyn zhazasyn beret.

Oo, paigambar! Alarga ait: <<Ei, zhoottordon zhana khristiandardan bolgon kitep eeleri! Kelgile, baarybyz birdei bolgon adilettuu sozgo birigeli: <<Zhalgyz Allakhka ibadat kylabyz zhana Andan bashkanyn ordu zhana darazhasy kanchalyk zhogoru bolso da, Any menen katar ech kimge syiynbaibyz. Oshondoi ele Allakhty tashtap, biri-biribizdi syiynuu zhana bash iiuu uchun kudai tutpaibyz>>. Oo, yimanduular! Egerde alar siler chakyryp zhatkan akyikattan zhana adilettuulukton bash tartyshsa, anda alarga: <<Kubo bolgula, biz Allakhka ozubuzdu tapshyrdyk zhana moiun sunuu menen Any eerchidik>> - dep aitkyla.

Ei, kitep eeleri! Emne uchun Ibrakhimdin dini tuuraluu talashyp zhatasyn'ar? Zhoottor Ibrakhimdi zhoot bolgon deshet, khristiandar bolso any khristian bolgon deshet. Birok siler iudaizm zhana khristian dini anyn olumunon kop ubakyt otkondon kiiin gana paida bolgonun bilesin'er. Siler sozun'ordun zhalgan zhana oiun'ardyn kata ekenine akylyn'ar zhetpeibi?!

Ei, kitep eeleri! Myna, siler ozun'or bilgen dinii ishter zhana silerge tushurulgon nerseler tuuraluu paigambar menen talashyp-tartyshtyn'ar. Emi bolso silerdin kitepterin'erde aitylbagan zhana paigambarlaryn'ar alyp kelbegen Ibrakhimdin ishi zhana anyn dini tuuraluu ozun'or bilbegen nerseler zhonundo emnege talashyp zhatasyn'ar. Allakh ishterdin akyikatyn zhana ichki tabiiatyn bilet, siler bilbeisin'er.

Ibrakhim iudaizm dininde da, khristian dininde da bolgon emes, al zhalgan dinderden alystagan zhana Allakhty zhalgyzdap, Aga moiun sungan adam bolgon. Arab mushrikteri biz anyn dinindebiz dep oiloshkondoi al Allakhka shirk kylgandardan emes ele.

Ibrakhimge koshuluuga en' tatyktuular - alar anyn zamanynda al alyp kelgen nerselerge eerchigender, oshondoi ele adamdardyn arasynan aga en' tatyktuusu - bul Mukhammad paigambar zhana bul ummotton aga yiman keltirgender. Allakh Aga yiman keltirgenderge zhardam beruuchu zhana alardy korgoochu.

Oo, yimanduular! Kitep eelerinen bolgon zhoottor menen khristiandardyn aalymdary silerdi Allakh bagyttagan tuura zholdon adashtyruunu kaalashat, birok ozdorun gana adashtyrat. Antkeni alardyn yimanduulardy adashtyruuga bolgon araketi ozdorunun adashuusun gana kuchotot. Alar ish-araketterinin kesepeti kandai bolorun bilishpeit.

Ei, kitep eelerinen bolgon zhoottor zhana khristiandar! Emne uchun Allakhtyn silerge tushurgon aiat-belgilerine zhana anyn ichinde Mukhammaddyn paigambarlygyn korsotkon nerselerge ishenbeisin'er, anyn akyikat ekeni kitepterin'erde korsotulgonuno ozun'or kubo boldunar go?!

Ei, kitep eeleri! Emne uchun kitepterin'erde tushurulgon akyikatty ozun'ordogu zhalgan menen aralashtyrasyn'ar, andagy chyndykty zhana tuura zholdu zhashyrasyn'ar, anyn ichinde Mukhammaddyn paigambarlygynyn chyndyk ekendigi da kamtylgan zhana akyikatty zhalgandan, tuura zholdu adashuudan aiyrmalap bilesin'er?!

Zhoot aalymdarynyn bir tobu aityshty: <<Musulmandarga tushkon Kuranga erten' menen syrtynan yiman keltirgile, kechinde aga kaapyrlyk kylgyla. Balkim alar silerdin yiman keltirgenden kiiin kaapyrlyk kylganyn'ar sebeptuu: <<Bular bizge karaganda Allakhtyn kitepterin zhakshyraak bilgendikten andan kaityp ketishti>> - dep dininen shektenip, andan kaityp ketishet.

Zhana dagy: <<Yiman keltirbegile zhana dinin'erdi tutungandardy gana eerchigile>> - deshet. Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Chyndygynda akyikatka karai tuura zhol - Allakhtyn tuura zholu, al - silerge berilgen zhakshylyk bashkalarga berilbesin degen korkunuchtan zhe siler alarga tushkon nerseni moiunga alsan'ar, alar Rabbin'erdin aldynda siler menen talashyp-tartyshat degen korkunuchtan ulam siler karmangan zhalgandyk zhana bash iibestik emes>>. Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Zhakshylyk Allakhtyn kolunda, any pendelerinen kimge kaalasa beret. Anyn zhakshylygy bir ele ummotko chektelbeit. Allakhtyn zhakshylygy ken' zhana Al aga tatyktuulardy bilet>>.
Zharatkandarynan kimdi kaalasa, Ozunun meerimine boloit zhana aga tuura zholdu, paigambarlykty, turduu syilyktardy tartuu kylat. Allakh ech kandai chegi zhok uluu zhakshylyk eesi.

Kitep eelerinin arasynda ishenip kop mal-mulk tapshyrsan', amanatyn'dy kaitaryp bergender bar, oshondoi ele alardyn arasynda bir az mal-mulktu tapshyrsan', amanat kylgan nersen'di artynan tushup doolaganda zhana sottoshkondo gana kaitargandary bar. Bul alardyn: <<Biz arabdar uchun zhana alardyn mal-mulkun zhegenibiz uchun kunookor emespiz, antkeni Allakh any bizge adal kylgan>> - degen sozdoru zhana buzuku ishenimderi sebeptuu. Alar Allakhka zhalaa zhaap zhatkandaryn bilip turup ushul zhalgandy aityshat.

Abal alar oilogondoi emes, teskerisinche, alar kunoo alyshat. Birok kim Allakhka zhana Anyn elchilerine yiman keltirip Any menen bolgon mildettenmesin atkarsa, amanatka bekem bolup adamdar menen bolgon mildettenmesin atkarsa zhana Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiuularyn tashtap Andan korkso, albette Allakh takybalardy zhakshy korot zhana zhakynda alarga en' zhakshy syilyktardy beret.

Allakh Ozunun kitebinde tushurgon zhana Ozunun elchilerine zhibergen nersege eerchuu tuuraluu alarga kylgan osuiatyn, oshondoi ele Allakh menen bolgon kelishimdi buzbaibyz degen anttaryn arzybagan duino zhyrgalchylygyna almashtyrgandar akyrette ech kandai soopko ee bolushpait, kyiamat kunu Allakh alardy kubanta turgandai soz aitpait, alarga yraiymduuluk menen karabait zhana alarga kyinoochu azap bolot.

Zhoottordun bir tobu bar, siler alardy Toorattan okup zhatat dep oiloshun'ar uchun alar Allakhtan tushurulgon Tooratta zhok ele nerseni tilderi menen burmalap aityshat, birok al Toorattan emes. Teskerisinche, bul alardyn zhalgandarynan zhana Allakhka zhapkan zhalaalarynan. Alar: <<Biz okup zhatkan nerseler Allakhtan tushkon>> - deshet, birok al Allakhtan emes. Alar Allakhka zhana Anyn elchilerine zhalganchylyk kylyp zhatyshkanyn bilip turup, Allakhka karshy zhalgan aityshat.

Kaisy bir adamga Allakh Ozu taraptan kitep tushurso, aga ilim zhana tushunuk berse zhana any paigambar kylyp tandasa, kiiin al adamdarga: <<Allakhty tashtap maga kulchuluk kylgyla>> - dep aituusu mumkun emes. Birok alarga: <<Siler adamdarga tushurulgon kitepti uirotup, oshondoi ele any zhattoo zhana tushunuu menen uirongon nersen'er arkyluu adamdardy tarbiialoochu, alardyn ishterin zhongo saluuchu, ish zhuzundo atkaruuchu ilimduulordon bolgula>> - dep aitat.

Oshondoi ele al silerge Allakhtyn orduna perishtelerdi zhana paigambarlardy kudai tutup syiyngyla dep buiurushu mumkun emes. Siler Allakhka moiun sunup, ozun'ordu toluk tapshyrgandan kiiin silerdi Aga kaapyrlyk kyluuga buirugany bolmok bele?

Oo, paigambar! Estechi, bir kezde Allakh paigambarlardan bekem ubada alyp, alarga myndai dedi: <<Men silerge tushurgon kitepten zhana uirotkon daanyshmandyktan emneni bersem, oshondoi ele aran'ardan kimdir biroo artykchylykka zhana kadyr-barkka zhetse, kiiin Men taraptan Mukhammad silerge elchi bolup kelip, silerdegi kitepti zhana daanyshmandykty tastyktasa, anda siler al alyp kelgen nersege sozsuz yiman keltiresin'er zhana any eerchuu menen zhardam beresin'er. Oo, paigambarlar! Siler ushuga makulsun'arby, Menin bekem kelishimimdi kabyl aldyn'arby? - degende, alar: <<Any kabyl aldyk>> - deshti. Allakh aitty: <<Ozun'orgo zhana ummottorun'orgo kubo bolgula, Men dagy silerge zhana alarga kubo boluuchulardanmyn>>.
Kimde-kim Allakhtyn zhana Anyn elchilerinin kubolugu menen tastyktalgan bul kelishimden zhuz bursa, myna osholor Allakhka bash iibestik kylyp, Anyn dininen chykkandar.

Allakhka bash iibestik kylyp, Anyn dininen chykkandar Allakh pendeleri uchun Ozu tandagan Islam dininen bashkany kaalap zhatyshaby?! Asmandardagy zhana zherdegi makuluktardyn baarysy yimanduulardyn abaly syiaktuu yktyiarduu turdo zhana kaapyrlardyn abaly syiaktuu mazhbur turdo Aga moiun sunup, bagynyshty. Kiiin kyiamat kunu makuluktardyn but baarysy surak beruu uchun, syilyk zhana zhaza aluu uchun Allakh taalaga kaityshat.

Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Allakhty kudai dep yiman keltirdik, Anyn bizge buirugan nerselerine moiun sunduk, bizge tushurgon vakhiiine, oshondoi ele Ibrakhimge, Ismailge, Iskhakka zhana Iakubga tushurgon nerselerge, Iakubdun baldarynan bolgon paigambarlarga tushurgon nerselerge, Musaga, Isaga zhana bardyk paigambarlarga Rabbisinen tushkon kitepterge zhana aiat-belgilerge yiman keltirdik. Biz alardyn birine yiman keltirip, birine kaapyrlyk kylyp, alardy bolup-zharbaibyz. Biz bir gana Allakhka eerchiibiz zhana Aga bagynabyz>>.
Al emi kim Allakh Ozu yraazy bolgon Islamdan bashka dindi kaalasa, Allakh andan any kabyl albait zhana al akyrette tozokko kiruu menen ozdoruno zyian keltirgenderdin katarynda bolot.

Allakhka yiman keltirip, Mukhammad paigambar alyp kelgen nerse akyikat ekendigine kuboluk berip zhana anyn tuuralygyna achyk-aikyn dalilder kelgenden kiiin kaira kaapyrlyk kylgan koomgo Allakh Ozuno zhana elchisine yiman keltiruugo kantip iigilik bersin?! Allakh tuura zholdun orduna adashuunu tandap algan zalym koomdu Aga yiman keltiruugo iigilik berbeit.
Zhalgandy tandap algan zalymdardyn zhazasy - alarga Allakhtyn, perishtelerdin zhana butkul adamdardyn kargyshy bolot. Alar Allakhtyn yraiymynan kuulup, alystatylgandar.
Alar tozokto tuboluk kalyshat, andan chygyshpait, azaptary zhen'ildetilbeit zhana alarga toobo kylyp, kechirim suroo uchun moonot berilbeit.

Birok kaapyrlyk zhana zulumduk kylgandan kiiin Allakhka kaitkandar zhana zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandar gana andaiga kabylbait. Chyndygynda Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerine Kechirimduu, alarga Yraiymduu.

Yiman keltirgenden kiiin kaapyr bolgondor zhana olumdu oz kozu menen korgongo cheiin kaapyrlygyn ulantkandar, olum kelgen kezde tooboloru kabyl kylynbait, sebebi anyn ubaktysy otup ketti. Myna osholor Allakh taalaga alyp baruuchu tuura zholdon adashkandar.

Al emi kaapyrlyk kylyp zhurup oshol abalda olgondor, tozokton kutulush uchun zherdin salmagyndai altyndy sunush kylsa da kabyl kylynbait. Alarga kyinoochu azap bar zhana kyiamatta alardy azaptan kutkargan zhardamchylar bolboit.

Oo, yimanduular! Ozun'or zhakshy korgon mal-mulkun'ordon Allakh zholuna sarptamaiyncha zhakshylyk eelerinin sooptoruna zhana darazhasyna zhete albaisyn'ar. Sarptagan nersen'er az bolobu, zhe kop bolobu, Allakh nietin'erdi zhana ish-araketin'erdi Biluuchu zhana ar birine ish-araketine zharasha syilygyn beret.

Israil urpaktaryna taza tamaktyn baary ele adal bolchu. Bolgonu Toorot tusho eleginde Iakub paigambar kee bir tamaktan ozun tyiyp zhechu emes. bul Iakhudiler aitkandai Toorotto aram kylyngan emes. Oo, paigambar, sen alarga: eger aityp zhatkanyn'ar chyn bolso, Toorottu alyp kelip okup korgulochu, - dep ait. Alar oozunan sozu uchup any alyp kele alyshpait. Bul Iakhudilerdin Toorotko zhalaa zhaap, anyn mazmunun ozgortup zhibergenine dalil bolo turgan bir misal

Iakub paigambar tyiylgan azyktar Allakhtyn tyiuusu emes, zheke ozunun kaaloosu menen tyiyluu degen achyk dalil kelgenden kiiin dele Allakhka bul nerseni zhuktop doomat kyla bergender; alar dalili achyk bolgondon kiiin da chyndykty tashtap zhandaryna zulum kylgandar

Oo, paigambar, alarga ait: Allakh Taala Iakub paigambar tuuraluu tuura kabar aitty, oshondoi ele Anyn ar bir tushurgonu zhana shariiat kylgany chyndyk. Ibrakhimdin dinine eerchigile, Islamdan bashka bardyk dinden zhuz burgan, Allakhka bashka nerseni ech sherik kylgan emes

Chynynda adamdar Allakhka ibadat kyluusu uchun kurulgan zherdegi ui - bul, Mekkedegi Allakhtyn uiu Kharam mechiti. Al oto yiyk ui, duino zhana dinii paidalary kop, anda butundoi aalamga tuura zhol bar

Bul uido anyn sharapattuuluguna zhana ozgocholuguno achyk belgileri bar, ibadat kylyna turgan orundary syiaktuu, misaly, dubalyn turguzuuda Ibrakhim paigambar butunun aldyna koigon tash. Dagy biri, aga kirgen adamdyn zhurogu tynchyp korkuusu zhogolot zhana aga ech zyian bolboit. Adamdarga Allakh uchun bul uidu maksat kylyp kelip azhy amaldaryn atkaruu mildeti zhuktoldu. Bul mildet, aga keluugo mumkunchulugu zhetken adamga gana tiesheluu. Al emi kim azhy amaly parz ekenine kaapyr bolso, Allakh aga muktazh emes, degi ele Allakh Taala aalamda ech nersege muktazh emes

Oo, paigambar, alarga ait: ei, iakhudiler menen khristiandar, emnege menin paigambarlygym tuuraluu achyk dalilder kelip zhatsa dele any tana beresin'er, myndai dalilderdin keesi Toorot menen Inzhilde da kelbedi bele?! Allakh Taala bul kylganyn'ardy karap, aga kubo bolup turat, kiiin oshogo zharasha zhazalanasyn'ar

Oo, paigambar, alarga mintip ait: Ei, iakhudiler zhana khristiandar, Allakhka ishengen adamdardy emne uchun Anyn dininen tyiasyn'ar, Allakhtyn dinin chyndyktan zhalganga ozgortuugo araket kylasyn'ar dindegilerdi tuura zholdon adashuuga uguttoisun'or. A ozun'or bul din chynygy din ekenine, silerdin kitebin'erdi tastyktap kelgenine kubo bolup turasyn'ar?! Allakh Taala siler Aga kaapyrlyk kylyp, Anyn zholunan tosup zhatkanyn'ardan beikapar emes, kiiin ushuga zharasha zhazalanasyn'ar.

Oo, Allakhka ishenip, paigambardy eerchigen yimanduular, eger iakhudi zhe khristiandardyn kee bir taipalary aityp zhatkan sozgo kirsen'er zhana alardyn oiuna eerchisen'er, yimanyn'ardan kiiin kaira kaapyrlykka eerchitip ketet, antkeni alarda silerdi koralbastygy zhana tuura zholdon adashuu bar

Allakhka yiman keltirgenden kiiin kaira kantip kaapyr bolosun'ar, yimanyn'ardy saktap turuuga chon' sebepter turbaiby! Allakhtyn aiattary okulup zhatat, Anyn elchisi Mukhammad (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) silerge achyk baiandap zhatat. Kim Allakhtyn dinin zhana paigambardyn sunnotun bekem karmansa, Allakh Taala any adashuusu zhok tuura, tuz zholgo bagyttap koiot

Oo, Allakhka ishengen, paigambarga eerchigen yimanduular, Zharatuuchun'ardan chyndap korkkula, bul Anyn buiruktaryn atkaruu, kunoolordon tyiyluu, neemattaryna shugur kyluu arkyluu bolot. Azhalyn'ar zhetip otup ketkichen'er dinin'erde bekem bolgula

Oo, yimanduular, kitep zhana sunnottu bekem karmagyla, bolunup-zharyluuga alap barchu ishterden sak bolgula. Islamdan murda bolbogon sebep menen sogushup, dushman elen'er, Allakh Taala zhurogun'ordu islamga biriktirip, biri-birin'e yraiymduu, zhardam beruuchu dindesh bir tuugan boldun'ar. Allakhtyn myna ushul neematyn estegile. Buga cheiin kaapyrlygyn'ar menen tozokko bet algan elen'er, andan Allakh Taala Islam menen kutkaryp kaldy zhana yimanga bashtady. Allakh Taala siler tuz zholdo bekem boluun'ar, tuura zholdo zhuruun'or zhana duino, akyrette abalyn'ar zhakshy boluusu uchun myna ushintip aiattaryn baiandady

Oo, yimanduular, silerden Allakhka zhakkan badyk zhakshylykka undogon, shariiat talap kylgan zhana akylga syia turgan zhakshy ishterge chakyrgan, shariiatta tyiuu salyngan zhana akylga da tuura kelbegen zhaman ishterden kaitargan zhamaat bolsun. Myna ushular duino zhana akyrette zhen'ishke zhetken adamdar

Oo, yimanduular, bolunup-zharylyp bir kancha taipa, toptorgo ailangan kitep berilgenderge okshobogula. Alar Allakh Taaladan achyk-aikyn aiat, dalilder kelgenden kiiin dininde karshylash bolup ketishti. Bularga Allakh Taalanyn katuu azaby bolot

Alarga bul katuu azap kyiamat kunu bolot. Bul kunu yimanduulardyn zhuzu kubanych zhana bakyttan ulam agaryp nurdanyp turat. Kaapyrlardyn zhuzu bolso kaigy zhana kyiynchylyktan ulam kararyp ketet. Al uluk kundo zhuzu kararyp kalgandarga: Ishenip, tastyktaganyn'ardan kiiin Allakhtyn Zhalgyzdygyna kaapyr bolup, Aga ech sherik kylbagyla degen kelishimin buzdun'arby?! Emi ushul kaapyrlygyn'ar sebeptuu silerge daiardalyp koiulgan azaptyn daamyn tata bergile
A berki zhuzu agargan adamdardyn ordu neemattuu beiishte, anda tuboluk kalyshat, anyn neemat zhakshylygy azaibait zhana tugonboit

Allakhtyn bul zhakshylykty zhana zhamandykty ubada kylgan aiattaryn saga, oo, paigambar, chynygy kabar, adilettuu okum menen okup berebiz. Allakh Taala aalamda ech kimge zaalymdyk kylbait, ar kimdi kylgan ishine zharasha gana azaptait
Asman zherdeginin baarynyn zharaluusu da, bashkaryluusu da Zhalgyz Allakhka tiesheluu, baarynyn ishi Aga kaitat, anan ar birine ozuno tiesheluu zhazasyn zhe syiyn beret

Oo, Mukhammad paigambardyn (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) ummotu, siler ummottordun arasynan yimanyn'arda zhana amalyn'arda en' zhakshy ummot boldun'ar. Adamdarga en' paidaluu boldun'ar, shariiat korsotkon zhana akylga tuura kelgen zhakshy ishterge chakyrasyn'ar, shariiat tyiuu salgan zhana akylga syibas zhaman ishterden tyiasyn'ar. Allakhka chyndap ishenip, ishenimin'erdi ish zhuzundo dalildeisin'er. Eger tigi kitep berilgen iakhudiler menen khristiandar Mukhammad paigambarga (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) ishenishse alardyn duino akyreti uchun zhakshy bolmok. Alardyn arasynan azy gana Mukhammad paigambar (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) alyp kelgen dinge ishenishti, kobu Allakhtyn dini zhana shariiatynan syrtta kaldy

Oo, yimanduular, alardyn dushmandygy kanchalyk kuchobosun silerdin dinin'erge zhana ozun'orgo ech zyian tiigize albait, bolgonu doomat artyp, zhe silerdi shyldyn'dap tili menen zyian tiigizet. Kokus sogushup kalsan'ar, aldyn'arga tushup kachyshat, alarga ech kim ech kachan zhardam berbeit

Iakhudiler kaida barbasyn kor, zher koz bolup zhurushot. Allakhtyn zhe adamdardyn kelishimin atkaryp zhashashsa gana tynch bolushat. Alar Allakhtyn kaar-kazabyna kalyshty, emi alar muktazhdykta bechara omur surushot. Sebebi alar Allakhtyn aiatyna kaapyrlyk kylyshty, zaalymdyk menen paigambarlaryn olturushtu, kunoogo batyp Allakh chiigen chekten chygyp ketishti

Allakh Taala kitep berilgenderdin kopchulugunun abalyn baiandagandan kiiin,emi alardyn tuura zholdo bekem bolgon kee bir taipasy tuuraluu soz kylat:
Kitep berilgenderdin baarynyn abaly okshosh emes, alardyn arasynda Allakhtyn dininde bekem bolgon taipasy da bar. Buirugun atkarat, kunoodon tyiylat, Allakh uchun namazga turup, tunu Allakhtyn aiattaryn okuit. Bul taipa Mukhammad paigambar (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) zhiberilgenge cheiin bolchu. Alardyn kataryndagylardan paigambarybyzdyn paigambarlygyna zhetkeni, Islamdy kabyl kyldy.

Allakhka zhana kyiamat kununo sheksiz, toluk ishenishet, tuura, zhakshy ishterge chakyrat, tyiuu salyngan, zhaman ishterden kaitaryshat. Zhakshy amaldardy zhasoogo shashylat. ibadattyn zhemishin tatyshat. Bular niet zhana amaly tuz bolgon pendeler

Bular zhakshy ishteri azby, koppu, anyn soobu zhogolboit zhana kemibeit. Buirugun atkaryp, tyiganynan tyiylgan takyba kishilerdi Allakh zhakshy bilet. Alardyn emne kylyp zhatkanynan bei kapar emes, kiiin alardy oshol amaldaryna zharasha syilait

Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyr bolgondorgo mal-duinosu, bala-chakasy ech paida berbeit, Allakhtyn azabynan arachalai albait. Allakh alarga yraiym kylbait, alardyn azabyn zhana okunuchun arttyrat. Alar tozokto tuboluk kaluuchular

Al kaapyrlardyn zhumshagan zhakshylyktary zhana soobun kutup oturgan ishteri, shamalga okshosh; al yzgaarduu shamal kunoosu menen oz zhandaryna zyian kylgan kaisy bir koomdun eginin talkalap zhok kylat. Alar bolso egininen kop zhakshylykty umut kylyp oturgan ele. Shamal talkalap ketkenden kiiin al eginden kypyndai da paida korushpoit. Oshol syiaktuu kaapyrlar da amaldarynyn soobun umut kylyshat. Allakh Taala ch kimge zulum kylbait, birok tigiler Allakhka kaapyr bolup, Anyn elchisin zhalganga chygaryp ozdoruno ozdoru zulum kylyshty

Oo, Allakhka ishengen zhana Anyn elchisin eerchigen yimanduular, momundardan bashkalardy syrdash, akyldash kylbagyla. Alarga ozun'ordun syryn'ardy achpagyla zhana abalyn'ardy bildirbegile. Alar silerge zyian tiigizuudon abalyn'ardy buzuudan kaira tartpait. Silerge mashakat zharatyp, zyianyn tiigizuunu samashat. Alardyn dushmandygy zhana zhek koruusu, dinin'erdi kemsintken, syryn'ardy zhaiyltkan, orton'orgo ot zhakkan sozdorunon bilinip turat. Al emi ichine katkan zhek koruusu andan da zhaman. Ei, momundar, eger Zharatuuchun'ar tushurgon nersege zhakshy akyl zhugurtson'or, silerge duino, akyrette paidasyn tiigize turgan achyk dalilderdi baian kyldyk.

Oo, yimanduular, siler al koomdu zhakshy korup, alarga zhakshylyk kaalaganyn'ar menen alar silerge zhakshylyk kaalabait, teskerisinche, silerge zhaaldanat. Siler bardyk kitepterge anyn ichinde alardyn kitebine da ishenesin'er. Alar bolso Allakh Taala silerdin paigambaryn'arga tushurgon kitepke ishenishpeit. Silerge zholukkanda til uchunda: yiman keltirdik deshet. Al emi ozdoru menen ozdoru kalganda siler bir oozdon yraazy bolup, birigip alganyn'arga, Islamdyn yzatyna, a ozdoru kor bolup kalganyna ichi kuiup, silerdi zhek korup manzhalaryn chainashat. Ei, paigambar, al koomgo kairylyp: ushul achuulangan, zhek korgon abalyn'ardy zhurup otup ketkile, Allakh Taala kokurokto zhashyrylgan yiman zhana kaapyrlykty, zhakshylyk zhana zhamandykty bilip turat - dep ait.

Oo, yimanduular, eger dushmandaryn'ardy zhen'sen'er, zhe mal-mulk, bala-chakan'ar koboiso, alar buga kyzhaalat bolup kaigyrat. A eger dushmanyn'ardan zhen'ilsen'er, zhe mal-mulk, bala-chakan'ar azaisa, buga kubanyshat zhana silerge zhaman aitat. Siler takyba bolup, alardyn kylyk-zhoruguna sabyr kylsan'ar, alardyn kylgany zhana kuuluk-shumduktary silerge zyianyn tiigizbeit. Allakh Taala alardyn kuuluk-shumdugun bilip turat zhana alardy kaigyrgan abalda kaitarat

Oo, paigambar, estegin, tan' erte Madinadan chygyp Ukhudda butparastar menen sogushuu uchun momundardy ordu-orduna zhaigashtyrdyn', ar birine ordun tabyshtadyn'. Allakh silerdin sozun'ordu Uguuchu, ishin'erdi Biluuchu

Oo, paigambar, estegin, Banu Salama zhana Banu Kharisa uruularynan bolgon momundardyn eki taipasy munafyktar kaira tartkanda, ozdorun alsyz sezip zhen'ishten umutu uzuldu. Allakh Taala alardyn umutun zhandyruu zhana sogushta turuktuu kyluu menen zhardam beruuchu. Momundar bardyk abalda Allakh Taalaga gana taianyp, suionushsun

Badr sogushunda da silerdin sanyn'ar, kural-zharagyn'ar az bolgonu uchun alsyz bolup turganyn'arda butparastardy zhen'uun'orgo Allakh Taala zhardam bergen. Allakhtan korkkula, silerge bergen zhakshylyktaryna shugur kylgyla

Oo, paigambar, estegin, oshondo, Badrda butparastarga zhardam kelgenin ugushkanda momundarga sen dagy: Allakh Taala silerge zhardam bersin dep uch min' perishteni tushurgonu zhetishtuu emespi?! dep aittyn'.

Eger ushul zhetishtuu bolup, sogushka sabyr kylyp chydap tursan'ar zhana Allakhka takyba bolson'or, silerge Allakhtan dagy bir zhardam boloru suiunchulonot. Dushmandaryn'ar silerge atyrylyp kol salary menen kaapyrlardyn ailasyn bilgen, achyk belgileri bar besh min' perishte menen zhardam beret.

Allakh Taala bul zhardamyn zhana perishteler arkyluu koldoosun silerdin zhurogun'or tynchtansyn uchun kubanychtuu kabar kyldy. Bolboso, negizi zhardam myndai achyk sebepter menen bolboit. Zhardam chynynda ech kim ustomduk kyla albai turgan Yzattuu, tagdyry zhana shariiatynda Daanyshman Allakhtan bolot
Badrdagy silerge berilgen zhen'ish arkyluu Allakh Taala sogushta kaapyrlardyn bir tobun kyiratyp, bir tobun achuulangan, kordolgon, umutsuz abalda kaitaruunu kaalady

Ukhudda kyiroogo uchuragandan kiiin Allakhtyn elchisi butparastardyn bashchylaryn daabat kylganda, Allakh Taala: senin kolun'da alardy ary-beri kyla turgan ech mumkunchuluk zhok, Allakh alarga okum chygargancha sabyr kylyp kuto tur. Alar zhe toobo kylyp musulman bolushat, zhe kaapyr boiuncha kala berishet da azapka tush bolot. Alar azapka tatyktuu zaalymdar - dedi.

Zharatuuda, bashkaruuda da asman-zherdeginin baary Allakhtyn mulku, pendelerinen kimdi kaalasa, aga yraiym kylyp kunoosun kechiret, kimdi kaalasa adildigi menen any azaptait. Toobo kylgan pendelerine Allakh Taala yraiymduu zhana Kechirimduu

Oo, Allakhka ishenip, paigambardy eerchigen yimanduular, bergen karyzyn'ardyn ustuno ustok paiyz alyp sutkorluk kyluudan saktangyla. Myndaidy islamdan murdagy doordo kylyshchu. Buirugun atkaruu zhana kunoodon tyiyluu menen Allakhka takyba bolgula. Oshondo bul duinodo zhana akyrette kaalagan zhakshylygyn'arga zheteersin'er
Allakh Taala kaapyrlarga daiardap koigon tozok menen ozun'odun orton'orgo tosmo koigula, bul tosmo zhakshy amaldardy atkaruu, kunoodon tyiyluu menen bolot
Buirugun atkaruu zhana tyiganynan tyiyluu menen Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine bash iigile. Oshondo bul duinodo dagy, akyrette dagy yraiymga ee boloorsun'ar

Ibadattyn turlorun atkaruu menen Allakhka zhakyndoogo, zhakshylyktardy zhasoogo shashylgyla; Allakhtyn kenen kechirimine zhetuun'or uchun zhana chon'dugu asman-zherdei beiishke kiruun'or uchun, any Allakh Taala takyba pendelerine daiardagan

Chynygy takybalar, bular barchylykta da, zhokchulukta da Allakh zholunda sadaga bergen, och aluuga kuchu zhetip turup achuusun zhutkan, zyianyn tiigizgen adamdardy kechirip zhibergen adamdar. Myna ushundai akhlaktagy adamdardy Allakh Taala zhakshy korot

Bular kokustan chon' kunoo kylyp alyshsa, zhe maida kunoolordu zhasasa, Allakhty estep, Anyn kunookorlorgo ubada kylgan azabyn estep, takybalarga ubada kylgan zhyrgaldy estep, kylganyna okunup, daroo Allakhtan kunoolorun zhashyruunu zhana kechiruunu suranyp tobo kylyshat. Antkeni, kunoonu Zhalgyz Allakhtan bashka kim kechirmek ele. Bular kunoo kylganyn zhana Allakh Taala bardyk kunoolordu kechiruuchu ekenin bilip turup, kunoosun kaira-kaira ulanta berbeit.

Ushundai maktoogo tatyktuu sypattar menen sypattalgandar, alardyn soop-syiy Allakh alardyn kunoosun zhashyrat zhana kechiret, alar uchun akyrette ak sarailardyn astynan daryialary agyp turgan beiish bar. Anda tuboluk turushat. Bul Allakhka bash iiip amal kyluuchularga berilgen kandai sonun neemat

Momundar Ukhud kunu bashyna ish tushup synalganda, Allakh Taala alardyn kon'ulun tynchytyp myndai dedi: Silerden murdagy doorlordo da kaapyrlardy kyiratkan uchurlar bolgon, synoodon kiiin momundarga akybeti berilgen. Zher betin karap, Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine zhalganchy bolgondordun abaly kandai bolgonuna, zhashagan zherleri an'gyrap bosh kalyp, zhyigan mulku typtyipyl bolup ketkenine etibar bergile
Bul Kasiettuu Kuran zhalpy adamdarga chyndykty baiandoochu, zhalgandy eskertuuchu, tuura zholgo bagytoochu zhana takybalarga nasaatchy. Antkeni, myndan paidalanuuchular tuura zholgo bagyt alat

Oo, yimanduular, Ukhud kunundo bolgon ishke okunbogulo zhana alsyrabagyla, myndai kyluu silerge ylaiyk emes. Siler eger Allakhka zhana Anyn yimanduularga bergen ubadalaryna ishensen'er, yimanyn'ar menen, Allakhtyn zhardamy menen zhana Anyn zhardamyn umut kyluu menen ar daiym zhogoru bolosun'ar

Oo, yimanduular, Ukhud kunu silerde olum, zharakat koop bolso, Badrda kaapyrlarga ushundai bolgon. Allakh Taala myndai kundordu momundarga da, kaapyrlarga da keede kaalasa zhen'dirip kaalasa, zhen'ildirip ailanta beret, munu kop syry bar; anyn biri: chynygy yimanduulardy munafyktardan aiyrmaloo, dagy biri, kaalagan adamyn sheiittik menen syiloo. Zhikhaddy tanyp ozuno-ozu zulum kylgandardy Allakh Taala zhakshy korboit
Bul syrlardyn keesi, momundardy kunoosunon tazaloo, alardyn arasyn munafyktardan aryltuu zhana kaapyrlardy kyiratyp zhok kyluu
Oo, yimanduular, siler Allakh zholunda chyndap zhikhad kylganyn'ardy zhana bashyn'arga kelgen baleege sabyr kylganyn'ardy biluu uchun synalbai turup ele beiishke kirebiz dep oilodun'arby?!

Oo, yimanduular, olumgo sebep bolgon katuu sogushka katyshkanga cheiin, biz da Badr sogushunda sheiit bolgondor syiaktuu sheiit bolsok dep kaapyrlar menen bet keluunu samabadyn'ar bele? Myna Ukhud kunu oshol samaganyn'ar boldu, munu oz kozun'or menen kordun'or

Ukhud kunu askerlerge paigambar (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salymattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) olturuldu dep kabar zhaiylganda, sogushtan bash tartyp oturup algan musulmandardy zhekirip Allakh Taala myndai dedi:
Mukhammad murda zhiberilip olgon zhe olturulgon elchiler syiaktuu ele Allakhtyn elchisi. Eger al olso zhe olturulso siler dinin'erden kaityp ketesin'erbi, zhikhaddy tashtap koiosun'arby? Dininen kaityp ketken adam Allakhka kypyndai zyianyn tiigizbeit; antkeni, Allakh Yzattuu, Kuchtuu. Dininen kaitkan adam duino zhana akyrette okunuchko kalyp, ozunun zhanyna zyian kylat. Dininde bekem, Allakh zholundagy sogushta turuktuu bolgonu uchun Allakh Taala shugur kyluuchulardy chon' syilyk menen syilait.

Adam kachan Allakh Taala zhazgan kunu butup azhaly zhetmeiinche olboit, buga koshumcha da kyla albait, kemite da albait. Kim kylgan amalyna duino zhakshylygyn kaalasa, aga olchomdogu zhakshylyk berilet, birok akyrette aga ech nerse berilbeit. A kim kylgan amalyna akyret soobun umut kylsa, aga akyrette soobu berilet, Zharatuuchusuna shugur kylgandardy oto chon' syi menen syilaibyz

Koptogon paigambarlardyn sakhabalary paigambarlary menen birge olum, zharakat koshtogon sogushtarga katyshkan. Alar dushmanga karshy turuuda alsyzdyk kylgan emes, sabyr kylyp, turuktuu bolushkan. Allakh Taala Anyn zholundagy kyiynchylykka sabyr kylgandardy zhakshy korot.

Al, sabyrduular bashyna balee tushkondo: Zharatuuchubuz, bizdin kunoobuzdu, ishibizde chekten chygyp ketkenibizdi kechir, dushmandar menen betme-bet kelgende kadamybyzdy bekem kyl, saga kaapyr bolgon koomgo karshy bizge zhardam ber - dep aityshkan.

Allakh Taala alarga zhardam zhana zhen'ishke mumkunchuluk beruu menen syilady. A akyrette bolso neemattuu beiish, Ozunun yraazylygy syiaktuu soop-syi tartuulait. Ibadatynda zhana mamilesinde zhakshy bolgondordu Allakh Taala zhakshy korot

Oo, Allakhka ishengen, paigambardy eerchigen momundar, eger iakhudi, khristian zhe butparas kaapyrlarga bash iisen'er, yimanyn'ardan kiiin silerdi ozdorunun kaapyrlygyna tartat, anan duino, akyrette okunuuchulordon bolosun'ar

Al kaapyrlar siler alarga bash iisen'er da zhardam berbeit. Al emi Allakh dushmanyn'arga karshy silerge zhardam beruuchu, Aga bash iigile, Al Kemchiliksiz Allakh zhardam beruuchulordun en' zhakshysy, Andan kiiin ech kimdin zhardamyna muktazh bolboisun'ar

Kaaloolorun eerchip, ech dalili zhok ele Allakhka bashka nerselerdi sherik kylyp, anan aga syiyngany uchun kaapyrlardyn zhuroguno katuu korkunuch salabyz. Anan siler menen sogushuuda turushtuk bere albait. Alardyn akyrette tura turgan zhailary tozok. Zaalymdardyn zhaiy bolgon tozok kandai zhaman

Ukhud kunu Allakhtyn uruksaty menen siler kaapyrlardy kyryp-zhoiup kirgenin'erde, Allakh Taala silerge zhen'ish berem degen ubadasynyn ustunon chykkan bolchu. Kiiin siler Allakhtyn elchisi silerdi buirugan ishte alsyzdyk kylyp zhana ordun'arda kaluu zhe ordun'ardy tashtap, olzho zhyiuuga kirishuu zhonundo talashtyn'ar. Abal kandai ozgorso da eelegen ordun'ardan zhylbagyla degen Allakhtyn elchisine kunookor boldun'ar. Bul, siler dushmanyn'ardy zhen'uunu kaalap turganyn'ardan kiiin boldu. Silerdin aran'ardagy duino olzhosun kaalagandar, eelegen orundaryn tashtap koiushtu. Al emi akyret soobun kaalagandar, Allakhtyn elchisine bash iiip orundarynda kalyshty. Andan kiiin Allakh Taala silerdi synoo uchun alardy silerge ustom kylyp koidu. Bashyna kelgen baleege aly zhetpei, kadamy titirep chynygy sabyrduu yimanduular achyk boldu. Anan Allakh Taala paigambardyn buirugun atkarbai koigonun'ardy kechirdi. Allakh Taala yimanduularga ushundai artykchylyk kylat, alardy yimanga bashtait, kunoolorun kechiret, kyiynchylyktan chygarat.

Oo, yimanduular, estegile, Ukhud kunu sogushka chykkanyn'arda, Allakhtyn elchisi aitkan ishti kylbai kyiynchylykka kabylyp, biri-birin'e karabai kachyp zhonogonun'ordo, Allakhtyn elchisi silerdin artyn'arda siler menen butparastardyn ortosunda kalyp, silerge: ei, Allakhtyn kuldary! Maga kaitkyla! Ei, Allakhtyn kuldary! Maga kaitkyla dep kyikyryp zhatty. Zhen'ishti zhana olzhonu ozun'or koldon chygaryp alganynar uchun Allakh ushintip yza, kyiynchylyk menen zhazalady. Al az kelgensip, aran'arda paigambar olturuldu degen kep tarady. Bul siler zhanagy koldon chygargan zhen'ish menen olzhogo zhana olgondor menen zharatkattangandarga okunboshun'or uchun boldu. Kachan Allakhtyn elchisi tiruu ekenin ukkanyn'arda kaigy-kapa, okunuchtun baary unutuldu. Allakh Taala silerdin kylgan ishin'erden kabardar. Zhuroktogu nietter da, syrtky ish-araketter da Allakhka zhashyruun kalbait

Kyinalyp-kystalyp, zhabyrkaganyn'ardan son', Allakh silerge beipildik berdi. Allakhtyn ubadasyna ishengen adamdardy zhen'il uiku basyp, zhuroktoruno beipildik ornodu. Al emi kert bashynyn kyzykchylygyn oilogon munafyktardy uiku baspady, alardyn zhurogu da es albady. Alar tynchsyzdanyp, korkup, Allakh Taala elchisine da, pendelerine da zhardam berbeit dep, tigi zhakhiliiat doorunda Allakhtyn kadyryna shek keltirishkeni syiaktuu mynda da zhaman kumondo bolushtu. Alar Allakhty zhakshy taanybagany sebeptuu: bizde bul sogushka chyga turchu oiubuz da zhok ele, eger oiubuzga koigondo, bul zherge kelbeit elek deshti. Ei, paigambar, alarga zhoop kylyp, myndai de: "Ishtin baary Allakhtyn kolunda, Al kaalagandai tagdyr kylat, kaalagan okumun zhurguzot, silerdin bul zhakka chyguun'ardy Al tagdyr kylgan". Munafyktar zhaman, shektuu kumon sanagany uchun korkup saga achygyn aityshpait: eger bul zhakka chyguuga bizdin oiubuzga koigondo sogushka chykpait elek deshet. Ei, paigambar, sen alardyn aitkanyn zhokko chygaryp: "Siler eger sogush talaasynan, andagy olumdon alys ozun'ordun uiun'ordo oltursan'ar da, Allakh zhazyp koigon olum maaly kelse, olosun'or. Allakh Taala munu (sogushtu) silerdin niet, maksatyn'ardy teksheruu zhana yimanduu menen munafykty azhyratuu uchun zhazdy. Allakh Taala pendenin kokurogundogu syrdy Biluuchu, Aga ech nerse zhashyruun kalbait

Oo, Mukhammad paigambardyn sakhabalary, Ukhud kunu butparastar menen musulmandar betteshkende silerdin aran'ardagy artka kachkandardy alardyn kee bir kunoosu sebeptuu shaitan azgyrdy. Allakh alardy kechirdi, yraiymy zhana artykchylygy menen alardy zhazalabady. Allakh Taala toobo kyluuchulardyn toobosun kabyl kyluuchu, alardy zhazaloogo shashylbagan Zhumshak peiil.

Oo, Allakhka ishengen, paigambardy eerchigen yimanduular, yrysky izdep saparga chygyp zhe, kazatka attanyp oshondo olgon zhe olturulgon bir tuugandary tuuraluu, eger alar bizdin zhanybyzdan alys chykpaganda olboit ele dep aitkan munafyk kaapyrlarga okshobogula. Allakh Taala alardyn zhurogundogu okunuch zhana kaigyny koboituu uchun alarga ushundai tuura emes ishenimdi kirgizip koigon. A chyny, Allakh Oz kaaloosu menen olturot zhana tiriltet. Anyn tagdyryndagy olumdu uido olturuu toktotpoit, zhe sogushka chyguu tezdetpeit. Allakh silerdin kylganyn'ardy Koruuchu, amalyn'ar Aga zhashyruun emes, oshol amalyn'arga zharasha syi korosun'or zhe zhazalanasyn'ar

Oo, momundar, siler Allakh zholunda olturulson'or zhe olson'or, Allakh silerdin kunoon'ordu kechiret zhana yraiym kylat, myna ushul bul duinodon zhana anda zhyiylgan ertebi-kechpi zhok boluuchu kor ookattan zhakshy
Kaisy zherde, kandai abalda olson'or zhe olturulson'or; baaryn'ar Zhalgyz Allakhka kaitasyn'ar zhana ar kimin' amalyn'a zharasha syi zhe zhaza alasyn'ar

Allakh yroologon yraiym menen senin munozun', ei, paigambar, sakhabalaryn'a zhumshak boldu. Eger sozun' zhe ishin' alarga katuu tie turgan tash zhurok bolgonun'da, anda alar senden azhyrap ketishmek zhana senin ukugun'du kyskartyshmak. Sen emi alarga kechirim tile, ken'eshke muktazh bolson' alardyn oi-pikirin sura. Ken'eshten kiiin oiun'a bekem ishensen', any atkar, Allakhka tobokel kyl, chynynda, Allakh Taala Aga tobokel kylgandardy zhakshy korot, alardy iigiliktuu kylyp zhardam beret

Eger Allakh silerge zhardam berip, korgoosuna alsa, zher betindeginin baary chogulsa da silerge ech kim ustomduk kyla albait. A eger silerge zhardam berbei ozun'ordu tashtap koiso, Allakhtan bashka silerge ech kim zhardam bere albait. Zhardam Zhalgyz Anyn kolunda. Momundar bir gana Allakhka taianyshsyn, Andan bashka ech nersege taianbasyn

Paigambarlardyn ech kimisi olzhodon ozuno bolunbogon nerseni kyianattyk menen algan emes. Silerden kim olzhodon ozuno tiesheluu bolbogon nerseni kyianattyk menen alsa, kyiamat kunu oshonun zhaman akybetin tartat, katyp algan nersesin kalaiyktyn aldyn kotorup kelet. Kiiin ar bir zhan kylgan ishine zharasha ech bir azaitpastan zhazasyn alat, alarga kunoosu koboitulup, zhe zhakshylygy azaitylyp zulum kylynbait

Yimany zhana zhakshy amaly menen Allakhtyn yraazylygyn tabuunu koksogon adam menen kaapyr bolup, zhaman ishterdi zhasap, Allakhtyn kaar-kazabyna kalyp, barar zheri tozok bolgon adam Allakh Taalanyn khuzurunda birdei emes. Tozok kandai zhaman zhai.
myndai adamdar bul duinodo da, akyrette da birdei emes. Allakh Taala alardyn emne kylganyn Koruuchu, Aga ech nerse kupuia-syr emes, kiiin baaryn kylgan amalyna zharasha syilait zhe zhazalait

Ozdorunon paigambar zhiberip, Allakh Taala momundarga chon' zhakshylyk kylgan. Al paigambar alarga Kuran okup beret, shirk zhana zyianduu akhlaktardan aryltat, Kuran, sunnottu uirotot. bul paigambar alarga kele eleginde tuura zholdon adashyp, zhan'ylyp zhurushkon ele.

Oo, yimanduular, Ukhudda artka kachkanyn'arda zhana aran'ardan bir top adam olturulgondo: Biz yiman keltirgen bolsok, anan kantip myndai baleege kabyldyk?! dedin'er. A Badr sogushunda dushmandaryn'ar olup zhana tutkun boluuda silerden eki ese kop zhapa tartyshkan ele. Oo, paigambar, alarga: "Bul baleege oz ara talashyp, Allakhtyn elchisine bash iibei koigon sebeptuu kabyldyn'ar, - dep ait. Chynynda, Allakh Taala bardyk ishke Kadyr; kaalaganyna zhardam beret, kaalaganyn tashtap koiot

Ukhud kunu siler menen mushrikter zholukkandagy olum, zharakat zhana bashka kyiynchylyktar Allakhtyn uruksaty zhana tagdyry menen boldu. Bul chynygy momundardy azhyratuudagy Allakhtyn zhetkiliktuu daanyshmandygy

Oshondoi ele silerdin aran'ardagy munafyktardy achykka chygaruu uchun boldu. Alarga: Allakhtyn zholunda sogushkula zhe zhon ele musulmandardyn karaanyn koboitup biz menen choguu chykkyla - degende, alar: Biz siler menen chykmakpyz, birok siler menen butparastardyn ortosunda ech kandai sogushtu korboi ele turabyz - deshti. Ushintishken uchurda alardyn abaly yimanduularga emes, kaapyrlarga koburook okshop turdu. Tilderi zhurogundo bolbogon nerseni aityp zhatty. Allakh Taala alar ichine zhashyrgan nerseni bilet, kiiin alardy oshogo zharasha zhazalait

Oshentip sogushka chykpai kalyp kalgandar, Ukhud sogushuna baryp zhapa chekkenderi tuuraluu: Eger bular chykpai koigondo mintip olumgo uchurabait ele - deshet. Ei, paigambar, alardyn aitkanyn chetke kagyp: Alar bizdi ukkanda olboit ele degen sozun'or chyndykka zhakyn bolso zhana sogushka chykpai uido oturuu adamdy olumdon saktap kala turgan bolso, olum kelgen uchurda siler ozun'ordu olumdon alyp kalgylachy, - dep ait

Oo, paigambar, Allakh zholundagy zhikhadda sheiit bolgondordu oluk dep oilobogula. alar Zharatuuchusunun aldynda keremettuu orunda ozdoruno gana tiesheluu zhashoodo tiruu. Allakhtan bashka ech kim bilbegen turduu yryskylardy zheshet

Alardy bakyt orop, shan' kurchagan, munun baaryn alarga Allakh Ozunun artykchylygy menen bergen. Alar bul zhakta bul duinodo kalgan bir tuugandaryn kutushot. Eger alar da zhikhadda sheiit bolushsa, bular syiaktuu zhyrgaldy tabyshat. Alarda akyret ishterinen korkup chochuloo bolboit, oshondoi ele duinodo zhasagan ishterine okunboit
myndan syrtkary Allakh alarga daiardap koigon chon' sooptorgo kubanyshat. Allakh Taala momundardyn soobun kemitpeit, any toluk beret zhana koshumcha koshot

Ukhud sogushunda zhapa chegip turganyn'arda, anyn artynan ele "Khamra al-Asad" sogushuna attangyla degen Allakhtyn zhana Anyn elchisinin buiruguna bash iiip, zharakattaryna karabai attanyp chykkandarga, alardan amaldaryn zhakshy atkargandarga, Allakhtyn buirugun atkaryp, kunoodon tyiylyp takyba bolgondorgo Allakhtyn chon' syilygy bar, al - beiish

Butparastardan birooloru kelip: Kuraishtar Abu Sufiandy bashchy kylyp, kop kol toptop, siler menen sogushkany turat, - dep korkutkanda, bul korkutuu yimanduulardyn Allakhka ishenimin zhana Allakhtyn ubadasyna bolgon umutun kuchottu. Anan: Bizge Allakh zhetishtuu,Al, ishibizdi ishenip tapshyra turgan en' zhakshy Koldoochu - dep, sogushka attanyshty

Kiiin alar Khamra al-Asad kazatynan ech kandai sogushsuz, olum-zharakatsyz, birok oto chon' soopko ee bolup kaityp kelishti. Kunoodon tyiylyp, ibadatyn bekem karmanyp Allakhty yraazy kylyshty. Allakh Taala momun pendelerine ozgocho Artykchaluu

Silerdi korkutkan al shaitan, al silerge ozunun dostoru, zhardam beruuchulorun (kaapyrlardy) aityp korkutat. Alardan korkpogula, alarda kuch da, kubat da zhok. Eger Aga chyndap ishensen'er, katuu bash iiuu menen bir gana Zhalgyz Allakhtan korkkula.

Oo, elchi, kaapyrlykka shashyp zhatkan munafyktar seni kaigyrtpasyn. Allar Allakhka ech zyian tiigize albait, Allakhtan zhana Anyn ibadatynan alystagany uchun ozdoruno gana zyian kylyshat. Alardyn eki zhuzduulugu, bekem turbagany sebeptuu Allakh Taala alarga akyrette ech nerse berboonu kaalady. Akyrette alarga tozokto katuu azap bolot
yimandy kaapyrlykka almashtyryp algandar Allakhka ech zyian tiigize albait, bolgonu ozdoruno zyian tiigizet, akyrette alarga zhan keiitken azap bar

Shariiatyna moiun sunbai kezhirlenip, Zharatuuchusuna kaapyr bolgondor, kaapyrlykta kop omur surgonu alarga zhakshy dep oiloshot. Birok, alar oilogondoi emes, alardyn omuru kunooloruno dagy kunoo koshuluusu uchun uzun boldu, emi alarga katuu azap bolot

Oo, yimanduular, Allakh Taalanyn daanyshmandygy silerdi munafyktar menen aralash, alardyn kim ekenin bilbegen abalda kaltyryp koiboit. Taza momundardy ypylas munafyktardan azhyratuu uchun silerdi ar turduu kyiynchylyktar menen synait. Oshondoi ele, Allakh Taala daanyshmandygy menen silerdi kaiypty bilbei turgan kylyp koidu. Birok, kaalagan adamyn paigambar kylyp, aga kee bir kaiypty bildirip koidu. Misaly, Mukhammad paigambarga (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) munafyktardy bildirgen syiaktuu. Emi Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine yimanyn'ardy bekemdegile. Eger Allakhka chyndap yiman keltirsen'er, Anyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiuusunan tyiylyp Aga takyba bolgula, silerge Allakh Taala chon' syi daiardap koigon

Allakh Taala artykchylygy menen bergen neemat-zhakshylyktarga saran'dyk kylyp, Allakhtyn akysyn berbegender, munu zhakshylyk kyldy dep oilobosun, teskerisinche, bul zhamandyk. Antkeni, azyr saran'dyk kylyp,ech kimge berbegen nerseleri kyiamat kunu alardyn bashyna azap bolot, oshol nerseleri alardy moiununan kysat. Asman-zherdeginin baary Zhalgyz Allakhka tiesheluu emespi, zharatylgandyn baary zhok bolup ketkende da Al Tiruu kalat. Allakh Taala silerdin kylgan ishin'erdi iine-zhibine cheiin Biluuchu, kiiin oshol amalyn'arga zharasha syilait, zhe zhazalait

Iakhudilerdin: "Allakh bizden karyz talap kylat, Al kembagal, a biz bolso mal-duinobuz kop baibyz" degenin Allakh Taala uktu. Zharatuuchularyna ushintip zhalaa zhapkan sozdorun zhana paigambarlardy sebepsiz olturgondorun zhazyp koiobuz. Anan alarga: tozokto kuiguzuuchu azaptyn daamyn tartkyla deibiz
Ei, iakhudiler, bul azap kunoo zhana ton' moiundugun'ardyn sebebinen bolup zhatat, bolboso, Allakh Taala pendelerinin ech birine zulumdyk kylbait

Bul iakhudiler zhalgan zherden: "Allakh Taala bizge kitebinde paigambarlardyn tili menen, bul elchi kachan gana ozunun aitkanyn tastyktai turgan nerseni b.a. Allakhka sadaga kylyp, anysyn asmandan tushkon ot zhalmap ketkenin silerge korsotup bermeiinche, aga ishenbegile dep osuiat kylgan" dep aityshat. Ushintip Allakhty zhalganga aralashtyryshat. Oshon uchun Allakh Taala Mukhammad paigambardy alarga mintip ait dep buirugan: "Silerge menden murdagy elchiler da chynygy elchi ekenine achyk-aikyn dalilderi menen kelgen, siler aityp zhatkan asmandan tushkon ot sadagany zhalmap ketchu kurbandykty da alar korsotkon, eger azyr aityp zhatkanyn'ar chyn bolso, anda emne uchun oshol paigambarlardy da zhalganga chygardyn'ar zhana olturdun'or!?"

Oo, paigambar, seni zhalganchy deshse, kaigyrba, bul kaapyrlardyn konumush adaty. Senden murdagy paigambar,elchilerdi alar zhalganga chygaryshkan. Bolboso, alar achyk-aikyn dalilderdi, ulgu, ornok ala turgan kitepterdi tuura zholgo bashtai turgan okum, shariiatty kamtygan kitepti alyp kelishken.

Tiruu zhan kancha kop zhashasa da bir kunu olumdun daamyn tatat. Duinogo turkuk bolup ech kim kalbait. Kyiamat kunu bul duinodo atkargan ish-amaldaryn'ardyn soop-syiyn ech kemitilbesten alasyn'ar. Allakh Taala kimdi tozokton ary kylyp, beiishke kirgizse; umut-tilek kylgan zhakshylykka zhetip, korkkon zhamandyktan kutulat. Duino zhashoosu tukko turbagan, arzybagan zhashoo, aga aldangan adamdar gana bailanyp kalat.

Oo, yimanduular, mildettuu zeket, sadaga beruu zhe zhut, kyrgyn syiaktuu mal-kelge keluuchu synoo menen synalasyn'ar.Oshondoi ele, ozun'or da shariiatty tak atkarganyn'ar zhe atkarbaganyn'ar zhana bashyn'arga kelgen ar turduu baleeler arkyluu synalasyn'ar. Kitep berilgenderden zhana Allakhka sherik koshkon butparastardan silerge zhana dinin'erge zhalaa zhapkan kop zhaman sozdordu ugasyn'ar. Myna ushundai oor synoo, baleelerge sabyr kylsan'ar, buirugun atkaryp, tyiganynan tyiylyp Allakhka takyba bolson'or, chyny bul oto chydamkailykty talap kylgan zhana buga shashylyp zharysha turgan uluk ishterden.

Oo, paigambar, estegin, Allakh Taala kitep berilgen Iakhud zhana khristiandardyn aalymdaryna Allakhtyn kitebin elge achyk aitkyla, andagy tuura zholdu zhana Mukhammad paigambar (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) tuuraluu kabardy zhashyrbagyla dep ant albady bele. Kiiin alardy keesi antty buzdu, aga kon'ul da burbady, chyndykty zhashyryp, zhalgandy zharyia kyldy, Allakhtyn ant-kelishimin zharybagan baaga, mansap, mal syiaktuu nersege almashtyryp zhiberishti.Bul kandai zhaman ish.

Oo, paigambar, zhaman ishterine kubanyp, zhakshylyk kylbagany uchun bashkalardan maktoo uguunu kaalagan adamdar azaptan salamat kutulup ketet dep oilobo. Teskerisinche alardyn ordu tozok, alar anda katuu azaptalat
Asman, zher zhana andagynyn baaryn zharatuu zhana bashkaruu Zhalgyz Allakhtyn Ozuno taandyk, Allakh bardyk nersege Kudurettuu

Murda ech bolbogon asman menen zherdin zharatylyshy, tun menen kundun birde uzaryp, birde kyskaryp eerchiship zhuruusu; akyl-esi zhaiyndagy adamdarga aalamdyn zharatuuchusu bardygyna zhana Al ibadat kyluuga ylaiyktuu Zhalgyz Allakh ekenine achyk-aikyn dalil

Allakh Taalany bardyk uchurda, turup baratkanda da, oturganda da, zhambashtap zhatkanynda da estep, zikir kylgandar zhana asman-zherdin zharalyshyna oi zhugurtkondor: Oo, zharatuuchubuz, bul korkom zharatylyshty zhondon-zhon ele zharatkan emessin', zhon ele zharatyp koiuudan Sen Aruu-Tazasyn'. Zhakshy amaldardy atkaruuga topuk ber, zhaman amaldardan sakta, tozok otunan alys kyla kor" - deshet.

Oo, Zharatuuchubuz, Sen pendelerin'den kimdi tozokko kirgizsen', any kordogonun' zhana shermende kylganyn'. Kyiamat kunu zaalymdardy Allakhtyn azabynan zhana kaarynan korgoi turgan ech zhardamchy bolboit

Zharatuuchubuz, biz yimanga chakyrgan paigambaryn' Mukhammaddy (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) uktuk. Al: Zharatuuchun'ardy syiynuuga ylaiyk Zhalgyz Allakh dep ishengile - dep aitty. Biz anyn aitkanyna yiman keltirdik, shariiatyn karmandyk. Bizdin kunoolorubuzdu zhashyr, achykka chygarba, katalarybyzdy kechir, al uchun zhazalaba. Zhakshy amaldardy kylyp zhaman amaldardy tashtoogo topuk berip, zhakshy adamdardyn katarynda zhanybyzdy al

Zharatuuchubuz, paigambaryn'dyn tili menen ubada kylgan bul duinodogu zhen'ish, tuura zholdu bere kor. Kyiamat kunu tozokko kirgizip shermende kylba. Sen, oo, Zharatuuchubuz, ubadasyn tuk buzbagan bereshensin'.

Zharatuuchusu alardyn dubasyna zhoop kylyp myndai dedi: Erkekpi, aialby zhakshy amal kylgandardyn amaly meili az, meili kop bolsun anysynyn soop-syiyn ech kemitpei beremin. Baaryn'ar bir ishenimdesin'er, erkekterge koshumchalanbait, aialdarga kemitilbeit, baaryn'arga birdei okum. Allakh zholunda kochup chykkandar, kaapyrlar zhurtunan kuup chykkan adamdar, Zharatuuchusuna bash iigeni sebeptuu yza tartkandar, Allakh zholunda sogushkandar, Allakhtyn sozu biiik bolsun uchun sogushta olturulgondor, Kyiamat kunu myna ushulardyn kunoosun kechirem, kunoosuuchun zhazalabaim, ak sarailardyn aldynan shyldyr suulary agyp turgan beiishke kirgizem. Bul Allakhtyn syilygy, Allakhta bashka ech bir okshoshu zhok ushundai syilyktar bar.

Oo, paigambar, kaapyrlardyn bir shaardan ekinchi shaarga kochup konuusu, shaarlardy mekendep oturuktashuusu, soodasy kiresheluu, yryskysy mol bolgonu seni aldabasyn. Alardyn ushul abalynan kyzhaalat, kaigyny sezesin'.
Bul duinonun myndai kyzyktary oto kyska, tuboluk ulanbait. Kiiin Kyiamatta alardyn barar zheri tozok, tozok otunun toshogu kandai zhaman!

Al emi Zharatuuchusuna takyba bolup, Anyn buirugun atkaryp, kunoodon tyiylgandarga ak sarailarynyn aldynan daryialar agyp turgan beiish bar. Allakh Taala alarga ubadalap, bergen syilyk ushu, anda tuboluk turushat. Allakh Taala yimanduu pendelerine ubada kylgan nerseler, kaapyrlar bul duinodo zhyrgal dep eseptegen nerselerden alda kancha zhakshy, abzel.

Kitep berilgenderdin da baary okshosh emes. arasynda Allakhka, silerge tushurulgon Kuranga zhana ozdorunun kitebinde aitylgan chyndykka ishengen, Allakhtyn elchilerin biri-birinen azhyratpagan, Allakhtan korkup, kichi peiil bolup, Anyn soop-syiyna kyzykkan, Allakhtyn aiat-sozdorun duino uchun arzybagan baaga satpagan zhakshylary da bar. Myndailarga Zharatuuchusu ulkon soop-syi tartuulait. Allakh Taala ishti oto tez esep-kysap kylat zhana syi zhe zhazasyn da oto tez beret.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, paigambardy eerchigender, shariiatty atkaruuda, zhashoodogu kee bir kyiynchylyktarda sabyrduu bolgula. Sabyrduulukta kaapyrlardan kem bolboogula, alar silerden sabyrduu bolup ketpesin. Allakh zholundagy zhikhadga daiar turgula. Buiruktaryn atkaryp, kunoodon tyiylyp, Allakhka takyba bolgula. Myna oshondo tozokton kutulup, beiishke kirip maksatyn'arga zhetesin'er.

Oo, adamdar, Zharatuuchun'ardan korkkula. Al silerdi bir zhandan, tagyraagy Adam atadan zharatty. Adam atadan anyn zhubaiy, silerdin enen'er Khavany zharatty. Anan al ekoonon zher beti tolo erkek, aialdardy taratty. Allakhtan korkkula, Anyn aty menen biri-birin'den bir nerse suraisyn'ar, bashkacha aitkanda, Allakhtyn aty menen suraimyn, maga myndai zhardam berchi dep aitasyn'ar. Orton'ordo bailanyshy bar tuugandykty uzuudo da Allakhtan korkkula. Allakh Taala chynynda silerdi kozomoldop turat, silerdin kylganyn'ar Anyn kozomolunon syrtta kalbait. Baaryn eseptep, oshogo zharasha syi zhe zhaza beret.

Oo, osuiat kylyngandar, zhetimderdin (zhetim - balakat zhashyna zhete elek atasynan azhyragan bala zhe kyz) malyn alar balakatka zhetip, oz aldyncha zhol taap kalganda otluk kaitaryp bergile. Aramdy adalga aralashtyrbagyla; b.a. zhetimderdin zhakshy mal-mulkun alyp, kiiin any kaira bergenden anyn orduna ozun'ordun zhaman mal-mulkun'ordon berbegile. Oshondoi ele zhetimderdin mal-mulkun ozun'ordukuno koshup alyp zhebegile. Bul Allakhka oto chon' kunoo

Eger kepildigin'erdegi zhetim kyzdarga uilonuudo alarga adilet bolo albaim dep, zhe alarga berchu makhyr akysyn toluk bere albai kalam dep, zhe alarga mamile kyluuda kemchilik ketirem dep korkson'or, anda alardan bashka aialdarga kaalasan'ar ekoono, uchoono zhe tortoono uilongulo. A eger bulardyn ortosunda adilettuu bolo albaim dep korkson'or, anda biroo menen chektelgile zhe kol aldyn'ardagy kun' aialdardy algyla (paidalangyla). Antkeni, kun'dordo erkin aialdarda saktalchu ukuktardyn kobu zhok. Ushul zhogoruda aitylgan zhetimderge adilettuu boluu, bir aial menen chekteluu, kun' aialdardy paidalanuu zyian tartyp kalboon'orgo sebep bolchu amaldar
Aialdaryn'arga beriluusu mildettuu bolgon makhyr akysyn bergile.Makhyrynan bir nerseni silerge ozu yraazy bolup, zhek korboston berse, any zhei bergile, anda ech zhamandyk zhok

Oo, kepildikke algandar, zhetimderdin mal-mulkun ali ishtetuugo kuch-kudureti zhete eleginde alarga berbegile. Bul maldy Allakh Taala alardyn zhashoo-turmushun tikelei turgan, adamdardyn ortosundagy mamileni bekemdei turgan sebep kylyp koigon. Al akyly zhete elekter, malyn saktoonu bilbeit. Oshon uchun alardy ozunun maldarynan zhedirip-ichirip, kiiintkile. Alarga zhakshy soz aitkyla. Balakatka zhetip, ak-karany azhyratyp kalganyn'arda mal-mulkun'ordu ozun'orgo berem dep kubantkyla.

Oo, kepildikke algandar, zhetimderdi alar balakatka zhetkende mal-mulkunon bir az berip, synap, teksherip korgulo. Eger any tuura paidalanyp, ishtete alsa, buga silerdin kozun'or zhetse, anda alardyn mal-mulkun toluk otkorup bergile. Muktazhdykta zhegile dep Allakh uruksat bergen olchomdon ashyryp alardyn mal-mulkun zhebegile. Bular balakatka zhetkende bergichem zhep turaiyn dep alardyn mal-mulkun zhegenge shashylbagyla. Eger silerde ozun'orgo zheterlik mal-mulkun'or bolso, zhetimderdin malyna tuk tiibegile. A eger zhakyr bolson'or, ozun'ordo mal zhok bolso, anda muktazhdykka zharasha zhetimderdin malynan zhep tursan'ar bolot. Kachan alar balakatka zhetip, mal-mulk paidalanuunu bilip kalganda alardyn mal-mulkun bergile zhana bergenin'erge biroolordu kubo kylgyla. Kubo ukuktun saktaluusuna, kiiin talash-tartysh bolboosuna sebep bolot. Buga kubo boluuda zhana pendelerin amalyna zharasha esep kyluuda Allakh zhetishtuu

Ata-enesi, zhe bir tuugany zhe atasy menen bir tuugan aga-inisi syiaktuu zhakyn tuugandarynan kalgan murasta, al muras azby, koppu anda erkek kishinin ulushu bar. Oshondoi ele anda aial kishinin da ulushu bolot; A zhakhiliiat, karan'gy doordo myndai emes ele, anda muras aial kishi menen zhash balaga tiichu emes. Murasty ar birine tiesheluu olchomdo ulush kylyp tak bolup beruunu Allakh Taala parz kyldy.

Eger muras bolushturulgondo al zherde muras albai turgan zhakyndar, zhetimder zhe zhakyr adamdar bolup kalsa, zhakshylyk uchun murasty bolushturboi turup alarga da bir azdan bergile, alar oshogo muktazh, alarga zhyluu-zhumshak soz aityp kon'ul kotorgulo

Otup ketsem, ali zhash, kembagal baldarymdyn abaly kandai bolot dep korkkon adamdar, kol aldyndagy bashka zhetim baldarga zalym kyluuda Allakhtan korksun Otup ketkenden kiiin munun baldaryna da bashkalar zhakshylyk kyluusu uchun, ozu azyr zhetimderge zhakshylyk kylsyn. Olumu zhakyn adamga, al otkon son' osuiat, murasyna zalym kylbai tak bolushturorun aityp, zhakshy sozu menen uzatsyn.
Zhetimderdin mal-mulkun alyp, kiiin any ozu kaalagandai ishtetip zulum kylgandar alardy ichinen kuiguzo turgan ottu zhegendei bolot, Kyiamat kunu alar tozokto kuiot.

Allakh Taala silerge kelishim kylyp, baldaryn'ardyn murasy tuuraluu bularga buirudu; Muras uul balaga eki kyz balaga berilchu olchomdo berilet. Eger markumda uulu zhok zhalan' kyz bolso, anda eki kyzyna murastyn uchton ekisi tiet. A eger muras aluuchu zhalgyz ele kyz bolso, aga murastyn zharymy berilet. Eger markumdun uul zhe kyzy bolso, bul uchurda anyn ata-enesine altydan biri tiesheluu bolot. A eger markumdun perzenti bolboso, anda anyn enesine uchton biri berilip, kalgany atasyna berilet. Eger markumdun eki zhe andan kop aga-ini, ezhe-karyndashtary bolso, anda enesine mildettuu turdo altynan biri berilet da, kalgany atasyna kalat, bir tuugandaryna ech nerse berilbeit. Murasty myndai tartipte bolushturuu, markum murasty osuiat kylgandan kiiin zhana markumdun karyzdary bolso, any tologondon kiiin ishke ashyrylat. Anan da murasty markumdun malynyn uchton birinen ashyryp zhiberboo kerek, tagyraagy, andan kalgan mal-mulkton uchton biri gana muraska bolunot. Murasty ushintip bolushturuunu parz kylganynyn sebebi, adamdar ata-enesinin zhe baldarynyn kimisi aga bul duinodo da, akyrette da paidaluu ekenin bilbeit. Bilbegeni sebeptuu biroosun zhakshy korup, but malyn aga muraska kaltyryshy mumkun. Dagy birin zhaman korup,aga takyr muras kaltyrbai koiushu da mumkun. A chynynda, al oilogondoi bolboi (zhakshy korgonu zyiankech, zhaman korgonu paidaluu bolup) kaluusu toluk mumkun. Munun baaryn Aga ech nerse zhashyruun kalbagan Allakh bilet. Oshon uchun murasty zhogorudagydai bolushturuunu buirudu. Munu pendeleri sozsuz atkara turgan mildet kyldy. Allakh Taala chynynda Biluuchu, pendelerine emne zhagary Aga zhashyruun emes. Al shariiat kyluuda, zhana okum chygaruuda Daanyshman.

Oo, kuioolor, eger aialyn'ardyn silerden zhe bashkadan perzenti bolboso, andan kalgan murastyn ten' zharymy silerge tisheluu. A eger, alardyn erkekpi, kyzby, ishi kylyp perzenti bolso, anda kalgan mulkton silerge tortton biri gana tiet. Bul ulush kachan al aial murasty osuiat kylyp zhana anyn karyzdary tolongondon kiiin bolunot. Ei, kuioolor, eger silerdin balan'ar bolboso, silerden kalgan mulkton aialdaryn'arga tortton biri tiesheluu bolot. A eger balan'ar bolso, anda aialdaryn'arga segizden biri tiet. Bul ulush kachan siler murasty osuiat kylyp zhana silerdin karyzyn'ar tolongondon kiiin bolunot. Eger kaza bolgon erkektin zhe aialdyn ata-enesi da, bala-chakasy da zhok bolso, birok ene taraptan bir erkek zhe urgaachy bir tuugany bolso, kalgan mulkton aga altydan biri mildettuu turdo berilet. Eger al tuugandar birden kop bolso, alardyn baary kalgan mulktun uchton birine sheriktesh bolup bolup alyshat. Bolushuudo erkek, urgaachysy birdei. Bul ulushun da alar markumdun osuiatynan zhana karyzy tolongondon kiiin bolup alyshat. Sebebi, osuiat kylgan murasy mal-mulkunun uchton birinen kop bolup kalyp, muraskorlordun birine zulum bolup kaluusu mumkun. Myna ushul aiatta aitylgan muras bolushturuu okumu Allakhtyn silerge mildet kylgan kelishim-buirugu. Allakh Taala pendelerine bul duinodo da,akyrette da emne paidaluu ekenin Biluuchu, kunookorlordu zhazaloogo shashylbagan Zhumshak peiil.

Zhetimder tuuraluu, muras tuuraluu aitylgan okumdor, pendeleri biluusu uchun tuzulgon Allakhtyn shariiaty. Buiruktaryn atkaruu, kunoolordon tyiyluu arkyluu Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine bash iigenderdi Allakh Taala ak saraiynyn aldynan shyldyr suulary agyp turgan beiishke kirgizet. Alar anda tuboluk turushat, anda ech nerse zhok bolup ketpeit. Bul Allakhtyn syilygy iigiliktin iigiligi.

Al emi okumdorun burmalap, any ish zhuzundo atkarbai, aga kumon sanap, shariiat chektegen chekten chygyp Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kunookor bolgondordu tozokko kirgizet. Anda alar tuboluk kalat zhana tugonbos azapka malynat

Aialdaryn'ardan zinaga baryp kunoogo batkany bolso, aga adyl tort musulman erkek kishi kubogo tartkyla, eger alar aialdyn ushul kunoogo barganyna kubo bolushsa, aialdyn zhazasy katary any uigo kamap koigula. Al olgongo cheiin zhe Allakh Taala aga kamaktan bashka bir zhazany sunushtaganga cheiin uido kamalyp tursun. Kiiin Allakh Taala alarga bashka zhazany shariiat kyldy, tagyraagy, eger zyna kylgan aial turmushka chyga elek bolso aga zhuz balak urulat, al emi turmushka chykkan zhuban bolso tash baran'ga alynat.

Zyna kylgan erkek menen aialdy tilin'er zhana kolun'ar menen zhazalap kordogula. A eger kunoolorun moiundap, andan bash tartyp, zhakshy amaldardy zhasasa, yza beruunu toktotkula. Antkeni, toobo kyluuchu kunoosu zhok adamdai bolup kalat. Allakh Taala pendelerinen kim toobo kylsa, aga yraiym kylyp toobosun kabyldait. Zhazanyn myndai turu islamdyn algachky kundorundo bolchu, kiiin bul okum kuchun zhogotup, turmush kura elekterge zhuz balak, turmush kurgandarga tash baran' okumu chykty

Kunoonun akybetin zhana zyianyn bilbesten but koiup algan adam, meili al kunoonu bilbesten zhasasyn, meili ataiyn zhasasyn, kiiin daroo Zharatuuchusuna kaityp, olumu kele elekte toobo kylsa, myndai adamdardyn toobosun Allakh kabyl kylat, kunoosun kechiret. Allakh Taala Ozu zharatkan makuluktarynyn abalyn Biluuchu, alarga tagdyr kyluuda zhana shariiat kyluuda Daanyshman

Kunoo artynan kunoo zhasap, kekirtegine azhaly kelgenche toobo kylbai, anan oshol kezde: kunoomo toobo kyldym dep zhan urogondordun toobosun Allakh kabyl kylbait. Oshol uchurda alardyn biri: myna azyr kylgan kunoolorumo toobo kyldym - dep aitat. Oshondoi ele kaapyr boiuncha zhurup otup ketkenderdin toobosun da kabyl kylbait. Ushintip kunoo ustuno kunoo kylgandarga zhana kaapyr teide otup ketkenderge zhan keiituuchu azap daiardap koigonbuz.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, paigambardy eerchigen yimanduular, atan'ardan zhana zhakyndaryn'ardan kalgan zhesir aialdardy maldy muraska algandai murastap alganyn'ar, alardy nikege alganyn'ar, kaalaganyn'arga nikelegenin'er zhana alardy bashka biroogo turmushka chyguudan tyiyp koigonun'ar tuura emes zhoruk. Siler ozun'orgo zhakpagan aialyn'ardy, eger al makhyr akysynyn bir bolugun zhe bashka nerseni silerge tolop, azhyrashuunu talap kylsa, any zhazalaiyn dep ketirbei koibogula. Egerde al aial zyna syiaktuu zhaman ishke but koiso, anda makhyr akysyn kaitaryp aluu uchun any ketirbei tursan'ar bolot. Aialyn'arga zyian azar berbei, napakany zhakshy berip zhyluu-zhumshak bolgula. Kaisy bir kemchiligi uchun zhaman korson'or, aga sabyr kylgyla; oshol silerge zhakpagan nerse arkyluu bul duinodo da, akyrette da zhakshylyk tabyshyn'ar toluk mumkun

Oo, kuioolor, eger aialyn'arga talak beruunu kaalasan'ar zhana ordun bashka biroonu almakchy bolson'or; bul silerge kunoo emes. Birok, anyn makhyryna kop mal-mulk bergen bolson'or, any kaira alyp kalbagyla, any alyp kaluu anyk doomat zhana achyk kunoo

Myna oshol makhyr sebeptuu aialdarga ee bolgonsun'ar, Allakhtyn sozu menen aialdar silerge adal bolgon zhana alardy kamkordugun'arga aluuga ant bergensin'er, anan kantip bergen makhyrdy kaira alyp kalasyn'ar, bul zhaman korulgon, tuura emes ish

Atan'ar uilonup, kiiin alardan kalgan aialdarga uilonbogulo, bul aram. A eger bul ish zhakhiliiatta, karan'gylykta bolgon bolso, al kechirimduu. Atanyn aialdaryna balanyn uilonup aluusu zhaman ypylas ish. Myndai kylgandarga Allakh katuu achuulanat

Allakh Taala silerge enen'erge nikelenuunu aram kyldy, oshondoi ele bul kancha oidoloso da aram; b.a. taene, anyn enesi chon' ene zh.b. Kyzdaryn'arga nikelenuu da aram, kancha yldyilasa da; b.a. kyz, anyn kyzy, anyn kyzynyn kyzy zh.b. Oshondoi ele balan'ardyn zhana kyzyn'ardyn kyzdaryna nikelenuu aram. Ozun'ordun bir tuugan ezhe-karyndashtaryn'arga zhana ata-enen'erdin bir tuugan ezhe-karyndash zhe ezhe-sin'dilerine nikelenuu aram. Bir tuuganyn'ardyn kyzdaryna zhana alardyn kyzdaryna, oshondoi ele silerge sutun emizgen emchek enen'erge, oshol aialdy emgen emchektesh ezhe-karyndashtaryn'arga nikelenuu aram. Aialyn'ardyn enesi, kainenen'er, al aialyn'arga zhakyndyk kylsan'ar da, kylbasan'ar da baary bir nikelenuu aram. Aialyn'ar bashka kuioosunon eerchitip kelgen kyzga nikelenuun'or aram, eger al kyzdyn enesine zhakyndyk kylsan'ar, a eger enesine zhakyndyk kylbasan'ar, anda any talak kylgan son', anyn kyzyna nikelensen'er bolo beret. Dagy ozun'ordun balan'ardyn aialyna nikelenuu aram, bul okumgo emchektesh zhagynan bolgon balan'ardyn aialy da tiesheluu. Dagy eki bir tuugan ezhe-sin'dini, meili alar emchektesh zhagynan bolsun choguu bir niekege aluu da aram, birok bul islamga cheiin bolso, any Allakh kechiret. Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerin kechiruuchu, alarga yraiymduu. Oshondoi ele khadisterde aial menen anyn atasynyn ezhesin zhe taezhesin choguu bir nikege aluu aram ekendigi aitylgan.

Oshondoi ele kuioosu bar aialdarga nikelenuun'or aram, birok kol aldyn'arga tutkun bolup kelgen kun' aialdarga alar bir aiyz korup tazalangandan kiiin koshula bersen'er bolot. Myna ushulardy Allakh silerge mildet kyldy. Emi zhogoruda aitylgandan bashka aialdar silerge adal, zynany maksat kylbai, taza-adal zhol menen alardyn Allakh silerge mildet kylgan makhyrlaryn berip, nikelene bergile. Nikeden kiiin kelishimin'erdi ozgortup, siler alarga aitylgandan kop bersen'er, zhe alar aitylgandyn keesin. zhe baaryn aluudan bash tartsa mynda ech kimge kunoo zhok. Allakh Taala chynynda pendelerin bilip turat, Aga ech nerse zhashyruun emes, bashkaruuda zhana shariiat kyluuda Daanyshman.

Oo, erkekter, eger mal-kelin'er zhok, erkin aialdarga uilono albasan'ar, biroolordun kol astyndagy kun' aialdarga, eger alar yimanduu bolso uilonson'or bolot. Allakh Taala yimanyn'ardyn akyikatyn zhana ichki abalyn'ardy zhakshy bilet. Siler alar menen dinde da, insaniiattykta da birdeisin'er. Alarga uilonuudon bash tartpagyla. Alardyn kozhoiununun uruksaty menen uilongulo. Alardyn makhyr akysyn toluk zhana kechiktirbei bergile. Munun baary eger alar zyna kyluuchu bolboso zhana zyna kyluu uchun zhashyruun oinosh kutposo. A eger alarga uilongondon kiiin alar zynaga barsa, anda alardyn zhazasy erkin aialdardyn zhazasynyn zharymyndai, eluu balak urulat, erkin aialdardan aiyrmalanyp alar tash baran' kylynbait. Zhogoruda aitylgan ushul taza-topuk kun' aialdarga uilonuugo berilgen uruksat, erkin aialdarga uilonuugo kudureti zhetpei, birok zynaga but koiuu korkunuchu bar erkekter uchun. Ushundai uchurda kun' aialdarga uilonuugo sabyr kyluu zhakshy. Allakh Taala pendelerinen toobo kylgandaryn Kechiruuchu, alarga Yraiymduu. Allakh Taalanyn yraiymduulugunun bir belgisi myna ushul, siler erkin aialdarga uilono albai, zynaga but koiuu korkunuchu bolgon uchurda kun' aialdarga uilonuugo uruksat bergeni

Allakh Taala silerge bul okumdordu shariiat kyluu menen shariiat zhana dinin baiandoonu kaalait. Bul duino zhana akyrette silerge paidaluu nerseni baiandoonu kaalait. Silerdi murdagy paigambarlardyn zholuna, alardyn zhakshy zhurum-turumuna, aram-adaldy azhyratuuga bashtoonu kaalait. Silerdi kunoodon ibadatka, kaitaruunu kaalait. Allakh Taala pendelerine emne paidaluu ekenin bilet zhana oshonu shariiat kylat. Alardy bashkaruuda zhana shariiat kyluuda Daanyshman.
Allakh silerdin toobon'ordu kabyl kyluunu, kunoon'ordu kechiruunu kaalait. Al emi kumar-kaaloosunan chyga albagan adamdar, silerdin tuz zholdon alys adashuun'ardy kaalait.
Allakh Taala shariiatyn silerge zhen'il kyluunu kaalait, kolun'ardan kelbegen nersege buirubait. Antkeni al insan biologiialyk zhaktan da, fizikalyk zhaktan da alsyz ekenin bilet

Oo, Allakhka ishengen, paigambardy eerchigen momundar, biri-birin'din mal-mulkun'du zhaman zholdor menen alyp zhebegile, misaly: tartyp aluu, urdoo,para aluu zh.b. Biri-birin'e yraazy bolup keliship aldy-berdi kylgan soodan'ar adal. Munun akchasyn zhegile zhana paidalangyla. Biri-birin'erdi olturbogulo, ozun'ordu ozun'or da olturbogulo, olumgo alyp barbagyla. Allakh Taala chynynda silerge yraiymduu. Anyn yraiymynyn biri belgisi, kanyn'ardy malyn'ardy zhana abiiirin'erdi biri-birin'e aram kylgany

Myna ushul biroonun malyn zhesh, adam olturuu syiaktuu tyiuu salyngan kunooluu ishterdi bilbesten zhe unutup emes, bilip turup ataiyn kylgandardy kyiamat kunu Allakh Taala tozokko kirgizet, anyn otu taptuu azaby katuu. Myndai kyluu Allakh Taalaga zhen'il; Al buga Kudurettuu, ech nersege kuchu zhetpei kalbait.

Oo, yimanduular, Allakhka sherik koshuu, ata-enenin kargyshyna kaluu, adam olturuu, sutkorduk kyluu syiaktuu chon kunoolordon saktansan'ar, kichine kunoolorun'ordu kechirem. Anan keremettuu zhai beiishke kirgizem

Oo, yiman keltirgender, biri-birin'erdegi Allakh yroologon artykchylyktarga koralbastyk kylbagyla; Allakh Taala erkekterge gana tiesheluu kylgan nersege aialdardyn umut kyluusu bolboit. Ar birinde ozuno zharasha ulushu bar. Allakh Taaladan Al bere turgan nerseni koboituusun surangyla; Allakh Taala chynynda bardyk nerseni Biluuchu zhana ar birine ozuno ylaiygyn beret.

Baaryn'arga ata-enesinen zhe zhakyn tuugandarynan kalgan murasty ala turgan tuuganchylykty zharatyp koiduk. Silerge zhardam beruugo zhana artyn'arda turuuga ishenimduu kelishim tuzgon dos-zhardamchylaryn'arga murastan nasibin bergile. Allakh Taala chynynda baardyk nersege Kubo boluuchu, silerdin yimanyn'arga zhana kelishimin'erge da kubo. Bul, dostorgo muras beruu islamdyn bashtapky uchurunda bar bolchu, kiiin bul okum zhokko chykkan.

Erkekter aialdaryn bashkaruuchu zhana kozomoldoochu, antkeni erkekterdi Allakh Taala ushuga ylaiyk kylyp, aialdardyn napakasyn (ui-zhai, tamak-ash, kiiim-keche) alardyn moiununa zhuktogon. Zharatuuchusuna, kuioosuno bash iigen, kuioosu zhokto Allakhtyn komogu menen oz abiiirin zhana kuioosunun mal-duinosun saktagan aialdar - zhakshy aialdar. Tili zhe ish-araketi menen kuioosuno bash iibei, ton' moiunduk kylgan aialdarga, zhyluu-zhumshak eskertip, Allakhtan korkuu kerektigin nasaat kylgyla. Buga konboso, anda toshok arkyluu, tagyraagy, birge zhatpai, zhakyndyk kylbai eskertkile. Buga da bolboso, anda aza berbei, akyryn urgula. Eger mainap chygyp, silerge bash iie bashtasa, myndan ashykka baryp (urup-urushup) alarga zulum kylbagyla. Allakh Taala chynynda uluuluktun Eesi, zaty da, sypaty da Zhogoru, Andan korkkula

Oo, zhubailardyn ishenimduu kishileri (okuldoru), eger zhubailardyn ortosunda kelishpestik, dushmandyk paida bolot dep korkson'or, alardy azhyratuuga zhe eldeshtiruugo okum chygaruu uchun kuioonun da, aialdyn da tuugandarynan bir adil kishini zhibergile. Okum chygaruuchular alardy eldeshtiruunu kaalasa zhana alarga ushundai zholdu korsotushso, zharashtyruu zhakshy, paidaluu ish. Oshondo Allakh zhubailardyn yntymagyn bekemdep, ortodogu kelishpestikti zhok kylat. Allakh Taalaga chynynda pendelerinin ech bir ishi zhashyruun emes, alardyn zhurogundo zhashyrylgan maida-baratty but Biluuchu

Allakhka bash iiip ibadat kylgyla, Any menen birge bashkaga ibadat kylbagyla. Ata-enen'erdi urmattap, bapestep zhakshylyk kylgyla. Zhakyn tuugandaryn'arga, zhetimderge, kedeilerge zhakshylyk kylgyla. Tuugandygy bar koshunan'arga da, tuugandygy zhoguna da zhakshylyk kylgyla. Zhanyn'ardagy sherigin'erge, saparyn ulai albai kalgan karyp, musaapyrga zhakshylyk kylgyla. Kol aldyn'ardagy kyzmatchy, kuldarga zhakshylyk kylgyla. Ozuno-ozu chirenip ozun-ozu maktagandardy zhana ozgolordu togotpoi tekeberlik kylgandardy Allakh Taala zhakshy korboit.

Allakh yrysky kylyp bergen nerseden bashkalarga beruu mildetinen kachyp saran'dyk kylgandardy zhana bashkalardy da ushuga unodgondordu Allakh Taala zhakshy korboit. Alar Ozunun artykchylygy menen bergen ilim, yrysky zhana bashka nerselerdi zhashyryshat. Elge chyndykty aitpai, zhashyryp, zhalgandy aityshat. Myndai zhaman sypattar kaapyrlarga taandyk. Kaapyrlarga alardy kor kyla turgan azapty daiardap koigonbuz

Oshondoi ele, Allakhka da, Kyiamat kununo da ishenbegen, elge korunuu zhana alardyn maktoosuna tatyktuu boluu uchun mal-mulkunon sadaga bergenderge da azapty daiardap koigonbuz; alarga oshol kor kyluuchu azapty daiadaganbyz. Alar shaitanga eerchigen uchun gana adashyshty. Kimge shaitan daiyma choguu zhuruuchu zholdosh bolso, demek al en' zhaman zholdosh

Eger alar Allakhka zhana Kyiamat kungo chyndap yiman keltirip, mal-duinosun Allakh zhakshy korup, yraazy bolgon zholgo sadaga kylsa, alarga emne zyianyn tiigizmek?! Teskerisinche, zhakshylyktyn baary ushunda bolmok. Allakh Taala alardy Biluuchu, alardyn abaly Aga zhashyruun emes, kiiin baaryn kylgan ishine zharasha zhazalait zhe syilait.

Allakh Taala chynynda Adil, pendelerine zulum kylbait. Alardyn zhakshy ishterinen kichine kumurskachalyk da kemitpeit, kunooloruno da ech nerse koshpoit. Eger pendede chan'dyn kypynyndai zhakshylygy bolso, artykchylygy menen any bir kancha ese koboitot, anan Ozunon oto chon' soop-syi beret
Oo, elchi, Kyiamat kunu ar bir ummotko alardyn emne kylganyna kubo kylyp paigambarlaryn alyp kelgende, seni da ummotun'o kubo kylyp alyp kelsek abal kandai bolot?!

Oshol azaby katuu kundo (Kyiamatta) Allakhka kaapyr bolup, Anyn elchisine kunookor bolgondor topurakka ailanyp zher menen zheksen bolup ketsek eken dep tileshet. Kylgan ish-araketterinen ech nersesin Allakhtan zhashyryp kala albait; antkeni, Allakh Taala alardyn tiline moor basyp, emne kylganyna kubo otuugo dene-mucholoruno uruksat beret

Oo, Allakhka ishenip, paigambardy eerchigen momundar, mas bolup kalsan'ar, kachan soolugup, emneni suilop zhatkanyn'ardy bilmeiinche namazga zhakyndabagyla (okubagyla). Bul okum arakty toluk boidon aramga chygargan okumdon murda kelgen. (Kiiin bul okum kuchun zhogotkon). Oshondoi ele zhunup bolson'or da, zhuunup tazalanmaiyncha namaz okubagyla zhana mechitke kirbegile. Birok kopko karmalbai kirip chygyp ketkenderge uruksat. Eger suu menen zhuunsa kuchop kete turgan ooru menen oorusan'ar, zhe saparda bolson'or, zhe daaratsyz bolup kalsan'ar, zhe aialyn'ar menen koshulsan'ar, anan zhuunuga zhe daarat aluuga suu tappasan'ar, anda niet kylyp taza topurakka kolun'ardy urup any menen beti-kolun'ardy surtkulo. Allakh Taala chynynda silerdin kemchiligin'erdi Ochuruuchu zhana silerdi Kechiruuchu

Oo, elchi, Allakh Taala Toorattan ilim bergen iakhudiler, tuura zholdu adashuuga almashtyrganyn bilbeisin'bi. Ei, momundar, alar ozdorunun iiri zholuna tushuruu uchun silerdi da elchi-paigambar alyp kelgen tuz, tuura zholdon adashtyruuga kyzykdar.

Oo, yimanduular, Allakh Taala dushmanyn'ardy silerge karaganda zhakshy bilet, silerge alar tuuraluu kabar berip, alardyn dushmandygyn baiandait. Silerdi alardyn zhamandygynan saktoogo Allakh Ozu zhetishtuu Bashchy. Alardyn zyianynan, kuuluk-shumdugunan korgop, silerge zhardam beruugo Allakh Ozu zhetishtuu Zhardamchy

Iakhudilerdin arasynda Allakh Taala tushurgon sozdordu ozgortkon zhamandary bar. Sozdu Allakh Taala tushurgon maani-man'yzynan burmalap, tuura emes, bashka maanide koldonushat. Allakhtyn elchisi (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) alarga bir ishti buirugan kezde, alar: senin sozun'du uktuk, birok senin buirugun'a bash iibedik deshet. Anan shyldyn'dap: bizdin aitkanybyzdy ukpasan' da ugasyn'; dep, anan "raaina" (bizge kuto tur) degen sozdu burmalap, paigambarga (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) soz tiigizip, dindin barkyn tushuruunu maksat kylyp (ushul sozgo un'gulash bolgon) "naadan" degen sozdu koldonushtu. Eger alar senin aitkanyn'dy uktuk, birok senin buirugun'a bash iibedik degendin orduna, senin aitkanyn'dy uktuk, senin buirugun'a bash iidik deshkende, oshondoi ele, bizdi ukpasan' da ugasyn' debei, bizdi uk deshkende zhana "raaina" debei "unzurnaa" senin aitkanyn'dy biz tushunushubuz uchun bizdi kuto tur deshkende alardyn ozdoruno zhakshy zhana tuura bolmok; antkeni mynda paigambarga (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) ylaiyktuu zhakshy adep bar ele. Birok alar mintishken zhok, Allakh Taala alardy kaapyrlygy sebeptuu yraiymynan kuup kargyshtady. Alar paidaluu yimanga kelishpeit.

Oo, kitep berilgen iakhudiler zhana khristiandar, silerdegi Toorat zhana Inzhilde aitylgandardy tastyktagan, Biz Mukhammad paigambarga (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) tushurgon Kuranga ishengile.
