Bolboso, zhuzun'ordu artyn'arga karatyp koiobuz zhe, ishembi kunu balyk uuloogo tyiuu salynganda aga bash iibegen "ishembi kun eelerin" kargap, yraiymynan alystatyp, maimylga ailandyrgandai, silerdi da kargaibyz. Allakhtyn ishi zhana tagdyry sozsuz bolot.

Ozu zharatkan nerselerdin birin Aga sherik kylyp aluunu Allakh Taala chynynda kechirbeit. Shirk zhana kaapyrlyktan bashka kunoolorun kaalagan adamynan Ozunun artykchylygy menen kechirip zhiberet. Zhe Ozununun adildigi menen kaalagan pendesin kunoosuno zharasha zhazalap, azaptait. Allakhka bashka nerseni sherik kylgan adam oto chon' kunoonu zharatyptyr, oshol boiuncha otup ketse, anysy kechirilbeit

Oo, elchi, tigi ozun zhana ishin maktap, aruulangandardyn abalyn bilbeisin'bi? Chyny, Zhalgyz Allakh gana kaalagan pendesin maktap, aruulait; Antkeni Al zhurokto zhashyrylgandardy bilet, ish-araketterin'erdin soobu ech kemitilbeit, eger al kurma daneginin chel kabygyndai bolso da
Oo, elchi, alardy karachy, ozdorun maktoo menen Allakhka kandai zhalgan nerselerdi zharatyp zhatyshat! Myna ushunun ozu alardyn adashuusuna anyk, zhetishtuu kunoo

Oo, elchi,Allakh Taala Toorattan ilim bergen iakhudilerdin abalyn bilbeisin'bi zhana aga tan' kalbaisyn'by? Alar Allakhtan bashka nerseni syiynuuga ylaiyktuu dep, aga ishenip, anan butparastardyn kylyk-zhorugun maktap: "Mukhammaddyn sakhabalarynyn zholuna karaganda bular tuura zholdo" deshet.
Myna ushundai buzuk ishenimdegilerdi Allakh Taala yraiymynan alystatkan. Allakh kimdi yraiymynan chettetse, aga zhardam bere turgan ech bir zhardamchy tabylbait
Alarda mulkton ulushu zhok, eger bolso dele andan ech kimge ech nerseni, kurma daneginin ustundogu chekittei kichine nerseni da bermek emes

Mumkun alar Allakh Taala Mukhammad (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) zhana anyn sakhabalaryna bergen paigambarlyk, yiman zhana meken syiaktuularga koralbastyk kylyshaby? Emne uchun koralbastyk kylyshat, murda dele Ibrakhim paigambardyn uruk-tukumuna kitep, tushurgonbuz, kitepten bashka nerselerdi da aian-kabar bergenbiz zhana eldin ustuno chon' biilikke ee kylganbyz

Kitep berilgenderdin arasynda Allakh Taala Ibrakhim paigambarga (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy bolsun) zhana anyn urpagynan chykkan bashka paigambarlarga tushrgon nersege (dinge) yiman keltirip ishengenderi bar. Oshondoi ele alarga ishenbei bash tartkandary da zhok emes. Myna ushundai ele abal Mukhammad paigambardyn (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) paigambarlygynda da boldu. Alardyn arasyndagy kaapyrlardy zhazaloochu azap, bul, tozok otu.

Bizdin aiattarybyzga kaapyr bolgondordu zhakynda, Kyiamat kunu, alardy orop ala turgan tozokko tashtaibyz. Tuboluk azaptaluusu uchun terileri kuiup butkondo, kaira zhan'y teri menen kaptaibyz. Allakh Taala chynynda Aga ech kim ustomduk kyla albai turgan Yzattuu, ezelten chara koruudo zhana any ishke ashyruuda Daanyshman.

Allakh Taalaga ishenip, Anyn elchisin eerchip taat-ibaadat kylgandardy zhakynda, Kyiamat kunu, ak sarailarynyn aldynan daryialary agyp turgan beiishke kirgizebiz. Alar anda tuboluk kalyshat. Anda alarga takyr kemchiligi zhok aruu-taza koluktular bar. Alardy ysyk da, suuk da bolbogon, salkyn kolokoluu zhaiga kirgizebiz.

Chynynda, Allakh Taala silerdi algan amanatyn'ardy eesine kyianat kylbai tapshyruuga buirudu. Oshondoi ele adamdarga okum chygaruuchu bolson'or, zhek korup zhe chyndyktan chettebesten, adil okum chygaruuga buirudu. Allakh Taala silerge sonun eskertuuchu zhana kandai abalda bolbogula silerdi tuura zholgo bagyttait. Allakh Taala silerdin sozun'ordu Uguuchu, ish-araketin'erdi Koruuchu.

Oo, Allakhka ishenip, Anyn paigambaryna eerchigen yimanduular, Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine bash iigile, alardyn buiruktaryn atkargyla, tyiuularynan tyiylgyla. Oshondoi ele ozun'ordun bashchyn'arga, eger al silerdi kunoogo buirubasa, bash iigile. Eger siler Allakhka zhana Kyiamat kununo ishengen yimanduu bolson'or zhana kaisy bir nersede orton'ordo talash chyksa, anda daroo Allakhtyn kitebine (Kuranga) zhana paigambardyn (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) sunnotuno kaitkyla. Ushintip Allakhtyn kitebine zhana sunnotko kaituu, talashty kuchotuudon zhe akylga salyp chechim chygaruudan alda kancha zhakshy. Munun akybeti da silerge zhakshy bolot.

Oo, elchi, saga zhana senden murdagy paigambarlarga tushkon nersege ishendik dep zhalgan aityshkan iakhudilerdin eki zhuzduulorun kordun'bu? Alar ishterinde Allakhtyn shariiaty emes, adamdar kaalagan nerse menen okum kyluunu kaalashat. A chyny, alar myndaidan bash tartuuga buirulgan ele. Shaitan alardy ech tuura zholgo tusho albai turgandai kylyp chyndyktan alystatuunu kaalait.

Bul eki zhuzduulorgo, kelgile, Allakh Taala kitebinde tushurgon okumdorgo zhana Allakhtyn elchisine kaitaly, silerdin talashyn'arga tuura okum chygaryp bersin dep aitylsa, alardyn senden toluk bash tartyp, bashka okum chygaruuchuga ketkenin korosun'

Zhasagan kunoolorunun sebebinen eki zhuzduulordun bashyna balee kelse, abaldary kandai bolot? Ei, elchi, kiiin alar saga kelip, senden bashkadan okum suroo menen zhakshylykty zhana talashuuchulardy biriktiruunu kaalaganbyz dep, uzur-sebebin aityp ant ichishet (berishet) Alar ushuntip zhalgan aityshat, chyny, zhakshylyk Allakh Taala pendelerine shariiat kylgan okumdordo

Allakh Taala alardyn zhurogundogu eki zhuzduulugun zhana zhaman nietterin bilet. ei, elchi, alardy tashta, alardan zhuz bur, alarga Allakhtyn okumun kyzyktyryp, eskertip, zhan-duinosuno turgandai zhetkiliktuu kylyp ait

Ar bir zhonotulgon paigambardy Allakhtyn kaaloosu zhana tagdyry menen Allakhka bash iie turgan kylyp zhonottuk. Eger tigi eki zhuzduulor kunooloru menen zhanyna zyian keltirgenden kiiin saga kelip, kylgandaryna okunup, toobo kylyshkanda zhana alarga kechirim tiloonu suranyshkanda, anda alar Allakh Taala alarga yraiym kylyp, toobolorun kabyl kylganyn korushmok.

Ishtin zhaiy tigi eki zhuzduulor oilogondoi emes. Allakh Taala bul zherde Ozunun uluuluguna ant berip, alar bardyk talashtuu ishterinde paigambardyn kozu tiruusundo any okum chygaruuchu kylmaiyncha, kozu otup ketkenden kiiin anyn shariiatyn okum chygaruuchu kylmaiyncha zhana paigambardyn okumuno yraazy bolmoiuncha, zhuroktorundo aga karata ech bir zhek koruu, shek-kumon kaltyrbai, ichi-syrty menen toluk ishenip ozdorun tapshyrmaiyncha, alardy chynygy yimanduu bolushpait.

(66-68-aiattarga tushundurmo) Biz alarga biri-birin olturuunu zhe zhashagan zherinen chygyp ketuunu buirusak; buirugubuzdu alardyn azy gana atkardy, alarga mashakat zharatkan ishti zhuktobogonu uchun Allakhka maktoo aityshsyn. Eger tigiler karshy chyguunun orduna Allakhka bash iiip Anyn aitkanyn atkaryshkanda zhakshy bolmok, yimandary da bekemdelmek. Alarga chon' soop-syi tartuulamakpyz, Allakhka zhana beiishke alyp bara turgan tuura zholgo salyp koimokpuz.

(66-68-aiattarga tushundurmo) Biz alarga biri-birin olturuunu zhe zhashagan zherinen chygyp ketuunu buirusak; buirugubuzdu alardyn azy gana atkardy, alarga mashakat zharatkan ishti zhuktobogonu uchun Allakhka maktoo aityshsyn. Eger tigiler karshy chyguunun orduna Allakhka bash iiip Anyn aitkanyn atkaryshkanda zhakshy bolmok, yimandary da bekemdelmek. Alarga chon' soop-syi tartuulamakpyz, Allakhka zhana beiishke alyp bara turgan tuura zholgo salyp koimokpuz.

(66-68-aiattarga tushundurmo) Biz alarga biri-birin olturuunu zhe zhashagan zherinen chygyp ketuunu buirusak; buirugubuzdu alardyn azy gana atkardy, alarga mashakat zharatkan ishti zhuktobogonu uchun Allakhka maktoo aityshsyn. Eger tigiler karshy chyguunun orduna Allakhka bash iiip Anyn aitkanyn atkaryshkanda zhakshy bolmok, yimandary da bekemdelmek. Alarga chon' soop-syi tartuulamakpyz, Allakhka zhana beiishke alyp bara turgan tuura zholgo salyp koimokpuz.

Kim Allakhka zhanan Anyn elchisine bash iise, al, Allakh Taala beiishke kiruu zhakshylygyn yroologon paigambarlar, alyp kelgen nersege chyn zhurokton ishenip, any ish zhuzundo atkargan yimanduular, Allakh zholunda kaza bolgon sheiitter, ichi-tyshy taza, ibadat-ishteri tak salikh kishiler menen birge bolot. Bular beiishtegi en' zhakshy zholdoshtor.
Zhogoruda aitylgan soop-syi Allakh Taalanyn pendelerine bergen artykchylygynan, alardyn abaldaryn biluugo Allakh zhetishtuu, emi alardyn ar birin ishine zharasha syilait

Oo, Allakhka ishengen zhana paigambardy eerchigen yimanduular, sogushka zhardam berchu ish-araketin'erdi kylyp sak turgula. Alarga karshy top-top bolup, birin'erdin artyn'ardan birin'er chykkyla, zhe choguu chykkyla. Munun baary ozun'ordu on'doogo zhana dushmanyn'ardan och aluuga ylaiyk.

Oo, musulmandar, silerdin aran'arda korkoktugunan ulam dushmanga betme-bet chyguudan aibygyp, bashkalardy da artka kaitargandar bar. Bular eki zhuzduu, yimany alsyz adamdar. Eger silerden biroolor sheiit bolso, zhe zhen'iluugo uchurasan'ar, tigilerdin biroosu tiruu kalganyna suiunup: Allakh meni bular syiaktuu sogushka katyshtyrbai, alardyn bashyna tushkon ishti menin bashyma tushurboi, meni syilady dep maktanat

Oo, musulmandar, eger Allakhtyn artykchylygy menen siler zhen'ishke zhetip olzhogo ee bolson'or, baiagy zhikhadga chykpai koigondor, tim ele siler menen murda ech bailanysh, mamilesi bolbogondoi: attin', alar menen birge zhikhadda bolsok, alar algan olzhogo biz da maarymakpyz deshet.

Bul duinonun kyzygyn kechip, akyrettin kyzygyna beriluu menen duinonun orduna akyretti satyp algan chynygy yimanduular Allakhtyn sozu biiik boluusu uchun Allakh zholunda sogushsun. Allakhtyn sozu biiik boluusu uchun sogushup, sheiit bolgondor, zhe dushmanyn zhen'gender, alarga zhakynda uluu soop-syi berebiz. Bul soop-syi - Allakhtyn yraazylygy zhana beiish.

Oo, momundar, Allakhtyn sozu biiik boluusu uchun zhana Allakhka kairylyp: O, Zharatuuchubuz, bizdi turgundary Allakhka shirk kyluu zhana pendelerge dushmandyk kyluu menen zulum kylyp zhatkan Mekkeden chygar, bizge Ozun'don bizdi saktap, zhardam berip kalkalap ala turgan dos-zhardamchy zhiber dep duba kylgan alsyz aial-erkek, zhash baldardyn azattygy uchun kazatka chyguudan silerdi emne tyiyp zhatat?

Chynygy yraimanduular Allakhtyn sozu biiik boluusu uchun sogushat, kaapyrlar bolso, ozdorunun "kudailarynyn" zholunda sogushat. Shaitandyn zhardamchylaryna karshy sogushkula, eger sogushsan'ar alarga ustomduk kylasyn'ar; antkeni shaitandyn aila-amaly alsyz, al Allakhka tobokel kylgandarga zyianyn tiigize albait

Oo, elchi, alarga zhikhad parz bolso dep surap zhurgon kee bir sakhaba-zholdoshtorun'du bilesin'bi? Alarga: sogushka kol sunbai tura turgula, namaz okup, zeket berip zhuro bergile dep aitylgan bolchu, (bul uchurda zhikhad parz bolo elek ele). Kiiin alar Madinaga kochup baryp, Islam kuch alganda zhikhad parz kylyndy. Bul alardyn keesine oor sezildi. Adamdardan Allakhtan korkkondon da katuu korkup: Oo, Zharatuuchubuz, bizge emne uchun zhikhaddy parz kyldyn'? Biz duino yrakhatyn tatyp algancha bir az kechiktirip tursan' zhakshy bolmok deshti. Ei, elchi, alarga: duino yrakhaty kanchalyk kop bolbosun baary bir zhok bolo turgan az nerse, al emi akyret tugongus zhakshylyktarga ee boluu uchun Allakhka takybalyk kylgan adamdarga zhakshy zhai, anda silerdin zhakshy ishterin'erden kurma daneginin chel kabygyndai da kemitilbeit.

Eger azhalyn'ar zhetse, kaisy zherde bolson'or da, sogush talaasynan alystagy bekem kurulgan ak saraiyn'ardyn ichinde bolso da olum kelet. Tigi kaapyrlar bala-chakasy, yryskysy mol bolup kalsa: bul Allakhtyn bergeni deshet. A eger bala-chakasynda zhe yryskysynda tarchylyk bolup, kyiynchylykka kabylsa, munu daroo paigambarga (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) shyltap yrymdap: bul zhamandyk senin aiyn'dan boldu deshet. Ei, elchi, alardyn sozun kaitaryp: bardyk zhakshylyk zhana zhamandyk Allakhtyn olchom, tagdyry menen bolot dep ait. Myna ushundai sozdor aitylsa da aga tushunbogon bul adamdarga emne bolgon?!

Oo, Adam balasy, seni kubandyra turgan bala-chaka, yrysky zh.b. kop boluusu bul Allakhtan, munu saga Allakh artykcha kyldy. Al emi seni kaigyrta turgan bala-chaka, yrysky zh.b. nersedegi zhamandyktar senin ozun'don, senin kunoogo kiripter bolgondugun'dan. Ei, paigambar, biz seni bardyk adam balasyna Allakhtyn elchisi kylyp, Zharatuuchun'dun dinin zhetkiruu uchun zhibergenbiz. Saga bergen dalilder menen dindi zhetkirgenin'eAllakh Ozu zhetishtuu kubo.

Paigambardyn buirugun atkaryp, tyiganynan tyiylyp aga bash iise; demek al Allakhka bash iigen bolot. Al emi, ei, elchi, kim saga bash iibese, sen aga kaigyrba, Biz seni anyn ar bir ishin kozomoldoochu karool kylyp zhibergen emespiz, Biz anyn ishin eseptep, esep-kysap kylabyz.

Eki zhuzduulor saga tili menen: saga bash iiebiz zhana aitkanyn'dy kylabyz deshet. Senden chykkandan kiiin alardyn bir zhamaaty saga aitkanynan zhashyruun kaityp ketet. Allakh alardyn ozgorgonun zhakshy bilet zhana ushul kuuluktary sebeptuu alardy zhakynda zhazalait. Sen alarga karaba; alar saga ech zyianyn tiigize albait. Ishin'de Allakhka gana tapshyryp Aga taian, saga taianych boluuga Allakh Taala zhetishtuu (Okul).

Alar emne uchun Kuranda bir da karama-karshylyk zhe talash zhok ekenine oi zhugurtushpoit?! Oshondo sen alyp kelgen nersenin chyndygyna ishenishmek. Eger Kuran Allakhtan bashkanyn sozu bolso, anyn okumdorundo bir kancha talashtardy, maanisinde karama-karshylyktardy tabyshmak.

Al eki zhuzduulorgo musulmandardyn amandygy, kubanychy zhe teskerisinche, korkunuchu, kaigysy tuuraluu kabar ugulsa, any daroo zhaiyp, taratyp zhiberishet. Eger antpesten, kabardy Allakhtyn elchisine (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) zhe ilimduu, akylduu, ken'esh beruuchu adamdaryna aityp baryshsa, alar bul kabardy zhaiuu zhe zhashyryp koiuu tuuraluu zhakshy bilmek. Oo, yimanduular, eger silerge Allakh pazileti menen Islamga kirgizip, yraiym kylyp Kuran tushurup, eki zhuzduulordu synagan syiaktuu synoodon kutkarbaganda, silerdin da kobun'or shaitandyn azgyrygyn eerchip ketmeksin'er.

Oo, elchi, Allakhtyn sozu biiik boluusu uchun sogush, bashkalardan suralbaisyn' zhana bul zaryl emes. Sen ozun'du gana sogushka buiru. Yimanduulardy aga shyktandyr zhana kyzyktyr. Silerdin sogushuun'ar sebeptuu, Allakh Taala kaapyrlardyn kuch-kubatyn alyp koiuusu mumkun, Allakh Taala oto kubattuu zhana Anyn azyby da katuu

Kim bashkalarga zhakshylyk alyp keluugo araket kylsa, aga oshol zhakshylygynan soop berilet. Kim bashkalarga zhamandyk alyp keluugo tyryshsa, aga oshol zhamandygynan kunoo berilet. Allakh Taala pendenin ar bir kylgan ishine kubo, kiiin oshol ishine zharasha zhazalait zhe syilait. Silerdin kimin'er zhakshylykka sebepker bolso, aga oshondon ulush berilet. Al emi kim zhamandykka sebepker bolso, aga oshondon berilet

Eger silerge biroo salam aitsa, anyn salamynan ashykcharaak kylyp, zhe salamynyn ozundoi zhoop kaitaryp alik algyla. Anyn salamynan ashykcha zhoop beruu zhakshy. Allakh Taala chynynda silerdin kylgan ishin'erdi saktoochu, kiiin ar birin'di oshol ishin'erge zharasha syilait zhe zhazalait

Allakh - Al andan bashka syiynuuga ylaiyktuu ech nerse zhok (Zhalgyz) Zat. Ech bir kumonu zhok kyiamat kunu Al silerdin murdagylaryn'ardy da kiiinkilerin'erdi da chogultat, ishterin'erge zharasha syilait zhe zhazalait. Allakhtan tuura, chyn suilogon ech kim zhok

Oo, yimanduular, eki zhuzduulor menen mamile kyluu boiuncha kaichy pikirde bolup ekige bolunup ketkenin'er emne: birin'er alar kaapyr bolgonu uchun alar menen sogushuu kerek dese, ekinchin'er: alar yimanduu, alar menen sogushuuga bolboit deisin'er?! Alar uchun silerdin bolunuun'or tuura emes. Alardy kylgan ishteri uchun Allakh Taala kaapyrlykka zhana adashuu zholuna saldy go, Allakh tuura zholdu yraa korbogon adamdardy siler tuura zholgo saluunu kaalaisyn'arby?! Allakh kimdi adashtyrsa, aga ech tuura zhol taba albaisyn'

Eki zhuzduulor silerge tushkon dinge ozdoru syiaktuu siler da kaapyr bolup, alar menen kaapyrlykta birdei boluun'ardy samait. Alar yimanyna dalil kylyp, shirkke tolgon zherden islam zhaiylyp zhatkan shaarga Allakh zholunda kochup chygyshsa gana alardy dos tutkula. A eger myndan bash tartyp, kaapyrlyktaryn ulanta berse, kaisy zherde zholuksan'ar oshol zherde olturgulo. Alardy ishin'erde bashkaruuchu dos da, dushmanyn'arga karshy kol kabysh kyluuchu zhardamchy da kylbagyla.

Birok, siler menen tynchtyk kelishimin tuzgondorgo koshulup algan adamdardy, siler menen da, koomu menen da sogushuuga zhurogu ee berbei, silerge kelgen adamdardy olturbogulo. Eger Allakh kaalasa, alardy silerge karshy koiup, alar siler menen sogushmak. Allakhtyn kechirimin kabyl kylgyla, alarga sogushuu, tutkundoo menen karshy chykpagyla, silerge tynchtykty sunushtasa, alar menen sogushpagyla. Allakh Taala alardy olturuun'orgo zhe tutkundoon'orgo zhol (uruksat) berbeit.

Oo, yimanduular, ozdorunun zhanynyn tynchtygyn kozdop, silerge yimanduu korungon, koomuna barganda alardan aman kaluu uchun alarga kaapyrlygyn korsotkon eki zhuzduulordun bir tobun korosun'or. Alardy kaapyrlykka, shirkke chakyrsa, alar aga bash otu menen berilishet. Eger alar silerge sogushun toktotposo, tynch zhashoonu sunushtabasa, silerden kolun tartpasa, anda alardy korgon zherde olturgulo. Myna ushundai sypattagy eki zhuzduulordu, alardyn buzuku zhana kuulugu uchun olturuugo silerge achyk dalil uruksat berdik.

yimanduu adam yimanduu adamdy olturuugo bolboit, birok adashyp kokustan olturup aluusu mumkun. Kim ushintip kokustan yimanduu adamdy olturup alsa, munusun zhuu uchun bir kuldu azattykka chygaruusu kerek. Olturgon adamdan muras ala turgan zhakyn tuugandary olgon adamdan muras ala turgan zhakyndaryna kun tolop beruusu kazhet. A eger tuugandary kechip zhiberse, anda kun toloodon kutulat. Egerde olturulgon adam yimanduu, birok musulmandarga karshy sogushup zhatkan koomdon bolso, anda olturuuchu bir kuldu azat kylsa zhetishtuu, kun tolonboit. A eger olturulgon adam yimanduu bolboso, birok musulmandar menen anyn koomunun ortosunda tynchtyk kelishim tuzulgon koomdon bolso (musulmandarga salyk tolop, alardyn arasynda zhashagan kaapyrlar syiaktuu), anda olturgon adamdan muras ala turgan zhakyn tuugandary kun toloit zhana olturuuchu kunoosun zhuu uchun kul azat kylat. Eger azat kyluuga kul tappasa zhe kuldun baasyn toloi albasa, anda Allakh Taala anyn toobosun kabyl kyluusu uchun, katary menen arasyn uzboston altymysh kun orozo karmasyn. Allakh Taala pendelerinin ishterin zhana nietterin Biluuchu, shariiat kyluuda zhana bashkaruuda Danyshman.

Al emi yimanduu adamdy akysyz atailap olturgon adamdyn zhazasy, eger al kylganyn adal dep eseptese, zhe toobo kylbasa, anda tozokko kirip, tuboluk kalat. Allakh Taala aga achuulanat, yraiym kylbait, ushundai chon' kunoogo batkandygy uchun aga katuu azap daiardap koigon.

Ei, Allakhka ishenip, paigambardy eerchigen yimanduular, Allakh zholunda kazatka attansan'ar, kim menen sogusharyn'ardy zhakshylap bilip algyla. Musulman ekeni korunup turgan adamga sen musulman emessin', sen zhanyn' zhe malyn' uchun korkup ele musulman korunup zhatasyn' debegile. Anan anyn bolor-bolbos duinosuno kyzygyp olturosun'or. Allakhtyn aldynda olzho kop, al olzho myna bul siler algan nerseden zhakshy zhana tuboluktuu. Silerda bir kezde tigi syiaktuu koomun'ardan yimanyn'ardy zhashyryp korkup zhurgonsun'or, kiiin Allakh Taala silerdi islam menen kubattandyrdy, kanyn'ardy saktady, emi ishin'erdi tak bilgile. Silerdin kylganyn'ar kanchalyk kichine bolbosun Allakhka zhashyruun kalbait, kiiin oshol ishin'erge zharasha syi zhe zhaza alasyn'ar (Zhikhadga bara zhatkan sakhabalar, aldynan chykkan kishi musulmancha salam aitsa, "bul korkup ele salam aitty, ozu kaapyr eken" dep olturup, mal-kelin ailap ketishet. Allakh Taala alardy tuura emes kylgany uchun zhemelep, bir kezde ozdoru da ushintip korkup-urkup zhurgonun eskertti).

Ooruluu, kozu korbogon zh.b. sebepteri zhok ele kazatka chykpai uido kalyp kalgan yimanduular menen mal-mulkun sarptap kazatka attangan yimanduular birdei bolboit. Allakh Taala mal-zhany menen kazatka attangandardyn darazhasyn tigilerge karaganda zhogoru kyldy. Maly-zhany menen kazatka attangandardyn da, zhe bir sebep menen uido kalgandardyn da ozuno zharasha soop-syiy bar. Allakh Taala mal-zhany menen kazatka attangandardy ozgocho chon' soop-syi menen artykcha kyldy
Bul soop-syi - kunoolorunun kechiriluusu, Allakhtyn yraiymy zhana birinen-biri oido bolgon orun-darazhalar, Allakh Taala pendelerin Kechiruuchu zhana alarga Yraiymduu

Kaapyr zherinen islam zherine kochuudon bash tartyp oz zhandaryna zulum kylgan adamdardyn zhanyn alaar uchurda, perishteler alardy zhemelep: Abalyn'ar emne boldu? Butparastardan emnen'er menen aiyrmalandyn'ar? dep surashat. Alar: biz alsyz elek, alardy kaitaruuga bizdin kuch-kuduretibiz zhetken zhok dep shyltoo aityshat. Perishteler alardy zhemelep: Allakhtyn zheri kenen emespi, bul zherden chygyp ketip dinin'erdi da, ozun'ordu da kaar-kazaptan aman alyp kalsan'ar bolboit bele?! deshet. Myna ushintip kochup chykpai kalgandardyn barar zheri tozok, bul alar kaityp bara turgan en' zhaman zhai

Bul korkunuchtuu ubada (tozokko tushuu) alsyz sebebi bar erkek, aial zhana baldarga tiesheluu emes. Bular kaar, zaalymdardy toktotuuga chamasy chark kelbegen, myndai kyiynchylyktan chygyp ketuugo zhol taba albagan zhardy-zharmachtar. Bulardy Allakh Taala yraiymy zhana zhumshaktygy menen kechirip koior. Allakh Taala pendelerine Zhumshak, alardyn toobo kylgandaryn Kechiruuchu

Bul korkunuchtuu ubada (tozokko tushuu) alsyz sebebi bar erkek, aial zhana baldarga tiesheluu emes. Bular kaar, zaalymdardy toktotuuga chamasy chark kelbegen, myndai kyiynchylyktan chygyp ketuugo zhol taba albagan zhardy-zharmachtar. Bulardy Allakh Taala yraiymy zhana zhumshaktygy menen kechirip koior. Allakh Taala pendelerine Zhumshak, alardyn toobo kylgandaryn Kechiruuchu

Kochuugo mumkunchulugu bolup turup kochpoi koigondorgo zhaman akybetti ubada kylgandan kiiin, kochuugo kyzyktyryp myndai deit:
Kaapyr zherinen islam zherine Allakhtyn yraazylygyn kozdop kochup chykkan adam, kochup bargan zherinen tashtap ketken zherine karaganda zhyluu orundu tabat, al zherde yzattuu bolup, kenen yryskyga zhetet. Allakh zhana anyn elchisi uchun uiunon kochup chykkan adam, koksogon zherine zhetpei ara zholdo kaza bolup kalsa, zhetpei kalgany aga ech zyianyn tiigizbeit, anyn soop-syiy Allakhtyn aldynda saktaluu. Allakh Taala toobo kylgan pendelerin Kechiruuchu, alarga Yraiymduu.

Saparda kaapyrlar taraptan zhamandyk keleerinen korkkson'or, tort rekettuu namazdy eki reketke kyskartyp okuun'arda kunoo zhok. Antkeni alardyn silerge bolgon dushmandygy achyk-aikyn. Saparda amanchylyk uchurunda da namazdy kyskartyp okuunun durustugu sakhikh khadisterde kelgen.

Oo, elchi, dushmandar menen sogush uchurunda askerlerin' menen birge namaz okui turgan bolson', askerdi eki zhamaatka bol. Birinchi zhamaat seni menen namazga tursun, namazga kural-zharaktary menen tura bersin. Ekinchi zhamaat bolso silerge karool bolup tursun. Birinchi zhamaat imam menen bir reket okugan son', namazdyn kalganyn ozdoru akyryna chygarat. Akyryna chygargandar silerdin artyn'arga otup dushmanga bet turat, bul uchurda korgop turgan ekinchi zhamaat kelip imam menen bir ireket okuit, imam salam bergen son' namazdaryn toluktap buturot. Bul uchurlarda dushmandan etiiat bolushsun zhana kural-zharagyn alyp alyshsyn. Antkeni kaapyrlar, siler namazga turganda kural-zharak, buium-terimin'erden kaparsyz kalsan'ar, kaparsyzdygyn'ardan paidalanyp daroo kol saluunu kozdop turushat. Eger zhamgyrdyn aiynan zhe ooruu sebeptuu zyian tartyp zhatsan'ar, anda kural-zharagyn'ardy zherge koiup tursan'ar dele kunoo emes, bolgonu, kolun'ardan kelishinche dushmandan etiet kylgyla. Allakh Taala chynynda kaapyrlarga alardy kordoochu azapty daiardap koigon

Oo, yimanduular, namazdy butkonun'ordo aruuloo, (tasbikh), maktoo (tamkhid), kelime (takhlil) aituu menen turgan, oturgan, zhatkan abalyn'arda Allakhty estep zikir kylgyla. Korkunuch zhok bolgondo, tynchtyk kezde namazdy parz, vazhyb, sunnottorun toluk tak atkaryp buirulgandai okugula. Namaz chynynda yimanduularga oz ubaktysynda okula turgan parz, mildet. Namazdy sebepsiz ubaktysynan kechiktiruugo bolboit. Bul okum zhergiliktuu turgundarga tiesheluu, al emi saparda bolson'or koshup zhana kyskartyp okusan'ar bolot.

Oo, yimanduular, kaapyr dushmanyn'ardyn artynan saia tushuugo alsyzdyk zhe zhalkooluk kylbagyla. Olum, zharakat aluu zh.b. silerdi charchatkan bolso, bul nerseler alardy dele charchatty, alar dele siler syiaktuu kyinaldy. Alardyn sabyr-chydamy, silerdin sabyr-chydamyn'ardan ashyp ketpesin. Siler Allakhtan soop-syi, zhardam, koldoo umut kylyp zhatasyn'ar, alar bolso bulardy umut kylbait. Allakh Taala pendelerinin abalyn Biluuchu, kozomoldoodo zhana shariiat kyluuda Daanyshman

Oo, elchi, Biz saga Kurandy bardyk chyndykty kamtygan abalda tushurduk; sen adamdardyn ortosunda oz oiun' zhana pikirin' menen okum chygarbai, kandai abal bolso da Allakh uirotkon zhana pikirin'e salgan nerse menen okum kyluun' uchun. Emi sen andan chyndykty talap kylgan adamdy kaitaryp, zhanyna zhana amanatka kyianat kylgan adamga tarapker bolbo.
Allakh Taaladan kechirim zhana yraiym kyluusun sura, Allakh Taala chynynda toobo kylgan pendesine Kechirimduu zhana aga Yraiymduu
Kyianat kylgan zhana kyianattygyn zhaap-zhashyrgan adam tarabynda bolup talashpa, Allakh Taala myndai zhalganchy kyianatchylardy zhakshy korboit.

Adamdardan korkup zhe uialyp batyp ketken kunoolorun zhashyruusu mumkun, birok Allakhtan zhashyra albait. Allakh alardy ilimi menen orop alar menen birge. Taza adamga zhalaa zhabuu, kunoonu zhashyruu syiaktuu Allakhty yraazy kylbai turgan nerselerdi kyluunu oilop zhatyshkandary da Allakhka zhashyruun emes. Allakh Taala alardyn achyk zhana zhashyruun kylgan ishterin orop aluuchu, Aga ech nerse bilinbei kalbait, kiiin oshol kylgan ishterine zharasha zhazalait

Oo, mobureki kunoogo batkandardyn ishine arachy bolgondor, bul duinodo alardy taza dep, alardy zhazadan saktap talashkandar, a kyiamat kunuchu, alardyn kylgany achykka chykkanda, Allakh Taala menen kim talasha alat?! Oshol kunu kim alarga koldoochu okul bolo alat?! Shek zhok, myndai kyluu ech kimdin kolunan kelbeit.

Zhaman ish kylyp, zhe kunoogo but koiup ozuno zulum kylgan adam, kunoosun moiundap, aga okunup, emi any takyr kylbaim dep Allakhtan kechirim surap toobo kylsa, Allakh Taalany daiyma anyn kunoosun Kechiruuchu zhana aga Yraiymduu tabat.
Adam chon' kunoo kylaby, kichine kunoo kylaby anyn zhaman akybeti ozuno, al uchun bashka zhoop berbeit. Allakh Taala pendelerdin ishin Biluuchu, kozomoldoodo zhana shariiat kyluuda Daanyshman
Kim bilbesten kata ketirse, zhe atailap ele kunoo kylsa, kiiin myndai kunoodon taza adamga oshonu kyldyn' dep zhalaa kylsa, bul kylygy menen oto zhalganchylykty zhana achyk kunoonu moiununa ilip aldy

Oo, elchi, eger senin tazalygyn'a Allakhtyn artykchylygy bolbogondo, tigi zhandaryna kyianat kylgandardyn bir zhamaaty seni adashtyruunu zhana tuura emes okum chygartuunu koksop kalgan ele. Akyikatta alar ozdorun gana adashtyrdy; antkeni adashtyruuga zhasagan araketinin zhaman akybeti ozdoruno kaitty. Allakh taala seni korgogonu sebeptuu alar saga zyian bere alyshpait. Allakh taala saga Kuran, sunnottu tushurdu, sen buga cheiin bilbegen tuura zholdu, nurdu bildirdi. Allakhtyn artykchylygy saga bergen paigambarlyk zhana kunoosuzduk menen uluu boldu.

Adamdar kubur-shybyr kylgan kop sozdordo zhakshylyk zhok, alardan paida da chykpait. Birok, sadaga beruugo buirugan, shariiatka tuura kelgen zhana akylga syigan zhakshy ishterge chakyrgan, talashyp-tartyshkandardy zharashtyruuga undogon sozdor zhakshy zhana paidaluu. kim ushundai sozdordu Allakhtyn yraazylygyn talap kylyp aitsa, zhakynda aga chon' soop-syi tartuulaibyz.

Chyndyk achyk-aikyn bolgondon kiiin dele paigambarga kezhirlik kylyp, aga karshy ish kylsa zhana yimanduulardyn zholunan bashka zholgo tushso, ozuno tandagan zholuna zhon koiobuz. Ataiyn bash tartkany uchun any tuura zholgo bagyttabaibyz. Any taby kuchtuu tozok otuna kirgizebiz, kirgen adam uchun al en' zhaman zhai.

Allakh Taala chynynda Aga sherik koshkondordu kechirbeit, teskerisinche, sherik koshuuchulardy tozokto tuboluk kaltyrat. Shirkten bashka kunoolordu yraiymy zhana artykchylygy menen kaalagan adamdan kechiret. Kim Allakhka bashka bir nerseni sherik kylyp alsa, chyndyktan taiyp andan oto alys ketiptir; antkeni al Zharatuuchunu zharatylgandarga ten'edi

Bul butparastar (sherik kyluuchular) ibadat kylyshpait, Allakh menen birge "Lat", "Uzza" degen syiaktuu aial tegindegi aikelderge da duba kylyshat. Bulardan paida da, zyian da zhok. Bular Allakhtyn zholunan chykkan, ech paidasy zhok shaitanga ibadat kylyshat; antkeni oshol shaitan alardy aikelderge ibadat kyluuga buiruit
Oshon uchun Allakh Taala any yraiymynan kuuganda, al shaitan Zharatuuchusuna ant berip: maga pendelerin'den belgiluu bir bolugun ber, men alardy tuura zholdon buraiyn degen

Alardy Senin tuura zholun'dan tosom, alarga adashuusun kooz korsoto turgan zhalgan ubadalardy berem, Allakh adal kylgan maldaryn aramga chygartuu uchun alardyn kulagyn kesuugo buiruimun (aikelderine arnap kee bir toolorunun kulagyn kesip, en tamga salyp, oshol toonu yiyk sanap, any minbei, ishtetpei, soiboi bosh koio berip koiushkan) Allakhtyn zharatkanyn zhana tabiiatyn ozgortuugo buiruimun (deit shaitan). Kim shaitandy dos-bashchy kylyp, aga bash iise kuulgan shaitandy dos kylgany uchun anyk zyianga tush boluptur
Alarga shaitan zhalgan ubada beret, zhalgan kyialga beriltet, chynynda ech bir akyikaty zhok zhalgan nerseni ubada kylat.
Shaitandyn zholuna tushkon'dordun baryp toktoochu zhaiy tozok otu, andan alardy kutkaryp chygaruuchunu taba alyshpait

Allakh Taala shaitandy eerchigenderdin zhazasyn aitkandan kiiin, emi paigambardy eerchigenderdin syiyn aityp myndai deit:
Allakhka ishenip, Aga zhakyndatuuchu zhakshy ish-araketterdi kylgan yimanduu adamdardy ak sarailarynyn aldynan daryialar agyp turgan beiishke kirgizebiz. Alar anda tuboluk kalyshat. Bul Allakhtyn ubadasy, Allakhtyn ubadasy chyndyk, Al ubadasyna teskeri ish kylbait, ech kim Allakh Taaladai chyn suiloi albait

Oo, musulmandar, iigilik zhana zhen'ish siler, zhe kitep berilgender kyialdangandai ele bolup kalbait. Bul, ish araketke zharasha bolot. Silerdin kimin'er zhaman ish kylsa, kyiamatta oshogo zhoop beret, aga paidasyn tiigize turgan Allakhtan bashka dos, any zyiandan korgop kala turgan Allakhtan bashka zhardamchy tabylbait.

Allakh Taalaga chyndap ishengen erkek bolobu, aial bolobu zhakshy ishterdi kylsa, myna ushul yiman menen zhakshy ishterdi birge kylgan adamdar beiishke kiret zhana alardyn kylgan ishterinen kurmanyn daneginin chel kabygyndai da kemitilbeit

Nietin Zhalgyz Allakhka burup, ichi-syrty menen Allakhka bash iiip ozun tapshyrgan, shariiatty toluk karmangan, shirk zhana kaapyrlyktan teskeri burulup, bir Kudaiga syiynuu ishenimine zhana yimanga kaitkan, Mukhammad paigambardyn (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) dininin negizi bolgon Ibrakhim paigambardyn dinine eerchigen adamdyn dininen otkon dindi karmangan zhan barby? Allakh Taala paigambary Ibrakhimdi bardyk adamdardyn arasynan chyndap zhakshy koruu menen Ozuno dos kylyp tandap algan.
Asman-zherdegi mulk, padyshalyktyn baary Zhalgyz Allakhka taandyk, Allakh Taala Ozu zharatkandyn baaryn ilimi, kudureti zhana kozomolu menen orop algan.

Oo, elchi, senden aialdar tuuraluu alarga zhana alardan emne atkaruu mildet ekenin surashat. Sen ait: Allakh siler suragan nerseni baian kylgan, Kurandagy silerdin kol aldyn'ardagy zhetim kyzdardyn abaly, alarga beriluusu parz bolgon makhyr zhana murasty berbei koigonun'ar, alardy nikeloogo kyzykpaganyn'ar, alardyn malyna kyzygyp alardy nikelendirbei koigonun'ar (tuuraluu aitylgan aiattarda baian kylgan). Silerge al alsyz-baikushtar kichine kezinde alarga muras beruu mildet ekeni, alardyn malyn ishtetip zulum kylboon'or zaryl ekeni baian kylyndy. Zhetimderge alardyn duino-akyrettegi abalyn zhakshyrta turgandai adildik menen mamile kyluu mildet ekeni baian kylyndy. Zhetimderge bolobu, bashkaga bolobu kandai zhakshylyk kylsan'ar, any Allakh Biluuchu, kiiin oshogo zharasha syilanasyn'ar

Eger aial kuioosu aga kon'ulkosh boluusunan korkso zhe any tashtap ketet dep chochulasa, anda ekoo aialdyn napakasy, zhashai turgan zheri syiaktuu ukuktaryn chektoo uchun kelishim kylyshsa kunoo emes. Kelishim kyluu talakka karaganda ekoono zhakshy. Chynynda napsi ach koz zhana saran', ozuno tiesheluu ukuktardyn chekteluusun kaalabait, zhubailar kechirimduu boluu, zhakshylyk kyluu menen napsilerin tarbiialap bul tabigyi ooruunu daryloosu kazhet. Bardyk abaldarda zhakshylyk kyluuchu bolson'or, buirugun atkaryp, tyiganynan tyiylyp Allakhka takyba bolson'or, Allakh Taala chynynda silerdin emne kylganyn'ardan Kabardar, Aga ech nerse bilinbei kalbait, kiiin oshogo zharasha silerdi syilait.

Oo, kuioolor, kanchalyk araket kylsan'ar da zhuroktun beriluusundo aialdaryn'arga baary bir adilettik kyla albaisyn'ar; Sebebi keede ishter silerdin kaaloon'ordon syrtkary bolot. Zhakshy korbogon aialyn'ardy ashykcha zhek korup, any kam korbogon kuioosu bar, zhe kuioosu zhok kuioogo muktazh bolgon aial syiaktuu ara zholgo tashtabagyla. Aialyn'ardyn akysyn beruunu kaalabagan napsin'erdi konduruu menen orton'ordu on'doson'or zhana Allakhka takyba bolson'or, Allakh Taala chynynda silerge Kechirimduu zhana Yraiymduu.

Eri-katyn talak zhe khul'u sebeptuu biri-birinen azhyrashsa, Allakh Oz pazileti menen alardy biri-birine muktazh kylbait. Allakh taala Pazilettuu, Yraiymduu bashkaruu zhana tagdyr kyluusunda Daanyshman.

Asman-zherdegi zhana alardyn ortosundagy mulk, padyshalyktyn baary Zhalgyz Allakhka taandyk. Kitep eelerine da, silerge da Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiuularynan tyiyluunu kelishim kylganbyz. Bul kelishimdi buzsan'ar, ozun'orgo gana zyiany tiet. Allakh Taala silerdin bash iiuun'orgo muktazh emes, asman-zherdegi mulk, padyshalyktyn baary Aga taandyk. Al bardyk zharatylgandarga muktazh emes, bardyk sypattary zhana ishteri maktalgan Zat
Asman-zherdegi mulk, padyshalyktyn baary Zhalgyz Allakhka taandyk, bash iiuugo ylaiyk. Zharatylgandardyn bardyk abaldaryn kozomoldoogo zhetishtuu Okul
Ei, adamdar, eger kaalasa silerdi zhok kylyp kyryp, Allakhka bash iiip, kunoodon tyiyla turgan silerden bashkalardy zharatyp koiot, myndai kyluuga Allakh Taala Kudurettuu

Ei, adamdar, silerden kim ish-araketi uchun bul duinonun gana zhakshylygyn kaalasa, bilsin, Allakhta duino-akyrettin soobu bar, bul ekoonun ten' soop-syiyn surasyn, Allakh Taala silerdin sozun'ordu Uguuchu, ish-araketin'erdi Koruuchu, kiiin oshogo zharasha silerdi syilait zhe zhazalait

Oo, Allakhka ishenip, paigambarga eerchigen yimanduular, bardyk abalyn'arda adilettuu bolgula. Bardyk adamdarga kuboluk beruudo adil bolgula. Eger ozun'ordun zyianyn'arga zhe ata-enen'erdin, zhe zhakyn tuugandaryn'ardyn zyianyna bolso da kuboluk beruudo adil bolgula. Alardyn kedeiligi zhe bailygy alarga kuboluk beruugo zhe berbei koiuuga toskool bolbosun. Kedeige da, baiga da silerge karaganda Allakh abzelireek zhana alardyn zhakshylygyn biluuchurook. Chyndyk achykka chygyp kalboosu uchun kuboluk beruudo kaaloon'orgo berilip ketpegile. Eger kuboluktu ozuno ylaiyk bolbogon zhakka burup ozgortson'or zhe kuboluk beruudon bash tartsan'ar; Allakh Taala chynynda silerdin emne kylganyn'ardan Kabardar.

Oo, yimanduular, Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine, Anyn elchisine tushurulgon Kuranga, andan murdagy paigambarlaryna tushurgon kitepke bolgon ishenimin'erde bekem bolgula. Kim Allakhka, perishtelerine, kitepterine, elchilerine, kyiamat kununo ishenbei kaapyrlyk kylsa; anda al tuura zholdon oto alys ketiptir

Yiman keltirgenden kiiin kaira dinden chygyp, kiiin kaira yiman keltirip,kiiin dagy dinden chygyp, kaapyrlygyn bir kancha zholu kaitalagan zhana kaapyr teiinche zhurup otup ketkender; Allakh alardyn kunoosun kechirbeit, Allakh Taalaga alyp barchu tuz zholdu alarga yraa korboit
Oo, elchi, syrtynan yimanduu, ichinde kaapyr bolgon eki zhuzduulorgo kyiamat kunu Allakh Taalanyn kordoochu azaby bolorun aityp suiunchulo

Alar yimanduulardy emes, kaapyrlardy zhardamchy, koldoochu kylyp algany uchun alarga ushundai azap bolot, (alardyn osholorgo ishenip aluusu tan' kalyshtuu). alar kotoruluu uchun osholordon kuch, koldoo surashaby?! Chynynda kuch da, koldoo da, baary Allakhta.

Oo, momundar, Allakh Taala silerge Kuranda, eger bir oturushta otursan'ar zhana anda Allakhtyn aiattaryna kaapyr bolgon zhana any shyldyn'dagandardy uksan'ar; Allakhtyn aiattaryna kaapyr bolbogon zhana shyldyn'dabagan bashka sozgo otmoiuncho alardy tashtap al zherden turup ketuu zaryl degen okumdu tushurdu. Eger alardan Allakhtyn aiattaryna kaapyr bolgon zhana any shyldyn'dagan sozdorun ukkandan kiiin dele alar menen otura bersen'er, Allakhtyn ishine karshy chyguuda alar menen birdei bolup kalasyn'ar; antkeni alar kaapyrlygy menen Allakhka kunookor bolgondoi ele siler da alar menen choguu olturup Allakhka kunookor boldun'ar. Kyiamat kunu Allakh Taala syrtyn musulman korsotup, kaapyrlygyn ichine zhashyrgan eki zhuzduulordun baaryn kaapyrlar menen birge tozokko kirgizet

Alar silerge zhakshylyk bolobu, zhamandyk bolobu kutup turushat. Eger silerge Allakh zhardam berip, olzhogo ee bolson'or, olzhodon alyp kaluu uchun: "biz siler menen birge, siler kubo bolgon nersege kubo bolbodukpu?!" deshet. A eger zhen'ish kaapyrlar tarapka bolso, alarga: "biz silerge zhardam, koldoo korsotup, yimanduulardan silerdi korgoboduk bele?! deshet. Kyiamatta baaryn'ardyn ustunon Allakh okum chygarat, yimanduular beiishke kiruu menen syilanat, eki zhuzduulor tozoktun en' tomonku katmaryna tushuu menen zhazalanat. Allakh Taala kyiamat kunu kaapyrlar yimanduulardyn ustunon dalil alyp keluusuno zhol berbeit, teskerisinche yimanduularga zhakshy akybetin beret. Eger yimandarynda chynchyl bolup, shariiattyn cheginen chygyshpasa.

Syrtynan islamdy korsotup, kaapyrlygyn ichine katyp eki zhuzduulor Allakhty aldaibyz dep oiloit, Allakh alardy aldait; alardyn kaapyrlygyn bilip kanyn kechip koidu zhana akyrette alardyn akybeti katuu bolorun ubada kyldy. Eki zhuzduulor namazga tursa, any zhaktyrbai, zhalkoolonup turushat, Allakhty yimanduulardy korgondo gana bir az esteshet

Al eki zhuzduulor eki anzhy bolup airan kalyshty, ichinde da, syrtynda da yimanduular menen birge emes, kaapyrlar menen da birge emes. Alardyn syrty musulmandar menen ichi kaapyrlar menen birge,ei, elchi, Allakh kimdi ushintip adashtyryp koiso, any adashuudan tuura zholgo ech bashtai albaisyn'

Oo, Allakhka ishenip, paigambardy eerchigen yimanduular, yimanduulardy emes, Allakhka kaapyr bolgondordu dos kylasyn'arby, ushul kylygyn'ardy Allakh Taala azapka ylaiyk kyla turgan anyk dalil kyluusun kaalaisyn'arby?!
Eki zhuzduulordu Allakh Taala kyiamat kunu tozoktun en' tupku katmarynda kylat, alardy azaptan kutkara turgan ech bir zhardamchy tappaisyn'

A birok, eki zhuzduulugun tashtap, toobo kylyp Allakhka kaitkandar, ichindegi kirin tazartkandar, Allakhtyn kelishimin bekem karmagandar, ishterin elge korsotuu uchun emes, kalys Allakh uchun kylgandar, myna ushul sypattar menen sypattalgandar bul duinodo da, akyrette da yimanduular menen birge, zhakynda Allakh Taala yimanduularga kop soop-syiyn beret

Eger Allakhka ishenip, Aga shugur kylsan'ar, Allakh Taalaga silerdi azaptoonun kazheti zhok. Allakh Taala zhakshylyk kyluuchu, yraiymduu, Al silerdi kunoon'or sebeptuu gana azaptait. Eger ishin'erdi on'doson'or, zhakshylktaryna shugur kylsan'ar, ichin'erde da, tyshyn'arda da Aga ishensen'er, silerdi ech azaptabait. Zhakshylygyn moiundagan adamdarga Allakh Taala Shugur kyluuchu, al uchun alarga soobun kop kylat, pendelerinin yimanyn zhakshy bilet, kiiin ar birin oshogo zharasha syilait zhe zhazalait

Allakh Taala zhaman sozdordun ashkere aityluusun zhaktyrbait, aga achuusu kelet zhana myndai sozdordu aitkandardyn akybeti zhaman bolorun ubada kylgan. Birok kimdir biroodon zyian korup, zhapa chekken adam aga karata zhaman soz aitsa uruksat. Misaly, zalymdygyn aityp aryzdansa, zhe aga zhaman duba kylsa, zhe anyn aitkanyndai zhoop kaitarsa bolot. A eger zyian korgon kishi sabyr kylyp unchukpai kalsa, bul andan da zhakshy. Allakh Taala silerdin ar bir sozun'ordu Uguuchu, nietin'erdi Biluuchu, zhaman soz aituudan zhana any maksat kyluudan etiet bolgula.

Soz menen bolobu, ish menen bolobu, aitor kandai zhakshylyk bolbosun, any ashkere kylsyn'ar da, zhashyruun kylsyn'ar da, zhe silerge zhasalgan zhamandykty kechirip koison'or; (Allakh silerdi kechiret) antkeni Allakh Taala chynynda Kechirimduu zhana Kudurettuu. Kechirimduuluk silerdin kulkun'ardan bolsun, oshondo Allakh Taala da silerdi kechireer

Allakhka da, Anyn elchisine da kaapyr bolgondor zhana Allakhka yiman keltirip, paigambarlaryn zhalganga chygaruu menen Allakh zhana Anyn elchilerinin ortosun boluunu kaalagandar: elchilerdin kee birine yiman keltirebiz, kee birine yiman keltirbeibiz deshet. Alar kaapyrlyk menen yimandyn ortosunda bir zholdu karmap, myna ushul zhol menen iigilikke zhetebiz dep kyialdanat.

myna ushundai zholdu tandap algandar chynygy kaapyrlar; antkeni elchilerdin kee birine kaapyr boluu, bul Allakhka zhana bardyk elchilerge kaapyr boluu degen soz. Kaapyrlardy kor kyla turgan azapty Kyiamat kungo daiardap koigonbuz. Bul zhaman akybet alar Allakhka zhana Anyn elchilerine yiman keltiruudo tekeberlengeni uchun.

Kaapyrlardyn zhazasyn eskertkenden kiiin, Allakh Taala yimanduulardyn syiyn eskertip myndai deit:
Allakhka ishenip, Any Zhalgyz dep taanygan, Aga ech nerseni sherik kylbagan zhana Anyn bardyk elchilerin chyndyk dep ishengen, kaapyrlar syiaktuu al elchilerdi biri-birinen azhyratpastan baaryna birdei ishengen adamdar; myna ushundai adamdarga Allakh Taala zhakynda alardyn yimany zhana zhakshy ishteri uchun chon' soop-syi tartuulait. Allakh Taala toobo kylgan pendelerine Kechirimduu zhana alarga Yraiymduu

Oo, elchi, iakhudiler senden senin chyn paigambar ekenin'din belgisi katary, Musa paigambarga tushurulgon syiaktuu, Kurandy da toluk boidon daroo tushurup beruun'du surashat. Alardyn bul kylygyn sen oor sanaba, alardyn murdagylary Musadan myndan da oor nerseni 'alyp kylgan. Alar Allakhty bizdin kozubuzgo korsot deshken. Anan ushul kylgandarynyn aiynan alar chagylgan urup azaptaldy. Kiiin alardy Allakh kaira tiriltti. Alar Allakh Taalanyn zhalgyzdygyna, zharatuuda da, ibadat kyluuda da Allakh Zhalgyz ekenine achyk dalil, belgiler kelgenden kiiin dele Allakhka ibadat kylbai, muzoogo syiynyp ketishti. Kiiin alardyn bul kylygyn da kechirdik. Musaga bolso koomuna korsotuusu uchun achyk-aikyn belgi-dalilderdi berdik

Alardy emne kutup turganyn bilsin dep korkutup, anan ant-ubadasyn aluu uchun toonu alardyn ustuno kotorduk. Toonu alardyn ustuno kotorgondon kiiin: emi yiyk uigo (bait al-mukaddaska) bashyn'ardy iiip, sazhda kylyp kirgile dedik. Alar arty menen soilop kirishti. Anan alarga: ishembi kunu balyk uuloogo chygpagyla dedik. Birok alardyn kee birleri bul kunu uuloogo chygyshty. Ushintip alar menen bekem ant-ubada alyshtyk, birok bul ubadany alar buzushtu

Bergen ubadalaryn atkarbagany, Allakhtyn aiattaryna kaapyr bolgonu, paigambarlardy tartynbai olturgonduktoru zhana Mukhammad paigambarga (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) bizdin zhurogubuz kulptanuu degeni sebeptuu alardy yraiymybyzdan chettetik. Birok ishtin zhaiy alar aitkandai emes, Allakh Taala alardyn kaapyrlyktary sebeptuu zhuroktoruno moor basyp koigon, alarga emi ech zhakshylyk zhetpeit, alar yimanga kelbeit kelse da paidasyn tiigizbei turgan az gana yimanga kelet.
oshondoi ele kaapyrlygy zhana Mariiamga (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy bolsun) zyna kyldyn' dep zhalgan zhalaa zhapkany uchun alardy yraiymdan chettettik

Biz Allakhtyn elchisi Mariiamdyn uulu Masikhti olturduk degen zhalgan maktanych sozdoru sebeptuu alardy kargadyk. Alar aityshkandai, any (Isany) olturgon da emes, askan da emes. Alar Allakh Taala Isaga okshotup koigon adamdy asyp olturushkon. Anan oshol olturgondoru Isa dep oiloshkon. Any olturduk degen iakhudiler da, alarga ishengen khristiandar da, ekoo ten' bul ishte shek-kumondo, alar any achyk bilbeit, kumondorun gana aityshat. Chynynda, alardyn kumonundo ech bir chyndyk zhok, alar isany olturgon emes zhana any askan da emes

Allakh Taala Isany alardyn zhamandygynan saktap, any dene zhana rukhu menen birge Ozuno kotorup algan. Allakh Taala padyshalygynda Yzattuu, Aga ech kim ustomduk kyla albait. Kozomol kyluuda, ishke ashyruuda zhana shariiat kyluuda Daanyshman.

Isa paigambar akyr zamanda kaira tushup, olgongo cheiin aga kitep berilgenderdin baary yiman keltirip, ishenishet. Kyiamat kunu Isa paigambar alardyn shariiatka dal kelbegen, aga karshy bolgon ishterine kubo otot.

Iakhudilerdin zalymdygy sebeptuu alarga murda adal bolgon kee bir taza azyktardy aram kylyp, tyiuu saldyk. Alarga bardyk (ai) tuiaktuulardy, ui, koidun zhonundagy maiy, charbysy zhana chuchugunan bashka mailaryn, aram kyldyk. Bul, alar ozdorun da, ozgolordu da Allakhtyn zholunan toskondugu uchun boldu, alardyn tosuusu tubasa adatka ailandy.

Paidalanuudan Allakh Taala tyigandan kiiin dele sutkorduktu paidana bergeni zhana shariiattyk ukugu zhok ele bashkalardyn malyn alyp zhegeni sebeptuu (adal nerselerdi alarga aram kyldyk). Alardyn kaapyrlaryna zhan keiitken azapty daiardap koiduk

Kitep berilgenderdin kemchiligi aitkandan kiiin alardyn arasyndagy yimanduular tuuraluu soz bolot:
Birok iakhudilerdin arasynda ilimde bekem bolgondoru, Allakh Taala saga tushurgon Kuranga, senden murdagy paigambarlarga tushurgon Toorot, Inzhil syiaktuu kitepterge ishengenderi, namaz okgandary, malynyn zeketin bergenderi, Allakhty Zhalgyz dep taanyp, Aga ech sherik koshpogondoru, kyiamat kununo ishengenderi da bar; myna ushundai sypattar menen sypattalgandarga zhakynda chon' soop-syi berebiz

Oo, elchi, biz saga senden murdagy paigambarlarga aian-kabar bergen syiaktuu aian-kabar berdik. Sen birinchi elchi emessin'. Biz Nukhka da aian-kabar bergenbiz zhana andan kiiin kelgen paigambarlarga da aian-kabar tushurgonbuz. Ibrakhimge aian-kabar berdik, anyn baldary Ismail menen Iskhakka berdik, Iskhaktyn uulu Iakubga berdik zhana alardyn urpaktaryna berdik (alar Iakub paigambardyn on eki uulunan taragan Israil urpaktarynan chykkan paigambarlar). Isaga, Aiubga, Iunuska, Kharunga zhana Sulaimanga aian-kabar berdik. Oshondoi ele Daudga Zabur kitebin tushurduk

Biz saga Kuranda an'gemelep aityp bergen elchiler bar, saga aitpagan elchiler da bar. Alardy aitpai koiuunun ozuncho daanyshman syry bar. Al emi Musa paigambar menen Allakh Taala ortomchusuz Ozuno gana ylaiyk chynygy suiloshuu menen suiloshtu, Musany urmattagany uchun

Paigambar, elchilerden kiiin adamdar Allakh Taalaga turduu shyltoo aityp, dalil kylboosu uchun, Allakhka ishengenderge chon' soop-syi bolorun suiunchuloochu, al emi Aga kaapyr bolgondorgo katuu azap bolorun aityp korkutuuchu kylyp bul elchilerdi zhiberdik. Allakh Taala padyshalygynda Yzattuu, ishke ashyruuda Daanyshman.

Oo, elchi, saga iakhudiler kaapyr bolgonu menen, Allakh Taala saga tushurulgon Kurandyn tuura, chyndyk ekenin bekemdep, tasyktap zhatat. Allakh Taala Kurandy emneni zhakshy korup, emnege yraazy bolorun, emneni zhek korup, emnege naarazy bolorun pendelerine bildiruunu kaalap, Oz ilimi menen tushurdu. (Ei, Mukhammad) Allakhtyn kubolugu menen birge perishteler da saga tushkon Kuranga kuboluk berip zhatat. Allakh Taala zhetishtuu Kubo, Anyn kubolugu bashkalardyn kubolugusuz ele zhetishtuu
Senin paigambarlygyn'a ishenbegender zhana adamdardy islamdan tyigandar chyndyktan aiabai alys ketishti

Allakhka zhana Anyn elchilerine ishenbegenderdi,kaapyr teiinde kalyp oz zhandaryna zalym kylgandardy, ala kaapyrlygyn ulantkany sebeptuu Allakh Taala kechirbeit zhana azaptan kutula turgan tuura zholgo bagyttabait
Birok alardy tozokko alypbarchu zholgo bagyttait, anda tuboluk kalyshat. Myndai kyluu Allakh Taalaga zhen'il, Al ech nerseni atkara albai kalbait

Oo, adamdar, Mukhammad paigambar (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) chynynda silerge Allakh Taaladan akyikat dindi, tuura zholdu alyp keldi. Al alyp kelgen dinge ishengile, bul duinodo da, akyrette da ozun'orgo zhakshy. Eger Allakhka ishenbei kaapyrlyk kylsan'ar, Allakh silerdin ishenimin'erge muktazh emes, kaapyrlygyn'ar Aga ech zyianyn tiigizbeit. Asmandardagy, zherdegi zhana bulardyn ortosundagy bardyk mulk padyshalyk Allakhka taandyk. Allakh Taala tuura zholgo kim ylaiyktuu ekenin bilet zhana aga al zholgo tushuunu zhen'il kylat, al emi kim ylaiyk bolboso, any al zholdon tyiyp koiot, Allakh sozundo, ishinde, shariiatynda zhana tagdyr kyluuda Oto Daanyshman

Oo, elchi, Inzhildin eesi bolgon khristiandarga ait: Dinin'erde asha chappagyla, Allakh Taalaga Isa paigambar tuuraluu chyndykty gana aitkyla, chynynda Mariiamdyn uulu Isa Masikh chynygy din menen Allakh Taala chygargan elchi, any Zhebireiildi Mariiamga zhiberip Ozunun bir ooz sozu menen zharatkan, al sozu "bol" degen soz, oshonu menen "bolup" kaldy. Al Allakhtyn buirugu menen Zhebireiil uilogon Allakhtyn demi. Allakhka zhana Anyn elchilerine biri-birinen azhyratpastan ishengile. Allakhty uchoo debegile, bul zhalgan, buzuku sozun'ordu toktotkula, toktotkonun'ar duino zhana akyrette ozun'orgo zhakshy. Allakh Taala chynynda Zhalgyz sherigi, balasy boluudan aruu-taza, Al muktazh emes, Asmandagy, zherdegi zhana bulardyn ortosundagy mulk, padyshalyktyn baary Anyky, asman-zherdeginin baaryn kozomoldop, bashkaruuga Zhetishtuu

Mariiamdyn uulu Isa Allakhka kul boluudan ardangan zhana tyiylgan zhok, Allakh Ozuno zhakyn kylgan perishteler da Aga kul boluuga ardangan zhok. Anan kantip siler Isany kudai sanaisyn'ar?! Kim Allakhka ibadat kyluudan ardanyp, tekeberlense, kyiamat kunu Allakh Taala alardyn baaryn zhyinait zhana ar birin ozuno zharasha zhazalait

Allakh Taala baaryn chogultaryn baiandagandan kiiin alardyn zhaza zhana syilaryn azhyratyp baiandap myndai deit:
Al emi Allakhka ishenip, Anyn elchilerin tastyktap, shariiatka ylaiyk ishterdi Allakhka yklas kylyp atkargandarga, alardyn ishterinin soop-syiyn ech kemitpesten beret. Andan syrtkary alarga Allakh Ozunun artykchlyk, zhakshylyktarynan koshumcha kylat. A Allakhka bash iiuudon, ibadat kyluudan ardanyp tekeberlengenderdi kordoochu azap menen kyinait, oshondo alar alarga paida berchu Allakhtan bashka dostu, alardy zyiandan saktoochu Allakhtan bashka zhardamchyny taba albait.

Oo, adamdar, chynynda Zharatuuchun'ardan silerdin shyltoon'ordu zhoiup, kumonun'ordu ketire turgan chon' dalil keldi. Al - Mukhammad (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) zhana silerge achyk-aikyn zharyk nurdu tushurduk, bul - Kuran.

Allakhka ishenip, paigambaryna tushkon Kurandy bekem karmangandardy beiishke kirgizuu menen alarga yraiymyn togot, soop-syilaryn arttyrat, darazhalaryn kotorot. olku-solkusu zhok tuura zholgo tushuugo alarga zhen'ildik beret, bul zhol Adn beiishine alap bara turgan zhol.

Oo, elchi,senden "kalala"kishiden kalgan muras zhonundo okum surashat. Kalala degeni - balasy zhok, atasy da zhok kaitysh bolgon kishi. Alarga myndai kishinin murasy tuuraluu Allakh Taala mintip baian kyldy dep ait: kaza bolgon kishinin balasy da, atasy da zhok bolso, birok anyn bir tuugan ezhesi zhe karyndashy bolso, zhe atasynyn bir tuugan ezhesi zhe karyndashy bolso, anda markumdan kalgan mulktun ten' zharymy mildettuu turdo oshol aialga tiet. A eger aial kishi kaza bolso erkek bir tuugany, zhe atasynyn erkek bir tuugany bolup, andan bashka mildettuu turdo muras ala turgan ech kim bolboso, anda al kalgan mulktu toluk alat. Eger mildettuu turdo muras boluno turgan adamy bolso, anda bashkalar andan kiiin gana alat. Eger bir tuugan ezhe-karyndashtary, zhe atasy menen bir tuugan ezhe-karyndashtary ekoo zhe andan kop bolso, alarga uchton biri mildettuu tiet. A eger markumdun aial-erkek bir tuugandary, zhe atasynyn aial-erkek bir tuugandary bolso, anda tuuganchylyktagy erezhe boiuncha alyshat (bir erkekke eki aialdyn ulushu) aialdyn ulushunon erkektin ulushu eki ese kop bolot. Siler muras ishinde adashpoon'or uchun Allakh Taala ushintip kalalanyn zhana bashkalardyn muras okumun baiandap berdi. Allakh Taala bardyk nerseni biluuchu, Aga ech nerse bilinbei kalbait.

Oo, yimanduular, Zharatuuchun'ar menen silerdin zhana adamdar menen silerdin orton'ordogu ubada-kelishimin'erdin baaryn toluk atkargyla. Allakh Taala silerge yraiym kylyp mal-zhandyktardy (too, ui, koi zh.b.) adal kyldy, birok tomondo silerge aram ekeni aitylgandar adal emes. Oshondoi ele, azhy zhe umra uchun ikhramga kirgenden kiiin kurgaktyktagy zhanybarlarga an'chylyk kyluuga tyiuu saldy (aram kyldy). Allakh Taala Ozunun daanyshmandagyna ylaiyk adal zhana aram kyluuda kaalagandai okum kylat, any zhek koruugo zhana aga karshy chyguuga bolboit

Oo, yimanduular, siler urmattoogo buirulgan Allakhtyn aram ishterin adal kylyp albagyla. Ikhramdyn bul tyiuularynan etiet bolgula: tigilgen kiiim kiiuu syiaktuu, kharamdyn tyiularynan etiet bolgula: an'chylyk kyluu syiaktuu. Kharam ailarynda (sogushka tyiuu salyngan Zul-Kaada, Zul-Khidzha, Mukharram, Razhab ailarynda) sogushtu adal kylyp albagyla. Allakh uchun belekke chegerilgen mal-zhandyktardy bolzhogon zherine zhetkirbei tartyp aluu, olturuu zh.b. zholdor menen adal kylyp albagyla. Belek ekeni bilinuusu uchun zhundon zhe bashka nerseden moiununa monchok tagylgan maldardy (olturup zh.b.) adal kylyp albagyla. Allakhtyn yraazylygyn, sooda kireshesin maksat kylyp chykkan kishilerdi (olturuunu, sogushuunu) adal kylyp albagyla. Azhy zhe umranyn ikhramynan adal bolup, kharamdan chykkanyn'ardan kiiin kaalasan'ar an'chylyk kyla bergile. Silerdi Kharam mechitine kirgizbei koigon bir koomdu zhaman koruun'or alarga zulumduk zhana adiletsizdik kyluuga alyp barbasyn! Ei, yimanduular, buirulgan ishin'erdi atkaruuda, tyiylgan ishin'erden tyiyluuda biri-birin'e zhardam bergile. Atkaruuchusu kunookor bolo turgan ishterde zhana kalaiyktyn kany, maly zhana abiirine dushmandyk kyluuda biri-birin'erge zhardam berbegile. Bekem bash iiuu zhana kunoodon alys boluu menen Allakhtan korkkula, Allakh Taala aga kunoo kylgandardy katuu azaptait, Anyn azabynan korkkula.

Allakh Taala silerge olup kalgan olumtuktu, muuzdaganda orgup chykkan kandy, chochkonun etin, muuzdagan uchurda Allakhtyn atynan bashka nersenin aty atalyp muuzdalgan maldy aram kyldy. Oshondoi ele muunup olgon, sokku zhep olgon, biiik zherden kulap olgon, bashkasy menen suzushup olgon, arstan, zholbors, karyshkyr syiaktuu zhyrtkychtar tytyp olturgon maldar aram kylyndy. Birok bulardyn zhany chykkancha zhetiship Allakhtyn atyn atap muuzdasan'ar, adal bolot. Dagy but-aikelderge arnalyp muuzdalgan maldar aram kylyndy. Oshondoi ele silerge kaiyp bolgon ishterde tolgo saluu aram kylyndy, bul tolgo "atkar", "atkarba" degen zhazuulary bar tashtar zhe zhebeler menen salynat da, oshondo bul eki ishtin kaisynysy chyksa oshonu kylat. Myna ushul zhogoruda aitylgan aram ishterdi kyluu Allakhka bash iibestik bolup sanalat. Bugun kaapyrlar islamdyn kuch-kubatyn korup, silerdi dinden chygaruudan umutun uzdu. Alardan korkpogula, Menden gana korkkula. Islam dep atalgan dinin'erdi bugun silerge toluk kyldym. Achyk zhana kupuia bolgon zhakshylygymdy silerge toluk berip buttum. Islamdyn silerge din boluusun yktyiar kylyp kaaladym, andan bashka dindi kabyl kylbaim. Katuu achkalyktan ulam, kaaloosu zhok bul aram kylyngandardan bir az zhep ozok zhalgasa, aga kunoo emes, Allakh Taala chynynda Kechirimduu, Meerimduu

Allakh Taala zhegenge aram bolgondordu aityp, anan zhegenge mumkun bolgondorgo toktolot
Oo, elchi, sakhabalaryn' senden alarga Allakh Taala kandai tamakty adal kylganyn surashat. Oo, elchi, alarga ait: Allakh Taala silerge bardyk taza zhele turgan tamaktardy adal kyldy. It, leopard zhe itelgi syiaktuu zhyrkych, birok Allakhtyn bergen ilimi menen koldo an'chylykka uirotulup, agytsan' uuga atyrylyp, tyisan' tyiylyp kala turgan zhanybarlar algan uu (kiiik, koion zh.b.) adal. Myna ushular algan uunu eger any olturup koiushsa da zhei bergile, bolgonu alardy uuga salarda Allakhtyn atyn atap boshotkula. Buiruktaryn atkaruu, kunoodon tyiyluu menen Allakhka takyba bolgula, Allakh Taala ish-araketterdi oto bat esep kylat.

Bugun silerge taza tamaktardyn baaryn zhesh adal boldu, kitep berilgen iakhudi zhana khristiandar soigon maldyn eti da silerge adal boldu, a silerdin soigonun'ar alarga adal. Oshondoi ele taza, erkin momun aialdarga nikelenuu, silerden murdagy kitep berilgen iakhudi zhana khristian aialdardyn taza (soiku emes), erkinderine, eger alardyn makhyrlaryn bersen'er zhana oinoshtuk menen zyna kylbai, taza bolup, ak nikelep alsan'ar, anda alarga nikelenuu adal kylyndy. Kimde-kim Allakh Taala pendelerine shariiat kylgan okumdorgo bash iibei kaapyrlyk kylsa, ibadattyn kabyl boluusunun negizgi sharty bolgon yimany bolbogonu uchun anyn ibadattary zhokko chygat zhana kyiamat kunu tuboluk kala turgan tozokko kirgeni uchun okunuuchulordon bolot.

Oo, yimanduular, namaz okumakchy bolup tursan'ar zhana kichi daaratyn'ar zhok bolso, anda betin'erdi zhuup, kolun'ardy chykanagy menen birge zhuup, bashyn'ardy suu kolun'ar menen syipap maskh tartyp zhana butun'ardy baltyrdan azhyratyp turgan tomugu menen birge zhuup daarat algyla. A eger chon' daaratyn'ar zhok bolso, anda zhuungula. Eger ooruluu bolup, oorunun kuchoosunon zhe aiykpai kaluusunan korkson'or, zhe denin'er taza birok saparda zhurson'or, anan daarat ushatyp zhe bashka sebep menen kichi daaratyn'ar buzulsa, zhe aialdaryn'arga koshulup chon' daaratyn'ar buzulsa, kiiin daaratka zhe zhuunuga suu taba albasan'ar, anda zher kyrtyshyn maksat kylyp any kolun'ar menen chaap, betin'erdi anan kolun'ardy surtup chykkyla. Allakh Taala okumdorundo silerge zyiany tie turgan uchurda da suunu koldonuunu buirup kyiynchylyk tuuduruunu kaalabait. Ooru zhe suu zhok bolgondo suunun orduna topurakty koldonuunu silerge shariiat kylyp, zhakshylygyn toluktady, myndai zhakshylykka kaapyrlyk kylbai, shugur kylaarsyn'ar

Allakh Taala silerdi islamga bagyttagan zhakshylygyn estegile. Paigambar (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) menen "Senin aitkanyn'dy uktuk zhana senin buirugun'a bash iidik" dep, zhyrgalda da, kuuralda da any ugup bash iiuugo bergen ant-ubadan'ardy estegile. Allakh Taalanyn buiruktaryn, anyn ichinde ant-kelishimdi atkaryp, tyigandarynan tyiylyp, Aga takyba bolgula. Allakh Taala chynynda zhuroktogu syrlardy Biluuchu, andan ech nerse Aga zhashyruun kalbait

Oo, Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine ishengen yimanduular, Allakhtyn yraazylygyna zhetuu uchun Anyn akylaryn bergile, kubo otkondo zhabyr kylbastan, adilettik menen otkulo, kaisy bir koomdu zhek koruun'or alarga adiletsiz kubo otuugo turtup koibosun. Adilettik dosko da dushmanga da birdei boluusu kerek, alarga adiettuubolgula. Adilettuuluk Allakhtan korkonduktun belgisi, adiletsizdik Allakhka kyr korsotuunun (korkpogondun) belgisi. Buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiganynan tyiylyp Allakhka takyba bolgula, Allakh siler kylgan ishin'erden Kabardar, kiiin oshol kylganyn'arga zharasha syilait zhe zhazalait.
Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine inenip, zhakshy ishterdi kylgandarga Allakh Taala alardyn kunoosun kechirerin zhana beiishke kirgizip syilaryn ubada kyldy, Allakh Taala bergen ubadasynan ech taibait

Allakhka kaapyr bolup, Anyn aiattaryn zhalganga chygargandar, alar tozokko tushuuchulor, kaapyrlygy zhana zhalganga chygargany sebeptuu, dos dosunan azhyrabagan syiaktuu tozokton azhyrabai, tuboluk kalyshat.

Oo, yimanduular, Allakh Taala silerge bergen tynchtyk, amandyk syiaktuu zhakshylyktaryn estegile.Oshondoi ele, dushmanyn'ar silerge kol saluunu niet kylganda alardyn zhuroguno korkunuch kirgizip, tyiyp koigon zhakshylygyn da estegile. Allakh alardy alagdy kylyp, silerdi saktap kaldy. Buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiganynan tyiylyp Allakhka takyba bolgula. Yimanduular duino zhana akyret ishterin on'doo uchun bir gana Zhalgyz Allakhka tobokel kylgyla.

Allakh Taala Israil urpaktarynan bekem ant-ubada algan, bul kandai ubada ekeni tomondo aitylat. Alarga on eki bashchyny daiyndadyk, ar bir bashchy kol adyndagylardy kozomoldoochu boldu. Anan Allakh Taala alarga aitty: siler namazdy toluk atkarsan'ar, malyn'ardyn zeketin bersen'er, elchilerimdi biri-birinen azhyratpai baaryna ishensen'er, alardy urmattap, zhardam bersen'er, zhakshylyk kylyp sadaga bersen'er, men silerdi koldop, zhardam berip siler menen birge bolom. Oshondoi ele, zhogoruda aitylgandardy but atkarsan'ar, zhasagan kunoon'ordu kechirem, kyiamat kunu ak sarailarynyn aldynan daryialary agyp turgan beiishke kirizem. Al emi ushundai bekem-ant kelishimden kiiin dagy kaapyrlyk kylgandar, ataiyn, bilip turup tuz zholdon taiyptyr

Ant-ubadany buzgan sebeptuu alardy yraiymybyzdan alystattyk, zhuroktorun katyryp, zhakshylyk zhetpei turgan, eskertuu paida berbei turgan kylyp koiduk. Alar kiteptegi sozdu burmalap maanisin ozdorunun kaaloosuna ylaiyktap ozgortushtu zhana anda eskeritilgenderdi ish zhuzundo atkaruunu unutushtu. Ei, elchi, alardyn ushul tapta da Allakhka zhana yimanduu pendelerge kyianat kylyp zhatkanyn korosun'. Birok alardyn azy gana moiununa algan ant-abadasynyn otoosuno chykty, sen alardyn kunoosun kechirip koi, myna ushul zhakshylyk bolup eseptelet, Allakh Taala zhakshylyk kyluuchulardy zhaktyrat

Iakhudilerden bekem ant-ubada algan syiaktuu, ozdorun Isa paigambardy eerchigenderbiz dep eseptegenderden (khristian) da ant ubada alganbyz. Alar da murdagy iakhudiler syiaktuu kitepbinde aitylgan okumdordun keesin atkarbai koiushtu. Alardyn ortosuna tee kyiamatka cheiin ulanchu talash-tartysh, zhek koruu salyp koiduk. Oshentip biri-biri menen sogushup, zhoolashyp, biri-birin kaapyr eseptep kalyshty. Zhakynda Allakh Taala alarga zhasagan ishteri tuuraluu kabar beret zhana oshogo zharasha zhazalait.

Kitep berilgenden alyngan ant ubada, alardyn antty buzuusu tuuraluu aitkandan kiiin, Allakh Taala alardy Mukhammad paigambarga (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) yiman keltirip ishenuugo buirudu:
Ei, Toorottun eesi iakhudiler zhana Inzhildin eesi khristiandar, silerge tushkon kitebin'erde aitylyp, birok siler zhashyryp koigon kop nerseni achyk baiandap, kee bir silerge aituunun zaryldygy bolbogon nerselerdi syr kylyp elchibiz Mukhammad (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) paigambar bolup keldi. Allakh Taaladan Kuran kitebi keldi, al zharyk chachuuchu nur zhana adamdar duino, akyret ishterinde muktazh bolchu nersenin baaryn baiandagan kitep.

Bul kitep menen Allakh Taala, Aga ishenip, zhakshy ishterdi kylyp yraazylygyn samagan adamdardy azabynan kutkaruuchu zholgo bagyttait. Bul beiishke alyp barchu zhol, Ozunun uruksaty menen kaapyrlyk zhana kunookorduktun tun'guiugunan yimandyn zhana bash iiuunun zharyk nuruna chygarat, islamdyn zholu bolgon tuz, bekem zholgo salat

Khristiandardyn arasyndagy "Mariiamdyn uulu Isa Kudai "degender kaapyr boldu. Ei, elchi, alarga ait: Mariiamdyn uulu Isany zhok kyluudan, anyn enesin zhok kyluudan, zher betindeginin baaryn zhok kyluudan Allakhty kim tyia alat, eger Al ushunu kaalasa?! Ech kim Any myndan tyia albagany, demek Al Andan bashka ibadat kyluuga ylaiyktuu ech bir kudai bolbogon Zhalgyz Allakh ekenine dalil. Al emi Mariiamdyn uulu Isa, anyn enesi, zhana al ekoonon bashkanyn baary Allakh zharatkan nerseler. Asman-zherdegi zhana alardyn ortosundagy mulk, padyshalyktyn baary Allakhka taandyk. Al emne kaalasa zharatat, myna oshol zharatkandarynyn biri Mariiamdyn uulu Isa; al Allakhtyn pendesi zhana elchisi, Allakh bardyk nersege kuchu zhetuuchu Kudurettuu.

Bardyk iakhudiler zhana khristiandar ozdorun Allakhtyn balasybyz, Allakhtyn zhakshy korgon suiuktuulorubuz deshet. Ei, elchi, alardyn aitkanyn zhokko chygaryp alarga ait: Anda emnege silerdi Allakh Taala kylgan kunoon'or uchun azaptait?! Eger chyndap ele ozun'or aitkandai, Allakhtyn suiuktuuloru bolson'or, emnege silerdi bul duinodo olturuu, buzuu menen, a akyrette tozokko saluu menen azaptait; sebebi Allakh Taala zhakshy korgondorun azaptabait. A siler bolso, bashka adamdar syiaktuu ele adamsyn'ar, bulardan kim zhakshy bolso, beiish menen syilait, kim zhaman bolso, tozok menen zhazalait. Artykchylygy menen kimdi kaalasa kechiret, adildigi menen kimdi kaalasa azaptait. Asman zherdegi zhana alardyn ortosundagy mulk padyshalyk Allakhka taandyk, kaira kaituu Zhalgyz Allakhka.

Ei, iakhud zhana khristiandar, kopko cheiin elchiler kelbei, alarga muktazhdyk kuchogon kezde paigambarybyz Mukhammad (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) keldi. Siler: bizge Allakhtyn soop-syiyn suiunchulogon, azap-tozogunan korkutkan elchi kelgen emes dep shyltoo kylboon'or uchun. Mukhammad paigambar (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) chynynda silerge Allakhtyn soop-syiyn suiunchuloo, azap-tozogun eskertken elchi bolup keldi. Allakh Taala bardyk nersege Kudurettuu, ech nersege kuchu zhetpei kalbait. Elchilerdi zhibergeni zhana alardy Mukhammad paigambardy zhiberuu menen zhyiyntyktagany Anyn Kudurettuulugunon

Oo, elchi, estegeni, Musa paigambar Isirail urpaktarynan bolgon koomuna: ei, koomum, Allakh Taalanyn silerge kylgan zhakshylyktaryn tilin'er menen da, zhurogun'or menen da estegile, Al silerdi tuura zholgo bashtagan paigambarlardy zhiberdi, siler bashkalarga kul bolup, koz karandy bolup turganyn'arda ozun'odon padyshalardy chygardy. Oshondoi ele, silerge zamanyn'arda aalamda ech kimge berbegen zhakshylyktardy berdi.

Musa paigambar aitty: ei, koomum, kiruugo zhana andagy kaapyrlardy olturuugo Allakhka ubada kylgan taza zherge (Kudus zhana anyn ailanasyna) kirgile, alardyn aldynda korkoktuk kylbagyla, andai kylsan'ar, duino-akyretin'er okunuch bolot

Koomu aga myndai dedi: ei, Musa, bul yiyk zherde kuch-kubaty artyk el bar eken, myna ushul bizdi al zherge kiruudon tyiyp turat, alar anda turganda biz kire albaibyz; antkeni alar menen sogushuuga bizdin kuchubuz da, kubatybyz da zhetpeit. Alar andan chygyp ketse, anan biz kirebiz

Musanyn sherikterinen Allakhtan korkup, Anyn azabynan chochulagan, Allakh Ozuno bash iidirip koigon eki kishi koomun Musanyn buirugun atkaruuga kyzyktyryp myndai dedi: Bul kunookorlorgo shaardyn eshiginen kirgile, eger eshikten atyrylyp kirip barsan'ar, boldu, Allakhtyn uruksaty menen alarga ustomduk kylasyn'ar. Allakhka ishenuu menen birge materialdyk daiardyk korgondorgo zhen'ish beruu Allakhtyn zholu ekenine ishengile. eger chyndap yimanduu bolson'or, Zhalgyz Allakhka taiangyla zhana Aga tobokel kylgyla, yiman Aga tobokel kyluunu talap kylat

Musanyn koomu aga karshy chyguusun ulantyp: Shaarda kuch-kubattuu adamdar turganda biz aga kirbeibiz, ei, Musa, bar, Zharatuuchun' ekoon' alar menen sogusha bergile, biz ushul ordubuzda silerdin sogushun'ardan yraak turaly deshti
Musa Zharatuuchusuna aitty: Oo, Zharatkan, men bir tuuganym Kharun menen ozumdon bashka ech kimge tilim otpoi kalyptyr, Saga zhana Senin elchin'e bash iibegen bul koom menen bizdin arabyzdy azhyrat

Allakh Taala paigambary Musaga aitty: Allakh Taala Israil urpaktaryna bul yiyk zherge kiruugo kyrk zhylga tyiuu saldy. bul zhyldary alar choldo akyly airan bolup zhol tappai adashyp zhurushot. Ei, Musa Allakhtyn buiruguna bash iibegen koomdun abalyna sen kyzhalat bolbo, alardyn bashyna tushkon balee kunoo-katalary sebeptuu boluuda

Oo, elchi, tigi koralbas, zalym iakhudilerge Adam atanyn eki balasy Kabyl menen Khabyldyn ech zhalgan aralashpagan chyn okuiasyn an'gemelep ber. Alar Allakh Taalaga kurbandyk kylyshkanda, Allakh Taala Khabyldyn kurbandygyn kabyl kyldy, antkeni al takyba bolchu. A Kabyldyn kurbandygyn kabyl kylbady, antkeni al takyba emes ele. Kabyl Khabyldyn kurbandygy kabyl bolgonun koro albai, any chetke kagyp: Ei, Khabyl men seni olturom dedi. Khabyl: Allakh Taala kim Anyn buirugun atkaryp, tyiuusunan tyiylyp, takyba bolso, oshonun kurbandygyn kabyl kylat dedi.
Eger olturuunu maksat kylyp maga kol salsan' da, men sen kylgan ishti kylbaim, bul menin korkoktugumdan emes, men bardyk zharatylyshtyn Zharatuuchusu Allakhtan korkom

Any korkutup myndai dedi: ozun'dun murdagy kunoolorun'o, zalymdyk, dushmandyk menen meni olturgon kunoon' koshulup kaityp, kyiamat kunu tozokko kiruuchulordon boluun'du kaalaim. Bul zhaza kunookorlordun zhazasy, men bolso, seni olturuu sebeptuu alarga koshulup kaluunu kaalabaim.
Buzuku napsisi Kabyldy agasy Khabyldy zalymdyk menen olturuugo turttu zhana al any olturdu, oshol sebeptuu ozunun duino-akyrettegi ulushun kemitip aluuchulardyn katarynda bolup kaldy

Allakh aga bir tuuganynyn denesin kantip zhashyruunu uirotuu uchun zher tytkan bir kargany zhiberdi. Oshondo olturuuchu (Kabyl) aitty: <<Oo, shorum kurusun!>> Men bir tuuganymdyn soogun ekinchi oluk kargany komgon ushul kargachalyk komo albadymby?" - dep, any zherge komdu da kaigyruuchulardan boldu.

Kabyl agasyn olturgon okuia arkyluu kimde-kim biroonu och aluu uchun emes, zhe bolboso, sogushup zhe kaapyrlygy sebeptuu da emes, zhondon-zhon ele olturso, adamdardyn baaryn olturgondoi bolorun, Israil urpaktaryna bildirdik. Antkeni, myndai adam olturuuchugo taza kishi menen kylmyshker kishinin aiyrmasy zhok. Al emi kimde-kim Allakh Taala olturuugo tyiuu salgan adamdy oshol tyiuu salyngandygy uchun ozun tyiyp olturboso, bardyk adamdarga zhan bergendei bolot. Antkeni, al baaryna tynchtyk alyp kelet. Chynynda bizdin elchileribiz Israil urpaktaryna achyk-aikyn dalilderdi alyp keldi. Oshentse da, alardyn kobu kunoogo berilip zhana elchilerge karshy chygyp Allakhtyn chegininen chygyp ketishti

Allakh zhana Anyn elchilerine karshy sogushup, adamdardy olturuu, mal-mulkun tartyp aluu, zhol tosup karakchylyk kyluu menen zherde dushmandykty kuchotup, bulgun salgandardyn akybet zhazasy - alardy asyp zhe bashka zhol menen olturuu zhe on' kol sol butun kesuu, kiiin kylmyshyn dagy kaitalasa, sol kol on' butun kesuu zhe zhashagan zherinen surgun kyluu; alardyn bul duinodogu zhazasy ushundai, a akyrette alarga katuu azap bar.

Oo, zhol bashchylar, eger tigi kylmyshkerler siler alardy karmaganga cheiin toobo kylyshsa, Allakh Taala alardy Kechiruuchu zhana Yraiymduu ekenin bilip algyla. Allakh Taala yraiymy menen alardy zhazadan kutkarat.

Oo, yimanduular, buirugun atkaryp, kunoodon tyiylyp Allakhka takyba bolgula. Anyn buirugun atkaruu arkyluu Aga zhakyndoonun zholun izdegile zhana tyiuularynan saktangyla. Allakhtyn yraazylygyn talap kylyp, kaapyrlarga karshy zhikhad kylgyla; oshondo izdegenin'erge zhetip, tyiuulardan sak bolushun'ar mumkun

Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyr bolgondor, eger alardyn ar birinde zher betindegi mulkton eki ese bolso zhana oshol mulktorun kyiamat kundogu azaptan kutuluu uchun zhumshasa, baary bir kabyl kylynbait, alarga zhan chydagys katuu azap bolot.
Tozokko tushkondon kiiin andan chyguuga araket kylyshat, birok kaidan chyga almak ele?! Andan ech chyga alyshpait, anda tuboluk azaptalyshat.

Allakh Taala eldin mal-mulkun achyk ele tartyp algandardyn okumu kandai bolorun aitkandan kiiin emi bilgizbei, zhashyruun algan uurunun okumu kandai bolorun aitat:
Oo, okumdarlar, uuruluk kylgan erkek zhana aialdyn on' kolun keskile. Bul, eldin mal-mulkun akysyz uurdap kunoogo batkany uchun zhana alarga da, bashkalarga da eskertuu boluusu uchun Allakh Taalanyn bergen zhazasy. Allakh Taala Yzattuu, Aga ech kim ustomduk kyla albait, tagdyr kyluuda, shariiat kyluuda Daanyshman.

Al emi kim toobo kylyp, uurulugun toktototup, ishin zhakshyrtsa, Allakh Taala anyn toobosun kabyl kylat; antkeni, Allakh Taala pendelerinen kim toobo kylsa, aga yraiym kylyp, anyn kunoosun kechiret. Birok, ish okumdarga otkondon kiiin toobo kylsa da baary bir duinodogu zhazasyn alat.

Oo, elchi, asman-zherdegi mulk, padyshalyk Allakhka taandyk ekenin, Allakh any kaalagandai bashkararyn bilesin'. Al kaalaganyn adildigi menen azaptait, kaalaganyn artykchylygy menen kechiret, chynynda Allakh Taala bardyk nersege kadyr, ech nersege kuchu zhetpei kalbait

Oo, elchi, seni achuulantuu uchun, syrtynan yimanduu korunup, ichine kaapyrlygyn zhashyrgan eki zhuzduulordun kaapyrlyk ish-araketterine karai shashylgandarga kaigyrba. Oshondoi ele uluularynyn zhalganyna muiup, kabyl kylgan, senden bash tarkan zhana Toorottogu Allakhtyn sozun kaalooloruna ylaiyktap ozgortkon bashchylaryn eerchigen iakhudilerge da kaigyrba. Alar artyndagy eerchigenderge: Eger Mukhammaddyn okumdoru kaaloon'orgo tuura kelse, any eerchigile, eger tuura kelbese, andan bash tartkyla dep aityshat. Allakh Taala adamdardan kimdi adashtyruunu kaalasa, ei, elchi, any adashuudan kutkara turgan zhana tuura zholgo bagyttai turgan ech kimdi taba albaisyn'. Zhogorudagy sypattar menen sypattalgan iakhudiler menen eki zhuzduulordu Allakh Taala alardyn zhurogun kaapyrlyktan tazaloonu kaalabait. Alarga bul duinodo korduk zhana uiat, al emi akyrette katuu azap bolot, bul tozok azaby.

Al iakhudiler zhalgandy kop ugat, sutkorduk syiaktuu aram tamakty kop zheshet. Ei, elchi, eger alar senden okum surasa, kaalsan' okum chygar, kaalasan' bash tart, bul eki ishti kyluuda yktyiarluusun'. Alarga okum chygarbai koison', alar saga zyian tiigize albait. A eger okum chygarsan', alar zaalym, dushman bolgonuna karabai anda adildik menen okum chygar. Okum kylyngandar okum kyluuchunun dushmany bolso da, alarga adail okum chygargandardy Allakh Taala zhakshy korot.

Bul iakhudilerdin kylgany tan' kalyshtuu, alar saga ishenishpeit, alar senden ozdorunun kaaloosuna ylaiyk okum chygaryp beruun'du umut kylyshat. Alarda ozdoru ishenimish bolgon Toorot kitebi bar, anda Allakhtyn okumu bar. Kiiin sen chygargan okum alardyn kaaloosuna tuura kelbei kalsa, andan bash tartyshat, kitepterindegi okumdorgo kaapyrlyk kylgandai kylyshat. Senin okumun'o karshy boluusu, alardyn kylgany yimanduulardyn kylgany emes, demek alar saga da, sen alyp kelgen Kuranga da yiman keltirishpeit.

Biz Musaga (aga Allakhtyn salamy bolsun) Toorottu tushurduk. Anda zhakshylakka bagyttagan dalilder, zharyk chachkan nur bar. Any menen Israil urpagynan chykkan, Allakhka bash iigen paigambarlar okum kylat. Allakhtyn kitebinde saktalyp kalgan nerse menen adamdardy tarbiialoochu fakykh, aalymdar okum kylat. Alarga kitepti ozgortuu, almashtyruudan saktoo amanat kylyngan. Alar anyn chyndyk kitep ekenine kubo, alarga adamdar ar ishteri menen kairylat. Ei, iakhudiler, elden korkpogula, Menden korkkula, Menin aiattarymdy arzybagan bilik, mansap, mal-mulkko almashtyrbagyla. Kim Allakh Taala aian-kabar menen tushurgon okum menen okum chygarbai zhana munusun adal dese, zhe bashkany andan artyk zhe ten' dep eseptese, anda al anyk kaapyr.

Toorotto iakhudilerge, kimde-kim biroonu atailap olturso, olturulot, kimde-kim biroonun kozun atailap oiup alsa, kozu oiulat, kimde-kim biroonun murdun atailap syndyrsa, murdu syndyrylat, kimde-kim biroonun kulagyn ataiy zhulup alsa, kulagy zhulunat, kimde-kim biroonun tishin syndyrsa, tish syndyrylat, kyskasy, kandai zharakat berse, oshonun ozundoi zharakattandyrylat dep zhazganbyz. Kimde-kim och albai kechirip zhiberse, aga zalym kylgan adamga bolgon anyn kechirimi kunoosu kechiriluugo sebep bolot. Och aluuda zhana bashka ishterde Allakh tushurgon nerse menen okum chygarbagandar Alakhtyn cheginen chygyptyr.

Israil urpaktarynyn paigambarlarynyn artynan Toorotto aitylgandarga ishengen zhana osho menen okum zhurguzgon Mariiam uulu Isany paigambar kylyp zhiberdik. Aga chyndykka zhol korsotkon, dalilderdegi kumondordu zhokko chygargan, okumdordogu mushkuldordu chechken, ozunon murdagy Toorottun kee bir gana kuchu zhokko chygarylgan okumdorunon bashkasyn butundoi tastyktagan Inzhildi berdik. Inzhildi tuura zholgo bagyttoochu zhana alarga aram bolup tyiuu salyngan nerselerden tyiyp toktotuuchu kyldyk.

Khristiandar emi Allakh Taala Inzhilde tushurgon nerselerge ishenishsin zhana andagy chyndyk okumdor menen okum kylyshsyn (Mukhammad paigambar zhiberilgenge cheiinki okumdor menen). Kimde-kim Allakh tushurgon okumdor menen okum kylbasa, alar - Allakhtyn zholunan chyguuchular, chyndyktan bash tartuuchular, zhalganga but koiuuchular.

Allakh Taala Toorot menen Inzhildi eskerip, maktap otkon son' Kurandy soz kylyp, maktap myndai deit:
Oo, elchi, saga Allakhtan ekenine ech shek-kumon bolbogon chyndyk Kurandy tushurduk. Al murdagy kitepterdi tastyktap, alardagy artykchylyktaryd ozuno kamtyit, murdagylardan aga (Kuranga) dal kelgeni chyndyk, karshy kelgeni zhalgan. Adamdarga Allakh oshol Kuranda tushurgon okumdor menen okum kyl. Allakh Taala tushurgon ech shek-kumonu zhok chyndykty chanyp, alardyn kaaloosuna eerchip ketpe. Chynynda ar bir ummotko ish zhuzundo atkarylchu okumdordu shariiat kyldyk zhana alar adashpai turgan achyk-aikyn zholdu korsottuk. Allakh shariiattyn bir boluusun kaalasa, any biroo ele kylmak. Birok, alardy synap, kunookordu kunoosuzdon azhyratuu uchun ar bir ummotko ozuncho shariiat kyldy. Emi zhakshy ishterdi zhasap, zhaman ishterdi tashtoogo shashylgyla. Kyiamat kunu baaryn' Allakhka kaityp barasyn'ar. Oshondo emneden ozgocholongonun'ordu bildiret zhana kylgan ish-araketin'erge zharasha syi zhe zhaza beret

Oo, elchi, alarga saga Allakh tushurgon nerse menen okum kyl, alardyn ozdorunun kaaloosuna ylaiyktap algan koz karashtaryna eerchibe. Allakh saga tushurgon nersenin kee birinde seni adashtyryp koiuusunan etiet bol, myndai kyluudan alar takyr kaira tartpait. Eger saga Allakh tushurgon okumdu kabyl kyluudan alar bash tartsa, anda bilip koi, Allakh kee bir kunooloru uchun alardy bul duinodo ele azaptoonu kaalait. Oshondoi ele akyrette bardyk kunooloru uchun azaptait. Chynynda, oto kop adamdar Allakhka bash iibei zhurushot.

Senin okumdorun'don bash tartyp, ilgerki ozdorunun kaalooloruna ylaiyk okum kylyshkan but-aikelderge syiyngan karan'gy doordun okumun kaalashaby?! Allakh Taala elchisine tushurgon nersege akyl zhugurtkon bekem ishenimdegi adamdar uchun Allakhtan zhakshy okum kyluuchu zhok. Al emi zhalgan bolso da ozdorunun kaaloosuna ylaiyk okumdu gana kabyl kylgan, kaaloosun eerchigen, karan'gy adamdarga myndai emes.

Oo, Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine ishengen yimanduular, iakhudi zhana khristiandardy dos tutup, bashchy kylyp albagyla. Iakhudiler da, khristiandar da ozdorunun zholundagylarga dos, eki taipa ten' ozdorunun kataryndagylardy chogultat. Silerden kimdir-biroo alardy dos tutsa, al da osholordun katarynda bolot. Allakh Taala zalym koomdu kaapyrlardy dos tutkany uchun tuura zholgo bashtabait.

Oo, elchi, yimany alsyz eki zhuzduulor, iakhudiler menen khristiandardy dos tutuuga shashylyp: eger bular zhen'ishke zhetip, biilikke ee bolup kalsa, bizge zhaman bolot dep korkobuz deshet. Mumkun Allakh Taala zhen'ishti elchisine zhana yimanduularga berip koior. Zhe bolboso, iakhudilerdin zhana alardy dos tutkandardyn biiligin zhok kyla turgan ish kylaar, oshondo alardy dos tutuuga shashylgan eki zhuzduulor, oilogon oiloru maanisiz bolup tukko zharabai kalgany uchun, zhuroktoruno bekitken, eki zhuzduu oiloruna okunup kalyshat.

Yimanduular eki zhuzduulordun kylygyna tan'danyp: Yimanduubuz dep katuu ant berip, ei, yimanduular, biz yimanduulukta, zhardam beruudo, dostukta siler menen birgebiz degen adamdar ushularby?! - deshet. Alardyn kylgan ish-araketteri zhokko chygarylat. maksattaryna zhete albai zhana akyrette katuu azapka duushar bolup zyianga uchurashty

Oo, yimanduular, silerdin aran'dan biroolor dininen kaityp kaapyr bolso, Allakh Taala alardyn orduna Ozun zhakshy korgon Allakh da alardy dinge bekem bolgonu uchun zhakshy korgon, yimanduularga meerimduu, kaapyrlarga kataal, Allakhtyn sozu zhogoru boluusu uchun maly-zhanyn aiabai kazatka chyga turgan, ushak-aiyn' kyluuchulardyn ushagynan korkpogon, munun baaryn Allakhty yraazy kyluunu bashkalardy yraazy kyluudan oido koigonu uchun zhasagan koomdu alyp kelet. Bul Allakh Taala Ozu kaalagan pendelerine bere turgan artykchylyk. Allakhtyn artykchylygy zhana zhakshylygy kenen, artykchylygyna kim ylaiyktuu, kim ylaiyksyz ekenin bilet zhana ylaiyktuusuna beret, ylaiyksyzyn kuru kaltyrat.

Iakhudi, khristian zh.b. kaapyrlardy dos tutuuga tyiuu salgandan kiiin, kimdi dos tutuu kerektigin eskertip myndai deit:
Iakhudiler, khristiandar zh.b. kaapyrlar silerdin dosun'ar emes, silerdin dosun'ar zhana zhardamchyn'ar - Allakh, Allakhtyn elchisi zhana namazdaryn toluk atkargan, malynyn zeketin bergen, Allakhka chyn yklasy menen berilgen yimanduular
Allakhty, Anyn elchisin zhana yimanduulardy zhardamchy dos kylgan adam Allakhtyn zhamaatynan. Allakhtyn zhamaatyndagylar ustomduk kyluuchu, antkeni alarga Allakh Ozu zhardam beret
