Oo, yimanduular, dinin'erdi shyldyn'dap, oinogon kitep berilgen iakhudi, khristiandardy zhana butparastardy ozun'orgo bashchy kylyp tandap albagyla. Eger Allakhka zhana Al tushurgon kitepke chyndap ishensen'er, tigilerdi dos tutuudan tyigan tyiusun atkaryp Allakhka takyba bolgula.

Oshondoi ele namazga azan chakyrsan'ar da (bul chon' kurbandyk) alar shyldyn' kylyshat. antkeni alar Allakhka zhana Aga kylyngan ibadattyn maanisine zhana Allakhtyn adamdarga tuzgon shariiatyna akyly zhetpeit.

Oo, elchi, yimanduulardy shyldyn'dagan iakhudi zhana khristiandarga ait: biz Allakhka ishengenibiz uchun, Allakh bizge tushurgon, bizden murdagylarga tushurgon kitepterge ishengenibiz uchun, silerdin kobun'or Allakhka ishenbei, Anyn buiruktaryn atkarbaganyn'ar uchun dinden chygyp ketkensin'er dep ishengenibiz uchun ele zhek koro beresin'erbi?!

Oo, elchi, tigilerden katuu azaptalchu, zhazaga tatyktuular kimder ekenin kabarlaiynby? Bular tigilerden murda zhashap otkon adamdar, alardy Allakh Taala yraiymynan alystatyp, kaaryn tokkon, alardy maimyl zhanan chochkogo ailandyryp koigon, keesin taagutka syiyndyryp koigon. Taagut - bul, adamdar oz yktyiary menen syiynyp alyshkan Allakhtan bashka nerseler. Ushul atalgandar kyiamat kunu en' zhaman orunda bolot, bular tuura zholdon takyr adashyp ketishken.

Oo, yimanduular, eki zhuzduulor silerge kelgende eki zhuzduulugun zhashyryp, syrtynan yimanduu bolup korunushot. A, chynynda, alar silerge kelgende da, ketkende da kaapyrlykty zhamynyp syr aldyryshpait. Silerge yimanduu korungonu menen alardyn zhashyruun kaapyrlygyn Allakh zhakshy bilet. Kiiin oshogo zharasha zhazasyn beret.

Oo, elchi, iakhudi zhana eki zhuzduulordun kobun zhalganchylyk, biroolorgo zalym kyluu, adamdardyn mal-mulkun aram zhol menen aluu syiaktuu kunoolorgo bash otu menen kirgenin korosun'. Bulardyn kylgany oto zhaman.

Imamdary zhana aalymdary alardy zhalgan suiloodon, zhalgan kuboluk beruudon', eldin malyn aram zhol menen aluudan tyiyp eskertishpeibi. Imamdary menen aalymdary eldi kunoo ishten tyibai koigon oto zhaman ish.

Iakhudilerdin bashyna oorchuluk tushup, kurgakchylyk bolgondo: Allakhtyn kolu zhabyk, bizge Ozundogu zhakshylyk, belekterin berbei koidu deshet. Zhok, zhakshylyk kyluudan alardyn ozdorunun kolu zhabylgan. Myna ushul aitkandary uchun Allakhtyn yraiymynan kuulushtu. Chyndygynda, zhakshylyk kyluuda Allakhtyn koldoru achyk, kandai kaalasa, oshondoi beret. Beret zhana tyiyp koiot, Aga toskoolduk kyluuchu da, mazhburloochu da zhok. Ei, elchi, saga tushurulgon nerse (Kuran) alardyn chekten chyguusun zhana tanuusun kuchottu; antkeni alarda koralbastyk bar ele. Iakhudilerdin taipalaryna biri-birine dushmandyk zhana zhek koruu paida kyldyk. Alar sogushka chogulup, toptolgondo, zhe sogush otun tutantkanda, Allakh alardyn tobun chachyratat, kuchun ketiret. Alar Islamdy buzuu uchun kuuluk kylyp, zher betine bulgun salyp zhuro berishet, Allakh Taala buzuku-bulgunchulordu zhakshy korboit.

Eger iakhudiler zhana khristiandar Mukhammad paigambar (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) alyp kelgen nersege ishenishse, kunoolordon tyiylyp Allakhka takyba bolso, anda alardyn murdagy kunoolorun chon' bolso da kechirebiz, kyiamat kunu zhakshylygy tugongus - Naim - beiishine kirgizebiz, anda tugonbos zhakshylykka chomulushot.

Eger iakhudiler Toorotto zhazylgandardy ishke ashyrganda, khristiandar Inzhilde zhazylgandy ishke ashyrganda, oshondoi ele ekoo ten' Kuranda tushurulgon nerselerdi ishke ashyrganda, alarga zhamgyr zhaadyryp, osumduktordu osturup yryskynyn sebepterin zhen'ildetmekmin. Kitep berilgenderdin arasynda ortocho chyndykty karmanyp zhashagandary da bar. Kobunun yimany zhok bolgonu uchun kylgan ishteri oto zhaman.

Oo, elchi, Zharatuuchun'dan saga tushurulgon nerseni toluk tarat, andan ech nerseni zhashyryp kalba. Eger andan zhashyryp kalsan', sen anda Zharatuuchun'dun dinin zhetkiruuchu bolboi kalasyn'. (Paigambar, aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun, zhetkiruugo buirulgan nersenin baaryn zhetkirdi, kim myndan bashkacha kumon kylsa, al Allakhka chon zhalganchy bolot) Bugundon kiiin adamdardan seni Allakh Ozu saktait, alar saga zhamandyk kyla alyshpait, senin mildetin' zhetkiruu gana. Tuura zholgo tushuunu kaalabagan kaapyrlardy Allakh Taala bul zholgo bagyttabait

Ei, elchi, aitkyn: "Ei, iakhudiler zhana khristiandar, siler Toorot zhana Inzhildegi buiruktardy atkarmaiyncha, siler aga ishengende gana yimanyn'ar achyk bolo turgan Kuranda aitylgan buiruktardy atkarmaiyncha, andagylardy ishke ashyrmaiyncha, bul dinderdin birin da karmagan bolup eseptelbeisin'er. Zharatuuchun' saga tushurgon Kuran, kitep berilgenderdin kobunun kaapyrlygynyn ustuno kaapyrlygyn, chekten chyguusunun ustuno chekten chyguusun kuchotot. Sebebi alar koralbastyk kylyshat. Sen al kaapyrlarga kapa bolbo. seni eerchigen yimanduular zhetishtuu

Yimanduular, iakhudiler, saaibinder (kee bir paigambarlarga ishengen taipa) zhana khristiandar, bulardan kimisi bolso da Allakhka zhana kyiamat kununo ishenip, zhakshy ishterdi kylsa, akyrette alarga korkunuch bolboit zhana bul duinodo kylgandaryna da okuboit.

Israil urpaktarynan uguuga zhana bash iiuugo ant-ubada alyp zhana alarga Allakhtyn shariiatyn zhetkiruu uchun elchilerdi zhiberdik ele, birok alar al ant-ubadasyn buzushtu. Alar paigambarlary alyp kelgen nerseden zhuz burup, kee birin zhalganga chygaryp, kee birin olturup, napsi-kaaloolorun eerchip ketishti.

Alar ant-ubadalardy buzgandygy, paigambarlardy zhalganga chygargany zhana olturgonu ozdoruno zyianyn tiigizbeit dep oiloshot. Birok alar oilogondoi bolboit. Alar chyndykty korbodu zhana al zholgo tushpodu, sozdu kabyl kyla turgandai uguudan keren' bolushtu. Kiiin Allakh Taala alarga boor tartyp, toobolorun kabyl kyldy. Alar bolso, dagy chyndykty korboi, ukpai koiushtu. Alardyn kobu ushundai kylyshty. Allakh alardyn kylgandaryn Koruuchu, Aga ech nerse zhashyruun kalbait, kiiin alardy oshol ish-araketterine zharasha zhazalait

Allakh bul Mariamdyn uulu Isa-Masikh degen khristiandar chynynda kaapyr, Allakhtan bashkaga kudailyk sypatty yigaryshkany uchun. A, Maiiamdyn uulu Isa alarga: Ei, Israil urpaktary, Allakhtyn zhalgyz Ozuno ibadat kylgyla, Al menin zhana silerdin Zharatuuchun'ar, Aga ibadat kyluuda baarybyz birdeibiz. Kim Allakhka bashka nerseni sherik kylsa, Allakh Taala aga beiishke kiruugo tyiuu salat, anyn bara turgan zheri tozok otu. Allakhtyn aldynda aga zhardamchy da koldoochu da zhok zhana any kutup turgan azaptan saktap kaluuchu bolboit.

Allakh uch iltiktin (ata, bala zhana yiyk rukh) biri degen khristiandar da kaapyr. Allakh Taala alardyn aitkanynan oto Biiik, Allakh bir kancha emes, Allakh Zhalgyz, ech sherigi zhok. Eger alar bul zhiiirkenichtuu sozdorunon kaitpasa, zhan keiitken katuu azapka kiripter kylabyz.

Alar bul aitkandarynan kaityp, Allakhka toobo kylyp, shirk kylyshkany uchun kechirim tilebeibi?! Allakh Taala yimanduularga yraiym kylyp, kaisy kunoo bolso da toobo kylgandardy kechiret, meili al kunoo kaapyrlyk bolso dagy.

Mariamdyn uulu Isa bashka elchiler syiaktuu ele elchi, alar syiaktuu ele aga da olum kelet. Anyn enesi Mariam oto chynchyl zhana tastyktoochu aial bolgon. Ekoo ten' el katary muktazh bolup tamak zheit, tamakka muktazh bolup tursa, anan kantip bul ekoo kudai bolmok ele?! Ei, elchi, oi zhugurtuu menen karachy: biz alarga Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygyn dalildoochu zhana kudailyk sypatty Allakhtan bashkaga yigaruulary katuu adashuu ekenine turduu achyk-aikyn dalilderdi korsottuk. Oshogo karabastan, alar bul dalil-belgilerdi chetke kagyshty. Anan, Allakhtyn Zhalgyzdygyna achyk-aikyn dalilder turganyna karabai, alardyn chyndyktan ushunchalyk taiyp ketishkenin karabaisyn'by.

Oo, elchi, Allakhtan bashkaga ibadat kylyp zhatyshkanyn dalil kylyp alarga ait: Silerge paida alyp kele albagan zhana zyianyn da tiigize albagan nersege ibadat kylasyn'arby?! Al alsyz. Allakh bolso alsyzdyktan taza. Allakh Al Zhalgyz Ozu silerdin sozun'ordu Uguuchu, sozun'ordon ech nerse ugulbai kalbait. Ish-araketin'erdi Biluuchu, ishin'erden ech nerse zhashyruun kalbait, kiiin oshol sozun'or zhana ish-araketin'erge zharasha zhazalait.

Oo, elchi, khristiandarga ait: ozun'ordon murdagy adashkan, kop adamdardy da adashtyrgan, tuz zholdon taiyp ketkenderdi eerchip, siler da tuz zhuruugo buirulgan zholun'arda chekten chykpagyla, paigambarlar syiaktuu syilagyla dep buirulgandardy syiloodo Mariamdyn uulu Isaga kudaidyk sypatty yigaryp zhibergendei asha chappagyla.

Allakh Taala, Israil urpaktaryn yraiymynan kuup, kargyshtaganyn Daud paigambarga tushurgon kitebi Zaburda, Isa paigambarga tushurgon kitebi Inzhilde da kabar bergen. Mintip yraiymynan kuup, kargyshtoosuna, alardyn kunoogo batkandygy zhana Allakh aram kylgan ishterde chekten chykkandary sebep boldu.

Biri-birin kunoodon kaitaryshkan emes, kunookorloru kunoo zhana tyiuu salyngan zhaman ishterdi achyk-aikyn kylyshkan. Antkeni, alardy tyigan ech kim bolgon emes. Kunoo ishten kaitaruunu tashtap koiushkany kandai zhaman ish.

Oo, elchi, baikap kor: iakhudi kaapyrlardyn kobu kaapyrlardy zhakshy korot, alarga zhakyndashat, bir kudaiga syiynuuchularga dushman bolushat. Kaapyrlardy dos-bashchy kylyp alyshkany akyretine toptogon en' zhaman ishteri. Antkeni munusu Allakhtyn achuusuna zhana alardy anda tuboluk kalyp, ech kachan kaira chykpai turgan tozok otuna kirgizuusuno sebep bolot

Eger al iakhudiler Allakhka, zhana Anyn paigambaryna chyndap ishengende, yimanduulardy tashtap, butparastardy zhakshy korup, alarga zhagynyp dos-bashchy kylyp albait ele. Antkeni alar kaapyrlardy dos kyluudan tyiylgan bolchu. Birok iakhudilerdin kobu Allakhka bash iiuudon, Any zhana yimanduulardy dos tutuudan bash tartty.

Oo, elchi, saga zhana sen alyp kelgen dinge ishengen yimanduularga oto katuu dushman bolgondor iakhudiler, but-aikelderge syiyngandar zh.b. Allakhka sherik koshkon butparastar ekenenin korosun'. Antkeni, alarda zhek koruu, ichi tardyk, tekeberlik sypattary bar. Al emi saga zhana sen alyp kelgen dinge ishengen yimanduularga zhakyn adamdar ozdorun khristian dep atagandar ekenin korosun'. Bulardyn yimanduularga zhakyn boluusunun sebebi, alardyn arasynda aalym, ibadatkoi adamdary bar, bular tekeber emes, kichi peiil adamdar. Tekeber adamdardyn zhuroguno zhakshylyk kirbeit.

Bulardyn, misaly Nazhashi zhana anyn zhan-zhokorloru syiaktuulardyn zhurogu zhumshak. Bular Kurandy ukkanda, anyn chyndyk ekenin bilip, katuu berilgendikten yilap zhiberishet, sebebi alar Isa paigambar alyp kelgen dindi zhakshy bilishchu. Anan: Oo, Zharatkan, Mukhammad (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) paigambaryn'a tushurgon dinin'e yiman keltirdik. Oo, Zharatkan, bizdi da kyiamat kunu adamdarga dalil boluuchu ummottun kataryna, tagyraagy, Mukhammaddyn (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) ummottunun kataryna zhaz.

Alar: Allakhka ishenuugo, Mukhammad paigambar (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) alyp kelgen chyndykka ishenuugo bizge emne toskool boldu?! Biz paigambarlar zhana Allakhtyn azabynan korkup alardy eerchigen yimanduular menen birge beiishke kiruunu umut kylabyz go deshet.

Chyndykty moiundagany zhana yimany bekem bolgonu uchun Allakh Taala alarga ak sarailarynyn, bak-daraktarynyn aldynan daryialar agyp turgan beiishti daiardap koidu. Anda tuboluk kalyshat. Bul, zhakshy ishterdi kyluuchularga alar ech chektoo zhe shart koiboston chyndykka daroo ishenip, any eerchigeni uchun berilgen syi.
Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyr bolgondor, elchisine tushurgon aiattardy zhalganga chygargandar, bular kuiguzuuchu tozokto tuboluk kalyp, andan ech kachan chygyshpait

Oo, yimanduular, tamak-ashtan, suusunduktardan zhana nikelenuudon adal bolgon yrakhattuu nerselerdi ozun'orgo-ozun'or aram kylyp albagyla. Oto ibadatchyl, duinonu kechip koiuuchu bolup bulardy aramga chygarbagyla. Allakh Taala silerge aram kylgan nerselerdin cheginen ashyp ketpegile. Allakh Taala chekten chykkandardy zhakshy korboit, teskerisinche, alarga achuulanat.

Allakh Taala silerge yrysky kylyp bergen tabiiatynan adal, taza bolgon nerselerdi zhei bergile. Tartyp aluu syiaktuu aram zholdor menen aram bolgon zhe oto zyianduulugu uchun aram bolgon nerselerdi zhebegile. Buirugun atkaryp, tyiuusunan tyiylyp Allakhka takyba bolgula. Siler aga yiman keltirgensin'er, yimanyn'ar Aga takyba boluunu talap kylat

Oo, yimanduular, chyn zhurokton emes, ooz uchunan chykkan antyn'ar uchun Allakh Taala silerdi surak kylbait. Maksat kylyp, chyn zhurokton bergen antyn'ardy buzsan'ar, anda surak kylat. Maksat kylyp, tilin'er menen bergen antyn'ardy buzgan kunoon'or tomonku uch ish menen zhuulat: ozun'or zhashagan zherde ortocho dep eseptelgen tamak menen on zhakyr adamdy tamaktandyruu, ar bir zhakyrga zharym saa' (tort koshuuch, 3, 300gr), zhe eldin urpundo kiiim dep eseptelgendei kiiim kiigizuu, zhe bir musulman kuldu azattykka chygaruu. Eger myna ushul ich ishtin biroono da karazhat tappasa, anda uch kun orozo karmasa zhetishtuu. Ei, yimanduular, ushul aitylgandar Allakhtyn aty menen ant berip, anan any kaira buzgan kunoon'ordu zhuuit. Allakhtyn aty menen zhalgan ant ichuudon, kop ant iche beruudon, zhana antty orundoo zhakshy emes bolgondo any orundabai koiuudan etiet bolgula. Zhakshylyk kylgyla zhana zhogoruda Allakh baiandagandai zholdor menen antyn'ardyn kunoosun zhuugula. Allakh Taala anyn aramga da, adalga da tisheluu okumdorun silerge baiandady. Bilbegen nersen'erdi uirotkonu uchun Allakhka shugur kylaarsyn'ar.

Oo, yimanduular, adamdy akylynan taidyra turgan mas kyluuchu ichimdikter, eki taraptan ortogo koiulup oinolchu kumar oiundary, butparastar any yiyktap kurmandyk chalgan zhe syiynuu uchun ornotup algan tash-aikelder, kaiypty chechmeloo uchun tolgo salyna turgan zhebeler, ushulardyn baary shaitan kooz korsotkon kunoolor. bulardan alys bolgula, bul duinodo beipil zhashoogo, akyrette beiish zhakshylyktaryna zhetesin'er.

Shaitan zhuroktorgo zhek koruu, dushmandyk kirgizuu uchun arakty, kumar oiundaryn kooz korsotot. Oshondoi ele Allakhty zikir kyluudan, namaz okuudan alagdy kyluunu kaalait. Ei, yimanduular, bul zhaman ishterdi tashtaisyn'arby? Bulardy tashtoo silerge ylaiyk ekeninde shek zhok, emi kaitkyla!

Shariiatta emneni buirusa atkaryp, emneden tyisa tyiylyp, Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine bash iigile. Karshy chyguudan etiet bolgula, eger zhuz burup, teskeri bassan'ar, anda bilip algyla, bizdin elchibizdin mildeti Allakh zhetkir degen nerseni zhetkiruu gana. Tuura zholgo bassan'arda ozun'orgo, teskeri ketsen'er da ozun'orgo.

Araktyn aramdygy tuuraluu aiat tushkon'do kee bir musulmandar arak aram bolgongo cheiin zhashap otkon musulman bir tuugandyrynyn abaly kandai bolorun biluunu kaalashty ele, Allakh Taala alarga zhoop kylyp tomonku aiattardy tushurdu:
Allakh Taalaga ishengen, Allakhka zhakyndoo uchun zhakshy ish-araketterdi kylgan kishi, murda arak aram bolgongo cheiin any ichken bolso, aga kunoo emes., eger al Allakhtyn achuusunan korkup, Aga ishenip, bashka aram ishterden tyiylsa zhana zhakshy ishterdi zhasap zhurso. Kiiin (arak aram bolgon son') Allakhka zhakyndoonu dagy kuchotup Allakhty korup turgandai ibadat kylyshsa, Allakh Taala Any korup turgandai ibadat kylgandardy zhakshy korot; sebebi myndai ibadat kylganda alar Allakhtyn daiyma zhakyn ekenin sezishet, myndai abalaga yimanduu adam zhakshy ish-araketin zhana takybalygyn takai zhakshyrtuu arkyluu zhetishet.

Oo, yimanduular, Allakh Taala siler (azhy-zhe umra uchun) kharamda turgan kezin'erde kurgaktyktagy zhan-zhanybarlardy, alardyn kichinesin kolun'ar menen, chon'dorun kuralyn'ar menen karmap ala turgandai zhakyn alyp kelip synait. (Kharamda kurgaktyktagy zhan-zhanybarlarga uuchuluk kyluuga tyiuu salyngan, Allakh adamdardy synoo uchun ech kim zhok zherde alarga zhan-zhanybarlardy korsotot).Bul synoonu Allakh Taala pendelerinen kimisi Allakhtyn bilimine teren' ishenip, kaiyptan korkorun zhana kylgan ishinin baaryn bilip turuuchu Zharatuuchusunan korkup uuchuluktan ozun karmanaryn biluu uchun, oshondoi ele kim (takybalyk kylbai) chekten chygaryn bilip, oshogo zharasha esep-kysap kyluu uchun zhurguzdu. Kim azhy zhe umrada kharamda turup, uuchuluk kylyp chekten chyksa, Allakh Taala tyigan ishke but koigonu uchun kyiamat kunu aga zhan keiitken azap bar.

Oo, yimanduular, azhy zhe umrada ikhramda turganyn'arda kurgaktyktagy zhan-zhanybarlardy olturbogulo. Kim alardy atailap olturso, anyn zhazasy olturgonuno ylaiyk too, ui zhe koi-echki toloit. Buga musulmandardan eki adilettuu kishi okum chygarat. Ekoo okum kylgan nerse, Mekkege zhetkirilip, kharamda muuzdala turgan belek zhandyktar syiaktuu kylynat. Zhe bolboso, oshol maldyn baasyndai akcha tolonup, kedeiler tamaktandyrylat, ar bir kedeige zharym saa' olchomdo tamak berilet. Zhe bolboso, ar bir zharym saa' tamak uchun bir kundon orozo karmait. Munun baary an'dy olturgon adam kylgan kylygynyn akybet azabyn tatyp koruusu uchun. Tyiuu salynganga cheiin kharamdyn zhan-zhanybaryn olturgon zhana kharamda turup kurgaktyktagy zhan-zhanybarlarga an'chylyk kylgan adamdardy Allakh Taala kechirdi. Al emi tyiuu salyngandan kiiin dagy bul ishke kol sozgon adamdy Allakh Taala azaptap och alat, Allakh Kuchtuu, bekem. Anyn kuchtuulugunun bir belgisi - kaalasa, kunoo kylgan adamdan och alat, Any ech kim toktoto albait.

Musaapyr bolobu, zhergiliktuu turgun bolobu, kyskasy siler any azyk kylyp paidalanuun'ar uchun den'iz zhanybarlaryna uuchuluk kyluu, den'iz zheekke turtup chygargan zhanybarlar, al meili tiruu, meili oluk bolsun silerge adal boldu. Azhy zhe umrada ikhramda turganyn'arda kurgaktyktagy zhanybarlarga an'chylyk kyluu aram. Buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiganynan tyiylyp Allakhka takyba bolgula. Al kyiamat kunu baaryn'ar Anyn aldyna chogula turgan Zhalgyz Allakh, silerdi ish-araketterin'erge zharasha syilait zhe azaptait

Allakh Taala Kaabany - Bait al-Kharamdy - adamdar turchu zher kyldy. Anda alar dinii ishterin namazdy, azhyny, umrany, atkaryshat. Oshondoi ele kharamdagy amanchylyk, momo-zhemishterdi chogultuu syiaktuu duinoluk zhakshylyktar bar. Aram ailarynda (Zul-Kaada, Zul-Khidzha, Mukharram, Razhab) bashkalar menen sogushuudan silerdi aman kylyp koidu. Oshondoi ele kharamga aidalyp barchu belek-kurmandyktardy, alardy biluu uchun moiundaryna tagyp koigon monchok belgilerdi eesi alarga zyian tiigizuudon aman bolsun uchun kyldy. Munun baaryn Allakh Taala siler Al asman-zherdeginin baaryn bilerin an'doon'or uchun kyldy. Chynynda Allakh Taala bardyk nerseni Biluuchu. Zhogorudagydai shariiattary kelechekte silerdi zyiandan saktap, zhakshylykka duushar kyluu uchun. Bul pendelerine emne paidaluu ekenin aldyn-ala bilgenine dalil.
Ei, adamdar, Allakh Taala kunoo kylgan adamdy katuu azaptoochu, al emi toobo kylgan adamga yraiymduu, kechirimduu

Elchinin mildeti Allakh Taala zhetkiruusun buirugan nerseni zhetkiruu gana, adamdardy tuura zholgo salyluuga anda mumkunchuluk zhok. Tuura zholgo saluu Zhalgyz Allakhtyn kolunda. Allakh Taala tuura zholdo zhe adashuudagy silerdin achyk zhana zhashyruun isherin'erdi bilet, kiiin oshogo zharasha syilait zhe zhazalait

Oo, elchi, aitkyn: bardyk nersedegi yplastyk bardyk nersedegi tazalyk menen birdei bolboit. Yplastyktyn koptugu seni kyzyktyrsa da, anyn koptugu anyn zhakshy ekenine dalil emes. Ei, akylduular, yplastykty tashtap, zhakshy ishterdi kyluu menen Allakhka takyba bolgula, oshondo beiish zhen'ishine zheteersin'er.

Oo, yimanduular, elchin'erden silerge kereksiz, din ishterin'erde zaryl bolbogon suroolordu surai berbegile, eger suroon'orgo zhoop berilse, andan ozun'orgo kyiynchylyk zharatyp alasyn'ar. Suroogo tyiuu salyngan myndai suroolordu paigambarga Kuran aian-kabar bolup tushup zhatkanda surasan'ar, silerge anyn zhoobun maalym kylat, bul Allakh Taalaga zhen'il. Birok, Kuranda aitylbagan nerselerdi Allakh kechiret, any kaira surai berbegile, eger surai bersen'er anyn okumun atkaruu moiunun'arga zhuktolot. Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerinin kunoosun Kechiruuchu, alardy azaptoogo peiili Zhumshak.
Myndai suroolordu silerden murdagy koomdor da surashkan, kiiin alardyn moiununa zhuktolgondo atkarbai koiushtu, anan ushunun sebebinen kaapyr bolushtu

Allakh Taala mal-zhandyktardy adal kylgan, butparastar but-aikelderine arnap ozdoruno aram kylyp algan nerselerdi Allakh Aram kylgan emes. Misaly, bakhiira, al belgiluu bir sanda tuugandan kiiin kulagyn kesip belgi salyp koigon too, saaiba but-aikelderge arnap karyganda koio berip zhibergen too, vasiila eki zholu udaa urgachy tuugan too, khamii uiurgo koiulup bir kancha zholu (on zholu) tuudurgan atan too, bulardy minbei, soiboi koiup zhiberishken. Anan bulardy Allakh aram kylgan dep zhalgan doomat kylyshat, kaapyrlardyn kobu ushintip chyndyk menen zhalgandy, adal menen aramdy azhyrata albait.

Kee bir maldardardy aram kylgan dep Allakhka zhalgandy oodargan butparastarga: Allakh tushurgon Kuranga zhana paigambardyn (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) sunnotuno kaitkyla, oshondo aram menen adaldy azhyratasyn'ar dep aitylsa, alar: bizge ata-babalarybyzdan muras kalgan ishenim, aitym zhana ishter zhetishtuu deshet. Bular kantip zhetishtuu bolsun, alardyn babalary ech nerseni bilbese zhana tuura zholgo bashtabasa?! Alardy alardan otkon ilimsizder zhana alardan otkon adashuuchular gana eerchiit, alar karan'gy, adashuuchular

Oo, yimanduular, oz napsin'erge ozun'or zhoop beresin'er, any on'doi turgan ishke bekem bolgula. Eger siler tuura zholgo tushson'or, adamdardyn adashkandary zyianyn tiigize albait, silerge zhoop da berbeit. Tuura zholgo tushkonun'ordun bir belgisi zhakshylykka chakyryp, zhamandyktan tyiganyn'ar. Kyiamat kunu zhalgyz Allakhka kaitasyn'ar, oshondo bul duinodo emne kylganyn'ardyn kabaryn bildiret zhana oshogo zharasha syilait zhe zhazalait

Oo, yimanduular, eger saparda zhurgonun'ordo kimdir biroon'orgo olumdun belgilerinen korunup, olumu zhakyndap kalsa, eki adilettuu musulmandy, musulmandar zhok bolup, muktazhdyk tuulsa, kaapyrlardan eki kishini kaltyrchu murasyn'arga kubo kylgyla. Eger kaapyrlardy kubo kyla turgan bolson'or, alardy kaisy bir namaz okulup butkondon kiiin karmagyla. Anan alar: bul kuboluktu bir maksatta satyp zhiberbeibiz, zhakyn tuugandarybyzga tartpaibyz zhana zhashyryp koiboibuz dep Allakhtyn aty menen ant berishsin. Kiiin anttaryn buzup, aitylgandardy kylsa Allakhka da pendege da kunookor bolot

Ant berishkenden kiiin kuboluktu zhe antty buzup kyianat kylary belgiluu bolup kalsa; markumdun tuugandarynan kubolukko akyluuraak bolgon eki kishi kubo bolup, alar da: Bizdin kubolugubuz alardyn zhalganchy zhana kyianatchy kuboluktoruno karaganda chyndykka zhana amanatka bek, biz akyikattan taibai ant berdik, eger akyikattan taisak Allakhtyn cheginen chykkan zalymdardan bolup kalabyz dep ant berishet.

Namazdan kiiin kubo bolgon kubolordun kubolugu shektuu bolup kaluusunan zhe any kabyl kylbai koiuularynan, zhogoruda aitylgan eki adamdyn kubolugu shariiatka ylaiyk kubolukko zhakynyraak bolot. Alar kuboluktu buzbait, almashtyrbait zhana kyianat kylbait. Oshondoi ele muras kyluuchu kishinin tuugandarynyn kabyl kyluusuna da zhakynyraak bolot. Bular tigi ekoo kubo bolup duushar bolgondon bashka ant berishet. Kubo boluuda zhana ant beruudo kyianattykty zhana zhalgandy tashtap Allakhka takyba bolgula, buirulgan nerseni kabyl kyla turgandai berilip ukkula. Aga bash iibegenderdin ishin Allakh Taala iigiliktuu kylbait.

Oo, adamdar, esin'erde bolsun, kyiamat kunu Allakh Taala bardyk elchilerdi zhyiyp, alarga: Men silerdi elchi kylyp zhibergen ummottorun'or silerdin chakyrygyn'arga kandai zhoop kaitardy? dep suraganda, Allakhka zhoop kaitara albai: Biz munu bilbeibiz, munu Sen zhakshy bilesin', oo, Zharatuuchubuz, kaiyp ilimin bilgen bir gana Sensin' deshti.

Estegin, Allakh Taala Isa paigambarga kairylyp: Ei, Mariamdyn uulu Isa, men seni atasyz zharatkan zhakshylygymdy estegin, enen'di zamanyndagy aialdardyn arasynan tandap chygargan zhakshylygymdy estegin, seni Zhebireiil perishtenin zhardamy menen kubattandyrganymda beshiktegi ubagyn'da adamdardy daavat kylganyn'dy, chon' kishi bolgonun'da alarga menin dinimdi zhetkirgenin'di, saga zhazuunu, Musaga tushurulgon Toorottu, ozun'o tushurulgon Inzhildi uirotkonumdu zhana shariiattyn zhashyruun zhaktaryn, paidalaryn, syrlaryn uirotkon zhakshylygymdy estegin. Sen ylaidan kushtun kelbetin zhasap, anan uilogonun'do al tiruu kushka ailangan, kozu sokur tuulgan adamdyn koruu kasietin kaitargansyn', ala oorusun aiyktyrganyn'da anyn terisi taptaza bolgon, tiriltuusun Allakhka duba kylyp oluktordu tiriltkensin', ushunun baary Menin uruksatym menen bolgon. Sen alarga achyk-aikyn muzhiza-keremetterdi korsotkonun'do seni olturmokchu bolgon Israil urpaktarynan saktagan zhakshylygymdy estegin. Alardyn baary kaapyr bolup saga ishenbei, Isanyn korsotkondoru anyk syikyr deshken bolchu.

Maga zhana Saga ishenuusun shakirtterin'din zhuroguno kirgizip, zhardamchy boluusun zhen'il kylgan zhakshylygymdy estegin, alar buga bash iiip, makul bolushtu zhana: Oo, Zharatuuchubuz, biz Saga gana taiangan musulman ekenibizge Ozun' kubo bol! - deshti.

Shakirtter: sen Aga duba kylsan' Zharatuuchun' asmandan dastorkon tushuro alaby? - dep surashkanyn estegin. Oshondo Isa paigambar alardy takyba boluuga zhana myndai suroo berboogo buirup: (antkeni mynda alarga buzukuluk boluusu mumkun) Eger chyndap yimanduu bolson'or, yrysky talap kylganda Zharatuuchun'arga tobokel kylgyla - dedi.

Shakirtter Isaga: ushundai dastorkondon daam tatyp, Allakhtyn kuduretine zhana sen Anyn elchisi ekenin'e kon'ulubuz toiuusun kaalaibyz. Sen Allakhtan alyp kelgen nerse tuuraluu bizge chyndykty aitkanyn'a chyn zhurokton ishenebiz, adamdardyn dastorkongo kelbei kalgandaryna myna biz kubo bolobuz - deshti

Isa paigambar alardyn talabyn kabyl kylyp Allakh Talaaga myntip duba kyldy: "Rabbibiz, bizge tamak-ashy menen dastorkon tushur, al tushkon kundu mairamdaibyz, biz ozubuz zhana bizden kiiin keluuchulor Saga shugur kylyp oshol kundu uluktaibyz. Bul Senin Zhalgyzdygyn'a, dinin'din chyndygyna belgi zhana dalil bolsun. Bizge yrysky ber, oo, Zharatuuchubuz, Ozun' en' zhakshy yrysky beruuchusun'.

Allakh Taala Isa paigambardyn dubasyn kabyl kyldy zhana myndai dedi: siler tushuruunu surangan dastorkondu tushurom, birok any tushurgondon kiiin kim kaapyr bolso, ozunon korsun, any ech kimdi azaptabagan katuu azap menen azaptaim; antkeni al aidan achyk dalilge kubo boldu, anyn kaapyrlygy kezhirlikten ulam bolup zhatat. Allakh alarga bergen ubadasynyn otoosuno chygyp, dastorkondu tushurdu.

Estegin, kyiamat kunu Allakh Taala Isa paigambarga kairylyp: Ei, Mariamdyn uulu Isa, sen adamdarga Allakhty ary koiup maga zhana menin apama ibadat kylgyla dedin' bele? - dep suraganda, Isa Zharatuusun aruulap: maga alar uchun chyndyktan bashkany aituu ylaiyk emes, eger menin kolumdan kelip mintip aitkanymda, Sen any bilet elen', antkeni Saga ech nerse zhashyruun emes, ozumo bek zhashyrgandy da bilesin'. Al emi men Sendegi nerseni bilbeim, chynynda Sen bardyk achyk, kupuia zhana kaiyp ishterdi bilesin'.

Isa Zharatuuchusuna myndai dedi: Men adamdarga Sen maga buirugan sozdu: ibadat kyluuga ylaiyk bir gana Sen ekenin'di aittym. Men alardyn arasynda zhashap turgan uchurda alardyn aitkandaryna kubo bolup turganmyn, kiiin Sen meni tiruu asmanga kotorup, alardyn arasyndagy moonotum butkon son' alardyn ishin Sen Ozun' kozomoldop kaldyn', oo, Zharatuuchum. Sen bardyk nersege kubo boluuchusun', Saga ech nerse zhashyruun kalbait, menin alarga emne degenim zhana men ketkenden kiiin alardyn emne degeni Saga zhashyruun emes.

Oo, Zharatkan, eger azaptaim desen', alar ozun'dun pendelerin', kaalaganyn'dy kylasyn'. Eger alardyn yiman keltirgenderin kechirim menen syilaim desen', Seni myndan ech kim tyia albait, Saga ech kim ustomduk kyla albai turgan Kubattuusun', bashkaruuda Daanyshmansyn'

Allakh Taala Isa paigambarga myndai dedi: Kyiamat kunu chynchyldarga nietinin zhana ishterinin chyndygy paidasyn tiigize turgan kun. Alarga ak sarailarynyn zhana bak-daraktarynyn astynan daryialar agyp turgan beiish bar, anda tuboluk kalyshat, alarga olum bolboit. Allakh alarga yraazy boldu, emi takyr achuulanbait. Alar da, tuboluktuu zhakshylykka zhetkirgendigi uchun Allakhka yraazy boldu. Myna ushul syi zhana yraazylyk oto chon' zhen'ish, myndan otkon zhen'ish bolboit.

Asman-zherdin mulk-padyshalygy Zhalgyz Allakhka tiesheluu, Allakh al ekoonu zharatkan zhana alardy bashkaryp turat. Oshondoi ele asman-zherdegi bardyk zharatylyshtyn mulk-padyshalygy da Allakhka taandyk, Al bardyk nersege Kudurettuu, ech nersege kuch-kubaty zhetpei kalbait.

Zhakshy koruu menen aitylgan, oto korkom, toluk sypattalgan maktoolor Allakhka gana tiesheluu. Al murda ech okshoshu bolbogon asman zhana zherdi zharatty, biri-birinin artynan eerchip zhurgon tun menen kunduzdu zharatty. Tundu karan'gy, kunduzdu zharyk kyldy. Ushuga karabastan, kaapyrlar Aga bashka nerseni ten'ep, sherik koshup alyshty.

Ei, adamdar, Al kemchiliksiz Zat atan'ar Adamdy (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy bolsun) zharatkanda silerdi topuraktan zharatty. Kiiin duino zhashoosunda zhashap turuun'ar uchun silerge moonot berdi. anan kyiamat kunu silerdi kaira tiriltip chygaruu uchun Ozunon bashka ech kim bilbegen azhal moonotun berdi. Ushundan kiiin da Allakhtyn kaira tiriltuuchu kuduretine ishenbei shektenesin'er.

Al kemchiliksiz Zat asman-zherdeginin baary Aga ibadat kyluusuna tatyktuu, Aga ech nerse zhashyruun boiuncha kalbait, Al siler nietin'erdi, sozun'ordu, ishin'erdi zhashyrsan'ar da, achyk kylsan'ara da bilip turat. Kiiin oshogo zharasha syilait zhe azaptait

Butparastarga Zharatuuchun'ardan dalil, belgi kelse, aga kon'ul burbastan tashtap koiushtu. Chynynda alarga Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygyn dalildegen aidan achyk bir kancha dalil, belgiler keldi, Allakhtyn elchisinin chyndyk ekenine bir kancha dalilder keldi. Oshogo karabastan kosh kon'ulduk menen zhuz burup, teskeri ketishti.

Alar achyk-aikyn dalil, belgilerden bash tartuu menen andan da achyk bolgon nerseden bash tartyp alyshty. Mukhammad paigambar (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) alyp kelgen Kurandy zhalgan deshti. Zhakynda kyiamat kunu azapty korgondo alarga kelgen chyndykty shyldyn'dagan kandai bolorun bilishet.

Zaalym ummottordu kyiratyp zhok kylchu Allakhtyn zholun bul kaapyrlar bilbeibi? Chynynda Allakh Taala bul kaapyrlarga berbegen zherdi bergen, bularda zhok kuchtu bergen kanchalagan elderdi zhok kyldy. Alarga asmandan uturu zhamgyr zhaadyryp turchu, turgan zherlerin aralai daryialardy agyzyp koigon ele. Kiiin alar Allakhka kunookor bolushtu, kunoogo batkandygy uchun alardy kyiratyp zhok kyldy, anan alardyn orduna bashka elderdi zharatty

Oo, elchi, eger saga baraktarga zhazylgan kitepti tushursok, alar any oz kozu menen korup, anan koldoru menen karmap korgonun tastyktasa da, baary bir any tan albai, ishenbei koimok zhana: sen alyp kelgen nerse anyk syikyr eken, biz buga ech ishenbeibiz dep aityshmak.

Tigi kaapyrlar: Eger Allakh Taala Mukhammadga bir perishteni tushurup, al anyn chyndyk ekenine kubo otup bizge suilogondo, oshondo aga ishenmekpiz deshet. Eger alar sypattagandai perishteni tushurgonubuzdo da ishenishpese, alardy kyiratyp zhok kylmakpyz, anda alarga toobo kyluuga moonot da berilmek emes.

Alarga perishteni elchi kylyp zhibere turgan bolgonubuzda dele, alar aga zholugup, any uguusu uchun perishteni erkek kishinin keipinde zhibermekpiz; sebebi, perishteni Allakh Taala zharatkan chynygy oz keipinde zhibersek aga turushtuk bere alyshmak emes. A any kishi keipinde zhibersek, bul alarga dagy kumon zharatmak.
Bular saga perishte tushuruunu talap kylyp shyldyn'dashsa, murdagy koomdor da elchilerin shyldyn'dashkan. Kiiin, alar azapka kabyldy, bul azapka alar ishenbei, chetke kagyp shyldyn'dagan ele.

Oo, elchi, bul zhalganchy, shyldyn'doochularga mintip ait: zher betin kydyrgyla, Allakhtyn elchilerin zhalganga chygargandadyn abaly emne bolgonuna oi zhugurtkulo, chynynda, alar kuchtuu, bekem bolgonuna karabastan kiiin Allakhtyn azabyna kabylyshty

Oo, elchi, alarga dagy mintip ait: Asmandyn, zherdin zhana bul ekoonun ortosundagylardyn mulk-padyshalygy kimge taandyk? Ait: bulardyn baarynyn mulk-padyshalygy Allakhka tiesheluu. Al pendelerine artykchylyk berip, Oz napsisine yraiymduuluktu zhazyp koigon, alardy azaptoogo shashylbait, kachan gana toobo kylyshpasa, kyiamat kunu baaryn zhyiat. bul kundun boloruna shek zhok. Allakhka kaapyr bolup, oz zhanyna zyian kylgandar yiman keltirishpeit zhana zyiandan oz zhandaryn kutkara alyshpait
Tunu-kunu zhan kechirgendin baarynyn mulk-padyshalygy Allakhka taandyk, Al alardyn sozdorun Uguuchu, kylgan ishterin Biluuchu, kiiin oshogo zharasha zhazalait zhe syilait

Oo, elchi, Allakh menen birge but-aikelderge zh.b. nerselerge ibadat kylgan butparastarga mintip ait: Allakhtan bashkany zhardamchy kylyp, andan zhardam suroom akylga syichu ishpi?! Al murda ech okshoshu bolbogon asman menen zherdi zharatty, zharatuuda ech kimdi aldyna salbady. Al pendelirinen kimdi kaalasa oshogo yrysky beret, pendelerinen ech kim aga yrysky bere albait. Al pendelerine muktazh emes, pendeler Aga muktazh. Ei, elchi, alarga dagy mintip ait: Meni Zharatuuchum bul ummottun ichinen en' birinchi Allakhka moiun sunup, Aga taianuuchulardan boluumdu buirudu zhana Aga sherik kyluuchulardyn katarynda boluudan tyidy.

Oo, elchi, aitkyn: men shirk zhana bashka Allakh tyiuu salgan kunoolorgo but koiup, Allakhka kunookor boluudan, zhe yiman zhana bashka Allakh buirugan nerselerdi atkarbai kyiamat kunu katuu azapka duushar boluudan korkom.

Kyiamat kunu Allakh kimdi bul azaptan alystatsa, Allakhtyn yraiymy menen zhen'ishke zhetiptir, myn ushul Allakhtyn azabynan kutuluu zhen'ishi - ech bir zhen'ish ten' kelbei turgan achyk-aikyn, chynygy zhen'ish.

Oo, Adam balasy, eger saga Allakhtan bir balee kelse, seni andan Allakhtan bashka ech kim arylta albait, eger saga Allakhtan zhakshylyk kelse, myndan Any tosuuchu zhok, anyn artykchylygyn kaitaruuchu da bolboit. Al bardyk nersege Kudurettuu, Any ech nerse alsyz kyla albait

Al pendelerin kordop ustomduk kyluuchu, any ech nerse alsyz kyla albai turgan bardyk taraptan biiik, Aga ech kim ustomduk kyla albait, baary aga koz karandy. Ozunun kemchiliksiz sypattaryna ylaiyk pendelerinin ustundo, zharatuuchulugunda, bashkaruusunda zhana shariiatynda Daanyshman zhana Kabardar, Aga ech nerse zhashyruun kalbait.

Oo, elchi, seni zhalganchy degen butparastarga: Menin chynchyldygyma kaisy nerse kuchtuu zhana ishenimduu kubo bolot? - dep ait. Anan ait: Allakh menin chynchyldygyma kuchtuu, ishenimduu kubo, Al meni menen silerdin orton'ordo Kubo boluuchu, meninsilerge emneni alyp kelgenimdi zhana silerdin emneni kaitararyn'ardy bilet. Allakh Taala maga silerdi zhana Kuran zhetken insan, zhinderdin baaryn eskertuu uchun Kurandy aian kylgan. Siler, ei, butparastar, Allakh menen birge dagy bashka ibadat kyluuga bolo turgan nerseler bar dep ishenesin'er. Ei, elchi, alarga dagy mintip ait: Siler ishengen nersen'er zhalgan bolgonu uchun aga men kubo bolo albaim, chynynda Allakh ibadatka ylaiyktuu Zhalgyz, Anyn sherigi zhok, men Aga sherik koshkondordun baarynan zhuz burup chetteimin.

Biz Toorottu bergen iakhudiler zhana Inzhildi bergen khristiandar, Mukhammad paigambardy (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) ozdorunun baldaryn bashkalardyn baldarynan airyp taanygandai daana taanyp bilishet. Bul, tozokko kiruu menen zhandaryna zyian kylgandar ech yiman keltirishpeit.

Allakhka sherik koshup, anan koshkon nersesine syiyngan zhana Allakh Taala elchisine tushurgon aiattardy zhalgan dep eseptegen adamdan otkon zaalym adam bolboit. Allakhka sherik koshup zhana Anyn aiattaryn zhalganga chygaryp zaalym bolgondor eger toobo kylyshpasa, anda ech zhen'ishke zhetishpeit.

Kyiamat kunu alardyn baaryn chogultkanda ech kimisine kyianat kylbaibyz. Allakhka bashka nerseni sherik kylyp ibadat kylgandardy zhemelep: Allakhtyn sherikteri dep zhalgan aityp zhurgon sherikterin'er kaida? dep aitabyz.

Ushundai synoodon kiiin alardyn shyltoosu ozdoru syiyngan nerseden bash tartuu gana bolot da: Allakhka ant bolsun, o, Zharatuuchubuz, al duinodo biz butparas bolgon emespiz, Saga ishengen, Seni zhalgyz dep taanygandardan bolgonbuz - dep zhalgan aityshat.
Oo, Mukhammad, bulardyn Allakhka ech nerseni sherik kylgan emespiz dep tanyshkanyn, zhana bul duinodo Allakhka sherik kylgan sherikterinin alardan kachyp, zhok bolup ketkenin karachy?!

Oo, elchi, sen Kuran okuganda butparastardyn arasynda any ukkandary da bar, birok alar ukkandarynan paidalana alyshpait; antkeni kezhirligi zhana bash iibegendigi uchun alardyn Kurandy tushuno albai turgan kylyp zhuroktoruno tosmo koigonbuz zhana paidaluu nerseni uguudan kulaktaryn keren' kylganbyz. Alar achyk dalilderdi, aikyn belgilerdi kop korso da baary bir ishenbeit. Saga kelip, chyndyk tuuraluu zhalgandy aityp talashat da: Senin aityp zhatkandaryn' murdagylardyn kitebinen alyngan bolmushtar - deshet.

Alar adamdardy elchige yiman keltiruudon tyiyp, andan alystatat, paida aldyra koiboit, ozdoru da andan paidalanbait. Bul kylyktary menen ozdorun zhok kylyshat, zhana kylgan ishteri kyiroo ekenin bilishpeit.

Oo, elchi, kyiamat kunu alardy tozokko tikelei alyp kelgendegi abalyn korgonun'do... Alar anda okunuch menen: Attin' ai, duino zhashoosuna kaira baryp kalsak kana, anda Allakhtyn aiattaryn zhalgan debeit elek, Allakh ishengen yimanduulardan bolot elek - deshet. Alardyn oor abalyn tan' kaluu menen korosun'.

Biz kaira duino zhashoosuna zhiberilsek yiman keltiret elek degenderi da zhalgan. Alardyn den-mucholoru kuboluk bergende, wa'llWahi rabWina ma (kun)Wa mushrikiyna (Allakhka ant, biz murda butparas bolgon emespiz) degen ichindegi zhalgandary achykka chygyp kaldy. Eger alar bul duino zhashoosuna kaira keluugo kudureti zhetkende dele, kaira ele tyiuu salyngan kaapyrlygy menen butparastygyna baryshmak, chynynda alardyn kaira kaitsak yiman keltirebiz degen ubadasy zhalgan.
Bul butparastar: biz azyr zhashap zhatkan zhashoodon bashka zhashoo zhok, biz esep beruu uchun kaira tirilbeibiz deshti

Oo, elchi, kaira tiriluu bolboit degender Allakhtyn aldynda turganyn korgonun'do, alardyn abaly oto oorluguna tan' kala karait elen'. Allakh Taala alardan: Siler zhalgan degen ech shegi zhana zhalgany zhok kaira tiriluu ushul emespi?! - dep surait. Alar: Bizdi zharatkan Zharatuuchubuzga ant berip aitabyz, kaira tiriluu ech shegi zhok chyndyk eken - deshet. Oshondo Allakh Taala alarga: Ushul kungo ishenbegenin'er uchun azaptyn daamyn tatkyla, duino zhashoosunda zhurgonun'ordo bul kundu bolboit dep zhalganga chygargansyn'ar - deit.

Kyiamat kunu kaira tiriluunu zhalgan, Allakhtyn aldyna choguluunu mumkun emes degender chynynda zyian tartyshty. Alar kabarsyz turganda kokusunan kyiamat bolup, anan katuu okunup: shorubuz kurusun, Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyp zhana kyiamat kununo daiardanbai zhan'ylysh umut kylyppyz - deshet, alar kunoolorun zhonuna kotorup zhurushot, alardyn kotorgon kunooloru kandai zhaman

Allakhty yraazy kylchu ishti kylbagandarga soionup algan bul duino zhashoosu otup ketchu oiundai ele. Al emi yiman keltirip, bash iiip zhakshy ishterdi zhasagan zhana shirk, kunoo kyluu syiaktuu tyiuu salyngan ishterden tyiylyp Allakhka takyba bolgondorgo akyret zhashoosu zhakshy. Ei, butparastar, ushuga akyl zhugurtson'or, yimanga kelip, zhakshy ishterdi zhasait elen'er.

Oo, elchi, alar seni syrtynan zhalganga chygarganyna kaigyrganyn'dy Biz bilebiz. Sen bilgin alar senin amanatka bek, chynchyl ekenin'di bilet zhana oz ara seni zhalganga chygaryshpait. Birok alar zalym adamdar, senin ishin'e ichinen ishenip tursa da, syrtynan chetke kaga beret.

Bul zhalganga chygaruu saga gana tiesheluu dep oilobo. Senden murdagy elchiler da zhalganga chygarylgan, koomdoru alardy azaptagan. Alar uguttoodo, Allakh zholunda kazat kyluuda sabyrduuluk kylyshkan zhana alarga Allakhtyn zhardamy kelgen. Allakh kitebinde zhazgan zhardamdy zhana elchilerine bergen ubadany ech kim ozgorto albait. Ei, elchi, chynynda saga murdagy elchilerdin kabary, b.a. alarga koomu kandai karshy chykkany zhana Allakh Taala alarga zhardam berip dushmandaryn kandai kyiratkany tuuraluu kabar berildi

Oo, elchi, sen alyp kelgen chyndyktan teskeri burulup, zhalganga chygargandary saga katuu tiise, eger zher astyn kiruuchu zhol zhe asmanga kotorulchu tepkich taap, Biz saga bergenden bashka dalil, belgi korsoto alsan', anda oshondoi kyl. Eger Allakh kaalasa alardyn baaryn chogultup sen alyp kelgen tuura zholgo salyp koimok. Birok Ozunun zhetkiliktuu daanyshmandygy menen myndai kyluunu kaalbady. Sen buga akyly zhetpegen ilimi taikylardan bolbo. Alardyn yimanga kelbegenine kaigyrganyn'dy toktot.

Sen alyp kelgen dinin'di sozdu ugup, tushungondor gana kabyl kylyshat, a kaapyrlar oluk syiaktuu alardyn ech kadyry zhok, zhuroktoru olup kalgan. Oluktordu kyiamat kunu Allakh kaira tiriltet, anan kylgan ishterine zhoop beruu uchun Zhalgyz Allakhtyn aldyna kaityshat

Butparastar: Mukhammadga al alyp kelgen dini chyndyk ekenine dalil bolo turgan adattan tysh belgi berilbeibi? - deshet. Ei, elchi, alarga: Allakh Taala siler kaalagandai belgini tushuruugo kudurettuu - dep ait. Birok oshol belgini tushuruunu talap kylgan butparastardyn kobu belgini tushuruu, alardyn talaby menen emes, Allakhtyn daanyshmandyk syry menen bolorun bilishpeit. Eger myndai belgini tushurgondon kiiin da yimanga kelishpese, anda kyiroogo uchurap kalyshmak.

Oo, Adam baldary, zher betinde kybyrygan zhanduunun baary, asmanda kanat kakkan kanattuular zharatyluusunda zhana yryskylanuusunda siler syiaktuu ele ummot. Saktalgan kitepte (Lavkh al-Makhfuzda) ech nerseni kaltyrbai zhazganbyz. Baarynyn ilimi Allakhka maalym. Kiiin, kyiamat kunu okumdu uguu uchun baaryn'ar Allakhka kaitasyn'ar zhana ar kim ozuno ylaiyk syilanat zhe zhazalanat.

Aiattarybyzdy zhalgan degender kulagy ukpagan keren'der, suiloi albagan duduktar syiaktuu. Buga koshumcha alar karan'gylykta, koro alyshpait, myndailar tuura zholdu tapmak bele?! Allakh adamdardan kimdi adashtyruunu kaalasa, adashtyrat, kimdi tuura zholgo bashtoonu kaalasa, ech kyishygy zhok tuz zholgo bagyttait

Oo, elchi, tigi butparastarga mintip ait: Aitkylachy, eger silerge Allakhtyn azaby, zhe boluusu ubada berilgen kyiamat bolup kalsa, oshol ubakta bashyn'arga tushkon balee, kyiynchylyktan kutkaruusun suranyp Allakhtan bashkaga kairylasyn'arby?! Eger siler syiyngan nerseler paidasyn zhana zyianyn tiigize alat dep ishengenin'er chyn bolso ushintmeksin'er.

Bul uchurda ozun'ordu zharatkan Allakhtan bashkaga duba kylbastygyn'ar chyndyk. Al silerdi baleeden saktap, zyiandy toktotot, Al buga bashchy zhana ushundai kyluuga Kudurettuu. Al emi Allakhka sherik kylyp ibadat kylgan "kudailaryn'ardy" alardan paida da, zyian da bolboosun bilip, tashtap koiosun'ar.

Oo, elchi, senden murdagy ummottorgo da elchilerdi zhibergenbiz, alardy da koomdoru zhalganchy dep, alar alyp kelgen dinden teskeri burulushkan. Biz alardy Zharatuuchularyna bagynyp, Anyn aldynda kemsinuusu uchun zhakyrchylyk, dene-boiuna zyiany tiichu ooru-syrkoo menen azaptadyk.

Alardyn bashyna balee tushurgonubuzdo, andan kutuluu uchun Allakhtyn aldynda kemsinip, Aga bagynyp kalyshsa, Biz alarga yraiym kylmakpyz. Birok alar mintpedi, alardyn zhurogu katyp kalgandyktan etibar kylbady zhana sabak albady. Berilip algan kunoo zhana kaapyrlyktaryn shaitan alarga kooz korsotup, kaapyrlyktaryn ulanta berishti.

Zhakyrlyk zhana oorudan sabak albai, Allakhtyn buiruktaryn da atkarbai koiushkanda, alarga yrysky eshikterin achyp, bailyk berip, den-sooluktaryn chyn'dap azgyryp kyzyktyrdyk. Kachan alar koodonun kotorup menmensinip, ozdoruno berilgen nersege chirenip kalyshkanda, kokustan Bizdin azabybyz keldi ele, umuttoru uzulup emne kylaryn bilbei kalyshty.

Elchilerge zhardam beruu, kaapyrlardy kyiroogo uchuratuu arkyluu kaapyrlardyn aiagy kesildi. Dushmandaryn kyiratyp, dostoruna zhardam bergen Aalamdardyn Zharatuuchusu Allakhka shugur, maktoo zhana yraazylyk bolsun.

Oo, elchi, tigi butparastarga mintip ait: Eger Allakh silerdin uguu zhana koruu kasietin'erdi alyp, keren', sokur kylyp koiso, zhurogun'orgo moor basyp, ech nerseni baamdabai kalsan'ar; silerdin zhogotkon nersen'erdi kaisy kudaiyn'ar kaitaryp bere alat, aitkylachy? Ei, elchi, oilop korchu, biz bularga kandai gana belgilerdi baiandabadyk, kandai gana dalilderdi keltirbedik, alar bolso oshondon kiiin da teskeri burulushtu!

Oo elchi, alarga mintip ait: Allakhtyn azaby silerge bilinbei kokustan kelse da zhe achyk ele bilinip kelse da, Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgan zhana paigambarlaryn zhalganga chygargan zaalymdar gana kyiroogo uchurait

Biz elchileribizdi yimanduu, bash iigen adamdarga alardy kubantuuchu, ech tugonbogon, uzgultukko uchurabagan tuboluk zhakshylykty aityp kabarloo uchun zhana kaapyr, kunookor adamdarga katuu azabybyzdy aityp eskertuu uchun zhiberdik. Elchilerge ishenip, zhakshy ishterdi kylgandarga akyrette ech korkunuch bolboit, oshondoi ele alar bul duino zhashoosunda atkargan ishterine okunboit zhana kaigyrbait.
Bizdin aiattarybyzdy zhalgan degender, Allakhka bash iibegeni sebeptuu azapka kabylyshat

Oo, elchi, tigi butparastarga dagy mintip ait: Mende ozum kaalagandai alyp ishtete turgan Allakhtyn yrysky kazynasy bar dep aitpaimyn. Maga Allakh aian-kabar arkyluu bildirgenden bashka kaiyptardy da bilem dep aitpaimyn. Men perishtelerdin birimin dep da aitpaimyn. Men Allakhtyn elchisimin, maga aian-kabar bolgon nerseni gana eerchiim, ozumdo bolbogon nerseni aitpaim. Ei, elchi, alarga dagy myndai de: Chyndyktan kozu tosulup kalgan kaapyr menen chyndykty korup aga ishengen yimanduu birdei bolobu? Ei, butparastar, ailan-choiron'ordogu belgilerge akylyn'ardy ishtetpeisin'erbi?

Oo, elchi, kyiamat kunu Zharatuuchusunun aldynda tirilip turuudan korkkondordu Kuran menen korkutup, eskert. Alarga Allakhtan bashka paida alyp kele turgan dos, zyiandan saktap kala turgan koldoochu zhok. Alar buirulgan ishti atkaryp, tyiylgan ishten tyiylyp Allakhka takyba bolushaar. Myna ushular Kurandan paida ala turgan adamdar

Oo, elchi, erteli-kech Allakhka chyn yklasy menen daiyma ibadat kylgan kembagal musulmandardy zhanyn'dan alystatpa. Butparastardyn chon'dorun ozun'o zhakyndatuu uchun bulardy zhanyn'dan alystatpa. Sen al zhakyrlardy ech esep kylbaisyn', alardy Allakh esep-kysap kylat, alar da seni esep kylbait. Sen eger alardy zhanyn'dan oolaktatsan', anda Allakhtyn cheginen chykkan kishilerden bolup kalasyn'.

Ushintip alardy biri-biri menen synadyk. Alardy duino ulushundo ar turduu kyldyk. Bai kaapyrlar kedei musulmandardy ten'sinbei: Allakh bizdin arabyzdan myna ushul zhakyrlardy tuura zholgo saldyby? Eger yiman zhakshylyk bolgondo anda alar bizden murda ee bolmok emes, biz alardan murda ee bolmokpuz - deshkeni uchun, Biz alardy ushundai synadyk. Zhakshylygyna shugur kyluuchulardy Allakh zhakshyraak bilet emespi, oshon uchun alardy yimanga bagyttady, kaapyrlardy da zhakshy bilip, alardy kur kaltyrdy, alar yimanga kelishpeit. Ooba, Allakh alardan Biluchuurook.

Oo, elchi, eger saga sen alyp kelgen dindin chyn ekenine dalil bolgon Bizdin aiattarybyzga ishengen yimanduular kelse, alardy urmattap salamyna zhoop kaitar, alarga Allakhtyn yraiymy kenen ekenin suiunchulo. Allakh Taala Ozuno kenen yiraiymduuluktu yigargan. Alardyn kimisi bolso da bilbesten zhe unutup kunoogo barsa, kiiin andan kaityp toobo kylsa, ish-araketterin zhakshyrtsa, Allakh Taala chynynda anyn kylgan kunoosun kechiret. Allakh Taala toobo kylgan pendelerine Kechirimduu zhana alarga Yraiymduu.

Zhogoruda aitylgandardy saga baiandagan syiaktuu, zhalgan ishenimdegilerge da dalil, belgileribizdi baiandaibyz, kunookorlordun zholu zhana tuzulushtoru aikyn boluusu uchun zhana alardan alys bolup saktanuun'ar uchun

Oo, elchi, alarga: Siler syiynyp zhatkan Allakhtan bashka nerselerge syiynuuga Allakh maga tyiuu salgan - dep ait. Dagy ait: Allakhtan bashkaga syiynuu kaaloon'ordu eerchibeim, eger mynda men silerdi eerchisem ak zholdon adashkan bolom, aga bagyttalbai kalam. Allakhtyn dalilisiz kaaloolorun eerchigenderdin baarynyn abaly ushundai bolot.

Oo, elchi,tigi butparastarga mintip ait: Men kaaloomdu emes, Zharatuuchumdun achyk-aikyn dalilin eerchiim. a, siler bolso bul dalildi zhalganga chygardyn'ar.Siler talap kylyp zhatkan adattan tysh dalilder zhana siler shashylyp zhatkan azaptar menin kolumda emes. Bular Allakhtyn kolunda. Zhalpy siler talap kylgan nerselerdin okumu Allakhka tiesheluu. Al chyndykty aitat, chyndyk menen okum chygarat. Al chyndyk menen zhalgandy azhyratuuchulardyn zhana baiandoochulardyn en' zhakshysy.

Oo, elchi, alarga ait: Eger menin kolumda zhe mumkunchulugumdo siler shashyp talap kylyp zhatkan azap bolgon, any ebak ele tushurmokmun zhana anda meni menen silerdin ortobuzdagy ishibiz da butmok. Allakh Taala zaalymdardyn moonotun kancha uzartuunu zhana alardy kachan azaptoonu zhakshy bilet

Kaiyptyn kazynalary zhalgyz Allakhtyn kolunda, any Andan bashka ech kim bilbeit. Al kurgaktyktagy zhana den'izdegi aibanattardy, osumduktordu zhana zattardy bilet. Daraktyn kaisy bir zherge uchup tushkon zhalbyragy, zher tubundo ongon dan, byshkan zhana bysha elek nersenin baary anyk kitepte zhazylyp saktalgan, al kitep Lavkhul Makhfuz.

Siler uktaganda rukhun'ardy belgiluu moonotko alyp turgan Al Allakh. Kunduzu oigoo kezin'erde ishterden emneni kylganyn'ardy bilgen da Allakh. Uikuda rukhun'ardy algandan kiiin ishin'erdi kyluun'ar uchun kunduzu kaira tiriltet. Ushintip Allakh olchop koigon omurun'or butkondon kiiin, kyiamat kunu tirilip Allakhtyn Ozuno kaitasyn'ar. Oshondo siler bul duino zhashoosunda emne kylyp zhurgonun'ordu kabarlait zhana oshogo zharasha syilait zhe zhazalait

Allakh Taala pendelerine ustom; bardyk taraptan alardan Biiik, bashka baardyk nerse Aga koz karandy. Ozunun kemchiliksiz uluktuguna zharasha pendeleriinin ustundo. Ei adamdar, Allakh silerge kylgan ishin'erdi eseptep saktoochu perishtelerin zhiberet, azhalyn'ar zhetkende zhanyn'ardy aluu uchun olum perishtesin zhana anyn zhardamchylaryn zhiberet. Al perishteler buirulgan ishin kemchiliksiz atkarat

Kiiin zhany alyngandyn baary, kylgan ishterine esep beruu uchun, alarga kuchtuu chechim zhana adil okum chygaruuchu chynygy padyshasy Allakhtyn aldyna chogulat. Al ish-araketterdi oto bat esep kyluuchu.

Oo, elchi, bul butparastarga mintip ait: Kurgaktyn zhana den'izdin karan'gylygynda kabylgan apaat-baleelerden kim silerdi salamat saktap kalat? Ichin'erden da, syrtyn'ardan kemsinip, Anyn zhalgyz Ozuno: O, Zharatkan, eger ushul baleeden bizdi sak-salamat alyp kalsan', bul zhakshylygyn'a shugur kyluuchulardan bolup, Senden bashkaga syiynbaibyz - dep zhalbarasyn'ar go.

Oo, elchi, alarga mintip ait: Silerdi al baleeden kutkara turgan Allakh Ozu, bardyk kaigy-kapadan aryltat. siler bolso oshondon kiiin da, zhyrgalchylyk uchurda Aga bashka nerseni sherik kylasyn'ar. Ushul kylganyn'ardan da otkon zalymdyk bolobu?!

Oo, elchi, alarga dagy mintip ait: Allakh Taala silerge ustun'ordon keluuchu tash zhaadyruu, chagylgan tushuruu, topon suuga chokturuu syiaktuu oshodoi ele but astyn'ardan keluuchu zher titiroo, zher zhutuu syiaktuu azaptardy zhiberuugo kuchu zhetuuchu-Kudurettuu. Zhe zhurogun'ordu biri-birin'e karshy kylyp koiot da, ar kimin' oz kaaloon'du eerchip, biri-birin'erdi olturosun'or. Ei elchi, alardyn ishenimi zhalgan, sen alyp kelgen din chyndyk ekenin tushunuusu uchun alarga turduu belgi, dalilderdi korsotup zhana baiandap zhatkanybyzdy karap korchu.

Koomun' bul Kurandy zhalgan dedi. Kuran chyndyk, anyn Allakhtan ekenine ech kumon zhok. Ei, elchi, alarga: Maga silerdi kozomoldoo zhuktolgon emes, bolgonu men silerge zhakyn arada tush boluuchu katuu azapty eskertuuchumun.
Ar bir kabardyn turuktuu ubaktysy zhana buto turgan akyrky chegi bar. Ushunun biri silerdin malyn'ardyn zhana akybetin'erdin kabary. Munu kyiamat kunu kaira tirilgende bilesin'er.

Oo, elchi, eger butparastardyn Bizdin aiattarybyz tuuraluu kelekeluu, shyldyn' sozdorun uksan', aiattarybyzdy shyldyn'dagan sozdon bashka sozgo kochmoiuncho alardan alys bol. Eger shaitan untturup alar menen oturup kalsan' zhana kiiin estesen', alardyn oturushun tashta, myndai buzukular menen oturba.

Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiuusunan tyiylyp takyba bolgondor butparastar uchun zhoop berbeit, bolgonu alardyn moiununda tuura emes ishten kaitaruu gana bar, mumkun butparastar da, buiruktardy atkaryp, kunoodon tyiylyp takyba bolup kalaar

Oo, elchi, dinderin oiun-tamashaga ailantyp, shyldyn', keleke kylgan butparastardan alys bol, alardy duino zhashoosu zhana andagy ubaktyluu kyzyktar azgyryp koigon. Ei, paigambar, adamdarga Kuran menen nasaat kyl, kylgan kunooloru sebeptuu ozdorun kyiroogo duushar kylyp albasyn. Aga zhardam bere turgan Allakhtan bashka zhardamchy bolboit zhana Kyiamat kunu any Allakhtyn azabynan arachalai turgan koldoochu da bolboit. Azaptan kutuluu uchun zhaza akysyna emneni berbesin, baary bir kabyl kylynbait. Bular kunoogo batkan sebeptuu oz zhandaryn kyiroogo uchuratkandar, Kyiamat kunu alardyn kaapyrlygy uchun ysyktygy akyrky chegine zhetken ichimdikter berilip, zhan keiitken azap menen azaptalat.

Oo, elchi, tigi butparastarga mintip ait: Allakhtan bashka, paida beruugo da, zyian beruugo da eelik kyla albagan but-aikelderge syiynalyby. Allakh Taala tuura zholgo salyp koigondon kiiin dinden kaityp, shaitandar adashtyryp, tuura zholun tappai akyly airan bolgon kishige okshoilubu. Anyn tuz zholdogu zholdoshtoru bar, alar any chyndykka chakyrat, al bolso alardyn chakyrygyna zhoop bere albait. Ei, elchi, alarga dagy mintip ait: Chynynda Allakhtyn zholu myna ushul tuura zhol, Allakh bizdi Anyn Zhalgyzdygyn moiundap, Aga ibadat kylyp moiun sunuuga buirugan, Al aalamdardyn Zharatuuchusu

Chynynda bizdi namazdy toluk kanduu okuuga buirudu, Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiuusunan tyiylyp, takyba boluuga buirudu. Al Zhalgyz, kyiamat kunu pendeler toptolup, kylgan ishterine esep-kysap beruu uchun Aga barat.

Al asman-zherdi chyndyk menen zharatkan kemchiliksiz Allakh Taala. Allakh bir nersege bol degen kunu al bolup kalat. Kyiamat kunu turgula degende turushat. Anyn sozu sozsuz bolo turgan chyndyk. Kyiamat kunu Israfil perishte surnaiyn ekinchi zholu uilogondo bardyk padyshalyk Aga taandyk bolot. Al kaiypty da, korunup turgandy Biluuchu, zharatuuda zhana bashkaruuda Daanyshman, ech nerse zhashyruun bolbogon Kabardar, ishterdin ichki syry Aga syrtynda korunup turgandai ele maalym

Oo, elchi, Ibrakhim (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy bolsun) buttarga syiyngan atasyna kairylyp: "Ata, Allakhty tanyp, ushul buttarga ibadat kylasyn'by? Siz dagy, buttarga ibadat kylgan sizdin koomun'uz dagy Allakhty tanyp, Andan bashka nerselerge ibadat kylyp, achyk-aikyn adashyshty zhana chynygy tuura zholdon chettep ketishti. Al Kemchiliksiz Allakh chynygy ibadatka tatyktuu, Andan bashkalary ibadat kyluuga tatyktuu emes

Atasynyn zhana anyn koomunun adashuusun korsotkon syiaktuu, Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygyna, ibadat kyluu zhalgyz Aga ylaiyk ekenine zhyiyntyk chygaryp, Allakh ech bir sherigi zhok, bardyk nersege Kudurettuu ekenine anyk ishenuuchulordon boluusu uchun aga asman-zherdin tugongus mulkun korsottuk.

Karan'gy kirgende asmandan zhyldyzdy korup: "Ushul menin Rabbim" - dedi. (Zher zharyp) zhyldyz korunboi kalganda: "Zhok bolup ketuuchulordu zhakshy korboimun", - dedi. Antkeni, chynygy Kudai daiyma bar bolot, Al zhogolup ketpeit.

Tolup chykkan aidy korup: "Myna ushul menin Rabbim" - dedi. Ai batyp ketkende: "Zhalgyzdygyn taanuuga zhana Aga ibadat kyluuga Allakh Ozu zhol korsotposo, Anyn chynygy dininen alystap, adashkan koomdon bolup kalchudaimyn" - dedi.

Zharkyrap tiigen kundu korup: "Myna bul zhyldyzdan da, aidan da chon' bolgon Kun menin Rabbim" - dedi. Kun batyp ketkende: "Ei, el-zhurt, siler Allakhka sherik kylgan nerselerdin baarynan zhuz burdum" - dedi.

Oshentip alar ibadat kylgan Allakhtan bashka nerselerdin baarynan zhuz burganda, alar: Anda sen kimge ibadat kylasyn'? - dep surashty.
Men kop kudailuuluk isheniminen bir Kudaiga ishenuugo kaityp, murda ech bir okshoshu bolbogon asman-zherdin Zharatuuchusuna dinimdi tapshyrdym. Men Allakhka bashka nerseni sherik kylyp ibadat kyluuchulardan emesmin.

Butparas koomu Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygy tuuraluu talashyp-tartyshyp, any but-aikelderi menen korkuta bashtaganda, alarga mintip aitty: "Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygy, ibadatka tatyktuulugu tuuraluu talashasyn'arby? Rabbim meni bul zholgo Ozu bagyttagan, men silerdin but-aikelderin'erden korkpoimun. Antkeni, eger Allakh kaalabasa, alar maga zyianyn da, paidasyn da tiigize albait. Allakh kaalagan nerse gana bolot. Allakh bardyk nerseni bilip turat, asman-zherde bolgondordun baary aga zhashyruun emes. Ei, el, siler Aga kaapyr bolup, shirk kylyp, zhalgyz Allakhka ishenbei zhurosun'or, ushunu oilonboisun'arby?!

Siler Allakhka ech dalilsiz shirk kylyp, Allakh zharatkan nerselerdi Aga sherik kyluudan korkposon'or, men siler ibadat kylyp zhatkan buttardan emnege korkmok elem.?! Bul eki toptun: bir Kudaiga ishenuuchulor menen shirk kyluuchulardyn kaisynysy beipildikke, tynchtykka tatyktuu? Bulardyn kaisynysy tatyktuuraak ekenin bilsen'er, oshonusun eerchigile, akyikatta tatyktuuragy - ech sheksiz - bir Kudaiga ishenuuchu, yimanduulardyn tobu.
Allakhka yiman keltirip, shariiatty bekem karmap, yimandaryna shirkti aralashtyrbagan adamdarga gana tynchtyk, amandyk bolot. Alar bagyttalgan adamdar, alardy Rabbileri tuura zholgo bagyttagan.

(fa'ayWu 'lfariyqayni 'aHaqWu bi'l'amni...) (Bul eki toptun kaisynysy tynchtykka akyluu...) degen Allakhtyn sozu Biz Ibrakhimge bergen dalil. Al oshol dalil menen koomunun dalilderine ustomduk kylyp, alardyn dalilderin zhokko chygardy. Biz kaalagan pendebizdin darazhasyn bul duinodo da, akyrette da kotorbuz. Ei, elchi, akyikatta senin Rabbin' zharatuuchulugunda zhana bashkaruusunda Daanyshman, pendelerin Biluuchu.

Ibrakhimge balasy Iskhakty zhana neberesi Iakubdu berdik zhana al ekoon' ten' tuura zholgo saldyk. Bulardan murda Nukhtu da tuura zholgo salganbyz.Oshondoi ele anyn urpaktarynan Dauddu, anyn uulu Sulaimandy, Aiiubdu, Iusuftu, Musany, anyn agasy Kharundu (alarga Allakhtyn tynchtygy bolsun) tuura zholgo salganbyz. Biz paigambarlardy alardyn zhakshylyktary uchun ushundai syilaganbyz. Alardan bashka zhakshylyk kyluuchulardy da ushundai syilaibyz.

Oshondoi ele Zakariiany,Iakhiiany, Mariiamdyn uulu Isany zhana Iliasty (alarga Allakhtyn tynchtygy bolsun) tuura zholgo bagyttaganbyz. Bul paigambarlardyn baary Allakh elchi kylyp tandagan saalikh-yimanduu adamdardan ele.

Oshondoi ele Ismaildi, Al-Iasa'ny,Iunustu zhana Luttu da (alarga Allakhtyn tynchtygy bolsun) tuura zholgo bagyttadyk. Mukhammad paigambar (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) bash bolgon ushul paigambarlardyn baaryn aalamdardan artyk kyldyk.
Biz tuura zholgo tushuusun kaalap, tandagan alardyn kee bir atalaryn, kee bir baldaryn zhana kee bir tuugandaryn da bir Kudaiga syiynuu zhana bash iiuu zholu bolgon tuz, tuura zholgo bagyttadyk.

Alardyn tuura zholgo tushuusu Allakhtyn bagyttoosu menen, Allakh kaalagan pendelerin ushintip bagyttait. Eger alar Allakhka bashka nerseni sherik kylyshsa, kylgan zhakshy ish-araketteri tekke ketet. Antkeni, shirk zhakshy ishterdi zhokko chygarat.

Zhogoruda aitylgan paigambarlarga Biz kitepterdi, daanyshmandykty zhana paigambarlykty bergenbiz. Eger senin koomun' Biz paigambarlarga bergen bul uch nersege kaapyrlyk kylyshsa, aga kaapyr bolboi turgan bashka koomdu daiardap, almashtyryp koiobuz. Alar any bekem karmagan yimanduular bolushat. Alar mukhazhirler zhana ansarlar, oshondoi ele alardyn zholun zholdogon kyiamatka cheiinki yimanduular.

Oshol paigambarlar zhana alar menen birge aitylgan atalary, baldary zhana bir tuugandary akyikatta tuura zholgo tushkon adamdar. Ei, elchi, sen ushulardy eerchi zhana koomun'a: "Men Kurandy zhetkirgenim uchun silerden aky surabaimyn. Kuran - insan zhana zhinder uchun nasaat-eskertme, al arkyluu tuz, tuura zholdu tabasyn'ar" - dep ait.

Butparastar Allakhtyn paigambary Mukhammadga (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun): "Allakh adamzatka ech kandai aian-kabar tushurgon emes" - degende, Allakhty Oz uluuluguna zharasha baalashkan zhok. Ei, elchi, alarga mintip ait: "Musaga anyn koomu uchun nur, tuura zhol zhana bagyt kylyp Toorottu kim tushurgon?" Zhoottor anyn zhazyp alyshyp, kon'uluno zhakkan zherin achyk korsotup, Mukhammaddyn sypattary syiaktuu kon'uldoruno zhakpagan zherin zhashyryp koiushkan. Ei, araptar, siler ozun'or da, silerden murdagylar da bilbegen nerselerdi Kurandan uirondun'or. Ei, elchi, alarga: "Any Allakh tushurgon" - dep ait. Kiiin alardy chyndyk achykka chykchu kun kelgiche, karan'gy, adashkan, shyldyn'dagan abaldarynda tashtap koi.

Oo, paigambar,Kuran Biz saga tushurgon kitep, al berekeluu, murdagy asman kitepterin tastyktagan kitep. Al Mekke elin zhana zherdin chygysh-batyshyndagy adamdardyn baaryn tuura zholgo kirgizuu uchun eskertuu. Akyret zhashoosuna yiman keltirgender, Kuranga da yiman keltirishet. Anda aitylgandardy ish zhuzundo atkaryshat. Namazdaryn parz, vazhyb, mustakhabdary menen shariiatta belgilengen tak ubaktysynda okushat.

Oz oiunan oilop taap Allakhka zhalgan aitkan adamdan otkon zaalym bolobu!? Al: "Allakh Taala adam balasyna ech kandai aian-kabar tushurgon emes" - dep aitat. Zhe Allakh aga ech nerse tushurboso dele, ozuno aian-kabar tushurdu dep aitat. Zhe bolboso: "Men dagy Allakh Kuranda tushurgon din syiaktuu dindi tushuromun" - deit. Ei, elchi, al zalymdar olumdun daamyn tatyshkanyn, perishteler alarga kolun sozup, azaptap, urup zhatyshkanyn korgonundo... Perishteler alarga kaarduu mamile zhasap: "Zhanyn'ardy chygargyla, biz any alyp ketebiz. Paigambarlyk, aian-kabar zhana Allakh tushurgon syiaktuu dindi tushuruu tuuraluu Allakhka zhalgan aitkanyn'ar sebeptuu oshondoi ele Allakhtyn aiattaryna yiman keltiruudon tekeberlengenin'er uchun bugun katuu, kor kyluuchu azap menen kyinalasyn'ar" - deshet. Eger oshol uchurdu korgon'un'do oto korkunuchtuu abaldy korot elen'.

Kaira tiriluu kunu alarga mintip aitylat: "Biz silerdi algach zharatkanda zhylan'ach, zhylan' aiak zharatkandai, Bizdin aldybyzga bugun bailygyn'ar da, biiligin'er da zhok zhalgyz keldin'er go! Biz bergen bailyk, biiligin'erdi tigi duinogo tashtadyn'ar. Ibadat kylganda Allakhka sherik bolot, bizge ortomchuluk kylat dep oilogon "kudailaryn'ardy" da zhanyn'arda korboduk. Silerdin alar menen bailanyshyn'ar uzuldu. Bular Allakhtyn sherikteri, bizge koldoo korsotot degen oiun'ar zhokko chykty".

Chynynda, uroondu ondurup, andan egin chygargan zhalgyz Allakh. Danekti zharyp, andan kurma, zhuzum, zh.b. daraktardy osturgon da zhalgyz Allakh. Al olukton tiruunu chygarat; misaly, adam balasy da, aibanattar da bir tamchy uruktuk suudan chykkan. Al tiruudon oluktu chygarat; misaly, oshol uruktuk suu adamdan chygat, zhumurtka tookton chygat. Ushunun baaryn silerdi zharatkan Allakh zhasait. Ei, butparastar, Allakhtyn zhokton bar kylganyna kubo bolup turup, chyndyktan kantip kachasyn'ar!?

Al, Kemchiliksiz, Uluu Allakh tundun karan'gylygyn tan'dyn nuru menen zharytat. Al, kunduzu ishtep charchagan adamdar es alyp, ish-araketterin toktotuusu uchun tundu es aluuchu ubak kyldy. Al, kun menen aidy chenelgen tagdyr menen zhuro turgan kyldy. Myna ushul aitylgan zhokton bar kyluunun baary ech kimdin kuchu zhetpegen Kubattuu Allakhtyn tagdyry, Al zharatkandaryn zhana alarga emne paidaluu ekenin Biluuchu.

Oo, Adam, balasy, Al, Kemchiliksiz, Uluu Allakh siler kurgakta zhana den'izde saparda zhurgondo alardy karap zhol tabuu uchun asmandagy zhyldyzdardy zharatty. Chynynda, dalil, belgilerge akyl zhugurtup, andan paida ala turgan adamdar uchun, Kuduretibizdi bildirgen dalil, belgilerdi achyk-aikyn baian kyldyk.

Al Kemchiliksiz, Uluu Allakh silerdi bir zhandan, atan'ar Adamdan zharatkan. Al emi zharatyluun'ar atan'ardyn topuraktan zharaluusunan bashtalgan. Kiiin andan silerdi zharatty. Silerge enen'erdin zhatynyn byshyp zhetiluuchu zhai, atan'ardyn bel omurtkasyn saktaluuchu zhai kylyp koidu. Allakhtyn sozuno tushungon adamdar uchun dalilderdi ushindai baian kyldyk.

Al, Kemchiliksiz, Uluu Allakh asmandan zhamgyr zhaadyrat. Zhamgyr suusu menen osumduktordun bardyk turun osturduk, osumduktordon zhapzhashyl eginderdi zhana daraktardy chygardyk. Andan dandary biri-birine zhabyshkan mashaktardy chygarabyz. Kurmanyn butaktarynan oturgan adam da, turgan adam da zhetchudoi iiilgen shin'gil momoloru chygat. Oshondoi ele zhuzum bakchalaryn, zhalbyraktary okshosh birok, momoloru ar bashka zaitun zhana anar baktaryn chygarabyz. Ei, adamdar, momolor emi bailaganda zhana alar byshyp-zhetilip kalganda alarga karagyla! Ei, adamdar, mynda, dalil, belgilerden paida alyp, Allakhka yiman keltirgen adamdar uchun Allakhtyn kudurettuuluguno achyk-aikyn dalilder bar.

Butparastar paida-zyiany tiet degen ishenimi menen ibadat kylgan uchurda zhinderdi Allakhka sherik kylyshty. Chynynda, alardy da Allakh zharatkan, Andan bashka ech kim zharatkan emes. Oshon uchun ibadat kyluuga bir gana Allakh ylaiyktuu. Zhoottor Uzairdy, khristiandar Isany Allakhtyn balasy dep, butparastar perishtelerdi Allakhtyn kyzdary degen syiaktuu Allakhka uul-kyzdy tan'uulashty. Allakh zhalgan ishenimdegiler sypattagan sypattardyn baarynan Aruu zhana Biiik.

Al, Kemchiliksiz, Uluu Allakh muda bolbogon surottogu asmandardyn zhana zherdin Zharatuuchusu. Anyn aialy bolboso, kantip balasy bolsun!? Al chynynda, bardyk nerseni zharatkan, Al bardyk nerseni Biluuchu, Aga ech nerse zhashyruunu emes.

Oo, adamdar, ushundai sypattar menen sypattalagan Zat silerdin Rabbin'er, andan bashka silerge Rabbi zhok. Andan ashka ibadat kyluuga tatyktuu ech kim zhok, Al bardyk nerseni zharatuuchu, Anyn Ozuo gana syiyngyla, Al ibadat kyluuga tatyktuu. Al bardyk nerseni saktap turuuchu.
Kozdor any oroi albait, Al Kemchiliksiz Zat kozdordu orop alat. Al saalikh pendelerine Zhumshak, alardan Kabardar.

Oo, adamdar, silerge Rabbin'erden achyk-aikyn dalilder zhana belgiler keldi, kim aga akyl zhugurtup, bash iise, paidasy ozuno. Al emi kim sokur bolup, akyl zhugurtposo zhana bash iibese, anyn zyiany ozuno. Men silerdin ish-araketin'erdi sanagan kuzotchu emesmin. Men silerdi kuzotup turgan Rabbimdin elchisimin.

Allakhtyn kuch-kuduretine ar turduu dalil, belgilerdi korsotkonubuz syiaktuu, aiattarybyzdy da ubada, eskertuu, nasaat kylyp ar turduu tushurduk. Butparastar: Bul aian-kabar emes, sen munu murdagy kitep eelerinen uirongonsun' - deshet. Oshondoi ele chyndykty Mukhammaddyn ummotuno baian kyluubuz uchun aiattardy turduu kyldyk. Alar chyndykty kaly kylyshat zhana any eerchishet.

Oo, elchi, Rabbin' saga aian-kabyr kylgan chyndykty gana eerchi. Al kemchiliksiz Allakh, Andan bashka ibadtka tatyktuu ech kim zhok. Kaapyrlardyn ton' moiunduguna zhurogun'du alagdy kylba, alardyn ishi Allakhtyn kolunda.

Eger Allakh alardyn Aga ech nerseni sherik kylboosun kaalaganda, alar Aga ech nerseni sherik kylbait ele. Ei elchi, seni alardyn ishin kozomoldoi turgan karool kylgan emespiz. Sen alarga mazhburlanbaisyn', chynynda sen elchisin', senin mildetin' zhetkiruu.

Oo, yimanduular, soguugo ylaiyktuu oto zhaman nerseler bolgonuna karabastan, butparastar Allakhka sherik kylyp syiynyp zhatkan but-aikelderdi sokpogulo. Butparastar aga ochoshup zhana karan'gylyk kylyp Allakhty sokposun. Alarga adashuulary kooz korungon syiaktuu bardyk ummottorgo ozdorunun ish-araketteri zhakshy bolso da, zhaman bolso da any kooz korsottuk. Biz alarga kooz korsotkon nerseden saktangyla. Kyiamat kunu baary Rabbisine kaitat. Oshondo alardyn bul duinodo emne ish-araket kylganyn kabar berip, oshogo zharasha zhazalait.

Eger Mukhammad alarga alar talap kylgan Allakhtyn aiat-belgilerinen bir belgini alyp kelse, aga yiman keltirebiz dep, butparastar kolunan kelishinche zhan urop Allakhka ant berishet. Ei elchi, alarga: "Aiat-belgilerdi tushurgudoi alar menin kolumda emes, al Allakhtyn kolunda kachan kaalasa, oshondo tushurot" - dep ait. Ei, yimanduular, eger alardyn talabyna ylaiyk aiat-belgi kelse da alardyn yiman keltirbestigin bilesin'erbi? Alar kezhirlenip, moiununa albagan boiuncha kala berishet, antkeni alar tuura zholdu kaalashpait.

Ozdorunun kezhirligi sebeptuu birinchi iret Kuranga yiman keltiruudon alystatyp koigonubuz syiaktuu, alardyn zhuroktorun zhana kozdorun chyndykka alyp barchu tuura zholdon alagdy kylyp, oodaryp koiduk. Emi alardy adashyp, durbolon'go tushup, tentigen boiuncha Rabbisine kaltyryp koiobuz.

Biz alar talap kylgan nerseni alyp kelip, perishtelerdi tushursok zhana aga kubo bolushsa, oluktor suilop, sen alyp kelgen din chyndyk ekenin aityshsa, alar talap kylgan nersenin baaryn alardyn aldyna keltirsek dagy, baary bir alar sen alyp kelgen nersege yiman keltirishpeit. Allakh tuura zholdu kaalagandary gana yiman keltirishet. Birok, alardyn kobu myndan kabary zhok, Allakhtan tuura zhol tilep zhalynyshpait.

Seni butparastardyn dushmandygy menen synagan syiaktuu senden murdagy paigambarlardy da synaganbyz. Alardyn ar birine adamdardan zhana zhinderden bolgon dushmandardy kylganbyz, alar biri-birin azgyryp, eldi aldoo uchun zhalgandy kooz kylyp korsotushkon. Eger Allakh kaalasa myndai kylbait ele, birok, Allakh synoo uchun ushunu kaalady. Emi zhalgan, kaapyrlygy menen tashtap koi, alarga eerchibe.
Alardyn biri-birine bolgon azgyrygyna akyretke yiman keltirbegenderdin zhurogu zhibip, aga yraazy bolup, kabyl kylyp, kunoo-katalardy zhasap zhuro beruusu uchun.

Oo, elchi, Allakh menen birge bashka nerselerge ibadat kylgan bul butparastarga: "Men menen silerdin orton'ordo okum chygaruu uchun Allakhtan bashkany tandap aluu akylga syiaby?" - dep ait. Kurandy toluk, baiandoochu kylyp tushurgon al - Allakh Ozu. Toorot berilgen zhoottor zhana Inzhil berilgen khristiandar, Kuran chyndykty alyp tushkon kitep ekenin zhakshy bilishet. Antkeni, alar kitepterinen buga dalilderdi korushkon. Biz saga aian-kabar kylyp tushurgon nersege shektenuuchulordon bolbo.

Kuran sozdordun da, kabarlardyn da chyndygyn chegine zhetkirgen, Anyn sozun ozgortuuchu zhok. Al pendelerinin sozun uguuchu, alardy biluuchu. Aga ech nerse zhashyruun kalbait. Anyn sozdorun ozgortuugo araket kylgandardy kiiin zhazalait.

Oo, elchi, eger sen zherdegi adamdardyn kopchuluguno bash iisen', seni Allakhtyn dininen adashtyryp koiushat. Akyikatta, chyndykty azchylyk tarapta kylgany bul Allakhtyn sunnot-zholu. Adamardyn kobu daiyny zhok kumongo eerchishet, ibadat kylyp zhatkan nerseleri Allakhka zhakyndatat dep oiloshot zhana bul tuuraluu zhalgandy oilop chygaryshat.
Oo, elchi, senin Rabbin' adamdardyn kimisi adashkanyn zhana kimisi tuura zholgo tushkonun zhakshy bilet. Myndan Aga ech nerse zhashyruun kalbait.
Oo, adamdar, eger Anyn achyk dalilderine chyndap yiman keltirgen bolson'or, Allakhtyn aty atalyp muuzdalgan adaldy gana zhegile

Oo, yimanduular, Allakhtyn aty atalgan nerseni zhegenden silerdi emne tyiyp zhatat. Chynynda, Allakh silerge aram nerselerdi baiandagan, alardan saktanuu silerge vazhyb, birok, oto zaryldykta zhesen'er bolot. Zaryldyk tyiuunu zhokko chygarat. Butparastardyn kobu bilbesten, tuura emes pikirden ulam chyndyktan alystap ketishuudo. Alar olumtuk syiaktuu Allakh aram kylgan nerselerdi adal deshet. Bakhira (besh zholu botologon too), vasila (udaa-udaa eki zholu urgachy botologon too) zhana khami (on zholu botolotkon erkek too) syiaktuu Allakh adal degen nerselerdi aram kylyshat. Ei, elchi, Rabbin' chekten chykkandardy zhakshy bilet zhana alardy chekten chykkandygy uchun zhazalait.
Oo, adamdar, achyk zhana zhashyruun kunoonun baaryn tashtagyla. Achyk zhana zhashyruun kunoogo berilgenderdi, alardyn kylganyna zharasha Allakh Taala zhazalait.

Oo, musulmandar, Allakhtyn aty atalbagan nerseni, meili aga bashkanyn aty atalsyn zhe atalbasyn, baary bir any zhebegile. Antkeni, any zhesh Allakhka bash iiuudon chygaryp, kunoogo turtot. shaitandar ozdorunun dostoruna olumtuktu zhesh-zhebesh boiuncha kumon zharatat. Oo, musulmandar, eger siler ushundai kumongo eerchip any zhesen'er, siler da shirk kyluuda alar menen birdei bolup kalasyn'ar.

Kaapyr bolup, karan'gylykta, kunoogo batyp oluk syiaktuu bolgon, anan Allakh any tuura zholgo, yimanga bagyttap, Ozuno bash iidirip tiriltken adam, kaapyrlyktyn, ilimsizdiktin zhana kunookorduktun karan'gylygynda zhurgon, andan chyga albai, zholdoru zhabylyp, karan'gylykta kalgan adam menen birdei bolmok bele!? Butparastarga ozdorunun shirki, olumtuk zhegeni,zhalgandy talashyp-tartyshuusu zhakshy korsotulgon syiaktuu, kaapyrlarga da kylgan kunooloru zhakshy korsotuldu, kyiamat kunu alardy oshogo zharasha azaptoo uchun.

Mekkede butparastardy Allakhtyn zholunan tosuuchu chon'doru bolgon syiaktuu, bardyk aiyldarda alardy kuuluk-shumdugu menen shaitandyn zholuna chakyryp, elchilerge zhana alardy eerchigenderge karshy tukurgan bashchy, chon'dorun kylyp koiduk. Ish zhuzundo alar kuuluk-shumdugu menen ozdorun aldashat, birok, alar ilimsizdigi zhana kaaloosuna berilgendigi sebeptuu munu sezishpeit.

Kaapyrlardyn chon'doruna Allakh Taala paigambaryna tushurgon aiat-belgilerden bir belgi kelse, alar: "Allakh bizge da paigambarlarga bergen paigambarlyk zhana elchilik ozuipany bermeiinche yiman keltirbeibiz" deshet. Allakh elchilikke zhana anyn mildettirin atkaruuga kim ylaiyk ekenin zhakshy bilet zhana paigambarlyk ozuipany oshogo gana taandyk kylat. Chekten chykkan adamdarga chyndykka tekeberlengeni uchun korduk, kuuluk-shumdugu uchun katuu azap bolot.

Allakh kimdi tuura zholgo salgysy kelse, anyn kokurogun achyp, islamdy kabyldoogo zhibitip koiot. Al emi kimdi tuura zholgo salgysy kelbese, chyndykty kabyl aluuga anyn kokurogun tarytyp koiot. B.a.asmanga kotorulo albagan syiaktuu zhuroguno chyndykty kirgize alyshpait. Adashkandardy ushundai kyiyn, tar abalga kaltyrgan syiaktuu, yiman keltirbegenderdi da katuu azaptait.
Oo, elchi, Biz saga shariiat kylyp bergen ushul din Allakhtyn ech iirisi zhok tuz zholu, Allakhty estep, tushuno turgan akyl-estuu adamdarga aiattardy baian kyldyk.
Alar uchun bardyk zhamandyktan sak-salamat bolo turgan beiish bar. Zhakshy ishterdi zhasaganyna syilyk katary Allakh alardy koldoit zhana kam korot

Oo, elchi, insandar menen zhinderdi chogultkan Kyiamat kunun este. Oshondo Allakh: "Ei, zhinder zhamaaty, insandardyn kobun adashtyryp, Allakhtyn zholunan tostun'ar" deit. Alardy eerchigen insandar Rabbisine zhoop berip: "Oo, Rabbibiz, biz biri-biribizdi paidalandyk, zhinder aga bash iigen insandy paidalandy, insandar kumar kaaloosunan paidalandy, oshentip zhurup bizge chektelgen kun Kyiamat keldi" deshet. Allakh: "Silerdin turak zhaiyn'ar tozok, anda tuboluk kalasyn'ar, birok, Allakh kaalagandar, kaira tirilgenden tartyp tozokko kirgenche tuboluk tozokto bolboit" deit. Allakh ushul moonottu tuboluk tozokto kaluu dep eseptegen zhok. Ei, elchi, akyikatta senin Rabbin' tagdyr kyluuda zhana bashkaruuda Daanyshman, pendelerin kimisi tozokko tatyktuu ekenin Biluuchu.

Zhinderdin keesin bashchy kylyp, insandardy azgyruu uchun alarga erk berip koigonubuz syiaktuu, zaalymdy zaalymga bashchy kylyp koiobuz, alar biri-birin zhamandykka undop, kyzyktyrat. zhana zhakshylyktan kachyryp, alystatat; bul alardyn kunoogo berilgendiginin zhazasy.

Kyiamat kunu alarga: "Ei, insan zhana zhinderdin zhamaaty, silerge ozunordun zhynsyn'ardagy - insandardan bolgon - elchiler kelbedibi, alar Allakh tushurgon nerseni silerge okup berip, kyiamat kunu zholugarybyzdy aityp, eskertishpedibi?" - dep aitabyz. Alar: Ooba, Senin elchilerin' bul kun tuuraluu bizge zhetkirgenin, bul kunu zholugushuu bolorun moiunubuzga alabyz. Birok, elchilerin'di zhalganga chygarganbyz, Kyiamattagy zholuguunu da zhalganga chygarganbyz - deshet. Alardy ubaktyluu koozdugu, zhakshylygy zhana yrakhaty menen duino zhashoosu aldap koidu. Alar duino zhashoosunda Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyr bolushkanyn moiununa alyshty, birok, ubaktysy otup ketkendikten alardyn emi moiununa algany da, yiman keltirgeni da paidasyz
Insandarga zhana zhinderge elchilerdi zhiberuunun syry, elchi zhonotpoi, daavatyn zhetkirbei turup ech kimdi azaptabagandygynda, ech bir ummottu elchilerin zhiberip eskertmeiinche azaptagan emes.

Alardyn ar birinin ishine zharasha darazhasy bolot. Zhamandygy kop adam menen zhamandygy azy birdei bolboit. Eerchuuchu menen eerchigen birdei bolboit. Oshondoi ele, zhakshy ishterdi kyluuchulardyn sooptoru da birdei bolboit. Rabbin' alardyn emne ish kylganynan kabarsyz emes, Al baarynan kabardar, Aga ech nerse zhashyruun emes. Emi baaryn kylgan ishterine zharasha zhazalait.

Oo, elchi, Rabbin' pendelerine muktazh emes, alardyn ibadatyna da muktazh emes. Alardyn kaapyrlygy Aga zyianyn tiigizbeit. Alarga muktazh bolbogonuna karabai, alarga meerimduu. Ei, kunookor pendeler, eger silerdin zhok boluun'ardy kaalasa, Ozunun bir azabyn zhiberip koiot. Silerdi zhok kylgandan kiiin ozuno yiman keltirip,bash iigen eldi paida kylat. Silerdi da ozun'ordon murdagy koomdun uruk-nasilinen ushintip paida kylgan.
Ei, kaapyrlar, ubada kylyngan kaira tiriluu, choguluu, esep beruu zhana azap cheguu sozsuz bolot. Rabbin'erden ech kachyp kutula albaisyn'ar, Al silerdi kachyrbait zhana azaby menen azaptait.

Oo, elchi, alarga ait: Ei, koomum, kaapyrlyk zhana adashuuda zhurgon zholun'arda bekem tura bergile, men silerge achyk-aikyn dalilderdi zhetkirip ozuipamdan kutuldum. Silerdin kaapyrlygyn'arga zhana adashuun'arga kon'ul buruuchu emesmin. Men emi ozum turgan chyndyk zholunda zhuro berem.Emi kimge zher betinde zhardam bolorun, zher kimge muras kalaryn, kimge akyrette zhen'ish bolorun bilesin'er. Butparastar zherde da, akyrette da zhen'ishke zhetishpeit, alardyn akybeti okunuch bolot.

Butparastar Allakh zharatkan eginderden, mal-zhandyktardan Allakhka bolushturup, buga cheiin bolbogon ishti bashtashty. Bolgon nerselerinin bir bolugun Allakhka, bir bolugun ozdoru ibadat kylgan but-aikelderge dep oiloshtu. Ozdorunun but-aikelderine dep bolgon boluktu, Allakhka dep bolgon bolukko b.a. Allakh shariiatta buirugan kedei-kembagaldarga ishtetilchu boluguno takyr aralashtyryshpady. Al emi Allakhka degen boluktu ozdorunun aikelderine bolgon bolukko kaalagandai arylashtyryshty. Bul kandai zhaman bolushturuu zhana okum!

Shaitan myna ushul zhaman okumdu butparastarga kooz kylyp korsotkon syiaktuu, butparastardyn shaitandardan bolgon sherikteri alarga kedeilikten korkup baldaryn olturuunu kooz korsottu. Allakh tyiuu salgan adam olturuu ishine kadam tashtatuu uchun zhana kaisy shariat, kaisy shariat emes ekenin bilbei, dinderin aralashtyryp aluusu uchun ushundai kyldy. Eger Allakh alardyn andai kylboosun kaalaganda, andai kylyshpait ele. Birok, Ozunun cheksiz daanyshmandygy menen Allakh ushunu kaalady. Ei, elchi, butparastardy Allakhka zhapkan zhalgan zhalaalary menen tashtap koi, bul saga zyianyn tiigizbeit, alardyn ishin Allakhka tapshyr.

Butparastar bul mal-zhandyktardy zhana eginderdi biz kaalagandan bashka adamdarga zhegenge bolboit deshet. Bul zhanybarlardyn ustu aram b.a.minuugo, zhuk artuuga bolboit dep, bakhirany, saibany, khamini aityshat, bulardy soigondo Allakhtyn aty atalbait deshet. Alardy but-aikelderdin atyn atap muuzdashat. Munun baaryn Allakhtan dep zhalgan aityshat. Ushintip zhalgan zhalaa zhapkan sebeptuu kiiin Allakh alardy zhazalait.

Oshondoi ele: saiba zhana bakhira eger tiruu tuusa, anyn ichindegisi erkekteribizge adal, aialdarybazga aram, a, eger oluk tuusa, anda erkekteribizge da, aialdarybyzga da adal deshet. Emi alardy ylaiyksyz sozdoru uchun Allakh zhazalait. Al shariiatynda zhana zharatkandarynyn abalyn zhongo saluuda Daanyshman, alardy zhakshy Biluuchu.

Akyly zhana ilimi zhetishsizdikten baldaryn olturgondor zhana Allakh yrysky kylyp bergen mal-zhandyktardy Allakhtan dep zhalgan aityp aramga chygargandar zyianga uchurashty. Alar tuz zholdon alystap, tuura zholgo tushuuchu bolbodu.

Kemchiliksiz Allakh zher betine son'gogu zhok zhapyz oso turgan zhana son'goktuu biiik kotorulup oso turgan baktardy zharatkan. Oshondoi ele kurmany,korunushu zhana daamy ar turduu eginderdi zharatty. Al zhalbyraktary okshosh, daamy okshobogon zaitun zhana anardy zharatty. Ei, adamdar, byshkan uchurda alardyn momosun zhegile, terip-zhyiganyn'arda anyn ushurun bergile, zhegende zhana napaka kylyp bergen shariiat cheginen chykpagyla. Zhep, napaka kyluuda zhe bashka zhol menen ishtetuudo chekten chykkan ysyrapkorlordu Allakh zhashy korboit, alarga achuulanat.
