Bul nerselerdi zharatkan Zat Ozu alardy silerge adal kylgan, alardy aramga chygaruu butparastardyn ishi emes.

Al Zat silerge chon' toolor syiaktuu zhuk tashuuchu zhana alardyn kichineleri zhe koi-echkiler syiaktuu maida, zhuk tashuuga zharabagan zhan-zhanybarlardy berdi. Oo, adamdar, Allakh silerge adal kylyp koigon ushul nerselerden zhegile, butparastarga okshop Allakh adal kylgan nerseni aram, aram kylgan nerseni adal korsotkon shaitandyn zholuna eerchibegile. Oo, adamdar, akyikatta, shaitan ushunusu menen silerdi Allakhka kunookor kyluunu kaalagan anyk dushmanyn'ar.

Silerge mal-zhandyktan segiz zhuptu zharatty; koidun erkek urgaachysyn zhana echkinin erkek urgaachysyn. Ei, elchi, butparastarga: Allakh Taala bulardyn erkekterin erkektigi uchun aram kyldyby? - dep ait. Eger: ooba - deshse, Anda urgaachylaryn emne uchun aramga chygarasyn'ar? zhe alardy urgaachylygy sebeptuu aram kyldyby? - dep ait. Eger: ooba, - deshse, Alardyn erkekterin emnege aramga chygarasyn'ar? zhe alardyn ichindegiler aralash bolgonu uchun alardyn urgaachylaryn aram kyldyby? - dep ait. Eger ooba - deshse, Alardyn ichindegileri aralash bolgondo emne uchun keede erkekterin, keede urgaachylaryn aram dep azhyratasyn'ar - dep ait. Ei, butparastar, eger ushul nerselerdi Allakh aram kyldy degen sozun'or chyn bolso, tuura ilim menen tushundurup bergilechi - degin.

Segiz mal-zhandyktyn kalgany, bular: erkek-urgaachy eki too zhana erkek-urgaachy eki ui. Ei, elchi, butparastarga: Allakh bulardyn erkekterin aram kyldyby, zhe urgaachylaryn aram kyldyby, zhe ekoonun ichindegilerinbi? - dep ait. Ei, butparastar: zhe oz oiun'arda, Allakh siler aramga chygaryp zhatkandardy aram dep osuiat kylganda kubo boldun'ar bele? Ech bir ilimi zhok turup, adamdardy tuura zholdon adashtyruu uchun, Allakh aram kylbagan nerselerdi aram kyldy dep Allakhka zhalgan zhalaa zhabuuchudan otkon chon' kunoo zhana chon' zaalymdyk bolboit. Allakhka zhalgan zhalaa zhapkany uchun Allakh zaalymdardy tuura zholgo bagyttabait.

Oo, elchi, aitkyn: Maga Allakh aian-kabar kylgan nerselerden Allakhtyn aty atalbai olup kalgan olumtuk, muuzdaganda akkan kan, chochkonun eti, but-aikelderge arnalyp soiulgan maldar syiaktuu muuzdaganda Allakhtyn ysymy aitylbagan mal-zhandyktar gana aram ekenin kordum. Kim katuu achkalyktan ulam zaryl bolup, ushul aram nerselerden zaryldyktyn cheginen ashyrbai, araany achylyp berilbei, az gana zhese, aga kunoo emes. Oo, elchi, akyikatta, Rabbin' andan zhegen zarylmandardy kechiruuchu, alarga yraiymduu.

Allakh Taala ummotko emne aram ekenin aitkandan kiiin zhoottorgo emne aram kylynganyn kabarlait; butparastardyn mal-zhandyktardy aram kylyp aluusu Allakhtan kelgen nersege takyr dal kelbestigin, alar shaitandyn zholun eerchip ketkendigin baian kyluu uchun myndai deit:
Zhoottorgo acha tuiak bolbogon too syiaktuu zhanybarlardy aram kylganbyz. Oshondoi ele alarga ui zhana maida zhandyktardyn zhonundagy, ichegilerindegi mailarynan zhana sooguno aralashkan kuiruk, zhambash mailarynan bashka mailaryn aram kylganbyz. Biz zaalymdygy uchun bul nerselerdi alarga aram kylyp zhazaladyk. Biz bardyk aitkan sozdorubuzdo chynchylbyz.

Oo, elchi, eger seni zhalganga chygaryshsa zhana Rabbin'den alyp kelgen nersege ishenishpese, alardy kyzyktyryp: Rabbin'erdin yraiymy kenen, silerge uzun moonot berip, azaptabai kutup turgany Anyn yraiymynan dep ait. Oshondoi ele alardy eskertip: Kunoogo batkan koomgo Allakhtyn azaby kelbei koiboit degin.

Ozdorunun shirk kyluusu tuura ekenine Allakhtyn tagdyryn zhana kaaloosun shyltoolop, butparastar: eger Allakh kaalaganda biz da, bizdin atalarybyz da Aga sherik kylbait elek. Eger Allakh kaalaganda, ozubuzgo aram kylgan nerseni aram kylbait elek deshet. Bular syiaktuu zhalgan shyltoonu murdagy kaapyrla da aityshkan Alar: Eger Allakh kaalaganda biz azyr zhalganga chygargan nerselerdi zhalganga chygarbait elek deshet. Alar oshentip Biz ustuno azap tushurgongo cheiin zhalganga chygaryp zhurushtu. Ei elchi butparastarga: Silerdin shirk kyluubuzga zhana aramdy adalga, adaldy aramga chygarganybyzga Allakh yraazy boldu degenin'erge dalilin'er barby? dep ait. Silerdi ushul boiuncha tashtap koigonu silerge yraazy bolgonunun dalili emes. Siler bul boiuncha kumondu eerchip zhatasyn'ar, a kumondo ech kandai chyndyk bolboit. Siler zhalganchysyn'ar.

Oo, elchi, butparastarga mintip ait: silerde ushul tukko turbagan dalilin'erden bashka dalilin'er zhok bolso, Allakhta silerdin shyltoon'ordu zhokko chygara turgan, siler eerchigen kumonun'du zhok kyla turgan keskin dalilderi bar. Eger Allakh baaryn'ardyn chyndykka eerchuun'ordu kaalaganda, oshondoi kylmak.

Oo, elchi, Allakh adal kylgan nerseni aramga chygaryp, anan munu Allakh ozu aramga chygardy dep zhalgan aitkan butparastarga: "Siler aram dep zhatkan nerselerdi Allakh aramga chygarganyna kubo bolgon kubon'ordu alyp kelgilechi" dep ait. Ei, elchi, eger alar ilimsizdik kylyp, Allakh aram kyldy dep kubo otushso, sen alardyn kuboluguno ishenbe. Antkeni al zhalgan kuboluk, kaalooloru menen okum kylgandardyn kaaloosuna eerchip ketpe. Alar Allakh adal kylgandy aram deshkende bizdin aiattarybyzdy zhalganga chygaryshty. Akyretke ishenbegenderdi eerchibe, alar Rabbisine sherik koshup, Aga bashkany ten'eshet. Rabbisine ushundai mamile kylgandardyn zholuna kantip eerchilsin?!

Oo, elchi, adamdarga mintip ait: "kelgile, men silerge Allakh aram kylgan nerselerdi okup bereiin. Allakh silerge zharatkan nerselerin Aga sherik kyluunu, ata-enen'erden ak boluunu aram kyldy, ata-enege zhakshy mamile kyluu vazhyb boldu. Dagy silerge,zhakhiliiattagy adamdarga okshop, zhakyrlyk sebebinen baldaryn'ardy olturuunu aram kyldy, silerge da, baldaryn'arga da yryskyny Biz berebiz. Dagy silerge buzuk ishterdin achygyna da, zhashyruununa da zhakyndoonu aram kyldy. Dagy silerge Allakh akysyz olturuugo tyiuu salgan b.a.uilongondon kiiin zina kylgan, islamga kirgenden kiiin kaira dinden kaitkan adamdardan bashka adamdardy olturuunu aram kyldy. Myna ushul aitylgandardy Allakhtyn buiruk zhana tyiuularyna akyl zhugurtuun'or uchun silerge nasaat kyldy.

Dagy silerge zhetimdin malyn ishtetuunu aram kyldy, zhetim - atasy zhok balakat zhashyna zhete elek kyz-baldar. Birok, zhetimge zhakshylyk, paida kyluu uchun zhe al balakatka zhetkenge cheiin mal-mulkun koboituu uchun ishtetse bolot. Dagy silerge tarazada zhana olchop-chenoodo kem kyluunu aram kyldy. Sooda-satyk, aldy-berdide adilettuu boluu silerge vazhyb. Adamga anyn kolunan kelgen ishti gana zhuktoibuz, tartyp, olchop, chenoodo ashyk-kem ketiruudon saktana albagan uchurlarda kunoo zhok. Dagy silerge kabar aituuda zhe kuboluk beruudo zhakyndaryn'arga, dostorun'arga zhan tartyp tuura emes suiloonu aram kyldy. Dagy silerge Allakhka bergen antyn'ardy zhe Allakhtyn aty menen bergen antyn'ardy atkarbai koiuunu aram kyldy. Silerge myndai antyn'ardyn otoosuno chyguu vazhyb. Zhogoruda aitylgandar ishterin'erdin akybetin estep zhuruu uchun Allakhtyn silerge bekemdep bergen buiruktary.

Dagy silerge adashuuga alyp barchu zholdorgo tushuunu aram kyldy. Allakhtyn ech kyishygy zhok tuz zholuna eerchu silerge vazhyb. Adashtyruuchu zholdor silerdi chyndyk zholunan alystatyp, azhyratat. Tyiuularynan tyiylyp, buiruktaryn atkaryp Allakhka takyba boluun'ardy umut kylyp Allakh silerge Ozunun tuz zholun eerchuunu osuiat kyldy.

Zhogorudagylardy kabar bergenden kiiin, Musaga Toorottu tushurgonubuz tuuraluu kabar berebiz. Zhakshylyktarybyzdy toluktap, Musanyn zhakshy ishterine syilyk kylyp, dinde dalil kerek bolgon bardyk nerseni baiandap, chyndyk zhana yraiymga dalil kylyp, kyiamatta Rabbisine zholuguuga yiman keliruulorun zhana aga zhakshy ishteri menen daiardanuularyn umut kylyp Toorottu tushurduk.

Bul Kuran, Biz berekeluu kylyp tushurgon kitep;antkeni al duino zhana akyretke paidaluu nerselerdi ichine kamtyit. Anda tushurulgon nerselerge eerchigile, aga karshy boluudan saktangyla, yraiymdy umut kylgyla.

Ei, arap butparastary, siler: Allakh bizden murda zhoottorgo Toorottu, khristiandarga Inzhildi tushurdu, bizge bolso kitep tushurgon zhok, bizdin tilibizde emes, alardyn tilindegi kitepterin okuunu bilbeibiz dep aitpoon'or uchun...

Oshondoi ele, "Eger Allakh bizge da zhootor menen khristiandarga tushurgon syiaktuu kitep tushurgondo, alarga karaganda koburook tuura zholdo bolot elek" dep aitpoon'or uchun, ozun'ordun tilin'erde paigambaryn'ar Mukhammadga kitep tushurduk. Bul achyk dalil, tuura zholgo bagyt zhana ummotko yraiym. Maanisiz shyltoolordu aitpagyla, zhalgan nerselerdi sebep kylbagyla. Allakhtyn aiattaryn zhalganga chygaryp, andan bash tartkan adamdan otkon zalym bolobu. Kiiin Bizdin aiattarybyzdan bash tartkandardy bash tartkany zhan zhuz burgany uchun tozokko kirgizip katuu azaptaibyz.

Bul zhalganga chygaruuchular emi alarga olum perishtesi zhana anyn zhardamchylary kelip, zhandaryn duinodon alyp ketuusun kutushot. Zhe alarga okum chygaruu uchun azhyratuuchu kundo Rabbin'din keluusun kutushot. Zhe Rabbin'din kyiamatka dalil bolchu kee bir belgilerin kutushot. Rabbin'din kundun batyshtan chykkany chyiaktuu kee bir belgileri kelgende, kaapyrlarga yimany paida berbeit, buga cheiin zhakshy ish kylbagan momunga emi kylgan zhakshy ishi da paida berbeit. Ei, elchi, zhalganchy butparastarga: "Ushul nerselerdin birin kutkulo, biz da kutobuz" dep ait.

Dinderinin kee birin alyp, kee birin tashtap, bolup algan zhoottor menen khristiandar - bolunup ketken taipalar. Ei Elchi, sen ech bir nersede alardan emessin', Alar tushup algan adashuudan sen kaitarylgansyn'. Senin mildetin' alardy eskertuu gana, alardyn ishteri Allakhka taandyk.Kyiamat kunu Allakh alarga duinodo emne ish kylgandaryn kabar beret zhana oshogo zharasha zhazalait.

Yimanduulardyn kaisy biri kyiamat kunu bir zhakshy ish menen kelse, Allakh any on zhakshylykka koboitot. Al emi kim bir kunoo ish menen kelse, aga zhen'ildik kylyp oshogo zharasha gana zhazalait, andan ashyryp zhiberbeit. Kyiamatta alar zhakshylygynyn soobu azaitylyp zhe kunoosunun azaby koboitulup zulum kylynbait.

Oo, elchi, zhalganchy butparastarga: "meni Rabbim tuz zholgo bashtady, al zhol duino zhana akyret ishterin ondoi turgan bekem dindin zholu, al zhol chyndykka iiilgen zhana ech kachan butparas bolbogon Ibrakhimdin zholu" dep ait.

Oo, elchi, "Menin namazym zhana kurmandygym Allakh uchun, Allakhtyn ysymyna bolgon, bashkanyn ysymyna bolgon emes. Tiruulugum menen olumum da, bulardyn baary but zharatylgandardyn zhalgyz Rabbisine, Andan bashkalardyn mynda ech nasibi zhok.

"Al Kemchiliksiz Allakh Anyn sherigi zhok, Andan bashka ibadatka tatyktuu ech nerse zhok. Meni Allakh myna ushul shirkten taza bolgon ishenimge buirugan, men bul ummottun ichinen buga en' birinchi moiun sunuuchumun" dep ait.

Oo, elchi, bul butparastarga: "Kemchiliksiz Uluu Allakh bardyk nersenin Rabbisi bolso, men Andan bashka Rabbi izdeiinbi? Al siler syiynyp zhatkan nerselerdin da Rabbisi. Taza adam bashka biroonun kunoosun kotorboit, kiiin kyiamat kunu baaryn'ardyn kaituun'ar zhalgyz Rabbin'erge bolot, oshondo bul duinodo din ishterine kandai karshy bolgonun'ardyn kabaryn beret.

Allakh tukumun uloo uchun silerdi zher betinde murdagylarga orun basar kylgan. Kee birin'erdi kee birinerden zharaluusunda, yryskysynda zh.b.darazhasyn zhogoru kylgan; bergen nerseleri menen silerdi synoo uchun. Ei, elchi, akyikatta Rabbin' tez esepteshuuchu. Chynynda Al pendelerinin toobo kylgandaryna Kechirimduu zhana Yraiymduu.
(lm)S Bul tamgalardyn chechmelenuusu tuuraluu Bakara surosunun bashtalyshynda soz bolgon.

Oo, elchi, Kurani Karim Allakh saga tushurgon kitep, zhurogun'do aga ech shek-kumon bolbosun. Any menen adamdardy korkutuun' zhana alarga dalil kyluun', oshondoi ele eskertuudon paida aluuchu yimanduularga eskertuun' uchun saga any tushurduk.

Oo, adamdar, Rabbin'er silerge tushurgon kitepke zhana paigambaryn'ardyn sunnotuno eerchigile. zhaman ishti kooz korsotkon shaitandardyn dostorunun kaaloosuna eerchibegile. Kaaloon'orgo zhakkan uchun silerge tushkon nerseni tashtap alardy uzgultuksuz eerchiisin'er. Siler oto az eskeresin'er; Eger bashkaga karaganda chyndykka zhakyn ekenin'erdi estegenin'erde, elchin'er alyp kelgen dinge eerchip, oshonu atkaryp, andan bashkasynyn baaryn tashtait elen'er.

Kaapyrlykka zhana adashuuga kirip ketken oto kop aiyldardy azabybyz menen kyirattyk. Katuu azaptarybyz alar ech nerseden kabarsyz turgan kundordo zhana tundordo tushtu. Alar ozdorun azaptan saktai algan zhok zhana alar kudai dep eseptegen nerseleri da saktap kala algan zhok
Alarga azap tushkondo, Allakhka kaapyr bolup ozdoruno zyian kylganyn moiununa alyshkanynan bashka ech nerse kalbady.

Kyiamat kunu elchileribiz zhiberilgen elderden, alar elchilerge kandai zhoop bergenin suraibyz. Oshondoi ele elchilerden alarga zhuktolgon mildetti kandai zhetkirgendigin zhana eli alarga kandai zhoop bergenin suraibyz.

Ozubuzdun ilimibiz menen bardyk zharatylgandarga alar duinodo kandai ishterdi kylganyn aityp berebiz. Akyikatta, Biz alardyn kylgan ishterinin baaryn biluuchu bolgonbuz, anyn ech nersesi bizge belgisiz bolup kalbait. Biz ech bir ubakta alardyn zhanynda zhok bolup kalgan emespiz.

Kyiamat kunu ishterdi tarazaga tartuu adildik menen bolot, anda ech kim zhabyr zhana zulum kylynbait. Tarazada kimdin zhakshy ishteri zhaman ishterine karaganda salmaktuu bolso, myna osholor samaganyna zhetet, korkkonunan kutulat.
Al emi tarazada kimdin zhaman ishteri zhakshy ishterine karaganda salmaktuu bolso, alar Allakhtyn aiattaryn tangany sebeptuu kyiamat kundo boluuchu azapty tandap ozdoruno zyian kylyp algandar
Oo, Adam baldary, chynynda, Biz silerdi zherge oturuktashtyrdyk zhana anda zhashap ketuugo sebepterdi kyldyk. Bul uchun siler Allakhka shugur kylyshyn'ar kerek ele, birok, oto az shugur kyldyn'ar.

Oo, adamdar, Biz atan'ar Adamdy zharattyk, aga oto kooz surot zhana keiip berdik. Anan urmat korsotuu uchun perishtelerdi aga sazhda kyluuga buiruduk, alar buiruktu atkaryp, sazhda kylyshty. Bir gana Ibilis tekeberlik zhana kezhirlik kylyp, sazhda kyluudan bash tartty.

Allakh Taala Ibilisti zhemelep: "Adamga sazhda kyl degen buirugumdu atkaruudan seni emne tostu?" dedi. Ibilis Rabbisine zhoop kylyp: "meni toskon nerse - men andan zhakshymyn, meni otton zharatkansyn', a, any bolso, ylaidan zharattyn'. Ot ylaidan kadyrluu" dedi

Allakh aga myndai dedi: "Beiishten chyk, saga beiishte tekeberlenip zhuruugo bolboit. Antkeni, beiish zhakshy, tazalardyn zhaiy. Saga anda zhuruugo uruksat emes. Sen, ei, ibilis, ozun'du adamdan kadyrluumun dep eseptesen', anda zhek korulgon, mitaamdardansyn'".
Ibilis mintip aitty: Adamdardyn arasyndagy men adashtyra ala turgan adamdardy adashtyruu uchun Rabbim, maga kaira tiriluu kununo cheiin tiruu boluuga moonot ber.
Allakh aga mintip aitty: "Ei, ibilis, sen, birinchi surnai tartylyp, bardyk zharatylgandar olup, bir gana Zharatuuchun' kala turgan kungo cheiin tiruu kaluu moonotu berilgenderdensin'".

Ibilis mintip aitty: "Men Senin adamga sazhda kyl degen buirugun'du atkarbai, Sen meni adashtyrganyn' sebeptuu, men emi Senin tuura zholun'da adam baldaryn karap oturamyn, meni alardyn atasyna sazhda kyluuda adashtyrganyn' syiaktuu men da alardy tuura zholdon taidyryp, adashtyramyn".

Men alarga ar tarabynan kelip, akyretten kon'ulun burup, duinogo kyzyktyramyn, kumongo kirgizem, kumarduu ishterdi zhakshy korsotom. O, Rabbi, alar kaapyrlykka iiilip, kobu Saga shugur kylbaganyn korosun'.

Allakh mintip aitty: "Ei, ibilis, beiishten kor bolup, Allakhtyn yraiymynan kuulgan abalda beiishten chyk! Kyiamatta seni zhana seni eerchip, saga bash iiip Rabbisine kunookor bolgondordun baaryn tozokko kirgizip, tozoktu tolturamyn"

Alla Adamga mintip aitty: "Ei, Adam, aialyn' Khava ekoon' beiishte turgula. andagy taza nerselerden kaalaganyn'ardy zhegile. Birok, mobu (Allakh daiyndap korsotkon) darakka zhakyndabagyla. Tyiylganyn'ardan kiiin al daraktyn momosunon zhesen'er, anda Allakhtyn cheginen chyguuchulardan bolosun'ar".

Alarga avretteri achylyp kalganyn korsotuu uchun, ibilis alarga zhashyruun soz tashtap, myndai dedi: "Allakh silerdi bul daraktan zhep, perishte bolup kalboon'or uchun, zhe beiishte tuboluk zhashap kaluuchulardan bolboon'or uchun munun momosunon zhegenge tyiuu saldy".
Alarga Allakhtyn aty menen ant berip: "Ei, Adam zhana Khava, men silerge munu aityp nasaat kylyp zhatamyn" dedi.

Alardy kuuluk zhana aldoo menen turgan darazhalarynan tushurdu. Alarga zhegenge tyiuu salyngan daraktyn momosunon zheer zamat, avretteri achyk bolup korunup kaldy. Beiishtegi zhalbyraktar menen avretterin zhabyshty. Anan alarga Rabbisi kairylyp: "Silerdi bul daraktan zhegenge tyibadym bele zhana silerdi eskertip: shaitan silerge dushmandygy anyk bolgon dushman dep aitpadym bele" dedi.

Adam menen Khava myndai dedi: "O, Rabbibiz, daraktan zhebegile degen tyiuun'du buzup, kunoo kyluu menen ozubuzgo zulum kylyp aldyk. Sen bizdin kunoobuzdu kechirbesen', yraiymyn' menen yraiym kylbasan', anda duino zhana akyrettegi nasibibizden azhyrap zyian koruuchulordon bolup kalabyz".

Allakh Adamga, Khavaga zhana Ibiliske myndai dedi:"Beiishten zherge tushkulo, emi biri-birin'e dushman bolosunar, belgiluu bir moonotko cheiin silerge zher betinde oturuktashyp zhashoo bar, belgilengen moonot kelgiche andagy nerselerdi paidalangyla"

Allakh Adam menen Khavaga zhana alardyn urpaktaryna kairylyp: "Bul zher betinde Allakh tagdyr kylgan azhalyn'ar zhetkenche zhashaisyn'ar, zher betinde olup, oshondo komulosun'or, kiiin kabyryn'ardan tirilip chygasyn'ar".

Oo, Adam baldary, silerdin avretin'erdi zhaba turgan zaryl kiiimdi berdik, oshondoi ele el aldynda zhasanyp kiiinuu uchun toluk kiiimderdi da berdik. Allakhtyn buirugun atkaryp, tyiganynan tyiylyp takyba boluu kiiimi bul kiiimderden zhakshy. bul aitylgan kiiimder Allakhtyn kuduretine dalil bolchu belgilerden. Allakhtyn silerge bergen myndai zhakshylyktaryn estep, shugur kylaarsyn'ar.

Oo, Adam baldary, shaitan avretin'erdi achuu uchun silerdi kiiimin'erdi chechuugo zhana takyba kiiimin tashtap koiuuuga kyzyktyryp azgyrbasyn. Chynynda, shaitan silerdin atan'ardy alarga tyiuu salyngan daraktyn momosunon zhegenge kyzyktyryp aldagan, bul alardyn avreti achylyp kaluusuna zhana beiishten chygaryluusuna sebep bolgon.Akyikatta, shaitan zhana anyn urpaktary silerdi korup, kubo bolup turat, siler alardy korboisun'or da, kubo da bolboisun'ar. Adan zhana anyn urpaktarynan saktangyla. Biz shaitandardy Allakhka ishenbegender dos kylyp koigonbuz. Al emi zhakshy ishterdi kylgan yimanduular alara koshulbait.

Butparastar shirk kyluu, zhe Kaabany zhylan'ach toop kyluu syiaktuu oor kunoolordu zhasasa, bul ishterdi Allakhtyn buirugu menen ata-babalary ushintip atkarganyn aityp shyltoo kylyshat. Ei, Mukhammad, alardyn aitkanyn kaitaryp: Allakh kunoo ishke buirubait, andan tyiat, kantip bul ishterin'erdi Allakhka ton'korosun'or? Ei, butparastar, Allakhka bilbegen nersen'erdi zhalgan, zhalaa kylyp aitasyn'arby? degin.

Oo, Mukhammad, butparastarga mintip ait: Chynynda Allakh adilettikke buirudu, zhaman, buzuk ishterge buirugan zhok. Baardyk ibadattardy kalys Aga atkaruuga buirudu. Aga ykylas kylyp, bash iiip duba kyluuga buirudu. Al silerdin zhokton bar kylyp zharatkan syiaktuu ekinchi zholu dagy tiriltet. Zhok nerseni zharatkanga kudureti zhetken, kaira zharatuuga zhana tiriltuugo da kudureti zhetet.

Allakh adamdardy eki top kylgan: bir tobun tuura zholgo salgan, alarga tuura zholgo tushuu sebepterin zhen'il kylgan, toskoolduktardy alyp salgan. Bir tobun chyndyktyn zholunan adashuunu zhazyp koigon, antkeni alar Allakhty emes, shaitandardy dos tutushtu zhana bilbesten alardy eerchishti. Alar ozdorun tuura zholdo dep oiloshot.

Oo, Adam balasy, avretin'erdi zhaba turgan kiiimderdi kiigile, namaz okuganda zhana toop kylganda taza, zhakshy kiiimderin'erdi kiigile. Allakh adal kylgan taza nerselerden kaalaganyn'ardy zhegile zhana ichkile. Birok, anyn ortocho cheginen chygyp ketpegile, adaldan aramga otup chekten chykpagyla. Akyikatta, Allakh ortocho cheginen ashyp ketkenderdi zhakshy korboit.

Oo, elchi, Allakh adal kylgan kiiimderdi, taza tamak-ashtardy aramga chygargan butparastarga zhoop kylyp: "Silerge kork berchu kiiimderdi kim aramga chygardy? Allakh silerge yrysky kylyp bergen taza tamak zhana suusunduktardy kim aramga chygardy? dep ait. Ei, elchi, chynynda, bul taza nerseler bul duinodo yimanduularga taandyk, eger bashkalar sherik bolushsa, bul duinodo gana sherik bolo alyshat, akyrette kaapyrlar aga sherik bolo alyshpait. Antkeni, kaapyrlar beiishke kirbeit. Ushintip tushundurgon syiaktuu aiattarybyzdy da tushungon koomgo aityp berebiz, antkeni alar myndan paida ala turgan adamdar.

Oo, elchi, Allakh adal kylgan nerseni aramga chygargan butparastarga mintip ait: "Akyikatta, Allakh pendelerine buzuku ishterdi aram kyldy, meili zhashyruun, meili ashkere bolsun, alar kunoolordun en' zhamandary. Oshondoi ele kunoolordun baaryn zhana adamdardyn zhanyna, malyna, abiiirine zulum kylyp dushmandyk kyluunu aram kyldy. Dagy, kudailygyna ech bir dalili zhok nerselerdi Allakhka sherik kylyp aluun'ardy aram kyldy. Anan da, ech nerseni bilbei turup Anyn ysymdary, sypattary, ishteri zhana shariiaty tuuraluu suiloonu aram kyldy".
Ar bir muunga alardyn azhaly belgilengen cheneluu moonotu bar, chektelgen moonotu kelgende any bir azga kechiktire da, ilgerilete da alyshpait.

Oo, Adam baldary, silerge ozun'ordun koomun'ardan elchilerdi chygaryp, alar Men tushurgon kitepterdi silerge okup berse, alarga bash iigile, alar alyp kelgen nersege eerchigile. Buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiganynan tyiylyp, zhakshy ishterdi kylyp, Allakhka takyba bolgon pendelerge kyiamat kunu korkunuch bolboit, oshondoi ele alar duino nasibinde kylyp otkon ishterine okunboit.
Bizdin aiattarybyzdy zhalgan dep aga ishenbegen, elchileri alyp kelgen buiruktardy atkarbagan kaapyrlar tozokko kiruuchulor, alar anda tuboluk kalyshat.

Allakhtyn sherigi bar dep zhe kemchiliktuu dep zhe Al aitpagan nerseni aitty dep Aga zhalgan zhalaa zhapkan, zhe tuura zholgo bashtagan aiattaryn zhalganga chygargan adamdan otkon zaalym bolobu. Myna ushul zhogorudagy sypattardyn eelerine Lavkh al-Makhfuzda zhazylgan azhal-moonotu kelip, olum perishtesi zhana anyn zhardamchylary alardyn zhandaryn algany kelgende, alardy zhemelep: "Allakhty tashtap, Anyn orduna ibadat kylgan kudailaryn'ar kana!? Silerge zhardam beruusu uchun alardy chakyrgyla" deshet. Oshondo butparastar perishtelerge: "Biz ibadat kylgan kudailarybyz zhok bolup ketti, alar kaida ekenin bilbeibiz" deshet. Kaapyr bolushkanyn oshentip moiundaryna alyshat, birok, al uchurda moiundaryna algany ozdoruno karshy dalil bolot zhana paidasyn tiigizbeit.

Perishteler alarga: "Ei, butparastar, silerden murda kaapyrlyk zhana adashuu menen otkon zhin zhana insandardyn zhamaaty menen birge tozokko kirgile" dep aityshat. Ar bir ummot tozokko kirgen saiyn, alardy ushul zholgo bashtagan, murdaraak tozokko kirgen zhol bashchylaryna kargysh aityshat. Baary tozokko kirgenden kiiin, murdagylardy kem akyldyk menen eerchip, anan tozokko akyry bolup kirgender, murda kirgen bashchy, chon'doruna karap, (anan Rabbisine): "Ei, Rabbibiz, myna ushul chon'dorubuz bizdi tuura zholdon adashtyrgan, bizge adashuunu koozdop korsotkonu uchun alardyn azabyn katuu kyl" deshet. Allakh alarga zhoop kylyp:Silerdin ar birin'erge tiesheluu kuchotulgon azap bar, birok, siler any bilbeisin'er.

Chon'doru artynan eerchigenderine: "Ei, eerchuuchulor, silerdin azabyn'ardy zhen'ildetkidei, siler bizden artyk emessin'er, kylgan ishin'erdin natyizhasy ushul, zhalgandy eerchigenin'er uchun silerge kechirim zhok, ei, eerchuuchulor, kaapyrlygyn'ar zhana kunookorlugun'or sebeptuu biz syiaktuu ele siler da azaptyn daamyn tatkyla" deshet.

Bizdin achyk-aikyn aiattarybyzdy zhalganga chygargany, tekeberlik kylyp bash iibegeni uchun zhakshylyktan kuru kalgandarga, kaapyrlygy sebeptuu alardyn kylgan ishterine zhana alar olgondo alardyn rukhtaryna asman eshikteri achylbait. Zhan-zhanybarlardyn chon'u bolgon too buiumdardyn en' kichinekeii bolgon iinenin kozunon oto albagan syiaktuu, alar da ech kachan beiishke kire albait. Toonun iinenin kozunon otuusu mumkun bolbogon syiaktuu alardyn beiishke kiruusu da mumkun emes. Allakh alardy kunooloru oto chon' bolgonu uchun ushintip zhazalait.
Bul tekeber zhalganchylar uchun tozok otunan toshonchu zhana zhuurkan bolot. Myndai zhaza menen Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyp, Andan zhuz burup, Anyn cheginen chykkandardy zhazalaibyz.
Rabbisine yiman keltirip, kolunan kelishinche zhakshy ishterdi zhasagandar beiishke kirip, anda tuboluk kalyshat. Allakh ech kimdi kolunan kelbegen ishke buirubait.

Beiishtegi zhakshylyktardyn kemchiliksizdigi ushul, anda adamdardyn zhurogundogu zhek koruu, kekter alynyp salynat, alardyn but aldynan daryialar agyp turat. Alar Allakhtyn alarga bergen zhakshylyktaryn moiundap: "Bizdin ushul zhaiga kiruubuzgo sebep bolgon zhakshy ishterdi atkaruuga bagyt bergen Allakhka maktoo bolsun. Rabbibizdin elchileri ech shegi zhok akyikatty, beiish zhana tozok tuuraluu chyn ubadalardy alyp kelishken eken" deshet. Anan alarga myndai degen un ugulat: "Bul silerge Menin elchilerim kabaryn bergen - beiish. Munu Allakh silerge, Allakhtyn yraazylygy uchun duino zhashoosunda zhakshy ishterdi kylganyn'ardyn syiy katary berdi.

Baary ozdoruno ylaiyk ubada kylyngan zhailaryna kirgenden kiiin, beiishke kirgender tozokko kirgenderge: "Biz Raabbibiz bizge ubada kylgan beiishke chyndap zholuktuk zhana aga kirdik. Ei, kaapyrlar, siler da Allakh silerge ubada kylgan tozokko kirdin'erbi?" dep un salyshat. Kaapyrlar: "Bizge ubada kylyngan tozokko chyndap kirdik" deshet. Oshondo: Allakh zaalymdardy yraiymynan kuusun" degen un ugulat. Duino zhashoosunda alarga yraiym eshigi achylgan ele, birok alar andan bash tartyshtkan.

Al zaalymdar ozdoru Allakhtyn zholuna bash tartkan zhana bashkalardy da bash tartuuga alyp kelishken, chyndyktyn zholu adamdar aga tushpoi turgan tataal boluusun kaalap, umut kylyshkan. Alar akyretke ishenishken emes zhana daiardanyshkan da emes.

Bul eki toptun ortosunda, b.a.beiishke kiruuchulor menen tozokko kiruuchulordun ortosunda biiik orunda "A'raf" dep atalgan tosmo bar. Bul biiik tosmodo zhakshylyk ishteri menen kunooloru birdei bolup kalgan adamdar toptolot. Alar beiishke kiruuchulordu zhuzdorunun aktygy syiaktuu belgilerinen, al emi tozokko kiruuchulordu zhuzdorunun karalygy syiaktuu belgilerinen taanyp bilishet. Bul zherdegi adamdar beiishke kire turgan adamdarga urmat korsotup: "Silerge tynchtyk bolsun" dep salam aityshat. Alar bul uchurda beiishke kire elek, birok beiishke kiruugo Allakhtyn yraiymyn kutup turgan bolushat.

Eger A'rafta turgandar tozokko kiruuchulorgo kozu burulup, alardyn katuu azapka duushar bolushkanyn korushso, Allakhka kairylyp: "Oo, Rabbibiz, Saga kaapyrlyk zhana shirk kylgan zaalym koom menen birge kylba" dep duba kylyshat.

A'rafta turgan adamar tozokko kire turgan adamdardy alardy chochulagan kozdorunon, karargan zhuzdorunon taanyp, alarga: "Silerge mal-mulkun'ordun zhana sanyn'ardyn koptugu menen maktanganyn'ar zhana chyndyk zholdon tekeberlenip, menmensinip bash tartkanyn'ar paida berbedibi?" deshet.

Anan: "Siler: "Allakh alardy yraiymyna albait" degen adamar ushularby?" deshet (beiishke kiruuchulordu korsotup). Anan Allakh Taala yimanduularga: "Oo, yimanduular, beiishke kirgile, silerge kelechekte ech korkunuch bolboit zhana duino nasibin'erde kylgan ishin'er uchun okunboisun'or, antkeni, tuboluktuu zhakshylykka kirdin'er" deit.

Tozokko kiruuchulor beiishke kiruuchulordon zhalynyp: "Ei, beiishke kiruuchulor, bizge suu zhana Allakh silerge yrysky kylyp bergen tamaktardan bergile" dep suranyshat. Beiishke kiruuchulor: "Allakh Taala bul nerselerdi kaapyr bolgonu sebeptuu kaapyrlarga aram kylgan, Allakh aram kylgan nerseni biz bere albaibyz" deshet.

Al kaapyrlar dinderin oiun, tamasha kylyshkan, alardy duino zhashoosu koozduk yrakhaty menen aldap koigon. Alar bul duinodo kyiamat kunundogu zholuguunu unutup, aga ech araket kylyshpai, daiardanyshpai, Allakhtyn achyk dalil-belgilerin tanyp, anyn chyndyk ekenin bilip turup chetke kagyshkany uchun, kyiamat kunu Allakh alardy azap ustuno kaltyryp unutup koiot.

Akyikatta, Biz silerge Mukhammadga (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) tushurulgon Kurandy alyp keldik. Al - Kuran, yimanduulardy chyndykka zhana tuura zholgo bashtoochu zhana alarga duino menen akyrettin zhakshylyktaryn bildiruuchu yraiym.

Kaapyrlar alarga akyrette ishterine zharasha berile turgan katuu azap tuuraluu kabardyn ishke ashuusun kutushot. Alarga kabary berilgen azap zhana yimanduularga kabary berilgen syi berile turgan ubak kelgende, duinodo Kurandy unutup, andagy buiruktardy atkarbagandar mintip arman kylyshat: "Rabbibizdin elchileri Allakhtan ekenine ech shegi zhok, kemchiliksiz chyndykty alyp kelishken eken. Emi bizdi koldop, azaptan saktap kaluuga Allakhka ortomchu bolo turgan koldoochu bolso kana. Zhe duino zhashoosuna kaira kaityp, murda atkargan zhaman ishteribizdin orduna zhakshy ishterdi kylyp kelsek kana". Katuu azapka tush boloruna ishenbei, kaapyrlar ozdorun zyianga uchuratyp alyshty. Oshondoi ele alar ibadat kylgan zhalgan "kudailary" alarga ech paidasyn tiigizbei zhok bolup ketti.

Oo, adamdar, akyikatta silerdin Rabbin'er al - murda ech okshoshu bolbogon zherdi alty kundo zharatkan Allakh. Andan kiiin ozunun uluuluguna ylaiyk bizdin akylybyz zhetpegen kotoruluu menen Arshyna kotoruldu. Al tundun karan'gylygyn kunduzdun zharygy menen, kunduzdun zharygyn tundun karan'gylygy menen ketiret. Alar biri-birinin artynan yldam kechikpesten kuup zhurot da, biri ketkende, ekinchisi kelet. Al Ozuno moiun sungan kundu, aidy zhana zhyldyzdardy zharatty. Bilip algyla, zharatuu bir gana Allakhka taandyk, andan bashka zharatuuchu barby?! Ishtin baary Aga taandyk, Anyn zhakshylygy uluu, zhakshylyk kyluusu kop, uluu zhana toluk degen sypattar menen sypattalgan, aalamdardyn Rabbisi.

Oo, yimanduular, Rabbin'erge kichi peiildik menen berilip kupuia, zhashyruun duba kylgyla. Korsotuu uchun emes, chyn yklas menen Kemchiliksiz Allakhka ech nerseni sherik kylbai duba kylgyla. Akyikatta Al dubada chekten chyguuchulardy zhakshy korboit, dubadagy chekten chyguunun en' zhamany butparastar syiaktuu Aga koshup bashka nerselerge duba kyluu.

Allakh elchilerin zhiberip zher betindegilerdi bir Ozuno bash iidirip on'dogondon kiiin, kaira kunoogo berilip any buzbagyla. Azabynan korkkonun'ardy bildirip, soop-syiyna zhetuugo umut kylyp Allakhka duba kylgyla. Akyikatta Allakhtyn yraiymy zhakshylyk kyluuchularga zhakyn, ushulardan bolgula.

Zhamgyrdyn zhakshy kabaryn alyp keluuchu shamaldardy Allakh zhiberet. Shamal suuga tolgon oor buluttardy alyp kelgende alardy kurgakchylyk bolgon zhailarga zhaadyryp, anyn suusu menen turduu momolordu chygarabyz. myna ushul momolor onup chykkan syiaktuu kyiamatta oluktor da kabyrlarynan tirilip chygyshat. Ei, adamdar, Allakhtyn kuduretin, zhokton bar kyluuchulugun zhana oluktordu tiriltuugo kadyr ekenin estet go degen umutto ushundai ishterdi kylabyz.

Taza topuraktuu zherde, Allakhtyn uruksaty menen, osumduk kooz,zhetile osup chygat. Oshol syiaktuu ele yimanduu adam nasaatty ugup, andan paidalanyp, zhakshy ishterdi atkarat. Al emi shor kaptagan tashtak zherge osumduk kyiynchylyk menen chygyp, korksuz bolot. Oshol syiaktuu kaapyr adam nasaattan paida albait, aga paidasyn tiigizuuchu zhakshy ishi da zhok. Rabbisine bash iiip, Aga kaapyrlyk kylbai, Anyn zhakshylyktaryna shugur kylgan adamdarga chyndykty bekemdoo uchun ushundai turduu dalilderdi korsotobuz.

Bir Allakhka ibadat kylyp, andan bashkasyn tashtoogo undoo uchun Nukhtu koomuna elchi kyldyk. Nukh koomuna: "Ei, koomum, Allakhka zhalgyz Ozuno syiyngyla, silerge Andan bashka ibadat kyluuga tatyktuu zhok.Ei, koomum, kaapyrlyk kylyp zhurup, kyiamat kunu azapka kabylyp kalasyn'ar go dep korkom.
Koomunun attuu-bashtuulary aga: "Ei, Nukh, biz senin tuuralyktan oto alystap ketkenin'di korup turabyz" - deshti.

Nukh paigambar koomunun attuu-bashtuularyna: "Men siler oilogondoi adashuuchu emesmin, men Rabbimdin tuura zholundamyn. Silerge menin, silerdin zhana but aalamdardyn Rabbisi Allakh tarabynan zhiberilgen elchimin" - dedi.

Berilgen aian kabar arkyluu Allakh meni zhibergen dindi silerge zhetkiremin. Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaruu arkyluu soop-syiga zhetuugo kyzyktyryp silerge zhakshylyk kaalaimyn. Tyiuu salyngan ishterge beriluu arkyluu azapka duushar bolup kaluun'ardan eskertemin. Allakhtan Anyn aian kabary arkyluu siler bilbegen nerseni bilip turam.

Rabbin'erdin aian kabary zhana nasaat eskertuusu silerdin aran'ardagy ozun'orgo taanysh adamdyn tili arkyluu kelgenine tan' kaluun'ar kuchodubu?! Al silerdin aran'arda osup chon'oigon, ozun'ordun zhynsyn'ardan, zhalgan suilobogon, adashkan da emes. Al, siler zhalgan aityp, kunookor bolgonun'arda Allakhtyn azabyn eskertip silerdi korkutuu zhana Allakhtyn buirugun atkaryp, tyiuusunan tyiylyp takyba boluun'ar uchun oshondoi ele Aga yiman keltirip Anyn yraiymyna ee boluun'ardy umut kylyp kelgen.

Koomu any zhalganga chygaryp, yiman keltirishpedi, kaapyrlyktaryn ulanta berishti. Oshondo alardy kyiratuunu suranyp Allakhka duba kyldy. Any zhana any menen birge yiman keltirgen adamdardy kemege chygaryp topon suudan saktap kaldyk. Bizdin aiattarybyzdy zhalgan dep, oshol oiunan kaitpagan kaapyrlardy topon suuga chokturup azaptadyk. Akyikatta alardyn zhurogu chyndykty korbogon sokur ele.

Aad eline ozdorunun arasynan Khuddu (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy bolsun) paigambar kylyp zhiberdik. Al: "Ei, koomum, Allakhtyn Ozuno gana ibadat kylgyla, silerge Andan bashka ibadatka tatyktuu zhok. Anyn azabynan aman kaluun'ar uchun buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiuularynan tyiylyp, takyba bolboisun'arby?!" - dedi.

Koomundagy Allakhka kaapyr bolup, Anyn elchisin zhalganga chygargan attuu-bashtuulary: "Ei, Khud, bizdi but-aikelderge ibadat kyluunu tashtap, zhalgyz Allakhka ibadat kyluuga undogonun'don senin kem akyl, kelesoolugun'du bilip zhatabyz. Ozun'du paigambar dep eseptegenin' anyk zhalganchylyk ekenine bekem ishenebiz" - deshti.
Khud koomunun aitkanyna zhoop kylyp: "Ei, koomum, men kem akyl, kelesoo emesmin, men aalamdardyn Rabbisi zhibergen elchimin" - dedi.
Allakh silerge zhetkiruunu buirugan shariiatyn zhana bir kudaiga ibadat kyluu ishenimin zhetkiremin. Silerge buirulgan nerseni zhetkiruudo ishenimduu nasaatchymyn, aga alymcha-koshumcha kylbaimyn.

Rabbin'erdin aian kabary zhana nasaat eskertuusu silerdin zhynsyn'ardagy adamdyn, perishte zhe zhin zhynsynan emes,tili arkyluu kelgenine tan' kaluun'ar kuchodubu?! Silerdi zherge zhaigashtyryp koigonuna zhana kaapyrlyktary uchun Allakh kyiratyp zhok kylgan Nukhtun koomuna orun basar kylgany uchun Allakhka maktoo aityp, shugur kylgyla. Silerge olburluu dene, chon' kuch-kubat bergenine shugur kylgyla. Azap-tozokton kutuluunu umut kylsan'ar, anda Allakhtyn silerge bergen kop zhakshylyktaryn estegile.

Koomu Khudga kairylyp: "Ei, Khud, bizdi ata-babalarybyz ibadat kylyp kelgen but-aikelderdi tashtap, zhalgyz Allakhka ibadat kyluuga buiruisun'bu?! Aitkandaryn' chyn bolso, anda bizge ubada kylyp zhatkan azabyn'dy alyp kele ber" - deshti.

Khud alarga zhoop kylyp: "Chynynda, Allakhtyn azabyn zhana kaaryn talap kyldyn'ar, munun silerge kelerine ech shek zhok. Atan'ar da, siler da "kudai" dep atap algan, chyndykka dal kelbegen but-aikelder tuuraluu meni menen talashasyn'arby?! Allakh alardyn "kudai" ekenine dalil bolo turgan dalildi tushurgon emes. Ozun'or batyraak zhiberuusun Allakhtan talap kylgan azapty kutkulo, men da any siler menen birge kutom, al zhakynda bolot.

Khuddu zhana any menen birge bolgon yimanduularga yraiym kylyp, azaptan saktap kaldyk. Al emi Bizdin aiattarybyzdy zhalganga chygaryp, yiman keltirishpei, zhalganchy bolgondordu kyiratyp zhok kyldyk, alar ushundai azapka ylaiyk bolchu.

Samud koomuna ozdorunun ichinen Salikhti paigambar kyldyk. Al alardy Allakhty zhalgyz dep biluugo zhana Aga ibadat kyluuga chakyrdy. Salikh koomuna kairylyp: "Allakhka Ozuno gana ibadat kylgyla, silerge Andan bashka ibadatka tatyktuu zhok. Menin paigambarlygymdyn chyndyk ekenine achyk-aikyn dalil boluuchu belgi keldi. Al tashty zharyp chykkan too. Anyn suu iche turgan belgiluu ubaktysy bar, siler da suunu ozun'orgo tiesheluu ubakta algyla. Aga tiibegile, Allakhtyn zherinde ottop zhuro bersin, anyn silerge zyiany zhok. Siler da aga zyian tiigizbegile. Eger aga zyian tiigizsen'er, oshol sebeptuu azapka kiripter bolosun'ar.

Silerdi Aad koomunun artynan alyp kelgendegi Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryn estegile. Zhalganchylygy zhana kaapyrlygy chekten chykkan Aad koomu kyiratylgandan kiiin silerdi zherge zhaigashtyryp, anda orun-ochok aldyn'ar, izdegenin'erdi taptyn'ar. Siler emi zherdin tegiz betine ak sarailardy salasyn'ar, ui zhasoo uchun toolordu kesesin'er. Allakhka shugur kyluu uchun Anyn zhakshylyktaryn estegile. Zher betinde buzukuluk kylyp zhuruunu tashtagyla. Buzkuluktu tashtoo - Allakhka kaapyrlyk kyluunu zhana kunoolordu tashtoo arkyluu bolot.

Koomundagy tekeberlengen bailary zhana bashchylary yiman keltirgen zhardy-zharmachtardy (shyldyn'dap): "Ei, yimanduular, siler, Salikh chyn ele Allakhtyn paigambary dep ishenesin'erbi? - deshet. Kedei yimanduular alarga zhoop kylyp: "Biz Salikh alyp kelgen nersege ishenuuchu, tastyktoochu, bash iiuuchu zhana anyn shariiatyn atkaruuchubuz" - deshti.
Koomundagy tekeberler: "Ei, yimanduular, biz siler ishengen nersege kaapyrbyz, aga ech ishenbeibiz zhana anyn shariiatyn da atkarbaibyz" - deshti.

Anan Allakhtyn buirugun atkaruuga tekeberlik kylyp, zyian tiigizbegile dep buirugan toonu soiup salyshty da, Salikh alarga ubada kylgan azapka ishenbei, shyldyn'dap: "Ei, Salikh, eger chyndap ele Allakhtyn elchilerinen bolson', bizge aityp zhurgon katuu azabyn'dy alyp kel" - deshti.
Kaapyrlarga alar shashylgan azap kelip, katuu zher titiredi da, ozdoru da, mingen ulooloru da baary zherge zhutulup zhok boldu. Bul kyiroodon alardyn biroosu da kutulbady.

Salikh, koomu any kabyl kyluusunan umutun uzgondon kiiin, alardan teskeri burulup: "Ei, koomum, Allakh maga silerge zhetkiruunu buirugan nerseni zhetkirdim, silerdi korkutup zhana kyzyktyryp nasaat aittym, birok, siler zhakshylykka zhakyndatyp, zhamandyktan alystatuuga kyzykdar bolgon nasaat aituuchulardy zhaktyrbadyn'ar" - dedi.

Ozunun koomuna zhiiirkenip: "Erkekti erkek en'segen en' zhaman zhiiirkenichtuu ishti kylasyn'arby?! Bul ishti siler bashtap zhatasyn'ar, silerge cheiin myndai ishke ech kim bargan emes" - degen Lut paigambardy da estegin.

Kumaryn'ardy kandyruuga ylaiyk zharatylgan aialdardy karabai, erkekter menen kumar kandyruunu kaalaisynarby. Bul kylygyn'ar akylga da syibait, adamdyn taza tabiiatyna da tuura kelbeit. Siler adamdyk sapattan chygyp zhana adamdyn akyly menen tabiiaty talap kylgan nerseni buzup, Allakh chektengen cheginen chygyp kettin'er!

Buzukulukka berilgen adamdar chyndyktan bash tartyp, bul kaitaruuga mintip zhoop berishti: "Luttu zhana aga ishengenderdi aiyldan chygaryp salgyla! Alar biz kylyp zhatkan ishke baryshpait eken, myndailar menen choguu zhashoo bizge ylaiyk emes".
Bir azdan kiiin azap tusho turgan aiyldan chygyp ketkile dep aiankylyp Luttu zhana anyn ui-bulosun azaptan saktadyk. Birok, anyn aialy koomu menen kalyp, bashkalar kabylgan azapka kabyldy.

Alardyn ustuno ysyk ylaidan katuu zhamgyr zhaadyrdyk, aiyldy bolso, astyn-ustun kyldyk. Oo, elchi, Lut paigambardyn kunookor koomunun akybeti kandai bolgonuna oi zhugurt, akyikatta, alardyn akybeti kyiroo zhana tuboluk azap boldu.

Chynynda Biz Madiian eline ozdorunon Shuaibdy paigambar kyldyk. Al koomuna kairylyp: "Ei, koomum, zhalgyz Allakhka ibadat kylgyla, Andan bashka ibadat kyluuga tatyktuu zhok. Silerge, Men Rabimden alyp kelgen dindin chyndyk ekenine dalil bolchu achyk-aikyn belgiler keldi. Olchoonu zhana tarazada tartuunu tak kylyp, adamdardyn akysyn zhebegile. buiumdarynyn aiyby menen adamdardyn baasyn tushurbogulo. Murda paigambarlardy zhiberuu arkyluu on'dogon zher betinde kaira buzukuluktu taratpagyla. Ushul aitylgandar eger yiman keltirsen'er siler uchun paidaluu zhana zhakshy. Antkeni, Allakhtyn tyiuusuna bash iiip kunoonu tashtaisyn'ar zhana Anyn buirugun atkaruu menen Aga zhakyndaisyn'ar.

Malyn tonoo, dinge kiruunu kaalagan adamdardy Allakhtyn dininen tosuu, adamdar aga kirbesin uchun dindi burmalap korsotuu arkyluu ary-beri otkon adamdardy korkutup ar kaisy zholdun boiunda turbagyla. Allakhka shugur kyluu uchun Anyn zhakshylyktaryn estegile; silerdin sanyn'ar az ele, Al any koboittu. Silerden murdagy zher betinde buzukuluk kylyp otkon adamdardyn akybeti kandai bolgonun oilop korgulo. Alardyn akybeti kyrap zhok boluu menen butkon.

Eger men Rabimden alyp kelgen nersege silerdin aran'ardan bir zhamaat yiman keltirse, bir zhamaat buga yiman keltirbese, anda, ei, zhalganchylar, Allakh silerdin orton'ordu azhyratkancha kutup turgula. Al en' zhakshy azhyratuuchu zha en' adilettuu okum chygaruuchu.

Shuaibdyn koomundagy tekeberlengen chon'doru zhana bashchylary aga: "Ei, Shuaib, bizdin dinibizge kaira kaitkyla, bolboso seni da, saga ishenip yiman keltirgenderdi da aiyldan kuup chygabyz" - deshti. Shuaib alarga tan' kalyp zhana alardyn aitkanyn chetke kagyp: "Siler tutungan dindin zhalgan ekenin bilip, any zhaman korup tursak, kantip kabyldamak elek?!" - dedi.

"Biz silerdin kaapyrlyk zhana shirkke negizdelgen "dinin'erge" kaitsak, Allakhka zhalganchy bolup kalabyz, antkeni, Allakh Ozu bizdi kaapyrlyk zhana shirkten kutkaryp chygargan. Silerdin zhalgan ishenimin'erge kaituu bizge tuura da kelbeit, ylaiyk da emes, birok, Allakh kaalasa gana. Koz karandylyktyn baary Allakhtyn kaaloosunda, Rabbibiz ilimi menen bardyk nerseni orop algan, Aga ech nerse zhashyruun bolboit. Tuura zholdon taidyrbai kadamdarybyzdy bekem kyluusu zhana tozoktun zholunan saktoosu uchun bir gana Allakhka taianabyz. Oo, Rabbi, biz menen kaapyr koomubuzdun ortosuna Ozun' okum chygar. Kok bettik menen zyian korsotkon zalymdarga karshy tuura zholdo zyian tartyp zhatkandarga zhardam ber.Oo, Rabbi, Sen okum chygaruuchulardyn en' zhakshysysyn'" - dedi.

Koomundagy Allakhty zhalgyz dep biluu daavatyna karshy bolgon kaapyrlardyn chon'doru zhana bashchylary Shuaibdan zhana anyn dininen kaitaryp: "Ei, elder, eger ata-baban'ardan beri kele zhatkan dinin'erdi tashtap, Shuaibdyn dinine kirsen'er, anda kyirap zhok bolosun'ar" - dep korkutushtu.
Anan zher katuu titirep, ar kimisi turgan zherinde zherge zhutulup zhok bolushtu.

Shuaibdy zhalganga chygargandardyn baary, al zherde takyr zhashabagan syiaktuu typ-tyipyl bolup kyirap zhogoldu. Shuaibdy zhalganga chygargandar ozdoru zyianga tush boldu, antkeni alar ozdoruno, ozdoru eelik kylgandarga zyian kylyp alyshty. Al emi zhalganchy kaapyrlar "kyirait" dep oilogon el arasyndagy yimanduular ech kandai zyianga uchuragan zhok.

Alar kyirap kalgandan kiiin Shuaib teskeri burulup: "Ei, elim, Rabbim silerge zhetkir dep buirugan nerseni zhetkirdim, silerge nasaat aittym, nasaatymdy ukpadyn'ar, men bashtagan zholgo baspadyn'ar. Allakhka kaapyr bolup, kaapyrlygynan kaitpagan elge emnege kaigyrmak elem?!" - dedi.

Biz kaisy bir aiylga kaisy bir paigambardy zhibersek, birok al zherdin eli any zhalganga chygaryp kaapyr bolso, alar kaapyrlygyn zhana tekeberligin tashtap, Allakhka bash iiebi degen umutto, alardy kedeilik, kyiynchylyk, ooru-syrkoo menen eskertebiz. Ushul eskertuu kuraishtarga da, bardyk kaapyr, zhalganchylarga tiesheluu Allakhtyn sunnot zholu.

Zhakyrlyk, ooruu-syrkoo menen eskertkenden kiiin, alardyn zhashoosun zhakshylyk, amanchylykka ailandyrdyk ele alardyn sany osup, mal-zhany koboidu. Oshondo alar: "Bizdin bashybyzga kelip zhatkan kaatchylyk zhana tokchuluk murdagylardyn da bashyna tushkon adattagy ele korunush" - deshti. Etibar alsyn dep berilgen kyiynchylykty da, onok alsyn dep berilgen zhyrgalchylykty da sezishken zhok. Anan alar beikapar, daiardyksyz turganda kapystan azapka aldyk.

Eger Biz elchileribizdi zhibergen aiyldardyn elderi elchiler alyp kelgen dinge ishenip, Rabbisine takyba bolup, kaapyrlyk zhana kunoonu tashtap, Anyn buiruktaryn atkaryshkanda, alarga bardyk taraptan zhakshylyk eshikterin achyp koimokpuz. Birok, alar ishenishken da zhok, takyba da bolushkan zhok. Teskerisinche, elchiler alyp kelgen nerseni zhalganga chygaryshty. Anan kunoo, kataalary sebeptuu Biz alardy kokustan azapka tush kyldyk.
Aiyldardyn zhalganchy elderi alar yrakhatka batyp, beipil uktap zhatkanda Bizdin azap kelip kalsa, aman kalmakpy?!
Zhe kunduzu, alar duino ishteri menen alek bolup, oinop, beikapar turushkanda, Bizdin azap kelip kalsa, aman kalmak bele?

Allakhtyn alarga bergen mumkunchuluktorun karagyla, osup-onuguusu uchun alarga kuch-kubat, kenen yrysky berdi. Bul aiyldardyn ishenboochu elderi Allakhtyn ailakerliginen zhana zhashyruun chara koruusunon kabarsyz bele? Allakhtyn ailakerliginen kyiroochu koom gana kabarsyz kalat. Al emi iigilikke zhetuuchu koom Anyn ailakerliginen korkot, ozdoruno berilgen zhakshylyktarga azgyrylbait zhana any syi katary korup, al uchun shugur kylat.

Kunoolorunun aiynan kyiroogo uchuragan murdagy elderdin orduna zhaigashyp, alardyn kyiroosunan etibar albai, kaira osholordun kylgan ishin kaitalagan adamdarga eger Allakh kaalasa kunooloru sebeptuu murdagylar kabylgan baleege kabyltyp koioru belgiluu emespi? Zhe zhuroktoruno moor basyp, nasaattan taasirlenbei, eskertuudon paida albai turgan kylyp koiorun bilishpeibi?

Oo, paigambar, saga murdagy otkon Nukh, Khud, Salikh, Lut zhana Shuaib paigambarlardyn koomdoru tuuraluu, alardyn paigambarlaryn zhalganga chygargany, ton' moiundugu zhana kyiroogo uchuragany tuuraluu kabar berebiz. Bul, myndan ulgu algandarga ulgu, nasaat algandarga nasaat boluusu uchun. Bul aiyldyn eline paigambarlary ozdorunun chyndyk ekenine achyk-aikyn dalilderdi alyp kelse da, paigamabrlary kelgende yiman keltirishpedi, bulardyn zhalganga chygaruusu Allakhtyn iliminde bar ele. Oshol paigambarlaryn zhalganga chygargan aiyl elderinin zhuroktorun moorlop koigon syiaktuu Mukhammad paigambarga (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) kaapyr bolgondordun da zhurogun moorlop koiobuz, alar yiman zholuna tusho alyshpait.
Biz elchileribizdi zhibergen eldin kobu Allakhtyn osuiatyn atkarbaganyn, nyn buiruktaryn orundabaganyn korduk. Alardyn kobu Allakhka bash iibedi.

Al elchilerden kiiin Faraongo zhana anyn koomuna Musa paigambardy paigambarlygy chyndyk ekenine achyk-aikyn dalil, belgileri menen zhiberdik. Birok, alar da anyn belgilerin zhokko chygaryp, aga kaapyr bolushtu. Oo, elchi, anan Faraondun zhana anyn koomunun akybeti kandai bolgonun kara; Allakh alardy chokturup zhok kyldy zhana duino, akyrette kargyshka duushar kyldy.
Allakh Musany Faraongo zhibergende, aga baryp: "Ei, Faraon, men butkul zharatylgandardyn Zharatuuchusu, Padyshasy zhana ishterin kozomoldoochusu tarabynan zhiberilgenmin" - dedi.

Musa dagy: "Men Andan kelgendikten, Al tuuraluu zhalan' gana chyndykty aituuga mildettuumun. Silerge paigambarlygymdyn chyndygyna zhana Rabbim tarabynan zhiberilgen elchi ekendigime achyk-aikyn dalilderdi alyp keldim. Emi Israil urpaktaryn tutkundan chygaryp meni menen zhiber" - dedi.
Faraon Musaga: "Eger aitkandaryn' chyn bolso, Allakhtan alyp keldim dep zhatkan dalilderin'di korsot" - dedi.
Musa kolundagy taiagyn yrgytty ele, chon' zhylanga ailanyp karap turgandarga daana korundu
Koinogunun kokurogundogu zhe koltugunan yldyiyraagyndagy chontogunon kolun chygarsa, pes oorusu zhok ele kolu appak bolup chykty zhana appaktygynan karap turgandarga nurdanyp korundu.
Musanyn taiagy zhylanga ailanganyn zhana koldoru pes oorusu zhok agaryp kalganyn korgon koomdun bashchy, chon'doru: "Musa syikyr ilimin mykty bilgen syikyrchy eken" - deshti.
"Bul ishteri menen al silerdi Misirden, zherin'eden chygargany zhatat" - dedi Faraon, anan Musanyn ishi tuuraluu ken'esh surap: "Munu emne kyluuga ken'esh beresin'er?" - dedi
Alar Faraongo: "Musa menen Kharundu koio turup, Misirdegi baardyk shaarlarga andagy syikyrchylardy alyp keluugo kishi chaptyr" - deshti.
Zhibergen adamdaryn' shaarlardagy baardyk syikyr ishin mykty bilgen cheber syikyrchylardy taap kelsin
Faraon syikyrchylardy chogultup keluugo kishi chaptyrdy. Syikyrchylar Faraongo kelip: eger Musanyn syikyryna ustomduk kylyp zhen'ip chygyshsa, alarga syilyk berilebi dep surashty
Faraon alarga: "Ooba, silerge syilyk zhana syi bar, siler menin mansabymda maga zhakyn adamdar bolosun'ar" - dedi.
Musany zhen'ip alaryna bekem ishengen syikyrchylar boi kotoro tekeberlenip: "Ei, Musa, sen tandachy kana, ozun' birinchi tashtoonu kaalaisyn'by, zhe biz birinchi tashtailyby?" - deshti.

Rabbisinin zhardamyna bekem ishengen Musa alarga maani berbesten: "Taiak zhana zhibin'erdi siler birinchi tashtagyla" - dedi. Alar taiaktaryn zhana zhipterin tashtaganda, adamdardyn kozdorun boiop, uroi uchura turgan kuchtuu syikyrdy el kozuno korsotushtu.

Oshondo Allakh paigambary Musaga: "Ei, Musa, kolun'dagy taiakty tashta" - dep aian kabar berdi. Musa taiagyn tashtady, oshondo al chon' zhylanga ailanyp, tigilerdin el kozuno soilogon zhylandai korungon taiak zhana zhipterin op tartyp zhutup koidu.
Chyndyk achykka chykty, Musa paigambardyn alyp kelgen dini chyndyk ekeni al emi syikyrchylardyn zhasagan syikyry zhalgan ekeni anyk boldu.
Alar zhen'ilip, talkalanyp, uiat bolup kaityshty, Musa alardy bul zherde zhen'ip aldy.
Syikyrchylar Allakhtyn uluu kuduretin zhana achyk belgilerin korushkon son', Kemchiliksiz Allakh Taalaga sazhda kylyp zhygylyshty.
Syikyrchylar: "Bardyk zharatylgandardyn Rabbisine yiman keltirdik" - deshti.
"Musa menen Kharundun (alarga Allakhtyn tynchtygy bolsun) Rabbisine yiman keltirdik, Al chynygy ibadatka tatyktuu, bashka oilonup tabylgan kudailar syiaktuu emes".

Alar zhalgyz Allakhka yiman keltirgenden kiiin Faraon alardy korkutup: "Menin uruksatymsyz ele Musaga ishenip aldyn'arby? Aga yiman keltiruun'or zhana Musa alyp kelgen nerseni tastyktap, ishenuun'or, shaar elin chygaryp ketuu uchun Musa menen keliship algan aldoo, kuulugun'ar ele. Ei, syikyrchylar, silerge kandai azap zhana kandai zhazaloo bolorun emi korosun'or" - dedi.

"Silerdin on' kolun'ar menen sol butun'ardy, zhe sol butun'ar menen on' kolun'ardy kaichylash kestirip, anan kurma daragyna kerdirip olturomun. Bul silerge zhaza zhana silerdin korgondordun baaryna eskertuu bolot" - dedi.
Syikyrchylar Faraondun korkutuusuna zhoop kylyp: "Biz zhalgyz Rabbibizge kaituuchubuz, bizge kandai korkunuchtu ubada kylsan' da baary bir" - deshti.

"Ei, Faraon, biz Msua arkyluu kelgen Rabbibizdin belgisine ishengenibiz uchun sen och alyp zhatasyn', eger ushul kylganybyz aiyptala turgan kunoo bolso, anda bizdin kunoobuz ushu" - deshti. Anan Allakhka zhalbaruu menen duba kylyp: "Oo, Rabbibiz, chyndyktan taibai turuuga bizge sabyr ber, bizdi saga musulman bolup, buirugun'a bash iiip, elchin'e eerchigen abalda oltur" - deshti.

Faraondun koomundagy attuu-bashtuular Firaundu Musaga zhana any eerchigen yimanduularga karshy undop: "Ei, Firaun, Musa menen anyn koomun zherde buzukuluk kyldyryp tashtap koiosun'bu? Alar seni zhana senin kudailaryn'dy tashtap, zhalgyz Allakhka duba kylyp zhatyshat." - deshti. Firaun: "Emi Israil urpaktarynyn erkekterin but kyrdyryp, kyzmat kyldyruu uchun aialdaryn gana alyp kalamyn, Biz alarga biilik, kuch menen mazhburloo menen ustomduk kylabyz" - dedi.

Musa koomuna osuiat kylyp: "Ei, koomum, zhamandyktan saktanuuda, zhakshylykka zhetuudo zhalgyz Allakhtan zhardam suragyla, bashyn'arga tushkon synoogo sabyr kylgyla, akyikatta, zher Allakhtyky, anda kaalagandai okum chygargydai zher Firaunga zhe bashka biroogo taandyk emes. Any Allakh pendelerine kaalagandai bolushturot. Birok, zherdegi zhashoonun zhakshy zhyiyntygy Anyn buirugun atkaryp, tyiuusunan tyiylgan yimanduularga bolot. Synoo, meenet kancha oor bolso da, zhyiyntygynda silerge zhakshylyk bolot" - dedi.

Israil urpaktarynan bolgon Musanyn koomu aga kairylyp: "Ei, Musa, Firaun sen kelgenge cheiin baldarybyzdy olturup, aialdarybyzdy tiruu kaltyryp azaptap kelgen ele, bul azaby sen kelgenden kiiin dele ulanyp zhatat" - deshti. Musa alarga nasaat kylyp zhana kutular kundu suiunchulop: "Rabbin'er silerdin dushmanyn'ar bolgon Firaundu zhana anyn elin olturup, silerdi zher betinde saktap kalaar. Oshondon kiiin siler shugur kylasyn'arby zhe kaapyr bolosun'arby karap turat.

Faraondun elin kaatchylyk zhana kurgakchylyk menen azaptadyk, momo-zhemishterdin zhana tushumdun tartyshtygy menen synadyk. Bul bolup zhatkandar kaapyrlyktary sebeptuu bolup zhatkanyn eskerip, andan sabak alyp tobo kylyshaby degen umutto ushundai kyldyk.

Faraondun eli, ken'irchilik bolup, momo-zhemish koboiup, baalar arzandasa: "Biz ushuga tatyktuubuz, biz uchun' ushundai ken'irchilik bolup zhatat" - dep esepteshti. A eger kurgakchylyk bolup, kaatchylyk bashtalsa, ooruu-syrkoo koboiso zh.b. baleeler bashyna tushso, munu Musa zhana any menen birge zhurgon Israil urpaktarynyn aiynan dep yrym kylyshty. Chynynda, alardyn bashyna kelip zhatkan ishtin baary Kemchiliksiz Allakh Taalanyn tagdyry, buga alardyn da, Musanyn da tieshesi zhok. Alarga karshy Musanyn dubasynyn gana tieshesi bar. Birok, munu alardyn kobu bilbeit zhana munun sebebin Allakhtan bashkaga ton'korushot.

Faraondun koomu chyndykty kabyldoogo ton' moiunduk kylyp: "Biz ibadat kylyp zhatkan nerselerden bizdi kaitaruu uchun zhana ozun' alyp kelgen din chynygy din ekenin dalildoogo arakettenip, kandai dalil alyp kelbe, kandai muzhiza korsotpo, biz baary bir saga ishenbeibiz zhana tastyktabaibyz" - deshti.

Zhalganga chygargany zhana ton' moiundugu uchun alardy zhazalap, egin talaalaryn, momo baktaryn suuga chaipattyk, zhyigan-tergen tushumdoruno chegirtke kaptattyk, eginderin kuurata turgan zhana adamdardyn chachyn aralap aza bere turgan bitterdi paida kyldyk, idish-aiaktaryn aralap, tamak-ashtaryn buzup,toshok-orundaryn aralap ketken bakalardy zhiberdik, kuduktaryndagy, daryialaryndagy suularyna kan aralashtyrdyk. Myna ushul achyk-aikyn belgilerdi birinin-artynan birin udaa-udaa zhiberdik. Birok, bul belgiler kelgen saiyn yiman keltiruudon zhana Musa alyp kelgen dindi tastyktoodon tekeberlenip bash tarta berishti. Oshentip kunoogo batkan koom bolushtu, zhalgandan suurulup chyga alyshpady, chyndyktyn zholuna tusho alyshpady.

Zhogorudagy baleeler bashyna tushkondo Musaga kairylyp: "Ei, Musa, saga gana tiesheluu bolgon paigambarlygyn'dy zhana toobo kylgandardy baleeden arylta turgan kelishimin'di ortogo salyp Rabbin'e duba kyl, bizdi baleeden aryltsyn. Eger bizdi ushul baleelerden saktap kalsan', saga yiman keltirebiz zhana Israil urpaktaryn azattykka chygaryp seni menen ketirebiz" - deshet.

Chogup zhok boloordon murda belgiluu bir moonotko alardy baleeden aryltsak, dindi tastyktaibyz zhana Israil urpaktaryn azat kylyp ketirebiz degen ubadalaryn buzup, kaira ele kaapyrlygyn ulantyp Israil urpaktaryna Musa menen birge ketuugo toskool bolushtu.

Kachan alardyn zhok bolo turgan moonotu kelgende alardan och alyp den'izge chokturup zhiberdik. Bul alardyn Allakhtyn aiat-belgilerin zhalganga chygargany zhana ech shek-kumonu zhok chyndyktan bash tartkany sebeptuu boldu.

Faraon zhana anyn elinen korduk korgon Israil urpaktaryna zherdin chygysh zhana batyshyn murastap berdik. B.a. Sham mamleketin berdik, al egin, momoloru kop berekeluu zher bolchu. Ei, elchi, oshentip Rabbin' aitkan sozunun otoosuno chykty. Al: (wanuriydu 'an nWamunWa `ala~ 'lWadhiyna 'stuD`ifuw fiy 'l'arDi wanaj`alahum 'ay'imWa@ wanaj`alahumu 'lwarithiyna) "Biz zherde (Misirde) zyian korgon adamdarga zhakshylyk kylyp, alardy aldyn'kylar zhana muraskorlor kyluunu kaaladyk" (Kasas,5-aiat) dep aitkan ele. Alarga myndai zherdi Faraon zhana anyn elinin azabyna chydap, sabyr kylgany uchun berdi. Al emi Faraon zhasagan eginderin, turak-zhailaryn, ak sarailaryn baaryn talkalap zhok kyldyk.

Musa paigambar taiagy menen den'izdi chapkanda, Biz any ekige azhyratyp, Israil koomun andan alyp ottuk. Alar but-aikelderdi zhasap alyp, Allakhty tashtap oshol aikelderge ibadat kylyp zhatkan eldin zhanynan otushtu. Oshondo Israil urpaktary Musaga: "Ei, Musa, mobu adamdar ibadat kylyp zhatkan but-aikelder syiaktuu bizge da but-aikelderdi zhasap ber, biz oshogo ibadat kylaly" - deshti. Musa alarga: "Ei, koomum, siler Allakhty uluktoo, zhalgyzdoo mildet ekenin bilbeit ekensin'er, shirk kylyp, Andan bashka nersege ibadat kyluu Aga ylaiyk emes" - dedi.
Tigi but-aikelderge ibadat kylyp zhatkandar bashka nersege ibadat kylgany uchun zhok bolushat, alardyn Allakhka bashka nerseni sherik kylyp zhasagan ishterinin baary zharaksyz

Musa koomuna: "Ei, koomum, Allakhtan bashka, ibadat kyla turgan kudaidy silerge kantip taap berem? Anyn chon' belgilerin kordun'or, Allakh Taala silerdi oz zamanynda aalamdarga artykcha kylyp, dushmandaryn'ardy talkalap, alardyn orduna silerdi orun-ochok aldyrbadyby?" -dedi.

"Oo, Israil urpaktary, erkek baldaryn'ardy olturup, aialdardy kyzmat kyldyruu uchun alyp kalyp, silerge turduu azaptyn daamyn tattyrgan Firaun zhana anyn elinin kordugunan kutkargan uchurubuzdu estegile! Silerdi Faraon zhana anyn elinen kutkaruusu, shugur kylar beken degen chon' synoo ele" - dedi.

Allakh zhashyruun suiloshuu uchun Musany otuz tungo ubadalashyp, anan dagy on tun koshup, kyrk tun kyldy. Anan Rabbisi menen suiloshuugo zhonop zhatkanda Musa bir tuugany Kharunga kairylyp: "Ei, Kharun, menin orduma koomdu bashkaryp tur, zhakshy saiasat zhurguzup, zhumshaktyk menen alardy bashkar, kunoogo but koiup, buzukulardyn zholuna tushup ketpe zhana kunoogo bashtoochu bolbo!" - dedi.

Musa Rabbisi menen kyrk tunduk suiloshuugo ubadalashkan kunu kelgende, Rabbisi aga buiruktar, tyiuular zhana bashka nerselerdi aitty. Musa Allakhtyn zhuzun korgusu kelip, Any koruunu surandy. Allakh Taala aga zhoop berip: "Meni bul duino zhashoosunda koro albaisyn'; koruugo kuduretin' zhetpeit. Azyr mobu toonu kara, Men aga korungonumdo al taasirlenbei, ordunda kala alsa, anda sen da Meni koro alasyn', a eger zherge tegizdelip ketse, anda Meni bul duinodo koro albaisyn'" - dedi. Oshentip Allakh toogo korungondo any zher menen zheksen kyla koidu. Musanyn esi oop zhygyldy. Kachan ozuno kelip, ordunan turganda: "Ei, Rabbi, Seni Saga ylaiyksyz bolgon kemchiliktin baarynan aruulaimyn, Seni bul duinodo koruunu suranganyma toobo kyldym, men koomumdagy birinchi yiman keltirgen adam boldum" - dedi.

Allakh Taala Musaga: "Ei, Musa, Men seni Ozumdun dinim menen zhonotkondo seni adamdardan tandap artykcha kyldym. Oshondoi ele, ech ortomchusuz suilop seni artykcha kyldym. Men bergen bul kadyr-barkty al zhana bul uluu syi uchun Allakhka shugur kyluuchulardan bol" - dedi.

Anan Musaga Israil urpaktary duino zhana akyret ishterinde muktazh bolo turgan bardyk ishterdi uguuchular uchun nasaat kylyp zhana baiandoogo muktazh bolgon okumdordun baian-chechilmelerin taktaiga zh.b. nerselerge zhazyp berdik. Ei, Musa, Toorottu bekem karmap, koomun' Israil urpaktaryn anda aitylgan sabyrduuluk, kechirimduuluk syiaktuu soop-syiy kop zhakshy ishterdi atkaruuga buiru. Menin buirugumdu atkarbai, bash iiuudon chygyp ketkenderdin akybeti kyiroo bolorun silerge korsotomun".

Allakhtyn pendelerine zhana chyndykka akyikatsyzdyk menen tekeberlenip, dalil-belgilerdi korgon saiyn zhokko chygaryp, aga toskoolduk kylyp, andan chettegen zhana Allakh menen Anyn elchisinin cheginen chykkan, Allakhtyn yraazylygyna alyp bara turgan tuura zholdu korso aga tushpogon zhana kyzykpagan, Allakhtyn kazabyna alyp bara turgan teskeri zholdu korso, oshogo tushup ketken adamdardy ozundogu zhana aalamdagy belgilerge kon'ul burbai turgan zhana kitebimdegi aiattardy tushuno albai turgan kylyp burup koiomun. Bul alardyn elchiler alyp kelgen nersenin chyn ekendigine dalil bolgon Allakhtyn aiat-belgilerin zhalganga chygaryp, aga kon'ul burup karabagany uchun boldu.

Paigambarlarybyzdyn chyndyk ekenine dalil bolgon bizdin aiattarbyzdy zhana kyiamat kunu Allakhka zholuguunu zhalganga chygargandardyn ibadat katary zhasagan ishteri zharaksyz bolup tekke ketet zhana al uchun soop alyshpait, antkeni ishterdin kabyl boluusunun negizgi sharty bolgon yiman bolbodu. Kyiamat kunu alar Allakhka shirk kylgany zhana kaapyrlygy uchun zhazalanat, alardyn zhazasy tozoktoo tuboluk kaluu.

Musa Rabbisi menen suiloshuugo ketkenden kiiin, ozdorundogu zhasalgalarynan zhany zhok, un chyga turgan muzoonun aikelin zhasatyp alyshty. Bul muzoo alarga suiloi albastygyn, zhakshy zholgo materialdyk zhaktan da, moraldyk zhaktan da bashtai albastygyn, alarga paidasyn tiigize albastygyn zhana zyiandan tyia albastygyn bilishpei bele?! Alar ushundai nerseni ibadat kyluuchu kylyp alyp, oz zhandaryna zyian kylyshty.

Kachan gana, muzoonu Allakh menen birge ibadat kyluuchu nersege ailandyruu arkyluu tuura zholdon adashkanyn biliiship, okunushkondo, Allakh Taalaga zhalbaryp: "Ozun'o bash iiuugo topuk berip yraiym kylbasan', muzoogo ibadat kylgan kunoobuzdu kechirbesen', duino akyrette zyianga uchuroochulardan bolup kalabyz" - deshti.

Musa Allakh Taala menen suiloshup koomuna kelgende, muzoogo syiynyp ketishkenin korup, alarga achuulanyp, kaigyryp: "Ei, koom, men zhokto kyiroonu zhana baktysyzdykty shashtyra turgan oto zhaman ish kylypsyn'ar, meni kutpoi, muzoogo syiynuuga bet aldyn'arby?!" - dedi. Achuusunun zhana kaigysynyn katuulugunan kolundagy taktailaryn zherge tashtap, bir tuugany Kharundun chach-sakalynan silkildetip, muzoogo syiynyp ketken koomdu ozgorpoi, alar menen birge zhurgonuno aiyptai bashtady. Kharun Musadan kechirim surap, aga zhagynyp: "Ei, apmadyn uulu, bular meni alsyz sanap, kordoshtu, az zherden olturup koioiun deshti, meni dushmandaryma ylaiyk zhaza menen zhazalaba, achuun' menen meni Allakhtan bashkaga ibadat kylgan koomdogu zaalymdardyn kataryna koshpo" - dedi.

Musa Rabbisine duba kylyp: "Ei, Rabbim, meni kechir, bir tuuganym Kharundu da kechir, bizdi yraiymyn'a al zhana ar taraptan yraiymyn'a bolo, Sen, oo, Rabbim, bizge bardyk yraiym kyluuchulardan yraiymduusun'" - dedi.

Muzoonu kudai dep eseptep, aga ibadat kylgandar Rabbisinin katuu achuusuna kabylat zhana Rabbisin achuulantkany, Any kemsintkeni sebeptuu bul duinodo kordukka kabylyshat. Myna ushundai zhaza menen Allakhka zhalgan oilop tapkandardy zhazalaibyz.

Allakhka shirk keltirip, kunoo kylyp zhaman ishterdi zhasagandar, bul ishterinen kiiin, Allakhka yiman keltirip, kylyp zhurgon kunoo ishterden arylyp, Allakhka tobo kylsa, ei, elchi, shirkten yimanga, kunoodon ibadatka kaitkan tobodon kiiin Rabbin' alardyn kunoosun kechiruu, zhana aiybyn zhashyruu menen alarga Kechirimduu zhana Yraiymduu.

Musanyn achuusu taraganda achuusu kelgende yrgytyp zhibergen taktailaryn aldy. Bul taktailarda adashuudan kaitaruuchu tuura zhol, chyndyk tuuraluu baian, Raabisinen korkup, Anyn azabynan chochulagandar uchun yraiym boloru tuuraluu zhazylgan ele.

Arasyndagy kelesoo, kem akyldary muzoogo syiynyp ketkeni uchun Rabbisinen kechirim suroogo Musa koomundagy zhakshy adamdardan zhetimishti tandap aldy. Anan Allakh belgilegen ubakka baryshty. Bargandan kiiin Allakhka oroiluk kylyp, Musadan Allakhty oz kozdoru menen koruunu talap kylyshty. Oshondo zher titirep, katuu chagylgan tushup kyirap zhok bolushtu. Musa Rabbisine zhalynyp: "Oo, Rabbim, eger bulardy, bular menen birge meni zhok kyluunu kaalaganyn'da, biz bul zherge kele elekte ele zhok kylat elen'. Emi bul akyly taiyzdardyn aiynan bizdi zhok kylasyn'by? Koomumdun muzoogo ibadat kylyp ketuusu, kaalagan adamyn'dy adashtyruu, kaalagan adamyn'dy tuura zholgo saluu uchun synoo, Sen bizdin ishibizdi bashkaruuchusun', bizdin kunoobuzdu kechir, kenen yraiymyn' menen yraiym kyl, Sen kunoo-katalardy en' zhakshy kechiresin'.

"Bul duinodo Sen zhakshylyk berip, kechirip, zhakshy ishterdi zhasatyp urmattagan adamdardyn katarynda kyl. Akyrette bolso, alarga beiish daiardalyp koiulgan saalikh pendelerin'din katarynda kyl. Biz Saga toobo kyldyk, kemchilikteribizdi moiundap, Ozun'o kaittyk" - dedi. Allakh Taala: "Baktysyzdykka alyp baruuchu ishti kylgan adamdardan kaalaganyma azabym tushot, bul duinodo yraiymym baardyk nerseni orop turat; Allakhtyn yraiymy zharatylgandardan biroosuno da zhetpei kalbait, Anyn artykchylygy menen zhakshylygy baaryn kurchap turat. Al emi akyrette Men yraiymymdy Allakhtyn buirugun atkaryp, tyiuusunan tyiylyp takyba bolgondorgo, tiesheluu adamdarga bailygynan zeket bergenderge, Bizdin aiattarybyzga yiman keltirgenderge zhazamyn.

Zhazuunu da, okuunu da bilbegen, Rabbisinen gana aian-kabar algan paigambar Mukhammaddy (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) eerchigender anyn aty zhana sypattary Musa paigambarga tushurulgon Toorotto zhana Isa paigambarga tushurulgon Inzhilde zhazyluu ekenin korushkon. Al alardy zhakshylygy anyk zhana on'dop-tuzoi turgan ishterge undoit, akylga zhana taza ishenimge zhaman ekendigi bilinip turgan ishterden tyiat. Tamaktanuu, suusunduk ichuu zhana nikelenuu syiaktuu zyiansyz ishterdi atkaruunu yktyiarduu kylgan. Bulardan taza, adal emesterin alarga aram kylat. Murda moiundaryna zhuktolgon oor ishterdi, misaly, ataiyn zhe kokustan adam olturgon kishiden och alyp any olturuu syiaktuu ishterdi alardyn moiununa zhuktoboit. Israil urpaktaryby zhe bashkalarby, aitor, kim aga yiman keltirse, any urmattap-syilasa, kaapyrlarga karshy aga zhardam berse, tuura zholgo bashtoochu nur bolup tushurulgon Kurandy eerchise, myna osholor kaalagan nersesine zhetip, korkkon nersesinen kutulup iigilikke zhetishet.

Oo, elchi, alarga: "Oo, adamdar, men silerdin baaryn'arga, arabyn'arga da arap emesin'erge da Allakh tarabynan zhiberilgen elchimin. Asman zhana zherdin mulku Aga taandyk. Andan bashka ibadatka tatyktuu zhok. Al oluktordu tiriltet zhana tiruulordu olturot. Ei, adamdar, Allakhka zhana Anyn zhazuunu da, okuunu da bilbegen, Rabbisi aga tushurgon aian-kabardy alyp kelgen, Allakhka yiman keltirgen, anyn ozuno zhana ozunon murdagy paigambarlarga tushurulgon nersege ech azhyratyp bolboston yiman keltirgen elchi-paigambary Mukhammadga (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) yiman keltirgile. Duinodo da, akyrette da paidaluu bolgon zholgo tushuunu umut kylyp, al Rabbisinen alyp kelgen dinge eerchigile.

Israil urpaktarynan muzoogo ibadat kylyp ketkenderin aitkandan kiiin, alardyn arasynda muzoogo ibadat kylgandarga karshylar da bar ekenin eskerip, mintip aitat:
Musanyn Israil urpaktarynan bolgon koomunda tuura dindi bekem karmagandary da bar, bashkalardy da oshogo chakyryshat zhana zhabyr kylbai, adilet okum kylyshat.

Israil urpaktaryn on eki uruuga bolduk. Alar Musadan Allakhka duba kylyp suu sura dep talap kylyshkanda, aga, ei, Musa, taiagyn' menen tashty ur dep aian kyldyk. Al tashty urganda, andan koomundagy on eki uruunun sanyna zharsha on eki bulak agyp chygyp, ar bir uruu ozuno tiesheluu bulakty bilip, aga bashka uruular sheriktesh bolboi turgan boldu. Alar kaida bassa zhylyp, toktoso toktop alardyn ustuno koloko tushuro turgan buluttu daiyndap koiduk. Alarga zhakshylyk kylyp bal syiaktuu daamduu suusunduktu, bodono syiaktuu eti daamduu chymchykty tushurup berdik. Anan alarga: "Silerge yrysky kylyp bergen taza nerselerdi zhegile, zhakshylykka kaapyrdyk kyluu, zaalymdyk syiaktuu kemchilikterdi kylbagyla. aga ozuno ylaiyk baa berbei koibogula" - dedik. Birok, alar ozdoruno ozdoru zulum kylyp, Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryn chetke kagyp, Anyn buiruktaryna karshy chygyp kunookor boluu menen kyiroogo tush bolushtu.

Oo, elchi, dagy estegin, Allakh Israil urpaktaryna: "Yiyk uigo kirgile, andagy aiyldan kaalagan ubakta, kaalagan tamagyn'ardy zhegile. Oo, Rabbibiz, bizdin katalarybyzdy ochur dep, Rabbin'erge kichipeiildik menen ruku kylyp iiilip kirgile. Eger ushundai kylsan'ar, kunoon'ordu kechirebiz, zhakshylyk kyluuchularga duino, akyrettin zhakshylygyn koboitobuz" - dep aitty.

Alardyn zaalymdary alarga buiruk iretinde aitylgan sozdu burmalap, "kechirim tilegile" degen sozdun orduna "arpanyn dany" degen sozdu almashtyryp, alarga buirulgan ishti ozgortup, eshikten bashyn iiip kichi peiildik menen kiruunun orduna, artyn salyp zhormolop kirishti. Anan alardyn zaalymdygy sebeptuu asmandan azap tushurduk.

Oo, elchi, zhoottorgo eskertuu iretinde aiyldagy bir okuianyn aiynan azapka kabylyshkanyn suragyn. Al aiyl den'izdin zheeginde bolchu. Allakh alardy synoo uchun ishembi kundoru balyktardy den'iz betine zhakyn alyp kelip, bashka kundoru alystatyp, anan ishembi kunu alarga balyk uuloogo tyiuu salgan ele. Birok, alar Allakhtyn cheginen chygyp ishembi kunu balyk uulashty. Allakh alardy myndai synoo menen alar bash iibei, kunoogo berilip ketken sebeptuu synady. Alar kuuluk kylyp, ishembi kunu torlorun zhaiyp, chukurlardy kazyp koiup, aga tushup kalgan balyktardy zhekshembi kunu tartyp alyp, zheshti.

Oo, elchi, dagy estegin, bir zhamaat alardy bul tyiuu salyngan ishti (balyk uuloonu) atkaruudan tyiyp, eskertkende, bashka bir zhamaaty: "Kunooloru uchun Allakh bul duinodo kyiratyp zhok kylyp, akyrette katuu azapka duushar kyla turgan adamdarga emne uchun nasaat aitasyn'ar?! - deshti. Nasaat aityp zhatkandar: "Allakhtyn bizge buirugan zhakshylykka chakyruu zhana zhamandyktan kaitaruu buirugun atkaryp, any atkarbai koiup azapka kabylboo uchun nasaat aityp zhatabyz. mumkun alar nasaattan paida alyshar zhana kylyp zhatkan kunoo ishterinen kol uzoor" - deshti.

Kunookorlor nasaat aituuchulardyn aitkanyna kon'ul burbai, kylyp zhatkan ishterin ulanta bergende, alardy zhaman ishten tyigandardy kutkaryp, ishembi kunu balyk uulap zulumdyk kylgandardy Allakhtyn cheginen chygyp, kunoonu ulanta bergeni uchun katuu azap menen azaptadyk.

Nasaatty ukpai, tekeberiligi zhana kezhirligi menen Allakhka kunoo kylyp chekten chygyshkanda, alarga: "Ei, kunookorlor, kor bolgon maimyldarga ailangyla" - dedik. Anan alar Biz kaalagandai bolushtu. Biz kaisy bir ishti kaalasak, aga: "Bol" - dep aitsak, bolup kalat.

Oo, elchi, dagy estegin, Allakh zhottordun ustunon alardy duino zhashoosunda tee kyiamatka cheiin kordop, korkutup tura turgan adamdardy zhibererin achyk zharyia kyldy. Ei, elchi, akyikatta, Rabbin', kunoo kylgandardyn zhazasyn oto tez beruuchu, alarga bul duino zhashoosunda ele zhazalap koiot. Oshondoi ele Al pendelerinen tobo kylgandarga Kechirimduu zhana alarga Yraiymduu.

Alardy zher betinde bolup-zharyp, bir kancha taipalarga azhyratyp koiduk, buga cheiin alar bir choguu zhamaat bolchu. Alardyn arasynda Allakhtyn da, pendenin da akysyn atkargandary, ortocholoru zhana kunoo zhasap oz zhandaryna zyian kylgandary da bar. Alardy kylyp zhatkan ishterinen kaitaby degen umutto zhyrgal menen da kural menen da synap korduk.

Anan bul zhaman ish zhasagandardyn artynda orun basar bolup bir muun keldi. Alar murdagylardan Toorottu muras alyp, any okup birok, anda zhazylgandardy atkarbai, Allakhtyn kitebin ozgortuu uchun zhana okumdordu tushkon maksatynan burmaloo uchun zharybagan duino buiumdarynan para alyp, Allakh kunoolorubuzdu kechiret dep ozdorun alaksytyshty. Alarga zhok bolup ketuuchu duino buiumdaryn alyp kelishken saiyn, birinin artynan birin ala berishti. Akyikatta, Allakh Taala alar menen chyndykty ech ozgortposton, burmalabastan aituuga kelishim, ubada kylgan emse bele?! Kitepte zhazylgan ishterdi alar bilbestikten kylbai koigon zhok, teskerisinche alarda ilimi bar bolchu, alar any okup, bilishken. Oshon uchun alardyn kunoosu oor boldu. Akyret korgonu, anda Allakhtyn tyiganynan tyiylyp, buiruganyn atkaryp, takyba bolgondor uchun, bul duinodogu zhok bolup ketuuchu nerselerge karaganda tuboluktuu zhakshylyktar bar. Myna ushul zhok bolup ketuuchu duino buiumdaryn aluuchular, Allakh takybalarga akyrette zhakshy zhana tuboluktuu nerselerdi daiardap koigonuna akyl zhugurtushpoibu?!

(Alardyn arasynda) kitepti bekem karmangan, anda zhazylgandardy ish zhuzundo atkargan, namzadaryn ubaktysynda bardyk sharttaryn, vazhybdaryn zhana sunnottorun toluk atkaryp okugandary da bar. Emi Allakh alardy kylgan ishterine zharasha syilait, Allakh zhakshy ishterdi kylgandardyn soop-syiyn tekke ketirbeit.

Oo, Mukhammad, dagy estegin, Toorotto aitylgandardy atkaruudan bash tartyshkanda, Biz toonu azhyratyp alyp, Israil urpaktarynyn ustuno kotorup, too alardy kolokologon bulut syiaktuu bolup, alar too ustubuzgo tushot dep ishenip kalyshkanda, alarga: "Biz silerge bergen kitepti tyryshuu menen bekem karmagyla, anda Allakh silerge shariiat kylgan okumdordu estegile zhana ushunu kylyp takyba boluunu umut kylsan'ar any unutpagyla" - dep aityldy.

Oo, Mukhammad, dagy estegin, Rabbin' adam balasynyn belinen anyn urpaktaryn chygardy. Oshondo alar Anyn Zharatuuchu zhana Rabbi ekenin taza tabiiaty menen kabyl kylyshty. Rabbisi alarga: "Men silerdin Rabbin'er emesminbi?" - dedi. Alar baary birigip: "Ooba, Sen bizdin Rabbibizsin'" - deshti. Allakh: "Chynynda, siler kyiamat kunu dalilderdi chetke kagyp, bul tuuraluu ech nerse bilbeibiz dep aitpoon'or uchun, Biz silerdi synadyk zhana ubadan'ardy aldyk" - dedi.

"Zhe ata-baban'ar butparas bolup, kelishimdi buzganyn aityp, siler bolso alardyn shirk ishenimderin eerchip ketkenin'erdi shyltoo kylyp: "Ei, Rabbibiz, bizdi shirk kylyp ish-amaldaryn zhok kylyp algan ata-babalar uchun azaptaisyn'by? Bizde kunoo zhok, biz bilbesten atalarybyzdyn kylganyn kyldyk" - dep tanyp ketpoon'or uchun ushundai kyldyk"- dedi.
Zhalganchy koomdordun zhazmyshy tuuraluu aiattardy baiandaganybyz syiaktuu, shirk ishenimin tashtap, bir Kudaiga ishenip, Aga ibadat kyluusun umut kylyp, bularga da aiattardy baiandap berdik.

Oo, Mukhammad, Israil urpaktaryna alardyn ozunon chykkan bir adam tuuraluu okup ber. Biz aga aiattarybyzdy berip, al any bilip, aga dalil bolgon chyndykty tushunup turup, any ish zhuzundo atkarbady, any tashtap, andan uzuldu. Oshondo aga shaitan zholugup, any ozuno zhakyn kylyp aldy. Anan al iigilikke zhetuuchu tuura zholdon, kyiroogo uchuroochu kyishyk zholgo tushup aldy.

Eger ushul aiattar arkyluu anyn darazhasyn kotoruunu kaalasak, any ish zhuzundo atkaruuga zhen'ildik berip, duino, akyrette kotorup koimokpuz. Birok, al akyretke karaganda duino yrakhattaryna taasirlenip, zhardamsyz kala turgan zholdu tandap aldy. Anyn duinogo ach kozdugu, itke okshosh, it baardyk abalynda sugalaktanyp tilin salan'data beret, zhatsa da, tilin salan'datat, kuusan' da tiliin salan'datat.Bul salyshtyruu, Bizdin aiattarybyzdy zhalganga chygaryp adashkan koomgo okshosh. Ei, elchi, pikir kylyp, ozdorunun zhalganyn, adashuusun tashtap kaluusun umut kylyp, alarga ushundai an'gemelerdi an'gemele.
Bizdin dalilderibizdi zhalganga chygaryp, aga ishenbei, ushunusu menen ozdorun tuboluk kyiroogo turtkon adamdardan da zhaman adam bolobu

Allakh kimdi tuura zholgo ylaiyktuu kylyp, tuz zholgo salyp koiso, al chyndap tuura zholgo tushot; kimdi tuz zholdon alystatyp koiso, alar chyndap ozdorunun nasibin kemituuchulor. Alar kyiamat kunu ozdoruno zhana ui-buloloruno zyian kyluuchular, bul anyk zyian tartuu.

Akyikatta, tozokko ylaiyktuu ishterdi kylaryn bilip, koptogon zhinderdi zhana adamdardy tozokko tatyktuu kylyp zharattyk. Alardyn zhurogu bolgon menen zhurogu paida beruuchunu da, zyian beruuchunu da sezbeit. Alardyn kozdoru bolgon menen ozdorundogu zhana aalamdagy Allakhtyn belgilerin korboit zhana andan etibar alyshpait. Alardyn kulagy bolgonu menen Allakhtyn aiattaryn ugushpait zhana aga akyl kalchabait. Ushul zhogorudagy sypattar menen sypattalgan adamdar akylsyzdykta aibandar syiaktuu, a tugul, adashuuda bular aibandarga karaganda zhaman. Bular Allakhka zhana kyiamat kununo yiman keltiruudon bei kapar kalyshkan.

Kemchiliksiz Allakhta Anyn uluulugun zhana kemeldigin aiginelegen kooz ysymdary bar. Oshol ysymdary menen Allakhka maktoo aityp, oshol ysymdary arkyluu Andan kaalaganyn'ardy suragyla. Allakhtyn ysymdarynda chekten chygyp, bul ysymdardy Allakhtan bashkaga yigargan, zhe Allakhka myndai ysymdardy yraa korbogon, zhe maanisin burmalagan, zhe bashka nersege okshotkon adamdardan alys bolgula. Kiiin Allakhtyn ysymdarynda chekten chykkandardy kylgan kylyktary uchun katuu azap menen zhazalaibyz.
Biz zharatkandardyn arasynda, ozdorun tuura zholgo salgan, bashkalardy da aga chakyryp tuura zholgo bashtagan, ech kimge zhabyr kylbai, adil okum kylgan zhamaat bar.

Bizdin aiattarybyzga yiman keltirbei, teskersinche, alardy chetke kagyp, zhalganga chygargandarga, yrysky eshikterin achabyz. Birok, bul alardy syiloo uchun emes, kunoolorun udaa-udaa ulanta berip, adashuulary oto kuchoosu uchun ushundai kylabyz. Anan kokustan alarga azap zhiberebiz.

Alardyn azaby kechiktirilip, azaptalbaibyz go dep oilop kalyshat da, zhalganga chygaruusun zhana kaapyrlygyn ulanta berishet, oshentip alardyn azaby da kuchoi beret. Menin ailam kuchtuu, alarga zhakshylyk kylyp zhatkandai korunup, birok zhardamsyz tashtap koiom.

Allakhtyn aiattaryn zhana elchisin zhalganga chygargandar Mukhammaddyn (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) zhindi emes ekenine pikir kylyp, akyldaryn ishtetpeibi. Al Allakhtyn elchisi, any Allakhtyn azabyn achyk-aikyn eskertuu uchun eskertuuchu kylyp zhibergen.

Alar Allakhtyn asman-zherdegi mulktoruno etibar kylyp karashpaiby. Allakh asman-zherde zharatkan aibanat, osumduk zhana bashka nerselerge karashpaiby. Oto zhakyndap kalgan azhaldaryna karap, ubakytty otkorboi toobo kylyshpaiby. Eger Kuranga zhana anda aitylgan zhakshy zhana zhaman ubadalarga ishenishpese, anda kaisy kitepke ishenishmek ele?!

Allakh kimdi chyndykka alyp baruuchu tuura zholdon chettetip, tuz zholdon adashtyryp koiso, any tuz zholgo bashtoochu bashka ech kim bolboit. Allakh alardy adashkan, kaapyr abaldarynda tashtap koiot da, alar argasyz tuura zholdu taba albai kala berishet.

Zhalganga chygaruuchu kok better senden kyiamat tuuraluu, anyn kachan boloru tuuraluu surashat. Ei, Mukhammad, alarga: "Kyiamattyn ilimin men da, menden bashka da bilbeit, Any bir gana Allakh bilet, anyn belgilengen ubaktysyn bir gana Allakh achykka chygarat, anyn achykka chygary asman-zherdeginin baaryna zhashyruun. Al kokustan bolot" - dep ait. Sen kyiamat tuuraluu biluugo kyzykdar bolgonsup, senden al tuuraluu surashat. Sen Rabbin'di zhakshy bilgendikten, kyiamat tuuraluu Andan surabastygyn'dy bilishpeit. Ei, Mukhammad, alarga: "Kyiamattyn ilimi bir gana Allakhta, birok, kop adamdar munu bilishpeit" dep aitkyn.

Oo, Mukhammad, alarga mintip ait: "Allakh kaalabasa, men ozumo zhakshylyk alyp kele albaimyn, ozumdu zhamandyktan saktai da albaimyn, zhakshylyk beruu zhana zhamandyktan saktoo Allakhtyn kolunda. Oshondoi ele, Allakh bildirgen nerseni gana bilem, kaiypty bilbeimin. Eger kaiypty bilgenimde, ishke asha elek ishterdin emne bolurun bilip alyp, maga zhakshylyk alyp kele turgan, zhamandykty ketire turgan sebepterdi zhasap almakmyn. Men Allakh tarabynan zhiberilgen elchimin, menin Allakhtan zhiberilgen elchi ekenime yiman keltirgen zhana men alyp kelgen dindi tastyktagan adamdarga Allakhtyn katuu azybyn eskertem, uluk soop-syiyn suiunchuloimun.

Oo, erkekter zhana aialdar, Allakh silerdi bir zhandan, Adam atadan zharatty. Adamdan anyn aialy Obonu zharatty. Obonu Adamga uironup, Adam any menen beipil zhashoosu uchun anyn kabyrgasynan zharatty. Zhubailar koshulgandan kiiin Obo boiuna butup, birok any sezbei zhuro berdi. Antkeni, boiuna birinchi zholu bolup zhatkandyktan, bashtapky mezgilde ech kandai oorluktu baikagan zhok, kachan gana tuiulduk chon'oiup zhugu oorlogondo, zhubailar Rabbisine duba kylyp: "Oo, Rabbibiz, bizge bala bersen', salikh, deni soo bala bergin, Senin zhakshylygyn'a shugur kyluuchulardan bolobu" - deshti.

Allakh alardyn dubasy kabyl kylyp, alar surangandai taza, saalikh bala bergende, balasyn Allakhtan bashkaga kul kylyp, (Abdul Khaaris) "Zherdin kulu" dep atap, shirk kylyshty. Allakh bolso bardyk sherikterden taza, zharatuuda da, ibadat kyluuda da zhalgyz.

But-aikelderdi zhana bashka nerselerdi ibadatta Allakhka sherik kylyshat. Alar bul ibadat kylyp zhatkan nerseleri ech nerse zharatpagan, teskerisinche, ozu zharatylgan anan da ibadat kyluuga tatyksyz ekenin bilishet. anan kantip ushundai nerselerdi Allakhka sherik kylyshat?!
Ibadat kylynyp zhatkan bul but-aikelder alarga ibadat kylyp zhatkandarga da, ozdoruno da zhardam bere albait, anan kantip osholorgo ibadat kylyshat.

Ei, butparastar, eger siler Allakhtyn orduna kudai kylyp algan but-aikelderdi tuura zholgo chakyrsan'ar, chakyrygyn'arga zhoop da berbeit, eerchibeit dagy. Alardy tuura zholgo chakyrasyn'arby, zhe unchukpai koiosun'arby alarga baary bir, antkeni alar zhansyz zattar; akyl zhugurto albait, ukpait zhana suiloboit.
