Ei, butparastar, siler Allakhtyn orduna ibadat kylyp zhatkan nerseler siler syiaktuu ele Allakh tarabynan zharatylgan anyn mulktoru, birok alar silerge karganda zhakshyraak. Antkeni, siler suilogon, baskan, ukkan zhana korgon tiruu zhansyn'ar, al emi but-aikelderin'er bolso, myndai emes. Alardy kudai degenin'er chyn bolso, alarga duba kylgylachy, duban'arga zhoop berisher beken?!

Siler kudai kylyp algan but-aikelderdin muktazhdyktaryna chyguu uchun basa turgan buttary barby? Zhe alarda silerden zhamandykty kuch menen karmap toktotup kala turgan koldoru barby? Zhe silerdin zhogolgon nersen'erdi korup, silerge kabar bere turgan kozdoru barby? Zhe silerge ugulbai kalgan nerseni ugup, silerge zhetkirip tura turgan kulaktary barby? Eger bul aitylgandardyn bir da bolboso, anda emne uchun alardan paida beret, zyiandan saktait dep umut kylasyn'ar?! Ei, elchi, bul butparastarga: "Oshol Allakhka ten'egen but-aikelderin'erge duba kyla bergile zhana maga zyian beruugo araket kyla bergile, meni kutpogulo" - degin.

Albette, menin korgoochum zhana zhardamchym Allakh, Al meni saktait, Andan bashkadan umut kylbaim.Silerdin but-aikelderin'erden ech korkpoim. Al maga adamdarga tuura zhol bolgon Kurandy tushurgon, Al pendelerinen salikhterdi dos kylgan, alardy saktagan zhana zhardam bergen.

Ei, butparastar, siler ibadat kylyp zhatkan but-aikelder silerge zhardam bergenge zharabait, a tugul, ozdoruno da zhardam bere albait. Alar alsyz, Allakhtyn orduna kantip osholorgo ibadat kylasyn'ar?!

Ei butparastar, oshol Allakhtyn orduna ibadat kylyp zhatkan but-aikelderin'erge duba kylsan'ar, ugushpait, zhaldyrap karap turushkanyn gana korosun'or, alar zhansyz zattar, alar korboit. Bul estelikterdi adamdyn, aibanattardyn keipinde zhasashkan, alardyn, kolu, butu zhana kozdoru bar, birok, alar zhansyz zattar, zhany da zhok kyimyly da zhok.

Oo, elchi, adamdarga ishterdi zhana akhlaktardy alardyn napsisi kotoro ala turgandai zhukto, alardyn tabiiatyna oor kele turgan nerseni zhuktobo, andai kylsan', alardy kachyrat, alarga zhyluu soz zhana zhakshy ish menen buiruk ber. Al emi karan'gy, ilimsizderden alys bol, alardyn karan'gylygyna zharasha ish kylba. Saga zyian tiigizgenge zyian tiigizbe, seni kuru kaltyrgandy sen kuru kaltyrba.

Oo, elchi, eger shaitandyn saga ustomduk kyla bashtagan azgyrygyn sezsen', Allakhtan korgoo tilep, Aga taian. Antkeni, Al sen aitkandy Uguuchu, senin korgonuun'du Biluuchu, Al seni shaitandan korgoit.

Allakh tyiuu salgan kunoo ishterden tyiylyp, buirugan ishterdi atkaryp, Aga takyba bolgondordu kokustan shaitan azgyryp, kunoo kylyshsa, daroo Allakhtyn uluulugun, Anyn kunookorlorgo beruuchu azabyn, bash iiuuchulorgo beruuchu soop-syiyn estep, kunoolorunon tobo kylat, Rabbisine kaitat. Oshentip, alar chyndykka bekem turushat, kylgan kunoosun tashtap, ekinchi kylbait.

Al emi kunookor zhana kaapyrlardan bolgon shaitandyn tuugandaryn shaitandar ulam adashuusun kuchotup, alar kunoo ustuno kunoo zhasai berishet. Shaitandar azgyruudan zhana adashtyruudan charchabait, kunookor insandar bolso alardy eerchuudon zhana zhaman ishterdi kyluudan tyiylbait.

Oo, elchi, sen alarga aiat-belgilerdi korsotkonun'do, seni zhalganga chygaryp, al belgilerden zhuz burushtu, a aiat-belgilerdi korsotpoi koison': "Kana, ozun ele oilop taap zhasai koiboisun'bu?" dep kelekeleshti. Ei, elchi, alarga: "Oz aldyncha aiat-belgilerdi korsoto albaim, Allakh aian-kabar kylgan nerseni gana eerchiimin, men silerge okup berip zhatkan Kuran Allakhtyn silerdin Zharatuuchun'ar zhana ishterin'erdi bashkaruuchun'ar ekenine achyk-aikyn dalil zhana yimanduu pendeleri uchun tuura zhol zhana yraiym. Al emi yimanduulardan bashkalary baktysyz adashuuchular.
Kuran okulganda suiloboi, bashka ishke alagdy bolboi, Allakhtyn yraiymyn umut kylyp, Kurandyn okulushuna kulak toshogulo

Oo, elchi, Rabbin'di, berilip, kichi peiil bolup, korkuu menen este (zikr kyl). Artykchylygy bar eki ubakta, t.a. erten' menen zhana kechinde unun'du oto biiik da, oto akyryn da chygarbai ortocho unun' menen duba kyl

Oo, elchi, perishteler da Rabbisine ibadat kyluuda tekeberlenbeit, ibadatty berilip, bash iiuu menen atkaryshat, kosh kon'ulduk kylyshpait. Alar kunu-tunu Allakhty aga ylaiyk kelbegen kemchilikterden aruulap, dan'ktap turushat zhana Anyn Ozuno sazhda kylyshat.

Oo, elchi, sakhabalaryn' senden olzho tuuraluu, any kantip bolushturorun'du, kimge bererin'di surashat. Ei, elchi, alardyn suroosuna zhoop berip: "Olzholor Allakh zhana Anyn elchisine tiesheluu, any bolushturuu zhana taratuu okumu da Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine tiesheluu. Siler bash iigile zhana makul bolgula. Ei, yimanduular, Allakhtyn tyigan ishterinen tyiylyp, buirugan ishterin atkaryp Aga takyba bolgula. Zhumshaktyk, bailanyshuu, kechiruu zhana zhakshy munoz arkyluu aran'ardagy kaichy pikirdi, teskeri buruluunu on'dogula. Eger chyndap yimanduu bolson'or, Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine bekem bash iigile. Antkeni, yiman bash iiuugo zhakyndatyp, kunoodon alystatat" - dep ait. Sakhabalar "Badr" kazaty bolgondo ushintip surashkan.

Akyikatta, chynygy yimanduular, eger Kemchiliksiz Allakh Taala zikr kylynsa, zhuroktoru korkunuchka tolot; zhuroktoru da deneleri da ibadatka tartylat. Eger alarga Kuran aiattary okulsa, aga akyl zhugurtushot, anan alardyn yimany andan da koboiot. Zhakshylyk ishterdi kyluuda da, zhamandyk ishterden kutuluuda da Rabbisine gana taianyp, tobokel kylyshat.
Alar namazdy oz ubaktysynda, talaptagydai atkaruunu ulantyshat zhana Biz yryskylandyrgan nerselerden mildettuu zhana yktyiarduu sadagalaryn berishet.

Zhogorudagy sypattar menen sypattalgandar yimandyn belgilerin zhana Islamdyn korunushun ozdoruno kamtygyny uchun alar chynygy yimanduular; Alardyn syiy Rabbisinin aldyndagy biiik orun, kunoolorunun kechiriluusu zhana kenen yrysky. Bular Allakh alarga daiardap koigon zhakshylyktar.

Siler olzhonu bolushturuudo kelishe albai, talashyp-tartyshkanyn'arda, Allakh any silerden tartyp alyp Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine tiesheluu kylyp koigonu syiaktuu, Ei, elchi, yimanduulardyn bir boluguno zhakpasa da, Rabbin' seni Madinadan butparastarga karshy attanuuga buirudu.

Oo, elchi, yimanduulardyn bul bolugu, alarga okum anyk bolgondon kiiin dele butparastar menen sogushuu tuuraluu, abaldy kozdoru menen korup turup, olumgo aidalyp bara zhatkansyp seni menen talashat. Bul alardyn sogushka chyguunu aiabai zhek korushkonunon ulam.

Oo, talashyp-tartyshkan yimanduular, estegile, Allakh silerge butparastardyn eki tobunun birin zhen'diruunu ubada kyldy.Eki toptun biri buium-terim alyp kele zhatkan kerben, any zhen'ip olzho alasyn'ar, ekinchisi kuralduu askerler, alar menen sogushup zhen'ishke zhetesin'er degende, siler sogushsuz on'oi basyp alyna turgan kerbendi tandadyn'ar. Allakh bolso, siler butparastardyn baatyrlaryn olturup, kobun tutkun kylyp, Islamdyn kuch-kubatyn zharyia kyluun'ar uchun sogush arkyluu chyndykty achykka chygaruunu kaalady.

Islamdyn zhana musulmandardyn zhuzun achuu menen Allakh akyikatty ornottu, bul dindin chyndyk ekenin korsotuu menen boldu. Oshondoi ele Allakh zhalgandy zhok kyldy, bul anyn zhalgan ekenine achyk dalilder menen boldu. Munu butparastar zhaktyrbasa da, Allakh achykka chygardy.

Badr sogushu bolgon kunu dushmandaryn'arga karshy zhen'ish tilep, zhardam suraganyn'ardy estegile. Oshondo Allakh silerdin duban'ardy kabyl kylyp, birinin artynan biri kelgen min' perishteni tushurup silerdi koldodu.

Oo, yimanduular, Allakh perishteler menen koldoonu silerdin dushmanyn'ardy zhen'genin'er uchun suiunchu katary zhana zhen'ishke zhurogun'or tynchtanuusu uchun korsottu. Zhen'ish askerdin sanynyn koptugu menen bolboit, zhen'ish - Allakhtyn kolunda. Akyikatta, Allakh padyshalygynda Kubattuu, Aga ech kim ustomduk kyla albait, shariiat zhana tagdyr kyluuda Daashynman.

Oo, yimanduular, dagy estegile, dushmanyn'ar taraptan bolgon korkunuchtan aman saktoo uchun Allakh silerge zhen'il uiku berdi. Zhurogun'ordu tazalap, silerden shaitandyn azgyrygyn ketiruu uchun zhana zholukkan uchurda zhurogun'or zhana denen'er bekem boluusu uchun, oshondoi ele kumduu zherde baskanda butun'ar taigylboosu uchun zhamgyr zhaadyrdy.

Oo, paigambar, Badr kunu yimanduulardy koldoo uchun tushurgon perishtelerge Allakh mintip aian-kabar berdi: Ei, perishteler, zhardam zhana koldoo korsotuudo Men siler menenmin, yimanduulardyn erktuulorun dushmanga karshy turuuga shyktandyrgyla. Azyr kaapyrlardyn zhuroguno katuu korkunuch salamyn. Ei, yimanduular, siler da kaapyrlardy moiunun kyia chapkyla, muun-muundaryna kylych shiltep, sogushka zharaksyz kylgyla.

Kaapyrlardy mintip olturuunun zhana uruunun sebebi, alar Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine karshy chygyshty. Alar buirulugan ishti atkargan zhok, tyiuu salyngan ishten tyiylgan zhok. Kim bul ishterde Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine karshy bolso, akyikatta, Allakh bul duinodo alardy olturuu zhana tutkun kyluu, akyrette bolso tozokko tushuruu menen katuu azaptait.

Oo, Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine karshy bolgondor, aitylgan azaptardyn daamyn bul duinodo tez arada tatkyla, akyrette bolso silerge tozok azaby bar, eger ushintip kaapyrlygyn'arda zhana kezhirligin'erde otup ketsener.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn elchisin eerchigender eger sogushta butparastarga betme-bet kelsen'er, alardan korkpogula zhana artyn'ardy salyp kachpagyla. Teskerisinche, tike karap bekem turgula, bet kelgenin'erge sabyr kylgyla, zhardam zhana koldoo korsotup Allakh siler menen birge.

Kim alarga artyn salyp kachsa, Allakhtyn achuusuna kachat zhana oshogo tatyktuu bolot. Akyrette anyn ordu tozok, bul al bara turgan zhana kocho turgan zhaidyn en' zhamany. Al emi kim sogushtun zhurushun ozgortuu uchun dushman kozuno kachymysh bolup ailakerik kylsa zhe bashka musulman tobuna koshuluu uchun cheginse ech nerse emes.

Oo, yimanduular, Badr kunu butparastardy ozun'ordun kuch-kubatyn'ar menen olturbodun'or, buga Allakh zhardam berdi. Ei, paigambar, alardy atkanyn'da sen ozun' atkan zhoksun', senin atkandaryn' alarga zhetip zhatkanda Allakh atkan bolchu. Munun baaryn Allakh sanynyn azdygyna karabai dushmandaryn zhen'ip, Aga shugur kyluulary zhana ushul zhakshylyk arkyluu yimanduulardy synoo maksatynda kyldy. Akyikatta, Allakh alardyn aitkandaryn zhana dubalaryn Uguuchu, alardyn kylgan ishterin zhana kantkende alarga paidaluu bolorun Biluuchu.

Zhogoruda aitylgandai butparastardy olturuun'or, alardyn kyirap, artyna kachuusuna cheiin atkyloon'or, yimanduularga berilgen dushmandaryna bolgon zhen'ish, bular Allakhtan, Allakh Islamga ailakerlik kylgan kaapyrlardyn ailasyn alsyzdatuuchu.

Ei, butparastar, eger zaalym, chekten chyguuchularga Allakh azabyn tushursun dep talap kylsan'ar, Allakh siler talap kylgan nerseni tushurdu. Munu silerge zhaza, takybalarga ornok kylyp tushurdu. Eger dagy talap kyluudan ozun'ordu tyisan'ar, bul silerge zhakshy. oshondo moonotun'ordu uzartyp, silerdi kyiratuuga shashylbait. A eger kaira talap kylsan'ar zhana yimanduular menen sogushuuga kaitsan'ar, anda zhamaatyn'ar zhana zhardamchyn'ar kanchalyk kop bolso da yimanduulardyn azdygyna karabai, zhen'ishke zhete albaisyn'ar. Akyikatta, Allakh zhardamy zhana koldoosu arkyluu yimanduular menen birge. Allakh kim menen birge bolso, aga ustomduk kyluuchu bolboit.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, paigambardy eerchigender, buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiuularynan tyiylyp Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine bash iigile. Buirugun atkarbai, tyiganyn atkaryp Aga karshy bolbogula. Silerge okulgan Allakhtyn aiattaryn ugup zhatasyn'ar go.

Oo, yimanduular, eki zhuzduulor zhana butparastarga okshosh bolbogula. Alarga Allakhtyn aiattary okulsa, alar: "Okulgan Kurandy kulaktarybyz menen uktuk" deshet. Birok, alar oi-zhugurtuu, nasaat aluu menen ugushpait zhana ukkandarynan paida alyshpait.

Zharatylgandardan zher betinde basyp zhurgondordun Allakhtyn aldyndagy en' zhamany - akyikatty kabyl kyluu menen ukpagan keren'der, (akyikatty) suilobogon duduktar, alar Allakhtyn buiruktaryna da, tyiularyna da kon'ul burushpait.

Eger bul zhalganchy butparastardan zhakshylyk bolorun bilgende, andan paida ala turgan kylyp ukturup, dalil, belgilerge akyl zhugurtturup koimok. Birok, alardan ech zhashylyk bolboosun bildi. Eger Allakh Taala buiruk zhana tagdyr zholu menen ukturup koiso dele, alar kezhirlik kylyp yimandan burulup, bash tartmak.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, paigambardy eerchigender, silerdin zhashoon'or bolgon akyikatka chakyrsa, buirugan nersesine bash iiip, tyigan nersesinen saktanyp Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine zhoop bergile. Allakh akyikatta bardyk nersege kuchu zhetuuchu ekenine bekem ishengile. Al silerdi akyikatka bash iiuudon tosup koiuuga kuchu zhetet. Aga shashylgyla zhana kyiamat kunu zhalgyz Allakhka tirilip chygaryn'arga bekem ishengile. Oshondo bul duinodo zhasagan ishterin'erge zharasha syilait zhe zhazalait.

Oo, yimanduular, aran'ardagy kunookorlorgo gana emes, alarga da, alardan bashkalarga da zhetuuchu azaptan korkkula. Bul zaalymdyk achykka chygyp, birok kaitarylbai kalganda bolot. Akyikatta, kunookorlorgo Allakhtyn azaby katuu ekenine bekem ishengile, alardyn kunoosunon saktangyla.

Oo, yimanduular, estegile, siler Mekkede az sanda elen'er, Mekke eli silerdi alsyratyp, kordoit ele. Dushmandaryn'ar silerdi tez arada tonop ketuusunon korkot elen'er. Kiiin Allakh silerge Madinany orun kylyp berdi. Badr syiaktuu sogush zherlerinde dushmanyn'ardy zhen'ildirip, silerge kuch-kubat berdi. Silerge adal, taza yrysky berdi, anyn ichinde dushmanyn'ardan algan olzholor da bar. Balkim, Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryna shugur kylsan'ar, any dagy koboitup beret.Anyn zhakshylyktaryna kaapyrlyk kylbagyla, anda any silerden alyp koiot zhana silerdi azaptait.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn elchisine eerchigender, buiruktaryn tashtoo, tyiularyn buzuu arkyluu Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kyianat kylbagyla. Din zhana bashka moiunun'arga zhuktolgon amanattarga, kylgan ishin'er kyianat ekenin bilip turup kyianat kylbagyla. Anda kyianatchylardan bolup kalasyn'ar.

Bailykty zhana bala-chakany zhakshy koruu pendeni kyianatchylykka turtoru belgiluu, oshon uchun Allakh alardy fitna, bulgun dep kabar berdi:
Oo, yimanduular, bilgile, akyikatta silerdin bailygyn'ar zhana bala-chakan'ar Allakhtyn silerge bolgon synoosu. Chynynda, alar silerdi akyret ishterinen tosot zhana kyianatchylykka alyp barat. Bilgile, Allakhtyn aldynda ulkon sooptor bar. Bailygyn'arga zhana bala-chakan'arga beriluu, alardyn aiynan kyianat kyluu sebeptuu, soop-syiyn'ardy zhogotup albagyla.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, paigambardy eerchigender, bilip algyla, egerde siler buiruktaryn atkaruu zhana tyiuularynan tyiyluu menen Allakhka takyba bolson'or, akyikat menen zhalgandy azhyrata turgan ilim beret, oshondo bul ekoo silerdi chatashtyrbai, achyk bolot. Siler but koigon kichine kunoon'ordu ochurot, chon' kunoon'ordu kechiret. Allakh chon' artykchylyktyn eesi. Anyn artykchylyktarynyn biri - pendelerinin takybalaryna daiardap koigon beiishi.

Oo, elchi, estegin, butparastar seni kamoogo, zhe olturuugo, zhe shaaryn'dan bashka shaarga kuup chyguuga aila izdep, kuuluk kylyshkanda, Allakh alardyn kuulugun ozdoruno kaitardy. Allakh da ailakerlik kylat, Allakh ailakerlerdin en' zhakshysy.

Alarga Bizdin aiattarybyz okulgan uchurda, akyikattan bash tartyp, tekeberlenip: "Buga okshogondu murda da ukkanbyz, kaalasak bul Kuran syiaktuu sozdordu biz dele aita alabyz, biz ugup zhatkan bul Kuran murdagylardyn zhalgany, buga ech ishenbeibiz" - deshet.

Oo, elchi, dagy estegin, butparastar: "Oo, Allakh, eger Mukhammad alyp kelgen nerse akyikat bolso, bizdin ustubuzgo asmandan tash zhaadyryp kyiratyp zhok kyl, zhe bizge katuu azabyn'dy zhiber" - deshti. Alar munu zhokko chygaruu zhana tanuunun cheginen chygyp aityshty.

Oo, Mukhammad, senin ummotun'du, meili alardyn arasynda daavatka zhoop beruuchusu bolsun, zhe daavat kyluuchusu bolsun, sen alardyn arasynda tiruu turup, alar seni aralarynda korup turgan uchurda Allakh alardy azaptabait. Oshondoi ele alar kylgan kunooloruno toobo kylyp, kechirim tileshse da, Allakh alardy azaptabait.

Kharam mechitine kirip tavaf kyluudan zhana namaz okuudan tosup azapka duushar kyla turgan ishke but koigon adamdardy kaisy nerse azaptan toktoto almak ele? Butparastar Allakhtyn dotoru emes, Anyn buirugun atkaryp, tyiuusunan tyiylgan takybalar gana Allakhtyn dosoru bolo alat. Birok, ozdorun Allakhtyn dosu dep eseptegen butparastardyn kobu alar Allakhtyn dostoru emes ekenin bilishpeit.

Butparastardyn Kharam mechitinin aldyndagy namazdary yshkyryk zhana kol chabuu ele. Emi ei, butparastar, Badr kunu olum zhanan tutkun boluu azabyn tatkyla. Bul azaptar silerdin Allakhka kaapyr bolup, Anyn elchisin zhalganga chygarganyn'ar uchun boldu.

Akyikatta, Allakhka kaapyr bolgondor bailyktaryn adamdardy Allakhtyn dininen tosuu uchun zhumshashat zhana kelechekte da zhumshai berishet, birok kaalaganyna zhetishpeit. Kiiin bailygynan da airylyp, maksatyna da zhetpei, bailyktaryn ushintip ishtetkeni alarga okunuch alyp kelet. Allakhka kaapyr bolgondor kyiamat kunu tozokko baryshat zhana anda tuboluk kaluuchular bolup kirishet.

Adamdardy Allakhtyn zholunan tosuu uchun bailyktaryn zhumshagan kaapyrlar tozokko baryshkanynyn sebebi, Allakh ypylas kaapyrlardy taza yimanduulardan azhyratyp zhana ypylas adamdardy, ish-araketterdi, bailyktardy birinin-ustuno birin kabattap, tozokko tashtoosu uchun. Myna oshol adamdar zyian tartuuchular; antkeni, kyiamat kunu alar ozdorun da, ui-bulosun da zyianga uchuratat.

Oo, elchi, koomun'dagy Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyr bolgondorgo ait: "Eger Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyrlygyn'ardy toktotup,Allakhka yiman keltirgenderdi Allakhtyn zholunan tosposon'or, Allakh silerdin murda kylgan kunoon'ordu kechiret. Islam murda zhasalgan kunoolordu zhok kylyp zhiberet. A eger kaapyrlygyn'ardy ulanta bersen'er, myndai adamdardy Allakh emne kylary murdagy koomdordo bolup otkon. Alar dindi zhalganga chygaryp, kaapyrlygyn ulanta bergende tez arada azapka kabylyshkan.

Oo, yimanduular, shirk zhana musulmandardy Allakhtyn dininen tosuu toktomoiuncha, din zhana bash iiuu sherigi zhok Zhalgyz Allakhka arnalmaiyncha kaapyr dushmandaryn'ar menen sogusha bergile. Eger kaapyrlar shirkterin zhana Allakhtyn zholunan tosuularyn toktotushsa, alardy tashtap koigula. Akyikatta, Allakh alardyn kylgandaryn korup turat, Aga ech nerse zhashyruun kalbait.

Eger Allakhtyn zholunan tosuusun zhana kaapyrlygyn toktotuunu buiruganyn'arda andan bash tartyshsa, anda, ei, yimanduular, Allakh silerdin zhardamchyn'ar ekenine bekem ishengile. Al bashkargandaryna en' zhakshy bashchy zhana zhardam bergenderine en' zhakshy zhardamchy. Kimdin bashchysy Allakh bolso, al utup chygat, kimdin zhardamchysy Allakh bolso, al zhen'ishke zhetet.

Oo, yimanduular, bilip algyla, Allakh zholundagy kazatta kaapyrlardan tartyp algan olzholor besh bolukko bolunot da beshten tort bolugu kazatka katyshkandarga bolunup berilet. Al emi kalgan bir bolugu dagy beshke bolunup, anyn bir bolugu Allakhka zhana Allakhtyn elchisine tiesheluu bolup, any zhalpy musulmandarga ishtetet. Ekinchi bolugu paigambarybyzdyn zhakyn tuugandary bolgon Khashim zhana Mutalibdin baldaryna berilet. Uchunchu bolugu zhetimderge, tortunchusu kolunda zhok kedei, zhakyrlarga, beshinchisi maksat kylgan zherine zhete albai ara zholdo kalgan musaapyrlarga berilet. Eger Allakhka zhana Allakh silerge dushmanyn'ardy zhen'dirip, akyikat menen zhalgandy azhyratkan Badr kunu mukhammad paigambarga tushkon nersege (Kuran aiatyna) yiman keltiruuchu bolson'or. Silerge zhardam bergen Allakh bardyk nersege kuchu zhetuuchu.

Estegile, siler Madinaga zhakyn oroondo, a butparastar bolso andan chetireek Mekke taraptagy oroondo, kerben bolso, silerden tomonurook kyzyl den'izdin zheegi tarapta bara zhatkan. Egerde siler butparastar menen Badrda zholugushuunu murdatan ubadalashyp alganyn'arda biri-birin'erge makul bolmok emessin'er. Birok, Allakh Taala silerdi ech kandai ubadasyz ele Badrda keziktirip koidu; Allakh munu bolgon ishti bolturuu b.a. yimanduulardy zhen'diruu, kaapyrlardy kordoo, dindi kubattandyruu zhana shirkti zhok kyluu, olgondordun sany da, kuchu da az yimanduulardy zhen'dirgen dalilin korgondon kiiin olturuu, tiruulordu dalildi korgondon kiiin tiruu kaltyruu uchun ushundai kyldy. Oshentip ech kimge Allakh menen talasha turgan dalili kalbady. Allakh baarynyn sozun uguuchu, kylgan ishterin biluuchu, Aga myndan ech nerse zhashyruun teide kalbait, kiiin oshogo zharasha syilait zhe zhazalait.

Oo, elchi, estegin, tushun'do butparastardy az sanda korgonun' Allakhtyn silerge kylgan zhakshylyktarynyn biri. Sen munu yimanduularga aityp, zhakshylykty suiunchulodun', dushman menen betteship, sogushuuga erk berip kuchtondurdun'. A eger Allakh senin tushun'o butparastardyn sany kop ekenin korsotkondo, sakhabalaryn'dyn erki alsyzdap, sogushtan korkup kalyshmak. Birok, Allakh myndan salamat kylyp, koigoidon saktady, alardyn sanyn Allakhtyn elchisine az kylyp korsotup koidu. Akyikatta Al zhuroktu eelegen zhana napside zhashyrylgan syrlardy Biluuchu.

Oo, yimanduular, estegile, butparastarga betme-bet kelgenin'erde Allakh alardyn sanyn silerdin kozun'orgo az kylyp korsotup, sogushka kiruugo kairat berdi. Silerdi da alardyn kozuno az korsotup, alar kaira kaituunu pikir kylbastan sogushka kirishti. Munu Allakh tagdyrga zhazylgan butparastardyn olup zhana tutkun bolup zhen'iluusun, musulmandarga dushmanyn zhen'uu zhakshylygy beriluusun ishke ashyruu uchun zhasady. Ishtin baary bir gana Allakhka kaitat. Kiiin kunookordu kunoosuno zharasha zhazalap, sooptuunun soobuna zharasha syilait.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, paigambardy eerchigender, eger kaalaganyn'arga zhetip, kaalabaganyn'ardan alys boluunu umut kylsan'ar, anda kaapyrlardyn zhamaaty menen bet kelgende, alarga zholukkanda bekem bolup, korkpogula. Allakhty koburook estep, duba kylgyla. Al silerge zhardam berip, alardy zhen'diruugo kadyr;

Sozun'ordo, ishin'erde zhana bardyk abalyn'arda Allakh zhana anyn elchisine bekem bash iigile. Ech kachan kaichy pikirde bolbogula; antkeni kaichy pikirde bolup talashuu silerdin alsyzdoon'orgo, korkuun'arga zhana kubatyn'ardyn ketuusuno sebep bolot. Dushmanyn'arga zholukkanda sabyrduu bolgula. Akyikatta, Allakh kotormolop, koldop, zhardam beruudo sabyrduular menen birge. Allakh kim menen birge bolso, al ech shegi zhok ustomduk kyluuchu zhana zhen'uuchu bolot.

Mekkeden chykkanda adamdarga korunup, tekeberlenip chykkan, adamdardy Allakhtyn dininen tosup, aga kiruugo mumkunchuluk berbegen butparastarga okshobogula. Allakh alardyn kylgan ishterin orop aluuchu, alardyn ishterinen ech biri zhashyruun kalbait, kiiin oshogo zharsha zhazalait.

Oo, yimanduular, Allakhtyn silerge kylgan dagy bir zhakshylygy, shaitan butparastarga kylgan ishterin kooz korsottu. Alardy musulmandar menen betteshuugo, sogushuuga shyktandyrdy. Alarga: "Bugun silerge ech kim ustomduk kyla albait, akyikatta men silerge zhardam berip, dushmanyn'ardan korgoim" - dedi. Kachan eki top bet kelgende, yimanduulardyn tobu menen alarga zhardam beruuchu perishteler kelishti, butparastardyn tobu menen alardy tashtap ketuuchu shaitan keldi. Oshondo shaitan artyn salyp kachty da, butparastarga: "Men silerden zhuz burdum, men yimanduularga zhardam bergeni kelgen perishtelerdi kordum, Allakh meni zhok kylyp zhiberuusunon korkom, Allakhtyn azaby katuu, Anyn azabyna ech kim chydai albait" - dedi.

Dagy estegile, eki zhuzduulor menen yimany alsyzdar: "Bul musulmandardy, dushmandyn koptuguno karabai, alsyz zhana az sanyn'ar menen zhen'ishke zhetesin'er dep ubada bergen dinderi aldap koidu" - deshti. Alar kim Allakhtyn Ozuno taiansa, zhen'ish ubada kylgan sozuno bekem ishense, akyikatta Allakh aga zhardam berip, kanchalyk alsyz bolso da karoosuz kaltyrboosuna ishenishpedi. Allakh kubattuu, aga ech kim ustomduk kyla albait, tagdyr kyluuda zhana shariiatynda daanyshman.

Oo, elchi, perishteler Allakhka zhana Anyn elchilerine kaapyr bolgondordun zhanyn algan uchurda, bet kelgenderin betine, artyn salyp kachkandaryn kochuguno urup olturup, alarga: "Ei, kaapyrlar, kuiguzuuchu azapty tatkyla" - dep aitkanyna kubo bolgonun'da kana. Eger buga kubo bolgonun'da, oto chon' ishke kubo bolot elen'.

Ei, kaapyrlar, zhanyn'ardy algandagy oorutuuchu azaptar zhana kabyryn'arda,akyretin'erde boluuchu kuiguzuuchu azaptar, bul duinodo kylgan ishin'er sebeptuu boldu. Allakh adamdarga zulum kylbait, alardyn ortosunda adilettuu okum kylat, Al adilettuu okumdar.

Bul kaapyrlarga tushuuchu azap ushularga ele tiesheluu emes, bul ar kaisy zamanda zhana mekende kaapyrlyk kylgandardyn baaryna bolup kelgen Allakhtyn sunnot zholu. Firaundun koomu zhana andan murdagy ummottor da Allakhtyn aiattaryna kaapyrlyk kylganda ushundai azapka kabylgan. Allakh alardy kunooloru sebeptuu karmady zhana azap tushurdu. Akyikatta, Allakh kuchtuu Aga ech kim ustomduk kyla albait zhana mazhburlai albait, kunookorlorgo azaby katuu.

Bul katuu azaptyn bolgon sebebi tomonkucho. Akyikatta, Allakh eger bir koomgo ozundogu zhakshylyktardan berse, alar ozdorunun yimanyn, tuz zholdo zhuruusun, zhakshylykka shugur kyluusun, Allakhka kaapyrlyk kyluuga kunoogo zhakshylykka shugur kylboogo almashtyryp zhibermeiinche kaira albait. Akyikatta Allakh pendelerinin sozun uguuchu, kylgan ishterin biluuchu, Aga andan ech nerse zhashyruun kalbait.

Bul kaapyrlardyn abaly alardan murdagy Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgan Faraon zhana bashka zhalganchy ummottordun abalyna okshosh. Allar Rabbisiin aiattaryn zhalganga chygaryshty. Anan kunoogo berilgendikteri uchun Allakh alardy talkalady. Faraondun koomun den'izge chokturup zhok kyldy. Bulardyn baary, Faraondun koomu da, alardan murdagy ummottor da Allakhka kaapyr bolgonu zhana shirk kylgany sebeptuu zaalym bolushtu. Alar ushundai azapka tatyktuu bolushtu ele alarga azapty tushurdu.

Chynynda, zher betinde kybyrap zhurgon zhanduulardyn en' zhamany Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyr bolgondor (ishenbegender). Alar kaapyrlykka oto berilgendikten, alarga ar kandai aiat-belgiler kelse da yiman keltirishpeit. Alardyn tuura zholgo tushuusuno sebep boluuchu akyly, uguu zhana koruu kasietteri tosulup kalgan.

Kuraiza uruusu syiaktuu, algach (tynch zhashoogo) ubada-kelishim kylyp, anan kaira-kaira al kelishimin buza bergender - alar, Allakhtan korkpoit, ubada-kelishiminin otoosuno chykpait, ortodo tuzulgon kelishimdi bekem saktabait.

Oo, paigambar, oshol kelishimdi buzgandar menen sogushta bet kelsen', alardy katuu zhazala. Ushunu ugup, bashkalar da oz abalyna karap, seni menen sogushuudan zhana saga achyk dushmandyk kyluudan korkup kalyshsyn.

Oo, paigambar, eger seni menen tynchtyk kelishimin tuzgondor aga kyianattyk kylyp buzuusunan korkson', sen da alarga kelishimdin zhokko chykkanyn bildirip koi. Alar da munu bilip alyshsyn. Alarga eskertpesten turup kol salba, eskertpesten kol saluu - kyianattyk. Allakh kyianat kyluuchulardy zhakshy korboit, teskerisinche, oto zhaman korot. Kyianat kyluudan sen da sak bol.

Kaapyrlar Allakhtyn zhazasynan kutulduk, andan otup kettik dep oilobosun! Chynynda, alar otup da ketken zhok, Allakhtyn zhazasynan kutulbait dagy. Allakhtyn zhazasy alardy eerchip zhurot zhana alarga zhetuuchu.

Ei,yimanduular! Kolun'ardan kelishinche askerlerin'erdi zhana kural-zhabdyktaryn'ardy daiardap koigula. Alarga Allakh zholuna mine turgan attardy daiardagyla. Ushunu menen ailanan'arda silerge koz salyp turgan Allakhtyn zhana silerdin dushmanyn'ar bolgon kaapyrlardy korkutasyn'ar. Oshondoi ele siler takyr bilbegen, silerge dushmandyk kylaryn da ali bilbegen bashka elderdi da sestentesin'er. Zhalgyz Allakh gana alardy bilet, alar ichine emneni zhashyrganyn da bilet. (Allakh zholunda) bergen azdyr-koptur napaka-sadagan'ardy Allakh bul duinodo kaitaryp beret. A akyrette bolso soop-syiyn kemitpesten toluk beret. Anyn zholunda sadaga bergenge shashylgyla!

Oo, paigambar, eger alar sogushtu tashtap, tynch zhashoogo makul bolso, sen da makul bolup, kelishimdi bekemde. Allakhka tobokel kylyp, Aga ishen, Al seni ech kachan zhardamsyz tashtabait. Al alardyn sozdorun Uguuchu, niet, amaldaryn Biluuchu.

Oo, paigambar, eger alar sogushtu tashtap, tynch zhashoogo makul boluuda, sogushka daiardanyp aluu uchun, seni aldoonu maksat kylgan bolso, alardyn aila-amalynan zhana aldamchylygynan seni saktoogo Allakh zhetishtuu. Al Allakh Ozunun zhardamy menen seni kubattandyrdy go, mukhazhir zhana ansarlardan turgan yimanduulardyn zhardamy menen seni kubattandyrdy go.

Saga zhardam bergen yimanduulardyn zhuroktorun biriktirip koidu, murda alardyn zhuroktoru chachyrandy bolchu. Sen zher beti tolo bailyk zhumshasan' da alardyn zhuroktorun biriktire almak emessin'. Allakh Zhalgyz Ozu alardyn zhurogun biriktirip koidu, antkeni, Al padyshalygynda Yzattuu, Aga ech kim ustomduk kyla albait, shariiatynda, bashkaruusunda zhana tagdyr kyluuda Okumdor.
Oo, paigambar, dushmandaryn'dyn zhamandygynan saktoogo saga Allakh zhetishtuu, yimanduularga da zhetishtuu. Allakhka ishenip, Aga suiongun.

Oo, paigambar, yimanduulardy sogushka kyzyktyr, alardyn chechkinduulugun kuchotup, kam-pikirin oigoto turgandai shyktandyr. Oo, yimanduular, eger silerden kaapyrlardyn chabuuluna sabyr kyla turgan zhyiyrma zhooker bolso, kaapyrlardyn eki zhuzuno ten' kelet. A eger myndai sabyrduulardan zhuzu bolso, kaapyrlardyn min'ine ten' kelet; sebebi, Allakhtyn dostoruna zhardam berchu zhana dushmandaryn kyiratchu adatyn kaapyrlar bilishpeit. Alar sogushuudagy maksatty da bilbeit, bolgonu duino zhashoosunda zhogoru boluu uchun sogushushat.

Oo, yimanduular, Allakh silerdin alsyzdygyn'ardy bilip, silerdin mildetin'erdi zhen'ildetti, silerge yraiym kylgany uchun ushintti. Emi silerdin biroon'orgo kaapyrlardan onu emes, ekoosu ele tuura kelet. Kaapyrlar menen sogushuuda silerden zhuz adam bolso, alardyn eki zhuzuno ustomduk kylat. A eger silerden sogushta min' sabyrduu bolso, Allakhtyn kaaloosu menen eki min' kaapyrga ustomduk kylat. Zhardam beruudo zhana koldoodo Allakh yimanduulardyn sabyrduulary menen birge.

Paigambarda olumdu koboituu uchun (musulmandar menen) sogushkan kaapyrlardyn tutkundary bolboosu kerek (b.a. kolgo tushkon tutkundar olturuluusu kerek bolchu). Bul, alar kairadan sogushpoosu uchun alardyn zhurogunun ushun almak. A siler bolso, ei, yimanduular, Badr sogushunda tutkunga tushkondorgo kun-aky alyp boshotuunu kaalaisyn'ar. Allakh bolso dinge zhardam beruu zhana any yzattuu kyluu menen zhete turgan akyretti kaalait. Allakh zatynda, sypatynda zhana kaar-kudurettuulugundo yzattuu, Aga ech kim ustomduk kyla albait. Shariiat zhana tagdyr kyluuda Okumdar, Daanyshman.

Eger Allakhtyn kaza-kadary (tagdyrlar) zhazylgan kitebinde silerge olzholor zhana tutkundardyn kun-akysy adal dep zhazylbaganda, silerge Allakhtan katuu zhaza berilmek. Antkeni, siler Allakhtan munun yktyiarduu ekendigi tuuraluu aian-kabar tusho elekte ele olzholordu olzholop, tutkundardyn orduna kun-aky tolotup boshotup zhiberdin'er.

Oo, yimanduular, emi kaapyrlardan algan olzhon'ordu zhei bergile, al silerge adal. Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaruuda zhana tyiuularynan tyiyluuda Allakhka takyba bolgula. Chynynda, Allakh yimanduu pendelerine Kechirimduu zhana alarga Yraiymduu.

Oo, paigambar, Badr sogushunda silerdin kolun'arga tutkunga tushkon mushrik tutkundarga: "Allakh silerdin zhurogun'ordogu zhakshy maksatyn'ardy zhana nietin'erdi tuzdogonun'ordu bilse, silerge ozun'ordon alyngan kun-akyga karaganda alda kancha zhakshy nerseni beret, siler uchun berilgen kun-akyga okunbogulo. Al silerdin kunoon'ordu kechiret, Allakh pendelerinen kim toobo kylsa, any Kechiruuchu zhana aga Yraiymduu" - dep ait. Chynynda, Allakh ubadasyn atkaryp, paigambardyn agasy Abbasty zhana bashka dindi kabyl kylgandardy kechirdi.

Oo, Mukhammad, a eger alar saga aityp zhatkan sozdorundo saga kyianat kyluunu maksat kylsa, alar buga cheiin Allakhka da kyianat kylyshkan, chynynda Allakh saga zhardam berdi. Alardan olgondor oldu, tutkunga tushkondor tutkunga tushtu. Eger dushmandyk kylsan'ar dagy ushundaidy kuto bergile. Allakh Ozu zharatkandardy zhana alardy emne on'doorun Biluuchu, alardy bashkaruuda Daanyshman Okumdar.

Allakhka yiman keltirgender, Anyn elchisin tastyktagandar, shariiatyn ish zhuzundo atkargandar, kaapyrlardyn shaarynan islam shaaryna, zhe Allakhka koopsuz ibadat kyluuga mumkun bolgon zherge kochup kelgender, Allakhtyn sozu biiik bolsun uchun mal-zhany menen zhikhad kylgandar zhana oshondoi ele alardy oz zhailaryna oturuktashtyryp zhardam bergender, b.a. tigi mukhazhirler (kochup kelgender) menen alardy tosup algan ansarlar (zhergiliktuulor) zhardam, kol kabysh kyluuda biri-birine dos. Al emi Allakhka yiman keltirip, birok kaapyrlardyn shaarynan Islam shaaryna kochup kele elekterge kochup keluusuno zhardam berip, kol kabysh kylsan'ar bolot, ei, yimanduular. Eger alarga kaapyrlar zulum kylyp, alar silerden zhardam surasa, dushmandarga karshy alarga zhardam bergile. Birok, alardyn dushmandary menen silerdin orton'ordo kelishim bolso, anda al kelishimdi buzbagyla (alarga zhardam berbegile). Allakh silerdin emne kylganyn'ardy Koruuchu, silerdin ish-amaldaryn'ardan ech nersesi Aga bilinbei kalbait, kiiin silerdi oshogo zharasha zhazalait.

Allakhka ishenbegenderdi kaapyrlyktary tabyshtyrgan, alar biri-birin koldoit, alarga yimanduu adam dos bolboit. Eger yimanduulardy dos zhana kaapyrlardy dushman sanabasan'ar, anda yimanduular arasynda buzukuluk bolup, dinde alarga zhardam beruuchu bir tuugandaryn'ardy tappai kalasyn'ar zhana zher betinde Allakhtyn zholunan toskon buzukuluk tarait.

Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn zholunda khizhrat kylyp kochkon'dor zhana Allakh zholunda mukhazhirlerdi tosup alyp, alarga zhardam kylgandar, myna ushular chynygy yiman sypaty menen sypattalgandar, Allakhtyn aldyndagy alardyn syilygy - kunoolorunun kechiriluusu zhana alarga chon' yryskynyn beriluusu, al - beiish.

Murda yimanga kelgen mukhazhir zhana ansarlardan kiiinireek yiman keltirgender zhana kaapyr shaarlardan Islam shaaryna kochup kelgender, Allakhtyn sozu biiik, kaapyrlardyn sozu tomon boluusu uchun Allakh zholunda zhikhad kylgandar, alar da - silerden. Ei, yimanduular, silerdin emnege ukugun'ar bolso, alardyn da oshogo ukugu bar, silerge emneni atkaruu vazhyb bolso, alarga da oshonu atkaruu vazhyb. Allakhtyn okumundo kurbandyk kyluuchular yiman zhana khizhra kyluu murasyn aluuda biri-birinen artyk bolushat. Chynynda, Allakh bardyk nerseni Biluuchu, Aga ech nerse zhashyruun emes, Al pendelerin emne on'doorun bilet zhana any alarga shariiat kylat.
Oo, musulmandar! Bul Allakh taraptan zhana Anyn Elchisi tarabynan bolgon bash tartuu zhana Arab zharym aralyndagy mushrikter menen tuzgon kelishimderdin butkondugu tuuraluu zharyia.

Ei, mushrikter! Zher betinde tort ai boiu tynch zhurgulo. Andan kiiin siler uchun kelishim da zhok, tynchtyk da zhok. Eger siler Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyp zhuro bersen'er, anda Anyn azabynan zhana zhazasynan ech kachan kutulbaisyn'ar. Myna ushunu bilgile! Allakh kaapyrlardy bul duinodo olturuu zhana tutkundoo menen kordoit zhana kyiamat kunu tozokko kirgizip kordoit. Bul nerse kelishimdi buzgandarga zhana chektelbegen moonotko kelishim kylyngandarga tiesheluu. Al emi ubaktyluu kelishim kylyngandarga, alardyn kelishimi tort aidan ashsa dagy, anyn kelishimi oz moonotuno cheiin atkarylat.
Ei, mushrikter! Zher betinde tort ai boiu tynchtykta zhurgulo.

Birok siler menen tuzgon kelishimdi atkargan zhana andan ech nerseni kemitpegen mushrikter zhogorudagy okumgo kirishpeit. Alar menen bolgon kelishimdin moonotu butkongo cheiin kelishimdi toluk atkargyla. Chyndygynda Allakh takybalardy zhakshy korot. Alar Anyn buiruktaryna bash iiip, kelishimdi atkaryshat. Oshondoi ele Anyn tyigandarynan alystap, kelishimge kyianattyk kylyshpait.

Dushmanyn'arga koopsuz bolgon yiyk aram ailary butkondo mushrikterdi zholukkan zherde olturgulo, chepterinde kamoogo algyla, zholdorun tosup an'dygyla. Egerde alar shirkti tashtap Allakhka toobo kylsa, namaz okusa, mal-mulkunon zeket berse, anda silerdin Islamdagy bir tuugandaryn'ar bolushat zhana myndai uchurda alar menen sogushpagyla. Chyndygynda, Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerine Kechirimduu zhana Yraiymduu.

Oo, paigambar! Egerde kanyn tokkongo zhana mal-mulkun tartyp alganga uruksat berilgen mushrikterden biroo zharymy saga kirip korgoo surasa, al Kurandy ugushu uchun suranychyn kabyl kyl. Andan son' any koopsuz zhaiga zhetkir. Munun sebebi kaapyrlar bul dindin baaluuluktaryn bilbegen koom. Eger alar Kuran okulganda kulak salyp oshol nerseler tuuraluu bilishse, balkim tuura zholgo tushushor.

Allakh zhana Anyn elchisinin aldynda mushrikter uchun kelishimge zhana korgoo kepildigine uruksat zhok. Oo, musulmandar! Birok Al'-Kharam mechitinin aldynda siler menen Khudaibiia tynchtyk kelishimin tuzgon mushrikterge gana uruksat. Alar orton'ordo bolgon kelishimdi buzgan zhok, siler dagy aga bekem bolgula zhana any buzbagyla. Chyndygynda Allakh pendelerinen takybalaryn zhakshy korot. Alar Anyn buiruktaryna bash iiishet zhana tyigandarynan alystashat.

Alar dushmanyn'ar bolup atsa, anan kantip alarga kelishim zhana korgoo kepildigi bolsun?! Eger alar zhen'ishke zhetishse, anda Allakhtyn aldyndagy akyn'arga da, tuugandykka da, kelishimge da karashpait. Teskerisinche, silerdi katuu azapka salyshat. Bal tilge salyp zhakshy soz menen silerdi yraazy kylabyz deshet, birok alardyn aitkan sozdoru menen zhuroktogu oiloru bashka. Alar aitkandaryn atkaryshpait zhana kelishimdi buzushkany sebeptuu alardyn kopchulugu Allakhka moiun sunushpait.

Ubadaga turuunu ozuno kamtygan Allakhtyn aiattaryn eerchuunu bul duinonun arzybagan baasyna almashtyryp zhiberishti zhana alar bul duino zhyrgalchylyktary arkyluu napsileri, shakybattary kaalagan nerselerge zhetuugo areket kylyshat. Oshonduktan akyikatty eerchuudon bash tartyshty zhana bashkalardy da akyikattan tosushtu. Alardyn kylgan ish-araketteri kandai zhaman!
Alar dushmandyk sebeptuu musulmandyn Allakh aldyndagy akysyna da, tuugandykka da, kelishimge da karashpait. Alarda dushmandyk zhana zulumduk bolgon uchun Allakhtyn chekterinen chygyp ketishti.

Eger alar kaapyrlyktan Allakhka kaityshsa, kuboluk kelmeni aityshsa, namaz okushsa, mal-mulkunon zeket berishse, anda alar musulman bolushat. Osholor dindegi bir tuugandaryn'ar. Siler kandai ukukka ee bolson'or, alar da oshondoi ukukka ee. Silerge alar menen sogushuuga bolboit. Alar Islamdy kabyl alyshkany uchun alardyn kany, mal-mulku, ar namysy korgolot. Bilgen adamdar uchun aiattardy achyktap baiandaibyz. Myna osholor aiattardan paida alyshat, bashkalarga da paida berishet.

Belgiluu bir moonotko cheiin sogushpaibyz dep siler menen kelishim tuzgon mushrikter kelishimderin zhana ubadalaryn buzushsa, dinin'erdi aiyptashsa zhana kemsintse, anda alar menen sogushkula. Alar kaapyrlyktyn zhol bashchylary. Alardyn kanyn toguunu tyigan ech kandai ubada da, kelishim da zhok. Alardyn kaapyrlygyn zhok kylysh maksatta, oshondoi ele kelishimderdi buzushup, dindi kemsintkenderi uchun alar menen sogushkula.

Oo, yimanduular! Emnege siler kelishim zhana ubadalaryn atkarbagan adamdar menen sogushpai zhatasyn'ar? Alar paigambardy Mekkeden chygarysh uchun "Daar an-Nadva (zhyiyn uiundo)" chogulush uiushturushtu zhana alar paigambardyn onoktoshu Khuzaa uruusuna karshy Kuraishtyn onoktoshu Bakr uruusuna zhardam berip silerge karshy sogushtu birinchi bashtashty. Alar menen sogushuuga emnege bet albadyn'ar, alardan korktun'arby?! Egerde chyndap yimanduu bolson'or, Allakh taaladan gana korkkonun'ar en' tuura bolot.

Oo, yimanduular! Mushrikter menen sogushkula! Eger alar menen sogushsan'ar, Allakh alardy silerdin kolun'ar menen azaptait, alardy zhen'iluu zhana tutkundoo menen kordoit, alarga karshy zhardam berip silerdi ustom kylat, oshondoi ele sogushka katyshpai kalgan yimanduulardy alardyn dushmandary kabylgan olum, tutkundoo, zhen'iluu zhana Allakhtyn yimanduulardy koldoosu menen kokuroktorundogu darttaryn aiyktyrat.

Yimanduular mushrikterdin ustunon zhen'ishke zhetishkendigi sebeptuu Allakh alardyn zhuroktorunon achuulanuunu ketiret. Allakh oshol karshy chykkandardyn kaalaganynyn toobosun kabyl kylat, eger alar Mekkeni bagyntkanda anyn elinin kee birleri toobo kylgan syiaktuu toobo kylyshkan bolso. Allakh alardyn kimisi chyndap toobo kylganyn Biluuchu. Al - zharatuusunda, bashkaruusunda zhana shariiatty okum kyluusunda Daanyshman.

Oo, yimanduular! Allakh silerdi synoosuz tashtap koiot dep oilodun'arby?! Synoo - Allakhtyn zholdorunun bir zholu. Aran'ardan Allakh uchun gana sogushkan pendelerin anyk bilgenge cheiin synalasyn'ar. Alar Allakhty, Anyn Elchisin zhana yimanduulardy tashtap kaapyrlardan syrdash dos tutushkan zhok, alardan zhakyn dos kutup zhakshy korushkon zhok. Allakh silerdin kylyp zhatkanyn'ardy bilet. Ech bir nerse Aga zhashyruun emes zhana Al kylgan ishterin'erge zharasha syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Mushrikter uchun Allakhtyn mechitterin ibadattar menen zhandantuuga uruksat emes! Alar kaapyrlykta ekendikterin achyk ele ozdoru yrastashty. Alardyn kylgan ish-araketteri zhokko chygaryldy. Sebebi anyn kabyl kylynuu sharty bolgon yiman atkarylgan zhok. Eger alar olum kelgenge cheiin shirkke toobo kylyshpasa, anda alar kyiamat kunu tozokko kirishet, al zhaida tuboluk kalyshat.

Chyndygynda mechitterdi zhandantuuga zhana anyn akysyn atkaruuga - zhalgyz Allakhka yiman keltirgen, Aga ech kimdi sherik kylbagan, kyiamat kununo ishengen, namaz okugan, mal-mulkunon zeket bergen, Allakh taaladan gana korkkon adamdar gana tatyktuu. Balkim myna osholor tuura zholgo tushkondor. Al emi mushrikter bolso bul nerseden ushunchalyk alys.

Ei, mushrikter! Azhylardy suusunduk menen kamsyz kylgan zhana Al'-Kharam mechitinin kyzmatyndagy adamdardy -- Allakhka yiman keltirgen, Aga ech kimdi sherik kylbagan, kyiamat kununo ishengen, Allakhtyn sozu uluk bolush uchun, kaapyrlardyn sozu tomon bolush uchun oz zhanyn zhana bailygyn aiabastan sogushkan adamdarga ten'ep zhatasyn'arby? Allakhtyn aldynda alardy artykchylyk zhaktan birdei kylyp koidun'arby?! Alar Allakhtyn aldynda ech ubakta birdei emes! Shirk kylgan zalymdarga Allakh iigilik berbeit, eger alar azhylardy suusunduk menen kamsyz kylgan syiaktuu zhakshylyk ishterdi kylyshsa dagy.

Allakhka yiman keltiruunu, kaapyr olkodon islam olkosuno kochuunu, zhany zhana bailygy menen Allakh zholunda sogushuunu chogu atkargan adamdar -- Allakhtyn aldynda bashkalarga karaganda en' biiik darazhada bolushat. Ushul sypattarga ee bolgon oshol adamdar beiishke zhetishet.

Alardyn Rabbisi Allakh Oz yraiymynan zhana alarga sozsuz yraazy bolgondugunan alardy kubandyrgan nerselerdi kabarlady. Al alarga ech kachan achuulanbait. Alar beiishterge kirgende alar uchun tugonbogon tuboluk yrakhattar bolot.

Alar bul duinodo kylyshkan zhakshylyk ishterinin syilygy katary myna oshol beiishterde tuboluk kalyshat. Chyndygynda dindi Allakh uchun chyn yklastan tutunup Allakhtyn buiruktaryna bash iigen zhana tyigandarynan tyiylgan adamdar uchun Allakhtyn aldynda uluu sooptor bar.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirgender zhana paigambar alyp kelgen nersege eerchigender! Atalaryn'arga, bir tuugandaryn'arga zhana zhakyn tuugandaryn'arga yimanduulardyn syrlaryn achyp, alar menen ken'eship alardy zhakyn tutpagyla. Alar zhalgyz Allakhka yiman keltiruudon kaapyrlykty artyk korushtu. Kim alardy kaapyrlygyna karabastan zhakyn tutsa, alardy zhakshy korso, anda al Allakhka kunookor boldu zhana kunoosu sebeptuu ozuno ozu zyian kyldy.

Oo, paigambar! Yimanduularga ait: <<Egerde silerdin atalaryn'ar, baldaryn'ar, bir tuugandaryn'ar, aialdaryn'ar, tuugandaryn'ar, ishtep tapkan bailygyn'ar, kiresheluu bolushun kaalap, zyian tartuudan korkkon sooda-satygyn'ar, zhashagan zhagymduu uilorun'or, myna ushulardyn baarysy siler uchun Allakhtan, Anyn elchisinen zhana Allakh zholunda sogushuudan da suiuktuu bolso, anda Allakhtyn silerge zhibere turgan zhazasyn kutkulo. Allakh Ozu yraazy bolgon ishterde Aga moiun sunbagandarga iigilik berbeit.

O, yimanduular! Butparas dushmandaryn'arga karshy chykkanyn'arda, sanyn'ardyn azdygyna, daiardygyn'ardyn nachardygyna karabai Allakh Taala kop sogushta silerge zhardam berdi. Al kezderde Allakhka tobokel kylgansyn'ar zhana sebepterin atkargansyn'ar, koptugun'orgo manchyrkagan emessin'er. Mushrikterdi zhen'gen zhen'ishin'er silerdin koptugun'ordon ulam bolgon zhok. Al emi Khunain sogushu bolgon kunu, siler koptugun'orgo manchyrkap: "Bugun biz zhen'ilbeibiz, biz koppuz" dedin'er. Siler manchyrkagan koptugun'or silerge paida berbedi. Dushmanyn'ar silerge ustomduk kyldy. Kenen zher silerge tar bolup, dushmanyn'ardan zhen'ilip artka kachtyn'ar.

Siler dushmandan kachkandan kiiin Allakh Oz elchisinin zhuroguno beipildik tushurdu zhana yimanduulardyn zhuroguno da tushurdu. Oshondo alar sogushka kairattuu turushtu zhana siler korbogon perishtelerdi tushurdu. Alar kaapyrlyk kylgandardy olturuu, tutkunga tushuruu, mal-mulktu tartyp aluu zhana aial, bala-chakan'ardy tutkun menen azaptashty. Alarga berilgen myna ushul zhaza -- Allakhtyn elchisine tushkon nerseden bash tartkan zhana any zhalganga chygargan kaapyrlardyn zhazasy.

Oshondoi azaptoodon kiiin kim kaapyrlyktan zhana adashuudan toobo kylyp kaitsa, anda Allakh anyn toobosun kabyl kylat. Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerine Kechirimduu. Kaapyrlyktan zhana kunoo kylgandan kiiin toobo kylyp Allakhka kaitkan pendelerine Meerimduu.

Oo, Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirgender zhana anyn shariiatyn eerchigender! Chyndygynda mushrikter ypylas. Antkeni alarda kaapyrlyk, zulumduk, ters sypattar zhana zhaman adattar bar. Myna ushul zhyldan kiiin (khizhriidin 9-zhyly) alar azhylykka zhe umraga kelishse da, alar yiyk Mekkege zhana anyn ichindegi Al'-Kharam mechitine kirishpeit. Ei, yimanduular! Egerde alar taraptan silerge kelgen azyk-tuluk zhana turduu sooda-satyktar toktop kalyp zhakyrlykka kabylabyz dep korkson'or, anda Allakh kaalasa silerge Oz zhakshylygy menen zhetishtuu bolot. Chyndygynda Allakh silerdin abalyn'ardy Biluuchu zhana silerge bolgon bashkaruusunda Daanyshman.

O, yimanduular! Ech sherigi zhok Allakhka zhana kyiamat kununo yiman keltirbegen, oshondoi ele olumtuk, chochkonun eti, spirt ichimdikteri, sutkorluk syiaktuu Allakh zhana Anyn elchisi aram kylgan nerselerden tyiylbagan, Allakh shariiat kylgan nerselerge bash iibegen (zhoot zhana khristiandardan bolgon) kaapyrlar menen alar kor bolup, oz koldoru menen salyk tologongo cheiin sogushkula!

Chyndygynda zhoottor da, khristiandar da mushrikter. Zhoottor Uzeirdi Allakhtyn balasy deship Aga sherik kylyshty. Al emi khristiandar Mariiamdyn balasy Isany Allakhtyn balasy deship Aga sherik kylyshty. Alar ozdoru oilop tapkan myna oshol zhalgan sozdu alar ech kandai dalili zhok ele oozdoru menen aityp koiushtu. Alardyn bul aitkan sozu alarga cheiinki mushrikterdin <<chyndygynda perishteler - Allakhtyn kyzdary>> dep aitkan sozuno okshosh. Allakh bul nerseden biiik. Allakh alardy kyiratsyn! Alar kantip achyk chyndykty tashtap zhalganga ketip zhatyshat?!

Zhoottor menen khristiandar Allakhty kaltyryp ozdorunun aalymdaryn zhana kechilderin "kudai" kylyp alyshty. Al "kudailary" Allakh aram kylgan nerselerdi adal, Allakh adal kylgan nerselerdi aram kylyp berdi. Khristiandar Mariiamdyn uulu Isany Allakh menen bir katar "kudai" kylyp alyshty. Allakh zhoottordun aalymdaryna da, khristiandardyn kechilderine da, oshondoi ele Uzair menen Mariiamdyn uulu Isaga da zhalgyz Ozuno gana ibadat kylgyla, Aga ech kimdi sherik kylbagyla dep buirugan. Allakh Taala zhalgyz Kudai, Andan bashka ibadat kyluuga tatyktuu zat zhok. Allakh Taala mushrikter (butparastar) zhana bashka oshol syiaktuular aitkan "sherigi bar" degen aiyptan Aruu, Taza.

Kaapyrlar zhana kaapyrlyk zholun zholdogondor ushundai zhalgan zhalaalardy zhabuu menen zhana Mukhammad alyp kelgen nerseni zhalganga chygaruu menen Islamdy zhok kyluunu zhana any zhokko chygaruunu kaalashat. Andagy kelgen Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygy zhana paigambar alyp kelgen nerseler akyikat ekendigi tuuraluu achyk-aikyn dalilderdi zhokko chygaryshat. Allakh taala sozsuz Oz dinin toluktait, achykka chygarat zhana bashkalardan ustom kylat. Kaapyrlar Allakhtyn dinin toluk bolushun, achykka chygyshyn zhana ustom bolushun kaalashpasa dagy Allakh any toluktait, achykka chygarat zhana ustom kylat. Egerde Allakh bir ishti kaalasa, anda bashkalardyn kaalooloru zhokko chygat.

Allakh taala Oz elchisi Mukhammaddy Kuran menen zhiberdi. Oshondoi ele kaapyrlar zhaman korushso da dinde kelgen dalilder zhana okumdor arkyluu any bashka dinderden ustom kylysh uchun akyikat din bolgon Islam dini menen zhiberdi.

Oo, yiman keltirgender zhana Allakhtyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Chyndygynda zhoottordun kopchuluk aalymdary zhana khristiandardyn kopchuluk kechilderi adamdardyn mal-mulktorun shariiat uruksat berbegen zholdo alyshat. Alar parakorluk zhana bashka zholdor menen alyshat, oshondoi ele adamdardy Allakhtyn dinine kiruudon tyiyshat. Ei, paigambar! Altyn-kumushtu zhyinap alyp, parz bolgon zeketti berishpegen adamdarga kyiamat kunundo alardy okundurgon zhan oorutkan azapty kabarla!

Kyiamat kunu alar chogultkan zhana akysyn berbegen nerseleri tozok otuna kyzytylat. Kachan choktoi kyzarganda alardyn man'dailaryna, kaptaldaryna zhana arkalaryna basylat zhana alarga eskertuu ireetinde: <<Myna bul siler zhyinagan zhana mildet akylaryn berbegen bailyktaryn'ar. Emi zhyinagan zhana akysyn berbegen nersen'erdin akybetin korgulo, azabyn tatkyla>> - dep aitylat.

Chyndygynda zhyl ichindegi ailardyn sany Allakhtyn okumundo zhana tagdyrynda on eki ai. Allakh obolu asmandar menen zherdi zharatkanda munu tagdyr kitebinde bekemdegen. Bul on eki aidyn ichindegi tort aiynda Allakh sogushuunu tyigan. Alar katar kelgen zul'-kaada, zul'-khizhzha, mukharram ailary zhana ozuncho kelgen razhab aiy. Zhyl ichindegi ailardyn sany zhana alardyn tortoosundo sogushuu tyiylgan dep aitylgan myna ushul nerseler - tuura din. Andyktan bul yiyk ailarda sogushup, anyn yiyktygyna shek keltirip ozun'orgo ozun'or zulumduk kylbagyla. Bardyk mushrikterdin siler menen sogushkandai siler dagy alar menen baaryn'ar sogushkula. Bilgile, Allakh Oz koldoosu zhana bekem kyluusu menen Anyn buiruktaryn atkargan, tyigandaryn tashtagan takyba adamdar menen birge. Kim Allakh menen birge bolso, any ech kim zhen'e albait.

Karan'gylyk doorunda arabdar kylgandai yiyk aidyn yiyktyk okumun yiyk emes aiga zhyldyruu zhana anyn ordularyn almashtyruu alardyn Allakhka kylgan kaapyrlygyna kaapyrlyk koshup koboitot. Antkeni alar Anyn yiyk ailar tuuraluu okumuno kaapyrlyk kylyshty. Shaitan alarga bul zhaman zholdu taap berip ushul arkyluu Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandardy adashtyrat. Alar bir zhyly yiyk aidy yiyk emes ailardyn biri menen orun almashtyryp, any yiyk emes kylyshsa, kiiinki zhyly oshol ele aidy Allakh yiyk kylgan ailardyn sanyna tuura kelish uchun yiyk boidon kaltyryshat. Kaisy aidy yiyk emes kylyshsa, anda anyn orduna sozsuz bashka aidy yiyk kylyshat. Munu menen alar Allakh yiyk kylgan ailardy yiyk emes kylyshyp, Anyn okumuno karshy chygyshat. Shaitan alarga zhaman ishterdi zhakshy kylyp korsottu, alar any atkaryshty. Oshondoi ele alar oilop tapkan ailardyn ordun almashtyruu da ushul nerselerden. Allakh kaapyrlyktan koshorup kaitpagan kaapyrlarga iigilik berbeit.

Oo, Allakhka zhana Anyn Elchisine yiman keltirgender zhana Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Silerge emne boldu, Allakhtyn zholunda dushmanyn'arga karshy sogushkula dep aitylsa kybyrap kaldyn'ar, uiun'ordo ele bolgun'ar kelip kaldy? Allakh zholunda sogushkandarga daiardalgan tuboluk akyret zhyrgalchylyktarynan da bul ubaktyluu duino zhashoosunun zhyrgalchylyktaryn yraa kordun'orbu? Akyret zhyrgalchylyktarynyn zhanynda bul duinonun zhyrgalchylyktary ech nersege arzybait. Akyly bar adam kantip ubaktyluunu tubolukko, arzybagan nerseni uluu nersege almashtyrsyn'?!

Oo, yimanduular! Egerde siler dushmanyn'arga karshy sogushuuga chykpai turgan bolson'or, anda Allakh silerdi zorduk-zombuluk, korduk zhana bashka zholdor menen zhazalait. Egerde alardy sogushka chakyrsa da alar kachyshsa, anda Allakh alardyn orduna Ozuno moiun sungan koomdu alyp kelet. Siler Allakhka karshy chyguu menen Aga ech zyian alyp kelbeisin'er. Al silerge muktazh emes. Siler Aga muktazhsyn'ar. Allakh bardyk nersege kudurettuu. Any ech bir nerse alsyratpait. Al Ozunun dinin zhana paigambaryn silersiz ele zhen'ishke zhetkirip koiot.

Oo, yimanduular! Egerde Allakhtyn elchisine zhardam berbesen'er zhana Allakh zholunda sogushkula degen chakyrygyna zhoop berbesen'er, mushrikter paigambar menen Abu Bakrdy kuup chykkanda Allakh aga silersiz ele zhardam bergen. Al ekoosu kaapyrlardan Khira unkuruno zhashynyshkanda alardy izdeshti. Abu Bakr Allakhtyn Elchisin korup kalat eken dep kabatyr bolgondo al dosuna: <<Kapalanba! Chyndygynda Allakh biz menen birge. Al koldoit zhana zhardam beret>> - dep aitty. Allakh Oz elchisinin zhuroguno beipildik ornottu zhana alarga korunbogon perishtelerden bolgon askerlerdi zhiberdi. Alar aga zhardam berishti. Allakh Islamdy kotoruu menen Ozunun sozun biiik kyldy, mushrikterdin sozun tomon kyldy. Allakh Oz Zatynda, bagyntuusunda zhana biiliginde kubattuu. Any ech kim zhen'e albait. Oshondoi ele Al bashkaruusunda, shariiatynda zhana tagdyr kyluusunda daanyshman.

Oo, yimanduular! Kyiynchylyk zhana bakubatchylykta, zhashtyk zhana karylykta Allakh zholunda sogushuuga bargyla zhana oz zhanyn'ar zhana mal-mulkun'or menen sogushkula. Myna oshol silerdin sogushka baruun'ar zhana mal-zhanyn'ar menen sogushkanyn'ar bul duinodo da, akyrette da silerdin barbai koigonun'arga zhana mal-zhanyn'ardyn amandygyn oilogonun'arga karaganda silerge koburook paida alyp kelet. Egerde munu bilsen'er anda aga umtulgula.

Oo, paigambar! Senden sogushka barbai ele koiolu dep uruksat suragan eki zhuzduulorgo siler chakyrgan nersede on'oi olzholor zhana mashakatsyz zhol zhuruu bolgondo alar seni sozsuz eerchishmek. Birok siler dushmanga karai basyp oto turgan aralyk alarga alys korungonu uchun sogushka barbai koiushtu. Sogushka barbai ele koiolu dep uruksat suragan myna oshol eki zhuzduulor sen kaityp kelgende kasam ichiship: <<Egerde biz dagy siler menen sogushka baruuga chamabyz zhetkende sozsuz barmakpyz>> - dep aityshat. Alar sogushka baryshpagany zhana ushundai zhalgan anttary sebeptuu ozdorun Allakhtyn zhazasyna duushar kylyp kyiratyshty. Allakh alar aitkan sozdorundo zhana ushul anttarynda zhalganchylar ekenin bilet.

Oo, paigambar! Alarga sogushka barbai koiuuga uruksat beruu tuuraluu senin kylgan chechimin'di Allakh kechirdi. Emnege sen alarga bul nersede uruksat berdin'? Myndai kylganyn'dyn sebebi alardyn aitkan shyltoolorunda kimisi chynchyl, kimisi zhalganchy ekenin achyk bilip, anan oshogo zharasha alardyn chynchyldaryna uruksat berip, zhalganchylaryna uruksat berbeiin dedin'bi?

Oo, paigambar! Allakhka zhana kyiamat kununo chyndap yiman keltirgender uchun mal-zhandary menen Allakh zholunda sogushka barbai koiuuga uruksat suroo alardyn kylar ishi emes. Teskerisinche alardy sogushka chakyrgan kezde alar mal-zhandary menen chygyp sogushuulary kerek. Allakh takyba pendelerin zhakshy bilet. Alar seni menen sogushka baruuga toskool bolgon kechirimduu sebepter bolgondo gana senden uruksat surap kelishet.

Oo, paigambar! Senden sogushka barbai koiuuga uruksat suragandar - Allakhka zhana kyiamat kununo yiman keltirbegen eki zhuzduulor. Alardyn zhuroktorundo Allakhtyn dini tuuraluu shek bar. Alar oz shekterinde akyikat zholgo tushushpoi temselep adashyp zhurushot.

Egerde alar siler menen Allakh zholunda sogushka chyguunu kaalaibyz degen sozdorundo chynchyl bolushkanda, anda alar sozsuz sogushka daiardyk korushmok. Birok Allakh alardyn seni menen baruusun zhek kordu. Oshonduktan alar uchun sogushka baruu oor bolup, uilorundo kaluunu yraa korushtu.

Alardyn sogushka barbai koiuulary yimanduulardy kaigyga salgandyktan, Allakh alardyn sogushka baruusu barbai kaluularyna karaganda zyianduuraak ekendigin yimanduularga eskertip soorottuu. Anan myndai dedi:
Oshol eki zhuzduulordun siler menen baryshpagany da zhakshy. Eger siler menen baryshsa, anda silerdi buzup, zhardamsyz tashtashat, shek salyshat zhana silerdi bolup zharysh uchun aran'arga kirip ushak-aiyn'dardy tarkatuuga araket zhasashat. Ei, yimanduular! Aran'arda alar tarkatkan zhalgandarga kulak salgandar bar. Alar any tuura kabyl alyp, bashkalarga aityshsa, aran'arda talash-tartyshtar zharalat. Allakh yimanduulardyn arasyna shekterdi, aram oilordu tashtagan eki zhuzduulordon bolgon zaalymdardy bilet.

Myna oshol eki zhuzduulor Tabuk sogushunan aldyn musulmandardyn sozun bolup, birimdigin ydyratyp alardy buzuuga araket kylyshty. Ei, paigambar! Alar aila-amaldardy koldonuu menen saga ishterdi ar kandai kylyp korsotushup, alardyn aila-amaldary senin sogushuuga bolgon chechimin'e taasir etet dep oiloshtu. Akyry Allakhtyn zhen'ishi zhana koldoosu keldi. Alar zhaman korushso dagy Allakh Oz dinin kubattuu zhana dushmandaryna ustom kyldy. Antkeni alar akyikattyn ustunon zhalgandyn zhen'ishin kaalashkan ele.

Eki zhuzduulordun arasynda zhalgan shyltoolordu taap: <<Oo, Allakhtyn elchisi! Maga uruksat ber, sogushka barbai ele koioiun. Seni menen baruuga mazhbur kylba. Antkeni men dushmandyn (Rimdin) aialdaryn korgon kezde alarga azgyrylyp kunoogo batyp kalyshym mumkun>> - degender bar. Alar ozdoru oilogondon da chon' azgyrykka kabylyshty. Al - eki zhuzduuluk zhana sogushka barbashtyn azgyrygy. Kyiamat kunundo tozok kaapyrlardy chulgap alat. Andan ech kim kachyp kutulbait zhana andan kachyp chyguu mumkun emes.

Oo, paigambar! Egerde saga Allakh taraptan seni kubandyrgan zhen'ish zhe olzho syiaktuu zhakshylyktar zhetse, anda alar zhaman korushup, kon'uldoru chogot. A eger senin bashyn'a kataaldyk zhe dushmandan zhen'iluu syiaktuu kyiynchylyktar tushso, eki zhuzduulor aityshat: <<Biz oz zhanybyzdy saktap kaldyk. Biz musulmandarga koshulup sogushka barbaibyz dep chechkinduuluk kyldyk. Emi alar bolso tutkunga tushushtu, olumgo duushar bolushtu>>. Andan son' al eki zhuzduulor aman kaldyk dep suiungon boidon uiloruno kaityp ketishti.

Oo, paigambar! Oshol eki zhuzduulorgo ait: <<Allakh bizge tagdyr kylgan nerse gana bolot. Al bizdin bashchybyz, bizdin bash kalkaloochubuz, biz bardyk ishibizde Aga gana taianabyz. Yimanduular bardyk ishin zhalgyz Aga gana tapshyryshat. Al alarga zhetishtuu zhana en' zhakshy kamkorchu>>.

Oo, paigambar! Alarga aitkyn: <<Siler bizdin zhen'ishke zhetishibizdi zhe sheiit bolushubuzdu kutup atasyn'arby? Biz bolso Allakh silerge Oz tarabynan azaptyn tushurushun kutup zhatabyz. Al bizge siler menen sogushuuga uruksat bergende silerdi bizdin kolubuz menen azaptatyp zhana kyiroogo uchuratyp tutkanga tushurot zhe olumgo duushar kylat. Biz kandai natyizhaga zheteribizdi kutkulo, biz da silerdikin kutobuz>>.
Oo, paigambar! Alarga aitkyt: <<Mal-dunuion'du mazhbur zhe yktyiarduu sadaka kylgyla. Birok kaapyrlygyn'ar zhe Allakhka bash iibegenin'er uchun silerdin sadakan'ar ech kachan kabyl kylynbait>>.

Sadakalarynyn kabyl bolushuna uch nerse gana toskool boldu: Allakh zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyrlyk kylyshty; namaz okuganda zhalkooluk zhana kosh kon'ulduk kylyshty; alar mal-dunuiosun ozdoru kaalap emes, mazhbur turdo sadaka kylyshty. Antkeni alar okugan namazdarynda zhana sadaka beruudo soop umut kylyshpait.

Oo, paigambar! Eki zhuzduulordun mal-mulktoruno zhana bala-chakalaryna suktanba, zhakshy dep da oilobo. Alardyn mal-mulktorunun zhana bala-chakalarynyn akybeti zhaman. Allakh bular menen alardy azapka salat. Alarga kyinalyp, charchap zhetishet zhana kaigy-baleelerge tush kylat. Bul nerse Allakh alardy kaapyr abalda zhandaryn alganga cheiin ulanyp, alar tozoktun tubundo tuboluk azaptalyshat.

Oo, yimanduular! Eki zhuzduulor silerge kasam ichiship: <<Biz silerdenbiz>> - dep zhalgan aityshat. Birok alar ozdorun syrtynan silerdenbiz dep korsotushso da ichterinde silerden emes. Birok alar mushrikter kabylgan olumgo, tutkunga tushuu syiaktuu nerselerge kabylbaily dep korkushat. Oshonduktan korkkonu uchun ozdorun musulmanbyz dep korsotushot.

Egerde oshol eki zhuzduulor ozdoru korgono turgan sepil tabyshsa, zhe toolordo zhashyryna turgan unkurlordu tabyshsa, zhe kirip saktana turgan zher astyndagy zholdordu tabyshsa, anda alar al zhakka dalbastap kirishmek.

Oo, paigambar! Sen sadakalardy bolushturgondo oz kaalagandaryna zhetpei kalgan eki zhuzduulor seni aiyptai bashtashat. Egerde alardyn suraganyn bersen', anda yraazy bolushat. A eger alardyn suraganyn berbesen', anda naarazy bolup kun'kuldoi bashtashat.

Seni sadakalardy tuura emes bolushturdun' dep aiyptagan oshol eki zhuzduulor, Allakh alarga parz kylgan nersege zhana paigambar bergen nersege yraazy bolushup: <<Bizge Allakh zhetishtuu. Allakh bizge Oz zhakshylygynan kaalaganyn beret zhana Anyn elchisi da Allakh aga bergen nerseden bizge beret. Chyndygynda Allakh Ozu bizge zhakshylyktaryn beret dep umut kylabyz>> - deship ushundai kylyshsa, anda bul nerse seni aiyptagandaryna karaganda alar uchun zhakshyraak bolmok.

Alar Allakhtyn elchisin sadakalardy tuura emes bolushturdun' - dep aiyptashkanda, Allakh elchisin korgop, anyn kimderge berile turgandygyn baiandap myndai dedi:
Chyndygynda parz zeketter muktazh kedeilerge berilishi kerek. Alardyn ishtegen ishi zhe kesibi menen tapkan akchasy bar bolso da alarga zhetpeit, alardyn al-akybaldaryn adamdar zhakshy bilishpeit. Oshondoi ele kolunda zhok zhana aitkan sozunon zhe shartynan ele adamdarga belgiluu bolgon zhakyrlarga berilet. Oshondoi ele bashchy zeket chogultkula dep zhibergen zhumushchularga berilet. Oshondoi ele kaapyrlardy Islam dinine tartysh uchun zhe yimany alsyzdardyn yimanyn kotorush uchun zhe zyianynan korgosh uchun berilet. Oshondoi ele kuldardy azat kylysh uchun, ysyrapsyz zhana kunoosuz zholdo karyz bolup karyzynan kutuluuga karazhat tappagandarga berilet. Zhookerlerdi Allakh zholundagy sogushka daiardoogo zhana akchasy tugonup kalgan musapyrga berilet. Zeketterdi myna ushularga beruu Allakh taraptan parz boldu. Allakh pendelerine emne paidaluu ekenin Biluuchu, shariiatynda zhana bashkaruusunda Daanyshman.

Eki zhuzduulordun arasynda sozu menen paigambarga zyian bergender bar. Alar anyn toktoolugun korup: <<Al ar bir adamdan ukkanyna ele ishene beret. Akyikat menen zhalgandy aiyrmalai albait>> - deshet. Ei, paigambar! Alarga aitkyn: <<Chyndygynda paigambar zhakshylykty gana ugat, Allakhka ishenet zhana chynchyl momundardyn aitkandaryna ishenet, alarga yraiym kylat. Chyndygynda anyn paigambar bolup zhiberilishi aga yiman keltirgender uchun yraiym. Al emi aga ar kandai turdo zyian bergender uchun zhan oorutkan azap bar>>.

Oo, yimanduular! Silerge eki zhuzduulor Allakhka kasam ichiship paigambarga zyian bere turgandai ech nerse aitkan zhokpuz deshet. Alar munu silerdi yraazy kylysh uchun aityshat. Birok Allakh zhana Anyn elchisin yraazy kyluu tatyktuuraak, eger yiman keltirip zhana zhakshylyk ishterdi kylyp chynygy yimanduu bolushsa.

Eki zhuzduulor bul kylgan ishi menen Allakh zhana Anyn elchisine dushmandyk kylyp zhatyshkanyn zhana al ekoosuno dushmandyk kylgandar kyiamat kunu tozok otuna kirip al zhaida tuboluk kalysharyn bilishpeibi?! Bul zhetken korduk zhana kemsintuu.

Eki zhuzduulor zhuroktorundo zhashyrgan kaapyrlykty Allakh Oz elchisine suroo tushuruu menen yimanduularga bildirip koiobu dep korkushat. Oo, paigambar! Alarga aitkyn: <<Ei, eki zhuzduulor! Dindi shyldyn'dap kemsintkenin'erdi ulanta bergile! Allakh suroo tushurup zhe paigambaryna al tuuraluu kabar berip siler korkkon nerseni achykka chygarat>>.

Oo, paigambar! Eki zhuzduulor yimanduulardy sogup kemsintkenderi tuuraluu Allakh saga kabar bergenden kiiin alardan bul tuuraluu surasan': <<Biz any chyn aitkan emespiz, zhon ele tamashalap aityp koigonbuz>> - deshet. Ei, paigambar! Alarga aitkyn: <<Siler Allakhty, Anyn aiattaryn zhana elchisin shyldyn' kyldyn'arby?!>>.

Zhalgan aktanuun'ardy aityp kechirim surabai ele koigula! Siler kaapyrlykty zhashyryp zhurup bul shyldyn'yn'ardan kiiin achykka chygardyn'ar. Biz silerdin kee birin'erdi eki zhuzduuluktu tashtap, toobo kylyp, Allakhka yklastuuluk kylyshkany uchun kechirebiz. Kee birin'erdi eki zhuzduulukton kaitpagany, aga toobo kylbagany uchun azaptaibyz.

Eki zhuzduulor - bular eki zhuzduulukto birikken erkekter zhana aialdar. Alar yimanduularga karshy bolushkan adamdar. Alar zhamandykka chakyryp, zhakshylyktan tyiyshat, mal-mulktoruno saran'dyk kylyp Allakh zholuna sarptashpait. Alar Allakhka moiun sunuudan bash tartyshty, Allakh da alarga iigilik beruudon bash tartty. Chyndygynda eki zhuzduulor - Allakhka bash iibegender, akyikat zholdu tashtap, adashuu zholuna tushkondor.

Allakh toobo kylbagan eki zhuzduulor menen kaapyrlardy tuboluk kala turgan tozok otuna kirgizet. Al alardy zhazaloogo zhetishtuu. Allakh alardy Oz yraiymynan alystatty zhana alar uchun tugonbogon azaptar bar.

Ei, eki zhuzduulor zhamaaty! Siler kaapyrlykta zhana shyldyn' kyluuda silerden murun kelgen zhalganchy koomdorgo okshoshsun'ar. Alar silerden da kuchtuu, bai zhana bala-chakaluu ele. Alar bul duino zhyrgalchylyktarynan alarga zhazylgan oz nasipterin paidalanyshty. Ei, eki zhuzduulor! Silerden murunku zhalganchy koomdor oz nasipterin paidalanyshkan syiaktuu siler dagy tagdyryn'ardagy oz nasibin'erdi paidalandyn'ar. Alar akyikatty zhalganga chygaryp, oz paigambarlaryn zhamanatty kylyshkandai siler dagy alarga okshop akyikatty zhalganga chygaryp, paigambardy zhamanatty kyluuga kirip kettin'er. Oshondoi ters sypattagy adamdar - Allakhtyn aldynda kaapyrlyk kylyp ish-araketteri buzulgan adamdar. Osholor ozdorun kyiroogo uchuratkandar.

Al eki zhuzduulorgo zhalganchy koomdordun zhana alarga kandai zhaza berilgendigi tuuraluu kabar zhetken zhokpu?! Alar Nukhtun koomu, Khuddun koomu, Salikhtin koomu, Ibrakhimdin koomu, Madiian eeleri zhana Luttun koomu. Alarga paigambarlary achyk-aikyn dalilder menen kelishti. Allakh alarga zulumduk kylgan zhok. Alarga paigambarlary eskertishti. Birok alar Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyshyp, paigambarlardy zhalganga chygaryshkany sebeptuu ozdoruno zyian kylyshty.

Yimanduu erkekter menen aialdardyn ortosun yiman biriktirgeni uchun alar biri-birin koldoshot zhana zhardamdashat. Alar zhakshylykka chakyryshat zhana aga Allakhty zhalgyzdoo, namaz okuu syiaktuu Allakh taala suigon bardyk ibadattar kiret. Alar zhamandyktan tyiyshat zhana aga kaapyrlyk, sutkorluk kyluu syiaktuu Allakh taala zhaman korgon kunoolor kiret. Oshondoi ele alar namazdy toluk atkaryshat, Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine moiun sunushat. Oshondoi zhakshy sypattarga ee adamdardy Allakh Oz yraiymyna zhetkiret. Chyndygynda Allakh kudurettuu. Any ech kim zhen'e albait. Al Oz zharatuusunda, bashkaruusunda zhana shariiatynda Daanyshman.

Allakh taala yiman keltirgen erkekter menen aialdardy kyiamat kunu beiishterge kirgizuunu ubada kyldy. Andagy kan sarailardyn aldylarynan daryialar agyp turat. Alar al zhaida tuboluk kalyshat, ech kachan olushpoit zhana alardyn zhyrgalchylyktary butpoit. Oshondoi ele alardy beiishtegi en' sonun turak zhailarga kirgizuunu ubada kyldy zhana Allakhtyn alarga bolgon yraazylygy bulardyn baarysynan uluk. Bul aitylgan syilyk - ech bir zhen'ish ten' kelbegendei uluu zhen'ish.

Oo, paigambar! Kaapyrlarga karshy kylych menen sogush! Eki zhuzduulorgo karshy tilin' menen zhana dalil menen sogush! Bul eki topko kataal bol! Alar oshogo tatyktuu. Kyiamat kunu alardyn barar zhaiy tozok bolot. Alardyn barar zhaiy kandai zhaman!

Eki zhuzduulor zhalgan kasam ichiship, alardyn seni sokkondugu zhana dinin'di kemsintkendigi tuuraluu saga zhetken sozdordu aitkan zhokpuz dep chygyshat. Sen ukkan sozdordu alar aityshkany anyk. Bul alardy kaapyr kyldy zhana alar yiman keltirgenden kiiin kaapyr bolushtu. Alar paigambardy zhok kylabyz dep iigiliksiz ishke araket zhasashty. Ishke ashpai turgandy ishke ashyrabyz deshti. Al emi Allakh bolso alardy Ozunun paigambaryna bergen olzholor menen baiytyp alarga zhakshylyk kyldy. Egerde alar Allakhka toobo kylyshyp eki zhuzduulukton kaityshsa, anda alardyn toobosu alardyn oshol nersede bolgondugunan zhakshyraak. A eger alar Allakhka toobo kyluudan bash tartyshsa, anda Al alardy bul duinodo olturuu zhana tutkundoo menen zhan oorutkan azapka salat. Al emi akyrette tozok otu menen kyinap azatpait. Alardy azaptan kutkargan ech bir dos bolboit zhana alardy azaptan alystatkan ech bir zhardamchy da bolboit.

Eki zhuzduulordun kee birleri Allakhka ubada berip: <<Egerde Allakh bizge Oz zhakshylyktaryn bergende, anda biz muktazhdarga sozsuz zhardam bermekpiz zhana zhakshy ishterdi kylgan zhakshy adamdardan bolmokpuz>> - deshet.
Kachan Allakh alarga Oz zhakshylyktaryn bergende, alar Allakhka bergen ubadalaryn atkaryshpady. Teskerisinche, malk-mulktorun berishpei ech sadaka kylyshpady zhana yimandan zhuz burup ketishti.
Allakh alardyn akybetin kyiamatka cheiin zhuroktorundo ozgorboi turgan eki zhuzduuluk kylyp koidu. Bul zhaza alar Allakhka bergen ubadany buzup zhalgan aityshkandary sebeptuu boldu.

Eki zhuzduulor Allakh alardyn chogulushtarynda zhashyruun kylgan aila-amaldaryn bilbeit dep oiloshobu? Chyndygynda Allakh kaiyptardy Biluuchu. Alardyn ar bir kylgan ishi Aga belgiluu. Al uchun alardy zhakynda zhazalait.

Yimanduulardyn arasynda tapkany az bolso dagy oz yktyiary menen sadaka kylgandaryn aiyptap: <<Bulardyn sadakasy emne paida bermek ele?>> - dep shyldyn' kylgandardy Allakh da zhaza katary alardy shyldyn'dady zhana alar uchun zhan oorutkan azap bar.

Oo, paigambar! Alar uchun kechirim sura zhe suraba, sen zhetimish iret surasan' da, alardyn koptugu alardy ech kachan Allakhtyn kechirimine zhetkirbeit. Antkeni alar Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyrlyk kylyshty. Allakhtyn shariiatynan atailap chygyp ketkenderge akyikatka zhetuugo iigilik berbeit.

Kee bir eki zhuzduulor paigambarga karshy chygyp Allakh zholundagy Tabuk sogushuna barbai koiushkandary uchun suiunushtu. Alar yimanduular syiaktuu Allakh zholunda oz zhandaryn zhana mal-mulktorun aiabastan sogushuunu zhaktyryshpady. Alar ozdorunun eki zhuzduu tuugandarynyn zholun tosup: <<Myndai ysykta barbai ele koigula>> - deshti. Tabuk sogushu kun ysyk uchurda bolgon. Ei, paigambar! Alarga aitkyn: <<Eger alar bilishse, eki zhuzduulordu kutup zhatkan tozok otu alar kachyp zhatkan bul ysyktan da katuu>>.

Sogushka barbagan oshol eki zhuzduulor bul ubaktyluu duino zhashoosunda az kulup, tuboluk akyret zhashoosunda kop yilashsyn. Bul alardyn kylgan kaapyrlygy, kunooloru zhana zhamandyk ishterinin zhazasy bolot.

Oo, paigambar! Eger Allakh seni oshol eki zhuzduulukton kaitpagan eki zhuzduulordun tobuna kaira kaitarsa zhana alar seni menen emki sogushtarga baraly dep uruksat surashsa, alarga ait: <<Ei, eki zhuzduulor! Siler meni menen ech kachan Allakh zholundagy sogushka barbaisyn'ar. Bul silerdin zhazan'ar zhana siler menen bolgonumdagy zyiandardan bolgon saktyk. Oshondo siler Tabuk sogushuna barbagandy zhaktyrdyn'ar. Emi sogushka barbagan oorukchandar, aialdar zhana zhash baldar menen kalgyla>>.

Oo, paigambar! Eki zhuzduulordun olgondoruno ech kachan zhanaza okuba, al uchun kechirim surap murzosundo duba kylyp turba. Antkeni alar Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyrlyk kylyshty zhana Allakhka bash iibei olushtu. Kim ushundai bolso, anda aga zhanaza da okulbait, duba da kylynbait.

Oo, paigambar! Seni al eki zhuzduulordun bailyktary zhana bala-chakalary suktandyrbasyn. Chyndygynda Allakh alardy bul duino zhashoosunda ushul nerseler menen azaptoonu kaalait. Alarga zhetuu uchun oor mashakattardy tartyshat zhana alar sebeptuu kyiynchylyktarga kabylyshat. Oshondoi ele alardy kaapyr bolgon abalda zhandary chyguusun kaalait.

Egerde Allakh Ozunun paigambary Mukhammadga "Allakhka yiman keltirgile zhana Allakh zholunda sogushka bargyla" degen buirugun kamtygan suroo tushurso, anda alardyn arasyndagy bailary seni menen sogushka barbai ele koiolu dep uruksat surap: <<Bizdi zhon ele koichu. Biz alsyzdar zhana oorukchandar syiaktuu uzurluu adamdar menen chogu kalaly>> - deshet.

Al eki zhuzduulor kechirimduu sebepterden ulam sogushka barbagandar menen sogushtan kaluunu kaalashkan kezde ozdoruno kordukdu zhana tomonduktu yraa korushtu. Allakh alardyn kaapyrlygy zhana eki zhuzduulugu uchun zhuroktoruno moor basty. Emi alar kaisy nerse alarga paidaluu ekenin bilishpeit.

Al emi paigambar zhana any menen birge bolgon yimanduular alarga okshop Allakh zholundagy sogushka barbai koiushkan zhok. Alar oz zhandaryn zhana mal-mulktorun aiabastan Allakh zholunda sogushushtu. Alardyn Allakhtyn aldyndagy syilyktary - zhen'ishke zhetuu, olzho aluu syiaktuu duinoluk paidalarga zhetuu boldu zhana oshondoi ele akyrettik paidalarga zhetuu boldu, misaly beiishke kiruu, kozdogon maksatka zhetuu zhana korkkon nerseden kutuluu.

Allakh alarga kan sarailarynyn aldylarynan daryialar akkan beiishterdi daiardap koidu. Alar al zhaida tuboluk kalyshat. Ech kachan zhok bolushpait. Bul syilyk - bir dagy iigilik ten' kelbegendei chon' iigilik.

Medinalyk zhana anyn ailanasyndagy arabdardyn bir tobu Allakhtyn elchisine shyltoolorun aityp Allakh zholundagy sogushtan kaluuga uruksat surap kelishti. Al emi bashka bir tobu uruksat surabastan ele kalyp kalyshty. Antkeni alar paigambarga ishenishpeit zhana Allakhtyn ubadasyna yiman keltirishpeit. Alar zhakynda bul kaapyrlyktary sebeptuu zhan chydagys azapka tush bolushat.

Al emi aialdar, zhash baldar, oorukchandar, alsyzdar, sokurlar zhana sogushka daiardyk koruugo ech kandai karazhat tappagan kedeiler syiaktuu adamdar sogushka bara albai kalyshsa kunookor bolushpait. Antkeni alardyn uzurluu sebepteri bar. Egerde alar Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine chyn yklastuu bolushsa, Anyn shariiatyn atkaryshsa, anda zhakshylyktardy kylyshkan myndai kechirimduu sebepteri bar adamdardyn zhazalanyshyna ech kandai zhol berilbeit. Allakh zhakshylyk kyluuchulardyn kunoolorun Kechiruuchu, alarga Meerimduu.

Oo, paigambar! Oshondoi ele senden uloo taap berishin'di surap kelishkende sen alarga: <<Siler minip barganga ech kandai uloo tappai koidum>> - dep aitkanyn'da alar artka burulup, sen taraptan zhe ozdorunun zhanynan sarptaganga ech nerse tappai kalganyna okunup, yilagan boidon artka kaityp sogushka seni menen bara albai kalgandar da kunookor bolushpait.

Uzurluu sebepteri bar adamdarga ech kandai zhaza zhok ekenin achyk aitkandan kiiin kim zhazaloogo tatyktuu ekenin aitty: <<Ei, paigambar! Chyndygynda zhaza senden sogushtan kaluuga uruksat surap kelgenderge berilet. Antkeni alardyn daiardyk koruugo toluk mumkunchuluktoru bar bolchu. Birok alar ozdoruno tomonduktu zhana korduktu yraa korup, sogushka barbagandar menen uilorundo kalyshty. Allakh alardyn zhuroktoruno moor basty. Emi alarga nasaat da taasir berbeit. Alar bul moor sebeptuu tandaiyn deshse emne paidaluu ekenin bilishpeit, alystaiyn deshse emne zyianduu ekenin bilishpeit>>.

Musulmandar sogushtan kaityp kelishkende sogushka barbagan eki zhuzduulor alarga negizsiz shyltoolordu aityp bashtashat. Allakh Ozunun paigambaryn zhana yimanduulardy alarga zhoop kyldyrtyp aitat: <<Zhalgan shyltoon'ordu aityp aktanbai ele koigula. Silerdin aitkan sozun'orgo ishenbeibiz. Allakh bizge silerdin kokurogun'ordogu nerselerdi bildirdi. Allakh zhana Anyn elchisi korup turat. Siler toobo kylasyn'arby, Allakh toobon'ordu kabyl kylsyn zhe eki zhuzduuluk kylyp zhuro beresin'erbi? Kiiin bardyk nerseni bilgen Allakhka kaitasyn'ar, oshondo Al kylgan ishin'erden kabar beret zhana al uchun syilyk zhe zhazan'ardy beret. Andyktan toobo kyluuga zhana zhakshy ishterdi atkaruuga shashylgyla>>.

Oo, yimanduular! Siler al eki zhuzduulorgo kaityp kelgenin'erde alar zhalgan shyltoolorun tastyktap Allakhka kasam ichishet. Munu silerdin zhemen'erge kalbash uchun kylyshat. Alardy achuulanyp tashtagyla zhana mamile kylbagyla. Akyikatta alar ichi buzuk ypylastar. Alardyn barar zhaiy tozok bolot. Bul alardyn kylgan eki zhuzduuluktoru menen kunoolorunun zhazasy.

Oo, yimanduular! Al eki zhuzduulor silerdi yraazy kylysh uchun zhana alardyn shyltoolorun tuura kabyldoon'or uchun silerge kasam ichishet. Alarga yraazy bolbogula! Alardan yraazy bolgonun'ar Rabbin'erge karshy chykkanyn'ar. Chyndygynda kaapyrlyk zhana eki zhuzduuluk kylyp Aga bash iibegen adamdarga Allakh yraazy bolboit. Ei, musulmandar! Allakh yraazy bolbogon adamdarga yraazy boluudan sak bolgula!

Kochmon arabdar eger kaapyrlyk zhe eki zhuzduuluk kylyshsa, anda alardyn kaapyrlygy zhergiliktuu arabdardyn kaapyrlygynan da kuchtuu zhana alardyn eki zhuzduulugu tigilerdin eki zhuzduulugunon da kuchtuu bolot. Alar dinden taptakyr kabary zhok. Alar paigambarga tushkon parzdardy, sunnottordu, okumdordun zhol-zhobolorun uironuugo tatyktuu. Antkeni alardyn tabiiatynda oroiluk, odonoluk bar zhana adamdar menen kop aralashkan emes. Allakh alardyn abaldaryn Biluuchu. Aga anyn baary belgiluu. Al Oz bashkaruusunda zhana shariiatynda Daanyshman.

Choldo zhashagan adamdardyn arasynda Allakh zholunda bergen mal-mulktu chygasha zhe zhogotuu dep oilogon eki zhuzduulor da bar. Alar sadaga bersem soop bolboit, berbei koisom Allakh zhazalabait dep oiloit. Birok, keede aga karabastan, elge korunuu uchun zhe korkkonunan ulam sadaga beret. O, yimanduular! Alar silerge zhamandyk kaalap, silerden kutuluunu samait. Allakh alardyn yimanduularga kaalap zhatkan arty zhakshylykka alyp barbai turgan zhamandygyn zhana zamandyn oomaluulugun yimanduulardyn bashyna emes, teskerisinche, alardyn ozunun bashyna tushurot. Allakh alardyn aitkanyn Uguuchu, zhashyrganyn Biluuchu.

Choldo zhashagandardyn arasynda Allakhka zhana akyretke yiman keltirgenderi bar. Alar Allakh zholunda bergen mal-mulktu Allakhka zhakyndatkan ibadattardan zhana paigambardyn batasy menen kechirim dubasyna zhetish uchun kylyshat. Albette anyn Allakh zholunda bergen sadakasy zhana paigambardyn aga kylgan dubasy any Allakhka zhakyndatkan ibadattardan. Zhakynda anyn soobun Allakhtyn aldynda alat. Allakh any Oz kechirimin zhana beiishin kamtygan cheksiz yraiymyna kirgizet. Chyndygynda Al toobo kylgan pendelerine Kechirimduu, Yraiymduu.

Oz mekenin tashtap Allakhka karai kochkon mukhazhirlerden en' aldyn'ky bolup yimanga shashylgandardan, paigambardy koldoshkon ansarlardan zhana oshondoi ele ishenimde, sozdordo, ish-araketterde en' aldyn'kylardan bolup yimanga kelishken mukhazhirler menen ansarlardy eerchigenderden Allakh yraazy boldu, alardyn atkargan ibadattaryn kabyl kyldy. Alar dagy Allakhtan yraazy bolushtu. Antkeni Al alarga uluu sooptordu berdi zhana alar uchun kan sarailarynyn aldylarynan akkan daryialary bar beiishterdi daiardap koidu. Alar al zhaida tuboluk kalyshat. Myna ushul syilyk - en' chon' iigilik

Medinaga zhakyn zhashashkan kochmon arabdardyn arasynda eki zhuzduulor bar. Oshondoi ele medinalyktardyn arasynda da eki zhuzduulor bar. Alar eki zhuzduulukton kaityshpait. Ei, paigambar! Sen alardy bilbeisin', alardy Allakh bilet. Zhakynda Allakh alardy eki zholu azaptait, birinchisi bul duinodo alardyn eki zhuzduulugun achuu, alardy olturuu zhana tutkunga aluu menen bolot, ekinchisi akyrette kabyrda azaptaluu, andan son' kyiamatta tozoktun en' tubundo chon' azapka saluu menen bolot.

Medinalyktardyn arasynda kee bir adamdar bar. Alar sogushka sebepsiz ele barbai koiushkan. Alar munu moiundaryna alyshat. Alar zhalgan shyltoolorun aityp kelishken zhok. Alar Allakhka moiun sunuu, Anyn shariiatyn karmanuu zhana Anyn zholunda sogushuu syiaktuu murun kylyshkan zhakshylyk ishterin zhaman ishter menen aralashtyryp zhiberishti. Alar Allakhtan toobolorun kabyl kyluusun, alardy kechiruusun umut kylyshat. Chyndygynda Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerine Kechirimduu, alarga Meerimduu.

Oo, paigambar! Sen alardyn mal-mulktorunon zeket al. Bul alardy kunoolordun kirlerinen tazalait, zhakshylyktarynyn koboiushuno sebep bolot. Alardan zeketti algandan kiiin alarga duba kyl. Chyndygynda senin duban' alar uchun yraiym zhana beipildik. Allakh senin duban'dy Uguuchu, alardyn kylgan ishterin zhana nietterin Biluuchu.

Sogushka barbai koigondor zhana Allakhka toobo kylgandar bilishsin, Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerinin toobosun kabyl kylat zhana Al sakadakalardy da kabyl kylat. Birok Al aga muktazh emes. Sadaka bergen adamga sadakasy uchun soop beret. Chyndygynda Allakh taala toobo kylgan pendelerinin toobosun kabyl kyluuchu, alarga Yraiymduu.

Oo, paigambar! Myna oshol sogushka barbai koigondorgo zhana kunooloruno toobo kylgandarga ait: <<Oshol ketirgen zhogotuunun ordun toluktagyla, ar bir ishti Allakh uchun chyn yklastan kylgyla, Any yraazy kylgan ishterdi atkargyla. Myna oshondo Allakh, Anyn elchisi zhana yimanduular silerdin kylgan ishterin'erdi korushot. Siler kyiamat kunu baaryn bilgen Rabbin'erge kaitasyn'ar.
