Oshondo Al siler zhashyrgan zhana aitkan nerselerdin baarysyn bildiret. Bul duinodo kylgan ishterin'erdin kabaryn beret zhana silerdi al uchun syilait zhe zhazalait>>.

Tabuk sogushuna barbai koigondordun kee birinin ech kandai sebepteri bolgon emes. Myna osholorgo Allakhtyn okumu kechiktirilet. Allakh alarga Ozu kaalagandai okum chygarat, eger toobo kylyshpasa alardy azaptait, a eger toobo kylyshsa toobolorun kabyl kylat. Allakh zhazaga zhana kechirimge tatyktuulardy Biluuchu, Oz shariiatynda zhana bashkaruusunda Daanyshman. Al emi al adamdar - Murara ibn ar-Rabii, Kaab ibn Malik zhana Khilal ibn Umeiia.

Eki zhuzduulordun arasynda dagy ushundai adamdar bar, alar Allakhka bash iibestik uchun mechit kurushtu. Alar munu musulmandarga zyian berish uchun, eki zhuzduulordu kubattandyruu menen kaapyrlykty achykka chygarysh uchun, yimanduulardy bolup zharysh uchun, oshondoi ele mechit kurulganga cheiin Allakh zhana Anyn elchisi menen dushmandashkandardy kutup, sogushka kamdanuu uchun gana kurushtu. Oshol eki zhuzduulor silerge kasam ichiship: <<Bizdin kozdogonubuz - musulmandarga zhakshylyk kaaloo gana bolchu>> - deshet. Alar bul aitkan sozdorundo zhalganchylar ekenine Allakh Ozu kubo.

Oo, paigambar! Eki zhuzduulor seni ushul sypattagy mechitte namaz okuuga chakyrsa, alarga zhoop berbe! Chyndygynda kaapyrlyktyn ustuno kurulgan bul mechitke karaganda tee bashynan ele takybalyktyn ustuno kurulgan Kubaa mechitinde namaz okuganyn' artygyraak. Kubaa mechitinde ypylastyktan zhana daaratsyzdyktan suu menen tazalangandy, oshondoi ele kechirim suroo zhana toobo kyluu menen kunoolordon tazalangandy suigon erkekter bar. Allakh daaratsyzdyktan, ypylastyktan zhana kunoolordon tazalangandardy zhakshy korot.

Allakhtyn yraazylygyn kozdop koptogon zhakshylyk ishterdi zhasap, Anyn buiruktaryna bash iiip, tyigandaryn tashtoo menen Aga bolgon takybalyktyn ustuno imarat kurgan adamdar - musulmandarga zyian berish uchun, kaapyrlykty kuchotush uchun zhana yimanduulardy bolup zharysh uchun mechit kurgan adamdar menen kantip ten' bolushsun?! Alar ech kachan ten' bolushpait! Birinchisi kynalyp kurulgan bekem imarat syiaktuu. Any kulap kalat dep korkpoisun'. Al emi tiginisi bolso zhardyn kyryna salyngan imarat syiaktuu. Al akyry buzulup kulait. Oshonu menen al imaraty tozoktun tubuno urap tushot. Allakh kaapyrlyk zhana eki zhuzduuluk kylgan zalymdardyn ishterin on'unan chygarbait.

Alar zyian berish uchun kurushkan mechiti zhuroktorundo ochpogon eki zhuzduuluk boidon kala berdi. Bul abal alar kylych menen olturulup zhe olum kelip zhuroktoru tytylyp ketkenge cheiin ulanat. Allakh pendeleri kylgan ishterin Biluuchu zhana zhakshylykka syilyk, zhamandykka zhazany okum kyluuda Daanyshman.

Allakh sogushka barbai koiushkan eki zhuzduulordun anyk zhuzun achyp korsotkondon kiiin Anyn zholunda sogushkandardyn syilygyn aityp myndai dedi:
Chyndygynda yimanduulardyn zhandary Allakhtyn mulku bolso dagy Al Oz aikoldugu menen beiishti berip alardyn zhandaryn kymbat baaga satyp aldy. Antkeni alar Allakhtyn sozu biiik bolush uchun kaapyrlar menen sogushtu. Alar kaapyrlardy olturushtu zhana kaapyrlardyn kolunan olushtu. Bul uchun Allakh alarga Musanyn kitebi Tooratta, Isanyn kitebi Inzhilde, Mukhammaddyn kitebi Kuranda chynygy ubada berdi. Al emi ubadany atkaruuda Allakhtan otkon ech kim zhok. Ei, yimanduular! Allakh menen kylgan soodan'arga suiungulo! Siler bul arkyluu chon' kireshe taptyn'ar. Myna ushul soodan'ar - en' chon' iigilik.

Myndai syilykka arzygandar - alar Allakh zhaman korgon zhana Anyn kaaryn zharatkan nerselerdi tashtap Al suigon zhana yraazy bolgon nerselerge kaitkandar. Alar Allakhtan korkup, Al uchun zhonokoi bolup ozdorun kor tutushkandar, Aga moiun sunuuda bolgon araketin kylyshkandar, bardyk abalda Rabbisine shugur kylgandar, orozo tutkandar, namaz okugandar, Allakhtyn zhana Anyn elchisinin buiruktaryna chakyrgandar, Allakhtyn zhana Anyn elchisinin tyiuularynan kaitargandar, Allakhtyn okum-buiruktaryn atkargandar, tyiuularyn tashtagandar. Ei, paigambar! Myna ushul sypattarga ee bolgon yimanduulardy bul duinodo zhana akyrette kubanychka sala turgan kabardy zhetkir.

Mushrikter shirk kylyp olgonu sebeptuu tozokko tushoru anyk bolgondon kiiin alar yimanduulardyn zhakyn tuugandary bolushsa da paigambar menen yimanduularga alar uchun Allakhtyn kechirimin suroogo bolboit.

Ibrakhim oz atasy uchun Allakhtyn kechirimin surashyshy - al uchun sozsuz kechirim suraimyn degen ubadasy sebepten gana bolgon. Any musulman bolot dep umuttongon. Ibrakhimdin aitkan nasaaty atasyna ech paida berbegeni zhe Allakh taraptan any kaapyr bolup olot degen aiandy bilgeni sebeptuu al Allakhtyn dushmany ekeni aga maalym bolgondo al andan bash tartty. Al uchun Allakhtan kechirim suragany - Allakh aga aian kylgan okumdon korkkonu uchun emes, ozu taraptan bolgon chechimden ulam bolgon. Chyndygynda Ibrakhim Allakhka kop zhalbargan zhana zalym elin kop kechirgen adam ele.

Adamdarga tashtash mildet bolgon aram nerselerdin baaryn Allakh baiandap berip tuura zholgo salgandan kiiin alardy adashty dep okum beruusu mumkun emes. Eger alar Allakh aram kylgan nerselerdi baiandagandan kiiin kylyshsa, anda alarga adashty dep okum beret. Chyndygynda Allakh baaryn bilet. Andan ech nerse zhashyruun emes. Akyikatta al silerge bilbegenin'erdi uirottu.

Chyndygynda zherdegi zhana asmandardagy butkul mulk Allakhka gana taandyk. Al ekoosundo Aga ech kim sheriktesh emes zhana andagy ech bir nerse Aga zhashyruun emes. Al kimdi kaalasa tiriltet, kimdi kaalasa olturot. Ei, adamdar! Silerdin ishin'erdi zhongo salgan Allakhtan bashka bashkaruuchu zhok zhana dushmanga karshy silerge zhardam bergen, silerdi zhamandyktan korgogon koldoochu zhok.

Allakh Mukhammad paigambardyn toobosun kabyl kyldy. Antkeni al eki zhuzduulorgo Tabuk sogushuna barbai koiuuga uruksat berip koigon ele. Oshondoi ele mukhazhirler menen ansarlardyn da toobolorun kabyl kyldy. Alar sogushtan kalyshkan zhok. Teskerisinche, alar katuu ysykka, karazhattyn azdygyna, dushmandyn kuchtuuluguno karabastan any menen baryshty. Birok ara zholdo kataal kyiynchylyktarga tush bolgondo alardyn kee toptorunun zhuroktoru sogushtan kaityp ketuugo yktady. Andan son' Allakh alarga kairattanuuga zhana sogushka baruuga iigilik berdi zhana toobolorun kabyl kyldy. Chyndygynda Allakh alarga Kichipeiil zhana Meerimduu. Alarga toobo kyluuga mumkunchuluk berip, toobolorun kabyl kyluusu da - Anyn yraiymduulugunan.

Allakh bul uch adamdyn toobolorun da kabyl kyldy. Alar Kaab ibn Malik, Murara ibn ar-Rabii zhana Khilal ibn Umeiia. Alar paigambar menen Tabuk sogushuna barbai koiushkandan kiiin kylgan toobolorunun kabyl kylynuusu kechiktirilgender. Oshondon kiiin paigambar adamdarga alar menen mamileni uzuunu buirudu. Bul sebeptuu alardy kaigy-tuishuk basyp, akyry alar uchun ken' zher da taryp ketti, zhalgyzdyktan kokuroktoru sygylyp ketti. Oshondo alar uchun zhalgyz Allakhtan bashka bash kalkalar ech kim zhok ekenin bilishti. Allakh alarga toobo kyluuga mumkunchuluk berip yraiym kyldy, kiiin toobolorun kabyl kyldy. Chyndygynda Al pendelerinin toobolorun kabyl kyluuchu, alarga Yraiymduu.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirgender, paigambardy eerchigender zhana Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandarynan alystoo menen Allakhtan korkkula! Yimandarynda, sozdorundo zhana ishterinde chynchyl adamdar menen birge bolgula! Siler uchun chyndyktan bashkada ech kutuluu zhok.

Paigambar ozu bash bolup Allakh zholunda sogushka chyksa, anda medinalyktar zhana anyn ailanasynda zhashagan kochmon arabdar uchun andan kaluuga uruksat zhok. Alar uchun oz zhandaryn aiap, any paigambardyn zhanynan da kastarloogo bolboit. Teskerisinche alar uchun paigambardyn zhanynan da oz zhandaryn kurman kyluu mildet. Munun sebebi eger alar chan'koogo, charchoogo, Allakh zholunda achkalykka kabylyshsa, zhe kandaidyr bir zherge konushup, alardyn oshol zherde bolushu kaapyrlardyn kyzhyryn kainatsa, zhe dushmandyn kolunan olumgo duushar bolup, zhe tutkundalyp, zhe olzhogo ee bolup, zhe zhen'iluu yzasyn tartyshsa, anda bul sebeptuu Allakh alarga sozsuz kabyl kylyngan zhakshylyk ishtin soobun zhazat. Chyndygynda Allakh zhakshylyk kyluuchulardyn soobun zhok kylbait. Teskerisinche, alarga toluk kylyp zhana koboitup beret.

Az bolso da, kop bolso da alar mal-mulk sarptashsa zhana kaisy bir oroondu basyp otushso, anda Allakh alardyn sarptagany zhana kylgan sapary uchun alarga syilyk katary sooptordu zhazat zhana akyrette kylgan ishterine en' zhakshy sooptordu beret.

Yimanduulardyn but baary sogushka ketuusuno uruksat zhok. Antkeni alar dushmanga zhen'ilip kalyshsa, anda tukum kurut bolup ketuuloru mumkun. Andyktan alardyn bir bolugu sogushka ketip, bir bolugu paigambar menen birge kalgany, andan shariiat okumdorun zhana Kurandan ukkany arkyluu dindi teren' uironushup, kiiin adamdar sogushtan kaityp kelishkende uirongon nerselerin alarga uirotushkonu zhakshy emespi?! Balkim alar Allakhtyn azabynan zhana zhazasynan korgonushar, Anyn buiruktaryna bash iiip, tyigandarynan tyiylyshar. Bul okuia Allakhtyn elchisi sakhabalarynan kee birlerin ozu tandap, cholgo zhoortulga zhibergen askerlerde bolgon.

Allakh taala yimanduulardy ailanasyndagy kaapyrlar menen sogushuuga buirudu. Antkeni alardyn yimanduularga zhakyn turushkany alar uchun korkunuch tuudurushu mumkun. Oshondoi ele alardy korkunuch salyp, zhamandyktaryn aldyn alysh uchun alarga kuch-kubattuuluktu zhana kairattuuluktu korsotuulorun buirudu. Allakh taala Oz zhardamy zhana koldoosu menen takyba yimanduular menen birge.

Egerde Allakh Oz elchisine suro tushurso, eki zhuzduulordun kee birleri maskara shyldyn' kylyshyp: <<Mukhammadga tushkon bul suroo kimin'erdin yimanyn'ardy koboitup zhiberdi?>> - suroo tashtashat. Al emi suroonun tushushu Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn elchisine ishengenderdin yimandaryna yiman koshot zhana tushkon vakhii sebeptuu alar kubanychka batyshat. Antkeni bul nersede alar uchun duinoluk zhana akyrettik paidalar bar.

Al emi okumdordu zhana okuialardy kamtygan Kurandyn tushushu eki zhuzduulordun oorusuna ooru, buzukuluguna buzukuluk koshot. Sebebi alar tushkon nerseni zhalganga chygaryshty. Oshonduktan Kurandyn tushushu koboigon saiyn alardyn zhuroktorundogu ooru da koboiot. Antkeni alar ar bir tushkon nersege shektenishti zhana kaapyrlykta olushtu.

Allakh eki zhuzduulordun abalyn zhana eki zhuzduuluktorun ar zhyly bir zhe eki zholu achykka chygaryp alardy synap zhatkanyn korup sabak alyshpaiby?! Myna oshonu kylyp zhatkan Allakh ekenin bilishkenden kiiin da kaapyrlyktaryn tashtap Aga toobo kylyshpady, eki zhuzduuluktorun da tashtashpady zhana alardyn bashyna tushkon nerse Allakh taraptan bolso da sabak alyshpady.

Egerde Allakh Oz elchisine eki zhuzduulordun abaldary tuuraluu aitylgan suroo tushurso, eki zhuzduulor biri-birin karap: <<Silerdi ech kim korgon zhokpu?>> - dep surashat. Eger alardy ech kim korboso, anda al zherden tarap ketishet. Allakh alardyn zhuroktorun tuura zholdon zhana akyikattan burup koidu zhana alar tushunbogon koom bolushkan sebeptuu alardy zhardamsyz kaltyrdy.

Ei, arabdar! Silerge ozun'ordon bolgon paigambar keldi. Al dagy silerge okshogon ele arab. Silerge mashakat zharatkan nerse any da mashakatka salat. Al tuura zholgo tushushun'ordu ushunchalyk kaalait zhana silerge oto kamkor. Airykcha yimanduularga oto kichipeiil zhana meerimduu.

Oo, paigambar! Egerde alar senden zhuz burup ketishse zhana sen alyp kelgen nersege yiman keltirishpese, anda alarga ait: <<Ozunon bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu zat bolbogon Allakh maga zhetishtuu. Zhalgyz Aga gana taianam. Al uluu Arshtyn Rabbisi>>.

(lr) Alif, Lam, Ra. Ushuga okshogon aiattyn tushundurmosu bakara suroosunun bashynda aitylgan. Bul suroodogu okulgan myna ushul aiattar -- achyk-aikyn, oto tak zhana oz ichine daanyshmandyk menen okumdordu kamtygan Kuran aiattary.

Adamdarga Allaxtyn azabyn eskertkin dep ozdorunon bir adamga vaxii tushurgonubuz alardy tan' kaldyryp zhataby? Ei, Paigambar! Allakhka yiman keltirgenderdi suiundurgon nerseler tuurasynda alarga kabar ber. Alardyn kylgan zhakshy ish-araketterinin syilygy katary alar Rabbisinin aldynda uluu darazhaga ee bolushat. Kaapyrlar: Chyndygynda, bul aiattardy alyp kelgen adam anyk syikyrchynyn ozu, - deshti.

Ei, tan' kalgandar! Chyndygynda, silerdin Rabbin'er asmandardy ushunchalyk chon' kylyp, zherdi da ushunchalyk ken' kylyp alty kundo zharatyp, kiiin Arshka kotoruldu. Emi kantip silerdin aran'ardan bir adamdy paigambar kylyp zhonotkonuno tan' kalyp zhatasyn'ar? Al Zhalgyz Ozu ken' padyshalygynda kaalagandai okum zhurguzup bashkarat. Anyn aldynda ech kim Anyn uruksatyn yraazylygyn albai turup ech kimge shapaat kyla albait. Myna bul sypattar menen sypattalgan Zat - Al silerdin Rabbin'er Allakh. Anyn zhalgyz Ozuno gana chyn yklastan ibadat kylgyla. Anyn Zhalgyzdygyn korsotkon bul dalilderden ulgu-nasaat albaisyn'arby? Kimde-kim bir az da bolso ulgu alganda, anda al Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygyn taanyp-bilip zhana Aga yiman keltirmek.

Kylgan ishterin'erdin syilyk-zhazasyn beruu uchun kyiamat kunu zhalgyz Allakhtyn Ozuno gana kaitasyn'ar. Allakhtyn adamdarga bergen bul ubadasy akyikat zhana Al ubadasyn buzbait. Chyndygynda, Al bul nersege kudurettuu. Al makuluktardy buga cheiin ech nersege okshobogon korunushto zharatyp bashtait. Andan son' olgondon kiiin Allakhka yiman keltirip, zhakshy ish-araketterdi kylgan adamdardy adilettuuluk menen syilyktaryn beruu uchun kaira tiriltet. Alardyn sooptoru kemitilbeit zhana kunooloru dagy koboitulboit. Al emi Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyr bolgondorgo ichegilerin uzup ketuuchu oto ysyk, kainak suu bar. Zhana Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyr bolgondoru sebeptuu alar uchun zhan oorutuuchu azap bar.

Al Allakh kundu zharyk chachkan zhana zharygyn ar tarapka tarai turgan kylyp zharatty. Al emi aidy nur kylyp, anyn nurun paidalanuu uchun zharatty. Zhana aiga zhyiyrma segiz orundu belgiledi. Bir orundun aralygy ar bir kun-tundun otuusu menen olchonot. Ei, adamdar! Mintip belgi koigondun sebebi, siler kun menen kundordun sanyn zhana ai menen ailar zhana zhyldardyn sanyn bilishin'er uchun kylyngan. Allakh Taala Oz kuduretin zhana uluulugun adamdarga korsotuu uchun asmandar menen zherdi zhana andagy nerselerdi akyikat menen zharatty. Allakh Ozunun zhalgyzdygyn korsotkon achyk-aikyn dalilderdi, Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygyna dalil keltirgendi bilgen adamdar uchun myna ushundai kylyp baiandait.

Chyndygynda, tun menen kunduzdun biri-birinin artynan keluusundo, bularga karangylyk menen ai zharygynyn birge koshtoluusunda, tun menen kunduzdun biri kyska biri uzun boluusunda, asmandarda zhana zherdegi makuluktarda Allakhtan korkkon, Anyn buiruktaryn atkargan zhana tyigandarynan alys bolgon adamdar uchun Allakhtyn kudurettuulugun korsotkon aiat-belgiler bar.

Chyndygynda, kaapyrlar Allakhka zholuguunu umut kylbagandar - alar Allakhtan korkushpait zhe zholuguunu kaalashpait. Alar tuboluk akyret zhashoosunun orduna zhok bolup ketuuchu ubaktyluu duino zhashoosuna yraazy bolushat zhana bul zhashoogo kubanyshyp, zhan duinoloru beipil bolot. Oshondoi ele alar Allakhtyn aiat-belgilerinen zhana dalilderinen zhuz burup, kon'ulgo albagandar.
Bul sypattar menen sypattalgan al adamdardyn turuktuu zheri tozok. Bul zhaza alardyn kylgan kaapyrlyk ishteri zhana kyiamat kunun zhalganga chygargandary sebeptuu berildi.

Chyndygynda, Allakhka yiman keltirip, zhakshy ish-araketterdi kylgandardy Allakhtyn yraazylygyna zhetkire turgan zhakshy ish-araketterdi kyla turgan tuura zholgo salat. Bul alardyn yimandary sebeptuu boldu. Andan kiiin kyiamat kunu Allakh alardy aldylarynan daryialar akkan tuboluktuu zhyrgal beiish bakchalaryna kirgizet.

Alardyn beiishtegi aitkan dubalary - al Allakhty bardyk kemchilikterden aruuloo zhana Any uluktoo. Al emi Allakhtyn alar menen salamdashuusu, perishtelerdin zhana alardyn oz ara biri-biri menen salamdashkanda aitkan sozdoru "salam" sozu bolot. Oshondoi ele alardyn dubalarynyn aiagy butkul makuluktardyn Rabbisi bolgon Allakhka alkysh-maktoo sozdoru menen butot.

Egerde Allakh Taala adamdardyn achuulanyp turgan kezde ozdoruno, baldaryna zhana mal-mulkuno kylgan zhaman dubalaryn kabyl kyluuda, alardyn zhakshy kylgan dubalaryna zhoop bergendei tez zhoop kylganda, anda alar kyirap kalyshmak. Birok Allakh alardy kiiinkige kaltyrat. Zhana Aga zholuguunu umut kylbagandardy tashtap koiot. Antkeni alar zhazadan korkushpait zhana soop da umut kylyshpait. Allakh alardy surak kunu ekilenip, ozun zhogotkon, shektengen abalda tashtap koiot.

Egerde chekten chygyp oz nafsisine zulumduk kylgan adamga bir ooru zhetip zhe zhaman abalga tush bolso, anda al kaptaldap zhatkan abalda zhe oturgan abalda zhe turgan abalda bolsun aga zhetken zyiandykty alyp saluubuzdu umut kylyp Bizge zhalynyp-zhalbaryp duba kylat. Al emi kachan anyn dubasyn kabyl kylyp, andagy zyiandykty alyp salganybyzda, buga cheiin aga zhetken zyiandykty alyp tashtoobuzdu suranyp duba kylbagandai eski abalyna kaityp ketet. Akyikattan zhuz burgan bul adamga adashkan zholun ulanta beruu kooz korsotulgondoi, kaapyrlyk zhana bash iibestik kylyp chekten ashkan zhana bul kylganyn tashtabagan kaapyrlarga da kylgan ish-araketteri kooz korsotuldu.

Ei, mushrikter! Allakhtyn paigambarlaryn zhalganga chygargandary zhana kylgan kunooloru sebeptuu silerden murdagy koomdordu zhok kylganbyz. Alarga paigambarlar alyp kelgen nerseler anyk Allakhtan ekenine achyk-aikyn dalilder menen kelishse da, alar yiman keltiruugo daiar bolbogonduktan yiman keltirishpedi. Oshonduktan Allakh alardy zhardamsyz tashtap koidu zhana alarga yiman keltiruunugo iigilik berbedi. Oshol zalym koomdordu zhazalaganybyz syiaktuu osholordoi zalym bolgondordu ar ubakta, ar zherde zhazalaibyz.

Ei, adamdar! Kiiin, siler zhakshy ish-araketterdi zhasap, ishin'erge zharasha soop alasyn'arby zhe zhaman ishterdi zhasap kylgan ishin'er uchun zhazalanasyn'arby? Silerdi koruu uchun, zhalganga chygargan koomdordon kiiin, silerdi alardyn artynan zherge orun basar kyldyk.

Egerde alarga Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygyna achyk-aikyn dalil bolgon Kuran aiattary okulsa, kairadan tiriluunu chetke kakkan, soop umut kylbagan zhana zhazadan korkpogondor: "Ei, Mukhammad! Aikelderge syiynuunu sokkon zhana bashka nerselerdi oz ichine kamtygan bul Kurandan bashkany alyp kel. Zhe bizdin kaaloolorubuzga ylaiyktap kee bir zherlerin zhe bolboso butundoi Kurandy ozgort" - deshti. Ei, paigambar! Alarga ait: "Menin Kurandy ozgortkonum tuura bolboit. Zhana mende andan da zhakshysyn alyp keluugo kuduretim zhok. Zhalgyz Allakhtyn Ozu gana andan kaalagan zherin ozgortot. Men Allakhtyn maga vakhii kylyp zhonotkon nerseni gana eerchiimin. Silerdin menden suragan nersege zhoop berip, Allakhka kunoo kyluudan zhana Al uluu kundun azabynan korkomun. Al kun kyiamat kun".

Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: "Eger Allakh, Kurandy silerge okup berbeshimdi kaalaganda, anda men any silerge okubait bolchumun zhana any silerge zhetkirbeit elem. Eger Allakh kaalaganda Kurandy silerge oz tilimde uirotpoit elem. Men okubagan zhana zhazbagan abalda silerdin aran'arda uzun bir ubakyt -kyrk zhyl- boldum go. Men bul ishti surangan dagy emesmin, izdebedim dagy. Menin silerge alyp kelgen nerse menin ozumdon emes Allakhtan ekenine akyl zhugurtpoisun'orbu?".

Allakhka zhalgan nerseni oilop tapkan adamdan otkon zalym ech kim zhok. Emi kantip men Kurandy zhalgandan ozgortmok elem? Zhalgan oilop tabyp Allakhtyn chekterinen ashkan adamdar, kaalagan nerselerinde ech kachan iigilikke zhetishpeit.

Mushrikter Allakhtan bashka ozdoru kudai dep oiloshkon, paida da zyian da bere albagan nersege syiynyshat. A chynygy kudai - al kaalagan ubakta paida da zyian da beret. Alar syiynyp zhatkan kudailary tuurasynda myndai deshet: "Kudailarybyz Allakhtyn aldynda bizge ortomchu bolup, bizge shapaat kylyshat. Oshondo Allakh bizdi kunoolorubuz sebeptuu azaptabait". Ei, paigambar! Alarga ait: "Siler bardyk nerseni bilgen Allakhka, Anyn bir sherigi bar ekenin Aga kabar berip zhatasyn'arby? Al Allakh asmandarda da zherde da Anyn sherigi bar ekenin bilbeit". Allakh mushrikter zhalgandan aityp zhatkan nerselerden Taza zhana Uluk.

Adamdar bashynda yimanduu, Allakhty zhalgyzdagan bir ummot bolushkan. Birok kiiin pikirde kelishpei bolunup ketishti. Alardyn kee birleri yimanduu boidon kaldy. A kee birleri kaapyr bolup ketishti. Eger Allakh alardyn ortolorundagy kelishpei bolunup ketkenderine karata alardy kyiratuu okumun bul duinodo emes, akyrette okum kylaaryn tagdyr kylbaganda, anda Allakh alardyn okumun bul duinodo berip kyiratmak. Oshondo alardyn kimisi tuura zholdo, kimisi adashkan ekeni achykka chykmak.

Mushrikter aityshat: "Mukhammaddyn aityp zhatkany akyikat ekenin tastyktagan bir aiat-belgi tushurulboit beken?". Oo, paigambar! Alarga ait: "Aiat-belgilerdin tushuusu - kaiyp nerselerden zhana anyn ilimi Allakhka gana taandyk. Siler talap kylyp zhatkan kozgo korungon aiat-belgilerdi kuto bergile. Men dagy any siler menen kutomun".

Egerde mushrikterge zhetken kurgaktyk, kedeilikten kiiin zhamgyr zhana egin-teginderinde kop tushum berip, zhakshylyktarybyzdyn daamyn tattyrsak, alar bolso aiattarybyzdy shyldyn' kylyshyp zhalganga chygaryshat. Ei, paigambar! Mushrikterge ait: "Allakhtyn amalkoilugu tezireek zhana Anyn silerge zhazasy da tezireek. Sakchy perishteler silerdin kandai amalkoiluk kylyp zhatkanyn'ardy zhazyp turat. Perishtelerden ech bir nerse zhashyruun kalbait. Emi kantip alardyn Zharatuuchusunan bir nerse zhashyruun kalsyn? Allakh silerdi kylgan amalkoilugun'orgo zharasha zhazalait".

Ei, adamdar! Silerdi kurgaktykta bastyrgan zhana uloon'ordun ustundo zhurguzgon - al Allakh. Zhana den'izde silerdi kemelerdin ichinde zhurguzgon da Allakh. Siler kachan den'izde kemede zhagymduu zhel menen suzup baratkanyn'arda, keme minip baratkandar bul zhagymduu zhelge suiunup ketip zhatyshkan. Oshentip alar suiunup bara zhatyshkan kezde kutulbogon zherden katuu shamal kelip, ar taraptan tolkundar kaptai bashtaganda, alar boldu biz kyiraibyz dep tushunup kalyshty. Oshondo alar zhalgyz Allakhka ech nerseni sherik koshposton: "Eger bizdi bul kyiratuuchu synoodon kutkarsan', bizge bergen bul zhakshylyktaryn' uchun Saga sozsuz shugur kyluuchulardan bolobuz" - deship Allakhka duba kylyp zhalbaryshat.

Allakh alardyn dubalaryn kabyl kylyp, alardy oshol kyiynchylyktan kutkargandan kiiin alar kaapyrlyk zhana kunoolordu kyluu menen zher zhuzundo buzukuluk kylyshat. Ei, adamdar! Esin'erge kelgile. Buzukulugun'ardyn akybeti ozun'orgo ele kaitat. Silerdin buzukulugun'ar Allakhka zyian berbeit. Al buzukuluk ishterin'er menen bul duino zhashoosunda zhyrgap zhurosun'or. Bul duino zhashoosu da butot. Kiiin kyiamat kunu Bizge kaitasyn'ar. Oshondo kylyp zhurgon kunoolorun'or tuuraluu kabar berebiz zhana alar uchun silerdi zhazalaibyz

Siler zhyrgap zhurgon bul duinonun tez zhok boluusunun misaly myndai -- zhamgyrdyn suusu zherge sin'ip adamdar zhei turgan dan osumduktor zhana momo-zhemishter osup, mal-zhandyktar zhei turgan turduu choptor osup, zher kokko bolonup zhana ar turkun osumduktoru menen koozdukka bologondo adamdar osup chykkan osumduktordu terip aluuga kuchubuz zhetet dep turushkanda bul osumduktordu kyiratuuga buirugubuz kelip, kechee zhakynda ele daraktar zhana osumduktor menen koozdolup turbagandai kylyp kyiratkanybyz syiaktuu. Silerge bul duinonun abalyn zhana bat zhok boluusun baiandagandai ele oi zhugurtup sabak algandar uchun aiat-belgileribizdi baiandaibyz

Allakh bardyk adamdardy tynchtyk zhaiy bolgon beiishke chakyrat. Al zhaida adamdar kyiynchylyktardan, kaigy-kapadan zhana olumdon kutulushat. Allakh Ozu kaalagan pendesine oshol tynchtyk zhaiyna zhetkire turgan Islam dinine keluugo iigilik beret.

Allakh buirugan ibadattardy en' zhakshy atkargandar zhana oshondoi ele aram kylgan kunoolordu tashtagandar uchun en' zhakshy zhai berilet. Al beiish. Buga kosho dagy chon' syilyk berilet. Al Bereshen Allakhtyn zhuzun koruu. Al kunu alardyn zhuzun chan' da, korduk da zhana shermendelik da kaptabait. Zhogorudagy en' zhakshy atkargandar dep sypattalgandar - alar beiish eeleri. Alar al zhaida tuboluk kalyshat.

Kaapyrlyk zhana kunoolordon bolgon zhaman ishterdi kylgandar uchun ozdoru kylgan zhamandyktaryna zharasha akyrette Allakhtyn azabynan turgan kataal zhaza bar. Alardyn zhuzdorun korduk kaptap turat. Eger Allakh alarga azabyn tushurso, anda alardy Allakhtyn azabynan tosuuchu toskoolduk zhok. Ottun tutunu zhana karasy alardyn zhuzun ushunchalyk kop kaptagandyktan karan'gy tundun karasy menen alardyn zhuzdoru zhabylyp kalgandai bolot. Myndai sypattar menen sypattalgandar tozok eeleri. Alar al zhaida tuboluk kalyshat.

Ei, paigambar! Biz adamdardyn baaryn chogultup, anan bul duinodo Allakhka sherik koshkondorgo: "Ei, mushrikter! Siler zhana siler syiynyp zhurgon Allakhtan bashka kudaichalaryn'ar, ordun'ardan zhylbagyla!" - dep aita turgan kyiamat kunun estegin. Biz syiyngandar menen syiynylgandardy bolobuz. Oshondo syiynylgandar syiyngandardan: "Siler duinodo bizge syiynbait elen'er" - dep bash tartyshat.

Myna oshondo syiynyp zhurushkon Allakhtan bashka kudaichalary alardan myndai dep bash tartyshat: "Allakh zhetishtuu kubo, silerdin bizge syiynuun'arga biz yraazy emes elek, biz silerdi andai kyluuga buirugan emesbiz zhana bizge syiynuun'ardy sezgen da zhokbuz".

Oshol adamdar zhyinalgan uluu zhaida ar bir zhan duino zhashoosunda kylgan ishteri tuuraluu synaktan otot. Mushrikter alardy surakka ala turgan chynygy Rabbisi bolgon Allakhka kaitarylyshat. Oshondoi ele, bizge shapaat kylat dep aityshkan kudaichalary da alardy tashtap ketishet.

Oo, paigambar! Allakhka sherik koshkon al mushrikterge myndai dep aitkyn: "Silerge zhamgyr zhaadyryp asmandan kim yrysky beret? Ken bailyktardy kamtygan zhana osumduktordu osturgon zherden silerge kim yrysky beret? Uruktuktan chykkan adam syiaktuu zhana zhumurtkadan chykkan kush syiaktuu olukton tiruunu kim chygara alat? Tiruu zhandan chykkan uruktuk syiaktuu zhana kushtan chykkan zhumurtka syiaktuu tiruudon oluktu kim chygara alat? Asmandardy, zherdi zhana al ekoonun ortosundagy makuluktardy kim bashkaryp turat?". Alar: "Munun baaryn kyluuchu Allakh" - dep zhoop berishet. Alarga: "Bulardy bilip, Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp zhana tyiganynan tyiylyp Allakhtan korkpoisun'arby?!" - dep aitkyn".

Ei, adamdar! Bulardyn baaryn kylyp zhatkan al Allakh. Al Akyikat, silerdin Zharatuuchun'ar zhana ishin'erdi bashkaruuchu. Akyikatty bilgenden kiiin (any eerchibesen'er), akyikattan alystoo zhana zhogotuu gana kalat?! Bul achyk akyikattan adashyp akylyn'ar kaida baratat?!
Oo, paigambar! Chynygy Zharatuuchuluk Allakhka taandyk ekeni tastyktalgandai kok bettik kylyp akyikattan chykkandar yiman keltirbeit degen Rabbin'din tagdyrdagy sozu da tastyktaldy.

Oo, paigambar! Al mushrikterge myndai dep aitkyn: "Siler syiynyp zhatkan Allakhtan bashka kudaichan'ardyn arasynda murun zharatylynbagan zharatylyshty zharata ala turgany barby?". Myndai dep aitkyn: "Murun zharatylynbagan korunushto Allakh zharatat. Kiiin al olgondon kiiin any kaira tiriltet. Ei mushrikter! Emi siler kantip chyndyktan zhalganga baryp zhatasyn'ar?".

Oo, paigambar! Alarga myndai dep aitkyn: "Siler syiynyp zhatkan Allakhtan bashka kudailaryn'ardyn arasynda akyikat zholgo sala turgany barby?". Alarga: "Zhalgyz Allakh akyikat zholgo salat" - dep aitkyn. Adamdardy akyikatka salgan, alardy akyikatka chakyrgan (Allakh adamdardyn) bash iiuusuno tatyktuubu zhe bashkalar tuura zhol korsotso gana tuurany korgon kudailaryn'ar bash iiuugo tatyktuubu?! Al kudailaryn'ardy Allakhka sherik dep kantip zhalgandan okum kylyp zhatasyn'ar?! Silerdin bul sozun'ordon Allakh biiik, aruu.

Mushrikterdin kopchulugu ozdoru bilbegen nerselerdi gana eerchishet. Alar oigo kelgen nerselerdi zhana shektuu nerselerdi gana eerchishet. Chyndygynda, shektenuu anyk biluudoi emes. Allakh alardyn kylyp zhatkan ishterin bilip turat. Alardyn ishterinin ech nersesi Allakhka zhashyruun emes zhana al ishteri uchun Allakh alardy zhazalait.

Adamdar bul Kuranga okshosh kitep alyp keluugo alsyzdyk kylyshkandyktan bul Kuran adamdar tarabynan zharalyshy zhana al Allakhtan bashkaga taandyk kylynyshy tuura emes. Birok Kuran ozunon aldyn'ky tushkon kitepterdi tastyktait zhana murunku kitepterde kyskacha kelgen okumdordu baiandait. Andyktan al makuluktardyn Rabbisi aruu zhana uluk Allakh taraptan tushurulgondugundo shek zhok.

Zhok, al mushrikter: "Chyndygynda, Mukhammad bul Kurandy oz oiunan chygaryp, kiiin any Allakhka taandyk kylyp koigon" - dep aityshat. Oo, paigambar! Alarga zhoop kylyp myndai dep aitkyn: "Men silerdei ele adam bolup turup Kurandy ozum ele zhazyp algan bolsom, anda siler Kuranga okshosh bir suroonu alyp kelgilechi. Oshondoi ele Kuran oidon chygarylgan zhalgan dep aityp zhatkan sozun'or chyn bolso, anda any achykka chygaryshyn'ar uchun kimdi chakyra alsan'ar chakyrgyla. Siler ech kachan andai kyla albaisyn'ar. Siler tildin zhana taza adabii tildin eesi bolup turup andai kyluu kolun'ardan kelbeshi - Kuran Allakhtan tushurulgonuno dalil bolot.

Alar zhoop berishpedi. Teskerisinche, Kurandy tushunup, aga oi zhugurtuunun orduna zhana alarga eskertilgen azap kelgenge cheiin alar Kurandy zhalganga chygaruuga shashyshty. Alarga azap kelishine az kaldy. Murunku elder da ushundai zhalganga chygaryshkan. Oshondo alarga zhalganga chygargandary sebeptuu azap tushtu. Oo, paigambar! Andyktan zhalganga chygargan elderdin akyr-aiagy kandai bolgonuna oi zhugurtkun. Alardy Allakh kyiratty.

Mushrikterdin arasynan olushunon aldyn Kuranga yiman keltirgenderi bar zhana alardyn arasynda olgongo cheiin kok bettik kylyp zhana tekeberlenip yiman keltirbegenderi bar. Oo, paigambar! Senin Rabbin' Al kaapyrlykka bekem zharmashkandardy zhakshy bilet zhana alardyn kaapyrlyktary uchun alardy zhazalait.

Oo, paigambar! Seni koomun' zhalganchy deshse, alarga myndai dep aitkyn: "Ish-araketterimdin soobu men uchun zhana anyn kesepetin ozum kotorom. Oshondoi ele silerdin ish-araketterin'din soobu ozun'orgo paida zhana anyn zhazasy da ozun'orgo zyian. Men zhasap zhatkan ishtin zhazasynan silerdin tieshen'er zhok. oshondoi ele siler kylyp zhatkan ishin'erge menin tieshem zhok.

Oo, paigambar! Sen Kuran okuganyn'da mushrikterdin arasynan seni ukkandary da bar, birok bash iiip zhana kabyl kyluu menen ugushpait. Uguu mumkunchulugunon airylgan adamga sen uguza alsyn'by?! Sen aga uguza albaganyn'dai ele al akyikatty ukkusu kelbegenderdi da tuura zholgo sala albaisyn', alar aga akyldaryn ishtetishpeit.

Oo, paigambar! Mushrikterdin arasynan seni kozu menen korup birok kokurogu menen korbogondor bar. Sen koruu mumkunchulugunon airylgandardy kantip korduro almak elen'? Albette, al senin kolun'dan kelbeit. Myna oshondoi ele korogochtuulukton airylgandardy da tuura zholgo saluu senin kolun'dan kelbeit.

Chyndygynda, Allakh pendelerine zulumduk kyluudan aruu boldu. Andyktan Allakh alarga kypyndai da zulumduk kylbait. Birok alar kyiroogo alyp bara turgan ishterdi kylyshyp ozdoruno ozdoru zulumduk kylyshat. Bul alardyn zhalgandan, tekeberlikten zhana kok bettuulukton kaitpagandary sebeptuu boldu.

Kyiamat kunu Allakh adamdardy surakka aluu uchun chogultat. Alar duino zhashoosunda zhana kabyrda kunduzdun bir az ubaktysynchalyk gana ubakyttai andan ashykcha bolbogondoi bolushat. Alar al zherde biri-birin taanyshat. Kiiin alar kyiamattyn korkunuchunun katuulugunan biri-birin taanybai da kalyshat. Oshondo Kyiamat kunu Rabbisine zholuguunu zhalganga chygaryp zhatyshkandar zyianga uchurashat. Alar zyiandan kutulgudai bul duinodo kyiamat kununo yiman keltirishken emes.

Oo, paigambar! Biz saga ubada kylgan azaptardyn kee birin sen olgongo cheiin saga korsotuubuz mumkun. Zhe aga cheiin senin zhanyn'dy alyshybyz mumkun. Bul eki abalda ten' alar Kyiamat kunu bizge kaityshat. Kiiin Allakh alardyn kylyp zhurgon ishterin dykkat karap chygat. Allakhka alardyn ish-araketterinen ech nerse zhashyrylbait. Alardy Allakh ish-araketteri uchun zhazalait.

Murunku ar bir eldin zhiberilgen elchisi bar. Al elchi alarga zhetkiruugo buirulgan tapshyrmany zhetkirip, alar any zhalganga chygaryshkan kezde al elder menen al elchinin ortosunda adilettuu okum chygarylyp Allakh al elchini Oz zhakshylygy menen kutkaryp zhana alardy adilettuulugu menen kyiratkan. Alar kylgan ish-araketterinin zhazasyn aluuda alarga ech kandai zulum kylynbait.
Al kaapyrlar kok bettenip zhana ozdoruno ishenip myndai dep aityshat: "Siler chakyryp zhatkan nersede chynchyl bolson'or, anda siler bizge ubada kylyp zhatkan azaptyn ubaktysy kachan?".

Oo, paigambar! Alarga myndai dep aitkyn: "Men oz zhanyma zyian da bere albaimyn zhana zyiandy oz zhanymdan ketire da kylbaimyn. Oshondoi ele ozumo paida da bere albaimyn. Anan kantip bashkalarga paida zhe zyian bere almak elem? Allakhtyn kaalagany gana bolot. Anan men kantip Allakh zhashyrgan ilimdi bilmek elem? Allakh kyiratuunu ubada kylgan ar bir eldin kyiroosuna belgiluu moonot bar. Any Allakh Ozu gana bilet. Eger alardyn kyiroo ubaktysy kelgen bolso, anda al ubakyttan ech kandai ubakyt kechikpeit da zhana al ubakyttan aldyn da bolup ketpeit.

Oo, paigambar! Al azapka shashylgandarga myndai dep aitkyn: "Aitkylachy, eger Allakhtyn azaby tunubu zhe kunduzubu kaisy bir ubakta kelgen bolso, abalyn'ar kandai bolot. Bul azaptyn emnesine shashyp zhatasyn'ar?!".

Murun yiman keltirbei andan kiiin yimany paida berbei turgan ubakta, silerge ubada kylyngan azap kelgenden kiiin yiman keltirip zhatasyn'arby? Emi yiman keltirip zhatasyn'arby, siler zhalganga chygaruu menen azaptyn keluusun shashtyryp zhattyn'ar elego?!

Alardy azapka salgandan kiiin zhana azaptan chygaruunu suranyshkandan kiiin alarga myndai dep aitylat: "Akyrette tuboluktuu azapty tatkyla! Siler kylyp zhurgon kaapyrlyk zhana kunoolordun zhazasyn gana alasyn'ar!".

Oo, paigambar! Mushrikter senden: <<Ushul bizge ubada kylyngan azap chyndykpy?>> - dep surashat. Alarga: <<Ooba! Allakhka ant bolsun! Albette al azap chyndyk! Siler andan kachyp kutula albaisyn'ar" - dep aitkyn.

Zher betindegi bardyk baaluu bailyktar Allakhka sherik koshkon ar bir mushriktin bailygy bolup, aga oshol bailyktaryn Allakhtyn azabynan kutuluu uchun kun toloo mumkunchulugu berilse, anda bardyk bailyktaryn Allakhtyn azabynan kutuluu uchun berishmek. Mushrikter kyiamat kunu azapty korushkondo, kylgan kaapyrlyktaryna okungonun zhashyryshat. Allakh alarga adilettuuluk menen okum zhurguzot zhana alarga zulumduk kylynbait. Bolgonu alar ozdoru kylgan ish-araketterine zharasha gana zhazalaryn alyshat.

Akyikatta asmandardagy zhana zherdegi nerseler zhalgyz Allakhtyn mulku emespi?! Chyndygynda Allakh kaapyrlarga ubada kylgan azap sheksiz bolo turgan nerse emespi?! Birok bul nerseni alardyn kopchulugu bilishpegendikten, shektene berishet.
Allakh - aruu Zat. Oluktordu tiriltet, tiruulordu olturot. Kyiamat kunu zhalgyz Aga kaitasyn'ar. Oshondo silerge kylgan ish-araketin'erge zharasha zhaza zhe syilyktardy beret.

Ei, adamdar! Silerge eskertuulordu, uguttogon zhana korkutkan aiattardy kamtygan Kuran keldi. Kuran zhuroktun shek sanoosuna zhana kumondonuu ooruularyna shypaa. Oshondoi ele al akyikat zholuna bashtait. Anda yimanduular uchun yraiymduuluk bar. Alar any menen paidalanyshat.

Oo, paigambar! Adamdarga aitkyn: "Men silerge alyp kelgen Kuran - silerge Allakhtan bolgon artykchylyk zhana yraiym. Oshonduktan bul Kuran sebeptuu Allakhtyn silerge bergen artykchylygy zhana yraiymy menen gana suiungulo, al ekoosunon bashka nerse menen suiunbogulo. Mukhammad paigambardyn Rabbisinen adamdarga alyp kelgeni - alar toptop zhatkan zhok bolup ketuuchu duino zhyrgalynan zhakshy.

Oo, paigambar! Al mushrikterge aitkyn: "Allakh silerge yrysky kylyp bergen zhakshylyktary zhonundo maga kabar bergilechi. Siler al yryskylardyn kee birlerin oz oiun'ar menen aramga chygardyn'ar, al emi kee birlerin adalga chygardyn'ar". Alarga aitkyn: "Siler adal kylyp algan nersen'erdi Allakh adal kyldyby zhe aram kylyp algan nersen'erdi Al aram kyldyby? Zhe siler Allakhka zhalaa zhaap zhatasyn'arby?!"

Allakhka zhalaa zhapkan adamdar kyiamat kunu bashtaryna kelgende emneni oilonushat? Alar bizdin kunoolor kechirilet dep oiloshobu? Mintip oiloshkonu alys nerse. Chyndygynda Allakh adamdardy azaptoogo shashylbai alarga moonot beruu menen alarga Oz paziletin tartuulait. Birok alardyn kopchulugu Allakhtyn alarga bergen zhakshylyktaryn chetke kagyshyp, al zhakshylyktar uchun shugur kylyshpait.

Oo, paigambar! Ishterdin kaisy birin kylba zhana Kurandan emneni okuba. Zhana ei, yimanduular! Siler da ish-araketerdin kaisy birin kylbagyla, Biz siler ish-araketterdi umtuluu menen bashtap zhatkanyn'ardy korup turabyz, silerdi bilip zhana ugup turabyz. Asmandagy zhana zherdegi kypyndai nerse zhana andan da maida zhe chon' nerseler Rabbin'den zhashyruun emes. Akyikatta alardyn baary Kitepte zhazylgan. Al Kitepte maida zhana chon' nerselerdin baary eseptelip zhazylyp turat.
Allakhtyn zhakyn pendeleri akyrettegi abaldardy korushkon kezde alarga ech kandai korkunuch bolboit. Zhana bul duinodo zhetpei kalyshkan zhyrgalchylyktarga kaigyryshpait.
Myna oshol Allakhtyn zhakyn pendeleri - alar Allakhka zhana Anyn Elchisine toluk yiman keltirgen adamdar zhana Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryshkan, Anyn tyigan nerselerinen alys bolgon takybalar.

Rabbisinen alarga aian tush koruu menen zhe adamdar alarga aitkan maktooloru menen bul duinodo alarga suiunuch kabarlar bolot. Oshondoi ele perishteler alardyn zhandaryn alyp zhatkanda da alarga suiunuch kabarlardy aityshat. Olumdon kiiin zhana kyiamatta kaira tirilishkende alarga Allakhtyn bergen ubadasy ech ozgorboit. Myna ushul syilyktar - uluu zhen'ish. Antkeni alar en'segen zhyrgaldarga zhetishti zhana korkkon azaptan kutulushtu.

Oo, paigambar! Alar dinin'di zhemelegen zhana akaarat kylgan sozdordu aitkandaryna kapa bolbo. Antkeni bagyntuu zhana ustomduk kyluu Allakhka gana taandyk. Any ech nerse alsyz kyla albait. Allakh alardyn sozdorun Uguuchu zhana kylgan ishterin Biluuchu. Oshol ishterine zharasha alardy zhazalait.

Akyikatta asmandardagy zhana zherdegi zhanduulardyn baaryna zhalgyz Allakh gana eelik kylbaiby?! Allakhka bashka kudailardy sherik kylgan mushrikter emneni gana eerchip zhurushot? Chynyn aitkanda alar shekti gana eerchishet. Alar Allakhka sherik koshuuda zhalgan sozdordu gana aityshat. Alar aitkan sozdordon Allakh aruu.

Ei, adamdar! Siler charchagandyktan zhana kyimyldan es aluun'ar uchun tundu zhalgyz Ozu gana zharatty. Zhana zhashoo-tirichiligin'erge paida alyp keluugo arakettenuun'or uchun kunduzdu zharyk kyldy. Myna ushul zharatuuda ukkanda eske algan zhana kabyl algan koom uchun achyk dalilder bar.

Mushrikterdin bir taipasy: "Allakh perishtelerdi Ozunun kyzdary kylyp aldy" - dep aityshty. Allakh alardyn aitkan sozdorunon aruu boldu. Al zharatylgan nerselerdin ech kimisine muktazh emes. Asmandagy zhana zherdegi nerselerdin baary Aga gana taandyk. Ei, mushrikter! Bul aitkan sozun'orgo ech kandai dalil zhok. Silerde ech kandai dalil zhok turup akyikatty bilbei ele Allakhka perzentti tan'uulaisyn'arby? Allakhka ushunchalyk korkunuchtuu chon' sozdordu da aitasyn'arby?!
Oo, paigambar! Alarga: "Allakhtyn balasy bar dep zhalgan sozdordu aitkan adamdar talap kylgan nerselerine zhetishpeit zhana korkkon nersesinen da kutula alyshpait" - dep aitkyn.

Andyktan bul duinodo tapkan zhyrgalchylyktarga zhana kumarga aldanyshpasyn. Antkeni al az zhana tez zhok boluuchu zhyrgalchylyktar. Andan kiiin alar kyiamat kunu Bizdin aldybyzga kaityshat. Oshondo alar Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandygy uchun zhana Anyn elchisin zhalganga chygargandyktary uchun alarga katuu azap berebiz.

Oo, paigambar! Tigi mushrikterge Nukh paigambar koomuna aitkan sozun kabarlagyn. Al koomuna: "Ei, elim! Egerde men silerdin aran'arda turushum silerge oor kelip zhatsa zhana silerdi Allakhtyn aiattary menen eskertip chakyrganym silerge mashakat keltirse, oshondoi ele meni olturobuz dep chechim chygarsan'ar, anda men aila-amalyn'ardy zhok kyluusuna zhalgyz Allakhka gana taiandym. Chechimin'erdi atkaryp meni zhok kyluuga araket kyla bergile. Zhardam suroo uchun kudailaryn'ardy da chakyrgyla. Aila-amalyn'ar budomuk bolup zhurbosun. Menden zhashyryp olturuugo chechken chechimin'erdi bir az bolso da kechiktirbei daroo atkargyla.

Egerde siler menin daavatymdan zhuz bursan'ar, anda yiman keltiresin'erbi zhe kaapyr bolosun'arby men silerden ech kandai aky surabaimyn. Rabbimdin dinin zhetkiruudogu syilyktar Allakhtan gana bolot. Al meni bash iiip zhana zhakshy ish-araketterdi kylyp moiun sungandardan boluumdu buirudu.

Aga ozunun eli ishenishpei any zhalganga chygaryshty. Oshondo Nukhtu zhana any menen kemege chykkan yimanduulardy saktadyk. Osholordu gana koomunun tukumun ulagan adamdardan kyldyk. Aiat-dalilder kelgenge karabai zhalganga chygargan adamdardy topon suu menen zhok kyldyk. Ei, paigambar! Nukh paigambar eskertip kelgen koom yiman keltirbegendikten, alardyn akybeti kandai bolgonduguna oi zhugurt.

Nukhtan bir kancha ubakyttan kiiin oz koomdoruna elchilerdi zhiberdik. Elchiler oz ummottoruno aiattar zhana dalilder menen kelishti. Oshondo alar buga cheiin elchilerdi zhalganga chygaruusun koibogondun sebebinen gana alar yiman keltiruugo kaalooloru bolgon zhok. Myndan ulam Allakh alardyn zhuroktorun moorlop saldy. Murunku elchilerdin ubagynda adamdardyn zhuroktorun moorlop salgandai ele, Allakhtyn koigon chekterinen ashkan kaapyrlardyn zhuroktorun kaisyl ubakytta zhana kaisyl zherde bolso da moorlop salabyz.

Al elchilerden bir kancha ubakyttan kiiin Misirge padysha bolup turgan Faraongo zhana oshol koomdun chon'doruna Musany zhana anyn bir tuugany Kharundu zhiberdik. Alar aitkan sozdordun akyikattygyna dalil bolgon aiat-belgiler menen kosho zhiberdik. Al ekoo alyp kelgen yimandan alar bash tartyp tekeberlenishti. Antkeni alar Allakhka kaapyr bolgonduktan zhana elchilerin zhalganga chygargandyktan, alar buzuku adamdardan bolushkan.

Faraongo zhana al koomdun chon'doruna Musa zhana Kharun alyp kelgen akyikat kelgende, alar Musa paigambardyn aitkany akyikat ekendigine dalil bolgon aiattaryna: "Chyndygynda bul achyk syikyr. Akyikat emes" - dep aityshty.
Oshondo alardy tyiyp: "Silerge kelgen akyikatty syikyrga chygarasyn'arby?! - dedi Musa paigambar - Zhok! Al ech kandai syikyr emes. Chynynda syikyrchy ech kachan iigilikke zhetpeshin men bilemin.

Faraondun koomu Musa paigambarga myndai dep zhoop berishti: "Sen bir tuuganyn' ekoon' padyshalykka zhetuu uchun ata-babalarybyz karmanyp zhurgon dinden buruu uchun bul syikyr menen keldin'erbi? Oo, Musa menen Kharun! Siler bizge zhiberilgen elchi ekenin'erge biz ishenbeibiz".
Faraon koomuna: "Syikyrchylykty zhakshy ozdoshturup bilgen syikyrchylardy maga toptop alyp kelgile" - dep aitty.
Faraon syikyrchylar menen kelishken kezde Musa alarga karshy zhardam keleerine bekem ishengen abalda alarga: "Ei, syikyrchylar! Emneni tashtagany zhatsan'ar oshonun'ardy tashtagyla" - dep aitty.

Alar ozdorunun nerselerin tashtagan kezde Musa alarga aitty: "Silerdin korsotkonun'or - bul syikyrchylyk. Chynynda Allakh siler kylgan nerseni ech nersege taasiri tiibegen paidasyz nersege ailandyryp koiot. Siler syikyryn'ar menen zher zhuzundo buzukuluk kylyp zhatasyn'ar. Kimde-kim buzuku bolgon bolso, Allakh anyn ishin on'doboit".
Faraondun ui-bulosunon bolgon kylmyshker kaapyrlar zhaman korushso da Allakh akyikatty ornotot zhana any tagdyrda zhana shariiatta zhazylgan sozdorundogu dalilder menen kubattait.

Koomu bash tartabyz dep chechti. Musa alarga achyk-aikyn aiattardy zhana dalilderdi alyp kelgenine karabastan Israil urpaktarynyn kee bir zhashtary gana aga yiman keltirishti. Egerde alardyn bul ishi bilinip kalsa, anda Faraon menen el bashchylary alardy aiosuz azaptap yimandan kaittyrat degen korkunuchka da karashpady. Chyndygynda Faraon Misirdi zhana anyn elin kuchko salyp bashkargan anyk tekeber zhana kaapyrlykta, kyryp olturuugo, Israil urpaktaryn azaptoodo chekten ashkandardan.

Musa eline aitty: "Oo, elim! Egerde siler chyn ishenim menen Allakhka yiman keltirsen'er zhana musulman bolson'or, anda zhalgyz Allakhka taiangyla. Allakhka tobokel kylgyla, silerden zhamandykty tosot zhana silerge zhakshylykty alyp kelet."
Alar Musaga zhoop berip aityshty: "Zhalgyz Allakhka gana tobokel kyldyk. Oo, Rabbibiz zaalymdardy bizdin ustubuzdon bashchy kylba! Alar bizdi azap, olum zhana kyzyktyruu menen dinibizge bulgun salat
Oo, Rabbibiz! Bizdi Oz yraiymyn' menen kaapyr Faraondun koomunun kol astynan chygara kor! Alar bizdi kul kylyshty zhana bizdi olturup zhana azaptap kyinashty.

Biz Musa menen Kharunga: "Zhalgyz Allakhka ibadat kyluu uchun elin'erge uilordu tandap bergile zhana uilorun'ordu Aksa mechitine karai kybyla kylgyla, oshondoi ele namazdy toluk okugula" - dep aian tushurduk. "Ei, Musa! Yimanduularga Allakhtyn zhardamyn, koldoosun zhana dushmandaryn kyiratyp zhok kylyp, zher betinde alardy kaltyrabyz degen kubanychtuu kabaryn ait" - dep aittyk.

Musa paigambar myndai dep aitty: "Oo, Rabbibiz! Sen Faraongo zhana anyn koomundagy kadyrluu adamdarga koozduk uchun duino zyinattaryn berdin'. Oshondoi ele duino zhashoosunda mal-mulktordu berdin'. Alar Sen bergen nerselerge shugur kylyshpady. Teskerisinche al nerselerdi Senin zholun'dan adashtyrganga koldonushtu. Oo, Rabbibiz! Alardyn mal-mulktorun kyiratyp zhok kyl, zhuroktorun merez kyl! Alar zhan oorutuuchu azapty kormoiuncho yiman keltirishpeit. Oshol kezde alardyn yiman keltirgeni ech paida berbeit".

Allakh myndai dep aitty: "Ei, Musa zhana Kharun! Faraon zhana anyn koomundagy kadyrluu adamdarga karshy kylgan duban'ardy kabyl kyldym. Emi ekoon'or dinin'erge bekem bolgula zhana akyikat zholdu bilbegen naadandardyn zholun eerchip dinden chygyp ketpegile".

Biz Israildin urpaktaryna ekige bolungon den'izden aman-esen otuusun zhen'il kyldyk. Faraon zhana anyn askerleri zulumduk zhana dushmandyk menen alardy kuup kelishti, eki bolungon den'iz birigip, chogushko zhakyn kalyp, kutuluudan umut uzgon Faraon myndai dep aitty: "Israildin urpaktary ishengen Allakhtan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu zat zhok dep yiman keltirdim. Menda Allakhka bash iiip moiun sunuuchulardanmyn".

Kachan toobo kabyl kylynbai olum kozuno korunup kalgan uchurda Allakh myndai dep aitty:
Zhashoodon umut uzgondon kiiin emi yiman keltiresin'bi? Ei, Faraon! Azap tushordon murun Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyp. Anyn zholunan tosuu menen kunoo kyldyn'. Ozun'du zhana bashkalardy adashtyruu sebepten sen buzukulardan boldun'.

Ei, Faraon! Senden kiiin kelgen adamdar sabak alysh uchun denen'di bugun den'izden chygaryp zher betinin biiik zherine koiobuz. Chyndygynda kopchuluk adamdar bizdin dalilderden zhana kuch-kuduretibizdi bildirgen belgilerden beikapar. Al tuurasynda alar oi zhugurtushpoit.

Chyndygynda Biz Israildin urpaktaryn berekeluu Sham olkosunun alar yraazy bolgon ardaktuu zhaiga zhaigashtyrdyk. Alarga adal taza yrysky berdik. Alar Tooratta okushkan Mukhammad paigambardyn sypattaryn Kuran tastyktap kelgenge cheiin din ishterinde talashyp tartyshkan zhok. Kachan alar senin paigambarchylygyn'dy chetke kagyshkanda oz mekenderin tarttyryp zhiberishti. Ei, paigambar! Kyiamat kunu senin Rabbin' alardyn talashyp tartyshkan nerselerinde Ozu okum chygarat. Allakh alardyn chynchyl zhana zhalganchylarynyn ar birine ozuno ylaiyktuu zhazasyn zhe syilygyn beret.

Oo, paigambar! Biz saga tushurgon Kurandyn akyikat ekendigine shektenip kumon sanagandardan bolson', anda yiman keltirgen zhoottordon zhana khristiandardan sura. Alar Tooratty zhana Inzhildi okushat. Alar saga tushkon nerse akyikat ekenin aityshat. Antkeni anyn sypatyn alar oz kitepterinde tabyshat. Chyndygynda Saga Rabbin'den kelgen akyikatta ech kumon zhok. Oshonduktan shektengenderden bolbo.

Zhana Allakhtyn dalilderin zhalganga chygargandardan bolbo. Eger oshondoi kylsan', anda kaapyrlyk kylyshkandary sebeptuu ozdorun kyiroogo uchuratkandardan bolup kalasyn'. Bul eskertuulordun baarysy zhalgan menen shektin korkunuchun baiandash uchun kelgen. Birok paigambar taraptan bul kunoolordun biri da kylynyshy mumkun emes.
Chyndygynda, kaapyrlykty kok bettik menen karmanyp kaapyr bolup olushot dep Allakhtyn tagdyrynda zhazylgan adamdar ech kachan yiman keltirishpeit.

Eger alarga zhan oorutuuchu azap kelgenge cheiin bardyk shariiat zhana tabiiat aiat belgileri dalil kylyp keltirilse da yiman keltirishpeit. Birok azap kozdoruno korunup kalgan uchurda keltirgen yimandary ech paida berbeit.

Biz paigambarlarybyzdy zhibergen shaardyn zhashoochulary azap kozdoruno korungongo cheiin ozdoru kaalap yimanga kirishken zhok. Alar azap kozdoruno korunoordon murun yiman keltirishkende ozdoruno gana paida bermek. Birok Iunustun koomu chynygy yiman keltirishken uchurda alardy duino zhashoosundagy korduk azabynan kutkardyk. Alarga azhaldary kelgiche zhashoo zhyrgalchylyktaryn berdik.

Oo, paigambar! Eger senin Rabbin' zher betindegi bardyk adamdardyn yimanga keluusun kaalaganda anda alar yiman keltirishmek. Birok Allakh daanyshmandyk uchun andai bolushun kaalabady. Al kaalagan adamyn Ozunun adilettuulugu menen adashtyrat, oshondoi ele kaalagan adamyn Oz zhakshylygy menen tuura zholgo salat. Chyndygynda sen adamdardy mazhburlap yimanga kirgize albaisyn'. Alardyn yiman keltiruusu bir gana Allakhtyn kolunda.

Allakhtyn uruksatysyz ech bir zhan oz yktyiary menen yiman keltire albait. Anyn kaaloosuz yiman kiltiruu mumkun emes. Sen kaapyrlardy oilonup tuishuk tartpa. Anyn buiruk-tyiuularyn zhana dalilderin bilbegen adamdardy Allakh kor kylyp azaptait.

Oo, paigambar! Senden aiat-belgilerdi suragan mushrikterge: "Asmandar menen zherde Allakhtyn kuch-kuduretine zhana zhalgyzdygyn bildirgen aiat-belgilerge oi zhugurtpoisun'orbu?"-dep aitkyn. Yiman keltiruugo daiar emes adamdar kaapyrlykty kok bettik menen karmangandary uchun alarga aiattardyn, dalilderdin tushuusu zhana paigambarlardyn zhiberilishi paida berbeit.

Al zhalganchy adamdar ozdorunon murun otkon zhalganchy koomdorgo tushkon Allakhtyn azabyn kutup zhatyshaby? Oo, paigambar! Sen alarga aitkyn: "Allakhtyn azabyn kuto turgula, menda siler menen Allakhtyn ubadasyn kutomun".

Andan kiiin Biz kaapyrlarga azap tushurobuz. Biz paigambarlarybyzdy zhana alar menen birge yiman keltirgenderdi kutkarabyz. Oshondo alar ozdorunun koomuna tushkon azapka uchurashpait. Paigambarlardy zhana alar menen birge momundardy kutkargan syiaktuu Allakhtyn paigambaryn zhana any menen birge momundardy kutkaruu Biz uchun anyk mildet bolup sanalat.

Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn:" Oo, adamdar! Eger men silerdi chakyryp zhatkan Allakhty zhalgyzdoonun dininen shektengen bolson'or, anda men silerdin dinin'er zhalgan ekenine chynygy ishenimde bolup any eerchibeimin. Allakhtan bashka kudaiga syiynyp zhatkan'ynarga men syiynbaimyn. Birok silerdi olturo turgan Allakhka gana syiynamyn. Allakh meni zhalgyz Ozuno gana chyn yklastan ibadat kylgan yimanduulardan boluumdu buirudu.
Oshondoi ele Allakh meni akyikat dinde tuz zhuruumdu buirudu. Men bardyk zhalgan dinderden alys bolup, akyikat dinde bekem bolom. Meni mushrikterden boluumdu tyidy.

Oo, paigambar! Allakhtan bashka aikelderge zhana paida bere ala turganchalyk den'geelde da paida bere albagan zhana zyian bere alganchalyk den'geelde da zyian bere albagan nerselerge duba kylbagyn. Eger sen alarga syiynsan', anda sen Allakhtyn cheginen ashkan zhana ozuno zyian bergen zaalymdardan bolup kalasyn'.

Oo, paigambar! Eger Allakhtan saga synoo kelse. Al synoonu ozun'don ketiruunu talap kylsan', any Allakh gana ketiret. Eger Allakh saga zhyrgalchylykty kaalasa, anyn zhakshylygyn ech kim tyia albait. Anyn zhakshylygy kaalagan pendesine zhetet. Ech bir zhan Any mazhburlai albait. Pendelerinin arasynan toobo kylgandarga Al yraiym kylgan Kechirimduu Zat.

Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: "Oo, adamdar! Silerge Rabbin'er tushurgon Kuran keldi. Kim tuura zholgo tushup aga yiman keltirse, anda anyn zhakshylygy ozuno gana kaitat. Antkeni Allakh pendelerinin ibadattaryna muktazh emes. Kim adashsa zhamandygy ozuno gana kaitat. Pendelerdin kunoo kyluusu Allakhka zyian bere albait. Men siler kylgan amaldaryn'ardy saktoochu emesmin, kylgan amaldaryn'ar uchun silerdi suraka albaim.

Oo, paigambar! Saga Rabbin' vakhii kylgan nerselerdi eerchip oshol nerseni atkar. Saga elin'den karshy chykkandardyn saga bergen yzaasyna sabyr kyl. Zhana sen zhetkiruugo buirulgan nerselerdi zhetkirgenge sabyr kyl. Allakh saga alardyn ustunon bul duinodo Oz okumu menen zhen'ish bergenge cheiin buirugan nerselerin ulanta ber. Eger alar kaapyrlykta olushso, Allakh alardy akyret kunu azaptait.

(lr) Alif, Laam, Ro. Bul aiattyn chechmelenishine okshosh sozdor bakara suroosundo otkon. Kuran aiattary maanisi zhana zhazylyshy zhagynan birdei bolgon kitep. Andan kata zhana kemchilik tappaisyn'. Oshondoi ele adal-aramdy, buiruk-tyiuunu, zhakshylykty ubada kyluu, zhamandyk menen korkutuu, okuialar zhana bashka nerseler Allakh taraptan baiandalyp kelgen. Al Ozunun bashkaruusunda zhana shariiatynda Daanyshman. Al pendelerine emne paida bereerin Biluuchu Zat.

Mukhammad paigambarga tushurulgon aiattardyn kamtygan nerseleri- pendelerdi Allakh menen katar bashka nerselerge ibadat kyluudan tyiuu. Ei, adamdar! Eger siler Allakhka kaapyrlyk zhana kunoo kylsan'ar, anda men silerdi Allakhtyn azaby menen korkutuuchumun. Al emi Aga yiman keltirip Anyn shariiatyna amal kylsan'ar, anda men Allakhtyn sooptoru menen suiuntuuchumun.

Ei, adamdar! Kylgan kunoon'or uchun Rabbin'erden kechirim suragyla. Al buirugan nerselerdi kyla albai kalganyn'arga okunup Allakhka kaitkyla. Al silerdi duino zhashoosunda belgilengen azhal ubaktyn'ar kelgiche zhakshy nerseler menen yrakhattandyrat. Ibadat zhana amaldaryn zhakshy kylgan adamdardyn baryna zhakshylyktary uchun Allakh syilykty ech kemitpesten toluk kylyp beret. Eger men Rabbimden alyp kelgen yimandan zhuz bursan'ar, anda kyiamat kunu silerge zhete turgan korkunuchtuu azaptan korkomun.

Ei, adamdar! Kyiamat kunu Allakhtyn Ozuno gana kaityp barasyn'ar. Al Aruu Zat bardyk nersege kudurettuu. Any ech bir nerse alsyz kyla albait. Silerdi olgondon kiiin kaira tiriltip, kalybynarga keltirip surak kyluuda Allakhty ech bir nerse alsyz kyla albait.

Al mushrikter zhuroktorun zhumshak kylyshyp Allakhka bolgon naadandyktary sebeptuu zhuroktorundogu shekti Andan zhashyryshat. Alar bashtaryn kiiimderi menen orop alyshkan uchurda, Allakh alar emne zhashyryp zhana emneni achyk kylgandaryn bilet. Chyndygynda Al zhuroktor emne zhashyryp zhatkanyn Biluuchu Zat.

Zher betinde basyp zhurgon kandai gana makuluk bolbosun, Allakh Ozunun bereshendiginen aga yryskysyn beruu kepildigin algan. Allakh Taala anyn zher betinde oturuktashkan ordun bilet. Zhana anyn olo turgan zherin bilet. Bardyk makuluktar, alardyn yryskylary, oturuktashkan orundary zhana olo turgan zherleri - achyk kitepte zhazylgan. Al kitep al'-Laukh al'-Makhfuz.

Al Allakh Taala asmandar menen zherdi chon'duguna karabai zharatty. Zhana al ekoosundogu makuluktardy alty kundo zharatty. Al emi Anyn arshy asmandar menen zherdi zharatkanga cheiin ele suunun ustundo bolchu. Oo, adamdar! Allakh silerdin kimin'er zhakshy ish-araketterdi kyluu menen Any yraazy kylat zhana kimin'er zhaman ish-araketterdi kyluu menen Anyn kaaryna kalat dep synoo uchun zharatty. Andan kiiin ar birin ozu tatyktuu bolgon nerse menen syilait zhe zhazalait. Oo, paigambar! Egerde sen: "Oo, adamdar! Siler olgondon kiiin esep-kysap beruu uchun kaira tirilesin'er" dep aitsan', anda alardyn Allakhka kaapyr bolgondoru zhana kaira tiriluunu chetke kakkandary: "Sen okup zhatkan bul Kuran achyk syikyr" dep aityshat. Alardyn bul aitkan sozdoru anyk zhalgan.

Biz mushrikterge alar tatyktuu bolgon azapty bul zhashoodo bir kancha ubakka cheiin kechiktirip koisok, alar azaptyn keluusun shashtyryp zhana shyldyn'dashyp: "Azapty bizden emne tosup kaldy" dep aityshat. Albette, alar tatyktuu bolgon azaptyn Allakh belgilegen oz moonotu bar. Al azap alarga kelgen kezde andan kutkara turgan ech kimdi taba alyshpait. Al azap alarga sozsuz zhetet. Oshentip alar shyldyn'doo zhana mazaktoo menen kechikti dep zhatyshkan azap alarga keldi.

Egerde Biz adamga zhakshylyktardyn arasynan den-sooluk, bailyk syiaktuu zhakshylykty berip, kiiin al adamdan oshol zhakshylykty alyp koisok, anda al Allakhtyn meeriminen koptogon umutsuzdukto kalat zhana Anyn zhakshylyktaryn chetke kagat. Al zhakshylyktardy Allakh andan alyp koiso ele unutat.

Egerde Biz aga kedeilik zhana ooru kelgenden kiiin yryskysyn ken'eitip, den-sooluk bersek, anda al: "Menden zhamandyk ketti, menden kyiynchylyk ketti" dep aitat. Al oshol nerse uchun Allakhka shugur kylbait. Chyndygynda adam tekeberlenip kop suiuno beret, bashka adamdarga kop boi kotorot zhana Allakh bergen zhakshylyktar menen maktanat.

Birok kyiynchylyktarga, ibadattarga sabyr kylgandar zhana kunoolordon tyiylyp, zhakshy ish-araketterdi atkargandar andai emes. Alardyn abaly myndan bashkacha bolot. Antkeni alar umutsuz bolushpait. Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryn chetke kagyshpait. Zhana adamdarga boi kotorushpoit. Myna ushul sypattarga eelik kylgan adamdarga Rabbisi kunoolorun kechiret. Zhana Akyrette alardy chon' syilyk kutot.

Oo, paigambar! Balkim sen alardyn kaapyrlygyn, karshy chyguusun zhana aiattardy talkuuga saluusun korgondon kiiin Allakh saga zhetkiruugo buirugan kee bir nerselerdi alardyn oshol nerselerdi ishke ashyruusu kyiyn dep zhetkirbei koiosun'. Sen oshol nerselerdi zhetkirsen' alar saga: "Aga koz karandysyz bolo turgandai bailyk tushpoibu? Zhe any menen birge anyn chynchyldygyn tastyktagan perishte kelbeibi?" - dep aityp koiushat dep koodonun' kysylat. Andyktan sen oshol sozdor uchun saga vakhii bolgon kee bir nerselerdi tashtaba. Sen zhon gana eskertuuchusun'. Allakh saga zhetkir dep buirugan nerseni zherkiresin'. Sen alardyn aiattardy talkuuga alyp zhatkanyna zhoop beruun'dun keregi zhok. Allakh bardyk nerseni Saktoochusu.

Al mushrikter: "Mukhammad Kurandy ozu oilop tapkan. Al Allakhtan tushkon vakhii emes" - dep aityshaby? Ei, paigambar! Alarga chakyryk tashtap: "Kurandagydai chyndykty kamtyi albagan zhana ozun'or oilop tapkan Kurandagy suroolorgo okshosh on suroonu alyp kelgilechi. Kuran oilop tabylgan dep aitkan sozun'ordo chynchyl bolson'or, anda zhardamdashuu uchun chakyra ala turgan ishengenin'erdin baaryn chakyrgyla.

Oo, yimanduular! Egerde siler talap kylgan nersege alardyn kuchu zhetpei alyp kele alyshpasa, anda bilip koigula, chyndygynda Kurandy Allakh elchisine Oz ilimi menen tushurgon. Oilop tabylgan nerse emes. Bilip koigula! Allakhtan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok. Myna bul keskin turdogu dalilderden kiiin siler Allakhka bash iiesin'erbi?

Egerde kim kylgan ish-araketteri menen bul duinonu zhana andagy ubaktyluu zhyrgalchylyktardy kaalasa, anda kylgan ish-araketterinin syilygyn bul duinodo ele berip koiobuz. Den-sooluk, amandyk zhana kenen yrysky zhagynan ech kam sanabai zhashashat.

Myndai zhaman maksattardy koigon adamdar uchun kyiamat kunundo ech kandai syilyk bolboit. Alar tozokko gana kirishet. Alardyn kylgan ish-araketterinin syilygy bolboit. Antkeni alardyn ish-araketteri tuura emes bolgon, alar yiman keltirishken emes zhana tuura maksat koiushkan da emes. Oshondoi ele alar Allakhtyn zhuzun zhana akyret syilygyn kaalashkan emes.

Mukhammad paigambarda Rabbisinen achyk dalil bolgon zhana Zhebreil perishte Rabbisinen kelgen kubo bolup any menen birge zhurgon. Oshondoi ele elderge yraiym, ulgu bolup Musa paigambarga tushkon Toorat kitebi anyn paigambarlygyna kubo bolgon. Andyktan any menen adashuuda buzulup zhurgon kaapyrlar ten' bolo alyshpait. Zhana kaapyrlar paigambardyn zhanynda zhurgon yimanduular menen da ten' bolo alyshpait. Antkeni yimanduular Kuranga zhana Mukhammadga yiman keltirishet. Kuranga zhana paigambarga kaapyrchylyk keltirgen bashka dinderdegi adamdarga ubada kylyngan nerse - al kyiamat kunundogu tozok. Ei, paigambar! Kurandan zhana alarga kylyngan ubadadan shek-kumondo bolup zhurbo. Al sheksiz akyikat. Achyk dalilder zhana daana bilingen negizder bolso da, kopchuluk adamdar yiman keltirishpeit.

Allakhta sherigi zhe balasy bar dep Allakhtyn atynan zhalgan sozdordu oilop tapkan adamdardan otkon zaalym adam zhok. Allakhtyn atynan zhalgan sozdordu oilop tapkan adamdar kyiamat kunu Rabbisinin aldynda ish-araketteri boiuncha suralat. Alarga karshy elchiler zhana perishteler myndai dep kubo bolushat: "Myna ushular Allakhtyn sherigi zhana balasy bar deship Allakhtyn atynan zhalgan aitkandar. Allakhtyn atynan zhalgan sozdordu aityshyp ozdoruno ozdoru zulum kylgan adamdardy Allakh yraiymynan alys kylsyn".
Allakhtyn tuura zholunan toskondor zhana tuura zholdon taiyp adashuuga araket kylgandar - alar olumdon kiiin kaira tiriluugo kaapyr bolushat zhana any chetke kagyshat.

Myna oshol sypattar menen sypattalgan adamdarga Allakhty azaby kelgende, alar andan zher betinde kachyp kutula alyshpait. Alardy Allakhtyn zhazasynan korgoi turgan Ozunon bashka zhardamchy da onoktosh da zhok. Alar ozdorun da bashkalardy da Allakhtyn zholunan adashtyrgandygy uchun Kyiamat kunu azabynyn ustuno azap koshulat. Alar akyikatka katuu karshy chykkandary sebepten bul duinodo chyndykty zhana tuura zholdu kabyl algandai uga alyshkan emes. Oshondoi ele alar tabiiattagy Allakhtyn aiat-belgilerin paida algandai koro alyshkan emes.

Oshol sypattar menen sypattalgan adamdar Allakh menen birge bashka sherikterdi kudai kylyp aluu menen ozdoru ozdorun azapka turtup, kyiroogo duushar bolushtu. Kiiin alar shapaatchy zhana sherik kylyp algan kudaichalar alardan ketip kalyshat.
Tuura! Albette, alar Kyiamat kunundo soodada en' chon' utturuuga uchuragandardan bolushat. Antkeni alar yimandy kaapyrchylykka, Akyretti bul duinogo zhana yraiymduuluktu azapka almashtyryshkan ele.

Chyndygynda, Allakhka zhana Anyn elchilerine yiman keltirgender, zhakshy ish-araketterdi atkargandar, oshondoi ele Allakhka moiun sunup bash iigender myna osholor beiish eeleri. Alar beiishte tuboluk bolushat.

Kaapyr zhana yimanduu eki toptun misaly - kozu korbogon sokur, kulagy ukpagan duloi menen kulagy ukkan zhana kozu korgon adamdar syiaktuu. Birinchi misal kaapyrlarga tiiishtuu. Alar chyndykty ugushat birok kabyl alyshpait zhana any korushot birok paida alyshpait. Al emi yimanduular uguu menen koruunu birdei paidalanyshat. Myna ushul eki toptun abaly zhana sypattary biri-birine ten' kelebi? Albette ten' kelbeit. Alar bul eki toptun biri-birine ten' kelbegeninen sabak alyshpaiby?

Mushrikterdin yimandan bash tartkany achykka chygyp bilingenden kiiin Allakh Taala Oz paigambarynyn kaigysyn ketirish uchun al birinchi zhalganga chygarylgan paigambarlardan emes ekenin aitty. Allakh Taala paigambardyn kaigysyn ketirish uchun bashka paigambarlardyn da okuialaryn aitty:
Biz Nukh paigambardy ozunun eline elchi kylyp zhiberdik. Al eline aitty: Chyndygynda, men silerdi Allakhtyn azabynan eskertemin zhana silerge zhonotulgon nersemdi achyktaimyn.
Oshondoi ele men silerdi zhalgyz Allakhka syiynuuga chakyram. Andan bashka ech kimge syiynbagyla. Chyndygynda, men silerge zhan oorutkan kundun azabynan korkom.

Oshondo anyn koomundagy kaapyr bolgon attuu-bashtuular myndai deshti: Biz senin chakyrygyn'a ech kachan zhoop berbeibiz. Antkeni sen bizden ozgocho emessin'. Sen bizge okshogon ele adamsyn'. Antkeni bizdin koz karashybyz boiuncha achyk bolgondoi arabyzdagy tomonku adamdar gana seni eerchishti. Biz silerdi eerchigenge tatyktuu bolgudai silerdin ashyp tashkan mal-mulkun'or, atak-dan'kyn'ar zhana mansabyn'ar zhok. Teskerisinche, biz silerdi chakyryp zhatkan nersen'erde zhalganchy dep oiloibuz.

Alarga Nukh aitty: Oo, elder! Aitkylachy maga? Egerde Rabbimden menin chynchyldygymdy tastyktagan zhana maga ishenuun'ordu mildet kylgan dalil menen kelip tursam. Oshondoi ele Allakh maga Ozunon yraiymduuluktu berdi. Al - paigambarchylyk zhana elchilik. Al nersede siler naadan bolgonduktan any silerden zhashyryp koidu. Emi oshol nersege yiman keltiruugo biz silerdi mazhburlashybyz kerekpi? Biz silerdi kyinap any zhurogun'orgo kirgizishibiz kerekpi? Al nerse kolubuzdan kelbeit. Allakhtan bashka ech kim yimanga bagyttai albait.

Oo, elim! Dindi silerge zhetkiruudo silerden akcha surabaimyn. Bul nersege syilyk Allakhtan gana bolot. Siler talap kylgandai yimanduulardyn kedeilerin kuup zhiberbeimin. Chyndygynda alar kyiamat kunu Rabbisine zholugushat. Rabbisi alardyn yiman keltirgendikteri uchun syilyktaryn beret. Siler yiman keltirgenderdin alsyzdaryn kuup zhiber dep talap koigondugun'ardan, men silerdi bul daavattyn akyikatyn tushunbogon koom dep bildim.

Oo, elim! Egerde men al yimanduulardy ech kandai kunoosuz ele alarga zulumduk kylyp kuup zhibersem, anda meni Allakhtyn azabynan kim korgoi alat? Myna emi esin'erge kelip, paidaluu nersege araket kylbaisyn'arby?

Oo, elim! Men silerge: "Mende yryskyga tolgon Allakhtyn kazynalary bar. Egerde yiman keltirsen'er, andan men silerge sarptaimyn" - dep aitpaimyn. Zhana men silerge: "Men kaiypty bilemin" - dep da aitpaimyn. Silerge: "Men perishtelerdenmin" - debeimin. Men silerdei ele adammyn. Siler kenebei zhana kemsintip zhatkan kedeiler tuurasynda: "Alarga Allakh iigilik zhana tuura zhol berbeit" - debeimin. Alardyn abaldaryn zhana nietterin Allakh Ozu zhakshy bilet. Egerde men bul sozdordu aita turgan bolsom, anda men Allakhtyn azabyna tatyktuu bolgon zaalymdardan bolup kalamyn.

Alar kyikymchyldyk zhana tekeberlik menen myndai dep aityshty: "Ei, Nukh! Sen biz menen talashyp-tartyshtyn'. Talashkandy da koboitup zhiberdin'. Egerde aitkan sozun'do chynchyl bolson', anda bizge ubada kylgan azabyn'dy alyp kelchi".
Nukh alarga aitty: "Azapty men alyp kele albaimyn. Egerde Allakh kaalasa Ozu alyp kelet. Egerde Al silerge azap zhiberuunu kaalasa, anda Allakhtyn azabynan kachyp kutula albaisyn'ar".

Egerde Allakh silerdi tuura zholdon adashtyruunu kaalasa zhana kok bettengenin'er uchun tuura zholunan alystatsa, anda men silerdi eskertkenim zhana nasaat kylganym silerge paida berbeit eken. Al silerdin Rabbin'er. Al gana silerdin ishin'erdin baaryn bashkarat. Andyktan Al kaalasa adashtyrat. Kyiamat kunundo Aga gana kaityp barasyn'ar. Oshondo kylgan ish-araketin'erdin zhazasyn beret.

Nukhtun koomu kaapyr bolgonunun sebebinen alar any Allakhtyn atynan ozu oilop tapkan din alyp keldi dep oiloshot. Ei, paigambar! Alarga aitkyn: "Egerde men bul dindi oilop tapkan bolsom, anda anyn kunoosu ozumo gana bolot. Zhana men da silerdin bul dindi zhalganga chygarganyn'ardyn kunoosun kotorboimun. Men andan alysmyn.

Allakh Nukhka vakhii kylyp myndai dep aitty: "Ushul ubakytka cheiin yiman keltirgenderden bashka emi ech kim yiman keltirbeit. Ei, Nukh! Ushul uzak ubakyttyn ichinde zhalganga chygaruulary zhana shyldyn'dooloru uchun kapa bolbo.

Bizdin koz aldybyzda zhana korgoobuzdun aldynda keme zhasa. Kemeni kantip zhasoonu uirotup saga vakhii kylabyz. Zhana kaapyr bolup ozdoruno zulumduk kylgandardyn azabyn kechiktir dep Maga kairylba. Alar kaapyrlykka bekem turup algandyktary uchun zhazalanyp topon suuga sozsuz chogushot.

Nukh Rabbisinin buirugun atkaryp keme kuruuga kirishe bashtady. Al daryialar zhana suu zhok zherde keme zhasap zhatkandyktan, anyn koomunun attuu-bashtuulary kachan anyn zhanynan otkon saiyn shyldyn'dap otushot ele. Alar kop shyldyn'dap bashtaganda Nukh alarga: "Ei, adamdar! Biz keme zhasap zhatkanda shyldyn'dasan'ar, anda siler chogup ketishin'erden kabarsyz zhurgonun'orgo biz da shyldyn'daibyz.
Kyiratkan zhana zyianga uchuratkan azap kimge kelishin zhakynda bilesin'er. Al emi kyiamat kunu alar uzulboi toktoosuz daiyma bolup turgan azapta bolushat.

Allakh zhasa dep buirugan kemeni Nukh paigambar zhasap buttu. Alardy zhok kyluuga buirugubuz kelgende topon suunun kelishine belgi bolup alar nan zhasap zhurgon tandyrlardan suular atylyp chykty. Oshondo Nukh paigambarga myndai dep aittyk: "Zher betinde zhurgon aibanattardan erkek-urgaachy kylyp kemege sal. Zhana ui-bulon'don yiman keltirbegendikten, al chogot dep okum bolgon adamdan bashkalaryn kemege kirgiz. Koomun'dan seni menen kosho yiman keltirgen adamdardy da kirgiz. Birok Allakhka yiman keltiruugo chakyrgan uzak ubakyttyn ichinde anyn koomunan az gana adamdar yiman keltirishken ele.

Nukh ozunun koomunan zhana ui-bulosunon yiman keltirgenderge myndai dep aitty: "Kemege chykkyla, Allakhtyn aty menen keme zhyla bashtait zhana Anyn aty menen toktoit. Chyndygynda Rabbim toobo kylgan pendelerinin kunoolorun Kechiruuchu zhana alarga Yraiymduu. Yimanduularga yraiym kylyp alardy kyiroodon saktait".

Keme ichindegi adamdar zhana zhanybarlar menen toodoi bolgon chon' tolkundardy aralap zhurup ketti. Atalyk sezimdin sebebinen Nukh paigambar kaapyr balasyn chakyrdy. Anyn balasy koomunan alys ozuncho bashka zherde turgan ele. "Ei, balam! Biz menen kosho kemege chyk! Chogup ketuudon aman kalasyn'. Kaapyr koom menen birge bolbo. Egerde alar menen birge bolson', alarga zhetken kyiroo zhana choguu saga da zhetet.

Nukhtun balasy atasyna aitty: "Bul suu maga zhetpeshi uchun men biiik toogo chygyp ketemin". Nukh balasyna: "Topon suu menen chogup ketuu azabynan bugun bir gana Yraiymduu Allakh kimdi kaalasa saktait. Al gana chogup ketuudon saktai alat" - dep aityp zhatkanda Nukh paigambar menen kaapyr balasynyn ortosun tolkun kelip bolup salat. Oshentip Nukhtun kaapyr balasy kaapyrchylygy sebepten topon suuga chokkondordun katarynda boldu.

Topon suu basylyp kalganda Allakh zherge: "Ei, zher! Topon suunun kalganyn ozun'o sin'irip al" - dep aitty. Asmanga bolso: "Ei, asman! Zhamgyrdy toktot" - dep buirudu. Oshondo suu azaiyp zherge sin'ip ketti. Allakh kaapyrlardy zhok kyldy. Keme Zhuudii toosuna kelip toktodu. Oshondo: "Kaapyrlyk menen Allakhtyn cheginen ashkan adamdar alys bolsun zhana alarga kyiroo bolsun!" - dep aityldy.

Nukh paigambar Rabbisinen zhardam surap Aga myndai dep kairyldy: "Oo, Rabbim! Ui-bulon'du saktaimyn dep ubada kylgandai ele menin balam da ui-bulomdun katarynda ele. Chyndygynda Senin ubadan' akyikat zhana anda kyianattyk bolboit. Sen okum kyluuchulardyn en' Adilettuususun' zhana Biluuchusun'.

Allakh Nukh paigambarga myndai dep aitty: "Ei, Nukh! Chyndygynda sen Menden saktoo boiuncha suragan balan' - any saktaimyn dep ubada kylgan ui-bulon'don emes. Antkeni al kaapyr. Chyndygynda bul suraganyn' saga ylaiyksyz ish. Sendei orunda bolgon adamga myndai kyluu tuura kelbeit. Andyktan ozun'do bir nerse tuurasynda ilim bolboi turup any Menden suraba. Sen Menin ilimime zhana daanyshmandygyma tuura kelbegen nerseni surap koiup kaidyger adamdardan bolup kaluun'dan Men seni eskertemin.

Nukh paigambar aitty: "Oo, Rabbim! Chyndygynda mende bir nerse tuurasynda ilim zhok turup Senden suragandan Ozun' menen saktanam zhana Seni menen korgonom. Egerde menin kunoomdu kechirbesen' zhana yraiymyn'a albasan', anda men akyrette sooptordon kuru kalyp zyianga uchuragandardan bolup kalamyn".

Allakh Nukh paigambarga aitty: <<Oo, Nukh! Tynchtyk, amandyk menen zhana Allakhtan saga berilgen koptogon zhakshylyktar menen kemeden zherge tush. Al zhakshylyktar seni menen kemede birge bolgon adamdardyn senden kiiin kele turgan yimanduu urpaktaryna da berilgen. Al zhakta alardyn urpaktarynan bolgon bashka koomdor bar. Alar kaapyrlar. Biz alarga bul duinodo zhyrgalchylyktardy berebiz zhana alarga zhashoo yryskylaryn da berebiz. Andan kiiin alarga Biz taraptan akyrette oorutuuchu azap zhetet.

Bul Nukh paigambardyn okuiasy kaiyp kabarlardan. Oo, Mukhammad! Bul vakhiidi Biz saga kabar kylganga cheiin sen da, senin koomun' da bilgen emes. Andyktan seni koomun' zhalganga chygaryp zhana saga zhetkirgen zyiandaryna Nukh paigambar sabyr kylgandai sabyr kyl. Chyndygynda, zhen'ishke zhana ustomduk kyluuga Allakhtyn buiruktaryna moiun sungan zhana Anyn tyigan nerselerinen tyiylgan adamdar gana zhetishet.

Biz Aad koomuna alardyn bir tuugany Khud paigambardy zhiberdik. Al alarga: <<Oo, elim! Zhalgyz Allakhka gana syiyngyla zhana Any menen birge ech kimdi sherik kylbagyla. Silerge Allakhtan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu zat zhok. Siler Anyn sherigi bar degen yrastoon'ordo anyk zhalganchysyn'ar>>. - dep aitty.

Oo, elim! Men silerge Rabbim taraptan kelgen nerseni zhetkirgenime zhana aga chakyrganyma silerden soop-syilyktardy surabaimyn. Menin soop-syilygymdy meni zharatkan Allakh gana beret. Oshol nersege akyl zhurguzboisun'orbu?! Siler, men chakyrgan nerseni kabyl alasyn'arby?!

Oo, elim! Allakhtan kechirim suragyla, andan son' Aga en' chon' kunoo bolgon shirk kunoon'orgo toobo kylgyla. Myna oshondo Allakh silerge noshorlogon zhamgyr beret. Al silerge mal-mulk zhana urpaktardy koboituu menen kuchun'orgo kuch koshot. Men chakyrgan nersege karshy chykpagyla. Sebebi menin chakyrygyma karshylyk kyluu menen, Allakhka kapyr boluun'ar menen zhana men alyp kelgen nerselerdi zhalganga chygaruun'ar menen kunookorlordon bolup kalasyn'ar.

Anyn eli aitty: <<Oo, Khud! Sen bizdi ishendire turgandai achyk dalil alyp kelbedin'. Senin dalilsiz sozun' sebeptuu biz kudailarybyzga syiynuunu tashtabaibyz. Chyndygynda, sen ozun'du paigambar dep yrastap zhatkan nersege biz saga yiman keltiruuchulordon da emespiz.

Biz: <<Sen bizdi kudailarybyzga syiynuudan tyiganyn' uchun seni kee bir kudailarybyz zhindi kylyp koidu>> - dep gana aitabyz. Khud aitty: <<Men Allakhty kubo kylamyn zhana siler da kubo bolgula: Albette men siler syiyngan Allakhtan bashka kudailaryn'arga syiynuudan alysmyn. Oshonduktan meni zhindi kylyp koidu dep siler oilogon kudailaryn'ar da zhana siler da maga ailakerlik kyla bergile. Andan kiiin menden moonot surabagyla.

Biz: <<Sen bizdi kudailarybyzga syiynuudan tyiganyn' uchun seni kee bir kudailarybyz zhindi kylyp koidu>> - dep gana aitabyz. Khud aitty: <<Men Allakhty kubo kylamyn zhana siler da kubo bolgula: Albette men siler syiyngan Allakhtan bashka kudailaryn'arga syiynuudan alysmyn. Oshonduktan meni zhindi kylyp koidu dep siler oilogon kudailaryn'ar da zhana siler da maga ailakerlik kyla bergile. Andan kiiin menden moonot surabagyla.

Chyndygynda, men zhalgyz Allakhka tobokel kylamyn zhana bardyk ishterimde Aga gana taianam. Antkeni Al menin Rabbim zhana silerdin da Rabbin'er. Zher betinde kandai gana basyp zhurgon nerse bolbosun Allakhtyn padyshalygynyn zhana bashkaruusunun astynda moiun sunushat. Allakh alardy kaalagandai bashkarat. Albette menin Rabbim akyikat zholunda zhana adilettuu. Oshonduktan Allakh silerdi maga ech kachan ustomduk kyldyrbait. Antkeni men akyikat zholundamyn, a siler tuura emes bagyttasyn'ar.

Eger men alyp kelgen nerseden zhuz burup karshy chyksan'ar da silerge zhetkiruu maga mildet. Allakh maga zhibergen, zhetkiruugo buirugan bardyk nerselerdi men silerge zhetkirdim. Albette silerge karshy kubo boluuchu dalil turdu. Zhakynda silerdi Rabbim kyiratyp zhok kylat. Zhana silerdin ordun'arga silerden bashka eldi keltirip koiot. Siler Allakhty zhalganga chygaruun'ar menen zhana Aga karshy chyguun'ar menen chon' da kichine da zyian zhetkire albaisyn'ar. Antkeni Al oz pendelerine muktazh emes. Chyndygynda, Rabbim bardyk nerseni kozomoldoochu. Oshonduktan Al meni amalkoilugun'or menen kylgan zhamandyktardan saktait.

Alardy kyiratuu uchun buirugubuz kelgende Khud zhana any menen birge bolgon yimanduulardy Biz taraptan zhetken yraiymduuluk menen aman kaltyrdyk. Zhana Biz anyn kaapyr koomun azaptagan katuu azaptan alardy saktadyk.

Al Aad koomu oz Rabbisinin aiat-belgilerin chetke kagyp paigambary Khudka da karshy chygyshty. Antkeni alar ar bir akyikatty kabyl aluudan tekeberlengen zhana chekten ashyp any kabyl kylbagandardyn buiruguna bash iiishti.

Alardy bul duinodo korduk eerchidi zhana alar Allakhtyn yraiymynan kuulushtu. Oshondoi ele kyiamat kunundo dagy alar Allakhtyn yraiymynan alys bolushat. Bul nerselerdin baary alar Allakh Taalaga kaapyr bolushkandygy sebebinen boldu. Allakh alardy bardyk zhakshylyktan alystatyp, alarga bardyk zhamandykty zhakyndatty.

Samud koomuna alardyn bir tuugany Salikhti Paigambar kylyp zhiberdik. Al aitty: <<Oo, elim! Zhalgyz Allakhka gana syiyngyla. Siler uchun Allakhtan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu zat zhok. Al Allakh tupku atan'ar Adamdy zherdin topuragynan zharatuu menen silerdi da zharatty. Zhana silerdi anda zhashoochulardan kyldy. Oshonduktan siler Andan kechirim suragyla da andan kiiin ibadattardy atkaryp, kunoolordu tashtap Aga kaitkyla. Chyndygynda, Rabbim chyn yklastan ibadat kylgandarga zhakyn zhana Al duba kylgandardyn dubasyn kabyl kylat.

Aga eli aitty: <<Ei, Salikh! Sen bizdin arabyzda bul dinge chakyruuga cheiin ordun' biiik abroiluu elen'. Biz chyndap ele nasaatchy, ken'eshchi, akylduu boluun'du umut kylgan elek. Ei, Salikh! Sen bizdin ata-babalarybyz syiyngan nersege syiynuudan tyiasyn'by? Chynynda, biz zhalgyz Allakhka ibadat kyluuga chakyryp zhatkan nersen'e shektenebiz. Al nerse seni Allakhka zhalgan nerseni aityp zhatat dep kunoologonubuzgo turtku bolup zhatat.

Salikh oz eline zhoop iretinde myndai dedi: <<Oo, elim! Maga aitkylachy! Men Rabbim taraptan achyk dalil boldum, maga Rabbim paigambarlykty berdi. Eger men silerge zhetkiruugo buirugan nerseni zhetkirbesten tashtap kunookor bolsom, kim meni Anyn azabynan kutkarat? Siler maga adashuudan bashka zhana Anyn yrazylygynan alystatuudan bashka ech nerse aitkan zhoksun'ar.

Oo, elim! Bul Allakhtyn toosu - silerge chyndykty aitkandygymdyn belgisi. Any bosh tashtap koigula. Allakhtyn zherinde ottop zhuro bersin. Aga ech kandai zyian berbegile. Eger siler any soison'or zhakynky ubakta bashyn'arga azap tushot.

Alar any chekten ashyp zhalganga chygaryshkandygy uchun soiup salyshty. Oshondo alarga Salikh aitty: <<Ozun'ordun zherin'erde any soigon kundon bashtap uch kunduk zhashoon'ordu paidalangyla. Andan kiiin silerge Allakhtyn azaby tushot. Allakhtyn azabynyn keluusu zhalgan emes, sozsuz turdo atkaryluuchu ubada. Taktap aikanda al chynygy ubada>>.

Alardy kyiratyp zhok kyluuga buirugubuz kelgende Biz Salikhti zhana any menen birge bolgon yimanduulardy Biz taraptan bolgon yraiymduuluk menen aman kaltyrdyk. Alardy oshol kundun korkunuchunan zhana kordugunan saktap kaldyk. Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda, senin Rabbin' Kuchtuu zhana Kudurettuu. Aga ech kim ustomduk kyla albait. Oshonduktan Al zhalganga chygargan koomdu kyiratyp zhok kyldy.
Samud koomuna asmandan kyiratuuchu katuu un tushkondo undun katuulugunan baary olushtu. Alar betteri menen zhygylyshyp alardyn betteri topurakka zhabyshyp kaldy.

Kudum alar oz shaarlarynda zhashoo zhyrgalchylygynda zhana zhakshylygynda zhashashpagan syiaktuu. Chyndygynda, Samud koomu Rabbisi Allakhka kaapyr bolushpadyby. Oshonduktan alar ar daiym Allakhtyn yraiymynan alys.

Perishteler Ibrakhim paigambarga adam kelbetinde kelishti da aga zhana aialyna Iskhak, andan kiiin Iakub menen suiunchuloshtu. Oshondo perishteler: <<Salam>> - dep aitkanda aga Ibrakhim oz sozu menen: <<Salam>> - dep zhoop berdi. Ibrakhim alardy adamdar dep kumon kylyp shashyp chygyp, alar zhesh uchun kaktalyp byshyrylgan torpoktu alyp keldi.

Sara bul suiunchu kabarga tan'yrkaganda perishteler aityshty: <<Sen Allakh tagdyr kylgan nersege zhana Anyn buiruguna tan' kalasyn'by?!>>. Albette sendei adamdar uchun Allakh Taala bardyk nersege Kudurettuu ekendigi zhashyruun emes. Ei, Ibrakhimdin ui bulosu! Silerge Allakhtyn yraiymy zhana berekesi bolsun. Chyndygynda, Allakh sypattarynda zhana ishterinde maktoogo ee bolgon zat zhana Dan'azaluu, Uluuluk eesi.

Ibrakhimdin aialy Sara turgan ele. Aga Biz any suiunto turgan nerseni kabar berdik. Al suiunuchtuu kabar - Sara Iskhakty toroit. Iskhaktyn Iakub attuu balasy bolot. Oshondo al suiunuchtuu kabardy ukkanda kubandy.

Perishte Saraga bul kabardy suiunchulogon kezde al tan'yrkap: <<Men kartaiyp baladan umutsuz bolsom, kuioom da karylyk zhashyna zhetken bolso, kantip toroimun? Ushul kurakta boiuna bala boluusu adatta tan' kalaarlyk nerse esmepi>> - dep aitty.

Sara bul suiunchu kabarga tan'yrkaganda perishteler aityshty: <<Sen Allakh tagdyr kylgan nersege zhana Anyn buiruguna tan' kalasyn'by?>>. Albette sendei adamdar uchun Allakh Taala bardyk nersege kudurettuu ekendigi zhashyruun emes. Ei, Ibrakhimdin ui bulosu! Silerge Allakhtyn yraiymy zhana berekesi bolsun. Chyndygynda Allakh sypattarynda zhana ishterinde maktoogo ee bolgon zat zhana Dan'azaluu, Uluuluk eesi.

Ibrakhim paigambar tamagyn zhebegen konoktorunan kabatyrlandy. Al alardy perishte ekendigin bilip anyn korkunuchu ketkenden kiiin aga: <<Albette Ibrakhimden Iskhak, andan kiiin Iskhaktan Iakub torolot>> - degen shashylysh kabar keldi. Bizdin elchibiz Lut koomunun abaly tuuraluu, taktap aitkanda perishteler alarga tushuuchu azapty kechiktirishebi zhe bolboso alar Lut zhana anyn ui-bulosun kutkaryshaby degen umut menen talashyp-tartysha bashtady.
