Chyndygynda Ibrakhim tusho turgan azaptyn kechiguusun zhakshy korgon sabyrduu, oz Rabbisine kop-kop ibadat, kop-kop duba, toobo kyluuchu.

Perishteler aityshty: <<Oo, Ibrakhim! Lut koomu tuuraluu bolgon talash-tartyshty tashtagyn. Antkeni alarga tagdyr kylgan azaptyn tushuusuno Rabbin'din buirugu keldi. Chyndygynda Lut koomuna chon' azap kelet. Any talash-tartysh da, duba da kaitara albait>>.

Perishteler Lutka adam surotundo kelishkende, Lut alardyn keluusun zhaman kordu. Aialdardy kaalashpai erkekter menen kumarlaryn kandyryshkan koomunan Lut korkkonu sebeptuu zhurogu kysyldy. Oshondo al koomu ustomduk kylyp konoktorun ustuno kirip kelishet dep kumon kylyp: <<Bul oor kun>> - dep aitty.

Lut paigambarga anyn koomu uiuno kelgen konoktoru menen buzuku ishti kyluu maksatynda shashkalaktap kelishti. Alardyn erkekteri buga cheiin ele aialdaryn karabastan erkekter menen kumarlanuunu adat kylyp alyshkan ele. Lut oz koomun korgop, konoktorunun aldynda uzur surap, koomuna myndai dep aitty: <<Tigi menin kyzdarym silerdin koomun'ardagy aialdardan, myna osholorgo uilongulo. Antkeni alar siler uchun buzukuluk ishin'erden taza. Allakhtan korkula. Meni konoktorumdun aldynda uiatka kaltyrbagyla. Oo, koomum! Silerdin aran'arda bul buzuku ishten toskon akylduu kaitaruuchu erkek zhokpu?

Aga koomu myndai dep aitty: <<Oo, Lut! Chyndygynda biz senin kyzdaryn'a zhana koomun'dun aialdaryna da, alar menen kumarlanuuga da muktazh emestigibizdi bilgensin'. Albette sen biz emneni kaalap zhatkan nerseni da bilgensin'. Biz erkekterdi gana kaalap turabyz.
Lut aitty: <<Attin' ai! Silerdi toktotuuga kuchum zhetkende zhe meni korgogon koomum bolgondo, anda men silerdi konoktorumdan tosmokmun>>.

Lut paigambarga perishteler aityshty: <<Oo, Lut! Chyndygynda biz Allakh zhibergen elchibiz. Koomun' ech kachan saga zhamandyk zhetkire albait. Sen bul aiyldan ui-bulon' menen karan'gy tun bolgondo chygyp ketkin. Silerdin ech kimin'er artyn burulup karabasyn. Birok senin aialyn' artka burulup kalyp kalat. Antkeni koomun'a zhetken azap aga da zhetet. Alardyn kyiroo ubaktysy tan'ga zhuuk bolot. Al oto zhakynky ubakyt>>.
Lut koomuna bizdin kyiratuuchu buirugubuz kelgende alar zhashagan aiyldy kotorup astyn-ustun kylyp ton'korup saldyk. Zhana alarga asmandan toktoosuz tash zhaagan zhamgyr zhaadyrdyk.

Bul tashtar Allakhtyn aldynda ataiyn belgiler menen belgilengen. Al tashtar kuraishtyk zhana andan bashka zaalymdarga tushuusu da alys emes. Balkim al tashtardyn tushuusu zhakyn. Allakh al tashtardyn tushuusun kachan tagdyr kylgan bolso, anda oshol ubakta alarga tushot.

Madiian koomuna (alardyn ozunon chykkan) bir tuugany Shuaibdy zhiberdik. Al myndai dedi: <<O, elim! Zhalgyz Allakhka ibadat kylgyla. Siler uchun Allakhtan bashka ibadatka tatyktuu zat zhok. Adamdarga bir nerseni olchop zhe tarazaga tartyp bergen uchurda tarazadan zhe chen-olchomdon azaityp aldabagyla. Chynynda, men silerde kenen yrysky, zhakshylykty korup turamyn. Andyktan, ozun'or kunoo kylyp Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryn azaityp albagyla. Chynynda men silerdin ar birin'erge keluuchu kundun azabynan korkom. Al kundun azabynan kachyp kutuluuga bash kalkaloochu zhai taba albaisyn'ar.

Oo, elim! Ozun'ordon bashkalarga bir nerseni olchop zhe tartyp zhatkanyn'arda tarazany zhe olchomdu adilettuuluk menen tartkyla. Adamdardyn akylarynan bir nerseni aldap alyp azaitpagyla. Zher betinde olturuu zhana bashka kunoolor menen buzukuluktu taratpagyla.

Adamdardyn akylary adilettuuluk menen otolgondon kiiin Allakh silerge kaltyrgan adal nerselerde, zher betinde buzukuluk taratuuga zhana aldap alyngan ashykcha nerselerge karaganda oto kop zhakshylyktar zhana berekeler bar. Egerde chynygy yimanduu bolson'or, anda kalgan adal nerselerge yraazy bolgula. Men silerge kylgan ishin'erdi eseptep siler menen esepteshken kozomoldoochu emesmin. Birok Al bardyk nerselerdi Kozomoldoochu kupuia zhana zhashyruun syrdy bilgen Zat.

Shuaibtyn eli aga aityshty: <<Ei, Shuaib! Allakh uchun okugan namazyn' saga bizdin ata-babalarybyz syiyngan kudailarga syiynuunu tashtoogo buiuraby? Zhana bizdi mal-mulkubuzdu kaalagandai ishtetuunu zhana kaalagandai koboituunu tashtoogo buiuraby? Chyndygynda sen kechirimduu tuura zholdu korgozuuchusun. Sen bizdi bul dinge chakyrardan murda ele biz seni akylduu danyshman dep tanyit elek. Saga emne boldu?

Shuaib oz eline aitty: <<Oo, elim! Maga abalyn'ardy aitkylachy! Men Rabbim taraptan achyk dalil zhana korogoch boldum. Maga Rabbim taraptan adal yrysky zhana Al taraptan paigambarlyk berildi. Andyktan men silerdi bir nerseden kaitaryp any atkargyla dep karshy chyguunu kaalabaimyn. Men kuchumdun zhetishinche silerdi Rabbin'erge sherik koshpoi zhalgyz aga syiynuuga chakyryp, silerdi on'oluun'ardy gana kaalaimyn. Myna ushulardyn boluusuna aruu Allakh gana iigilik beret. Bardyk ishterimde Aga gana tobokel kylyp kaitamyn.

Oo, elim! Menin silerge karshy chykkanym, silerdi men alyp kelgen nerseni zhalganga chygarganga turtposun. Nukh, Khud zhana Salikhtin elderi azap korgondoi silerge da oshondoi azap kelishinen korkom. Al emi Luttun elinin zhashagan zheri zhana zamany da silerden uzak emes. Alardyn bashyna emne tushkonun bildin'er. Emi sabak algyla.
Siler Rabbin'erden kechirim suragyla. Kunoolorun'or uchun Aga toobo kylgyla. Chyndygynda Rabbim toobo kylgandarga yraiymduu. Alardyn toobo kylgandaryna Anyn suiuusu oto kuchtuu.

Shuaibdyn eli Shuaibga aitty: "Ei, Shuaib! Sen alyp kelgen nersege kop tushuno berbeibiz. Seni bizdin arabyzdan alsyz oiloibuz, antkeni eki kozun' zhakshy korboit zhe kor bolup kalgansyn'. Egerde senin uruk tuugandaryn' bizdin dinibizde bolbogondo, seni tash baran'ga alyp olturmokpuz. Seni olturuudon korkkondoi sen bizge syiluu emessin'. Bolgonu senin zhakyn tuugandaryn'dy urmattaganybyzdan seni olturboi tashtap koiduk".

Shuaib eline aitty: "Oo, elim! Emne silerge menin uruk tuugandarym silerdin Rabbin'er bolgon Allakhtan da syiluu zhana urmattuubu? Silerge zhonotkon paigambaryna yiman keltirbei koigon kezin'erde Allakhty arkan'arga kaltyryp, tashtap koidun'ar. Chyndygynda Rabbim silerdin kylganyn'ardy but taraptan bilip turat. Aga kylgan ishterin'erdin ech nersesi zhashyruun emes. Bul kylganyn'ar uchun silerdi bul duinodo kyiroo zhana Akyrette azap menen zhazalait.

Oo, elim! Siler yraazy bolgon zholun'arda kolun'ardan kelgenin kylgyla. Men da ozum yraazy bolgon zholumda koluman kelgenin kylamyn. Zhakynda kimibizge zhaza katary azap kelip kor boloorun zhana kimibizdin aitkan sozdorubuz zhalgan ekenin bilesin'er. Emi Allakhtyn buga bolgon okumun kutkulo! Men da siler menen birge kutomun.

Shuaibdyn elin kyiratuuga buiruk kelgende, Shuaibdy zhana any menen yiman keltirgenderdi bizdin oz yraiymybyz menen kutkardyk. Al emi anyn elinen bolgon zalymdar katuu kyiratuuchu undon olushtu. Zherge zhuzdoru menen kulashyp, betteri topurakka zharmashyp kaldy.

Alar buga cheiin al zherde murda zhashabagan syiaktuu bolup kalyshty. Alarga Allakhtyn azaby zhetip, murda Samud koomuna Allakhtyn kaary tushup, anyn yraiymynan alystatylgandai myna Madiian da Allakhtyn yraiymynan alystatyldy.
Chyndygynda Musany Allakhtyn zhalgyz ekendigine dalil bolgon belgileribiz menen zhana anyn alyp kelgeninin chyndyk ekenine achyk-aikyn dalilderibiz menen zhonottuk.

Any Faraongo zhana anyn elinin kadyr barktuularyna zhonottuk. Al emi kadyr barktuulary bolso Faraondun "Allakhka kaapyr bolgula" degen buirugun eerchishti. Any eerchigendei Faraondun buirugu akyikatka tuura kelbeit.
Kyiamat kunu Faraon elin ozu bashtap kelip, baary tozokko kiret. Tozokko alyp baruuchu zhol kandai gana zhaman zhol.

Alar suuga chogup kyiragandaryna koshumcha kylyp Allakh alardy bul duinodo Oz yraiymynan alystatyp, kargyshka kaltyrdy. Oshondoi ele alardy kyiamat kunu da Oz yraiymynan alystatty. Alar uchun bul duinodo da akyrette da kargyshtyn ustuno kargysh zhana azap bolgonu kandai zhaman!
Oo, paigambar! Saga bul suroodo kelgen shaarlardyn kabaryn aitabyz. Bul shaarlardyn kee birlerinin belgileri dagy ele turat. Kee birlerinin ech kandai belgi kalbastan ochup zhok bolup ketken.

Alarga kyiroo alyp kelgenibiz menen biz alarga zulumduk kylbadyk. Birok alar Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyshyp, kyiroogo alyp kelgen zholdu tandashyp, ozdoruno ozdoru zulumduk kylyshty. Ei, paigambar! Rabbin'din alardy kyiratuuga buirugu kelgende, alarga tushkon azaptan alardyn Allakhtan bashkaga syiynyp zhatkan kudailary al azapty toso alyshpady. Alardyn bul kudailary alarga bir gana zhogotuu zhana kyiroonu alyp keldi.

Oshondoi ele zhalganga chygargan shaarlardy Allakh azaptady, myndai azaptoo zhana zhok kyluu bardyk zamanda zhana bardyk zherde bolup kelgen. Chyndygynda zalym bolgon shaarlardyn azaby zhan chydagys katuu azap bolot.

Chyndygynda al eli zaalym bolgon shaarlardy katuu azaptoosu kyiamat kunundogu azaptan korkkondorgo sabak bolot. Al kunu Allakh al zherge adamdardy surak alysh uchun chogultat. Al kubo kylyngan kun. Al zherde chogulgandardyn baarysy aga kubo bolushat.
Al kubo kylyna turgan kundu kechiktirbei sany belgiluu bolgon kungo gana zhyldyrabyz.

Oshol kun kelgende ech bir zhan dalil kylyp zhe shapaat surap suiloi albait, bir gana Allakh uruksat bergenden kiiin suiloshot. Al zherde adamdar eki turduu bolushat: baktysyzdar tozokko kiret zhana baktyluular beiishke kiret.

Al emi baktysyzdar bolso kaapyrlyk kylgandary zhana kylgan ishteri tuura emes bolgonu uchun tozokko kirishet. Al zhakta tozoktun zhalynynan oto katuu zapky zhegendikterinen alardyn undoru zhana dem algandary katuu chygat.

Asmandar menen zher turganda alar tozokton chygyshpait. Alar al zhakta tuboluk kalyshat. Bir gana zhalgyz Allakhka syiyngan kunookorlordon Allakh Ozu kaalaganyn al zhaktan chygarat. Ei, paigambar! Chyndygynda Rabbin' kaalaganyn kyluuchu. Allakhty ech kim mazhburlai albait.

Al emi baktyluular bolso Allakhtyn baktyluu bolot degen murda zhazylgan tagdyry menen yiman keltirgenderi uchun zhana zhakshy ishteri uchun alar asman menen zher turganda beiishte tuboluk bolushat. Bir gana Allakh kaalagan kunookor yimanduulardy beiishke kirgizerden murda tozokko kirgizet. Chyndygynda beiish eelerine bolgon Allakhtyn zhakshylyktary tugongus.

Oo, paigambar! Al mushrikterdin syiynyp zhatkandary tuura emes ekendiginde sende ech shek-kumon bolbosun. Bul nersenin tuura ekendiginde alarda shariiatka zhana akylga tuura kelgendei ech kandai dalilderi zhok. Chyndygynda alardy Allakhtan bashkaga syiynuuga turtkon nerse - ata-babalaryn eerchuusu. A biz bolso alarga azaptan bolgon enchisin kemitpei toluk berebiz.

Chyndygynda Biz Musaga Toorat kitebin berdik. Adamdar al tuurasynda talashyp tartyshyp kalyshty. Kee biri aga yiman keltirse, kee biri aga kaapyr bolushtu. Egerde Allakhtyn tagdyry murda zhazylbaganda, alar tatyktuu bolgon azapty bul duinodo tushurmok. Chyndygynda al azapty erteletpei daanyshmandyk kylyp kyiamat kununo kechiktirip koidu. Chyndygynda zhoottor zhana mushrikterden bolgon kaapyrlar Kuranga bolgon shekteri alardy kumongo tushurot.

O, paigambar! Zhogoruda aitylgan talashyp- tartyshuuchulardyn baaryna Rabbin' alardyn kylgan ishterine zharasha zhaza-syilygyn toluk beret. Eger kylgan ishi zhakshy bolso, syiy da zhakshy bolot. Kylgan ishi zhaman bolso, zhazasy da zhaman bolot. Chynynda, Allakh alardyn kylyp zhatkan ishterin maida-chuidosuno cheiin Biluuchu. Alardyn kylgan ishterinin ech biri Allakhka zhashyruun emes.

Oo, paigambar! Sen tuura zholdo daiyma Allakh buirugandai zhur. Buiruktaryna moiun sun, tyigandarynan alys bol. Seni menen birge toobo kylgan yimanduular menen tuura zholdo bekem bol. Kunoo kylyp, chekten ashyp ketpegile. Chyndygynda Allakh emne kylyp zhatkanyn'ardy Koruuchu. Silerdin ishterin'erdin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhana silerdin kylgan ishterin'erge zharasha zhakynda zhaza-syilyk beret.

Zalym kaapyrlardy suiup zhe koshamat kylyp alarga yktabagyla. Myndai yktagandyktyn sebebinen siler tozokko tushosun'or. Silerdi tozokton kutkara turgan Allakhtan bashka ech bir dos zhok. Andan kiiin silerge zhardam beruuchunu tappaisyn'ar.

Oo, paigambar! Namazdy erten' menen kechinde en' zhakshy abalda okugun. Oshondoi ele namazdy tunku ubaktarda da oku. Chyndygynda zhakshy ishter kichine kunoolordu ochurot. Bul aitylgandar ulgu aluuchular uchun nasaat, sabak aluuchular uchun sabak.

Sen buirulgan tuura zholdo zhana bashka ishterde oshondoi ele sen tyiylgan chekten ashuuda zhana zaalymdarga taianuunu tashtoodo sabyr kyl. Chyndygynda Allakh zhakshylyk kylgandyrdyn soobun zhok kylbait. Tetirisinche alardyn kylgan en' zhakshy ishterin kabyl kylat zhana alar kylgan ishterinin soobun andan da zhakshy kylyp syilyk beret.

Kana eger silerden murunku azaptalgan elderdin arasynda zherde kunoo menen buzukuluk kylgandardy zhana kaapyrlyktan kaitara turgan oshol elde zhakshy takyba adamdar bolgondo, birok andai adamdar bolgon zhok. Bolgonu alardan oto azy gana buzukuluktan tyiyshty. Biz alardy zalym elderin kyiratkan kezibizde kutkaryp kaldyk. Alardyn elderinen bolgon zaalymdar ozdorundo bolgon duino zhyrgalchylyktaryna eerchishti. Zaalymdar aga eerchip ketishti.

Oo, paigambar! Egerde kaisy bir shaardyn eli zher betinde zhakshylykka chakyrgandardan bolso, anda Rabbin' alardy zhok kylbait. Chyndygynda zherde kaapyrlyk, zulumduk zhana kunoo kylyp buzuku kylgan shaardyn elin kyiratat.

Oo, paigambar! Egerde Rabbin' kaalaganda, adamdardyn baaryn akyikat zholunda zhurgon bir ummot kylyp koimok. Birok Al andai bolushun kaalabady. Alar dushmandyk kylgandyktary zhana oz kaaloolorun eerchigen sebeptuu al nersede talashyp tartyshyp zhatyshat.

Bir gana Allakh yraiym kylyp, tuura zholgo iigilik bergenderden bashka. Chyndygynda alar Al Aruu Zattyn zhalgyz ekendiginde talashyshpait. Myna ushul synoo uchun Al Aruu Zat alardy ar kandai kylyp zharatty. Alardan baktyluusu zhana baktysyzy bar. Ei, paigambar! Senin Rabbin' abalky tagdyr zhazmyshynda "tozoktu zhinderden zhana adamdardan bolgon shaitandy eerchigender menen tolturat" degen sozu toluk atkaryldy.

Oo, paigambar! Biz saga aityp bergen okuialardyn baarysy senden murdagy elchilerdin okuialary. Al okuialardy saga kuch berip zhana zhurogun'du akyikatka bekemdesh uchun aittyk. Bul suroodo saga ech shegi zhok akyikat keldi. Zhana mynda kaapyrlar uchun nasaat zhana eskertuulordon paida algan yimanduular uchun eskertuulor aityldy.

Oo, paigambar! Allakhka yiman keltirbegenderge zhana Any zhalgyzdabagandarga aitkyn: "Siler akyikattan zhuz burgan zhana aga zhol toskon zholun'arda zhuro bergile. Biz da oz zholubuzda bekem bolup, aga chakyryp zhana al zholdo sabyr kyla berebiz.
Bizge emne tushorun kutkulo. Biz da silerge emne tushorun kutobuz.

Asmandardagy zhana zherdegi kozgo korunbogondordun ilimi zhalgyz Allakhka gana taandyk. Aga alardyn ech nersesi zhashyruun emes. Kyiamat kunu ishterdin baardygy zhalgyz Ozuno kaitat. Ei, paigambar! Anyn Ozuno gana syiyn zhana bardyk ishterin'de aga tobokel kyl. Rabbin' silerdin kylyp zhatkanyn'ardan beikapar emes. Teskerisinche Al any bilet zhana ar birinin kylganyna zharasha zhaza-syilyk beret.
(lr) "Alif laam raa" bul tamgalar zhana ushuga okshogon aiattar tuurasynda bakara suroosunun bashynda aityldy. Bul suroodogu tushkon myna ushul aiattar - achyk-aikyn Kurandyn aiattarynan.
Oo, arabdar! Siler Kurandyn maanilerin tushunush uchun any arab tilinde tushurduk.

Oo, paigambar! Biz saga bul Kuran kitebin tushuruu menen chynygy bolup otkon zhana sozdoru menen korkomdugu kemchiliksiz en' sonun okuialardy aityp berebiz. Chyndygynda, bul okuialardy tushurgongo cheiin senin kabaryn' zhok ele. Zhana bul tuurasynda sende ech kandai ilim bolgon emes.

Oo, paigambar! Iusuf atasy Iakubga myndai dep aitkandygy tuurasynda Biz saga kabar berebiz. Al: "Oo, atake! Men tushumdo on bir zhyldyzdy zhana kun menen aidy kordum. Zhana alardyn baary maga sazhda kylyp zhatyshkandygyn kordum" - dep aitty. Myna bul tush Iusuf paigambarga suiunuch kabary bolgon.

Iakub balasy Iusufka myndai dep aitty: "Ei, balam! Bul tushun'du agalaryn'a aitpa. Tushunup kalyp seni koro albai zhurbosun. Koralbastyktyn aiynan saga aila-amal kylyp zhurbosun. Chyndygynda, shaitan adamga achyk dushman boldu".

Oo, Iusuf! Sen bul tushtu korushun' menen seni Rabbin' tandap alat. Zhana saga tush zhoruunu uirotot zhana saga paigambarlyk beret. Ata-babalaryn' Ibrakhim zhana Iskhak paigambarlarga Oz zhakshylyktaryn toluktap bergendei ele saga da zhakshylyktaryn toluktap beret. Chyndygynda, Rabbin' zharatkan makluktaryn Biluuchu. Bashkaruusunda Daanyshman.
Chynynda Iusuf tuurasynda zhana anyn agalary tuurasyndagy kabarlarda suragan adamdar uchun sabaktar zhana eskertemeler bar.
Anyn agalary oz ara suiloshkon kezde biri-birine myndai dep aityshty: "Bizdin bir tuuganybyz Iusuf biz kopchuluk bolsok da atabyzga bizge karaganda suikumduu

Iusuftu olturgulo zhe alys zherge alyp baryp zhok kylgyla. Oshondo atan'ardyn zhuzu silerge burulup silerdi toluk zhakshy korup kalat. Siler Iusuftu olturup zhe zhok kylgandan kiiin kylgan kunoon'or uchun toobo kylyp zhakshy adamdardan bolosun'ar.

Agalarynyn biroosu aitty: "Iusuftu olturbogulo. Birok any kuduktun tubuno tashtap zhibergile. Kuduktun zhanynan otkon musapyrlar any alyp ketishet. Oshondo any olturuudon bir az zhen'ilireek bolot. Egerde ushul tuurasynda aitkan sozun'ordo chynchyl bolson'or, anda ushundai kylgyla".

Kachan alar Iusuftu alyska alyp baryp tashtaibyz degen bir sozgo kelishkende atasy Iakubka kelip myndai dep aityshty: "Oo, atake! Emnege Iusuftu bizge berip ishene albaisyz? Biz aga yraiym kylyp zyian kelgen nerseden saktaibyz. Iusuf sizge kaityp kelgiche biz any saktap zhana korgop boorukerlik menen alyp baryp kelebiz. Iusuftu biz menen zhonotuugo sizdi emne tosup zhatat?".
Erten' Iusuftu biz menen baryp tamak zhep es alyp oinop keluusuno uruksat berin'iz. Biz aga zhetken bardyk zyiandardan any saktap zhurobuz.

Iakub baldaryna myndai dep aitty: "Iusuf menen barganyn'ar meni kapalandyrat. Antkeni al menden azhyragandygyna sabyr kyla albaimyn. Siler oinop es alyp zhatyp andan kabarsyz kalganda any karyshkyr zhep ketishinen korkomun.

Alar atasyna aityshty: "Egerde aga karyshkyr kol sala turgan bolso, biz zhamaat bolup turup any korgoi albasak, anda bizden ech kandai paida zhok. Any karyshkyrdan korui albasak, anda biz zyianga uchurap kalabyz.

Iakub Iusuftu alar menen zhiberdi. Any alyska alyp baryshyp, kuduktun tubuno yrgytuunu chechishti. Biz oshol uchurda Iusufka aian berdik: "Ushul kylgan ishteri zhonundo alarga kabar beresin', birok alar saga maani berishpeit".
Iusuftun agalary kechinde aila-amaldaryn ishke ashyrysh uchun yilamsyrap atasyna kelishti.

Alar aityshty: "Oo, atake! Biz zhaa atyshyp, zhoo zharyshyp oinop, Iusuftu kiiimderibizdin zhana tamaktarybyzdyn zhanyna karap tursun dep tashtap ketsek, karyshkyr zhep ketiptir. Chyndygynda biz al zhonundo aitkan sozubuzdo chynchyl bolsok da siz bizge ishenbeisizbi?".

Iusuftu karyshkyr zhep ketti dep koinoguno anyn kany bolbogon bashka bir kandy boiop, bul kabardy ailakerlik menen tastyktashty. Birok Iakub alardyn zhalgan maksatyn kiiimine karap tushundu, antkeni kiiim tytylgan emes bolchu. Iakub alarga aitty: "Birok bul ish siler aitkandai bolgon emes. Teskerisinche, napsin'er silerge kylgan zhaman ishin'erdi kooz korgozdu. Emi menin kylar ishim - naalybastan zhakshy sabyr kyluu. Iusuf tuuraluu siler aitkan sozdo Allakhtan gana zhardam suraim".

Anan zholoochu kerben kelip, alarga suu alyp keluuchu adamdy kudukka zhiberishti. Al chakasyn kudukka yrgytkanda Iusuf anyn zhibinen karmap ilinip aldy. Chakany yrgytkan kishi any korgondo - Suiunchuu! Bul bala go, - dep kubanyp ketti. Suu alyp keluuchu zhana anyn dostoru any bashka zholoochular korup kalbasyn dep buiumdardyn arasyna zhashyryp koiushtu. Allakhtyn aldynda alardyn kylgan ishteri zhashyruun emes. Iusuftu kordop, satykka koigondugun Allakh Biluuchu.

Suu alyp keluuchu zhana anyn dostoru Misirge kelgende Iusuftan tez kutulush uchun sanaluu dirkhamga satyp zhiberishti. Antkeni, anyn abalynan kul emestigi bilishti. Oz zhandaryna zyian bolbosun dep anyn tuugandarynan korkushtu. Oshonduktan alar menen kopko kalbady. Bulda bolso Allakhtyn Iusufka bolgon toluk yraiymynan.

Any Misirde satyp algan kishi aialyna aitty: "Aga zhakshy mamile kylyp, biz menen bolgondo aga syi korsot. Balkim ozubuzdun kee bir muktazhdyktarybyzdy buturuugo paidasy tiet. Zhe bolboso any bala kylyp bagyp alabyz. Iusuftu olumdon saktagandai, any kuduktan chygardyk. Oshondoi ele vazirdin zhurogun aga zhumshartyp koiduk. Aga tush zhoorunu uirotuu uchun any Misirde zhashattyk. Allakh Oz ishinde Zhen'uuchu zhana Anyn buirugu daiyma ishke ashat zhana any ech kim mazhburlai albait. Birok adamdardyn kopchulugu al nerseni bilishpeit. Antkeni alar kaapyrlar.
Iusuftun denesi kuchko tolgon zhashynda ilim zhana tuura tushunuk berdik. Ushul syiaktuu syilykty Allakhka syiynyp, zhakshy ish kylgandarga da berebiz.

Vazirdin aialy zhumshaktyk zhana ailakerlik menen Iusuftan buzukulukka baruunu suranyp, any menen zhalgyz kalysh uchun eshikterdin baaryn kulptady da aga: <<Beri kelchi maga!>> - dedi. Iusuf aitty: <<Allakh meni bul chakyryp zhatkan ishin'den saktasyn! Menin kozhoiunum oz aldynan meni zhakshy orunga zhaigashtyrdy. Men aga ech kachan kyianat kylbaim. Aga kyianattyk kylchu bolsom zalymdardan bolup kalam. Chyndygynda zalymdar zhen'ishke zhetishpeit>>.

Al aialdyn napsisi buzukuluk kyluunu kaalady. Egerde oshol nerseden any toktotup alystatkan Allakhtyn belgilerin korbogondo, al nerse anyn da oiuna kelmek. Any zhamandyktan saktash uchun zhana any zyna menen kyianattyktan alystatysh uchun Biz aga alardy korsottuk. Chyndygynda Iusuf paigambarlykka tandalgan pendeleribizden ele.

Ekoo ten' eshikti kozdoi zharysha churkap zhonoshtu, Iusuf ozun saktash uchun, tigil bolso any chygarbash uchun. Oshondo any chygarbaiyn dep koinogunon tartkanda arka zhagy airylyp ketti. Ekoosu eshiktin oozunan kuioosuno tush bolup kalyshty. Vazirdin aialy vazirge zhalgan suilop: <<Oo, vazir! Sizdin aialyn'yz menen buzukuluk kylam degendin zhazasy - zyndan zhe zhan kyinoochu azap bolsun!>> - dedi.

Iusuf (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy bolsun) myndai dedi: <<Al ozu meni buzuk ishke chakyrdy. Men any kaalagan da emesmin>>. Aialdyn tuugandarynan biroo kubo bolup: <<Egerde Iusuftun koinogu aldy zhagynan airylsa, anda aialdyn aitkany chyn ekenine dalil bolot. Antkeni, aial andan ozun korgogon bolot. Mynda tigi (Iusuf) zhalganchy bolot.
A, eger anyn koinogunun arty airylsa, anda bul Iusuftun chyn aityp zhatkanyna dalil bolot. Antkeni aial any azgyrdy, al bolso andan kachty. Mynda aial zhalganchy bolot>>.

Vazir Iusuftun koinogu art zhagynan airylganyn korgondo anyn aitkan sozu chyn ekeni anyk boldu. Al aitty: <<Ei, aialdar! Munun buga zhapkan zhalgan zhalaasy - silerdin ailakerligin'erden. Chyndygynda silerdin ailakerligin'er oto kuchtuu>>.
Iusufka aitty: <<Oo, Iusuf! Bul bolgon ishti kon'ulun'o alba, any ech kimge aitpa! A sen bolso kunoon' uchun kechirim sura. Chyndygynda sen Iusuftu azgyrganyn' sebeptuu kunookor boldun'>>.

Shaarda al tuuraluu soz tarkady. Bir top aialdar zhaktyrbagandai: <<Vazirdin aialy oz kulun azgyryptyr. Any chyn dilinen suiup kalyptyr. Biz anyn azgyrganyn zhana suiup kalganyn achyk ele adashuu dep oiloibuz>> - dep soz kylyshty.

Vazirdin aialy alardyn zhamandagandaryn zhana al zhonundo ushaktagandaryn ukkanda alar ozdoru Iusuftu korushsun, anan any zhemelegenin toktotushat dep alarga adam zhiberip chakyrtty. Alar uchun toshoktordu salyp, zhazdyktardy koiup ataiyn zhai daiardady da kelgen aialdardyn ar birine momo-zhemish kesip zhesin dep birden bychak berip: <<Bulardyn aldyna chyk!>> - dep Iusufka aitty. Alar any korushoru menen ushunchalyk uluktap, anyn suluuluguna akyl-esten tana tan'danyshyp, akyry ushunchalyk suktangandarynan momo-zhemish kesish uchun berilgen bychaktar menen koldorun kese bashtashty. Alar: <<Allakh aruu! Bul bala adamzattan emes. Bul anyk ele keremettuu perishtelerdin biri go!>> - deshti.

Aialdar ozdoruno emne bolgonun korushkondo vazirdin aialy alarga aitty: <<Any suiup kalganym uchun siler meni aiyptagan zhigit ushul! Men andan surandym, any azgyryshtyn ailasyn izdedim, birok al bash tartty. Egerde al men talap kylgandy kelechekte kylbai turgan bolso, anda al sozsuz zyndanga kiret zhana kordolgondordon bolot>>.

Iusuf paigambar Rabbisine duba kylyp aitty: <<Oo, Rabbim! Alar meni chakyryp zhatkan buzukulukka karaganda korkutup zhatyshkan zyndany maga suiuktuurook. Egerde Sen meni alardyn aila-amaldarynan kutkarbasan', alarga tartylyp ketem. A eger alarga tartylyp ketsem, anda naadandardan bolup kalam zhana alar menden kaalap zhatyshkandaryn ishke ashyryshat>>.

Allakh anyn dubasyn kabyl kyldy. Any vazirdin aialy menen shaardyk aialdardyn aila-amaldarynan kutkardy. Chyndygynda Allakh Taala Iusuftun dubasyn zhana ar bir duba kyluuchunun dubasyn Uguuchu, anyn zhana bashkalardyn abaldaryn Biluuchu.

Vazir zhana anyn zhan-zhookorloru dalilderdin negizinde Iusuftun kunoosuz ekendigin korushkondon kiiin bul uiat ish elge zhaiylyp ketpesin dep belgisiz moonotko any zyndanga oturguzuu tuuraluu oigo makuldashyshty.

Any zyndanga oturguzushtu. Any menen kosho eki zhigit da oturdu. Osholordun biroosu Iusufka: <<Men tushumdo sharap zhasash uchun zhuzum sygyp zhatyptyrmyn>> - dedi, al emi ekinchisi bolso: <<A men tushumdo bashyma nan kotorup baratypmyn, andan chymchyktar zhep zhatyshyptyr>> - dep tushtorun aityp: <<Oo, Iusuf! Emi tushubuzdu zhorup berchi. Biz seni zhakshylygyn aiabagan adamdardan dep oiloibuz>> - deshti.

Iusuf aitty: <<Ekoon'orgo padysha zhana bashkalar taraptan berilgen tamagyn'ar kelgenge cheiin silerge anyn akyikatyn zhana kandai bolorun aityp bereiin. Myna bu men bilgen tush zhoruu kasieti maga Rabbim uirotkon nerselerden. Bul kozu achyktyk zhe zhyzdyz tolgo emes. Chyndygynda men Allakhka yiman keltirbegen koomdun dinin tashtadym. Antkeni alar akyretke ishenishpeit.

Men ata-babalarym - Ibrakhim, Iskhak zhana Iakubdun dinin eerchidim. Al - zhalgyz Allakhka syiynuu dini. Biz uchun Allakhka bashkalardy sherik kyluu ylaiyk emes zhana zhalgyz syiynuuchuluk Aga gana taandyk. Men zhana ata-babalarym tutungan oshol zhalgyz Allakhka syiynuuchuluk menen yiman - bizge iigilik bergen Allakhtyn zhakshylyktarynan zhana zhalpy adamdarga kylgan zhakshylyktarynan. Antkeni Al alarga paigambarlardy zhiberdi. Birok adamdardyn kopchulugu Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryna shugur kylyshpait, teskerisinche, alardy tanyshat>>.
Andan son' Iusuf zyndandagy eki zhigitke kairylyp aitty: <<Kop kudailarga syiynuu zhakshyby, zhe ech bir sherigi zhok Zhalgyz zhana zhen'ilbes Kaarduu Allakhka syiyngan zhakshyby?>>.

Allakhtan bashka siler syiynyp zhatkan nerseler ozun'or zhana ata-babalaryn'ar kudailar dep atap alyshkan atyna zaty tuura kelbegen atalyshtardan bashka ech nerse emes. Alardyn kudai boluuga ech kandai ukugu zhok. Siler alarga ysymdardy yigaryp alganyn'ardy tuura degenge Allakh ech kandai dalil tushurgon emes. Butkul zharatylgandardyn okumu - siler zhana ata-babalaryn'ar atap algan ysymdarga emes, zhalgyz Allakhka gana taandyk. Allakh silerdi zhalgyz Aga gana syiynuun'ardy buirudu zhana Aga bashkalardy sherik kyluun'ardy tyidy. Myna oshol zhalgyz Allakhka syiynuuchuluk - ech kandai burmalanuusu zhok tuura din. Birok kopchuluk adamdar munu bilishpeit. Oshol sebepten alar Allakhka sherik koshushup, kee bir zharatylgandarga syiynyshat.

Oo, menin zyndandagy sherikterim! Tushundo sharap zhasash uchun zhuzum sygyp zhatkanyn korgon adam murunku ishine kaityp, kozhoiununa sharap kuiup beret. Al emi tushundo bashyna nan kotorup, andan chymchyktar chokup zhatkanyn korgon adam bolso butu-kulunan darga kagylyp olturulot, anan chymchyktar anyn bashynyn etinen chokup zheshet. Siler okumun suragan ishtin toluk chechmelenishi ushundai. Al sozsuz ishke ashat.

Iusuf ekoosunon aman chygat dep oilogonuna, tagyraak aitkanda kozhoiununa sharap kuiup bere turganyna aitty: <<Kozhoiunun'a menin okuiamdy zhana abalymdy aitkandy unutpa! Balkim al meni zyndandan chygarar>>. Kiiin shaitan sharap koiuuchuga Iusuf tuuraluu kozhoiuna aitkandy unutturup koidu. Oshondon kiiin da Iusuf zyndanda bir top zhyl zhatty.

Padysha aitty: <<Men tushumdo zheti semiz ui kordum. Alardy zheti aryk ui zhep zhatyptyr. Oshondoi ele zheti daana zhashyl mashak zhana zheti daana kuuragan mashak kordum. Ei, bashchylar zhana kadyrmandar! Kimin'er bul tushtun zhandyrmagyn bilsen'er, anda maga tushumdu zhorup bergile>>.
Alar aityshty: <<Korgon tushun'uz chatashkan tush eken. Eger ushundai bolso, anda al zhorulbait. Biz chatashkan tushtordu zhorui albaibyz>>.

Oshondo zyndandan aman chykkan sharap kuiuuchu Iusuftun tushtu zhakshy zhoruganyn zhana anyn abalyn kop ubakyttan kiiin esine tushurup: <<Men sizderge padyshanyn korgon tushu kandai zhorularyn tush zhorugandy zhakshy bilgen biroodon sizderge suratyp bereiin. Oo, padysha! Meni Iusufka zhiberin'iz, tushun'uzdu zhorutup keleiin>> - dedi.

Aman chykkany Iusufka kelip aitty: <<Oo, Iusuf! Oo, chynchyl zhigit! Biroo tushundo zheti semiz ui korup, alardy zheti aryk ui zhep zhatkan eken. Oshondoi ele zheti daana zhashyl mashak zhana zheti daana kuuragan mashak koruptur. Bizge bul tushtu zhorup ber. Men padyshaga zhana anyn zhanyndagylarga baryp aitaiyn. Balkim alar padyshanyn tushunun maanisin bilisher zhana senin artykchylygyn'dy zhana kadyryn'dy baamdashar.

Iusuf bul tushtu zhorup myndai dedi: <<Zheti zhyl boiu zhakshylap buudai egesin'er. Oshol zheti zhyldyn ar bir zhylynda zhyinagan tushumdon ozun'orgo zhete turgandai az gana bolugun zhegenge zhanchyp alyp, al emi kalgan bolugun kurttap ketpesh uchun mashagy menen kaltyrasyn'ar.

Andan son' oshol mol tushumduu zheti zhyldan kiiinki zheti zhyl kurgakchylyk bolot. Oshol zhyldary adamdar mol tushumduu zhyldary zhyinap saktap koigon tushumdun az gana bolugun urukka alyp kalyshat da kalganyn ozdoru zheshet.
Andan son' oshol kurgakchylyk zhyldardan kiiinki zhyly kop zhamgyr zhaait, eginder koktoit zhana adamdar zhuzum, zaitun, kant kamyshy symal kerektuu zhemishterdin shirelerin sygyp alyshat>>.

Padyshanyn tushun Iusuf kandai zhoruganyn ukkandan kiiin zhan-zhokorloruno: <<Any zyndandan chygargyla da maga alyp kelgile!>> - dedi. Iusufka padyshadan elchi kelgende al aga aitty: <<Bashchy kozhoiunun'a baryp koldorun kesishken aialdardyn okuiasyn suragyn. Chyndygynda Rabbim alardyn meni azgyrganyn Biluuchu. Aga bul nersenin ech biri zhashyruun emes>>. Al munu zyndandan chygardan murun ozunun aktygyn bildirish uchun aitty.

Padysha (Malik) aialdarga kairylyp: "Emne uchun Iusuftu ozun'or menen buzuku ishke baruusun talap kyldyn'ar?" dedi. Aialdar: "Allakhka ant bolsun, biz anyn ech zhamandygyn korboduk, aga zhalaa zhabylyp zhatat" dep zhoop berishti. Oshondo yzattuu kishinin aialy (Zulaika) aiybyn moiununa alyp: "Chyndyk achykka chykty, men any azgyruuga araket kylgam, al meni azgyrgan emes, anyn ozunun tazalygy zhana menin zhalgan zhalaam tuuraluu aitkany chyndyk" dedi.

Vazirdin aialy aitty: <<Men any ozum azgyrganymdy zhana kuioom zhokto aga kyianattyk kylbaganym chyn dep aitkan sozun moinuma alyp zhatkanymdy Iusuf bilsin. Men myndan zhalgan aitkandar menen aila-amal kylgandarga Allakh iigilik berbesin tushundum>>.

Vazirdin aialy sozun ulap myndai dedi: <<Zhamandyk ishti kaalaganymdy tanbaim. Men munu menen ozumdu aktaiyn degen oium zhok. Antkeni adamdyn napsisi ozu kaalaganga tartkany uchun zhana any toktotush kyiynga turgany uchun al zhaman ishterge kop buiruit. Bir gana Allakh yraiym kylgan napsiler gana andai kylyshpait. Allakh alardy zhamandykka buiuruudan korgodu. Chyndygynda Rabbim toobo kylgan pendelerine Kechirimduu, alarga Yraiymduu>>.

Padysha Iusuftun kunoosuz ekenin bilgenden kiiin zhardamchylaryna: <<Any maga alyp kelgile! Men any ozumo zhakyn alyp zhuroiun" dedi. Iusuftu aga alyp kelishti. Any menen suiloshkondon kiiin anyn bilimduu zhana akylduu ekeni anyk boldu. Padysha aga: <<Iusuf! Bugunton tarta sen bizdin aldybyzda kadyrluu, ardaktuu zhana ishenimduu adamga ailandyn'>> dedi.
Iusuf padyshaga: <<Meni Misir zhergesinin mal-mulk zhana azyk-tuluk kazynalaryna bashchy kylyp daiyndan'yz. Chyndygynda men ishenimduu kazynachymyn zhana atkargan ishimdi mykty bilemin>>.

Biz Iusuftu aktap zhana abaktan kutkaryp zhakshylyk kylganybyz syiaktuu ele aga Misirde biilik kyluunu da berdik. Al ozu kaalagan zherine konup zhashai alat. Biz bul duinodo Ozubuz kaalagan pendeleribizge yraiymduulugubuzdan berebiz zhana zhakshylyk kylgandardyn soobun zhok kylbaibyz. Teskerisinche, alarga sooptorun ech kemitbesten toluk kylyp berebiz.
Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtoo menen Andan korkushkandar uchun daiardap koigon akyrettegi Allakhtyn soobu - bul duino soobunan da zhakshyraak.

Iusuftun bir tuugandary Misir zherine buium-taiymdary menen keliship anyn ustuno kirishkende anyn bir tuugandary ekenin taanydy. Birok aradan kop ubakyt otup, syrtky kelbeti ozgorgonu sebeptuu alar Iusuftu taanyshkan zhok. Antkeni any kudukka tashtaganda kichinekei bala ele.

Alarga suragan azyk-tuluktorun bergende alar atalash dagy bir tuugany bar ekenin zhana al atasy menen kalganyn aityshkanda al aitty: <<Oshol atalash bir tuuganyn'ardy da alyp kelgile, men silerge dagy bir tooluk azyk koshup beremin. Kordun'or go, silerge olchomun kemitpesten toluk chenep berdim. Men en' zhakshy meimandosmun.
Egerde any alyp kelbesen'er, anda atalash bir tuuganybyz bar degen sozun'or zhalgan ekeni anyk bolot. Oshondo silerge azyk-tuluk da berbeim, menin zherime da zholoboisun'ar>>.
Oshondo bir tuugandary aga: <<Biz any atabyzdan suraibyz. Kolubuzdan kelishinche araket kylabyz. Chyndygynda biz senin buirugun'du kaidyger karabai atkarabyz>> - deshti.

Iusuf zhumushchularyna aitty: <<Bergen buiumdaryn kosho salyp koigula. Alar kaityp baryshkanda biz alarga satpaganybyzdy bilishsin. Bul alardy chynchyl ekendikterin tastyktash uchun zhana alar buiumdaryn kaitarysh uchun dagy bir iret bir tuugany menen kaityp keluuloruno turtot>>.

Alar atasyna kaityp keliship Iusuftun bereshendigi tuuraluu okuiany kep kylyp myndai deshti: <<Oo, atake! Egerde biz bir tuuganybyzdy alyp barbasak, bizge azyk-tuluk berilbei turgan boldu. Any biz menen zhiberin'iz. Zhebere turgan bolson'uz azyk toptop alabyz. Al sizge esen-aman kaityp kelishi uchun any korgoibuz dep sizge ubada berebiz>>.

Alarga atasy aitty: <<Murda agasy Iusuftu silerge ishenip tapshyrgandai emi anyn bir tuuganyn da tapshyrmak belem?! Men silerge any ishenip tapshyrgan bolchum, siler any korgoibuz dep ubada bergen elen'er, birok udaban'ardy atkarbadyn'ar. Emi silerdin saktaibyz degen ubadan'arga ishenbeim. Men Allakhka gana ishenim artam. Al saktagysy kelgenderdi en' zhakshy saktoochu zhana Oz yraiymyn kaalagandarga oto yraiymduu>>.

Kachan alar alyp kelishken azyk-tuluk kurzhundaryn achyshkanda ichinen buiumdaryn taap alyshyp atasyna: <<Ushundai zhoomarttyktan kiiin biz bul bashchydan emneni suraibyz? Myna bu azyk-tulukko baalangan buiumdardy bashchy oz aikoldugu menen bizge kaitaryptyr. Biz ui-bulobuzgo azyk-tuluk alyp kelebiz, siz korkkon inibizdi korgoibuz zhana al uchun da bir tooluk ashykcha zhuk alyp kelebiz. Al emi bir tooluk zhuktu ashykcha beruu - bashchy uchun oto zhen'il ish>>.

Atasy alarga aitty: <<Siler any kaira alyp kelebiz dep Allakhtyn aldynda anyk ubada bermeiinche any siler menen zhiberbeim. Silerdin baaryn'ar kyirap ketsen'er zhe aran'ardan ech birin'er aman kalbasan'ar zhe any korgop zhe kaitara albai kalsan'ar gana kechiremin>>. Kachan alar Allakhtyn anyk ubadasyn berishkende al aitty: <<Bizdin bul sozdorubuzgo Allakh Ozu kubo. Anyn kubolugu bizge zhetishtuu>>.

Alarga atasy osuiat kylyp aitty: <<Shaarga kirgende chogu bir eshikten kirbegile. Ar bashka eshikten kirgile! Munun sebebi kimdir biroo silerge zyian beruunu kaalasa zyiany baaryn'arga chogu tiiip kaluusunan saktait. Birok bul nerseni Allakh silerge kaalagan zyiandan korgosh uchun zhe Allakh silerge kaalabagan paidaga zhetkirish uchun aitkan zhokmun. Tagdyr - Allakhtyn gana zhazgan tagdyry. Buiruk dagy Anyn gana buirugu. Bardyk ishterimde Aga gana tobokel kyldym. Tobokel kylgandar bardyk ishterinde zhalgyz Aga gana tobokel kylyshat>>.

Alar inisi menen chogu zhonop ketishti. Alar atasy buirugandai ar bashka eshikten kirishse da alardyn ar bashka eshikten kirishkeni Allakhtyn alarga tagdyr kylgan nersesin toso albait. Chyndygynda bul Iakubdun baldaryna karata bolgon boorukerligi zhana aitkan osuiaty. Al Allakhtyn tagdyrynan bashka ech bir tagdyr zhok ekenin bilet. Antkeni al tagdyrga ishenuu zhana sebepterdi atkaruu syiaktuu Biz aga uirotkon nerselerdi bilet. Birok adamdardyn kopchulugu munu bilishpeit.

Kachan Iusuftun bir tuugandary anyn ustuno inisi menen chogu kirishkende inisin ozuno zhakyndatyp syr kylyp aitty: <<Men senin bir tuugan agan' Iusufmun. Bir tuugandaryn'dyn bizge bolgon yza beruusu, zhek koruusu zhana meni kudukka tashtagan syiaktuu oilonboston kylgan ishterine kapalanba>>.

Kachan Iusuf kyzmatchylaryna bir tuugandarynyn azyk-tuluktorun toolorgo zhuktoonu buiruganda adamdarga azyk-tuluktu chenegen padyshanyn choichogun inisinin kurzhununa alarga bilgizbei salyp koiot. Bul any ozu menen birge kaltyruunun aila-amaly bolchu. Alar uiun kozdoi zhol tartkanda arttan bir adam zhar salyp: <<Ei, azyk-tuluk zhuktolgon too eeleri! Siler anyk uuru ekensin'er>> - dep kelet.
Iusuftun bir tuugandary artta kyikyryp kele zhatkan adamdy zhana anyn zhanyndagy zhan-zhokoorlorun kozdoi bet alyp: <<Bizdi uuru dep aiyptai turganchalyk emnen'erdi zhogottun'ar?>> - dep surashty.

Zharchy menen anyn zhan-zhookorloru Iusuftun bir tuugandaryna: <<Padyshanyn chenegich choichogun zhogottuk. Biz ozubuz tintigenge cheiin padyshanyn choichogun kim tapsa, aga syilyk bar. Aga bir too zhugu menen berilet. Men buga ozum kepildik beremin>> - dep aitty.

Iusuftun bir tuugandary alarga: <<Allakhka ant bolsun! Siler bizdin akybalybyzdy korgondoi ele ak niettuulugubuzdu zhana buga katyshybyz zhok ekenin bildin'er. Biz Misir zherine buzukuluk kylgany kelbedik zhana biz zhashoodo uuru emespiz>> - deshti.
Zharchy menen anyn zhan-zhookorloru aityshty: <<Uurulukka katyshybyz zhok dep zhalgan aitkan bolson'or, anda silerde uurdagan adamga kandai zhaza berilet?>>

Iusuftun bir tuugandary aityshty: <<Uurunun bizdegi zhazasy - uurdalgan buium kimdin kurzhununan tabylsa, anda al adam buiumdun eesine berilet, al any kul kylat. Biz uurulardy myna ushintip kul kylyp zhazalaibyz>>.

Alardy Iusufka kurzhundaryn tekshertkeni alyp kelishti. Aila-amaldy zhashyrysh uchun inisinin kurzhununan murun agalarynyn kurzhundaryn teksherip bashtady. Andan son' inisinin kurzhunun teksherdi. Anyn kurzhununan padyshanyn choichogun suurup chykty. Biz Iusufka inisinin kurzhununa choichoktu saldyryp aila-amal uirotkonubuz syiaktuu aga bashka bir aila-amaldy da uirottuk. Al aila-amal bir tuugandaryn ozdoru zhaktyn salty boiuncha uurunu kul kylyp zhazaloo ele. Egerde al padyshanyn zhazasy boiuncha uuruga balak urup, aiyp pul tolotuu menen zhazalai turgan bolso, anda bul nerse ishke ashpait bolchu. Bir gana Allakh bashka aila-amaldy kaalasa ishke ashmak. Al aga kudurettuu. Biz Iusuftun darazhasyn kotorgon syiaktuu Ozubuz kaalagan pendeleribizdin da darazhasyn kotorobuz. Ar bir ilimduunun ustundo andan da ilimduusu bar. Al emi Allakhtyn ilimi butkul ilimden zhogoru turat. Al but baaryn bilet.

Iusuftun bir tuugandary aityshty: <<Al uurdasa tan' kalyshtyn keregi zhok. Buga cheiin munun agasy da uuruluk kylgan dep Iusufka tiiishtirip aityshty. Alardyn bul sozu aga katuu tiigenin ichine katyp syr berbedi. Alarga ichinen myndai koro albastyk menen kara niettikti murun da kylgansyn'ar. Ushul zherde da bul kylganyn'ar anyk kara niettik. Silerdin kylyp zhatkan bul zhalgan zhalaan'ardy Allakh Taala zhakshy bilet>>.

Iusuftun bir tuugandary aga aityshty: <<Oo, bashchy! Bul balanyn karyp kalgan atasy bar. Al munu aiabai zhakshy korot. Sen munun orduna biroobuzdu alyp kal. Chyndygynda senin bizge zhana bashkalarga kylgan mamilen'den seni zhakshylygyn aiabagan adamdardan dep bilebiz. Bizge bir zhakshylyk kyla kor>>.

Iusuf paigambar aitty: <<Allakh saktasyn! Biz kunooluunun kylmyshy menen kunoosuzgo zulumduk kylyp, padyshanyn choichogu kurzhununan tabylgandan bashka biroonu alyp kalmak belek?! Egerde biz kunoosuzdu zhazalap, kunooluunu koio bersek, anda anyk zalym bolobuz.

Iusuf alardyn suranychyna zhoop bergenden kiiin umuttoru uzulup adamdardan chetireek baryp ken'eshishti. Alardyn uluusu aitty: <<Atan'arga anyn balasyn alyp kelebiz dep Allakhtyn aldynda anyk ubada bergenin'erdi unuttun'arby? Al silerge any korgoi albai turgandai abalga kabylsan'ar gana kechirem degen. Buga cheiin Iusufka da kaidygerlik kylgansyn'ar. Al tuuraluu atan'arga bergen ubadan'ardy da atkargan emessin'er. Emi atam maga kaityp baruuga uruksat bermeiinche zhe Allakh inimdi alyp ketuunu nasip kylmaiyncha men Misir zherinen kaitpaim. Allakh en' zhakshy okum kyluuchu. Al akyikat zhana adilettik menen okum kylat>>.

Uluu agasy aitty: <<Atan'arga bargyla da aga aitkyla: <<Balan'yz uuruluk kyldy. Uurulugunun zhazasy katary Misirdin bashchysy any kul kyldy. Anyn kurzhununan padyshanyn choichogu chykkanyn oz kozubuz menen korup bilgenibiz uchun gana aityp zhatabyz. Biz anyn uurdashyn bilgen emespiz. Eger munu bilgenibizde anda sizge kaira alyp kelebiz dep ubada berbeit elek.

Oo, atake! Bizdin sozubuz chyn ekenin bilgin'iz kelse, biz bargan zherdegi misirlikterden suran'yz zhana biz menen birge kelgen kerbendegi adamdardan da suran'yz. Alar biz sizge aitkan sozdu aityshat. Chyndygynda anyn uurdagany tuuraluu sizge aitkan sozubuzdo chyndykty gana aityp zhatabyz>>.

Alarga atasy aitty: <<Any uurdady dep aitkan sozun'or akylga syibagan ish. Birok silerge napsin'er aga aila-amal kyluun'ardy kooz kylyp korsotuptur. Buga cheiin anyn agasy Iusufka da ushundai aila-amal kylgansyn'ar. Emi zhakshy gana sabyr kylam zhana Allakhtyn Ozuno gana aryzdanam. Balkim Allakh alardyn baarysyn - Iusuftu, anyn inisin zhana alardyn uluu agasyn chogu kaitaraar. Chyndygynda Allakh menin abalymdan Kabardar zhana menin ishimdi zhongo saluuda Daanyshman>>.

Alardan zhuzun burup: <<Attin' ai, Iusuf balama bolgon kaigym zhan kyinady go!>> - dedi. Balasy uchun kop yilagandygynan anyn kozunun karasy bozorup, kaigy-kapaga tolup ketken ele. Birok al kaigysyn adamdarga aitchu emes.

Atasy alarga aitty: <<Bashyma tushkon kaigy-kapamdy zhalgyz Allakhka gana aityp aryzdanam. Men Allakhtyn meerimduulugu, zhakshylyk kyluusu, zarykkandyn dubasyna zhoop beruusu zhana bashyna kyiynchylyk tushkon adamga bergen syilygy tuuraluu siler bilbegen nerselerdi bilemin>>.

Alarga atasy aitty: <<Oo, baldarym! Bargyla da Iusuf menen inisinen kabar algyla! Allakhtyn pendelerine bolgon kutkaruusunan umut uzbogulo! Chyndygynda kaapyr koom gana anyn kutkaruusunan umut uzot. Antkeni alar Allakhtyn kuduretinin uluulugun zhana pendelerine kylgan zhashyruun zhakshylyktaryn bilishpeit>>.

Alar atasynyn buiruguna bash iiiship Iusuf menen inisin izdep zhonoshtu. Kachan alar Iusufka kirishkende aga aityshty: <<Bashybyzga kataalchylyk zhana zhakyrchylyk tushtu. Biz saga satkanga bir az buiumdarybyzdy alyp keldik. Emi sen murda tartyp bergendei kylyp toluk ele tartyp ber. Bizge bir az ashyryp zhe arzybagan buiumdarybyzga karabai sadaka kyla kor. Chyndygynda Allakh sadaka beruuchulorgo en' zhakshy syilyktardy tartuulait>>.

Oshondo alar airan tan' kalyshyp: <<Sen chyn ele Iusufsun'bu?>> - degende Iusuf alarga aitty: <<Ooba, men Iusufmun. Myna bu zhanymda turgan menin bir tuugan inim. Allakh bizdi murunku abalybyzdan kutkaryp zhana kadyrybyzdy kotorup bizge zhakshylyk kyldy. Kimde-kim Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Aga moiun sunsa zhana kyiynchylykka sabyr kylsa, anda anyn kylgany zhakshylyk ishterden. Allakh zhakshylyk kylgandardyn soobun zhok kylbait. Teskerisinche, any alar uchun saktap koiot>>.

Bir tuugandary kylgan ishteri uchun kechirim surashyp: <<Allakhka ant! Allakh saga kemchiliksiz sypattardy berip seni bizden artyk kyldy. Chynynda biz saga kylgan ishibizde katalyk zhana zulumduk kyldyk>> - dep aityshty.
Iusuf alardy kechirip myndai dep aitty: <<Bugun silerdi zhazalap zhe zhamandai turgandai silerge ech kandai aiyptoo zhok. Allakhtan silerdi kechiruusun suraim. Al yraiymduulardyn Yraiymduusu>>.

Alar atasynyn kozuno emne bolgonu tuuraluu aga aityshkanda al koinogun berip: <<Bul koinogumdu alyp baryp atamdyn zhuzuno zhapkyla, oshondo kozu korup kalat. Baaryn'ar ui-bulon'or menen maga kaityp kelgile>> - dep aitty.

Kerben Misirden chygyp shaardan alystagan kezde Iakub paigambar baldaryna zhana zhanyndagy zherdeshterine: <<Men chyndap ele Iusuftun zhytyn sezip zhatam. Siler bul chal alzhyp kaldy, emne dep zhatkanyn da bilbeit dep meni akylynan adashkan dep zhurbogulo>> - dep aitty.
Anyn aldyndagy baldary aga: <<Allakhka ant! Siz dagy dele Iusuftun kadyryn estep zhana any ekinchi iret koruugo mumkunchuluk bolot degen eski oilorun'uzdan ech ele kaitpadyn'yz go>> - deshti.

Iakubga suiunuch kabardy alyp kelgen adam anyn zhuzuno Iusuftun koinogun yrgytkanda anyn kozu korup kaldy. Oshondo al baldaryna: <<Men Allakhtyn meeriminen zhana zhakshylygynan siler bilbegen nerselerdi bilem dep aittym ele go?>> - dep aitty.

Baldary atasy Iakub paigambardan Iusuf menen inisine kylgan nerseleri uchun kechirim surashyp: <<Oo, atake! Bizdin otkon kunoolorubuz uchun Allakhtan kechirim suran'yz! Chyndygynda biz Iusuf menen inisine zhamandyk kylgan kunookorlordon bolduk>> - deshti.
Alarga atasy aitty: <<Emi Rabbimden siler uchun kechirim suraimyn. Chyndygynda al toobo kylgan pendelerinin kunoolorun Kechiruuchu, alarga Yraiymduu>>.

Iakub ui-bulosu menen oz zherinen Iusuftu kozdoi Misirge zhonoshtu. Kachan alar aga kirishkende ata-enesin kuchaktady zhana ui-buloloru menen turushkan bir tuugandaryna: <<Allakhtyn kaaloosu menen tynchtykta Misirge kosh keldin'izder! Bul zherde ech kandai yza tartpaisyzdar>> - dep aitty.

Ata-enesin ozu oturgan taktyga oturguzdu. Ata-enesi zhana on bir bir tuugany aga sazhda kylyp uchurashyshty. Bul sazhda tushundo korgondoi Allakhtyn buirugun ishke ashyrysh uchun kylyngan taazim kyluu sazhdasy ele, syiynuu sazhdasy emes. Oshonduktan Iusuf paigambar atasyna: <<Sizderdin maga sazhda kylyp uchurashkanyn'yzdar - men murda korup sizge aityp bergen tushumdun zhandyrmagy. Rabbim al tushumdu ishke ashyrdy. Rabbim meni abaktan chygaryp, meni menen bir tuugandarymdyn ortosun shaitan buzgandan kiiin sizderdi alysky choldon maga alyp kelip zhakshylyk kyldy. Chyndygynda Rabbim Ozu kaalagan ishterinde Meerimduu. Al pendelerinin abaldaryn Biluuchu, Oz bashkaruusunda Daanyshman>>.

Andan son' Iusuf Rabbisine duba kylyp: <<Oo, Rabbim! Sen maga Misirdin biiligin berdin', tush zhoorugandy uirottun'. Oo, asmandar menen zherdin Zharatuuchusu zhana al ekoosun murda bolbogondoi korunushto paida Kyluuchu! Sen menin bul duinodogu zhana akyrettegi bardyk ishterimdi bashkaruuchusun'. Azhalym zhetkende musulman abalda zhanymdy al. Meni ata-babalarymdan zhana bashkalardan bolgon paigambarlar menen uluu Firdaus beiishinde birge kyl!>>

Oo, paigambar! Biz saga kabar bergen Iusuf menen anyn bir tuugandary tuuraluu bul okuiany sen bilchu emessin'. Antkeni Iusuftun bir tuugandary any kuduktun tubuno tashtaibyz dep chechiship, aila-amaldardy oilop tabyshkan maalda sen alardyn zhanynda emes elen'. Birok biz saga munun kabaryn berdik.
Oo, paigambar! Sen adamdar yiman keltirishsin dep bolgon araketin'di zhumshasan' da alardyn kopchulugu yiman keltirishpeit. Andyktan alar uchun ozun'du kyinap sygylba.

Asmandar menen zherde Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygyn tastyktap bildirgen koptogon aiat-belgiler bar. Alar anyn ustundo basyp zhurushot, birok alar tuuraluu oi-zhugurtuudon zhana ibarat aluudan bash tartyshat zhana alarga kon'ul da burushpait.

Adamdardyn kopchulugu Allakhty Zharatuuchu, yrysky Beruuchu, Olturuuchu, Tiriltuuchu dep ishenishet, birok Any menen katar bashka kudailarga zhana aikelderge syiynyshat. Alar Anyn balasy bar dep aityshat. Al andan Aruu.

Mushrikter bul duinodo korgono albai turgandai zhaza alardy kaptap basyp kelishinen, zhe bolboso kyiamat kelet dep aga daiardyk korushpoi, anyn kelishin sezbei turushkanda kapystan alarga kyiamat kelip kaluusunan kon'uldoru tynchpy?! Myna oshonduktan alar yiman keltirishpeit.

O, paigambar! Sen daavat kylgandarga mintip ait: <<Ushul menin zholum. Men adamdardy ushul zholgo chakyram. Bul zholgo men zhana meni eerchigender, tuura zholuma tushkondor, sunnotumdu karmangandar achyk-aikyn dalilder menen chakyrabyz. Men Allakhka sherik kylgandardan emesmin. Teskerisinche, zhalgyz Aga gana ibadat kyluuchulardanmyn>>.

Oo, paigambar! Biz saga cheiin perishtelerden emes, adamzattan erkekterdi gana paigambar kylyp zhibergenbiz. Saga kabar tushurgondoi alarga da kabar tushurgonbuz. Alar chol elinen emes, shaar elinen ele. Alardy elderi zhalganga chygaryshkanda Biz alardy kyiratyp zhok kyldyk. Seni zhalganga chygargandar da zher betin kydyryp, alarga cheiinki zhalganga chygargandardyn akybeti kandai bolgonuna oi zhugurtup sabak alyshpaiby?! Bul duinodo Allakhtan korkkondor uchun akyret zhaiyndagy zhyrgalchylyktar zhakshyraak. Bul nerse zhakshy ekendigine akyl zhugurtpoisun'orbu, Allakhtyn buiruktaryna bash iiip, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkpoisun'arby?! Buiruktardyn en' ulugu - yiman keltiruu. Al emi tyigandardyn en' chon'u - Allakhka sherik koshuu.

Biz zhibergen paigambarlardyn dushmandaryna moonot berebiz, alardy aldap kyzyktyrysh uchun zhazaloogo shashylbaibyz. Antkeni alardyn kyirashy kechen'degende, paigambarlar alardyn kyiroosunan umut uzup kalyshkanda zhana paigambarlardyn <<zhalganga chygargandarga azap kelet, yimanduular aman kalyshat>> dep bergen ubadalaryn kaapyrlar zhalgan eken dep oilop kalyshkanda paigambarlarybyzga Bizdin zhen'ishibiz kelet zhana Biz paigambarlar menen yimanduulardy zhalganchylar kabylgan kyiroodon saktap kalabyz. Kunookor koomgo tushkon azabybyz ech kachan kaitarylbait.

(lm)r Alif, laam, ro. Ushuga okshogon aiattyn tushundurmosu bakara suroosunun bashtalyshynda aitylgan. Ei, paigambar! Bul suroodogu ushul uluu aiattar zhana Allakh saga tushurgon Kuran - ech kandai shek-kumonu zhok akyikat. Al Allakhtyn aldynan ekendiginde shek zhok. Birok adamdardyn kopchulugu kok bettikten zhana tekeberlikten aga yiman keltirishpeit.

Allakh siler korup turgan biiik asmandardy tiroochsuz zharatty. Andan son' ech bir nersege okshobogon zhana kandai bolgondugu belgisiz abalda Ozuno ylaiyk kelgendei Arshka kotorulup biiiktedi. Zhana Kun menen Aidy adamdardyn paidalary uchun bash iidirdi. Allakhtyn iliminde Kun dagy Ai dagy belgilengen moonotko cheiin zhurot. Allakh asmandar menen zherdegi ishterdi Ozu kaalagandai bashkarat. Kyiamat kunu Rabbin'er menen zholuguuga toluk ishenip, aga zhakshylyk ishter menen daiardangyla degen umutto Al Ozunun kudurettuulugun bildirgen aiat-belgilerdi achyktap korsotot.

Zher betinde zhakyn zhaigashkan zher tilkeleri, zhuzum baktar, eginzarlar, bir ozokton chykkan kurmalar zhana ozoktoru ar bashka kurmalar bar. Myna oshol bakchalar zhana eginzarlar bir suudan sugarylat. Alar bir zherden suu ichip, zhakyn zhaigashkanyna karabastan paidalary uchun Biz alardy daamynda zhana bashka nerselerde biri-birinen artyk kylabyz. Chyndygynda bul aitylgandarda akyl zhugurtkon adamdar uchun dalilder bar. Antkeni myna osholor bul nerselerden sabak alyshat.

Oo, paigambar! Egerde bir nersege tan' kalchu bolson', anda alardyn kairadan tiriluunu zhalganga chygargandaryna zhana any zhokko chygaryp "biz olup topurakka zhana chirigen sookko ailangandan kiiin kairadan tirilmek belek?!" dep dalil kylgan sozdoruno tan' kalganyn' tatyktuuraak. Rabbisine kaapyrlyk kylyshyp, olgondordu kaira tiriltuugo Anyn kudureti zhetpeit dep olumdon kiiin kaira tiriluunu zhokko chygargandar - osholor kyiamat kunu moiundaryna otton bolgon chynzhyrlar orolgondor, myna osholor tozokko kirgender. Alar al zhaida tuboluk kalyshat, alar zhok da bolushpait zhana alardan azap toktotulbait.

Oo, paigambar! Mushrikter senden azapty shashtyryshat. Allakh alarga tagdyr kylgan zhakshylyktardy toluk alyshkanga cheiin azaptyn kelishi kechigip ketti deshet. Alardan murun alarga okshogon zhalganchy koomdor da zhazalanyshkan. Emnege alardan sabak alyshpait? Ei, paigambar! Chyndygynda Rabbin' adamdar zulumduk kylyshsa dagy alarga kechirimduu. Alar Allakhka toobo kyluulary uchun alardy zhazaloogo shashylbait. Oshondoi ele Al kaapyrlyktan kaitpagandar toobo kylyshpasa alardy katuu zhazalait.

Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandar bash tartkandarynan zhana kok bettikterinen kaityshpai: <<Musa menen Isaga tushkondoi aiat-belgiler Mukhammadga da tushpoit bele?!>> - deshet. Oo, paigambar! Sen adamdardy Allakhtyn azabynan korkutkan gana eskertuuchusun'. Allakh saga kaisy aiat-belgilerdi berse, osholor gana bolot. Ar bir koomdo alardy akyikat zholgo salgan, aga karai zhol korsotkon paigambar bolot.

Allakh ar bir aialdyn kursagyndagy kotorgonun bilet. Al tuuraluu baarysyn bilet zhana zhatynda bolup zhatkan azaiyp koboigonun, salamattygyn zhana ildettuulugun bilet. Allakhtyn aldynda bardyk nerse belgilengen olchomdo bolot, al andan azaibait da kemibeit.

Antkeni Allakh zharatylgandar sezbegen bardyk kaiyp nerselerdi zhana alardyn sezimderi sezgen ar bir nerseni Biluuchu. Al Ozunun sypattarynda, ysymdarynda zhana ish-araketterinde Uluk. Al Oz Zaty zhana sypattary menen butkul zharatylgandardan Zhogoru.

Oo, adamdar! Al zhashyruun syrlardy bilet. Anyn iliminde silerdin aran'arda sozun zhashyrgan adam menen achyk aitkan adam birdei, oshondoi ele karan'gy tundo adamdardyn kozuno korunboi zhashyngan adam menen kunduzgu zharykta koz koruno ish kylyp zhatkan adam Anyn iliminde birdei.

Allakh Taalanyn adamga kezekteship kelgen perishteleri bar. Alardyn kee birleri kechinde kelet, kee biri kunduzu kelet. Alar Allakh tagdyr kylyp zhazgan birok bolturbai koiuu kerek bolgon tagdyrdy toktotuu uchun adamdardy Allakhtyn buirugu menen saktashat. Oshondoi ele adamdyn sozdorun zhana kylgan ishterin zhazyshat. Chyndygynda Allakh bir el ozdorun shugur kyluuchu abalga ozgortposo, anda al eldi zhakshy abaldan bashka abalga ozgortpoit. Allakh Taala bir koomdu kyiratuunu kaalasa, anda ech kim Allakhtyn kaaloosun kaitara albait. Ei, adamdar! Siler uchun silerdin ishin'erdi bashkargan Allakhtan bashka bashkaruuchu zhok. Oshonduktan silerge tush bolgon baleelerdi kaitarysh uchun Aga taiangyla.

Oo, adamdar! Al silerge chagylgandy korgozot. Al chagylgandyn sokkusu menen silerge korkunuch zhana zhamgyrga bolgon umut zharatat. Oshondoi ele Al noshoorlogon zhamgyr suusu menen oor bolgon buluttardy zharatat.

Kundun kurkurogu Rabbisin maktoo menen birgelikte Any aruulait. Oshondoi ele perishteler Rabbisinen korkup, uluktap zhana urmattap aruulashat. Allakh makuluktarynyn kaalaganyna kuiguzuuchu chagylgan tushurup, alardy kyiratat. Al emi kaapyrlar bolso, Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygy tuuraluu talashyp-tartyshat. Allakhtyn kuch-kubaty kataal, Al kaalaganyn atkarat.

Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygyna chakyruu zhalgyz Allakh uchun gana boluu kerek. Bul nersede ech kim aga sherik emes. Mushrikter duba kylyp surap zhatkan Allakhtan bashka kudaichalar alar emne gana duba kylyp surabasyn, alardyn dubalaryna zhoop berishpeit. Alardyn aga kylgan dubalary suusagan adam suuga kolun sunup suunu oozuna zhetkizip ichem degen syiaktuu. Suu bolso anyn oozuna zhetpeit, al emi kaapyrlardyn kudaichalarga kylgan dubalary tuuradan alys zhana alar zhogotuuda. Antkeni kuidaichalar alarga paida alyp kelgenge zhana alardan zyiandy tosuuga eelik kylbait.

Asmandardagy zhana zherdegilerdin baary zhalgyz Allakh uchun sazhda kylyp moiun sunushat. Bul nersede musulman zhana kaapyr birdei. Bolgonu musulman Allakhka oz kaaloosu menen moiun sunup sazhda kylat. Al emi kaapyr bolso Allakhka mazhbur turdo moiun sunat. Birok anyn tabiiaty Allakhka oz kaaloosu menen moiun sunuunu aityp turat. Kolokosu bar bardyk zharatylgandardyn kolokoloru erten' menen kechinde Allakhka bash iiishet.

O, paigambar! Allakh menen birge bashka nerselerge da syiynyp zhatkan kaapyrlarga: "Asmandardyn zhana zherdin Zharatuuchusu zhana al ekoonu Bashkaruuchu kim?" dep aitkyn. O, paigambar! Dagy alarga: "Al ekoonu Zharatuuchu zhana Bashkaruuchu - Allakh. Munu siler da moiunga alasyn'ar" dep ait. O, paigambar! Alarga dagy mintip aitkyn: "Allakhtan bashka alsyz oluialardy ozun'orgo dos kylyp aldyn'arby? Alar ozdoruno paida alyp kele albait, zyiandan saktana albait. Anan kantip bashkalarga zhardam bere almak ele?" O, paigambar! Alarga aitkyn: "Kokurogu kor kaapyr menen tuura zholdogu korogoch musulman birdeibi? Zhe karan'gy kaapyrlyk menen nurduu yiman birdeibi?" Zhe Allakh Taalaga zharatuuda sherik bolushtubu? Zhe alar Allakhtyn zharatkanyndai zharatyshtyby? Alar Allakhtyn zharatkanyn alardyn sherikteri zharatty dep aralashtyryp alyshty. O, paigambar! Alarga aitkyn: "Zhalgyz Allakh bardyk nerseni Zharatuuchu. Zharatuuda Aga ech kim sherik emes. Kudai boluu zhalgyz Aga gana taandyk. Al zhalgyz Ozu gana ibadat kyluuga tatyktuu zhana bardyk nersege ustomduk kyluuchu.

Allakh, zhalgandyn zhok boluusuna zhana akyikattyn saktalyp kaluusuna asmandan tushkon zhamgyrdyn suusun misal kyldy. Al olchomuno zharasha az zhe kop bolup ozondordo agat. Anan al sel tashtandy, kobuktordu suunun ustuno chygarat. Oshondoi ele Allakh al ekoono, kymbat baaluu metaldardy otko eritip, anyn shirendi-datyn azhyratyp, zhasana turgan zhasalgalardy zhasagandy misal kylat. Allakh ushundai misaldardy akyikat menen zhalganga misal katary keltiret. Zhalgan - suunun ustuno chygyp kalgan tashtandy zhana kobuktorgo zhana metaldy eritkende chykkan shirendi-dattarga okshosh. Al emi akyikat - ichile turgan taza suu syiaktuu. Anyn natyizhasynda momolor, osumduktor, choptor osot. Zhana zhasalgandan kiiinki (taza) temir syiaktuu. Any adamdar paidalanat. Allakh akyikat zhalgandan aiyrmalanyp turuusu uchun adamdarga ushul eki misaldy keltirgen syiaktuu bashka misaldardy da keltiret.

Rabbisi Any zhalgyzdoogo zhana Aga moiun sunuuga chakyrganda Aga zhoop bergen yimanduular uchun zhakshy syilyk bar, al - beiish. Al emi Anyn zhalgyzdygyna zhana Aga moiun sunuuga chakyrganda zhoop berbegen kaapyrlar egerde alarda zher betindegi turduu mal-mulktor bolso zhana oshogo koshumcha dagy oshoncholuk mal-mulktoru bolso, anda alar oshonun baaryn zhandaryn azaptan kutkaruu uchun sarptap zhiberishmek. Alar Allakhtyn chakyrygyna zhoop berishpedi. Alar bardyk kylgan kunooloru uchun surakka alynyshat. Alardyn bara turgan zhaiy tozok. Alardyn bara turgan zherleri zhana zhailary tozok kandai zhaman!

Oo, paigambar! Allakh saga tushurgon nerse Rabbin'den ekenin zhana anda ech bir shegi zhok akyikat ekenin bilip, Allakhka moiun sungan yimanduu adam menen Allakhka moiun sunbagan sokur kaapyr adam ten' emes. Bul nerseden akyly tunuk adamdar gana akyl-nasaat alyshat.
Allakhka bash iigender myna osholor Aga bergen ubadalaryn zhe Anyn pendelerine bergen ubadalaryn atkaryshat. Alar Allakh menen bolgon zhe Andan bashkasy menen bolgon bekem ubadalardy buzushpait.

Alar Allakh uzbogongo buirugan bardyk tuugandyk mamilelerdi bekemdeshet zhana Rabbisinen korkushat. Al korkuu - alardy Anyn buiruktaryn atkaruuga zhana Anyn tyigan nerselerinen tyiyluuga turtot. Allakh alar kylgan bardyk kunooloru sebeptuu alardy esep-kysap kyluusunan korkushat. Antkeni kimge esep-kysap kylynsa, anda al kyiroogo uchurait.

Alar Allakhka bash iiuudo zhana Allakh alarga tagdyr kylyp bergen zhakshylyk-zhamandykta sabyr kylgandar. Allakhtyn yraazylygyn kozdop kunoodon tyiylyshkandar. Namazdy toluk atkaryshkandar. Biz bergen mal-mulktordu mildettuu bolgon akylarga zhumshagandar. Alardy yktyiarduu turdo zhana zhashyruun turdo el koruusunon saktanyp berishkender zhana alardy korup bashkalar da eerchish uchun achyk turdo bergender. Alarga zhamandyk kylgan adamdardyn zhamandygyna zhakshylyk menen zhoop berishkender. Ushul sypattar menen sypattalgan adamdar uchun Kyiamat kunu maktoogo tatyktuu akybet bar.

Maktoogo tatyktuu akybet - bul beiishter. Anda adamdar tuboluk zhyrgalchylykta zhashashat. Alardyn beiishtegi toluk zhyrgachylyktarynyn biri - alar menen aga tuura zholdo zhurgon atalary, eneleri, zhubailary zhana baldarynyn kiruusu. Bul nerse alarga zholuguunu kaalagandyktary sebeptuu bolot. Perishteler alarga beiishtegi zhailarynyn bardyk eshikterinen kiriship alardy kuttuktashat.

Alarga perishteler kirgen saiyn: <<Silerge Allakhtyn tynchtygy bolsun>> - dep salam berishet. Tagyraak aitkanda, Allakhka bash iiuudo, Anyn tagdyrynyn zhamandygyna sabyr kylganyn'ar sebeptuu zhana Aga kunoo kyluudan tyiylgandygyn'ar sebeptuu apaattardan salamat bolgula. Silerdin akybetin'er bolgon Akyret uiu kandai zhakshy!

Allakh yimanduulardyn sypattaryn eskergenden kiiin artynan (akyikattan) zhuz burgan kaapyrlardyn sypattaryn baiandap myndai dedi:
Allakhka bergen ubadalaryn bekemdegenden kiiin da ubadalaryn buzgandar zhana Allakh buiurugan tuuganchylyk karym-katyshty uzgondor baktysyz adamdar. Alar Allakhtyn yraiymynan kuulgandar. Andai adamdardyn akybeti zhaman, al - tozok.

Allakh kaalagan pendelerine yryskysyn ken'eitet zhana kaalagan pendelerine tarytat. Yryskynyn ken'digi baktyluuluktun zhana Allakhty zhakshy koruusunun belgisi emes. Al emi yryskynyn tardygy baktysyzdyktyn belgisi emes. Kaapyrlar bul duino zhashoosuna kubanyshyp, al zhashoogo katuu taianyshyp beipil zhashashty. Birok bul duino zhashoosu akyret zhashoosunun aldynda bir az gana arzybagan zhyrgalchylyk.

Allakhka zhana Anyn aiattaryna kaapyr bolgondor myndai dep aityshty: <<Eger Mukhammadga Rabbisinen chynchyldygyna dalil bolgon korunuktuu aiat-belgi tushurulgondo biz aga yiman keltirmekpiz>>. Oo, paigambar! Al sunush kylgandarga aitkyn: <<Chyndygynda Allakh adilettuulugu menen kaalagan adamdy adashtyrat. Zhana Allakh pazileti menen toobo kylyp kaitkandardy tuura zholgo salat. Alar tuura zholgo tushuunu aiat-belgilerdin tushuusuno bailashsa da al tuura zholgo bashtoo alardyn kolunda emes>>.

Allakh tuura zholgo bashtagan adamdar - alar Allakhka yiman keltirip, Allakhty aruulap, maktap, Kurandy okup zhana ugup zikr kylganda zhuroktoru tynchtangan adamdar. Kon'ul burgula! Zhalgyz Allakhty estoo menen zhuroktor tynchtanat. Allakh zhuroktu ushul uchun zharatkan.
Allakhka yiman keltirgender zhana Allakhka zhakyndatuuchu zhakshy ish-araketterdi kylgandarga akyrette zhakshy zhashoo bar. Andai adamdardyn akybeti zhakshy beiish gana bolot.

Oo, paigambar! Biz murunku ummottordun elchilerine zhonotkon kitepterdin okshoshundai senin ummotun'o da zhiberdik. Biz saga tushurgon kurandy alarga okup ber. Andyktan al Kuran senin chynchyl ekendigin'e zhetishtuu dalil. Birok senin koomun'dun abaly bul aiattardy chettke kagyshty. Sebebi alar yraiymduu Allakhka bashka nerseni sherik kylyshyp kaapyr bolushtu. Ei, paigambar! Alarga aitkyn: <<Siler sherik koshkon yraiymduu Allakh al menin Rabbim. Andan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu zat zhok. Bardyk ishterimde Aga gana taianam zhana Aga gana toobo kylamyn.

Oo, paigambar! Eger Allakhtan tushkon kitepterdin biri keremetuu bolup, oshol keremet menen toolor ordularynan zhyldyrylsa, zher zharylyp daryialar zhana bulaktar aga turgan bolso, al keremettuu kitep oluktorgo okulganda tirilip kete turgan bolso, anda al keremet saga tushkon Kuranda bolmok. Eger alardyn zhuroktorundo korkuu bolgondo al Kuran oto taasirduu achyk dalil bolot ele. Birok alar any chetke kagyshty. Taktap aitkanda, keremetterdi zhana aiat-belgilerdi tushuruu tuurasyndagy ishterdin baary Allakhka gana taandyk. Allakhka yiman keltirgender bilishpeibi?! Eger Allakh adamdardy baaryn tuura zholgo tushuruunu kaalasa, anda Allakh alarga aiat-belgilerin tushurboston turup ele tuura zholgo salyp koimok. Birok Allakh andaidy kaalabady. Allakhka kaapyr bolgondorgo kapyrlyktary zhana kunooloru sebeptuu oor kyiynchylyktar zhetip turat. Al baleeler Allakhtyn toktoosuz tushuuchu azabynyn ubadasy kelgenche, alardyn turak zhailaryna zhakyn zherge tushot. Chyndygynda Allakh ubada kylgan nersesin belgilengen ubagy kelgende ubadasyn atkarbai koiboit.

Oo, paigambar! Seni koomun' shyldyn'dap zhalganga chygargan en' birinchi paigambar emessin'. Senden murdagy ummottor da paigambarlaryn shyldyn'dashkan. Oz paigambarlaryn shyldyn'dagan kaapyrlar Meni: <<Al azaptabait>> - dep oiloshup kalganga cheiin moonot berdim. Moonot butkondon kiiin alardy ar kandai azaptar menen azaptadym. Men alardy azaptaganymdy korgonun'do kandai bolmok? Al oto kataal azap.

Bardyk zharatylyshtyn yryskylaryn saktoonu oz mildetine algan, butkul adamdardyn ish-araketterin kozomoldoochu zhana kylgan ishterine zharasha zhaza zhe syilyk bergen Zat syiynyluuga tatyktuuraakpy zhe taptakyr syiynyluuga tatybagan bul aikelderbi? Kaapyrlar bulardy Allakhka zulumduk kylyshyp zhana zhalgandan sherik kylyp zhatyshat. Ei, paigambar! Alarga aitkyn: "Eger aityp zhatkan nersen'erde chynchyl bolson'or, siler Allakhka koshup syiynyp zhatkan kudaichalaryn'ardyn attaryn atap bergilechi. Zhe emne Allakhka siler zher zhuzundo Al bilbegen sherikter zhonundo kabar berip zhatasyn'arby? Zhe ech dalilsiz usturton aitylgan bosh sozdu Aga kabarlap zhatasyn'arby?". Zhok! Shaitan kaapyrlardyn zhaman ailakerlikterin alarga koozdop korsottu zhana ushunun natyizhasynda alar Allakhka kaapyr bolushtu. Zhana alardy khidaiattan zhana tuura zholdon tosup koidu. Kimdi Allakh tuura zholdon adashtyrsa, any tuura zholgo saluuchu ech kim zhok.

Alar uchun duino zhashoosunda musulmandar tarabynan olturuluu zhana alardyn koldoruna tutkunga alynuu menen ishke asha turgan azap bar. Al emi akyrette alardy kutkon azap uzgultuksuz toktobogonu menen duinodogu azaptan da katuuraak zhana oto oor. Kyiamat kunu alardy Allakhtyn azabynan kutkara turgan ech kim bolboit.

Allakh Taalanyn buiruktaryna moiun sunup zhana Anyn tyigandaryn tashtagan takyba adamdar uchun Allakhtyn ubada bergen beiishinin sypaty - khan sarailarynyn zhana bak-daraktarynyn aldynan daryialar agyp turat. Al zherdin momo-zhemishteri ech kachan tugonboit. Alar bul duinodogu momo-zhemishterdei emes. Kolokosu da turuktuu, zhok bolup zhana kyskaryp da ketpeit. Allakhka takybalyk kylgan, Anyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandarynan kaitkan adamdyn akybeti myna ushundai. Al emi kaapyrlardyn akybeti tozok. Alar aga kiriship, al zhakta tuboluk kalyshat.

Oo, paigambar! Biz Tooratty bergen zhoottor zhana Inzhildi bergen khristiandar saga tushurulgon nersenin kee biri alarga tushkon nerselerge shaikesh kelgendigi uchun suiunushot. Zhoottor menen khristiandardyn kee bir taipalary saga tushurulgon kee bir nerselerdi ozdorunun kaalooloruna ylaiyk kelbegendigi uchun zhe alardy ozgortup burmalagandaryn sypattagandygy uchun chetke kagyshat. Oo, paigambar! Alarga ait: "Chyndygynda Allakh Taala meni zhalgyz Ozuno syiynuumdu zhana Aga ech nerseni sherik koshpoomdu buirudu". Zhalgyz Aga gana duba kylam, Andan bashka ech kimge duba kylbaim. Zhalgyz Aga gana kaitamyn. Toorat zhana Inzhil da myna ushul nerseler menen kelgen.

Oo, paigambar! Biz murunku kitepterdi elderinin tilinde tushurgonubuz syiaktuu saga da okumdu achyktap, akyikatty baiandai turgan Kurandy arab tilinde tushurduk. Ei, paigambar! Eger Allakh saga uirotkon ilim kelgenden kiiin Kitep eelerinin kaalooloruna ylaiyk kelbegen nerseni ochuruu tuurasynda seni menen tartyshkan nersesinde alardyn kaalooloruna eerchii turgan bolson', anda Allakh tarabynan senin ishin'e zhardam bere turgan dos da, dushmandaryn'a karshy saga zhardamchy da bolboit. Zhana seni Anyn azabynan tyia turgan ech kim bolboit.

Oo, paigambar! Chynynda senden murda da adamdardan paigambarlardy zhibergenbiz. Sen zhan'y paida bolgon zhalgyz paigambar emessin'. Alarga da bashka adamdar syiaktuu aialdardy zhana bala-chakalardy berdik. Alardy uilonbogon zhana bala korbogon perishteler syiaktuu kylbadyk. Sen dagy uilonup, bala korgon adamdardan bolgon paigambarlardansyn'. Emi emnege mushrikter senin ushundai bolgonun'a tan' kalyp zhatyshat? Allakhtyn uruksatysyz ech bir paigambar ozunon bir aiat-belgi alyp keluusu mumkun emes. Allakh tagdyr kylgan ar bir ishtin moonotu eskerilgen kitep bar. Al moonot oozup da ketpeit kech da kalbait.

Allakh Taala zhakshylyk-zhamandyktyn zhe baktyluuluk-baktysyzdyktyn zhana bashka nerselerdin kaalaganyn ketirip zhok kylat. Zhana alardan kaalaganyn bekemdep koiot. Tagdyr kitebi da Anyn aldynda. Al bardyk nersenin kaita turgan zheri. Ochurulgon zhe bekemdelgen kandai gana nerse bolbosun, anyn baary andagy zhazylgan nersege tuura kelet.

Oo, paigambar! Biz ubada kylyp zhatkan azaptyn kee birin sen olo elegin'de saga korsotuu -- al bizdin ishibiz. Zhe saga korsotkongo cheiin senin zhanyn'dy alsak da senin mildetin' zhetkiruugo buirulgan nerseni zhetkiruu gana. Alardy zhazalap zhana surakka aluu senin mildetin' emes. Al Bizdin ishibiz.

Biz Islamdy zhaiyltuu menen zhana musulmandardyn zherlerdi achuusu menen kaapyrlyk kylyngan zherlerdi chetinen kemitip zhatkanybyzdy al kaapyrlar korushkon zhokbu. Allakh Ozu kaalagan nerse menen pendelerinin arasynda okum kylat. Anyn okumun ech kim buzup zhe ozgortup zhe almashtyruu menen artka kaitara albait. Al Aruu Allakhtyn azaby bat bolot. Abalkylar menen kiiinkilerdi bir kundo surakka alat.

Murunku elder paigambarlaryna ailakerlik kylyshty zhana alar alyp kelgen dindi zhalganga chygaryshty. Birok, alar ailakerlikteri menen emne kyla alyshty? Ech nerse kyla algan zhok. Antkeni, ishke ashkan chechim, ech kimdin chechimi emes, Allakhtyn chechimi. Oshondoi ele Allakh Taala alardyn kylyp zhatkan ishterin bilet zhana al uchun alardy zhazalait. Myna oshondo alar Allakhka yiman keltirbei kanchalyk kata ketirgenin zhana musulmandar tuura zholdu karmanyp, oshol sebeptuu beiishke zhana zhakshy akybetke ee bolgonun bilishet.

Kaapyr bolgondor: "Ei, Mukhammad! Sen Allakhtan zhiberilgen elchi emessin'" - dep aityshat. Ei, paigambar! Sen alarga myndai dep aitkyn: "Menin zhana silerdin orton'ordo men silerge Rabbim taraptan elchi ekenime Allakh zhana menin sypatym kelgen asmandan tushkon kitepter tuuraluu ilimi barlar kubo ekeni zhetishtuu. Kimdin chynchyldygyna Allakh kubo bolso, anda any zhalganga chygargandardyn zhalganga chygaruusu zyian berbeit.

(lr) Alif, Lam, Ra. Ushuga okshogon aiattyn tushundurmosu Bakara suroosunun bashtalyshynda aitylgan. O, paigambar! Allakhtyn kaaloosu zhana zhardamy menen sen adamdardy kaapyrlyktan, bilimsizdikten zhana adashuudan yimanduulukka, ilimduulukko, tuura zholgo chygaruun' uchun zhana ech kim zhen'e albagan Kuchtuu, bardyk nersede maktoogo tatyktuu Allakhtyn zholu bolgon Islam dinine chakyruun' uchun Biz saga bul Kuran kitepti tushurduk.
Asmandardagy zhana zherdegi mulktor zhalgyz Allakhka gana taandyk. Andyktan Aga zharatylgandardan ech kimdi sherik kylbastan syiynyluuga Ozu gana tatyktuu. Kaapyr bolgondorgo katuu azap zhetet.

Kaapyr bolgondor bul duino zhashoosun zhana andagy ubaktyluu zhyrgalchylyktardy akyretten zhana andagy tuboluktuu zhyrgalchylyktardan zhogoru koiushat. Oshondoi ele adamdardy Allakhtyn zholunan adashtyryshat zhana Allakhtyn zholun burmaloonu, adamdardy chyndyktan adashtyruunu zhana al zholdu ech kim karmanboosu uchun al zholdu karmanuudan adamdardy bashka zhakka buruunu kaalashat. Myna ushul sypattar menen sypattalgandar akyikattan zhana tuuralyktan alystatkan adashuuda.

Allakh taraptan alyp kelgen nerseni tushunuu zhen'il boluusu uchun kaisy elchini zhiberbeili, oz elinin tilinde suilogon adamdy gana elchi kylyp zhiberdik. Zhana Biz any Allakhka yiman keltiruugo adamdardy mazhburloosu uchun zhiberbedik. Allakh kimdi kaalasa adilettuulugu menen adashtyrat zhana kimge kaalasa Oz zhakshylygy menen tuura zholdu karmanuuga iigilik beret. Al ech kimge zhen'ilbes Kuchtuu. Zharatkanynda zhana bashkaruusunda Daanyshman.

Chyndygynda Biz Musany zhiberdik zhana anyn chynchyldygyn zhana al Rabbisi tarabynan zhiberilgenin dalildegen aiat-belgiler menen any kubattadyk. Oshondoi ele oz koomun kaapyrlyktan zhana naadandyktan yimanga zhana ilimge chygaruuga buiruduk. Zhana alarga zhyrgalchylyktardy bergen Allakhtyn kundorun estetuugo any buiruduk. Chyndygynda al kundordo Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygyna, Anyn uluu kuduretine zhana yimanduularga berilgen zhakshylyktaryna achyk dalilder bar. Myna bul nerse menen Allakhka ibadat kyluuga sabyr kylgandar, Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryna daiym shugur kylgandar paida alyshat.

Oo, paigambar! Musa Rabbisinin buirugun atkaryp oz koomunan bolgon Israil urpaktaryna Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryn eskertip myndai dep aitty: "Ei, koomum! Allakh silerdi Faraondun zhan-zhookorlorunon kutkaryp, silerdi alardyn azabynan saktady. Alar silerdi katuu azapka saldy, antkeni silerden Faraondun taktysyn eelep ala turgan urpaktar torolbosh uchun erkek uuldaryn'ardy soidu. Silerdin aialdaryn'ardy duino zhashoosunda kor kylysh uchun tiruu kaltyrdy. Alardyn bul kylgan ishterinde sabyrduulukka bolgon chon' synoo bar. Bul synoogo sabyr kylganyn'ar uchun Allakh silerdi Faraondun zhan-zhookorlorunon kutkaruu menen syilygyn berdi".

Alarga Musa myndai dep aitty: "Rabbin'er silerge kylgan achyk bildiruusun estegile. Eger silerge bergen zhogorudagy eskertilgen zhakshylyktary uchun Allakhka shugur kylsan'ar, anda silerge Oz zhakshylygy menen andan da ashyryp beret. Eger Allakh silerge bergen zhakshylyktaryn zhokko chygaryp shugur kylbasan'ar, anda Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryn zhokko chygaryp shugur kylbagandar uchun Allakhtyn azaby katuu".

Musa oz koomuna myndai dep aitty: "Ei, koomum! Eger siler kaapyrlyk kylsan'ar, anda siler menen birge zher zhuzundogu adamdardyn baary kaapyrlyk kylyshat. Anyn zyiany ozun'orgo kaityp kelet. Antkeni Allakh ech nersege muktazh emes. Al Ozu maktoogo tatyktuu. Aga momundun yiman keltiruusu ech paida berbeit. Oshondoi ele kaapyrlardyn kaapyrlygy ech zyianyn tiigizbeit".

Oo, kaapyrlar! Silerge ozun'ordon murun otkon zhalganchy koomdor, Nukh paigambardyn koomu, Khud paigambardyn Aad koomu, Salikh paigambardyn Samud koomu zhana alardan kiiin kelgen koomdordun sany kop bolup, alardyn sanyn Allakhtan bashka ech kim sanai albagandardy zhok kylgan kabary kelgen zhok bele? Alarga paigambarlary achyk dalilderdi alyp kelishti. Alar paigambarlaryna achuulangandary sebeptuu barmaktaryn tishtep kalyshty. Oshondo alar paigambarlaryna myndai dep aityshty: "Biz siler zhiberilgen nersege kaapyr bolduk. Albette bizdi shekke alyp bara turgan siler chakyryp zhatkan nersege kumon sanap zhatabyz".

Alarga paigambarlary zhoop kaitaryp myndai dep aityshty: "Allakhty zhalgyzdoodo zhana zhalgyz Ozuno syiynuuda shek barby? Al asmandar menen zherdin zharatuuchusu, al ekoosun murun bolbogondoi korunushto zharatty. Al silerdin otkon kunoon'ordu kechirish uchun silerdi Ozuno yiman keltiruugo chakyryp zhatat. Silerdi duino zhashoosundagy belgilengen azhalyn'ar kelgiche kechiktiret". Oshondo elderi paigambarlaryna myndai deit: "Siler bizge okshogon adam emessin'erbi? Silerde bizden ozgocho bolo turgan nerse zhok go. Siler murun ata-babalarybyz syiyngan nerseden bizdi alystatuunu kaalap zhatasyn'arby? Anda siler bizge Allakhtan kelgen paigambarlarbyz degen sozun'orgo chynchyl bolson'or achyk dalil alyp kelgilechi?"

Paigambarlary alarga zhoop kylyp myndai dep aityshty: "Biz siler syiaktuu ele adambyz. Biz silerge okshosh ekenibizdi chetke kakpaibyz. Birok, bizdin silerge bolgon okshoshtugubuz bardyk nersede okshoshbuz degenge zhatpait. Allakh ozgocho zhakshylyktaryn Ozu kaalagan pendelerine berip, adamdardyn arasynan paigambarlardy tandap alat. Siler talap kylgan dalildi Allakh kaalasa gana alyp kele alabyz. Al dalildi alyp keluu bizdin kuch-kuduretibizge bailanyshtuu emes. Al dalildi alyp keluugo zhalgyz Allakhtyn gana kuch-kudureti zhetet. Oshonduktan yimanduu musulmandar bardyk ishinde zhalgyz Allakhka gana tobokel kylyshat".

Allakhka tobokel kyluudan bizdi kandai karshylyk, kandai sebep tyiyp turat? Chynynda, Allakh bizdi en' tuura akyikat zholuna saldy. Siler bizdi zhalganga chygaryp, shyldyn'dap azap bergenin'erge biz sabyr kylabyz. Zhalgyz Allakhka tobokel kyluuchular bardyk ishinde Aga gana tobokel kylat.

Oz koomdorunan chykkan elchilerge kaapyr bolgondor alarga karshy dalil aituudan alsyz bolgon kezde: <<Albette biz silerdi aiylybyzdan chygarabyz zhe bolboso silerdi sozsuz dinin'erden ozubuzdun dinibizge kaitarabyz>> - dep aityshty. Oshondo Allakh alardy bekemdep paigambarlarga: <<Albette Biz Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyr bolgon zaalymdardy kyiratyp zhok kylabyz>> - dep vakhii tushurdu.

Oo, elchiler! Biz alardy kyiratyp zhok kylgandan kiiin albette silerdi zhana silerdi eerchigenderdi bul zherge zhashatabyz. Bul zhalganchy kaapyrlardy kyiratuu, yimanduulardy zhana elchilerdi bul zherge zhashatuu alardy kyiratyp zhok kylgandan kiiin bolot. Al zherdegi zhashoo Menin uluulugumdu, kozomolumdu seze bilgen zhana eskertken azabymdan korkkon adamdar uchun gana bolot.
Elchiler Rabbisinen dushmandaryn zhen'uugo zhardam surashty. Akyikatka karshy chykkan bardyk ton' moiun tekeberler zyianga uchurashty. Akyikat anyk bolso da any eerchishpedi.

Kyiamat kunu bul tekeberdin aldynda tozok kutup turat. Antkeni al tozok anyn baraar zhaiy. Anda aga tozok eelerinen akkan irin'den ichirilet. Myndan anyn chan'koosu da tarkabait. Al daiyma chan'kooluk menen zhana andan bashka turduu azaptar menen azaptalat.

Al irin' aiabai achuu, ysyk, sasyk zhyty bolgondugu uchun kyinalyp kaira kaira ichuugo araket kylat. Any zhutuuga kuchu da zhetpeit. Aga ar taraptan olumgo tete bolgon katuu azaptan olum kelet. Al es aluu uchun olup da kalbait. Teskerisinche, al azapty chegip tiruu boidon kala beret. Zhana anyn aldynda andan da bashka katuu azap kutup turat.

Kaapyrlar bergen sadaka, bashkalarga zhakshylyk kyluusu, alsyzdarga yraiymduuluk kyluusu syiaktuu zhakshylyk ish-araketterinin misaly boroonduu kundo shamal uchurup ketken kulgo okshosh. Antkeni any shamal kotorup ar tarapka izin kaltyrbai chachyp salat. Kudum ushundai ele kaapyrlardyn kaapyrchylygy da zhakshylyk ish-araketterin uchurup zhok kylat. Kyiamat kunu zhakshylyk ish-araketteri alarga paida berbeit. Ish-araketter yimanga negizdelbegen bolso, anda al akyikat zholunan alys bolgon adashuu bolot.

Oo, adam! Bilesin'bi? Albette Allakh asmandar menen zherdi akyikat uchun zharatty. Myna oshonduktan al ekoosun maksatsyz zharatkan zhok. Eger Allakh silerdi zhok kylyp ordun'arga Ozuno gana syiyngan, moiun sungan bashka adamdardy alyp keluunu kaalasa, anda silerdi zhok kylyp Ozuno gana syiyngan, moiun sungan bashka adamdardy alyp kelip koiot. Antkeni al ish Allakhka oto zhen'il.
Silerdi kyiratyp silerden bashka adamdardy alyp keluu Aga oor emes. Al bardyk nersege kudurettuu. Any alsyrata turgan ech nerse zhok.

Ubada berilgen kunu adamdar kabyrlarynan Allakhtyn aldyna chygyshty. Oshondo eerchigen alsyz adamdar attuu-bashtuularga aityshty: <<Oo, el bashchylary! Chyndygynda biz silerdin buirugan buiruktaryn'ardy atkaryp, tyigan nerselerin'erden tyiylyp silerdi eerchidik ele. Emi siler bizdi Allakhtyn azabynan kutkara alasyn'arby?>> Attuu-bashtuular myndai dep zhoop berishti: <<Egerde Allakh bizdi tuura zholgo bashtasa, anda biz dagy silerdi tuura zholgo bagyttait elek. Oshondo baarybyz Allakhtyn azabynan kutulmakpyz. Birok biz adashtyk zhana silerdi da adashtyrdyk. Emi azap bizge da silerge da any kotoruudo alsyzdyk kylabyzby zhe sabyr kylabyzby birdei bolot. Bizdi al azaptan ech kim kutkarbait>>.

Beiish eeleri beiishke zhana tozok eeleri tozokko kirishkende shaitan myndai dedi: <<Chyndygynda Allakh silerge akyikat ubada berdi. Zhana silerge bergen ubadasyn atkardy. Al emi men zhalgan ubada berdim. Zhana silerge bergen ubadamdy atkargan zhokmun. Duinodo men silerdi kaapyrlykka zhana adashuuga mazhburlai turgan ech kandai kuchum zhok bolchu. Bolgonu men silerdi kaapyrlykka chakyryp, kunoo ishterdi kooz kylyp korsottum ele siler meni zharyshyp eerchip kettin'er. Andyktan silerdin bashyn'arga tushkon adashuu uchun meni kunoolobogulo. Siler ozun'ordu ozun'or kunoologulo. Al biroonu zhemeloodon zhakshyraak. Men silerdi azaptan kutkaryp zhardam bere albaim. Siler dagy meni azaptan kutkaryp zhardam bere albaisyn'ar. Siler meni Allakhka syiynuuda Aga sherik kyluun'ardy chetke kaktym. Chyndygynda duinodo Allakhka sherik keltirip, aga kaapyr bolgon zaalymdardy kyiamat kunu kutup turgan zhan oorutkan azap bar>>.

Kachan Allakh kaapyrlardy korkutuu uchun alardyn kyiamat kunu bara turgan zhaiyn aitkan kezde yimanduulardy da shyktandyruu uchun alardyn bara turgan zhaiyn aityp myndai dedi:
Al emi zalymdardyn bara turgan zherinin karama karshysynda, yiman keltirgender zhana zhakshy ish-araketterdi atkargandardy kan sarailarynyn zhana bak-daraktarynyn aldynan daryialar akkan beiishke kirgizdi.
