Alar al zhakta Rabbisinin uruksaty zhana kudureti menen gana tuboluk zhashashat. Alar biri-biri menen salamdashyshat zhana perishteler da alar menen salamdashat. Oshondoi ele Rabbisi alarga Ozunun salamy menen alarga salam beret.

Oo, paigambar! Allakh <<Allakhtan bashka kudai zhok>> degen kuboluk kelmesine kandai misal keltirgenin bilesin'bi? Al aga momoluu darakty misal kyldy. Al darak kurma daragy. Al daraktyn son'gogu zherdin tubuno teren' kirip, zhakshy tamyrlary menen suu ichet. Al emi anyn butaktary asmanga kotorulup, shudurumdon ichet zhana taza aba menen dem alat.
Bul momoluu bak Rabbisinin buirugu menen zhakshy momosun bardyk mezgilde berip turat. Allakh Taala adamdarga ushul syiaktuu misaldardy balkim alar esterine kelishet dep aityp turat.

Al emi yplas shirk sozunun misaly zhaman darak syiaktuu. Al darak khanzal daragy. Al ozunun tamyrynan zhulunup kalgan. Zherge turuktuu negizi zhok. Al asmanga karai kotorulboit. Oshonduktan al kuurap olup kalat da any shamal uchurup ketet. Myna oshondoi ele kaapyrlyk sozdor akyr aiagy baryp zhok bolot. Al sozdordu aitkan adam uchun Allakhtyn aldynda zhakshy ish bolup zhazylbait.

Allakh yimanduulardyn yimanyn bul duinodo bekem kuboluk kelmesi menen toluk bekemdeit. Alardyn yimany toluk bolgon abalda bul duinodon kaityshat. Kabyr zhashoosunda alarga suroo berilgen kezde zhana kyiamat kunundo kubattait. Allakh zalymdardy Rabbisine shirk keltiruu menen zhana tuura zholdon bash tartuusu menen adashtyrat. Allakh kaalaganyn ishke ashyrat - kimdi adashtyruunu kaalasa, anda any adilettuulugu menen adashtyrat. Oshondoi ele kimdi tuura zholgo saluunu kaalasa, any Ozunun zhakshylygy menen tuura zholgo salat. Allakhty ech kim mazhburlai albait.

Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryn almashtyrgan Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyr bolgon kureish uruusunun abalyn korbodun'bu? Mukhammad paigambar bolup zhiberilgen zhana Kharam zherin aman kylyp koigon zhakshylyktardy alar Rabbisinen kelgen akyikatty zhalganga chygargan kaapyrlygy menen almashtyryshty. Zhana alardyn koomunan alardy kaapyrlykta eerchigen adamdardy kyiratuuchu zhaiga tushurushtu.
Kyiratuuchu zhai - alar kire turgan tozok zhaiy. Alar anyn ysygyn tatyshat. Alardyn kala turgan zhaiy - kandai zhaman zhai boldu.

Mushrikter eerchigen adamdardy Allakhtyn zholunan adashtyrgandan kiiin dagy da adashtyruu uchun kudailaryn Allakhka ten'desh kylyshty zhana Aga okshoshturushtu. Ei, paigambar! Alarga: "Bul duinodo kumarga batkan zhashoon'ordo zhyrgai bergile zhana shektengen kumonun'ordu tarata bergile. Albette kyiamat kunundo bara turgan zhaiyn'ar tozok bolot. Andan bashka zhakka kete albaisyn'ar" - dep aitkyn.

Oo, paigambar! Yimanduularga myndai dep ait: "Oo, yimanduular! Namazdy toluk turdo okugula. Dos dosuna shapaat kyla albagan, Allakhtyn azabynan kutuluu uchun soodalashuu zhana kun toloo kabyl alynbagan kun kele elekte, siler Allakh bergen yryskylardan parz zhana nafil sadakalardan bergile. Sadakany el korunuudon saktanuu uchun zhashyruun turdo zhana bashkalarga ulgu boluu uchun achyk turdo bergile.

Allakh asmandardy zhana zherdi murda bolbogon korunushto zhokton bar kyldy. Asmandan zhamgyr suusun tushurdu. Oo, adamdar! Silerge yrysky kylyp zhaagan zhamgyrdan ar turduu momo-zhemishterdi chygardy. Oshondoi ele silerge tagdyr kylyp suu ustundo zhurgon kemelerdi zhana suusun ichuu uchun daryialardy bash iidirip koidu. Andan malyn'ardy zhana eginin'erdi suugarasyn'ar.
Toktoboi chygyp turgan Kun menen Aidy zhana birinin artynan biri kelgen kun menen tundu silerge bash iidirdi. Tun silerdi uktap es aluun'ar uchun, kunduzu siler sergek bolup meenet kyluun'ar uchun.

Al silerge talap kylgan nersen'erdin baaryn berdi. Talap kylbagan nersen'erdi da berdi. Egerde Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryn eseptesen'er, anda alardyn koptugunon eseptep buto albaisyn'ar. Silerge aitylgan zhakshylyktar - zhakshylyktardyn kee bir misaldary. Chyndygynda adam ozuno kop zulumduk kylat zhana Allakh Taalanyn zhakshylyktaryn kop chetke kagat.

Oo, paigambar! Ibrakhim balasy Ismaildi zhana anyn apasy Khazhardy Mekkenin bir talaasyna alyp kelgende myndai dep aitkanyn estegin: "Oo, Rabbim! Men ui-bulomdu zhashatkan bul zherdi (Mekkeni) tynchtyk ornogon zher kylgyn. Bul zherdi kan togulbogon zhana ech kim zulumduk korbogon zher kylgyn. Oshondoi ele meni zhana baldarymdy aikelderge syiynuudan alys kylgyn" - dep duba kyldy.

O, Rabbim! Chynynda, aikelder adamdardyn kobun adashtyrdy. Aikelder adamdarga koldoochu bolot dep oilop aga azgyrylyshty zhana Allakhtan bashkaga syiynyshty. Adamdardan kim meni Allakhty zhalgyzdoodo zhana Aga moiun sunuuda eerchise, anda al menden zhana meni eerchigenderden. Al emi kim menden bash tartsa, anda al zhalgyz Allakhka syiynuuda zhana Aga moiun sunuuda meni eerchigenderden emes. O, Rabbim! Sen kimdi kaalasan' kechiresin'. Chynynda, Sen kunoolordu Kechiruuchusun', alarga Yraiymduusun'.

Oo, Rabbibiz! Chyndygynda men baldarymdyn kee birlerin Mekkede kaltyrdym. Alar Ismaildin urpaktary. Osumduk ospogon, zhaka belinde suu chykpagan Mekke oroonundo baldary kalyshty. Oo, Rabbibiz! Alardy Mekkenin zhanynda zhashat, alar al zherde namazdaryn okushsun. Oo, Rabbim! Adamdardyn zhurogun alarga zhumshak kyla kor. Alar Sen bergen zhakshylyktaryn'a shugur kyluusu uchun momolordon yrysky bere kor!

Oo, Rabbibiz! Chyndygynda, Sen biz zhashyrgan nerselerdin zhana achyk zhasagan nerselerdin bardygyn bilesin'. Allakhka zherde da, asmanda da ech nerse zhashyruun emes. Teskerinche Al baaryn bilet. Zhana Aga bizdin muktazhdyktarybyz, kedeiligibiz da zhashyruun emes.

Maktoo-shugurlor Aruu zat Allakhka bolsun. Al menin dubamdy kabyl kylyp yimanduu baldardy berdi. Al maga zhashym otkon kezde Khazhardan Ismaildi berdi zhana Saradan Iskhakty berdi. Chynynda Allakh Taala kim duba kylsa, dubany Uguuchu.
Oo, Rabbim! Meni namazdy toluk okugandardan kyl. Oshondoi ele menin urpaktarymdy da namazdy toluk okugandardan kyl. Oo, Rabbibiz! Menin dubama zhoop ber zhana any kabyl kyl.

Oo, Rabbibiz! Menin kunoolorumdu kechire kor, ata-enemdin kunoolorun kechire kor (atasy Allakhtyn dushmany ekenin bile elekte aitkan. Kachan atasy Allakhtyn dushmany ekenin bilgende andan alystap ketken) zhana yimanduulardyn kunoolorun adamdar surak beruu uchun Rabbisinin aldyna barganda kechire kor!

Oo, paigambar! Egerde Allakh zalymdardyn azabyn kechiktirip zhatsa, sen Allakhty zalymdar kylyp zhatkandarynan, zhalgan aityp Allakhtyn zholunan toskondorunan zh.b.u.s. nerselerinen kapilette dep oilobo. Albette Allakh al nerselerdi Biluuchu. Andan ech nerse zhashyruun bolup kalbait. Bolgonu Al alardyn zhazasyn kyiamat kungo kaltyrdy. Myna oshol kundo kozdor korgon nersesinen korkkondugunan koktu karap kalat.

Adamdar kabyrynan turgan kezde alardy chakyrgan zhakka shashyp baryshat. Bashtaryn kotorup korkkon abalda asmandy karashat. Korushkon nersesin korkkondugunan kozdorun ala alyshpai katyp karap kalyshat. Korgon nersesinen korkup kalyshkandyktan alardyn zhuroktorunun akyly ketip bosh bolup, tushunuusu da zhok bolup kalyshat.

Oo, paigambar! Ummotun'du kyiamat kunundogu Allakhtyn azaby menen korkut. Myna oshol kunu ozdoruno shirk zhana kaapyrlyk menen zulum kylgandar myndai dep aityshat: <<Oo, Rabbibiz! Bizge ubakyt ber, azabyn'dy kechiktirip tur. Bizdi bul duinogo bir az moonotko kaitar, biz Saga yiman keltirip, bizge zhonotkon elchilerin'di eerchiibiz>>. Myna oshondo alardy zhemelep myndai zhoop kaitarylat: <<Siler bul duinodo zhurgondo ushul duinodon akyretke barbaibyz dep ant ichtin'er. Oshondoi ele olgondon kiiin kaira tiriluunu chetke kaktyn'ar ele>>.

Silerden murunku zhashagan koomdordun zherlerine kelip zhashadyn'ar. Alar silerge cheiin Allakhka kapyrlyk kylyp, alar ozdoruno ozdoru zulum kylyshty. Alar Khud zhana Salikh paigambarlardyn koomu. Alardy kantip zhazalaganybyz silerge maalym. Oshondoi ele siler sabak alysh uchun al tuurasynda Allakhtyn kitebinde koptogon misaldardy keltirdik. Andan siler kandai sabak aldyn'ar?

Zalym koomdordun zhashagan zherlerine kelip oturuktashkan adamdar paigambardy olturup, daavatyn toktotuuga aila-amal oiloshtu. Allakh alar emne uiushturup zhatkandaryn bilet zhana alar kylyp zhatkan nerselerinin ech biri Allakhka zhashyruun emes. Alardyn aila-amaly alsyz. Alardyn aila-amaly alsyz bolgonduktan toonu zhana bashka nerseni dagy zhok kyla albait. Al emi Allakhtyn aila-amaly alardykynan kuchtuu.

Oo, paigambar! Paigambarlaryna zhen'ishti zhana dindi ustom kyluunu ubada kylgan Allakhtyn oshol paigambarlaryna bergen ubadasyn buzat dep oilobo. Chyndygynda Allakh Kudurettuu, any ech kim zhen'e albait. Oshondoi ele Ozunun suiuktuu pendelerin urmattait. Ozunun zhana paigambarynyn dushmandarynan katuu och aluuchu.

Al kapyrlardan och aluu kyiamat kunu bolot. Al kunu bul zher bashka appak taza zherge almashat. Oshondoi ele asman dagy bashka asmanga almashat. Andan kiiin adamdardyn baary oz deneleri, ishteri menen kabyrlarynan turup zhalgyz Allakhtyn aldyna surak beruugo turat. Allakh Ozunun padyshachylygynda zhana uluktugunda zhalgyz. Al Kaarduu, baaryn bagyntat, birok bagynbait. Al baarynan ustomuk kylat zhana Aga ech kim ustomduk kyla albait.

Oo, paigambar! Zher bashka zherge almashyp, asmandar dagy almashkan kunu kapyrlar menen mushrikterdi korosun'. Alar biri-birine kishendelip, al emi alardyn koldoru menen buttary moindaryna biriktirilip chynzhyr menen bailanat. Alardyn kiigen kiiimderi kara maidan (al katu kuio turgan suiuktuktan zhazalgan tozok kiiimi). Alardyn zhuzdorun aloolongon ot kaptap turat.

Oo, paigambar! Zher bashka zherge almashyp, asmandar dagy almashkan kunu kapyrlar menen mushrikterdi korosun'. Alar biri-birine kishendelip, al emi alardyn koldoru menen buttary moindaryna biriktirilip chynzhyr menen bailanat. Alardyn kiigen kiiimderi kara maidan (al katu kuio turgan suiuktuktan zhazalgan tozok kiiimi). Alardyn zhuzdorun aloolongon ot kaptap turat.
Allakh ar bir adamdyn kylgan zhakshy ishine zhe zhaman ishine zharasha syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret. Chyndygynda, Allakh ish-araketterdin esebin tez beruuchu.

Bul Mukhammadka tushkon Kuran Allakhtan adamzatka kelgen bildiruu. Andagy katuu azaptar menen korkutuulardan korkkula. Zhana syiynuuga tatyktuu zhalgyz Allakh ekenin bilgile. Andyktan Aga gana syiynyp zhana Aga ech bir sherik koshpogula. Bul nerseden taza akyl eeleri ulgu sabaktardy alyshsyn. Antkeni osholor ulguluu sabaktardan paida alyshat.

(lr) Alim, laam, ro. Ushuga okshogon aiattyn tushundurmosu bakara suroosunun bashtalyshynda aitylgan. Allakhtyn aldynan tushkondugun bildirgen biiik darazhaluu bul aiattar - zhalgyz Allakhka syiynuunu zhana shariiattardy achyktap tushundurgon Kuran aiattary.
Kyiamat kunu kaapyrlarga baary achyk bolgondo zhana bul duinodogu alardyn kaapyrlygy zhokko chykkany bilingende alar musulman boluunu en'seshet.

Oo, paigambar! Al zhalganchylardy tim koi! Alar maldarga okshop zhep-ichip, bul ubaktyluu duinonun yrakhattaryn paidalanyp zhana duinogo beriluu alardy yiman menen zhakshylyk ishterdi kyluudan alaksyta bersin. Alar kyiamat kunu Allakhtyn aldyna kelishkende kandai zhogotuuga uchuragandaryn bilishet.
Zulumduk kylgan shaarlardyn kaisynysyna kyiroonu tushurboiluk, Allakhtyn iliminde anyn belgilengen moonotu bolgon, al aldyga da artka da zhyldyrylgan emes.
Kaisy gana koom bolbosun, anyn kyiroo moonotu kelmeiinche kyiroogo uchurabait, kyiroo moonotu kelgen bolso, anda al kechiktirilbeit.
Mekkelik kaapyrlar paigambarga aityshty: <<Ei, eskertme tushkon adam! Chyndygynda sen bul aitkan sozun' menen anyk zhindisin'. Sen ozundu zhindilerdei alyp zhurosun'>>.
Sen chyn ele zhiberilgen paigambar zhana bizge azap keleerinde chynchyl bolson', saga kubolukko otkon perishtelerdi alyp kelbeisin'bi?

Alardyn perishtelerdi alyp kel degen sozdoruno Allakh zhoop kyldy: <<Silerdi azap menen zhok kyluuga ubakyt kelgende Biz daanyshmandyk talap kylgan abalda gana perishtelerdi tushurobuz. Biz perishtelerdi zhibergende alar yiman keltirishpese, alarga moonot berilbeit. Teskerisinche, zhazany erte alyshat>>.
Chyndygynda bul Kurandy Biz Mukhammaddyn zhuroguno adamdarga eskertuu bolush uchun tushurduk zhana Kurandy burmalanuudan, ozgortuudon, ashyryp zhe kemituudon Ozubuz saktaibyz.

Oo, paigambar! Biz senden murun kaapyrlyk kylgan abalky zhamaattarga paigambarlardy zhibergenibizde alardy zhalganga chygaryshty. Koomun'dun seni zhalganga chygaruusu paigambarlardyn arasynan saga birinchi zholu bolup zhatkan zhok.
Abalky kaapyr zhamaattarga paigambar kelse, alar any zhalganga chygaryshty zhana any mazaktap kulushtu.
Biz oshol koomdordun zhuroktoruno zhalganga chygaruunu salyp koigon syiaktuu Mekke mushrikterinin zhuroktoruno da zhuz buruunu zhana kok bettikti salyp koiobuz.

Alar Mukhammadga tushurulgon bul Kuranga yiman keltirishpeit. Buga cheiin paigambarlar alyp kelgendi zhalganga chygaryshkan adamdardyn zhok kylyngany tuuraluu Allakhtyn okumu bolup ottu. Emi seni zhalganga chygargandar sabak alyshsyn.
Oshol zhalganga chygargandar menen kok bettik kylgandarga achyk-aikyn dalilderdin negizinde akyikat korunup tursa dagy zhana alarga asmandan eshik achylyp, kotorulup baratyshsa dagy
Alar ech ishenishpeit zhana sozsuz aityshat: <<Chyndygynda kozdorubuz bashkalardy koruudon tosulup kaldy. Biz korup turgan nerse syikyrdyn gana taasiri. Biz syikyrlanyp kaldyk>>.

Biz asmanda chon' zhyldyzdardy zharattyk. Adamdar saparga chygyshkanda alar arkyluu kurgaktyk menen den'izdegi karan'gylyktardan zhol tabyshat. Alardy Allakhtyn kuduretine dalil kyluulary uchun aga koz chaptyryp karagan adamdar uchun koozdop koiduk.
Oshondoi ele asmandy Allakhtyn yraiymynan kuulgan bardyk zhin-shaitandardan korgop koiduk.
Al emi biiiktegi perishteler tobunun sozdorun zhashyrynyp ukkandardy bolso bir nurduu zhyldyz kuup zhetip kuiguzot.

Adamdar zher betinde zhaigashuulary uchun any zhaiyk kyldyk. Al adamdardy chaipabash uchun bekem toolordu ornottuk. Oshondoi ele turluu osumduktordu osturduk. Bular daanyshmandyktyn talabyna ylaiyk chektelip belgilengen.

Ei, adamdar! Biz siler uchun zher betinde zhashagan uchurun'arda kun koruun'or uchun tamak-ash zhana suusunduktardy zharattyk. Oshondoi ele silerden bashka silerdin yryskyn'arsyz kun korushkon adamdar menen zhanybarlar uchun da zharattyk.

Adamdar zhana zhanybarlar paidalanyshkan kandai gana nerse bolbosun, Biz any zharatuuga zhana al arkyluu adamdarga paida bergenge kudurettuubuz. Biz osholordon kandai gana nerselerdi zharatpaily, alar Bizdin daanyshmandygybyzdyn talabyna ylaiyk chektelip belgilengen olchomdo bolot.

Biz buluttardy chan'dashtyruuchu shamaldardy zhiberdik. Chan'dashkan buluttardan zhamgyr zhaadyrdyk. Zhamgyrdyn suusu menen silerdi sugardyk. Ei, adamdar! Zher betindegi bul suulardy bulak zhana kuduktarga siler toptoboisun'ar. Akyikatta alardy Allakh Ozu gana toptoit.

Chyndygynda Biz Ozubuz gana zhokton zharatyp zhana olgondon kiiin kaira zhan saluu menen oluktordu tiriltebiz. Oshondoi ele tiruulordun azhaldary kelgende alardy olturobuz. Biz zher betin zhana andagylardy muras kylyp Ozubuz gana kalabyz.
Biz silerden aldyn zhana kiiin kim torolgonun zhana kim olgonun bilgenbiz. Bulardyn biri da Bizge zhashyruun emes.

Ei, paigambar! Chyndygynda Rabbin' alardyn zhakshylyk kylgandaryna syilyk, zhamandyk kylgandaryna zhazasyn berish uchun baarysyn kyiamat kunu chogultat. Chyndygynda Al bashkaruusunda Daanyshman zhana Al bardyk nerseni Biluuchu.
Biz Adamdy chertse un chykkan kurgak ylaidan zharattyk. Al zharatylgan bul ylai kop ubakyt turgany uchun zhyty ozgorup, kara tusto bolchu.
Al emi Adamdan murun zhinderdin tupku atasyn zhalyndagan kuchtuu otton zharattyk.

Oo, paigambar! Rabbin'din perishtelerge zhana alar menen chogu bolgon Ibliske aitkanyn este: <<Men zhakynda kurgak ylaidan adamdy zharatam. Any chertkende un chykkan, zhyty ozgorgon kara tusto bolot>>.
Any kelbetine keltirip, dene-tuzulushun toluktagandan kiiin Menin buiruguma bash iiip zhana aga salamdashyp sazhda kylgyla.
Perishteler moiun sunushtu. Rabbisi alarga buiruk kylgandai baarysy aga sazhda kylyshty.
Birok Iblis perishteler menen birge Adamga sazhda kyluudan bash tartty. Al perishteler menen bolso dagy alardan emes ele.
Iblis Adamga sazhda kyluudan bash tartkandan kiiin Allakh andan: <<Menin buiruguma bash iiip sazhda kylyshkan perishteler menen birge sazhda kyluudan seni emne tostu?>> - dep surady.
Iblis tekeberlenip aitty: <<Menin adamga sazhda kylganym tuura emes. Sen any kurgagan ylaidan zharattyn'. Al ozgorgon kara tustogu ylai>>.
Allakh Ibliske aitty: <<Beiishten chyk! Chyndygynda sen kuulgandardansyn'.
Sen kyiamatka cheiin Menin kargyshyma kaldyn' zhana yraiymymdan kuuldun'>>.
Iblis aitty: <<Oo, Rabbim! Anda maga zharatylgandar kaira tiriluuchu kungo cheiin meni olturboi moonot ber>>.
Allakh aga aitty: <<Albette sen azhaly kechiktirilip moonot berilgenderden boldun'.
Surnai tartylyp bardyk zharatylgandar olgon ubakytka cheiin>>.
Iblis aitty: <<Oo, Rabbim! Sen meni adashtyrganyn' sebeptuu men dagy alarga zher betinde kunoolordu kooz kylyp korgozom zhana alardyn baarysyn tuura zholdon sozsuz adashtyram.
Bir gana Ozun'o syiynuu uchun tandap algan pendelerin'den bashkasyn>>.
Allakh aitty: <<Bul - Maga zhetkiruuchu tuz zhol.
Chyndygynda Menin yklastuu pendelerimdi azgyruuga kuduretin' zhetpeit zhana alardy bashkara da albaisyn'. Birok seni eerchip adashkandardy gana bashkara alasyn'>>.
Chyndygynda tozok Iblis zhana any eerchigen bardyk adashkandarga ubada kylyngan zhai.
Alar kire turgan tozoktun zheti eshigi bar. Anyn ar bir eshiginen Iblisti eerchigenderden kire turgan belgiluu olchom bar.
Chyndygynda Rabbisinin buiruktaryna moiun sunup, tyigandarynan alystap Andan korkkondor uchun beiish baktary zhana bulaktar bar.
Alar kirip baratkanda alarga aitylat: <<Balee-korkunuchtardan kutulup salamattykta beiishke kirgile!>>
Biz alardyn kokuroktorunon zhek koruunu zhana dushmandykty alyp saldyk. Alar biri-birin zhakshy korgon bir tuugandar. Alar bet man'dai biri-birin karap sorulordo oturushat.
Alar beiishte charchashpait zhana al zhaktan chygyshpait. Alar beiishte tuboluk kalyshat.
Oo, paigambar! Pendelerime bildir: <<Chyndygynda alardyn toobo kylgandaryn Men gana kechirem zhana yraiym kylam>>.
Zhana Menin azabym - zhan oorutkan azap ekenin alarga zhetkir. Alar Menin kechirimime zhetip, azabymdan kutulush uchun Maga toobo kylyshsyn.
Oshondoi ele Ibrakhimge konok bolup kelishken perishtelerdin kabaryn alarga zhetkir. Alar aga balaluu bolorun suiunchulop zhana Luttun koomun zhok kyluu uchun kelishken.

Alar anyn aldyna <<Salam!>> dep aityp kirishti. Al alardyn salamyna andan da zhakshyraak alik aldy. Alarga zhesin dep otko kaktalyp byshkan torpoktun etin tartty. Alardy adamdardan dep oilogon. Kachan alardyn tamaktan zhebegenderin korgondo: <<Biz silerden kooptonup zhatabyz>> - dedi.
Elchi perishteler aga: <<Ech korkpo! Biz seni kubandyrgan kabar alyp keldik. Zhakynda sen ilimduu erkek balaluu bolosun'>> - deshti.
Ibrakhim balaluu bolosun' degen kabarga tan' kala alarga: <<Men karygan kurakka kelip kartaiyp kalsam kaidagy balany suiunchulop zhatasyn'ar? Kaisy negizge taianyp suiunchulop zhatasyn'ar?>> - dedi.
Elchi perishteler Ibrakhimge: <<Biz saga ech kandai shek-kumonu zhok chyndykty suiunchuloduk. Biz saga suiunchulogon nerseden umutsuz kalgandardan bolbo>>.
Ibrakhim aitty: <<Rabbisinin yraiymynan tuura zholdon adashkandar gana umut uzushot>>.
Ibrakhim: <<Oo, Allakh taraptan kelgen elchiler! Emne ish menen keldin'er?>> - dep surady.
Elchi perishteler aityshty: <<Allakh bizdi chon' buzukuluk zhana zhamandyk kylgan Luttun koomun zhok kylysh uchun zhiberdi.
Bir gana Luttun ui-bulosu menen any eerchigender aman kalyshat. Alar kyiroogo uchurashpait. Biz alardyn baarysyn al nerseden kutkarabyz.
Birok anyn aialynan bashkasyn. Biz any kyiroogo duushar bolgondor menen kalat dep okum kyldyk.
Elchi perishteler Luttun ui-bulosuno erkekterdin kelbetinde kelishti.
Lut paigambar alarga: <<Siler choochun ekensin'er>> - dep aitty.
Elchi perishteler Lutka aityshty: <<Ei, Lut! Korkpo! Biz elin' kumon sanagan kyiratuuchu azapty alyp keldik.
Biz saga ech kandai tamashasy zhok chyndyk menen keldik. Biz saga aitkan sozubuzdo chynchylbyz.

Tundun bir bolugu otkondon kiiin ui-bulon' menen zholgo chyk. Alardyn artynda zhur. Alardyn bashyna tushkon nerseni korush uchun aran'ardan ech kim artyn karabasyn. Allakh silerdi buirugan zhakty kozdoi zhonogulo.
Biz tagdyr kylgan al buiruktu Lutka aian arkyluu bildirdik. Al buiruk - tan' atkanda al koomdun birin da kaltyrbai kyiratyp zhok kyluu ele.
Sadumdun eli buzukuluk kyluunu kaalashyp suiungon boidon Luttun konoktoruna zhetip kelishti.
Lut alarga aitty: <<Bul adamdar menin konoktorum. Bulardan kaalap zhatkan nersen'er menen meni shermende kylbagyla!
Bul buzukuluktu tashtap Allakhtan korkkula! Bul zhiiirkenichtuu zhorugun'ar menen meni kordukka salbagyla>>.
Aga koomu aitty: <<Biz seni adamdardy konoktobo dep tyigan elek go?>>.
Konoktorunun aldynda kechirim surap Lut alarga aitty: <<Bul kyzdar silerdin aialdaryn'ardan. Egerde shakybat kaaloon'ordu ishke ashyrgyn'ar kelse, anda alarga uilongulo!>>
Oo, paigambar! Zhashoon'o ant bolsun! Chyndygynda Luttun koomu ashyp tashkan shakybattarynda temselep zhurushot.
Kun chygar maalda alardy olturuuchu achuu kyikyryk aldy.
Anan Biz alardyn shaaryn astyn-ustun kylyp saldyk. Alardyn ustuno katyp kalgan chopo tashtardy zhaadyrdyk.
Chyndygynda Luttun koomuna tushkon kyiroo tuuraluu bul aitylgan nerselerde oi zhugurtkondor uchun belgiler bar.
Chyndygynda Luttun shaary zholdun boiunda zhaigashkan. Al zherden otkon zholoochular any korushot.
Albette bul bolgon okuiada andan sabak ala turgan yimanduular uchun belgiler bar.
Chyrmalyp oskon daraktuu shaardyn zhashoochulary Shuaibdyn koomu zalymdar bolushkan. Antkeni alar Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyshty zhana alardyn paigambary Shuaibdy zhalganga chygaryshty.
Biz alardy azapka salyp och aldyk. Chyndygynda Luttun koomunun shaary zhana Shuaibdyn elinin zhashagan zherleri al zherden otkondordun ken' zholunun boiunda.
Khizhaz menen Shamdyn ortosunda zhaigashkan Khizhrdin zhashoochulary Samud da ozdorunun paigambary Salikhti zhalganga chygaruu menen bardyk paigambarlardy zhalganga chygaryshty.
Al Rabbisi taraptan alyp kelgen nerselerde chynchyl ekendigine alarga dalilderdi zhana belgilerdi berdik. Osholordun biri too ele. Alar bul belgilerden sabak alyshpady zhana kon'ul burushpady.
Alar ui kylysh uchun toolordu oiushup, al zherde korkkon nerselerinen koopsuzdukta zhashashchu.
Tan'ga maal alardy ach aikyryk azaby aldy.
Alardyn ishtep tapkan bailyktary zhana turak-zhailary alardy Allakhtyn azabynan korgoi algan zhok.

Biz asmandar menen Zherdi zhana al ekoosunun ortosundagy nerselerdi sebepsiz zhon ele zharatkan zhokpuz. Biz alardyn baarysyn akyikat menen gana zharattyk. Albette kyiamat saaty sozsuz keluuchu. Ei, paigambar! Seni zhalganga chygargandardan zhuz bur zhana alardy zhakshylyk menen kechir.
Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda Rabbin' - Al butkul nerselerdi Zharatuuchu zhana alardy Biluuchu.
Biz saga zheti aiattan turgan fatikhany berdik. Al - uluu Kuran.
Biz kee bir kaapyrlarga bergen ubaktyluu zhyrgalchylyktarga kyzygyp karaba! Alardyn zhalganga chygargandaryna kaigyrba zhana yimanduularga kichipeiil bol!
Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Chyndygynda men azapty anyk eskertuuchumun.
Men silerdi Allakhtyn kitepterin boluktorgo bolgondordun bashyna Allakh tushurgon nerse silerge da zhetishinen eskertemin. Alar kee birine yiman keltirip, kee birine kaapyr bolushkan.
Alar Kurandy boluk-boluk kylyshyp: <<Bul syikyr zhe tolgoo zhe yr saptary>> - dep aityshty.
Oo, paigambar! Rabbin'e ant, Biz any boluktorgo bolgondordun baarysyn kyiamat kunu sozsuz surakka alabyz.
Biz alardyn bul duinodo kylyshkan kaapyrlyktary zhana kunooloru tuuraluu sozsuz suraibyz.
Oo, paigambar! Allakh seni daavat kyluuga buirugan nerseni zharyia kyl zhana mushrikterdin aitkandaryna zhana kylgandaryna kon'ul burba!
Zhana alardan korkpo! Kuraishtyn seni shyldyn'dagan kaapyr bashchylarynyn ailakerligine Biz Ozubuz zhetishtuubuz.
Alar Allakh menen katar bashka nerselerdi kudai kylyp alyshkandar. Zhakynda alar kylgan shirkterinin zhaman natyizhasyn bilishet.
Oo, paigambar! Biz alardyn seni shyldyn'dap zhana zhalganga chygaryp zhatkandary sebeptuu kokurogun' kysylyp zhatkanyn bilebiz.

Allakhka ylaiyk kelbegen nerselerden Any aruulap zhana kemchiliksiz sypattar menen Aga maktoolordu aityp, Aga gana bet al. Allakhka ibadat kylgandardan zhana Al uchun namaz okugandardan bol. Bul nersede senin kokurogun'dun kysylganyna shypaa bar.
Oshondoi ele Rabbin'e daiym ibadat kyl zhana oshogo bekem bolup saga olum kelgenge cheiinki tiruulugun'do any uzboi ulant.
Ei, kaapyrlar! Allakh okum kylgan silerdin azabyn'ar da zhakyndap kaldy. Andyktan siler any ubaktysynan murun shashtyrbagyla! Allakh mushrikterdin Aga kylgan sherikterinen Aruu zhana Biiik.

Allakh Oz elchilerinin kimisine kaalasa, anda Ozunun okum-buiruktary menen: <<Ei, elchiler! Adamdardy Allakhka shirk kyluudan korkutkula! Menden bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok. Oo, adamdar! Andyktan menin buiruktarymdy atkaryp, tyigandarymdan alystap Menden korkkula!>> - degen kabar menen perishtelerdi tushurot.

Allakh asmandar menen zherdi murda bolbogondoi korunushto akyikat menen zharatty. Alardy zhon ele zharatyp koigon zhok. Alardy Ozunun uluktuguna dalil kylysh uchun zharatty. Al alardyn koshkon sherikterinen aruu.
Al insandy alsyz bel suudan zharatty. Anyn dene-tuzulushu ulam oorchup ostu. Kiiin ele al akyikatty zhok kylysh uchun zhalganga taianyp, achyk ele talashyp tartyshkan adam bolup chyga keldi.

Oo, adamdar! Oshondoi ele Al silerdin paidan'ar uchun too, ui, koi syiaktuu ui zhanybarlaryn zharatty. Al emi bul paidalardan - alardyn zhundoru zhyluuluk uchun paidalanylat. Oshondoi ele alardyn sutundo, terisinde zhana alardy minuudo bashka dagy paidalar bar zhana alardan zheisin'er.
Oshondoi ele alar kechinde zhaiyttan kaityp kelishkende zhana tan' erte zhaiytka chygyshkanda da siler uchun koozduktar bar.

Bul ui zhanybarlary siler zholgo chykkanda oor zhuktorun'ordu adamdar uchun kyiynchylyk menen gana zhetuu mumkun bolgon shaarlarga tashyp baryshat. Ei, adamdar! Chyndygynda Rabbin'er silerge oto Meerimduu, Yraiymduu. Antkeni Al silerge bul ui zhanybarlaryn bash iidirdi.

Allakh siler minish uchun, zhugun'ordu artysh uchun zhana adamdarga zhagynganga koozduk bolush uchun silerge zhylkylardy, kachyrlardy zhana eshekterdi zharatty. Al Ozu zharatuunu kaalagan siler bilbegen nerselerdi zharatat.

Ozunun yraazylygyna zhetkirgen tuura zholdu achyktap baiandoonu Allakh Oz mildetine algan. Al zhol - Islam dini. Zholdordun arasynda akyikattan taigan shaitandyn zholdoru da bar. Islamdyn zholunan bashka bardyk zholdor burmalangan zholdor. Eger Allakh baaryn'ar yimanga kelishin'erdi kaalaganda, anda Al baaryn'arga aga zhetuugo iigilik bermek.
Al silerge buluttardan suu tushurdu. Al suudan siler ichesin'er zhana mal-zhandyktaryn'ar da ichishet. Oshondoi ele malyn'ar zhaiylgan zhaiyttar da oshol suu menen kogorup zhashyldanat.

Allakh al suu arkyluu siler zhep zhatkan osumduktordu osturot zhana any menen silerge zaitundu, kurmalardy, zhuzumdordu zhana momo-zhemishterdin bardyk turlorun osturot. Albette bul suuda zhana andan chykkan nerselerde Allakhtyn zharatkandary tuuraluu oi zhugurtkon adamdar uchun Anyn kudurettuulugun bildirgen dalilder bar. Alar osholordu Allakhtyn kudurettuuluguno dalil kylyshat.

Al silerge es alyshyn'ar uchun tundu zhana tirichilik kylyshyn'ar uchun kunduzdu bash iidirdi. Zhana zharyk chachkan Kundu, nurun chachkan Aidy zhana Anyn tagdyr buirugu menen silerge karap zhylgan zhyldyzdardy bash iidirdi. Siler alardyn zhardamy menen kurgaktyk zhana den'iz karan'gylyktarynda zhol tabasyn'ar zhana ubakyttardy bilesin'er. Chyndygynda bul bash iidiruudo - akyldaryn ishtetken adamdar uchun Allakhtyn kudurettuuluguno achyk-aikyn dalilder bar. Myna osholor gana myndan emne maksat kylynganyn an'dap bilishet.

Allakh zher betinde zharatkan ar turduu ken bailyktardy, zhanybarlardy, osumduktordu zhana zhashylcha-zhemishterdi silerge bash iidirip koidu. Chyndygynda bul aitylgan zharatuuda zhana moiun sunduruuda nasaat algan adamdar uchun Allakhtyn kudurettuuluguno achyk dalilder bar. Alar Allakh kudurettuu zhana zhakshylyk kyluuchu ekenin an'dap bilishet.

Al Allakh silerge den'izdi bash iidirip, anyn ustundo suzup zhuruugo zhana andagy nerselerdi paidalanuuga mumkunchuluk berdi. Antkeni siler andan zhumshak ettuu balyktardy uulap zheisin'er, bermet syiaktuu asyl tashtardy ozun'or zhana aialdaryn'ar tagynysh uchun den'izden alasyn'ar. Oshondoi ele kemeler den'iz tolkundarynan suzup otkondorun korosun'or. Siler al kemelerge sooda-satyktan tushkon paida syiaktuu Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryna zhetish uchun oturasyn'ar. Siler munu Allakh bergen zhakshylyktarga shugur kyluunu kaalap, Anyn Ozuno gana ibadat kylasyn'ar.

Zher betinde silerdi chaipabash uchun zhana kyimyldatpash uchun any bekem karmagan toolordu ornottu. Zhana siler ozun'or ichip, maldaryn'ardy zhana eginzaryn'ardy sugarysh uchun zher betinde daryialardy agyzdy. Oshondoi ele siler zhurush uchun zholdordu kyldy. Alar menen kozdogon zherin'erge adashpastan zhetesin'er.
Al siler uchun zher betinde achyk belgilerdi kyldy. Siler alarga karap kunduzu zhol zhurosun'or. Zhana Al siler tundosu zhol tabuun'ar uchun asmanda zhyldyzdardy kyldy.

Myna ushul zhana bashka nerselerdi zharatkan menen ech nerseni zharata albagany birdeibi?! Bardyk nerselerdi zharatkan Allakhtyn uluktugun' estebeisin'erbi? Zhalgyz Aga gana syiyngyla zhana ech bir nerseni zharata albagandardy Aga sherik kylbagyla.

Oo, adamdar! Allakhtyn silerge bergen koptogon zhakshylyktaryn eseptei turgan bolson'or, anyn koptugunon zhana ar turduulugunon anyn esebine zhete albaisyn'ar. Chyndygynda Allakh oto Kechirimduu, antkeni Al silerdi shugur kyluunu unutkanyn'ar uchun zhazalagan zhok. Al Yraiymduu, antkeni Al silerdin kylgan kunoolorun'or zhe shugur kyluudagy kemchilikterin'er uchun zhakshylyktaryn berbei koigon zhok.
Ei, pendeler! Allakh silerdin zhashyrgan ishterin'erdi bilet zhana achyk kylgan ishterin'erdi da bilet. Aga ech nerse zhashyruun emes. Al silerge kylgan ishin'erdin syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Al emi mushrikterdin Allakhtan bashka syiyngan kudailary az nerseni da zharata alyshpait. Alardyn Allakhtan bashka syiyngan kudaichalaryn zhasagan da ozdoru. Anan kantip Allakhty tashtap oz koldoru menen zhasagan nerselerine syiynyp zhatyshat?!

Oz koldoru menen zhasashyp alyp ozdoru alarga syiynyshat. Alar ech nerseni bilbegen zhansyz zattar. Alar kyiamat kunu syiynuuchulary menen tozokko birge yrgytyluulary uchun kachan tirilisherin da bilishpeit.

Silerdin chynygy kudaiyn'ar ech bir sherigi zhok bolgon zhalgyz kudai - al Allakh. Al emi akyrette surak uchun kaira tiriluugo ishenbegenderdin zhuroktorundo korkunuch bolbogonu uchun alar Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygynyn chetke kagyshat. Alar surakka da, zhazaga da ishenishpeit. Alar akyikatty kabyl alyshpagan zhana aga moiun sunbagan tekeberler.

Ech sheksiz Allakh alardyn zhashyrgan ishterin bilet zhana achyk kylgan ishterin da bilet. Al uchun alarga syilyk zhe zhazasyn beret. Chyndygynda Allakhka moiun sunup, Aga syiynuudan tekeberlengenderdi zhakshy korboit. Teskerisinche, alardy ushunchalyk zhek korot.

Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygyn chetke kagyp, kaira tiriluunu zhalganga chygargandarga: <<Allakh Mukhammadga emneni tushurdu?>> - dep aitylsa, alar: <<Aga ech nerse tushkon zhok. Chyndygynda al oz oiunan ele murunkulardyn okuialaryn zhana ulamyshtaryn alyp keldi>> - deshet.

Alardyn natyizhasy - ozdorunun kunoolorun toluk kotoruu zhana naadandyktan, sokur eerchuudon ulam Islamdan adashtyrgandardyn da kunoolorun kotoruu boldu. Oz kunoolorun zhana alardy eerchigenderdin da kunoolorun kotoruu kandai zhaman!

Alardan murunku kaapyrlar da paigambarlaryna aila-amaldardy kylyshkan. Kiiin Allakh alardyn turak-zhailaryn ordu tubu menen buzup tashtady, alardyn chatyrlary ustuloruno kulady. Alar kutpogon taraptan alarga azap keldi. Alar turak-zhailary korgoit dep oiloshkon, birok alar menen kosho kyirap zhok boldu.

Andan kiiin Allakh alardy azaptap kordoit. Alarga aitylat: <<Syiynuuda Maga sherik kylgan, alar uchun paigambarlarym zhana yimanduular menen dushmandashkan Maga sherik kylgandaryn'ar kaida?!>>. Oshondo chynygy aalymdar aityshat: <<Chyndygynda kyiamat kunu korduk zhana azap kaapyrlardyn bashyna tushot>>.

Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyshyp ozdoruno zulumduk kylgandardyn zhandaryn olum perishtesi zhana anyn zhardamchy perishteleri alyp zhatkanda alar bashtaryna tushkon olumgo moiun sunushup, birok kaapyrlyktaryn zhana kunoolorun chetke kagyshty. Alar chetke kakkanybyz paida beret dep oiloshtu. Oshondo alarga: <<Siler zhalgan aittyn'ar! Siler buga cheiin kunoolordu kylgan kaapyr elen'er. Chyndygynda Allakh silerdin bul duinodo emne kylganyn'ardy bilet. Aga munun ech biri zhashyruun emes. Al zhakynda silerdi al uchun zhazalait>> - dep aitylat.

Alarga aitylat: <<Kylgan ish-araketterin'erge zharasha tozoktun eshikterinen kirgile! Al zhaida tuboluk kalasyn'ar. Allakhka yiman keltirip, zhalgyz Aga syiynuudan tekeberlengenderdin zhaiy kandai zhaman!>>

Rabbisinin buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkon adamdardan: <<Silerdin paigambaryn'arga Rabbin'er emne tushurdu?>> - dep suralganda, alar: <<Allakh aga uluu zhakshylykty tushurdu>> - deshet. Allakhka talaptagydai ibadat kylyshyp zhana bul duino zhashoosunda adamdar menen zhakshy mamilede bolgondor uchun zhen'ish zhana mol yrysky zh.b. zhakshy syilyktar bar. Al emi Allakhtyn alar uchun akyrette daiardap koigon syilygy - alarga bul duinodo bergeninen da zhakshyraak. Rabbisinin buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandarynan alystagan takybalardyn zhaiy bolgon akyret zhaiy kandai sonun!

Bul alar kirip turuktashyp zhashashkan beiishter! Andagy khan sarailardyn zhana bak-daraktardyn aldylarynan daryialar agyp turat. Alar uchun bul beiishterde kon'uldor samagan tamak-ashtar, suusunduktar zh.b. nerseler bar. Mukhammaddyn ummotundogu takybalarga berilgen myndai syilyk - murunku ummottordun takybalaryna da berilet.

Al mushrikter menen zhalganchylar alarga olum perishtesi zhana anyn zhardamchy perishteleri zhandaryn alysh uchun zhana zhuzdoru menen zhondoruna uruu uchun kelishin, zhe bolboso alar bul duinodo azap menen zhok kylynsyn degen Allakhtyn buirugu kelishin kutup zhatyshaby? Mekkelik mushrikter kylyp zhatyshkan myna ushundai ishti alardan murunku mushrikter da kylyshkan. Oshol sebepten Allakh alardy kyiratyp zhok kyldy. Alardy zhok kylganda Al alarga zulumduk kylgan zhok. Birok alar Allakhka kylgan kaapyrlyktary sebeptuu ozdorun kyiroogo uchuratyp zulumduk kylyshty.
Alardyn kylgan ishterinin zhazasy oz bashtaryna tushtu zhana alarga eskertilgende alar shyldyn'dap kulushkon azap alardy kurchap aldy.

Allakh menen katar bashkalarga syiynyp shirk kylgandar aityshty: <<Egerde Allakh bizdi Ozuno gana syiynuubuzdu zhana Aga shirk kylbashybyzdy kaalaganda, anda biz zhana bizden murunku ata-babalarybyz da Andan bashka ech kimge syiynmak emes. Egerde Al biz bir nerseni aram kylyshybyzdy kaalabaganda, anda biz any aram kylmak emespiz>>. Myna ushundai ele zhalgan doomattardy murunku kaapyrlar da aityshkan. Elchilerge zhetkir dep buirulgan nerselerdi achyk-aikyn zhetkiruu mildeti gana zhuktolgon. Alar any zhetkirishti. Emi kaapyrlar tagdyrdy shyltoolop doomat kyla alyshpait. Antkeni Allakh alarga kaaloo, tandoo berdi zhana alarga paigambarlardy zhiberdi.

Biz murunku ar bir koomgo paigambar zhibergenbiz. Al oz koomun zhalgyz Allakhka syiynuuga zhana Andan bashka aikelder menen shaitandarga syiynuunu tashtoonu buirugan. Alardyn arasynda Allakh iigilik berip Aga yiman keltirgenderi zhana paigambary alyp kelgendi eerchigenderi bar. Zhana alardyn arasynda Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandary zhana paigambarynan bash tartkandary bar. Allakh alarga iigilik berbedi. Andyktan alarga adashuu mildet boldu. Emi zhalganchylardyn bashyna azap zhana kyiroo tushkondon kiiin alardyn akybeti kandai bolgonun oz kozun'or menen korush uchun zher betin kydyrgyla!

Oo, paigambar! Sen alarga kolundan kelishinche daavat kylyp, alardyn tuura zholgo kelishin kaalasan' da zhana anyn sebepterin kylsan' da Allakh Ozu adashtyrgandardy tuura zholgo tushuugo iigilik berbeit zhana alardy azaptan korgogon Allakhtan bashka ech bir zhardamchy bolboit.

Kaira tiriluunu zhalganga chygargandar aga ech kandai dalili zhok ele any zhokko chygaryp: <<Allakh olgondordu kaira tiriltpeit>> - dep basa belgilep, asha chaap kasam ichishti. Zhok! Allakh bardyk olgondordu kaira tiriltet. Anyn ubadasy chyndyk. Birok adamdardyn kopchulugu Allakh oluktordu tirilterin bilishpeit. Alar kaira tiriluunu chetke kagyshat.

Allakhty zhalgyzdoo, kaira tiriluu zhana paigambarlyk tuuraluu alar talashyp tartyshkan nerselerinin chyndygyn korgozush uchun zhana kaapyrlar Allakhtyn sherikteri bar dep aitkan sozdorundo zhana kaira tiriluunu zhokko chygaruuda zhalganchy ekendikterin bilish uchun Allakh kyiamat kunu alardyn baarysyn kaira tiriltet.
Egerde biz oluktordu tiriltuunu kaalasak, anda any kyluudan Bizdi ech kim toktoto albait. Eger biz any kaalasak, anda aga (kun) <<Bol!>> dep gana aitabyz, al oshol zamat sozsuz ishke ashat.

Allakh zholunda kochkondor - myna osholor oz eli korsotkon zyiandarga zhana oz ui-bulosun, mekenin tashtoogo sabyr kylyshkandar. Alar Allakhka moiun sunuuga sabyr kylyshkandar zhana bardyk ishterinde zhalgyz Rabbisine gana taiangandar. Oshol sebepten Allakh alarga ushundai uluu syilykty berdi.

Oo, paigambar! Biz senden murun adamzattan erkek kishilerge gana kabar tushurup alardy paigambar kylyp zhibergenbiz. Al emi perishtelerden paigambar zhibergen emespiz. Bul Bizdin adatta karmangan zholubuz. Egerde munu chetke kaksan'ar, anda murunku Kitep eelerinen suragyla. Alar silerge paigambarlar adamzattan bolgondugun aityshat. Alar perishtelerden bolgon emes, eger siler alardy adamzattan emes dep bilgen bolson'or.
Allakhtyn zholunan tosush uchun aila-amaldardy kylgandar Allakh Karundu zherge zhutturgandai alardy da zherge zhutturuudan zhe alar kutpogon taraptan alarga azap keluusunon kon'uldoru tynchpy?!
Zhe bolboso alar zher kesip zhana tirichilik kylyp zhurushkon uchurda alarga azap keluusunon kon'uldoru tynchpy?! Alar andan korgono da kutula da alyshpait.

Zhalganga chygargan adamdar Anyn zharatkandaryna oi zhugurtuu menen nazar salyshpaiby? Alardyn kolokosu Rabbisine moiun sunup Aga chyndap sazhda kylgan abalda kunduzu kundun zhurushuno, tundosu aidyn zhylyshyna karap on'go, solgo zhylyp zhatpaiby?

Alar daiym kylgan ibadattaryna zhana moiun sungandaryna karabastan Rabbisinen korkushat. Al Oz Zaty, bagyntuusu zhana biiligi menen alardan zhogoru. Oshondoi ele alar Rabbisi buirugan ibadattardy atkaryshat.
Allakh bardyk pendelerine aitty: <<Eki kudai tutup albagyla! Chyndygynda Al zhalgyz chynygy Kudai, Anyn ekinchisi da sherigi da zhok. Menden gana korkkula zhana Menden bashka ech kimden korkpogula>>.

Zharatuuda, biilik kyluuda zhana bashkaruuda asmandar menen zherdegi nerseler zhalgyz Aga gana taandyk. Bash iiuu, zhalbaruu, yklastuuluk zhalgyz Aga gana tiesheluu. Emi siler Allakhtan bashkadan korkup zhatasyn'arby?! Zhok! Andan gana korkkula!

Oo, adamdar! Silerde bolgon dinii zhana duinoluk zhakshylyktardyn baarysy bir Allakhtyn Ozunon. Kiiin silerdin bashyn'arga balee zhe ooru zhe zhakyrlyk tushso, al nerseden kutulush uchun zhalgyz Aga gana duba kylyp zhalbarasyn'ar. Kim zhakshylyktardy berip, zhamandyktardan kutkargan bolso, anda zhalgyz oshogo gana syiynuu mildet.

Anan Al silerdin duban'ardy kabyl kylyp, bashyn'arga tushkon baleeden kutkargandan kiiin silerdin bir tobun'ar Rabbisine shirk kylyp, Any menen katar bashkalarga da syiynyp ketishti. Bul ne degen zhuzu karalyk?!

Alardyn Allakhka kylgan shirkteri - alardy kyiynchylyktan kutkaruu syiaktuu Anyn alarga kylgan zhakshylyktaryn tanuuga turttu. Myna oshonduktan alarga: <<Ertebi-kechpi akyry silerge Allakhtyn azaby kelgenge cheiin berilgen zhakshylyktarga zhyrgai bergile>> - dep aitylat.

Mushrikter Allakhtyn kyzdary bar, alar perishteler dep oiloshot. Oshondoi ele Aga perzentti tan'uulashyp, ozdoruno zhakpagan nerselerdi Aga tiiishtuu kylyshat. Allakh alardyn kylyp zhatkandarynan aruu zhana yiyk. Al emi ozdoruno bolso kon'uldoruno zhakkan uul baldardy arnashat. Myndan da otkon kunoo barby?!

Egerde al mushrikterdin biroosuno kyzduu bolgonu tuuraluu kabar aitylsa, anda ukkan nersesin ushunchalyk zhek korgondugunon zhuzu kararyp, zhurogu kaigy-kapaga tolup ketet. Andan son' ozuno zhakpagan nerseni Allakhka tiiishtuu kylat.

Akyretke yiman keltirbegen kaapyrlarga balaga bolgon muktazhdyk, naadandyk zhana kaapyrlyk syiaktuu en' tomon sypattar taandyk. Al emi Allakhka uluuluk, kemchilsizdik, beimuktazhdyk, ilim syiaktuu maktoogo arzygan biiik sypattar taandyk. Al Oz padyshalygynda Kudurettuu, Aga ech kim ustomduk kyla albait. Al zharatuuda, bashkaruuda zhana okum kyluuda Daanyshman.

Egerde Allakh Taala adamdardy zulumduktary, kaapyrlyktary sebeptuu zhazalai turgan bolso, anda zher betinde kybyr etken adam da zhandyk da kalmak emes. Birok Al Oz iliminde alardy belgiluu ubakytka cheiin kechiktiret. Eger Anyn iliminde belgilengen oshol ubakyt kelse, anda alar any bir az moonotko aldyga da artka da zhyldyra alyshpait.

Alar ozdoruno zhakpagan kyz perzentti Allakhka tan'uulashat zhana alar uchun Allakhtyn aldynda en' zhakshy darazha bar dep tilderi menen zhalgan suiloshot. Eger alar aitkandai kaira tirileri chyndyk bolso, anda alar uchun tozok boloru anyk. Alar al zhaiga tashtalat zhana al zhaktan ech kachan chygyshpait.

Oo, Mukhammad! Allakhka ant, Biz senden murunku koomdorgo da paigambarlardy zhibergenbiz. Birok shaitan alar kylgan shirkti, kaapyrlykty zhana kunoolordu alarga kooz kylyp korgozdu. Alar any kyiamatta bizge koldoo korgozgon koldoochu bolot dep oiloshot. Alar uchun kyiamatta zhan oorutkan azap bar.

Oo, paigambar! Biz saga adamdar talashyp tartyshyp zhatkan Allakhty zhalgyzdoo, kaira tiriluu zhana shariiat okumdoru syiaktuu nerselerdi zhalpy adamdarga tushundurup berishin' uchun gana Kurandy tushurduk. Oshondoi ele Kuran - tuura zhol zhana Allakhka, paigambarlarga, Kurandagy kelgen nerselerge yiman keltirgender uchun yraiymduuluk. Myna osholor gana akyikattan paida alyshat.

Allakh asman taraptan zhamgyr tushurup, al sebeptuu kakyragan kak zherden osumduktordu chygaryp zherge zhan kirgizdi. Chyndygynda zhamgyrdyn asmandan tushuusundo zhana al arkyluu zherden osumduktordu chygaruusunda Allakhtyn sozun ugup, aga oi zhugurtkon adamdar uchun Allakhtyn kudurettuuluguno achyk-aikyn dalilder bar.

Oo, adamdar! Chyndygynda toodo, uida, koido siler uchun ulgu-sabaktar bar. Biz silerdi alardyn kursagyndagy bok-zhini menen kandan turgan zattyn arasynan zhelinderi arkyluu sut chygaryp ichirebiz. Buga karabastan ichkenderge zhagymduu taza, daamduu sut bolup chygat.

Zhana Biz silerge yrysky kylyp bergen kurmanyn zhana zhuzumdun momolorundo da siler uchun ulgu-sabaktar bar. Siler alardan adamdyn akylyn mas kylgan sharaptardy chygarasyn'ar. Bul zhakshy emes. Oshondoi ele alardan kurma, meiiz, sirke, koiuu shirelerdi chygaryp paidalanasyn'ar. Chyndygynda bul aitylgandarda Allakhtyn kudurettuuluguno zhana pendelerine kylgan zhakshylyktaryna akyl zhugurtkon adamdar uchun dalilder bar. Myna osholor myndan sabak alyshat.
Oo, paigambar! Rabbin' bal aaryga zhol korgozup aga myndai dep ilkham kyldy: <<Uian'dy toolorgo sal, bak-daraktarga sal zhana adamdar zhapkan kurulushtarga sal.

Andan kiiin ozun' kaalagan momolordon zhegin zhana Rabbin' saga bash iidirip ilkham kylgan zholdor menen zhurgun>>. Myna oshol bal aarynyn ichinen ak, sary zh.b. turduu tustogu baldar chygat. Anda adamdar uchun shypaa bar. Alar any menen oorularynan darylanyshat. Chyndygynda bal aaryga kylyngan ilkhamda zhana anyn ichinen chykkan balda Allakhtyn kudurettuulugu zhana Al zharatkandarynyn ishterin bashkaruusu tuuraluu oi zhugurtkon adamdar uchun dalilder bar. Myna osholor myndan sabak alyshat.

Allakh silerdi murda bolbogondoi korunushto zharatty. Kiiin azhalyn'ar kelgende silerdi olturot. Silerdin aran'arda omurdun en' zhaman baskychy bolgon karylykka zhetip kop zhashagandar bar. Al murda bilgenderinin da unutup kalat. Chyndygynda Allakh Biluuchu, Aga pendelerinin kylgan ishterinin biri da zhashyruun emes. Al Kudurettuu, Any ech nerse alsyrata albait.

Allakh Taala silerge bergen yryskyda birin'erdi bashkan'ardan artyk kylyp, silerdin aran'arda bai zhana kedeilerdi, bashchy zhana bash iiuuchulordu kyldy. Al emi Allakh kop yrysky berip artyk kylgandary mal-mulkto kuldary menen ten' ata bolup alar menen sheriktesh bolobuz dep Allakhtyn alarga bergen nerselerin zhokko chygaryshpait. Egerde alar ozdoruno kuldary ten' ata bolup sherik boluusun kaalashpasa, anda nege Allakhka kuldaryn Aga sherik kyluunu kaalap zhatyshat? Bul emne degen zulumduk! Myndan da otkon Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryn zhokko chygaruu barby?!

Oo, adamdar! Allakh silerge ynak bolsun dep ozun'ordon zhubailardy zharatty zhana zhubailaryn'ardan baldardy, neberelerdi zharatty. Silerge et, dan azyktary, momo-zhemishter syiaktuu adal tamak-ashtardy yrysky kyldy. Emi alar zhalgan kudailarga zhana aikelderge yiman keltirip zhatyshaby?! Sanasa sanak zhetpegen Allakhtyn koptogon zhakshylyktaryn zhokko chygaryp, zhalgyz Aga yiman keltirip shugur kylyshpai zhataby?!

Al mushrikter Allakhtan bashka kudailarga syiynyshat. Alar bolso asmandar menen zherden alarga ech kandai yrysky bere alyshpait zhana alarga eelik da kylyshpait. Antkeni alar ech nerseni bilbegen zhansyz zattar.

Ei, adamdar! Silerge paida da zyian da bere albagan bul aikelderdi Allakhka okshotpogula! Syiynuuda Aga sherik kyla turgandai Anyn ech kandai okshoshu zhok. Chyndygynda Allakh Ozuno tiiishtuu uluktuk zhana kemchiliksiz sypattardy bilet. Siler any bilbeisin'er. Oshonduktan Any ozun'ordun kudailaryn'arga okshoshturup Aga shirk kylyp atasyn'ar.

Allakh mushrikterge zhoop kylyp misal keltiret - ech nerse kyla albagan, sadaka kylganga ech nersesi zhok alsyz kul zhana Biz Oz aldybyzdan adal bailyk berip, al andan ozu kaalagandai achyk da zhashyruun sarptagan erkin adam ekoosu biri-birine ten' emes. Siler Oz mulkun Ozu kaalagandai sarptap bashkargan Allakh menen alsyz kudailaryn'ardy kantip ten'ep zhatasyn'ar?! Allakh Ozu gana maktoolorgo tatyktuu. Birok mushrikterdin kopchulugu kudai boluuga zhana syiynyluuga zhalgyz Allakh Ozu gana tatyktuu ekendigin bilishpeit.

Allakh alarga zhoop kylyp eki adam tuuraluu dagy bir misaldy keltirdi - alardyn biroosu duduk-duloi, al duduktugu sebeptuu suiloboit, duloilugu sebeptuu ukpait, sozgo tushunboit. Ozuno da bashkaga da paida bere albait. Any bakkan ui-bulosu uchun al oor tuishuk. Any kaida zhiberse da zhakshylyk alyp kelbeit, kozdogon maksatty ishke ashyrbait. Emi ushundai adam menen kulagy ukkan, suilogon, ashykcha paida keltirgen, adamdardy adilettikke buirugan, tabiiaty tuz zhana ech kandai burmalanbagan tuura zholdogu adam ten' bolobu? Ei, mushrikter! Siler uluktuk zhana kemchiliksiz sypattarga ee bolgon Allakhka ozun'ordun ukpagan, suilobogon, paida keltirbegen, zyiandan kutkarbagan kudailaryn'ardy kantip ten'ep zhatasyn'ar?!

Asmandardagy zhana zherdegi kaiyp nerselerdin ilimi zhalgyz Allakhka gana taandyk. Any zheke Ozu gana bilet, zharatylgandardan ech kimisi bilbeit. Al emi Ozuno gana tiiishtuu kaiyptardan bolgon kyiamattyn tez bolushun Al kaalai turgan bolso, anda koz achyp zhumgucha ele keltirip koiot, balkim andan da tezireek bolot. Chyndygynda Allakh bardyk nersege kudurettuu, Any ech kim alsyra albait. Egerde al bir ishti kaalasa, anda (kun) <<Bol!>> dep gana aitat, al oshol zamat bolot.

Oo, adamdar! Torot ubagy kelgende Allakh silerdi enen'erdin kursagynan ech nerseni bilbegen ymyrkai abalda chygardy zhana silerge ugush uchun kulak, korush uchun koz zhana akyl zhugurtush uchun zhuroktordu berdi. Balkim Al silerge bergen zhakshylyktarga shugur kylarsyn'ar.

Mushrikter abada kalkyp zhen'il uchkan kushtarga nazar salyshpaiby? Allakh alarga kanattardy berdi zhana abany zhumshak kyldy. Oshondoi ele alarga kanattaryn zhazyp, kaira zhyinoonu ilkham kyldy. Alardy kudurettuu Allakh gana zherge tushurboi abada karmait. Chyndygynda bul moiun sunduruuda zhana tushurboi karmoodo Allakhka yiman keltirgen adamdar uchun belgiler bar. Antkeni alar gana belgilerden zhana sabaktardan paida alyshat.

Allakh taala siler tashtardan zhana bashka nerselerden kurgan uilorun'ordu siler uchun es aluu zhana turak-zhai kyldy. Zhana silerge shaardagy uilorgo okshosh kylyp toonun, uidun, koidun terilerinen choldordo chatyrlardy kyldy. Bir zherden ekinchi zherge kochkon saparlaryn'arda alardy tashuunu zhana kongondo any ornotuunu zhen'il kyldy. Oshondoi ele belgiluu bir ubakka cheiin paidalanuun'ar uchun koidun, toonun, echkinin zhundorunon uilorun'orgo kerektuu buiumdardy, kiiimderdi, zhamynchylardy kyldy.

Allakh silerge ysykta kolokolonush uchun bak-daraktardy, turak-zhailardy kyldy zhana silerge suuktan, ysyktan, dushmandan korgonush uchun toolorgo unkurlordu kyldy. Oshondoi ele ysyk-suuktan saktanysh uchun silerge kebezden zh.b. nerselerden kiiim-kechekterdi kyldy zhana sogushta biri-birin'erdin sokkun'ardan korgonush uchun silerdi korgogon soot kiiimderdi kyldy. Alar arkyluu kural denen'erge teship kire albait. Oshondoi ele Allakh silerge zhogorudagy zhakshylyktardy bergen syiaktuu ele siler zhalgyz Aga moiun sunup, Aga ech bir nerseni sherik kylbashyn'ardy kaalap Al silerge zhakshylyktaryn toluk kylyp beret.

Oo, paigambar! Egerde alar sen alyp kelgen nersege yiman keltiruudon zhana ishenuudon bash tartyshsa, anda senin mildetin' saga buirulgan nerseni gana achyk-aikyn kylyp zhetkiruu. Al emi alardy tuura zholgo saluu senin mildetin' emes.

Mushrikter Allakhtyn alarga bergen zhakshylyktaryn bilishet. Alarga paigambardy zhiberuu da oshol zhakshylyktardan. Kiiin alar uchun shugur kylyshpai, paigambardy zhalganga chygaryshyp zhakshylyktardy tanyshat. Alardyn kopchulugu Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryn tangandar.

Oo, paigambar! Allakh ar bir ummotton alarga zhiberilgen elchini kaira tiriltip, al musulmandyn yimanyna zhana kaapyrdyn kaapyrlygyna kubogo oto turgan kundu estegin. Oshondon kiiin kaapyrlarga alardyn kylgan kaapyrlygy uchun kechirim suroogo uruksat berilbeit zhana alar Rabbisin yraazy kylgan ishterdi kylysh uchun bul duinogo da kaityshpait. Akyret - ibadat kyluu zhaiy emes, surak beruu zhaiy.
Zulumduk kylgan mushrikter azapty korushkondo alarga azap zhen'ildetilbeit zhana al kechiktirilip alarga moonot da berilbeit. Teskerisinche, alar tuboluk azapka kirishet.

Mushrikter Allakhka sherik kylyp syiyngan kudailaryn akyrette korushkondo aityshat: <<Oo, Rabbibiz! Myna ushular Senden bashka syiyngan kudailarybyz>>. Alar munu kunoolorun alarga artysh uchun aityshat. Oshondo Allakh alardyn kudailaryn tilge keltirip, alar aityshat: <<Ei, mushrikter! Chyndygynda siler Allakh menen katar syiyngan sherikterde anyk zhalganchysyn'ar. Any menen katar syiynylgan ech kandai sherik zhok>>.
Mushrikter boi sunushup, zhalgyz Allakhka gana bash iiip kalyshat. Al emi Allakhtyn aldynda shapaat kylyshat degen oido talashyp zhurushkon kudailary bolso alardy tashtap ketishet.

Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyshyp, bashkalardy Allakhtyn zholunan burgan adamdardyn azabyna azap koshobuz. Alar kaapyrlyktary uchun aga tatyktuu bolushtu. Sebebi alar ozdoru buzulushtu zhana bashkalardy adashtyruu menen buzushtu.

Oo, paigambar! Biz ar bir ummotton paigambardy kaira tiriltip, al alardyn kaapyrlygyna zhe yimanyna kubogo oto turgan kundu estegin. Oshol paigambar alardyn ozdorunon zhana osholordun tilinde suiloit. Ei, paigambar! Biz seni bardyk ummottorgo kubo katary alyp keldik. Biz saga adal-aram, syilyk-zhaza zh.b. tushunduruusu zaryl bolgon bardyk nerselerdi baiandoo uchun Kurandy tushurduk. Biz any adamdardy akyikatka bagyttash uchun, aga yiman keltirip, andagy aitylgandardy atkargandarga yraiym bolush uchun zhana tuboluk zhyrgalchylykty kutushup Allakhka yiman keltirgenderge suiunchu kabar kylyp tushurduk.

Chyndygynda Allakh pendelerin adilettuulukko, Allakhtyn zhana adamdardyn aldyndagy mildetterin atkaruuga zhana okum chygaruuda birin ekinchisinen artyk korbogongo buirudu. Birok artyk koruunu talap kylganga ukuktuu bolgon abalda gana uruksat. Oshondoi ele pendege mildet bolbogon zhakshylyk ishterdi kyluuga buirudu, misaly, oz yktyiary menen sadaka kyluu, zulum kylgandy kechiruu, zhakyn tuugandarga muktazh bolgon nerselerin beruugo buiruu, bardyk zhaman sozdordon zhana zyna syiaktuu zhaman ishterden tyiuu, shariiat zhaman korgon bardyk kunoolordon tyiuu, adamdarga tekeberlik zhana zulumduk kyluudan tyiuu. Allakh bul aiatta silerge buirugan zhana tyigan nerselerdi atkaruunu osuiat kylat. Balkim Anyn kylgan okuiatynan sabak alarsyn'ar.

Allakhka zhe adamdarga bergen bardyk ubadan'ardy atkargyla! Allakhtyn aty menen kasam ichip bergen bekem anttaryn'ardy buzbagyla! Siler atkaram dep kasam ichip Allakhty ozun'orgo kubo kylgansyn'ar. Chyndygynda Allakh silerdin kylyp zhatkanyn'ardy bilet. Aga ech bir nerse zhashyruun emes. Al zhakynda silerge syilygyn'ardy zhe zhazan'ardy beret.

Zhen'il oiluu kem akyl adamdardai ubadalaryn buzgandardan bolbogula! Bul akylsyz aialga okshobogula - al zhundu zhe kebezdi iirigenden tazhap, bekem iirigenden kiiin murunkudai kylyp kaira any chechip chubap saldy. Al iirigenden da chubagandan da charchady, kozdogon oi-maksatyna da zhetpedi. Silerdin ummotun'or dushmandaryn'ardan kop zhana kubattuu bolush uchun siler antyn'ardy biri-birin'erdi aldagan kuralga ailantyp aldyn'ar. Allakh silerdi ubadalaryna bek beken dep synap zhatat. Siler any atkarasyn'arby zhe buzasyn'arby? Kyiamatta Allakh silerdin bul duinodo talashyp tartyshkanyn'ardy sozsuz achyk aityp beret. Oshondo akyikatchyl adamdy zhalganga chygargan adamdan, chynchyldy zhalganchydan aiyrmalap beret.

Egerde Allakh kaalasa baaryn'ardy akyikatty karmangan bir ummot kylyp koimok. Birok Allakh Oz adilettigi menen kimin'erdi kaalasa akyikatta zhana ubadalardy atkaruuda zhardamsyz kaltyryp adashtyrat zhana Oz aikoldugu menen kimge kaalasa iigilik beret. Siler kyiamatta bul duinodo kylgan ishterin'er uchun sozsuz suralasyn'ar.

Oz kaaloon'ordu eerchip antyn'ardy kaalaganda atkaryp, kaalaganda buzup any biri-birin'erdi aldagan kuralga ailantyp albagyla! Egerde siler oshondoi kyla turgan bolson'or, anda akyikat zholdo bekem tursan'ar da al zholdon taiyp ketesin'er. Ozun'or adashyp zhana bashkalardy adashtyrganyn'ar sebeptuu azaptyn daamyn tatasyn'ar. Siler uchun eselegen azaptar bolot.

Siler Allakhka berilgen ubadany buzup arzybagan nersege almashtyryp zhiberbegile! Chyndygynda bul duinodogu Allakhtyn aldyndagy zhen'ish, olzholor zhana akyrettegi Anyn aldyndagy tuboluk zhyrgalchylyk - arzybagan nerse uchun ubadany buzup zhetkenin'erge karaganda zhakshyraak, eger munu bilgen bolson'or.

Ei, adamdar! Silerdin aldyn'ardagy mal-mulktor, yrakhat-zhyrgalchylyktar kanchalyk kop bolso dagy akyry tugonot. Al emi Allakhtyn aldyndagy syilyktar tuboluktuu. Siler ubaktyluu nerseni tuboluktuudon kantip artyk korup zhatasyn'ar? Ubadalaryn buzbai aga bekem bolup sabyr kylgandardyn sooptorun kylgan ibadattarynan da zhakshyraak kylyp berebiz. Zhakshylyktyn syilygyn on eseden zheti zhuz esege cheiin zhe andan da eselep koboitup berebiz.

Erkek bolobu zhe aial bolobu, al Allakhka yiman keltirip, shariiatka tuura kelgendei zhakshy ishterdi kylsa, anda Biz any bul duino zhashoosunda Allakhtyn tagdyryna yraazy bolup, kaniettuuluk kylyp, ibadattarga iigilik beruu menen sozsuz zhakshy zhashatabyz zhana akyrette alardyn sooptorun bul duinodo kylgan zhakshy ishterinin soobunan da artyk kylyp berebiz.
Oo, musulman! Egerde sen Kuran okuunu kaalasan', anda Allakhtyn yraiymynan kuulgan shaitandyn azgyryktarynan seni korgoosun sura!
Allakhka yiman keltirip, bardyk ishterinde zhalgyz Aga gana taiangandardyn ustunon shaitan bashkara albait.
Bir gana any dos tutup, aga azgyrylgandardy zhana anyn azgyrygy sebeptuu Allakhka sherik koshup, Any menen katar bashkalarga syiyngandardy gana azgyrygy menen bashkarat.

Egerde Biz bir aiattyn okumun ochurup anyn orduna bashka bir aiatty alyp kelsek, alar: <<Ei, Mukhammad! Albette sen zhalganchysyn'. Allakhtyn atynan zhalgandy oilop taap zhatasyn'>> - dep aityshat. Alardyn kopchulugu ozgortulgon okumdun artynda Allakhtyn syry bar ekendiginin bilishpeit. Allakh kandai maksatta Kurandan kaisy okumdu ochuruunu zhe ochurboshtu Ozu zhakshy Biluuchu.

Oo, paigambar! Alarga ait: <<Ech kandai katasy, ozgoruusu zhana burmalanuusu zhok bul Kuran menen Zhebreil perishte Allakhtyn aldynan akyikat menen tushtu. Any Allakhka yiman keltirgendin yimanyn bekemdesh uchun tushurdu. Andan zhan'y nerse tushkon saiyn, anyn kee bir okumdoru ochurulgon saiyn yimandary bekemdeit. Oshondoi ele alardy akyikatka bagyttap, musulmandar zhete turgan uluu sooptordu suiunchulosh uchun tushurdu>>.

Biz mushrikterdin: <<Chyndygynda Mukhammadga Kurandy bir adam ele uirotup zhatat>> -- dep zhatyshkanyn bilebiz. Alardyn bul aitkandary zhalgan. Alar uirotup zhatat dep oiloshkon adam tili bolok adam. Al emi bul Kuran zhogorku adabii taza arab tilinde tushkon. Alar kantip any tili bolok adamdan uirondu dep aityp zhatyshat?

Allakhtyn aiattary Al taraptan tushkon dep yiman keltirbegender bul zholdon kaityshmaiyncha Allakh alarga tuura zholgo tushuugo iigilik berbeit. Alar Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyp, Anyn aiattaryn zhalganga chygargandary sebeptuu alarga zhan oorutkan azaptar bar.

Mukhammad Rabbisi taraptan alyp kelgen nersede zhalganchy emes. Chyndygynda al zhalgandy Allakhtyn aiattaryna ishenbegender gana oilop taap zhatyshat. Antkeni alar azaptan korkushpait zhana soop da umut kylyshpait. Myna oshol kaapyrlyk menen sypattalgandar ozdoru zhalganchylar. Antkeni zhalgan aituu alardyn kongon adaty bolup kalgan.

Kimde-kim yimanga kelgenden kiiin Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyp, kokurogun kaapyrlykka kenen achyp koiso, any yimandan artyk korup tandasa, aga bash iiip kaapyrlyk sozun suiloso, anda al Islamdan chygat. Alarga Allakhtyn kaary bolot zhana alar uchun chon' azap bar. Al emi kaapyrlyk kyluuga mazhbur kylynyp, tili menen kaapyrlyk sozun suiloso, birok zhurogundo yimandyn akyikatyna shektenbei beikut bolgondor kunookor bolushpait.

Oshol Islam dininen chyguunun sebebi -- alar kaapyrlyktary uchun syilyk katary alyshkan arzybagan duinonu akyretten artyk korushtu. Al emi Allakh kaapyr koomgo yimanga keluugo iigilik berbeit. Teskerisinche, alardy zhardamsyz tashtait.

Yimanga kelip kaira dinden kaityp ketkender -- Allakh zhuroktoruno moor baskandar. Alar nasaattardy tushunushpoit. Alardyn kulaktaryna da moor basylgan, alar nasaattardy ugup paida alyshpait. Alardyn kozdoruno da moor basylgan, alar yimandy bildirgen aiat-belgilerge koz salyshpait. Myna osholor baktyluuluk menen baktysyzdyktyn sebepterinen zhana Allakhtyn alarga daiardagan azabynan beikapar zhurgondor.

Ech sheksiz alar kyiamat kunu zyianga uchuragandar. Alar yimanga kelgenden kiiin kaapyrlyk kylyshyp ozdorun kyiroogo uchuratyshty. Egerde alar yimandy bekem karmanyshkanda, anda sozsuz beiishke kirishmek.

Oo, paigambar! Senin Rabbin' yimanduulardyn alsyzdaryna oto Kechirimduu, Yraiymduu. Mushrikter alardy dini uchun azaptap, korduk korsotushkondo alar kaapyrlyk sozun aityshka argasyz bolushtu, birok zhuroktorundogu yimany ozgorgon zhok. Oshondon kiiin alar Mekkeden Medinaga kochushtu. Kiiin Allakhtyn sozu biiik bolush uchun, al emi kaapyrlardyn sozu tomon bolush uchun Anyn zholunda sogushushtu zhana andagy kyiynchylyktarga sabyr kylyshty. Chyndygynda Rabbin' alar kabylgan oshol synoolordon zhana azaptoolordon kiiin argalary kalbai kaapyrlyk sozdu aityshsa da Al alarga Kechirimduu, alarga Yraiymduu. Antkeni alar kaapyrlyk sozdu argasyzdan gana aituuga mazhbur bolushtu.

Oo, paigambar! Al zherdin ushunchalyk kyiynchylygy sebeptuu ar bir adam bashkalardy unutup, ozunun gana talamyn talashyp kalgan kundu estegin. Ar bir adamga kylgan zhakshylyk-zhamandygy uchun syigyly zhe zhazasy toluk berilet. Alardyn zhakshylyktary kemitilip zhe kunooloru koboitulup zulumduk kylynbait.

Allakh Mekke shaaryn misal kyldy. Al shaardyn turgundary korkunuchtan koopsuz zhana tynch ele. Oshol ele uchurda anyn ailanasyndagy adamdar talanyp tonoluuda bolchu. Al shaardyn yryskysy but taraptan on'oi zholdo kelip turchu. Kiiin anyn zhashoochulary Allakhtyn alarga bergen zhakshylyktaryn tanyshyp, Aga shugur kylyshpady. Oshondo Allakh alardy achkachylyk zhana zhuzdorunon ele bilingen katuu korkunuch menen zhazalady. Bul nerse alardyn kaapyrlyk kylgandary zhana zhalganga chygargandary sebeptuu alardyn kiiimi syiaktuu ele bolup kaldy.

Mekkenin eline ozdorunon ele bolgon paigambar keldi. Alar any amanatkoi zhana chynchyl dep bilishchi. Al - Mukhammad ele. Alar Rabbisi taraptan aga tushkon nerseni zhalganga chygaryshkanda alarga achkachylyk, korkunuch syiaktuu Allakhtyn azaby tushtu. Alar Allakhka shirk kylyp, Anyn paigambaryn zhalganga chygaryshyp ozdorun kyiroogo duushar kylyp zalym bolushtu.

Oo, pendeler! Allakh silerge yrysky kylyp bergen zhegenge zhagymduu adal nerselerden zhegile! Zhana Allakh silerge bergen zhakshylyktardy tanbastan moiunga alyp Aga shugur kylgyla! Egerde Aga shirk kylbai zhalgyz Aga gana syiyngan bolson'or, anda al zhakshylyktardy Al yraazy bolgon zholdorgo sarptagyla!

Allakh silerge adaldap soiulbastan olgon maldy, akkan kandy, chochkonun but mucholorun, Allakhtan bashkaga zhakyndash maksatta kurmandykka chalyngan maldyn etin aram kyldy. Bul aram kyluu - yktyiary bar bolgon abalga gana tiiishtuu. Al emi kim ushul aitylgandardy argasyz zhegenge mazhbur bolup, al aramga kon'ulu tartpai, birok zaryldyk chekte gana zhegen bolso, anda al kunookor emes. Chyndygynda Allakh Kechirimduu, Al anyn zhegenin kechiret. Al aga Yraiymduu, antkeni argasyz abalda any zheshke uruksat berdi.

Ei, mushrikter! Allakhka zhalgan zhalaa zhabysh maksatta <<Bul nerse adal, bul nerse aram>> - dep adaldy aram kylyp zhe aramdy adal kylyp Allakhka karata tilin'erden chykkan zhalgandy aitpagyla! Chyndygynda Allakhka zhalgan zhalaa zhapkandar kozdogon oi-maksattaryna zhetishpeit zhana korkkon nerselerinen da kutulushpait.
Alar oz kaaloolorun eerchip ketishkendigi sebeptuu bul duinodo alarga arzybagan gana nerseler bar. Al emi kyiamatta alar uchun zhan oorutkan azaptar bar.

Murda Biz iakhudiilerge, saga (Kuranda) aitkan nerselerdi aram kylgan elek. Biz alarga zulumduk kylbadyk. Birok ozdoruno-ozdoruzulumduk kylyshty.
Biz saga (An'aam suroosunun 146-aiatynda) aityp otkon nerselerdi airykcha zhoottorgo aram kyldyk. Biz munu aram kyluu menen alarga zulumduk kylgan zhokpuz. Birok alar zhazaga tatyktuu sebepterdi kylyp ozdoruno-ozdoru zulumduk kylyshty. Anan Biz alardy chekten chykkandygy uchun zhazalap, alardyn zhazasy katary oshol nerselerdi alarga aram kyldyk.

Oo, paigambar! Andan son' senin Rabbin' - arty emne menen butorun bilbesten ataiylap kunoo kylyshsa da, birok kiiin oshol kylgan kunooloru uchun Allakhka toobo kylyshyp, buzukuluk aralashkan ishterin on'dogon adamdarga - albette Rabbin' alar toobo kylyshkandan kiiin alardyn kunoolorun Kechiruuchu, alarga Yraiymduu.

Mushrikter ozdorun Ibrakhimdin dinindebiz dep oiloshkon kezde Allakh alardyn aitkandaryna zhoop kylyp myndai dedi:
Chyndygynda Ibrakhim paigambar asyl sypattarga ee, Rabbisine daiym ibadat kylgan, bardyk dinderdi tashtap Islam dinine gana kaitkan adam ele zhana al ech kachan mushrikterden bolgon emes.
Allakh aga bergen zhakshylyktarga daiym shugur kylat ele. Oshonduktan Allakh any paigambarlykka tandady zhana akyikat Islam dinine bagyttady.
Biz aga bul duinodo paigambarlyk, alkysh-maktoo zhana takyba penzent berdik. Zhana al akyrette Allakh beiishtegi biiik darazhalardy daiardap koigon zhakshy adamdardyn katarynda bolot.

Oo, paigambar! Andan son' Biz saga kabar tushurduk: <<Zhalgyz Allakhka syiynuuda, mushrikterden bash tartuuda, Allakhtyn zholuna chakyruuda zhana bardyk dinderden Islam dinine kaityp Anyn shariiatyn atkaruuda Ibrakhimdin dinin eerchigin. Antkeni al kee bir mushrikter oilogondoi ech kachan mushrikterden bolgon emes. Teskerisinche, Al zhalgyz Allakhka gana syiyngan>>.

Ishenbi kun tuuraluu talashyp tartyshkan zhoottorgo al kunu bardyk tirichilikterin tashtap any uluktoo parz kylyndy. Buga cheiin alar zhuma kunu tirichilikterin tashtoogo buirulushkan ele, birok alar adashyp ketishti. Ei, paigambar! Chyndygynda Rabbin' kyiamat kunu oshol talashyp tartyshkandardyn talashy tuuraluu okum kylat. Oshondo alardyn ar biri ozuno tatyktuu zhazasyn alat.

Oo, paigambar! Sen zhana seni eerchigen yimanduular adamdardy Islam dinine daavat kylganda alardyn abalyna, tushunuguno, kyzyguusuna karap zhana korkutuu zhe kyzyktyruu menen nasaat aityp chakyrgyla. Alar menen en' zhakshy soz, oi-pikir zhana adepke tuura kelgen zholdo talash zhurguz. Birok adamdardy tuura zholgo salysh senin kolun'da emes. Senin mildetin' alarga zhetkiruu gana. Chyndygynda Rabbin' Islam dininen adashkandardy zhana tuura zholgo tushkondordu en' zhakshy bilet. Andyktan alardy korup zhanyn'dy keiitpe.

Egerde dushmanyn'ardy zhazaloonu kaalasan'ar, anda alar silerge kylgan zyiandan ashyrbastan zhazalagyla! Egerde zhazalaganga kuchun'or zhetip turup alardy zhazalabai sabyr kylsan'ar, anda alardy adilettik menen zhazaloon'orgo karaganda sabyrduuluk kylganyn'ar zhakshyraak.

Oo, paigambar! Alardyn saga bergen zyiandaryna sabyr kyl! Senin sabyr kyluuga bolgon iigiligin' - Allakhtyn saga bergen iigiligine gana bailanyshtuu. Kaapyrlardyn senden zhuz burushkanyna kapalanba zhana alardyn saga kylgan aila-amaldary sebeptuu zhurogun' kysylbasyn!

Albette Allakh kunoolordu tashtap Andan korkkondor menen birge zhana oshondoi ele ibadattardy kylyp, buirulgan nerselerdi atkaryp zhakshylyk kylgandar menen birge. Al Oz zhen'ishi zhana koldoosu menen daiym alar menen birge.

Allakh Ozunon bashka ech kimdin kudureti zhetpegen kudureti sebeptuu uluk zhana aruu boldu. Allakh Ozunun kulu Mukhammaddy Allakh Taalanyn kuduretine dalil bolgon kee bir belgileribizdi korush uchun tundun bir bolugundo al oigoo abalda denesi zhana rukhu menen Al'-Kharam mechitinen ailanasy paigambarlardyn ordulary zhana momo-zhemishter menen berekeluu bolgon Baitul-Makdis mechitine alyp bardyk. Chyndygynda Al Uguuchu zhana ugulgan undordun ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Al Koruuchu zhana korungon nerselerdin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.

Biz Musaga Tooratty berdik zhana any Israil urpaktaryna tuura zholdu korgozuuchu kyldyk. Biz Israil urpaktaryna aittyk: "Siler ozun'ordun ishin'erdi tapshyrgan Menden bashka koldoochu kylyp albagyla. Teskerisinche zhalgyz Maga taiangyla".

Siler Biz Nukh menen kosho topon suuga chogup ketuudon kutkaryp zhakshylyk kylgandardyn urpaktarysyn'ar. Bul zhakshylykty estep zhurgulo! Zhalgyz Allakhka bash iiip zhana syiynyp shugur kylgyla. Bul nersede Nukhtu eerchigile. Chyndygynda al Allakh Taalaga kop-kop shugur kyluuchu bolgon.

Biz Israil urpaktaryna aian kylyp, chyndygynda alar kunoo kylyp zhana akyikatty chetke kagyp zherde sozsuz eki zholu buzukuluk kylysharyn Tooratta bildirdik. Alar adamdarga zulumduk zhana dushmandyk kylyshyp, adamdardyn ustunon ozdorun biiik korushup, alarga bolgon tekeberdiktin cheginen ashyshat.

Alardan birinchi buzukuluk bolgondo, alardyn ustunon Bizdin kuchtuu zhana kaarduu pendeleribizdi bashkartyp koiduk, alardy olturup kuuguntuktady. Zhashagan zhailaryn kydyryshyp, bargan zherlerin buzushtu. Bul nersege Allakhtyn ubadasy bolgon, al sozsuz ishke ashat.

Ei, Israil urpaktary! Andan kiiin siler Allakhka toobo kylganyn'arda, silerdi bashkargandardyn ustunon zhen'ishke zhetkirip, silerge mamleketin'erdi kaitardyk. Mal-mulkun'ordu tartyp, baldaryn'ardy kul kylyp algandan kiiin silerge zhardam berdik. Oshondoi ele sanyn'ardy dushmanyn'ardan da kop kylyp koiduk.

Oo, Israil urpaktary! Egerde siler ishterin'erdi zhakshy kylyp, talaptagydai atkarsan'ar, anda syilygy ozun'orgo ele kaitat. Allakh silerdin ishin'erge muktazh emes. A eger ishin'erdi zhaman kylsan'ar, anyn akybeti ozun'orgo zyian. Kylgan zhakshy ishin'er Allakhka paida berbeit, zhaman ishin'er zyian berbeit. Egerde ekinchi zholu dagy buzukuluk kyla turgan bolson'or, silerdi dushmanyn'ardyn koluna salyp berebiz. Alar silerge korduk korsotot zhana silerge korsotkon turduu korduktardan ulam kyinalganyn'ar zhuzun'orgo chygat. Oshondoi ele alar Baitul-Makdiske kiriship, any birinchi zholkusunda talkalashkandai bul iret da talkalashat zhana alar bagyntkan zherlerdin baarysyn kyiratyp zhok kylyshat.

Oo, Israil urpaktary! Egerde Allakhtyn bul katuu och aluusunan kiiin Aga toobo kylsan'ar zhana zhakshy ishterdi atkarsan'ar, balkim Rabbin'er silerge yraiym kylar. A eger buzukulukka uchunchu zholu zhe andan da kop kaita turgan bolson'or, anda kairadan silerden och alabyz zhana tozoktu kaapyrlar uchun zhatak kylabyz. Alar andan ech kachan kutula alyshpait.

Chyndygynda Mukhammadga tushkon bul Kuran zholdordun en' zhakshysyn korgozot zhana al Islam zholu. Oshondoi ele zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgan yimanduulardy suiunuchko salgan Allakh taraptan bolo turgan uluu sooptordu kabarlait.
Zhana kyiamat kununo yiman keltirbegenderge zhamandykty kabarlait. Al nerse - Biz alar uchun kyiamat kunu daiardap koigon kyinoochu azap.

Adam ozuno zhakshylyk tilep duba kylgan syiaktuu achuulanganda da bilbestikten ozuno, baldaryna zhana mal-mulkuno zhamandyk tilep duba kylat. Egerde Biz anyn kylgan zhaman tilegin kabyl kylganda, al bala-chakasy zhana mal-mulku menen kosho kyirap zhok bolmok. Adam balasy tabiiatynan shashkalak. Oshonduktan al ozuno zyian bergen nersege shashat.

Tundu zhana kunduzdu Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygyna zhana Anyn kudurettuuluguno dalil-belgi kylyp zharattyk. Al ekoonun uzun-kyskalygynda, ysyk-suugunda aiyrmachylyk bar. Tundu es alyp uktoo uchun karan'gy kyldyk. Kunduzdu adamdar koruusu zhana tirichilik kyluusu uchun zharattyk. Oshondoi ele kun menen tundu baikoo arkyluu zhyldardyn sanyn zhana alarga kerek bolgon ailardyn, kundordun zhana saattardyn ubaktylaryn biluu uchun zharattyk. Bardyk nerseler biri-birinen, akyikat zholdogular zhalgan zholdogulardan aiyrmalanuusu uchun Biz ar bir nerseni achyk-aikyn baiandadyk.

Ar bir adamdyn kylgan ishteri moiunga tagylgan chynzhyrdai any daiym koshtop zhurot. Kylgan ishterinen esep-kysap kylynmaiyncha andan azhyrabait. Kyiamat kunu al kylgan bardyk zhakshylyk zhana zhamandyk ishterin kamtygan kitepti aga chygaryp berebiz, al anyn bet aldynda zhaiylyp achylyp turganyn korot.
Oshol kunu aga aitabyz: "Ei, adam! Kitebin'di oku! Sen oz suragyn'dy ish-araketterin'e tapshyr. Kyiamatta senden surak aluuga ozun' zhetishtuusun'.

Kim yiman zholuna tushso, anda anyn tuura zholgo tushkonunun soobu ozu uchun. Al emi kim adashkan bolso, anda anyn adashkanynyn zhazasy da ozu uchun. Ech bir adam bashkanyn kunoosun kotorboit. Biz kaisy bir koomgo elchi zhiberip alarga dalil alyp kelbesten turup alardy azaptabaibyz.

Egerde Biz kaisy bir shaardy zulumdugu uchun zhok kyluunu kaalasak, anda zhakshylykty kotoro albai chirengenderdi bash iigile dep buiruibuz, birok alar bash iiishpeit. Teskerisinche, moiun sunuudan bash tartyshat. Myna oshondo alardy zhok kyluuchu azap sozu bashtaryna tushup, Biz alardy kyiratyp zhok kylabyz.

Biz Nukhtan kiiin kelgen Aad zhana Samud koomdoru syiaktuu kanchalagan zhalganchy koomdordu zhok kyldyk. Ei, paigambar! Rabbin' Oz pendelerinin kunoolorunon zhetishtuu Kabardar, Koruuchu. Aga ech biri zhashyruun emes zhana al uchun alardy zhazalait.

Kimde-kim zhakshylyk ishterdi duino zhashoosun maksat kylyp atkarsa zhana Akyretke yiman keltirbese, aga kon'ul burbasa, anda Biz aga bul duinodo al kaalagan nerseni emes, Ozubuz kaalagandarga berchu zhakshylykty erteletip berebiz. Andan son' Biz aga tozoktu daiardaibyz, kyiamat kunu al tozokko kirip ottun ysygyna azaptalat. Bul Anyn akyretke ishenbei, bul duinonu tandap Allakhtyn yraiymynan kuulgandygy uchun.

Al emi kimde-kim zhakshylyk ishterdi kyluu menen Akyrettin soobun kaalasa zhana el korsun, el uksun degenden alys bolup atkargan bolso zhana Allakh yiman keltiruugo buirugan nersege yiman keltirgen bolso, anda myna ushul sypattar menen sypattalgan adamdardyn kylgan ishteri Allakhtyn aldynda kabyl bolot. Allakh alardyn syilyktaryn beret

Oo, paigambar! Zhakshylyk kyluuchu adam bolobu zhe buzuku adam bolobu, bul eki topko ten' Rabbin'din yryskysynan toktotposton koboitup bere berebiz. Al zhakshylyk kyluuchu adam bolsun zhe buzuku adam bolsun bul duinodo Rabbin'din yryskysy ech kimden tyiylbait.

Oo, paigambar, oi zhugurtup korchu! Bul duinodo yrysky beruudo zhana darazhalardy kotoruudo alardy birinen ekinchisin artyk kyldyk. akyrettegi zhyrgalchylyk darazhalary zhana zhakshylyktary bul duinogo salyshtyrmaluu aiyrmasy oto chon'. Oshonduktan yimanduu adam alarga araket kylyp umtulsun.

Oo, pende! Allakh menen birge bashka kudaiga syiynba. Egerde oshondoi kylsan', anda sen Allakhtyn aldynda zhana Anyn zhakshy pendelerinin zhanynda zhek korulup kalasyn zhana seni ech kim zhaktyrbait. Allakhtyn zhardamynan kuru kalasyn' zhana saga ech kim zhardam berbei kalat.

Oo, pende! Rabbin' Ozunon bashkaga syiynboonu keskin turdo buirudu. Ata-enege zhakshylyk kyluunu buirudu, airykcha alar karylyk zhashyna zhetken bolushsa. Egerde al ekoonun biroosu zhe ekoosu ten' senin aldyn'da karylyk zhashka zhetken bolushsa, anda soz zhe ushuga okshogon nerse menen tazhaganyn'dy bildirbe. Alarga kyikyrba, katuu suilop oroilonbo. Alarga sylyk zhana zhumshak sozdordu gana aitkyn.
Ata-enen'e zhumshak bolup zhana alarga yraiym kylyp zhonokoi bol. Zhana myndai dep ait: "Oo, Rabbim! Maga kichinemde tarbiia bergendikteri uchun alarga yraiym kyl".

Oo, adamdar! Rabbin'er Aga ibadat zhana zhakshy ishterdi kyluuda oshondoi ele ata-enege zhakshylyk kyluuda silerdin ichin'erdegi Aga bolgon yklasyn'ardy zhakshy bilet. Egerde ibadatyn'arda, ata-enen'erge kylgan mamilen'erde zhana dagy ekoonon bashka ishterde silerdin nietin'er tuura bolso, anda aiyp-kemchilikterden aruu Allakh Aga toobo kylyp kaitkandardy kechiret. Kimde-kim Rabbisine ibadat kyluuda murda kemchilik kylgandygy uchun zhe ata-enesin naarazy kylgandygy uchun kiiin toobo kylsa, anda Allakh any kechiret.
Oo, yimanduu adam! Tuugandyn tuugandyk akysyn ber. Muktazh bolgon kedeige sadaka ber. Saparda akchasy kalbai kalgan adamga zhardam ber. Bailygyn'dy kunoogo zhe ysyrapchylykka zhumshaba.

Chyndygynda ozunun mal-mulktorun kunoo ishterge zhumshagandar zhana ysyrapkorlor mal-mulktorun sarptoodo shaitandardyn bir tuugandary bolup sanalat. Shaitandar alardy ysyrapkorlukka buirusa, alarga bash iiishet. Al emi shaitan Oz Rabbisine kaapyr bolgon. Al kunoo ishti gana kylat. Al Rabbisin achuulantkan nersege gana buiruit.

Allakhtyn saga yrysky beruusun kutup sende alarga bere turgan ech nersen' zhok bolgondugu uchun alarga bir nerse beruudon tyiylgan bolson', anda alarga kon'ul oorutpagan zhumshak soz ait. Misaly, alarga yryskyn'ar kenen bolsun dep duba kyl zhe egerde Allakh saga bailyk berip kalsa, silerge da berem dep ubada kyl.

Sadaka kyluudan kolun'du tyiba. Akcha sarptoodo ysyrap kylba. Egerde kolun'du sadaka beruudon tyisan', anda saran'dyk kylgandygyn' uchun adamdardyn zhemesinde kalasyn' zhana ysyrap kylgandygyn' uchun bergenge ech nerse tappai sadaka bere albai kalasyn'.

Chyndygynda Rabbin' chon' bir daanyshmandyk uchun kaalaganyna yryskyny koboitup beret zhana kaalaganyna azaityp beret. Al pendelerin korup bilip turat. Alardan Aga ech nerse zhashyruun emes. Alarga Ozu kaalagan nerse menen ish zhurguzot.

Egerde baldarybyzdy baksak, kiiin achka kalabyz dep korkup alardy olturbogulo. Biz alarga da zhana silerge da yrysky beruunu Ozubuzdun kepildigibizge alabyz. Alardy olturuu chon' kunoo. Antkeni alardyn kunoosu zhok zhana alardy olturuugo turtkon sebep da zhok.
Zynanyn ozunon zhana aga kyzyktyra turgan nerselerden da alys bolgula. Al zhamandyktyn zhetken chegi. Al ata-tektin buzulup ketuusuno zhana Allakhtyn azabyna alyp bargandygy uchun zhaman zhol boldu.

Allakh yiman sebeptuu zhe korgoo kepildigi berilgendigi sebeptuu any olturuunu aram kylgan zhandy olturbogulo. Bir gana dinden chygyp zhe uilongondon kiiin zyna kylyp zhe och aluu menen olumgo tatyktuu bolup kalsa olturulso bolo beret. Kimde-kim olturuunu adal kylbagan sebep menen zulum chekken abalda olturulso, anda Biz markumdun muraskorlorunun biroosuno olturuuchunun ustunon biilik berebiz. Oshondo al andan och alam dep olturuusun talap kylsa bolot. Oshondoi ele aga ech bir nerse talap kylbai ele kechirip koiso bolot. Zhe kechirip kun alsa da bolot. Al olturuuchunu Allakh adal kylgan chekten ashyp ashykcha keskilep salbasyn, zhe al olturbogon nerse menen any olturbosun, zhe olturuuchudon bashka adamdy olturbosun. Chyndygynda al zhardam berilgen adam.

Atalary olgon zhash baldardyn mal-mulktorun paidalanbagyla. Bir gana aga paida bolup koboio turgan bolso zhana saktalyp tura turgan bolso, anda anyn akyly tolup chon'oigongo cheiin paidalansan'ar bolot. Allakh menen silerdin orton'ordogu kelishimdi zhana siler menen Anyn pendelerinin ortosundagy kelishimderdi buzbai zhe kemitpei atkargyla. Chyndygynda Allakh ubada bergen adamdan ubadasyn atkardyby zhe atkarbadyby surait. Egerde atkargan bolso, anda aga syilygyn beret, a eger atkarbagan bolso, anda aga zhazasyn beret.

Egerde ozun'ordon bashka biroogo taraza tartyp bersen'er kemitpesten toluk tartkyla. Ech nerseni kemitpegen tuura taraza menen tartkyla. Ushundai olchogonun'or zhana tarazaga tartkanyn'ar siler uchun bul duinodo zhana akyrette zhakshy. Anyn akybeti taraza olchomdorundo azaityp tartuudan zhakshy.

Oo, adam balasy! Bilbesten turup eerchibe! Kumonduu oilordon, bozhomoldordon etiiat bol! Chyndygynda adam kulagy, kozu zhana zhurogu menen kylgan zhakshylyktary zhana zhamandyktary uchun suralat, zhakshylygy uchun soop alat, zhamandygy uchun zhazalanat.

Zher betinde tekeberlenip, boi kotorup baspa! Sen tekeberlene bassan' da, bul basygyn' menen zherdi teship zhibere albaisyn' zhana bul turpatyn' menen toolor tiregen biiiktikterge da zhete albaisyn'! Anda kaisyga tekeberlenip zhatasyn'?!
Oo, insan! Zhogoruda aitylgan nerselerden zhaman dep sanalgandary Rabbin'din aldynda tyiylgan. Al any kylgan adamga yraazy emes, teskerisinche, aga kaardanat.

Biz achyktap tushundurgon buiruktar, tyiuular zhana okumdor - Rabbin' saga aian kylgan kabarlardan. Ei, insan! Allakh menen birge bashka nerseni kudai kylyp alba! Andai kylsan' kyiamatta tozokko yrgytylasyn', oshondo ozun'du-ozun' zhemeleisin', adamdar da seni zhemeleit zhana bardyk zhakshylyktan kuru kalasyn'.

Oo, perishteler Allakhtyn kyzdary dep aitkandar! Ei, mushrikter! Rabbin'er silerge uul perzentterdi tandap, Ozu bolso perishtelerdi kyz kylyp alyptyrby?! Allakh siler aitkan nerseden aruu. Chyndygynda siler Allakhtyn balasy bar, kyzdary bar dep kaapyrlyk kylyp Aga karshy oto oor sozdu aityp zhatasyn'ar.

Adamdar paidaluusun atkaryp, zyianduusun tashtap sabak aluulary uchun Biz bul Kuranda okum-buiruktardy, ulgu-nasaattardy zhana okuialardy baiandadyk. Birok anygynda bul nerse ichki duinosu buzuktardyn kee birlerin kaira akyikattan alystatty zhana zhaman koruulorun kuchottu.

Oo, paigambar! Mushrikterge ait: <<Eger alar zhalgan zhalaa zhaap aitkandai Allakh menen katar bashka kudailar bolgondo, anda al zhalgan kudailary Arshtyn Eesi Allakhtyn biiligin basyp aluuga zhol izdeshmek, any talashyshmak>>.
Allakh mushrikter sypattagan nerselerden aruu, yiyk zhana alar aitkan sozdordon biiik.

Allakhty asmandar aruulait, zher aruulait zhana asmandar menen zherdin ortosundagy butkul makuluktar aruulait. Kaisy nerse bolbosun, Aga maktoo aityp aruulap turat. Birok siler alardyn kantip aruulap zhatkandaryn tushunboisun'or. Siler tilin'er menen aruulaganyn'ardy gana tushunosun'or. Chyndygynda Allakh zhazaloogo shashylbagan Ken'peiil zhana Aga toobo kylgandarga Kechirimduu.

Oo, paigambar! Sen Kuran okuganda alar andagy nasaattardy, korkutuulardy ugushup bash tartyshkan bolso, alardyn zhazasy katary seni menen kyiamat kununo ishenbegenderdin ortosunda tosmo kylyp koiobuz. Al alardy Kurandy tushunuudon tosup koiot.

Alar Kurandy tushunbosh uchun zhuroktorun zhaap koiduk. Alar ugup paida albash uchun kulaktaryn duloi kylyp koiduk. Egerde sen Kuranda Rabbin'di ele aityp, alardyn zhalgan kudailaryn aitpai turgan bolson', anda alar Allakhty chyn yklastan zhalgyzdabastan artka burulup ketishet.

Biz alardyn bashchylary Kurandy kandai maksatta ugup zhatyshkandaryn zhakshy bilebiz. Alar any menen tuura zholgo tushuunu kaalashpait. Alardyn kaaloosu - sen Kuran okuganda maanisiz sozdordu suilop, togotpogondoi mamile kyluu.
