Allakh Musanyn kon'ulun tynchtandyryp myndai dedi: <<Saga eles bolup korungon nerselerden korkpo! Oo, Musa! Chyndygynda sen zhen'ish zhana koldoo menen alardan biiiksin'>>.

On' kolun'dagy asa taiakty tashta, al zhylanga ailanyp, alardyn kylgan syikyrlaryn zhutup koiot. Alardyn kylgandary syikyrluu aila-amaldan bashka ech nerse emes. Syikyrchy kaida bolso dagy maksatyna zhetpeit.

Musa asa taiagyn tashtaganda al zhylanga ailanyp, syikyrchylardyn kylgandaryn zhutup koidu. Oshondo syikyrchylar Musanyn kylgany syikyr emes ekendigin zhana bul Allakh taraptan gana bolgondugun biliship Allakhka sazhda kylyshty. Alar: <<Biz Musa menen Kharundun Rabbisine yiman keltirdik. Al bardyk zharatylyshtyn Rabbisi>> - deshti.

Syikyrchylardyn yiman keltirgenderin Faraon chetke kagyp, azap menen korkutup: <<Men silerge uruksat bere elekte ele Musaga yiman keltirdin'erbi?! Ei, syikyrchylar! Korso, Musa silerge syikyrdy uirotkon bashchyn'ar turbaiby?! Emi men ar birin'erdin kolu-butun'ardy kaichylashtyryp kesip, tiruuloi kurma daragyna asamyn. Bul kylganyn'ar bashkalarga sabak bolot! Oshondo kimibizdin azabybyz oor zhana uzak ekenin anyk bilesin'er, meninbi zhe Musanyn Rabbisininbi?!>> - dedi.

Syikyrchylar Faraongo aityshty: <<Ei, Faraon! Saga eerchuunu, bizge kelgen aiat-belgilerge eerchuudon zhogoru koio albaibyz zhana bizdi zharatkan Allakhtan seni zhogoru koio albaibyz. Bizge emne kylam desen' oshonu kyla ber! Sen bizge bul ubaktyluu duinodo gana biilik kyla alasyn', zhakynda senin da biigilin' butot.

Chyndygynda biz Rabbibizge yiman keltirdik. Emi Andan kaapyrlyk syiaktuu murunku kunoolorubuzdu kechirishin zhana sen bizdi uironuugo, kyluuga zhana any menen Musany zhen'uugo mazhburlagan syikyrdyn kunoosun kechirishin umut kylabyz. Allakhtyn syilygy sen bizge ubada kylgan nersen'den da zhakshy zhana Anyn zhazasy sen bizdi korkutup zhatkan azabyn'dan da uzak>>.
Chyndygynda kyiamat kunu Rabbisine kaapyr bolup kelgen adamdyn akybeti al tuboluk kala turgan tozok otu bolot. Al zhaktyn azabynan kutulbastygy uchun al olboit zhana zhakshy zhashoodo da zhashabait.
Al emi kyiamat kunu Rabbisine yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylyp kelgenderge, myna ushundai uluu sypattarga ee bolgondorgo biiik darazhalar zhana zhogorku orundar bar.

Bul darazhalar - tuboluk beiishter. Andagy khansarailardyn aldylarynan daryialar agyp turat, alar anda tuboluk kalyshat. Bul aitylgan syilyk - kaapyrlyktan zhana kunoolordon taza bolgon adamdardyn syilygy.

Biz Musaga vakhii kyldyk: <<Menin pendelerim menen ech kimge bilinbei amanchylykta Misirden tundop zholgo chyk zhana den'izdi taiagyn' menen urup, alar uchun den'izde kurgak zhol kylyp ber. Faraon zhana anyn zhan-zhookorloru silerge zhetip alat dep kooptonbo zhana den'izge chogup ketuudon da korkpo!>>.

Faraon askerleri menen birge alardyn artynan tushtu. Oshondo den'iz any zhana askerlerin chokturdu. Alardyn kandai chokkondorun Allakh gana bilet. Alardyn baary chogup zhok bolushtu. Musa zhana any menen bolgondor gana aman kalyshty.
Faraon kaapyrlykty eline kooz korgozup alardy adashtyrdy, zhalgandyk menen aldady zhana alardy tuura zholgo bashtagan zhok.

Biz Israil urpaktaryn Faraon menen anyn askerlerinen kutkargandan kiiin alarga aittyk: <<Ei, Israil urpaktary! Biz silerdi dushmanyn'ardan kutkardyk. Tur toosunun zhanynda zhaigashkan oroondun on' tarabynda Musa menen suiloshuunu silerge ubada kyldyk. Biz silerge choldo bal syiaktuu shirindikterdi zhana bodonogo okshogon eti daamduu kichine kushtardy tushurduk>>.

Biz silerge yrysky kylyp bergen adal tamak-ashtardy zhegile! Birok Biz adal kylgandy tashtap aram kylgan nerselerge otup ketpegile! Bolboso silerge Menin kaarym tushot. Kimge Menin kaarym tushso, anda al kyirap zhok bolot zhana eki duinodo baktysyz bolot.
Chyndygynda Maga toobo kylyp, yiman keltirgenderge zhana zhakshylyk ishterdi kylyp, tuura zholgo tushkondorgo Men Kechirimduumun.
Oo, Musa! Emnege elin'den shashylyp, alardy artka kaltyrgan boidon aldyga ozup kettin'?
Musa aitty: <<Myna alar artymda kele zhatyshat, zheteiin dep kalyshty. Seni yraazy kylysh uchun Saga shashylyp elimden aldyga ozup kettim>>.
Allakh aitty: <<Sen artta kaltyryp ketken elin'di Biz torpokko syiynaby dep synadyk. Alardy aga syiynuuga Samirii chakyrdy. Al any menen alardy adashtyrdy>>.

Musa kaityp kelgenche eli muzoogo syiynyp ketken ele. Alardy korup achuulanyp, alardyn kylganyna kaigyryp myndai dedi: <<Ei, elim! Allakh silerge Tooratty tushurom, beiishke kirgizem dep zhakshynakai ubada bergen ele go?! Zhe ubakyt oshoncholuk sozulup, unutup kaldyn'arby? Zhe bul kylganyn'ar sebeptuu silerge Rabbin'erdin kaary tushushun, azaby kelishin kaaladyn'arby? Oshon uchun men silerge kaityp kelgenche moiun sunuuda bekem bolobuz degen ubadan'ardy buzdun'arby?!>>.

Musaga eli aitty: <<Ei, Musa! Biz saga bergen ubadany oz yktyiarybyz menen buzgan zhokpuz. Argasyzdan buzduk. Biz Faraondun koomuna tiiishtuu koptogon zer buiumdardy kotoro chykkan elek. Kiiin andan kutulush uchun any bir chun'kurga tashtadyk. Biz chun'kurga yrgytkan syiaktuu ele Samirii da ozundogu Zhebreiildin atynyn tuiagy baskan topurakty kosho yrgytty.

Samirii al zerger buiumdardan Israil urpaktaryna zhansyz muzoonun solokotun zhasap berdi. Andan uidun moorogonundoi un chygat ele. Samiriidin kylgan ishine azgyrylgandar aityshty: <<Myna ushul silerdin zhana Musanyn kudaiy. Al any ushul zherge unutup tashtap ketiptir>>.

Myna oshol muzoogo azgyrylyp syiynyp ketkender, al muzoo alarga suiloi albaganyn, zhoop kaitara albaganyn, alardan zhana bashkalardan zyiandy ketire albaganyn, ozuno zhana bashkalarga paida bere albaganyn korboi zhatyshaby?!

Musa alarga kaityp kelgenge cheiin Kharun alarga aitkan: <<Altyndan kuiulgan muzoonun solokotu zhana andan moorogon undun ugulgany -- silerdin yimanduun'ardy kaapyrlaryn'ardan aiyrmalash uchun gana bolgon synoo. Ei, elim! Chyndygynda Rabbin'er -- yraiymduuluk Eesi. Al silerge ar kandai paida keltire aluuchu, zyiandan korgoochu Zat. Andyktan zhalgyz Aga syiynuuda meni eerchigile, buiruguma bash iiip, Andan bashkaga syiyngandy toktotkula!>>.
Muzoogo syiynyp azgyrylyp ketkender aityshty: <<Musa bizge kaityp kelgenge cheiin biz aga syiyna berebiz>>.
Musa bir tuugany Kharunga aitty: <<Alardyn Allakhtan bashka muzoogo syiynyp adashkandaryn korgon kezde alardy kaitaruudan seni emne toktottu.
Emnege alardy tashtap maga kelgen zhoksun'? Men seni alarga bashchy kylyp daiyndap ketkenimde menin buiruguma karshy chyktyn'by?>>.

Musa bir tuugany Kharundun kylganyna kyzhyrlanyp anyn sakalynan zhana chachynan tartkanda al maga yraiym kyl degendei: <<Sakalymdan, chachymdan tartpachy. Chyndygynda menin alar menen kalganymdyn sebebi bar. Egerde men alardy ozdorun ele tashtap koichu bolsom, alar bolunup, chachyrap ketishebi dep korktum. Oshondo sen maga alardy boldun' zhana alar tuuraluu maga aitkan osuiatyn'dy atkarbai koidun' demeksin'>>.
Musa Samiriige aitty: <<Ei, Samirii! Bul emne kylganyn'? Munu kylyshyn'a emne turtku berdi?>>.

Samirii Musaga aitty: <<Men alar korbogon nerseni kordum. Men Zhebreildi at ustundo baratkanyn korup, anyn aty baskan zherden bir uuch topurak algam. Kiiin any zerger buiumdardan eritilip kuiulgan muzoonun solokotuno chachtym ele, al muzoonun solokotunon moorogon un chykty. Napsim dagy kylgan ishimdi kooz kylyp korgozdu>>.

Musa Samiriige aitty: <<Ketkin! Emi sen omurun' otkucho <<maga tiibegilechi, men da tiibeim>> dep kordukta zhashap otosun'. Kyiamat kunu surak berip zhana zhazalanaryn'a ubada bar. Allakh bul ubadany ech kachan buzbait. Sen Allakhtan bashka kudai dep syiynyp zhatkan muzoon'du karachy? Biz any eerigenche otko kuiguzobuz. Anan ech nersesin kaltyrbai den'izge chachyp salabyz>>.
Ei, adamdar! Allakh gana silerdin chynygy kudaiyn'ar. Andan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok. Al bardyk nerselerdi Oz ilimi menen kamtyp algan. Zhana Aga ech bir nersenin ilimi zhashyruun emes.

Oo, paigambar! Senin kon'ulun'du kotorush uchun Biz saga Musa menen Faraondun zhana alardyn koomdorunun okuiasyn aityp bergenibiz syiaktuu saga murunku paigambarlar menen koomdordun kabarlaryn da aityp berebiz. Biz saga adamdardy eskertish uchun Oz aldybyzdan Kurandy berdik.
Kim saga tushkon bul Kurandan zhuz bursa, aga yiman keltirbese zhana andagy aitylgandardy atkarbasa, anda al kyiamat kunu oor kunoolordu kotorgon zhana kyinoochu azapka tatyktuu bolgon abalda kelet.
Alar al azapta tuboluk bolushat. Kyiamatta alar kotorgon zhuk kandai zhaman!

Al kunu kaira tiriltuu uchun perishte sur kerneiin ekinchi zholu tartat. Biz oshol kunu kaapyrlar akyret korkunuchtarynyn kataaldygyn korushkondo on'doru zhana kozdoru ozgorgonunon kokmok bolup kalgan keiipte chogultabyz.
Alar biri-birine shybyrap aityshat: <<Siler olgondon kiiinki abalda on kundoi ele turdun'ar okshoit>>.
Oo, paigambar! Alar senden kyiamatta toolor kandai abalda bolorun surashat. Alarga ait: <<Rabbim toolordu tubunon zhulat zhana alardy chan'dai sapyrat.
Al emi alardy kotorgon Zherdi ech kandai kurulushtary zhana osumduktoru zhok teptegiz kylyp tashtaibyz.
Ei, nazar saluuchu! Sen zherdin ushunchalyk tegizdiginen andan ech kandai iirilikti, biiiktikti zhana oidun'du korboisun'.

Oshol kunu adamdar surak maidanyn kozdoi zharchynyn unun eerchip zhonoshot. Any eerchuudon alardy ech kim burbait. Yraiymduunun urmaty uchun korkunuchtan ech kandai undor chykpai kalat. Al kunu shybyragan undor gana ugulat.
Al uluu kundo Allakh shapaat kyluuga uruksat bergenderge gana zhana shapaat kyluuda, sozuno yraazy bolgondorgo gana shapaat berilip, al shapaat osholorgo gana paida beret.
Allakh kyiamattyn kachan bolooru syiaktuu adamdardyn kelechek ishterin da, alardyn otup ketken duino ishterin da bilet. Bardyk pendelerdin ilimi Allakhtyn zatyn zhana sypattaryn kamtyi albait.
Pendelerdin zhuzdoru ech kachan olbogon tuboluk Tiruugo zhana pendelerdin ishterin bashkaryp Turuuchuga bash iiishet. Ozun-ozu kyiroogo tush kylyp kunoolordu kotorgon adam kyirady.

Kim Allakhka zhana paigambarlaryna yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgan bolso, anda al syilygyn toluk alat. Al ozu kylbagan kunoosu uchun azaptalyp zhe kylgan zhakshylyk ishterinin soobu kemitilip zulumduk kylynat dep korkpoit.

Biz abalkylardyn okuialaryn tushurgon syiaktuu bul Kurandy taza arab tilinde tushurduk. Zhana alar Allakhtan korkushsun zhe Kurandan ulgu-nasaat alyshsyn degen maksatta anyn ichinde korkutup sestentuu syiaktuu eskertuulordun turlorun baiandadyk.

Allakh baarynan biiik, baarynan yiyk zhana baarynan uluk. Al - butkul mulk Aga gana taandyk bolgon Padysha. Al Ozu Akyikat, Anyn sozu da akyikat. Allakh ar kandai nerslerge syiynuuchular aityp zhatkan sypattardan aruu. Oo, paigambar! Saga Zhebreiil toluk zhetkirip buto elekte ele Kurandy any menen kosho okuganga shashylba! Zhana <<Oo, Rabbim! Maga uirotkon ilimdi koboitkun>> - dep ait!

Kachan Allakh Musanyn okuiasy zhana andagy kelgen Faraondun bash tartkany, Israil urpaktarynyn kapilettigi tuuraluu aitkanda, unutkandardy Allakhka bash iiuugo kaituuga chakyryp Adam atanyn okuiasyn aityp myndai dedi:
Biz murun Adamga bul daraktan zhebegin dep tyiuu salyp, anyn akyry emne bolorun aityp osuiat kylganbyz. Al osuiatty unutup, al daraktan zhep aldy, aga sabyr kyla albady. Biz andan osuiatybyzdy bekem karmanuuga bolgon turuktuuluktu koro albadyk.

Oo, paigambar! Biz perishtelerge: <<Adamga salamdashyp sazhda kylgyla!>> - dep aitkanybyzdy estegin. Oshondo Iblisten bashka baarysy sazhda kylyshty. Al oshol kezde alar menen birge ele, birok alardan emes bolchu. Al tekeberlenip sazhda kylbai koidu.
Chyndygynda sen beiishte ach kalbaisyn', Allakh seni toiundurat. Zhylan'ach kalbaisyn', Al Allakh seni kiiindiret.
Chan'kabaisyn', Al suusundugun'du kandyrat. Kundun ysygy otpoit, Al seni kundun ysygynan kalkalait.
Shaitan Adamdy azgyryp myndai dedi: <<Men saga bir darakty korgozoiunbu, kim andan zhese ech kachan olboit, tuboluk tiruu zhashait zhana tugongus mulkko ee bolot?!>>.

Oshondo Adam menen Khava zhegenge tyiylgan daraktan zhep alyshty. Anan alardyn zhabylgan avrattary achylyp kaldy. Oshondo alar beiishtegi daraktardyn zhalbyraktaryn uzup avrattaryn zhaap bashtashty. Adam daraktan zheboogo bolgon Allakhtyn buirugun atkarbai zhana da aga uruksat bolbogon ishti kyldy.
Kiiin Allakh any tandap, toobosun kabyl kyldy zhana aga tuura zholgo tushuugo iigilik berdi.

Allakh Adam menen Khavaga aitty: <<Ekoon'or Iblis menen kosho beiishten tushkulo! Emi al silerge, siler aga dushmansyn'ar. Emi silerge Menin zholuma bagyttagan zholdomo kelse zhana silerden kim any eerchise, any atkarsa zhana andan burulbasa, anda al akyikattan adashpait, akyrette azaptalyp baktysyz kalbait. Allakh any sozsuz beiishke kirgizet>>.

Al emi kim Menin eskertmemden bash tartyp kabyl albasa, aga zhoop berbese, anda aga bul duinodo zhana kabyrda tar zhashoo bolot zhana kyiamat kunu any dalilsiz zhana sokur abalda surak maidanyna alyp barabyz.
Eskertmeden bash tartkan adam: <<Oo, Rabbim! Emnege meni sokur kylyp tirilttin'? Duinodo menin kozum korchu ele go?>> - deit.

Allakh aga zhoop kylyp aitty: <<Sen dagy ushundai kylgansyn', duino zhashoosunda saga Bizdin aiattarybyz kelgende, andan bash tartyp, alardy tashtagansyn'. Oshol syiaktuu ele sen dagy bugun azapta tashtalasyn'>>.

Oo, paigambar! Egerde Rabbin' taraptan "Allakh dalil alyp kelbesten turup ech kimdi azaptabait" degen soz zhana Anyn aldynda alar uchun belgilengen moonot bolbogondo, anda alar tatyktuu bolgon azapty tezdetmek.

Biz synoo maksatta kee bir zhalganchylar uchun kylgan bul duino zhashoosunun koozduktarynan bolgon zhyrgalchylyktarga nazar salba! Chyndygynda Biz alarga kylgan nerseler ubaktyluu. Al emi seni yraazy kylyp ubada kylgan Rabbin'din soobu -- bul duinodo alarga berilgen ubaktyluu zhyrgalchylyktardan zhakshyraak zhana tuboluktuu.

Oo, paigambar! Ui-bulon'du namaz okuuga buiur zhana sen dagy any atkaruuga sabyrduu bol! Biz senden ozun' zhana bashkalar uchun yrysky surabaibyz. Senin yryskyn'a Biz Ozubuz kepilbiz. Bul duinodogu zhana akyrettegi maktoogo tatyktuu akybet -Allakhtan korkkon, Anyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiuularyn tashtagan takyba adamdar uchun.

Paigambardy zhalganga chygargan al kaapyrlar: <<Mukhammad bizge Rabbisi taraptan anyn chynchyldygyn zhana paigambar ekendigin dalildegen keremet alyp kelse kana?!>> -- deshti. Al zhalganchylarga asmandan tushkon murunku kitepterdi tastyktagan Kuran keldi go?!

Eger Biz paigambardy zhalganga chygargan al zhalganchylardy kaapyrlyktary zhana bash iibestikteri uchun alarga paigambar zhibergenge zhe kitep tushurgongo cheiin ele azap zhibergenibizde, anda alar kyiamatta kaapyrlyktary uchun kechirim surap: <<Oo, Rabbibiz! Duino zhashoosunda bizge paigambar zhibergenin'de, Biz aga yiman keltirip, Senin azabyn' sebeptuu kordukka tush bolgongo cheiin al alyp kelgen aiattarga eerchimekpiz go?!>> - dep aityshmak.
Oo, paigambar! Al zhalganchylarga ait: <<Baardygybyz Allakhtyn korgozgonun kutolu. Siler dagy kutkulo! Zhakynda siler menen bizdin kimibiz tuura zholdo ekendiginin sozsuz bilesin'er>>.
Adamdar kylgan ishteri uchun Kyiamat kunu bere turgan suraktary zhakyndap kaldy. Birok alar duino menen alek bolushkany uchun akyretten zhuz burup beikapar zhurushot.
Rabbisi taraptan alarga Kurandan kandai gana soz kelbesin, alar andagy nerselerge kon'ul burushpai, paida da alyshpai oiunkaraaktyk menen gana ugushtu.

Any zhuroktoru kapilet bolgon abalda ugushtu. Kaapyrlyk kylgan zaalymdar oz ara syrdashyp: <<Myna bu ozun paigambarmyn dep zhatkan adam silerden ech aiyrmasy zhok silerge okshogon ele adam go?! Anyn alyp kelgeni syikyr. Emi siler anyn ozun'orgo okshogon ele adam ekenin zhana anyn alyp kelgeni syikyr ekenin bilip turup any eerchiisin'erbi?!>> - dep suiloshkon sozdorun zhashyryshty.

Paigambar aitty: <<Rabbim siler zhashyrgan sozdu bilet. Al asmandar menen zherdegi aitylgan sozdordun baarysyn bilet. Al pendelerinin sozdorun Uguuchu, alardyn kylgan ish-araketterin Biluuchu. Al alarga kylgan ishteri uchun syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret>>.

Teskerisinche, alar Mukhammad alyp kelgen nersege shektenip any birde: <<Chechmelenishi zhok bashalaman tushtor>> - dese, birde: <<Zhok! Ech kandai negizi zhok ozu ele oilop tapkan nerse>> - deshti. Al emi keede: <<Al akyn. Eger al aityp zhatkan sozundo chynchyl bolso, anda abalky paigambarlar alyp kelgendei keremet alyp kelsinchi. Alar Musanyn asa taiagy, Salikhtin toosu on'duu keremetterdi alyp kelishken>> - deshti.

Bul surap zhatkandardan aldyn otkon bir dagy shaardyn elderi ushundai aiat-belgilerdi alyp keluunu surashkanda alarga suraganyndai alyp kelingende da yiman keltirgen emes. Alar teskerisinche any zhalganga chygaryshkan, oshondo Biz alardy kyirattyk. Emi ushular yiman keltirishmek bele?!

Oo, paigambar! Biz saga cheiin adamzattan erkekterdi gana paigambar kylyp zhiberip, alarga vakhii tushurgonbuz. Biz alarga perishtelerdi zhibergen emespiz. Egerde munu bilbesen'er, anda silerden murunku Kitep eelerinen suragyla.
Biz alarga zhibergen paigambarlardy tamak-ash zhebegen deneluu adamdardan kylgan zhokpuz. Alar dagy bashkalar syiaktuu tamak zheshet. Zhana alar bul duinodo olboi tuboluk kalyshpait.

Kiiin Biz paigambarlarga bergen ubadabyzdy atkaryp, alardy zhana yimanduulardan Ozubuz kaalagandardy kyiroodon kutkardyk. Zhana Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyp chekten chykkandardy zhana kunoo kylgandardy kyiratyp zhok kyldyk.

Biz silerge Kurandy tushurduk. Anyn ichinde silerdin kadyryn'ar, syimygyn'ar bar, eger aga ishengen bolson'or zhana andagy aitylgandardy atkargan bolson'or. Aga akyl zhugurtpoisun'orbu, aga yiman keltiruugo shashylyp, andagy kelgenderdi atkarbaisyn'arby?!
Kaapyrlyk kylyp zulumduk kylyshkany uchun Biz nechendegen shaarlardy zhok kyldyk zhana alardan kiiin bashka koomdordu zharattyk.
Kyiroogo uchuragan adamdar tup-ordu menen zhok kyluuchu azabybyzdy koroor zamat shaardan dalbastap kachyp zhonoshtu.
<<Kachpagyla! Yrakhattanyp kon'ul achkan abalyn'arga zhana uiun'orgo kaitkyla! Balkim biroo zharym silerdin dunuion'ordon bir nerse surait chygar>> - dep kakshyktap chakyryshat.
Kunoolorun moiunga algan al zaalymdar aityshty: <<Emi olduk! Emi kyiradyk! Chyndygynda biz Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgan zaalymdardan boluppuz>>.
Biz alardy orulgan chop syiaktuu kyimylsyz oluktorgo ailantkanga cheiin alar kylgan kunoolorun moiunga alyshyp, kyiradyk dep kyikyryk salgan chakyryktaryn kaitalai berishti.
Biz Asman menen Zherdi zhana al ekoonun orosundagy nerselerdi zhon ele oiun uchun zharatkan zhokpuz. Biz al ekoosun Ozubuzdun kuduretibizdi korsotush uchun zharattyk.
Egerde Biz biroonu aial kyluunu zhe bala kyluunu kaalaganybyzda, anda Ozubuzdun aldybyzdan ele kylyp almakpyz. Birok Biz myndan aruu bolgonubuz uchun any kylgan zhokpuz.

Teskerisinche, Biz paigambarybyzga vakhii kylgan akyikatty kaapyrlardyn zhalganynyn ustuno tashtaibyz, al any zhok kylat. Oshentip alardyn zhalgany zhok bolot. Ei, Allakhtyn aialy zhana balasy bar dep aitkandar! Allakhka ylaiyk kelbegen sypattardy Aga tan'uulaganyn'ar uchun silerge kyiroo bolsun!

Aialduu zhe balaluu boluu - muktazh boluu degendik ekenin bildirgendikten, Allakh Taala Ozu bul aalamdyn padyshasy ekenin baiandap myndai dedi:
Asmandar menen zherdin mulku zhalgyz Allakhka gana taandyk. Anyn aldyndagy perishteler Aga syiynuudan tekeberlenishpeit zhana charchashpait.
Alar Allakhty ar daiym aruulashat zhana andan tazhashpait.
Birok mushrikter Allakhtan bashkalardy kudai kylyp alyshty. Alar oluktordu da tirilte alyshpait. Anan alar ushunu da kyla albagandarga kantip syiynyp zhatyshat?!

Egerde asmandar menen zherde bashka kudailar bolgondo, anda "kudailar" biilik talashyp, asmandar menen zher kyirap kalmak. Birok, zhagdai myndai emes. Arshtyn Rabbisi bolgon Allakh mushrikterdin Anyn sherigi bar degen (zhalgan) sypattoosunan taza, aruu.

Allakh Ozu zhalgyz biilik kylat zhana Ozu chechet. Al tagdyr kylgan zhana chechim chygargan nerselerde ech kim Andan surabait. Teskerisinche, al pendelerinen ish-araketteri uchun surak alat zhana alarga syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Birok alar Allakhtan bashkalardy kudai kylyp alyshty. Oo, paigambar! Mushrikterge ait: <<Alar syiynuuga tatyktuu ekendigine dalilin'erdi alyp kelgilechi! Myna maga tushkon kitep zhana paigambarlarga tushkon kitepter. Siler myndan ech kandai dalil tappaisyn'ar>>. Teskerisinche, mushrikterdin kopchulugu naadandykka zhana sokur eerchuugo taianat. Alar akyikatty kabyl aluudan zhuz burushkan.
Oo, paigambar! Biz senden murun zhibergen ar bir paigambarga: <<Menden bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok. Zhalgyz Maga syiyngyla zhana ech nerseni sherik kylbagyla!>> - dep vakhii kylganbyz.
Mushrikter: <<Allakh perishtelerdi Ozuno kyz kylyp aldy>> - deshti. Allakh alardyn aitkan zhalgandarynan aruu zhana yiyk. Teskerisinche, perishteler Allakhka zhakyn zhana Anyn urmattuu kuldary.
Alar Rabbisinen murun suiloshpoit, alarga buiruk berilmeiin unchugushpait, Anyn buiruktaryn atkaryshat zhana Anyn buiruktaryna karshy chygyshpait.
Al alardyn otkon zhana kelechek ishterin bilet. Ozu yraazy bolup uruksat bergenderge gana shapaat surai alyshat. Alar Allakhtan korkup saktanyshat zhana Anyn buiruk-tyiuularyna karshy chygyshpait.

Misal katary aitsak, egerde perishtelerden kimisi: <<Men Allakhtan bashka kudaimyn>> - dep aitkan bolso, Biz any ushul sozu uchun kyiamat kunu zhaza katary tuboluk tozok menen azaptaibyz.Zhana ushundai zhaza menen kaapyrlyk zhana shirk kylgan zaalymdardy da zhazalaibyz.

Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyshkandar bilishpeibi, murda Asmandar menen Zher biri-birine zhabyshyp turat ele, ortosunda zhamgyr zhaai turgandai da boshtuk zhok bolchu. Kiiin Biz al ekoosun bolup, Asmandan zherge tushkon suudan bardyk zhandyktardy zhana osumduktordu zharattyk. Alar myndan sabak alyshpaiby zhana zhalgyz Allakhka yiman keltirishpeibi?!

Zher oz betindegilerdi silkibesh uchun Biz anyn ustuno bekem toolordu zharattyk. Zhana anyn ustundo kenen zholdordu kyldyk. Balkim alar saparga chygyshkanda osholor arkyluu kozdogon zherlerine zhol taap baryshat.

Biz asmandy urap kalbagydai kylyp, shyp syiaktuu ustunsuz zharattyk. Oshondoi ele sozdordu ugup uurdabai turgandai korgop koiduk. Al emi mushrikter asmandagy Kun zhana Ai syiaktuu aiat-belgilerdi korup sabak alyshpastan zhuz uirushtu.

Allakh zhalgyz Ozu tundu es aluu uchun, kunduzdu tirichilik kylysh uchun zharatty. Al emi Kundu kunduzdun belgisi kyldy, Aidy tundun belgisi kyldy. Kun dagy, Ai dagy ozuno tiiishtuu orbitada zhylyp zhurot. Alar andan burulup da, oop da ketishpeit.

Oo, paigambar! Biz senden murun ech bir adamdy bul zhashoodo tuboluk zhashai turgan kylbadyk. Bul zhashoodo azhalyn' zhetip sen olup, al emi alar senden kiiin da tuboluk tiruu kalyshat beken?! Andai bolboit!

Ar bir zhan, al yimanduu bolobu zhe kaapyr bolobu, bul duinodo olumdu tatat. Oo, adamdar! Biz silerdi bul duino zhashoosunda dinii mildetter, zhakshylyktar, kyiynchylyktar menen synaibyz, olgonun'ordon kiiin Bizge gana kaitasyn'ar. Oshondo Biz silerdi kylgan ishterin'erge zharasha syilyk zhe zhazan'ardy berebiz.

Oo, paigambar! Mushrikter seni korushkondo kakshyktap shyldyn'dashyp, zhaktoochularyna seni zhaman korgozup: <<Siler syiyngan kudailaryn'ardy sogup zhatkan adam ushulbu?>> - dep aityshat. Alar seni shyldyn'doo menen Allakh alarga tushurgon Kurandy zhokko chygaruuda zhana alarga bergen zhakshylyktarga shugursuz kesir boluuda. Alar bardyk zhamandyktardy ozudoruno zhyinagandygy uchun aiyptoogo tatyktuu!

Adam tabiiatynan shashkalak. Al ubagy kele elekte ele ertereek bolso eken dep shashtyrat. Mushrikterdin da azapty shashtyruusu da ushuga kiret. Ei, Menin azabymdy shashtyrgandar! Siler shashtyrgan nerseni zhakynda korgozom. Siler any ertelet dep shashtyrbagyla!

Kaira tiriluunu zhokko chygargan kaapyrlar shashtyryshyp: <<Ei, musulmandar! Eger siler anyk bolot dep aityp zhatkan nersen'erde chynchyl bolson'or, zhanagy bizge ubada kylyp zhatkan kaira tiriluu kachan bolot?>> - dep aityshat.

Kaira tiriluunu chetke kakkan kaapyrlar zhuzdorunon zhana zhondorunan tozok otun toso albai kalganda, alardy azaptan korgoi turgan koldoochu zhok ekenin anyk bilishkende, azapty anchalyk shashtyryshmak emes.

Alar azaptala turgan bul tozok otu alarga ubakyty anyk aitylyp kelbeit. Teskerisinche, kapysynan kelet. Oshondo alar any artka kaitara alyshpait zhana alar tooba kylyp, yraiymga zhetip alyshsyn dep artka kechiktirilip da koiulbait.

Kachan Allakhtyn elchisi eli taraptan shyldyn'doogo zhana zhalganga chygaruuga tush bolup bushaiman tartkanda Allakh anyn kon'ulun zhubatyp myndai dedi:
Oo, paigambar! Elin'din seni shyldyn'dagany zhan'ylyk emes. Senden murunku paigambarlar da shyldyn'ga kabylyshkan. Oshondo alardy shyldyn'dagan kaapyrlardy azap kurchady. Antkeni paigambarlary alardy bul duinodo azap menen korkutup-eskertishkende any shyldyn'ga alyshkan ele.

Oo, paigambar! Myna oshol azapty shashtyryp zhatkandarga: <<Yraiymduu Allakh tarabynan kunduzu zhe tunubu silerge azap tushurup, zhok kyluunu kaalasa, andan silerdi kim kutkara alat?>> - dep aitkyn. Teskerisinche, alar Rabbisinin aitkan nasaattaryn zhe dalilderin eske aluudan zhuz burushtu zhana naadandyktan ulam alarga oi zhugurtushpodu.

Zhe alardy Bizdin azabybyzdan korgoi turgan kudailary barby? Alar ozdoruno da zhardam bere alyshpait, paida da, zyian da keltire alyshpait. Ozuno zhardam bere albagan kantip bashkalarga zhardam bersin?! Oshondoi ele alar Bizdin azabybyzdan da korgoi alyshpait.

Biz al kaapyrlarga zhana alardyn ata-babalaryna alardy akyryndyk menen zhazalash uchun Oz zhakshylyktarybyzdy kenen kylyp berdik. Oshentip alardyn zamany sozulup, azgyrylyp ketishti zhana kaapyrlyktan kaityshpady. Bizdin (synoo uchun bergen) zhakshylyktarybyzga azgyrylgandar, azabybyzdy shashtyrgandar Biz elderdi bash iidirip, ustomduk kylyp alardyn zherin ar taraptan kyskartyp zhatkanybyzdy korboi zhataby?! Bashkalarga tushkon azap alardyn da bashyna tusho elekte myndan sabak alyshpaiby?! Alar zhen'ishke zhetkender emes, alar zhen'ilgender.

Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Ei, adamdar! Maga Rabbim tushurgon vakhii menen silerdi Allakhtyn azabynan korkutam. Birok akyikatka duloi bolgon adamdardy Allakhtyn azabynan korkutup akyikatka chakyrsa da alar any kabyl aluu menen ugushpait>>.

Oo, paigambar! Egerde azapty shashtyryp zhatkandarga Rabbin'din bir az ele azaby zhetken bolso, alar oshol kezde: <<Kuruduk ai! Emi olduk! Chyndygynda biz Allakhka shirk kylyp zhana Mukhammad (aga Allakhtyn salamattygy, tynchtygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) alyp kelgendi zhalganga chygaryp zalimderden bolduk>> -- deshmek.

Biz kyiamat kunu adamdardyn ish-araketterin olchogongo adilettuu tarazalardy ornotobuz. Al kundo ech bir adamga sooptoru kemitilip zhe kunooloru koboitulup zulumduk kylynbait. Eger tartylgan nerse sary kychynyn danynchalyk kichine bolso dagy any alyp kelebiz. Biz pendeleribizdin ish-araketterin eseptoogo zhetishtuubuz.
Biz Musa menen Kharunga Tooratty berdik. Al akyikat menen zhalgandy, adal menen aramdy azhyratuuchu, aga yiman keltirgenderge tuura zhol zhana Rabbisinen korkkondorgo eskertme.
Alar Rabbisinin zhazasynan korkkondor, Any korushposo dagy yiman keltirgender zhana kyiamat kaiymdan korkkondor.

Mukhammadga (aga Allakhtyn salamattygy, tynchtygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) tushkon bul Kuran ulgu-nasaat alam degender uchun eskertme zhana kop-paidaluu, berekeluu kitep. Siler buga karabastan chetke kagasyn'arby?! Andagy kelgenderdi moiunga albai zhana ish zhuzundo atkarbai koiosun'arby?!
Biz Ibrakhimge kichinesinde koomuna karshy dalilderdi bergenbiz zhana Biz any bilgenbiz. Oshondoi ele al koomuna karshy koldongon dalilderdin Biz tatyktuu dep eseptegenderdi gana berdik.
Bir kezde al atasy Azarga zhana koomuna aitty: <<Siler oz kolun'ar menen zhasap alyp syiynyp zhatkan bul aikelder emne?>>.
Aga koomu aitty: <<Ata-babalarybyz alarga syiynyshkan. Biz dagy alarga eerchip syiynyp zhatabyz>>.
Ibrakhim alarga aitty: <<Ei, sokur eerchuuchulor! Siler da, ata-babalaryn'ar da akyikat zholdon anyk adashuudasyn'ar".
Koomu aga aitty: <<Sen bul sozun'du chyndap aityp zhatasyn'by zhe tamashalappy?>>.

Ibrakhim aitty: <<Tamashasy zhok chyndap aityp zhatam. Silerdin Rabbin'er -- Al Asmandar menen Zherdi murun bolbogondoi korunushto zharatkan Rabbisi. Al silerdin zhana Asmandar menen Zherdin Rabbisi ekenine kubogo otkondordonmun. Silerdin aikel-buttaryn'ardyn mynda ech kandai tieshesi zhok>>.
Ibrakhim koomuna uguzbai ozuncho: <<Allakhka ant! Siler mairamga ketkende aikelderin'erdi silerge zhakpagandai bir nerse kylamyn>> - dedi.
Anan Ibrakhim alardyn aikel-buttaryn maidalap talkalap saldy. Birok alar kaityp kelishkende, alardy kim talkalaganyn surashsyn degen niette chon'una tiigen zhok.

Kachan alar kaityp kelip, aikel-buttary talkalanganyn korgondo biri-birinen surashty: <<Bizdin kudailarybyzdy kim talkalady? Chyndygynda alardy talkalagan adam anyk zulum eken. Antkeni al uluktap yiyk tutuuga tatyktuu bolgon nersege shek keltirdi>>.
Kee birleri aityshty: <<Ibrakhim degen zhash zhigit alardy zhamandap,aiyptap zhurgonun ukkanbyz. Balkim oshol talkalagan bolush kerek>>.

Alardyn bashchysy aitty: <<Ibrakhimdi adamdar kubo bolup koro turgan zherge alyp kelgile. Alar anyn kylganyn moinuna alganyna kubo bolushsun. Al kylganyn moinuna alsa, any ozuno karshy dalil kylasyn'ar>>.
Alar Ibrakhimdi alyp kelip andan surashty: <<Ei, Ibrakhim! Bizdin aikel-buttarybyzga myndai maskara ishti sen kyldyn'by?>>.

Ibrakhim adamdardyn koz aldynda aikel-buttaryn alsyzdygyn bildirish uchun zhana alardy shyldyn' boluusu uchun myndai dep aitty: <<Munu men kylgan zhokmun. Munu aikel-buttaryn'ardyn chon'u kyldy. Eger aikel-buttaryn'ar suiloi alsa, anda osholordon suragyla>>.
Oshondo alar ozdoruncho oilonup kalyshty. Alarga aikel-buttary paida da, zyian da berbestigi zhana alar Allakhtan bashka aikel-buttarynaga syiynyp zulumduk kylyp zhatyshkandygy anyk boldu.

Kiiin kaira koktukko, bash iibestikke otup: <<Ei, Ibrakhim! Sen bulardyn suiloboi turganyn ozun' dele bilesin'. Anan kantip bizdi sura dep zhatasyn'?>> - deshti. Alar munu ozdorun zhaktap dalil kylyshkan, birok ozdoruno karshy dalil bolup kaldy.

Ibrakhim alardyn sozun chetke kagyp aitty: <<Allakhtan bashka aikel-buttarga syiynyp zhatasyn'arby? Alar silerge paida da zyian da bere albait. Ozdoruno paida beruugo zhe bir zyiandy tosuudan alsyz>>.
Allakhtan bashka syiynyp zhatkan aikelderin'er menen kosho kurup ketkile! Alar paida da, zyian da bere alyshpait. Ushuga da akylyn'ar zhetpeibi?! Syiynganyn'ardy toktotpoisun'arby?!

Kachan alar dalil menen betteshe albasyn bilishkende kuch koldonuuga kiriship: <<Ibrakhimdi otko orttogulo! Al syndyryp talkalagan aikel-buttaryn'arga zhardam bergile! Egerde aga katuu, zholunan kaitaruuchu kylyp zhazalagyn'ar kelse, ushundai kylgyla!>> -- dep aityshty.
Anan alar ot zhagyp, any otko yrgytyshty. Oshondo Biz aittyk: <<Ei, ot! Ibrakhimge muzdak zhana zyiansyz bol! - dedik. Al oshondoi boldu zhana Ibrakhim ech kandai zyian tartkan zhok>>.
Ibrakhimdin koomu any orttoibuz dep aga karshy ailakerlik kyluunu kaalashty. Birok Biz alardyn ailakerligin zhok kyldyk zhana alardyn ozdorun kyiratyp zhen'iluugo tush kyldyk.

Biz any menen Lut ekoosun kutkardyk zhana alardy berekeluu kylgan Sham zhergesine chygaryp zhiberdik. Sebebi Biz al zhakka paigambarlardan zhibergenbiz zhana insan, zhan-zhanybarlar uchun zhakshylyktardy chachyp koigonbuz.

Al Rabbisine maga perzent ber dep duba kylganda Biz aga Iskhakty berdik zhana koshumcha kylyp Iakubdu berdik. Biz Ibrakhimdi zhana anyn balasy Iskhakty, neberesi Iakubdu baarysyn Allakhka moiun sungan salikh-zhakshy pendelerden kyldyk.

Biz alardy adamdar zhakshylykta eerchii turgan bashchylardan kyldyk. Alar Allakhtyn kaaloosu menen adamdardy zhalgyz Aga gana syiynuuga chakyryshat. Biz alarga zhakshylyktardy kylgyla, namazdy toluk turdo atkargyla zhana zeket bergile dep vakhii kyldyk. Alar Bizge moiun sunuuchulardan ele.

Biz Lutka zhaattashkan taraptardyn ortosunda okum kyluunu zhana din ishterine bailanyshtuu ilim berdik. Eli buzukuluk kylgan anyn shaary Sadumga tushurgon azaptan Biz any aman alyp kaldyk. Alar Rabbisine bash iibei buzukuluk kylgan koom ele.
Biz any koomu duushar bolgon azaptan kutkaryp Oz yraiymybyzga aldyk. Chyndygynda al Bizdin buirugubuzdu atkargan, tyiganybyzdy tashtagan salikh-zhakshy adamdardan ele.

Oo, paigambar! Nukhtun okuiasyn estechi, al Ibrakhim menen Luttan murun Allakhka kairylyp duba kylganda Biz anyn suraganyn berip dubasyna zhoop berdik, any zhana yiman keltirgen ui-bulosun chon' kaigydan kutkardyk.

Biz any koldosh maksatta bergen anyn chynchyl ekenin tastyktagan aiat-belgileribizdi zhalganga chygargan koomdun ailakerliginen any kutkardyk. Chyndygynda alar buzuku zhana yplas koom ele. Oshonduktan Biz alardyn baaryn chokturup zhok kyldyk.

Oo, paigambar! Daud menen Sulaimandyn okuiasyn estechi, alar kelgen zhaattashkan eki taraptyn ortosundagy bir ishke okum kylyshty. Birinchisi tarabynan koiloru tundosu berkisinin zhaiytyna kirip tebelep salyptyr. Biz Daud menen Sulaimandyn kylgan okumuno kubo bolgonbuz. Alardyn kylgan okumunun ech bir nersesi Bizge zhashyruun emes.

Oshondo Daudga emes, Sulaimanga ishtin choo-zhaiyn tushundurduk. Biz Daudga da, Sulaimanga da paigambarlyk zhana shariiat okumdoru tuuraluu ilim bergenbiz. Munu zheke Sulaimanga ele chektegen emespiz. Daudga ozu menen koshulup Allakhty aruulap uluktagan toolordu zhana kanattuu kushtardy moiun sundurduk. Oshondoi ele silerge zhen'ildik, tushunuk, okum zhana ilim berdik. Ushunun baaryn Biz zhasadyk.
Biz Sulaimanga emes, Daudga silerdin denen'erdi kuraldyn sokkusunan saktai turgan soot kiiimderdi zhasoo onorun uirottuk. Ei, adamdar! Allakh silerge bergen ushul zhakshylyk uchun shugur kyldyn'arby?

Biz Sulaimanga katuu sokkon shamaldy moiun sundurduk. Al anyn buirugu menen Biz paigambarlardy chygargan zhana zhakshylyktardy mol kylgan Sham zhergesin karai sogup turat. Biz bardyk nerseni bilebiz. Alardyn ech biri Bizge zhashyruun emes.

Zhana al uchun den'izdin tubuno chumkup bermetterdi zhana bashka nerselerdi alyp chykkan zhana kurulush syiaktuu ishterdi kylgan zhin-shaitandardy aga moiun sundurduk. Biz alardyn sanyn zhana kylgan ishterin kozomoldoochubuz. Alardyn ech bir nersesin otkorup zhibergen zhokpuz.

Oo, paigambar! Aiubdun okuiasyn estechi, al baleege tush bolgondo Rabbisine kairylyp: <<Oo, Rabbim! Chyndygynda men ooruga zhana ui-bulomdu zhogotuuga kabyldym. Sen baaryna yraiym kylgandardyn yraiymduususun'. Bashyma tushkon nerseden meni alystat>> - dep duba kyldy.

Biz anyn dubasyn kabyl kylyp, al zyian tartkan nerseden any alystattyk zhana al zhogotkon ui-bulo, bala-chakasyn ozuno kaitaryp, alardyn ustuno da oshoncho koshup berdik. Bul nerselerde Allakhka ibadat kylyp, bash iigenderge iigilikke zhetuu uchun Aiub sabyr kylgandai sabyr kyluu kerek degen eskertme-ulgu bar. Ushunun baaryn aga Oz yraiymybyzdy tokkondukton kyldyk.
Oo, paigambar! Ismail, Idris zhana Zulkifldi estechi, alardyn baarysy synoogo zhana Allakh alarga mildet kylgan okumdordu atkaruuda sabyrduulardan bolushkan.

Biz alardy Oz yraiymybyzga alyp, alardy paigambar kyldyk zhana alardy beiishke kirgizdik. Chyndygynda alar Rabbisine ibadat kylgan, ichki zhana syrtky duinosu taza bolgon Allakhtyn salikh-zhakshy pendelerinen.

Oo, paigambar! Kittin eesi Iunustun (aga Allakhtyn salamattygy, tynchtygy bolsun) okuiasyn estechi, al elinin bash iibestigine achuulanyp Rabbisinin uruksatysyz ketip kalgan ele. Al ketip kalgany uchun Biz any kysymga albaibyz dep oilogon. Kiiin kit any zhutkan kezde katuu kysylyp, kamakta kalyp synaldy. Oshondo al kittin, den'izdin zhana tundun karan'gylyktarynda kunoosun moiunga alyp Allakhka toobo kylyp: <<Senden bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok. Sen aruusun' zhana yiyksyn'. Chyndygynda men zalymdardan boldum>> - dep duba kyldy.

Biz anyn dubasyn kabyl kyldyk zhana any karan'gylyktardan zhana kittin ichinen chygaryp chon' kyiynchylyktan kutkardyk. Biz Iunustu bul kyiynchylygynan kutkargan syiaktuu ele kyiynchylykka tushup, Allakhka duba kylgan yimanduulardy da kutkarabyz.

Oo, paigambar! Zakariianyn okuiasyn estechi, al Rabbisine kairylyp: <<Oo, Rabbim! Meni balasyz zhalgyz kaltyrba! Sen kaluuchulardyn, zhakshylykty maga kaltyruuchulardyn en' zhakshysysyn'! Maga ozumdon kiiin kala turgan perzent ber>> - dep duba kyldy.

Biz anyn dubasyn kabyl kylyp, aga Iakh'iany bala kylyp berdik zhana aialyn aiyktyrdyk. Al torobos aial ele, birok oshondon kiiin toroi turgan bolup kaldy. Chyndygynda Zakariia, aialy zhana balasy zhakshylyktardy kyluuga shashylgandardan ele. Alar Bizdin aldybyzdagy sooptordu kaalashyp zhana zhazadan korkushup Bizge duba kylyshat ele. Alar bizge zhalynyp zhalbaryshkan moiun sunuuchulardan ele.

Oo, paigambar! Abiiirduu zherlerin zynadan saktagan Mariiamdy estechi, Allakh aga Zhebreiildi zhiberdi. Al aga rukh uilogondo anyn boiuna Isa buttu. Al zhana anyn balasy Isa ekoosu adamdar uchun Allakhtyn kuduretin bildirgen belgi boldu. Antkeni Al any atasyz ele zharatkandygy chyndygynda Allakhty ech nerse alsyz kyla albastygyna dalil.
Ei, adamdar! Chyndygynda silerdin bul dinin'er - bir din. Al Allakhty zhalgyzdoo bolgon Islam dini zhana Men silerdin Rabbin'ermin. Andyktan Maga gana chyn yklastan ibadat kylgyla!

Birok adamdar bolunup, alardyn arasynda Allakhty zhalgyzdagandar, mushrikter, kaapyrlar zhana musulmandar paida boldu. Myna oshol bolungondordun baarysy kyiamat kunu Bizge gana kaityp kelishet. Oshondo Biz alardy kylgan ishterine zharasha syilygyn zhe zhazasyn berebiz.

Alardyn kimisi Allakhka, paigambarlarga zhana akyret kununo yiman keltirip zhakshylyk ishterdi kylsa, anda anyn zhakshylyk ishi tekke ketpeit. Teskerisinche, Allakh andan yraazy bolup soobun eselep beret. Al kaira tirilgen kunu alardy amal kitebinen tabat zhana kubanychka batat.
Kaapyrlyktary sebeptuu Biz zhok kylgan shaarlardyn elderi bul duinogo kaityp toobo kylyshyp zhana tooboloru kabyl bolushu takyr mumkun emes.
Alar Iazhuzh-Mazhuzhdun tosmosu achylganga cheiin ech kachan kaityshpait. Oshol kunu alar zherdin bardyk biiik zherlerinen zhutunup chygyshat.

Alardyn chygyshy menen kyiamat zhakyndady zhana anyn korkunuchtary menen kyiynchylyktary korunup kaldy. Oshol kezde katuu korkunuchtan kaapyrlardyn kozdoru tostoiup: <<Olduk emi! Biz duinodo oinop ele zhurupturbuz, bul uluu kungo ech kandai daiardyk da korbopturbuz. Korso, biz kaapyrlyk zhana kunoo kylyp zaalymdardan bolupturbuz>> - deshet.

Ei, mushrikter! Siler zhana siler syiyngan Allakhtan bashka aikel-buttar, oshondoi ele silerdi ozuno syiynganyn'ardy tuura korgon adamdar menen zhinder - tozoktun otunu bolosun'ar. Siler zhana kudailaryn'ar al zhakka sozsuz kiresin'er.

Egerde alar syiynuuga tatyktuu chynygy kudailar bolgondo, anda alar syiyngandar menen kosho tozokko kirishpeit bolchu. Syiyngandar da, syiynylgandar da tozokto bolushat. Alar al zhakta tuboluk kalyshat zhana andan chygyshpait.
Alar al zhaida korgon azaptardyn kataaldygynan ulam oor dem alyshyp, kokuroktoru kysylyp, kyinalgan undoru chygat. Alar tozokto bashyna tushkon katuu korkunuchtan undordu da ukpai kalyshat.

Kachan mushrikter: <<Chyndygynda Isa menen perishteler tozokko kirishet, antkeni bashkalar alarga syiynyshty>> deshkende, Allakh aitty: <<Chyndygynda aldyn ala Allakhtyn iliminde alar Isa syiaktuu baktyluulardan bolot dep zhazylgandar gana tozokton alys bolushat.
Alarga tozoktun unu da ugulbait. Zhana alar kon'uldoru kaalagan zhakshylyktarda zhana zhyrgalchylyktarda bolushat. Alardyn zhyrgalchylyktary ech kachan tugonboit>>.

Tozokko kirgenderdi al chulgap algan uchurdagy chon' korkunuch alardy korkunuchka salbait. Perishteler alarga: <<Bul silerge duinodo ubada kylyngan zhana andagy siler koro turgan zhyrgalchylyktardy suiunchulogon kunun'or>> - dep salamdashyp tosup alyshat.

Biz al kunu Asmandy barakty ichindegisi menen kosho togoloktop orogondoi orop koiobuz. Zhana insan zhana zhan-zhanybarlardy abalky zholu zharatkan abalda chogultabyz. Bizdin bul bergen ubadabyz buzulbait. Chyndygynda Biz bergen ubadabyzdy atkarabyz.
Biz saktalgan Tagdyr Kitebinde zhazgandan kiiin paigambarlarga tushurgon kitepterde da <<Zherdi Allakhka ish zhuzundo bash iigen yimanduu pendeleri muraska alyshat>> dep zhazyp koigonbuz.
Chynynda, Biz tushurgon nasaattarda Rabbisinin shariiatyna ylaiyk ibadat kylgan adamdar uchun zhetkiliktuu, paidaluu ulgu-nasaattar bar. Myna osholor andan paida alyshat.
Oo, Mukhammad! Biz seni butkul aalamga yraiym bolushun' uchun gana zhiberdik. Antkeni sen adamdardyn tuura zholgo tushushuno zhana alardy Allakhtyn azabynan kutkaruuga daiyma araket kylasyn'.

Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Chyndygynda maga Rabbim taraptan <<Silerdin chynygy kudaiyn'ar - Al zhalgyz kudai. Anyn sherigi zhok. Al - Allakh>> dep vakhii kylyndy. Andyktan siler Aga yiman keltirip moiun sungula zhana Aga ish zhuzundo bash iigile>>.

Oo, paigambar! Egerde alar sen alyp kelgen nerseden bash tartyshsa, aitkyn: <<Ortobuzdagy maga da, silerge da birdei bolgon ishti baaryn'arga tegiz zhetkirdim. Birok men Allakh silerge ubada kylgan azaptyn kachan tushorun bilbeimin>>.
Chyndygynda Allakh siler achyk aitkan zhana zhashyrgan sozdordu bilet. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Al zhakynda silerge anyn zhazasyn zhe syilygyn beret.

Men bilbeim, silerge azaptyn kechigip zhatkany balkim silerge bolgon synoodur? Zhe moonot beruu chygar zhe Allakhtyn iliminde belgilengen ubakytka cheiin kaapyrlygyn'arda, adashuun'arda ubaktyluu zhyrgalchylykta zhurguzup turuudur.

Allakhtyn elchisi (aga Allakhtyn salamattygy, tynchtygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) Rabbisine kairylyp: <<Oo, Rabbim! Kaapyrlyktan kaitpagan koomum menen bizdin ortobuzda Ozun' akyikat menen okum kyl! Siler aityp zhatkan kaapyrlyk zhana zhalgan sozdorun'orgo karshy Yraiymduu Rabbisibizden zhardam suraibyz>>.

Ei, adamdar! Rabbin'erdin buiruktaryn atkaryp zhana tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkula! Chyndygynda kyiamat menen koshtolo turgan zher titiroolor zhana bashka korkunuchtar - uluu nerse. Aga Allakh yraazy bolgon ishterdi kylyp daiardyk koruu mildet.

Al kundo siler katuu korkunuchtan ulam bala emgizgen aial balasyn unutup kalganyn, kosh boiluu aial boiundagysyn tushurup salganyn korosun'or. Al zherdegi katuu korkunuchtan adamdardy akylynan adashkan mas adamdardai abalda korosun'. Alar arak ichip mas bolushkan zhok. Birok Allakhtyn azabynyn kataaldygy alardy akyldarynan adashtyryp koidu.

Kachan Allakh kyiamat kunu menen koshtolo turgan korkunuchtardy aitkanda kyiamatty zhana kaira tiriluunu zhokko chygargandarga zhoop kylyp myndai dedi:
Adamdardyn arasynda oluktordu kaira tiriltuugo bolgon Allakhtyn kudurettuulugu tuurasynda taianar ilimi zhok turup talashkandar bar. Alar oz isheniminde zhana sozdorundo Rabbisine bash iibegen shaitandardy zhana adashtyrgan bashchylardy eerchishet.

Al bash iibegen adam menen shaitandyn tagdyryna <<Kim alardy eerchise zhana alarga ishense, anda alar any akyikat zholdon adashtyrat, oshondoi ele kaapyrlyk zhana kunoo kyldyryp tozok azabyna alyp barat>> dep zhazylgan.

Oo, adamdar! Olumdon kiiin silerdi kaira tiriltuugo bolgon kudurettuulugubuz tuuraluu shektenip zhatsan'ar, anda ozun'ordun zharalganyn'arga oi zhugurtup korgulochu. Biz tupku atan'ar Adamdy topuraktan zharattyk. Andan son' anyn urpaktaryn aialdyn zhatynyna atylyp kuiulgan erkektin bel suusunan zharattyk. Kiiin al koiuu kanga ailandy, kiiin tishtelgen etke okshosh bir tishtem etke ailandy, kiiin bir kesim etke ailandy, anan toluk kanduu tuiulduk bolup anan tiruu ymyrkai bolup torolgucho zhatynda boldu, zhe toluk kanduu tuiulduk bolboi zhatyndan tushup kaldy. Biz munu silerdi turduu baskychtarda zharatuuga kudurettuu ekenibizdi baiandoo uchun kyldyk. Zhana Biz Ozubuz kaalagan tuiulduktu belgiluu bir ubakka cheiin zhatynda karmaibyz. Al toguz ai. Kiiin silerdi enen'erdin kursagynan ymyrkai kylyp chygarabyz. Kiiin siler toluk akylga zhana kuch-kubatka zhetesin'er. Kee biroolorun'or aga zhetpei kaitysh bolot, kee biroolorun'or kuch-kubattan zhana akyldan alsyragan karylyk kurakka cheiin zhetesin'er. Al kezde silerdin abalyn'ar zhash naristenin abalynan da nachar bolot. Aga cheiin bilgenin da bilbei kalat. Oshondoi ele sen zherdi osumduk ospogon kurgak abalda korosun'. Egerde Biz aga zhamgyr suusun zhaadyrsak, osumduktor onup al achylat, alardyn onushu menen al koop kotorulot, anan kooz korunushtogu osumduktordun turlorun chygarat.

Silerdin abalky zharaluun'ar, anyn baskychtary zhana aran'ardan torolgondordun abaldary syiaktuu Biz silerge aityp otkon nerselerdi - chynygy akyikat siler syiyngan aikel-buttar emes, silerdi zharatkan Allakh chynygy akyikat ekenine yiman keltiruun'or uchun zhana Al oluktordu tirilterine, Al bardyk nersege kudurettuu zhana Any ech bir nerse alsyrata albasyna yiman keltiruun'or uchun aittyk.
Oshondoi ele kyiamat sozsuz kelerine yiman keltiruun'or uchun aittyk. Allakh alardyn kylgan ishterinin syilygyn zhe zhazasyn berish uchun oluktordu kaira tiriltip kabyrlarynan chygarat.

Allakh Taala uchunchu aiatta sokur eerchunun sebebinen bolgon adashuunun abaly tuuraluu aityp ottu, emi bul aiatta kaapyrlyktyn bashchylarynyn adashuusu kandai bolgonun aityp myndai dedi:
Kaapyrlardyn kee birleri akyikatka zhetkirgen, tuuralykka zhol korgozgon ilimi, Allakh taraptan tushkon Aga bagyttagan nurduu kitebi zhok turup ele, Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygy tuurasynda talasha berishet.

Al adamdardy yimandan zhana Allakhtyn dinine kirishinen burush uchun tekeberlenip moiun tolgoit. Kim ushundai sypatta bolso, anda anyn bul duinodogu zhazasy korduk bolot. Al emi akyrette aga kuiguzuuchu tozok azabyn tattyrabyz.
Aga aitylat: <<Bul kaapyrlyk zhana kunoo kylganyn' sebeptuu korgon azabyn'. Allakh adamdardan kunoo kylgandardy gana azaptait>>.

Adamdardyn arasynda Allakhka shektenip ara zholdo syiyngandar bar. Egerde al den-sooluk, bailyk syiaktuu zhakshylyktarga zhetse, anda yiman zholunda Allakhka syiynuusun ulanta beret. A eger ooru, kedeilik syiaktuu oor synoolorgo kabylsa, anda dinin zhamandykka zhoorup, andan kaityp ketet. Al bul duinosun zhogotot, anyn kaapyrlygy bul duinodo aga zhazylbagan nasibin ech kachan koboitpoit. Zhana al akyretin zhogotot, antkeni al Allakhtyn azabyna duushar bolot. Myna ushul anyk zhogotuu!

Al Allakhtan bashka aikel-buttarga syiynat. Alar aga zyian berishpeit, eger alarga bash iibestik kylgan bolso zhana paida da berishpeit, eger alarga bash iigen bolso. Anyn oshol paida da, zyian da berbegen aikel-buttarga kylgan dubasy - akyikattan alys bolgon adashuu.

Aikel-buttarga syiyngan bul kaapyr adam zhok paidasynan da anyk zyiany bolgon kudailarga duba kylat. Paida bul zhakta tursun, anyk ele zyianda turgan kudaiy kandai zhaman! Al koldoo suragandarga kandai zhaman koldoochu zhana aga zhanashkandarga kandai zhaman dos!

Chyndygynda Allakh yiman keltirgenderdi zhana zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandardy khansarailarynyn aldynan daryialar akkan beiishterge kirgizet. Chyndygynda Allakh Ozu kaalagandy kylat, kimge kaalasa yraiym kylat, kimdi kaalasa zhazalait. Any ech kim mazhburlai albait.

Kimde-kim Allakh bul duinodo zhana akyrette paigambaryna zhardam berbeit dep oiloso, anda uiunun tobosuno uzun zhip bailasyn da, kiiin ozun zherden uzulgondoi kylyp muuntsun. Anan karasyn, bul anyn ichindegi kyzhyrdanuusun ketiret beken. Al karshy chykkan adam kaalasa-kaalabasa dagy Allakh paigambaryna zhardam beret.

Biz silerge kaira tiriluugo achyk-aikyn dalilderibizdi baiandagan syiaktuu Mukhammadga da Kurandy achyk-aikyn aiattar turundo tushurduk. Allakh Oz urmaty menen kaalagan adamdaryna tuura zholgo iigilik beret.

Chyndygynda bul elderden Allakhka yiman keltirgender, zhoottor, sabiiler (kee bir paigambarlardy eerchigen toptor), khristiandar, otko tabyngandar zhana aikel-buttarga syiyngandardyn ortosunda Allakh kyiamat kunu okum kylyp, yimanduulardy beiishke kirgizet, kalgandaryn tozokko kirgizet. Chyndygynda Allakh pendelerinin bardyk sozdoruno zhana ishterine kubo. Alardyn ech nersesi Aga zhashyruun emes zhana Al zhakynda alardyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Oo, paigambar! Bilbeisin'bi, Allakhka asmandardagy perishteler, zherdegi adamdar menen zhinderdin yimanduulary moiun sunup sazhda kylyshat, oshondoi ele Aga Kun, Ai, asmandardagy zhyldyzdar, too-tashtar, bak-daraktar zhana zher betindegi zhan-zhanybarlar Aga moiun sunup sazhda kylyshat. Aga kop adamdar bash iiip sazhda kylyshat zhana kop adamdar moiun sunup sazhda kyluudan bash tartyshat. Osholorgo kaapyrlyktary uchun Allakhtyn azaby tushoru anyk. Egerde Allakh kimdir biroogo kaapyrlygy sebeptuu kordukdu zhana tomonduktu okum kylgan bolso, anda any ech kim urmattabait. Chyndygynda Allakh Ozu kaalagandy kylat. Any ech kim mazhburlai albait.

Kachan Allakh Taala Ozuno bash iiip sazhda kylgandardy zhana andan bash tartkandary baiandagan kezde anyn artynan ele alardyn kimisi kai zhakka baraary tuurasynda myndai dep aitty:
Kimibizdiki akyikat dep Rabbisi tuuraluu talashkan bul eki top - yimanduular menen kaapyrlar tobu. Kaapyrlar tobun kiiim adamdy chulgagandai tozok da alardy chulgap orop alat zhana alardyn bashtarynan katuu kainagan suu kuiulat.
Anyn ushunchalyk ysyktygynan alardyn ichindegi ichegi-karyndary ezilip-eerip ketet zhana terilerine zhetkende alar da ylzhyrap-eerip ketet.
Tozokto alar uchun ataiyn temir soiuldar bolot. Any menen perishteler alardy bashtaryna urushat.
Alar tozoktogu kabylgan kyiynchylyktyn kataaldygynan al zhaktan chyguuga araket zhasashkan saiyn kaira-kaira azapka kaitarylyshyp zhana alarga: <<Tozoktun kuikalagan azabyn tatkyla!>> - dep aitylat.

Al emi yimanduular tobu - alar Allakhka yiman keltirgender zhana zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandar. Allakh alardy khansarailarynyn aldynan daryialar akkan beiishterge kirgizet. Allakh alarga altyn bilerikterdi zhana bermetterdi tagyp zhasantat. Alar al zhakta zhibek kiiimderdi kiiishet.

Allakh alardy duino zhashoosunda kuboluk kelmesi "Laa ilaakha illallakh", "Allakhu akbar" (Allakhty uluktoo) zhana "Alkhamdulillakh" (Allakhka maktoolordu aituu) syiaktuu asyl sozdorgo bagyttagan. Oshondoi ele maktoogo ylaiyk Islam zholuna bagyttagan.

Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandarga zhana bashkalardy Islamga kiruudon burgandarga, oshondoi ele adamdardy Khudaibiia zhylyndagydai Al'-Kharam mechitinen toskondorgo zhakynda kyinoochu azapty tattyrabyz. Biz adamdar uchun namazdarynda kybyla kylgan zhana azhylyk menen umranyn zhorolgolorunon kylgan Al'-Kharam mechiti - al zherde zhashagan mekkelikke da, Mekke elinen emes syrttan kelgenderge da birdei. Kim anyn ichinde akyikattan burulup ataiylap kunoo ish kylgan bolso, anda Biz aga kyinoochu azapty tartyrabyz.

Oo, paigambar! Estechi, Biz Ibrakhimge Kaabanyn zhaigashkan zherin zhana anyn chegarasyn aityp berdik. Al aga cheiin belgisiz bolup ketken. Oshondoi ele Biz aga vakhii kyldyk: <<Maga syiynuuda ech kimdi sherik kylba, zhalgyz Ozumo gana syiyn zhana tavaf kylgandar (Kaabany ailangandar) menen namaz okugandar uchun Uiumdu ichki zhana syrtky ypylastardan tazala>>.

Adamdarga zhar salyp, Biz saga kur dep buirugan bul Uigo alardy azhylyk kyluuga chakyr! Alar saga zhoo zhalan' zhe zhol zhurup aryktap azgan toolordu minip kelishet. Alardy tooloru alysky zholdordon tashyp kelet.

Alar kunoonun kechiriluusu, sooptorgo zhetuu zhana birdiktuu sozgo keluu syiaktuu paidalardy alyp kelgen nerselerge kubo bolushsun. Oshondoi ele alarga berilgen too, ui, koi syiaktuu yryskylary uchun Allakhka shugur keltiruu maksatta belgiluu kundordo soiushkan kurmandyktaryna Allakhtyn atyn atashsyn. Al kundor - Zulkhizhzha aiynyn onu zhana andan kiiinki uch kun. Al kurmandyktardan ozun'or zhegile zhana andan baikush, kembagaldardy tamaktandyrgyla!

Andan kiiin alar azhylyktyn kalgan zhorolgolorun atkaryshsyn, chachtaryn zhana tyrmaktaryn alyshsyn, ikhram kiiiminde bir neche kundor zhurgonu sebeptuu chogulup kalgan denelerindegi kirlerinen tazalanyshsyn. Zhana azhylyk zhe umra zhe kurmandyk chaluu syiaktuu ozdoruno mildet kylgan ubadalaryn atkaryshsyn. Oshondoi ele Allakh zaalymdardyn karamagynan chygargan Uidu (Kaabany) ailanyp (parz) tavafyn kylyshsyn.

Biz silerge chachty zhana tyrmakty aluu, kirlerdi ketiruu, ozuno mildet kylgan ubadalardy atkaruu zhana Uidu tavaf kyluu syiaktuu buirugan nerselerdi - Allakh silerge mildet kyldy. Allakhtyn silerge kylgan mildetterin urmattagyla! Kimde-kim ikhramda zhurgondo Allakh tashta dep buirugan nerselerdi tashtap, Allakhty uluktash uchun Anyn chekterin karmansa zhana Al aram kylgan nerselerdi adal debese, anda bul kylgany Allakhtyn aldynda al uchun duinodo da, akyrette da zhakshyraak. Ei, adamdar! Silerge too, ui zhana koi syiaktuu aibandar adal kylyndy. Oshondoi ele alardyn ichinen khami, bakhira zhana vasyla (Islamdan aldynky doordo zhashagan arab mushrikterinde bul aty atalgan zhanybarlardy buttaryna arnap zhe kaisy bir nersege zhetkende paidalanuuga bolboit dep okum chygaryp, tashtap salyshchu. Khami: bul toonun erkegi bolup sanalat. Andan bir neche zhakshy tukum alynsa, any boldu, kyzmatty buttu degendei talaaga bosh koiup zhiberishchu. Bakhira: egerde too zhandygy kop zholu bala tuugan bolso anyn kulagyna belgi salyp, boldu emi any paidalanuuga bolboit dep tashtap koiushchu. Vasyla: bul toonun urgachysy egerde udaama-udaa bir neche zholu urgaachy gana botolordu tuugan bolso, any da kyzmaty buttu dep paidalanbastan talaaga bosh koiup zhiberishchu. Islam bul tuura emes okumdordu zhokko chygargan.) toolorun silerge aram kylgan emes. Al silerge olumtuk, kan zh.b.u.s. Kuranda aram dep kelgen nerselerdi gana aram kyldy. Emi siler yplas aikel-buttardan alys bolgula! Oshondoi ele Allakhka zhana Anyn zharatkandaryna karata aitylgan zhalgan zhalaa sozdordon alys bolgula!

Siler Allakh Ozu yraazy bolgon dinden bashka dinderden alys bolup, syiynuuda Aga ech bir nerseni sherik kylbagyla! Kimde-kim Allakhka shirk kylsa, al asmandan kulap tushkon zhe kushtar any et-soogun apchyp zhulushkan zhe shamal any alys zhaktarga uchurup tashtagan syiaktuu.

Myna ushular - Allakhty zhalgyzdoo, Aga yklastuu boluu, aikel-buttardan zhana zhalgan sozdordon alys boluu syiaktuu Allakh buirugan nerseler. Kimde-kim kurmandyk chaluu, azhylyk zhorolgolorun atkaruu syiaktuu Allakhtyn dinii belgilerin urmattasa, anda al urmattagany zhuroktordun Rabbisine bolgon takybalygynan.

Siler Yiyk Uido kurmandykka chalgan mal-zhandyktarda siler uchun paidalar bar. Siler alardy Allakh zaalymdardyn karamagynan chygargan Ozunun Uiuno zhakyn zherde soigongo cheiin belgiluu ubakyt aralygynda minesin'er, uruk alasyn'ar, zhunun zhana sutun paidalanasyn'ar.

Biz murunku bardyk ummottorgo Allakhka zhakyndash uchun kan chygaruuga bailanyshkan dinii zhorolgonu kylganbyz. Biz any alarga bergen too, ui zhana koi syiaktuu yryskylary uchun Allakhka shugur kyluu maksatta alar kurmandyktardy soiup zhatkan uchurda Allakhtyn atyn atasyn degen umutto kylganbyz. Ei, adamdar! Silerdin chynygy kudaiyn'ar zhalgyz kudai zhana Anyn sherigi zhok. Zhalgyz aga gana moiun sunup bash iigile! Ei, paigambar! Yklastuularga, zhalbaruuchularga suiunchu kabardy zhetkir!

Alarga Allakh tuuraluu eskertilgende Anyn zhazasynan korkot, Anyn buiruguna karshy chykpait, bashyna kelgen baleege sabyr kylat zhana namazdy zhetkiliktuu atkarat. Allakh alarga bergen yryskydan zhakshy zholdorgo sarptait.

Biz Yiyk Uigo kurmandykka soiulgan toolor menen uilardy siler uchun dinii zhorolgo zhana belgi kyldyk. Alarda siler uchun duinoluk zhana dinii paidalar bar. Ei, kurmandyk chaluuchular! Alardy soiordo "Bismillakh (Allakhtyn ysymy menen)" dep aitkyla! Aga cheiin buttaryn tuzdop, al kachpash uchun tike turgan abalynda bir butuna tushoo salgyla. Soigondon kiiin al kaptalyna zhygylat, andan ozun'or zhegile, oshondoi ele suragan kedeilerge zhana suroodon uiattuulugunan tyiylgan kembagaldarga bergile! Oshol syiaktuu ele alar menen zhuk tashuu uchun zhana alardy minish uchun silerge moiun sundurduk. Zhana Allakhka zhakyndash uchun alardy kai zherde soison'or da bash bere turgan kylyp silerge moiun sundurup koiduk. Balkim Allakh silerge alardy bash iidirgen zhakshylygyna shugur kylaarsyn'ar.

Silerdin chalgan kurmandygyn'ardyn eti da, kany da Allakhka zhetpeit zhana Aga kotorulboit. Birok bul nersede silerdin Allakhtan bolgon takybalygyn'ar gana kotorulot. Andyktan Aga zhakyndash uchun bash iiip atkarganyn'ardy yklastuuluk menen kylgyla. Oshondoi ele Allakh silerdi tuura zholgo salgany uchun Aga shugur kylyp, Any uluktashyn'ar uchun zhandyktardy silerge moiun sundurdu. Oo, paigambar! Rabbisine bolgon syiynuuda zhana adamdar menen bolgon mamilede zhakshylyk kylgandarga suiunchu kabardy zhetkir!

Allakh yiman keltirgenderdi dushmandarynyn zhamandygynan korgoit. Chyndygynda Allakh amanatka kyianatchyldardy, Allakhtyn zhakshylygyn tanyp, Aga shugur kylbagandardy zhakshy korboit. Teskerisinche, alardy zhek korot.

Kachan Allakh Taala yimanduulardy korgoorun aitkanda alardyn kon'uldoru tynch aldy. Oshondo alarga kaapyrlar menen sogushuuga uruksat berip myndai dedi:
Mushrikterdin chabuuluna tush bolgon yimanduular dushmandary taraptan korgon zulumduktary uchun alarga karshy sogushuuga Allakh uruksat berdi. Albette Allakh yimanduularga dushmandaryna karshy sogushsuz ele zhardam beruugo kudurettuu. Birok Anyn daanyshmandygy yimanduulardy kaapyrlarga karshy sogushturup synoonu talap kylat.

Kaapyrlar alardy oz mekeninen zulumduk menen alar ech kandai kylmysh kylyshpasa da "Rabbibiz Allakh, Andan bashka Rabbibiz zhok" dep aitkandary uchun gana kuup chygyshty. Egerde Allakh paigambarlaryna zhana yimanduularga dushmandarga karshy sogushuunu okum kylbaganda, alardyn ibadat zhailaryna kol salyshyp, kechilderdin ibadatkanalaryn, khristiandardyn chirkoolorun, zhoottordun sinagogalaryn, namaz okuu uchun daiardalgan zhana Allakhty kop zikir kylgan musulmandardyn mechitterin talkalashmak. Allakhtyn dinine zhana paigambaryna zhardam bergenderge Allakh sozsuz zhardam beret. Chyndygynda Allakh dinine zhardam bergenderge zhardam beruugo Kubattuu zhana Any ech kim zhen'e albagan Kudurettuu.

Zhardam ubada kylyngan al adamdarga eger Biz dushmandaryna karshy zhardam berip, alardy zher betinde biilik kyldyrsak, anda alar namazdy toluk turdo atkaryshat, mal-mulktorunon zeket berishet, shariiat buirugandy buirushat zhana al tyigandy tyiyshat. Soop zhe zhaza aluuda ishterdin akybeti zhalgyz Allakhka gana kaitat.

Oo, paigambar! Egerde elin' seni zhalganga chygarsa, anda sabyr kyl! Sen koomu zhalganga chygargan paigambarlardyn birinchisi emessin'. Senin koomun'dan murun Nukhtu koomu zhalganga chygargan, Aad koomu Khuddu zhalganga chygargan, Samud koomu Salikhti zhalganga chygargan.
Ibrakhimdi koomu zhalganga chygargan, Luttu koomu zhalganga chygargan.

Madiian eli Shuaibdy zhalganga chygargan, Faraon menen anyn koomu Musany zhalganga chygargan. Men alardyn koomdoruna moonot berip zhazany kechiktirdim, kiiin alardy azap menen karmadym. Karachy, Men alardyn kaapyrlygyn kaitaryp azaptap zhok kylganymdy.

Biz kaapyrlyk sebeptuu zulum kylgan nechendegen shaarlardy kyrgyn azap menen kyiratyp zhok kyldyk. Emi alardyn uiloru talkalanyp, zhashoochulary zhok een kaldy. Nechendegen kuduktar tashtandyda kaldy, alardan suu algandar kyirap zhok boldu. Nechendegen biiik kooz khansarailar andagy zhashagandardy azaptan korgoi albady.

Paigambar alyp kelgendi zhalganga chygargandar oshol kyiragan shaarlardyn urandylaryn korush uchun zher betin kydyryshpaiby? Akyl zhugurtup ulgu-nasaat alyshpaiby, alardyn okuialaryn kabyl aluu menen ugup sabak alyshpaiby? Chyndygynda kozu korbogonduk sokurluk emes, chynygy kyiratuuchu sokurluk zhuroktun, tushunuktun sokurlugu. Antkeni andai adam ulgu da, sabak da albait.

Oo, paigambar! Koomun'dun kaapyrlaryna bul duinonun erte azaby zhana kiiin bolo turgan akyret azaby eskertilgende alar senden any tezdetchi dep shashtyryshat. Allakh alarga bergen ubadasyn ech kachan buzbait. Alarga bul duinodo bolgon erte azaptardyn biri Badr kunu boldu. Al emi akyrettegi azaptyn bir kunu siler bul duinodo eseptegen zhyl sanak boiuncha min' zhylga barabar.

Dagy nechendegen shaarlardy alar kaapyrlyk kylyp zalym bolushsa da Men alarga azapty kechiktirdim zhana moonot berip alarga azapty tezdetpedim. Kiiin alardy kutuusuzdon kyrgyn azap menen aldym. Kyiamatta Maga gana kaitasyn'ar. Oshondo Men silerdi kaapyrlygyn'ar uchun tuboluk azap menen zhazalaim.
"Ei, adamdar! Chynynda, men silerge eskertuuchu elemin. Maga berilgen dindi silerge zhetkiremin zhana achyk eskertip, (tushunduromun)" dep ait.
Al emi yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandar uchun Rabbisi taraptan kunooloruno bolgon kechirim bar zhana alar uchun beiishte ech kachan tugonbogon berekeluu yrysky bar.

Bizdin aiattarybyzdy zhalganga chygaruuga arakettenip Allakhty alsyratabyz zhana Anyn azabynan kutulup ketebiz dep oilogondor - alar tozok eeleri. Alar tozok menen dos dosko zhanashkandai birge bolushup, andan kutulushpait.

Oo, paigambar! Biz senden murda kandai elchi zhe paigambar zhiberbeili, al Allakhtyn kitebin okup zhatkanda shaitan anyn okugan kyraatyna any vakhiiden degendei kylyp adamdardy chatashtyrgan nerselerdi baikatpai koshkon. Allakh shaitan koshkon nerselerdi zhok kylat zhana Oz aiattaryn bekem ornotot. Allakh bardyk nerseni Biluuchu. Aga ech bir nerse zhashyruun emes. Al zharatuuda, tagdyr kyluuda zhana bashkaruuda Daanyshman.

Shaitan paigambardyn okuganyna koshkon nerselerdi Allakh eki zhuzduulor uchun zhana zhuroktoru merez bolup katyp kalgan mushrikter uchun synoo kylyp koidu. Chyndygynda eki zhuzduulordon zhana mushrikterden bolgon zaalymdar Allakh zhana Anyn elchisi menen anyk dushmandykta zhana akyikat zholdon alys.

Allakh ilim bergen adamdar Mukhammadga tushkon Kuran akyikat ekenin anyk bilishsin. Oo, paigambar! Allakh any saga vakhii kyldy, oshondo al sebeptuu alardyn yimandary kuchodu zhana zhuroktoru Aga moiun sundu. Chyndygynda Allakh yiman keltirgenderdi ech kandai burmalanbagan tuz akyikat zholgo salat. Bul alardyn Aga moiun sungandarynyn syilygy.

Allakhka kaapyr bolgondor zhana Anyn elchisin zhalganga chygargandar Allakh saga tushurgon Kuranga shektene beret. Alardyn bul kylygy, kapystan Kyiamat kaiym bolgongo cheiin zhe alarga ech kandai zhakshylyk zhana yraiym bolboi turgan kun kelgenge cheiin ulana beret, bul kun alar uchun Kyiamat bolot.

Azap ubada kylyngandar bilip alyshsyn: kele turgan kyiamat kunundogu biilik Allakhka gana taandyk. Al kundo Any menen ech kim talashyp tartyshpait. Al yimanduular menen kaapyrlardyn ortosunda okum kylat. Alardyn ar birine ozdoruno ylaiyk okum kylat. Oshondo Allakhka yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandar uchun ech kachan butpogon tuboluk zhyrgalchylyk beiishteri bolgon uluu sooptor bar.
Al emi Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyp, paigambarybyzga tushurgon aiattarybyzdy zhalganga chygargandar uchun tozokto Allakh alardy kordogon azap bar.

Allakhtyn yraazylygyn zhana dindi kubattoonu kozdop oz ui-zhailaryn zhana mekenin tashtap, kiiin Anyn zholunda sogushta olturulgondorgo zhe olgondorgo Allakh beiishte ech kachan tugonbogon en' sonun yryskylardy beret. Chyndygynda Allakh en' zhakshy yrysky beruuchu.

Allakh alardy ozdoru yraazy bolgon beiish zhailaryna sozsuz kirgizet. Chyndygynda Allakh alardyn kylgan ish-araketterin zhana nietterin anyk Biluuchu. Zhana Al alardyn kemchilikteri uchun zhazany tezdetpegen Ken' peiil.

Bul aitylgandar, bashkacha aitkanda Allakh zholunda kochkondordu beiishke kirgizuu, zalymga ozundoi kylyp zhoop kaitaruunun uruksattygy, al bul nersede kunookor bolboit. Egerde zalym kaira dagy zulumduk kyla turgan bolso, Allakh zalymga karshy aga zhardam beret. Chyndygynda Allakh yimanduulardyn kunoolorun Kechiruuchu, alarga daiym kechirimduu.

Bul zhapa chekken adamga bolgon koldoo. Antkeni Allakh Ozu kaalagan nersege kudurettuu. Anyn kudurettuulugunon -- birin ekinchisinen uzartyp zhe kyskartyp tundu kunduzgo, kunduzdu tungo kirgizet. Allakh pendelerinin sozdorun Uguuchu, ish-araketterin Biluuchu. Aga alardyn ech biri zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda alarga syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Allakh tundu kunduzgo, kunduzdu tungo kirgizgeni tuuraluu bul aitylgandar Allakhtyn Ozu Akyikat Zat ekendigin korgozup-bilgizet, oshondoi ele Anyn dini akyikat, ubadasy akyikat zhana yimanduulardy koldoosu akyikat. Al emi mushrikter syiyngan Andan bashka aikel-buttar ech kandai negizi zhok zhalgan. Zhana Allakh Ozunun Zaty, kudureti zhana kaarduulugu menen zharatylgandardan Biiik zhana Ozunun biiik tutuusu, uluktugu zhana yiyktygy menen Uluk.

Oo, paigambar! Korboisun'bu, Allakh asmandan zhamgyrdy tushurup, al zhaagan zhamgyrdan kiiin zherden osumduktor onup chygyp al zhapzhashyl bolup kaldy. Chyndygynda Allakh pendelerine Meerimduu, antkeni alarga zhamgyrdy tushurdu zhana zherden osumduktor chykty. Al pendelerine emne paidaluu ekenin en' zhakshy Biluuchu. Alardyn ech nersesi Aga zhashyruun emes.
Asmandardagy zhana zherdegi bardyk mulk zhalgyz Aga gana taandyk. Chyndygynda Allakh Ozu gana ech bir nersege, ech kimge muktazh bolbogon Bai, butkul abalda Maktoogo tatyktuu.

Oo, paigambar! Allakh saga zhana adamdarga zher betindegi zhanybarlardy, zhansyz zattardy ozun'ordun paidan'ar zhana muktazhdygyn'ar uchun bash iidirip koigonun, oshondoi ele Anyn buirugu zhana moiun sunduruusu menen bir shaardan ekinchi shaarga den'izde suzgon kemelerde siler zhurgongo zhen'il kylyp koigonun korbodun'bu? Al Oz uruksaty menen asmandy zherge kulap ketuusunon karmap turat. Eger Al aga kulap ketuugo uruksat bergende, al sozsuz kulamak. Chyndygynda Allakh adamdarga Meerimduu, Yraiymduu. Antkeni Al adamdardyn zulumduguna karabastan bul nerselerdi alarga moiun sundurup koidu.

Allakh silerdi zhok nerseden zharatyp tiriltti. Kiiin omurun'or butkondo silerdi olturot. Andan son' olumdon kiiin kylgan ish-araketterin'erge surak alysh uchun zhana anyn syilyk zhe zhazasyn berish uchun silerdi kaira tiriltet. Chyndygynda insan Allakhtan bashkaga syiynuu menen Anyn zhakshylyktary achyk-aikyn korunup tursa da, tanyp ketuuchu.

Biz ar bir din eelerine ozuncho shariiat kylganbyz. Alar oz shariiattaryn atkaryshkan. Oo, paigambar! Mushrikter zhana bashka dindegiler senin shariiatyn' tuuraluu talashpasyn! Sen alarga karaganga akyikatka tatyktuusun'. Antkeni alar tuura emes zholdogular. Adamdardy zhalgyz Allakhka gana yklastuuluk menen syiynuuga chakyr! Chyndygynda sen ech kandai burmalanuusu zhok tuz zholdosun'.

Egerde alar buga da konushpoi, dalildin achyktygynan kiiin da seni menen talasha berishse, anda alardyn ishin Allakhka tapshyr da, alarga eskertuu iretinde ait: <<Allakh siler kylyp zhatkan ishterin'erdi zhakshy bilet. Kylgan ishterin'erdin ech biri aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda al uchun silerge zhazasyn zhe syilygyn beret>>.
Allakh kyiamat kunu yimanduular menen kaapyrlardyn bul duinodogu dinge bailanyshkan ishterdegi talashyp tartyshkan nerseleri tuuraluu pendelerinin ortosunda okum kylat.

Oo, paigambar! Bilbeisin'bi, Allakh asmandagy zhana zherdegi nerselerdin bardygyn bilet. Alardagy ech bir nerse Aga zhashyruun emes. Chyndygynda munun ilimi saktalgan Tagdyr Kitepte zhazylgan. Bul ilimdin baarysy Allakhga zhen'il.

Mushrikter Allakhtan bashka aikel-buttarga syiynyshat, birok Allakh kitepterinde alarga syiynuuga ech kandai dalil tushurgon emes. Zhana alardyn ilimden da aga ech kandai dalilderi zhok. Alardyn taiangan nersesi - ata-babalaryna sokur eerchuuloru gana. Zalimderge tushkon Allakhtyn azabyn toktotkon ech bir zhardamchy, korgoochu bolboit.

Egerde sen alarga achyk-aikyn Kuran aiattaryn okusan', Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyshkandar alardy ukkan kezde kabagyn tuiup zhaktyrbagandaryn zhuzdorunon ele bilesin'. Alar katuu yzyrynganynan Bizdin aiattarybyzdy okugandardy mykchyp salgylary kelet. Oo, paigambar! Alarga ait: <<Silerge bul yzyrynganyn'ardan, kabagyn'ardy tuigonun'ordon da zhaman nerseni aitaiynby? Al - tozok! Allakh kaapyrlardy aga kirgizem dep ubada kylgan. Al bara turgan zhai kandai gana zhaman!>>.

Ei, adamdar! Keltirilgen misalga kulak salgyla, sabak algyla, chyndygynda siler syiynyp zhatkan Allakhtan bashka aikel-buttar alsyzdyktary sebeptuu kichinekei bolgon chymyndy da zharata alyshpait. Egerde alardyn baary birigip any zharatabyz deshse da zharata alyshpait. A eger al chymyn aikel-buttardyn ustundogu atyrdan zhe oshol syiaktuu nerseden alyp alsa, alar any andan kaitara da alyshpait. Alar chymyndy da zharata alyshpasa zhana andan oz nerselerin da kaitaryp ala alyshpasa, anda alar andan chon' nerselerdi zharata albashy anyk nerse. Anan Allakhtan bashka alarga alsyzdygyna karabai kantip syiynyp zhatasyn'ar?! Talap kyluuchu da alsyz, al aikel kudaiy, al chymyn alyp koigon nerseni da kaitaryp ala albait. Zhana talap kylyngany da alsyz, anysy bolso chymyn.

Alar Allakh menen katar kee bir nerselerge syiynyp Any chyndap uluktashpady. Chyndygynda Allakh oto Kubattuu. Asmandar menen zherdi zhana alardyn ortosundagy nerselerdi zharatuu Anyn kuch-kudurettuulugunon. Al Kudurettuu. Any ech kim zhen'e albait. Al emi mushrikterdin aikel-buttary ech nerseni zharata albagan alsyz zhana tomon.

Allakh taala perishtelerden elchilerdi tandap alat zhana adamdardan da elchilerdi tandap alat. Al Zhebreiil syiaktuu perishtelerdin kee birin adamzattan bolgon paigambarlarga zhiberdi. Oshondoi ele adamzattan bolgon elchilerdi ozdoruno okshogon insandarga zhiberdi. Chyndygynda Allakh mushrikterdin Anyn elchileri tuuraluu aityp zhatkandaryn Uguuchu zhana elchilikke kimdi tandash kerek ekenin Biluuchu.

Allakh Taala perishtelerden zhana adamzattan bolgon elchilerinin alar zharalganga cheiinki zhana olumdon kiiinki abaldaryn bilet. Kyiamatta ishter zhalgyz Allakhka gana kaitat. Antkeni Al pendelerin kaira tiriltip, alardyn kylgan ishterinin syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

O, Allakhka yiman keltirgender zhana Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Kozdogonun'orgo zhetuu zhana korkkonun'ardan kutuluunu umut kylsan'ar, anda uruku zhana sazhdany zhalgyz Allakhka bagyshtap namaz okugula! Oshondoi ele sadaga beruu, karym-katnash kyluu symal zhakshy ishterdi atkargyla!

Siler Allakh zholunda Anyn yraazylygy uchun gana sogushkula! Al silerdi tandady zhana dinin'erdi ech kandai tardygy, katuulugu bolbogon aikol kyldy. Bul aikol din - silerdin baban'ar Ibrakhimdin dini. Paigambar ozuno buirulgan nerseni silerge zhetkirgenine kubo bolushu uchun zhana siler dagy murunku paigambarlar oz ummottoruno zhetkirgenine kubo boluun'ar uchun Allakh silerdi murunku kitepterde zhana Kuranda "musulmandar" dep atady. Emi siler ushul nerselerge namazdy toluk atkaruu menen Allakhka shugur kylgyla! Oshondoi ele mal-mulkun'ordon zeket bergile, Allakhka kalkalangyla, bardyk ishin'erde Aga gana taiangyla! Al koldoo suragan yimanduularga kandai zhakshy Koldoochu! Zhana Al zhardam suragandarga kandai zhakshy zhardam Beruuchu! Any kozhoiun tutsan'ar Al silerdi koldoit, Andan zhardam surasan'ar Al zhardam beret.
Allakhka yiman keltirgender, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar kozdogon maksattaryna zhetip zhana korkkon nerselerinen kutulup zhen'ishke zhetishti.
Alar namaz okushkanda ozdorun tomon tutushat zhana namazda dene-mucholoru tynch alyp, zhuroktorun ech bir nerse alaksytpait.
Alar zhalgandan, paidasyz nerselerden zhana kunoo sozdor menen kunoo ishterden bash tartkandar.
Alar ozdorun yplas ishterden taza tutkandar zhana zeket berip mal-mulktorun tazalagandar.
Alar zhynys mucholorun zynadan, bachabazdyktan zhana buzukuluktan saktashkandar. Alar abiiirduu, taza adamdar.
Birok nikeluu aialdary zhana kol astyndagy kun'doru menen zhynystyk zhana bashka zholdor menen yrakhat alyshkany uchun aiyptalyshpait.
Al emi kim nikeluu aialdarynan zhana kol astyndagy kun'dorunon bashkalar menen yrakhat aluunu izdese, anda al adal zholdu tashtap aram zholgo otup Allakhtyn chekterinen chykty.
Alar Allakhtyn zhana Anyn pendelerinin aldyndagy amanattaryn zhana ubadalaryn buzbastan toluk atkaryshat.
Alar namazdaryn daiym oz ubagynda parzdary, vazhipteri zhana mustakhabdary menen kosho toluk okushat.
Myna ushul sypattarga ee adamdar -- osholor muras aluuchular.
Alar beiishtin en' biiik zherin muraska alyshkandar. Alar al zhakta tuboluk kalyshat zhana alardyn zhyrgalchylyktary tugoboit.
Kiiin Biz anyn urpaktaryn torot ubagyna cheiin zhatynda zhailanyshkan bel suudan zharatyp koboittuk.

Andan son' al zhatyndagy zhaigashkan bel suudan kochkul koiuu kandy zharattyk. Kiiin al kochkul koiuu kandy tishtelgen bir kesim et kyldyk. Kiiin al bir kesim etten katuu sooktordu zharattyk. Kiiin al sooktorgo et kaptadyk. Andan son' Biz aga zhan salyp, bashka zharatylyshta osturo bashtap, zhashoogo chygardyk. Zharatuuchulardyn en' myktysy yiyk bolgon Allakh.
Ei, adamdar! Andan son' siler ushul zhoshoonun baskychtarynan otkondon kiiin azhalyn'ar zhetkende olosun'or.
Andan son' siler olgondon kiiin kylgan ishterin'erge surak berish uchun kyiamat kunu kabyrlaryn'ardan kairadan tirilesin'er.
Ei, adamdar! Biz silerdin ustun'orgo kabat-kabat zheti asmandy zharattyk. Biz Ozubuz zharatkan nerselerden beikapar emespiz zhana alardy unutkan da zhokpuz.

Biz asmandan kerektuu olchomdo zhamgyr suusun tushurduk, al kop bolup zyian berbeit zhana az bolup zhetishsiz bolboit. Zhana any adamdar menen zhan-zhanybarlar paidalanyshy uchun zher betinde tura turgan kyldyk. Chyndygynda Biz any alar paidalana albai turgandai kylyp ketirip koiuuga da kuduretibiz zhetet.
Biz al suu menen kurma zhana zhuzum zh.b. baktardy osturobuz. Al baktarda siler uchun anzhir, anar zhana alma syiaktuu ar kandai turdogu zhana tustogu momo-zhemishter bar. Siler andan zheisin'er.
Zhana Biz silerge al suu menen Sinai toosunun aimagynda oskon Zaitun daragyn osturduk. Anyn momosunon mai chygarylyp, any syipanyshat zhana andan nan malyp zhechu tatymal alynat.

Ei, adamdar! Chyndygynda siler uchun (too, ui, koi syiaktuu) ui zhanybarlarynda ibarat-ornoktor bar. Siler alardy Allakhtyn kudurettuuluguno zhana silerge kylgan meerimine dalil kylasyn'ar. Biz silerge alardyn ichinen chykkan ichkenge zhagymduu taza suttu ichirebiz. Siler uchun alarda koptogon paidalar bar. Siler alardy minesin'er, zhunun zhana tybytyn paidalanasyn'ar zhana etterinen zheisin'er.
Kurgaktykta ui zhanybarlarynan toolordun ustundo, al emi den'izde kemelerdin ustundo zhurosun'or.

Biz Nukhtu Allakh zholuna chakyruu uchun oz eline zhiberdik. Al alarga aitty: <<Oo, elim! Zhalgyz Allakhka syiyngyla! Siler uchun Andan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok. Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp zhana tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkpoisun'arby?!>>.

Oshondo anyn elinen Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgan kadyrluu adamdar menen bashchylary oz taraptashtaryna zhana zhalpy elge aityshty: <<Myna bu ozun paigambarmyn dep oilop zhatkan adam silerge okshogon ele adam. Al silerdin ustun'ordon biilik kylyp, bashchy bolgusu kelip zhatat. Egerde Allakh bizge paigambar zhiberuunu kaalasa, anda adamzattan emes, perishtelerden zhibermek. Biz munun aitkandaryn bizden murun zhashap otkon ata-babalarybyzdan ukkan emespiz.
Al ozu aitkanyn ozu tushunbogon zhin tiigen adam. Anyn ishi adamdarga achyk bolgongo cheiin any kutup turgula!>>.
Nukh (aga Allakhtyn salamattygy-tynchtygy bolsun) aitty: <<Oo, Rabbim! Alar meni zhalganga chygargany sebeptuu alardan och alyp, maga alarga karshy zhardam ber!>>.

Oshondo Biz aga vakhii kyldyk: <<Bizdin koz aldybyzda zhana Biz saga kantip zhasashty uirotkondoi kylyp keme kur! Kachan alardy zhok kyluu tuuraluu buirugubuz kelgende tandyr kainap, zherden kuch menen suu atyrylyp chykkanda, kemege ar bir tiruu zhandyktan andan tukum ulash uchun erkek-urgaachysynan sal. Oshondoi ele ui-bulon'du sal, birok aialyn' zhana balan' syiaktuu Allakh taraptan kyiroogo uchurait dep aldyn ala zhazylgandardy salba. Kaapyrlygy menen zulumduk kylyshkandardy kutkar zhe kyiroogo uchuratpa dep Maga kairylba! Chyndygynda alar topon suuga chokturulup sozsuz kyiroogo uchurashat>>.
Kachan sen zhana seni menen aman kala turgan yimanduular kemege tushkondo myndai dep aitkyn: <<Kaapyr koomdu kyiratyp, bizdi alardan kutkargan Allakhka cheksiz maktoolor bolsun>>.
Zhana aitkyn: <<Oo, Rabbim! Meni zher betindegi berekeluu zhaiga tushur. Sen en' zhakshy zhaigashtyruuchusun'!>>.

Chyndygynda bul aitylgandarda, tagyraak aitkanda Nukhtu zhana any menen birge bolgon yimanduulardy kutkaryp, kaapyrlardy zhok kyluuda - Biz paigambarlarybyzga zhardam beruugo zhana alardy zhalganga chygargandardy zhok kyluuga kudurettuu ekenibizge achyk-aikyn belgiler bar. Chyndygynda Biz Nukhtu eline any paigambar kylyp zhiberip, yimanduunu kaapyrdan zhana moiun sungandy kunookordon aiyrmalash uchun anyn koomun synadyk.
Andan son' Nukhtun koomun zhok kylgandan kiiin bashka koomdu paida kyldyk.

Alardy Allakhka chakyrysh uchun ozdorunun arasynan paigambar zhiberdik. Al alarga aitty: <<Zhalgyz Allakhka syiyngyla! Siler uchun Andan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok. Allakhtyn tyigandaryn tashtap zhana buiruktaryn atkaryp Andan korkpoisun'arby?!>>.

Anyn elinen Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgan, akyretti zhana andagy bolo turgan syilyk zhe zhazany zhalganga chygargan, bul duino zhashoosunda Biz alarga ken' kylyp bergen zhakshylyktarda asha chapkan kadyrluu adamdar menen bashchylary oz taraptashtaryna zhana zhalpy elge aityshty: <<Myna bu silerge okshogon ele adam. Al siler zhegendi zheit, siler ichkendi ichet. Al silerge paigambar bolup zhiberilgidei ech kandai artykchylykka ee emes.

Egerde ozun'orgo okshogon, silerden ech kandai artykchylykka ee bolbogon adamga eerchip, aga bash iiip, kudailaryn'ardy tashtasan'ar, anda siler anyk zyianga uchurap zhana da aga bash iigenin'erden ech bir paida tappaisyn'ar.

Myna bu ozun paigambarmyn dep oilop zhatkan adam: <<Siler olup topurakka zhana chirigen sookko ailangandan kiiin kabyrlaryn'ardan tirilip chygasyn'ar>> - dep silerge ubada kylyp zhataby? Munun akyly zhaiyndaby?
Siler olup topurakka zhana chirigen sookko ailangandan kiiin kabyrlaryn'ardan tirilip chygasyn'ar dep aitkan ubadasy oto alys!

Bul duino zhashoosunan bashka zhashoo zhok! Akyret zhashoosu da zhok! Bizden tiruulor olot, alar kaira tirilishpeit. Bashkalar torolup, alar zhashashat. Biz olgondon kiiin kyiamat kunu surak uchun kaira tirilip chykpaibyz.
Myna bu ozun silerge paigambarmyn dep aityp zhatkan adam zhonokoi ele adam. Al bul sozu menen Allakhka zhalgan zhalaa zhaap zhatat. Biz buga yiman keltirbeibiz.
Paigambar aitty: <<Oo, Rabbim! Bular meni zhalganga chygargany sebeptuu alardan och alyp alarga karshy maga zhardam ber>>.
Allakh aga zhoop kylyp: <<Sen alyp kelgen nerseni zhalganga chygargan al zhalganchylar bir az ubakyttan kiiin zhalganga chygargandaryna okunushot>> - dep aitty.

Alar bash iibestikteri uchun azapka tatyktuu bolushkany sebeptuu alardy kyiratuuchu ach kyikyryk alyp, seldin suusunun ustundo kalkygan, alsyz chyrpyktardai zhansyz olumtuktorgo ailandyrdy. Zaalym koomdorgo kyiroo bolsun!
Kiiin Biz alardy kyiratyp zhok kylgan son' Luttun, Shuaibdyn, Iunustun koomdoru syiaktuu bashka koomdordu zhana ummottordu paida kyldyk.
Bul zhalganchy koomdordun kaisynysy bolbosun, alarda kandai karazhattar bolso dagy kyiroosu belgilengen moonotunon ashpait zhana kechikpeit.

Kiiin Biz paigambarlarybyzdy birinin artynan birin zhiberdik. Kachandyr oshol koomdordun ar birine zhonotulgon paigambarlary kelgende alardy zhalganga chygaryshty. Oshondo Biz dagy alardy birinin artynan birin kyirattyk zhana alar tuuraluu el oozunda aitylgan sozdordon bashka ech nerse kalbady. Paigambarlary Rabbisi taraptan alyp kelgen nersege yiman keltirbegen koomdorgo kyiroo bolsun!

Andan son' Biz Musa menen bir tuugany Kharundu toguz keremet-belgileribiz (taiak, kol, saranchalar, bitter, bakalar, kan, suu kaptoo, kurgakchylyk, tushumdun zhoktugu) zhana achyk-aikyn dalilder menen zhiberdik.

Al ekoosun Faraongo zhana elindegi kadyrluu adamdarga zhibergenibizde alar tekeberlenishti, al ekoosuno yiman keltirip bash iiishken zhok. Alar adamdardy basmyrlap, zulumduk kylyp ozdorun alardan zhogoru koigon adamdar ele.
Alar aityshty: <<Bizge ele okshogon, ech kandai artykchylygy bolbogon bul eki adamga yiman keltirebizbi? Bul ekoonun eli (Israil urpaktary) bizge bash iiishkender go?>>.
Oshondo al ekoosu Rabbisi taraptan alyp kelgen nerseni zhalganga chygaryshty. Alar zhalganga chygargandary sebeptuu suuga chokturulup kyiroogo uchurashty.
Biz Musaga Tooratty eli akyikat zholgo tushsun zhana any ish zhuzundo atkarsyn degen umutto berdik.

Zhana Biz Yisa menen anyn enesi Mariiamdy kuduretibizdi bildirgen belgi kyldyk. Al atasyz boiunda boldu zhana Biz al ekoosun zherdin oturuktashuuga ylaiyktuu, suu agyp turgan biiik zherinde kalkaladyk.

Oo, paigambarlar! Men silerge adal kylgan, zhegenge zhagymduu nerselerden zhegile zhana shariiatka tuura kelgen zhakshy ishterdi kylgyla. Chyndygynda Men silerdin ar bir kylgan ishin'erdi bilemin. Maga silerdin ishterin'erdin ech biri zhashyruun emes.
