Oo, paigambarlar! Chyndygynda silerdin dinin'er - bir din. Al Islam dini. A Men silerdin Rabbin'ermin, silerdin Menden bashka Rabbin'er zhok. Andyktan Menden gana korkkula, buiruktarymdy atkargyla zhana tyigandarymdy tashtagyla!

Birok alardy eerchigender alardan kiiin dinde toptorgo bolunup ketishti. Ar bir top ozu ishengenin gana tuura dep oshonu Allakhtyn aldynda kabyl kylyna turgan din dep kalyshty. Al emi bashkalardykyna kon'ul da burushkan zhok.
Oo, paigambar! Sen alardy oz naadandygynda zhana adashuusunda azap tusho turgan ubakka cheiin tim koi.

Aldyndagy nerselerge kubangan al toptor Biz alarga bul duino zhashoosunda bergen bailyktardy zhana bala-chakany alar tatyktuu bolgon zhakshylyktyn tezdeshi dep oilop zhatyshaby?! Alar oilogondoi emes! Chyndygynda Biz any alarga moonot berip, akyryndyk menen azaptash uchun berip zhatabyz. Alar any sezishpeit.

Aldyndagy nerselerge kubangan al toptor Biz alarga bul duino zhashoosunda bergen bailyktardy zhana bala-chakany alar tatyktuu bolgon zhakshylyktyn tezdeshi dep oilop zhatyshaby?! Alar oilogondoi emes! Chyndygynda Biz any alarga moonot berip, akyryndyk menen azaptash uchun berip zhatabyz. Alar any sezishpeit.
Al emi yiman keltirip, zhakshylyktardy kyluu menen birge Rabbisinen korkushkandar,
Anyn Kitebindegi aiattarga yiman keltirishkender,
Rabbisin zhalgyzdap Aga ech bir nerseni sherik kylbagandar,

Zhakshylyktardy kyluuda tyryshchaak bolgondor, zhakshy ish-araketter menen Allakhka zhakyndagandar. Alar kyiamat kunu Allakhka kaitkanda sadakalary zhana zhakshy ish-araketteri Allakhtyn aldynda kabyl kylynbai kaluusunan korkkondor.
Myna ushundai asyl sypattarga ee adamdar zhakshylyk ishterdi algachkylardan bolup kyluuga umtulushat. Alar aga karai zharyshkandar, al uchun bashkalardan ozup ketkender.

Biz ech bir zhanga anyn kudureti zhetpegen ishti mildet kylbaibyz. Bizdin aldybyzda ar bir adamdyn ish-araketi zhazylgan Kitep bar, al ech kandai shek-kumonu zhok akyikatty gana suiloit. Alarga sooptoru azaitylyp zhe kunooloru koboitulup zulumduk kylynbait.

Teskerisinche, kaapyrlardyn zhuroktoru akyikatty suilogon bul Kitepten (Lavkhul-Makhfuz) zhana alarga tushkon Kitepten (Kurandan) beikapar. Alardyn kaapyrlyktan bashka dagy kylgan ish-araketteri bar. Alar osholordu kylyshat.
Kachan Biz alardyn bul duinodo zhyrgap zhashagandaryn (kunoogo batkandaryn) kyiamat kunu azaptap zhazalaganybyzda alar undorun biiik chygaryp zhardam surashat.

Oshondo Allakhtyn yraiymyna bolgon umuttorun uzup alarga myndai dep aitylat: <<Siler bugun kyikyrbagyla zhana zhardam da surabagyla! Chyndygynda silerdi Allakhtyn azabynan kutkara turgan ech bir koldoochu zhok>>.
Duino zhashoosunda silerge Allakhtyn Kitebindegi aiattar okulganda any ugaryn'ar menen zhaktyrbai zhuz burup kachat elen'er.

Siler munu al'-Kharamdyn eesi bizbiz degen oido adamdarga tekeberlenip kylat elen'er. Siler anyn eesi emessin'er! Anyn eesi - takybalar. Oshondoi ele siler anyn tegereginde tunu boiu zhaman sozdordu suiloshup oturchusun'ar. Siler any yiyk tutkan zhoksun'ar.

Allakh Kurandagy aiattardy yiman keltirip, andagy aitylgandardy atkaruu uchun tushurgon. Mushrikter bul nerselerge oi zhugurtushpoibu zhe alarga murunku ata-babalaryna kelbegen zhan'y nerse keliptirbi?! Birok alar andan zhuz burushtu zhana zhalganga chygaryshty.

Zhe alar Allakh paigambar kylyp zhibergen Mukhammaddy (aga Allakhtyn salamttygy-tynchtygy bolsun) bilishpeibi?! Alar any zhakshy taanyshat zhana anyn chynchyldygyn, amanatkoilugun da zhakshy bilishet. Birok alar any chetke kagyshty.

Alar any zhindi dep zhatyshat. Alardyn sozu zhalgan. Teskerisinche, al alarga Allakh taraptan kelgendiginde ech kandai shek zhok akyikat menen keldi. Birok alardyn kopchulugu akyikatty zhaman korushot, ozdorundogu koro albastyktan zhana zhalganga katuu berilgendikten ulam any zhek korushot.

Eger Allakh ishterdi alardyn napsileri kaalagandai kylganda, asmandar menen zher zhana andagylar ishterdin akybetin, tuura zhe tuura emestigin bilbegendikten kyirap kalmak. A Biz bolso, alardyn yzattuulugun zhana kadyr barkyn kamtygan nerseni: Kurandy alyp keldik. Alar bolso, andan zhuz burup zhatyshat.

Oo, paigambar! Sen alyp kelgen nersen' uchun alardan aky surap zhatasyn'by, alar oshon uchun yimanga chakyrygyn'dan bash tartyp zhatyshaby? Sen andai kylgan zhoksun'. Rabbin'din syilygy - alardyn zhe bashkalardyn syilygynan zhakshyraak. Al en' zhakshy yrysky beruuchu.
Oo, paigambar! Sen alardy zhana bashkalardy ech kandai burmaloosu zhok tuura zholgo chakyryp zhatasyn'. Al Islam zholu.
Al emi akyretke zhana andagy bolo turgan surakka, zhazaga, syilykka ishenbegender Islam zholunan chygyp, tozokko alyp baruuchu burmalangan zholdorgo tushkondor.
Eger Biz alarga yraiym kylyp, alardyn bashyna tushkon kurgakchylykty, achkachylykty ketirgen bolsok da alar akyikat zholdon adashuusunan bash tartpai temselep zhuro berishet.
Biz alardy ar kandai kyiynchylyktar menen synadyk. Birok alar Rabbisine moiun sunushkan zhok zhana alarga tushkon kyiynchylyktardan kutkar dep zhalynyp duba da kylyshkan zhok.
Kachan Biz alarga katuu azaptyn eshigin achkanda alar bardyk zhakshylyktan zhana kutuluudan umuttorun uzushot.

Kulagyn, kozun zhana akylyn tuura paidalangan adam kaira tiriluunu chetke kakpasy maalym bolgondo Allakh alarga bergen kee bir zhakshylyktaryn eskertip myndai dedi:
Ei, kaira tiriluunu zhalgan degender! Allakh silerge uguu uchun kulakty, koruu uchun kozdu, tushunuu uchun zhuroktu zharatty. Buga karabastan siler bul zhakshylyktar uchun az gana shugur kylasyn'ar.
Ei, adamdar! Al silerdi zher betinde zharatty. Zhana siler surak berip, zhaza zhe syilyk alysh uchun kyiamat kunu zhalgyz Aga gana chogultulasyn'ar.

Al zhalgyz Ozu gana tiriltet, Andan bashka tiriltuuchu zhok. Al zhalgyz Ozu gana olturot, Andan bashka olturuuchu zhok. Al zhalgyz Ozu tun menen kundun almashuusundagy karan'gylykty, zharykty, alardyn uzundugu menen kyskalygyn belgileit. Siler Anyn kudurettuuluguno akyl zhugurtpoisun'orbu zhana zharatuu menen bashkaruu Aga gana taandyk debeisin'erbi?!
Birok alar kaapyrlykta murunku ata-babalary aitkan sozdordu aityshty.
Mumkun emes degendei chetke kagyp myndai deshti: <<Biz olup topurakka zhana chirigen sookko ailangandan kiiin surak berish uchun kairadan tirilet bekenbiz?!

Olgondon kiiin kaira tiriluu tuuraluu aitylgan bul ubada bizge zhana bizge cheiinki ata-babalarybyzga da ubada kylyngan. Biz bul ubadany ishke ashpait dep oiloibuz. Bul baiyrkylardyn zhomoktoru menen ulamyshtarynan bashka ech nerse emes.
Oo, paigambar! Kaira tiriluunu chetke kakkan al kaapyrlardan surachy: <<Eger bilsen'er aitkylachy, bul Zher zhana andagy nerseler kimge taandyk?>>.

Alar: <<Zher zhana andagy nerseler Allakhka taandyk>>,- dep zhoop berishet. Alarga ait: <<Estebeisin'erbi, oshol Zherge zhana andagylarga eelik kylgan Allakh silerdi olgondon kiiin kaira tiriltuugo kudurettuu emespi?>>.
Alarga ait: <<Zheti asmandyn Rabbisi kim? Allakh zharatkandardyn en' chon'u bolgon uluu Arshtyn Rabbisi kim?>>.
Alar: <<Zheti asman zhana uluu Arsh Allakhtyn mulku>>,- dep zhoop berishet. Alarga ait: <<Allakhtyn azabynan kutuluu uchun Anyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkpoisun'arby?>>.

Alarga ait: <<Butkul nersenin biiligi kimdin kolunda? Anyn biiliginen ech bir nerse chygyp ketpeit. Al Ozu kaalagan pendesine zhardam beret. Al kimge zhamandykty kaalasa, ech kim any azaptan kutkaryp, korgop kala albait. Eger (bashka biroo bolso) bilsen'er aitkylachy?>>.
Alar: <<Butkul nersenin biiligi Allakhtyn gana kolunda>>,- deshet. Alarga ait: <<Munu moinun'arga algan bolson'or, anda emnege akylyn'ardan adashyp, Andan bashka nerselerge syiynyp zhatasyn'ar?>>

Alar oilogondoi emes! Teskerisinche, Biz alarga ech kandai shek-kumonu bolbogon akyikatty alyp keldik. Al emi alardyn Allakhtyn sherigi zhana balasy bar degen oiloru anyk zhalgan. Allakh alardyn aitkan sozdorunon aruu zhana biiik.

Kaapyrlar oilogondoi Allakh ech kimdi Ozuno bala kylgan emes zhana Any menen katar syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok. Egerde Any menen katar syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai bolgondo, anda alardyn ar biri ozu zharatkan nerselerin bolup ketmek zhana biri-birine ustomduk kylmak, anan aalamdyn tartibi buzulmak. Akyikatta andai nerse bolgon zhok. Demek, bul nerse syiynuuga tatyktuu zhalgyz kudai - Allakh ekendigine dalil bolot. Allakh mushrikter Aga tan'uulap balasy bar zhana sherigi bar degen syiaktuu Aga tuura kelbegen sypattardan aruu zhana yiyk.

Al insandarga zhana bashka zharatylgandarga bilinbegen ar bir nerseni Biluuchu. Oshondoi ele korungon, korunbogon zhe sezilbegen bolsun ar bir nerseni Biluuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Allakh sherikterden aruu.
Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Oo, Rabbim! Eger maga mushrikterge ubada kylgan azapty korgozo turgan bolson'.
Oo, Rabbim! Eger Sen alardy zhazalai turgan bolson' zhana men any korgon bolsom, anda meni alardyn arasynda kaltyrba. Alarga tushkon azap maga da tiiip kalbasyn>>.
Chyndygynda Biz alarga ubada kylgan azapty saga da korgozuugo kuduretibiz zhetet. Biz any da, bashkasyn da kyluuga alsyz emespiz.

Oo, paigambar! Saga zhamandyk kylgan adamga en' zhakshy sypatta, kechirim menen zhoop ber. Anyn bergen zyianyna sabyr kyl. Biz alar sypattap zhatkan shirk, zhalganga chygaruunu, oshondoi ele zhindi, syikyrchy dep saga ylaiyk kelbegen sypattardy aityp zhatkandaryn zhakshy bilebiz.
Aitkyn: <<Oo, Rabbim! Men Ozun' menen zhin-shaitandardyn azgyryktarynan zhana zhaman oilorunan, kuuluuluktarynan korgonomun.
Oo, Rabbim! Alar menin ishterime aralashuusunan Senden korgoo suraimyn>>.

Kachan al mushrikterdin birine olum kelip, any oz kozu menen korgon kezde al otkorgon omuruno zhana Allakhtyn aldyndagy mildetterin atkarbaganga okunup myndai dep aitat: <<Oo, Rabbim! Meni duinogo kaitara kor!

"Attin', eger kaira zharalsam, zhakshy ishterdi kylmakmyn" (deit). Zhok, ish al talap kylgandai bolboit! Chynynda, bul zhon ele aitylgan soz. Eger al duino zhashoosuna kaira kaitarylsa da aitkan ubadasyn atkarbait. Al olgon adamdar kaira tiriluu kununo cheiin duino menen akyrettin ortosun bolgon zhaida bolot. Alar otkorup zhibergen ishin kaira atkaruu zhana buzuku ishterin kaira on'doo uchun duino zhashoosuna kaityp kelbeit.

Surnai tartuuga zhoopker bolgon perishte kyiamattyn bashtalganyn zhar salyp ekinchi zholu surnaidy tartkan kezde alardyn ortosundagy syimyktanyshkan tuuganchylygy da zhok bolot. Antkeni alar akyrettegi korkunuchtar menen alek bolup kalyshat. Oshondoi ele alarga tushkon chon' mushkul ubaiymga salgan sebeptuu alar biri-birin da surashpai kalat.
Kimdin sooptoru kunoolorunon koptuk kylyp tarazasy oor bolso, myna osholor kozdogonuno zhetip zhana korkunuchtardan kutulup iigilikke zhetkender.

Al emi kimdin kunooloru sooptorunan koptuk kylyp tarazasy zhen'il bolso, myna osholor zyian ishterdi kylyp zhana paida bergen yiman menen zhakshylyk ishterdi tashtap ozdoruno zyian kylgandar. Alar tozok otunda bolushat, al zhaktan chygyshpait.
Alardyn zhuzdoru tozokko kuikalanat. Al zhaida alardyn betteri katuu tyryshkany uchun aldyn'ky zhana ustun'ku erinderi tartylyp, tishteri korunup kalat.
Alarga aiyptoo menen myndai dep aitylat: <<Silerge duino zhashoosunda Kuran aiattary okulbady bele, a siler bolso any zhalganga chygargansyn'ar?!>>.
Alar aityshat: <<Oo, Rabbibiz! Senin abalky ilimin'de bizge zhazylgan baktysyzdyk ustomduk kylyp, biz akyikattan adashkan koom bolduk.
Oo, Rabbibiz! Bizdi tozokton chygara kor! Eger biz kaira kaapyrlykka zhana adashuuga kaita turgan bolsok, anda ozubuzgo zulum kylgandardan bolobuz. Myna oshondo bizge kechirim bolboit>>.
Allakh aitat: <<Tozokto kor bolup zhashagyla zhana Maga suilobogulo!>>.

Chyndygynda Maga yiman keltirgen pendelerimdin bir taipasy aityshat: <<Oo, Rabbibiz! Biz Saga yiman keltirdik, bizdin kunoolorubuzdu kechir zhana bizge Ozun' yraiym kyl. Sen yraiymduulardyn en' zhakshysysyn'>>.

Siler bolso Rabbisine duba kylgan al yimanduulardy maskaralap shyldyn'dai berip, alardy shyldyn'doo menen alek bolgonun'ar akyry silerge Allakhty estoonu unutturup koidu. Siler bolboi ele alardyn ustunon kulup shyldyn'dap maskaralai berdin'er.
Kyiamat kunu Men al yimanduulardy beiishke zhetkirip syilyk beremin. Antkeni alar Allakhka moiun sunuuga zhana silerden korgon zyiandarga sabyr kylyshty.

Kachan alar ketirgen katalaryn on'dosh uchun bul duinogo kaituunu surashkanda, alarga al zhakta ozdoru kaalagandai toobo kyluuga mumkunchuluk bolgon zhashoo berilgenin eskertti.
Al aitty: <>.
Alar: <<Bir kun zhe kundun bir boluguncho zhashadyk. Zhakshysy kundordu zhana ailardy eseptegenderden sura>>,- dep zhoop berishet.
Al aitty: <<Siler duinodo az gana ubakyt boldun'ar. Eger siler kancha bolgonun'ardyn chenin bilgenin'erde, anda Allakhka moiun sunuuga sabyr kyluu zhen'il bolmok.
Ei, adamdar! Biz silerdi zhanybarlar syiaktuu syilyk-zhazasy zhok maksatsyz zharatyp zhana kyiamat kunu surak berish uchun Bizge kaitpaibyz dep oilop zhatasyn'arby?!>>.

Zharatkandaryn Ozu kaalagandai bashkargan Padysha Allakh aruu. Al - Ozu akyikat, ubadasy akyikat, sozu akyikat zhana Andan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok. Al - zharatylgandardyn en' chon'u bolgon uluu Arshtyn Eesi. Eger kim zharatylgandardyn en' chon'unun Rabbisi bolso, anda Al butkul zharatylgandardyn Rabbisi.

Kimde-kim Allakh menen katar syiynuuga tatyktuu ekenine ech kandai dalili zhok bashka bir kudaiga duba kylsa (bul Allakhtan bashka bardyk kudaichalarga tiiishtuu), anda anyn bul kylgan kunoo ishinin zhazasy Rabbisinin aldynda. Al Ozu any azap menen zhazalait. Chyndygynda kaapyrlar kozdogonuno zhetishpeit zhana korkkon nerselerinen da kutulushpait.
Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Oo, Rabbim! Kunoolorumdu kechir zhana maga Ozun' yraiym kyl! Sen - kunookorgo yraiym kylyp, toobosun kabyl kylgandardyn en' zhakshysysyn'>>.
Bul suroonu Biz tushurduk, andagy okumdordu atkaruunu mildet kyldyk zhana andagy okumdordon sabak alyp, alardy atkarat degen umutto anyn ichinde achyk-aikyn aiat-belgilerdi tushurduk.

Uilonboston turup zyna kylgan aial menen erkektin ar birine zhuz balaktan urgula! Alardy zhazaga tartpai zhe alarga zhen'ildik kylyp boorun'ardy oorutpagyla zhana yraiym kylbagyla, eger Allakhka zhana akyret kununo yiman keltirgen bolson'or. Al ekoonun kylganyn adamdarga zhetkirish uchun zhana bashkalarga sabak bolush uchun alardyn zhazasyna bir top musulmandar katyshsyn.

Zynadan korkutush uchun Allakh aitty, zynany adat kylgan erkek ozuno okshogon zynakor zhe mushrik aialga gana uilonuunu kaalait. Aga uilonuu uruksat emestigine karabastan zynadan saktanbait. Zhana zynany adat kylgan aial da ozuno okshogon zynakor zhe mushrik erkekke gana turmushka chyguunu kaalait. Any menen turmush kuruu aram ekendigine karabastan zynadan saktanbait. Al emi musulmandar uchun zynakor aialga uilonuu zhe zynakor erkekke turmushka chyguu aram kylyndy.

Oo, bashchylar! Abiiirin taza saktagan aialdardy (zhana abiiiri taza erkekterdi) buzukuluk-zyna kyldy dep zhalaa zhaap, andan son' oshol buzukuluk-zyna kyldy degen zhalaasyna tort kubo alyp kelbegen adamdarga seksen balak urgula zhana alardyn kubolugun ech kachan kabyl albagyla! Abiiiri taza aialdarga zhalaa zhapkan oshol adamdar -- alar Allakhka bash iibegender.

Birok ushul kylgandarynan kiiin Allakhka toobo kylyp zhana tuura emes kylgan ishterin on'dogon adamdardyn toobolorun zhana kuboluktorun Allakh kabyl kylat. Chyndygynda Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerine Kechirimduu, Yraiymduu.

Oz aialdaryna zyna kyldy dep doomat kylyp, birok aitkan doomatynyn tuuralygyna ozunon bashka kubosu zhok bolgon erkekterdin ar biri <<Aialym zyna kyldy degen doomatymda chyndykty gana aittym>> dep tort zholu Allakhtyn aty menen ant ichip kuboluk beret.
Al emi beshinchi zholku kubolugundo <<Egerde men zhalgan aitsam, anda Allakhtyn kargyshyna kalaiyn>> dep ozuno karshy duba kylat.

Al aial munu menen zyna uchun berilgen okum zhazaga tatyktuu bolot. Egerde al aial <<Kuioomdun maga kylgan doomaty zhalgan>> dep Allakhtyn aty menen ant ichip tort zholu kuboluk berse, anda al bul okum zhazadan kutulat.
Al emi beshinchi zholku kubolugundo <<Egerde kuioomdun aitkan doomaty chyn bolso, anda maga Allakhtyn kaary bolsun>> dep ozuno karshy duba kylat.

Ei, adamdar! Egerde silerge Allakhtyn zhakshylygy zhana yraiymy bolbogondo zhana Al toobo kylgan pendelerinin toobolorun kabyl kyluuchu, Oz bashkaruusunda zhana shariiatynda daanyshman bolbogondo, anda Al silerdi kunoolorun'or uchun tezinen zhazalamak zhana abiiirin'erdi achmak.

Chyndygynda zhalgan zhalaa zhapkandar (yimanduulardyn enesi Aishany (Allakh andan yraazy bolsun) buzukuluk kyldy degender) ozun'ordon ele bolgon bir taipa. Oo, yimanduular! Siler bul zhalgan zhalaany siler uchun zhamandyk dep oilobogula, teskerisinche bul nersede yimanduular uchun soop zhana tazalanuu, oshondoi ele yimanduulardyn enesinin aktaluusu syiaktuu zhakshylyktar bar. Any buzukuluk kyldy degen zhalaaga sherik bolgon ar bir adam uchun zhalgan zhalaa zhaap zhasagan kunoosuno zhaza bar. Al emi anyn kopchulugun any bashtagan adam, tagyraak aitkanda eki zhuzduulordun bashchysy bolgon Ubai ibnu Salul kotorot. Al uchun chon' azap bar.

Emnege yimanduu erkekter menen aialdar oshol chon' zhalaa zhonundo ugushkanda oz musulman bir tuugandarynan bolgon, zhalaaga kabylgan adam tuuraluu zhakshy oiloshup: <<Bul anyk zhalgan!>>,- dep aityshkan zhok?!

Yimanduulardyn enesi Aishaga (Allakh andan yraazy bolsun) zhalaa zhapkan adamdar alardyn aitkan zhalaasy chyndyk ekenin tastyktagan tort kubonu alyp kelishpeit bele?! Eger alar tort kubonu alyp kele alyshpasa (birok alar ech kachan alyp kele alyshpait), anda alar Allakhtyn okumundo zhalganchylar.

Oo, yimanduular! Egerde Allakhtyn silerge zhazany tezdetpei, ichin'erden toobo kylgandardyn toobosun kabyl kylgan syiaktuu Anyn zhakshylygy zhana yraiymy bolbogondo, anda siler yimanduulardyn enesine karata aitkan zhalgan sozgo zhana zhalaaga batyp ketkenin'er uchun chon' azapka tush bolmoksun'ar.

Oshol kezde siler any biri-birin'erge aityp, ozun'or bilbegen nerseni zhalgandygyna karabastan any oozun'ar menen zhaiylttyn'ar. Siler munu zhen'il dep oilodun'ar. Birok bul Allakhtyn aldynda oor. Antkeni bul nersede abiiirduu adamga karata zhalgan sozdor zhana zhalaalar bar.

Siler bul zhalgan zhalaany ukkanda: <<Biz bul zhiiirkenichtuu ish zhonundo suilogongo akybyz zhok. Oo, Rabbibiz! Sen aruusun'! Alardyn yimanduulardyn enesine zhapkan bul zhalaasy anyk zhalgan>>, - desen'er bolboit bele?!
Allakh silerge eskertet zhana nasaat kylat, ushuga okshogon zhalgan zhalaaga dagy kaityp, abiiiri taza adamdy buzukuluk kyldy dep zhalaa zhappagyla, eger Allakhka yiman keltirgen bolson'or!

Allakh silerge Ozunun okumdorun zhana osuiattaryn kamtygan aiattardy achyktap baiandait. Allakh silerdin ishterin'erdi Biluuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Al zhakynda silerge zhazasyn zhe syilygyn beret. Al Oz bashkaruusunda zhana shariiatynda Daanyshman.

Yimanduu adamdar arasynda buzukuluktardy, zhaman ishterdi (anyn ichinde zyna kyldy dep zhalaa zhabuu, zh.b. buzukuluktardy da bar) zhaiyltuunu zhakshy korgondorgo bul duinodo zhalaasynyn zhazasyn aluu arkyluu kyinoochu azap bar zhana akyrette tozok azaby bar. Allakh alardyn zhalgandaryn bilet, pendeler kylgan ishterinin akybeti emnege alyp baraaryn zhana alarga emne paidaluu ekenin bilet, siler bilbeisin'er.

Ei, zhalaa zhapkandar zhana alarga koshulup ketkender! Egerde silerge Allakhtyn zhakshylygy zhana yraiymy bolbogondo zhana Allakh silerge Booruker, Yraiymduu bolbogondo, anda silerge zhazany tezdetmek.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Zhalgandy kooz kylyp korgozgon shaitandyn zholdorun eerchibegile! Kimde-kim anyn zholdorun eerchise, anda al any zhaman ishterge zhana sozdorgo, oshondoi ele shariiat tyigan nerselerge buiruit. Oo, yimanduular! Egerde silerge Allakhtyn zhakshylygy bolbogondo, anda silerden ech kim eger toobo kylsa da ech kachan tazalanmak emes. Birok Allakh kimdi kaalasa toobosun kabyl kylyp tazalait. Allakh silerdin sozdorun'ordu Uguuchu, ishterin'erdi Biluuchu. Alardyn ech biri aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda Al silerge zhazasyn zhe syilygyn beret.

Dinde artykchylykka ee adamdar zhana mal-mulku ken' adamdar ozdorunun zhakyrlyktan muktazh bolgon zhe Allakh zholunda kochkon tuugandaryna kylgan kunooloru uchun ele alarga zhardam berbeim dep kasam ichishpesin! Alarga kechirimduu bolsun zhana alardyn zhamandygyna zhakshylyk menen zhoop bersin. Siler alardy kechiruu menen Allakh silerdin kunoolorun'ordu kechiruusun kaalabaisyn'arby?! Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerine Kechirimduu, alarga Meerimduu. Andyktan pendeleri Any ornok tutsun. Bul aiat Abu Bakr as-Syddyk zhalgan zhalaaga katyshy bar bolgon Mistakhka zhardam berbeim dep kasam ichkende tushkon.

Al emi buzukuluktu baamyna albagan yimanduu aialdarga, andan beikapar, abiiiri taza aialdarga zhalaa zhapkan adamdar bul duinodo zhana akyrette Allakhtyn yraiymynan kuru kalyshat zhana alar uchun akyrette chon' azap bar.
Alarga bul azap kyiamat kunu bolot. Al kundo alardyn tilderi zhalgandy suilogonun aityp aga karshy kubo bolushat zhana kolu-buttary kylgan ishterin aityp aga karshy kubo bolushat.

Oshol kunu Allakh alardyn zhazasyn zhe syilygyn adilettik menen toluk beret zhana alar Allakh Taala akyikat ekenin bilishet. Allakh taraptan kandai gana kabar zhe syilyk ubadasy zhe azap ubadasy kelbesin, al ech kumonu zhok achyk-aikyn chyndyk.

Bardyk buzuku erkekter, aialdar, sozdor zhana ishter ozdoru symal buzukularga gana ylaiyktuu. Oshondoi ele bardyk tazalar ozdoru symal tazalarga gana ylaiyktuu. Oshol taza erkekter menen taza aialdar - buzuku erkekter menen buzuku aialdar aityp zhatyshkan nerselerden taza adamdar. Alar uchun kunoolorun kechirgen Allakhtyn kechirimi bar zhana alarga uluu yrysky beiish bar.

Avratka karoo kumar kaaloosun kozgop, suroonun bashynda aitylgandai, zyna kyluuga turtku bolot. Avrat zherlerdi karoodon kozdu saktoo uchun uilorgo kirerde uruksat suroonu buirup, Allakh Taala myndai buirugan:
Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Oz uiun'ordon bashka uilorgo anyn zhashoochularynan kiruugo uruksat suramaiyncha zhana alarga salam bermeiinche kirbegile! Salam beruudo zhana uruksat suroodo <> dep aitkyla. Silerge buiruk kylyngandai ushintip uruksat suraganyn'ar siler uchun kutuusuz kirgenin'erden zhakshyraak. Balkim siler buirulgan nerseden eskertme alyp, any atkaraarsyn'ar.

Egerde al uilordon ech kimdi tappasan'ar, anda kiruugo uruksat bere turgan adam silerge uruksat bermeiinche kirbegile. Eger ui eeleri silerge <<ketkile>> dep aitsa, kirbesten kaityp ketkile. Chyndygynda ushul siler uchun Allakhtyn aldynda tazaraak. Allakh silerdin emne kylyp zhatkanyn'ardy bilet. Ishterin'erdin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Al zhakynda silerge alardyn zhazasyn zhe syilygyn beret.

Al emi ech kimge tiesheluu emes, zhalpy paidalanuuga daiardalgan kitepkana zhana bazardagy dukondor syiaktuu zhailarga uruksatsyz kiruun'or kunoo emes. Allakh silerdin achyk zhana zhashyruun kylgan ishterin'erdi zhana abaldaryn'ardy bilet. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Al zhakynda silerge alardyn zhazasyn zhe syilygyn beret.

Koz karash zynaga turtku bergen sebepterden bolgonu uchun Allakh andan saktanysh uchun kozdu kunoodon tyiuunu buirup myndai dep aitty:
O, paigambar! Yimanduu erkekterge aitkyn, kozdorun alarga adal bolbogon aialdarga, avrat zherlerge karoodon tyisyn, zhynys mucholorun aram ishten zhana achykka chygaruudan saktasyn. Allakh aram kylgan nerselerdi karoodon tyiyluu - Allakhtyn aldynda taza bolot. Chynynda, Allakh alardyn emne kylganynan kabardar. Alardyn ishinen ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda silerge kylgan ishin'erdin zhazasyn zhe syiyn beret.

Yimanduu aialdarga aitkyn, kozdorun alarga adal bolbogon uiattuu zherlerdi karoodon zhana zhynys mucholorun buzukuluktan zhana any korsotuudon saktashsyn. Kiiim syiaktuu zhashyruuga mumkun emes, korunup turgan koozduktarynan bashkasyn choochun erkekterge korsotushposun. Chachtaryn, zhuzdorun zhana moiundaryn zhabysh uchun koinogunun oido zhagyndagy achyk zherlerin zhooluktary menen zhabyshsyn. Zhashyruun koozduktaryn kuiooloruno gana korsotushsun, oshondoi ele atalaryna zhe kainatalaryna zhe baldaryna zhe kuioosunun baldaryna zhe aga-inilerine zhe aga-inilerinin baldaryna zhe ezhe-sin'dilerinin baldaryna zhe musulman zhe kaapyr bolgon ishenichtuu aialdarga zhe kol astyndagy aial zhe erkek kuldaryna zhe aialdarga kyzyguusu zhok kyzmatchylaryna zhe kichine bolgonu uchun aialdardyn avratyn aiyrmalap bilbegen zhash baldarga korsotushso kunoo emes. Aialdar butuna takkan bilerik zhe oshol syiaktuu zhashyruun koozduktaryn bilgizish uchun buttary menen zherdi tebishpesin. Ei, yimanduular! Koz karash zhe bashka zhol menen kylgan kunoolorun'or uchun baaryn'ar Allakhka toobo kylgyla! Balkim oshondo kozdogonun'orgo zhetesin'er zhana korkkonun'ardan kutulasyn'ar.

Kech turmush kuruu zynanyn zhaiylyshynyn sebepterinen bolgonu uchun Allakh boidoktorgo turmush kuruuga zhardam beruunu buirup myndai dep aitty:
Ei, yimanduular! Aialy zhok erkekterdi zhana kuioosu zhok erkin aialdardy uilondurgulo. Oshondoi ele kuldaryn'ardyn zhana kun'dorun'ordun yimanduularyn uilondurgulo. Eger alar zhardy bolushsa, Allakh alardy ken' peiildigi menen baiytat. Allakhtyn yryskysy kenen, biroogo bailyk beruu menen Anyn yryskysy kemip ketpeit. Al pendelerinin abaldaryn biluuchu.

Allakh yimanduularga boidoktordu uilondurgulo dep buirugan kezde uilonuugo sharty zhok boidok adamga abiiirin'di taza sakta dep buirup myndai dep aitty:
Zhardylygy sebeptuu uilono albai zhurgondor Allakh alardy ken' peiildigi menen baiytkanga cheiin zynadan abiiirlerin taza saktashsyn. Kuldardyn arasynan kimisi kulchuluktan kutulush uchun akcha tolop kozhoiundary menen azattyk kelishimin tuzuunu kaalasa zhana kozhoiundary alardyn kutulup kete alaryn zhana dindarlygyn bilishse, anda alardyn bul sunushun kabyl alyshsyn. Alar ortodo kelishken tolomdun bir bolugun alardan kechip Allakhtyn alarga bergen mulktorunon berishsin. Zhana kun'dorun'or oz abiiirin satyp tapkanyn alysh uchun alardy akcha tap dep zyna kyluuga mazhburlabagyla! (Abdullakh ibnu Ubaidyn eki kun'u buzukuluktan alys bolobuz, abiiiribizdi saktaibyz dep aityshsa da aga karabai kun'dorun mazhburlagan). Aran'ardan kim alardy ushundai kyluuga mazhburlasa, akyikatta Allakh alar mazhburlanuuga kabylgan son' al kun'dordun kunoolorun Kechiruuchu, alarga Yraiymduu. Antkeni alar zordoogo kabylyshty zhana kunoosun zordogondor kotorot.

Ei, adamdar! Biz silerge ech kandai budomugu zhok achyk-aikyn aiattardy tushurduk. Silerden murun zhashap otkon yimanduulardyn zhana kaapyrlardyn okuialaryn tushurduk. Oshondoi ele Rabbisinin buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiganynan tyiylgan takybalar sabak ala turgan nasaattardy tushurduk.

Allakh asmandar menen zherdin nuru zhana alardyn ortosundagy nerselerdi tuura bagytka zholdoochu. Yimanduu adamdyn zhurogundogu Anyn nuru - chyrak koiulgan dubal boorundagy oiuk tekche syiaktuu. Chyrak bolso kaukhardai zharkyrak zhyldyz symal zharkyragan shishenin ichinde. Al chyrak berekeluu daraktyn maiy menen kuiot. Al zaitun daragy. Al darakty erteli-kech kundon ech bir nerse tospoit. Anyn maiyna ot tiibese da tunuktugunan ele zharkyraiyn dep turat. A eger tiise kandai bolot?! Chyraktyn nuruna shishenin nuru koshuldu. Yimanduunun zhurogu da ushundai, eger anyn ichinde khidaiat nuru zharkyrai turgan bolso. Allakh pendelerinen kimdi kaalasa Kurandy eerchuugo iigilik beret. Allakh kee bir nerselerge ozdoruno okshosh nerselerdi aityp misaldardy keltiret. Allakh bardyk nerseni Biluuchu. Aga anyn ech biri zhashyruun emes.

Bul chyrak kadyry zhana kurulushu biiik bolsun dep Allakh buirugan mechitterde kuiup turat. Al zhailarda Anyn ysymy azan, zikir zhana namaz arkyluu eskerilip turat zhana erteli-kech Allakhtyn yraazylygy uchun namaz okulat.

Al erkekterdi Allakhty estoodon, namazdy toluk atkaruudan zhana tiiishtuu taraptarga zeketti beruudon sooda kyluu da, aluu-satuu da alaksyta albait. Antkeni alar kyiamat kununon korkushat. Al kundo zhuroktor azaptan kutuluunu kaaloo menen korkunuchtun ortosunda termelip kalat zhana kozdor kai zhaktan emne bolot eken dep tush keldi tarapty karap kalat.

Alar munu Allakh alardyn kylgan ish-araketteri uchun sooptordu en' zhakshy kylyp berip, syilyk katary alarga Allakh zhakshylyktaryn koboituusu uchun kylyshat. Allakh alardyn ish-araketterine zharasha Ozu kaalaganyna kylgan ishterinen da kop kylyp esepsiz yrysky beret.

Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandardyn soopsuz ish-araketteri yldyi zherde korungon zakym symal. Suusagan adam any korgondo suu dep oiloit. Kachan anyn zhanyna kelgende suunu tappai kalat. Oshol syiaktuu kaapyr dagy anyn ish-araketteri aga paida beret dep oiloit. Kachan al olup, kiiin kaira tirilgende alardyn soobun tappai kalat. Al bet aldynda Allakhty tabat. Oshondo Al anyn ish-araketterinin esebin toluk kylyp esepteit. Allakh tez surak aluuchu.

Zhe bolboso alardyn ish-araketteri teren' den'izdegi karan'gylyktarga okshosh. Anyn ustun tolkundar kaptap turat. Al tolkundar ustundo dagy bashka tolkundar bar. Anyn ustundo zhol korgozgon zhyldyzdardy toskon buluttar bar. Kabat-kabat zhaigashkan karan'gylyktar. Egerde bul karan'gylykka tushkon adam kolun chygarsa, katuu karan'gylyktan ulam kolun da koro albait. Kaapyr da ushul syiaktuu. Anyn ustun naadandyk, shektenuu, temseloo zhana zhuroguno moor basyluu syiaktuu karan'gylyktar kaptagan. Allakh kimge adashuudan tuura zholgo tushuunu zhana Oz kitebin uironuunu nasip kylbasa, anda al uchun tutuna turgan tuura zhol da, aga zharyk bere turgan kitep da zhok.

Oo, paigambar! Asmandardagy zhana zherdegi butkul zhandyktar, meikindikte kanattaryn zhaigan kushtar Allakhty aruulasharyn bilbeisin'bi? Allakh Taala myna ushul zhandyktardyn ar birin: adam syiaktuu namaz okuganyn da kushtar syiaktuu aruulaganyn da bilet. Allakh alardyn kylyp zhatkandaryn baaryn bilet. Alardyn kylgan ishterinin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.
Asmandardagy biilik zhana zherdegi biilik zhalgyz Allakhka gana taandyk. Kyiamat kunu surak beruu, zhaza zhe syilyk aluu uchun kaituu zhalgyz Aga gana bolot.

Oo, paigambar! Korboisun'bu, Allakh buluttardy aidap, kiiin alardy biri-birine koshot, kiiin katmarluu turmok-turmok kylat. Anan sen buluttardyn arasynan zhamgyr chykkanyn korosun'. Oshondoi ele Al asman taraptagy uluu toolorgo okshogon koiuulangan buluttardan maida tashtar syiaktuu mondurdu zhaadyryp, any menen Ozu kaalagan pendelerine paida zhe zyian zhetkiret zhana Ozu kaalagan pendelerinen any burup zhiberet. Buluttan chykkan chagylgandyn zharygy ushunchalyk zharyktygynan kozdordu kor kylyp zhiberchudoi bolot.

Allakh tun menen kunduzdu uzaktygyna zhana kyskalygyna, bashtalyshyna zhana butushuno karap almashtyryp turat. Chyndygynda bul aitylgandarda Allakhtyn zharatuuchuluguna dalil bolgon aiat-belgilerde akyl eeleri uchun Allakhtyn kudurettuulugun zhana zhalgyzdygyn korsotkon sabaktar bar.

Allakh zher betinde zhurgon bardyk zhan-zhanybarlardy bel suudan zharatty. Alardyn arasynda zhylan syiaktuu kursagy menen soilop zhurgondoru bar, insan zhe kush syiaktuu eki butu menen basyp zhurgondoru bar, ui zhanybarlary syiaktuu tort buttap basyp zhurgondoru bar. Allakh aitylgandardan zhana aitylbagandardan Ozu kaalaganyn zharatat. Chyndygynda Allakh bardyk nersege kudurettuu, Any ech bir nerse alsyrata albait.

Biz Mukhammadga (aga Allakhtyn salamattygy-tynchtygy bolsun) ech kandai budomugu zhok achyk-aikyn aiat-belgilerdi tushurduk. Allakh Ozu kaalagan adamga burmalanuusu zhok tuura zholgo tushuugo iigilik beret. Al zhol any beiishke zhetkiret.

Eki zhuzduulor: <<Biz Allakhka zhana paigambarga yiman keltirdik, Allakhka zhana paigambarga moiun sunduk>>,- dep aityshat. Kiiin alardyn bir tobu zhuz burup ketishet. Alar Allakhtyn zhana Anyn elchisinin Anyn zholunda sogushuu zh.b. tuuraluu kelgen buiruguna bash iiishpeit. Birok alar aga cheiin Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirdik, moiun sunduk dep oiloshkon ele. Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine moiun sunuudan bash tartkan al adamdar ozdorun yimanduubuz deshse dagy alar yimanduu emes.

Egerde al eki zhuzduulordun arasyndagy talash-tartyshtarga paigambar okum kylsyn dep alardy Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine chakyrsa, alar eki zhuzduuluktoru sebeptuu oshol zamat anyn okumunon bash tartyp ketishet.
Egerde chyndyk alar tarapta ekenin zhana al alardyn kyzykchylygyna karap okum kylaryn bilishse, alar aga moiun sunup kelishet.

Alardyn zhurogundo aiykpas ooru barby? Zhe alar anyn Allakhtyn elchisi ekendigine shektenip zhatyshaby? Zhe Allakh menen Anyn elchisi alarga adiletsiz okum kylat dep korkup zhatyshaby? Myndai kylyshkany bul aitylgan nerseler uchun emes! Teskerisinche, alar anyn okumunon bash tartyp, aga bash iibestik kylyshkany sebeptuu ozdorundogu ooru bar uchun ushundai!

Kachan Allakhtyn zhana Anyn elchisinin okum kyluusun chetke kakkan eki zhuzduulordun abaly tuuraluu aitkan son' aga yraazy bolgon yimanduulardyn abalyn aityp myndai dedi:
Al emi al yimanduulardyn arasynda okum kyluu uchun alar Allakhka zhana paigambarga chakyrylsa, alar: <> - degen sozdu gana aityshat. Ushul sypattarga ee adamdar - myna osholor bul duinodo zhana akyrette zhen'ishke zhetkender.

Kim Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine moiun sunsa, alardyn okumun kabyl alsa, kunoo zholdordon korkso, Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Anyn azabynan korgonso, myna osholor gana bul duino menen akyret zhakshylyktaryna zhetken zhen'uuchulor.

Eki zhuzduulor Allakhtyn aty menen chamalary zhetishinche aiabai bekemdelgen ant beriship: <<Eger sen bizdi sogushka chyguuga buirusan', sozsuz chygabyz>>,- deshet. Oo, paigambar! Alarga ait: <<Ant ichpegile! Silerdin zhalganyn'ar belgiluu. Bash iiip zhatabyz degenin'er da belgiluu. Allakh silerdin kylganyn'ardan kabardar. Siler ishterin'erdi kanchalyk zhashyrsan'ar da alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes>>.

Oo, paigambar! Al eki zhuzduulorgo ait: <<Ichin'erden da, syrtyn'ardan da Allakhka zhana paigambarga moiun sungula>>. Egerde siler moiun sungula degen buiruktan zhuz bursan'ar, anda zhetkiruu mildeti paigambardyn moinunda, al emi al alyp kelgenge bash iiuu zhana any atkaruu mildeti silerdin moinun'arda. A eger siler anyn buiruganyn atkaryp, tyiganyn tashtap aga bash iisen'er, akyikat zholgo tushosun'or. Paigambardyn mildeti achyktap zhetkiruu gana! Al silerdi tuura zholgo sala albait zhana aga mazhburlai da albait.

Allakh silerdin aran'ardagy Allakhka yiman keltirgen zhana zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandarga dushmandaryna karshy zhardam berem zhana alardan murunku yimanduulardy zher betine bashkaruuchu kylgan syiaktuu alardy da zher betinde bashkaruuchu kylam dep ubada berdi. Zhana alarga Ozu yraazy bolup bergen Islam dinin bekem kubattuu kylam dep ubada berdi. Oshondoi ele alardyn korkunuchtaryn kiiin tynchtykka almashtyram dep ubada berdi. Alar Maga ech kimdi sherik kylbai zhalgyz Ozumo gana syiynyshat. Kim ushundai zhakshylyktardan kiiin kaapyrlyk kylsa, osholor Allakhka bash iibestik kylgandar.

Siler namazdy toluk turdo atkargyla, mal-mulkun'ordon zeket bergile zhana paigambardyn silerge buiruganyn atkaryp, tyiganynan tyiylyp aga moiun sungula. Oshondo umut bolot Allakhtyn yraiymyna zhetuun'orgo.

Oo, paigambar! Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandarga azap tushuruunu kaalasam, alar Menden kachyp kutulup ketishet dep oilobo. Kyiamat kunu alardyn baraar zhaiy tozok bolot. Alardyn bara turgan zhaiy bolgon tozok kandai zhaman zhai.

Allakh buga cheiin balagatka zhetken erkin adamdardyn uruksat suroo okumdorun aityp otkon, emi kuldardyn zhana balagatka zhete elek erkin baldardyn uruksat suroo okumdorun aityp myndai dedi:
O, Allakhka yiman keltirgender zhana Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Kuldaryn'ar, kun'dorun'or zhana balakat kuragyna zhetpegen zhash baldar silerge kiruudo uch ubakta uruksat surasyn: bagymdat namazyna cheiinki, tunku kiiimdi syrt kiiimge almashtyrgan ubakta. Chak tushto uktoo uchun kiiimin'erdi chechken ubakta. Kuptan namazynan kiiinki ubakta. Antkeni, bul ubak uikuga zhatuuchu zhana syrt kiiimdi chechip almashtyrchu ubak. Ushul uch ubak avratyn'ar achyk bolushu yktymal. Ushul ubaktarda alarga uruksat bergenden kiiin gana kirishsin. Al emi bashka ubaktarda uruksatsyz kirse, silerge da, alarga da kunoo emes. Alar kop kirip-chygyp turuuchular. Oshol sebepten alardy daiyma uruksat surap kiruugo konduruu kerek. Allakh silerge uruksat suroonun okumdorun baiandagan syiaktuu, shariiattyn bashka kee bir okumdorun bildirgen aiattardy da baiandait. Allakh pendelerine emne paidaluu ekenin Biluuchu, alarga okumdordu shariiat kyluuda Daanyshman.

Egerde silerden bolgon zhash baldar balagatka zhetse, alar uilorgo kirgende murda chon'dorgo bailanyshtuu aitylgandai alar dagy ar daiym uruksat surap kirishsin dep aitkyla. Allakh silerge uruksat suroo okumdorun baiandagan syiaktuu Al silerge Ozunun aiattaryn da baiandait. Allakh pendelerine emne paidaluu ekenin Biluuchu, alarga okumdordu shariiat kyluuda Daanyshman.

Kaarylyk sebeptuu aiyzy zhana torotu toktop, turmushka chyguuga kaaloosu zhok ulgaigan aialdar zhaap zhashyruuga buirulgan zhashyruun koozduktaryn korsotposton, chepken zhe zhuzun toskon zhooluk syiaktuu kee bir tysh kiiimderin chechse kunoo emes. Birok al uchun tysh kiiimderin chechkenge karaganda zhamynuuga zhana abiiirduulukko kon'ul burup chechpegeni zhakshyraak. Allakh alardyn sozdorun Uguuchu, ish-araketterin Biluuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Al zhakynda alardyn zhazasyn zhe syilygyn beret.

Kozu korbogon sokurga kunoo bolboit, cholokko kunoo bolboit, ooruluuga kunoo bolboit, eger alar Allakh zholunda sogushuu syiaktuu mildetterdi atkara albai kalyshkan bolso. Oo, yimanduular! Siler uchun oz uiun'ordon tamak zhesen'er kunoo bolboit zhe baldaryn'ardyn uiunon zhe atan'ardyn uiunon zhe apan'ardyn uiunon zhe aga-inilerin'erdin uiunon zhe ezhe-karyndashtaryn'ardyn uiunon zhe abalaryn'ardyn uiunon zhe ezhelerin'erdin (atan'ardyn ezhe-karandashtarynyn) uiunon zhe taiakelerin'erdin uiunon zhe taezhelerin'erdin uiunon zhe bakchanyn karoolu syiaktuu silerge karoogo tapshyrylgan uilordon zhana adatta bul nerseni zhaman korbogon dostorun'ardyn uiunon tamak zhesen'er kunoo emes. Siler uchun chogu zhe oz-ozuncho tamaktanuuda kunoo bolboit. Egerde siler zhogoruda aitylgan syiaktuu uilorgo zhe bashkalaryna kirsen'er, andagy adamdarga <<Assalamu aleikum (silerge tynchtyk bolsun!)>> dep salam aitkyla. A eger ech kim bolboso, anda ozun'orgo <<Bizge zhana Allakhtyn takyba pendelerine tynchtyk bolsun>> dep salam aitkyla. Allakh taraptan silerge shariiat kylyngan bul salamdashuu berekeluu, antkeni al silerdin orton'ordo suiuunu zhana zhakyndykty taratat, oshondoi ele al ukkan adamdyn zhan duinosuno zhagymduu. Suroodogu kelgen zhogorudagy baiandoo syiaktuu Allakh aiattardy baiandait. Balkim akyl zhugurtosun'or zhana andagy aitylgandardy atkarasyn'ar.

Kachan Allakh kirgende uruksat suroo tuuraluu aitkanda ketip zhatkanda da uruksat suroo tuuraluu aityp myndai dedi:
Oz yimandarynda chynygy yimanduu adamdar - Allakhka yiman keltirgender zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirgender. Egerde alar musulmandardyn paidasy uchun bir ishte paigambar menen chogu bolushsa, andan uruksat suramaiyncha ketishpeit. Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda senden ketkenge uruksat suragandar - osholor Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine chyndap yiman keltirgender. Egerde alar ishteri chygyp senden uruksat surashsa, alardan ozun' kaalaganyna ketuugo uruksat ber zhana alardyn kunooloru uchun kechirim sura. Chyndygynda Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerinin kunoolorun Kechiruuchu, alarga Meerimduu.

O, yimanduular! Allakhtyn elchisin syilagyla! Aga kairylganda, biri-birin'erge kairylgandai any: <<Mukhammad>> dep, zhe atasynyn atynan aityp: <<Abdullakhtyn balasy>> dep chakyrbagyla! Aga: <<Allakhtyn elchisi! Allakhtyn paigambary>> dep kairylgyla. Eger al silerdi zhalpy ishke chakyrsa, anyn chakyrygyn biri-birin'erdi chakyrgandai kabyl kylbagyla. Teskerisinche, aga tez zhoop beruugo shashylgyla. Allakh silerdin aran'ardan uruksatsyz, baikatpai ketip kalgandardy zhakshy bilet. Andyktan, Allakhtyn elchisinin buiruguna karshy chykkandar, Allakh alardyn bashyna balee tushuruusunon zhe alar chydabagan oor azapka kiripter kyluusunan sak bolushsun!

Asmandar menen zherdegi zharatuu, biilik kyluu zhana bashkaruu zhalgyz Allakhka gana taandyk. Oo, adamdar! Al silerdin abaldaryn'ardy bilet. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Kachan alar olumdon kiiin kaira tirilip Aga kaitkan kyiamat kunu alarga duinodo kandai ishterdi kylyshkandygynyn kabaryn beret. Allakh butkul nerseni Biluuchu. Asmandar menen zherdegi ech bir nerse Aga zhashyruun emes.

Adamzat menen zhinderdi Allakhtyn azabynan korkutup alarga paigambar bolsun dep Ozunun pendesi zhana elchisi Mukhammadga (aga Allakhtyn salamattygy-tynchtygy bolsun) akyikat menen zhalgandy azhyratkan Kurandy tushurgon Allakh uluk zhana zhakshylygy kop Zat.

Asmandardyn mulku zhana zherdin mulku zhalgyz Aga taandyk. Anyn balasy zhok zhana mulkundo Anyn sherigi zhok. Al butkul nerseni zharatyp, alardyn zharaluusun Oz ilimi zhana daanyshmandygy talap kylgandai ar birin ozuno ylaiyk den'geelde olchop belgilep koigon.

Mushrikter Allakhtan bashka kudailardy tutup alyshty, alar bolso kichine da, chon' da nerseni zharata alyshpait, alar ozdoru zharatylgandar. Allakh alardy zhokton zharatty. Alar ozdorun zyiandan korgoi alyshpait, ozdoruno paida da keltire alyshpait, oluktu tirilte, tiruunu olturo alyshpait zhana oluktordu kabyrlarynan kaira tirilte alyshpait.

Kachan alardyn Allakhka shirk kylgandaryn eskertkende alardyn Anyn kitebine zhana paigambaryna bolgon abaldaryn aityp myndai dedi:
Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyrlyk kylgandar: <>,- deshti. Al kaapyrlar zhalgan sozdu oilop tabyshty. Kuran - bul Allakhtyn sozu. Myndai sozdu adamzat da, zhinder da alyp kele alyshpait.
Kurandy zhalganga chygargan oshol adamdar aityshty: <<Kuran - baiyrkylardyn sozdoru zhana alardyn zhazgan zhalgandarynan. Mukhammad any kochurup algan. Al aga erteli-kech okulup turat>>.

Oo, paigambar! Al zhalganchylarga ait: <<Kurandy asmandardagy zhana zherdegi butkul nerseni bilgen Allakh tushurdu. Siler oilogondoi al oilop tabylgan emes. Andan kiiin alardy toobo kyluuga chakyryp: <<Chyndygynda Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerine Kechirimduu, alarga Yraiymduu>> - dep aitty>>.

Paigambardy zhalganga chygargan mushrikter aitty: <<Ozun Allakh taraptan kelgen paigambarmyn dep oilop zhatkan buga emne boldu? Al bashka adamdar syiaktuu ele tamak-ash zheit, tirichilik kylysh uchun bazarlarda zhurot. Allakh any menen kosho zhurgon, anyn chynchyldygyn tastyktap, aga zhardam berip zhandagan perishte zhiberse bolboit bele?

Zhe aga asmandan kazyna tushpoit bele zhe momolorunon zhegen anyn bakchasy bolboit bele? Oshondo al bazarlarda yrysky izdep zhurboit ele>>. Zaalymdar aityshty: <<Ei, yimanduular! Siler paigambardy eerchigen zhoksun'ar! Siler syikyrlanyp akylyn zhogotkon adamdy gana eerchip zhurosun'or>>.

Oo, paigambar! Karachy, alar sen tuuraluu tan' kala turgandai zhalgan sypattardy aityp zhatyshkanyn. Syikyrchy deshti, syikyrlangan deshti, zhindi deshti. Oshol sebepten alar akyikattan adashty. Emi alar tuura zholgo tusho alyshpait zhana senin chynchyldygyn'dy zhana amanatkoilugun'du zhamanatty kyluuga da zhol taba alyshpait.

Allakh uluu berekettuu Zat. Al kaalasa bul duinodo saga alardyn sunushtagan nerselerinen da zhakshyraak bolgon bakchalardy kylat. Andagy khan-sarailardyn zhana bak-daraktardyn aldylarynan daryialar agyp turat. Sen alardyn momolorunon zheisin'. Oshentip eger kaalasa sen zhyrgap zhashai turgan khan-sarailardy zharatat.

Alardan akyikatty zhana dalilderdi izdegendei sozdor chykkan zhok! Teskerisinche, alar kyiamat kunun zhalganga chygaryshty. Biz kyiamat kundu zhalganga chygargandarga aloolonup kuiup turgan tozoktu daiardap koiduk.
Kachan tozok any kozdoi alystan aidalyp kele zhatkan kaapyrlardy korgondo, alar anyn burkuldap kainaganyn zhana alarga katuu kaardangan korkunuchtuu unun ugushat.
Kachan al kaapyrlar koldoru moiundaryna chynzhyr menen kishendelgen abalda tozoktogu tar zherge yrgytylganda, andan kutulush uchun ozdoruno olum tilep kalyshat.
Ei, kaapyrlar! Bugun olumdu bir ele zholu emes, kop zholu chakyrgyla! Birok suraganyn'arga ech kachan zhoop berilbeit. Siler kyinoochu azapta tuboluk kalasyn'ar.

Oo, paigambar! Alarga: <<Silerge sypattalyp aitylgan ushul azap zhakshyby zhe zhyrgalchylygy toktoboi daiym ulangan tuboluk beiish zhakshyby?>> - dep ait. Allakh any yimanduu pendelerinin ichinen takybalaryna syilyk zhana kyiamat kunu alardyn kaityp baraar zhaiy bolot dep ubada kylgan.
Alar uchun bul beiishte kaalagan zhyrgalchylyktar bolot. Bul Allakhtyn ubadasy. Andan takyba pendeleri bul tuuraluu surashat. Allakhtyn ubadasy ishke ashat. Al ubadasyn buzbait.

Al kundo Allakh zhalganchy mushrikterdi zhana Any menen katar syiynylgan kudailaryn zhyinait zhana syiynuuchularyn aiybyn bilgizuu maksatta al kudailaryna aitat: <<Siler pendelerimdi ozun'orgo syiyngyla dep adashtyrdyn'arby zhe alar ozdoru ele adashtyby?>>.

Kudailary aityshat: <<Oo, Rabbibiz! Sen Ozun'o sherik tutuudan aruusun. Senden bashkalardy bashkaruuchu-korgoochu tutkanybyz bizge ylaiyk emes. Kantip ele Senin pendelerin'di bizge syiyngyla dep aitmak elek?! Birok al mushrikterdi zhana alardan murunku ata-babalaryn akyryndyk menen zhazaloo uchun Sen alarga duino zhyrgalchylyktaryn bergende alar Seni estoonu unutup koiushtu. Kiiin Seni menen katar bashkalarga syiynyshty zhana alar baktysyzdyktary sebeptuu kyiragan koom bolushtu>>.

Ei, mushrikter! Siler Allakh menen katar syiyngan kudailaryn'ar silerdin aitkan sozdorun'ordu zhalganga chygaryshty. Emi siler ozun'ordu azaptan korgoi albaisyn'ar zhana alsyzdygyn'ar uchun ozun'orgo zhardam da bere albaisyn'ar. Oo, yimanduular! Silerden kim Allakhka shirk kylyp ozuno zulumduk keltirse, Biz aityp otkon adamdardy azaptagandai aga da katuu azapty tattyrabyz.

Mushrikter paigambardyn tamak zhegenin zhana bazarlarda zhurgonun aiyptashkanda Allakh alarga zhoop kylyp myndai dep aitty:
Oo, paigambar! Biz senden murun da adamzattan gana bolgon paigambarlardy zhibergenbiz. Alar da tamak zheshken, bazarlarda zhurushkon. Bul nersede paigambarlardan birinchisi emessin'. Oo, adamdar! Biz silerdi bailykta, kedeilikte, salamattykta zhana ooruda bolgon aiyrmachylyktar sebeptuu biri-birin'erge synoo kylyp koiduk. Siler synoolorgo sabyr kylasyn'arby? Oshondo Allakh silerge sabyrduulugun'ar uchun sooptordu beret. Senin Rabbin' sabyr kylgandy zhana sabyr kylbagandy, moiun sungandy zhana moiun sunbagandy Koruuchu.

Bizge zholuguunu umut kylbagan zhana azabybyzdan korkpogon kaapyrlar: <<Allakh bizge perishtelerdi tushurup, alar bizge Mukhammaddyn chynchyldygyn aityshsa zhe biz Rabbibizdi oz kozubuz menen korup, Al bizge al tuuraluu kabar berse bolboit bele?>> -- dep aityshty. Alardyn zhan duinosundo tekeberlik kuch alyp, al akyry alardy yimandan tostu zhana alar bul sozdoru menen kaapyrlyktyn zhana asha chabuuchuluktun cheginen chygyp ketishti.

Kaapyrlar olgondo, kabyrda, kaira tirilgende, surakka zhonoshkondo zhana tozokko kirishkende perishtelerdi oz kozdoru menen korushkon kunu, al zhailarda alar uchun yimanduularga bolgondoi suiunuch kabar bolboit. Perishteler alarga: <<Allakhtyn suiunuch kabary siler uchun taptakyr aram>> - deshet.

Biz kaapyrlardyn bul duinodo kylyshkan zhakshylyk ishterine bet alyp keldik zhana alardy kaapyrlyktary sebeptuu zhok kylyp, paidasyz kylganybyz kudum terezeden kirgen kundun shoolasyna chagylyshyp korungon sapyrylgan chan'dai kylyp saldyk.

Oshol kunu beiishke kirgen yimanduular al kaapyrlardan en' zhakshy orundarda zhana duinodo tushku es aluu ubagyndagydai en' rakhattuu zhailarda bolushat. Bul nerse alardyn Allakhka bolgon yimany zhana zhakshylyk ishteri uchun boldu.
Oo, paigambar! Asman zharylyp seirek agysh buluttar kaptagan zhana kop sandagy perishteler surak maidanyna tushkon kundu estegin.
Kyiamat kunundogu ozgorbos chynygy biilik cheksiz Yraiymduuga gana taandyk. Al kun kaapyrlar uchun oor, yimanduular uchun zhen'il bolot.

Oo, paigambar! Estegin, al kunu zaalym adam paigambardy eerchibegeni uchun katuu okunuchton eki kolun tishtep: <<Attin' ai! Paigambar Rabbisi taraptan alyp kelgenge eerchip, any menen birge kutuluu zholuna tushsom bolmok go!>> - dep aitat.
Katuu kaigyrgandan ozuno karshy zhamandyk tilep myndai dep aitat: <<Shorum kurugur ai! Balancha kaapyrdy dos tutpai koisom kana?!
Bul kaapyr dosum paigambar arkyluu zhetken Kurandan meni adashtyrdy>>. Chyndygynda shaitan adamdy daiym zhardamsyz tashtait. Eger anyn bashyna kyiynchylyktar tushso, andan bash tartyp ketet.
Oshol kunu paigambar oz elinin abalyn aityp: <<Oo, Rabbim! Chyndygynda Sen meni zhibergen elim bul Kurandy tashtap, andan bash tartyshty>> - dep aryzdandy.

Oo, paigambar! Sen oz elin' taraptan zyiandarga zhana senin zholun'dan tosuuga tush bolgonun' syiaktuu Biz senden murunku ar bir paigambarga da oz elindegi kunookorlordon dushmandardy kylyp koiduk. Tuura zholgo saluuga Rabbin' Ozu zhetishtuu zhana Al dushmanyn'a karshy saga zhardam beruugo da Ozu zhetishtuu!

Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandar: <<Bul Kuran paigambarga boluk-boluk bolup tushpoi, chogu bir ele tushso bolboit bele?>> - dep aityshat. Oo, paigambar! Biz Kurandy birinin artynan birin tushuruu menen senin zhurogun'du kubattash uchun boluk-boluk kylyp tushurduk. Oshondoi ele any zhen'il tushunup, zhen'il zhattash uchun birinin artynan ekinchisin tushurduk.
Oo, paigambar! Mushrikter saga kandai gana misaldardy alyp kelishpesin, Biz saga andan da negizduu akyikat zhooptu zhana en' tushunuktuusun alyp kelebiz.

Kyiamat kunu zhuzdoru menen tozokko suirolup kelingender - myna osholor en' zhaman orundagylar, antkeni alardyn ordu tozokto. Zhana alar akyikattan alys zholdogular, antkeni alardyn zholu kaapyrlyk menen adashuunun zholu.
Biz Musaga Tooratty berdik zhana aga zhardamchy bolush uchun bir tuugany Kharundu any menen birge elchi kyldyk.

Anan al ekoosuno: <<Bizdin aiat-belgileribizdi zhalganga chygargan Faraongo zhana anyn koomuna bargyla>> - dep aittyk. Alar buirugubuzga bash iiiship, alarga baryshty. Alardy zhalgyz Allakhka syiynuuga chakyryshkanda alardy zhalganga chygaryshty, oshondo Biz alardy typtyipyl kylyp kyirattyk.

Kachan Nukhtun eli any zhalganga chygaruu menen paigambarlardy zhalganga chygarganda Biz alardy den'izge chokturup zhok kyldyk. Alardyn kyiroosun Biz zaalymdardy kyryp zhok kyluuga kudurettuu ekenibizge dalil kyldyk. Zhana Biz kyiamatta zaalymdarga kyinoochu azapty daiardap koiduk.
Biz Khuddun koomu Aaddy, Salikhtin koomu Samuddu zhana kuduk eelerin zhok kyldyk. Zhana ushul uchoosunun ortolorundagy koptogon koomdordu zhok kyldyk.

Bul kyiroogo uchuragandardyn baaryna alardan murunku koomdordun kantip kyiragandaryn zhana anyn sebepterin sabak alyshsyn dep aityp bergenbiz. Biz baarysyn kaapyrlyktary zhana bash iibestikteri sebeptuu kyryp zhok kyldyk.

Senin elin'den bolgon zhalganchylar Shamga baratkanda buzukuluk kylgandary uchun zhaza katary tash zhaagan Luttun koomunun shaaryna kelishken ele go! Alar bul shaardy emne bolgonun korboi zhatyshaby, sabak alyshpaiby? Zhe kozdoru bul nerselerge sokur bolup kaldyby? Zhok! Birok alar surak bereerden aldyn'ky kaira tiriluunu kutushkon zhok.
Oo, paigambar! Seni shyldyn'dashkan zhalganchylar saga zholugup kalyshsa seni maskara kylyp shyldyn'dashyp myndai dep aityshat: <<Allakh bizge paigambar kylyp zhibergen adam ushulbu?

Al bizdi az zherden kudailarybyzga syiynuudan burup zhibere zhazdady. Eger biz alarga syiynuuda sabyr kylbaganda, al bizdi ozunun dalilderi menen burup zhibermek. Zhakynda alar kabyrdagy zhana kyiamattagy azapty oz kozdoru menen korushkon kezde alardyn kimisi tuura zholdon koburook adashkanyn bilishet, al beken zhe tigiler beken? Zhakynda kimisi anyk adashkanyn bilishet.
Oo, paigambar! Ozunun kaaloosun kudai kylyp, aga moiun sungan adamdy korboisun'bu?! Emi sen any yimanga keltirgen zhana any kaapyrlyktan saktagan kozomoldoochu bolosun'bu?

Oo, paigambar! Zhe sen Allakhka syiynuuga zhana Aga moiun sunuuga chakyryp zhatkandardyn kobu seni kabyl alyp ugushat zhe dalilderge akyl zhugurtushot dep oilop zhatasyn'by? Alar uguuda, akyl zhugurtuudo zhana tushunuudo aibandarga ele okshosh. Zhok! Alar (zhurgon zholunda) aibandardan da katuu adashkan.

Oo, paigambar! Sen Allakhtyn zher betinde kolokonu (tan' atkandan kun chykkanga cheiinki aralykta) zhaiyp koigon uchurdagy zharatuuchuluk belgilerin korboisun'bu? Eger Al any zhylbai turgan bolushun kaalasa, anda sozsuz oshondoi kylyp koimok. Kiiin Biz kundu anyn uzaryp kyskaryshyna belgi kyldyk.
Kiiin Biz kolokonu kundun kotorulgonuno zharasha akyryndyk menen az-azdan kyskartyp zhyinaibyz.

Allakh siler uchun tundu silerdi zhana bashka nerselerdi zhapkan kiiim syiaktuu kyldy zhana siler uchun uikunu zhumushtaryn'ardan es aluu kyldy. Oshondoi ele Al siler uchun kunduzdu zhumushtaryn'arga bara turgan ubak kyldy.
Zhana Al pendelerine karata yraiym bolgon zhamgyrdyn zhaashyn suiunchulogon shamaldardy zhiberdi. Zhana Biz asmandan pendeler tazalykka koldono turgan taza zhamgyr suusun tushurduk.

Sebebi Biz al tushkon suu menen chop chykpagan kurgak zherden turduu osumduktordu osturup, al zherdi zhashyldantyp tiriltebiz. Oshondoi ele al suu menen Ozubuz zharatkan koptogon adamdardy zhana aibanattardy suugarabyz.
Biz alar sabak alsyn degen maksatta Kuranda dalilderdi tur-turu menen keltirip baiandadyk. Birok kopchuluk adamdar akyikatka kaapyrlyk kylyp, any zhaktyrbai bash tartyshty.

Eger Biz kaalaganda ar bir shaarga Allakhtyn zhazasyn eskertken zhana andan korkutkan paigambar zhibermekpiz. Birok Biz munu kaalagan zhokpuz. Chyndygynda Biz Mukhammaddy gana butkul adamzatka paigambar kylyp zhiberdik.

Andyktan kaapyrlardyn aldamchylyk menen saga koigon talaptaryna zhana aitkan sunushtaryna moiun sunba. Sen alardan korgon zyiandarga sabyr kylyp, alardy dinge chakyruudagy kyiynchylyktarga chydoo menen saga tushkon bul Kuran arkyluu alar menen katuu kurosh.
Allakh Taala eki den'izdin suusun koshup koidu, alardyn tuzsuzuna tuzduusun koshtu. Zhana ortoloruna alardy aralashtyrbai, birin-biri buzbai, bolup turgan tosmo kylyp koidu.

Al erkek menen aialdyn bel suusunan adamdy zharatty zhana Al adamdy zharatkan Zat aga tuugan-uruktu zhana kuda-sooktu kyldy. Oo, paigambar! Senin Rabbin' kudurettuu, Any ech bir nerse alsyz kyla albait. Anyn kudurettuulugunon - insandy erkek menen aialdyn bel suusunan zharatuusu.

Kaapyrlar Allakhtan bashka kudailarga syiynyshat. Alarga moiun sunushsa paida bere albait, bash iibestik kylyshsa zyian bere albait. Chyndygynda kaapyr adam Allakh Taalanyn kaaryn keltirgen ishterde shaitandy eerchuuchu.

Oo, paigambar! Biz seni yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylyp Allakhka moiun sungandarga suiunuch kabardy zhetkiruuchu zhana kaapyrlyk kylyp, Aga bash iibestik kylgandarga eskertuuchu kylyp zhiberdik.
Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Men kabar zhetkirgenim uchun silerden aky surabaimyn. Birok aran'ardan kim Allakhtyn yraazylygyna karai sadaka beruu zholun tandasa, anda oshondoi kylsyn>>.

Oo, paigambar! Bardyk ishterin'de ech kachan olbogon, tuboluk Tiruu kaluuchu Allakhka taian zhana Aga maktoolordu aityp aruula. Al Ozu pendelerinin kunoolorunon zhetishtuu kabardar. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda alarga anyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Al asmandardy zharatty, zherdi zharatty zhana alardyn ortosundagy nerselerdi alty kundo zharatty. Andan son' Ozunun uluuluguna zharasha Arshka biiiktedi zhana kotoruldu. Al - Yraiymduu! Oo, paigambar! Sen al tuuraluu Kabardardan sura! Al Allakh butkul nerseni bilet. Aga ech bir nerse zhashyruun emes.

Egerde kaapyrlarga: <<Yraiymduuga sazhda kylgyla>> - dep aitylsa, alar: <<Biz Yraiymduuga sazhda kylbaibyz. Al Yraiymduu degen emne? Biz any bilbeibiz, any moiunga da albaibyz. Biz Any taanybasak dele sen sazhda kyl desen' ele sazhda kyla bermek belek?>> - dep aityshat. Anyn Allakhka sazhda kylgyla degen buirugu alardy Allakhka yiman keltiruudon alystoolorun kuchotot.

Asmanda planetalar menen top zhyldyzdardyn zhaigashkan orundaryn zharatkan, asmanda nur chachkan Kundu zharatkan zhana kun nurun chagyltyp zher betine zharyk chachkan Aidy zharatkan Zat uluu zhana berekettuu.
Allakh Anyn aiat-belgilerinen ulgu-nasaat alyp tuura zholgo tushuunu zhe Anyn zhakshylyktaryna shugur kyluunu kaalagandar uchun kun menen tundu birinin artynan biri kelip almasha turgan kylyp koidu.

Kachan Allakh bul suroodo Aga yiman keltiruudon zhana moiun sunuudan bash tartkan kaapyrlardy aitkanda, Aga moiun sunuuga bet algan takyba pendelerinin sypattaryn aityp myndai dedi:
Al emi Yraiymduunun yimanduu pendeleri - alar zher betinde salabattuuluk, kichipeiildik menen basyp zhurushot. Egerde alardy naadandar sozgo tartsa, alarga ten'elishpeit. Teskerisinche, alarga naadandyk kylbastan zhakshyny gana suiloshot.
Alar tun ichinde Rabbisine man'daiy menen sazhda kylgandar zhana Allakh uchun tike turup namaz okushkandar.
Alar Rabbisine duba kylyp aityshat: <<Oo, Rabbibiz! Bizden tozok azabyn alystat! Chyndygynda tozok azaby kaapyr bolup olgondordu ozunon kutkarbait.
Chyndygynda al zhakta turgandar uchun al en' zhaman orun zhana al zhakta zhashagandar uchun en' zhaman zhai.

Alar mal-mulktorun sarptashkanda ysyrapchylyk chekke zhetkirishpeit zhana ozdoru zhe bashkalar syiaktuu alarga kamsyzdoosu mildettuu bolgon adamdarga sarp kyluuda da saran'dyk kylyshpait. Alardyn sarptoosu ysyrapchylyk menen saran'dyktyn ortosunda adilettuu chekte bolot.

Alar Allakh menen katar bashka kudailarga duba kylyshpait, Allakh olturuunu aram kylgan zhandy olturushpoit, al emi, Allakh adam olturuuchunu, dinden bash tartkandy zhana ui-buloluu zynakordu olturuugo uruksat bergen (toptogu kishilerge zhazalaryn beruudo ozu bilemdik emes, shariiattyn talaptarynyn cheginde atkaryshat). Oshondoi ele alar zyna kylyshpait. Kimde-kim ushul chon' kunoolordu kylsa, anda al kylgan kunoosu uchun kyiamat kunu zhazaga tush bolot.
Aga (zhogorudagy kunoolordun baaryn zhe shirk kunoosun kylgan kishige) kyiamat kunu azaptar kaira-kaira kaitalanyp berilet zhana al kordolgon abalda tuboluk azapta kalat.

Birok kim Allakhka toobo kylsa, yiman keltirse zhana anyn toobosu chyn ekenin bildirgen zhakshylyk ishterdi kylsa, anda Allakh osholordun kylgan zhamandyktaryn zhakshylyktarga almashtyrat. Chyndygynda Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerine Kechirimduu, alarga Yraiymduu.
Zhana kim Allakhka toobo kylsa zhana ibadattardy atkaryp, kunoolordu tashtap toobosunun chyn ekenin dalildese, anda anyn toobosu kabyl kylynat.

Alar kunoo kylyngan zherler zhana aram kon'ul achuu zhailary syiaktuu zhalgandarga katyshpait. Eger man'yzsyz zhaman sozdorgo zhana ishterge kez bolup kalyshsa, anda alarga aralashpastan oz kadyryn saktap otup ketishet.
Alarga Allakhtyn uguuga zhana koruugo mumkun bolgon aiat-belgileri eskertilse, alar ugulgan aiattarga kulaktaryn zhabyshpait zhana korulgon aiat-belgilerdi kormokson bolushpait.

Alar Rabbisine kylgan dubalarynda aityshat: <<Oo, Rabbibiz! Bizge takybalygy zhana akyikatka bekemdigi menen kozubuzdu kubantkan zhubailardy zhana bala-chakalardy ber zhana bizdi akyikatta ulgu tutkan takybalarga bashchy kyl>>.

Myna ushul sypattagy adamdar Allakhka bash iiuudo sabyrduuluk kylyshkandary uchun beiishtin en' zhogorusu bolgon Firdaustagy biiik orundar menen syilanyshat. Alardy al zhaida perishteler salamdashyp tosup alyshat zhana alar bardyk baleelerden aman bolushat.
Alar al zhakta tuboluk bolushat. Alar turuktashkan zhai zhana alar zhailanyshkan zher kandai sonun!

Oo, paigambar! Kaapyrlyktan kaitpagan kaapyrlarga ait: <<Rabbim silerdin bash iiuun'ordon Aga kaitkan paidaga kon'ul burbait, eger Anyn syiynyp zhana surap duba kylgan pendeleri bolbogondo Al silerge kon'ul burmak emes. Siler Rabbisi taraptan paigambardyn alyp kelgenin zhalganga chygardyn'ar. Emi zhakynda zhalgandyn zhazasy siler menen birge bolot>>.
(Tsm) Ta-siim-miim. Ushuga okshogon aiattyn tushundurmosu bakara suroosunun bashynda kelgen.
Bular akyikatty zhalgandan achyktap korsotkon Kuran aiattary.
Oo, paigambar! Alar tuura zholgo tushsun dep zhantalashyp, kaigyryp zhurup ozun'du olturup albasan' boldu.

Egerde Biz alarga asmandan aiat-belgini tushuruunu kaalasak, alarga tushurmokpuz. Oshondo alar aga shylkyiyp moiun sunup kalmak. Birok Biz alar kaiypka yiman keltiret beken dep synash uchun munu kaalagan zhokpuz.

Al mushrikterge Yraiymduu (Allakh) taraptan Anyn zhalgyzdygyn zhana paigambarynyn chynchyldygyn bildirgen kandai gana zhan'y eskertme kelbesin, alar aga kulak saluudan zhana aga ishenuudon bash tartyshty.
Alar bolso paigambary alyp kelgen nerseni zhalganga chygaryshty. Emi zhakynda alarga shyldyn'dagan nerselerinin anyk kabarlary kelet zhana alarga azap tushot.
Al koshorgondor kaapyrlyktan kaityshpait beken, alar zherdi karashpaiby?! Biz anda ar turduu kooz zhana paidasy kop osumduktordu osturup koiduk.

Chyndygynda zher betinde turkun-turluu osumduktordu osturuudo - any osturgon Allakh oluktordu kaira tiriltuugo kudurettuu ekendigine achyk-aikyn belgiler bar. Birok alardyn kopchulugu yiman keltirishken zhok.
Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda senin Rabbin' ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu, pendelerine Yraiymduu.
Oo, paigambar! Estegin, bir kezde Rabbin' Musaga buirudu: <<Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgan zhana Musanyn elin kul kylgan zaalym koomgo bar.
Alar Faraondun koomu. Alarga sypaiylyk zhana zhumshaktyk menen buiru: <<Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, anyn tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkula!>>.
Musa aitty: <<Chyndygynda men Sen tuuraluu alarga zhetkirgen nersede meni zhalganga chygaruularynan korkomun.
Anan alardyn meni zhalganga chygaruusunan kokurogum sygylyp, tilim sozgo kelbei kaluusu mumkun. Oshon uchun Sen Zhebreiildi bir tuuganym Kharunga zhiber, al maga zhardamchy bolsun.
Bir kopttu olturup koigonum uchun alardyn aldynda kunoom bar. Oshol sebepten alar meni olturup koiuularynan korkomun>>.

Allakh Musaga aitty: <<Zhok! Alar seni olturo alyshpait. Bir tuuganyn' Kharun menen birge silerdin chynchyldygyn'arga dalil bolgon aiat-belgileribizdi alyp zhonogulo! Chyndygynda Biz zhardam berip zhana koldop siler menen birge bolobuz, silerdin alarga aitkanyn'ardy zhana alardyn silerge aitkandaryn ugup turabyz. Biz ech bir nerseni otkorup zhiberbeibiz.
Faraongo bargyla da mintip aitkyla: <<Chyndygynda biz saga butkul zhanduu-zhansyz aalamdyn Rabbisininen elchi bolup zhiberildik.
Sen Israil urpaktaryn biz menen koio ber>>.
Faraon Musaga aitty: <<Biz seni kichinen'den oz aldybyzda tarbiialadyk, omurun'don zhyldar biz menen chogu zhashadyn', emi senin paigambarmyn degen sozun'o emne turtku berdi?
Sen oz elin'den bolgon adamga bolusham dep bir kopttu olturup oor ish kylgansyn'. Saga kylgan zhakshylygymdy tangan adamdardansyn'>>.
Musa moiunga alyp Faraongo aitty: <<Men al adamdy bilbestikten olturup alganym maga vakhii kelgenge cheiin bolgon.
Men any olturup algandan kiiin siler al uchun meni olturosun'or dep Madiianga kachtym. Anan Allakh maga ilim berdi zhana adamdarga zhibergen paigambarlarynan kyldy.
Meni Israil urpaktary menen kosho kul kylbastan oz tarbiian'a alganyn' - chyndap ele maga kylgan zhakshylygyn'. Birok bul nerse men seni yimanga chakyruudan tospoit>>.
Faraon Musaga aitty: <<Sen elchisimin dep oilop zhatkan aalamdardyn Rabbisi degen emne?>>.

Musa Faraongo zhoop kylyp: <<Aalamdardyn Rabbisi - al asmandar menen zherdin Rabbisi zhana alardyn ortosundagy nerselerdin Rabbisi, eger siler Any osholordun Rabbisi dep ishensen'er, anda zhalgyz Aga gana syiyngyla!>> - dep aitty.
Faraon ozunun ailanasyndagy el bashchylaryna aitty: <<Musanyn bergen zhoobun uktun'arby? Bul anyk ele zhalgan soz!>>.
Musa alarga aitty: <<Allakh silerdin Rabbin'er zhana murunku ata-babalaryn'ardyn Rabbisi>>.
Faraon aitty: <<Chyndygynda silerge elchi bolup zhiberildim dep oilop zhatkan adam anyk ele zhindi, al kantip zhoop berishti bilbeit zhana ozunun akyly zhetpegen nerseni aityp zhatat>>.
Musa aitty: <<Men silerdi chakyryp zhatkan Allakh - Al chygyshtyn Rabbisi, batyshtyn Rabbisi zhana alardyn ortosundagylardyn Rabbisi, eger siler akylyn'ardy ishtetken bolson'or>>.
Faraon Musaga karshy zhoop tappai kalganda myndai dedi: <<Egerde sen menden bashka kudaiga syiyna turgan bolson', men seni sozsuz abaktagy adamdarga koshom>>.

Musa (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy bolsun) Faraongo aitty: <<Eger men saga Allakh taraptan alyp kelgen nersede chynchyldygymdy dalildegen nerseni alyp kelsem da meni abaktagylarga koshosun'bu?>>.
Al aitty: <<Kana, sen aityp zhatkan, chynchyldygyn'a dalil bolgon nerseni alyp kelchi, eger aityp zhatkan sozdorun'do chynchyl bolson'>>.
Oshondo Musa taiagyn zherge tashtady. Al kutulbogon zherden koz koruno chon' zhylanga ailandy.
Zhana al ech kandai agy zhok kolun chontoguno salyp kaira chygarganda al ala oorusunun agyndai emes nurduu appak bolup chykty. Any karap turgandar da korushtu.
Faraon ailanasyndagy el bashchylarga aitty: <<Chyndygynda bul adam syikyrchylykty abdan bilgen syikyrchy.
Al syikyry menen silerdi oz zherin'erden chygaruunu kaalap zhatat. Kana, oiun'ardy aitkylachy, buga kandai chara korolu?>>.
Alar aga aityshty: <<Any menen bir tuuganyna ubakyt ber, alardy zhazalaganga shashylbai tur zhana syikyrchylardy chogultup kelgenge Misirdin shaarlaryna chabarmandardy zhiber.
Alar (chabarmandar) saga syikyrchylykty mykty bilgen syikyrchylardy alyp kelishsin>>.
Kiiin ubadalashkan zhaida, belgilengen ubakta Faraon Musa menen kuch synashtyruu uchun syikyrchylardy chogulttu.
Adamdarga aityldy: <<Kimisi zhen'uuchu bolorun korush uchun choguldun'arby, Musaby zhe syikyrchylarby?
Umutubuz biz syikyrchylardyn dinin eerchisek, eger alar Musany zhen'ishken bolso>>.
Kachan syikyrchylar Musany zhen'ebiz dep kelishkende Faraongo kairylyp: <<Egerde biz Musany zhen'sek, bizge materaldyk zhe moraldyk syilyk bolobu?>> - deshti.
Faraon alarga aitty: <<Ooba, syilygyn'ar bar. Egerde siler any zhen'e turgan bolson'or, anda menin aldymda zhakyn adamdardan bolosun'ar, silerge zhogorku biilik orundaryn berem>>.
Musa Allakhtyn zhardamyna ishenip zhana andagy nerse syikyr emestigin baiandap alarga myndai dedi: <<Tashtaibyz degen zhipterin'erdi zhana taiaktaryn'ardy tashtagyla>>.
Alar zhipterin zhana taiaktaryn tashtashty. Tashtap zhatkanda: <<Faraondun kuch-kudureti menen biz gana zhen'ebiz, Musa bolso zhen'ilet>> - deshti.
Musa dagy taiagyn tashtady, al oshol zamat chon' zhylanga ailandy da kapystan ele alardyn syikyrlyk menen adamdardy aldagan nerselerin zhutup bashtady.
Kachan syikyrchylar Musanyn taiagy alardyn syikyrlyk menen tashtagan nerselerin zhutup zhatkanyn korgondo sazhdaga zhygylyshty.
Alar myndai deshti:<<Biz butkul aalamdardyn Rabbisine yiman keltirdik.
Musa menen Kharundun Rabbisine yiman keltirdik>>.

Faraon al syikyrchylardyn yiman keltirishkenin chetke kagyp myndai dedi: <<Menin uruksatymsyz ele Musaga yiman keltirdin'erbi? Chynynda Musa silerge syikyrchylykty uirotkon bashchyn'ar turbaiby. Korso siler baaryn'ar misirlikterdi oz zherinen chygaraiyn dep kelishken turbaisyn'arby. Silerge kandai zhaza bererimdi zhakynda bilesin'er. Men emi ar birin'erdin on' butu menen sol kolun zhe sol butu menen on' kolun kaichylash kesemin zhana baaryn'ardy kurma daragynyn son'goktoruno asamyn. Birin'erdi da kaltyrbaim>>.

Syikyrchylar Faraongo aityshty: <<Senin bul duinodo bizdi kesem, darga asam dep korkutup zhatkan nerselerin'din ech zyiany zhok. Senin azabyn' ubaktyluu. Biz bolso Rabbibizge kaitabyz zhana Al bizdi Ozunun tuboluk yraiymyna alat.
Biz Musaga birinchilerden bolup yiman keltirip zhana aga ishengenibiz sebeptuu Allakh bizdin murunku kylgan kunoolorubuzdu ochurot dep umut kylabyz>>.
Zhana Biz Musaga buirup: <<Israil urpaktaryn alyp tundo zholgo chyk. Faraon zhana any menen birge bolgondor silerdi kaitarysh uchun artyn'ardan tushot>> - dep vakhii kyldyk.
Faraon Israil urpaktary Misirden chygyp ketishkenin bilgende alardy artka kaitarysh uchun asker zhyinasyn dep bir top zhookerin shaarlarga zhiberdi.
Faraon Israil urpaktaryn ten'ine albai myndai dedi: <<Alar bolgonu bir az top ele.
Bular bizdin achuubuzdu kuchotkon nerseni kylyp zhatyshat.
Emi biz alarga daiardanyp sak bololu>>.
Biz Faraon menen anyn koomun Misir zhergesinen chygardyk. Al zherde tushumduu bakchalar zhana suu akkan bulaktar bar.
Bailyk kazynalary zhana kooz turak-zhailar bar.
Biz Faraon menen anyn koomun myna ushundai zhyrgalchylyktardan chygarganybyz syiaktuu Biz alardan kiiin Sham zhergesinde myna oshondoi ele zhakshylyktardy Israil urpaktaryna da berdik.
Faraon menen anyn koomu Israil urpaktaryn kun chykkan maalda kuup zhetishti.

Kachan Faraondun koomu menen Musanyn koomu biri-birine zholukkanda, alar biri-birin korushkondo Musanyn sherikteri aitty: <<Chyndygynda Faraon menen anyn koomu bizdi kuup zheterine az kaldy. Biz alarga turushtuk bere albaibyz>>.
Musa eline aitty: <<Abal siler elestetkendei emes! Chyndygynda Rabbim meni menen birge, Al koldoit zhana zhardam beret. Al maga zhol kutuluunun zholun korgozot>>.

Biz Musaga vakhii kylyp: <<Taiagyn' menen den'izdi chap!>> - dep buiruduk. Al any chapkanda den'iz ekige bolunup, al Israil urpaktarynyn uruularynyn sanyna barabar on eki zholgo ailandy. Den'izdin ar bir achylgan bolugu bekemdigi menen chon'dugunda uluu too syiaktuu bolup, alardan ech kandai suu akpai kaldy.
Biz Faraon menen anyn koomun zhakyn alyp keldik, anan alar zholdon otso bolot eken degen oido den'izge kirishti.
Biz Musa zhana any menen birge bolgon Israil urpaktaryn kutkardyk. Alardan bir da adam olgon zhok.
Andan son' Faraon menen anyn koomun den'izge chokturup zhok kyldyk.

Chyndygynda Musaga den'izdin ekige bolunushundo, anyn kutkarylyshynda zhana Faraon menen koomunun kyiroosunda Musanyn chynchyl ekenin bildirgen aiat-belgiler bar. Birok Faraon menen bolgondordun kopchulugu yiman keltirishken zhok.
Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda senin Rabbin' dushmandarynan och aluuga Kudurettuu, alardyn toobo kylgandaryna Yraiymduu.
Oo, paigambar! Alarga Ibrakhimdin okuiasyn okup ber.
Bir kezde al atasy Azarga zhana eline: <<Allakhtan bashka emnege syiynyp zhatasyn'ar?>> - dedi.
Eli aitty: <<Biz aikelder-buttarga syiynyp zhatabyz. Alarga syiynganybyzdy toktotpoibuz zhana alardy tashtabaibyz>>.
Ibrakhim alarga aitty: <<Al aikelder-buttarga duba kylsan'ar duban'ardy ugushaby?
Zhe siler alarga moiun sunsan'ar paida keltire alyshaby? Zhe siler alarga bash iibestik kylsan'ar zyian tiigize alyshaby?>>.

Alar aityshty: <<Alarga duba kylsak bizdi ugushpait, alarga moiun sunsak bizge paida keltire alyshpait, alarga bash iibestik kylsak bizge zyian tiigize alyshpait. Birok biz ata-babalarybyzdyn ushundai kylyshkandaryn korgonbuz. Oshonduktan biz alardy eerchiibiz>>.
Ibrakhim aitty: <<Siler oilonup kordun'or bele, Allakhtan bashka emne degen aikel-buttarga syiynyp zhatkanyn'ardy?
Zhana silerdin ilgerki ata-babalaryn'ardyn emnelerge syiynyshkandaryn?
Chyndygynda alardyn baarysy - menin dushmandarym. Antkeni butkul aalamdardyn Rabbisi Allakhtan bashkalary zhalgan.
Al meni zharatty zhana Al meni duino zhana akyret zhakshylyktaryna bagyttait.
Al zhalgyz Ozu meni tamaktandyrat, eger achka bolsom zhana Al maga ichiret, eger chan'kagan bolsom.
Eger oorup kalsam, Al zhalgyz Ozu meni oorumdan aiyktyrat. Menin Andan bashka aiyktyruuchum zhok.
Azhalym zhetken kezde Al zhalgyz Ozu meni olturot. Zhana Al meni olgondon kiiin kaira tiriltet.
Zhana men surak kunu zhalgyz Andan gana kunoolorumdu kechiruusun umut kylam.
Ibrakhim Rabbisine duba kylyp: <<Oo, Rabbim! Maga dinde tuura tushunuk ber zhana meni paigambarlardan bolgon takybaluulardyn kataryna kosh, alar menen birge beiishke kirgiz>> - dedi.
Meni kiiinki muundar alkysh-maktoo menen eskere turgandai kyl.
Zhana meni yimanduu pendelerin yrakhattangan beiishtegi orundardyn muraschylarynan kyl zhana anda zhashat.

Atamdy kechire kor! Chyndygynda al shirk kylgany sebeptuu akyikat zholdon adashkandardan boldu. Ibrakhimge atasy tozok eelerinen ekendiginin kabary bilingenge cheiin al aga duba kyldy. Kachan aga bul nerse anyk bolgondo al andan bash tartty zhana aga duba kylbai kaldy.
Adamdardy surak uchun kaira tiriltken kunu meni azap menen shermende kylba.
Al kundo adamga duinodo chogultkan bailygy da, any koldogon bala-chakasy da paida berbeit.

Birok Allakhka ech kandai shirk, eki zhuzduuluk, el korsunduk zhana ozuno-ozu suktanuu syiaktuu nerseler bolbogon taza zhurok menen kelgen adamga gana paida beret. Al Allakh zholunda sarptagan bailygy menen aga duba kylgan bala-chakasynyn paidasyn korot.
Beiish Rabbisinin buiruktaryn atkaryp zhana tyigandaryn tashtagan takyba adamdarga zhakyn keltirildi.
Al emi tozok surak maidanynda akyikat dinden adashkandarga korgozuldu.
Alarga aiyptoo maksatta aityldy: <<Siler syiynyp zhurgon aikel-buttaryn'ar kaida kaldy?
Allakhty tashtap alarga syiyngan elen'er? Alar silerdi Allakhtyn azabynan kutkaryp zhardam bere alat beken zhe ozdoruno bolso da zhardam bere alat beken?
Anan alar zhana alardy adashtyrgandar tozokko birinin ustuno biri yrgytylat.
Oshondoi ele zhin-shaitandardan bolgon Iblistin zhardamchylarynyn biri da kalbai but baarysy yrgytylat.
Allakhtan bashkaga syiynyp, alardy Aga sherik kylgan zhana Any tashtap ozdoru syiyngandar menen talashyp-tartyshkan mushrikter aityshty:
<<Allakhka ant bolsun! Korso biz akyikattan anyk adashuuda bolgon ekenbiz.
Biz silerdi but zharatylgandardyn Rabbisine ten'ep, Aga syiyngandai silerge syiynyppyz.
Bizdi akyikat zholdon kunookorlor gana adashtyrdy. Alar bizdi Allakhtan bashkaga syiynuuga uguttoshkon.
Emi Allakhtyn aldynda bizdi azaptan kutkaruuga ortomchu bolo turgan ech bir shapaatchy zhok.
Zhana bizdi korgoi turgan zhana bizge shapaat kyla turgan suiuktuu dos da zhok.
Egerde bizge duino zhashoosuna kaituuga mumkunchuluk berilgende biz Allakhka yiman keltirgenderden bolmokpuz>>.
Chyndygynda Ibrakhimdin okuiasy zhana zhalganchylardyn akybeti tuuraluu bul aitylgandarda adamdar uchun ulgu-nasaattar bar. Birok alardyn kopchulugu yiman keltirishken zhok.
Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda senin Rabbin' dushmandarynan och aluuga Kudurettuu, alardyn toobo kylgandaryna Yraiymduu.
Nukhtun koomu da any zhalganga chygaruu menen butkul paigambarlardy da zhalganga chygaryshty.
Bir kezde alarga tektesh tuugany Salikh mintip aitty: <<Allakhtan korkup, Andan bashka syiyngan nersen'erdi tashtap, Aga takyba bolboisun'arby?!".
Chyndygynda men Allakhtan silerge zhiberilgen elchimin zhana Allakh maga vakhii kylganga ech nerseni koshpogon zhana kemitpegen amanatkoimun.
Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkula zhana men silerge buirugan zhana tyigan nersede maga moiun sungula!
Men silerge Rabbim taraptan zhetkirgen nersem uchun silerden syilyk surabaim. Maga syilykty bashkalar emes, aalamdardyn Rabbisi gana beret.
Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkula zhana men silerge buirugan zhana tyigan nersede maga moiun sungula!

Aga eli aitty: <<Ei, Nukh! Biz saga yiman keltirip zhana sen alyp kelgen nerseni eerchip, any atkarat bekenbiz, a seni eerchigender bolso tomonku katmardagy adamdar, alardyn arasynda bashchylar da, kadyrluular da zhok?!>>.
Nukh alarga aitty: <<Men al yimanduular emne ish menen alektengeni tuuraluu kabarym zhok. Men alardyn kylgan ishterin sanap turgandai kozomoldoochu bolgon emes elem.
Alardyn esep-kysabyn aluu Allakhtyn moinunda. Alardyn ichki zhana syrtky duinosun men emes, Allakh Ozu bilet, eger aitkan sozun'ordu ozun'or tushungon bolson'or.
Men silerdi yiman keltirsin degen oido talabyn'ardy kabyl alyp yimanduulardy oturgan zhaiymdan kuup zhiberbeim.
Men bolgonu achyk eskertken eskertuuchumun. Silerge Allakhtyn azabyn eskertem>>.
Eli aga aitty: <<Egerde bizdi uguttop zhatkan nersen'di toktotposon', anda sen sozsuz sogushko kalyp, tashbaran'ga alynyp olosun'>>.
Nukh Rabbisine duba kylyp aitty: <<Oo, Rabbim! Elim meni zhalganga chygardy zhana Sen taraptan alyp kelgen nersede maga ishenishpedi.

Alar zhalgandan bash tartyshpagany uchun bizdin ortobuzda alardy zhok kyla turgandai okum chygar. Oshondoi ele meni zhana meni menen birge bolgon yimanduulardy elimdegi kaapyrlardy zhok kylgan nerseden kutkar>>.
Anan Biz anyn dubasyna zhoop berdik zhana adamdar menen aibanattarga tolgon kemede any menen birge yimanduulardy kutkardyk.
Andan son' alardyn artynda kalgan Nukhtun koomun chokturduk.

Chyndygynda bul aitylgan Nukhtun koomu menen bolgon okuiada, Nukh zhana any menen birge bolgon yimanduulardyn kutkarylyshynda zhana koomundagy kaapyrlardyn kyiroosunda adamdar uchun ulgu-nasaattar bar. Birok alardyn kopchulugu yiman keltirishken zhok.
Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda senin Rabbin' dushmandarynan och aluuga Kudurettuu, alardyn toobo kylgandaryna Yraiymduu.
Aad koomu da alardyn paigambary Khuddu zhalganga chygaruu menen butkul paigambarlardy zhalganga chygaryshty.
Estegin, bir kezde alarga tektesh tuugany Khud mintip aitty: <<Allakhtan korkup, Andan bashka syiyngan nersen'erdi tashtap, Aga takyba bolboisun'arby?!".
Chyndygynda men Allakhtan silerge zhiberilgen elchimin zhana Allakh maga buirugandy ashyrbastan zhana kemitpesten zhetkirgen amanatkoimun.
Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkula zhana men silerge buirugan zhana tyigan nersede maga moiun sungula!
Men silerge Rabbim taraptan zhetkirgen nersem uchun silerden syilyk surabaim. Maga syilykty bashkalar emes, aalamdardyn Rabbisi gana beret.
Siler emne, duinon'orgo zhana akyretin'erge paida alyp kelbegen imarattardy oiun, belgi katary biiik doboluu zherlerge kura beresin'erbi?!
Oshondoi ele bul duinodo tuboluk kalchudai, andan ketpechudoi bolup sepilderdi zhana sarailardy salyp zhatasyn'ar?!
Eger siler olturuu zhe urup-saboo menen kol salsan'ar, anda ech yraiym kylbastan kankorduk menen kol salasyn'ar.
Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkula zhana men silerge buirugan zhana tyigan nersede maga moiun sungula!
Silerdin ozun'orgo belgiluu zhakshylyktardy bergen Allakhtyn kaarynan korkkula!
Al silerge ui zhanybarlaryn zhana bala-chakalardy berdi.
Al silerge bakchalardy zhana akkan bulaktardy berdi.
Oo, elim! Chyndygynda men siler uchun uluu kyiamat kunundogu azaptan korkomun.
Eli aga aitty: <<Senin bizge eskertkenin' menen eskertpegenin' birdei. Biz saga yiman keltirbeibiz zhana ech kachan tutungan zholubuzdan kaitpaibyz.
Al emi bul abalkylardyn dini, urp-adattary zhana adepterinen bashka ech nerse emes.
Zhana biz azaptalbaibyz>>.

Alar Khud paigambardy zhalganga chygarganyn toktotushpady. Anan Biz alardy zhalganga chygaryshkany sebeptuu katuu shamal menen zhok kyldyk. Chyndygynda bul kyiratyp zhok kyluubuzda adamdar uchun ulgu-nasaattar bar. Birok alardyn kopchulugun yiman keltirishken zhok.
Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda Rabbin' dushmandarynan och aluuga Kudurettuu, pendelerinen toobo kylgandaryna Yraiymduu.
Samud eli da Salikh paigambardy zhalganga chygaruu menen butkul paigambarlardy da zhalganga chygaryshty.
Bir kezde alardyn tektesh tuugany Salikh aitty: <<Allakhtan bashka syiynganyn'ardy tashtap Andan korkpoisun'arby?!
Chyndygynda men Allakhtan silerge zhiberilgen elchimin zhana Al taraptan zhetkirgen nersede amanatkoimun, aga ech bir nerseni koshpoim zhana kemitpeim.
Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkula zhana men silerge buirugan zhana tyigan nersede maga moiun sungula!
Men silerge Rabbim taraptan zhetkirgen nersem uchun silerden syilyk surabaim. Maga syilykty bashkalar emes, aalamdardyn Rabbisi gana beret.
Siler zhakshylyk zhyrgalchylyktarda ech kandai korkunuchsuz aman-esen kalabyz dep kaalap zhatasyn'arby?
Bakchalarda zhana akkan bulaktarda.
Eginzarlarda zhana momoloru ezilip byshkan kurmalar arasynda.
Oshondoi ele ozun'or zhashash uchun toolordu oiup uilordu zhasap zhatasyn'ar. Siler toonu oigon zhaktan chebersin'er.
Emi Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkula zhana men silerge buirugan zhana tyigan nersede maga moiun sungula!
Kunoolordu kylyp ozdoruno zyian kylgan adamdardyn buiruguna bash iibegile!
Alar zher betinde kunoolordu zhaiyltyp buzukuluk kylyshkandar zhana Allakhka moiun sunuu menen ozdorun on'dobogon adamdar.
Aga eli aitty: <<Chyndygynda sen kop syikyrlana berip, akyry syikyr anyn akylyn zhogotkon adamdardansyn'!

Sen bizge okshogon ele adamsyn'! Bizge paigambar bolgudai senin bizden ech kandai artykchylygyn' zhok. Eger paigambarmyn dep aityp zhatkan sozun'do chynchyl bolson', anda paigambar ekenin'di dalildegen keremet belgi alyp kelchi?>>.

Allakh Salikhke keremet belgi kylyp, tashtan toonu chygaryp berdi. Oshondo Salikh alarga aitty: <<Myna bul too, karagyla zhana karmap korgulo.
