Suu ichuudo anyn oz kezegi bar, silerdin da belgiluu kezegin'er bar. Silerdin kezek kunun'ordo al suu ichpeit. Anyn kezek kunu kelgende siler da suu albaisyn'ar.
Emi any soiup zhe urup aga zyian keltirbegile, antsen'er, silerge Allakh taraptan azap kelet, al silerdin bashyn'arga balee tushkon uluu kundo silerdi oshol kunoon'or uchun kyiratyp zhok kylat>>.

Birok alar any soiobuz dep oz ara makuldashyp, alardyn en' baktysyzy any soiup saldy. Kachan alar azaptyn sozsuz tushorun bilishkende bul kylgandaryna okunup kalyshty. Birok azapty korgon kezde okunuch ech paida berbeit.

Oshondo alarga ubada kylyngan zher titiroo zhana ach kyikyryk syiaktuu azap alardy aldy. Chyndygynda bul aitylgan Salikhtin okuiasynda adamdar uchun ulgu-sabaktar bar. Birok alardyn kopchulugu yiman keltirishken zhok.
Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda Rabbin' dushmandarynan och aluuga Kudurettuu, pendelerinen toobo kylgandaryna Yraiymduu.
Luttun (aga Allakhtyn salamattygy, tynchtygy bolsun) eli da any zhalganga chygaruu menen butkul paigambarlardy zhalganga chygaryshty.
Bir kezde alardyn tektesh tuugany Lut mintip aitty: <<Allakhtan korkup, Aga sherik kylgan nersen'erdi tashtap, Aga takyba bolboisun'arby?!".
Chyndygynda men Allakhtan silerge zhiberilgen elchimin zhana Andan silerge zhetkirgen nersede amanatkoimun, aga ech nerseni koshpoim zhana kemitpeim.
Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkula zhana men silerge buirugan zhana tyigan nersede maga moiun sungula!
Men silerge Rabbim taraptan zhetkirgen nersem uchun silerden syilyk surabaim. Maga syilykty bashkalar emes, aalamdardyn Rabbisi gana beret.
Siler adamdardyn arasynan erkekterge artynan koshulup zhatasyn'arby?!
Allakh silerdin kumaryn'ardy kandyrysh uchun zharatyp koigon aialdaryn'ardy tashtaisyn'arby?! Birok siler bul buzukuluk kunoonu kyluu menen Allakhtyn chekterinen chyktyn'ar>>.
Eli Lutka aitty: <<Ei, Lut! Egerde bizdi bul ishten tyiganyn'dy toktotposon', anda seni zhana seni menen birge bolgondordu shaarybyzdan ketirebiz>>.
Lut alarga aitty: <<Chyndygynda men silerdin bul kylyp zhatkan ishin'erden zhiiirkenem, zhek korom.
Al Rabbisine kairylyp: <<Oo, Rabbim! Meni zhana ui-bulomdu bulardyn kylyp zhatkan kunoosu sebeptuu bashtaryna tusho turgan azaptan sakta>> - dep duba kyldy>>.
Oshondo Biz anyn dubasyna zhoop berdik, kiiin any zhana ui-bulosun tolugu menen kutkardyk.
Birok aialyn gana kutkarbadyk. Antkeni al kaapyr bolchu. Al kyirap ketkenderden boldu.
Andan son' Lut menen ui-bulosu Sadum shaarynan chykkandan kiiin Biz anyn artynda kalgan elin typtyipyl kylyp zhok kyldyk.
Biz alarga asmandan tashtardy zhamgyrdai zhaadyrdyk. Alarga zhaagan zhamgyr kandai zhaman! Lut alarga Allakhtyn azabyn eskertse da, alar aga karabastan kylgan kunoolorun ulanta berishti.
Chyndygynda buzukuluk kylyshkany sebeptuu Luttun koomuna tushkon azap tuuraluu aitylgan nersede adamdar uchun ulgu-sabaktar bar. Birok alardyn kopchulugu yiman keltirishken zhok.
Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda Rabbin' Oz dushmandarynan och aluuga Kudurettuu, toobo kylgan pendelerine Yraiymduu.
Madiianga zhakyn zhaigashkan zhysh bak-daraktuu shaardyn zhashoochulary da paigambary Shuaibga ishenbei, zhalpy paigambarlardy zhalganga chygaryshty.
Bir kezde alarga paigambary Shuaib aitty: <<Allakhka shirk kylganyn'ardy tashtap Andan korkpoisun'arby?!
Chyndygynda men Allakhtan silerge zhiberilgen elchimin zhana Andan silerge zhetkirgen nersede amanatkoimun, Al maga zhetkir dep buirugan nersege ech nerseni koshpoim zhana kemitpeim.
Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkula zhana men silerge buirugan zhana tyigan nersede maga moiun sungula!
Men silerge Rabbim taraptan zhetkirgen nersem uchun silerden syilyk surabaim. Maga syilykty bashkalar emes, aalamdardyn Rabbisi gana beret.
Sooda-satykta adamdarga toluk olchop-chenep bergile. Olchom-chenemdi kemitip zhep kaluuchulardan bolbogula!
Bashkalarga tartyp bergende tuura taraza menen tartkyla!
Adamdardyn akylaryn kemitpegile zhana zher betinde kunoolordu kylyp buzukuluktu zhaibagyla!
Silerdi zhana murunku muundardy zharatkan Allakhtyn silerge zhazasy tushuudon korkkula.
Shuaibdyn eli aga aitty: <<Chyndygynda sen kop zholu syikyrlanyp, akyry al syikyr senin akylyn'a ustomduk kylyp, any ketirdi.

Sen bizge okshogon ele adamsyn'. Bizden ech kandai artykchylygyn' dele zhok. Anan kantip paigambar bolmok elen'? Biz senin paigambarmyn dep aityp zhatkan sozun'do anyk ele zhalganchysyn' degen oidobuz.
Egerde aitkan sozun'do chynchyl bolson', anda bizdin ustubuzgo asmandyn bir bolugun tushurup zhiberchi.
Shuaib alarga aitty: <<Rabbim siler kylyp zhatkan shirkti zhana kunoolordu en' zhakshy bilet. Silerdin kylgan ishin'erdin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes>>.

Alar zhalganga chygaryshkanyn toktotkon zhok. Anan alarga aptaptuu kundun artynan bulut kolokologon azap keldi. Oshondo alardyn ustunon ot zhaap, alardy kuiguzup saldy. Chyndygynda alar kyiragan kun - chon' korkunuchka tolgon kun boldu.
Chyndygynda bul aitylgan Shuaibdyn elinin kyiroosunda adamdar uchun ulgu-sabaktar bar. Birok alardyn kopchulugu yiman keltirishken zhok.
Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda Rabbin' Oz dushmandarynan och aluuga Kudurettuu, pendelerinen toobo kylgandaryna Yraiymduu.
Chyndygynda Mukhammadga (aga Allakhtyn salamy, tynchtygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) tushkon bul Kuran - makuluktardyn Rabbisi tarabynan tushtu.
Any amanatkoi Zhebreil alyp keldi.
Oo, paigambar! Al any sen adamdardy eskertken zhana alardy Allakhtyn azabynan korkutkan paigambarlardan bolushun' uchun senin zhurogun'o alyp keldi.
Al any achyk-aikyn tushunuktuu bolgon arab tilinde alyp keldi.
Chyndygynda bul Kuran asmandan tushkon abalkylardyn kitepterinde eskerilip, al tuuraluu kush kabarlar aitylgan.
Saga tushkon nersenin akyikat ekenin Abdullakh ibn Salam syiaktuu Israil urpaktarynyn aalymdarynyn biluusu - al zhalganchylar uchun senin chynchyldygyn'a dalil bolo albaiby?
Egerde Biz bul Kurandy arab tilinde suilobogon arab emes elderge tushurgon bolsok
zhana alarga any okup berse, alar yiman keltirishmek emes. Sebebi alar: <<Biz munu tushungon zhokpuz>> - deshmek. Andyktan alar Allakhka shugur kylyshsyn, antkeni any alardyn tilinde tushurdu.
Oshondoi ele Biz kunookorlordun zhuroktoruno (Kuranga bolgon) zhalgan menen kaapyrlykty kirgizdik.
Alar kyinoochu azapty korushmoiuncho kaapyrlyktan kaityshpait zhana yiman keltirishpeit.
Al azap alarga kapystan kelet. Al alarga kutuusuz kelgenge cheiin alar anyn kelerin bilishpeit.
Alarga azap kutuusuz kelgende katuu okunuchton myndai deshet: <<Bizge moonot beriler beken, biz Allakhka toobo kylaly?>>.
Al kaapyrlar Bizdin azabybyzdy shashtyryp: <<Sen bizdin ustubuzgo asmandyn bir bolugun tushurmoiuncho biz saga yiman keltirbeibiz>> - dep zhatyshaby?!
Oo, paigambar! Aitchy Maga, egerde Biz sen alyp kelgen nerseden bash tartkan kaapyrlarga uzak ubakyt boiu zhakshylyktardy berip zhyrgatkan bolsok,
andan son' alar oshol zhakshylyktarga zhetken zamandan kiiin alarga ubada kylyngan azap kelgen bolso,
Alardyn bul duinodogu zhakshylyktary alarga kandai paida alyp kelmek?! Al zhakshylyktar ketti zhana ech kandai paida da keltirgen zhok.
Biz kaisy eldi kyiratyp zhok kylgan bolsok, demek alarga paigambarlar zhiberilip zhana kitepter tushurulup aktanuuga sebep kalbai kalgandan kiiin gana bolgon.
Alarga sabak zhana eskertuu bolsun uchun. Alarga paigambarlar zhiberilip zhana kitepter tushurulup aktanuuga sebep kalbai kalgandan kiiin Biz alardy azaptoo menen zaalymdardan bolgon zhokpuz.
Bul Kurandy paigambardyn zhuroguno shaitandar alyp kelgen zhok.
Anyn zhuroguno alardyn alyp keluusu tuura emes. Buga alardyn kuch-kudureti da zhetpeit.
Alardyn buga kudureti zhetpeit. Antkeni alar asmandagy anyn turgan zhaiynan tosulup, toluk bogottolgon. Anan kantip aga zhetip, any alyp tushushmok ele?!
Allakhka sherik kylyp Any menen katar bashka kudaiga syiynba! Bolboso, munun sebebinen azaptaluuchulardan bolup kalasyn'.
Oo, paigambar! Elin'din arasynan en' zhakyndaryn'ardan bashtap eskert! Egerde alar shirk kyla berishse, alarga Allakhtyn azaby kelet.
Zhana seni eerchigen yimanduularga meerimduuluk, zhumshaktyk kylyp ish zhuzundo zhana soz turundo zhyluu-zhumshak mamile kyl!

Eger alar saga bash iibestik kylyp, senin alarga aitkan Allakhty zhalgyzdoo zhana Aga moiun sunuu syiaktuu buiruktaryn'a zhoop berishpese, anda alarga: <<Chyndygynda men siler kylyp zhatkan shirkke zhana kunoolorgo katyshym zhok>> - dep aitkyn.
Ar bir ishin'de Oz dushmandarynan och aluuga Kudurettuu, alardyn Aga kaitkandaryna Yraiymduu Allakhka gana tobokel kyl.
Al senin namazga turganyn'dy korup turat.
Zhana Al namaz okugandardyn arasynda senin bir abaldan ekinchi abalga otkonun'du da korup turat. Aga senin zhana bashkalardyn kylgan nerselerinin ech biri zhashyruun emes.
Chyndygynda Al sen okugan Kurandy zhana zikirdi Uguuchu, senin nietin'di Biluuchu.

Kachan alar Kurandy shaitandar alyp tushkon zhana Mukhammad akyn dep aityshkanda Allakh alardyn bul oiuna zhoop kylyp myndai dedi:
Siler bul Kurandy alyp tushkon dep oilop zhatkan shaitandar kandai adamdarga tushoru tuuraluu silerge kabar bereiinbi?
Al shaitandar kop kunoo kylgan zhalganchy, kozu achyktarga okshogondorgo tushot.

Shaitandar biiiktegi perishteler tobunan uurdanyp soz tyn'shap, kiiin any dostoru bolgon kozu achyktarga aityshat. Kozu achyktar deerlik zhalganchylar. Alar bir sozdu chyn aityshsa da any menen kosho zhuz zhalgandy aityshat.

Al emi siler Mukhammaddy (aga Allakhtyn salamattygy, tynchtygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) osholordon dep oilop zhatkan akyndardy bolso, akyikat zholdon adashkandar eerchishet. Alar anyn aityp zhatkandaryn yr dep oilop zhatyshat.
Oo, paigambar! Sen alardyn ar kaisy oroondo temselep, birde maktoo ugup, birde aiyp ugup zhe bashka nerselerge kabylyp zhurushkonu alardyn adashkandarynyn korunushtorunon ekenin korgon zhoksun'bu?!
Alar zhalgan suiloshot. Biz munu kyldyk deshet, birok any kylyshkan emes.

Birok Khassan ibn Sabitke okshop yiman keltirgen, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgan, Allakhty kop eskergen zhana Allakhtyn dushmandarynan zulum korgondon kiiin alardan och algan akyndar andai emes. Al emi Allakhka shirk kylyp zulumduk kylgandar zhana Anyn pendelerine zorduk-zombuluk korsotkondor zhakynda kaisy zhaiga bararyn bilishet. Anan alar uluu zhaiga zhana kyldat surak beruugo kaityp kelishet.

(Ts) Ta, siin. Ushuga okshogon aiattyn tushundurmosu bakara suroosunun bashynda kelgen. Saga tushurulgon bul aiattar - Kuran aiattary zhana ech kandai budomugu zhok achyk-aikyn Kitep. Aga oi zhugurtkon adam anyn Allakh taraptan ekenin bilet.
Bul aiattar akyikat zholgo bagyttoochu, oshondoi ele Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirgenderge suiunchu kabar.
Alar namazdy toluk turdo atkaryshat, tiiishtuu zhaktarga mal-mulktorunon sarptap zeket berishet zhana alar akyrette bolo turgan syilyk zhana zhazaga teren' ishenishet.

Al emi akyrettegi bolo turgan syilyk zhana zhazaga ishenbegen kaapyrlarga Biz alardyn kylgan ishterin kooz kylyp korgozup koiduk. Alar any kylyshkandaryn toktotkon zhok. Alar tuuralykka da, akyikatka da kelbei dendaroo bolup zhurushot.

Ushul aitylgan sypattagy adamdarga bul duinodo olturuu, tutkunga tushuu syiaktuu zhaman azaptar bar. Al emi akyrette alar en' chon' zhogotuuga uchuragan adamdardan bolot. Antkeni alar kyiamatta ozdorun da, ui-bulosun da tuboluk tozokto kaltyruu menen kyiroogo uchuratat.

Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda sen bul tushkon Kurandy Daanyshman taraptan alyp zhatasyn'. Al Oz zharatuusunda, bashkaruusunda zhana okum chygaruusunda Daanyshman, pendelerinin kyzykchylyktarynyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun bolbogon Biluuchu.

Oo, paigambar! Estechi, bir kezde Musa oz ui-bulosuno: <<Men ot kordum. Oshol ot zhakkandardan bizge zholdu korgozup koigula dep surap zhe silerge suukta zhylynganga oshol otton bir az chok alyp keleiin>> - dedi.

Kachan al korgon ot kuigon zherge zhetkende Allakh aga kairylyp aitty: <<Ottun ichindegige zhana anyn ailanasyndagy perishtelerge bereke bolsun! Aalamdardyn Rabbisi uluk zhana Al adashuuchular aityp zhatkan Aga ylaiyksyz sypattardan aruu!>>.
Allakh aga aitty: <<Oo, Musa! Bul Men Allakh - ech kim Meni zhen'e albagan Kudurettuumun zhana zharatuumda, tagdyr zhana okum kyluumda Daanyshmanmyn.

Taiagyn'da tashta!>>. Musa aitkandy atkardy. Kachan Musa anyn zhylandai bolup kyimyldap zhatkanyn korgondo, burulup artyna karabai kachty. Oshondo Allakh aga aitty: <<Andan korkpo! Chyndygynda Menin aldymda paigambarlar zhylandan zhe bashka nerselerden korkushpait.
Birok kim kunoo kylyp ozuno zulumduk kylsa, andan son' toobo kylgan bolso, anda Men aga Kechirimduumun, Yraiymduumun.

Kolun'du moiundan yldyi koinogun'dun achyk zherine sal, any salgandan kiiin ala oorusunun agyndai emes kardai appak bolup chygat. Bul Faraodun zhana anyn koomunun aldynda senin chyndyldygyn'dy kubolondurgon toguz keremet belgilerden (kol, taiak, kurgakchylyk, tushumdun zhoktugu, suu kaptoo, saranchalar, bitter, bakalar, kan). Chyndygynda alar kaapyrlyk kylyshyp Allakhka moiun sunuudan bash tartyshkandar.
Kachan alarga Biz Ozubuz koldop Musaga bergen keremet belgileribiz kelgende alar aityshty: <<Musa alyp kelgen bul keremet belgiler anyk ele syikyr>>.

Alar bul aiat-belgilerge kaapyr bolushtu zhana Allakh taraptan ekenin bilip turushsa da zulumduktary zhana akyikatty kabyl aluudan tekeberlenishkeni sebeptuu alardy moiunga alyshkan zhok. Oo, paigambar! Oilonup korchu, kaapyrlyk zhana kunoo kylyp zher betinde buzukuluk kylgandardyn akybeti kandai boldu ele. Biz alardyn but baaryn typtyipyl kylyp zhok kyldyk.

Biz Daud menen anyn uulu Sulaimanga ilim berdik. Al ilimdin ichinde kanattuulardyn tilin biluu da bar. Daud menen Sulaiman Allakh Taalaga shugur kylyp: <<Allakhka alkysh-maktoolor bolsun! Al bizge ilim, paigambarlyk beruu menen kop yimanduu pendelerinen artyk kyldy>> deshti.

Sulaiman atasy Dauddan kiiin paigambarlykty, ilimdi zhana biilikti muraska aldy. Al Allakhtyn aga zhana atasyna kylgan zhakshylygyn soz kylyp myndai dedi: <<Oo, adamdar! Allakh bizge kanattuulardyn undorun tushunuunu uirottu, bizge paigambarlarga zhana padyshalarga bergen bardyk nerseden berdi. Chyndygynda Allakhtyn bizge bergen bul nersesi achyk-aikyn artykchylyk>>.
Zhana Sulaimanga adamdardan, zhinderden, kanattuu kushtardan turgan askerleri chogultuldu zhana alar tartip menen tizilip turushtu.

Alar zhol zhurup oturup, (Sham zhergesindegi) kumurskalardyn oroonuno kelishkende bir kumurska myndai dedi: <<Ei, kumurskalar! Uian'arga kirgile! Sulaiman menen askerleri silerdi baikabai tepselep olturup ketishpesin. Eger alar silerdi bilishse, anda tepseleshmek emes>>.

Kachan Sulaiman anyn bul aitkan sozun ukkanda aga zhylmaiyp kuldu zhana Rabbisine duba kylyp aitty: <<Oo, Rabbim! Maga zhana ata-eneme bergen zhakshylyktaryn'a shugur kyluuga maga mumkunchuluk ber zhana any kon'ulumo sal! Oshondoi ele Sen yraazy bolgon zhakshylyk ishterdi kyluuga iigilik ber zhana takyba pendelerin' menen birgelikte meni Oz yraiymyn'a al>>.

Sulaiman kanattuu kushtardy bir syira karoodon otkorup zhatyp upuptu tappady. Oshondo al aitty: <<Maga emne bolgon, upuptu korboi zhatam? Any koruumo bir nerse toskool bolup zhataby zhe al bul zherde zhokpu?>>.
Anyn zhok ekeni aga maalym bolgondo al aitty: <<Men any katuu azap menen azaptaim zhe kelbegeni uchun zhaza katary any soiom zhe kelbei kalganynyn sebebin achyktagan anyk dalil alyp kelsin>>.
Upuptun zhok bolgonu kopko sozulgan zhok. Al kelip Sulaimanga myndai dedi: <<Men sen bilbegen nerseni bilip keldim. Men saga Saba elinen ech kandai shegi zhok chyn kabar menen keldim.
Men alardy aial bashkarganyn kordum. Al aialga kubattuuluktun zhana biiliktin butkul sebepteri beriliptir. Anyn chon' taktysy bar eken, al anyn ustunon turup elinin koigoilorun chechet eken.

Men al aial menen anyn koomun Allakhtan bashka kungo sazhda kylyp zhatyshkanyn kordum. Shaitan alardyn kylgan shirk menen kunoo ishterin kooz kylyp korgozup, alardy akyikat zholdon adashtyryptyr zhana alar aga tushushkon zhok.

Shaitan alardy zhalgyz Allakhka sazhda kylbasyn dep shirk menen kunoo ishterdi koozdop korgozuptur. Al asmandagy zhashyrylgan zhamgyrdy zhana zherdegi zhashyrylgan osumduktordu chygarat. Al alardyn zhashyrgan da, achyk kylgan da ishterin bilet. Bulardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.
Allakhtan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok. Al uluu Arshtyn Rabbisi.
Sulaiman upupko aitty: <<Aitkan sozun'dun' chyn zhe zhalgan ekenin azyr teksherip korobuz>>.

Oshondo Sulaiman kat zhazdy zhana any sasyk upupko berip, myndai dedi: <<Bul katty algynyn' da, any Saba eline tashta, alarga zhetkir. Anan chetkereek turup, kat zhonundo emne dep aitkandaryn tyn'shap tur>>.
Khanysha aial al katty alyp myndai dedi: <<Oo, kadyrmandar! Maga bir oluttuu kat keliptir.
Bul zhiberilgen kat Sulaimandan eken. Anyn mazmunu myndaicha bashtalyptyr: <<Yraiymduu, Meerimduu Allakhtyn ysymy menen bashtaimyn.
Tekeberlik kylbagyla zhana men silerdi chakyrgan nersege bash iiip kelgile, zhalgyz Allakhka syiyngyla zhana siler Any menen katar kungo syiynuu menen kylyp zhatkan shirkti tashtagyla>>.
Khanysha aitty: <<Oo, bashchylar zhana kadyrmandar! Maga bul ishte tuura zholdu korgozgulo. Men siler katyshmaiyncha zhana bul nersede oiun'ardy aitmaiyncha ech bir ishke chechim kylbaim>>.

Elindegi kadyrmandar aityshty: <<Biz chon' kuchko zhana sogushta ebegeisiz kubattuulukka eebiz. Biz sizdin oiun'uz menen birgebiz. Bizge kandai buiruk beruunu oilonup korun'uz. Biz any atkaruuga daiarbyz>>.

Khanysha aitty: <<Chyndygynda padyshalar kaisy bir shaarga basyp kirishse, anyn tash-talkanyn chygaryshat, olturushot, talap-tonoshot. Aga cheiin kuch-kuduretke ee bashchylardy zhana kadyrluu adamdardy kordukka salyshat. Oshondoi ele padyshalar kaisy bir shaardyn elin bagyndyrsa, alardyn zhuroktoruno ar daiym korkunuch salyshat.
Men kattyn eesine zhana eline belek tartuu kylaiyn. Anan belekterdi tartuu kylgandan kiiin elchiler emne menen kaitaryn koroiun>>.

Kachan anyn elchisi menen zhardamchylary Sulaimanga belekterdi alyp kelishkende, al alardyn belek tartuu kylgandaryn chetke kagyp myndai dedi: <<Meni silerge tiiishpesin dep maga mal-mulk menen zhardam bereiin dedin'erbi? Allakh maga bergen paigambarlyk, biilik zhana bailyk silerdin bergen nersen'erden zhakshyraak. Teskerisinche, silerge bul duinonun arzybagan nerseleri belek kylynsa, suiungon adamdardansyn'ar>>.

Sulaiman anyn elchisine aitty: <<Belekterin'di al dagy, kaira alarga kaityp bar! Emi biz aga zhana eline alar turushtuk bere albai turgandai asker menen baryp, alardy Sabadan kuup chygabyz. Eger alar maga moiun sunup kelishpese, buga cheiinki kuch-kubattuulugun zhogotup, kordukka tush bolushat>>.
Sulaiman padyshalyk bashchylarga kairylyp: <<Oo, toboldor! Alar maga moiun sunup kelishkenge cheiin kim anyn biilik taktysyn alyp kele alat?>> - dedi.

Zhinderdin doo-shaalarynan bolgon biroosu aitty: <<Men anyn taktysyn sen ushul oturgan zherin'den turganga cheiin alyp kele alam. Chyndygynda men any alyp keluugo kudurettuumun, andan ech nerseni kemitpei toluk alyp keluugo ishenichtuumun>>.

Sulaimandyn aldyndagy bir takyba aalym kishi aitty. Anyn Kitepten ilimi bar ele, anyn ichinde Allakhtyn uluu ysymy aitylgan, any atap duba kylynsa, zhoop berilgen. Oshol kishi aitty: <<Men any kozun'du irmegenche ele alyp kele alam. Men Allakhka duba kylam, Al oshol zamat alyp kelet. Oshondo al duba kyldy, Allakh anyn dubasyna zhoop berdi. Kachan Sulaiman koz aldynda taktynyn turganyn korgondo myndai dedi: <<Bul Rabbimdin meni zhakshylyktarga shugur kylaby zhe alardy tanyp ketebi dep synash uchun bergen artykchylygy. Kimde-kim Allakhka shugur kylsa, anda anyn shugur kylganynyn paidasy ozuno gana kaitat. Allakh Beimuktazh, pendelerdin shugur kylgany Aga ech nerseni koshpoit. Al emi kim Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryn tanyp, Aga shugur kylbasa, anda Rabbim anyn shugur kyluusuna Beimuktazh, Ken'peiil. Zhakshylyktardy tangandarga da zhoomarttyk kyluusu - Anyn ken' peiildiginen>>.
Sulaiman aitty: <<Anyn biilik taktysyn murunku korunushunon bashkacha kylyp ozgortup koigula. Korolu, al oz taktysyn taanyp keter beken zhe oz buiumdaryn da taanybagan adamdardan bolot beken?>>.

Kachan Sabanyn khanyshasy Sulaimanga kelgende, any synash uchun: <<Bul senin taktyn'a okshosh beken?>> - dep suraldy. Al: <<Dal ozu go!>> - dep zhoop berdi. Oshondo Sulaiman aitty: <<Allakh bizge andan aldyn ushundai nerselerdi ishke ashyruuga bolgon kudurettuulugu tuuraluu ilimdi bergen. Biz Allakhtyn buiruguna eerchiibiz, Aga moiun sunabyz>>.

Al emi khanyshany zhalgyz Allakhka syiynuudan oz elin eerchip Andan bashkaga syiynyp kelgen nersesi tosup turdu. Chyndygynda al Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgan koomdordon ele. Osholor syiaktuu kaapyr bolchu.

Aga: <<Khan-saraiga kirin'iz!>> - dep aityldy. Al suunun betindei korunushto ele. Any korgondo suu eken dep oilop, any kecheiin dep kiiimin baltyryna cheiin kotorgondo Sulaiman aga: <<Bul khan-sarai zhylmakailap tegizdelgen ainekten kurulgan>> - dedi. Anan any Islamdy kabyl aluuga chakyrdy. Al anyn chakyrygyna zhoop berip myndai dedi: <<Oo, Rabbim! Chyndygynda men Seni menen katar bashkalarga syiynyp ozumo zyian keltirip zhurupmun. Men emi Sulaiman menen birgelikte butkul aalamdardyn Zharatuuchusu, Bashkaruuchusu bolgon Allakhka moiun sundum>>.

Biz Samud eli zhalgyz Allakhka gana syiynyshsyn dep alarga ozdorunon bolgon tektesh tuugany Salikhti zhiberdik. Alar anyn chakyrygynan kiiin ele yimanduular zhana kaapyrlar bolup eki topko bolunushup, kimisi akyikatta dep oz ara talashyp tartysha bashtady.
Salikh alarga aitty: <<Emnege siler yraiymdan murun azapty tezdet dep talap kylyp zhatasyn'ar? Andan koro Allakh silerge yraiym kylsyn dep kunoolorun'or uchun Andan kechirim tilesen'er bolboibu?>>.

Eli akyikattan bash tartyp aga: <<Biz senden zhana seni menen birge bolgon yimanduulardan bir zhamandyk bolorun zhorup zhatabyz>> - deshti. Salikh (aga Allakhtyn salamattygy zhana tynchtygy bolsun) alarga aitty: <<Bashyn'arga zhamandyk kelet dep oilop zhatkan zhoromolun'ardyn bilimi Allakhtyn aldynda. Anyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Teskerisinche, silerge berilgen koptogon zhakshylyktar zhana bashyn'arga tushkon zhamandyktar sebeptuu synalyp zhatkan koomsun'ar>>.
Khizhr shaarynda toguz kishi bar ele. Alar zher betinde kaapyrlyk zhana kunoolordu kylyp buzukuluk kylyshchu. Zhana alar yiman keltirip zhana zhakshylyk ishterdi kylyp zher betin on'doshkon emes.

Alar (Salikh paigambardy olturmokchu bolgondor) biri-birine: <<Tundo anyn uiuno baryp, alardy olturolu. Ushundai kyluuga baarybyz Allakhka ant bereli>>. Kiiin zhakyn tuugandaryna: <<Biz Salikh menen anyn ui-bulosunun olgonunon kabarybyz zhok. Biz chyndykty suilogon adamdarbyz>> - dep koiobuz>> deshti.

Alar Salikh zhana any eerchigen yimanduulardy zhok kyluu uchun zhashyruun aila kylyshty ele, anan Biz dagy any koldop, alardyn aila-amaldarynan kutkaryp zhana anyn elindegi kaapyrlardy zhok kylysh uchun aila kyldyk. Birok alar any bilbei kalyshty.
Oo, paigambar! Karachy, alardyn aila-amaldarynyn akybeti emne bolgonun? Biz alardy Oz azabybyz menen tup tamyry menen zhok kyldyk. Alardyn biri da kalbai zhok boldu.

Myna alardyn uiloru, dubaldary buzulup urap, zulumduk kylyshkandary sebeptuu eesiz bosh kaldy. Chyndygynda alardyn zulumduktary sebeptuu alarga azaptyn tushuusundo yiman keltirgen koom uchun ulgu-sabaktar bar. Myna osholor aiat-belgilerden sabak alyshat.
Biz Salikhtin elinen Allakhka yiman keltirgenderin saktap kaldyk. Alar Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkushat ele.
Oo, paigambar! Luttu estechi, bir kezde al koomuna katuu eskertip aitty: <<Siler chogulgan zhaiyn'arda ele biri-birin'erdin kozun'orcho zhiiirkenichtuu zhoruktu (bachabazdykty) kyla beresin'erbi?!

Siler abiiirdi saktoonu, balaluu boluunu kaalabastan, aiban kumaryn'ardy kandyrysh uchun aialdardy tashtap, erkekter menen koshulup zhatasyn'arby?! Zhok! Siler ozun'orgo mildet bolgon yimandan, tazalyktan zhana kunoodon alys boluu degendi bilbegen naadan koomsun'ar>>.

Oshondo eli aga zhoop kylyp ushul gana sozdu aitty: <<Luttun ui-bulosun shaaryn'ardan chygargyla! Chyndygynda alar ypylas nerselerden tazalanabyz degen adamdar eken>>. Alar munu Luttun ui-bulosun shyldyn'doo maksatta aityshty. Antkeni alardyn kylyp zhatkan buzukuluktaryna koshulgan zhok. Teskerisinche, alardy andai kyluudan eskertishti.
Kiiin Biz any zhana ui-bulosun kutkardyk. Al emi aialyn azapka duushar bolup, kyiragandardyn katarynda bolsun dep okum kylgandyktan kutkarbadyk.
Zhana Biz alarga asmandan tash zhaadyrdyk. Azap menen korkutulsa da zhoop berbegenderdi oiron kyluuchu zhamgyr kandai zhaman!

Oo, paigambar! Ait: <<Zhakshylyktar uchun Allakhka maktoolor bolsun zhana Lut menen Salikhtin koomun azaptagan azabynan paigambardyn sakhabalaryna amandyk bolsun! Butkul nersenin biiligi Anyn kolunda bolgon syiynuuga tatyktuu Allakh zhakshyby, zhe paida da, zyian da keltire albagan mushrikter syiynyp zhatkan kudailarby?!

Zhe bolboso, asmandar menen zherdi murda bolbogon korunushto zharatyp, silerge asmandan zhamgyr suusun tushurgon Zatpy, ei adamdar?! Biz any menen siler uchun kooz bakchalardy osturduk. Al bakchalardagy daraktardy osturuu silerdin kolun'ardan kelbeit bolchu. Alardy Allakh gana osturdu. Allakh menen katar ushundai kyla algan kudai bar beken?! Zhok! Birok alar akyikattan chygyp, zulumduk kylyp zharatylgandardy Zharatuuchuga ten'egen koom bolushtu.

Zhe bolboso, kim Zherdi anyn ustundogulordu silkibei turgandai turuktuu bekem kyldy, anyn ichinde daryialardy agyzdy, aga bekem toolordu ornottu, oshondoi ele tussuz suu buzulup ichuugo zharaksyz bolbosh uchun tuzduu zhana tuzsuz den'izdin ortosun bolgon tosmo kylyp koidu? Allakh menen katar ushundai kyla algan kudai bar beken?! Zhok! Birok alardyn kopchulugu bilishpeit. Egerde alar bilishkende, anda Allakhka zharatylgandardy sherik kylyshmak emes.

Zhe bolboso, kim ishi oorloshup kyinalgandyn dubasyna zhoop beret, ooruga zhana zhakyrlykka zh.b. kabylgan adamdy kutkarat, silerdi Zher betine muundan muunga biri-birin'erdin ordun baskan orunbasar kylat? Allakh menen katar ushundai kyla algan kudai bar beken?! Zhok! Birok siler oto az ulgu-sabak alasyn'ar.

Zhe bolboso, siler uchun belgilerdi zhana zhyldyzdardy zhaigashtyruu arkyluu kurgaktyk menen den'iz karan'gylyktarynda kim silerge zhol korgozot? Zhana pendelerine yraiym kylyp zhamgyrdyn zhaashyn suiunchulogon shamaldardy kim zhiberet? Allakh menen katar ushundai kyla algan kudai bar beken?! Allakh alardyn kylgan shirkterinen aruu zhana yiyk!

Zhe bolboso, insandy zhatynda baskych-baskych kylyp abalky iret zharatyp, zhashoodon olturup kiiin kaira tirilte turgan kim? Zhana silerge asman taraptan tushkon zhamgyr menen yrysky bergen, Zher betinde osturgon osumduktor menen yrysky bergen kim? Allakh menen katar ushundai kyla algan kudai bar beken?! Oo, paigambar! Al mushrikterge ait: <<Siler kylyp zhatkan shirkke dalilin'erdi alyp kelgilechi, egerde biz akyikattabyz dep aityp zhatkan sozun'ordo chynchyl bolson'or>>.

Oo, paigambar! Ait: <<Asmandardagy perishteler menen zherdegi adamdar kaiypty bilishpeit. Birok zhalgyz Allakh gana bilet. Alar surak uchun kaira kachan tirilerin Allakhtan bashka asmandardagylardyn zhana zherdegilerdin ech kimisi bilbeit.
Zhe alardyn akyret tuuraluu bilimi artyp, any anyk bilishiptirbi? Zhok! Teskerisinche, alar akyret tuuraluu shektenip, dendaroo bolup zhurushot. A tugul andan kor bolup kalyshty>>.
Kaapyrlyk kylgandar chetke kagyp myndai deshti: <<Biz olup topurakka ailangandan kiiin kaira kantip tirilmek elek?!

Bizge zhana buga cheiin ata-babalarybyzga kaira tirilesin'er degen ubadalar aitylgan. Birok biz bul ubada ishke ashpait dep oiloibuz. Bizge aitylgan bul ubadalardyn baarysy abalkylar kitepterine zhazyp ketken kalp ulamyshtan bashka ech nerse emes>>.

Oo, paigambar! Kaira tiriluunu chetke kakkandarga ait: <<Zherdin but tarabyn kezgile! Kaira tiriluunu zhalganga chygargan kunookorlordun akybeti kandai bolgonun korgulo! Alar any zhalganga chygargany uchun Biz alardy zhok kyldyk>>.
Mushrikter senin chakyrygyn'dan bash tartkandary uchun kaigyrba zhana alardyn aila-amaldary uchun kokurogun'don sygylba. Allakh saga alardyn ustunon zhen'ish beret.
Kaira tiriluunu chetke kakkan elin'degi kaapyrlar aityshat: <<Sen zhana yimanduular bizge ubada kylyp zhatkan azap kachan ishke ashat, eger siler bul aityp zhatkan nersen'erde chynchyl bolson'or?>>.
Oo, paigambar! Alarga ait: <<Siler shashtyryp zhatkan azaptyn kee biri zhakyndap kalgan bolushu mumkun>>.

Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda senin Rabbin' adamdarga yraiym kyluuchu. Antkeni alar kaapyrlyk zhana kunoo kylyshsa da alardy zhazaloogo shashylgan zhok. Birok adamdardyn kopchulugu Allakhtyn alarga bergen zhakshylyktaryna shugur kylyshpait.
Chyndygynda Rabbin' pendelerinin zhuroktoru emneni zhashyryp, emneni ashkere kylganyn zhakshy bilet. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda anyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.
Adamdar uchun asmandar menen Zherdegi kandai gana kaiyp nerse bolbosun, al anyk Kitep Lavkhul Makhfuzda (Saktalgan Taktada) zhazylgan.
Chyndygynda Mukhammadga tushkon bul Kuran Israil urpaktarynyn talashyp-tartyshkan kop nerselerin baiandap, alardyn adashkandaryn achyktap beret.
Chyndygynda Kuran andagy kelgenderdi atkargan yimanduular uchun tuura zhol zhana yraiym.

Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda senin Rabbin' kyiamat kunu adamdardyn yimanduulary menen kaapyrlarynyn ortosunda adilettuu okum zhurguzot. Al Oz dushmandarynan och algan, ech kim any zhen'e albagan Kudurettuu, chynchyl menen zhalganchyny zhan'ylbai aiyrmalagan Biluuchu.
Emi sen butkul ishin'de Allakhka tobokel kyl zhana Aga taian. Chyndygynda sen anyk akyikattasyn'.

O, paigambar! Sen, Allakhka kaapyr bolgonu uchun zhurogu olup kalgan oluktorgo uguza albaisyn' zhana Allakh kulaktaryn duloi kylyp sen chakyrgan chyndykty ukpai kalgandarga da uguza albaisyn', antkeni alar senden zhuz burup kaityp ketishken.

Akyikatty koruudon kozu kor bolup kalgandardy da tuura zholgo sala albaisyn'. Alar uchun kaigyrba, ozun'du kyinaba. Sen chyndykty Bizdin aiattarybyzga yiman keltirgenderge gana zhetkire alasyn'. Alar Allakhtyn buiruktaryna bash iigender.

Kachan alar kaapyrlyktan zhana kunoolorunon bash tartpagany sebeptuu alarga azap mildet bolup, en' zhaman adamdar kalganda, akyr zaman zhakyndaganda Biz alarga chon' belgileribizden bolgon bir belgini chygarabyz, al Zherden chykkan Zhanybar (Daabba). Al alarga adamdar Bizdin paigambarga tushkon aiattarybyzga ishenishken zhok dep alar tushuno turgandai suiloit.

Oo, paigambar! Estechi, al kunu Biz ar bir ummottun ichinen aiattarybyzdy zhalganga chygargandardan bolgon bashchylardyn toptorun chogultabyz, alar abalkysynan akyrkysyna cheiin zhyinalyp, andan son' surak beruugo zhonoshot.

Alar zhurup oturup surak maidanyna zhetkende Allakh alardy aiyptap myndai dep aitat: <<Menin zhalgyzdygyma dalil bolgon zhana shariiatymdy kamtygan aiattarymdy zhalganga chygardyn'arby zhana siler anyn kandai ekenin anyk bilbei turup, any zhalganga chygaruu uruksat dedin'erbi?! Zhe anyn akyikattygyn zhe zhalgandygyn tastyktash uchun emne kyldyn'ar?!>>.

Alar Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyp, Anyn aiattaryn zhalganga chygaryp zulumduk kylyshkandary sebeptuu alarga azap tushtu. Alar ozdorun korgop suiloi alyshpait, sebebi andai kyluuga chamasy zhetpeit zhana dalilderi da zhalgan.

Alar Toorat zhana Kuran tuuraluu: <<Chyndygynda bul ekoosu biri-birin kubattagan syikyr>> - deshken. Oshondoi ele aityshty: <<Biz Tooratka da, Kuranga da ishenbeibiz>>.

Oo, paigambar! Alarga ait: <<Egerde siler Toorat menen Kurandy syikyr degen sozun'ordo chynchyl bolson'or, anda Allakh taraptan Toorat menen Kurandan da tuuraraak kitep alyp kelgile. Eger alyp kelsen'er, men any eerchiim>>.

Eger Kuraish senin alarga Toorat menen Kurandan da tuuraraak kitepti alyp kelgile dep aitkanyn'a zhoop bere alyshpasa, anda al ekoosun zhalganga chygargandary dalildin negizinde bolgon zhok. Bul napsinin kaalooloruna eerchigendikten gana boldu. Allakhtyn tuura zholuna eerchibei oz napsi kaaloosuna eerchigen adamdan da katuu adashkan ech kim zhok. Chyndygynda Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyp ozdoruno zyian kylgan zaalym koomgo Allakh tuura zholgo tushuugo iigilik berbeit.

Biz mushrikter menen Israil urpaktarynan bolgon zhoottorgo murunku koomdordun okuialary tuuraluu sozdu zhetkirdik. Alar Bizdin paigambarlardy zhalganga chygarganda, balkim alar myndan sabak alyshaby, alardyn bashyna tushkon nerse kelgenge cheiin yiman keltirishebi degen umutto Biz alarga azapty mildet kylgan zhokpuz.
Kuran tushkongo cheiin Tooratka bekem yiman keltirgender - alar oz kitepterinen al tuuraluu zhana anyn sypattary tuuraluu kelgen nerselerdi tabyshkanda Kuranga da yiman keltirishet.

Egerde alarga okup berilse alar aityshat: <<Biz buga yiman keltirdik. Chyndygynda bul Rabbibiz taraptan tushkon ech kandai shek-kumonu zhok akyikat. Biz bul Kuranga cheiin ele paigambarlar alyp kelgen nerselerge yiman keltirgen musulmandardan bolgonbuz>>.

Myna ushul aitylgan sypattagy adamdarga Allakh alardyn kylgan ishterine eki ese soop beret. Sebebi alar ozdorunun kitebine yiman keltirip, al zholdo sabyr kylyshty zhana Mukhammad zhiberilgende aga yiman keltirishti. Oshondoi ele kunoo ishterin zhakshylyk ishteri menen ketirip turushtu zhana Biz alarga bergen yryskydan zhakshylyk zholdorgo sarptashty.

Egerde kitep eelerinen bolgon yimanduular zhalgan sozdu ugushsa, aga kon'ul burbastan zhuz burup, any aitkandarga kairylyp: <<Biz oz ishibizdin syilygyn alabyz, siler oz ishin'erdin zhazasyn alasyn'ar. Siler bizden sogush ukpaisyn'ar zhana zyian tartpaisyn'ar. Biz naadan adamdar menen zhanashpaibyz. Antkeni bul nerse dinge da, duinogo da zyian beret>> - deshti.

Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda sen Abu Talib zhana bashka ozun' zhakshy korgon adamdardy yimanga keltirip, tuura zholgo sala albaisyn'. Birok Allakh zhalgyz Ozu kaalagan adamdardy gana tuura zholgo salat. Al Ozunun abalky iliminde kim tuura zholgo tushuuchulordon bolorun zhakshy bilet.

Mekke elinen bolgon mushrikter Islamdy eerchii albaibyz, aga yiman keltire albaibyz dep uzurlorun aityshyp: <<Eger biz sen alyp kelgen bul Islamdy eerchisek, anda dushmandarybyz kee bir zherleribizdi tez ele tartyp alyshat>> - deshti. Biz al mushrikterdi yiyk zherge oturuktashtyrdyk go? Al zherde kan toguu, zulumduk kyluu aram kylyngan. Alar al zherde bashkalardyn basyp kiruusunon korkushpait zhana Biz Oz aldybyzdan al zherge ar kandai momo-zhemishterdi yrysky kylyp alyp keldik. Birok alardyn kopchulugu Allakhtyn bergen zhakshylyktaryn bilip shugur kylyshpait.

Kunoogo batyp Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryn tangan nechendegen shaarlarga Biz azap zhiberip, alardy kyryp zhok kyldyk. Mynakei alardyn buzulup zhok bolgon turak zhailary. Adamdar al zherden kesip otushot, anda-sanda gana kee bir zholoochulardyn turgany ele bolboso, al zherde alardan kiiin ech kim zhashagan zhok. Alarga asmandar menen Zherdi zhana alardyn ortosundagylarga eelik kylgan Biz murasker bolduk.

Oo, paigambar! Rabbin' seni shaarlardyn enesi bolgon Mekkege zhibergen syiaktuu kaisy bir chon' shaardyn eli shyltoo kylbash uchun alarga paigambar zhibermeiinche al shaarlardy kyiratyp zhok kylbait. Oshondoi ele shaarlardyn eli akyikat zholdo bolushsa, Biz alardy kyiratyp zhok kylbaibyz. Alar kaapyrlyk zhana kunoo kylyp zulumduk kylyshsa gana Biz alardy zhok kylabyz.

Kachan mushrikter akyikatty eerchii albaibyz, sebebi sogush kyiynchylyktaryna zhana soodanyn toktop kalyshyna duushar bolobuz dep uzurlorun aityshkanda Allakh alarga zhoop kylyp myndai dedi:
Rabbin'er silerge bergen nerseler bul duino zhashoosunda siler paidalangan zhana koozdongon nerseler, kiiin al butot. Al emi akyrettegi Allakhtyn aldyndagy uluu sooptor - bul duinodo siler paidalangan nerselerden zhana koozduktardan zhakshyraak zhana tuboluktuu. Buga akyl zhugurtpoisun'orbu, siler tuboluktuu nerseden ubaktyluunu artyk korup zhatasyn'ar?!

Biz akyrettegi beiishti zhana andagy tuboluktuu zhyrgaldy ubada kylgan adam menen, bul duino zhashoosunda paidalanchu bailyk zhana yrakhat berip, anyn zhyrgalyna batyp, kiiin kyiamat kunu tozokko keluuchulordon bolgon adam birdeibi?!
Al kunu alardyn Rabbisi chakyryk tashtap: <<Siler Menden bashka syiyngan zhana alardy Maga sherik dep oilogon sherikterim kaida?>> - dep aitat.

Kaapyrlykka chakyrgan, bashyna azap keleri anyk bolgon adamdar: <<O, Rabbibiz! Biz bulardy ozubuz adashkan syiaktuu adashtyrganbyz, Saga alardyn bizge katyshy zhok dep aitabyz. Alar bizge syiyngan emes, alar shaitandarga syiyngan>>.

Alarga: <<Sherikterin'erdi chakyrgyla, alar silerdi korduktan kutkarsyn!>> - dep aitylat. Alar sherikterin chakyryshat, birok alar chakyryktaryna zhoop berishpeit. Kiiin alar uchun daiardalgan azapty korushot. Oshondo alar duinodo akyikatty eerchigender bolsok kana deshet.
Al kunu alardyn Rabbisi chakyryk tashtap: <<Men silerge zhibergen paigambarlarga emne dep zhoop berdin'er ele?>> - dep aitat.
Alar dalil kylgan nerseler budomuk bolup, ech birin estei alyshpait zhana biri-birinen da surashpait. Antkeni alar azapka kozdoi baratyshkanyn anyk bilishkeni sebeptuu alardy korkunuch basat.

Al emi mushrikterden kimisi kaapyrlygynan toobo kylyp, Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirse, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylsa, balkim oshondo al kozdogonuno zhetken zhen'uuchulordon zhana korkkonunan kutulgandardan bolot.

Oo, paigambar! Rabbin' Ozu kaalagan nerseni zharatat zhana Ozuno moiun sunuuga zhana paigambar kyluuga Ozu kaalagandy tandait. Mushrikter Allakhka karshy chykkandai alarda yktyiar zhok. Allakh alar syiyngan sherikterden aruu zhana yiyk.
Zhana Rabbin' alardyn kokuroktoru zhashyrgan zhana ashkere kylgan nerselerdi bilet. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda al uchun alarga syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Al - Allakh! Andan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok. Bul duinodo zhana akyrette maktoo zhalgyz Aga gana taandyk. Okum zhurguzuu, da Aga gana taandyk, al ech kaitarylbait. Zhana kyiamat kunu surak berish uchun, syilyk zhe zhaza alysh uchun Aga gana kaitarylasyn'ar.

Oo, paigambar! Al mushrikterge ait: <<Aitkylachy, eger Allakh silerge tundu kyiamatka cheiin uzulboi daiym ulana turgan kylyp koiso, anda Allakhtan bashka kaisy kudai silerge kunduzgudoi zharykty alyp kele alat? Bul dalilderge kulak salbaisyn'arby zhana munu Allakhtan bashka ech bir kudai alyp kele albasyn bilbeisin'erbi?>>.

Oo, paigambar! Alarga ait: <<Aitkylachy, eger Allakh silerge kunduzdu kyiamatka cheiin daiym ulana turgan kylyp koiso, anda siler kunduzgu ishten charchap es aluun'ar uchun silerge tundu Allakhtan bashka kaisy kudai alyp kele alat? Siler bul aiat-belgilerdi korboisun'orbu zhana munun baaryn Allakhtan bashka ech bir kudai alyp kele albasyn bilbeisin'erbi?>>.

Oo, adamdar! Siler kunduzgu ishten charchagandan kiiin es aluun'ar uchun Allakh silerge tundu karan'gy kyluusu zhana yrysky izdeshin'er uchun kunduzdu zharyk kyluusu Anyn yraiymduulugunan. Balkim siler Allakhtyn silerge bergen zhakshylyktaryn chetke kakpastan Aga shugur kylasyn'ar.
Al kunu alarga Rabbisi chakyryk tashtap: <<Siler Menden bashka syiyngan zhana Maga sherik dep oilogon sherikterim kaida?>> - dep aitat.

Biz ar bir ummotton oz paigambaryn alyp kelebiz. Paigambarlar alardyn kaapyrlyktary menen zhalganga chygargandaryna kubo bolushat. Biz oshol ummottordon zhalganga chygargandarga: <<Siler kylgan kaapyrlygyn'arga zhana zhalganga chygaruun'arga dalilderin'erdi alyp kelgile>> -- deibiz. Alar dalil alyp kele alyshpait. Oshondo alar ech kandai shegi zhok akyikat Allakhka taandyk ekenin anyk bilishet zhana alardyn Allakhka karata oilop tapkan sherikteri zhok bolup ketet.

Kachan Allakh Faraon biilik sebeptuu zher betinde tekeberlenip ketkenin eskergende bailyk sebeptuu Karundun chekten chygyp ketkenin aityp myndai dedi:
Chyndygynda Karun Musanyn koomunan ele. Al alarga tekeberlik kyldy. Biz aga kazynalarynyn ele achkychtary alduu-kuchtuu zhamaat kotorso oor zhuk bolchudai bailyk kazynalaryn bergenbiz. Koomu aga aitty: <>.

Allakh saga bergen bailyktan zhakshylyk zholdorgo sarptap akyrettegi sooptordu talap kylbaisyn'by. Birok ysyrap zhana tekeberlik kylbastan zhep-ichuu, kiiinuu zhana bashka ushu syiaktuu zhakshylyktardan oz nasibin'di unutpa. Allakh saga zhakshylyk kylgandai sen dagy Rabbin' zhana Anyn pendeleri menen mamilen'di on'do. Zhana kunoo kylyp, ibadattardy tashtap zher betinde buzukuluk kylba. Chyndygynda Allakh zher betinde buzukuluk kylgandardy suiboit, teskerisinche alardy zhek korot.

Karun aitty: <<Maga bul bailyktar mendegi bilim zhana zhondom sebeptuu berildi. Men aga tatyktuumun>>. Karun bilbeit beken, Allakh andan murunku koomdordon andan da kuchtuu, andan da kop bailyk chogultkan adamdardy zhok kylganyn?! Alarga kuch-kubaty da, bailyktary da paida bergen zhok. Kyiamat kunu Allakh kunookorlordun kunoolorun bilgeni sebeptuu al tuuraluu suralyshpait. Alardyn suraluusu aiyptoo, yilatuu iretinde bolot.

Karun uluulugun korsotup zyinattary menen chykkanda, duino zhashoosunun koozduktaryn kaalagan anyn zhoro-zholdoshtoru: <<Attin', bizge da Karunga berilgendei nerseler berilse! Chyndygynda Karun ebegeisiz mol nasipke ee adam>>.

Al emi ilimduulor zyinattary menen chykkan Karundu korgondo zhana anyn zhoro-zholdoshtorunun kaalagandaryn ukkanda myndai deshti: <<Siler kurup ketkile! Allakhtyn akyrettegi soop-syilyktary zhana Aga yiman keltirip, zhakshy ishterdi kylgandar uchun daiardagan nerseleri Karunga berilgen duino koozduktarynan zhakshyraak. Myndai sozdu aituu zhana anyn talabyna ylaiyk ish-araket kyluu sabyrduularga gana nasip kylyngan. Alar bul duinonun ubaktyluu yrakhattarynan da Allakhtyn aldyndagy soop-syilyktardy artyk korup sabyr kylgandar>>.

Anan Biz any chekten chykkany uchun och aluu maksatta any ui-zhaiy zhana andagylar menen kosho zherge zhutkurup zhiberdik. Aga Allakhtan bashka zhardam bergen ech bir zhamaat bolbodu zhana al ozuno da zhardam bere algan zhok.

Any zher zhutkanga cheiin anyn bailygyn zhana zyinattaryn kaalap zhatkandar okunup, esterine kelip, myndai dep aita bashtady: <<Allakh pendelerinen Ozu kaalaganyna yryskyny kenen kylyp zhana Ozu kaalaganyna tar kylyp bereerin bilbeptirbiz?! Eger bizge Allakhtyn yraiymy bolbogondo bizdi da Karunga okshop zher zhutup ketmek. Al bizdi aitkan sozubuz uchun zhazalagan zhok. Chyndygynda kaapyrlar bul duinodo da, akyrette da zhen'ishke zhetishpeit. Teskerisinche alardyn akyry eki duinodo zyianga uchuroo menen butot>>.

Biz tigil zhaktagy akyret zhaiyn zher betinde akyikatka yiman keltirip, any eerchuudon tekeberlik kyluunu zhana buzukuluk kyluunu kaalabagan adamdar uchun zhyrgalchylyk zhana syi-urmat zhaiy kylabyz. Maktoogo tatyrlyk akybet - Rabbisinin buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtagan takybalar uchun berilgen beiishtegi zhyrgalchylyk zhana andagy Allakhtyn yraazylygynan bolgon nerselerge zhetuu.

Kimde-kim kyiamat kunu namaz, zeket, orozo zh.b. zhakshylyktar menen kelse, anda aga al zhakshylyktardan da artyk syilyktar berilet, bir zhakshylygy on esege koboitulot. Al emi kim kyiamat kunu kaapyrlyk, sutkorluk, zyna zh.b. zhamandyktar menen kelse, anda al zhamandyktardy kylgandar oz kylgandaryna zharasha ashyrbastan zhazalaryn alyshat.

Chyndygynda saga Kurandy tushurup, any zhetkiruunu zhana andagy kelgenderdi atkaruunu saga parz kylgan Zat seni Mekkege any bagyntuu uchun kaitarat. Oo, paigambar! Ait: <<Menin Rabbim kim tuura zhol alyp kelgenin zhana kim akyikattan anyk adashuuda ekenin zhakshy bilet>>.

Oo, paigambar! Oilonup korchu, sen paigambarlykka cheiin Allakh taraptan saga Kuran vakhii kylynat dep kutkon emessin'. Birok Anyn yraiymduulugu saga any tushuruunu talap kyldy. Emi sen kaapyrlardyn adashuularynda alarga zhardamchy bolbo!

Saga Allakhtyn aiattary tushkondon kiiin al mushrikter seni andan burup zhiberishpesin, anan sen any okuunu zhana zhetkiruunu tashtap koibo. Adamdardy Allakhka yiman keltiruugo, Any zhalgyzdoogo zhana Anyn shariiatyn atkaruuga chakyr. Zhana Allakh menen katar bashka kudailarga syiyngan mushrikterden bolbo. Zhalgyz Allakhka gana syiyngan adamdardan bol!

Allakh menen katar bashka kudaiga syiynba! Andan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok. Anyn Zhuzunon -- Ozunon bashka bardyk nerseler zhok bolot. Okum kyluu Aga gana taandyk, Al Ozu kaalagandy okum kylat. Kyiamat kunu surak berish uchun zhana syilyk zhe zhaza alysh uchun zhalgyz Aga gana kaitasyn'ar.
(lm) Alif. Lam. Mim. Ushuga okshogon aiattyn tushundurmosu bakara suroosunun bashynda kelgen.

Adamdar <<Allakhka yiman keltirdik>> dep aityp koiushsa ele, alardyn aitkan sozunon <<alar chyndap ele yimanduu beken?>> dep anyn chyndygyn anyktabastan turup, alardy synoosuz tashtap koiot dep oilop zhatyshaby? Bul ish alar oilogondoi emes.
Biz alardan murunkulardy da synaganbyz. Allakh chyndap yiman keltirgenderdin chyndygyn zhana zhalgan yiman keltirgendin zhalganyn sozsuz bilet zhana any silerge bildiret.

Shirk zhana bashka ushul syiaktuu kunoolordu kylgandar Bizge zhetkirbei zhazabyzdan kutulup ketebiz dep oilop zhatyshaby? Alardyn kylgan chechimi kandai zhaman chechim! Alar Allakhty alsyz kyla alyshpait zhana Anyn zhazasynan da kutulushpait, eger kaapyr bolup olushkon bolso.

Kimde-kim kyiamat kunu Allakhtyn syilygyna zhetish uchun Aga zholuguunu umut kylsa, anda Allakh al uchun belgilegen moonot zhakynda sozsuz kelet. Al pendelerinin sozdorun Uguuchu, alardyn ish-araketterin Biluuchu. Alardyn baarysy Aga belgiluu. Zhakynda al uchun syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Al emi kim ibadat kyluuda, kunoolordon alys boluuda oz napsisi menen kuroshso zhana Allakh zholunda sogushsa, anda al ozu uchun gana kuroshkon bolot. Antkeni anyn paidasy ozuno kaitat. Allakh zharatylgandardyn ech birine muktazh emes. Alardyn kylgan ibadattary Aga ech nerseni koshpoit zhana alardyn kunooloru Andan ech nerseni kemitpeit.

Yiman keltirip, synoolorubuzga sabyr kylyp zhana zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandarga Biz alardyn kylgan zhakshylyk ishteri sebeptuu kunoolorun ochurobuz zhana akyrette alardyn bul duinodo kylgan zhakshy ishterine sooptorun en' zhakshy kylyp berebiz.

Biz insanga ata-enesin urmattap, alarga zhakshylyk kyluusun buiruduk. Ei, insan! Egerde ata-enen' Saad ibn Abu Vakkastyn enesindei bolup seni ozun' bilbegen nerseni Maga sherik kyl dep kyinasa, anda bul nersede alarga moiun sunba! Allakhtyn aldynda kunoo bolgon ishte adamdarga moiun sunulbait. Kyiamat kunu Maga gana kaitasyn'ar. Oshondo Men silerdin duinodo kylgan ishterin'erdin kabaryn berem zhana alardyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn berem.
Allakhka yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandardy kyiamat kunu zhakshy ish zhasagan adamdarga koshobuz, alar menen birge chogultabyz zhana alardyn soobundai sooptordu berebiz.

Adamdardyn kee birleri <<Allakhka yiman keltirdik>> - deshet. Eger kaapyrlar any yimany sebeptuu kyinashchu bolso, alardyn azaptaganyn Allakhtyn azaptaganyndai kabyl alyp, kaapyrlardy tuura korup yimandan bash tartat. Oo, paigambar! Egerde Rabbin' taraptan saga zhen'ish kelse alar: <<Oo, yimanduular! Chyndygynda biz yimanda siler menen birge bolchubuz>> - deshet. Allakh adamdardyn kokurogundogunu bilbeit beken?! Aga andagy kaapyrlyktyn zhana yimandyn biri da zhashyruun emes. Allakh alardyn zhurogundogu nerseni alardan da zhakshy bilgen bolso, anda alar kantip zhuroktorundogu nerseni Allakhka aityp zhatyshat?!
Allakh chyndap yiman keltirgenderdi zhakshy bilet zhana syrtynan yimanduu korunup, ichinde kaapyrlykty zhashyrgan eki zhuzduulordu da zhakshy bilet.

Kaapyrlar zhalgyz Allakhka yiman keltirgenderge: <<Bizdin dinibizdi zhana zholubuzdu eerchigile. Biz silerdin kunoon'ordu kotorobuz zhana zhazasyn da ozubuz tartabyz>> - deshet. Alar silerdin ech bir kunoon'ordu kotorboit. Chyndygynda alar bul aitkan sozdorundo zhalganchylar.

Kachan alar bashkalardyn kunoolorun kotorboit dep aitylganda, myndan adashuuga chakyrgan kaapyrlar al sebeptuu ashykcha kunoo alyshpait degen tushunuk chygyshy mumkun. Myna oshol oidu zhok kylysh uchun myndai dep aityldy:
Zhalganga chakyrgan al mushrikter ozdoru kylgan kunoolorun kotorot, alardyn chakyrygyna eerchigenderdin kunoolorun da kotorot, birok alardy eerchigenderdin kunoolorunon ech bir nerse kemitilbeit. Oshondoi ele kyiamat kunu bul duinodo oilop tapkan zhalgandary uchun suralyshat.

Biz Nukhtu oz eline paigambar kylyp zhiberdik. Al alardyn arasynda toguz zhuz eluu zhyl turup, alardy Allakhka gana syiynuuga chakyrdy. Alar any zhalganga chygaryshty zhana kaapyrlyktaryn ulanta berishti. Alar Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyshkany zhana Anyn paigambarlaryn zhalganga chygaryshkany sebeptuu alardy topon suu alyp, suuga chogup zhok bolushtu.
Kiiin Biz Nukhtu zhana any menen birge bolgon yimanduulardy chokturup zhok kylbastan kemede kutkardyk zhana kemeni adamdar sabak alysh uchun eskertme kyldyk.

Oo, paigambar! Ibrakhimdin okuiasyn estechi, bir kezde al eline aitty: <<Zhalgyz Allakhka syiyngyla! Anyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtoo menen Anyn zhazasynan korkkula! Eger bilsen'er, silerge buirulgan ushul nerse siler uchun zhakshy>>.

Ei, mushrikter! Chyndygynda siler syiyngan aikelder paida da, zyian da bere alyshpait. Siler alardy syiynuuga tatyktuu dep oiloo menen zhalgandy oilop taap zhatasyn'ar. Chyndygynda siler Allakhtan bashka syiynyp zhatkan nerseler silerge yrysky bere alyshpait. Yryskyny Allakhtan suragyla, Al yrysky Beruuchu. Aga gana syiyngyla zhana Al silerge bergen yrysky uchun Aga shugur kylgyla. Kyiamat kunu surak berish uchun, syilyk zhe zhaza alysh uchun aikelderin'erge emes, zhalgyz Aga gana kaitasyn'ar.

Ei, mushrikter! Egerde Mukhammad (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) silerge alyp kelgendi zhalganga chygarsan'ar, silerden aldyn'ky koomdor da ozuloruno kelgen paigambarlardy zhalganga chygaryshkan. Misal katary Nukh, Aad, Samud koomdoru syiaktuu. Paigambar achyk-aikyn zhetkiruugo gana mildettuu. Al silerge Rabbisi buirugan nerseni zhetkirdi.

Al zhalganchylar Allakh zharatylgandardy algach iret kandai zharataryn, kiiin al zhok bolup ketkenden kiiin any kairadan zharatkanyn korushpoibu? Chyndygynda bul nerse Allakh uchun zhen'il. Al kudurettuu, Any ech kim alsyz kyla albait.

Oo, paigambar! Kaira zharaluunu zhalganga chygargandarga ait: <<Zher betin kezgile, Allakh zharatylgandardy bashtapky zholu kantip zharatkanyna nazar salgyla. Kiiin Allakh adamdar olgondon kiiin alardy surak berish uchun ekinchi zhashoogo kairadan tiriltet. Chyndygynda Allakh bardyk nersege Kudurettuu. Any ech bir nerse alsyz kyla albait. Al adamdardy algachky iret zharatuuda alsyz bolbogonu syiaktuu alardy kairadan tiriltuugo da alsyz emes>>.

Al zharatkandarynan Ozu kaalaganyn adilettigi menen azaptait, Ozu kaalaganyna aikoldugu menen yraiym kylat. Al silerdi kyiamat kunu kabyrlaryn'ardan kaira tiriltkende siler surak berish uchun zhalgyz Aga gana kaitasyn'ar.

Siler Rabbin'erden kutula albaisyn'ar, zher betinde zhana asmanda Anyn zhazasynan kachyp kete albaisyn'ar. Siler uchun ishin'erdi zhongo sala turgandai Allakhtan bashka koldoochu zhok zhana silerdi Anyn azabynan kutkara turgandai Andan bashka zhardamchy da zhok.

Allakhtyn aiat-belgilerine zhana kyiamatta Any menen zholuguuga kaapyrlyk kylgan adamdar - myna osholor Menin yraiymymdan umut uzgondor. Alar kaapyrlyktary sebeptuu ech kachan beiishke kirishpeit. Myna osholordu akyrette kutup turgan kyinoochu azap bar.

Ibrakhim elin zhalgyz Allakhka gana syiynuuga zhana Andan bashka syiyngan kudailardy tashtoonu buirugandan kiiin alardyn aga bergen zhoobu ushul boldu: <<Kudailaryn'ardy koldop any olturgulo zhe any otko yrgytkyla!>>. Birok Allakh any otton saktady. Chyndygynda otko yrgytylgandan kiiin anyn aman kaluusunda yiman keltirgen koom uchun ulgu-sabaktar bar. Antkeni osholor gana ulgu-sabaktardan paida alyshat.

Ibrakhim eline aitty: <<Siler duino zhashoosunda aikel-buttarga syiynuuda biri-birin'erdi zhakshy korgonun'or uchun zhana taanyganyn'ar uchun alardy kudai kylyp syiynyp zhatasyn'ar. Kiiin kyiamat kunu orton'ordogu al suiuu zhok bolot, azapty korgondo biri-birin'erden bash tartasyn'ar, biri-birin'erge kargysh aitasyn'ar. Silerdin bash kalkalar zhaiyn'ar tozok bolot. Silerdin Allakhtan bashka syiyngan aikelderin'erden zhana alardan bashkalarynan da silerdi Allakhtyn azabynan saktagan ech bir zhardamchy bolboit>>.

Aga Lut yiman keltirdi. Zhana Ibrakhim aitty: <<Chyndygynda men Rabbime, berekeluu Sham zhergesine kochomun. Chyndygynda Al Kudurettuu, Aga kochkon adam zhen'ilbeit zhana kordolboit. Al Oz bashkaruusunda zhana tagdyr kyluusunda Daanyshman>>.

Zhana Biz Ibrakhimge Iskhak menen anyn uulu Ia'kubdu berip, anyn belek kylyp urpaktaryna paigambarlyk zhana Allakh taraptan tushkon kitepterdi berdik. Oshondoi ele aga bul duinodo akyikatka sabyr kylganynyn syilygy katary taza urpak zhana aga en' zhakshy alkysh-maktoolor aityluuchu kyldyk. Chyndygynda al akyrette zhakshy-takybaluulardyn syilygyndai syilyk alat. Bul duinodo aga berilgen nerseler akyrette al uchun daiardalgan uluu syilykty kemitpeit.

Oo, paigambar! Luttu estechi, bir kezde al eline aitty: <<Siler ozun'ordon murun aalamdardan ech kim kylbagan zhaman kunoonu kylyp zhatasyn'ar. Adamdyn tabiiaty zhiiirkengen bul kunoonu en' birinchi siler bashtadyn'ar.

Siler kumaryn'ardy kandyrysh uchun erkekterdin artynan koshulup zhatasyn'arby?! Zholoochulardyn zholun tosup zhatasyn'arby?! Alar silerdin kylgan buzukulugun'ardan korkup otpoi kalyshty go. Oshondoi ele chogulgan zherin'erde zhylan'achtanuu zhana zhanyn'ardan otkondorgo sozun'or zhana ishin'er menen zyian berip kunoo ishterdi kylyp zhatasyn'arby?!>>. Al elin kunoolordu kyluudan tyigandan kiiin alardyn aga aitkan sozu ushul boldu: <<Egerde aityp zhatkanyn' chyn bolso, anda bizdi korkutup zhatkan Allakhtyn azabyn alyp kelchi>>.

Luttun eli aga koshoruuchuluk kylyp, any shyldyn'dai azapty alyp kelchi degenden kiiin al Rabbisine duba kylyp: <<Oo, Rabbim! Zher betinde kaapyrlykty zhana zhiiirkenichtuu kunoolordu zhaiyp buzukuluk kylgan koomgo karshy maga zhardam ber!>> - dedi.

Kachan Biz zhibergen perishteler Ibrakhimge Iskhak zhana anyn uulu Ia'kub tuuraluu suiunchulop kelishkende alar aga aityshty: <<Chyndygynda biz Luttun shaary Sadumdu zhok kylabyz. Chyndygynda anyn eli buzukuluk kylyp zaalym bolushtu>>.

Ibrakhim (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy, salamattygy bolsun) perishtelerge: <<Siler zhok kylabyz degen shaarda Lut bar go. Al zaalymdardan emes>> - dedi. Perishteler aityshty: <<Biz al zhakta kimder bar ekenin zhakshy bilebiz. Biz any zhana ui-bulosun shaar eline tushkon kyiroodon kutkarabyz. Birok anyn aialyn kutkarbaibyz. Al oshol zherde kalgan kyiroochulardan bolot, any alar menen kosho zhok kylabyz>>.

Biz Luttun koomun zhok kyluu uchun zhibergen perishteler aga kelishkende al alar uchun elinin buzukulugunan korkup zhaman abalga tushtu, alardyn kelgenine kyzhalat boldu. Antkeni al perishteler erkekterdin kelbetinde kelishken ele. Koomu bolso aialdardan emes, erkekterden zhynystyk kumarlaryn kandyryshchu. Perishteler aga aityshty: <<Korkpo! Elin' saga ech kandai zyian bere albait. Biz alardy kyiratyp zhok kylabyz degenibiz uchun kaigyrba! Biz seni zhana ui-bulon'du kutkarabyz. Aialyn' gana kyiragandar menen kosho kalat. Biz any alar menen birge zhok kylabyz.

Biz buzukuluktardy kylgan bul kalaanyn eline asmandan byshkan chopo tashtardy zhaadyryp azap tushurobuz. Alarga berilgen bul zhaza Allakhka bash iibestik kylyshkany uchun boldu. Antkeni alar aialdarga emes, erkekterge koshulup zhiiirkenichtuu buzukuluk kylyshty.
Biz al zhok kylgan kalaadan akyl zhugurtkon adamdar uchun aiat-belgilerdi kaltyrdyk. Antkeni osholor aiat-belgilerden sabak alyshat.

Zhana Biz Madiianga alardyn tektesh tuugany Shuaibdy paigambar kylyp zhiberdik. Al aitty: <<Oo, elim! Allakhka gana syiyngyla. Kylgan ibadatyn'ar menen akyret kundogu Anyn syilygyn gana umut kylgyla. Zhana zher betinde kunoolordu kyluu zhana zhaiuu menen buzukuluk kylbagyla>>.
Eli any zhalganga chygardy. Oshondo alarga zher titiroo kelip tiiip, oz turak-zhailarynda zhuzu menen zher suzgon abalda kyimylsyz sulap zhatyp kalyshty.

Oshondoi ele Salikhtin koomu "Aaddy" zhana Khuddun koomu "Samuddu" da kyiratyp zhok kyldyk. Ei, Mekke eli! Silerge alardyn kyiraganyn bildirgen belgiler Khadramaut taraptagy Al'-Khizhr menen Al'-Shikhrdegi turak-zhailarynan korunup turat go. Alardyn bosh kalgan turak-zhailary alardyn kyirap zhok bolgonuna dalil. Shaitan alardyn kaapyrlyktaryn zhana kunoolorun alarga kooz korgozup, alardy tuura zholdon adashtyrdy. Alarga paigambarlary uirotkondukton, alar akyikat menen zhalgandy, tuura zhol menen adashuunu aiyrmalai bilgen adamdar bolgon. Birok, tuura zholdu erchibei, napsinin buzulgan kaaloosuna eerchip ketishti.

Zhana Biz Musanyn eline zombuluk korgozgon Karundu turak-zhaiy menen kosho zherge zhutkurup zhok kyldyk. Oshondoi ele Faraon menen anyn vaziri Khamandy den'izge chokturup zhok kyldyk. Musa alarga anyn chynchyldygyn bildirgen aiat-belgilerdi alyp kelgen. Birok alar Baiyrky Egipet zherinde aga yiman keltiruudon tekeberlenishti. Alar Bizdin azabybyzdan kachyp kutulushkan zhok.

Zhogoruda aitylgandardyn baarysyn kyiratuuchu azabybyz menen aldyk. Luttun koomuna chokmorloshup byshkan chopo tashtardy zhaadyrdyk, Salikh menen Shuaibdyn koomdorun katuu kyikyryk aldy, Karundu turak-zhaiy menen kosho zherge zhutkurduk, al emi Nukhtun, Faraondun zhana Khamandyn koomdorun suuga chokturduk. Allakh alardy kunoosuz ele kyiratyp zhok kylgan zhok. Birok alar kunoolordu kyluu menen ozdoruno zulum kylyshty. Oshon uchun azapka tatyktuu bolushtu.

Allakhtan bashka aikel-buttardy paida keltiret zhe shapaat kylat dep kudai kylyp syiyngan mushrikterdin misaly - zyiandan korgonush uchun ozuno ui zhasagan zhorgomush symal. Chyndygynda en' nachar ui zhorgomushtun uiu. Al any dushmandan korgoi albait. Oshol syiaktuu ele alardyn aikelderi paida da, zyian da keltire alyshpait zhana shapaat da kylyshpait. Egerde mushrikter munu bilishkende Allakhtan bashka aikel-buttardy kudai kylyp syiynyshpait ele.
Albette Allakh alardyn bashkalarga syiynyp zhatkandaryn bilet. Munun ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Al zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu. Oz zharatuusunda, tagdyr kyluusunda zhana bashkaruusunda Daanyshman.

Biz, adamdardy oigotuu, alarga akyikatty korgozup, aga bagyttoo uchun ushundai misaldardy keltirebiz. Any Allakhtyn shariiatyn zhana shariiat syrlaryn bilgen ilimduu adamdar gana talaptagydai tushunot.

Allakh taala asmandar menen Zherdi akyikat menen zharatty. Any zhalgandan zhe zhon ele zharatkan zhok. Chyndygynda bul zharatuuda yimanduular uchun Allakhtyn kudurettuuluguno achyk-aikyn dalilder bar. Antkeni osholor Allakhtyn zharatkandary arkyluu Zharatuuchunun bar ekenin dalil kylyshat. Al emi kaapyrlar aalamdagy zhana ozdorundogu aiat-belgilerdi korgondo Zharatuuchunun uluktuguna zhana kudurettuuluguno kon'ul burushpait.

Oo, paigambar! Allakh saga vakhii kylgan Kurandy adamdarga okup ber zhana namazdy toluk turdo atkar. Chyndygynda toluk sypatta atkarylgan namaz adamdy kunoolordu, zhamandyktardy kyluudan tyiat. Antkeni al zhurokto kunoo kyluudan toskon nurdu paida kylat zhana zhakshylyk ishterge bagyttait. Allakhty zikir kyluu butkul nerseden da uluk zhana biiik. Allakh silerdin emne kylyp zhatkanyn'ardy bilet. Silerdin ishterin'erdin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda Al silerge ishterin'erdin syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret, zhakshy bolso zhakshysyn, zhaman bolso zhamanyn beret.

Ei, yimanduular! Zhoottor zhana khristiandar menen en' zhakshy ykmada zhana ulgu bolorluk zholdo gana talkuuga tushup, talashyp-tartyshkyla. Al anyk dalilderdi keltiruu zhana nasaat aituunun negizinde ugut kyluu zholu. Birok alardan kim bash iibestik zhana tekeberlik menen zulumduk kylsa zhana silerge sogush zharyialasa, anda alar Islamdy kabyl alyp zhe kor bolup oz kolu menen salyk tolomoiuncho alarga karshy sogushkula. Zhoottor menen khristiandarga aitkyla: <<Allakh bizge tushurgon Kuranga yiman keltirdik zhana silerge tushkon Toorat menen Inzhilge da yiman keltirdik. Bizdin kudai menen silerdin kudaiyn'ar bir kudai. Syiynuuda, zharatuuda zhana toluktukta Anyn sherigi zhok. Biz zhalgyz Aga gana moiun sunup, bash iiebiz.

Biz senden murun Kitepterdi tushurgonubuz syiaktuu saga da Kurandy tushurduk. Alardan Abdullakh ibn Salam syiaktuu Tooratty okugan kee birleri oz kitepterinen Kurandyn sypattaryn tabyshkany uchun aga yiman keltirishti. Mushrikterdin arasynda da aga yiman keltirgender bar. Bizdin aiattarybyzga kaapyrlykty zhana akyikatty korup turup chetke kakkandy adat kylgan kaapyrlar gana kaapyrlyk kylyshat.

Oo, paigambar! Sen Kuranga cheiin ech bir kitep okugan emessin' zhana on' kolun' menen ech nerse zhazgan emessin'. Antkeni sen okugandy da, zhazgandy da bilbegen kat-sabaty zhoiulbagan adamsyn'. Egerde sen okugandy zhana zhazgandy bilgenin'de, anda adamdardyn arasyndagy naadandar senin paigambarlygyn' tuuraluu shekteniship, seni murunku Kitepterden zhazyp aldy dep aityp chygyshmak.

Teskerisinche saga tushkon Kuran yimanduulardyn arasynda ilim berilgenderdin kokurogundogu achyk-aikyn aiattar. Bizdin aiattarybyzdy Allakhka kaapyrlyk zhana shirk kylyp ozdoruno zulumduk kylgandar gana chetke kagyshat.

Mushrikter: <<Emnege Mukhammadga Rabbisi taraptan murunku paigambarlarga tushkondoi aiat-belgiler tushkon zhok?>> - deshet. Oo, paigambar! Al suragandarga ait: <<Chyndygynda aiat-belgiler Allakhtyn gana kolunda. Al any kachan kaalasa tushurot. Any tushuruu menin yktyiarymda emes. Men bolgonu silerge Allakhtyn zhazasyn achyk eskertuuchumun>>.

Oo, paigambar! Al aiat-belgilerdi suragandarga Biz saga tushurgon, alarga okulup zhatkan Kuran zhetishtuu emes beken? Chyndygynda alarga tushurulgon Kuranda yiman keltirgen koom uchun yraiymduuluk zhana nasaattar bar. Myna osholor andagy kelgenderden paida alyshat. Alarga tushurulgon nerse aga cheiinki paigambarlarga tushurulgondoi nerseni suragandaryna karaganda zhakshyraak.

Oo, paigambar! Ait: <<Men silerge alyp kelgen nersede chynchyl ekenime zhana silerdin any zhalganga chygaruun'arga Allakh Ozu kubo boluuga zhetishtuu. Al asmandar menen Zherdegini bilet zhana al ekoosundogu ech bir nerse Aga zhashyruun emes. Al emi Allakhtan bashka syiynylgan butkul zhalgan nerselerge ishengender zhana syiynuuga Ozu gana tatyktuu bolgon Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandar - myna osholor kyiroogo uchuragandar. Antkeni alar yimandy kaapyrlykka almashtyryshty>>.

Oo, paigambar! Sen mushrikterge eskertken azapty alar senden shashtyryp zhatyshat. Egerde alarga kechikpegen, aldyga da zhylbagan Allakh belgilegen ubakyt bolbogondo, anda alar talap kylgan azap alarga kelmek. Azap oz kezinde alar kutpogon abalda, kapystan kelet.
Sen alarga ubada kylgan azapty senden shashtyryp zhatyshat. Chyndygynda Allakh kaapyrlarga ubada kylgan tozok alardy orop-chulgap alat. Alar anyn azabynan kachyp kete alyshpait.
Al kunu azap alardy ustulorunon zhana buttarynyn astyna tosholup orop-chulgap alat. Allakh alardy aiyptap: <<Siler kylgan shirk menen kunoolordun zhazasyn tatkyla>> - dep aitat.
Oo, Maga yiman keltirgen pendelerim! Maga ibadat kyluu mumkun bolboi kalgan zherden kochkulo. Chyndygynda Menin zherim kenen. Maga gana syiyngyla zhana Maga ech kimdi sherik kylbagyla!
Silerdi olumdon bolgon korkunuch kochuudon tosup koibosun. Ar bir zhan olum daamyn tatat. Kiiin kyiamat kunu surak berish uchun, syilyk zhe zhaza alysh uchun Bizge gana kaitasyn'ar.

Allakhka yiman keltirip zhana Aga zhakyndatkan zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandardy Beiishtegi en' biiik orundarga zhaigashtyrabyz. Alardyn astynan daryialar agyp turat. Alar al zhakta tuboluk kalyshat zhana ech kachan zhok bolushpait. Allakhka ibadat kylgandardyn bul syilygy kandai sonun syilyk!
Allakhka ibadat kylgandardyn syilygy kandai zhakshy! Alar Aga moiun sunuuga zhana Aga kunoo kyluudan tyiyluuga sabyr kylyshyp, bardyk ishterinde zhalgyz Rabbisine gana taianyshat.

Butkul zhan-zhanybarlar koptuguno karabastan oz azyktaryn zhyinap, kamdai alyshpait. Allakh alarga da, silerge da yrysky beret. Andyktan achkalyktan korkup kochuunu tashtoon'orgo kechirimduu sebep zhok. Al silerdin sozdorun'ordu Uguuchu, nietterin'erdi zhana ish-araketterin'erdi Biluuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda alar uchun silerge syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Oo, paigambar! Egerde sen al mushrikterden: <<Asmandardy kim zharatkan? Zherdi kim zharatkan? Oz ara almashyp turgan Kun menen Aidy kim moiun sundurgan?>> - dep surasan', alar: <<Alardy Allakh zharatkan>> - dep gana aityshat. Anda emnege Allakhka gana yiman keltiruudon zhuz burup, alarga paida da, zyian da keltire albagan Andan bashka kudailarga syiynyp zhatyshat?

Allakh pendelerinen Ozu kaalaganyna yryskyny kenen kylat, Ozu kaalaganyna tar kylat. Bul nerseler Anyn daanyshmandygy menen gana bolot. Chyndygynda Allakh bardyk nerseni Biluuchu. Aga ech bir nerse zhashyruun emes. Pendelerin bashkaruuda alarga emne paidaluu ekeni Aga zhashyruun emes.

Oo, paigambar! Egerde sen mushrikterden: <<Kim asmandan suunu tushurup, any menen kurgap kalgan zherdi guldotup osturdu?>> - dep surasan', alar: <<Asmandan zhamgyrdy tushurup, any menen zherdi guldotup osturgon Allakh>> - dep gana aityshat. Oo, paigambar! Alarga ait: <<Silerge dalildi achyktap korgozgon Allakhka maktoo bolsun! Birok akyr-aiagy alardyn kopchulugu akyl zhugurtushkon zhok. Eger alar akyl zhugurtushkondo, anda alarga paida da, zyian da keltire albagan aikelderdi Allakhka sherik kylyshmak emes>>.

Bul duino zhashoosu andagy kumarlar zhana yrakhat tartuulagan nerseler - aga bailangan zhuroktor uchun kon'ul achuudan zhana oiun-zookton bashka ech nerse emes. Al tez ele otup ketet. Al emi akyret zhaiy - al tuboluk kaluuchu chynygy zhashoo. Eger alar bilishkende, anda ubaktyluunu tuboluktuudon artyk korushmok emes.

Kachan Allakh mushrikterdin karama-karshylygyn achykka chygarganda, tagyraak aitkanda alardan <> - dep suralganda, alar Allakhtyn Zharatuuchu ekenine yiman keltirishti, birok Aga syiynuuga kelgende Aga kaapyrlyk kylyp, bashkalarga syiynyp ketishkenin achykka chygarganda, alardyn bashka karama-karshylygyn da achykka chygardy, al alardyn suuga choguu korkunuchuna kabylyshkanda zhalgyz Allakhka gana syiynyp zhalbaryshkanyn zhana andan kutkarylgandan kiiin kairadan shirkke kaityp ketishkenderin aityp myndai dedi:
Egerde mushrikter den'izde kemelerge oturushsa, bizdi chogup ketuudon sakta dep chyn yklastan Allakhka gana zhalbaryp syiynyshat. Al emi Allakh alardy chokturboi kutkarsa, kairadan kudailaryna syiynyp shirk kyla bashtashat.

Biz alarga bergen zhakshylyktardy tanyp, alarga berilgen duino zhashoosunun koozduktary menen zhyrgalga batuulary uchun alar mushrik bolup ketishti. Zhakynda alar olgondo alardyn akybeti zhaman ekenin bilishet.

Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryn zhokko chygargandar (Allakh alardy suuga choguudon kutkarganyn) korushpoibu? Dagy bashka bir zhakshylyk, Biz alar uchun Mekkeni yiyk kyldyk, alar al zherde kany toguluudon zhana mal-mulktoru talap-tonoluudan koopsuz, oshol ele uchurda alardan bashkalarga tush taraptan kol salynyp olturuluudo, ozdoru, aialdary, bala-chakalary tutkundaluuda zhana mal-mulktoru tonoluuda. Ushunun baaryn korup turup alar oiloshkon zhalgan kudailaryna yiman keltirishebi zhana Allakhtyn alarga bergen zhakshylyktaryna shugur kylyshpai tanyp ketishebi?!

Allakhka sherik koshup zhe Anyn elchisi alyp kelgen akyikatty zhalganga chygaryp Aga karata zhalgandy oilop tapkan adamdan da otkon zaalym adam zhok. Tozok kaapyrlar zhana alarga okshogon adamdar uchun turak-zhai ekendiginde shek zhok.

Bizdin yraazylyktardy kaalap, zhaman napsileri, shaitan, Allakhtyn dushmandary menen kuroshup, Bizdin zholgo arakettenip, umtulgan adamdardy tuura zholgo tushuugo iigilik berebiz. Chyndygynda Allakh Oz zhardamy, koldoosu zhana tuura zholgo saluusu menen zhakshylyk kyluuchular menen birge.
(lm) Alif. Laam. Miim. Ushuga okshogon aiattyn tushundurmosu bakara suroosunun bashynda kelgen.
Perster Rimdi zhen'di.
Persterdin mamleketine karai Sham zhergesine zhakyn zherde. Rimdikter persterden zhen'ilgenden kiiin kop otpoi kaira zhen'ishke zhetishet.
Uch zhyldan kem emes, on zhyldan ashyk emes aralykta. Rim zhen'ishke zhetkenge cheiin da, andan kiiin da okum kyluu Allakhka gana taandyk. Rimdikter persterdi zhen'gen kunu yimanduular suiunushot.
Allakhtyn rimdikterge zhardam bergenine suiunushot. Antkeni alar Kitep eeleri. Allakh kimdin ustunon kimge kaalasa zhen'ish beret. Al zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu, yimanduu pendelerine Yraiymduu.

Bul zhardam Allakhtyn bergen ubadasy bolchu. Allakh ubadasyn atkarbai koiboit. Ubadanyn ishke ashuusu menen, Allakhtyn zhardamy tuuraluu bergen ubadasyna yimanduulardyn ishenimi kuchoit. Birok, adamdardyn kobu kaapyrlygy sebeptuu munu tushunboit.

Alar yimandy zhana shariiat okumdorun bilishpeit. Chyndygynda alar tirichilik kyluu zhana materialdyk tsivilizatsiiany kuruu syiaktuu duino zhashoosunun syrtky korunushun gana bilishet. Alar chynygy zhashoonun zhaiy bolgon akyretten bash tartyshat zhana aga kon'ul da burushpait.

Zhalganchy mushrikter Allakh alardy kantip zharatkanyn zhana dene kelbetin mykty, ar tarabynan kelishimduu kylganyn oilonboibu? Allakh asmandar menen Zherdi zhana alardyn ortosundagy nerselerdi akyikattyk menen zharatty. Alardy zhondon-zhon ele zharatyp koigon zhok. Oshondoi ele asman-zherdin bul duinodo saktalyp turuusuna bir moonottu chektep koidu. Chynynda, adamdardyn kopchulugu kyiamat kunu Rabbisine zholuguuga ishenishpedi. Oshonduktan, alar Rabbisi yraazy bolo turgan zhakshylyk ishterdi kyluu arkyluu kaira tiriluugo daiardanbait.

Alar zher zhuzun kezip, alardan murunku akyikatty zhalganga chygargan koomdordun akybeti kandai bolgonun korushpoibu? Al koomdor alardan da kuchtuu bolushkan, zherlerdi aidoo eginzarlarga ailandyryshyp,kurulushtardy salyp zherdi ozgortushkon zhana any alardan da zhakshy guldotushkon. Kiiin alarga paigambarlary Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygyna achyk-aikyn dalilder menen kelishkende alardy zhalganga chygaryshty. Allakh alardy kyiratyp zhok kyluuda alarga zulumduk kylgan zhok. Birok alar kaapyrlyk kyluu menen kyiroogo tush bolup ozdoruno zulumduk kylyshty.

Kiiin Allakhka shirk zhana kunoolordu kylyp zhaman ishterdi zhasagandardyn akybeti en' zhaman akybet boldu! Antkeni alar Allakhtyn aiattaryn zhalganga chygaryshty zhana alardy maskara kylyp, shyldyn'ga alyshty.

Allakh zhan-zharatylyshty murun bolbogondoi korunushto abalky iret zharatat. Kiiin alardy kairadan zharatat. Kiiin siler kyiamat kunu surak berish uchun, syilyk zhe zhaza alysh uchun Aga gana kaitasyn'ar.
Kyiamat kaiym bolgon kunu kunookorlor Allakhtyn yraiymynan umuttorun uzushot. Alar Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyshkandaryna dalil taba albagandygy sebeptuu umuttoru uzulot.

Alardyn bul duinodo syiynyshkan kudailarynan ech kimisi alardy azaptan kutkaruu uchun shapaat kylbait. Anan alar kudailaryna kaapyr (karshy) bolushat. Alardy muktazh bolup turgan uchurda zhardamsyz tashtap ketishti. Antkeni alardyn baarysy kyiroodo birdei.

Kyiamat kaiym bashtalgan kunu adamdar syilyk zhe zhaza aluuda duinodogu kylgan ish-araketterine zharasha bolunushot, alardyn arasynda beiishtegi darazhalarga kotorulgondoru zhana en' tomon darazhaga tushkondoru bolot.
Al emi Allakhka yiman keltirip, Al yraazy bolgon zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandar beiishte bolushat. Alar andagy tugonbogon tuboluk zhyrgalchylyktar sebeptuu kubanychka batyshat.

Al emi Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandar, paigambarybyzga tushkon aiattarybyzdy zhalganga chygargandar zhana kaira tiriluunu, surak beruunu zhalgan degender -- myna osholor azapka alyp kelinet, alar anda kaluuchular.
Kech kirgende sham menen kuptan namazynyn ubagynda Allakhty aruulagyla zhana tan'ga maal bagymdat namazynyn ubagynda Allakhty aruulagyla.

Maktoolor zhalgyz Allakhka gana taandyk. Asmandagy perishteler Aga maktoo aityshat zhana zherdegi zhan-zharatylysh da Aga maktoo aityshat. Kechke maal asyr namazynyn ubagynda Any aruulagyla. Oshondoi ele beshim ubagynda Any aruulagyla.

Al bel suudan insandy, zhumurtkadan zhozhonu chygargan syiaktuu olukton tiruunu chygarat zhana insandan bel suunu, tookton zhumurtkany chygargan syiaktuu tiruudon oluktu chygarat. Oshondoi ele zherdi kurgap kalgandan kiiin zhamgyr zhaadyryp zhana any ondurup tiriltet. Zherdi ondurup tiriltken syiaktuu siler dagy surak beruu uchun, syilyk zhe zhaza alysh uchun kabyrlaryn'ardan chygarylasyn'ar.

Ei, adamdar! Allakh Taalanyn tupku atan'ar Adamdy topuraktan zharatkany, andan son' silerdin tukum ulap koboigonun'or, zherdin batysh-chygyshyna tarkoon'or -- Anyn kudurettuulugun zhana zhalgyzdygyn dan'azalagan uluu aiat-belgilerden.

Ei, erkekter! Oshondoi ele siler beipil-tynch boluun'ar uchun oz ara okshoshtuk sebeptuu ozun'ordon zhuptardy zharatuusu zhana orton'ordo suiuu menen meerimdi paida kyluusu -- Anyn zhalgyzdygyn zhana kudurettuulugun bildirgen aiat-belgilerden. Chyndygynda bul aitylgandarda akyl zhugurtkon koom uchun achyk-aikyn dalilder bar. Antkeni alar akyl zhugurtuudon paida alyshat.

Zhana Allakh asmandar menen zherdi zharatuusu, tilderdin zhana tustordun ar turduu boluusu - Anyn kudurettuulugun zhana zhalgyzdygyn bildirgen uluu aiat-belgilerden. Chyndygynda bul aitylgandarda ilim zhana korogoch eeleri uchun dalilder bar.

Zhana siler tundosu zhana kunduzu ishten charchaganyn'ardan es aluun'ar uchun uktashyn'ar - Anyn kudurettuulugun zhana zhalgyzdygyn bildirgen aiat-belgilerden. Oshondoi ele siler ar tarapka tarkap Rabbin'erden yrysky izdeshin'er uchun kunduzdu kyluusu da Anyn aiat-belgilerinen. Chyndygynda bul aitylgandarda oi zhugurtup, kabyl aluu menen ukkan koom uchun dalilder bar.

Zhana silerge asmandan chagylgandy korgozuusu, siler anyn sokkusunan korkuu menen birge andan zhamgyrdy umut kyluun'ar, silerge asmandan zhamgyr suusun tushuruusu zhana zherdi kurgap kalgandan kiiin osumduktordu osturup any tiriltuusu - Anyn kudurettuulugun zhana zhalgyzdygyn bildirgen uluu aiat-belgilerden. Chyndygynda bul nerselerde akyl zhugurtkon koom uchun achyk-aikyn dalilder bar. Alar bul nerselerdi olumdon kiiin surak berish uchun, syilyk zhe zhaza alysh uchun kaira tiriluugo dalil kylyshat.

Zhana Allakhtyn buirugu menen asmandyn kulabai, zherdin urabai karmalyp turuusu - Anyn kudurettuulugun zhana zhalgyzdygyn bildirgen aiat-belgilerden. Kiiin sur kerneiin perishtege tarttyruu menen Allakh silerge zherden bir zholu chakyryk tashtaganda siler kabyrlaryn'ardan surak beruu uchun, syilyk zhe zhaza aluu uchun chygasyn'ar.
Asmandardagy zhana zherdegi biilik kyluu, zharatuu zhana tagdyr kyluu Aga gana taandyk. Asmandar menen zherdegi butkul nerseler Anyn zharatkandary. Alar Anyn buiruguna moiun sunushat.

Al duino-aalamdy murun bolbogondoi korunushto abalky zholu zharatkan zhana zhok bolgondon kiiin alardy kairadan zharatat. Kairadan zharatuu abalky zharatuudan zhen'il. Ekoosu ten' Aga zhen'il. Antkeni Al bir nerseni kaalasa, anda aga <<bol>> dep aitat, al oshol zamat bolot. Butkul nersedegi uluuluk zhana toluktuk sypattary menen sypattalgan en' zhogorku sypattoolor Aga gana taandyk. Al zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu. Oz zharatuusunda zhana bashkaruusunda Daanyshman.

Ei, mushrikter! Allakh silerge ozun'ordon misal keltirdi. Silerdin kuldaryn'ardyn arasynda mal-mulkun'orgo siler menen birdei den'geelde sherik bolgondoru barby? Siler alar menen mal-mulkun'ordu bolushuudon kudum aran'ardan kee birin'er erkin kishi menen mal-mulktu bolushuudon korkkon syiaktuu korkosun'ar. Siler kuldaryn'arga ushundai boluusun yraazy bolup kabyl alat belen'er? Shek zhok, siler buga yraazy bolboisun'ar. Andai bolso Allakh Oz zharatkandaryna zhana kuldaryna eelik kyluuda sherigi zhok boluuga en' tatyktuu! Biz ushul syiaktuu misaldardy keltiruu menen akyl zhugurtkon koom uchun turduu-turduu dalilderdi baiandaibyz. Antkeni alar myndan paida alyshat.

Alardyn adashuusu dalilderdin zhetishsizdiginen, zhe any tushundurboi koiuudan ulam bolgon zhok. Napsi kaaloosun zhana ata-babalaryn sokur eerchigendikten ulam boldu. Allakh adashtyrgan adamdy tuura zholgo kim bagyttai alat? Ech kim. Alardy Allakhtyn azabynan kutkara ala turgan ech kandai zhardamchy bolboit.

Oo, paigambar! Sen zhana seni menen birge bolgondor bashka dinderden chettep, Allakh seni bagyttagan, adamdardyn tupku taza tabiiatyna salgan Islam dinine zhuzun'ordu burgula! Allakhtyn zharatkanyn ozgortuu mumkun emes. Al ech kandai burmalanuusu zhok tuura din. Birok adamdardyn kopchulugu bul din akyikat din ekenin bilishpeit.

Kunoon'orgo toobo kylyp Aga kaitkyla, Anyn buiruktaryn atkaruu, tyigandaryn tashtoo menen Aga takybalyk kylgyla zhana namazdy toluk turdo atkargyla! Allakh menen katar bashkalarga syiynyp, tupku taza tabiiatka karshy chykkan mushrikterden bolbogula!

Ozdorunun dinin ozgortkon mushrikterden bolbogula! Alar anyn kee birine yiman keltirip, kee birine kaapyrlyk kylyshty zhana toptorgo bolunup ketishti. Ar bir top ozdoru tutungan zhalgandary menen kubanyp, biz gana akyikattabyz, a bashkalar bolso zhalganda dep oiloshot.

Egerde mushrikterdin bashyna ooru, zhakyrchylyk, kurgakchylyk syiaktuu baleeler tushso, alar andan kutuluu uchun Rabbisine gana kaituu menen zhalbaryp duba kylyshat. Kiiin Al alardy andan kutkaryp yraiym kylgan bolso, alardyn bir tobu kairadan Allakhka bashkalardy ten'ep, sherik kylyp, al nerselerden duba kylyp surai bashtashat.

Alar Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryna (anyn ichinde kyiynchylyktan kutkaruu zhakshylygy da bar) kaapyrlyk kylyp, bul zhashoodogu kol astyndagy nerselerdi zhyrgap paidalana berishsin. Alar zhakynda kyiamat kunu achyk adashuuda bolgondorun oz kozdoru menen korushot.

Alarga ech kandai dalilderi zhok turup Allakhka shirk kyluuga emne turtku berdi? Alar Allakhka shirk kyluuga dalil kyla turgandai Biz alarga kitepten ech kandai dalil tushurgon emespiz. Oshondoi ele alardyn kolunda alar kylgan shirkteri tuuraluu aitylgan zhana alardyn kaapyrlygyn tuura dep tastyktagan ech kandai kitep zhok.

Egerde Biz adamdarga den-sooluk, bailyk syiaktuu zhakshylyktarybyzdan bergen bolsok, alar aga chirenip kubanychka batyshat zhana tekeberlenishet. A eger alarga oz koldoru menen kylgan kunooloru sebeptuu alarga zhakpagandai ooru, zhakyrchylyk kelgen bolso, alar daroo Allakhtyn yraiymynan zhana alarga zhetken zhamandyktan kutuluudan umuttorun uzushot.

Alar korushkon zhokpu, Allakh pendeleri shugur kylaby zhe tanyp ketebi dep synash uchun alardan Ozu kaalaganyna yryskysyn kenen kyldy, oshondoi ele alar sabyr kylaby zhe naarazy bolobu dep synash uchun alardan Ozu kaalaganynyn yryskysyn tar kyldy? Chyndygynda kee birlerge yryskynyn kop berilip, kee birlerge az berilishinde yimanduular uchun Allakhtyn yraiymduuluguna belgiler bar.

Ei, musulman! Tuuganyn'a, aga ylaiyktuu zhakshylyk kyl zhana any menen kattashkyn. Muktazh adamdy muktazhdygynan chygar, oz zherinen alysta zhurgon musapyrga (zhardam) ber. Ushundai zhakshylyktardy kyluu - Allakhtyn yraazylygyn kaalagandar uchun zhakshy. Alar ushundai zhardam berip, adamdardyn akysyn otop oz mildetterin atkaryshat. Myna osholor kozdogon beiishine zhetip, korkkon tozogunan kutulup, iigilikke zhetkender.

Kachan Allakhtyn Ozuno zhakyndatkan ish-araketterdi baiandagan kezde Anyn Zhuzun kaalabastan atkarylgan ish-araketterdi da baiandady. Chyndygynda munun artynda arzybagan duinoluk maksattar gana kozdolgonun aityp myndai dedi:
Siler ashygy menen kaitaryp aluu maksatta kee bir adamdarga bergen mal-mulkun'ordun Allakhtyn aldynda soobu koboiboit. Al emi siler kadyr-barkka zhana adamdardan syilykka zhetuunu kozdoboston, Allakhtyn gana Zhuzun kaalap muktazh bolgon adamdarga mal-mulkun'ordon bersen'er, myna osholorgo Allakhtyn aldynda sooptor eselep koboitulup berilet.

Allakh zhalgyz Ozu silerdi zharatty, kiiin silerge yryskyn'ardy berdi. Andan son' silerdi olturup, kiiin kaira tiriltet. Siler Any menen katar syiynyp zhatkan kudailaryn'ardan kimisi ushulardy kyla alat? Allakh mushrikterdin aitkan sozdorunon zhana oilogon oilorunan Aruu zhana Yiyk.

Adamdar kolu menen zhasagan kunoolorunun aiynan, alardyn zhashoosunda zhetishpestik, ar kandai zhugushtuu, zhaman oorular, kurgakta da, den'izde da turduu buzukuluktar paida boldu. Allakh Taala myndai nerselerdi adamdardyn kee bir kunooloruno zharasha alardy bul duino zhashoosunda zhazaloo uchun zhana alar toobo kylaby degen umutto zhasady.

Oo, paigambar! Al mushrikterge ait: <<Zher zhuzun kezip, silerden murunku zhalganchy koomdordun akybeti kandai bolgonun karap aga oi zhugurtkulo. Alardyn arty zhamandyk menen butkon. Alardyn kopchulugu Allakh menen katar bashka nerselerge syiynyp shirk kylyshkan. Oshonduktan alar Allakhka shirk kylyshkany sebeptuu kyirap zhok bolushkan.
