Oo, paigambar! Anyn keluusun ech kim toktoto albagan kyiamat kunu kelgenge cheiin ech kandai burmalanuusu zhok tuura Islam dinine zhuzun'du bur! Al kunu adamdar bolunup kalyshat, bir tobu beiishte zhyrgalchylykta bolushat, ekinchi tobu tozokto azaptalyshat.

Kimde-kim Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylsa, anda anyn kaapyrlygynyn zyiany ozuno kaitat, al tozokto tuboluk kalat. Al emi kim Allakhtyn Zhuzun kaalap zhakshylyk ishterdi kylsa, anda alar ozdoru uchun beiishke kiruunu zhana andagy zhyrgalchylyktardy daiardaptyr, alar al zhakta tuboluk kalyshat.

Al, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Rabbisin yraazy kyla turgan zhakshy ishterdi kylgandardy syiloo uchun ushintet. Chynynda, Allakh Aga zhana Anyn elchilerine kaapyr bolgondordu suiboit. Teskerisinche, alardy aiabai katuu zhek korot zhana kyiamat kunu katuu azaptait.

Ei, adamdar! Zhamgyrdan kiiinki paida bolgon tushumduuluk zhana bakubatchylyk arkyluu silerge Oz yraiymyn sezdirish uchun zhana Oz kaaloosu menen den'izde kemelerdi zhurguzush uchun zhana oshondoi ele den'izde sooda-satyk kylyp Anyn zhakshylyktaryn surashyn'ar uchun pendelerge zhamgyrdyn zhaashyn suiunchulogon shamaldardy zhiberuusu - Anyn kudurettuulugun zhana zhalgyzdygyn bildirgen uluu aiat-belgilerden.

Oo, paigambar! Biz senden murun da elchilerdi oz koomdoruna zhiberip, alarga chynchyldyktaryn bildirgen dalilderdi alyp kelishken. Oshondo alar elchileri alyp kelgen nerselerdi zhalganga chygaryshty. Anan Biz kunoolordu kylgandardan och aldyk zhana alardy Oz azabybyz menen kyiratyp zhok kyldyk. Al emi elchilerdi zhana alarga yiman keltirgenderdi kyiroodon saktap kaldyk. Yimanduulardy kutkaruu zhana alarga zhardam beruunu - Biz Ozubugo mildet kylganbyz.

Allakh Taala shamal sokturat. Shamal buluttardy kozgop aidait. Anan alardy asmanda Ozu kaalagandai, zhe az, zhe kop kylyp zhaiat zhana bolok-bolok kylyp tarkatat. Anan sen, ei, karap turgan adam, bulut arasynan chykkan zhamgyrdy korosun'. Al Ozu kaalagan pendelerinin ustuno zhamgyr zhaadyrganda, alar Allakhtyn yraiymy menen zhaagan zhamgyrga suiunushot. Antkeni, zhamgyrdan kiiin zher betine alardyn ozuno zhana ui zhanybarlaryna kerek bolgon azyk-toiuttar onup chygat.
Allakh alarga zhamgyr zhaadyrganga cheiin alar andan umutsuz bolup kalyshkan ele.

Oo, paigambar! Allakh Oz pendelerine yraiym kylyp tushurgon zhamgyrdyn belgilerin kara, Allakh zher beti kurgap kalgandan kiiin turduu osumduktordu osturup any kantip tiriltkenin kara! Chyndygynda al kurgak zherdi tiriltken Allakh oluktordu kaira tirilte alat. Al bardyk nersege kudurettuu. Any ech kim alsyz kyla albait.

Egerde Biz alardyn eginderine zhana zhashylcha-zhemishterine zyian keltire turgandai shamal zhiberip, aga cheiin zhapzhashyl bolup turgan eginderi sargaiyp ketkenderin korushso, anda any korushkondon kiiin Allakhtyn alarga murun bergen koptogon zhakshylyktaryn tanyp ketishet.

Sen oluktorgo sozun'du uguza albagan syiaktuu duloilorgo da sozun'du uguza albaisyn'. Alardyn ukpastygy anyk bolush uchun alar senden alystap ketishti. Oshol syiaktuu ele sen alarga okshop bash tartkandardy zhana paida albagandardy tuura zholgo sala albaisyn'.

Oshondoi ele sen tuz zholdon adashkandardy akyikat zholgo tushuro albaisyn'. Bizdin aiattarybyzga yiman keltirip, paida aluu uchun ukkan adamga gana uguza alasyn'. Antkeni al senin aitkan sozun'don paida alat. Myna osholor Bizdin buiruktarybyzga eerchip, bash iigender.

Ei, adamdar! Allakh silerdi alsyz suudan zharatty. Andan son' balalyk kezdegi alsyzdyktan kiiin kishi kuraktagy kuch-kubattuuluktu berdi. Andan son' kishi kuraktagy kuch-kubattuuluktan kiiin kaarylyk kezdegi alsyzdykty berdi. Allakh alsyzdyktan zhana kuch-kubattuuluktan Ozu kaalagandy zharatat. Al butkul nerselerdi Biluuchu, Aga ech bir nerse zhashyruun emes. Al Kudurettuu, Any ech kim alsyz kyla albait.

Kyiamat kun bolgondo kunookorlor kabyrlarynda az gana ubakyt bolduk dep kasam ichishet. Alar duinodo akyikattan adashyp ketishkeni syiaktuu alarga kabyrlarynda kancha ubakyt bolgondorun biluudo da adashyshty.

Allakh ilim bergen paigambarlar zhana perishteler mintip aityshat: <<Siler Allakh Taala ilimi menen zhazgan algachky zharalgan kunun'ordon bashtap, ozun'or ishenbei chetke kakkan kaira tiriluu kunun'orgo cheiin turdun'ar. Birok, siler kaira tiriluunu bilbei turup, aga kaapyr bolgonsun'ar".

Al kunu Allakh butkul adamdardy, zhinderdi, zhan-zhanybarlardy surak uchun zhana syilyk zhe zhaza berish uchun kaira tiriltet. Zaalymdarga alar oilop tapkan shyltooloru paida berbeit zhana alardan Allakhty yraazy kylysh uchun toobo kyluu da, Aga kaituu da talap kylynbait. Antkeni anyn ubaktysy otup ketken.

Biz adamdarga kamkorduk kylyp, alarga akyikat zhalgandan aiyrmalanyp bilinuusu uchun bul Kuranda ar turduu misaldardy keltirdik. Oo, paigambar! Egerde sen alarga chynchyldygyn'dy bildirgen dalil alyp kelsen', Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandar: <<Siler ozun'or alyp kelgen nersede anyk zhalganchysyn'ar>> - dep aityshat.
Sen alyp kelgen aiatka yiman keltirbegenderdin zhuroktoruno moor basylgan syiaktuu Allakh sen alarga alyp kelgendi akyikat dep bilbegen bardyk adamdardyn zhuroktoruno moor basat.

Oo, paigambar! Elin'din seni zhalganga chygarganyna sabyr kyl! Chyndygynda Allakh seni zhen'ishke, kubattuulukka zhetkirip, dinin'di bekem ornotuu tuuraluu ubadasy sheksiz ishke ashat. Andyktan kaira tiriluugo ishenbegender seni shashtyruuga zhana sabyrsyzdyk kyluuga turtposun.
(lm) Alif. Laam. Miim. Ushuga okshogon aiattyn tushundurmosu bakara suroosunun bashynda kelgen.
Oo, paigambar! Saga tushkon bul aiattar - daanyshmandyk menen suilogon kitep aiattary.
Al Rabbisinin zhana Anyn pendelerinin aldyndagy mildetterdi atkaryp zhakshy ish-araketterdi kylgandar uchun tuura zhol zhana yraiym.
Alar namazdy toluk turdo atkaryshat, mal-mulktorunon zeket berishet zhana akyrettegi kaira tiriluu, surak beruu, soop zhe zhaza aluu syiaktuu nerselerge anyk ishenishet.
Myna ushul sypattarga ee adamdar Rabbisi taraptan bolgon tuura zholdo zhana osholor kozdogondoruno zhetip zhana korkkondorunan alystap zhen'ishke zhetkender.

Kachan Allakh zhakshylyk kylgandardyn sypattaryn eskergende zhamandyk kylgandardyn sypattaryn da eskerip myndai dedi:
Adamdardyn arasynda Nadr ibn al'-Khariske okshogondor sabatsyzdyktan ulam Allakhtyn dininen adamdardy alaksytysh uchun maanisiz-bekerchi sozdordu tandashat zhana Allakhtyn aiattaryn shyldyn'dap kulushot. Myna ushul sypattarga ee adamdarga akyrette kordoochu azap bar.
Egerde aga Bizdin aiattarybyz okulsa, any ukpagandai, kulagynda duloilugu bardai any ukpastan tekeberlenip burulup ketet. Oo, paigambar! Aga any kutkon kyinoochu azaptyn kabaryn berip koi.
Al emi Allakhka yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandarga zhyrgalchylyk beiishteri bar. Alar al zhakta Allakh alar uchun daiardap koigon zhyrgalchylykta bolushat.
Alar anda tuboluk kalyshat. Allakh munu alarga Ozu ubada kyldy, mynda ech kandai shek zhok. Al ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu. Al Oz zharatuusunda, bashkaruusunda zhana shariiatynda Daanyshman.

Allakh Taala asmandardy turkuksuz kotorulgon abalda zharatty zhana silerdi chaipaltpasyn dep Zher betine bekem toolordu ornottu. Oshondoi ele Zher zhuzuno turduu zhan-zhanybarlardy taratty. Zhana Biz asmandan zhamgyr suusun tushurup, Zher betinde ar kandai turdogu kooz korunushtogu osumduktordu osturduk. Alardy adamdar zhana zhanybarlar paidalanat.

Bul aitylgandar Allakhtyn zharatkandary. Ei, mushrikter! Kana maga korsotkulochu, siler Allakhtan bashka syiynganyn'ar emnelerdi zharatty?! Teskerisinche zaalymdar akyikattan anyk adashuuda. Antkeni alar ech nerseni zharata albagan, ozdoru zharatylgan nerselerdi Rabbisine sherik kylyp zhatyshat.

Biz Lukmanga dindegi tuura tushunuktu zhana ishterdin tuuralygyn biluunu berdik zhana aga aittyk: <<Ei, Lukman! Rabbin' seni Ozuno moiun sunuuga iigilik berip kylgan zhakshylygyna shugur kyl! Kimde-kim Rabbisine shugur kylsa, chyndygynda anyn kylgan shuguru ozuno gana kaitat. Allakh anyn shuguruno muktazh emes. Al emi kim Allakhtyn bergen zhakshylygyn chetke kagyp, Aga kaapyrlyk kylsa, chyndygynda anyn kaapyrlygynyn zyianyn ozu tartat. Al Allakhka ech kandai zyian berbeit. Al zharatylgandardyn ech birine muktazh emes zhana butkul abalda maktoogo tatyktuu>>.

Oo, paigambar! Estechi, bir kezde Lukman balasyn zhakshylykka undop, zhamandyktan eskertip myndai dedi: <<Oo, balam! Allakh menen katar bashkaga syiynba! Chyndygynda Allakh menen katar bashka kudailarga syiynuu - adamdyn chon' zulumdugu. Antkeni al tuboluk tozokko alyp bara turgan chon' kunoonu kyldy>>.

Biz insanga Allakhtyn aldynda kunoo bolbogon ishte ata-enesine bash iiuunu, alarga zhakshylyk kyluunu osuiat kyldyk. Enesi any oz kursagynda kyiynchylyk artynan kyiynchylyk tartyp kotordu zhana any emchekten chygaruu eki zhyl. Biz aga aittyk: <<Allakh saga kylgan zhakshylyktar uchun Aga shugur kyl zhana saga tarbiia bergen, kamkorduk kylgan ata-enen'e shugur kyl! Maga gana kaitasyn'ar, oshondo Men ar birin'erge tatyktuu syilygyn zhe zhazasyn berem>>.

Egerde ata-enen' kuchko salyp seni Allakhka shirk kyldyruuga bolushuncha araket kylyp mazhburlashsa da, sen bul nersede alarga bash iibe! Antkeni Zharatuuchunun aldynda kunoo bolgon ishte insanga, pendege bash iiuu zhok. A, birok duinodo al ekoosun urmattap syila, mamilen'di bekemde zhana zhakshylyk kyl! Meni zhalgyz dep bilgen zhana bash iiuu menen Maga kaitkan adamdardyn zholun eerchi! Kiiin kyiamat kunu baaryn'ar Maga gana kaitasyn'ar. Oshondo Men silerge bul duinodo kylgan ishterin'erdin kabaryn bildirem zhana anyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn berem.

Oo, balam! Chyndygynda zhakshylyk zhe zhamandyk ish sary kychynyn danynyn salmagyndai kichine bolup, ech kim korbogon aska tashtyn ichinde bolso da, zhe bolboso asmandardyn zhe Zherdin kaisy zherinde bolbosun, Allakh any kyiamat kunu sozsuz alyp kelet zhana pendege anyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret. Chyndygynda Allakh Baamchyl, Aga butkul nerseler iine-zhibine cheiin belgiluu. Al Kabardar, butkul nerselerdin akyikatyn zhana ordun bilet.

Oo, balam! Namazdy toluk turdo atkar, zhakshylykka chakyr, zhamandyktan kaitar zhana bul nersede saga zhetken kyiynchylyktarga sabyr kyl. Chyndygynda saga buirulgan bul nerselerdi Allakh senin atkaruun'du buiurdu zhana saga bul nersede ech kandai tandoo berbedi.

Zhana tekeberlenip adamdardan zhuzun'du burba! Oshondoi ele zher ustundo menmensinip kerseiip baspa! Chyndygynda berilgen zhakshylyktar menen adamdarga tekeberlenip, al uchun Allakhka shugur kylbai maktanyp menmensingen adamdardyn ech birin Allakh zhakshy korboit.

Shashylbastan, oto zhai da emes salabattuuluktu korsotup bir kalypta bas zhana zyian bere turganchalyk unun'du katuu chygarba! Chyndygynda undordun en' zhamany - eshektin aikyrgany. Antkeni anyn unu katuu chygat.

Ei, adamdar! Korboi zhatasyn'arby, Allakh silerge Kun, Ai, zhyldyzdar syiaktuu asmandardagy nerselerdi paidalanuunu zhen'il kylyp koidu. Oshondoi ele silerge zhan-zhanybarlar, bak-daraktar, osumduktor syiaktuu Zherdegi nerselerdi paidalanuunu da zhen'il kyldy. Zhana silerge kozgo korungon suluu kelbet, kelishimduu turpat zhana kozgo korunbogon akyl, ilim syiaktuu Oz zhakshylyktaryn toluk kylyp berdi. Myna ushundai zhakshylyktarga karabastan, kee bir adamdar ech kandai ilimi zhok turup, Allakhtan kelgen vakhiige zhe tunuk akylga zhe Allakh taraptan tushkon achyk kitepke taianbastan, Allakhtyn zhalgyz Zat ekendigin kaitaryp, talashyp-tartyshat.

Kimde-kim Allakhka chyn yklastan syiynyp, zhakshylyk ishterdi atkaryp Aga bet alsa, anda al kutuluunu kaalagan adam uzulup ketet dep korkpoi turgan bekem nerseni karmaptyr. Ishterdin zhurushu, akybeti zhalgyz Allakhka gana kaitat. Al baaryna ozuno zharasha syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Oo, paigambar! Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandardyn kaapyrlygy seni kapalantpasyn. Alar kyiamat kunu Bizge gana kaityp kelishet. Oshondo Biz alardyn duinodo kylgan zhamandyktarynyn kabaryn uguzup, aga zhazasyn berebiz. Chyndygynda Allakh kokuroktordogu nerselerdi Biluuchu, alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.
Biz alarga duino zhyrgalchylyktaryn berip bolor-bolbos ubakyt zhyrgatabyz. Kiiin kyiamat kunu alardy tozok azaby bolgon katuu azapka salabyz.

Asmandardagy zhana zherdegi nerselerdin zharaluusu, eeligi zhana bashkaruusu zhalgyz Allakhka gana taandyk. Chyndygynda Allakh zharatylgandardyn ech birine muktazh emes, Al bul duinodo zhana akyrette maktoogo tatyktuu.

Egerde zher betindegi daraktar kesilip, kalemsap bolup uchtalsa zhana den'iz aga syia bolup, aga dagy zheti den'iz koshumcha berilse da Allakhtyn sozdorunun akyry zhok bolgonu sebeptuu alar ech kachan tugonboit. Chyndygynda Allakh Kudurettuu, Any ech kim zhen'e albait. Al Oz zharatuusunda zhana bashkaruusunda Daanyshman.

Ei, adamdar! Silerdin zharaluun'ar zhana kyiamat kunu surak beruu, syilyk zhe zhaza aluu uchun kaira tiriluun'or bir zhandy zharatkan syiaktuu, any kaira tiriltuu on'oi. Chyndygynda Allakh Uguuchu, bir undu uguuda aga bashka undor toskoolduk zharatpait. Al Koruuchu, bir nerseni koruudo aga bashka nerseler zholtoo bolboit. Oshol syiaktuu ele bir zhandy zharatuuda zhe any kaira tiriltuudo Any bashka zhandy zharatuu zhe kaira tiriltuu alaksytpait.

Kemeler den'izde Anyn meerimduulugu zhana zhen'ildetuusu menen suzup zhurgonun korbodun'bu?! Ei, adamdar! Al munu silerge Ozunun kudurettuulugun zhana meerimin bildirgen keremet-belgilerin korgozush uchun kyldy. Chyndygynda bul nersede kyiynchylykta sabyr kyluuchular zhana zhakshylykta shugur kyluuchular uchun Anyn kudurettuulugun bildirgen dalilder bar.

Kachan alardy but taraptan toolordoi zhana buluttardai tolkundar orop kalganda gana alar zhalgyz Allakhka chyn yklastan duba kylyp zhana syiynyp zhalbaryshat. Kachan Allakh alardyn dubasyna zhoop berip, alardy choguudon saktap, kurgaktykka chygarsa, alardyn kee birleri ortoluktu karmanyp, alarga mildet bolgondoi toluk turdo shugur kylyshpait, al emi kee birleri Allakhtyn zhakshylygyn chetke kagyshat. Bizdin keremet-belgileribizdi bardyk kyianatchylar (misaly, eger Allakh bizdi kutkarsa, anda sozsuz shugur keltiruuchulordon bolobuz dep ubada kylgandar), Allakhtyn bergen zhakshylyktaryna shugur kylbai alardy chetke kakkandar gana zhokko chygaryshat.

Ei, adamdar! Rabbin'erdin buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtoo menen Andan korkkula! Zhana atasy balasyna, balasy atasyna ech paida keltire albagan kundun azabynan korkkula! Chyndygynda Allakhtyn kyiamat kunundogu syilyk zhe zhaza tuuraluu bergen ubadasy anyk zhana sozsuz bolot. Andyktan silerdi duino zhashoosunun yrakhattary zhana zhyrgalchylyktary azgyryp koibosun zhana shaitan silerdi Allakhtyn toktoolugu zhana azapty kechiktiruusu menen aldap koibosun.

Chyndygynda kyiamattyn kachan boloorun zhalgyz Allakh gana bilet. Al kachan kaalasa zhamgyr zhaadyrat. Zhana zhatyndagy tuiulduk bala zhe kyz ekenin, baktyluu zhe baktysyz ekenin Ozu bilet. Ech bir zhan erten' kandai zhakshylyk zhe zhamandyk kylaryn bilbeit. Ech bir zhan kaisy zherde olorun da bilbeit. Munun baaryn Allakh gana bilet. Chyndygynda Allakh butkul nerseni Biluuchu, Kabardar. Bulardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.
(lm) Alif. Laam. Miim. Ushuga okshogon aiattyn tushundurmosu bakara suroosunun bashynda kelgen.
Mukhammad alyp kelgen bul Kuran aalamdardyn Rabbisi taraptan tushkon. Mynda ech kandai shek zhok.

Al kaapyrlar: <<Chyndygynda Mukhammad munu Rabbisinin atynan ozu oilop tapkan>> - deshet. Bul ish alar aitkandai emes. Teskerisinche bul Rabbin' taraptan tushkon ech kandai shek-kumonu zhok akyikat. Ei, paigambar! Senden murun alarga Allakhtyn azabynan korkutkan paigambar kelbegen koomdu eskertkin. Balkim alar akyikatka tushup, any eerchishet zhana any atkaryshat.

Allakh Ozu asmandar menen zherdi zharatty zhana al ekoosunun arasyndagylardy alty kundo zharatty. Al any bir koz irmemden da az ubakytta zharatyp koiuuga kudurettuu. Kiiin Al Ozunun uluuluguna ylaiyk den'geelde Arshka biiiktedi zhana kotoruldu. Ei, adamdar! Siler uchun Rabbin'erdin aldynda ishin'erdi kolgo algan koldoochu da, ortomchu bolgon shapaat kyluuchu da zhok. Oilonboisun'arby, bashkalarga syiynbai silerdi zharatkan Allakhka syiynbaisyn'arby?!
Allakh asmandar menen zherdegi butkul zhanduu-zhansyzdardyn ishterin Ozu bashkaryp turat. Ei, adamdar! Kiiin silerdin esebin'erde min' zhylga tete bolgon bir kundo al ishter Aga karai kotorulot.

Myna oshonun baaryn bashkaryp turuuchu - Al kaiypty da, ashkereni da Biluuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Al Kudurettuu, aga ech kim ustomduk kyla albait, Al oz dushmandarynan och alam dese, ech kim toso albait. Al Ozunun yimanduu pendelerine Yraiymduu.
Al butkul nerselerdi en' sonun korunushto zharatkan zhana Adamdy murda bolbogondoi kalypta ylaidan zharatyp bashtagan.
Kiiin any ulai urpaktaryn andan bolunup chykkan bel suudan zharatty.

Kiiin insandy toluk korkom kelbette zharatty zhana zhan saluuga zhoopker bolgon perishtege buiruu menen aga Oz rukhunan uilop zhan saldy. Ei, adamdar! Al silerge ugush uchun kulaktardy, korush uchun kozdordu, akyl zhugurtush uchun zhuroktordu berdi. Allakhtyn silerge bergen bul zhakshylyktaryna az shugur kylyp zhatasyn'ar.

Kaira tiriluunu zhalganga chygargan mushrikter aityshat: <<Biz olup, zherge komulup, deneleribiz topurakka ailanyp ketse, anan kantip kairadan tirilmek elek?!>>. Buga akyldary zhetpeit. Teskerisinche alar akyikatta kaira tiriluugo yiman keltirbei kaapyrlyk kylyshkandar.

Ei, paigambar! Kaira tiriluunu zhalganga chygargan mushrikterge ait: <<Allakh silerdin zhanyn'ardy aluuga daiyndagan olum perishtesi zhanyn'ardy alat. Andan son' kyiamat kunu surak berish uchun, syilyk zhe zhaza alysh uchun bizge gana kaityp kelesin'er>>.

Zhakynda kyiamat kunu kunookorlorgo baary achyk bolgondo, alar kaira tiriluugo kaapyrlyk kylyshkany sebeptuu korduktan bashtaryn zherge salyp kordolgon abalda turushkanda aityshat: <<Rabbibiz! Biz zhalganga chygargan kaira tiriluunu oz kozubuz menen korduk, Sen taraptan paigambarlar alyp kelgen nerselerdin chyndyk ekenin oz kulagybyz menen uktuk. Emi bizdi duino zhashoosuna kaitar, biz Seni yraazy kylgan zhakshylyk ishterdi kylaly. Biz kaira tiriluugo zhana paigambarlar alyp kelgen nerselerdin chyndyk ekenine emi ishendik>>. Eger sen kunookorlordun myna oshondoi abalda bolgondorun korson', abaldary kandai gana oor bolgondugun korosun'.

Eger Biz ar bir zhanga tuuralykty, iigilikti beruunu kaalasak, anda Biz any oshogo alyp barmakpyz. Birok daanyshmandyktan zhana adilettikten Menin: <<Kyiamat kunu tozoktu kaapyr adamdar zhana kaapyr zhinder menen sozsuz tolturamyn. Antkeni alar yiman zhana tuuralyk zholdu tashtap, kaapyrlyk zhana adashuu zholun tandashty>> degen sozum sozsuz ishke ashat.

Kyiamat kunu aiyptoo maksatta alarga myndai dep aitylat: <<Kyiamat kunundo surak berish uchun Allakh menen zholugushuunu duino zhashoosunda unutkanyn'ar sebeptuu azapty tartkyla! Chyndygynda Biz silerdi kyinalganyn'arga karabastan azapka tashtaibyz. Duinodo kunoolordu, kaapyrlykty kylganyn'ar sebeptuu ech kachan butpogon tuboluk azapty tartkyla>>.

Allakh kunookorlordun abalyn baiandap aitkandan kiiin yimanduulardyn da abalyn baiandap myndai dedi:
Chyndygynda Biz paigambarlarybyzga tushurgon aiattarybyzga, alar nasaat kylynganda Allakhty maktoo menen aruulap sazhda kylgandar, Allakhka syiynuudan zhana kandai abalda bolso da sazhda kyluudan tekeberlik kylbagandar yiman keltirishet.

Alar uikusunan oigonup kaptaldap zhatkan zherinen toshokton turushat zhana Allakhka bet alyshyp, namazdarynda zhana bashka ibadattarynda Anyn azabynan korkuu menen, Anyn yraiymyn umut kyluu menen duba kylyshat. Oshondoi ele alar Biz bergen mal-mulktordu Allakh zholunda sarptashat.

Alardyn duinodo kylgan zhakshylyk ishterinin syilygy katary Allakh alar uchun kozdordu kubantkan kandai gana nerselerdi daiardap koigondugun ech bir zhan bilbeit. Al syilyk aiabagandai biiik-chon', Anyn akyikatyn bir gana Allakh bilet.
Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn buiruktaryn atkargan zhana tyigandaryn tashtagan adam Aga moiun sunuudan bash tartkan adamdai emes. Bul eki tarap syilyk zhe zhaza aluuda Allakhtyn aldynda birdei emes.

Al emi Allakhka yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandarga daiardalgan alardyn syilygy beiishter bolot. Alar al zhaida Allakhtyn bereshendigi menen turuktuu zhashashat. Bul alardyn duinodo kylgan zhakshylyk ishterinin syilygy.

Al emi kaapyrlyk zhana kunoolordu kyluu menen Allakhka bash iibegender uchun kyiamat kunu daiardalgan zhailary tozok bolot. Alar al zhakta tuboluk kalyshat. Alar al zherden chyguuga araket kylyshsa, kaira aga kaitarylat zhana aiyptoo katary alarga aitylat: <<Duinodo paigambarlaryn'ar silerdi eskertken kezde any zhalganga chygargan tozok azabyn tartkyla>>.

Biz Allakhka bash iibegen al zhalganchylardy eger alar toobo kylyshpasa, akyrette daiardalgan chon' azapka cheiin bul duinodo kyiynchylyktardy zhana baleelerdi tarttyrabyz. Balkim alar Rabbisine bash iiip kaityshar.

Allakhtyn aiattary eskertuu katary aitylganda andan sabak albastan, kon'ul burbastan zhuz burgan adamdan otkon zalym ech kim zhok. Chyndygynda Biz Allakhtyn aiattarynan zhuz burup kaapyrlyk zhana kunoolordu kylgan kylmyshkerlerden sozsuz och alabyz.

Biz Musaga Tooratty berdik. Ei, paigambar! Sen Isra zhana Mirazh tunundo Musa menen zholukkanyn'a shektenbegin. Biz Musaga tushkon kitepti Israil urpaktaryn adashuudan tuura zholgo bagyttoochu kyldyk.

Biz, Israil urpaktarynan adamdar alardy akyikat zholunda eerchii turgan, ozdoru da akyikat zholgo bashtai turgan bashchylardy kyldyk. Antkeni, alar Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiganynan tyiylyp, yimanga chakyruudagy kyiynchylyktarga sabyr kylyshkan. Alar paigambarlaryna tushkon Allakhtyn aiattary chyndyk ekenine toluk ishenishken.

Ei, paigambar! Chyndygynda Rabbin' alardyn bul duinodo talashyp tartyshkan maselelerin kyiamat kunu kalystyk menen chechip beret. Kimisi chynchyl, kimisi zhalganchy ekenin achyk bildiret zhana ar birine tatyktuu syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Emne alar Biz murunku koomdordu zhok kylganybyzdy korushpoi sokur bolup kalyshtyby?! Myna osholordun zhok kylynganga cheiinki zhashashkan turak-zhailarynda basyp zhurushot go! Alardyn abaldaryn korup sabak alyshkan zhok. Chyndygynda al koomdor kaapyrlyktary zhana kunooloru sebeptuu zhok kylynuusunda ulgu-sabaktar bar. Bul alarga paigambarlary Allakh taraptan alyp kelgen nerse chyndyk ekendigine dalil bolot. Al zhalganchylar Allakhtyn aiattaryn kabyl aluu zhana ulgu aluu menen ugushpaiby?!

Kaira tiriluunu zhalganga chygargandar korushpoibu, Biz ech kandai osumduk ospogon kurgak zherge zhamgyrdyn suusun zhaadyryp, al suu menen alardyn tooloru, uilary, koiloru zhana alar ozdoru da zhegen eginderdi chygardyk go?! Alar munu korushpoibu, kurgak zherdi ondurgon Allakh oluktordu kaira tiriltuugo kudurettuu ekenin an'dap bilishpeibi?!

Kaira tiriluunu zhalganga chygargandar azapty shashtyryp myndai deshet: <<Kyiamat kunu biz menen silerdin ortobuzdu bolot, anan biz tozokko tushup, silerdi beiishke kirgizet dep siler oilop zhatkan okum kachan bolot?>>.

Ei, paigambar! Alarga ait: <<Bul ubada kyiamat kunu bolot. Chyndygynda al pendelerdin ortosun bolgon kun. Al kezde duinodo Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandar kyiamat kunun oz kozu menen korgondon kiiin chyndykty tastyktagandary alarga paida berbeit zhana alar Rabbisine toobo kylyp kaituulary uchun moonot da berilbeit>>.
Ei, paigambar! Alar adashuuga batyp ketken son' sen alardan zhuzun'du bur zhana alardyn bashyna tusho turgan nerseni kut! Alar da ubada kylyngan azapty kutushsun.

Oo, paigambar! Sen zhana seni menen birge bolgondor Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap takybalykka bekem bolgula zhana zhalgyz Andan korkkula! Zhana kaapyrlar menen eki zhuzduulorgo alardyn napsileri kaalagan nersede bash iibegile! Chyndygynda Allakh kaapyrlar menen eki zhuzduulordun aila-amaldaryn Biluuchu, Ozunun zharatuusunda zhana bashkaruusunda Daanyshman.

Rabbin' saga tushurgon vakhiidi eerchi! Chyndygynda Allakh silerdin kylgan ish-araketterin'erden Kabardar. Al alardyn ech birin otkorup zhiberbeit. Zhakynda Al silerge kylgan ish-araketterin'erdin syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.
Zhana bardyk ishterin'de zhalgyz Allakhka gana tobokel kyl! Pendelerinen Aga tobokel kylgandarga Allakh Ozu zhetishtuu korgoochu.

Allakh Taala bir adamdyn kokuroguno eki zhuroktu batyrgan emes. Oshondoi ele, tyiylchu ishterde aialdardy enelerdin orduna koigon emes. Bakma baldardy da bel suunan zharalgan oz baldaryndai kylgan emes. Zikhar kyluu (enesi zhe ezhe-karyndashtary syiaktuu aialyn ozuno aram kyluusu) zhana bakma balany oz balasyndai tegine otkorup aluu -- Islam dini zhokko chygargan, eski karan'gy doordun urp-adattarynan. Myna oshol zikhar kyluu zhana bakma balany ozunun balasyndai ata-tegine taandyk kylyp aluu -- bul, ech kandai chyndygy zhok kurulai sozdor. Aialy ech kachan enesindei bolboit, bakma balasy da oz balasy bolup kalbait. Allakh Taala pendeleri atkarsyn uchun akyikatty aitat zhana tuura zholgo bagyttait.

Siler balam dep oilogon bakma baldaryn'ardy oz atalarynyn attary menen chakyrgyla. Alardy oz atalaryna taandyk kyluu Allakhtyn aldynda adilettik. Eger alardyn oz atalaryn bilbesen'er, anda alar silerdin dindesh bir tuugandaryn'ar zhana mumkun kulchuluktan alardy kutkargan kishilerin'er. Alardy <<oo, aga zhe ini>> zhe <<oo, abamdyn balasy>> dep chakyrgyla. Eger bilbesten ogoi atasynyn aty menen chakyryp alsan'ar kunookor bolboisun'ar. Birok munu bilip turup aitsan'ar kunoo alasyn'ar. Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerine Kechirimduu, alardy katachylyk sebeptuu zhazalabagan Yraiymduu.

Mukhammad paigambar momundardy kaisy nersege chakyrbasyn, alardyn kon'ulu bashkaga tartyp tursa da paigambar alar uchun oz zhandarynan da artyk bolush kerek. Al emi anyn aialdary zhalpy musulmandardyn eneleri. Andyktan paigambar olgondon kiiin musulmandar uchun anyn aialdaryna uilonuu aram. Allakhtyn okumu boiuncha yimanduular menen Allakh zholunda kochkondorgo karaganda tuugandyk katyshy barlar biri-birinen muras aluuda akysy zhogoru. Alar Islamdyn bashtapky uchurunda biri-birinen muras alyshchu. Birok kiiin kop otpoi alardyn biri-birinen muras aluu okumu zhokko chygarylgan. Ei, yimanduular! Birok silerge murasker bolbogon zhakyn dostorun'arga muras osuiat kylsan'ar zhe zhakshylyk kylsan'ar uruksat. Myna ushul okum "Saktalyngan (tagdyr) Taktada" zhazylgan. Andyktan any atkaruu mildet.

Oo, paigambar! Estechi, bir ubakta Biz paigambarlardan Allakhka ech nerseni sherik kylbastan zhalgyz Aga syiynuu tuuraluu zhana alarga tushkon vakhiidi zhetkiruu tuuraluu bekem ubada alganbyz. Oshondoi ele zheke senden, Nukhtan, Ibrakhimden, Musadan zhana Mariiamdyn uulu Isadan da Allakhtyn zholdomosun zhetkiruu mildettemesin atkaruuga anyk ubada alganbyz.

Allakh kaapyrlardy aiyptoo maksatta chynchyl elchilerden alardyn chynchyldygy tuuraluu surash uchun paigambarlardan ushul anyk ubadany aldy. Allakh Ozuno zhana paigambarlaryna kaapyrlyk kylgandarga kyiamat kunu tozok otu bolgon kyinoochu azapty daiardap koidu.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirgender zhana shariiatyn atkargandar! Allakhtyn silerge bergen zhakshylygyn estegile, bir kezde kaapyrlardyn askeri silerge karshy sogushush uchun top-top bolup Medinaga kelishti. Alardy eki zhuzduulor menen zhoottor koldoshtu. Oshondo Biz alarga paigambardy zhen'ishke zhetkirgen batyshtan sokkon shamaldy zhiberdik. Oshondoi ele alarga korunbogon perishteler askerin zhiberdik. Oshondo kaapyrlar ech nerse kyla alyshpai kachyp zhonoshtu. Chyndygynda Allakh silerdin kylyp zhatkanyn'ardy bilet. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda al uchun silerge syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Oshondo kaapyrlar oroondun oido tarabynan, batysh menen chygyshyndagy yldyi tarabynan kelishti. Oshol kezde katuu korkunuchtan ulam kozdor dushman tarapty gana tiktep kaldy, zhuroktor alkymga keptelip kaldy. Siler Allakh tuuraluu ar kandai oiloi bashtadyn'ar, birde zhen'ishti oiloson'or, birde andan umut zhok dep oilop zhattyn'ar.

Yimanduular myna oshol Khandak sogushunda zhaaldangan dushman bastyryp kelgende synaldy. Aiabagandai korkunuch alardy katuu sestentti. Myna ushul synoodo kim yimanduu, kim eki zhuzduu ekeni achyk bilindi.

Oshol kunu eki zhuzduulor zhana zhurogundo shek-kumonu bar yimany alsyzdar: <<Allakh menen Anyn elchisinin bizdi zhen'ishke zhetesin'er, zher betinde biilik kylasyn'ar degen ubadasy ech kandai negizi zhok zhalgan eken>> - deshti.

Oo, paigambar! Estechi, oshol kezde eki zhuzduulordun bir tobu Medinanyn eline: <<Ei, Iasribdin eli! (Iasrib Medinanyn Islamga cheiinki atalyshy) Khandakka zhakyn zherdegi Sala toosunun eteginde turbai ele koigula! Andan koro uiun'orgo kaitkyla!>> - deshti. Al emi alardyn bashka bir tobu <<uilorubuz dushmanga achyk kaldy>> degen shyltoo menen paigambardan uiloruno ketuugo uruksat surashty. Birok alar oilogondoi achyk kalgan emes. Akyikatta alar bul zhalgan shyltoo menen dushmandan kachuunu kaalashkan.

Egerde dushman Medinanyn but tarabynan alardy bastyryp kirip, alardan Allakhka kaapyrlyk zhana shirk kyluuga kaitkyla dep talap kylsa, anda alar dushmandyn talabyn atkaryshmak. Alardyn bir az bolugu gana kaapyrlykka kaityshpait bolchu.

Tigi eki zhuzduulor "Ukhud" sogushu bolgon kundo sogushtan kachkandan kiiin Allakhka ant berip: <<Eger Allakh bizdi dagy bashka sogushka tush kylsa, biz, albette dushman menen sogushabyz, alardan korkup kachpaibyz>> - deshti ele. Birok alar anttaryn buzdu. Chynynda, pende Allakhka bergen ubadasy tuuraluu suraluuchu, zhakynda al tuuraluu surak beret.

Oo, paigambar! Alarga ait: <<Olumdon zhe olturuluudon korkup sogushtan kachsan'ar da silerge kachkanyn'ar ech paida berbeit. Antkeni azhal tagdyrda zhazylgan. A eger azhalyn'ardyn moonotu kele elek bolso, ozu bul zhashoodo az gana ubakyt paidalanyp zhashaisyn'ar>>.

Oo, paigambar! Alarga ait: <<Silerdi Allakhtan kim korgoi alat, eger Al siler zhaman korgon olumdu zhe olturuluunu silerge kaalagan bolso, zhe siler kaalagan amandykty zhana zhakshylykty silerge kaalagan bolso, kim toso alat. Silerdi myndan ech kim korgoi albait>>. Al eki zhuzduulor alardyn ishin zhongo salgan Allakhtan bashka dos taba alyshpait zhana alardy Allakhtyn azabynan korgogon koldoochu da taba alyshpait>>.

Silerdin aran'ardagy, Allakhtyn elchisi menen birge dushmanga karshy sogushuudan bashkalardy tyiyp zhatkandardy zhana tuugandaryna: <<Bizge koshulgula! Aga koshulup sogushpagyla, zhanyn'ar kyiylat! Chynynda, biz silerdin zhanyn'ar kyiylat dep korkup zhatabyz>> dep azgyrgandardy Allakh zhakshy bilet. Al satkyndar sogushka kelbeit zhana katyshpait, katyshsa da, seirek, Allakhty zhana Anyn elchisin koldoo uchun emes, ozdoru namyska kalboo uchun kelishet.

Oo, yimanduular zhamaaty! Alar silerden mal-mulkun aiagan saran'dar, alar silerge zhardam berishpeit. Alar zhanyna saran'dyk kylgandar, siler menen birge sogushpait. Alar suiuusun aiagandar, silerdi zhakshy korushpoit. Oo, paigambar! Dushman menen bolgon betteshte korkunuch baskanda, alardyn kozdoru korkoktuktan olum aldynda zhan alaketke tushkon adamdyn kozdorundoi bolup alan'dap seni zhaldyrap tiktegenderin korosun'. Al emi alardan korkunuch ketip, tynchtanyp kalganda zaar tilderi menen ar nerseni aityp zyian berishet. Alar olzhogo ach koz, any dalbastap izdeshet. Myna ushundai sypattagy adamdar chyndap yiman keltirishken emes. Oshol sebepten Allakh alardyn ish-araketterinin sooptorun zhok kyldy. Al zhok kyluu Allakh uchun oto zhen'il.

Al korkoktor Allakhtyn elchisi menen musulmandarga karshy sogushuuga kelgen zhoon toptor musulmandardy kyryp zhok kylmaiyn ketishpeit dep oiloshot. Eger tagdyr bolup, al zhoon toptor dagy bir zholu kelishse, anda al eki zhuzduulor silerden: <<Dushmanyn'ar menen sogushkandan kiiin silerge emne boldu?>> - dep kabar alyp arabdar menen Medinadan chygyp ketuunu kaalashmak. Oo, yimanduular! Alar silerdin aran'arda bolushsa da alardyn az gana bolugu siler menen birge sogushmak. Andyktan alarga maani berbegile, alar uchun kon'ulun'ordu chokturbogulo.

Allakhtyn elchisi aitkan sozdordo, atkargan ishterde siler uchun en' zhakshy ulgulor bar. Al uluu bashy menen ozu kelip sogushka katyshyp atsa, ushundan kiiin kantip andan oz zhanyn'ardy aiap zhatasyn'ar? Akyret kunun kaalap, al uchun araket kylgan zhana Allakhty kopton-kop zikir kylgan adam gana Allakhtyn elchisin ulgu tutat. Al emi akyret kunun kaalabagan zhana Allakhtyn kop zikir kylbagan adam Allakhtyn elchisin ulgu tutpait.

Kachan yimanduular alarga karshy sogushuuga birikken zhoon toptordu korgondo aityshty: <<Bul Allakhtyn zhana Anyn elchisinin bizge kyiynchylyktar, synoolor zhana zhen'ish tuuraluu aitkan ubadasy. Allakh zhana Anyn elchisi bul nersede chyndykty aityptyr. Oshol emi ishke ashyp zhatat>>. Alardyn zhoon toptordu koruusu Allakhka bolgon yimandaryn zhana moiun sunuularyn gana kuchottu.

Yimanduulardyn arasynda ushundai erkekter bar, alar Allakhka chynchyl, antkeni alar Allakh zholunda sogushuuda turuktuuluktu, sabyrduuluktu korsotup Aga bergen ubadalaryn atkaryshty. Alardyn arasynda olgondoru zhe Allakh zholunda olturulgondoru bar. Oshondoi ele alardyn arasynda Allakh zholunda sheiit boluunu kutkondoru da bar. Al yimanduular Allakhka bergen ubadalaryn eki zhuzduulor syiaktuu ozgortushkon zhok.

Allakh chynchyldardy oz chynchyldyktary zhana Aga bergen ubadalaryn atkargandyktary sebeptuu alardy syilash uchun zhana ubadalaryn buzgan eki zhuzduulordu azaptash uchun ushundai kyldy. Eger Al kaalasa alardy kaapyrlyktaryna toobo kylyshkanyna cheiin olturot zhe alarga toobo kyluuga iigilik berip, toobolorun kabyl kylat. Chyndygynda Allakh kunooloruno toobo kylgandarga Kechirimduu, Yraiymduu.

Allakh Kuraishty, Gatafandy zhana alar menen birge bolgondordu okunuchtoru, kaigylary menen artka kaitardy. Antkeni alar umut kylgandai bolboi kaldy, alardyn musulmandardy kyryp zhok kylabyz degen kaalooloru ishke ashpai kaldy. Allakh yimanduular menen birge sogushuuda Ozu zhetishtuu. Antkeni al shamaldy zhiberdi zhana perishtelerdi tushurdu. Allakh Kuchtuu, Kudurettuu, Any ech kim zhen'e albait.

Zhana Allakh alarga zhardam berishken zhoottordu dushmandarynan korgongon chepterinen chygardy. Alardyn zhandaryna korkunuch saldy. Ei, yimanduular! Siler alardyn bir tobun olturdun'or, bir tobun tutkunga aldyn'ar.

Alar zhok kylyngandan kiiin Allakh alardyn egin zhana kurma tigilgen bak-talaalary menen zherlerin silerge eelik kylyp berdi, alardyn ui-zhailaryn zhana bashka mal-mulktorun da silerge berdi. Oshondoi ele silerdi Khaibar zherine eelik kyldyrdy. Aldyn siler bul zherge kelgen emessin'er, emi kelesin'er. Myna ushul yimanduular uchun berilgen ubada zhana suiunuch kabar. Allakh bardyk nersege Kudurettuu, Any ech kim alsyz kyla albait.

Oo, paigambar! Aialdaryn' senin shartyn' bolboi tursa da senden ashykcha karzhy talap kylgan kezde alarga ait: <<Eger siler duino zhashoosun zhana andagy koozduktardy kaalasan'ar, kelgile anda men silerge talak algan aialdarga berilgen nerseni bereiin da, ech kandai zyian berbesten, urushpastan siler menen azhyrashaiyn.

A eger siler Allakhtyn yraazylygyn, Anyn elchisinin yraazylygyn kaalasan'ar zhana akyret zhaiyndagy beiishti kaalasan'ar, anda ushul akybalyn'arga sabyr kylgyla. Chyndygynda Allakh silerdin aran'ardan talaptagydai sabyrduuluk zhana zhakshy mamile kylgandarga uluu syilyktardy daiardap koidu>>.

Ei, paigambardyn aialdary! Silerden kimin'er achyk turdo kunoo ish kylsa, anda aga eelegen ordu, kadyr-barktuulugu zhana paigambardyn tarabyn korgosh maksatta kyiamat kunu eki ese kop azap berilet. Antip eselep beruu Allakh uchun zhen'il.

Silerdin aran'ardan kim Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine daiym moiun sunup, Allakhty yraazy kylgan zhakshylyk ishterdi kylsa, aga bashka aialdarga berilgen soopton eki ese zhogoru kylyp berebiz zhana aga akyrette beiish bolgon uluu syilykty daiardap koiobuz.

Oo, Mukhammad paigambardyn aialdary! Siler artykchylyk zhana kadyr-bark zhaktan bashka aialdardai emessin'er. Teskerisinche siler Allakhtyn buiruktaryna bash iiip, tyigandaryn tashtasan'ar, anda artykchylyk zhana kadyr-bark zhaktan ech bir aial zhete albai turgan darazhada bolosun'ar. Andyktan boton erkekterge sozdu zhumshartyp, undu nazik kylyp suilobogulo. Munun sebebinen zhurogundo eki zhuzduuluk oorusu bar zhana aramdy en'segen adam kyzygyp kaluusu mumkun. Zaryldyk chekte shektenuugo turtpogondoi tamashalabastan oluttuu suilogulo.

Uiun'ordo bolgula! Zaryldyk bolboso syrtka chykpagyla! Islamga cheiinki aialdardardyn kylganyndai suluuluktaryn'ardy korgozbogulo! Alar munu erkekterdi ozuno tartysh uchun achyk korgozup zhurushkon. Namazdy talaptagydai abalda atkargyla! Mal-mulkun'ordon zeket bergile! Allakh zhana Anyn elchisine moiun sungula! Ei, paigambardyn aialdary zhana anyn ui-bulo mucholoru! Chyndygynda Allakh silerden zyiandy zhana zhamandykty ketiruunu gana kaalait zhana oshondoi ele silerdi asyl sypattarga ee kyluu menen zhana ters sypattardan toluk aryltyp, artynan bir dagy yplasty kaltyrbastan silerdin zhan duinon'ordu tazaloonu kaalait.

Uiun'ordo okulgan Allakhtyn elchisine tushkon Anyn aiattaryn zhana Anyn elchisinin taza sunnotun eskerip (kadyryn bilip) ish zhuzundo atkargyla. Chyndygynda Allakh silerge Meerimduu, Al silerdi paigambardyn uilorundo zhashatuu menen chon' zhakshylyk kyldy. Allakh silerden Kabardar, Al silerdi paigambardyn aialdary zhana ummottogu zhalpy musulmandardyn eneleri kylyp tandady.

Chynynda, Allakhka bash iiuu menen ozdorun tomon tutkan erkekter zhana aialdar, Allakhka chyndap ishengen erkekter zhana aialdar, Allakhka moiun sungan erkekter zhana aialdar, yimanynda, sozundo chynchyl erkekter zhana aialdar, ibadatka, kunoogo barboogo, synoolorgo sabyr kylgan erkekter zhana aialdar, mildettuu zhana yktyiarduu turdo oz mal-mulktorunon sadaga bergen erkekter zhana aialdar, Allakh uchun parz zhana napil orozo tutkan erkekter zhana aialdar, ozdoruno adal emes adamdardyn aldynda avratyn korsotpoi zhapkan, zynadan zhana aga chakyra turgan sebepterden zhynys muchosun saktagan erkekter zhana aialdar, Allakhty achyk, zhashyruun abalda zhurogu zhana tili menen estegen erkekter zhana aialdar - Allakh alardyn kunoolorun kechiruugo daiar zhana alarga Kyiamat kunu berilchu chon' syidy - beiishti daiardap koigon.

Egerde Allakh zhana Anyn elchisi kaisy nersege okum kylsa, anda yimanduu erkekke da, yimanduu aialga da any kabyl alboogo,chetke kaguuga ech kandai tandoo berilbeit. Kimde-kim Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine bash iibestik kylsa, anda al tuura zholdon achyk adashty.

Oo, paigambar! Allakh any Islamga kirgizip zhakshylyk kylgan zhana sen any azat kylyp zhakshylyk kylgan adamga (tagyraak aitkanda Zeid ibn Kharisa saga aialy Zainab bint Zhakhshka talak beruu tuuraluu ken'esheiin dep kelgende) sen aga: <<Aialyn'dy ketirbe, aga talak berbe! Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiuularyn tashtap Andan kork>> - dep aittyn'. Oo, paigambar! Birok sen adamdardan korkup, Allakhtyn aga uilonuun' zhonundo saga kylgan vakhiiin zhashyryp koidun'. Zhakynda Allakh Zeiddin aga talak bergenin zhana senin aga uilonorun'du achykka chygarat. Bul ishte korkuun'a Allakh gana tatyktuu go. Kachan Zeiddin aga kon'ulu chappai, zhaktyrbai aga talak bergende Biz silerdi uilondurduk. Musulmandardyn bakma baldary aialdaryna talak berse zhana alardyn idda (kutuu) moonotu butso, anda alarga uilonuu kunoo emes. Allakhtyn buirugu sozsuz ishke ashat, any ech nerse toktoto albait zhana toskool bolo albait.

Paigambardyn oz bakma balasynyn aialyna uilonuusu syiaktuu Allakh uruksat bergen nerselerde al uchun ech kandai kunoo zhe kyzhalattyk bolboit. Al bul nersede ozunon murunku paigambarlardyn zholun zholdoit. Al munu paigambarlardan birinchi bolup kylyp zhatkan zhok. Allakhtyn bul uilonuunu ishke ashyruusunda zhana asyrandy balany oz ata-tegine taandyk kyluunu zhokko chygaruusunda paigambarga oi aituu zhe tandoo berilbeit. Allakhtyn tagdyr kylgan bul okumu sozsuz ishke ashat, al kaitarylbait.

Allakhtyn tushurgon zholdomolorun oz eline zhetkirgen paigambarlar Allakhtan bashka ech kimden korkushpait zhana Allakh alarga uruksat bergen ishterdi ishke ashyruuda bashkalardyn (aiyptoo, karshy chyguu menen) aitkan sozdoruno kon'ul burushpait. Allakh pendelerinin ish-araketterin eseptoogo Ozu zhetishtuu. Alar uchun pendelerinen surak alat zhana zhakshylyk ishterine syilygyn al emi, zhamandyk ishterine zhazasyn beret.

Mukhammad silerdin aran'ardagy ech bir erkektin atasy emes. Zeid aialyna talak bergenden kiiin aga uilonuu aram bolgudai al anyn atasy da emes. Birok al Allakhtyn adamzatka zhibergen elchisi, paigambarlardyn akyrkysy, andan kiiin ech bir paigambar bolboit. Chyndygynda Allakh butkul nerseni Biluuchu. Pendelerinin ishterinin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.
Ei, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Allakhty zhurogun'or, tilin'er zhana dene-mucholorun'or menen kop-kopton zikir kylgyla!
Artykchylykka ee bolgon tasbikh menen kelmeni aityp kundun bashtalyshynda zhana akyrynda Any aruulagyla!

Al silerge yraiym kylat, maktoo aitat zhana Anyn perishteleri silerdi kaapyrlyktyn karan'gylygynan yiman nuruna chygarsyn dep duba kylyshat. Al yimanduularga Yraiymduu. Eger alar Aga moiun sunushsa, alardy azaptabait. Andyktan Anyn buiruguna bash iigile, tyigandaryn tashtagyla.

Yimanduular Rabbisine zholukkan kundogu alardyn uchurashuulary <<Salam!>> sozu bolot zhana bardyk zhamandyktardan salamatta bolushat. Alar Allakhka moiun sunup, Aga bash iibestik kylyshpagany uchun Al alarga uluu syilyk beiishti daiardady.

Oo, paigambar! Biz seni adamdarga saga tushkon nerseni zhetkiruugo kubo boluuchu, alardyn arasyndagy yimanduular uchun Allakh daiardagan beiishti suiunchuloochu zhana kaapyrlarga daiardalgan azaptan korkutuuchu kylyp zhiberdik.
Zhana seni Allakhka gana syiynuuga, Anyn buiruguna bash iiuugo chakyruu uchun zhiberdik. Oshondoi ele seni tuura zholgo tushuunu kaalagan ar bir adam uchun zharkyragan chyrak kylyp zhiberdik.

Zhana Allakhtyn shariiatyn atkaryp Aga yiman keltirgenderge, alar uchun Allakh taraptan bul duinodogu zhen'ishti zhana akyrette beiishke kirgizgen iigilikti ozuno kamtygan uluu artykchylyk boloru tuuraluu suiunchu kabardy zhetkir.

Allakhtyn dininen zhuz buruuga chakyrgan kaapyrlar menen eki zhuzduulorgo moiun sunba zhana alardan bash tart! Balkim bul alardy sen alyp kelgen nersege yiman keltiruugo turtku beret. Butkul ishterin'de, dushmandaryn'dyn ustunon zhen'ishke zhetuudo da Allakhka gana taian! Allakh zhetishtuu Korgoochu, pendeleri duinodogu zhana akyrettegi bardyk ishterinde Aga taianyshat.

O, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Any shariiatyn atkargandar! Egerde yimanduu aialdardy nikege algandan kiiin zhynystyk mamile kylbai turup talagyn bersen'er, anda alar meili aiyz moonotu bolsun, meili ai moonotu bolsun iddaga oturbait. Antkeni, zhynystyk mamile bolbogon uchun alardyn boiunda zhok. Talaktyn aiynan chokkon kon'ulun kotorup, zhoomarttygyn'arga zharasha mal-mulkun'ordon bergile zhana alarga zyian tiigizbesten torkununo koio bergile.

Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda Biz sen makhr (kalyn') tolop algan aialdaryn'dy saga adal kyldyk, Allakh saga olzho kylyp bergen kol astyn'dagy tutkun kun'dordu da adal kyldyk, oshondoi ele seni menen Medinadan Mekkege kochkon atan' menen bir tuugan kishilerdin kyzdaryna uilonuunu, atan'dyn ezhe-karyndashtarynyn kyzdaryna uilonuunu, taiken'din kyzdaryna uilonuunu, taezhelerin'din kyzdaryna uilonuunu saga adal kyldyk. Oshondoi ele makhr (kalyn') surabastan ozun saga sunushtagan yimanduu aialdardy saga adal kyldyk, eger sen alarga uilonuunu kaalagan bolson'. Ozun belek kyluu nikesi paigambarga gana tiesheluu, ummotton andan bashka ech kimge uruksat emes. Biz yimanduularga alardyn aialdaryna tiiishtuu parz kylgan nerselerdi bilebiz, alarga tortton ashyk aial aluuga uruksat zhok. Zhana Biz alardyn kundoruno tiiishtuu shariiat okumdorun da bilebiz, alar ozdorunun kun'dorunon kaalagandai yrakhattanuuga ukuktuu, alardyn sany da chekteluu emes. Zhogoruda aitylgandardy saga da adal kyldyk zhana zhalpy musulmandarga uruksat berilbegen ozgocholuktordu saga gana uruksat bergenibizdin sebebi seni sygylbasyn, kyinalbasyn dedik. Chyndygynda Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerine Kechirimduu, alarga Yraiymduu.

Oo, paigambar! Sen aialdaryn'dan kimisin kaalasan', anykynda tunoboston anyn kunun kechiktire alasyn' zhana alardan kimisin kaalasan', anykynda tunop any menen birge bolo alasyn'. Zhana kunun kechiktirgen aialdaryn'dyn kimisinen birge boluunu talap kylsan', bul nersede saga kunoo bolboit. Saga berilgen bul tandoo zhana kenendik aialdaryn'dyn kozdoru kubanuusuna zhana alardyn baaryna bergen nersen'e yraazy boluusuna zhakynyraak. Antkeni alar seni zhoopkerchilikti tashtabait, akylarga saran'dyk kylbait dep bilishet. Ei, erkekter! Allakh silerdin zhurogun'ordogu aialdaryn'ardyn kee birlerine kon'ulun'or tartyp turganyn bilet. Chyndygynda Allakh pendelerinin ish-araketterin Biluuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Al Toktoo, balkim alar toobo kylat degen umutto alardy zhazaloogo shashylbait.

Oo, paigambar! Saga senin korgoon'dogu aialdaryn'dan bashka aialdarga uilonuugo uruksat zhok zhana alarga talak beruugo zhe bashka aialdardy suluuluguna kyzygyp alardy alysh uchun kee birlerine talak beruugo da uruksat zhok. Birok sanyn chektebesten kol astyn'a kun' aialdardy alsan' bolot. Chyndygynda Allakh bardyk nerseni baikap turat. Bul okum yimanduulardyn enelerinin artykchylyktaryn bildiret. Antkeni alarga talak beruu zhana uilonuu tyiylgan.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Silerdi tamakka chakyryp, kiruugo uruksat berilmeiinche paigambardyn uiuno kirbegile! Tamaktyn byshkanyn kutup kopko oltura berbegile! Birok tamakka chakyrylsan'ar, anda kirgile. Zhep butkondon kiiin shyr tarap ketkile. Andan kiiin biri-birin'er menen suiloshup sozgo alaksyp oltura berbegile. Chyndygynda bul olturganyn'ar paigambardy kyzhalat kylat. Al silerdi ketkile dep aitkandan uialat. Allakh bolso akyikatka buirugandan uialbait. Al silerge paigambarga zyian berbesh uchun olturbastan ketuun'ordu buiruit. Egerde siler paigambardyn aialdarynan idish-aiak syiaktuu zh.b. kerek bolgon nerselerdi surasan'ar, any pardanyn artynan suragyla. Allakhtyn elchisinin urmaty uchun zhana alardy korgoo uchun alar silerdi koro turgandai abalda betme-bet surabagyla! Shaitan silerdin zhana alardyn zhuroktoruno kirip azgyrboosu uchun zhana kunoonu kooz kylbashy uchun ushundai kylyp parda artynan suraganyn'ar silerdin zhurogun'or uchun da, alardyn zhuroktoru uchun da tazaraak. Ei, yimanduular! Siler uchun Allakhtyn elchisin kyzhalat kylyp suiloshup olturganga bolboit, oshondoi ele al duinodon otkondon kiiin anyn aialdaryna uilongongo da bolboit. Alar yimanduulardyn eneleri. Ech kimge oz enesine uilonuugo uruksat emes. Chyndygynda antip kyzhalat kylganyn'ar, oshondoi ele al otkondon kiiin aialdaryna uilongonun'or aram zhana Allakhtyn aldynda chon' kunoo.

Eger siler kee bir ish-araketterin'erdi bildirsen'er da, zhe any ichin'erde zhashyrsan'ar da, alardyn ech biri Allakhka zhashyruun emes. Chyndygynda Allakh butkul nerseni Biluuchu. Silerdin kylgan ishterin'erdin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda Al silerdin ish-araketterin'erdin syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret, zhakshylyk bolso syilygy, zhamandyk bolso zhazasy bolot.

Paigambardyn aialdaryn oz atalary, baldary, aga-inileri, aga-inilerinin baldary, bir tuugan zhana emchektesh ezhe-sin'dilerinin baldary korushso zhe alar menen tosmosuz suiloshso alarga kunoo bolboit. Oshondoi ele alar yimanduu aialdar menen zhana kol astyndagy kun'dor menen tosmosuz suiloshso kunoo bolboit. Ei, yimanduu aialdar! Allakh silerge buirugan zhana tyigan nerselerde Andan korkkula. Al silerdin emne kylganyn'ardy korup turat.

Chyndygynda Allakh perishtelerdin aldynda Mukhammad paigambardy maktait, perishteler bolso aga duba kylyshyp, salam-salavat aityshat. Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Paigambarga salam-salavat aitkyla!

Kachan Allakh paigambardy urmattoonu buirugan kezde aga zyian beruunu tyiyp myndai dedi:
Chyndygynda Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine sozu, ish-araketi menen zyian bergenderdi Allakh duinodo zhana akyrette Oz yraiym cholkomunon kuup alystatty. Zhana alar paigambarga zyian bergendiginin zhazasy katary alarga kordoochu azapty daiardady.
Yimanduu erkekter menen yimanduu aialdarga zyian bergenge tatyktuu kunoosu bolboso da alarga sozu zhe ish-araketi menen zyian bergender zhalgan zhalaaga zhana achyk kunoogo duushar bolushtu.

Oo, paigambar! Aialdaryn'a, kyzdaryn'a zhana yimanduulardyn aialdaryna aitkyn: <<Choochun erkekterdin aldynda avrattary korunbosh uchun ustundo kiiip zhurgon oromoldorun yldyi tushurushsun. Bul alar erkin aialdar eken dep bilinuusuno zhakynyraak. Andyktan kundorgo zyian bergendei alarga ech kim zyian berip tiiishpeit. Chyndygynda Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerine Kechirimduu, alarga Yraiymduu>>.

Egerde ichine kaapyrlykty zhashyryp, syrtynan Islamdy korgozup eki zhuzduuluk kylgan eki zhuzduulor, napsi kaalooruna berilgen zhurogundo buzukuluk bar adamdar zhana musulmandardy bolup-zharysh uchun Medinaga zhalgan kabarlardy tashyp kelgender toktoboso, ei, paigambar, Biz saga alardy zhazaloonu, alarga biilik kyluunu buiruibuz. Kiiin alar Medinada seni menen az gana moonot zhashap kalyshat, antkeni alar kyirap zhok bolushat zhe Zher betinde buzukuluk kylyshkan sebeptuu kuulushat.
Alar Allakhtyn yraiymynan kuulgan abalda kai zherde tush kelse, oshol zherden kolgo tushot zhana aiosuz olturulot. Antkeni alar eki zhuzduuluk kylyshty, Zher betinde buzukuluktu zhaiyshty.
Eki zhuzduulor ozdorunun eki zhuzduuluktorun achykka chygargan kezde bul alarga karata atkarylgan Allakhtyn okum zholu. Allakhtyn okum zholu turuktuu, sen aga ech kandai ozgormo taba albaisyn'.

Oo, paigambar! Mushrikter zhana oshondoi ele zhoottor chetke kaguu menen zhana zhalganga chygaruu uchun senden: <<Anyn ubaktysy kachan?>> - dep kyiamat tuuraluu surashat. Alarga: <<Kyiamat tuuraluu Allakh gana bilet. Men al tuuraluu ech nerse bilbeimin>> - dep aitkyn. Oo, paigambar! Sen kandai bilmek elen', balkim kyiamatka az kalgandyr?
Chyndygynda Allakh kaapyrlardy Oz yraiymynan alystatty zhana kyiamat kunu alardy kutkon zhalyndagan tozoktu daiardady.
Alar uchun daiardalgan oshol tozok azabynda alar tuboluk kalyshat. Alar al zhaida paida keltirgen dos da, alardy azaptan kutkargan koldoochu da taba alyshpait.

Alardyn zhuzdoru tozok otunda ary-beri oodarylyp (azaptalgan) kyiamat kunu alar katuu okunuchton, katuu kuiutton myndai dep aityshat: <<Attin', biz duino zhashoosunda Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Aga moiun sunganybyzda zhana paigambar Rabbisi taraptan alyp kelgen nersede aga moiun sunganybyzda!>>.
Alar arzybagan zhalgan dalildi aityp myndai deshet: <<Rabbibiz! Chyndygynda biz ozubuzdun bashchylarybyzga, elibizdegi uluu adamdarga bash iigenbiz, myna osholor bizdi tuura zholdon adashtyryshty.
Rabbibiz! Bizdi tuura zholdon adashtyrgan al bashchylarga zhana uluularga bizge bergen azaptan eki ese kop azap ber. Antkeni alar bizdi adashtyrdy. Oshondoi ele alardy Oz yraiymyn'dan oto alystat>>.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Paigambaryn'arga zyian berbegile! Bolboso siler Musaga zyian bergenderdei bolup kalasyn'ar, alar anyn denesin aityp aiyptashkan, Allakh any alardyn aitkan sozdorunon aruulagan. Oshondon kiiin al alardyn aitkan sozunon taza ekendigi anyk bolgon. Musa Allakhtyn aldynda barktuu, anyn suranychy kaitarylbait, anyn araketi iigiliksiz kalbait.
Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, Anyn tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkula zhana tuura chyndyk sozdordu suilogulo!

Egerde siler Allakhtan korkson'or zhana tuura soz suiloson'or, Al silerdin ish-araketterin'erdi on'doit, alardy kabyl kylat, kunoolorun'ordu ochurot, alar uchun zhazalabait. Kimde-kim Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine moiun sunsa, anda al ten'deshsiz uluu zhen'ishke zhetiptir. Al zhen'ish Allakhtyn yraazylygy zhana beiishke kiruu.

Chyndygynda Biz shariiat mildetterin asmandarga, Zherge zhana toolorgo sunushtaganybyzda alar any moiunga aluudan bash tartyshty zhana anyn akybetinen korkushtu. Birok any insan moinuna aldy. Chyndygynda al moinuna algan nersenin akybetin bilbegen ozuno zyian beruuchu pende.

Allakh eki zhuzduu erkekter menen eki zhuzduu aialdardy, mushrik erkekter menen mushrik aialdardy eki zhuzduuluktoru zhana shirk kylyshkandyktary sebeptuu alardy azaptash uchun, oshondoi ele moinuna algan amanat mildetterin en' zhakshy den'geelde atkaryshkan yimanduu erkekter menen yimanduu aialdardyn toobolorun kabyl kylysh uchun Allakhtyn tagdyry menen any insan moinuna aldy. Chyndygynda Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerinin kunoolorun Kechiruuchu, alarga Yraiymduu.

Allakhka maktoolor bolsun! Zharatuuda, eelik kyluuda zhana bashkaruuda asmandardagy zhana Zherdegi butkul nerseler Aga gana taandyk. Zhana akyrettegi maktoolor, da Aga gana taandyk. Al Oz zharatuusunda zhana bashkaruusunda Daanyshman, pendelerinin abaldarynan Kabardar. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.

Al suu, osumduktor syiaktuu zherge kirgen zhana osumduktor zhana bashka syiaktuu zherden chykkan nerselerdin baaryn bilet. Oshondoi ele zhamgyr, perishteler, yrysky syiaktuu asmandan tushkon zhana perishteler, pendelerdin ish-araketteri, zhandary syiaktuu asmanga kotorulgon nerselerdi bilet. Al yimanduu pendelerine Yraiymduu, toobo kylgandarga Kechirimduu.

Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandar: <<Bizge ech kachan kyiamat kelbeit>> - deshet. Oo, paigambar! Alarga aitkyn: <<Zhok! Allakhka ant bolsun, siler zhalganga chygargan kyiamat sozsuz kelet. Birok anyn ubaktysyn Allakh gana bilet. Al kyiamatty zhana bashka kaiyp nerselerdin baaryn bilet. Asmandar menen Zherdegi kumurskadan da az salmaktagy nerseler Allakhtyn iliminde belgisiz kalbait. Al aitylgandan da kichine zhana andan chon' bolgon nerseler da belgisiz kalbait, alardyn baarysy aikyn kitepte zhazylgan. Al saktalgan Kitep (Laukhul' Makhfuz), anda kyiamatka cheiin butkul bolo turgan nerseler zhazylgan.

Allakhka yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandarga syilygyn beruu (Kuranda aitylgandai ele saktalgan Kitepte (Laukhul Makhfuzda) da belgilengen). Myna ushul sypattarga ee bolgondor uchun Allakh alardyn kunooloruno kechirimdi daiardap koidu, al uchun alardy zhazalabait. Alarga uluu yrysky bar, al kyiamat kunundogu beiish>>.

Al emi Allakh tushurgon aiattardy zhokko chygaruuga araket kylgandar al tuuraluu <<syikyr>> dep aityshat, paigambarybyzdy <<kozu achyk, syikyrchy zhana akyn>> deshet. Myna ushul sypattardagy adamdarga kyiamat kunu en' zhaman zhana en' kataal azap bar.

Sakhabalardyn aalymdary zhana kitep eelerinen yiman keltirgen aalymdar Allakhtan saga tushkon vakhii ech kandai shek-kumonu zhok akyikat, al ech kim ustomduk kyla albagan Kudurettuunun tuura zholuna bagyttait zhana bul duinodo maktoogo tatyktuu dep kubogo otushot.

Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandar paigambar alyp kelgen nersege tan' kalyp zhana shyldyn'dap biri-birine aityshat: <<Silerge bir kishini korgozolubu, al silerge olup, kukumdoi maidalanyp kalsan'ar da olgonun'ordon kiiin kaira zharalasyn'ar dep aitat?>>.

Alar aityshty: <<Bu kishi Allakhka zhalgan zhalaa zhaap, bizdi olgondon kiiin kaira tirilet dep oilop zhataby zhe al chyndygy zhok nerseni doorugon zhindibi?>>. Bul nerse alar oilogondoi emes. Birok nazhyizhada akyretke yiman keltirbegender kyiamatta katuu azapta bolushat, duinodo akyikattan alystap adashuuda bolushat.

Kaira tiriluunu zhalganga chygargandar Zherdegi bet aldyndagy nerselerdi, asmandagy art zhagyndagy nerselerdi korushpoi zhataby? Egerde Biz alardy buttarynyn astynan zherge zhutkurup zhiberuunu kaalasak, alardy astylarynan zhutkurup zhibermekpiz. A eger alardyn ustuno asmandyn boluktorun kulatuunu kaalasak, alardyn ustuno kulatyp zhibermekpiz. Chyndygynda bul nersede ar daiym Rabbisine moiun sunuuga kaitkan pendesi uchun keskin belgiler bar. Al munu Allakhtyn kudurettuuluguno dalil kylat. Bul nersege kudurettuu Allakh siler olgondon kiiin, denen'er ydyragandan kiiin silerdi kairadan tiriltuugo kudurettuu.

Biz Daudga Ozubuz taraptan paigambarlyk zhana biilik berdik zhana toolorgo aittyk: <<Ei, toolor! Daud menen birge tasbikhti kaitalagyla>>. Oshondoi ele kanattuu kushtarga da ushintip aittyk. Anan al ozu kaalagandai shaimandardy zhasash uchun Biz aga temirdi zhumshartyp berdik.

Oo, Daud! Zhookerlerin'di dushmandyn sokkusunan korgogon kenen soot kiiimderdi zhasagyn zhana myktardy shakekchelerge ylaiyktuu kyl, alardy shalaktai turgandai ichke kylba zhana aga kirbei turgandai zhoon da kylba. Zhana zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgyla! Chyndygynda Men silerdin kylganyn'ardy korup turam. Silerdin ish-araketterin'erdin ech biri Maga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda alar uchun syilygyn zhe zhazasyn berem.

Biz Dauddun balasy Sulaimanga erten' menen bir ailyk zholdu, kechinde bir ailyk zholdu basyp otkon shamaldy moiun sundurduk. Zhana al ozu kaalagan nersesin zhasash uchun aga zhez bulagyn agyzyp koiduk. Oshondoi ele Rabbisinin buirugu menen anyn astynda ishtegen zhinderdi aga moiun sundurduk. Al emi zhinderden kimisi Biz buirugan ishten kachsa, Biz aga zhalyndagan tozoktun azabyn tattyrabyz.

Al zhinder Sulaimanga al kaalagandai namaz uchun mechitterdi, kan sarailardy, al kaalagandai aikelderdi, al kaalagandai suu saktagan chon' idishter syiaktuu tabaktardy, chon'dugunan kyimyldatuu mumkun bolbogondoi bekem ornotulgan tamak zhasagan kazandardy zhasashat. Biz alarga aittyk: <<Oo, Dauddun ui-bulosu! Allakhtyn silerge kylgan zhakshylyktaryna shugur kyluu maksatta ish-araket kylgyla!>>. Birok pendelerime bergen zhakshylykka alardyn azy gana shugur kylyshat.

Kachan Biz Sulaimanga olumdu okum kylganda, anyn taianyp olturgan taiagyn zher kurtu zhedi, oshondo gana zhinder anyn olgonun bilishti. Kachan al zherge kulap tushkondo, zhinder kaiypty bilbestigi anyk boldu. Eger alar any bilishkende Sulaiman uchun oor zhumushtardy atkaryp kordolgon azapta bolushpait ele. Alar any tiruu, korup turat dep oiloshkon.

Kachan Allakh Daudga zhana anyn balasy Sulaimanga bergen zhakshylyktardy aitkanda, Sabaa eline bergen zhakshylygyn da aitty. Daud menen Sulaiman Allakhka shugur kylyshkany, al emi Sabaa eli kaapyrlyk kylyshkany tuuraluu aityp myndai dedi:
Sabaa uruusu zhashagan zherde Allakhtyn kudurettuuluguno zhana alarga bergen zhakshylygyna achyk-aikyn belgi bolgon eki bakcha bar bolchu. Alardyn biri on' tarapta, ekinchisi sol tarapta ele. Biz alarga aittyk: <>.

Alar Allakhka shugur kyluudan zhana Anyn elchilerine yiman keltiruudon bash tartyshty. Oshondo Biz alardyn zhakshylyktaryn baleege ailantyp zhazaladyk, alardyn suu tosmosun katuu sel menen talkaladyk, egin talaalaryn suu astynda kaltyrdyk zhana alardyn momoluu eki bakchalarynyn momolorun achuu kylyp, dagy al ekoosun momosuz zhylgyn daragy zhana az sandagy sidr daraktaryna almashtyrdyk.
Alar zhakshylyktarda bolgondon kiiinki bul abaldyn ozgoruusu alardyn kaapyrlyktary zhana zhakshylyktarga shugur kyluudan bash tartkandyktary sebeptuu boldu.

Zhana Biz Iemendegi Sabaa eli menen Ozubuz berekeluu kylgan Shamdagy shaarlardyn ortosunda biri-birine zhakyn shaar-aiyldardy kyldyk. Oshentip alar bir shaardan ekinchi shaarga kyiynchylyksyz zhol zhurup Shamga zhetishet ele. Zhana Biz alarga aittyk: <<Siler al zherlerden dushmandan, achkalyktan zhana chan'koodon koopsuz abalda tundosu bolobu zhe kunduzu bolobu, kaalagan ubakta oto bergile>>.

Allakhtyn alarga aralyktardy zhakyndatyp kylgan zhakshylygyna shugur kylyshkan zhok. Alar aityshty: <<Oo, Rabbibiz! Sen al shaarlardy zhok kylyp bizdin sapar zholdorubuzdu alystat, biz zhol tuishugun tartaly zhana biz mingen toolordun artykchylygy da bilinsin>>. Alar Allakhtyn zhakshylygyn tanyp, Aga shugur kyluudan bash tartyshty zhana alardan bolgon kedeilerge koro albastyk kylyp ozdoruno zulum kylyshty. Oshentip Biz alardy kiiinkiler kep kylgan sozgo ailandyryp koiduk, alar biri-biri menen bailanysha albai turgandai alardy bytyrandy kylyp char tarapka chachtyk. Chyndygynda Sabaa eline berilgen zhakshylyk, andan son' alardyn kaapyrlyktary zhana tekeberlikteri sebeptuu alarga kelgen balee-azaptarda, Allakhka bash iigen, kunoolordon alys bolgon, kyiynchylyktarga sabyrduu bolgon pendeler uchun zhana Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryna shugur kylgandar uchun ulgu-sabaktar bar.

Chyndygynda Iblis alardy azgyram zhana akyikattan adashtyram degen oiun alardyn ustundo ishke ashyrdy, alar kaapyrlykta zhana adashuuda any eerchip ketishti. Birok yimanduular gana aga eerchibesten, anyn umutun ishke ashyryshpady.

Iblistin alardy mazhburlap adashtyruuga biiligi zhok, al bolgonu (kunoonu) zhakshy korgozup, alardy azgyrat. Birok, Biz alardyn kimisi akyretke, andagy zhaza zhe syiga yiman keltirerin zhana kimisi akyretten shek sanaryn biluu uchun shaitanga azgyruuga uruksat berdik. Oo, paigambar! Rabbin' bardyk nerseni Saktoochu. Al pendelerinin ish-araketterin saktap koiot zhana oshogo zharasha alarga syiyn zhe zhazasyn korsotot.

Oo, paigambar! Mushrikterge aitkyn: <<Siler paida beret zhe zyiandy ketiret dep Allakhtan bashka kudailaryn'ar dep oilogondordu chakyrgylachy?!>>. Alar asmandar menen Zherdegi kypyndai salmaktagy nersege da eelik kyla alyshpait. Alar bul nersede Allakh menen sherikteshtigi zhok. Allakhka zhardam bergen zhardamchy zhok. Al sherikterge zhana zhardamchylarga muktazh emes.

Allakhtyn aldynda Al uruksat bergendin gana shapaaty paida beret. Allakh Oz uluktugu menen Ozu yraazy bolgondorgo gana shapaat kyluuga uruksat beret. Anyn uluktuktarynan, eger Al asmanda suiloso, perishteler Anyn sozuno boi sunup kanattaryn kagyp turushat. Kachan alardyn zhuroktorunon korkunuch ketkende perishteler Zhebreilden: <<Rabbin'er emne aitty?>> - dep surashat. Zhebreil: <<Al akyikatty aitty>> - dep zhoop beret. Al Oz Zaty zhana ustomdugu menen Zhogoru, butkul nerse Anyn aldynda bolgon Uluk.

Oo, paigambar! Mushrikterge: <<Silerge asmandan zhamgyr zhaadyryp, zherden momo-zhemish, eginderdi osturup yrysky bergen kim?>> - dep aitkyn. Anan: <<Silerge asmandan yrysky berip zhatkan - Allakh! Al emi biz zhe siler, ei, mushrikter, akyikat zholdobuz zhe al zholdon anyk adashuudabyz. Biroobuz sozsuz ushundaibyz. Birok, shek-kumon zhok, akyikat zholdogular - alar, yimanduular, al emi adashkandar - alar, mushrikter>>.
Oo, paigambar! Alarga ait: <<Siler kyiamat kunu bizdin kylgan kunoolorubuz uchun suralbaisyn'ar, biz dagy silerdin kylgan ishterin'er uchun suralbaibyz>>.

Alarga ait: <<Allakh kyiamat kunu siler menen bizdi chogultup, anan siler menen bizdin ortobuzda adilettik menen okum kylyp, chynchyldy zhalganchydan aiyrmalap korgozot. Al adilettik menen okum kylgan Okumdar, Ozu kylgan okumun Biluuchu>>.

Oo, paigambar! Alarga ait: <<Allakhka sherik kylyp syiyngan sherikterin'erdi maga korgozgulochu? Zhok! Bul nerse siler Anyn sherigi bar dep elestetkendei emes. Al - Allakh, Any ech kim zhen'e albagan Kudurettuu, Al Oz zharatuusunda, tagdyrynda zhana bashkaruusunda Daanyshman>>.

Oo, paigambar! Biz seni takyba adamdarga suiunchu kabardy zhetkiruuchu zhana kaapyrlardy, buzukulardy tozokton korkutuuchu kylyp zhalpy adamzatka zhiberdik. Birok kopchuluk adamdar munu bilishpeit. Eger alar munu bilishkende, seni zhalganga chygaryshmak emes.
Mushrikter ozdoru korkkon azapty shashtyryshyp myndai dep aityshat: <<Egerde akyikat dep aitkan sozun'ordo chynchyl bolson'or aitkylachy, ubada kylyngan azap kachan bolot?>>.
Oo, paigambar! Azapty shashtyryp zhatkandarga ait: <<Silerge belgiluu bir kun ubada kylyngan, al ubakyt silerge kechigip da kelbeit, ubaktysynan erte da kelbeit. Al kun - kyiamat kun>>.

Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandar aityshty: <<Biz Mukhammad aga tushtu dep oilop zhatkan bul Kuranga ech kachan ishenbeibiz zhana asmandan tushkon murunku kitepterge da ech kachan ishenbeibiz>>. Oo, paigambar! Sen zaalymdardyn kyiamatta Rabbisinin aldynda surak uchun karmalyp turgandaryn, alardyn ar biri zhoopkerchilikti, aiypty bashkanyn moinuna ilip, biri-birine soz kaitaryp turgandaryn korson' kana ele! Bul duinodo alsyzdykta oz bashchylaryna eerchigen alsyzdar alarga aityshat: <<Eger siler bizdi adashtyrbaganda, biz Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirgenderden bolmokpuz>>.

Akyikatka tekeberlik kylyp ozdoruno eerchitkender alardy eerchigen alsyzdarga aityshty: <<Mukhammad silerge alyp kelgen tuura zholdu eerchuudon silerdi biz toskon belek?! Zhok! Siler ozun'or zulum kylgan, buzulgan zhana buzukuluk kylgan adamdar boldun'ar>>.

Al emi alardy eerchigen alsyzdary, chyndykka (muiubai) tekeberlik kylgan bashchylaryna mintip aitat: <<Zhok! Siler kunu-tunu aila-amal kylyp bizdi tuura zholdon tostun'ar, bizdi Allakhka kaapyr boluuga, Andan bashka nerselerge ibadat kyluuga buirudun'ar>>. Kachan alar azapty korgondo zhana azaptaalaryn bilgende bul duinodogu kaapyrlygyna ichterinen okunushtu. Biz kaapyrlardyn moiununa kishen salyp koiduk. Myndai zhazaga alardyn bul duinodo Allakhtan bashkaga syiynyp, kunoogo berilgeni gana sebep.

Paigambardy eli zhalganga chygarganda Allakh anyn kon'ulun zhooshutup, zhalganga chygaruu andan murunku koomdordun adaty ekendigin aga eskertip myndai dep aitty:
Biz kaisy bir shaarga alardy korkutush uchun paigambar zhiberbeili, al zherde zhyrgalchylykta zhashagan mansaptuu, ataktuu zhana bai adamdar: <> - dep aityshty.
Maktanyp boi kotorgon ataktuu adamdar aityshty: <<Bizdin bailygybyz zhana baldarybyz kop. Al emi siler bizdi azaptalat degen oiun'ar zhalgan. Biz duinodo da, akyrette da azaptalbaibyz>>.

Oo, paigambar! Al berilgen zhakshylyktarga azgyrylgandarga ait: <<Menin Rabbim Ozu kaalagan adamga, al shugur kylaby zhe tanyp ketebi dep synash uchun yryskysyn kenen kylat. Oshondoi ele Al Ozu kaalagan adamga, al sabyr kylaby zhe naarazy bolobu dep synash uchun yryskysyn tar kylat>>. A birok adamdardyn kopchulugu Allakh Daanyshman Zat ekendigin bile berishpeit. Al emneni tagdyr kylsa, anda teren' daanyshmandyk bar. Kim any bilse, biliptir, bilbegeni bilbeptir.

Siler maktanyp zhatkan bailygyn'ar zhana baldaryn'ar silerdi Allakhtyn yraazylygyna zhetkirbeit. Birok Allakhka yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandar eselegen syilykka zhetishet. Allakh zholunda sarptalgan bailygy zhana aga duba kylgan bala-chakasy any Aga zhakyndatat. Myna osholor yimanduular, zhakshylyktardy kylgandar, alarga kylgan zhakshylyktary uchun eselegen sooptor bar. Alar azap, olum zhana zhakshylyktyn toktop kaluusu syiaktuu bardyk korkunuchtardan salamatta boluu menen beiishtin biiik zhailarynda bolushat.
Al emi ozdorunun maksattaryn ishke ashyrysh uchun adamdardy Bizdin aiattarybyzdan buruuga bolgon araketterin zhumshagan kaapyrlar bul duinodo kyiroogo uchurashat, akyrette azaptalyshat.

Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Chyndygynda Rabbim Ozu kaalagan pendesine yryskyny kenen kylat, alardan kimisine kaalasa any tar kylat. Siler Allakh zholuna emneni sarptasan'ar, Allakh anyn orduna bul duinodo silerge andan da zhakshysyn beret zhana akyrette koptogon sooptordu beret. Allakh taala en' zhakshy yrysky beruuchu. Kim yrysky izdese, anda Aga kaitsyn>>.
Oo, paigambar! Allakh alardyn baarysyn chogultkan kundu estechi. Anan Al mushrikterdi aiyptap perishtelerden: <<Duino zhashoosunda Allakhtan bashka silerge syiyngandar ushularby?>> - dep aitat.

Perishteler aityshat: <<Sen aruusun' zhana yiyksyn'! Alar emes, Sen bizdin koldoochubuzsun'. Biz menen alardyn ortobuzda ech kandai dostuk mamile zhok. Teskerisinche al mushrikter zhin-shaitardarga syiynyshkan, alarga perishte bolup kubulup korunushkon, oshondo alar Allakhtan syrtkary alarga syiynyshkan, kopchulugu alarga yiman keltirishken>>.

Alar duinodo Allakhtan bashka syiyngan kudaichalary alarga zhyiyn zhana surak kunu paida bere alyshpait zhana zyian da keltire alyshpait. Biz kaapyrlyk zhana kunoolor sebeptuu ozdoruno zulum kylgandarga: <<Duinodo siler zhalganga chygargan tozok azabyn tartkyla>> -dep aitabyz.

Elchibizge tushkon ech kandai budomugu zhok achyk-aikyn aiattarybyz mushrikterge okulganda alar aityshty: <<Munu alyp kelgen bul kishi silerdi ata-baban'ardyn zholunan buruunu kaalagan kishi>>. Dagy alar: <<Bul Kuran Allakhtyn atynan oilop tabylgan zhalgan gana nerse>> - dep aityshty. Zhana Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandar Allakhtyn aldynan kelgen Kuran kuioo menen aialdy, ata menen balany azhyratkany uchun <<Bul syikyr gana!>> dep aityshty.

Oo, paigambar! Biz alarga bul Kuran Mukhammad oilop tapkan zhalgan nerse dep bildirgendei okui turgan kitepterdi bergen emespiz zhana Biz seni zhibergenge cheiin alardy Allakhtyn azabynan korkutkan elchini da zhibergen emespiz.

Aad, Samud zhana Luttun eli syiaktuu murda zhashagan kop koomdor (dindi) zhalganga chygaryshkan. Senin koomun'dagy mushrikter kuch, erk, bailyk zhana san zhagynan koomdordun ondon birine da zhetpeit. Alardyn baary paigambaryn zhalganga chygargan. Alarga berilgen bailygy, kubaty, sany alarga ech kandai paidasyn tiigizgen emes. Oshentip, alar Menin azabyma kabyldy. O, paigambar! Men alardy kandai chetke kakkanymdy zhana alardy kandai zhazalaganymdy karachy!

Oo, paigambar! Al mushrikterge ait: <<Men silerge bir sypatty ken'esh kylam: Allakh uchun napsi kaaloon'ordu tashtap eki-ekiden zhe zhalgyzdan turgula, anan Mukhammaddyn zhindi emestigi silerge achyk bolush uchun anyn omur tarzhymaly tuuraluu, oshondoi ele siler bilgen akylduulugu, chynchyldygy zhana amanatkoilugu tuuraluu oilonup korgulo. Siler Allakhka kylgan shirkke toobo kylbasan'ar al silerge bolgonu katuu azaptan aldyn ala eskertuuchu>>.

Oo, paigambar! Al zhalganchy mushrikterge ait: <<Men silerge alyp kelgen tuura zhol zhana zhakshylyk ozun'ordun paidan'arga, aga aky surabaimyn, andan bolgon soop-syilyktar ozun'orgo gana nasip bolot. Al emi menin soop-syilygymdy Allakh gana beret. Al butkul nersege Kubo. Men silerge zhetkirgenime Al ozu kubo zhana silerdin ish-araketterin'erge da kubo, emi alardyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn Ozu silerge tolugu menen beret>>.

Kachan Allakh Taala zhalganchylar menen mushrikterge dalilderdi achyktaganda bul Anyn tutungan zholu ekenin baiandap myndai dedi:
Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <>.
Oo, paigambar! Al zhalganchy mushrikterge ait: <<Akyikat bolgon Islam keldi zhana zhalgan zhok boldu. Emi zhalgandyn ech kandai taasiri zhe kuchu kalbait zhana al taasirduuluguno kaitpait>>.

Oo, paigambar! Al zhalganchy mushrikterge ait: <<Egerde men silerge zhetkirgen nersede akyikattan adashkan bolsom, anda al adashuumdun zyianyn ozum gana tartam, silerge anyn ech bir nersesi zhetpeit. A eger aga karai tuura zholgo tushsom, anda Rabbimdin maga vakhii kylgan sebebinen boldu. Chyndygynda Al pendelerinin sozdorun Uguuchu, Zhakyn, menin aitkan sozdorumdu uguu Al uchun kyiyn emes>>.

Oo, paigambar! Al zhalganchylar kyiamat kunu azapty korgondo korkushkandaryn korson' kana! Alar uchun andan kachyp kutuluu zhok, andan korgonor zhai da zhok. Alar birinchi zholkusunda ele zhakyn zherden zhen'il ele kolgo tushushot. Eger any korgon bolson', tan' kalyshtuu ishti kormoksun'.

Alar barar zhaiyn korushkondo: <<Biz kyiamat kununo ishendik>> -deshet. Alar surak kylynbastan ish-araket kylyna turgan duino zhaiynan ish-araket kylynbastan surak bere turgan akyret zhaiyna otup, oshondoi ele yiman kabyl kylyna turgan duino zhaiynan alystap ketishken bolso, emi alar kantip yiman keltiruugo, any kabyl kyluuga zhetishmek ele?!

Alar duino zhashoosunda aga kaapyr bolup, akyikatty bilbei turup, alystan ele Mukhammad (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) tuuraluu <<syikyrchy, kozu achyk, akyn>> dep, ar kandai zhalaa zhaap zhatsa, yiman alarga kantip zhetip, kantip kabyl kylynsyn?!

Al zhalganchylar ozdoru kaalagandai duino zhyrgalchylyktaryna, kaapyrlyktan toobo kyluuga, tozokton kutuluuga zhana duino zhashoosuna kaituuga zhetuudon tosulup kalyshty. Alarga okshogon murunku zhalganchy koomdorgo da ushundai kylyngan. Chyndygynda alar paigambarlar alyp kelishken zhalgyz Allakhka syiynuu, kaira tiriluugo ishenuu syiaktuu nerselerge kaapyrlykka alyp bargan katuu shektenuudo bolushkan.

Asmandar menen Zherdi murun bolbogondoi korunushto Zharatuuchu Allakhka maktoolor bolsun! Al perishtelerdin arasynda tagdyr buiruktaryn atkargan elchilerdi kyldy. Alardyn arasynda paigambarlarga vakhiidi zhetkirip, alardy oz amanattaryn atkaruuga kuch-kubat bergenderi bar. Oshondoi ele alardyn arasynda eki, uch, tort kanattuulary bar. Alardyn zhardamy menen buiruktardy atkaruu uchun uchushat. Allakh zharatkandaryna Ozu kaalagandai mucho zhe suluuluk zhe un koshup beret. Chyndygynda Allakh bardyk nersege Kudurettuu. Any ech kim alsyz kyla albait.

Chynynda, bardyk nersenin achkychy Allakhtyn kolunda. Al adamdarga yrysky, tuura zhol, baktyluuluk eshigin achsa, any ech kim toktoto albait. Al emi bul eshikterdin kaisy birin zhaap koiso, any ech kim acha albait. Al ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu, zharatuuda, tagdyr kyluuda zhana bashkaruuda Daanyshman.

O, adamdar! Allakhtyn silerge bergen zhakshylyktaryn zhurok, til zhana dene-muchon'or menen amal kylyp estegile. Silerge asmandan zhamgyr zhaadyryp, zherden momo-zhemish, egin osturup yrysky bergen, Andan bolok ibadatka tatyktuu bolbogon Allakhtan bashka zharatuuchun'ar barby? Ushundan kiiin kantip akyikattan zhuz burup, Allakhka zhalaa zhaap zhatasyn'ar?! Al silerdi zharatyp, yrysky berip zhatsa, siler Anyn sherigi bar dep oilop zhatasyn'ar?!

Oo, paigambar! Egerde elin' seni zhalganga chygaryshsa, sabyr kyl! Sen oz eli zhalganga chygargan birinchi paigambar emessin'. Senden murunku Aad, Samud zhana Luttun eli syiaktuu koomdor da paigambarlaryn zhalganga chygaryshkan. Bardyk ishter zhalgyz Allakhka gana kaitat. Zhalganchylar akyry kyirap zhok bolot, al emi paigambarlar menen yimanduularga zhen'ishti Allakh ozu beret.

Ei, adamdar! Kyiamat kunu kaira tiriluu, syilyk zhe zhaza aluu syiaktuu Allakhtyn silerge bergen ubadasy ech kandai shek-kumonu zhok chyndyk. Andyktan bul kungo zhakshylyk ishterdi kyluu menen daiardanuudan silerdi bul duino zhyrgalchylyktary zhana yrakhattary azgyryp koibosun. Oshondoi ele shaitan silerge zhalgandy kooz korgozup, duinogo beriltip azgyryp koibosun.

Ei, adamdar! Chyndygynda shaitan silerge tuboluk dushman. Andyktan aga karshy kuroshuu menen any dushman tutkula. Chyndygynda shaitan ozuno eerchigenderdi Allakhka kaapyrlyk kyluuga chakyryp, alardyn akybeti kyiamattagy zhalyndagan tozok boluusun kaalait.

Shaitandy eerchip Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandar uchun katuu azap bar. Al emi Allakhka yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandar uchun alardyn kunooloruno kechirim zhana alarga beiish bolgon uluu syilyk bar.

Shaitan anyn kylgan zhaman ishin kooz korgozup, al any zhakshy dep oilogon adam, Allakh aga akyikatty kooz korgozup, al any akyikat dep oilogon adam syiaktuu emes. Chyndygynda Allakh Ozu kaalagandy adashtyrat, Ozu kaalagandy tuura zholgo salat. Any ech kim mazhburlai albait. Oo, paigambar! Adashkandardyn adashkanyna kaigyryp taptakyr ele chogup ketpe! Chyndygynda Allakh Taala alardyn kylgandaryn bilet. Alardyn ish-araketterinin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.

Allakh shamaldy zhiberdi. Al shamaldar bolso buluttardy kyimylga keltirdi. Anan Biz al buluttardy ech kandai osumduk ospogon zherge aidap baryp, anyn suusu menen kurgap kalgan zherdi tiriltip osumduktordu osturduk. Biz bul oluk zherden osumduktordu osturup tiriltkenibiz syiaktuu kyiamatta oluktor da ushintip kaira tirilishet.

Kimde-kim bul duino menen akyrettegi kadyr-barkty kaalasa, anda any Allakhtan gana surasyn. Eki duinodogu kadyr-bark zhalgyz Aga gana taandyk. Zhakshy eskeruulor Anyn Ozuno gana kotorulot. Pendelerdin zhakshylyk ishteri, da Aga gana kotorulot. Al emi paigambardy olturuugo bolgon araketter syiaktuu zhaman aila-amal kylgandar uchun katuu azap bar. Al kaapyrlardyn ailakerligi zhokko chygat zhana buzulat, alardyn ech bir maksaty ishke ashpait.

Allakh silerdin tupku atan'ar Adamdy topuraktan zharatty, kiiin silerdi bel suudan zharatty, anan silerdi biri-birin'erge zhup bolgon erkekter zhana aialdar kyldy. Kaisy aialdyn boiunda bolbosun zhe balasyn torobosun, al Anyn ilimi menen gana bolot. Alardyn ech biri Andan zhashyrylyp kalbait. Al zharatkandardyn kimisinin omuru uzarbasyn zhe kemibesin, al nerse Saktalgan Taktada (Laukhul' Makhfuz) zhazylgan. Chyndygynda silerdin topuraktan zharalyshyn'ar, baskych-baskych bolup zharaluun'ar zhana Saktalgan Taktada omurlorun'ordun zhazyluusu syiaktuu bul aitylgan nerseler Allakh uchun zhen'il.

Eki den'iz birdei emes, alardyn biroosu tuzsuz taza suu, al tuzsuz bolgonu uchun any ichuu zhen'il, al emi ekinchisi oto tuzduu bolgonu uchun any ichuu mumkun emes. Siler bul aitylgan eki den'izdin ar birinen zhumshak ettuu balyktardy zheisin'er zhana alardan bermetterdi, marzhandardy koozdukka tagynysh uchun chygaryp alasyn'ar. Ei, nazar saluuchu! Siler sooda-satyk arkyluu Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryn izdep, den'izdi zharyp aldyga da, artka da suzgon kemelerdi korosun'or. Balkim siler Allakhtyn bergen zhakshylyktaryna shugur kylarsyn'ar.

Allakh tundu kuzduzgo kirgizip any uzartat zhana kunduzdu tungo kirgizip any uzartat. Oshondoi ele Al Kun menen Aidy moiun sundurdu. Alardyn ar biri Allakh bilgen belgiluu bir moonotko cheiin zhurushot. Al kyiamat kun. Myna osholordun baarysyn silerdin Rabbin'er Allakh olchop belgileit zhana zhurguzot. Biilik Aga gana taandyk. Andan bashka siler syiynyp zhatkan kudailar danektin kabygyndai nersege da eelik kylyshpait, anan Menden bashka alarga kantip syiynyp zhatasyn'ar?!

Egerde siler kudailaryn'arga duba kylsan'ar, alar duban'ardy ugushpait. Alar ech nerseni ukpagan zhansyz zattar. Eger alar silerdin duban'ardy ugushat dei turgan bolsok, alar silerge zhoop bere alyshpait. Alar kyiamat kunu silerdin shirkterin'erden zhana syiynganyn'ardan bash tartyshat. Oo, paigambar! Saga Allakhtan bashka ech kim chyndyk kabardy aitpait.

Ei, adamdar! Siler bardyk ishterin'erde, butkul abaldaryn'arda Allakhka muktazhsyn'ar. Al emi Allakh ech bir nersede silerge muktazh emes. Al bul duinodo zhana akyrette pendelerine tagdyr kylgan nersede maktoogo tatyktuu.
Egerde Al silerdi kyiratyp zhok kyluunu kaalasa zhok kylyp koimok zhana silerdin ordun'arga Aga syiyngan, Aga ech nerseni sherik kylbagan bashka zhan'y adamdardy alyp kelip koimok.

Ech bir kunookor bashka kunookordun kunoolorun kotorboit. Ar bir kunookor oz kunoosun gana kotorot. Eger oor kunooloru bar adam alardyn kee birlerin kotorushuugo bashkalardy chakyrsa, anyn kunoolorunon ech biri aga zhuktolboit, eger al chakyrylgan adam anyn zhakyny bolso dagy. Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda sen kaiyptagy Rabbisinen korkkon, namazdy toluk turdo atkaryshkan adamdardy gana Allakhtyn azabynan korkuta alasyn'. Myna osholor gana senin korkutuun'dan paida alyshat. Kimde-kim kunoolordon (alardyn en' chon' shirk kyluu) tazalangan bolso, anda al ozu uchun gana tazalangan bolot. Antkeni munun paidasy anyn ozuno kaitat. Allakh anyn moiun sunuusuna muktazh emes zhana kyiamatta surak beruu, zhaza zhe syilyk aluu uchun kaituu Allakhka gana bolot.
Sokur menen kozu korgon adam birdei bolbogonu syiaktuu kaapyr menen yimanduunun darazhalary da birdei emes.
Karan'gylyktar menen nur birdei bolbogonu syiaktuu kaapyrlyk menen yiman da birdei emes.
Koloko menen ysyk shamal birdei bolbogonu syiaktuu beiish menen tozoktun da taasirleri birdei emes.

Tiruulor menen oluktor birdei emes bolgonu syiaktuu yimanduular menen kaapyrlar da birdei emes. Chyndygynda Allakh Ozu kaalaganga tuura zholdu uguzat. Ei, paigambar! Sen kabyrlardagy oluktor symal kaapyrlarga uguza albaisyn'.
Sen bolgonu alarga Allakhtyn azabyn eskertuuchusun'.

Oo, paigambar! Biz seni Allakh yimanduularga daiardap koigon uluu sooptordu suiunchuloochu zhana kaapyrlarga daiardap koigon kyinoochu azapty eskertuuchu kylyp shek-kumonsuz akyikat menen zhiberdik. Murunku koomdordun kimisi bolbosun, alarga Allakh taraptan Anyn azabynan eskertuuchu elchi kelgen.

Oo, paigambar! Egerde elin' seni zhalganga chygargan bolso, anda sen koomu zhalganga chygargan birinchi paigambar emessin'. Aad, Samud, Luttun eli syiaktuu murunku koomdor da paigambarlaryn zhalganga chygaryshkan. Alarga paigambarlary Allakh taraptan alardyn chynchyldygyn bildirgen achyk-aikyn dalilderdi alyp kelishken, paigambarlary barakchalardy zhana oi zhugurtkondorgo nurduu Kitepti alyp kelishken ele.

Birok alar aga karabastan Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyrlyk kylyshty, Al taraptan alyp kelishken nerselerge ishenishpedi. Oshondo Men kaapyrlyk kylgandardy zhok kyldym. Oo, paigambar! Men alardy zhok kylyp chetke kakkanym kandai bolgonun karachy!
