Oo, paigambar! Korbodun'bu, Allakh asmandan zhamgyrdyn suusun tushurdu. Anan Biz al suunun zhardamy menen daraktardy sugargandan kiiin kyzyl, zhashyl, sary zhana bashka turkun tustogu momo-zhemishterdi chygardyk. Toolordun arasynda ak zholdor, kyzyl zholdor zhana kapkara zholdor bar.

Oshondoi ele adamdar, aibanattar zhana ui zhanybarlary (too, ui, koi) da zhogoruda aitylgandai ar turduu on'-tustordo bolushat. Chyndygynda ilimduulor gana Allakhtyn ordun uluktashat zhana Andan korkushat. Antkeni alar Anyn sypattaryn, shariiatyn zhana kuduretinin belgilerin bilishet. Chyndygynda Allakh ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu, pendelerinen toobo kylgandarynyn kunoolorun Kechiruuchu.

Chyndygynda Biz paigambarybyzga tushurgon Allakhtyn Kitebin okugandar, andagyny ish zhuzundo atkargandar, namazdy toluk turdo okugandar, Biz yrysky kylyp bergen nerselerden achyk zhana zhashyruun turdo zeket zh.b. bergender bul kylgan ish-araketteri uchun Allakhtyn aldynda zyianga uchurabagan soodany umut kylyshat.

Allakh alardyn ish-araketterinin sooptorun toluk berish uchun zhana alarga Oz zhakshylygyn koboitush uchun. Antkeni Al buga tatyktuu. Chyndygynda Allakh myna ushul sypattarga ee adamdardyn kunoolorun Kechiruuchu, alardyn zhakshylyk ishterine Yraazy boluuchu.

Oo, paigambar! Biz saga vakhii kylgan kitep ech kandai shek-kumonu zhok chyndyk. Allakh any murunku kitepterdi tastystap tushurgon. Chyndygynda Allakh pendelerinen Kabardar, alardy Koruuchu. Al bardyk koomdordun paigambarlaryna oz zamanyna zharasha zarylduu nerselerdi vakhii kylyp turgan.

Kiiin Biz bashka ummottordon artyk kylyp tandap algan Mukhammaddyn ummotuno Kurandy berdik. Alardyn arasynda aram ishterdi kylyp, parzdardy tashtap ozuno zulum kylgandary bar, oshondoi ele alardyn arasynda parzdardy atkaryp, aram ishterdi tashtoo menen birge kee bir mustakhabdardy tashtagan zhana kee bir makrukhtardy kylgan ortocholoru bar. Oshondoi ele alardyn arasynda Allakhtyn uruksaty menen zhakshylyktarda zharyshkandar bar. Bul nerse parz zhana mustakhab ishterdi atkaruu, aram zhana makrukh ishterdi tashtoo menen bolot. Bul ummottu tandoo zhana aga Kurandy beruu tuuraluu aitylgan bul nerseler artykchylykta aga ech bir nerse kelbegen uluu zhakshylyk.
Al tandalgandar kire turgan tuboluktuu beiish. Alar al zhaida bermetterdi, altyn bilerikterdi tagynyp zhurushot zhana alardyn kiiimderi zhibekten bolot.

Alar beiishke kirgenden kiiin aityshat: <<Biz tozokko kiruudon korkkonubuz sebeptuu bizden kaigy-kapany zhok kylyp koigon Allakhka maktoolor bolsun! Chyndygynda Rabbibiz pendelerinen toobo kylgandardyn kunoolorun Kechiruuchu, alardyn moiun sungandaryna Yraazy boluuchu.

Al bizdi Oz zhakshylygy menen zhaigashkandan kiiin kochup ketuu bolbogon tuboluktuu beiishke kirgizdi. Bul bizdin kuch-kuduretibiz menen bolgon zhok. Biz bul zhaida charchoogo zhana kyiynchylykka kabylbaibyz.

Kachan Allakh pendelerinin arasynan tandalgandardyn syilygy tuuraluu aitkandan kiiin alardyn arasyndagy en' tomon kaapyrlardy aityp myndai dedi:
Al emi Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandar tozok otunda tuboluk kalyshat. Alar olup kala turganchalyk zhana azaptan es ala turganchalyk olum menen alardyn zhany kyiylbait. Alarga ech bir tozok azaby zhen'ildetilbeit. Biz Rabbisinin zhakshylyktaryn chetke kakkan ar bir adamdy myna ushundai zhaza menen zhazalaibyz.

Alar al zhakta bolgon undoru menen zhardam surap kyikyryshyp: <<Rabbibiz! Bizdi tozokton chygara kor, biz Senin yraazylygyn'dy alyp, azabyn'dan kutulush uchun duinodo kylgan ishteribizden bashkacha zhakshylyk ishterdi kylabyz>> - dep aityshat. Allakh alarga zhoop kylyp aitat: <<Biz silerdi esine keluunu kaalagan adam esine kelip, Allakhka toobo kylyp zhana zhakshylyk ishterdi kylganchalyk omur berip zhashatpadykpy?! Silerge Allakhtyn azabynan eskertuuchu paigambar da kelgen! Silerdin ech kandai dalilin'er zhok, ushunun baarynan kiiin kechirim da zhok. Andyktan tozoktun azabyn tartkyla. Kaapyrlyk zhana kunoo kylyp ozdoruno zulum kylgandar uchun alardy Allakhtyn azabynan kutkargan zhe any alardan zhen'ildetken ech kandai zhardamchy zhok>>.
Chyndygynda Allakh asmandar menen Zherdegi kaiypty Biluuchu. Al anyn ech birin otkorup zhiberbeit. Chyndygynda Al pendeleri kokuroktorundo zhashyrgan zhakshylykty zhana zhamandykty Biluuchu.

Ei, adamdar! Al silerdi ish zhuzundo synash uchun zher betinde biri-birin'erge orun basar kyldy. Kimde-kim Allakhka zhana paigambarlar alyp kelgen nersege kaapyrlyk kylsa, anda anyn kaapyrlygynyn kunoosu ozuno kaitat, anyn kaapyrlygy Rabbisine zyian berbeit. Kaapyrlardyn kaapyrlygy Rabbisinin aldynda ashykcha zhek koruunu koboitkondon koboito beret zhana kaapyrlardyn kaapyrlygy zyianga uchuroonu da koboitot. Eger alar yiman keltirishkende Allakh alar uchun beiishte daiardap koigon nerselerde zyian tartyshmak emes.

Oo, paigambar! Al mushrikterge ait: <<Maga aitkylachy, siler Allakhtan bashka syiyngan kudailaryn'ar Zher betinde emneni zharatty? Toolordu zharattyby? Daryialardy zharattyby? Zhan-zhanybarlardy zharattyby? Zhe alar asmandardy zharatuuda Allakh menen sherikteshpi?>>. Zhe Biz alarga kudailaryna syiynuu tuura degen dalilderdi kamtygan kitep beriptirbizbi? Alardyn ech biri bolgon emes! Teskerisinche kaapyrlyk zhana kunoolordu kylyp ozdoruno zulum kylgandardyn biri-birine kylgan ubadasy aldoo gana.

Chyndygynda Allakh asmandar menen Zherdi zhok bolup ketuudon saktap karmap turat. Egerde al ekoosu zhok bolup ketsin dei turgan bolsok, anda Allakhtan kiiin any zhok bolup ketuudon ech kim karmap kala albait. Chyndygynda Al zhazaloogo shashylbagan Toktoo, pendelerinen toobo kylgandardyn kunoolorun Kechiruuchu.

Al zhalganchy kaapyrlar eger alarga Allakh taraptan Anyn azabyn eskertken paigambar kelse, anda akyikatka tuzdonuudo zhana any karmanuuda zhoottordon da, khristiandardan da ashyp tushobuz dep katuu ant berishken. Al emi kachan Mukhammad alarga Rabbisi taraptan paigambar bolup kelip, alardy Allakhtyn azabynan korkutkanda, anyn kelishi alardy akyikattan alystatyp, zhalgandy karmanuularyn kuchottu. Alar murunkulardan da tuz zholdo bolobuz dep bergen bekem anttaryn atkaryshkan zhok.

Alardyn Allakhtyn aty menen ant berishkeni zhakshy niette zhana tuura maksatta bolgon emes. Teskerisinche Zher betinde tekeberlik kyluu zhana adamdardy aldoo uchun bolgon. Buzuku aila-amal ailakerlerdin ozdorun kurchap alat. Al tekeber ailakerler alarga okshogon murunkulardy zhok kylgandai alardy da zhok kylgan Allakhtyn ozgorbos okum zholun kutup zhatyshaby?! Sen tebekerlerdi zhok kyluuda Allakhtyn okum zholu alarga kelbei turgandai kylyp any ozgortkon zhe alardan bashkalarga burup zhibere turgandai nerseni ech kachan taba albaisyn'. Antkeni Allakhtyn okum zholu ozgorboit.

Kuraishtagy seni zhalganga chygargandar zher betin kezip, alardan murunku zhalganchy koomdordun akybeti kandai bolgonun korushpoibu? Alardyn akybeti zhamandyk menen buttu, antkeni Allakh alardy zhok kyldy. Alar kuraishtan da kuch-kubattuu ele. Allakh asmandar menen Zherdegi ech bir nerseni otkorup zhiberbeit. Chyndygynda Al zhalganchylardyn ish-araketterin Biluuchu, alardyn ish-araketterinin ech birin otkorup zhiberbeit. Al kachan kaalasa alardy kyiratuuga Kudurettuu.

Egerde Allakh adamdardy kylgan kunooloru zhana kylmyshtary uchun zhazasyn tezdete turgan bolso, anda zher betindegi adamdardyn baarysy bailyktary zhana mal-zhandyktary menen kosho oshol zamat kyiroogo uchurashmak. Birok Allakh alardy Oz iliminde moonotu belgilengen kyiamat kununo cheiin kechiktiret. Al emi kyiamat kunu kelgende, albette Allakh pendelerin Koruuchu, alardyn ech bir nersesi Aga zhashyruun emes. Oshondo alarga ish-araketteri uchun syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret, zhakshy bolso zhakshy, zhaman bolso zhaman bolot.
ys Iaa-siin. Ushuga okshogon aiattyn tushundurmosu bakara suroosunun bashynda kelgen.
Aiattary bekemdelgen zhana aldynan da, artynan da zhalgan kele albagan Kuran menen Allakh ant berdi.
Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda sen Allakh pendelerin zhalgyz Ozuno syiynuuga zhana ibadat kyluuga buiruu uchun zhibergen paigambarlardansyn'.
Tuz zholdo zhana tuura shariiatta. Bul tuz zhol zhana tuura shariiat ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu, yimanduu pendelerine Yraiymduu Rabbin' taraptan tushkon.
Tuz zholdo zhana tuura shariiatta. Bul tuz zhol zhana tuura shariiat ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu, yimanduu pendelerine Yraiymduu Rabbin' taraptan tushkon.

Biz any saga arab koomun korkutup, eskertish uchun tushurduk. Alarga eskertuuchu paigambar kelgen emes, alar yimanga zhana Allakhka syiynuuga kon'ul burushpait. Oshondoi ele eskertuu zhetpegen bardyk koomdordun abaly ushundai, alar eskertuuchu paigambarlarga muktazh.

Alardyn kopchuluguno Allakhtyn azaby mildet boldu. Antkeni aga cheiin alarga paigambardyn oz oozu menen Allakhtyn akyikaty zhetken, birok alar Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirishken zhok zhana alarga kelgen akyikatty ish zhuzundo atkaryshkan zhok.

Alardyn bul nersedegi misaly moiundaryna kishen salynyp, zhaaktarynan yldyi moiundary menen kosho koldoru bailangan adamdar syiaktuu. Alar bashtaryn asmanga kotorup turuuga argasyz. Andyktan alar any yldyi kyla alyshpait. Myna osholor Allakhka yiman keltiruudon kishendelgender, alar Aga moiun sunushpait zhana Al uchun bashtaryn da iiishpeit.

Biz alardy aldynan da, artynan da akyikattan tosup koiduk zhana alardyn kozdorun akyikatty koruudon buup koiduk. Andyktan alar any paida ala turgandai koro alyshpait. Bul nerse alar bash iibestik kylyp, kaapyrlyktan bash tartpagandan kiiin boldu.
Oo, Mukhammad! Sen akyikatka karshy chykkan kaapyrlardy korkutasyn'by zhe korkutpaisyn'by, alarga baary bir. Alar sen Allakh taraptan alyp kelgen nersege yiman keltirishpeit.

Chyndygynda senin eskertmen'den bul Kurandy chyndyk degender, andagy kelgenge eerchigender zhana ech kim korboi turgandai zhalgyz kalgan uchurda Rabbisinen korkkon adamdar chyndap paida alyshat. Myna ushundai sypattarga ee bolgondorgo alardy kubandyrgan nerseni kabar ber, Allakh alardyn kunoolorun ochurot zhana kechiret, oshondoi ele akyrette alardy uluu syilyk bolgon beiishke kiruu kutup turat.

Chyndygynda Biz kyiamat kunu surak aluu uchun oluktordu kaira tiriltebiz zhana alar duino zhashoosunda kylgan zhakshylyk zhana zhamandyk ishterin zhazyp koiobuz, oshondoi ele alar olgondon kiiin artynda kaltyryp ketken soobu ulanuuchu sadaka zhe kaapyrlyk syiaktuu zhamandyktaryn da zhazyp koiobuz. Biz butkul nerselerdi anyk Kitepte (Laukhul' Makhfuzda) eseptep zhazyp koigonbuz.
Oo, paigambar! Al bash iibegen kaapyrlarga sabak alchu bir misaldy aityp ber, al bir shaar eline elchilerdin kelgendigi tuuraluu okuia.

Biz bashynda alardy Allakhty zhalgyzdoogo zhana Aga ibadat kyluuga chakyrysh uchun eki elchini zhibergenbiz. Alar al ekoosun zhalganga chygaryshty, anan Biz alarga uchunchu elchini koshup kubattadyk. Oshondo uch elchi shaardyn eline aitty: <<Chyndygynda biz uchoobuz ten' silerdi Allakhka gana syiuunuga zhana Anyn shariiatyn eerchuugo chakyruu uchun paigambar bolup zhiberildik>>.

Shaardyn eli elchilerge aityshty: <<Siler bizge okshogon ele adamsyn'ar, bizden artyk emessin'er. Yraiymduu silerge ech kandai vakhii tushurgon zhok zhana siler bul sozun'or menen Allakhka zhalgan zhalaa zhaap zhatasyn'ar>>.
Al uch elchi shaar elinin zhalganga chygarganyna zhoop kylyp aityshty: <<Oo, shaar eli! Rabbibiz bilet, biz silerge Al taraptan elchi bolup zhiberildik. Ushul nerse biz uchun dalilge zhetishtuu.
Bizdin mildet buirulgan nerseni gana silerge achyk-aikyn zhetkiruu. Al emi silerdi tuura zholgo saluu bizdin kolubuzda emes>>.

Shaar eli elchilerge aityshty: <<Biz silerdi zhamandykka zhorup zhatabyz. Eger bizdi zhalgyz Allakhka syiyngyla dep daavat kylganyn'ardy toktotposon'or, silerdi tash baran' kylyp olturobuz zhana bizden aiosuz azapty korosun'or>>.

Elchiler alarga zhoop kylyp: <<Siler Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyp, Anyn elchilerin eerchudon bash tartkanyn'ar sebeptuu zhorugan zhamandygyn'ar ozun'orgo kaitat. Biz silerge Allakhty eskertsek da zhamandykka zhoruisun'arby?! Siler kaapyrlykta zhana kunoo kyluuda anyk ele chekten chykkan koomsun'ar>>.

Oshondo shaardan alys zherden bir adam eli elchilerdi zhalganga chygaryp koiushpasyn, alardy olturup zhe zyian berip korkutushpasyn dep alar uchun korkup shashyp-bushup kelip myndai dedi: <<Oo, elim! Bul elchiler alyp kelgen nersege eerchigile.

Oo, elim! Kelgen nerseni zhetkirgeni uchun silerden aky surabagan adamdarga eerchigile! Alar Allakh taraptan silerge zhetkirgen nersede tuura zholdu tutungandar. Kim ushundai bolso, anda al eerchituugo tatyktuu.

Al nasaatchy adam aitty: <<Meni zharatkan Allakhka syiynuudan meni emne tosup zhatat?! Silerdi zharatkan Allakhka syiynuudan silerdi emne tosup zhatat?! Siler syilyk zhe zhaza alysh uchun kairadan tirilip Aga gana kaitasyn'ar.

Men akym zhok turup meni zharatkan Allakhtan bashkalardy kudai kylyp alaiynby?! Eger maga Yraiymduu zhamandykty kaalasa, maga al kudailardyn ortomchulugu ech paida berbeit zhana alar maga paida da, zyian da keltire alyshpait. Oshondoi ele men kaapyrlykta olgon bolsom, Allakh maga kaalagan zhamandyktan meni kutkara alyshpait.
Egerde men Allakhtan bashkalardy kudai kylyp alsam, anda men anyk zhan'ylgan bolom. Antkeni men syiynuuga tatyktuunu tashtap, syiynuuga tatyktuu emeske syiyndym.

Oo, elim! Chyndygynda men ozumdun zhana silerdin zhalpy Rabbibizge yiman keltirdim, emi meni ukkula, men silerdin olturom dep korkutkanyn'arga kon'ul da burbaim>>. Oshondo any eli olturup koiushat. Anan Allakh any beiishke kirgizdi.

Al sheiit bolgondon kiiin aga syi korgozulup: <<Beiishke kir!>> - dep aityldy. Al beiishke kirip, andagy zhyrgalchylykty korgondo ozuncho kyialdana: <<Attin', meni zhalganga chygargan, meni olturgon elim kunoolorumdu kechirilgenin zhana Rabbim maga kandai syi-urmat korgozgonun bilishse kana, alar maga okshop yiman keltirip, maga berilgendei syilykka zhetishse kana!>>.

Al sheiit bolgondon kiiin aga syi korgozulup: <<Beiishke kir!>> - dep aityldy. Al beiishke kirip, andagy zhyrgalchylykty korgondo ozuncho kyialdana: <<Attin', meni zhalganga chygargan, meni olturgon elim kunoolorumdu kechirilgenin zhana Rabbim maga kandai syi-urmat korgozgonun bilishse kana, alar maga okshop yiman keltirip, maga berilgendei syilykka zhetishse kana!>>.

Any zhalganga chygargan zhana olturgon eline asmandan perishtelerden bolgon asker tushurup, alardy zhok kyluuga Biz muktazh emespiz. Kaisy bir koomdu zhok kylganda alaraga perishtelerdi tushurgon emespiz, alardy zhok kyluu Bizge oto zhen'il. Biz, alardyn kyiroosu azap perishtelerin tushuruu menen emes, asmandan kelgen katuu kyikyryk arkyluu bolsun dep chechtik.

Anyn elinin okuiasy Biz alarga zhibergen bir kyikyryk gana boldu. Oshondo alar sulaiyp olushtu, alardyn ech biri kalbady. Alardyn misaly zhark etip kuiup, zhalp etip ochkon ottoi boldu, alardyn artynda ech nerse kalbady.

Kyiamat kunu azapty korgondo okunuchko batkan, okutto kalgan kairan gana zhalganchy pendeler! Antkeni duinodo paigambar alarga Allakh taraptan kandai nerseni alyp kelbesin, any sozsuz shyldyn'ga alyp maskaralashkan. Myna oshonduktan kyiamat kunu alardyn akybeti Allakh tarapka kosh kon'ul karagandaryna okunuu boldu.

Paigambarlardy shyldyn'dashkan zhalganchylar sabak alysh uchun alardan murunku koomdordu korushpoibu?! Alar olushtu, emi duinogo ech kachan kaityp kelishpeit. Alar kylgan ish-araketterin kozdoi ketishti. Zhakynda Allakh alarga syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.
Kyiamatta bardyk koomdor kaira tirilgenden kiiin alardyn biri da kalbastan kylgan ish-araketterinin syilygyn zhe zhazasyn alysh uchun Bizdin aldybyzga kelishet.

Kaira tiriluunu zhalganga chygargandarga anyn chyndyk ekendiginin aiat-belgisi - bul kurgap kalgan zher. Biz aga asmandan zhamgyr zhaadyryp, turkun-turduu osumduktordu osturduk zhana adamdar zhesh uchun ar kandai dan azyktaryn chygardyk. Zhamgyr zhaadyryp, osumduktordu chygaryp bul zherdi tiriltken Zat oluktordu da kaira tiriltuugo kudurettuu.
Biz zhamgyr zhaadyrgan bul zherdi kurma zhana zhuzum bakchalaryna ailanttyk zhana alardy sugaruuga bulaktardy chygardyk.

Allakh adamdarga bergen al bakchalardyn momo-zhemishterinen alar zheshsin dep. Bul nerseler alardyn araketi menen bolgon zhok. Emi alar bul zhakshylyktarga shugur kyluu uchun zhalgyz Allakhka ibadattardy kylyshpaiby, Anyn paigambarlaryna yiman keltirishpeibi?!

Turluu-turluu osumduktordu zhana bak-daraktardy osturgon, adamdardyn ozdorunon erkekter menen aialdardy zharatkan zhana oshondoi ele kurgaktyk menen den'izde adamdar bilbegen Allakhtyn bashka makuluktaryn zharatkan Allakh aruu zhana yiyk.

Adamdarga Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygyn bildirgen belgi - Biz kunduz menen kosho zharykty ketirebiz, kunduzdu tundon azhyratyp tundu keltirebiz zhana kunduz butkondon kiiin karan'gylykty alyp kelebiz. Oshondo adamdar karyn'gylykka kirishet.

Dagy alar uchun Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygyn bildirgen belgi - bul Kun. Al Allakh Ozu bilgen chekten ashyp ketpesten, oz ordunda suzup zhurot. Bul Kudurettuunun belgilep koigon tagdyry. Any ech kim zhen'e albait. Al Biluuchu, Aga makuluktardyn ech bir nersesi zhashyruun emes.

Dagy alar uchun Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygyn bildirgen belgi - bul Ai. Biz ar bir tungo anyn oz ordun belgilep koigonbuz. Al kichine bolup bashtalyp, ulam chon'oio beret, kiiin kaira kichireiip bashtait. Al ichkeliginde, iiilchektiginde, sargychtygynda zhana eskiliginde kudum iiilip zhok bolup bara zhatkan kurmanyn shagy symal.

Kun, Ai zhana tun menen kunduzdun belgileri Allakhtyn tagdyry menen belgilengen. Alar belgilengen chekten ashyp ketishpeit. Kun Aidyn zholun ozgortup zhe anyn nurun ketirip, Aga koshulup ketpeit. Oshondoi ele tun dagy kunduzdon ashyp ketpeit, anyn ubaktysy buto elekte ele kirip kelbeit. Planetalar, orbitalar zh.b. syiaktuu Allakhtyn tagdyry zhana korgoosu menen moiun sundurulgan bul makuluktardyn ar birinin zheke ozuno tiiishtuu zholdoru bar.

Oshondoi ele alarga Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygyn zhana pendelerine kylgan zhakshylygynyn belgisi - Biz Nukhtun zamanynda topon suudan aman kalgan Adamdyn kee bir urpaktaryn Allakhtyn makuluktary menen tolgon kemege tushurduk. Allakh aga ar bir turkumdon birden zhuptu tushurdu.
Dagy alarga Anyn zhalgyzdygyn zhana pendelerine kylgan zhakshylygynyn belgisi - Biz alar uchun Nukhtun kemesi syiaktuu unaalardy zharattyk.

Egerde Biz alardy chokturuunu kaalasak, chokturup zhibermekpiz. Eger Biz alardyn chogushun kaalaganda, alarga ech kim zhardam bere almak emes. Eger alar Bizdin buirugubuz zhana chechimibiz menen chogushkondo, alardy ech kim kutkara almak emes.

Birok Biz alardy choguudon kutkaryp zhana alar otup kete albagandai belgiluu bir moonotko cheiin zhashoodon paidalanuulary uchun alardy kaira kaitarsak, balkim oshondo alar sabak alyshyp yiman keltiret chygar.

Egerde yimandan zhuz burgan mushrikterge: <<Allakhtyn silerge kylgan yraiymyn umut kyluu menen aldyn'ardagy akyretten zhana anyn azaptarynan saktangyla zhana artta kaluuchu duinodon saktagyla!>> - dep aitylsa, alar bash iiishpeit.
Kachan al bash iibestik kylgan mushrikterge Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygyna zhana Al Ozu gana syiynuuna tatyktuu ekendigine dalil bolgon aiat-belgiler kelse, alar andan sabak albastan turup zhuz burushat.

Eger al bash iibesterge: <<Allakh silerge yrysky kylgan mal-mulkton kedei-kembagaldarga da zhardam bergile!>> - dep aitylsa, yimanduulardy betten alyp myndai deshet: <<Allakh Ozu tamaktandyruunu kaalagan adamdardy biz tamaktandyrmak belek?! Biz anyn kaaloosuna karshy chykpaibyz. Ei, momundar! Siler akyikattan alystap, anyk ele adashyp zhatasyn'ar>>.

Kaira tiriluunu zhalganga chygaryp, any mumkun emes dep chetke kakkan kaapyrlar aityshat: <<Ei, momundar! Siler kaira tiriluu anyk bolot degen sozun'ordo chynchyl bolson'or aitkylachy, al kachan bolot eken?>>.

Kaira tiriluunu mumkun emes dep zhalganga chygargandar surnaidyn birinchi tartylyshyn gana kutup zhatyshat. Bul katuu kyikyryk alar sooda-satyk, sugatchylyk, charbachylyk zh.b. bashka duino ishteri menen alek bolup zhatyshkanda kapystan kelet.

Bul kyikyryk alarga kutuusuz kelgende alar biri-birine osuiat kylganga da zhetishpei kalat, oz uiloruno zhana ui-buloloruno da kaityp bara alyshpai kalat. Alar oshol ishtep zhatkan zherlerinde zhan berishet.
Kaira tiriluugo ekinchi zholu surnai tartylganda, alardyn baarysy surak berish uchun, syilyk zhe zhaza alysh uchun Rabbisine karai shashylyp kabyrlarynan chygyshat.

Kaira tiriluunu zhalganga chygargan kaapyrlar okungon abalda: <<Shorubuz kurgur ai! Bizdi kim kabyrdan tiriltip chygardy?>> - degende, alarga zhoop berilet: <<Bul Allakhtyn bergen ubadasy. Chyndygynda al sozsuz ishke ashat. Paigambarlar da Rabbisi taraptan zhetkirgen bul nersede chyndykty aityshkan>>.
Kabyrlardan kaira tirilip chyguu kerneidi bir zholu uilogondo ele bolot. Oshondo kyiamat kunu surak berish uchun bardyk makuluktar Bizdin aldybyzga kelishet.

Al kundo adilettik menen okum kylynat. Ei, pendeler! Oshondo silerge kunoolorun'or koboitulup zhe sooptorun'ardan kemitilip zulumduk kylynbait. Chyndygynda siler duino zhashoosunda kylgan ishterin'erdin syilygyn zhe zhazasyn toluk turdo alasyn'ar.
Kyiamat kunu beiish eeleri tuboluk zhyrgalchylykty zhana uluu zhen'ishti korushkondo bashkalardy oilonboi kalyshat. Alar kubanychta oshonu gana oilonup kalyshat.
Alar zhana alardyn zhubailary beiish kolokolorundo sorulordun ustundo zhyrgalchylykta bolushat.
Al beiishte alar uchun zhuzum, anzhir, anar syiaktuu momo-zhemishter bolot. Oshondoi ele alar yrakhattyn zhana zhyrgalchylyktyn kandai turun surashpasyn, al nerseler alarga berilet.

Alar uchun bul zhakshylyktardan da otkon zhakshylyk - alarga Yraiymduu Rabbisi taraptan aitylgan salam bolot. Egerde Al alarga salam aitsa, alar but taraptan salamatta bolushat zhana en' zhogorku den'geeldegi salamdashuuga zhetken bolushat.

Kyiamat kunu mushrikterge aitylat: <<Yimanduulardan bolungulo! Alar siler menen boluuga ylaiyktuu emes. Antkeni silerdin zhazan'ar menen alardy syilygy, silerdin sypattaryn'ar menen alardyn sypattary ar bashka>>.

Men silerge paigambarlarymdyn tili menen osuiat kylyp zhana buirup myndai dep aitkan elem go: <<Ei, adam balasy! Kaapyrlyktyn zhana kunoolordun tur-turun kylyp shaitanga bash iibegile! Chyndygynda shaitan silerge anyk dushman. Akyly bar adam aga dushmandygyn achyk ele korgozgon dushmanyna kantip ele bash iisin?!

Ei, adam balasy! Silerdi Maga gana ibadat kylgyla zhana Maga ech nerseni sherik kylbagyla dep buirudum! Zhalgyz Maga ibadat kyluu zhana bash iiuu - Menin yraazylygyma zhana beiishke alyp bargan tuura zhol. Birok, siler Menin osuiatymdy zhana buirugumdu atkarbadyn'ar.

Shaitan silerden koptogon adamdardy adashtyrdy. Silerdi Rabbin'erge bash iiuugo, zhalgyz Aga syiynuuga buirugandai zhana silerge achyk ele dushmandyk kylgan shaitanga moiun sunuudan eskertkendei da akylyn'ar zhokpu?!
Myna bul kaapyrlygyn'ar uchun duinodo ubada kylyngan tozok. Al silerge korungon emes. Bugun bolso any oz kozun'or menen korup turasyn'ar.
Bugun al zhakka kirgile! Duino zhashoosunda Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylganyn'ar sebeptuu anyn zhalynduu ysygyn tatkyla!>>.

Bugun Biz alardyn oozdoruna moor basabyz, alar kaapyrlyktaryn zhana kunoolorun chetke kagyp suiloi albai duduk bolup kalyshat. Bizge alardyn kylgan ishterin koldoru aityp berishet zhana alar basyp baryp kylgan kunooloruno buttary kubo bolushat.

Eger Biz alardyn kozdorun sokur kylyp koiuunu kaalasak, alardy kor kylyp koimokpuz, anan alar koro albai kalyshmak. Kiiin alar Syrattan beiishke otush uchun zharyshyshat. Alardyn kozu korboso, alar andan kantip otushmok ele?!

Egerde Biz alardyn dene tuzulushun ozgortuunu zhana alardy buttaryna oturguzup koiuunu kaalasak, anda Biz alardyn dene tuzulushun ozgortmokpuz zhana alardy buttaryna oturguzup koimokpuz. Anan alar ordunan zhyla albai kalyshat zhana aldyga da, artka da kete albai kalyshat.
Biz zhashoodo adamdardyn kimisinin omurun uzun kylsak, any alsyz kurakka kaitarabyz. Alar akyl zhugurtushpoibu zhana tuboluk kala turgan zhai bul duino emes, akyret ekenin an'dap tushunushpoibu?!

Biz Mukhammadga yr uirotkon zhokpuz. Bul aga ylaiyk kelbeit. Antkeni al anyn tabiiatynda zhok zhana silerdin any akyn degen sozun'or tuura bolgudai tabiiaty any talap da kylbait. Biz aga uirotkon nerse oilongon adam uchun achyk-aikyn eskertme zhana Kuran.

Myndan paida algan zhurogu tiruu, akyly tunuk adamdarga eskertuu uchun zhana kaapyrlarga azapty tushurush uchun. Antkeni alarga anyn kelishi zhana daavattyn zhetishi menen dalil koiuldu. Emi alar ech kandai shyltoo aita alyshpait.
Alar korushpoibu, Biz alar uchun ui zhanybarlaryn zharatyp, alar al ui zhanybarlaryna eelik kylyshat, alardy oz kyzykchylyktaryna zharasha paidalanyshat.
Zhana Biz alardy moiun sundurup, alarga bash iie turgan kyldyk. Alardyn kee birlerin minishet, alarga zhuktorun artyshat zhana kee birlerinin etterin zheshet.

Zhana alardy mingenden zhana etterin zhegenden bashka dagy paidalary bar, misaly, zhundoru, tybyttary, kyldary zhana mailary. Alardan toshoktordu zhana kiiimderdi tigishet. Oshondoi ele alardyn suttorun suusunduk katary ichishet. Emi alar Allakhtyn alarga bergen ushundai zhakshylyktary uchun Aga shugur kylyshpaiby?
Mushrikter Allakhtan bashkalarga syiynyp, alardy Anyn azabynan kutkaruuga zhardam beret degen umutto kudai tutup alyshty.

Alardyn kudailary ozdoruno da, Allakhty tashtap alarga syiyngandarga da zhardam bere alyshpait. Alar zhana alardyn aikelderinin baarysy azapka alynyp kelinet, alardyn ar biri biri-birinen bash tartyshat.

Oo, paigambar! Alardyn <<sen paigambar emessin'>> zhe <<sen akynsyn'>> degen syiaktuu sozdoru zhana bashka zhalgan zhalaalary seni kapalantpasyn. Chyndygynda Biz alardyn bul tuuraluu zhashyrgandaryn da, achyk aitkandaryn da bilebiz. Bizge alardyn ech biri zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda Biz alarga anyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn berebiz.

Olumdon kiiin kaira tiriluunu chetke kakkan insan oilonboibu, Biz any bel suudan zharattyk, kiiin al torolgongo cheiin bir neche baskychtardan ottu zhana tarbiialandy. Kiiin al kop talashyp tartyshkanga ottu. Al munu kaira tiriluu mumkun ekendigine dalil katary korboibu?!
Bul kaapyr unuttu zhana naadandyk kyldy, chirigen sooktu kaira tiriluunun mumkun emes ekendigine dalil kylyp: <<Munu kim kaira tirilte alat?>> - dedi. Al ozunun zhokton zharalganyn korgon emes.

Oo, Mukhammad! Aga zhoop ber: <<Bul chirigen sooktordu any bashtapky zholu zharatkan Allakh tiriltet. Any bashtapky zholu zharatkan Zat any kairadan tiriltuugo kudurettuu. Al bardyk zharatylgandardy Biluuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes>>.

Oo, adamdar! Al silerge kok zhana suu daraktan ottu paida kylyp, siler andan ot tutandyryp zhatasyn'ar. Kok zhana suu darak menen zhalyndagan ot syiaktuu eki karama-karshylykty biriktirgen Zat oluktordu tiriltuugo kudurettuu.

Asmandar menen Zherdi zhana alardyn ortosundagy ebegeisiz chon' nerselerdi zharatkan Zat oluktordu kaira tiriltuugo kudurettuu emespi?! Albette, Al aga kudurettuu! Al butkul makuluktardy zharatkan Zharatuuchu, alardy Biluuchu.

Chyndygynda Allakhtyn ishi, eger Al bir nerseni zharatuunu kaalasa, anda <<bol!>> dep gana aitat, Anyn kaalagan nersesi oshol zamat ishke ashat. Bul nersege Anyn zhan saluuga, olturuugo zhana kaira tiriltuugo zh.b. kaalooloru da kiret.

Allakh mushrikterdin Aga alsyzdykty tan'uulap zhatkandarynan aruu zhana yiyk. Butkul nerselerdin biiligi Aga gana taandyk. Al alardy Ozu kaalagandai bashkarat. Bardyk nerselerdin achkysy Anyn gana kolunda. Siler akyrette zhalgyz Aga gana kaityp barasyn'ar. Oshondo Al silerge ish-araketterin'erdin syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.
Al ibadattarynda sap-sap bolup tizilip turgan perishteler menen ant berdi.
Al buluttardy aidagan zhana Allakh anyn tushuusun kaalagan zherge cheiin alyp bargan perishteler menen ant berdi.
Allakhtyn sozun okugan perishteler menen ant berdi.
Oo, adamdar! Chyndygynda silerdin chynygy kudaiyn'ar Zhalgyz, Anyn sherigi zhok, Al - Allakh.
Al asmandardyn Rabbisi, Zherdin Rabbisi zhana alardyn ortosundagylardyn Rabbisi. Oshondoi ele Al zhyl boiu chykkan zhana batkan Kundun Rabbisi.
Chyndygynda Biz Zherge zhakyn asmandy kooz zyinat bolgon zhyzdyzdar menen koozdop koiduk. Alardy bir karaganda zharkyragan asyl tashtardai korunot.
Zhana Biz duino asmanyn bash iibes bardyk shaitandarga atylgan zhyldyzdar menen saktap koiduk.
Al shaitandar asmandagy perishtelerge Rabbisi taraptan vakhii kylyngan shariiaty zhana tagdyry tuuraluu sozdorun uga alyshpait. Alarga but taraptan kyzygan chok zhyldyzdar atylat.
Alardy uguudan kuup alystatysh uchun! Alar uchun akyrette tuboluk kyinoochu azap bar.

Birok shaitandardan kimisi perishtelerdin ortosunda bolgon zher betindegi adamdarga ilimi zhete elek nerse tuuraluu bir ele sozdu kulak chalyp kalsa, anda any zhalyndagan chok zhyldyz kuup zhetip kuiguzup salat. Balkim al ukkan sozun any chok zhyldyz kuiguzup zhibergenge cheiin zhan-zhookorloruno aitkanga ulgurup, al soz kozu achyktarga zhetishi mumkun. Anan alar aga koshup zhuz zhalgandy kosho aityshat.

Oo, Mukhammad! Kaira tiriluunu chetke kakkan mushrikterden surachy: <<Alar zharalysh zhaktan Biz zharatkan asmandardan, Zherden zhana perishtelerden da oorbu, tuzulushu zhaktan kuchtuubu, mucholuu zhaktan chon'bu?>>. Chyndygynda Biz alardy zhabyshchaak ylaidan zharattyk. Alar kaira tiriluunu kantip zhokko chygaryp zhatyshat, alar zhabyshchaak ylai bolgon alsyz nerseden zharalyshty go?

Oo, Mukhammad! Sen Allakhtyn kuduretine, zharatkandarynyn ishterin bashkaruusuna tan' kalasyn' zhana kaira tiriluunu zhalganga chygargan mushrikterge da tan' kalasyn'. Al mushrikter kaira tiriluunu ashykcha zhalganga chygargandary sebeptuu al tuuraluu senin aitkan sozdorun'du mazaktap kulushot.
Egerde al mushrikterge kandaidyr bir nasaat aitylsa, alar andan paida alyshpait. Antkeni alardyn zhuroktoru merez bolup kalgan.
Egerde alarga paigambardyn chynchyl ekendigine dalil bolgon anyn aiat-belgilerinen bir aiat-belgini korushso, any aiabai shyldyn'dashat zhana aga tan' kalyshat.
Alar: <<Mukhammad alyp kelgen bul nerse anyk ele syikyr>> - deshet.
Biz olup topurakka zhana chirip ubolongon sookko ailangandan kiiin kairadan tirilebizbi? Myndai boluusu mumkun emes (dep oiloshot).
Bizden murunku otkon ata-babalarybyz da kaira tirilishebi?

Oo, Mukhammad! Alarga zhoop ber: <<Ooba. Siler topurakka zhana chirigen sooktorgo ailandan kiiin kaira tirilesin'er zhana silerdin murunku ata-babalaryn'ar da tirilishet. Baaryn'ar kor bolgon abalda tirilesin'er>>.
Surnai (ekinchi zholu) bir tartylganda baarysy Allakh alarga emne kylaryn kutushup kyiamattyn korkunuchtaryn karap kalyshat.
Kaira tiriluunu zhalganga chygargan mushrikter aityshty: <<Shorubuz kurgur ai! Bul kun Allakh pendeleri duino zhashoosunda kylgan ish-araketterinin syilygyn zhe zhazasyn bere turgan surak kun go!>>.
Oshondo alarga aitylat: <<Bul kun pendelerdin ortosunda okum kylyna turgan kun. Siler any duinodo chetke kakkansyn'ar zhana any zhalganga chygargansyn'ar>>.

Oshol kunu perishtelerge aitylat: <<Shirk kylgan zaalym mushrikterdi, alarga okshop shirk kylgandardy, alardy zhalganda koldogondordu zhana oshondoi ele alar Allakhtan bashka syiynyshkan aikelderin chogultkula da, alarga tozokko karai zholdu korgozgulo zhana al zhakka aidap bargyla. Chyndygynda al alardyn bara turgan zhaiy.

Oshol kunu perishtelerge aitylat: <<Shirk kylgan zaalym mushrikterdi, alarga okshop shirk kylgandardy, alardy zhalganda koldogondordu zhana oshondoi ele alar Allakhtan bashka syiynyshkan aikelderin chogultkula da, alarga tozokko karai zholdu korgozgulo zhana al zhakka aidap bargyla. Chyndygynda al alardyn bara turgan zhaiy.
Alardy tozokko kirgizerden aldyn surak beruu uchun karmap turgula. Alar surak berishet. Anan oshondon kiiin gana alardy tozokko alyp bargyla>>.
Alarga zheme iretinde aitylat: <<Silerge emne boldu, duinodo biri-birin'erdi koldogondoi koldoboi zhatasyn'ar, kudailaryn'ar silerdi koldoit dep oilochun'ar ele go?>>.
Zhok! Alar bugun kordolup Allakhtyn buiruguna bash iiishet. Alar alsyzdyktary zhana aila-amaldary tugongondugu sebeptuu biri-birin koldoi alyshpait.
Alar biri-birin zhemeleship, talashyp-tartyshat. Al kezde zheme da, talashuu da paida berbeit.

Eerchigender bashchylaryna aityshat: <<Ei, bizdin bashchylar! Siler din zhana akyikat taraptan kelip, bizge kaapyrlykty, shirkti zhana kunoolordu kooz kylyp korgozgonsun'or zhana Allakh taraptan paigambarlar alyp kelgen akyikattan bizdi alystatkansyn'ar>>.
Bashchylar eerchigenderge aityshat: <<Bul ish siler oilogondoi emes. Siler ozun'or kaapyr bolgonsun'ar, yimanduu bolgon emessin'er. Ozun'or chetke kakkansyn'ar>>.

Ei, eerchigender! Biz silerdi mazhburlap zhe ustomduk kylyp kaapyrlykka, shirkke zhana kunoogo turto turgandai bizge biilik berilgen emes. Siler ozun'or kaapyrlykta zhana shirkte chekten ashkan koom boldun'ar.

Emi bizge da, silerge da Allakhtyn (la'amla'anWa jahanWama minka wamimWan tabi`aka minhum 'ajma`iyna) <<Men tozoktu seni zhana seni eerchigenderdin baarysy menen tolturam (85-bet)>> degen ubadasy anyk boldu. Andyktan biz Rabbibiz ubada kylgan nerseni sozsuz tartabyz.
Biz silerdi adashuuga zhana kaapyrlykka undoduk. Chyndygynda biz akyikat zholdon adashkandar elek.
Chyndygynda eerchigender da, eerchitkender da kyiamat kunu birgelikte azapta bolushat.
Chyndygynda Biz alarga azapty tarttyrganybyz syiaktuu alardan bashka kunoolordu da oshondoi kylabyz.

Egerde al mushrikterge duinodo: <<Allakhtan bashka kudai zhok>> dep anyn talabyna ylaiyk ish-araket kylgyla zhana aga karshy kelgendi tashtagyla>> - dep aitylsa, alar akyikatka tekeberlik kylyp, boi kotorup aga zhoop beruudon zhana moiun sunuudan bash tartyshty.
Alar kaapyrlyktaryna dalil kylyp: <<Biz kaidagy bir zhindi akyndyn sozu uchun ele kudailarybyzga syiyngandy tashtamak belek?>> - deshti. Alar bul bul aitkan sozu menen paigambardy maksat kylyshty.

Alardyn zhalaasy asha chaap ketti. Allakhtyn elchisi zhindi da, akyn da emes. Al Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygynyna zhana Anyn elchisin eerchuugo chakyrgan Kurandy alyp keldi zhana oshondoi ele paigambarlardyn Allakh taraptan alyp kelishken Allakhty zhalgyzdoo zhana akyret anyk ekendigi tuuraluu nerselerde chynchyl ekendikterin tastyktady zhana alarga karshy chykkan zhok.
Ei, mushrikter! Siler kaapyrlygyn'ar zhana paigambarlardy zhalganga chygarganyn'ar sebeptuu kyiamat kunu kyinoochu azapty tatasyn'ar.
Ei, mushrikter! Siler duinodo Allakhka kaapyrlyk zhana kunoolordu kylganyn'arga zharasha zhazan'ardy alasyn'ar.
Birok Allakh alardy syiynuuda yklastuu kylgan zhana alar dagy Aga yklastuuluk menen syiynyshkan Anyn yimanduu pendeleri - myna osholor azaptan kutuluuchular.
Oshol yklastuu pendelerge oz zhakshylygy, koozdugu zhana tuboluktuulu menen maalym bolgon Allakhtyn yryskysy bar.
Alar kaalagan zhana zhegen daamduu momo-zhemishter alarga yrysky. Buga koshumcha alar darazhasy kotoruluu zhana Uluu Allakhtyn Zhuzun koruu menen da syilanat.
Alar ushulardyn baarysyna ech kachan butpogon turuktuu, tuboluktuu zhana zhyrgal beiishterde zhetishet.
Alar sorulorgo suionushup bet man'dai biri-birin karap olturushat.
Alarga akkan suudai taza bolgon sharap kuiulgan keseler ailantylat.
On'u appak, any ichken adam bolup korbogondoi yrakhat alat.
Al adamdyn akylyn ketirip mas kylgan duinodogu sharaptai emes. Any ichken adamdyn bashy oorubait, denesine zhana akylyna zakalasy tiibeit.
Zhana beiishte alardyn bakyran' kozduu, abiiirduu aialdary bolot, alar kuioosunon bashka ech kimge koz salbait.
Alardyn tusunun apapakailygy ech bir kol tiibei saktalgan chymchyk zhumurtkasynyn sarysy menen bolgon aralashma symal.
Beiishtegiler biri-birinen duinodogu otkon chagy zhana kandai okuialar bolgondugu tuuraluu surashat.
Al yimanduulardan biroosu aitat: <<Menin bir taanyshym bar ele, al kaira tiriluunu zhokko chygarchu.
Al meni zhaktyrbagandai shyldyn'dap myndai dedi: <<Ei, chynchyl! Sen oluktordun kaira tirilerin chyndyk dep tastyktagandardyn birisin'bi?
Biz olup, topurakka zhana chirigen sooktorgo ailangandan kiiin kaira tirilip, duinodo kylgan ishteribizdin zhazasyn zhe syilygyn alabyzby?
Anyn yimanduu zholdoshu beiishtik bolgon dostoruna aitty: <<Zhurgulo meni menen, kaira tiriluunu zhokko chygargan zhanagyl dosubuzdu korup kelelibi?>>.
Al koz chaptyryp karady. Oshondo dosun tozoktun ortosunan kordu.
Al aitty: <<Allakhka ant bolsun! Ei, dosum! Sen meni kaapyrlykka zhana kaira tiriluunu zhokko chygaruuga chakyryp, az zherden meni da kyiroogo uchuratyp koe zhazdaptyrsyn'!
Eger Allakh meni yiman zholuna salyp, iigilik berip maga zhakshylyk kylbaganda, meni dagy saga okshop azapka tushkondordon bolmok ekem>>.

Kachan al tozokko tushkon dosu menen sozun buturgondo, beiishtegi dostoruna kairylyp myndai dedi:
Biz, beiish adamdary, olboit ekenbiz.
Duino zhashoosundagy birinchi olumubuz menen gana olduk. Biz beiishte tuboluk kalabyz. Kaapyrlarga okshop azaptalbaibyz>>.
Chyndygynda Rabbibiz bizdi beiishke kirgizip zhana tozokton saktap, ushundai soop-syilyktardy bergeni - ech bir zhen'ish ten' kelbegen uluu zhen'ish.
Ish-araket kylgandar ushundai uluu syilyk uchun araket kylyshsyn. Chyndygynda bul kiresheluu sooda.

Allakh Ozunun chyn yklastan moiun sungan pendelerine daiardap koidum degen bul zhakshylyk artykpy zhe Kurandagy kargyshka kalgan Zakkum daragy zhakshyby? Al adamdy semirtpegen zhana kursagyn da toiguzbagan kaapyrlardyn tamagy.
Chyndygynda Biz al darakty kaapyrlyk zhana kunoolordu kylgan zaalymdardy azgyrgan synoo kyldyk. Al aitty: <<Chynynda ot darakty zhalmait. Al zhakta darak osushu mumkun emes>>.
Chyndygynda Zakkum daragy - en' zhaman zherden onup chykkan darak. Al tozoktun tubunon osup chygat.

Andan onup chykkan momolor - shaitandardyn bashtaryna okshogon zhiiirkenichtuu korunushto. Anyn syrtynyn zhiiirkenichtuulugu ichi da oshondoi ekenine dalil bolot. Bul anyn momosunun daamy zhiiirkenichtuu ekenin bildiret.
Kaapyrlar achka bolgondo, anyn achuu zhana zhiiirkenichtuu momolorunon kursaktary toigucha zheshet.
Kiiin alar any zheshken son' alarga zhiiinichtuu, kainak aralashma suusunduk berilet.
Andan kiiin alar tozok azabyna kaitarylat. Oshentip alar azaptan-azapka otup zhuro berishet.

Zhe alar bergenge zhana tyiganga akysy bolgudai asmandar menen zherdin mulku zhana al ekoosunun ortosundagy mulk alardyn kolunda beken? Egerde alardyn oiloru ushundai bolso, anda ozdoru kaalaganga berip zhe tyiyp koiuu okumun koldoruna alysh uchun asmanga zhetuunun sebepterin kylyshsyn. Birok alar ech kachan myndai kyla alyshpait.
Mukhammaddy zhalganga chygargandar - paigambarlaryn zhalganga chygargan murunku askerler syiaktuu zhen'ilgen askerler.
Alar birinchi bolup zhalganga chygargandar emes. Alarga cheiin Nukhtun koomu zhalganga chygargan, Aad zhalganga chygargan zhana adamdar azaptaluuchu ustundardyn eesi Faraon da zhalganga chygargan.

Samud zhalganga chygardy, Luttun koomu zhalganga chygardy, Shuaibdyn koomu zhalganga chygardy. Myna osholor paigambarlaryn zhalganga chygaruuga zhana alar alyp kelgen nersege kaapyrlyk kyluuga uiushkan toptor.
Bul toptordun biri da kalbai paigambarlardy zhalganga chygaryshty, anan alarga belgiluu bir ubakka cheiin kechikse da Allakhtyn azaby tushoru anyk boldu zhana alarga Anyn zhazasy keldi.
Mukhammaddy zhalganga chygargandar kaitaruu mumkun emes bolgon sur kerneiinin eki zholu tartylyshyn kutup zhatyshat. Eger alar any zhalganga chygargan abalda olushso, alarga azap tushot.
Alar shyldyn'dap aityshty: <<Oo, Rabbibiz! Kyiamat kungo cheiin ele bul duino zhashoosundagy azap enchibizdi ertele kor>>.

Oo, paigambar! Al zhalganchylardyn saga zhakpagan sozdoruno sabyr kyl. Dushmandaryna karshy turuuda kubattuu zhana Allakhka ibadat kyluuda sabyrduu pendebiz Dauddu este. Chyndygynda al Allakhka kop toobo kylyp kaitkan zhana Al yraazy bolgon ishterdin kylgan pende ele.
Biz aga kechke maal zhana tan'ga maal any menen kosho Allakhty aruulagan toolordu moiun sundurduk.
Zhana abada kalkyp turgan kanattuulardy aga moiun sundurduk. Alardyn baarysy anyn artynan kosho aruulashyp moiun sunushat.

Zhana Biz any aibattuuluk, kuch-kuduret zhana dushmandarynyn ustunon zhen'ishke zhetkirgen biilik menen kubattadyk. Biz aga paigambarlykty zhana ish-araketterdegi tuuralykty berdik. Oshondoi ele Biz aga ar bir kozdogon nersesinde zhetkiliktuu baiandoonu, sozundo zhana okum kyluuda kalystykty berdik.
Oo, paigambar! Saga talashyp-tartyshkan eki adamdyn kabary keldibi? Bir kezde alar Dauddun ibadatkanasyna ashyp tushushtu.

Alar Dauddun ustuno kutuusuz kirip baryshty. Al alardyn adattan tysh myndai zholdo kapystan kirip kelgeninen choochup ketti. Kachan alar anyn korkup ketkenin bilishkende aga: <<Korkpo! Biz ekoobuzdun ortobuzda talash zharalyp, ekoobuzdun biribiz zulumduk kyldy. Bizdin ortobuzda adilettik menen okum chygaryp ber. Okum kylganda bizge zulumduk kylba. Zhana bizge tuura zholgo karai tuura bagyt korgoz>>.

Talashkandardyn biroosu Daudga aitty: <<Bul kishi dindesh bir tuuganym. Munun tokson toguz koiu bar. A meniki biroo ele. Anan bul menden <<munu da maga ber>> dep talap kylyp, meni sozdon zhen'ip aldy>>.

Daud al ekoonun ortosunda okum kylyp doogerge kairylyp myndai dedi: <<Senin koiun'du ozunun koiloruna koshup aluunu talap kyluu menen bul dindesh bir tuuganyn' saga zulumduk kylyptyr. Chynynda kancha degen sherikter oz ara akysyn berbei zhana kalystyk kylbai asha chabyshat. Zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgan yimanduular gana sherikterine adil mamile kylat, alarga zulum kylyshpait. Myndai sypattagylar oto seirek>>. Oshondo Daud Biz any bul talash-tartysh arkyluu synap zhatkanybyzdy bilip kalyp, Rabbisinen kechirim surady, Allakhka zhakyndash uchun sazhda kyldy zhana Aga toobo kyldy.
Oshondo Biz aga zhoop berip, al kylganyn kechirdik. Chyndygynda al Bizdin aldybyzda zhakyndardan ele zhana al uchun akyrette zhakshy akybet bar.

Oo, Daud! Biz seni zher betinde dinii zhana duinoluk okum-buiruktardy ishke ashyruun' uchun orun basar kyldyk. Emi sen adamdardyn ortosunda adilettik menen okum kyl. Adamdardyn ortosunda okum kyluuda napsi kaaloon'o eerchibe! Tuugandyk zhe dostuk sebeptuu eki taraptyn bir zhagyna tartpa zhe dushmandyk sebeptuu ekinchi tarapka zyian berbe. Antsen' seni napsi kaaloon' Allakhtyn tuura zholunan adashtyryp koiot. Chyndygynda Allakhtyn tuura zholunan adashkandar surak kunun unutushkany sebeptuu alarga katuu azap bolot. Egerde alar any esteshkende zhana andan korkushkanda, anda napsi kaalooloruna eerchishpeit bolchu.

Biz asmandar menen zherdi zhondon-zhon ele zharatkan zhokpuz. Bul kaapyrlyk kylgandardyn oilogonu. Egerde alar kaapyrlykta zhana Allakh tuuraluu zhaman oido olgon bolso, anda al kaapyrlarga myndai oilogondoru uchun kyiamat kunu tozok azaby bolsun.

Biz Allakhka yiman keltirgenderdi, Anyn elchisin eerchigenderdi zhana zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandardy zher betinde kaapyrlyk zhana kunoolordu kylgandarga ech kachan ten'ebeibiz. Oshondoi ele Rabbisinin buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiuularyn tashtap Aga moiun sungandardy kaapyrlardai, eki zhuzduulordoi zhana kunoogo batkan adamdardai kylbaibyz. Chyndygynda alardy ten'oo Allakhka ylaiyk kelbegendei zulumduk. Teskerisinche, Allakh taza yimanduulardy beiishke kirgizip syilait, al emi shoorduu kaapyrlardy tozokko kirgizip zhazalait. Antkeni alar Allakhtyn aldynda birdei emes, alardyn syilyk-zhazalary da birdei bolboit.

Biz saga ozuno kop zhakshylyktardy zhana paidalardy kamtygan Kuran kitepti adamdar anyn aiattary menen maanilerinin ustundo oi zhugurtush uchun zhana tuura akyl zhugurtkon adamdar sabak alysh uchun tushurduk.
Zhana Biz Dauddun kozun kubantysh uchun Bizdin aga kylgan zhakshylygybyz katary aga Sulaimandy berdik. Sulaiman kandai zhakshy pende! Al Allakhka kop toobo kyluuchu zhana Aga kaituuchu.
Estechi, asyr maalynda aga uch tuiagy zherge tiigende, tortunchusun kotorgon asyl tukum kuluk attar korgozuldu. Al asyl tukum tulparlardy koruu menen alek bolup kun da batyp ketti.
Oshondo Sulaiman aitty: <<Men bul attar syiaktuu mal-duinonu suiuunu Rabbimdi eskeruudon artyk korupturmun. Kun batyp, asyr namazynan kechigip kalyptyrmyn.
Maga zhanagyl tulparlardy alyp kelgile!>>. Alardy alyp kelishti. Anan al alardyn buttaryn zhana moiundaryn kylych menen chaap bashtady.

Biz Sulaimandy synap, anyn taktysyna adam keipindegi shaitandy oturguzup koiduk. Al kyska moonotko anyn orduna biilik zhurguzdu. Kiiin biilik kairadan Sulaimanga kaitarylyp, aga zhin-shaitandar bash iidirildi.

Sulaiman aitty: <<Oo, Rabbim! Menin kunoolorumdu kechir zhana maga menden kiiin adamdardyn ech kimisinde bolbogondoi zheke ozumo gana tiiishtuu biilik ber. Oo, Rabbim! Chyndygynda Sen Bereshensin', Zhoomartsyn'>>.
Biz aga zhoop berdik zhana anyn buiruguna moiun sungan, any kaalagan tarabyna alyp bargan, katuuluguna zhana yldamduuluguna karabastan sydyrym sokkon shamaldy aga moiun sundurduk.
Oshondoi ele aga buiruktaryn atkargan zhin-shaitandardy moiun sundurduk. Alardyn kee birleri kuruuchular, kee birleri den'iz teren'dikterine chumkushup, bermetterdi alyp chygyshat.
Zhana zhin-shaitandardyn arasyndagy bash iibesterin da aga moiun sundurduk. Alar kishender menen bailangan, ech kyimyldai alyshpait.
Oo, Sulaiman! Bul senin suraganyn'a zhoop katary Bizdin saga bolgon belegibiz. Any kaalaganyn'a ber, kaalaganyn'an tyiyp koi. Bergenin' zhe tyiganyn' uchun suralbaisyn'.
Chyndygynda Sulaiman Bizdin aldybyzda zhakyndardan ele zhana al uchun beiish bolgon en' sonun kaituuchu zhai bar.
Oo, paigambar! Pendebiz Aiubdu estechi, bir kezde al Rabbisi Allakhka kairylyp: <<Men shaitandan azap tarttym, charchadym chalyktym>> - duba kyldy.
Oshondo Biz aga: <<Butun' menen zherdi tep>> - dedik. Al butu menen zherdi tepkende al zherden iche turgan zhana zhuunganda aga zyian bergen nerseni ketire turgan suu chykty.

Biz aga zhoop berip, anyn zyian tartkan nersesin zhok kyldyk. Oshondoi ele aga ui-bulosun kaitardyk zhana tuura akyl zhugurtkon adamdar <<sabyrduuluktun akybeti - kutuluu zhana soopko zhetuu>> ekendigi tuuraluu oi zhugurtuuloru uchun Biz aga Ozubuz taraptan yraiym katary anyn ustuno dagy oshoncho bala-chakany zhana neberelerdi koshup berdik.

Kachan Aiub aialyna achuusu kelip, aga zhuz balak uram dep kasam ichkende Biz aga aittyk: <<Ei, Aiub! Kasamyn'dy ishke ashyrysh uchun kolun'a bir uuch kurmanyn ichke sabaktaryn alyp, any menen aialyn'dy ur! Kasam ichkenden kiiin any buzba>>. Oshondo al bir uuch kurmanyn sabagyn alyp, any urdu. Chyndygynda Biz anyn synoolorubuzga sabyrduulugun korduk. Al kandai zhakshy pende! Chyndygynda al Allakhka daiym toobo kylyp kaituuchu.

Oo, paigambar! Sen Biz tandagan pendeler zhana Biz zhibergen elchiler bolgon Ibrakhim, Iskhak zhana Iakubdu estechi. Alar Allakhka ibadat kyluuda kuch-kubattuu, Anyn yraazylygyn izdegen zhana akyikatka chyndap korogochtuk kylgan adamdar bolchu.
Chyndygynda Biz alarga ozgocho kasiet berdik. Al kasiet - akyretti estoo menen zhuroktorun tiriltuu, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylyp aga daiardyk koruu zhana adamdardy alardy atkaruuga chakyruu.
Akyikatta alar Bizdin aldybyzda moiun sunuu uchun, ibadat kyluu uchun tandap alyngan adamdardan. Biz alarga paigambarlyk mildetti tapshyryp, any adamdarga zhetkiruu uchun tandap aldyk.

Oo, paigambar! Ibrakhimdin balasy Ismaildi, Al'-Iasaany zhana Zulkifldi estegin. Alarga en' sonun maktoolordu ait. Antkeni alar oshogo tatyktuu. Alardyn baarysy Allakhtyn aldynda tandalgan pendelerden.
Bul alarga karata aitylgan alkysh-maktoolor tuuraluu Kurandagy eskeruu. Oshondoi ele Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiuularyn tashtagan takybalar uchun akyrette en' sonun kaityp baruuchu zhai bar.
Al kaityp baruuchu en' sonun zhai - alar kyiamat kunu kire turgan tuboluktuu beiishter. Anyn eshikteri alarga saltanattuu achylat.
Alar koozdolgon sorulordo zhambashtap zhatyshyp, kyzmatchylardan ozdoru kaalagan turkun-turluu momo-zhemishterdi zhana sharap syiaktuu alar kaalagan suusunduktardy aldyryshat.
Alardyn aldynda kuioolorunon kozun albagan, bashkalarga koz salbagan zhana baary tegiz bir kurakta bolgon aialdar bar.
Oo, takybalar! Siler duinodo kylgan zhakshylyk ishterin'erdin kyiamattagy en' zhakshy syilygy katary silerge ubada kylyngan nerse - myna ushul.
Chyndygynda bul aitkan syilygybyz - Biz bergen yrysky. Biz any kyiamat kunu takybalarga nasip kylabyz. Al yrysky daiym ulanat, al ech kachan butpoit zhana tugonboit.

Biz aitkan bul nerse - takybalardyn syilygy. Al emi kaapyrlyk zhana kunoolordu kylyp Allakhtyn chekterinen chykkandarga takybalardyn syilygynan aiyrmalangan zhaza bar. Alar uchun kyiamatta en' zhaman kaityp baruuchu zhai bar.
Bul zhaza - alardy orop aluuchu tozok. Alar anyn ysygynan zhana zhalynan azap tartyshat. Alarga otton toshoktor bar. Alardyn toshogu kandai zhaman!
Bul azap - kainagan ysyk suu zhana tozokto azaptalgan adamdardyn akkan irin'deri. Any ichkile! Bul alardyn chan'koosun ketirbegen suusunduktary.
Alar uchun bul azapka okshogon bashka dagy azaptar bar. Alar akyrette azaptalysh uchun alarga turkun-turluu azaptar daiardalgan.
Eerchigender aityshty: <<Oo, Rabbibiz! Bizge akyikat kelgenden kiiin bizdi adashtyrgandardy tozokto eselep azapta>>.
Chekten chykkan tekeberler aityshty: <<Emnege biz duinodo azapka tatyktuu baktysyzdar dep eseptegen kishilerdi biz menen chogu korboi zhatabyz?
Biz alardy shyldyn'daganybyz katachylyk bolup, alar azapka tatyktuu bolboi kalyshtyby zhe biz alardy shyldyn'daganybyz tuura bolup, alar tozokko kirishtibi? Biz alardy korboi zhatabyz go?>>.
Chyndygynda Biz silerge aitkan kaapyrlardyn kyiamattagy talashyp-tartyshuusu ech kandai shek-kumonu zhok akyikat nerse.

Oo, Mukhammad! Koomun'dagy kaapyrlarga ait: <<Akyikatta men bolgonu silerge kaapyrlygyn'ar zhana paigambarlardy zhalganga chygarganyn'ar sebeptuu Allakhtyn azaby kelip kaluusunan eskertuuchumun. Allakhtan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok. Al Oz uluktugunda zhana ysym-sypattarynda Zhalgyz. Al baaryn bagyntkan zhana bash iidirgen Kaarduu.
Al asmandar menen zherdin zhana alardyn ortosundagy nerselerdin Rabbisi. Al Oz biiliginde ech kimden zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu. Al toobo kylgan pendelerinin kunoolorun Kechiruuchu.
Oo, paigambar! Al zhalganchylarga ait: <<Akyikatta Kuran - uluu martabaluu kabar.
Siler bul uluu martabaluu kabarga kon'ul burbastan, andan zhuz burup zhatasyn'ar.
Chyndygynda Allakh Ozu vakhii kylgan nerselerdi gana maga tushurdu. Antkeni men silerge Anyn azabyn achyk eskertuuchumun>>.
Estegin, bir kezde Rabbin' perishtelerge aitty: <<Men ylaidan adamdy zharatam. Al - Adam.
Men anyn tulku-boiun tuzdop, kelbet berip zhana aga Oz Rukhumdan zhan salganda, aga sazhda kylgyla>>.
Perishteler Rabbisinin buiruguna bash iiip, baarysy syi-urmat katary sazhda kylyshty. Alardyn arasynan Adamga sazhda kylbagan biri da kalgan zhok.
Bir gana Iblis sazhda kyluudan tekeberlendi. Al Rabbisinin buiruguna tekeberlik kylgany uchun kaapyrlardan boldu.

Allakh aitty: <<Ei, Iblis! Ozumdun eki Kolum menen zharatkan Adamga sazhda kyluuga saga emne toskool boldu? Seni sazhda kyluudan tekeberlik tostubu zhe sen buga cheiin ele Rabbin'e tekeberlenip, menmensinip kaldyn' bele?>>.
Iblis: <<Men Adamdan artykmyn. Seni meni otton, any bolso ylaidan zharattyn'>> - dedi. Anyn oiunda ot topuraktan sharapattuu ele.
Allakh Ibliske aitty: <<Beiishten chyk! Emi sen kargyshka zhana sogushko kaldyn'.
Sen syilyk zhana zhaza kun bolgon kyiamatka cheiin beiishten kuuldun'>>.
Iblis aitty: <<Pendelerin'di kaira tiriltken kungo cheiin maga moonot ber zhana meni olturbo>>.
Allakh aitty: <<Sen moonot berilgenderden boldun'.
Seni zhok kyluu uchun belgiluu bir ubakyt kelgen kungo cheiin>>.
Iblis aitty: <<Senin kudurettuulugun'o zhana kaarduulugun'a ant bolsun! Men butkul adam balasyn adashtyramyn.
Sen menin adashtyruumdan korgogondordu zhana zhalgyz Ozun'o chyn yklastan ibadat kylgandardy gana adashtyra albaim>>.
Allakh taala aitty: <<Akyikat Menden zhana Men akyikatty gana aitamyn:
Kyiamat kunu sen zhana seni kaapyrlykta eerchigen bardyk adam balasy menen tozoktu tolturamyn>>.
Kuran adamzat menen zhinderdin arasynan mildet algandaryna eskertme!
Kuran kitebi ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu zhana zharatuusunda, bashkaruusunda zhana shariiatynda Daanyshman Allakh taraptan gana tushkon.

Oo, paigambar! Biz saga akyikatty kamtygan Kurandy tushurduk. Andagy kabarlardyn baarysy chyndyk zhana okumdordun baarysy adilettuu. Andyktan shirkti tashtap, zhalgyz Allakhka gana chyn yklastan syiyn!

Shirkten taza bolgon din Allakhka gana taandyk! Al emi Allakhtan bashka kudailardy zhana taguttardy koldoochu tutup alarga syiyngandar bul kylgandarynyn shyltoosu katary myndai dep aityshat: <<Biz alarga bizdi Allakhka bir az bolso da zhakyndatsyn, muktazhdyktarybyzdy Aga aitsyn zhana Anyn aldynda bizge ortomchuluk kylyshsyn dep gana syiynabyz>>. Chyndygynda Allakh Aga gana syiyngan yimanduular menen mushrik kaapyrlardyn ortosundagy Allakhty zhalgyzdoogo bailanyshkan talash-tartyshtary tuuraluu kyiamatta okum kylat. Allakhtyn sherigi bar dep zhana Anyn zhakshylyktaryn tanyp ketkenderge Al akyikatka karai iigilik berbeit.

Egerde Allakh balaluu bolushun kaalaganda, anda zharatkandardyn arasynan Ozu kaalaganyn tandap, any bala kylyp almak. Allakh mushrikterdin aitkandarynan aruu! Al Oz zatynda, sypattarynda zhana ish-araketterinde Zhalgyz. Bul nerselerde Anyn sherigi zhok. Al butkul makuluktardy Bagyntuuchu.

Al asmandar menen zherdi uluu daanyshmandyk uchun zharatty. Zalymdar aitkandai zhondon-zhon ele zharatkan zhok. Tundu kunduzgo kirgizet, kunduzdu tungo kirgizet. Alardyn biri kelse, ekinchisi ketet. Zhana Kundu menen Aidy moiun sundurdu. Al ekoosunun ar biri bul zhashoo buto turgan belgilengen ubakytka cheiin zhurot. Chyndygynda Al Oz dushmandarynan och algan zhana ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu, toobo kylgan pendelerinin kunoolorun Kechiruuchu.

Ei, adamdar! Rabbin'er silerdi bir zhandan - Adamdan zharatty, kiiin andan aialy Khavany zharatty. Oshondoi ele siler uchun toolordu, uilardy, koilordu zhana echkilerdi segiz tur kylyp zharatty. Ar bir turunon erkek-urgaachysyn zharatty. Allakh silerdi enen'erdin kursagynda uch karan'gylykta - kursakta, zhatynda zhana tondun ichinde baskych-baskych kylyp zharatty. Myna osholordun baarysyn zharatkan Allakh - silerdin Rabbin'er. Biilik Aga gana taandyk. Andai bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok. Emnege siler Aga syiyngandyn orduna ech nerseni zharatalbagan, teskerisinche ozdoru zharatylgan nerselerge syiynyp zhatasyn'ar!

Ei, adamdar! Egerde Rabbin'erge kaapyrlyk kylsan'ar, Allakh silerdin yimanyn'arga muktazh emes. Silerdin kaapyrlygyn'ar Aga zyian keltirbeit. Anyn zyiany ozun'orgo gana kaitat. Al pendelerinin Aga kaapyrlyk kyluularyna yraazy emes zhana alardy kaapyrlykka da buirubait. Antkeni Allakh bukuzukulukka zhana kunoogo buirubait. Egerde Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryna shugur kylsan'ar zhana Aga yiman keltirsen'er, anda Al shugurchulugun'orgo yraazy bolot zhana al uchun sooptordu beret. Ech bir zhan bashkanyn kunoosun kotorboit. Teskerisinche, ar bir zhan kylgan ishine zharasha karmalyp turat. Kiiin siler kyiamatta zhalgyz Rabbin'erge kaitasyn'ar. Oshondo Al silerdin duinodo kylgan ishterin'erdin kabaryn beret. Silerge ish-araketterin'er uchun syilygyn beret. Chyndygynda Al pendelerinin zhuroktorundogu nerselerdi Biluuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.

Egerde kaapyr adam ooru, mal-mulk zhogotuu, suuga choguu syiaktuu zyianga uchurasa, al Rabbisine gana kaityp, andagy zyiandy ketiruusun surap duba kylat. Kiiin Al anyn bashyna tushkon zyiandy ketirip zhakshylyk kylgan bolso, anda aga cheiin Allakhka zhalynganyn tashtap koiot zhana bashkalardy Allakhka karai zhetkirgen zholdon adashtyrysh uchun Aga bashkalardy sherik kylyp syiynyshat. Oo, paigambar! Ushundai abaldagy adamdarga ait: <<Kalgan omurun'do kaapyrlygyn' menen zhyrgap al. Al az gana ubakyt. Chyndygynda sen kyiamatta dos dostu koshtogondoi tozokko kirgender menen birge bolosun'.

Zhe bolboso, Allakhka moiun sunup, tunku ubakyttardy Rabbisine sazhda kylgan, namazda turgan abalda otkorgon, akyret azabynan korkkon, Rabbisinin yraiymyn umut kylgan adam zhakshyby zhe kyinalganda gana Allakhka syiynyp, barchylykta Aga kaapyrlyk kylgan zhana Allakhka sherikterdi koshkon adam zhakshyby? Oo, paigambar! Allakhty taanyp bilishkeni sebeptuu alarga mildet bolgon nerselerdi bilgender menen bulardyn ech birin bilbegender ten' bolo alaby? Chyndygynda bul eki toptun aiyrmachylygyn tuura akyl zhugurtkondor gana bilishet.

Oo, paigambar! Maga zhana paigambarlarga yiman keltirgen pendelerime ait: <<Rabbin'erdin buiruktaryna bash iiip, tyiularyn tashtap Andan korkkula! Silerden bul duinodo zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandar uchun duino zhashoosunda zhen'ish, den-sooluk zhana bailyk syiaktuu zhakshylyktar bolot. Al emi akyrette beiish bolot. Allakhtyn zheri kenen. Andyktan Allakhka syiynuuga toskoolduk zharatpagandai zher tapkanga cheiin kocho bergile! Chyndygynda kyiamat kunu sabyrduularga berilgen soop-syilyktary koptuk zhana turduuluk zhaktan esepsiz zhana chenemsiz bolot>>.
Oo, paigambar! Ait: <<Allakh meni chyn yklastan Aga gana ibadat kyluuga buirudu.
Zhana bul ummotton meni en' birinchi bolup Aga bash iiip, Any eerchigenderden boluuga buirudu>>.
Oo, paigambar! Ait: <<Men chyn yklastan ibadat kylyp Allakhka gana syiynam. Andan bashka ech kimge syiynbaim.

Ei, mushrikter! Siler dagy Andan bashka kaalagan kudailarga syiyna bergile (korkutuu maksatta aitylgan buiruk)>>. Oo, paigambar! Ait: <<Chynygy zhogotuuga uchuragandar - alar ozdorun zhana ui-bulosun zyianga uchuratkandar. Alar ozdoru gana beiishke kirgeni sebeptuu zhe alar menen birge tozokko tushkonu sebeptuu alardan bolok bolgonu uchun alardy zholukturbait. Myna ushul ech kandai budomuksuz achyk-aikyn adashuu emespi!

Alar uchun ustulorundo tutun, zhalyn zhana ysyktyk bolot zhana astylarynda da tutun, zhalyn zhana ysyktyk bolot>>. Myna ushul aitylgan azap menen Allakh pendelerin korkutat. Oo, pendelerim! Menin buiruktaryma bash iiip, tyiuularymdy tashtap Menden korkkula!

Allakh kunookorlordun abalyn eskergende, salikh pendelerinin da abalyn eskerip myndai dedi:
Al emi aikelderge syiynuudan zhana Allakhtan bashka bardyk syiynylgan nerselerden alystagandarga zhana toobo kylyp Allakhka kaitkandarga olgondo, kabyrda zhana kyiamatta beiish tuuraluu kush kabar aitylat. Oo, paigambar! Pendelerime suiunchulo!

Al emi sozgo kulak salyp, anyn zhakshy-zhamanyn aiyrmalap, paidasy bar zhakshy sozdordu eerchigenderge - myna ushundai sypattagy adamdarga Allakh tuura zholgo karai iigilik beret, myna ushular tuura akyl zhugurtkondor.

Oo, paigambar! Kimge kaapyrlyktan zhana adashuudan bash tartpagany uchun azap sozu mildet bolso, sen any tuura zholgo saluuga zhana iigilik beruugo ech kandai aila taba albaisyn'. Oo, paigambar! Sen ushundai sypattagy adamdy tozokton kutkara alasyn'by?

Birok Rabbisinin buiruktaryna bash iiip, tyiuularyn tashtap Andan korkkondor uchun birinin ustuno biri kurulgan biiik bolmolor bar, alardyn aldylarynan daryialar agyp turat. Bul Allakhtyn alarga bergen anyk ubadasy. Allakh ubadasyn buzbait.

Siler korup bilesin'er, Allakh asmandan zhamgyr suusun tushurup, any bulaktarga zhana agyndarga kirgizdi. Kiiin al suu arkyluu turkun tustogu eginderdi chygardy. Kiiin al kurgady. Ei, nazar saluuchu! Sen any zhapzhashyl bolgondon kiiin sargaiganyn korosun'. Anan any kak kurgagandan kiiin synma zhana maidalanma kylyp koidu. Chyndygynda bul aitylgandarda zhurogu tiruu adamdar uchun eskertmeler bar.

Allakh kokurogun Islamga achyp, Ozuno karai bagyttap, Rabbisi taraptan korogochtuk berilgen adam Allakhty estebei zhurogu merez bolup kalgan adam menen ten' bolobu? Alar ech kachan ten' bolushpait! Tuura zholdogular kutkarylat, al emi Allakhty estebei zhuroktoru merez bolup kalgandar kyiroogo tush bolushat. Myna osholor akyikattan anyk adashuuda.

Allakh paigambary Mukhammadga en' mykty soz bolgon Kurandy tushurdu. Al any chyndykta, korkomdukto zhana shaikeshtikte zhana karama-karshylyktardyn zhoktugunda biri-birine okshosh kylyp tushurdu. Anyn ichinde koptogon okuialar, okumdor, ubadalar, korkutuular, akyikat zhana zhalgan zholdogu adamdardyn sypattary tuuraluu aitylgan. Rabbisinen korkkondor andagy kelgen korkutuulardy zhana eskertuulordu ukkanda terileri titireit. Andan son' eger alar andagy umut zharatkan nerselerdi zhana suiunchu kabarlardy ugushsa, Allakhty estep alardyn terileri zhana zhuroktoru tynch alat. Kurandagy bul aitylgandar zhana anyn taasiri - Allakh Ozu kaalagandy bagyttagan tuura zholu. Allakh kimdi zhardamsyz tashtasa zhana tuura zholgo iiligik berbese, anda any ech kim tuura zholgo sala albait.

Allakh tuura zholgo salgan, duinodo iigilik bergen zhana akyrette beiishke kirgizgen adam menen kaapyrlyk kylyp oshol zholdo olgon, kolu-butu kishendelip tozokko kirgen adam ten' bolobu? Al zher surgon zhuzu menen tozokton korgono albait. Kaapyrlyk zhana kunoo kylyp ozdoruno zyian bergenderge zhemeloo katary aitylat: <<Ozun'or kylgan kaapyrlyk menen kunoolordun azabyn tatkyla! Bul silerdin zhazan'ar>>.
Al mushrikterden murunku koomdor da zhalganga chygaryshkan. Oshondo alar any sezip toobo kylyp daiardyk koruugo zhetishpei turgandai abalda alarga kapystan azap kelgen.
Oshondo Allakh alarga bul azap menen duino zhashoosunda kordukdu, shermendelikti zhana maskaralykty tattyrdy. Al emi akyrette alardy kutkon azap myndan da kataal, eger alar munu bilishkende.

Biz Mukhammadga tushurulgon bul Kuranda adamdarga zhakshylyk menen zhamandyk, akyikat menen zhalgan, yiman menen kaapyrlyk tuuraluu turduu misaldardy keltirdik. Biz munu adamdar misaldardan ulgu alyp, akyikatty ish zhuzundo atkaryp, zhalgandy tashtap sabak alat degen umutto kyldyk.

Biz any arab tilindegi Kuran kyldyk, anda ech kandai burmaloo, ozgortuu zhana budomuk nerse zhok. Biz munu alar anyn buiruktaryna eerchip zhana tyiuularyn tashtap Allakhtan korkushat degen umutto kyldyk.

Allakh shirk kylgan adam menen Aga gana syiyngan adamdy salyshtyryp misal keltirdi. Yrky kelishpegen eki sheriktin bir erkek kulu bar, al biroosun yraazy kylsa, ekinchisin achuulantat. Oshol sebeptep al emne kylaryn bilbei bashy man'. Oshondoi ele bir erkekke tiiishtuu bir kul bar, al aga ozu gana eelik kylat, al anyn maksatyn bilet. Anyn kon'ulu tynch, ech kandai kabatyrlanuu zhok. Emi ushul eki erkek ten' bolobu? Allakhka maktoolor bolsun! Birok alardyn kopchulugu bilishpeit. Oshol sebepten Allakhka bashkalardy sherik kylyshat.
Oo, paigambar! Akyikatta sen dagy, alar dagy sozsuz olosun'or.
Ei, adamdar! Kiiin siler kyiamatta Rabbin'erdin aldynda talashyp-tartyshasyn'ar. Oshondo chynchyl menen zhalganchy achyk bilinet.

Sherigi bar, aialy bar, balasy bar dep Allakhka ylaiyk kelbegen nerseni Aga tiiishtuu kylgan adamdan da otkon zaalym zhok. Oshondoi ele Allakhtyn elchisi alyp kelgen vakhiidi zhalganga chygargan adamdan da otkon zaalym zhok. Allakhka kaapyr bolgondor uchun tozokto orun zhok beken? Albette, bar! Chyndygynda alar uchun al zhakta orun da, zhai da bar.

Kachan Allakh zhalganga chygargan zhalganchy tuuraluu soz kylganda any menen katar chyndykty tastyktagan chynchyl tuuraluu aityp myndai dedi:
Al emi sozundo, ish-araketterinde paigambarlardan zhana bashkalardan akyikatty alyp kelgen, anyn chyndyk ekenine ishengen zhana anyn talaptaryna ylaiyk ish-araket kylgandar - myna osholor Rabbisinin buiruguna bash iiip, tyiuularynan alystagan chynygy takybalar.
Alar uchun Rabbisinin aldynda ozdoru kaalagandai tuboluk yrakhattar bar. Bul Zharatuuchusuna zhana adamdarga zhakshylyk kylgandardyn syilygy.
Allakh alardyn duinodo kylgan en' zhaman kunoo ishterin ochurush uchun kyldy. Antkeni alar toobo kylyshty, Rabbisine kaityshty. Oshondoi ele alarga kylgan en' zhakshy ishterinine sooptordu beret.

Allakh pendesi Mukhammadga din zhana duino ishterinde, oshondoi ele any dushmandarynan korgoogo Ozu zhetishtuu emespi?! Albette, Al aga Ozu zhetishtuu! Oo, paigambar! Alar naadandyktan zhana kem akyldyktan ozdoru Allakh menen katar syiynyshkan kudailary saga zyian beret dep seni korkutushat. Allakh kimdi zhardamsyz tashtap, tuura zholgo tushuugo iigilik berbese, anda any tuura zholgo salgan, aga iiligik bergen ech kim bolboit.

Al emi Allakh kimge tuura zholgo tushuugo iigilik berse, anda any ech kim adashtyra albait. Allakh ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu zhana Aga kaapyrlyk kylyp, bash iibegenderden och Aluuchu emespi?! Albette, Al Ozu Kudurettuu, och Aluuchu!

Oo, paigambar! Egerde mushrikterden: <<Asmandar menen Zherdi kim zharatkan?>> - dep surasan', alar: <<Any Allakh zharatkan>> - dep gana aityshat. Alarga kudailarynyn alsyzdygyn zhar salyp myndai dep ait: <<Siler Allakhtan bashka syiyngan kudailaryn'ar tuuraluu maga aitkylachy, eger Allakh maga zyian beruunu kaalasa, alar meni andan kutkara alyshaby?! Zhe bolboso, Rabbim maga Oz aldynan yraiym tartuulasa, alar any menden toso alyshaby?!>>. Alarga aitkyn: <<Allakhtyn Ozu maga zhetishtuu! Butkul ishimde Aga gana tobokel kylamyn. Tobokel kylgan adamdar zhalgyz Aga gana taianyshat>>.

Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Oo, elim! Siler ozun'orgo zhakkandai abalda Allakhka shirk amalyn'ardy kyla bergile. A men bolso Rabbim maga buirugan Any zhalgyzdoogo chakyryp, Aga chyn yklastan ibadatymdy kylamyn. Zhakynda ar bir zholdun akybeti kandai ekenin bilesin'er>>.
Siler zhakynda kimge bul duinodo kordukka salgan azap kelerin zhana akyrette ech kachan butpogon tuboluk azap tushorun bilesin'er.

Oo, paigambar! Biz seni adamdardy eskertsin' dep alar uchun saga Kurandy akyikat menen tushurduk. Kim tuura zholgo tushso, anda anyn tuura zholgo tushkonu ozuno gana paida. Anyn tuuralykka tushkonu Allakhka ech kandai paida keltirbeit. Antkeni Al aga muktazh emes. Al emi kim adashsa, anda al adashkanynyn zyianyn ozu gana tartat. Anyn adashkany Allakhka ech kandai zyian berbeit. Sen alardy tuura zholgo saluuga kepil emessin'. Sen ozun'o buirulgandy gana alarga zhetkiruugo mildettuusun'.

Allakh zhandardy azhaly zhetkende alat. Oshondoi azhaly kele elek uikudagy zhandardy da alat, olot dep okum kylynganyn karmap kalat, al emi Allakhtyn iliminde belgiluu bir moonotko cheiin zhashait dep okum kylyngandardy koio beret. Chyndygynda zhandy aluuda, koio beruudo, olturuudo zhana tiriltuudo - ushundai nerselerdi kylgan Allakh adamdardy olgondon kiiin surak, syilyk zhe zhaza uchun kaira tiriltuugo kudurettuu dep oi zhugurtkon adamdar uchun dalilder bar.

Mushrikter Allakhtan bashka ozdorunun aikel kudailary paida beret degen umutto alardy shapaatchy kylyp alyshty. Oo, paigambar! Alarga ait: <<Alar siler uchun zhana ozdoru uchun ech nersege eelik kylbasa da, akyl zhugurto albasa da alardy shapaatchy kylyp aldyn'arby?! Alar suiloi albagan, ukpagan, korbogon, paida-zyian bere albagan zhansyz zattar>>.

Oo, paigambar! Al mushrikterge ait: <<Butkul shapaat Allakhka gana taandyk. Anyn aldynda Anyn uruksatysyz ech kim shapaat kyla albait, Ozu yraazy bolgondor gana shapaat kylyshat. Asmandardyn zhana Zherdin mulku zhalgyz Aga gana taandyk. Kiiin kyiamatta surak berish uchun, syilyk zhe zhaza alysh uchun zhalgyz Aga gana kaitasyn'ar. Al silerge ish-araketterin'erdin syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret>>.

Egerde Allakhtyn Ozu gana eskerilse, anda akyretke zhana andagy kaira tiriluugo, surakka, zhaza-syilykka ishenbegen mushrikterdin zhurogu irenzhip bashtait. A eger Allakhtan bashka alar syiynyshkan kudailary eskerilse, oshol zamat kubanyp shattanyshat.

Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Oo, Allakh! Asmandar menen Zherdi murda bolbogondon korunushto Zharatuuchu, kaiypty da, uchurdu da Biluuchu. Saga bulardyn ech biri zhashyruun emes. Pendeler duinodo talashyp tartyshkan nerselerge kyiamatta Ozun gana okum chygarasyn'. Oshondo chynchyl menen zhalganchy, baktyluu menen baktysyz anyk bolot>>.

Eger shirk zhana kunoo kylyp ozuno zulum kylgandarga zher betindegi bardyk bailyktar zhana andan bir neche ese kop bailyk taandyk bolso, kaira tiriluudon kiiin koro turgan katuu azaptan kutuluu uchun bailyktyn baaryn sadaga chaap zhibermek. Birok, alarga andai kyluuga uruksat berilbeit. Chyndap alarda oshoncho mulku bolso da, baary bir kabyl kylynbait. Allakh taraptan alar uchun kutulbogondoi azaptyn turloru achykka chygat.
Alar kylgan shirk zhana kunooloru achykka chygat zhana alarga duinodo korkutuu iretinde aitylganda shyldyn'dagan azap alardy orop alat.

Egerde kaapyr adam ooruga zhe zhakyrlykka kabylsa, Biz any kutkaryshybyz uchun duba kylat. Kiiin Biz aga zhakshylyk kylyp den-sooluk zhe bailyk bersek, al kaapyr: <<Allakh maga munu tatyktuu ekenimdi bilgen uchun gana berdi>> - deit. Chynynda bul synoo zhana akyryndyk menen zhazaloo bolchu. Birok kaapyrlardyn kopchulugu munu bilishpeit. Allakh alarga bergen zhakshylyktar sebeptuu kuru kyialdarga azgyrylyshat.
Bul sozdu alardan murunku kaapyrlar da aityshkan. Birok alarga tapkan bailyktary, kadyr-barktary ech kandai paida bergen zhok.

Kiiin alar kylgan shirk zhana kunoolordun zhazasyn ozdoru tartyshty. Shirk zhana kunoolordu kylyp ozdoruno zulum kylgan azyrky adamdar murunkulardai syiaktuu ele kylgan kunoolorun zhazasyn alyshat. Alar Allakhtan ech kachan kutula alyshpait zhana Aga ustomduk da kyla alyshpait.

Al mushrikter soz kylyp zhatyshaby, Allakh synash uchun Ozu kaalaganga yryskyny kenen kylyp bererin, oshondoi ele Allakhtyn tagdyryna kim sabyr kylaryn zhe kyzhyrdanaryn bilish uchun Ozu kaalaganga yryskysyn tarytaryn bilishpeibi?! Chyndygynda bul aitylgan yryskynyn kenendigi, tarlygy syiaktuu nerselerde - yimanduu adamdar uchun Allakhtyn bashkaruusun bildirgen aiat-belgiler bar. Antkeni myna osholor aiat-belgilerden paida alyshat. Al emi kaapyrlar bolso alardy eles alyshpait zhana alardan zhuz burushat.

Oo, paigambar! Allakhka shirk kylyp zhana kunoolordu kylyp chekten chykkan pendelerime ait: <<Allakhtyn yraiymynan zhana kunoolorun'ordu kechiruusunon umut uzbogulo! Chyndygynda Allakh toobo kylgandardyn bardyk kunoolorun kechiret. Chyndygynda Al toobo kyluuchulardyn kunoolorun Kechiruuchu, alarga Yraiymduu>>.

Toobo zhana zhakshy ishterdi kyluu menen Rabbin'erge kaitkyla zhana silerge kyiamattagy azap kelishinen murun Aga eerchigile! Bolboso kiiin kudailaryn'ardan zhana ui-bulon'ordon silerdi azaptan kutkaryp zhardam bergen ech kimdi tappaisyn'ar.

Zhana Rabbin'er Oz elchisine tushurgon en' sonun Kurandy eerchigile zhana siler toobo kylyp daiardyk koro elekte sezdirbesten, kutuusuz azap kelgenge cheiin anyn buiruktaryn atkargyla zhana tyigandaryn tashtagyla.

Siler kyiamatta katuu okunuchton: <<Attin' ai, men kaapyrlyk zhana kunoolor sebeptuu Allakhtyn akysyna kon'ul kosh karaganym uchun, yimanduulardy zhana Allakhka moiun sungandardy shyldyn'daganym uchun meni okunuch basty!>> - dep aityp kalbashyn'ar uchun munu atkargyla.
Zhe bolboso al tagdyrdy betine karmap: <<Eger Allakh maga iigilik bergende men dagy takybalardan bolmokmun, Anyn buiruktaryn atkarmakmyn, tyigandaryn tashtamakmyn>> - dep aitat.
Zhe bolboso al azapty oz kozu menen korgondo: <<Eger men duinogo kaira kaitsam, men Allakhka toobo kylmakmyn, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgan adamdardyn katarynda bolmokmun>> - dep aitat.

Sen tuura zholdu kyialdanyp oilogondoi bolboit! Saga Menin aiat-belgilerim kelgende sen any zhalganga chygargansyn', tekeberlik kylgansyn' zhana Allakhka, Anyn aiattaryna zhana paigambarlaryna kaapyrlyk kylgansyn'.

Allakhtyn sherigi bar, balasy bar dep Aga zhalgan zhalaa zhapkandardyn zhuzdoru kyiamatta kararyp ketkenin korosun'. Bul alardyn baktysyz ekendiginin belgisi. Allakhka zhana Anyn paigambarlaryna yiman keltiruugo tekeberlik kylgandar uchun tozokto orun zhok beken?! Albette, alar uchun orundar bar!

Rabbisinin buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkondordu Allakh iigilik zhaiy bolgon beiishke kirgizip azaptan saktait. Alarga azap tiibeit zhana alar duinodo otkorup zhibergen zhyrgalchylyktarga ech kachan kaigyryshpait.
Allakh butkul nerselerdin Zharatuuchusu, Andan bashka Zharatuuchu zhok. Al bardyk nerseni Saktoochu. Al ishterdi bashkarat zhana any Ozu kaalagandai zholgo salat.

Asmandar menen Zherdegi zhakshylyk kazynalarynyn achkychtary zhalgyz Aga gana taandyk. Al any Ozu kaalaganga beret, Ozu kaalagandan tyiyp koiot. Allakhtyn aiattaryna kaapyrlyk kylgandar - myna osholor zhogotuuga uchuragandar. Antkeni alar duino zhashoosunda yimandan kuru kalyshty zhana akyrette tuboluk tozokko kirishti.

Oo, paigambar! Seni ozdorunun kudailaryna syiynuuga azgyryp zhatkan mushrikterge ait: <<Ei, Rabbisine naadandyk kylgandar! Siler meni Allakhtan bashkaga syiynuuga buirup zhatasyn'arby?! Zhalgyz Allakhtan bashka ech kim syiynuuga tatyktuu emes. Men Andan bashkaga syiynbaim>>.

Oo, paigambar! Allakh saga zhana senden murunku paigambarlarga: <<Egerde sen Allakh menen katar bashkaga syiynsan', zhakshy ishterin'din sooptoru zhok bolup ketet zhana bul duinodo dinin'den kuru kalgan, akyrette azapka tush bolgon zhogotuuga uchuragandardan bolosun'>> - dep vakhii kylgan.
Zhalgyz Allakhtyn Ozuno gana syiyn, Aga ech kimdi sherik kylba zhana saga kylgan zhakshylyktary uchun shugur kylgandar menen birge bol!

Mushrikter Allakhka alsyz makuluktardy sherik kylyp, Any talaptagydai uluktashkan zhok. Zhana alar Allakhtyn kudurettuuluguno kon'ul burushkan zhok, Anyn kudurettuulugunun belgilerinen - zher betindegi toolor, bak-daraktar, daryialar, den'izder kyiamat kunu Anyn chen'gelinde bolot zhana zheti kabat asmandyn baarysy On' Kolunda turmoktolgon bolot.

Al kunu Sur kerneidi tartuuga zhoopker perishte any uiloit. Oshondo asmandar menen zherdegi bardyk zhanduular olot. Andan son' kaira tiriltuu uchun Surdu ekinchi zholu uiloit. Oshol zamat bardyk tiruu zhan Allakh emi alardy emne kylar eken dep kutup turup kalyshat.

Pendelerdin ortosunda okum kylysh uchun Rabbi paida bolgondo Zher zharkyrady, adamdardyn ish-araketteri zhazylgan barakchalar tarkatyldy, paigambarlardy alyp kelishti, oshondoi ele paigambarlar oz koomdoruna kubo bolushu uchun Mukhammad paigambardyn ummotun da alyp kelishti. Allakh alardyn baaryna adilettik menen okum kyldy. Al kunu alarga zulumduk kylynbait, ech bir adamdyn kunoosu koboitulboit zhana zhakshylyktary azaitylbait.

Allakh ar bir zhandyn kylgan zhakshylyk zhe zhamandyk ishterinin zhaza-syilygyn toluk beret. Allakh alardyn kylyp zhatkan ishterin bilet. Alardyn kylgan zhakshylyk, zhamandyk ishterinin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Al kun kelgende alar kylgan ishterinin syilygyn zhe zhazasyn alyshat.

Perishteler Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandardy top-tobu menen kordogon abalda tozokko alyp kelishet. Kachan alar tozokko kelgende aga sakchylyk kylgan perishteler anyn eshikterin achyshat zhana alardy zhemelelegen abalda: <<Silerge Rabbin'er taraptan tushkon aiattardy okup bergen, kyiamat kundogu katuu azaptar bolgon zholugushuu tuuraluu korkutup eskertken, ozun'ordon bolgon paigambarlar kelgen zhok bele?>> - dep tosup alyshat. Kaapyrlyk kylgandar moiundaryna alyp: <<Ooba, oshonun baarysy bolgon. Birok azap sozu kaapyrlardyn bashyna tushoru mildet eken. Biz kaapyrlardan bolchubuz>> - dep aityshat.

Alardy kordosh uchun zhana Allakhtyn meeriminen zhana tozokton chyguuga umutsuz kylysh uchun alarga aitylat: <<Siler tuboluk kala turgan tozoktun eshikterinen kirgile! Akyikatka tekeberlik kylgandardyn zhaiy kandai zhaman!>>.

Al emi Rabbisinin buiruktaryn atkaryp, Anyn tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkon yimanduulardy perishteler sypaiylyk, syi-urmat menen top-top kylyp beiishke alyp kelishet. Kachan alar beiishke kelgende anyn eshikteri achylat. Zhana aga sakchylyk kylgan perishteler alarga: <<Silerge zhakpagan bardyk nerselerden zhana butkul zhamandyktardan salamattyk bolsun! Zhurogun'or da, ishin'er da taza boldu. Emi siler tuboluk kala turgan beiishke kirgile!>> - dep aityshat.

Yimanduular beiishke kirgende: <<Paigambarlardyn tili menen bizge bergen ubadasyn atkargan Allakhka maktoolor bolsun! Al bizdi beiishke kirgizem, beiish zherine muraskor kylam dep ubada kylgan. Emi biz anyn kaalagan zherinen orun alabyz. Rabbisinin Zhuzun kaalap zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandardyn syilygy kandai sonun!>> - dep aityshat.

Bul uluu kundo perishteler Allakhty kaapyrlardyn aitkan Aga ylaiyksyz sozdorunon aruulap, Arshty tegerektep turushat zhana Allakh bardyk makuluktardyn ortosunda adilettik menen okum kylat. Kaalaganyn urmattait, kaalaganyn azaptait. Zhana aitylat: <<Yimanduularga yraiymduuluk menen, kaapyrlarga azap menen okum kylgan butkul makuluktardyn Rabbisi Allakhka maktoolor bolsun!>>.
(Hm) Khaa-miim. Ushuga okshogon aiattyn tushundurmosu bakara suroosunun bashynda kelgen.
Kurandyn baaryn ustom keluuchu Kudurettuu, pendelerinin paidasyn Biluuchu Allakh tarabynan elchisi Mukhammadka tushuusu.

Al kunookorlordun kunoolorun Kechiruuchu, toobo kylgan pendelerinin toobolorun kabyl kyluuchu, kunooloruno toobo kylbagandardy katuu zhazaloochu, zhakshylyk zhana aikolduk Eesi. Zhalgyz Ozu gana syiynuuga tatyktuu zhana kyiamatta pendelerdin baarysy zhalgyz Aga gana kaityp baryshat. Oshondo alarga tatyktuu bolgon zhazasyn zhe syilygyn beret.

Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygyna zhana paigambarlardyn chynchyldygyna dalil bolgon aiat-belgilerge akyly buzuk kaapyrlar gana karshy chygyp talashyshat. Alar uchun kaigyrba zhana alarga berilgen kenen yryskyga, zhyrgalchylyktarga azgyrylba! Alarga moonottun berilishi - bul alardy akyryndyk menen zhazaloo zhana alarga karata koldonulgan ailakerlik.

Alardan murun Nukhtun eli zhalganga chygaryshty, Nukhtun koomunan kiiin zhamaattar zhalganga chygaryshkan, Aad zhana Samud koomdoru, Luttun koomu, Madiian eeleri zhalganga chygaryshty, oshondoi ele Faraon da zhalganga chygardy. Ar bir koom alarga kelgen paigambardy karmap olturuunu kozdoshtu. Akyikatty zhok kyluu uchun zhalgandy aityp talashyp-tartyshty. Oshondo Men oshol koomdordun baarysyn karmadym. Menin alardy zhazaloom kandai boldu dep oiloisun'. Oto kataal zhaza boldu.
Oo, paigambar! Allakh al zhalganchy koomdordun zhok bolushun okum kylgan syiaktuu, alarga Rabbin'din kaapyrlyk kylgandar tozok adamdary degen sozu mildet boldu.

Oo, paigambar! Rabbin'din Arshyn kotorgon zhana anyn ailanasynda turgan perishteler Rabbisin Aga ylaiyk kelbegen nerselerden aruulashat, aga yiman keltirishet zhana Allakhka yiman keltirgenderge kechirim tilep duba kylyshat: <<Rabbibiz! Senin ilimin' zhana yraiymyn' butkul nerseni kamtyp turat. Kunooloruno toobo kylgandardy, dinin'di eerchigenderdi kechir zhana alardy tozokko tiigizbei sakta!>>.

Perishteler aityshat: <<Rabbibiz! Yimanduulardy Ozun' kirgizem dep ubada kylgan beiishke kirgiz zhana alar menen birge zhakshy ishterdi kylgan ata-babalaryn, zhubailaryn zhana bala-chakalaryn kirgiz. Chyndygynda Sen ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuusun', tagdyr kyluuda zhana bashkaruuda Daanyshmansyn'.

Alardy kylgan ishterinin zhamandygynan sakta, amaldary uchun alardy azaptaba. Kyiamatta kimdi kylgan zhaman ishterinin zhazasynan saktasan', demek aga yraiym kylgan bolosun'. Bul azaptan saktoo zhana beiishke kiruu arkyluu yraiymga zhetuu myna ushul ten'deshsiz uluu zhen'ish.

Allakhka zhana Anyn elchilerine kaapyrlyk kylgandar kyiamatta tozokko kirgende ozdorun zhek korup, kargysh aityp myndai dep chakyryk salyshat: <<Allakhtyn silerge bolgon zhek koruusu - ozun'ordu zhek korgondon da kuchtuu. Antkeni duinodo silerdi Allakhka yiman keltiruugo chakyrganda Aga kaapyrlyk kyldyn'ar, Any menen katar bashkalardy kudai tuttun'ar>>.

Kaapyrlarga toobo kyluu zhana moiunga aluu paida berbegen kezde alar kunoolorun moiundaryna alyp myndai dep aityshty: <<Rabbibiz! Sen bizdi zhok kezibizde eki zholu olturup, kaira zharattyn'. Kiiin oshol zharatuudan kiiin bizdi kaira olturdun'. Zhana bizdi kaira tiriltuu menen zhokton bar kylyp eki zholu tirilttin'. Biz kylgan kunoolorubuzdu moinubuzga alabyz. Biz uchun tozokton chyguunun zholu barby, biz zhashoogo kaira kaityp, zhakshy ishterdi kylaly, oshondo Sen bizden yraazy bolosun'?!>>.

Silerge berilgen azaptyn sebebi - silerdi Allakhka ech kimdi sherik kylbastan, Aga gana syiynuuga chakyrganda, Aga kaapyrlyk kyldyn'ar, Aga sherikterdi koshtun'ar. Egerde Allakh menen katar kaisy bir sherikke syiyngan bolso, aga ishendin'er. Okum kyluu zhalgyz Allakhtyn Ozuno gana taandyk. Al Oz Zaty, kudureti, ustomdugu menen Biiik, butkul nerseden zhogoru bolgon Uluk.

Allakh silerge Ozunun kudurettuulugun zhana zhalgyzdygyn bildirish uchun meikindikte zhana ozun'ordo aiat-belgilerdi korgozot. Oshondoi ele osumduktor zhana eginzarlar syiaktuu yryskyn'arga sebep bolush uchun asmandan zhamgyr suusun tushurdu. Allakhtyn aiat-belgilerinen Aga chyn yklastan toobo kylyp kaitkan adamdar gana sabak alyshat.
Oo, yimanduular! Kaapyrlar zhaman korup, kyzhyrlansa da Allakhka shirk kylbastan, Aga chyn yklastan bash iiip zhana duba kylyp zhalbargyla.

Al - adamdardyn Aga chyn yklastan duba kylyp kairyluusuna zhana bash iiuusuno tatyktuu. Al butkul makuluktardan darazhasy Biiik zhana uluu Arshtyn Eesi.
