Al pendelerin zhandantuu uchun zhana alar bashkalardy zhandandyruulary uchun, oshondoi ele abalkylar menen akyrkylar chogulgan kyiamat kununon adamdardy korkutush uchun pendelerinen Ozu kaalaganyna vakhii tushurot.

Al kunu alar achyk turdo bir zherge chogulushat. Allakhka alardyn ech bir nersesi zhashyruun bolboit, ozdoru da, ishteri da, syilyk-zhazalary da zhashyruun bolboit. Al: <<Bugun biilik kimge taandyk?>> - dep surait. Oshondo anyn bir gana zhoobu bolot: <<Biilik Oz Zatynda, sypattarynda zhana ish-araketterinde Zhalgyz bolgon zhana butkul nersege ustomduk kylgan, butkul nerseler Aga gana bash iigen Kaarduu Allakhka gana taandyk>>.

Al kunu ar bir zhan kylgan ishine zharasha zhazasyn alat, zhakshylyk bolso zhakshylyk, zhamandyk bolso zhamandyk. Al kunu ech kandai zulumduk bolboit. Antkeni okum kyluu adilettuu Allakh. Chyndygynda Allakh pendelerin toluk bilgeni sebeptuu alardy tezdik menen surakka aluuchu.

Oo, paigambar! Alardy kyiamat kunu menen korkut. Al zhakyndap kalgan kyiamat kelet, al emi keleri kutulgon ar bir nerse zhakyn. Al kundo zhuroktor katuu korkunuchtan ulam adamdardyn alkymyna tygylyp, Yraiymduu alardyn arasynan uruksat bergenderi gana suiloi alyshat. Shirk zhana kunoo kylyp ozdoruno zyian bergen zaalymdar uchun ech kandai dos, zhakyn zhana aga oz erki menen shapaat kyluuchu bolboit.
Allakh adamdardyn baikatpai tiktegen kyianat koz karashyn da bilet. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.

Allakh adilettik menen okum kylat. Ech kimge kylgan zhakshylyktary kemitilip zhe kunooloru koboitulup zulumduk kylynbait. Al emi mushrikter syiyngan Allakhtan bashka kudailary ech nerseni okum kyla alyshpait. Antkeni alar ech bir nersege ee emes. Chyndygynda Allakh pendelerinin sozdorun Uguuchu, alardyn nietterin zhana ishterin Koruuchu. Zhakynda al uchun alarga syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Mushrikter zher betin kezip, alardan murunku zhalganchy koomdordun akybeti kandai bolgonun oilonup korushpoibu? Alardyn akybeti zhamandyk menen butkon. Al koomdor bulardan kyila kuchtuu bolushkan zhana bular kaltyrbagandai imarattardy kaltyryshkan. Allakh alardy kunooloru sebeptuu zhok kyldy. Alardy Allakhtyn zhazasynan ech bir nerse korgop kala algan zhok.

Alardyn bashyna tushkon al azaptyn sebebi - alarga Allakh taraptan achyk-aikyn dalilder menen paigambarlar kelishken, birok alar Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyshty zhana paigambarlaryn zhalganga chygaryshty. Alardyn oshoncholuk kuchtuuluguno karabastan, Allakh alardy karmap turup zhok kyldy. Chyndygynda Al kaapyrlyk kylgandarga zhana paigambarlaryn zhalganga chygargandarga Kubattuu zhana zhazasy kataal.

Paigambar koomunun zhalganga chygaruusuna duushar bolgondo, anyn akybeti zhen'ish bolo turgandygyn suiunchulop, Musa menen Faraondun okuiasyn baiandap, myndai dedi:
Biz Musany achyk aiat-belgileribiz menen, keskin dalilderibiz menen zhiberdik.
Any Faraongo, anyn vaziri Khamanga zhana Karunga zhiberdik. Alar: <<Musa syikyrchy zhana paigambarmyn dep aityp zhatkan sozundo zhalganchy>> - deshti.

Kachan Musa alarga ozunun chynchyldygyn bildirgen dalil menen kelgende Faraon: <<Munu menen birge yiman keltirgendin baldaryn olturgulo, alar uchun korduk katary aialdaryn tiruu kaltyrgyla>> - dedi. Kaapyrlardyn yimanduulardyn sanyn azaitkyla dep buirup aila-amal kylyshkany ech nersege zharabait, taasiri da bolboit.

Faraon aitty: <<Meni tospogula, men Musany ozum zhazalap olturom. Emi al Rabbisine sakta dep zhalbarsyn. Birok men anyn zhalbarganyna karabaim. Menin korkkonum - al silerdin tutungan dinin'erdi ozgortup zhiberet zhe zher betinde olturuu, talkaloo syiaktuu buzukuluktar zhaiylat>>.

Kachan Musa Faraondun any korkutkanyn bilgende myndai dedi: <<Men ozumdun Rabbimden zhana silerdin Rabbin'erden akyikatka zhana aga ishenuugo tekeberlik kylgan, kyiamat kunundogu surak zhana zhazaga yiman keltirbegen adamdardan korgoosun suraimyn>>.

Oshondo Faraondun tuugandarynan bolgon, adamdardan yimanyn zhashyryp zhurgon bir kishi alardyn Musany olturobuz degen oilorun chetke kagyp myndai dedi: <<Siler ech kandai kunoosu bolbogon, Rabbim - Allakh degeni uchun ele adamdy olturo beresin'erbi?! Al silerge Allakh taraptan kelgen elchimin degen sozunun chyndyk ekendigin tastyktagan dalilderdi alyp keldi go?! Egerde al zhalgan aitkan bolso, anda zhalganynyn zyiany ozuno tiet. A eger aitkan sozu chyn bolso, anda al silerge ubada kylyp zhatkan kee bir azaptar kop otpoi oz bashyn'arga tushup zhurbosun. Chyndygynda Allakh Anyn chekterinen chykkandardy, Aga zhana paigambarlaryna zhalaa zhapkandardy akyikat zholgo salbait.

Oo, elim! Misir zherindegi ustom biilik silerdin gana kolun'arda. Eger Musany olturgon uchun bizge Allakhtyn azaby kelse, bizdi andan kim kutkarat?>>. Faraon aitty: <<Menin oium - chechuuchu oi, menin okumum - chechuuchu okum. Menin oium - zhamandykty zhana buzukuluktu tosush uchun Musany olturush kerek. Men silerdi tuura nersege gana bagyttaim>>.

Yiman keltirgen adam eline naasat kylyp aitty: <<Egerde siler zulumduk, kankorduk kylyp Musany olturchu bolson'or, anda men silerdin bashyn'arga murunkular syiaktuu zhamaat-zhamaat bolup paigambarlaryna karshy birigiship, kiiin Allakh alardy zhok kylgandai azap keluusunon korkomun.

Nukh koomu, Aad zhana Samud, oshondoi ele alardan kiiinki kelgender syiaktuu kaapyrlyk kylgandardy zhana paigambarlardy zhalganga chygargandardy - kaapyrlyktary zhana paigambarlardy zhalganga chygaryshkany uchun Allakh alardy zhok kyldy. Allakh pendelerine zulumduktu kaalabait. Al alarga ozdoruno ylaiyk zhaza berip, kunooloru uchun gana azaptait.

Oo, elim! Chyndygynda men siler uchun kyiamat kununon korkomun. Al kunu adamdar tuugandygy zhe kadyr-barktuulugu oshondoi korkunuchtuu abalda alarga zhardam beret degen oido biri-birin atap chakyryshat.

Siler al kunu tozokton artyn'ardy karabai zhandalbastap kachasyn'ar. Silerdi Allakhtyn azabynan korgop kala turgandai ech bir nerse bolboit. Allakh kimdi zhardamsyz tashtap, yiman keltiruugo iigilik berbese, anda any ech kim tuura zholgo sala albait. Antkeni tuura zholgo iigilik beruu Allakhtyn gana kolunda.

Musaga cheiin Iusuf da silerge Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygyna achyk dalilderdi alyp kelgen. Siler bolso al alyp kelgen nersege shektenip, zhalganga chygardyn'ar. Kachan al olgondo shek-kumon kyluun'ar kuch alyp: <<Allakh andan kiiin paigambar zhiberbeit>> - dedin'er. Silerdin akyikattan adashkanyn'ar syiaktuu Allakh bardyk chekten chykkandardy, Anyn zhalgyzdygyna shektengenderdi adashtyrat.

Allakhtyn aiat-belgilerin zhokko chygaruu uchun dalilsiz talashyp-tartyshkandardyn bul kylgany - Allakhtyn aldynda, Aga zhana paigambarlarga yiman keltirgenderdin aldynda ushunchalyk zhek korunchu ish. Bizdin aiat-belgileribizdi zhokko chygaruu maksatta talashyp-tartyshkandyn zhuroktoruno Allakh moor baskan syiaktuu akyikatka tekeberlik kylgandardyn da zhuroktoruno moor basty. Al alardy tuuralykka bagyttabait zhana zhakshylykka zhol korgozboit.
Faraon vaziri Khamanga aitty: <<Ei, Khaman! Maga biiik imarat kurchu, men zholdorgo zhetsem deim.

Balkim asmandarga zhetkirgen zholdorgo zhetsem, Musanyn chynygy syiynuuga tatyktuu degen kudaiyn korot elem. Birok men Musanyn aityp zhatkan sozdorun zhalgan dep oiloim>>. Kachan Faraon Khamandan oshonu talap kylganda anyn kylgan ishinin zhamandygy aga kooz korgozuldu zhana akyikat zholdon chygyp, adashuu zholuna tushtu. Faraondun zhalgandy ustom kylam, Musa alyp kelgen akyikatty zhokko chygaram degen aila-amaly zhokko uchurady. Antkeni anyn akybeti - ishinin on'unan chykpashyna, araketinin zhokko uchurashyna zhana ech kachan butpogon baktysyzdykka alyp barat.

Faraondun tuugandarynan bolgon yimanduu adam oz koomuna nasaat kylyp, alardy akyikat zholgo bagyttap myndai dep aitty: <<Oo, elim! Meni eerchigile, men silerge tuura zholdu zhana akyikatka karai bagytty korgozom.

Oo, elim! Chyndygynda bul duino zhashoosu ubaktyluu gana yrakhat. Andyktan al silerdi ubaktyluu yrakhattar menen aldap koibosun. Al emi akyret zhaiy - ech kachan tugonbogon zhyrgalchylyktarga tolgon, tuboluk kala turgan zhai. Allakhka moiun sunuu menen aga zhetuugo araket kylgyla zhana akyret ishterin tashtap, duino zhashoosu menen gana alek boluudan sak bolgula.

Kimde-kim kunoo ish kylsa, anda al oshol ishine zharasha gana zhazasyn alat, aga ashykcha zhaza berilbeit. Al emi erkek bolobu zhe aial bolobu, Allakhka zhana paigambarlarga yiman keltirip, Anyn zhuzun kaalap zhakshylyk ish kylsa, anda ushundai asyl sypattarga ee bolgon adamdar kyiamat kunu beiishke kirishet. Al zhaida Allakh alarga Ozu daiardap koigon momo-zhemishterden zhana tugonbogon tuboluk zhyrgalchylyktardan esepsiz yrysky kylyp beret.

Oo, elim! Men silerdi bul duinodo zhana akyrette Allakhka yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylyp kyiroodon aman kaluuga chykyryp zhatsam, anda emnege siler meni Allakhka kaapyrlyk kyluuga, Aga bash iibestikke undop tozokko kiruugo chakyryp zhatasyn'ar?!

Siler meni Allakhka kaapyr bolup, Any menen katar syiynuuga tuura keler-kelbestigin bilbesten turup Andan bashkaga syiynat degen umutto meni zhalganyn'arga chakyryp zhatasyn'ar. A men bolso silerdi zhen'ilbes Kudurettuu, pendelerine cheksiz Kechirimduu Allakhka yiman keltiruugo chakyryp zhatam.

Akyikatta siler meni yiman keltiruugo zhana moiun sunuuga chakyryp zhatkan kudaiyn'ar bul duinodo zhana akyrette bir da zholu duba kylynuuga tatyktuu emes, al duba kylgandarga zhoop da bere albait. Zhana baarybyz Allakhtyn Ozuno kaityp barabyz, al emi kaapyrlykta, zhana kunoo kyluuda chekten chykkandar - myna osholor kyiamat kunu tozokko tusho turgan adamdar>>.

Alar anyn nasaatyn kabyldashkan zhok. Oshondo al aitty: <<Menin silerge aitkan nasaatymdy kiiin esteisin'er, kabyl albai koigonun'arga katuu okunosun'or. Men butkul ishimdi Allakhka gana tapshyram. Chyndygynda pendelerdin kylgan ishterinin ech biri Allakhka zhashyruun emes>>.

Alar any olturobuz deshkende Allakh any alardyn aila-amaldarynan saktap kaldy. Al emi Faraondun ui-bulosun suuga chokturuu azaby orop aldy. Allakh any zhana bardyk askerin bul duinodo suuga chokturdu.

Alar olgondon kiiin erten' menen zhana kechinde alardyn kabyrlarynda tozok otu korgozulup turat. Al emi kyiamat kunu aitylat: <<Faraondu eerchigenderdi katuu zhana kataal azapka kirgizgile! Antkeni alar kaapyrlyk kylyshty, zhalganga chygaryshty zhana Allakhtyn zholunan tosushtu>>.

Oo, paigambar! Estechi, tozokko tushkondordon bolgon eerchigender zhana eerchitkender oz ara talashyp-tartyshyshat. Oshondo eerchigen alsyzdar alardy eerchitken tekeber zhol bashchylaryna aityshat: <<Chyndygynda biz duinodo adashuuda silerdi eerchigenbiz. Emi siler bizdi Allakhtyn azabynan bir az bolso da arylta alasyn'arby?>>.

Eerchitken tebeker zhol bashchylary aityshty: <<Chyndygynda eerchitkenderibiz da, eerchigenderibiz da tozoktobuz. Arabyzdan ech kim bashkanyn azabyn kotorboit. Chyndygynda Allakh pendelerinin ortosunda okum kylyp, alardyn ar birine tytyktuu bolgon azapty berdi>>.

Tozokto azaptalyp zhatkandardyn arasynan eerchigenderi da, eerchitkenderi da tozokton chyguudan zhana duino zhashoosuna kaityp toobo kyluudan umut uzushkondo tozoktun sakchy perishtelerine aityshty: <<Rabbin'erden bizdegi tuboluk azapty bir kungo bolso da zhen'ildetsin dep zhalbaryp suragylachy>>.

Tozok sakchylary kaapyrlarga: <<Silerge paigambarlaryn'ar achyk-aikyn dalilder menen kelgen zhok bele?>> - dep surashkanda kaapyrlar aityshty: <<Ooba, alar bizge achyk-aikyn dalilder menen kelishken>>. Sakchylar alardy shyldyn'dap: <<Anda ozun'or zhalbargyla! Biz kaapyrlarga ortomchu bolo albaibyz. Kaapyrlardyn zhalynyp-zhalbargandary alardyn kaapyrlygy sebeptuu kabyl kylynbastan tekke ketet>> - dep aityshty.

Kachan Allakh Faraondun okuiasy tuuraluu, anyn zhana any eerchigenderdin eki duinodogu akybeti tuuraluu soz kylganda any menen katar paigambarlar zhana yimanduular tuuraluu zhana alardyn eki duinodo zhetishken zhen'ishteri tuuraluu aityp myndai dedi:
Chyndygynda Biz paigambarlardy zhana bul duinodo Allakhka zhana Anyn elchilerine yiman keltirgenderdi dalilderin ustom kylyp, alardy dushmandaryna karshy koldop zhardam berebiz. Oshondoi ele alarga koldoo korgozup, alardy beiishke kirgizebiz, dushmandaryn bul duinodo zhazalaibyz zhana akyrette alarga paigambarlardy, perishtelerdi zhana yimanduulardy daavattyn zhetkenine zhana alardyn zhalganga chygargandaryna kubo kylyp tozokko kirgizebiz.

Al kundo kaapyrlyk zhana kunoo kylyp ozdoruno zulumduk kylgandarga al tuuraluu shyltooloru paida berbeit. Alar al kunu Allakhtyn yraiymynan kuup salynat zhana akyrette alar uchun zhan kyinagan azapka tush kyluuchu en' zhaman zhai bar.
Biz Musaga Israil urpaktaryn akyikatka bagyttagan ilimdi berdik zhana Tooratty muundan-muunga muras bolup otkon kitep kylyp koiduk.
Al akyikat zholgo karai bagyt zhana tuura akyl zhugurtkondor uchun eskertme.

Oo, paigambar! Elin'din seni zhalganga chygarganyna zhana alardyn zyiandaryna sabyr kyl! Chyndygynda Allakhtyn seni koldoim zhana zhen'ishke zhetkirem degen ubadasy shek-kumonsuz chyndyk. Oshondoi ele kunoon' uchun kechirim sura zhana erten' menen zhana kechinde Rabbin'e maktoolordu aityp aruula!

Allakhtyn aiat-belgilerin ech daiyn-dalilsiz ele zhokko chygaruuga araket kylyp talashyp-tartyshkandardyn myndai ishke baruusuna, alardyn boi kotoruusu zhana akyikatty moiundabagan tekeberligi turtup zhatat. Alar boi kotoruu menen kozdogonuno zhete albait. O, paigambar! Allakhtan korgoo suragyn! Chynynda, Al pendelerinin sozdorun Uguuchu, ish-araketterin Koruuchu. Amaldardyn ech biri Aga bilinbei kalbait, zhana oshol amalyna zharasha alarga syiyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Akyikatta ebegeisiz chon' zhana ken' bolgon asmandar menen zherdi zharatuu - adamdardy zharatkandan da uluu nerse. Al ekoosunun uluuluguna karabastan alardy zharatkan Allakh - oluktordu da kabyrlarynan surak zhana zhaza-syilyk uchun kairadan tiriltuugo kudurettuu. Birok adamdardyn kopchulugu bilishpeit, sabak alyshpait zhana munu aikyndygyna karabastan kaira tiriluugo dalil kylyshpait.

Kozu korgon adam menen korbogon adam ten' emes. Oshondoi ele Allakhka yiman keltirip, paigambarlardyn chynchyldygyn tastyktap, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandar menen buzuku ishenim zhana kunoolor sebeptuu zhamandyk ishterdi kylgandar ten' emes. Siler oto az gana ulgu alasyn'ar. Eger siler ulgu alganyn'arda, anda bul eki toptun aiyrmasyn bilmeksin'er, Allakhtyn yraazylygyn kozdop yiman keltirgenderden zhana zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandardan boluuga zhantalashmaksyn'ar.
Chyndygynda Allakh surak zhana zhaza-syilyk uchun oluktordu kaira tiriltken Saat sozsuz kelet. Birok kopchuluk adamdar anyn kelishine ishenishpeit. Oshonduktan aga daiardyk korushpoit.

Ei, adamdar! Rabbin'er aitty: <<Zhalgyz Maga syiyngyla zhana Menden suragyla, Men silerdin duban'arga zhoop berem, silerdi kechirem zhana yraiym kylam. Chyndygynda Maga gana syiynbastan tekeberlik kylgandar kyiamatta kor bolgon abalda tozokko kirishet>>.

Allakh siler es aluun'ar uchun tundu karan'gy kylyp koidu zhana tirichilik kyluun'ar uchun kunduzdu zharyk kylyp koidu. Chyndygynda Allakh adamdarga zhalpy zhana zheke zhakshylyktardy bergen uluu artykchylyk Eesi. Birok adamdardyn kopchulugu Allakhtyn alarga bergen zhakshylyktaryna shugur kylyshpait.

Silerge zhakshylyktardy bergen ushul Allakh - Al butkul nerselerdin Zharatuuchusu, Andan bashka Zharatuuchu zhok, Al Ozu gana syiynuuga tatyktuu. Anan kandaicha siler Allakhka syiynbastan turup, kaidagy bir paida da, zyian da bere albagan bashka nerselerge syiynyp zhatasyn'ar?!

Al alardy Allakhka yiman keltirip, zhalgyz Aga syiynuudan burgany symal, Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygyn bildirgen aiat-belgilerdi chetke kakkandardy da bardyk zherde, bardyk uchurda andan burup koiot, alardy akyikatka bagyttabait zhana tuuralykka iigilik berbeit.

Oo, adamdar! Allakh silerge zherdi zhailanyshuuga yn'gailuu zhai kylyp koidu zhana ustun'ordogu asmandy urap ketpei turgandai bekem kylyp kurup koidu. Oshondoi ele silerdi enen'erdin kursagynda en' sonun kelbette zharatty. Silerge tamak-ashtyn adalyn zhana tazasyn yrysky kyldy. Silerge ushundai zhakshylyktardy bergen - Rabbin'er Allakh. Butkul makuluktardyn Rabbisi Allakh yiyk boldu. Alardyn Andan bashka Rabbisi zhok.

Al tuboluk Tiruu, ech kachan olboit. Andan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok. Andyktan Anyn gana Zhuzun kaalap, Aga syiynyp zhana surap duba kylgyla! Aga makuluktardy ten'ep shirk kylbagyla! Makuluktardyn Rabbisi Allakhka maktoolor bolsun!

Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Maga kudailaryn'arga syiynuunun zhalgan ekendigine achyk-aikyn dalilder kelgen kezde Allakh meni siler Any menen katar syiyngan, paida da zyian da bere albagan aikelderin'erge syiynuumdu tyidy zhana zhalgyz Aga gana syiynyp moiun sunuumdu buirudu. Al butkul makuluktardyn Rabbisi, alardyn Andan bashka Rabbisi zhok.

Al silerdin tupku atan'ar Adamdy topuraktan zharatty. Andan kiiin silerdi bel suudan, andan son' uiugan kandan zharatyp, kiiin silerdi kichinekei ymyrkai kylyp enen'erdin kursagynan chygardy. Andan son' denen'er kuchko tolgon kurakka zhettin'er, kiiin chon'oiup oturup karylyk kurakka keldin'er, aran'ardan kee birler aga zhetpei olgondor bolot. Oshondoi ele Allakhtyn iliminde belgiluu moonotko cheiin zhettin'er, andan kemigen da zhok, aga koshulgan da zhok. Balkim siler Allakhtyn kudurettuulugun zhana zhalgyzdygyn bildirgen ushul dalilderden paida alarsyn'ar.
Tiriltuu da, olturuu da Anyn gana kolunda. Egerde Al bir ishke okum kylsa, anda al ishke <<bol!>> dep gana aitat, al oshol zamat ishke ashat.

Oo, paigambar! Allakhtyn aiat-belgilerinin achyk-aikyndygyna karabastan alardy zhalgan dep talashyp-tartyshkandardy karabaisyn'by?! Alardyn achyk kelgen akyikattan zhuz burgan abaldaryna tan' kalasyn'!
Alar Kurandy zhana paigambarlarybyzga zhibergen akyikatty zhalganga chygaryshty. Zhakynda al zhalganchylar zhalgandyn akybeti kandai bolorun bilishet, anyn arty zhaman ekenin korushot.
Alar anyn akybetin moiundary kishendelgende, buttary chynzhyrlanganda zhana azap perishteleri suirogondo bilishet.
Alardy burkuldap kainagan ysyk suuga suiroshot. Kiiin tozokto kuiushot.
Kiiin alarga zheme katary myndai dep aitylat: <<Siler sherik kylyp syiyngan zhalgan kudailaryn'ar kaida?

Paida da, zyian da bere albagan Allakhtan bashka aikelderin'er?>>. Kaapyrlar aityshty: <<Alar bizge korunboi zhok bolup ketishti. Biz duinodo syiynuuga tatyktuu dep ech kimge syiyngan emespiz>>. Allakh osholordu adashtyrgany syiaktuu kaapyrlardy da bardyk zherde zhana zamanda akyikattan adashtyrat.
Alarga aitylat: <<Siler tartkan bul azap - shirk kylganyn'ar zhana ashykcha kuturup suiunuchko batkanyn'ar sebeptuu berildi.
Siler tuboluk kala turgan tozoktun eshikterinen kirgile! Akyikatka tekeberlik kylgandardyn zhaiy kandai zhaman!>>.

Kachan Allakhtyn elchisi oz elinen ar kandai zapkylardy korgondo Allakh any sabyr kyluuga buirudu zhana zhen'ish tuuraluu ubadasy menen anyn kon'ulun' soorotup myndai dep aitty:
Oo, paigambar! Elin'din saga korgozgon zapkysyna zhana zhalgandaryna sabyr kyl! Chyndygynda Allakhtyn saga ubada kylgan zhen'ishi sheksiz chyndyk. Biz saga Badr kunundogudoi alarga ubadalangan azaptyn kee birlerin tiruun'do korgozobuz zhe aga cheiin ele zhanyn'dy alabyz. Siler kyiamatta Bizge gana kaityp kelesin'er, oshondo Biz alardyn ish-araketterinin zhazasyn berip, alardy tuboluk tozokko kirgizebiz.

Oo, paigambar! Biz saga cheiin koptogon paigambarlardy ozunun ummottoruno zhibergenbiz. Alar paigambarlardy zhalganga chygaryp, yza berishti, birok alardyn kylygyna, zapkylaryna paigambarlar sabyr kylyshty. Oshol paigambarlardyn kee birleri tuuraluu saga aityp berdik, kee birlerin aitkan zhokpuz. Ech bir paigambar Rabbisi kaalamaiyncha oz eline keremet-muzhiza korsoto albait. Kaapyrlardyn oz koomdoruna keremet-muzhiza alyp kelsin degen talaby - zulumduk. Egerde Allakh taraptan paigambarlar menen koomdorunun ortosun azhyratuu zhe zhen'ish beruu tuuraluu buiruk kelse, anda Al alardyn ortosun adilettik menen azhyratyp, kaapyrlardy zhok kylat zhana paigambarlardy saktap kalat. Pendelerdin ortosu azhyratylgan oshol ubakta zhalganchylar kaapyrlygynyn aiynan ozdorun kyiroogo tush kylyshat.
Allakh siler uchun toolordu, uilardy zhana koilordu zharatty, alardyn kee birlerin minesin'er, kee birlerinin etin zheisin'er.

Bul zhandyktarda siler uchun ar bir zamanda zhan'yryp turgan turduu paidalar bar. Siler alar arkyluu ozun'ordogu kaalagan muktazhdyktarga zhetesin'er. Alardyn en' belgiluusu -- den'izde zhana kurgaktykta minip zhurosun'or.
Allakh silerge Anyn kudurettuulugun zhana zhalgyzdygyn bildirgen aiat-belgilerdi korgozot. Siler Allakhtyn aiat-belgisi ekenine ynangandan kiiin alardyn kaisy birin moinun'arga albai koiosun'ar?

Al zhalganchylar zher betin kezishpeibi, alardan murunku zhalganchy koomdordun arty kandai butkonuno oi zhugurtup, alardan sabak alyshpaiby?! Al koomdor bulardan da bai, kuch-kubattuu bolushkan, zher betinde alardan kop tarykhyi estelikterdi kalgan. Alarga Allakhtyn kyiratuuchu azaby kelgende kuch-kubattuulugu alarga ech paida bergen zhok.

Kachan alarga paigambarlary achyk-aikyn dalilder menen kelishkende alardy zhalganga chygaryshty zhana paigambarlar alyp kelgenge karshy kelgen ozdorundogu ilimdi gana karmanuuga yraazy bolushtu. Alardy paigambarlary korkutkanda maskaralap kulushkon azap alardyn bashyna tushtu.

Kachan alar azabybyzdy korgondo ech kandai ishenim paida berbegen uchurda moiundaryna alyp: <<Biz zhalgyz Allakhka yiman keltirdik zhana Andan bashka syiyngan sherikterterge zhana aikelderge kaapyrlyk kyldyk>> - dep aityshat.

Birok alar Bizdin azabybyzdy oz kozu menen korgondo yiman keltirgenderi ech paida berbeit. Alar azapty korgon kezde yimandary paida berbeit degen - Allakhtyn pendelerine zhurgon okum zholu. Kaapyrlar Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyshkany sebeptuu zhana azapty korgongo cheiin toobo kylyshpagany sebeptuu azap tushkon kezde ozdorun kyiroogo uchuratyshty.
(Hm) Khaa-miim. Ushuga okshogon aiattyn tushundurmosu bakara suroosunun bashynda kelgen.
Bul Kuran Yraiymduu, Meerimduu Allakh taraptan tushurulgon.
Al aiattary en' toluk den'geelde baiandalgan Kitep zhana al bilgen adamdar uchun arabcha Kuran kylyndy. Antkeni alar anyn maanilerinen zhana andagy akyikatka karai bagyttamalardan paida alyshat.

Allakhtyn yimanduularga daiardagan uluu syilygyn suiunchuloochu, kaapyrlardy Allakhtyn zhan kyinagan azaby menen korkutuuchu. Birok alardyn kopchulugu zhuz burup ketishti. Alar andagy tuura zholdu kabyl aluu menen kunt koiup ugushpait.

Alar aityshty: <<Bizdin zhuroktorubuzdu tosmolor chulgap kalgan, alar sen chakyrgan nersege akyl zhugurto alyshpait. Kulaktarybyz duloilukton any uga alyshpait. Seni menen bizdin ortobuzda tosmo bolgonu uchun senin aitkan sozdorun bizge zhetpeit. Sen oz zholun'da araketin'di kyl, biz dagy oz zholubuzda araketibizdi kylaly. Biz seni ech kachan eerchibeibiz>>.

Oo, paigambar! Al karshy chykkandarga aitkyn: <<Chyndygynda men silerge okshogon ele adammyn. Allakh maga: <<Silerdin chynygy zhalgyz kudaiyn'ar - Allakh>> - dep vakhii kyldy. Andyktan Aga zhetkirgen zholgo tushkulo zhana Andan kunoolorun'du kechiruusun suragyla! Allakhtan bashkaga syiyngan zhe bashkany Aga sherik kylgan mushrikterge kyiroo zhana azap bolsun!>>.
Al emi mal-mulkunon zeket berbegender bolso tuboluk zhyrgalchylyktar zhana zhan oorutkan azaptar bolgon akyretke kaapyr bolgondor.
Al emi Allakhka zhana paigambarlaryna yiman keltirgenderdin, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandardyn syilygy ech kachan butpogon tuboluktuu beiish bolot.

Oo, paigambar! Mushrikterdi zhemelep myndai dep ait: <<Zherdi eki kundo, zhekshembi zhana duishombu kundoru zharatkan Allakhka emnege kaapyrlyk kylyp zhatasyn'ar zhana Andan bashkalarga syiynyp, alardy Aga sherik kylyp zhatasyn'ar? Al butkul makuluktardyn Rabbisi>>.

Murdagy eki kungo b.a. sheishembi zhana sharshembi kundoruno tort kun koshup, al kundoru zher ustuno al silkinboosu uchun bekem toolordu ornottu zhana adamdardyn, zhan-zhanybarlardyn azyk-ookattaryn olchop belgilep koidu. Muna al tuuraluu suroonu kaalagandar uchun (aitty).

Andan son' asmandy zharatuuga bet aldy. Oshol kezde al tutun bolchu. Oshondo aga zhana Zherge kairylyp: <<Oz yktyiaryn'ar menen zhe mazhbur turdo Menin buiruguma moiun sunup kelgile! Siler myndan kacha albaisyn'ar>> - degende alar: <<Moiun sunup keldik. Oo, Rabbibiz! Biz uchun Senin kaaloon'don bashka kaaloo zhok>> - deshti.

Oshentip Allakh asmandardy zharatuunu eki kundo, beishembi zhana zhuma kundoru toluk buturdu. Asmandar menen zherdin zharaluusu oshol ekoosu menen kosho alty kundo toluk buttu. Allakh vakhii kylyp ar bir asmanga ozuno tiiishtuu ishterdi belgiledi, oshondoi ele mildetterdi zhana ibadattardy buirudu. Zhana Biz duino asmanyn zhyldyzdar menen koozdop, alar arkyluu asmandy zhin-shaitandardyn uurdap ukkandarynan korgop koiduk. Bul aitylgandardyn baarysy ech kimden zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuunun, zharatkandaryn Biluuchunun tagdyry.

Oo, paigambar! Eger alar sen alyp kelgen nersege yiman keltiruudon bash tartyshsa, anda alarga ait: <<Men silerdi Khuddun koomu Aad zhana Salikhtin koomu Samud zhalganga chygaryshkanda alardyn bashyna tushkon azap syiaktuu azaptyn kelishinen eskerttim>>.

Kachan alarga paigambarlary birinin artynan biri kelip, alardy Allakhka gana syiyngyla degen nersege gana chakyrganda alardyn arasyndagy kaapyrlar aityshty: <<Egerde Rabbibiz bizge perishtelerdi elchiler kylyp zhiberuunu kaalaganda, anda al alardy tushurmok. Chyndygynda biz siler alyp kelgen nersege kaapyrlyk kyldyk. Antkeni siler biz syiaktuu ele adamsyn'ar>>.

Al emi Khuddun koomu Aad Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyshkany az kelgensip, zher betinde ech bir sebepsiz tekeberlenishti, ailanasyndagylarga zulumduk kylyshty zhana kuch-kubattuuluguna azgyrylyp: <<Bizden da kuchtuu kim bar?>> - dep aityshty. Alar bizden kuchtuu ech kim zhok dep oiloshkon. Oshondo Allakh alarga zhoop kylyp aitty: <<Alardy zharatkan zhana alarga chekten chygargan kuch-kubatty bergen Allakh alardan da kuchtuu ekenin bilishpeibi zhana korushpoibu?!>>. Alar Khud paigambar alyp kelgen Allakhtyn aiat-belgilerine kaapyrlyk kylyshty.

Kiiin Biz alarga duino zhashoosunda korduk azabyn tattyruu uchun kargashaluu kundordo azap menen koshtolgon dobulduu shamaldy zhiberdik. Alardy kutkon akyret azaby andan da kordoochu! Alar azaptan kutkaryp koldoi turgan ech kimdi taba alyshpait.

Al emi Salikhtin ummotu Samud koomuna akyikat zholdu tushundurup, bagyt korsottuk, birok alar akyikattyn orduna adashuunu artyk korushtu. Oshondo kaapyrlygy zhana kunooloru uchun alardy kordoochu kyikyryk azaby zhok kyldy.

Biz Allakhka zhana paigambarlarga yiman keltirgenderdi kutkardyk. Alar Allakhtan korkup Anyn buiruktaryna bash iiishti zhana Anyn tyiuularynan alystashty. Biz alardy koomuna tushkon azaptan kutkaryp kaldyk.
Allakh al kunu dushmandaryn tozokko chogultat zhana tozok sakchylary alardyn birin da kaltyrbai kaitarat. Alar tozokton kachyp kete alyshpait.
Alar tozokko aidalyp kelishkende duinodo kylgandaryn tanyp bashtashat. Oshondo alarga kulaktary, kozdoru, terileri alardyn duinodo kylgan kaapyrlyktaryn zhana kunoolorun aityp kubogo otushot.

Kaapyrlar terilerine: <<Emne uchun duinodo kylgan ishteribizdi aityp bizge karshy kubogo ottun'or?>> - deshkende, teriler oz eelerine aityshat: <<Butkul nersege til bergen Allakh bizdi da suilottu>>. Al silerdi duinodo bolgonun'arda algachky zholu zharatkan zhana siler akyrette surak berish uchun, zhaza-syilyk alysh uchun Aga gana kaitasyn'ar.

Siler kunoo kylgan kezde kulaktaryn'ar, kozdorun'or, terilerin'er silerge karshy kubogo otposun' dep zhashynbait elen'er. Antkeni siler olumdon kiiinki surakka, zhazaga zhana syilykka ishenchu emessin'er. Allakh silerdin kylganyn'ardyn kobun bilbeit dep oilogonsun'ar, atugul Aga belgisiz dep kuru oilorgo zhetelengensin'er.
Siler Rabbin'er tuuraluu oilogon myna ushul zhaman oiun'ar silerdi kyiroogo alyp keldi. Oshonun aiynan siler duinodo zhana akyrette zhogotuuga uchuragandardan boldun'ar.

Myna oshol kulaktary, kozdoru, terileri kubogo otkondor sabyr kylyshsa da tozok alardyn turak zhaiy zhana bash kalkalagan zheri bolot. Alar azapty aluunu zhana Allakhtyn yraazylygyn surashsa da alar ech kachan Anyn yraazylygyna zhetishpeit zhana beiishke da kirishpeit.

Biz al kaapyrlarga alardy koshtop zhurgon zhin-shaitandardan bolgon zhan-zhookorlordu kylyp koiduk. Al zhin-shaitandar alarga duinodo kylgan ish-araketterin kooz kylyp korgozushtu zhana alardyn artyndagy akyret ishterin da kooz kylyp korgozushup, alarga any estoonu, al uchun araket kyluunu unutturushtu. Oshentip alarga da adamzat menen zhinderden bolgon murunku otkon koomdor menen birge azap mildet boldu. Chyndygynda alar kyiamatta tozokko kirip ozdorun zhana ui-bulolorun zyianga uchuratkandardan bolushtu.

Kachan kaapyrlar dalilge dalil menen zhoop beruugo aldary kelbei kalganda biri-birine nasaat kylyp: <<Silerge Mukhammad okup zhatkan bul Kurandy ukpagyla! Andagy aitylgandarga eerchibegile! Al okup bashtaganda ele kyikyryp, yzy-chuu salyp bashtagyla! Balkim ushundai kyluu menen any zhen'esin'er. Oshondo al silerge okubai kalat, daavat da kylbai kalat, anan andan kutulup es alasyn'ar>> - deshti.

Biz Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyp, paigambarlardy zhalganga chygargandarga kyiamatta oor azapty tattyrabyz. Oshondoi ele alardyn zhazasy katary ozdoru kylgan shirk zhana kunoolordun en' kataaly menen zhazasyn berebiz.

Bul aitylgan zhaza - Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgan, paigambarlardy zhalganga chygargan Anyn dushmandarynyn zhazasy bolgon tozok. Alar al zhakta tuboluk kalyshat. Bul alardyn Allakhtyn aiat-belgilerin zhokko chygarganynyn, anyn achyktygyna zhana dalili kuchtuuluguno karabastan yiman keltirbegenin zhazasy boldu.

Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyp, Anyn paigambarlaryn zhalganga chygargandar aityshty: <<Rabbibiz! Bizdi adashtyrgan zhinder menen adamdardy korgoz, kaapyrlykty zhana aga uguttoonu negizdegen Iblisti zhana kan toguunu bashtagan Adam atanyn balasyn korgoz, biz al ekoosun tozokto en' katuu kordolup azaptalgandardan bolushu uchun alardyn ustuno chygyp buttarybyz menen tebelep-tepseibiz>>.

Kachan Allakh dushmandarynyn zhazasy tuuraluu soz kylganda any menen katar suiuktuu pendelerinin syilygy tuuraluu aityp myndai dedi:
Al emi <> dep aitkandarga zhana Anyn buiruktaryna bash iiuudo, tyiuularyn tashtoodo tuz zholdu tutungandarga olum kelgen kezde perishteler tushup: <

Biz silerdin duino zhashoon'ordogu koldoochun'arbyz. Biz silerdi tuuralap zhana korgop zhurgonbuz. Oshondoi ele silerdin akyrettegi koldoochun'arbyz. Bizdin koldoobuz daiym silerdi koshtoit. Beiishte siler uchun zhan duinon'or kaalagan zhyrgalchylyktar zhana kumarlar bar, oshondoi ele siler en'sep kaalagan but nerseler bar.
Toobo kylgan pendelerinin kunoolorun Kechiruuchu, alarga Meerimduu Rabbinin silerdi syilash uchun daiardap koigon yryskysy!>>.

Allakhty zhalgyzdoogo, Anyn shariiatyn ish zhuzundo atkaruuga zhana Rabbisin yraazy kylgan zhakshylyk ishterdi kyluuga chakyrgan, oshondoi ele <<Men Allakhka eerchip moiun sungandardanmyn>> dep aitkan adamdan da zhakshy suilogon ech kim zhok. Kimde-kim ushulardyn baarysyn kylsa, anda al adamdardan en' zhakshy suilogonu.

Allakhty yraazy kylgan zhakshylyktardy, ibadattardy kyluu menen Anyn kaaryn keltirgen zhamandyktardy, kunoolordu kyluu birdei emes. Saga zhamandyk kylgan adamga en' zhakshy munoz menen zhoop ber! Eger ekoon'ordun orton'ordo muruntan dushmandyk bolup, sen anyn zhamandygyna zhakshylyk menen zhoop bersen', anda al kuiumduu zhakynyn'dai bolup kalat.

Maktoogo arzygan myndai munozgo adamdardyn kylgan zhamandygyna sabyr kylgan adam gana zhete alat. Myndai munozgo uluu enchige ee bolgon adam gana zhetet. Antkeni bul nersede koptogon zhakshylyktar zhana paidalar bar.
Egerde shaitan seni kaisy ubakta bolbosun zhamandykka azgyrsa, anda Allakhtan korgoo sura! Chyndygynda Al senin aitkandaryn'dy Uguuchu, abalyn'dy Biluuchu.

Kun menen tundun almashuusu, Kun zhana Ai - Allakhtyn uluktugun zhana zhalgyzdygyn bildirgen aiat-belgilerden. Ei, adamdar! Kungo sazhda kylbagyla zhana Aiga sazhda kylbagyla! Eger Allakhka chyndap syiynsan'ar, anda osholordun baaryn zharatkan Allakhka gana sazhda kylgyla!
Egerde alar tekeberlenip zhana zhuz burup Zharatuuchu Allakhka sazhda kylyshpasa, anda Anyn aldyndagy perishteler kunu-kunu Any aruulashat, maktoolordu aityshat. Alar Aga syiynuudan tazhashpait.

Anyn uluktugun, zhalgyzdygyn zhana kaira tiriltuugo bolgon kudurettuulugun bildirgen aiat-belgilerinen - sen korup turgan osumduk ospogon zher. Eger Biz aga zhamgyr suusun tushursok, al andagy komulgon dandardyn ongonunon kyimylga kelip, kotorulo bashtait. Chyndygynda ushundai oluk zherdi osumduktor arkyluu tiriltken Allakh - surak zhana zhaza-syilyk uchun oluktordu kairadan tirilte alat. Al bardyk nersege kudurettuu. Oluk zherdi kaira tiriltuu zhana oluktordu kabyrlarynan kaira tiriltuu Any alsyratpait.

Al emi Allakhtyn aiat-belgilerin chetke kagyp, zhalganga chygaryp zhana burmalap tuuralyktan chettep ketkenderdin abaly bizge maalym. Biz alardy bilebiz. Tozokko yrgytylgan adam zhakshyby zhe kyiamatta azaptan kutulgan adamby? Ei, adamdar! Ozun'or kaalagan zhakshylyk-zhamandyk ishterdi zhasai bergile. Biz silerge zhakshyny da, zhamandy da baiandap berdik. Allakh kaisynysyn kylyp zhatkanyn'ardy Koruuchu. Silerdin ish-araketterin'erdin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.
Allakh taraptan Kuran kelgende aga kaapyrlyk kylgandar kyiamat kunu azaptalyshat. Chyndygynda al yiyk zhana uluk Kitep. Any ech kim burmalai albait, ech kim ozgorto da albait.

Aga koshumchalap zhe kemitip zhe ozgortup zhe burmalap, anyn aldynan da, artynan da zhalgan zholoi albait. Al kitep butkul abalda maktoogo arzygan zhana zharatuuda, tagdyr kyluuda, shariiatty okum kyluuda Daanyshman taraptan tushkon.

Kachan Allakh Kitepti zhalganga chygargandar tuuraluu soz kylganda Oz paigambaryna murunku paigambarlardan bolgon bir tuugandary da zhalganga, shyldyn'ga, zhalaaga tush bolgondorun aityp any sabyrduulukka chakyrdy zhana kon'ulun zhooshutup myndai dep aitty:
Oo, paigambar! Saga aitylgan zhalgan sozdor senden murunku paigambarlarga da aitylgan. Andyktan sabyr kyl! Chyndygynda Rabbin' toobo kylgan pendeleri uchun Kechirimduu zhana toobo kylbastan kunoo kyla bergenderdi kataal Zhazaloochu.

Egerde Biz bul Kurandy arab tilinde tushurbosok alardyn arasyndagy kaapyrlar: <<Bizge tushunuktuu bolush uchun aiattaryna tushundurmo berilse bolmok? Kurandy alyp kelgen arab bolso, anan al ozu bashka tilde bolmok bele?>> - dep aityshmak. Oo, paigambar! Alarga ait: <<Bul Kuran Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn paigambaryn chynchyl dep tastyktagandar uchun adashuudan saktagan tuura zhol, kokuroktogu naadandykka zhana ushuga okshogon nerselerge shypaa. Al emi Allakhka yiman keltirbegenderdin kulaktary duloi, aga karata kozdoru sokur, ala any tushunushpoit. Myna ushul sypattarga ee bolgondor alys zherden chakyryk salgan adamdardai, emi alar chakyrgan adamdy kantip ugushsun?>>.

Biz Musaga Tooratty berdik. Alar al tuuraluu talashyp-tartyshty, kee biri aga yiman keltirdi, kee biri aga kaapyr boldu. Egerde Allakhtyn alardyn talashtary tuuraluu kyiamatta pendelerdin ortosunda okum kylam degen ubadasy bolbogondo, anda Toorat tuuraluu talashyp-tartyshkandardyn ortosunda okum kylmak. Kimisi akyikatta, kimisi zhalganda ekenin achyktap, chynchyldy urmattamak zhana zhalganchyny kordomok. Chyndygynda kaapyrlar Kuran tuuraluu katuu shek-kumondo.

Kimde-kim zhakshylyk ish kylsa, anda zhakshylyk ishinin paidasy ozuno kaitat. Ech kimdin kylgan zhakshylyk ishi Allakhka paida keltirbeit. Al emi kim zhamandyk ish kylsa, anda anyn zyiany ozuno kaitat. Makuluktardan ech kimdin kylgan kunoosu Allakhka zyian berbeit. Ar birine ozu tatyktuu bolgon syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret. Oo, paigambar! Rabbin' pendelerine zulum kylbait, alardyn zhakshylygyn kemitpeit zhana kunoolorun koboitpoit.

Kyiamattyn ilimi Allakhtyn Ozuno gana kaitarylat. Al anyn kachan bolorun Ozu gana bilet, any Andan bashka ech kim bilbeit. Momo-zhemishterdin alardy saktoochu buchurlordon chyguusu, urgaachynyn boiuna butup zhana toroosu Anyn ilimi menen gana bolot. Al alardyn ech birin otkorup zhiberbeit. Kyiamatta Allakh menen katar aikelgenderge syiyngan mushrikterdi bul kylgandary uchun Allakh alardy zhemelep: <<Siler sherikter dep oilogon Menin sherikterim kaida?>> - degende mushrikter aityshat: <<Senin aldyn'da moinubuzga alabyz, Senin sherigin' bar dep arabyzdan azyr ech kim kubolukko otpoit>>.
Alar duba kylyshkan aikelderi alardy tashtap ketishti zhana Allakhtyn azabynan kachyp kutula albastaryn anyk bilishti.
Insan ozuno den-sooluk, bailyk zhana bala-chaka syiaktuu zhakshylyktardy suragandan ech tazhabait. Eger al kedeilikke zhe ooruga tush bolso, anda al Allakhtyn yraiymynan taptakyr ele umut uzup koiot.

Egerde Biz aga den-sooluk, bailyk bersek zhana any bashyna tushkon baleeden, oorudan salamat kylsak al myndai dep gana aitat: <<Bul maga buiruk eken. Antkeni men aga tatyktuumun. Men kyiamat bolot dep ech oiloboim. Eger kyiamat bolup kalchu bolso dele Allakhtyn aldynda men uchun bailyk zhana mal-mulk bar. Al maga any duinodo tatyktuu bolgonum sebeptuu bergeni symal akyrette da maga alardy beret>>. Biz Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandarga alardyn kylgan kaapyrlygy menen kunoolorunun kabaryn sozsuz aitabyz zhana alarga chekten ashkan kataal azapty tattyrabyz.

Egerde Biz insanga den-sooluk, amandyk syiaktuu zhakshylyktardy bersek, al Allakhty estoonu zhana Aga moiun sunuunu unutup, kyryn salyp tekeberlenip kalat. A eger anyn bashyna ooru, kedeilik kelse, al Allakhka bashyna tushkon baleeden kutkar dep aryz-mun'un aityp, uzak dubalardy kylyp bashtait. Al Rabbisinin aga bergen zhakshylyktaryna shugur kylbait zhana Anyn synooloruna sabyr kylbait.

Oo, paigambar! Al zhalganchy mushrikterge ait: <<Aitkylachy, eger bul Kuran Allakh taraptan bolup, kiiin siler aga kaapyrlyk kylyp, zhalganga chygargan bolson'or, anda silerdin abalyn'ar kandai bolot? Akyikattyn achyktygyna zhana anyn dalilderinin kuchtuuluguno karabastan aga bash iibestik kylgan adamdan da koburook adashkan kim bar?

Biz kuraish kaapyrlarynyn bul Kuran tuuraluu shektenuulorun zhok kylyp, al shek-kumonsuz akyikat ekeni anyk bolgongo cheiin alarga Allakhtyn musulmandarga achyp koigon zher meikindigindegi aiat-belgileribizdi korgozobuz zhana oshondoi ele Biz Mekkeni bagyntuu menen alarga ozdorundogu aiat-belgilerdi korgozobuz. Kuran Allakh taraptan ekendigine Al Ozu kubo bergeni mushrikterge zhetishtuu emespi? Allakhtan da kuchtuu kubolukko otuuchu kim bar? Egerde alar akyikatty kaalashkanda, anda alarga Rabbisinin kubolugu zhetishtuu bolmok.

Chyndygynda mushrikter kyiamatta kaira tiriluunu zhokko chygaryshkany uchun Rabbisine zholuguudan shektenuudo. Alar akyretke yiman keltirishpeit. Oshonduktan zhakshylyk ishterdi kylyp aga daiardyk korushpoit. Akyikatta Allakh ilimi zhana kudureti menen butkul nerseni Ozuno kamtyp alat.
(Hm) `sq Khaa. Miim. Ain. Siin. Kaaf. Ushuga okshogon sozdun tushundurmosu bakara suroosunun bashynda aitylgan.
(Hm) `sq Khaa. Miim. Ain. Siin. Kaaf. Ushuga okshogon sozdun tushundurmosu bakara suroosunun bashynda aitylgan.
Oo, paigambar! Dushmandarynan och aluuda Kudurettuu, bashkaruusunda zhana zharatuusunda Daanyshman Allakh saga zhana senden murunku paigambarlarga ushul syiaktuu vakhii tushurot.
Zharatuu, biilik kyluu, bashkaruu zhaktan asmandardagy zhana zherdegi butkul nerseler Allakhka gana taandyk. Al Oz zaty, kudureti zhana kaarduulugu menen Biiik, Oz zatynda Uluk.

Allakhtyn uluktugunan ebegeisiz zhana biiik asmandar dagy kabat-kabat zherdin ustunon zharylyp ketchudoi bolup turat. Al emi perishteler Rabbisin aruulashuuda, Aga bash iiuu menen maktoolordu aityp uluktashuuda zhana zher betindegiler uchun Allakhtan kechirim surashuuda. Akyikatta Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerin Kechiruuchu, alarga Yraiymduu.

Al emi Allakhtan bashka aikelderdi zhakyn tutushup, Allakh menen katar alarga syiyngandardyn ish-araketterin Allakh zhazyp kuzotup turat zhana al uchun alarga zhazasyn beret. Oo, paigambar! Sen alardyn ish-araketterin saktoogo zhoopker emessin' zhana alardyn ish-araketteri uchun suralbaisyn'. Sen bolgonu zhetkiruuchusun'.

Oo, paigambar! Sen Mekkeni zhana anyn ailanasyndagy arab shaarlaryn, oshondoi ele butkul adamzatty eskertuun' uchun zhana Allakh abalkylar menen akyrkylardy surak zhana zhaza-syilyk uchun bir zhaiga chogultkan, shek-kumonsuz bolo turgan kyiamat kununon adamdardy korkutuun' uchun Biz senden murunku paigambarlarga vakhii kylganybyz syiaktuu saga dagy arabcha Kurandy vakhii kyldyk. Al kezde adamdar eki topko bolunushot: bir tobu beiishtegi yimanduular, ekinchi tobu tozoktogu kaapyrlar.

Eger Allakh alardy Islam dinin tutungan bir ummot kyluunu kaalaganda, alardy bir ummot kylyp, alardyn baarysyn beiishke kirgizip koimok. Birok Anyn daanyshmandygynyn talabyna ylaiyk Al Ozu kaalagandy Islamga kirgizip, any beiishke kirgizet. Al emi kaapyrlyk zhana kunoolordu kyluu menen ozdoruno zulumduk kylgandar uchun alardy koldogon koldoochu zhana Allakhtyn azabynan kutkargan zhardamchy bolboit.

Birok mushrikter Allakhtan bashkalardy koldoochu kylyp alyshty. Allakh Ozu gana chynygy Koldoochu. Andan bashkalar paida da, zyian da keltire alyshpait. Al oluktordu surak zhana zhaza-syilyk uchun kaira tiriltet. Any ech kim alsyrata albait.

Ei, adamdar! Siler din negizderine zhana anyn ichine kirgen bolumdorgo bailanyshtuu kaisy bir nersede talashyp kalsan'ar, anyn okumu Allakhta. Al nersede Anyn Kitebine zhe paigambarynyn sunnotko kaitsyn. Menin Rabbim myna ushundai sypattarga ee, butkul ishterimde Aga gana taianam zhana Aga gana toobo kylyp kaitam.

Allakh asmandar menen zherdi murun bolbogondoi korunushto Zharatuuchu. Al silerge ozun'ordon zhubailardy zharatty. Zhana silerge too, ui zhana koilordu koboitush uchun zhup kylyp zharatty. Oshondoi ele Al silerdi uilonuu arkyluu ozun'ordon bolgon zhubailaryn'ardan zharatat zhana silerge zhan-zhanybarlardyn etteri zhana suttoru arkyluu zhashoo beret. Aga makuluktardyn ech biri okshoboit. Al pendelerinin sozdorun Uguuchu. Alardyn ech birin otkorup zhiberbeit. Al zhakynda alarga ish-araketteri uchun syilyk zhe zhazasyn beret. Zhakshy bolso zhakshy, zhaman bolso zhaman bolot.

Asmandar menen zher kazynalarynyn achkychtary zhalgyz Aga taandyk. Al pendeleri shugur kylaby zhe chetke kagaby dep synash uchun Ozu kaalaganyna yryskyny ken' kylat. Oshondoi ele alar sabyr kylaby zhe Allakhtyn tagdyryna kazhyrlanaby dep synash uchun Ozu kaalaganynyn yryskysyn tar kylat. Chyndygynda Al bardyk nerseni Biluuchu. Pendelerine paidaluu bolgon nerselerdin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.

Biz Nukhka zhetkir zhana any ish zhuzundo atkar dep buiruganybyz syiaktuu silerge da dindi shariiat kyldyk. Oo, paigambar! Biz saga vakhii kylgan nerselerdi da shariiat kyldyk. Oshondoi ele Biz Ibrakhimge, Musaga, Isaga zhetkirgile zhana any ish zhuzundo atkargyla, bir soz menen aitkanda: <<Dindi toluk turguzgula zhana anda bolunup-zharylbagyla>> - degen syiaktuu buiruktarybyzdy silerge da shariiat kyldyk. Siler mushrikterdi Allakhka gana syiynyp, Andan bashkaga syiynbagyla degen chakyrygyn'ar alar uchun oor boldu. Allakh pendelerinen Ozu kaalagandaryn tandap, Ozuno syiynuuga zhana moiun sunuuga iigilik beret, oshondoi ele kunooloruno toobo kylyp Aga kaitkandardy Ozuno karai bagyttait.

Kaapyrlar menen mushrikterge Mukhammad zhiberilip, alarga dalil koiulgandan kiiin bolunup ketishti. Alardyn bolunup-zharyluusu chekten chyguu zhana zulumduk sebepten gana boldu. Egerde Allakh alarga azapty belgiluu bir moonotko cheiin, tagyraak aitkanda kyiamat kungo cheiin kechiktiret dep aldyn ala Anyn iliminde zhazylbaganda, anda Allakh alardyn ortosunda okum chygarmak, alarga kaapyrlyktary zhana paigambarlardy zhalganga chygargandary sebeptuu azapty erteletmek. Al emi Tooratty muraska algan zhoottor, ata-babalarynan kiiin Inzhildi algan khristiandar, alardan kiiinki mushrikter Mukhammad alyp kelgen bul Kuranga katuu shektenishti zhana any zhalganga chygaryshty.

Sen bul tuura dinge chakyr, Allakh saga buirugandai aga bekem bol, alardyn zhalgan kaaloolorun eerchibe zhana alar menen talashyp-tartyshkanda ait: <<Men Allakhka zhana Al paigambarlaryna tushurgon kitepterge yiman keltirdim. Allakh maga silerdin orton'ordo adilettik menen okum kyluunu buirudu. Men syiyngan Allakh - Al menin da, silerdin Rabbin'er. Bizdin kylgan ishteribiz zhakshy bolso da, zhaman bolso da ozubuz uchun. Silerdin kylgan ishterin'er zhakshy bolso da, zhaman bolso da ozun'or uchun. Bizdin ortobuzda dalil achyk-aikyn bolgondon kiiin ech kandai talashyp-tartyshuu zhok. Allakh baarybyzdy chogultat. Kyiamatta Aga gana kaitabyz. Oshondo Al ar biribizge ozubuz tatyktuu bolgon syilykty zhe zhazany beret. Myna oshol kezde chynchyldan aldamchy, akyikatchydan zhalganchy aiyrmalanat>>.

Mukhammadga tushkon bul dinge adamdar zhoop bergenden kiiin al tuuraluu zhalgan dalilder menen talashyp-tartyshkandardyn dalilderi Rabbisinin zhana yimanduulardyn aldynda paidasyz zhana zhokko chygarylat. Alardyn ech taasiri bolboit. Alarga kaapyrlyktary zhana akyikatty chetke kakkandyktary uchun Allakhtyn kaary bolot zhana kyiamat kunu alardy kataal azap kutup turat.

Kaapyrlardyn dalilderi zhalgan ekendigin baiandagandan kiiin tuura dalilderdin tupku negizi bolgon, tagyraak aitkanda musulman adam dalil katary koldongon Kurandy baiandap myndai dedi:
Allakh Kurandy ech kandai shek-kumonu zhok akyikat menen tushurdu. Oshondoi ele adamdardyn ortosunda kalys okum kylysh uchun adilettikti tushurdu. Alar zhalganga chygaryp zhatkan kyiamat saaty zhakyn kalgan chygar. Kaisy bir nerse kele zhatsa, demek bul anyn zhakyn ekeninen kabar beret.

Aga ishenbegender anyn batyraak kelishin shashtyryshat. Antkeni alar surakka, soop-syilykka zhana zhazaga ishenishpeit. Al emi Allakhka yiman keltirgender bolso aga baruudan korkushat zhana alar anyn ech kandai shek-kumonu zhok akyikat ekenin anyk bilishet. Kaiamat saaty tuuraluu talashyp-tartyshkandar zhana anyn boloru tuuraluu shektengender akyikatka tuura kelbegendei anyk adashuuda!

Allakh pendelerine Booruker. Al Ozu kaalagan pendesine yrysky berip,yryskysyn kenen kylat zhana yraiym, daanyshandygy menen Ozu kaalagan pendesinin yryskysyn tarytat. Aga ech kim ustomduk kyla albait, Al dushmandarynan och aluuga Kudurettuu.

Zhe bolboso al mushrikterdin Allakhtan bashka kudailary barby zhana alar Allakh Oz shariiatynda uruksat berbegen shirk kyluu, adaldy aram zhe aramdy adal kyluu syiaktuu nerselerdi alarga dinden dep shariiat kylyp berishebi? Eger Allakh talashyp-tartyshkandardyn ortosunda okum kyluuga ataiyn bir moonottu belgilebegende zhana alardy oshogo cheiin kaltyram debegende, anda alardyn ortosunda sozsuz okum kylmak. Chyndygynda Allakhka shirk zhana kunoo kylyp ozdoruno zulumduk kylgandardy kyiamat kunu kutkon kyinoochu azap bar.

Oo, paigambar! Sen shirk zhana kunoo kylyp ozdoruno zulumduk kylgandardy kunooloru sebeptuu zhazalanuudan zhana sozsuz ishke ashuuchu zhazadan korkushkandaryn korosun'. Alarga toobosuz korkunuch ech paida berbeit. Al emi bulardan aiyrmalanyp Allakhka, Anyn elchilerine yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandar yrakhattangan abalda beiish bakchalarynda bolushat. Alar uchun Rabbisinin aldynda alar kaalagandai tugonbos zhakshylyktyn turloru bolot. Myna ushul ech bir zhakshylyk ten' kelbegendei uluu zhakshylyk.

Bul Allakhka zhana Anyn elchilerine yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandarga Ozunun paigambary arkyluu suiunchulogon uluu kush kabar. Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Men silerge zhetkirgen akyikat uchun syilyk surabaim. Men silerden paidasy ozun'orgo gana kaita turgan bir gana nerseni suraim - silerge bolgon zhakyndygym uchun meni zhakshy korgulo>>. Kim zhakshylyk kylsa, anyn soobun eselep berebiz. Bir zhakshylyk on esege koboitulot. Chyndygynda Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerine kechirimduu, Anyn Zhuzun kaalap zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandarga yraazy boluuchu.

Mushrikter Mukhammad bul Kurandy ozu oilop taap, any Rabbisine taandyk kylyp zhatat dep oiloshot. Allakh alarga zhoop kylyp aitty: <<Egerde sen zhalgan zhalaa oilop tabam dep ozun'o aitkan bolson', anda Men senin zhurogun'du moorlop koimokmun zhana zhalgan zhalaany ochurup, akyikatty kaltyrmakmyn. Birok ishtin myndai bolbogondugu - Rabbisi taraptan vakhii kylyngan nersede paigambar chynchyl ekendigine dalil bolot. Chyndygynda Allakh pendelerinin zhurogundogu nerselerdi Biluuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.

Allakh pendelerinin kaapyrlyk zhana kunooloru uchun kylgan toobolorun kabyl kylat zhana kylgan zhamandyktaryn kechiret. Al silerdin ar bir kylganyn'ardy bilet. Silerdin kylgan ishin'erdin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda silerge alardyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Allakhka zhana Anyn elchilerine yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandardyn dubasyna Allakh zhoop beret zhana alarga surashpasa da Oz zhakshylyktarynan koboitup beret. Al emi Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisilerine kaapyrlyk kylgandardy kyiamatta kutkon katuu azap bar.

Egerde Allakh bardyk pendelerine yryskyny kenen kylganda, alar zher betinde chekten chygyp ketishmek. Birok Allakh yryskyny Ozu kaalagan olchomdo koboitup zhana azaityp tushurot. Chyndygynda Allakh pendelerinin abaldaryn Biluuchu, alardy Koruuchu. Oshonduktan Al kandaidyr bir daanyshmandyk sebeptuu beret zhana kandaidyr bir daanyshmandyk sebeptuu alat.
Pendeleri zhamgyr zhaashynan umut uzup kalyshkanda Al alarga zhamgyr zhaadyrat zhana any zhaiyltyp, zherdi ondurot. Al pendelerinin ishterin bashkaruuchu, bardyk abalda maktoogo tatyktuu.

Asmandar menen zherdi zharatuu zhana al ekoosundo ukmushtuudai tiruu zhandyktardy taratuu - Allakhtyn kudurettuulugun zhana zhalgyzdygyn bildirgen aiat-belgilerden. Al alardy Ozu kaalaganda chogultuuga zhana alarga syilyk-zhaza beruugo kudurettuu. Alardy abalky uchurda zharatuu Any alsyratpagan syiaktuu bul nerse da Any alsyrata albait.

Ei, adamdar! Ozun'orgo zhe mal-mulkun'orgo tiiishtuu bashyn'arga tushkon kyiynchylyk oz kolun'ar menen kylgan kunoolor sebeptuu boldu. Allakh alardyn kopchulugun kechirdi zhana al uchun silerdi zhazalagan zhok.

Eger Allakh silerdi zhazaloonu kaalasa, Anyn zhazasynan kachyp kutula albaisyn'ar. Siler uchun ishin'erdi bashkargan Andan bashka koldoochu zhok zhana Al silerge azapty kaalasa, silerdi andan saktagan zhardamchy da zhok.
Allakhtyn kudurettuulugun zhana zhalgyzdygyn bildirgen aiat-belgilerden - den'izde toolordoi biiik bolgon kemelerdin zhuruusu.

Egerde Allakh kemelerdi zhurguzgon shamaldy toktotuunu kaalasa, any toktotup koimok. Anan alar den'izde kyimylsyz bir ordunda turup kalmak. Chyndygynda kemelerdi zharatuu zhana shamaldy moiun sunduruu syiaktuu bul aitylgan nerselerde synoolorgo zhana kyiynchylyktarga sabyr kylgan zhana Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryna shugur kylgan adamdar uchun Allakhtyn kudurettuuluguno achyk-aikyn dalilder bar.

Zhe Allakh katuu shamal zhiberip al kemelerdi zhok kyluunu kaalasa, anda adamdardyn kylgan kunooloru sebeptuu alardy kyiratyp zhok kylmak. Allakh pendelerinin koptogon kunoolorun kechirip, alardy zhazalagan zhok.

Katuu shamal zhiberip al kemelerdi zhok kyla turgan kezde Allakhtyn aiat-belgilerin zhokko chygarysh uchun talashyp-tartyshkandar, alar uchun kyiroodon kachyp kutuluu zhok ekenin bilishet. Oshondo alar Allakhtan bashkalardy tashtap, Aga gana zhalbaryshat.

Ei, adamdar! Silerge berilgen mal-mulk zhe kadyr-bark zhe bala-chaka bul duino zhashoosunun ubaktyluu yrakhattary. Al emi tuboluk zhyrgalchylyk - Allakh Ozuno zhana paigambarlaryna yiman keltirgen zhana butkul ishterinde zhalgyz Aga tobokel kylgandarga daiardap koigon beiish zhyrgalchylygy.

Alar chon' zhana zhiiirkenichtuu kunoolordon alystashat. Egerde alarga kimdir biroo sozu zhe ishi menen zyian berse, anyn katalygyn kechiret zhana al uchun zhazalashpait. Bul kechirimduuluk alardan bolgon aikolduk, antkeni anda zhakshylyktar zhana paidalar bar.

Alar Rabbisinin buirugun atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtoo menen Aga zhoop berishet zhana namazdy talaptagydai toluk atkaryshat. Oshondoi ele alar uchun maaniluu bolgon ishterde oz ara ken'eshishet zhana Biz alarga bergen yryskydan Allakhtyn zhuzun kaalap sarptashat.

Kimde-kim oz akysyn aluunu kaalasa, anda al any alganga akyluu. Birok ashyrbastan zhe chekten chykpastan dal ozundoi bolsun. Al emi kim aga zhamandyk kylgan adamdy kechirse, al zhamandygy uchun any zhazalabasa zhana any menen musulman bir tuuganyn zharashtyrsa, anda anyn soop-syilygy Allakhtyn aldynda. Chyndygynda Allakh adamdardyn ozuno zhe mal-mulkuno zhe abiiirine tiiiship zulumduk kylgandardy suiboit, atugul alardy zhek korot.
Kim oz talamy uchun zhen'ishke zhetse, anda alarga oz akylaryn algany uchun ech kandai zhaza zhok.
Chyndygynda zhazaloo adamdarga zulumduk kylyp zhana zher betinde kunoo ishterdi kylgandar uchun. Myna osholorgo akyrette kyinoochu azaptar bar.

Al emi kim bashkalardyn zyianyna sabyr kylyp, alardy kechirse, anda myndai sabyrduuluk ozuno zhana koomgo zhakshylyk alyp kelet. Bul maktoogo tatyktuu ish. Buga uluu enchige ee bolgondor gana zhetishet.

Allakh kimge tuura zholgo tushuugo koldoo korgozboi, any akyikattan adashtyrsa, anda al uchun anyn ishterin kolgo algan Andan bashka ech kandai koldoochu bolboit. Sen korosun', kaapyrlyk zhana kunoo ishterdi kylyp ozdoruno zulumduk kylgandar kyiamatta azapty oz kozdoru menen korushkondo: <<Duinogo kaira kaituunun zholu bar beken, biz kaityp Allakhka toobo kylaly?>> - dep umuttono aityshat.

Oo, paigambar! Sen al zaalymdardy tozokko kordolup alyp kelingende katuu korkunuchtan adamdardy kylchaktap tiktegenderin korosun'. Oshondo Allakhka zhana paigambarlarga yiman keltirgende aityshat: <<Chynygy zhogotuuga uchuragandar - alar kyiamatta Allakhtyn azabyna tush bolgon sebeptuu ozdorun zhana ui-bulolorun zhogotuuga uchuratkandar>>. Chyndygynda kaapyrlyk zhana kunoolordu kylyp ozdoruno zulumduk kylgandar ech kachan butpogon tuboluktuu azapta bolushat.

Kyiamatta alardy Allakhtyn azabynan kutkaryp alarga zhardam bergen ech bir koldoochu bolboit. Allakh kimdi akyikatka karai zhardamsyz tashtap adashtyrsa, anda any akyikatka bagyttagan ech bir zhol bolboit.

Oo, paigambar! Egerde alar senin buirugun'dan bash tartyshsa, Biz seni alardyn ish-araketterin saktoochu kylyp zhibergen emespiz. Sen ozun'o buirulgandy gana zhetkiruugo mildettuusun', al emi alardy surakka aluu Allakhtyn mildetinde. Egerde Biz adam balasyna Ozubuz taraptan bailyk, den-sooluk zhe ushuga okshogon nerselerdi berip yraiym kylsak, al aga suiunot. A eger anyn bashyna kunooloru sebeptuu aga zhakpagandai kyiynchylyktar kelse, akyikatta alar tabiiatynan Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryn tanyp ketishet, aga shugur kylyshpait zhana Allakhtyn Oz daanyshmandygy menen tagdyr kylgan nersesine achuulanyshat.

Asmandar menen zherdin mulku Allakhka gana taandyk. Al erkek zhe urgaachy zhe bashka ushul syiaktuu Ozu kaalagan nerseni zharatat. Kimge kaalasa kyz berip, uul berbeit zhana kimge kaalasa uul berip, kyz berbeit. Zhe kimge kaalasa uul da, kyz da beret zhana kimdi kaalasa torobos kylyp koiot. Chyndygynda Al bolup zhatkan zhana kelechekte bolo turgan nerselerdi Biluuchu. Bul anyn ilimi menen daanyshmandygy kemchiliksiz ekenin bildiret. Aga ech bir nerse zhashyruun emes zhana Any ech bir nerse alsyrata albait.

Asmandar menen zherdin mulku Allakhka gana taandyk. Al erkek zhe urgaachy zhe bashka ushul syiaktuu Ozu kaalagan nerseni zharatat. Kimge kaalasa kyz berip, uul berbeit zhana kimge kaalasa uul berip, kyz berbeit. Zhe kimge kaalasa uul da, kyz da beret zhana kimdi kaalasa torobos kylyp koiot. Chyndygynda Al bolup zhatkan zhana kelechekte bolo turgan nerselerdi Biluuchu. Bul anyn ilimi menen daanyshmandygy kemchiliksiz ekenin bildiret. Aga ech bir nerse zhashyruun emes zhana Any ech bir nerse alsyrata albait.

Allakh adam balasy menen vakhiidi ilkham kyluu arkyluu zhe Ozun korgozboston sozun uguzuu arkyluu zhe aga Zhebreil perishte syiaktuu perishteni elchi kylyp zhiberip, adamzattan bolgon paigambarga Allakhtyn uruksaty menen Al kaalagandy vakhii kyluu arkyluu gana suiloshot. Chyndygynda Al Oz zatynda zhana sypattarynda Biiik, Oz zharatuusunda, kudurettuulugundo zhana shariiatynda Daanyshman.

Oo, paigambar! Biz senden murunku paigambarlarga vakhii kylgandai saga dagy Kurandy Oz aldybyzdan vakhii kyldyk. Sen buga cheiin paigambarlarga asmandan tushkon kitepter emne ekenin zhana yiman degen emne ekenin bilchi emessin'. Birok Biz bul Kurandy nur kylyp tushurduk, Biz any menen Ozubuz kaalagan pendeleribizdi tuura zholgo salabyz. Chyndygynda sen dagy adamdardy tuura zhol bolgon Islam dinine bagyttaisyn'.

Zharatuu, eelik kyluu zhana bashkaruu zhaktan asmandar menen zherdegi nerseler Aga gana taandyk bolgon Allakhtyn zholu. Butkul ishter tagdyr kylynuu zhana bashkaruu zhaktan zhalgyz Allakhtyn Ozuno gana kaitat.
(Hm) Bul tuuraluu Bakara surosunun bashtalyshynda soz bolgon.
Allakh akyikatka karai bagyttoo zholun achyk korgozgon Kuran menen ant berdi.
Ei, silerdin tilin'erde Kuran tushkon koom! Siler any bashka koomdorgo zhetkirish uchun anyn maanilerine akyl zhugurtup tushunot degen umutto Biz Kurandy arab tilinde kyldyk.
Chyndygynda bul Kuran biiiktikke, uluktukka zhana daanyshmandykka ee bolgon Saktalgan Taktada (Laukhul Makhfuzda). Anyn buiruktary zhana tyiuulary tuuraluu aiattary bekemdelgen.

Siler shirk menen kunoolordu kop kylganyn'ar uchun ele Biz silerden bash tartyp Kurandy tushurboi koimok belek? Biz andai kylbaibyz. Teskerisinche silerge bolgon meerimduulugubuz munun karama-karshysyn talap kylat.
Biz murunku koomdorgo kanchalagan paigambarlardy zhiberdik.
Al koomdorgo Allakh tarabynan kandai paigambar kelse da, any shyldyn'dashkan.

Anan Biz al koomdordon da kuch-kubattuu bolgondordu zhok kyldyk. Biz alardan da alsyz koomdu zhok kylyp koiuuga kuchsuz emespiz. Kuranda Aad, Samud, Lut koomu zhana Madiian eeleri syiaktuu murunku koomdor kandai sypatta zhok kylyngany tuuraluu otkon.

Oo, paigambar! Zhalganchy mushrikterden: <<Asmandardy kim zharatkan? Zherdi kim zharatkan?>> - dep surasan', alar suroon'o zhoop kylyp: <<Alardy ech kimge zhen'ilbes Kudurettuu, butkul nerseni Biluuchu zharatkan>> - dep gana aityshat.
Allakh silerge Zherdi zhaiyk kylyp, any butun'ar menen basuuga ylaiyktuu toshok kyldy. Zhana siler zhol zhurgondo tuura bagyt alsyn dep andagy toolor menen oroondordo zholdordu kylyp koidu.

Al silerge, maldaryn'arga zhana eginzarlaryn'arga zhetishtuu olchomdo asmandan suu tushurdu. Anan Biz any menen osumduk ospogon kurgak zherdi tirilttik. Allakh osumduk ospogon al kurgak zherdi tiriltken syiaktuu silerdi da kairadan tiriltet.

Al tun menen kun, erkek zhana urgaachy syiaktuu bardyk turlordu zharatty. Oshondoi ele silerge saparlarda mingen uloolordu zhana kemelerdi zharatty. Siler den'izde kemelerge, kurgaktykta uloolorgo olturasyn'ar.

Siler saparlarda ustuno minip zhurosun'or degen umutto ushunun baaryn siler uchun zharatty. Andan son' Rabbin'er silerdi alardyn ustuno mingizip, moiun sunduruu menen kylgan zhakshylygyn estegile zhana tilin'er menen myndai dep aitkyla: <<Bizge bul uloonu daiardagan zhana moiun sundurgan Allakh aruu zhana yiyk! Emi biz alardy bashkara alabyz. Egerde Allakh alardy bizge moiun sundurbaganda alardy bashkara almak emespiz>>.
Zhana biz olgondon kiiin surak berish uchun zhana syilyk-zhaza alysh uchun Rabbibizge gana kaitabyz.

Mushrikter kee bir makuluktardyn Zharatuuchudan torolgon degen oido: <<Perishteler Allakhtyn kyzdary>> - dep aityshty. Chyndygynda ushundai sozdu aityp zhatkan insan - al anyk ele chetke kakkan zhana adashkan shugursuz adam.
Ei, mushrikter! Allakh zharatkandardyn arasynan Ozuno kyzdardy enchilep, al emi silerge uul baldardy yigardy dep zhatasyn'arby? Siler oilop zhatkan myndai bolushturuu emne degen bolushturuu?

Egerde alardyn birine Allakhka taandyk dep zhatkan syiaktuu kyzduu bolgonu zhonundo suiunchulonso, katuu kaigyryp kapalanganynan zhuzu kararyp, achuusu ichine batpai ketet. Anda emnege suiunchu aitylsa ozu kaigyryp zhatkan nerseni Rabbisine taandyk kylyp zhatat?
Alar aialzaty bolgonu uchun any zhasantyp tarbiialagan zhana talash-talkuuda sozun achyk aitalbagan kyz balany Rabbisine taandyk kylyp zhatyshaby?

Alar Yraiymduunun kuldary bolgon perishtelerdi kyzdar dep atashty. Alar kyzdar ekenin bilgidei Allakh alardy zharatyp zhatkanda korushupturbu? Alardyn bul kuboluktorun perishteler zhazyp koiushat. Al emi kyiamat kunu al tuuraluu suralyshat zhana zhalgandary sebeptuu azaptalyshat.

Tagdyrdy shyltoo kylgandar: <<Egerde Allakh bizdi alarga syiynuubuzdu kaalabaganda, anda biz alarga syiynbait elek. Anyn bizden ushunu kaaloosu - Anyn yraazy ekenin bildiret>> - dep aityshat. Alardyn bul aitkan sozu ilimge zhatpait, alar zhalgandy gana suilop zhatyshat.
Zhe Biz Kuranga cheiin al mushrikterge Allakhtan bashkaga syiynganga uruksat dep aitylgan kitep bergen bekenbiz? Alar oshol kitepti karmanyp, dalil kylyp zhatyshaby.

Zhok! Andai bolgon zhok! Teskerisinche alar eerchigenderin dalil kylyp: <<Biz murunku ata-babalarybyzdy ushul dinde taptyk. Alar aikelderge syiynyshkan. Emi biz dagy alardyn zholun zholdop, alarga syiynabyz>> - deshet.

Oo, paigambar! Bular zhalganga chygaryp, ata-babalaryn eerchuunu betke karmashkany syiaktuu Biz senden murun kaisy gana shaarga bolbosun, elin eskertsin dep paigambar zhiberbeili, alardyn bai bashchylary zhana chon'doru: <<Biz ata-babalarybyzdy ushul dinde tapkanbyz zhana biz alardyn zholun zholdoibuz>> - dep aityshkan. Bul nersede senin koomun' birinchi bolup zhatkan zhok.

Alarga paigambary: <<Men silerge ata-babalaryn'ardyn dininen da zhakshysyn alyp kelsem da alardy eerchiisin'erbi?>> - dep aitkanda alar aityshty: <<Chyndygynda biz sen alyp kelgen zhana senden murunku paigambarlar alyp kelishken nersege kaapyrlyk kyldyk>>.

Biz senden murunku paigambarlardy zhalganga chygargan koomdordon och alyp, alardy zhok kyldyk. Paigambarlaryn zhalganga chygargandardyn akybeti kandai bolgonun oilonup korchu. Alardyn akybeti okunuchtuu boldu.
Oo, paigambar! Estechi, bir kezde Ibrakhim atasyna zhana eline myndai dep aitty: <<Men siler Allakhtan bashka syiynyp zhatkan kudailaryn'arga ech katyshym zhok.
Meni zharatkan Allakhka gana syiynam. Al meni Ozunun tuura dinine eerchitip, paidaluu nersege bagyttait>>.

Ibrakhim alar shirkti zhana kunoolordu tashtap, Allakhka toobo kylyp kaityshat degen umutto <<Laa ilaakha illallakh>> degen Allakhty zhalgyzdoo kelmesin ozunon kiiinki urpaktaryna kaltyryp ketti. Alardyn arasynda Allakhka shirk kylbai, zhalgyz Aga syiyngandar dagy dele bar.

Men al zhalganchy mushrikterdi zhok kyluuga shashkan zhokmun. Teskerisinche alarga Kuran zhana baiandoochu paigambar Mukhammad kelgenge cheiin Men alardy bul duinodo zhashatyp zhyrgattym zhana alardan murunku ata-babalaryn da zhyrgattym.
Kachan alarga ech kandai shek-kumonu zhok bul Kuran kelgende alar aityshty: <<Bul syikyr! Mukhammad any menen bizdi syikyrlap koidu. Biz aga kaapyrlyk kyldyk zhana ech kachan ishenbeibiz>>.
Zhalganchy mushrikter aitty: <<Allakh bul Kurandy zhakyr zhana zhetim Mukhammadga tushurgondun orduna Mekke zhe Taiften bolgon eki uluu adamdyn birine tushurso bolboit bele?!>>.

Oo, paigambar! Alar Rabbin'din yraiymyn ozdoru kaalaganga berip, ozdoru kaalagandan tyiyp koigudai Anyn yraiymyn alar bolushturobu zhe Allakhpy? Biz duinodo alardyn yryskylaryn bolushturup, alar biri-birine moiun sunsun dep alardy bai-kedei kyldyk. Akyrette Rabbin'din pendelerine bolgon yraiymy alardyn ubaktyluu duinodo toptogon nerselerinen zhakshyraak.
Egerde adamdardyn baarysy kaapyrlykta bir koom bolbogondo, anda Biz Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandardyn uilorunun chatyrlaryn kumushton kylyp, alar aga chyga turgandai tepkichterdi kylmakpyz.
Biz alardy akyryndyk menen zhazalap zhana synash uchun alardyn uilorundo eshikterdi zhana zholonup oturgan sorulordu kyldyk.

Zhana Biz alarga altyndardy kyldyk. Myna ushulardyn baarysy duino zhashoosundagy gana yrakhattar. Alar ubaktyluu bolgonu uchun paidasy az. Oo, paigambar! Al emi Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtagan takybalar uchun Rabbin'din aldyndagy akyrettegi zhyrgalchylyktar zhakshyraak.
Kimde-kim Kuranga chyn kon'uldon nazar salbai, any zhuz burgan abalga zhetkirse, anda aga zhaza katary any shaitanga bashkartyp koiobuz, al anyn zhanynan kalbai adashkanyn kuchotot.

Kurandan zhuz burgandardyn ustunon bashkartyp koiulgan zhandooch shaitandar alardy Allakhtyn dininen tosushat. Alar Anyn buiruktaryn atkaryshpait, tyigandaryn tashtashpait zhana ozdorun akyikat zholdobuz dep oiloshot. Oshol sebepten alar adashkandaryna toobo kylyshpait.

Allakhty estoodon zhuz burgan adam kyiamatta akyry Bizge kelgen kezde umuttono: <<Ei, zhandoochu! Attin', sen ekoobuzdun ortobuzdagy aralyk chygysh menen batyshtai bolgondo kana! Sen en' zhaman zhandoochusun'!>> - dep aitat.

Kyiamat kunu Allakh kaapyrlarga aitat: <<Siler shirk zhana kunoolordu kylyp ozun'orgo zulumduk kyldyn'ar. Bugun silerge azapta sheriktesh bolgonun'ar ech paida berbeit. Al sherikterin'er silerdin ordun'arga azabyn'ardy ech kachan kotorboit>>.

Chyndygynda alar akyikatty ugaarga kelgende duloi, any koroorgo kelgende sokur. Oo, paigambar! Sen duloigo uguza alasyn'by zhe sokurdu tuuralykka bagyttai alasyn'by zhe akyikat zholdon achyk ele adashyp ketkendi tuura zholgo sala alasyn'by?
Egerde Biz alardy azaptaganga cheiin zhanyn'dy aluu menen seni alyp ketsek, anda Biz alardy duinodo zhana akyrette azaptap och alabyz.
Zhe Biz alarga ubada kylgan kee bir azaptardy saga korgozobuz. Alarga Bizdin kuchubuz zhetet. Alar Bizge ech bir nersede ustomduk kyla alyshpait.
Oo, paigambar! Rabbin' saga vakhii kylgan nerseni bekem karma! Sen ech kandai adashuusu zhok akyikat zholdosun'.

Chyndygynda bul Kuran sen uchun zhana senin koomun' uchun kadyr-bark. Zhakynda kyiamat kunu siler aga yiman keltirgenin'er, anyn zhol-zhobosun eerchigenin'er zhana aga daavat kylganyn'ar tuuraluu suralasyn'ar.
Oo, paigambar! Biz senden murun zhibergen paigambarlardan surachy, Biz Yraiymduudan bashka syiynuu uchun kudailardy kylgan bekenbiz?
Biz Musany aiat-belgileribiz menen Faraongo zhana anyn elindegi bashchylarga zhiberdik. Al alarga: <<Chyndygynda men butkul makuluktardyn Rabbisinin elchisimin>> - dep aitty.
Kachan alarga Bizdin aiat-belgileribiz kelgende alardyn ustunon maskaralap zhana shyldyn'ap kulushtu.

Biz Faraon menen anyn elindegi bashchylarga Musa alyp kelgen nerse akyikat ekendigine kandai dalilderdi korgozboilu, andan kiiinki kelgen dalil andan dagy kuchtuu bolchu. Biz alardy duinodo azap menen aldyk. Balkim alar kaapyrlyktan kaityshar dep umut kyldyk, birok ech kandai paida chykkan zhok.

Alarga kee bir azaptar kelgende Musaga aityshty: <<Ei, syikyrchy! Rabbin'din yiman keltirsen'er azaptan kutkarabyz dep saga aitkany boiuncha biz uchun Aga duba kylchy. Eger Al bizdi kutkarsa, Biz Aga karai tuura zholgo tushobuz>>.
Kachan Biz alardy azaptan kutkarsak, oshol zamat ubadalaryn buzushtu, any atkaryshkan zhok.

Faraon biiligine chirenip eline zhar saldy: <<Ei, elim! Misirdin biiligi zhana khan sarailarymdyn astynan akkan Nil syiaktuu daryialar maga taandyk emespi?! Siler biiligimdi korboi zhatasyn'arby zhana uluktugumdu taanybai zhatasyn'arby?!
Men kuulgan zhana alsyz Musaga karaganda artykmyn. Al sozdu da tyn'dap suiloi albait.
Any zhibergen Allakh anyn elchi ekenin korgozuu uchun aga altyndan bilerikterdi taksa bolboit bele zhe biri-birin eerchigen perishtelerdi any menen zhiberse bolboit bele?!>>.
Faraon oz elin azgyryp aldady. Oshondo alar anyn adashuusuna moiun sunushtu. Chyndygynda alar Allakhka bash iibegen koom ele.
Kachan alar kaapyrlyktan takyr bash tartpai achuubuzdu keltirgende Biz alardan och alyp, alardyn baarysyn suuga chokturduk.

Biz Faraon menen anyn zhan-zhookorlorun adamdardan aldyn kyldyk, al emi anyn kaapyr koomun alardan kiiin kyldyk zhana adamdar alardyn kylgandaryn kylyp, alardyn bashyna tushkon nersege kabylbash uchun alardy ibarat algandarga sabak kyldyk.

O, paigambar! Mushrikter Allakh Taalanyn: (inWakum wama ta`buduwna min duwni 'llWahi HaSabu jahanWama 'antum laha wariduwna ) <<Siler zhana siler syiyngan Allakhtan bashka nerseler siler kire turgan tozoktun otunu>> degen sozuno khristiandar syiyngan Isa dagy kirip kalat dep oiloshkon. Birok, Allakh Taala aikelderge syiynuudan tyigan syiaktuu Isaga da syiynuudan tyigan ele. Oshondo senin koomun' kyikyryp chuu chygaryp: <<Bizdin kudailarybyz da Isadai boluusuna yraazybyz>> deshkende, Allakh alarga zhoop kylyp: (inWa 'lWadhiyna sabaqat lahum mWinWa 'lHusna~ 'uwlay'ika `anha mub`aduwna) <<Al emi Biz kimge aldyn ala zhakshylyk zhazsak, myna osholor andan alys bolot>> - dep aitty.

Alar: <<Bizdin kudailarybyz zhakshyby zhe Isaby?>> - dep aityshty. Ibn Al'-Zibaara zhana aga okshogondor saga bul misaldy akyikatka zhetuunu zhakshy korushkonu uchun emes, talash-tartyshty zhakshy korushkonu uchun keltirdi. Alar tabiiatynan talashyp-tartyshkan adamdar.

Mariiamdyn uulu Isa - Allakhtyn pendelerinin biri. Biz aga zhakshylyk kylyp paigambarchylyk menen elchilikti berdik. Biz any Israil urpaktaryna Allakhtyn kudurettulugun dalil kyluulary uchun misal kyldyk. Antkeni Allakh Adamdy ata-enesiz zharatkan syiaktuu any atasyz zharatty.

Ei, Adam baldary! Eger Biz silerdi zhok kyluunu kaalaganda, silerdi zhok kylyp koimokpuz zhana silerdin ordun'arga perishtelerdi zher betinde orun basar kylyp koimokpuz. Alar Allakhka ech nerseni sherik kylbastan syiynyshmak.

Chyndygyndy Isa uluu kyiamattyn belgilerinen. Al akyr zaman kelgende tushot. Siler kyiamat kaiymdyn bolorunan shek sanabagyla. Men silerge Allakh taraptan alyp kelgen nersede meni eerchigile. Men silerge alyp kelgen bul nerse ech kandai burmalanuusu zhok tuura zhol.
Shaitan silerdi azgyruu zhana adashtyruu menen tuura zholdon chygaryp zhiberbesin'. Chyndygynda al silerge anyk dushman.

Isa oz eline anyn paigambar ekendigin bildirgen achyk-aikyn dalilder menen kelgende alarga aitty: <<Men silerge Allakh taraptan daanyshmandyk menen zhana oshondoi ele siler dinin'erde talashyp-tartyshkan kee bir nerselerdi baiandash uchun keldim. Emi siler Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkula zhana men silerge buirugan zhana tyigan nerselerde maga moiun sungula!
Chyndygynda Allakh menin zhana silerdin Rabbin'er. Biz uchun Andan bashka Rabbi zhok. Andyktan Aga gana chyn yklastan syiyngyla. Bul zhalgyz kudaiga syiynuu - ech kandai burmalanuusu zhok tuura zhol.

Khristian zhamaattar Isa tuuraluu talashyp-tartyshty. Kee birleri <<al - kudai>> deshse, kee birleri <<al kudaidyn balasy>> deshti, kee birleri bolso <<al enesi ekoosu kudai>> deshti. Isany kudai zhe anyn balasy zhe yiyk uchiltik dep sypattoo menen ozdoruno zyian keltirgenderge kyiamatta alardy kutkon kyinoochu azap-tozok bolsun!

Isa tuuraluu talashyp-tartyshkan al zhamaattar kyiamattyn kelgenin sezbei kalgan abalda alarga kapystan keluusun kutup zhatyshaby? Egerde al alardyn kaapyrlyk abalynda kelse, anda alardyn barar zhaiy kyinoochu azap bolot.

Kaapyrlykta zhana adashuuda dos bolgondor kyiamat kunu biri-birine dushman bolushat. Birok Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtagan takybalar gana andai bolushpait. Alardyn dostugu tuboluk.
Allakh alarga aitat: <<Oo, pendelerim! Bugun silerge myndan ary ech kandai korkunuch bolboit zhana siler otkorup zhibergen duino yrakhattary uchun kaigyrbaisyn'ar.
Alar paigambaryna tushkon Kuranga yiman keltirishti zhana Kuranga eerchip, anyn buiruktaryn atkaryshty zhana tyigandaryn tashtashty.
Siler zhana silerge okshogon yimanduular beiishke kirgile! Siler ech kachan butpogon zhana tugonbogon tuboluktuu zhyrgalchylyktardy korup kubanasyn'ar.

Alardy kyzmatchylary altyn idishter zhana karmoochsuz choichoktor menen ailanyp turushat. Beiishte kon'uldor samagan, kozdor karaganda yrakhattangan nerseler bar. Siler al zhakta tuboluk zhashaisyn'ar, al zhaktan ech kachan chykpaisyn'ar.
Silerge sypattalgan myna oshol beiish - Allakh Oz zhakshylygy menen silerge kylgan ish-araketterin'er uchun muras kyldy.
Al zhakta siler zheshin'er uchun tugonbogon momo-zhemishter bar.

Kachan Allakh takybalardyn syilyktary tuuraluu aitkanda alardyn karama-karshysy bolgon kunookorlor tuuraluu myndai dep aitty:
Chyndygynda kaapyrlyk zhana kunoolordu kylgan kunookorlor kyiamat kunu tozok azabynda tuboluk bolushat.
Alarga azap zhen'ildetilbeit zhana alar al nersede Allakhtyn yraiymynan umutsuz bolushat.
Biz alardy tozokko kirgizip zulumduk kylbadyk. Birok alar kaapyrlyk sebeptuu ozdoruno zulumduk kylyshty.

Alar tozoktun sakchysy Malikti chakyryp: <<Oo, Malik! Rabbin' bizdi oltursunchu, biz azaptan alaly>> - degende al alarga myndai dep zhoop beret: <<Siler olboston daiym azapta bolosun'ar, silerge azap toktotulbait>>.
Biz silerge duinodo shek-kumonsuz akyikat menen kelgenbiz, birok kopchulugun'or akyikatty zhaman kordun'or.
Egerde alar paigambarga ailakerdik kylyshyp, aga karshy aila-amal uiushtursa, Biz dagy alar uchun alardykynan da otkon aila-amaldardy kamdap koiduk.

Zhe Biz alar zhuroktoruno katkan syrlaryn zhe zhashyruun shybyrashkan syr sozdorun ugushpait dep oiloshobu? Albette, biz alardyn baaryn ugabyz! Alardagy perishteler alardyn kylgan bardyk ish-araketterin zhazyp turushat.
Oo, elchi! Kyzdardy Allakhka taandyk kylgandarga aitkyn: <<Allakh alardyn sozunon Zhogoru. zhana Al balaluu boluudan Taza. Allakhka ibadat kylyp, Any aruuloochulardyn algachkysy menmin>>.
Asmandar menen zherdin Rabbisi zhana Arshtyn Rabbisi mushrikterdin Anyn sherigi, aialy zhana balasy bar degen sozdorunon aruu.
Oo, paigambar! Alardy tim koi! Alar ubada kylyngan kyiamat kungo kezikkenge cheiin zhalganga batyp, oinop zhuro berishsin.

Al Allakh asmandagy chynygy kudai zhana zherdegi chynygy kudai. Al Oz zharatuusunda, tagdyr kyluusunda zhana bashkaruusunda Daanyshman, pendelerinin abaldaryn Biluuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.

Asmandar menen zherdegi zhana alardyn ortosundagy biilik Aga gana taandyk bolgon Allakhtyn zhakshylygy zhana berekesi koboidu. Kyiamattyn bolor ubaktysyn Al gana bilet. Any Andan bashka ech kim bilbeit. Siler akyrette surak berish uchun zhana syilyk-zhaza alysh uchun Aga gana kaitasyn'ar.

Mushrikterdin Allakhtan bashka syiyngandary Anyn aldynda shapaat kyluuga eelik kylyshpait. Birok Isa, Uzeir zhana perishteler syiaktuu <<Allakhtan bashka kudai zhok>> ekendigin bilip kubo berishkender gana eelik kylyshat.
Eger sen alardan: <<Silerdi kim zharatkan?>> - dep surasan', alar: <<Bizdi Allakh zharatkan>> - dep gana aityshat. Anda emnege ushintip moiunga algandan kiiin Aga syiynuudan chettep zhatasyn'ar?

Allakh paigambarynyn any oz eli zhalganga chygargany tuuraluu aryz-mun'un zhana al tuuraluu myndai dep aitkanyn bilet: <<Oo, Rabbim! Chyndygynda bul adamdar Sen men arkyluu zhibergen nersege yiman keltirishpedi>>.
Emi sen alardan zhuz bur zhana seni zhamandyktarynan korgogon sozdu ait: <<Siler zhakynda zhazan'ardy alganda bilesin'er>>. (Bul okuia Mekkede bolgon).
(Hm) Bul tuuraluu Bakara surosunun bashtalyshynda soz bolgon.
Allakh Tuura Zholdu baiandoochu Kuranga ant berdi.
Biz Kurandy Kadyr tundo tushurduk. Al zhakshylyktarga tolgon tun. Chyndygynda Biz bul Kuran menen korkutup eskertebiz.
Bul tundo Allakh oshol zhyly ishke ashyra turgan yrysky, azhal zhana bashka nerselerge bailanyshtuu okum kylyngan butkul ishter chechilet.
Biz Ozubuz taraptan okum kylyngan ar bir ishti chechebiz. Chyndygynda Biz paigambarlardy zhiberebiz.

Oo, paigambar! Biz Rabbin' taraptan paigambar zhiberile turgandarga yraiym katary paigambarlardy zhiberebiz. Chyndygynda Al pendelerinin sozdorun Uguuchu, alardyn ish-araketterin zhana nietterin Biluuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.
Al asmandar menen zherdin zhana alardyn ortosundagy nerselerdin Rabbisi. Egerde siler buga teren' ishensen'er, anda Menin elchime yiman keltirgile.
Andan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok. Al tiriltet zhana olturot. Andan bashka tiriltuuchu zhana olturuuchu zhok. Al silerdin zhana murunku ata-babalaryn'ardyn Rabbisi.
Al mushrikter buga ishenishpeit. Teskerisinche, alar zhalgan zholdo bolgonu sebeptuu bul nerseden shektenishet zhana kon'ul da burushpait.
O, paigambar! Sen elin'e zhakyndap kalgan azapty kut. Al azap asmandy tutun kaptagan kunu bolot, alar any katuu korkunuchta oz kozu menen korot.
Al elin'din baaryn orop alat. Alarga aitylat: <<Silerdin bashyn'arga tushkon bul azap - kyinoochu azap>>.
Oshondo alar Rabbisine zhalbaryp: <<Rabbibiz! Sen bizge zhibergen azapty bizden ketir. Eger Sen any bizden ketirsen', biz Saga zhana paigambaryn'a yiman keltirebiz>> - dep duba kylyshat.
Alar kantip esine kelip, Rabbisine kaityshmak ele, antkeni alarga chynchyldygy zhana amanatkoilugu belgiluu zhana paigambarlygy anyk elchi keldi?!
Kiiin alar aga ishenuudon bash tartyshty zhana al tuuraluu: <<Aga bashka biroolor uirotot, al paigambar emes>> - deshti. Oshondoi ele any zhindi dep da aityshty.
Chyndygynda Biz silerden azapty bir az ketirgen bolsok, siler kaira ele kaapyrlygyn'arga zhana zhalganyn'arga kaitasyn'ar.
Oo, paigambar! Biz koomun'dagy kaapyrlardy kuch menen katuu karmagan Badr kunun kut. Biz alardan Allakhka kylgan kaapyrlyktary zhana paigambardy zhalganga chygargandary uchun och alabyz.
Biz alardan murun Faraondun koomun synaganbyz. Alarga Allakh taraptan syiluu paigambar Musa kelip, alardy Allakhty zhalgyzdoogo zhana Aga syiynuuga chakyrdy.

Musa Faraon menen anyn koomuna aitty: <<Allakhtyn pendeleri bolgon Israildin urpaktaryn maga tashtagyla. Alardy kul kyluuga silerdin ukugun'ar zhok. Chyndygynda men silerge Allakh taraptan kelgen elchimin, Al maga buirugan nerseni zhetkiruugo ishenichtuumun, andan ech bir nerseni kemitpeim zhana koshpoim.
Zhana siler Allakhka syiynuudan bash tartyp zhana pendelerine boi kotorup tekeberlik kylbagyla. Chyndygynda men silerge achyk-aikyn dalildi alyp kelem.
Siler meni tashbaran'ga alyp olturup koiuun'ardan menin zhana silerdin Rabbin'erden korgoo suraimyn.
Eger siler men alyp kelgen nersege ishenbesen'er, anda meni tynch koigula zhana maga zyian berip zhakyn zholobogula>>.
Anan Musa Rabbisine: <<Faraon zhana anyn zhan zhokorloru - tezinen zhaza aluuga tatyktuu kunookor koom>> - dep duba kyldy.
Oshondo Allakh Musaga oz elin' menen tun zhamynyp zholgo chyk dep buirudu zhana Faraon menen anyn koomu silerdin artyn'ardan tushot dep kabar berdi.
Aga Israildin urpaktary menen birge den'izden otkondo any oz kalybynda tynch tashtap ketuunu buirudu. Chyndygynda Faraon zhana anyn askeri den'izge chokturulup zhok bolushat.
Faraon menen anyn koomu artynda kanchalagan baktardy zhana akkan bulaktardy kaltyryp ketishti.
Kanchalagan eginzarlardy zhana kooz oturum zhailardy kaltyryp ketishti.
Kanchalagan zhyrgalchylykka tolgon zhashoonu tashtap ketishti.
Silerge sypattap aitylgan myna ushul nerseler alardyn bashyna tushtu. Biz alardyn bakchalaryn, bulaktaryn, eginzarlaryn zhana orunduktaryn bashka koom bolgon Israildin urpaktaryna muras kyldyk.
Faraon menen koomu suuga chokkondo alar uchun asman da, zher da yilagan zhok zhana alarga toobo kyluuga moonot da berilgen zhok.
Biz Israildin urpaktaryn kordoochu azaptan kutkardyk. Antkeni Faraon menen koomu alardyn bala-chakalaryn olturup, aialdaryn tiruu kaltyryshchu.
Biz alardy Faraondun azabynan saktadyk. Chyndygynda al Allakhtyn buiruktary menen dininin cheginen chygyp tekeberlik kylgandardan bolchu.
Biz Ozubuz bilip Israil urpaktaryn al zamandagy aalamdardan paigambarlarynyn koptugu sebeptuu tandap alganbyz.
Biz alarga Musany koldoo maksatta bergen manna shirindigi, bodono zhana bashka ushular syiaktuu achyk zhakshylyktardy kamtygan dalilderdi berdik.
Chyndygynda al zhalganchy mushrikter kaira tiriluunu chetke kagyp myndai dep aityshat:
<<Biz uchun bir gana olum bar, andan kiiin ech kandai zhashoo zhok. Bul olumdon kiiin biz kaira tirilbeibiz.

Ei, Mukhammad! Sen zhana seni eerchigender Allakh oluktordu surak zhana zhaza-syilyk uchun kaira tiriltet degen sozun'ordo chynchyl bolson'or, anda olgon ata-babalarybyzdy tiriltip alyp kelgilechi?!>>.

Oo, paigambar! Kuch-kubattuuluk zhaktan seni zhalganga chygargan mushrikter artykpy zhe alardan murunku Aad zhana Samud syiaktuu Tubba koomu artykpy? Biz alardyn baarysyn zhok kyldyk. Chyndygynda alar kunookorlor ele.
Biz asmandar menen zherdi zhana alardyn ortosundagy nerselerdi oinop zharatkan zhokpuz.
Biz asmandar menen zherdi uluu daanyshmandyk uchun zharattyk. Birok kopchuluk mushrikter munu bilishpeit.
Allakh pendelerinin ortosunda okum kyla turgan kyiamat kun - Allakh but makuluktardy chogultuu uchun belgilegen ubakyt.

Al kundo zhakyn zhakynyna, dos dosuna paida keltire albait zhana alar ozdorun Allakhtyn azabynan korgoi alyshpait. Antkeni al kundo biilik Allakhka gana taandyk bolot. Ech kim aga ee ekendigin aityp chyga albait.
