Allakh yraiym kylgan adamdar gana kylgan zhakshylyk ishterinen paida alyshat. Chyndygynda Allakh ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu, toobo kylgan pendelerine Yraiymduu.

Kachan Allakh kyiamat kunu adamdar syilyk zhana zhazaga zharasha bolunorun aitkandan kiiin myndai dep aitty:
Allakh tozoktun tubundo osturgon Zakkum daragy.
Chon' kunoo kylgandyn tamak-ashy. Al kaapyr anyn zhiiirkenichtuu momosunon zheit.
Al momo kapkara maidai, al katuu ysygandyktan alardyn kursagynda kainait.
Oto ysyk suunun kainagany syiaktuu.
Tozoktun sakchylaryna aitylat: <<Any karmagyla da, kankorduk menen tozoktun ortosuna suirop bargyla.
Anan bul azaptalgandyn tobosuno kainak suu kuigula. Al azaptan kutulbait>>.
Aga shyldyn' iretinde aitylat: <<Bul kyinoochu azapty tart! Sen oz elin'de ech kandai zyian tartpagan kadyrluu emes belen'>>.
Chyndygynda siler kyiamat kunu bolo turgan bul azaptan shektengensin'er. Emi siler any korgonun'ordon kiiin shek-kumonun'or zhogoldu.
Al emi Rabbisinin buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtagan takyba adamdar ech kandai zhamandyk zhetpegen beipil zhailarda bolushat.
Bakchalarda zhana akkan bulaktarda.
Alar beiishte zhuka zhana kalyn' zhibek kiiimderdi kiiip, biri ekinchisinin artyn korbogudoi bet-man'dai olturushat.
Biz alardy bul aitylgandar menen syilaganybyz syiaktuu alardy beiishte kozunun karasy kapkara, agy appak bolgon bakyran' koz chyrailuu aialdarga uilondurobuz.
Alar al zhaida kyzmatchylaryn chakyryp, ozdoru kaalagan tugongus zhana zyiansyz momo-zhemishterdi aldyryshat.
Al zhakta tuboluk kalyshat. Alar duino zhashoosundagy birinchi olumdon bashka olumdu tatyshpait. Allakh alardy tozok azabynan korgoit.
Bul Rabbin'den bolgon aikolduk zhana zhakshylyk! Alardy beiishke kirgizuu zhana tozokton korgoo syiaktuu bul aitylgan nerseler - ech bir zhen'ish ten' kelbegen uluu zhen'ish.
Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda Biz bul Kurandy alar eskerme alyshar beken dep sen suilogon arab tilinde tushurup zhen'il kyldyk.
Emi sen zhen'ishin'di zhana alardyn kyiroosun kut. Alar dagy senin kyiroon'du kutup zhatyshat.
(Hm) Bul tuuraluu Bakara surosunun bashtalyshynda soz bolgon.
Kuran ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu, pendelerinin kyzykchylyktaryn Biluuchu Allakh taraptan tushtu.
Chyndygynda asmandar menen zherde yimanduular uchun Allakhtyn kudurettuulugun zhana zhalgyzdygyn bildirgen dalilder bar. Antkeni osholor aiat-belgilerden sabak alyshat.

Oo, adamdar! Silerdin bel suudan, kiiin bir uzum etten, kiiin koiuu kandan zharaluun'arda zhana Allakh zher betindegi zhan-zhanybarlardy tarkatyp zharatuusunda Allakh Zharatuuchu ekenine ishengen adamdar uchun Anyn zhalgyzdygyna dalilder bar.

Kun menen tundun almashuusunda, Allakh asmandan zhamgyr zhaadyryp ech kandai osumduk ospogon oluk zherdi ondurup tiriltuusundo zhana silerdin paidan'ar uchun birde bul taraptan, birde tigil taraptan sokkon shamaldardy zhurguzuusundo akyl zhugurtkon adamdar uchun dalilder bar. Alar bulardy Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygyna, kaira tiriltuugo zhana bardyk nersege kudurettuu ekendigine dalil kylyshat.

Oo, paigambar! Biz saga bul aiattar menen dalilderdi akyikat menen okup berebiz. Egerde alar pendebizge tushurgon Allakhtyn sozuno zhana dalilderine ishenishpese, anda myndan kiiin kaisy sozgo ishenishet, kaisy dalilderdi chyndyk dep bilishet?!
Kunooloru kop ar bir zhalganchyga Allakh taraptan kyiroo zhana azap bolsun!

Bul kaapyr Kurandagy aga okulgan Allakhtyn aiattaryn ukkandan kiiin da akyikatty eerchuudon ozuncho boi kotorup kaapyrlygyn zhana kunoolorun ulanta berse, anda al aga okulgan aiattardy ukpagan syiaktuu ele. Oo, paigambar! Aga akyrette zyian alyp kelgen zhan kyinoochu azap kutup turganyn kabarla!
Egerde aga Kurandan bir nerse zhetse, al any shyldyn'dap bashtait. Kurandy shyldyn'ga algan sypattagy al adamdarga kyiamat kunu kordoochu azap bar.

Alardy akyrette aldynan tozok otu kutup turat. Alarga tapkan bailyktary Allakhtyn aldynda ech paida keltirbeit zhana alardyn kudai tutup syiyngan Andan bashka aikel kudailary alardy ech nerseden korgoi alyshpait. Alar uchun kyiamatta chon' azap bar.
Biz elchibiz Mukhammadga tushurgon bul Kitep akyikat zholgo bagyttoochu. Al emi alardyn Rabbisinin Oz elchisine tushurgon aiattaryna kaapyrlyk kylgandarga katuu kyinoochu azap bar.

Oo, adamdar! Allakh zhalgyz Oz buirugu menen kemeler zhurush uchun zhana siler ar turduu adal emgekter arkyluu Anyn zhakshylyktaryn surashyn'ar uchun silerge den'izdi moiun sundurdu. Balkim siler Allakhtyn silerge kylgan zhakshylyktaryna shugur kylarsyn'ar.

Allakh Taala Ozunun artykchylygy zhana zhakshylyk kyluusu menen silerge asmandagy kun, ai, zhyldyzdardy zhana zherdegi daryia, bak-darak, toolordu zhana bashka neemattaryn moiun sundurdu. Chynynda, bul nerselerdi moiun sunduruuda, Allakhtyn aiat-belgilerine oi zhugurtup ibarat algandar uchun Anyn kudurettuuluguno zhana zhalgyzdygyna dalilder bar.

Oo, paigambar! Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn elchisin chynchyl dep bilgenderge ait: <<Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryna zhe zhamandyktaryna kon'ul burbagan kaapyrlardyn silerge keltirgen zyiandaryn kechirgile. Chyndygynda Allakh sabyr kylgan bardyk yimanduularga zhana chekten ashkan kaapyrlarga duinodo kylgan ishterine zharasha syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret>>.

Kimde-kim zhakshylyk ish kylsa, anda anyn kylgan zhakshylyk ishinin arty ozuno paida. Allakh anyn kylgan ish-araketine muktazh emes. Al emi kim zhamandyk ish kylsa, anda anyn kylgan zhamandyk ishinin arty ozuno zyian. Anyn kylgan zhamandygy Allakhka ech zyian keltirbeit. Kiiin akyrette Biz silerge ozun'or tatyktuu bolgon syilyk zhe zhazany berish uchun Bizge gana kaitasyn'ar.

Biz Israil urpaktaryna Tooratty, adamdardyn ortosunda any menen adilettuu okum kyluunu berdik, Ibrakhimdin urpaktary kopchuluk paigambarlardy alardan chygardyk, alarga turluu-turluu adal nerselerdi yrysky kyldyk zhana alardy oz zamanynda aalamda artyk kyldyk.

Zhana Biz alarga akyikatty zhalgandan aiyrmalagan dalilderdi berdik. Alarga paigambarybyz Mukhammaddyn zhiberilishi menen dalilder kelgenden kiiin gana talashyp-tartyshyshty zhana alardy myndai kaiym aityshuuga biilikke zhana kadyr-barkka zhantalashuudan ulam biri-birine bolgon zulumduk gana turtku berdi. Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda Rabbin' kyiamatta alardyn duinodo talashyp-tartyshkan nerselerine okum chygaryp, alardyn kimisi akyikatta, kimisi zhalganda bolgonun achyktait.

Kiiin Biz senden murunku paigambarlarybyzga buirugan Oz buirugubuz menen seni yimanga zhana zhakshylyk ishterge chakyrgan zholdo kyldyk. Emi sen ushul shariiatty eerchi. Akyikatty bilbegenderdin kaaloolorun eerchibe. Antkeni alardyn kaalooloru akyikattan adashtyrat.

Egerde sen alardyn kaaloolorun eerchisen', anda akyikatty bilbegender Allakhtyn azabyn senden toso alyshpait. Chyndygynda bardyk dindegi zalymdar yimanduularga karshy biri-birin koldop zhardam berishet. Allakh bolso Anyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtagan takybalardy koldoit.

Biz paigambarybyzga tushurgon bul Kuran adamdarga akyikatty zhalgandan aiyrmalap korgozgon aikyndoochu, akyikatka bagyttoochu zhana ishengen adamdar uchun yraiymduuluk. Antkeni myna osholor Rabbisin yraazy kyluu uchun al arkyluu tuura zholgo tushushot.

Dene-mucholoru menen kaapyrlyk zhana kunoolordu kylgandar syilyk zhe zhaza aluuda Biz alardy Allakhka yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandar syiaktuu kylyp, alardy duino menen akyrette birdei kylat dep oilop zhatyshaby? Alardyn bul okumu kandai zhaman!

Allakh asmandar menen zherdi uluu daanyshmandyk uchun zhana ar bir zhan ozu kylgan zhakshylyk zhe zhamandyk ishtin syilyk-zhazasyn alysh uchun zharatty. Alardy zhondon-zhon ele zharatkan emes. Allakh alardyn zhakshylyktaryn kemitip zhe kunoolorun koboitup zulumduk kylbait.

Oo, paigambar! Oz napsi kaaloosun eerchip, aga karshy chykpastan any kudai tutup algan adamdy karabaisyn'by. Allakh any Ozu bilip adashtyryp koidu. Antkeni al adashuuga tatyktuu. Anyn zhurogun moorlop koidu, al paida ala turgandai den'geelde ukpait zhana anyn kozun akyikatty koruudon tosup koidu. Allakh any adashtyryp koigondon kiiin kim any akyikatka bashtai alat?! Siler napsi kaaloonu eerchuunun zyianduulugun zhana Allakhtyn shariiatyn eerchuunun paidaluulugun oilonboisun'arby?!

Kaira tiriluunu chetke kakkan kaapyrlar aityshty: <<Bul duinodogu gana zhashoobuz bar, andan kiiin ech kandai zhashoo zhok. Muundar otot, alar kaira kaityp kelishpeit. Muundar zhan'yrat zhana alardy tun menen kundun almashuusu gana olturot>>. Alarda kaira tiriluunu zhokko chygaruu tuuraluu ilim zhok. Alar bozhomol oilorgo gana taianyshat. Chyndygynda bozhomol oilor akyikatka ech kandai paida keltirbeit.

Kaira tiriluunu zhokko chygargan mushrikterge achyk-aikyn aiattarybyz okulganda alardyn paigambarga zhana sakhabalarga aitkan bul sozdorunon bashka keltireer ech kandai dalilderi zhok: <<Biz olgondon kiiin kaira tirilebiz degen sozun'or chyn bolso, anda bizdin ata-babalarybyzdy tiriltkilechi?!>>.

Oo, paigambar! Alarga ait: <<Allakh silerdi zharatyp tiriltet, kiiin olturot. Olgonun'ordon kiiin kyiamatta surak zhana zhaza-syilyk uchun silerdi chogultat. Al kun shek-kumonsuz kelet>>. Birok kopchuluk adamdar bilishpeit. Oshonduktan al uchun zhakshylyk ishterdi kylyp daiardyk korushpoit.

Asmandar menen zherdin mulku zhalgyz Allakhka taandyk. Al ekoosundo Andan bashka ech kim syiynuuga tatyktuu emes. Allakh oluktordu surak zhana zhaza-syilyk uchun kaira tiriltken kyiamat kunu bolgondo Allakhtan bashkaga syiyngan zhana akyikatty zhok kylyp, zhalgandy ornotuuga araket kylgandar zhogotuuga uchurashat.

Oo, paigambar! Al kunu bardyk ummottor bizge emne kylynat dep kutkon abalda tizilep turgandaryn korosun'. Bardyk ummottor sakchy perishteler zhazyp koigon amal kitebine chakyrylat. Ei, adamdar! Siler bugun duinodo kylgan zhakshylyk-zhamandyk ishterin'erdin syilygyn zhe zhazasyn alasyn'ar.

Bizdin perishteler ish-araketterin'erdi zhazyp koigon bul kitebibiz akyikat menen silerge kubogo otot, emi any okugula. Chyndygynda Biz sakchy perishtelerdi duinodo kylgan ishterin'erdi zhazgyla dep buiruganbyz.
Yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandardy Rabbisi Oz yraiymy menen beiishke kirgizet. Allakh alarga bergen bul syilyk - ech bir zhen'ish ten' kelbegen anyk zhen'ish.

Al emi Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandarga zhemelep aitylat: <<Silerge Menin aiattarym okulganda, alarga yiman keltiruudon tekeberlik kylbadyn'ar bele? Siler kaapyrlyk zhana kunoolordu kylgan kunookor koom bolchusun'ar>>.

Egerde silerge: <<Chyndygynda Allakhtyn pendelerine alardy kaira tiriltip, syilyk-zhazalaryn berem degen ubadasy zhana kyiamattyn bolushu shek-kumonsuz akyikat. Emi siler al uchun araket kylgyla>> - dep aitylsa, siler myndai dedin'er: <<Biz bul kyiamat degendi bilbeibiz. Biz anyn keleri tuuraluu ara oidobuz, anyn kelerine takyr ishenbeibiz>>.
Alardyn duinodo kylgan kaapyrlyk zhana kunoolor syiaktuu zhamandyk ishteri achykka chykty zhana alarga eskertilgen kezde shyldyn'dashkan azap bashtaryna keldi.

Allakh alarga aitty: <<Siler bul kungo kezigerin'erdi unutkanyn'ar zhana aga yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kamdabaganyn'ar syiaktuu Biz bugun silerdi tozokko tashtaibyz. Silerdin bash kalkalar zhaiyn'ar tozok. Silerdi Allakhtyn azabynan korgoi turgan ech bir zhardamchy bolboit.

Siler azaptalyp zhatkan bul azaptyn sebebi, siler Allakhtyn aiattaryn shyldyn'dap azil-tamasha tutkansyn'ar zhana silerdi zhashoo zhyrgalchylyktary aldap koidu. Emi bugun Allakhtyn aiattaryn shyldyn'dagan al kaapyrlar tozokton chygyshpait. Alar al zhakta tuboluk kalyshat zhana Rabbisin yraazy kyla turgandai zhakshylyk ishterdi kyluu uchun duino zhashoosuna da kaityshpait.
Asmandardyn menen zherdin zhana butkul makuluktardyn Rabbisi bolgon Allakhka gana maktoolor bolsun!
Asmandardagy uluuluk zhana kudurettuuluk Aga gana taandyk. Al ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu, Oz zharatuusunda, bashkaruusunda zhana shariiatynda Daanyshman.
(Hm) Khaa. Miim. Ushuga okshogon sozdun tushundurmosu bakara suroosunun bashynda aitylgan.
Kuran ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu, Oz zharatuusunda, tagdyr kyluusunda zhana shariiatynda Daanyshman Allakh taraptan tushtu.

Biz asmandar menen zherdi zhana alardyn ortosundagylardy zhon saldy zharatkan emespiz. Biz alardyn baaryn akyikattyk menen zhetkiliktuu daanyshmandykta zharattyk. Oshol daanyshmandyktan biri - pendeler osholor arkyluu Allakhty taanyp biluusu, Aga ech nerseni sherik kylbastan zhalgyz Aga ibadat kyluusu, Allakhka gana belgiluu moonotko cheiin zher betinde orun basarlyk mildetin atkaryp turuusu. Al emi Allakhka kaapyr bolgondor Anyn kitebindegi eskertuulordon zhuz burup, kon'ul burbai koiushtu.

Oo, paigambar! Akyikattan zhuz burgan mushrikterge ait: <<Maga aitkylachy, siler Allakhtan bashka syiynyp zhatkan kudailaryn'ar zherdin kaisy bolugun zharatty? Alar toolordu zharattyby? Alar daryialardy zharattyby? Zhe asmandardy zharatuuda alardyn Allakh menen sherikteshtigi zhe enchisi barby? Kudailaryn'ar syiynuuga tatyktuu degen sozun'or chyn bolso, anda Allakh taraptan Kurandan murun tushkon kitepti zhe abalkylardan saktalyp kalgan ilimdi maga alyp kelgilechi?>>.

Kyiamatka cheiin dubasyna zhoop bere albagan Allakhtan bashka kudailarga syiyngan adamdan otkon adashuuchu zhok. Alardyn Allakhtan bashka syiyngan kudailary syiynuuchularyna paida zhe zyian keltirmek tursun, alardyn dubalaryn kapyryna da alyshpait.
Alarga bul duinodo paida berishpegenine karabastan, kyiamatta chogulganda syiynuuchularyna dushman bolushat, alardan bash tartyshat zhana alardyn syiyngandary tuuraluu bilbeibiz dep tanyp ketishet.

Egerde alarga paigambarybyzga tushkon aiattar okulsa, alardyn paigambary oz kolu menen alyp kelgen Kuranga kaapyrlyk kylgandar: <<Bul anyk ele syikyr. Allakh taraptan kelgen vakhii emes>> - dep aityshat.

Al mushrikter: <<Mukhammad bul Kurandy oz oiunan chygaryp, any Allakhka taandyk kylyp koidu>> - dep zhatyshaby? Oo, paigambar! Alarga ait: <<Egerde men any oz oiumdan chygarsam, anda siler Allakhtyn maga kaalagan azabynan kutkaruunun ailasyn taba almak emessin'er. Men Anyn atynan oiumdan chygaryp ozumdu-ozum kantip azapka salmak elem? Siler Allakhtyn Kurany tuuraluu zhaman sozdordu aityp zhana meni zhamanatty kylyp zhatkanyn'ardy Al zhakshy bilet. Al siler menen menin ortobuzda kubo boluuga Ozu zhetishtuu. Al toobo kylgan pendelerine Kechirimduu, alarga Yraiymduu>>.

Oo, paigambar! Paigambarlygyn'dy zhalganga chygargan mushrikterge ait: <<Siler kylgan daavatyma tan' kala turgandai, Allakh taraptan birinchi paigambar bolup kelip zhatkan zhokmun. Menden murun da koptogon paigambarlar kelishken. Bul duinodo Allakh meni zhana silerdi emne kylaryn bilbeimin. Men Allakhtyn vakhii kylgan nersesine gana eerchiim. Menin aitkan ar bir sozum, ar bir ishim Anyn vakhiiine tuura kelet. Men bolgonu silerge Allakhtyn azabyn eskertken achyk eskertuuchumun>>.

Oo, paigambar! Al zhalganchylarga ait: <<Aitkylachy, egerde bul Kuran Allakh taraptan bolup, birok siler aga kaapyrlyk kylsan'ar zhana Israil urpaktarynan biroosu al tuuraluu Tooratta kelgen nersege taianyp, al Allakh taraptan ekenine kubogo otso zhana aga yiman keltirse, birok siler aga yiman keltiruudon tekeberlik kylsan'ar, myna oshondo siler zulum kylgan bolboisun'arby? Chyndygynda Allakh akyikatka zulumduk kylgan koomgo iigilik berbeit>>.

Kuranga zhana alarga paigambary alyp kelgen nersege kaapyrlyk kylgandar yimanduularga: <<Egerde Mukhammad alyp kelgen nerse chyndap ele zhakshylykka bagyttagan bolso, anda tigil kedeiler, kuldar zhana alsyzdar bizden ashyp ketishpeit bolchu>> - deshet. Antkeni alar paigambary alyp kelgendi zholdogon zhok zhana alar: <<Anyn bizge alyp kelgen bul nersesi eski zhalgandardan. Biz zhalgandy eerchibeibiz>> - deshet.

Bul Kurandan murun Allakh Musaga akyikatta eerchuuchu zhol bashchy bolgon zhana Israil urpaktarynan aga yiman keltirip, eerchigenderge yraiym bolgon Toorat kitebin tushurdu. Al emi Mukhammadga tushkon bul Kuran Allakhka shirk zhana kunoolordu kyluu menen ozdoruno zyian keltirgenderdi eskertish uchun, oshondoi ele Zharatuuchusu zhana makuluktar menen zhakshy mamilede bolgon adamdarga suiunchu katary ozunon murunku kitepterdi tastyktap arab tilinde tushtu.

<<Rabbibiz - Allakh. Biz uchun Andan bashka Rabbi zhok>> - dep aityp, andan son' yiman zholuna tushup, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandarga kelechekte keluuchu akyrette ech kandai korkunuch zhok zhana alar duinodo otkorup zhibergen zhyrgalchylyktarga zhana artynda tashtagan nerselerge kaigyryshpait.
Myna ushundai sypattagy adamdar - beiish adamdary. Alar duinodo kylgan zhakshylyk ishterinin syilygy katary al zhakta tuboluk kalyshat.

Biz insanga ata-enesin tiruu kezinde zhana olgondon kiiin shariiatka karshy kelbegen den'geelde syilap, alarga zhakshylyk kyluuga keskin buiruk berdik. Airykcha enesi any kyiynchylyk menen boiunda kotordu zhana kyinalyp torodu. Any boiunda kotoruu zhana emchekten chygaruu moonotu otuz ai sozulat. Oshentip al akyl zhana dene zhaktan kubattuu bolup kyrk zhashka tolgondo aitty: <<Rabbim! Sen maga zhana ata-eneme kylgan zhakshylygyn'a shugur kyluunu zhana Seni yraazy kylgan zhakshylyk ishterdi kyluunu kon'ulumo sal zhana alardy menden kabyl kyl. Bala-chakamdy on'doi kor. Men Saga kunoolorum uchun toobo kyldym zhana Saga bash iiip, buiruktaryn'a moiun sunamyn>>.

Biz alardyn kylgan en' zhakshy ish-araketterin kabyl kylyp, kunoolorun kechirebiz, alar uchun zhazalabaibyz. Alar beiishtik adamdardyn katarynda bolushat. Alarga berilgen bul ubada - zhakynda sozsuz ishke ashuuchu chynygy ubada.

Kachan ata-enesin yraazy kyluuga chakyryp, alardy syilagan adamdy misal kylgan kezde ata-eneni naarazy kyluudan eskertip, alardy syilabagan adamdy misal kylyp myndai dep aitty:
Al emi ata-enesine myndai dep aitkany bar: <>. Ata-enesi Allakhtan any yimanga keltiruugo zhardam surap balasyna: <> - deshet. Oshondo al kaita tiriluunu dagy chetke kagyp myndai deit: <>.
Alarga zhinder menen adamdardan bolgon koomdordun katarynda azap mildet boldu. Chyndygynda alar ozdorun zhana ui-bulolorun tozokko kirgizip zhogotuuga uchuragandar.

Ar bir topko, tagyraak aitkanda beiish tobu menen tozok tobuna Allakh alardyn kylgan ish-araketterinin syilygyn toluk berish uchun ish-araketterine zharasha darazhalar bar. Beiishtegilerdin darazhalary biiik, tozoktogulardyn darazhalary tomon. Alarga kyiamat kunu sooptoru kemitilip zhana kunooloru koboitulup zulumduk kylynbait.

Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyp, paigambarlardy zhalganga chygargandar azaptalysh uchun tozokko alyp kelingen kunu alarga zheme katary myndai dep aitylat: <<Siler zhakshylyktaryn'ardy duino zhashoosunda korottun'ar zhana al zhaktagy zhyrgalchylyktardy paidalandyn'ar. Emi bugun bolso zher betindegi sebepsiz tekeberligin'er, oshondoi ele Allakhka kaapyrlyk zhana kunoolordu kylyp Aga moiun sunbaganyn'ar sebeptuu kordoochu azap menen zhazalanasyn'ar>>.

Oo, paigambar! Aaddyn tuugandashy Khuddu estechi. Al Arab zharym aralynyn tushtugundogu kum dobolordo zhaigashkan turak-zhailardagy oz koomun Allakhtyn azabynan eskertti. Khudga cheiin zhana andan kiiin da oz koomdorun eskertken paigambarlar otushkon. Alar koomdoruna aityshkan: <<Allakhka gana syiyngyla! Any menen katar bashkaga syiynbagyla! Oo, elim! Chyndygynda men siler uchun uluu kyiamat kundogu azaptan korkomun>>.
Eli aga aitty: <<Sen bizdi kudailarybyzga syiynuudan kaitargany keldin'bi? Ech kachan andai bolboit! Egerde aitkan sozun' chyn bolso, bizge ubada kylgan azapty alyp kelchi>>.

Al aitty: <<Azaptyn ubaktysyn Allakh gana bilet. Men al tuuraluu bilbeimin. Men silerge zhiberilgen nerseni gana zhetkiruuchu paigambarmyn. Birok siler naadandyk kylyp paidaluunu tashtap zhatasyn'ar, zyianduunu kylyp zhatasyn'ar>>.

Kachan alarga ozdoru shashtyrgan azap kelgende, asmandan alardyn oroonun kozdoi bet algan buluttardy korup: <<Bul bizge zhamgyr zhaadyruuchu kara bulut>> - deshti. Khud alarga aitty: <<Bul siler oilogondoi zhamgyrluu bulut emes. Al siler shashtyrgan azap. Al zhan kyinoochu azaptuu shamal>>.

Allakh aga zhok kyl dep buirugan kaisy nerseni zhandap otposun, alardyn but baarynyn tash-talkanyn chygardy. Alar kyrylyp kalyshty. Alardyn bir kezde zhashap otkonuno kubo bolgon uilorunon bashka ech nerse korunboi kaldy. Biz kaapyrlyktan zhana kunoolordon kooshorup kaitpagan kunookorlordu myna ushundai kyinoochu zhaza menen zhazalaibyz.

Biz Khuddun koomuna silerge berbegen kubattuuluk sebepterin berdik. Zhana alarga ugush uchun kulaktardy, korush uchun kozdordu, akyl zhugurtush uchun zhuroktordu berdik. Birok alarga kulaktary, kozdoru zhana akyldary ech paida keltirgen zhok zhana alardy Allakhtyn azaby kelgende korgoi algan zhok. Antkeni alar Allakhtyn aiattaryna kaapyrlyk kylyshty. Alarga paigambary Khud eskertkenine karabastan shyldyn'dap zhatyshkan azap bashtaryna tushtu.
Oo, Mekke eli! Biz silerdin ailanan'ardagy shaarlardy kyirattyk. Aad, Samud, Lut koomun zhana Madiian eelerin zhok kyldyk. Alar kaapyrlyktan kaityshat degen umutto alarga turduu dalilderdi keltirdik.

Alar zhakyndaibyz dep kudai tutup syiyngan zhana kurmandyk chalgan Allakhtan bashka kudailary alarga zhardam berishpeibi?! Alar ech kachan zhardam berishken emes. Teskerisinche alar oto muktazh bolup turgan uchurda zhok bolup ketishti. Bul alardyn oshol aikelderi zhardam beret zhana Allakhtyn aldynda shapaat kylat dep ozdorun tynchtantyp zhurgon zhalgandary zhana doomattary.

Oo, paigambar! Biz saga tushkon Kurandy uguu uchun bir top zhinderdi zhibergenibizdi estechi. Alar any uguuga kelishkende, biri-birine: <<Tynchtangyla, zhakshylap ugaly>> - deshti. Kachan paigambar okup butkondo, alar oz koomu bul Kuranga yiman keltirishpese, anda alarga Allakhtyn azaby bolorun eskertuu uchun kaityp ketishti.

Alarga aityshty: <<Oo, koomubuz! Biz Allakh taraptan tushkon murunku kitepterdi tastyktagan Musadan kiiinki tushkon kitepti uktuk. Biz ukkan bul kitep akyikatka zholdoit zhana tuura zhol bolgon Islam zholuna bagyttait.

Oo, koomubuz! Silerdi akyikatka chakyrgan Mukhammadga zhoop bergile zhana al Rabbisi taraptan kelgen elchi dep yiman keltirgile. Oshondo Allakh kunoolorun'ordu kechiret zhana silerdi zhan oorutkan azaptan saktait. Egerde siler anyn akyikatka karai chakyrygyna zhoop berbesen'er zhana al Rabbisi taraptan kelgen elchi dep yiman keltirbesen'er, anda silerdi zhan oorutkan azap kutot.

Kim Mukhammaddyn akyikatka karai chakyrygyna zhoop berbese, anda al zher betinde Allakhtan kachyp kutula albait zhana any azaptan kutkara turgan Allakhtan bashka ech bir zhardamchy bolboit. Alar akyikattan anyk adashuuda.

Kaira tiriluunu zhalganga chygargan mushrikter korushpoibu, asmandar menen zherdi zharatkan zhana alardyn chon'duguna zhana ken'digine karabastan alardy zharatuuda alsyzdyk kylbagan Allakh, surak zhana syilyk uchun oluktordu kaira tiriltuugo kudurettuu emespi? Albette, alardy tiriltuugo Kudurettuu. Chyndygynda Al bardyk nersege Kudurettuu. Oluktordu kaira tiriltuudo Any ech kim alsyz kyla albait.

Allakhka zhana Anyn elchilerine kaapyrlyk kylgandar tozokko azaptalysh uchun alyp kelingen kunu alarga zheme katary aitylat: <<Siler korup turgan bul azap chyndyk beken? Zhe al siler duinodo aityp zhurgondoi zhalgan beken?>>. Alar aityshty: <<Albette, Rabbibizge ant bolsun. Bul anyk chyndyk>>. Alarga aitylat: <<Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylganyn'ar sebeptuu azap tartkyla>>.

Oo, paigambar! Elin'din seni zhalganga chygarganyna turuktuuluk eeleri bolgon Nukh, Ibrakhim, Musa, Isa paigambarlardai bolup sabyr kyl zhana alarga azapty shashtyrba! Elin'degi kaapyrlar alarga ubada kylyngan akyrettegi azapty korushkondo, alarga berilgen azaptyn uzaktygynan ulam duinodo kunduzgu bir saattai gana zhashagandai bolushat. Mukhammadga tushurulgon bul Kuran zhetkiruu zhana al adamzat menen zhinderge zhetishtuu. Chyndygynda Allakhka kaapyrlyk zhana kunoo kyluu menen Aga bash iibestik kylgan koom gana azap menen kyirap zhok bolot.
Allakh kaapyrlyk kylgandardyn zhana adamdardy Anyn dininen burgandardyn ish-araketterin zhokko chygardy.

Allakhka yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi zhasagan zhana Allakh Ozunun elchisi Mukhammadga tushurgon nerseni Rabbisi taraptan kelgen akyikat dep ishengen adamdardyn kunoolorun ochurot, alardy zhazalabait zhana alardyn duinoluk zhana akyrettik ishterin on'doit.

Eki topko karata eskerilgen bul zhaza menen syilyktyn sebebi - Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandar zhalgandy eerchishti, al emi Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirgender Rabbisi taraptan kelgen akyikatty eerchishti. Oshonduktan alardyn syilygy menen zhazasy araketterine zharasha aiyrmalandy. Oshondoi ele Allakh yimanduular menen kaapyrlardan bolgon eki toptun okumun baiandady. Allakh adamdarga ozdorunun misaldaryn keltiret, ar kim ozuno okshogon menen birge bolot.

Oo, yimanduular! Sogushchan kaapyrlar menen betteshsen'er, alardyn moiundaryn kylychyn'ar menen kyia chapkyla. Alardan olgondor koboiup, alardyn kuch-kubatyn zhok kylganga cheiin sogushtu ulantkyla. Alardyn kopchulugun olturgondon kiiin tutkundardyn kishenderin bekem bailagyla. Egerde alardy tutkunga tushurson'or, anda paidasyna zharasha tandoon'or bar, orduna ech nerse albai azat kylgyla zhe akchalai zhe bashka turdo kun tolotkulo. Kaapyrlar Islamdy kabyl aluusu zhe kelishim tuzuusu menen sogush aiaktaganga cheiin alar menen sogushuunu toktotpogula. Yimanduulardyn kaapyrlar menen synaluusu, abaldardyn almashuusu, biri-birinin ustunon zhen'ishke zhetuu syiaktuu bul aitylgan nerseler - Allakhtyn daanyshmandygy. Egerde Allakh kaapyrlardy sogushsuz ele zhen'uunu kaalaganda, Al alardy zhen'mek. Birok Al alardy biri-biri arkyluu synash uchun sogushtu okum kyldy. Al yimanduulardan kimisi sogusharyn, kimisi sogushpasyn synait, oshondoi ele kaapyrdy yimanduu adam arkyluu synait. Egerde yimanduu olturulso, al beiishke kiret. Eger al yimanduunun kolunan olso, al tozokko kiret. Allakh zholunda olturulgon adamdardyn ish-araketterin Allakh ech kachan zhok kylbait.
Alarga duino zhashoosunda akyikat zholdu eerchuugo iigilik beret zhana ishterin on'doit.
Zhana alardy kyiamat kunu beiishke kirgizet. Alarga duinodo anyn sypattaryn baiandap bergen, alar any bilishken zhana akyrette alarga al zhaktagy orundaryn bildiret.

Oo, yiman keltirgender zhana shariiatty atkargandar! Egerde Allakhka Anyn paigambaryn zhana dinin koldop zhana kaapyrlar menen sogushup zhardam bersen'er, Al silerdi alardyn ustunon zhen'ishke zhetkiruu menen koldoit zhana alar menen sogushta betteshkende kadamdaryn'ardy bekem kylat.
Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyrlyk kylgandarga kyiroo zhana zhogotuu bolot zhana Allakh alardyn ish-araketterinin soobun zhokko chygarat.

Alar Allakhtyn Oz elchisine tushurgon zhana Aga syiynuunu kamtygan Kurandy zhaman korushkonu sebeptuu alarga ushundai zhaza berildi, Allakh alardyn ish-araketterin zhok chygardy. Oshonduktan alar duinodo zhana akyrette kyiroogo uchurashty.

Al zhalganchylar zher betin kezip, alardan murunku zhalganga chygargandardyn akybeti kandai bolgonun oilonup korushpoibu? Akybeti keiishtuu bolgon. Allakh alardyn turak-zhailaryn talkalap, alardyn ozdorun, bala-chakalaryn zhana bailyktaryn kyiratyp zhok kylgan. Kaapyrlar uchun butkul uchurda zhana bardyk zherde ushundai zhazalardyn misaldary bar.
Bul aitylgan syilyk zhana zhaza eki toptogular uchun. Antkeni Allakh yiman keltirgenderdin Koldoochusu. Al emi kaapyrlarga ech kandai koldoochu bolboit.

Chyndygynda Allakh Ozuno zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandardy khan sarailarynyn zhana bak-daraktarynyn aldylarynan daryialar agyp turgan beiishterge kirgizet. Al emi Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyrlyk kylgandar oz kaalooloruna eerchip duinodo zhyrgalchylykka batyshat. Alar aibandar zhegen syiaktuu zheshet. Alar kursaktary menen zhynys mucholorunon bashka ech nerseni oilonushpait. Kyiamat kunu tozok alardyn kire turgan turak-zhaiy bolot.

Seni elin' kuup chykkan Mekkeden da kuch-kubattuu, bailygy da, bala-chakasy da kop bolgon murunku koomdordun kanchalagan shaarlaryn, alar paigambarlaryn zhalganga chygaryshkanda kyiratyp zhok kyldyk. Alarga Allakhtyn azaby kelgende alardy kutkargan ech bir koldoochu bolbodu. Egerde Biz Mekke elin kyiratuunu kaalasak, ech kim Bizdi alsyrata albait.

Rabbisi taraptan achyk-aikyn dalilge ee bolup, Aga ilimdin negizinde syiyngan adam, shaitan aga zhaman ishterin kooz kylyp korgozgon zhana aikelderge syiynuu, kunoolordu kyluu, paigambarlardy zhalganga chygaruu syiaktuu alardyn napsileri kaalagan nerselerdi eerchigen adam syiaktuu bolup kalmak bele?

Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtagan takybalar kiret dep ubada kylyngan beiishtin sypaty - al zhakta turup kalsa da zhyty zhana daamyn buzulbagan suu daryialary bar, daamy ozgorbogon sut daryialary bar, ichkenderge zhagymduu sharap daryialary bar, koshulmalardan tazalangan bal daryialary bar, oshondoi ele alar kaalagandai ar turduu momo-zhemishter bar. Bulardan syrtkary alar uchun Allakh taraptan kunooloruno kechirim bar, alardy al uchun zhazalabait. Emi ushundai syilykka ee bolgon adam menen tozokto kala turgan adam ten' bolobu? Al tozokton ech kachan chykpait, aga kainak suu ichirilet, anyn ysyktygynan kursagyndagy ichegileri uzulup ketet.

Oo, paigambar! Eki zhuzduulordun arasynda senin sozun'don zhuz burup, kabyl albai ukkandary bar. Kachan alar senin aldyn'dan chygyshkanda zhuz burup, bilmeksen bolup: <<Al zhan'y ele suilogon sozundo emne dep aitty?>> - dep Allakh ilim bergenderden surashat. Allakh osholordun zhuroktoruno moor basty. Oshonduktan alarga ech kandai zhakshylyk zhetpeit zhana alar oz kaaloolorun eerchuusu alardy akyikatka kor kylyp koidu.

Al emi akyikat zholgo tushup, paigambar alyp kelgen nersege eerchigenderdi Rabbisi alardyn tuura zholgo tushuusun zhana zhakshylykka karai iigiligin dagy koboitot zhana alardy tozokton saktagan ishterdi atkaruunu kon'uldoruno salyp koiot.

Kaapyrlar aldyn ala bilbesten turup kyiamattyn kapystan kelishin gana kutup zhatyshaby? Anyn belgileri kelip kaldy. Alardyn biri paigambardyn kelishi zhana Aidyn bolunuusu boldu. Egerde alarga kyiamat kelse, alar kantip eskerishmek ele?

Oo, paigambar! Bilginin', Allakhtan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok! Allakhtan ozun'dun kunoolorun' uchun kechirim sura zhana yimanduu erkekter menen aialdardyn kunooloru uchun kechirim sura. Allakh silerdin kunduzdu ish-araketterin'erdi bilet zhana tunku zhailaryn'ardy bilet. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.

Yiman keltirgender Allakh Oz elchisine sogushuunu kamtygan suroonu tushurso eken dep umut kylyp: <<Allakh sogushuu tuuraluu aitkan suroo tushurso bolot ele!>> - dep aityshat. Oo, paigambar! Kachan Allakh sogushuu tuuraluu sozdu kamtygan, baiandoosu zhana okumdoru anyk suroonu tushurgondo zhuroktorundo shek-kumonu bar eki zhuzduulor katuu korkunuchtan ulam ozdorun zhogotup seni tiktep turup kalyshkanyn korosun'. Allakh alarga sogushuudan ketenchiktep, andan korkushkany uchun alarga zhakyn kalgan azapty eskertti.

Oshondoi ele Allakhtyn buiruguna bash iiuusu zhana zhamandykty kamtybagan zhakshy sozdordu suiloosu alar uchun zhakshyraak. Sogush parz kylynyp, ish oluttuu bolgon kezde alar Allakhka yiman keltiruudo zhana Aga moiun sunuuda chynchyl bolushsa, anda bul alar uchun eki zhuzduulukton zhana Allakhtyn buiruktaryna bash iibestik kyluudan zhakshyraak bolmok.

Abalyn'arga karai turgan bolsok, siler Allakhka yiman keltiruudon zhana Aga bash iiuudon bash tartsan'ar, anda karan'gy doordogu abalyn'ar syiaktuu zher betinde kaapyrlyk zhana kunoolordu kylyp, tuugandyk mamilelerdi uzup zhiberishin'er mumkun.

Zher betinde buzukuluktu zhaigan zhana tuugandyk mamileni uzgon syiaktuu sypattagy adamdardy Allakh Oz yraiymynan alystatty, kulaktaryn akyikatty kabyl alyp uguudan duloi kyldy zhana kozdorun ulgu alyp karoodon sokur kyldy.

Myna oshol zhuz burgandar Kuran zhonundo oilonushpaiby zhana andagy aitylgandarga oi zhugurtushpoibu? Egerde al tuuraluu oi zhugurtushkondo, al alardy zhakshylykka bagyttamak zhana bardyk zhamandyktardan alystatmak. Zhe alardyn zhuroktorundo nasaatty zhetkirbegen, eskertmeden paida berbegen bekem zhabuuchu kulpular barby?

Alarga dalil kelip, paigambardyn chynchyldygy anyk bolgondon kiiin yimandan bash tartyp, kaapyrlyk menen eki zhuzduulukko kaitkandarga shaitan alardyn kaapyrlygy menen eki zhuzduulugun kooz kylyp korgozup koidu, any alarga zhen'il kyldy zhana alardy kuru kyialdar menen umuttondurup koidu.

Bul adashuunun sebebi, alar paigambarga tushkon aian-kabardy zhaman korgon mushrikterge zhashyruun syr kylyp: <<Biz sogushuudan bash tartuu syiaktuu kee bir ishterde siler menen birgebiz>> - deshti. Allakh alardyn zhaap-zhashyrgan syrlaryn bilet. Aga ech nerse zhashyruun emes. Al syrlardan Ozu kaalaganyn paigambaryna bildiret.
Zhan aluuga mildettuu bolgon perishteler alardyn zhandaryn alyp, alardy zhuzdoruno zhana arkalaryna temir soiul menen urup zhatkandagy alardyn azaby zhana oor abaly kandai bolot dep oiloisun'?

Bul azaptyn sebebi, alar Allakhtyn achuusun keltirgen kaapyrlyk, eki zhuzduuluk, Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine karshy chyguu syiaktuu bardyk nerselerdi eerchishti zhana alar Allakhka yiman keltiruu, Anyn elchisin eerchuu syiaktuu Rabbisinin yraazylygyna zhetkirip, Aga zhakyndatkan nerselerdi zhaman korushtu. Myna oshonduktan Allakh alardyn ishterin zhokko chygardy.

Zhuroktorundo shek-kumonu bar eki zhuzduulor, Allakh alardyn zhek koruulorun achykka chygarbait dep oiloshtubu? Yiman keltiruudo chynchyldy zhalganchydan aiyrmalash uchun, yimanduunu achyktap, eki zhuzduunun zhuzun achysh uchun Al alardy synoolor arkyluu sozsuz achykka chygarat.

Oo, paigambar! Egerde Biz eki zhuzduulordu saga bildiruunu kaalasak, anda bildirip koimokpuz. Anan sen alardy belgilerinen bilip almaksyn'. Zhakynda sen alardy suilogon sozdorunon bilip bashtaisyn'. Allakh silerdin ish-araketterin'erdi bilet. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda Al alardyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Oo, yimanduular! Biz silerdin aran'arda Allakh zholunda chyndap sogushkandardy zhana dushmandar menen sogushuuda sabyrduuluk kylgandardy bilish uchun sogush, dushmandar menen salgylashuu zhana olturuu arkyluu sozsuz synaibyz. Oshondoi ele silerden kim chynchyl, kim zhalganchy ekenin bilish uchun da synaibyz.

Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyr bolup, ozun zhana bashkalardy Allakhtyn dininen tyigandar, paigambardyn paigambar ekenin bilgenden kiiin aga karshy chygyp, dushman bolgondor Allakhka ech kandai zyian keltire albait. Chynynda, alar ozdoruno gana zyian keltiret. Zhakynda Allakh alardyn ish-araketterin zhokko chygarat.

O, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Allakhtyn zhana Anyn elchisinin buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiganynan tyiylyp moiun sungula. Ish-araketterin'erdi kaapyr boluu menen zhana elge korsotuu uchun zhasap zhokko chygaryp albagyla.
Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandar, ozdorun zhana adamdardy Allakhtyn dininen burup, andan son' toobo kylbastan kaapyrlykta olgondordun kunoolorun Allakh ech kachan kechirbeit.

Oo, yimanduular! Dushman menen betteshuudo alsyrabagyla! Alar silerdi tynchtyk kelishimine chakyrganga cheiin siler alardy chakyrbagyla. Siler alardyn ustunon ustomsun'or, zhen'uuchusun'or. Allakh Oz zhardamy zhana koldoosu menen siler menen birge. Al silerdin ishterin'erdin sooptorunan ech nerseni kemitpeit. Teskerisinche, aikoldugu zhana bereshendigi menen koboitup beret.

Chyndygynda duino zhashoosu oiun zhana kon'ul achuu. Andyktan akyly bar adam akyret ishin tashtap duino menen alektenbeit. Egerde siler Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirsen'er zhana Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, Anyn tyigandaryn tashtasan'ar, anda Al ish-araketterin'erdin soobun kemitpesten toluk beret. Al silerdin mal-mulkun'ordun baaryn talap kylbait. Chyndygynda Al silerden zeketke mildettuusun gana talap kylat.

Egerde Al silerdin bardyk mal-mulkun'ordu talap kylsa zhana any talap kyluuda aitkanynan kaitpasa, anda siler saran'dyk kylyp bashtaisyn'ar. Anan Allakh silerdin zhurogun'ordogu Anyn zholunda mal-mulk sarptoogo bolgon zhek koruun'ordu chygaryp koiot. Oshonduktan Al silerge yraiym kylyp any talap kylgan zhok.

Myna siler mal-mulkun'ordun bir bolugun Allakh zholuna sarptoogo chakyryldyn'ar, silerden anyn baaryn sarpta dep talap kylyngan zhok. Aran'arda kee birler saran'dyktan ulam talap kylyngan olchomdu berbeit. Kimde-kim mal-mulkunun bir bolugun Allakh zholuna sarptoogo saran'dyk kylsa, anda al anygynda soopton kuru kalyp ozuno gana saran'dyk kyldy. Allakh Beimuktazh, Al silerdin sarptaganyn'arga muktazh emes. Siler Aga muzhtazhsyn'ar. Egerde siler Islamdan kaapyrlykka kaitsan'ar, Al silerdi kyiratyp, ordun'arga bashka koomdu alyp kelet. Kiiin alar silerdei bolushpait. Teskerisinche, alar Aga moiun sunushat.
Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda Biz saga Khudaibiia tynchtyk kelishimi arkyluu anyk zhen'ish berdik.

Allakh senin bul zhen'ishke cheiinki zhana andan kiiinki kunoolorun'du kechirip, dinin'di koldoo menen saga Oz zhakshylygyn toluk berip, ech kandai burmalanuusu zhok tuura zhol bolgon Islam zholuna salysh uchun.
Oshondoi ele Allakh seni dushmandaryn'dyn ustunon ech kim toktoto albagandai uulu zhen'ishke zhetkirish uchun.

Allakh momundardyn yimanyna yiman koshuluusu uchun alardyn zhuroktoruno bekemdikti zhana beipildikti tushurdu. Asmandar menen zherdin askeri zhalgyz Allakhka taandyk. Al any menen Ozu kaalagan pendelerin koldoit. Chyndygynda Allakh pendelerine emne paidaluu ekenin Biluuchu, zhen'ish zhana zhardam beruudo Daanyshman.

Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirgen erkekter menen aialdardy khan sarailarynyn zhana bak-daraktarynyn aldynan daryialar agyp turgan beiishke kirgizish uchun zhana alardy zhazalabastan kunoolorun kechirish uchun. Kozdogon beiishke zhetuu zhana kunoolor sebeptuu korkunuchka salgan zhazadan kutuluu syiaktuu bul aitylgan nerseler Allakhtyn aldynda ech bir nerse ten' kelbegendei uluu zhen'ish.

Zhana Allakh eki zhuzduu erkekter menen aialdardy, Aga shirk kylgan erkekter menen aialdardy zhana Al Ozunun dinin koldoboit, Ozunun sozun biiik kylbait dep Al tuuraluu zhaman oilogondordu azaptash uchun. Alardyn bashyna azap baleesi keldi. Allakh alarga kaapyrlyktary zhana zhaman oilogondoru sebeptuu kaardandy, alardy Oz yraiymynan alystatty zhana alarga akyrette tuboluk kala turgan tozoktu daiardap koidu. Alardyn Aga kaityp baruuchu zhaiy bolgon tozok kandai zhaman zhai!

Asmandar menen zherdin askerleri Allakhka gana taandyk. Al any menen Ozu kaalagan pendelerine zhardam beret. Chyndygynda Allakh ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu, zharatuusunda, tagdyr kyluusunda zhana bashkaruusunda Daanyshman.

Oo, paigambar! Biz seni kyiamat kunu ummotun'o kubo boluuchu, yimanduularga alar uchun daiardalgan duinodogu zhen'ishti, biilik zhurguzuunu zhana alar uchun daiardalgan akyrettegi zhyrgalchylykty suiunchuloochu zhana kaapyrlarga alar uchun daiardalgan duinodogu korduktu, yimanduulardyn kol aldynda zhen'iluunu zhana alar uchun daiardalyp, alardy kutkon akyrettegi kyinoochu azap menen korkutuuchu kylyp zhiberdik.
Silerdi Allakhka yiman keltiret, Anyn elchisine yiman keltiret, any uluktait zhana urmattait, oshondoi ele Allakhty kundun bashtalyshynda zhana akyrynda aruulait degen umutto.

Oo, paigambar! Mekkelik mushrikter menen sogushuuga "Rizvan" antyn berip anttashkandar, chynynda Allakh menen anttashty. Antkeni, Al Ozu alardy mushrikter menen sogushuuga buirugan zhana alarga syilygyn Ozu beret. Anttashuu uchurunda Allakhtyn kolu alardyn kolunun ustundo boldu. Allakh alardy bilip turat, alardyn ech bir ishi Aga zhashyruun emes. Kim antyn buzsa zhana Allakhka bergen "Anyn dinin koldoim" degen ubadasyn atkarbasa, anda antyn buzup, ubadasyn atkarbaganynyn zyiany ozuno gana tiet. Anysy Allakhka ech zyian tiigizbeit. Al emi kim Allakhka bergen "Anyn dinin koldoim" degen ubadasyn atkarsa, anda Al aga uluu syidy - beiishti beret.

Oo, paigambar! Seni menen birge Mekkege saparga chykpagan, Allakh kaltyryp koigon arabdardy zhemelegen' bolson', alar saga: <<Bizdi seni menen birge chyguudan mal-mulk zhana bala-chaka tirichilikteri alek kylyp koidu. Bizdin kunoolorubuz uchun Allakhtan kechirim sura>>! - dep aityshat. Alar paigambardan alar uchun kechirim sura dep zhurogundogu bolbogon nerseni tilderi menen aityshat. Antkeni alar kunooloruno toobo kylyshkan zhok. Alarga ait: <<Egerde Allakh silerge zhakshylyk zhe zhamandyk kaalasa, anda Allakh taraptan silerge ech kim ech nersege eelik kyla albait>>. Teskerisinche, Allakh silerdin kylgan ish-araketterin'erden kabardar. Ish-araketterin'erdi kanchalyk zhashyrsan'ar da alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.

Silerdin "mal-mulk zhana bala-chaka tiriligi menen alek bolup kaldyk" degen shyltoon'or silerdin paigambar menen barbai koigun'ardyn negizgi sebebi emes. Teskerisinche, siler paigambar zhana sakhabalardyn baary kyrylyp, Medinaga ui-buloloruno kaityp kelbeit dep oilogonsun'ar. Shaitan bul ishti silerdin zhurogun'orgo kooz kylyp korsottu zhana Rabbisi paigambaryna zhardam berbeit dep Al tuuraluu zhaman oilodun'ar. Allakh tuuraluu zhaman oilogonun'ar zhana Anyn elchisi menen birge barbaganyn'ar uchun siler kyiroogo uchuragan koom boldun'ar.
Kimde-kim Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirbese, al kaapyr bolot. Biz kyiamat kunu Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandar azaptala turgan aloolongon ottu daiardap koiduk.

Asmandar menen zherdin biiligi zhalgyz Allakhka taandyk. Al Ozu kaalagan pendesinin kunoolorun kechirip, any Oz zhakshylygy menen beiishke kirgizet zhana Oz adilettigi menen Ozu kaalagan pendesin azaptait. Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerinin kunoolorun Kechiruuchu, alarga Yraiymduu.

Oo, yimanduular! Siler Khudaibiia kelishiminen kiiin Allakh ubada kylgan Khaibardagy olzhonu aluun'ar uchun zhonogonun'ordo Allakh artta kaltyrgan adamdar: <<Biz dele siler menen baryp, alchubuzdu alaly>> - deshet. Al artta kalgandar bul suranychtary menen Allakhtyn Khudaibiia kelishiminen kiiin Khaibar olzhosun yimanduularga gana berem degen ubadasyn ozgortuunu kaalap zhatyshaby. Oo, paigambar! Alarga ait: <<Al olzholorgo biz menen barbaisyn'ar. Antkeni Allakh Khaibar olzhosun Khudaibiiaga katyshkandarga gana berem dep ubada kylgan>>. Alar aityshat: <<Biz menen barbaisyn'ar dep zhatkanyn'ar Allakhtan kelgen buiruk emes. Munun sebebi silerdin bizge bolgon koro albastygyn'ardan>>. Bul ish artta kalgandar oilogondoi emes. Teskerisinche, alardyn Allakhtyn buiruktaryn zhana tyiuularyn taiky tushungonduktorunon. Oshonduktan alar Aga bash iibestik kylyshty.

Oo, paigambar! Seni menen birge Mekkege barbagan arabdardy synap myndai dep ait: <<Zhakynda siler sogushta kuch-kubattuulukka ee bolgon elder menen sogushuuga chakyrylasyn'ar. Alar menen Allakh zholunda sogushasyn'ar zhe bolboso alar Islamdy sogushsuz kabyl alyshat. Egerde siler Allakhtyn sogush tuuraluu chakyrygyna moiun sunsan'ar, Al silerge beiish bolgon uluu syilykty beret. A eger paigambar menen birge Mekkege barbai koigonun'ar syiaktuu Aga moiun sunuudan bash tartsan'ar, anda kyinoochu azap menen azaptait>>.

Kozu sokur zhe cholok zhe ooruluu syiaktuu uzuru barlar Allakh zholunda sogushuuga barbai kalsa kunookor bolushpait. Kimde-kim Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine moiun sunsa, anda any khan sarailarynyn zhana bak-daraktarynyn aldynan daryialar agyp turgan beiishterge kirgizet. Al emi kim al ekoosuno moiun sunuudan bash tartsa, anda Allakh any kyinoochu azap menen azaptait.

Allakh Khudaibiiadagy daraktyn astynda Rizvan antyn berip anttashkan yimanduulardan yraazy boldu. Al alardyn zhurogundogu yimandy, yklastuuluktu zhana chynchyldykty bilip, alardyn zhuroktoruno beipildik ornottu zhana anyn syilygy katary alarga Khaibardy bagyntuu bolgon zhakynky zhen'ishti berdi.
Zhana alarga Khaibardyn zhashoochularynan alyna turgan koptogon olzholordu berdi. Allakh ech kimge zhen'ilbes Kudurettuu, Oz zharatuusunda, tagdyr kyluusunda zhana bashkaruusunda Daanyshman.

Oo, yimanduular! Allakh silerge kelechekte Islam zhen'ishterinde ala turgan koptogon olzholordu ubada kyldy. Oshentip Al silerge Khaibar olzholorun tezdetti zhana bul tezdetilgen olzholor Allakhtyn silerge bolgon zhardamy menen korgoosunun belgisi bolsun uchun zhana Allakh silerdi ech kandai burmalanuusu zhok tuura zholgo saluusu uchun Al silerdin artyn'ardagy ui-bulon'ordu zhoottordun kol saluusunan korgodu.

Oshondoi ele Allakh silerge azyrky uchurda kuduretin'er zhetpegen bashka dagy olzholordu ubada kyldy. Bir gana Allakh aga kudurettuu. Al Anyn iliminde zhana bashkaruusunda. Allakh butkul nersege kudurettuu. Any ech bir nerse alsyrata albait.

Oo, yimanduular! Egerde Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyrlyk kylgandar siler menen sogushkan bolso, anda alar koz aldyn'arda zhen'ilgen abalda kachyp zhonoshmok. Andan son' alardyn ishin kolgo algan ech bir koldoochu tabyshmak emes zhana alarga sogushuuga zhardam bergen ech bir zhardamchy tabyshmak emes.

Yimanduulardyn zhen'ishke zhetuusu zhana kaapyrlardyn zhen'iluusu butkul zamanda zhana bardyk zherde ishke ashary anyk. Bul nerse zhalganchylardan murun otkon koomdordon beri kele zhatkan Allakhtyn zholu. Oo, paigambar! Sen Allakhtyn zholun ozgorto turgan ech bir nerse tappaisyn'.

Mushrikterden seksendei adam Khudaibiiada silerge zyian beruunu kaalap kelishkende Al alardyn kolun silerden tyiyp koidu zhana silerdin kolun'ardy da alardan tyidy. Oshonduktan alardy olturbodun'or zhana alarga zyian keltirbedin'er. Atugul alardy tutkundap alganga kuduretin'er zhetip tursa da alardy bosh koio berdin'er. Allakh silerdin kylyp zhatkanyn'ardy Koruuchu. Aga silerdin ech bir ishin'er zhashyruun emes.

Alar Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyrlyk kylgandar zhana silerdi Al'-Kharam mechitinen zhana kurmandyk chaluudan toskondor. Oshol sebepten alar Al'-Kharamdagy kurmandyk chalynuuchu zhaiyna zhetpei kalyp ketishti. Egerde al zhakta siler taanybagan Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirgen erkekter menen aialdar bar bolbogondo zhana alardy kaapyrlarga koshup olturup aluu zhana bilbesten olturgonun'or uchun kunoo alyp, kun toloo bolbogondo, anda Allakh Mekkedegi yimanduular syiaktuu adamdardy Oz yraiymyna aluu uchun silerge Mekkeni aluuga sozsuz uruksat bermek. Egerde Mekkedegi kaapyrlar menen yimanduular aiyrmalanyp turganda, anda Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyrlyk kylgandardy katuu azaptamakpyz.

Oshondo Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyrlyk kylgandar zhuroktorundo akyikatty taanuuga emes, oz kaalooloruna bailanyshkan karan'gylyk doordogu tekeberlikti paida kylyshty zhana Allakhtyn elchisi alardy zhen'iptir degen aiyp sozdon korkup, any Khudaibiia zhylynda alarga kiruudon tyiyshty. Allakh bolso Oz elchisine zhana yimanduularga Oz aldynan beipildikti tushurdu zhana alardyn kyzhyrdanuusu mushrikterge ozdorundoi kylyp zhoop beruugo zhetkirgen zhok. Allakh yimanduularga <<Laa ilaakha illallakh (Allakhtan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok)>> akyikat sozun zhana anyn sharttaryn atkaruunu mildet kyldy, alar any atkaryshty. Kachan Allakh yimanduulardyn zhurogundogu zhakshylykty bilgende alar bashkalarga karaganda bul sozgo koburook akyluu zhana tatyktuu bolushtu. Allakh bardyk nerselerdi Biluuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.

Allakh Oz elchisi tushundo korgon nerseni chyndykka ailantty. Al tuuraluu sakhabalaryna aityp bergen. Al tushundo sakhabalary menen birge Allakhtyn yiyk Uiuno dushmandardan zyian tartpastan kirip zhatyshkan eken. Dinii zhorolgolordun butushun zhar salysh maksatta alardyn kee birlerinin chachtary kyrylgan, kee birleriniki kyskartylgan eken. Oo, yimanduular! Allakh silerdin paidan'arga tiiishtuu siler bilbegen nerseni bildi. Al oshol zhyly Mekkege kiruu tuuraluu tushtu chyndykka ailantuudan tyshkary zhakynda boluuchu zhen'ishti kyldy. Al Allakhtyn Khudaibiia kelishimin ish zhuzogo ashyruusu zhana andan son' Khudaibiiaga kelgen yimanduulardyn kol astynda Khaibardyn bagynyp beruusu.

Islam dini bardyk dinderden ustom bolush uchun Allakh Oz elchisi Mukhammaddy achyk-aikyn baiandoo zhana akyikat Islam dini menen zhiberdi. Allakh Ozu buga kubo boldu zhana Allakhtyn kubolugu zhetishtuu.

Mukhammad - Allakhtyn elchisi. Any menen birge bolgon sakhabalar sogushchan kaapyrlarga kataal, biri-birine meerimduu, zhumshak zhana zhan tartuuchu. Oo, nazar saluuchu! Sen alardy Allakh taalaga ruku-sazhda kylgan abalda Andan koptogon kechirimdi, uluu sooptordu zhana alardan yraazy boluusun surap zhatyshkandaryn korosun'. Tuuralyktan, syn-sypattuuluktan zhana zhuzdorundogu namazdyn nurunan paida bolgon alardyn man'daiyndagy sazhdanyn izderi -alardyn belgisi. Bul alardyn Musaga tushkon Toorat kitebinde kelgen sypattary. Al emi Isaga tushkon Inzhildegi misaly - alar biri-birine zhardam beruudo zhana toluktukta eginzar syiaktuu. Al kichine bolup chygyp, kiiin katat, anan zhoonoiup sabagy tuzdolot. Dyikandar anyn bekemdigine zhana toluktuguna suktanyshat. Allakh bul misaldy kaapyrlar alardyn kuch-kubatyn, bekemdigin zhana toluktugun korup kyzhyrlary kelish uchun aitty. Allakhka yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgan sakhabalar Allakh alardy zhazalabastan kunoolorun kechiruunu zhana Oz aldyndagy beiish bolgon uluu syilykty ubada kyldy.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn eerchigender! Soz zhe ish-araket menen Allakh zhana Anyn elchisinen ozbogula zhana Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkula. Chyndygynda Allakh silerdin sozdorun'ordu Uguuchu, ish-araketterin'erdi Biluuchu. Al alardyn ech birin otkorup zhiberbeit. Zhakynda alardyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn eerchigender! Anyn elchisi menen bolgon mamilede adepti karmangyla. Aga kairylganda unun'ordu anyn ununon biiik kotorbogulo zhana biri-birin'erdi chakyrgandai any atynan atap chakyrbagyla. Bul sebeptuu ish-araketin'erdin soobu siler bilbegen abalda kuiup ketpesh uchun any sylyktyk menen paigambar zhe elchi dep chakyrgyla.

Chyndygynda Allakh Anyn elchisinin aldynda unun zhai chygargandardyn zhurogundogu takybalykty zhana yklastuuluktu synady. Myna osholordun kunooloruno zhazasyz kechirim zhana kyiamatta Allakh alardy beiishke kirgizgen uluu sooptor bar.
Oo, paigambar! Saga aialdaryn'dyn bolmolorunun syrtynan seni chakyryp kyikyrgan arabdardyn kopchulugu akyl zhugurtushpoit.

Oo, paigambar! Aialdaryn'dyn bolmolorunun syrtynan seni chakyryp zhatkandar sen chykkanga cheiin chakyrbastan sabyr kylyp turushkanda zhana saga undorun zhai chygaryp kairylganda, bul nerse alar uchun syrttan chakyryp turganga karaganda zhakshyraak bolmok. Antkeni bul nersede urmattap syiloo zhana taazim kyluu bar. Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerinin zhana bashkalardyn kunoolorun Kechiruuchu, alardyn naadandygyn da Kechiruuchu, alarga Yraiymduu.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Egerde silerge bir buzuku adam kaisy bir adamdar tuuraluu kabar alyp kelse, al kabardyn tuuralygyn taktagyla zhana aga ishengenge shashylbagyla. Egerde taktabastan turup anyn kabaryna ishensen'er, anda ishtin choo zhaiyn bilbesten adamdardy kunoo ishke kiripter kyluu korkunuchu bar. Kiiin siler anyn kabary zhalgan ekenin bilip kalsan'ar, bul kylganyn'arga okunup kalasyn'ar.

Oo, yimanduular! Bilgile, aran'arda vakhii tushup turgan Allakhtyn elchisi bar. Zhalgan aituudan sak bolgula. Bolboso aga silerdin zhalganyn'ar tuuraluu kabar bergen vakhii tushposun. Al silerge emne paidaluu ekenin zhakshy bilet. Egerde al silerdin sunushtaryn'ardyn kopchuluguno makul bolo berse, anda al silerge yraa korbogondoi kyiynchylyktarga tushup kalasyn'ar. Birok Allakh Oz zhakshylygy menen silerge yimandy suiuktuu kyldy zhana any zhurogun'ordo kooz kyldy, anan siler yiman keltirdin'er. Zhana silerge kaapyrlykty, Aga bash iibestikti zhana Aga kunoo kyluunu zhaman korgozdu. Myna ushul sypattarga ee bolgon adamdar tuura zholgo tushkondor.

Zhurogun'orgo zhakshylyktyn kooz korunushu, zhamandyktyn zhek korunushu, chyndygynda bul Allakhtyn silerge kylgan aikoldugu zhana zhakshylygy. Allakh shugur kylgan pendelerin Biluuchu, Al alarga iigilik beret. Al bardyk nerseni ozuno ylaiyk orunga koigon Daanyshman.

Oo, yimanduular! Egerde momundardan eki taipa oz ara sogushup ketse, anda alardyn ortosundagy talash-tartyshty Allakhtyn shariiaty menen chechuugo chakyryp alardy zharashtyrgyla. Eger alardyn biri kelishuudon bash tartyp chekten chyksa, anda chekten ashkan tarap Allakhtyn okumuno kaitkanga cheiin any menen sogushkula. A eger Allakhtyn okumuno kaitsa, anda alardy biri- biri menen adilettik zhana kalystyk menen zharashtyrgyla zhana alardyn ortosunda okum kyluuda adilettuu bolgula. Chyndygynda Allakh adilettuu okum kylgandardy zhakshy korot.

Chyndygynda yimanduular - Islamda bir tuugandar. Oo, yimanduular! Islamdagy bir tuugandyk silerden urushup ketken eki musulman bir tuuganyn'ardy zharashtyruunu talap kylat. Siler Allakhtyn yraiymyn umut kyluu menen Anyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkula.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Aran'ardan bir adamdar bashka adamdardy shyldyn'dabasyn. Balkim shyldyn'ga kabylgandar Allakhtyn aldynda zhakshyraaktyr. En' negizgisi - Allakhtyn aldyndagy nerse. Oshondoi ele aialdar da bashka aialdardy shyldyn'dabasyn. Balkim shyldyn'ga kabylgandar Allakhtyn aldynda zhakshyraaktyr. Musulman bir tuugandaryn'ardy aiyptabagyla, antkeni alar siler menen birdei den'geelde. Paigambar kelgenge cheiin kee bir ansarlardyn abaly syiaktuu biri-birin'erdi zhaman attar menen atabagyla. Aran'ardan kim ushundai kylsa, anda al buzuku. Yiman keltirgenden kiiin buzukuluk sypatta boluu kandai zhaman! Kim bul kunoolorgo toobo kylbasa, anda alar kunoo kyluu menen ozdorun kyiroogo uchuratyp ozuno ozu zyian keltirgender.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Ech kandai sebepterge zhana dalilderge negizdelbegen kopchuluk aiyptoolordon alys bolgula. Chyndygynda kee bir kumon oilor kunoo. Misaly, syrtynan zhakshy korungon adam tuuraluu zhaman oiloo syiaktuu. Oshondoi ele yimanduulardyn artynan tushup aiyp-kemchilikterin izdebegile zhana aran'ardan ech kim musulman bir tuugany tuuraluu aga zhakpagandai sozdordu aitpasyn. Chyndygynda anyn aga zhakpagandai soz aitkany olumtuktun etin zhegen syiaktuu. Olgon musulman bir tuuganynyn etin zhesh kimin'erge zhakmak ele? Ushul syiaktuu ele al tuuraluu ushak aituunu zhaman korgulo. Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkula. Chyndygynda Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerinin toobolorun Kabyl kyluuchu, alarga Yraiymduu.

Oo, adamdar! Chyndygynda Biz silerdi Adam atan'ar bolgon bir erkekten zhana Khava enen'er bolgon bir aialdan zharattyk. Ata-tegin'erdi aityp biri-birin'erge maktanbagyla. Andan son' Biz silerdi maktanyshyn'ar uchun emes, oz ara taanyshuun'ar uchun koptogon elder zhana chachyrandy uruular kyldyk. Sebebi artykchylyk takybalyk menen gana bolot. Oshonduktan Al: <<Allakhtyn aldynda en' urmattuun'ar - en' takyban'ar>> - dep aitty. Chyndygynda Allakh silerdin abaldaryn'ardy Biluuchu, silerdegi artykchylyktar menen kemchilikter tuuraluu Kabardar. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.

Kee bir cholduk arabdar paigambarga kelip: <<Biz Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirdik>> - dep aityshty. Oo, paigambar! Alarga ait: <<Siler yiman keltirgen zhoksun'ar>>. Andan koro: <<Biz moiun sunduk zhana bash iidik>> - degile. Antkeni silerdin zhurogun'orgo yiman ali kire elek zhana al bara-bara kiret. Oo, arabdar! Egerde siler yiman keltiruudo zhana zhakshylyk ishterdi kyluuda Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine moiun sunsan'ar, anda Allakh silerdin kylgan ish-araketterin'erdin sooptorun kemitpeit. Chyndygynda Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerin Kechiruuchu, alarga Yraiymduu.

Chynygy yimanduular - Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirip, andan son' yimandaryna ech kandai shek-kumon aralashpagandar, mal-mulkun zhana zhanyn aiabastan Allakh zholunda sogushkandar. Myna ushundai sypattagy adamdar oz yimandarynda chynchyl adamdar.

Oo, paigambar! Oshol arabdarga ait: <<Siler Allakhka dinin'erdi bildirip zhana sezdirip koioiun dedin'erbi? Allakh asmandardagy nerselerdi bilet zhana zherdegi nerselerdi bilet. Allakh butkul nerselerdi bilet. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Al silerdin dinin'erdi bildiruun'orgo muktazh emes>>.

Oo, paigambar! Al arabdar saga Islamga kirgenderin mildet kylyshat. Alarga ait: <<Allakhtyn dinine kirgenin'erdi mildet kylbagyla! Anyn paidasy ozun'orgo gana kaitat. Teskerisinche, Allakh silerge yimanga keluun'orgo iigilik berip yraiymduuluk kyldy, eger siler Islamga kirdik dep aitkan sozun'ordo chynchyl bolson'or>>.

Chyndygynda Allakh asmandardagy zhana zherdegi kaiypty bilet. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Allakh silerdin kylyp zhatkanyn'ardy Koruuchu. Silerdin ish-araketterin'erdin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda Al alardyn zhakshysynyn syilygyn zhana zhamanynyn zhazasyn beret.

(q) Kaf. Ushuga okshogon sozdun tushundurmosu bakara suroosunun bashynda aitylgan. Allakh maanilerdi, koptogon zhakshylyktar menen berekeni kamtygan yiyk Kuran menen ant berdi. Siler kyiamat kundogu surak, syilyk zhana zhaza uchun sozsuz tiriltilesin'er.

Alardyn bash tartuusunun sebebi, alar seni kalp aitat dep kutushkon emes, antkeni alar senin chynchyldygyn'dy bilishet, teskerisinche, alarga perishtelerden emes, ozdorunon bolgon paigambar kelgenine tan' kalyshty. Alar tan' kalyp aityshty: <<Bizge adamzattan paigambardyn kelishi tan' kalyshtuu!
Biz olup, topurakka ailangandan kiiin kaira tirilebizbi? Oshol kaira tiriluu zhana denebiz chirigenden kiiin aga zhashoonun kaira kaituusu mumkun emes nerse, andai bolboit>>.

Biz alar olup zhok bolgondon kiiin alardyn denelerin zher zhegenin bilebiz. Alardyn ech biri Bizge zhashyruun emes. Bizdin aldybyzda Allakh alardyn zhashoosundagy zhana olgondon kiiinki tagdyr kylgan butkul nerselerdi saktoochu Kitep bar.
Birok al mushrikter paigambar alyp kelgen Kurandy zhalganga chygaryshty. Alar on'toisuz abalda turushat. Al tuuraluu ech nerseni dalildei alyshpady.

Mushrikterdin kaira tiriluunu chetke kakkanyn eskergende, alarga anyn boloorun dalilder menen eskertip, myndai dedi:
Kaira tiriluunu zhalganga chygargandar ustundogu asman tuuraluu oi zhugurtushpoibu, Biz any kantip zharattyk, kantip kurduk zhana zhyldyzdardy zhaigashtyryp kantip koozdoduk? Any kemchilduu kylgan ech kandai zharakalary zhok. Ushundai asmandy zharatkan Allakh oluktordu kaira tiriltuugo kudurettuu.
Biz zherdi zhashoogo yn'gailashtyryp ken' kyldyk, al termelbesh uchun bekem toolordu ornottuk zhana kozgo zhagymduu turduu-turduu osumduktordu zhana bak-daraktardy osturduk.
Biz bulardyn baarysyn Rabbisine moiun sunup kaitkan pendelerge tushunuk zhana eskertuu bolsun dep zharattyk.
Biz asmandan koptogon paidalary zhana zhakshylyktary bar suu tushurduk, oshol suu menen baktardy osturduk zhana siler tushumun zhyinagan arpanyn danyn zhana bashka nerselerdi osturduk.
Zhana sabaktary biri-birinin ustuno tosholgon biiik kurma daraktaryn osturduk.

Biz bul osturgon nerselerdi pendeler zhei turgan yrysky bolush uchun osturduk. Zhana any menen osumduk ospogon zherdi tirilttik. Biz bul zhamgyr menen osumduk ospogon zherdi tiriltken syiaktuu oluktordu da tiriltebiz, alar tirilip chygyshat.
Oo, paigambar! Seni zhalganga chygargandardan murunku koomdor da oz paigambarlaryn zhalganga chygaryshkan. Nukhtun koomu, kuduk eeleri zhana Samud koomu zhalganga chygaryshty.
Aad koomu, Faraon zhana Luttun koomu zhalganga chygaryshty.

Aika zhana Iemendegi Tubb'a koomu paigambary Shua'ibdy zhalganga chygardy, bul koomdordun baary alarga Allakh zhibergen paigambarlardy zhalganga chygaryshty zhana alarga Allakh ubada kylgan azapka kabylyshty.
Biz kaira tiriltuudo alsyzdyk kylchudai silerdi birinchi zharatkanda alsyzdyk kylyptyrbyzby? Birok alardyn birinchi zharaluudan kiiin kaira zharaluu tuuraluu bashtary katyp zhatat.
Biz insandy zharattyk zhana al dilinde suilogon sozdordu zhana oi tolgoolordu bilebiz. Biz aga zhurok menen bailanyshkan moiundagy kuroo tamyrynan da zhakynbyz.
Anyn ish-araketterin kabyl aluuchu eki perishte bar, alardyn biri on' tarabynda, ekinchisi sol tarabynda olturat.
Al kandai gana soz aitpasyn, anyn suilogondorun kuzotup turuuchu daiar perishte bar.
Kachyp kutuluu mumkun bolbogon olum kyiynchylygy akyikat menen keldi. Oo, beikapar insan! Bul sen alystap kachyp zhurgon nerse.
Kernei tartuuga zhoopker perishte kerneidi ekinchi zholu tartty. Myna ushul kyiamat kun. Kaapyrlar menen kunookorlorgo azap ubada kylyngan kun.
Ar bir zhandy bir perishte koshtop alyp kelet. Al perishte anyn kylgan ish-araketterine kubo bolot.

Al alyp kelingen insanga aitylat: <<Sen duinodo kumarlarga zhana zhyrgalchylyktarga azgyrylganyn' sebeptuu bul kundon beikapar bolchusun'. Emi Biz sen tartkan azap menen kyiynchylyktar sebeptuu senin beikaparlygyn'dy ketirip koiduk. Bugun bolso sen kapyryn'a albai zhurgon nerselerdi koro turganchalyk kozun' kurch.
Perishtelerden bolgon aga zhoopker zhandoochusu aitty: <<Myna mende anyn kylgan ishteri alymcha-koshumchasy zhok daiar turat>>.
Allakh al eki perishtege, koshtoochu menen kubogo otuuchugo aitty: <<Akyikatty chetke kagyp, aga bash iibegenderdin baarysyn tozokko yrgytkyla.
Al Allakhtyn aga zhuktogon mildetterinen kop bash tartkan, Allakhtyn chekterinen chykkan zhana aga aitylgan ubada zhe azap tuuraluu shektengen.
Al Allakhka syiynuuda Any menen katar bashka nerselerdi kudai tutup algan. Any katuu azapka tashtagyla>>.
Anyn shaitandardan bolgon zhandoochusu andan bash tartyp aitty: <<Rabbibiz! Men any adashtyrgan zhokmun. Birok al ozu akyikattan alystap adashuuga tushtu>>.

Allakh aitty: <<Menin aldymda talashpagyla! Myndan ech paida chykpait. Men silerge duinodo paigambarlarym alyp kelgen nerse arkyluu Maga kaapyrlyk zhana bash iibestik kylgan adamga kataal azap ubada kylynganyn aldyn ala eskertkem.
Biz oshol kunu tozokton: <<Saga yrtygylgan kaapyrlar menen kunoolorgo toldun'bu?>> - dep suraibyz. Oshondo al Rabbisine: <<Dagy barby?>> - dep Rabbisi uchun achuulanyp koshumcha talap kylyp surait.

Kachan Allakh kaapyrlarga katuu azapty ubada kylganda yimanduu pendelerine emnelerdi daiardaganyn aityp myndai dedi:
Rabbisinin buiruktaryn atkaryp zhana tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkondorgo beiish zhakyndatyldy. Alar andagy zhyrgalchylyktardy anchalyk alys emes zherden korushtu.
Alarga aitylat: <<Myna ushul Rabbisine daiym toobo kylyp kaitkan, Anyn aga zhuktogon mildetterin atkargan ar bir adamga berilet dep Allakhtyn silerge bergen ubadasy.
Osholorgo aitylat: <<Siler zhaman korgon nerseden salamatta beiishke kirgile! Bul ech kachan butpogon tuboluktuu kun>>.

Alar uchun al zhakta ech kachan tugonbogon, alar kaalagandai zhyrgalchylyktar bar. Oshondoi ele Bizdin aldybyzda ech bir koz korbogon, ech bir kulak ukpagan, adam balasynyn zhurogu tuibagan zhyrgalchylyktar bar. Myna osholordun biri - Allakh taalany koruu.

Mekke elinen chykkan zhalganchy mushrikterden murun alarga karaganda alda kancha kubattuu bolgon kanchalagan koomdordu kyiratyp zhok kylganbyz. Alar shaarlarynda ary-beri kachyp, azaptan saktoochu zhai izdedi, birok taba albady.

Chyndygynda murunku koomdordun kyiroosu tuuraluu aitylgan bul nersede akyl zhugurtuuchu zhurogu bar zhe beikapar bolboston, zhurogu menen tuiup kulak salgan adamdar uchun eskertuulor zhana sabaktar bar.
Oo, paigambar! Zhoottordun zhana bashkalardyn aitkandaryna sabyr kyl. Rabbin'e maktoolordu aityp Al uchun kun chykkanga cheiin bagymdat namazyn oku zhana kun batkanga cheiin asyr namazyn oku.
Tundun bir bolugundo Al uchun namaz oku zhana namazdardan kiiin Any aruula.
Oo, paigambar! Ukkun, al kunu surnai tartuuga zhoopker perishte zhakyn zherde surnaidy ekinchi zholu tartyp zhar salat.
Al kunu bardyk makuluktar shek-kumonsuz akyikat menen kaira tiriluunun kyikyryk unun ugushat. Any ugushkan kun - oluktor surak, zhaza zhana syilyk uchun kabyrlarynan chykkan kun.
Al kunu zher achylyp, alar andan shashylgan abalda chygyshat. Bul chogultuu Biz uchun on'oi.

Biz al zhalganchylardyn emne dep zhatyshkandaryn zhakshy bilebiz. Oo, paigambar! Sen alardy yimanga mazhburlai turgandai alardyn ustunon bashkaruuchu emessin'. Sen bolgonu Allakhtyn buirugun gana zhetkiruuchusun'. Andyktan sen Menin azabyn tuuraluu ubadalarymdan korkkon kaapyrlardy zhana kunookorlordu Kuran menen eskert.
Allakh topurakty sapyrgan shamal menen ant berdi.
Mol suunu kotorup zhurgon buluttar menen ant berdi.
Den'izde kyiynchylyksyz suzup zhurgon kemeler menen ant berdi.
Pendelerdin ishterine bailanyshtuu Allakhtyn buirugun bolushturgon perishteler menen ant berdi.
Kyiamat kunu pendelerdin suragy sozsuz bolot.

Ei, Mekke kalky! Silerdin aitkan sozun'or biri-birine karshy kelet, keede <<Kuran syikyr>> deisin'er, keede any <<poeziia>> deisin'er, keede <<Mukhammad syikyrchy>> deisin'er, keede any akyn deisin'er.
Kuran zhana paigambar tuuraluu ar kandai sozdordu aitkan zhalganchylarga kargysh bolsun!
Alar akyret zhaiy tuuraluu beikapar naadandykta, aga kon'ul da burushpait.
Alar: <<Zhaza zhana syilyk kun kachan?>> - dep surashat. Birok al uchun ech kandai araket dele kylyshpait.
Allakh alardyn suroosuna zhoop kylyp aitty: <<Alar tozokto azaptalgan kun>>.
Alarga: <<Azabyn'ardy tartkyla! Silerge eskertilgen kezde any ertelet dep shyldyn'dap suraganyn'ar - myna ushul>> - dep aitylat.
Al emi Rabbisinin buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkondor kyiamat kunu bakchalarda zhana agyp turuuchu bulaktarda bolushat.
Alar Rabbisi bergen uluu syilykty alyshat. Antkeni alar bul uluu syilykka cheiin duinodo zhakshylyktardy kylgandar ele.
Alar tundosu namaz okup, az gana ubakyt uktashat ele.
Al emi tan' zaarlarda kunooloru uchun Allakhtan kechirim surashat ele.
Alar surap kelgen adamga zhana kandaidyr bir sebepterten ulam yryskysynan kuru kalsa da surai albagan adamdarga mal-mulkunon yktyiarduu turdo alardyn akysyn berchi.

Zherde zhana Allakh aga zhaigashtyrgan toolordo, den'izderde, daryialarda, bak-daraktarda, osumduktordo zhana zhanybarlarda Allakh kelbet Beruuchu, Zharatuuchu dep teren' ishengender uchun Anyn kudurettuuluguno belgiler bar.
Oo, adamdar! Ozun'ordo da Allakhtyn kudurettuuluguno belgiler bar. Sabak alysh uchun nazar salbaisyn'arby?
Asmanda silerdin duinogo zhana dinge bailanyshtuu yryskyn'ar bar zhana silerge ubada kylyngan zhakshylyktar zhe zhamandyktar bar.
Asman menen zherdin Rabbisine ant! Chyndygynda kaira tiriluu silerdin suilop zhatkanyn'ardai ele shek-kumonsuz akyikat.
O, paigambar! Saga Ibrakhimge syiluu konok bolup kelgen perishteler tuuraluu kabar berildibi?
Kachan alar anyn ustuno kirshkende: <<Salam>> - deshti. Ibrakhim alarga: <<Salam>> - alik alyp, ichinen: <<Bular beitaanysh adamdar go>> - dedi.
Al ui-bulosuno zhashyruun baryp, al zhaktan toluk semiz muzoonu alyp keldi. Al alardy adamzat dep oilogon.
Anan muzoonu alarga zhakyndatyp, zhumshaktyk menen kairylyp: <<Aldyn'arga koiulgan tamaktan' zhebeisin'erbi?>> - dedi.

Alardyn zhebegenin korgondo ichinen korkup ketti. Alar any sezip, anyn kon'ulun tynchtantyp: <<Korkpo! Biz Allakhtyn aldynan kelgen elchilerbiz>> - deshti. Zhana aga koptogon ilimge ee bolgon perzenttuu balaluu bolorun suiunchuloshtu. Al suiunchulongon bala Iskhak bolchu.
Kachan anyn aialy suiunchunu ukkanda kubanganynan kyikyryp kelip, ozun zhuzuno chapkylap, tan' kalgan abalda: <<Kempir dagy toroibu?>> - dedi. Al buga cheiin torogon emes ele.

Aga perishteler aityshty: <<Biz saga aitkan kabardy Rabbin' Ozu aitty. Al emneni aitsa, any ech kim kaitara albait. Chyndygynda Al zharatuusunda zhana tagdyr kyluusunda Daanyshman, pendelerine emne paidaluu ekenin Biluuchu>>.
Ibrakhim alaikhi salam perishtelerge: silerge emne boldu? emneni maksat kylyp zhatasyn'ar - dedi.
Perishteler aga zhoop kylyp aityshty: bizdi Allakh yplas kunoolordu atkargan kunookor koomgo zhiberdi.
Alardyn ustuno katuu chopo-tashtardy zhaadyrysh uchun
Oo, Ibrakhim al senin Rabbyn'dyn aldynda Allakhtyn cheginen ashyp, kaapyrlyk zhana kunoo ishterge chun'kup kirgenderge belgilenip koiulgan.
Lut koomu (zhashagan) aiyldagy yimanduulardy kunookorlorgo zhetken azap zhetpeshi uchun chygardyk.
Alardyn ailynda bir uidon bashka musulmandardy tappadyk. Alar Lut alaikhi salamdyn ui-bulosu ele.
Luttun koomu (zhashagan) aiylga tushkon zhan chydagys azaptan korkup, ulgu alyp, andan kutuluu uchun al zholgo barbai turgandarga dalil bolo turgan belgilerdi kaltyrdyk.
Musany Faraongo achyk dalilder menen zhibergenibizde da zhan chydagys azaptan korkkondor uchun belgiler bar.
Faraon kubatyna zhana askerlerine ishenip, akyikattan zhuz burdu da Musa alaikhi salam zhonundo myndai dedi: al adamdardy syikyrlagan syikyrchy zhana tushunuksuz sozdordu suilogon zhindi.
Any, askerlerin baaryn azaptap den'izge tashtadyk. Alar chogup olushtu. Faraon (elchini) zhalganga chygaryp, Kudailykty daava kylyp aiyptaluuchu ish kyldy.
Khud koomu Aadka tushkon zhan chydagys azaptan korkkondor uchun ulgu (sabak) bar. Biz alarga zhamgyr kotorbogon, darak chan'dashtyrbagan berekesiz shamal zhibergenbiz.
Ech bir zhandy da maldy da andan bashkasyn da kaltyrbai, baaryn talkalap, chirip maidalangan (sook) syiaktuu kylyp koidu.
Salikh alaikhi salamdyn koomu Samudka (bul duino) zhashoon'ordu azhalyn'ar kelgenche paidalanyp kalgyla dep aitylganda tushkon zhan chydagys azaptan korkkondor uchun ulgu (sabak) bar.

Rabbylarynyn yiman keltirip, bash iigile degen buiruguna tekeberdenip karshy chygyshty. Oshondo alardy ach aikyryk azaby karmady. Alar anyn tushoorun kutup turushkan ele. Antkeni, (al azap) alarga uch kun murda ubada kylyngan ele.
Ozdoruno tushkon azapty ketire alyshpady. Andan korgono turgan kuchtoru dele zhok ele.
Chynynda alardan (Aad, Samud zhana Faraondon) murda Nukh koomun da chokturup zhok kylganbyz. Alar Allakhka bash iibei, zhazaga tatyktuu bolushkan.
Biz asmandy myktylap, bekemdep kurduk zhana anyn ailanasyn ken'eite berebiz.
Zherdi anyn betinde zhashagandarga toshok symal tegiz kylyp daiardadyk. Biz kandai zhakshy daiardoochubuz, sebebi any alarga tegiz kylyp daiardadyk.
Allakhtyn zhalgyzdygyn zhana kuduretin eskeruun'or uchun erkek-urgaachy, asman-zher, kurgaktyk-den'iz syiaktuu ar bir nerseni zhubu menen zharattyk.
Allakhka kunookor bolboi, Aga bash iiip, Anyn zhazasynan soobuna kachkyla (shashylgyla). Oo, adamdar! Men silerge Anyn zhazasynan achyk eskertuuchumun.
Allakh menen birge (ozun'orgo) andan bashka syiyngan kudai kylyp albagyla! Men silerge Andan (zhiberilgen) anyk estetuuchumun!
Mekkelikter (paigambardy) zhalganga chygargan syiaktuu murdaky koomdor dele zhalganga chygaryshkan. Allakh tarbynan kandai elchi kelse da, <<al zhalganchy>> zhe <<zhindi>> - dep aityshkan.
Murdaky zhana kiiinki kaapyrlar elchilerdi zhalganga chygaruuga biri-birine osuiat kylyshty bele?! Zhok, alardyn baary (kaapyrlykta) chekterinen ashkan elder.
Oo, elchi! Al zhalganga chygargandardan zhuz burgun. Aga sen aiyptuu emessin'. Chynynda sen alarga zhiberilgen nerseni zhetkirdin'.
Alardan zhuz buruun' alarga nasaat kylyp, eskertuudon tosup koibosun. Alarga nasaat aityp, eskertkin! Antkeni, eskertuu Allakhka yiman keltirgenderge paida beret.
Zhin menen insandy zhalgyz Maga gana ibadat kyluulary uchun zharattym. Maga sherik koshuulary uchun zharatpadym.
Alardan yrysky da Meni tamaktandyruularyn da kaalabaimyn.

Chynynda, Allakh pendelerine yrysky beruuchu, zharalgandyn baary Anyn yryskysyna muktazh. Al ech kim zhana ech nerse ustom bolo albagan bekem kubat eesi. Zhin zhana insandardyn baary Anyn kubatyna bash iiishet.

Oo, elchi, seni zhalganchyga chygaryp, oz zhandaryna zulumduk kylgandarga ozdorunon murdaky sherikterinin ulushundoi azaptan bolgon ulushtoru bar. Anyn belgilengen ubaktysy bar. Ubaktysy kelmeiinche any Menden erteletuunu talap kylyshpasyn!
Allakhka kaapyr bolup, elchilerin zhalganga chygargan adamdarga alarga azap tushuusu ubada kylyngan Kyiamat Kundo olum, zyianga uchuroo bolsun!
Allakh Musa alaikhi salamga suilogondo Musa turgan toogo ant berdi.
Zhazylgan kitepke ant berdi
Tushkon kitepter syiaktuu achyk, achylgan barakka
Perishteler Allakhka ibadat kylyp abad kylgan asmandagy uigo ant berdi.
Zherdin shyby bolgon kotorulgon asmanga ant berdi.
Tolup-tashkan den'izge ant berdi.
Oo, elchi! Rabbyn'dyn azaby kaapyrlarga sozsuz bolot. Anda shek zhok.
Al azapty alardan ech bir kaitaruuchu-tosuuchu zhok.
Kyiamattyn boloorun kabarlap asman katuu titiregen kundo.
zhana toolor ordularynan zhylyp uchkanda
Al kunu Allakhtyn kaapyrlarga ubada kylgan azabyn zhalganga chygargandarga olum, zyianga uchuroo bolsun!
Alar kaira tiriluunu da chogultuluunu da eske albai (kon'ul burbai), zhalgan nerselerge chumkup kirip, oinoshot.
Al kunu alar tozok otuna oto katuu, oroiluk turtulup kirgizilet.
Alardy zhemelep aitylat: elchilerin'er silerdi korkutup (eskertkende) zhalganga chygargan tozok - ushul!
Siler oz kozun'or menen korup zhatkan bul azap syikyr beken? Zhe siler any korboi zhatasyn'arby?
Anyn ysyktyk azabyna sabyr kylgyla zhe kylbagyla, silerdin sabyr kylganyn'ar menen kylbaganyn'ar baary bir. Bugun siler duinodo kylgan kaapyrlygyn'ar menen kunoolorun'ordun zhazasyn' alasyn'ar.

Kachan Allakh zhalganchylardyn zhazasyn aitkanda, chynchyl takybalardyn da syilygyn aityp myndai dedi:
Rabbisinin buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkondor beiishterde zhana tuboluktuu uluu zhyrgalchylyktarda bolushat.

Alar Allakh bergen tamak-ash, suusunduk zhana nike yrakhattary sebeptuu, oshondoi ele Rabbisi alardy tozok azabynan kutkargandygy sebeptuu kubanyshat. Antkeni alar kaalagan zhyrgalchylyktarga zhetip zhana kaigy-kapalardan korgoodo bolup zhen'ishke zhetishti.

Alarga aitylat: <<Kon'ulun'or kaalagan sin'imduu nerselerden zhegile zhana ichkile. Zhegen zhe ichken nerselerdi zyianduu dep korkpogula. Bul silerdin duinodo kylgan zhakshy ish-araketterin'erdi syilygy>>.
Alar biri-birine bet man'dai zhaigashkan zhasalgaluu sorulorgo suionup olturushat. Zhana Biz alardy bakyran' koz apapakai aialdarga uilondurobuz.

Yiman keltirgenderdi zhana alardy yimanda eerchigen bala-chakalaryn, alardy korgondo kozdoru kubanuulary uchun alar menen birge kylabyz. Alardyn ish-araketteri alardykyna zhetpese dagy, Biz alardyn ish-araketterinin sooptorunan ech nerseni kemitpeibiz. Ar bir adam kylgan zhamandyk ishi sebeptuu karmalyp turat. Bashka ech kim anyn ish-araketterin kotorboit.
Zhana Biz beiishtegilerdi turduu momo-zhemishter menen zhana alar kaalagan etter menen kamsyzdaibyz.
Alar beiishte biri-birine choichoktordu sunushat. Any ichkende duinodogudoi mas abalynan ulam zhalgan suiloo zhe kunoo kyluu syiaktuu nerseler bolboit.
Alarga kyzmat kyluuga daiyndalgan zhash zhigitter alardy ailanyp turushat. Alardyn terilerinin tunuktugu zhana aktygy sedepte saktalgan bermetter syiaktuu.
Zhana beiishtegilerdin kee birleri bashkalaryna kairylyp, biri-birinen duinodogu abaldary zhonundo surashty.
Alarga myndai dep zhoop berishet: <<Biz duinodo ui-bulobuzdun arasynda Allakhtyn azabynan korkkon abalda elek.
Anan Allakh bizge Islamga karai tuura zholdu tartuulady zhana bizdi oto ysygan azaptan saktady.

Biz duino zhashoosunda Aga syiynyp, bizdi tozok azabynan sakta dep duba kylat elek. Chyndygynda Al zhakshylyk Kyluuchu, pendelerine bergen ubadasyna Chynchyl, alarga Yraiymduu. Al bizdi yiman zholuna salyp, beiishke kirgizgeni zhana tozokton alystatkany - bizge kylgan zhakshylygy zhana meerimi>>.
Oo, paigambar! Kuran menen eskertkin! Allakh saga bergen yiman zhana akyl sebeptuu sen zhin-shaitandary bar kozu achyk emessin', zhindi da emessin'.
Zhe al zhalganchylar: <<Mukhammad elchi emes, al akyn. Biz anyn olumu kelgenche kutup, andan kutulup es alaly>> - deshebi?
Oo, paigambar! Alarga ait: <<Olumumdu kutkulo! Men dagy siler meni zhalganga chygarganyn'ar uchun silerge kele turgan azapty kutomun>>.

Teskerisinche, akyldary alarga: <<Al kozu achyk zhana zhindi>> - dep buiruk kylaby? Oshentip alar bir adamda bolbogon nerseni biriktirishet. Alar chekten chykkan koom. Andyktan alar shariiatka da, akylga da kaityshpait.
Zhe alar: <<Mukhammad bul Kurandy oilop tapkan, al aga vakhii kylyngan emes>> - dep aityshaby? Zhok! Alar aga yiman keltirishpesten: <<Al any oilop tapkan>> - dep aityshat.
Eger alar oilop tapty degen sozdorundo chynchyl bolushsa, anda ushundai sozdu ozdoru oilop taap bolso da alyp kelishsinchi?!

Zhe alar Zharatuuchusu zhok ele zharalyp kalyshkanby? Zhe ozdorun ozdoru zharatkanby? Zharatuuchusuz ech bir makuluk bolushu mumkun emes zhana ech bir makuluk zharata da albait. Emi emnege alar Zharatuuchusuna syiynbai zhatyshat?
Zhe alar asmandar menen zherdi zharatty bele? Zhok! Alar Allakh Zharatuuchusu ekenine ishenishpeit. Eger alar munu anyk bilishkende, Any zhalgyzdashmak zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirishmek.

Zhe alar ozdoru kaalaganga yrysky berip, ozdoru kaalaganga paigambarchylykty berip zhe tyiyp koigudai Rabbin'din kazynasy alardyn kolundaby? Zhe alar ozdorunun kaalooloruna zharasha ish kylyp, biilik zhurguzgondorbu?

Zhe alar akyikat zholdo degen Allakhtyn vakhiiin ukkudai asmanga karai kotorulgon tepkechi barby? Alardyn kimisi al vakhiidi ukkan bolso, anda alardyn akyikat zholdobuz dep aitkan sozdorun tastyktagan achyk-aikyn dalil alyp kelsin.
Zhe siler zhaman korgon kyz baldar Allakhka, al emi siler zhakshy korgon uul baldar silerge taandykpy?
Oo, paigambar! Zhe sen Rabbin' taraptan zhetkirgen nersen' uchun alardan syilyk aky surap zhatasyn'by? Ushundan ulam alar chamasy zhetpegen zhuktu kotorushot.
Zhe alarda kaiyp ilimi bar beken, alar kaiyptan bilgen nerselerdi adamdarga zhazyp berip, alardyn ichinen ozdoru kaalagandaryn gana kabarlaiby?
Zhe al zhalganchylar saga zhana dinin'e karshy aila-amal kylyp zhatyshaby? Sen emes, Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyrlyk kylgandar ailasy kurugandar.
Zhe alardyn Allakhtan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudaiy barby? Allakh alardyn koshkon sherikterinen aruu zhana yiyk. Zhogoruda kelgenderdin biri da bolgon emes zhana any elestetuu da mumkun emes.
Eger alar asman boluktoru kulap kele zhatkanyn korushso: <<Bul kadimki ele katmarluu buluttar>> - dep aityshat. Alar sabak alyshpait zhana yiman da keltirishpeit.
Oo, paigambar! Alardy azaptala turgan kyiamat kungo cheiin bash iibestik kylyp, karshy chykkan abaldarynda tim koi.
Al kunu az bolobu zhe kop bolobu, alardyn aila-amaldary paida keltirbeit zhana alardy azaptan kutkaruu arkyluu zhardam da korsotulboit.

Al emi ozdoruno shirk zhana kunoolordu kylyp zyian keltirgenderge akyret azabynan murun bul duinodo olturuu zhana tutkunga aluu syiaktuu azaptar bar zhana barzakhta kabyr azaby bar. Birok alardyn kopchulugu munu bilishpeit. Oshol sebepten kaapyrlyktan kaityshpait.

Kachan Allakh mushrikterdin zhalganda ekenin baiandaganda, oz elchisin alarga kon'ul burboogo zhana alardyn zhalganga chygaruusuna sabyr kyluuga buirup, myndai dedi:
Oo, paigambar! Rabbin'din chechimine zhana shariiat okumuno sabyr kyl! Chyndygynda sen Bizdin koz aldybyzdasyn' zhana korgoobuzdasyn'. Uikudan turganda Rabbin'e maktoolordu aityp aruula.
Tun ichinde Rabbin'di aruula, Al uchun namaz oku zhana kundun zharygy menen zhyldyzdar ochup baratkan mezgilde bagymdat namazyn oku.
Allakh kulagan zhyldyz menen ant berdi.
Allakhtyn elchisi Mukhammad akyikat zholdon taigan emes zhana adashkan da emes, al tuura zholdo.
Zhana al bul Kurandy oz kaaloosuna eerchip suiloboit.
Bul Kuran - Allakh aga Zhebreil perishte arkyluu tushurgon vakhii gana.
Any aga abdan kubattuu Zhebreil perishte uirotkon.
Zhebreil suluu kelbet eesi, al paigambarga Allakh any zharatkan kelbette paida bolup tike turdu.
Zhana Zhebreil asmandyn biiik meikindiginde.
Andan son' Zhebreil paigambarga zhakyndady, kiiin dagy zhakyndady.
Anyn aga zhakyndygy eki zhaanyn olchomundoi zhe andan da zhakyn boldu.
Anan Zhebreil Allakhtyn kulu Mukhammadga vakhii kyldy.
Mukhammaddyn zhurogu kozu menen korgon nerseni zhalganga chygargan zhok.
Ei, mushrikter! Al asmanga kotorulgon tunu Allakh aga korgozgon nerseler tuuraluu talashyp tartyshasyn'arby?
Mukhammad asmanga kotorulgon tunu Zhebreiildi dagy bir zholu oz kelbetinde kordu.
Zhetinchi asmandagy ebegeisiz chon' darak Sidra al'-Muntakhanyn aldynda.
Anyn aldynda Ma'va beiishi bar.
Kapystan Allakhtyn buirugu menen Sidrany bir uluu nerse orop aldy. Anyn akyikatyn Allakh gana bilet.
Mukhammaddyn kozdoru on'go da, solgo da burulgan zhok zhana al belgilengen chekten da ashkan zhok.
Mukhammad asmanga kotorulgon tunu Rabbisinin kudurettulugun bildirgen uluu aiat-belgilerdi kordu, beiish menen tozoktu kordu zhana alardan bashkasyn da kordu.
Ei, mushrikter! Siler Allakhtan bashka syiyngan Lat menen Uzza aikelderin korbodun'orbu?
Zhana silerdin aikelderin'erdin uchunchusu Manatty dagy. Aitkylachy maga, alar silerge paida zhe zyian keltire aldyby?
Ei, mushrikter! Silerge ozun'or zhakshy korgon uul baldar, al emi zhaman korgon kyz baldar Allakhka taandykpy?
Oz kaaloon'orgo karap myndai bolgonun'or adiletsiz boluu.
