Bul aikelder zhon gana maanisiz atalyshtar. Alar kudailyk sypattarga ee emes. Alardy ozun'or zhana ata-babalaryn'ar ele atap algansyn'ar. Allakh buga ech kandai dalil tushurgon emes. Mushrikter oz ishenimderinde bozhomolgo gana eerchishet zhana shaitan alardyn zhuroktorundo kooz kylyp korgozgon nerselerdi kaalashat. Alarga paigambardyn tilinde Rabbisi taraptan akyikat keldi. Birok alar al zholgo tushushkon zhok.
Zhe insan uchun Allakhtyn aldynda al kaalagandai aikelderdin shapaaty bar beken?
Zhok! Anyn kaalagany bolboit. Akyret zhana duino zhalgyz Allakhka taandyk. Alardan Ozu kaalagan nersesin beret, kaalabagan nersesin berbeit.

Asmandarda kanchalagan perishteler bar, alardyn shapaaty ech paida keltirbeit. Egerde alar kimdir biroogo shapaat kyluunu kaalashsa, anda Allakh Ozu kaalagandarga shapaat kyluuga uruksat berip zhana shapaat kylyngandarga yraazy bolgondon kiiin gana shapaat kyla alyshat. Allakh sherik kylyngandarga ech kachan shapaat kyluuga uruksat berbeit zhana Allakhtan bashka aga syiyngandardan ech kachan yraazy bolboit.
Akyrettegi tiriluugo yiman keltirbegender perishtelerdi Allakhtyn kyzdary degen ishenimden ulam alardy aialdardyn attary menen atashat. Allakh alardyn aitkan sozdorunon zhogoru turat.

Perishtelerdi aialdardyn attary menen atoodo alardyn taianar ilimi zhok. Alar bul nersede bozhomol zhana kumongo gana eerchishet. Chyndygynda kumon akyikattyn ordun baskydai ech kandai paida keltire albait.
Oo, paigambar! Allakhty estoodon bash tartkan, aga maani berbegen zhana duino zhashoosun gana kaalagan adamdan zhuz bur. Al akyreti uchun araket kylbait. Sebebi al aga ishenbeit.

Mushrikterdin perishtelerdi aialdardyn attary menen atap aitkan bul sozdoru -- alar zhetken ilimdin chegi. Antkeni alar sabatsyz, alar teren' ishenimge zhetishken emes. Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda Rabbin' akyikat zholdon chettegenderdi zhakshy bilet zhana Anyn zholuna tushkondordu da zhakshy bilet. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.

Eelik kyluuda, zharatuuda zhana bashkaruuda asmandardagy zhana zherdegi nerseler zhalgyz Allakhka taandyk. Oshon uchun Al duinodo zhamandyk ishterdi kylgandardy azap menen tatyktuu zhazasyn beret zhana zhakshylyk kylgan yimanduularga beiishti syilyk kylat.

Chon' kunoolordon zhana buzuku ishterden saktangandardyn kichine kunooloru, chon' kunoodon saktanyp, kop ibadat kylgany sebeptuu kechirilet. Oo, paigambar! Chynynda, Rabbin'din kechirimduulugu cheksiz. Al pendeleri toobo kylsa, kunoolorun kechiret. Al silerdi atan'ar Adamdy topuraktan zharatkandan (bashtap) enen'erdin ichinde ulam oorchugon tuiulduk kezdegi abalyn'ardy zhana (kiiinki) zhasagan ishterin'erdi zhakshy bilet. Aga ech nerse zhashyruun emes. Andyktan, ozun'ordu takybamyn dep maktabagyla. Allakh Taala anyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiganynan tyiylgan takybalardy zhakshy bilet.
Islamga zhakyndagandan kiiin zhuz burgan adamdyn zhiiirkenichtuu abalyn korbodun'bu?
Al bolbogon mal-mulk berdi, kiiin toktottu. Antkeni saran'dyk anyn tabiiaty. Birok al aga karabastan ozun maktait.
Zhe al Allakhka zhalaa zhabuuchubu? Zhe bul zhalaakorgo Allakh Musaga tushurgon baiyrky barakchalar tuuraluu kabar berilgen zhok bele?
Zhana Ibrakhimdin barakchalarychy, al Rabbisi tapshyrgan nerselerdin baaryn atkaryp, any aiagyna chygardy.
Ech bir insan bashkanyn kunoosun kotorboit.
Al kyiamat kunu ish-araketterin oz kozu menen korot.
Kiiin anyn ishterinin syilygyn kemitpesten toluk beret.
Oo, paigambar! Pendeler olumdon kiiin Rabbin'e kaityshat.
Al Ozu kaalaganyn kubandyryp kuldurot zhana Ozu kaalaganyn kaigyga salyp yilatat.
Al duinodo tiruulordu olturot zhana oluktordu kaira tiriltet.
Al erkek zhana urgaachy kylyp zhuptardy zharatty.
Zhatynga zhaigashkan bel suudan.
Alardy olgondon kiiin kaira zharatuu Anyn mildeti.
Al Ozu kaalaganyn mal-mulkko ee kylyp baiytty zhana adamdar eelik kylgan mal-mulkton berdi.
Al kee bir mushrikter Allakh menen katar syiyngan Sirius zhyldyzynyn da Rabbisi.
Al Khuddun koomu bolgon baiyrky Aaddy kaapyrlyktan kaitpagandygy uchun zhok kyldy.
Zhana Salikhtin koomu Samuddu da zhok kyldy. Alardan ech kim kalgan zhok.

Al Aad menen Samudga cheiin Nukhtun koomun zhok kylgan. Chyndygynda Nukhtun koomu Aad menen Samuddan otkon zaalym zhana chekten chykkandardan ele. Antkeni Nukh alardyn arasynda 950 zhyl zhashap, alardy zhalgyz Allakhka syiynuuga chakyrgan. Birok alar aga zhoop berishken emes.
Al Lut koomunun shaaryn asmanga kotorup, kiiin any oodaryp turup zherge tashtagan.
Al asmanga kotorulup, kaira zherge tushkondo anyn ustun zhaap kaldy zhana tashtar zhaady.
Ei, insan! Rabbin'din kudurettuulugun korgozgon kaisy aiat-belgileri tuuraluu talashyp tartyshyp, alardan sabak albai zhatasyn'?
Silerge zhiberilgen bul elchi abalky elchilerdin ele biri.
Zhakyndoochu kyiamat zhakyndap kaldy.
Any Allakhtan bashka ech kim kaitara albait zhana ech kim bile albait.
Silerge okulup zhatkan bul Kuran Allakhtan ekenine tan' kalyp zhatasyn'arby?
Siler andagy osuiattardy ukkanda yilagandyn orduna anyn ustunon kulup shyldyn'dap zhatasyn'arby?
Siler aga zhen'il karap, kon'ul burbai zhatasyn'arby?
Allakhka gana sazhda kylgyla zhana Aga chyn yklastan ibadat kylgyla!
Kyiamattyn kelishi zhakyndap kaldy. Zhana paigambardyn zamanynda Ai ekige bolundu. Aidyn bolunushu anyn korunuktuu aiat-belgilerinen boldu.
Mushrikter anyn chynchyldygynyn dalilderin korushso da, any kabyl aluudan bash tartyshty zhana aityshty: <<Biz andan korgon dalilder chyndykka dal kelbegen syikyr>>.
Oshondoi ele alarga kelgen akyikatty zhalganga chygaryshty zhana zhalganga chygaruuda oz kaaloolorun eerchishti. Kyiamat kunu kandai gana zhakshy zhe zhaman ish bolbosun, al ozuno tatyktuusun tabat.
Alardy kaapyrlyktan zhana zulumduktan kaitaruuga zhetishtuu bolgon, Allakh kaapyrlyktary zhana zulumduktary sebeptuu zhok kylgan koomdordun kabarlary kelgen ele.
Alarga karshy dalil bolsun uchun kelgen nerse - kemchiliksiz daanyshmandyk. Al emi Allakhka zhana akyret kungo yiman keltirbegenderge eskertmeler paida keltirbeit.

Oo, paigambar! Egerde alar tuura zholgo tushposo, anda surnai tartuuga mildettuu perishte aga cheiin ech bir makuluk bilbegen korkunuchtuu ishke chakyrgan kundu kutkon abalda alardy tashta zhana alardan zhuzun'du bur.
Alar kabyrdan basyngan koz karash menen chygyshat, alardyn surak zhaiyna zhonop baratkan abaly kaptagan chegirtkeler syiaktuu.
Oshol zhaidy kozdoi chakyruuchuga shashylgan kaapyrlar: <<Bul oto oor kun>> - deshet. Antkeni anda kyiynchylyktar zhana korkunuchtar bar.

Kachan Allakh kaapyrlar paigambarybyzdyn daavatynan bash tartkany tuuraluu soz kylganda, anyn kon'ulun zhooshutuu uchun paigambarlaryn zhalganga chygargan murunku koomdor tuuraluu da aityp myndai dedi:
Oo, paigambar! Al zhalganchylardan murun senin daavatyn'dy Nukhtun koomu zhalganga chygargan. Biz alarga kulubuz Nukhtu zhibergende any zhalganga chygaryshty. Any zhindi dep aityshty. Egerde daavatyn tashtabasa, any ar kandai sogush sozdor, mazaktoo zhana korkutuu menen zhemeleshti.
Oshondo Nukh Rabbisine zhalbaryp: <<Chyndygynda elim maga ustomduk kylyp, maga zhoop berbedi. Emi Ozun' alarga zhazan'dy berip, och al>> - dedi.
Anan Biz tynymsyz tokkon suu menen asman eshikterin achtyk.

Zhana Biz zherdi zharyp, al suu atylyp chykkan bulaktarga ailandy. Anan abalky tagdyrda zhazylgan Allakhtyn buirugunun negizinde asmandan tushkon suu menen zherden chykkan suu koshulup, Allakh saktap kalgandardan bashka but baarysyn suuga chokturdu.
Biz Nukhtu taktai zhana myktary bar kemege tushurup, any zhana any menen birge bolgondordu suuga choguudon saktap kaldyk.

Al keme Bizdin koz aldybyzda zhana kamkordugubuzda, Nukhtu zhalganga chygargan zhana Allakh taraptan alyp kelgen nersege kaapyrlyk kylgan koomuna karshy any koldoo maksatta biri-birine urungan suu tolkundarynda suzup bara zhatty.
Biz alarga bergen bul zhazany sabak zhana osuiat kylyp kaltyrdyk. Emi andan sabak ala turgandar bar beken?
Zhalganchylar uchun azabym kandai boldu zhana alardy zhok kylam degen eskertuum kandai boldu?
Biz Kurandy eskeruu zhana sabak aluu uchun zhen'il kyldyk. Emi andagy osuiattardan sabak ala turgandar bar beken?
Aad koomu Khud paigambardy zhalganga chygardy. Oilongula, ei, Mekke kalky! Menin azabym alar uchun kandai boldu? Menin bashkalarga azap tuuraluu eskertmem kandai boldu?
Biz alarga zhaman zhana kargashaluu kundo alar tozokko barganga cheiin toktobogon yzgaarduu shamal zhiberdik.
Al adamdardy zherden zhulup alyp, alardy tamyry menen zhulungan kurmalar syiaktuu bashy menen zherge yrgytty.
Oilongula, ei, Mekke kalky! Menin azabym alar uchun kandai boldu? Menin bashkalarga azap tuuraluu eskertmem kandai boldu?
Biz Kurandy eskeruu zhana sabak aluu uchun zhen'il kyldyk. Emi andagy osuiattardan sabak ala turgandar bar beken?
Samud dagy Salikh paigambardyn eskertmesin zhalganga chygardy.
Alar zhaktyrbagandai aityshty: <<Biz ozubuzdon ele bolgon bir adamdy eerchimek belek? Egerde biz bul abalda any eerchisek, anda tuuralyktan alystap, chettep ketebiz zhana kyiynchylykka kabylabyz.
Vakhii zhalgyz aga ele tushtubu zhana al baarybyzdan ozgochobu? Zhok! Al zhetken zhalganchy, tekeber>>.
Alar kyiamat kunu kim zhetken zhalganchy, tekeber ekenin, al menen tigilerdin kimisi zhakshy ekenin bilishet.
Biz tashtan toonu chygardyk zhana any alarga synoo uchun zhiberdik. Oo, Salikh! Emi sen alar any emne kylaryn zhana alarga emne bolorun koz salyp kut zhana alardyn zyiandaryna sabyr kyl!
Alarga kabar ber, kuduktun suusu alar menen toonun ortosunda bolundu, bir kun alar uchun, bir kun too uchun. Ar biri oz ulushu uchun ozunun kunundo kelet.
Anan alar toonu olturuugo sherigin chakyryshty. Al elinin buirugun atkarysh uchun kylychty aldy da, toonu olturup saldy.
Oilongula, ei, Mekke kalky! Menin azabym alar uchun kandai boldu? Menin bashkalarga azap tuuraluu eskertmem kandai boldu?
Biz alardy bir kyikyryp zhiberip zhok kyldyk. Alar korgonchu koi koroosun toskon kak chyrpyktai bolup kalyshty.
Biz Kurandy estoo zhana sabak aluu uchun zhen'il kyldyk. Emi andagy ulgu-nasaattardan sabak aluuchular barby?
Luttun koomu paigambary Lut eskertken nerseni zhalganga chygaryshty.
Biz alarga tash zhaadyrgan shamal zhiberdik. Luttun ui-bulosu gana azapka duushar bolgon zhok. Biz alardy andan kutkardyk. Al alar menen birge azap tushkongo cheiin tundun akyrynda zholgo chygyshty.
Biz alardy Oz zhakshylygybyz menen azaptan kutkardyk. Biz Lutka bergendei syilykty Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryna shugur kylgandarga da berebiz.
Lut alardy Bizdin azabybyz menen korkuttu, birok alar anyn eskertuusu tuuraluu talashyp tartyshty zhana any chetke kagyshty.

Luttun koomu andan buzukuluk maksatta perishtelerden bolgon konoktorun alar menen zhalgyz kaltyruusun talap kylyshty. Oshondo Biz alardyn kozdorun buup koiduk, alar korboi kalyshty. Zhana Biz alarga: <<Menin azabymdy zhana silerge aitkan eskertmemdin akybetin tartkyla>> - dep aittyk.
Erten' menen alarga akyretke baryshkanga cheiin toktobogon azap keldi zhana akyret azaby da kelet.
Alarga aitylat: <<Men silerge tushurgon azapty zhana Luttun silerge bergen eskertmesinin akybetin tartkyla>>.
Biz Kurandy eskeruu zhana sabak aluu uchun zhen'il kyldyk. Emi andagy osuiattardan sabak ala turgandar bar beken?
Faraondun ui-bulosuno eskertuubuz Musa menen Kharundun tili arkyluu keldi.
Alar Biz taraptan kelgen dalilderdi zhalganga chygaryshty. Anan Biz alardy zhalgandary sebeptuu ech kim ustom kyla albagan Zhen'ilgis, ech kim alsyrata albagan Kudurettuunun zhazasy menen zhazaladyk.

Oo, Mekke kalky! Silerdin kaapyrlaryn'ar zhogoruda aitylgan Nukhtun koomu, Aad, Samud, Luttun koomu zhana Faraondun koomundagy kaapyrlardan zhakshyraakpy? Zhe silerde asman kitepterinde kelgen Allakhtyn azabynan kutuluu barby?
Zhe bolboso Mekke kalkynan bolgon kaapyrlar: <<Biz zhamandyk kaalagandardyn zhana bizdin zhamaatty bolup zharuunu kaalagandardyn baarysyn zhen'ebiz>> - dep aityshaby?
Al kaapyrlardyn zhamaaty zhakynda zhen'ilet zhana yimanduulardyn aldynda artka karai kachyshat. Bul Badr kunu bolgon.
Alar zhalganga chygargan kyiamat - alar azaptaluuchu ubadalangan ubakyt. Kyiamat - alar Badr kunu tartkan duino azabynan da oor zhana kataal.
Chyndygynda kaapyrlyk zhana kunoolordu kylgan kunookorlor akyikattan adashuuda, azapta zhana kyiynchylykta.
Alar zhuzdoru menen tozokko suirolgon kunu alarga zheme katary: <<Tozok azabyn tatkyla>> - dep aitylat.
Chyndygynda Biz aalamdagy butkul nerseni Ozubuzdun murunku tagdyrdyn negizinde, ilimibizge zhana kaaloobuzga ylaiyk zhana oshondoi ele Saktalgan Taktada zhazganybyzdai zharattyk.
Egerde Biz bir nerseni kaalasak <<bol!>> degen sozdu gana aityp buiruk berebiz, oshondo al kaalagan nersebiz koz irmegenchelik tez ishke ashat.
Biz kaapyrlykta silerge okshogon murunku koomdordu zhok kylganbyz. Emi andan sabak alyp, kaapyrlykty tashtagan biroo zharym barby?
Pendelerdin kylgan butkul ish-araketteri saktoochu perishtelerdin kitepterinde zhazylgan. Alar anyn birin dagy kaltyrbait.
Maida zhana chon' ish-araketter menen sozdordun but baarysy Saktalgan Taktadagy ish-araketter barakchalarynda zhazylgan. Zhakynda alar anyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn alyshat.
Chyndygynda Rabbisinin buiruktaryn atkargan zhana tyigandaryn tashtagan takyba adamdar beiishterde zhana akkan daryialardyn boiunda zhyrgalchylykka batyshat.

Alar butkul nersege eelik kylgan Padyshanyn zhana ech bir nersege alsyz bolbogon Kudurettuunun aldynda kurulai soz zhe kunoo bolbogon akyikat oturumda bolushat. Emi sen alar Andan alyshkan tuboluktuu zhyrgalchylyk zhonundo surabai ele koi.
Meerimduu - cheksiz yraiym Eesi.
Al adamdarga Kurandy zhattoonu zhana anyn maanilerin tushunuunu zhen'il kyluu menen uirottu.
Al insandy tuz zhana en' suluu kelbette zharatty.
Al aga ichindegisin oozeki zhana zhazuu turundo kantip zhetkiruunu uirottu.
Al Kun menen Aidy adamdar zhyldardyn esebin zhana sanakty bilish uchun olchop belgilep koidu, al ekoosu tak esep menen zhurushot.
Kandai gana osumduktun zhana daraktyn sabagy bolbosun, alar Allakhka moiun sunup sazhda kylyshat.
Al asmandy zher ustundo chatyr kylyp kotordu, zherde adilettikti ornottu zhana any pendelerine buirudu.
Oo, adamdar! Al zulumduk zhana kyianattyk kylbashyn'ar uchun tarazada zhana olchomdo adilettikti ornottu.
Orton'ordo adilettik menen tarazalagyla zhana bashkalarga tarazaga tartkanda zhe olchogondo kemitpegile.
Al Zherdi makuluktar zhailanyshuuga ylaiyktuu kylyp ornottu.
Anda momoluu daraktar bar zhana kurma bolgon buchurluu kurma daraktary bar.
Anda buudai menen arpa syiaktuu samanduu dandar bar zhana zhyty zhagymduu osumduktor bar.
Oo, adamzat zhana zhinder zhamaaty! Allakhtyn silerge bergen koptogon zhakshylyktarynyn kaisy birin zhalgan dei alasyn'ar?!
Al Adamdy byshkan chopo syiaktuu chyn'kyldagan un ugulgan kurgak ylaidai zharatty.
Al emi zhinderdin tupku atasyn tutunduu taza zhalyndan zharatty.
Oo, zhinderdin zhana adamdardyn tobu, Allakhtyn kop neemattarynan kaisy birin zhalganga chygarasyn'ar?!
Al zhaiy-kyshy Kundun eki chygyshy menen eki batyshynyn Rabbisi.
Oo, adamzat zhana zhinder zhamaaty! Allakhtyn silerge bergen koptogon zhakshylyktarynyn kaisy birin zhalgan dei alasyn'ar?!
Allakh tuzduu zhana tuzsuz eki den'izdi aralashtyrdy, alar kozgo korungon abalda zholugushat.
Alardyn tuzduusu tuzduu boidon, tuzsuzu tuzsuz boidon kaluulary uchun al ekoonun ortosunda biri-birine otup ketuugo toskool bolgon tosmo bar.
Oo, zhinderdin zhana adamdardyn tobu, Allakhtyn kop neemattarynan kaisy birin zhalganga chygarasyn'ar?!
Al eki den'izden ten' chon' zhana kichine bermetter chygat.
Oo, zhinderdin zhana adamdardyn tobu, Allakhtyn kop neemattarynan kaisy birin zhalganga chygarasyn'ar?!
Den'izde suzgon toodoi kemelerdi bashkaruu da zhalgyz Allakh taalaga taandyk.
Oo, zhinderdin zhana adamdardyn tobu, Allakhtyn kop neemattarynan kaisy birin zhalganga chygarasyn'ar?!
Zher betindegi butkul makuluktar sozsuz zhok bolot.
Oo, paigambar! Uluuluk, zhakshylyk zhana pendelerine karata aikolduk Eesi bolgon Rabbin'din Zhuzu tuboluk kalat. Al ech kachan zhok bolboit.
Oo, zhinderdin zhana adamdardyn tobu, Allakhtyn kop neemattarynan kaisy birin zhalganga chygarasyn'ar?!

Asmandagy perishtelerdin zhana zherdegi zhinder menen adamdardyn baarysy muktazhdyktaryn Andan surashat. Al kun saiyn tiriltuu, olturuu, yrysky beruu zhana bashka ushul syiaktuu pendelerinin ishteri menen alek.
Oo, zhinderdin zhana adamdardyn tobu, Allakhtyn kop neemattarynan kaisy birin zhalganga chygarasyn'ar?!
Oo, adamdar zhana zhinder! Biz silerdi surakka aluu uchun boshoibuz zhana ar birine tatyktuu bolgon syilykty zhe zhazany berebiz.
Oo, zhinderdin zhana adamdardyn tobu, Allakhtyn kop neemattarynan kaisy birin zhalganga chygarasyn'ar?!

Allakh kyiamat kunu zhinder menen adamzatty chogultkanda aitat: <<Ei, zhinder zhana adamzat zhamaaty! Egerde siler asmandar menen zherdin bir tarabynan chyguunun zholun tapsan'ar, anda oshondoi kylgyla. Birok siler munu kuchsuz zhana dalilsiz ech kachan kyla albaisyn'ar. Siler munu kantip kylmak elen'er?>>.

Ei, zhinder zhana adamdar! Al silerge tutunsuz ottun zhalynyn zhana zhalynsyz tutundu zhiberet. Siler andan korgono albai kalasyn'ar.

Perishteler tushuusu uchun asman zharylganda, al achyk tustogu mai syiaktuu kyzyl bolup kalat.
Oo, zhinderdin zhana adamdardyn tobu, Allakhtyn kop neemattarynan kaisy birin zhalganga chygarasyn'ar?!
Oshol uluu kunu adamdardan da, zhinderden da kunooloru tuuraluu suralbait. Antkeni Allakh alardyn ish-araketterin bilet.

Alar any menen katuu kainagan suunun ortosunda ary-beri zhurushot.

Akyrette Rabbisinin aldynda turuudan korkkon, yiman keltirgen zhana zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandar uchun eki bakcha daiardalgan.
Oo, adamzat zhana zhinder zhamaaty! Allakhtyn silerge bergen koptogon zhakshylyktarynyn kaisy birin zhalgan dei alasyn'ar?!
Bul eki bakchanyn zhapzhashyl zhana momoluu chon' butakchalary bar.
Oo, adamzat zhana zhinder zhamaaty! Allakhtyn silerge bergen koptogon zhakshylyktarynyn kaisy birin zhalgan dei alasyn'ar?!
Al eki bakchada agyp turgan eki bulak bar.

Al ekoondo zhei turgan bardyk momo-zhemishterdin eki turu bar.
Oo, adamzat zhana zhinder zhamaaty! Allakhtyn silerge bergen koptogon zhakshylyktarynyn kaisy birin zhalgan dei alasyn'ar?!
Alar ichki beti maida zhibekten bolgon toshoktorgo zholonup oturushat. Al emi eki bakchanyn byshkan momo-zhemishterin uzup aluu turgan, olturgan zhana zhambashtap zhatkan adam uchun zhakyn.
Oo, adamzat zhana zhinder zhamaaty! Allakhtyn silerge bergen koptogon zhakshylyktarynyn kaisy birin zhalgan dei alasyn'ar?!
Al zhakta kuioolorun gana karagan aialdar bar. Alardyn kyzdyk abiiirine kuioolorunon murda adam da, zhin da tiigen emes.
Oo, adamzat zhana zhinder zhamaaty! Allakhtyn silerge bergen koptogon zhakshylyktarynyn kaisy birin zhalgan dei alasyn'ar?!
Alar suluuluk zhana tunuktuk zhaktan zhakut menen marzhan syiaktuu.
Oo, adamzat zhana zhinder zhamaaty! Allakhtyn silerge bergen koptogon zhakshylyktarynyn kaisy birin zhalgan dei alasyn'ar?!
Rabbisine moiun sunup zhakshylyk kylgan adamdyn syilygy - Allakhtyn aga kylgan en' zhakshy syilygy menen gana bolot emespi?
Oo, adamzat zhana zhinder zhamaaty! Allakhtyn silerge bergen koptogon zhakshylyktarynyn kaisy birin zhalgan dei alasyn'ar?!
Bul aitylgan eki bakchanyn aldynda bashka dagy eki bakcha bar.
Oo, zhinderdin zhana adamdardyn tobu, Allakhtyn kop neemattarynan kaisy birin zhalganga chygarasyn'ar?!
Al ekoo ten' kochkul zhashyl tusto.
Oo, zhinderdin zhana adamdardyn tobu, Allakhtyn kop neemattarynan kaisy birin zhalganga chygarasyn'ar?!
Bul eki bakchada suusu atylyp chykkan eki bulak bar. Alardyn suusunun burkuldagany toktoboit.
Oo, zhinderdin zhana adamdardyn tobu, Allakhtyn kop neemattarynan kaisy birin zhalganga chygarasyn'ar?!
Bul eki bakchada koptogon zhemishter, chon' kurmalar zhana anarlar bar.
Oo, zhinderdin zhana adamdardyn tobu, Allakhtyn kop neemattarynan kaisy birin zhalganga chygarasyn'ar?!
Al eki bakchada adep-akhlaktuu, suluu zhuzduu aialdar bar.
Oo, zhinderdin zhana adamdardyn tobu, Allakhtyn kop neemattarynan kaisy birin zhalganga chygarasyn'ar?!
Korgoo uchun chatyrlarda zhashyrylgan khur kyzdar.
Oo, zhinderdin zhana adamdardyn tobu, Allakhtyn kop neemattarynan kaisy birin zhalganga chygarasyn'ar?!
Alarga kuioolorunon murda ech bir adam zhana zhin zhakyndagan emes.
Oo, zhinderdin zhana adamdardyn tobu, Allakhtyn kop neemattarynan kaisy birin zhalganga chygarasyn'ar?!
Alar zhashyl tyshtuu zhazdyktarda, kooz toshoktordo zholonup zhatyshat.
Oo, zhinderdin zhana adamdardyn tobu, Allakhtyn kop neemattarynan kaisy birin zhalganga chygarasyn'ar?!
Uluuluk zhana pendelerine karata zhakshylyk zhana aikolduk Eesi bolgon Rabbin'din ysymy uluu zhana berekettuu boldu.
Kyiamat anyk kelgen kezde.
Any duinodo zhalganga chygargan syiaktuu zhalganga chygara turgandai ech bir zhan bolboit.
Al buzuku kaapyrlardy tozokko kirgizip basyntat, takyba yimanduulardy beiishke kirgizip kotorot.
Zher katuu titiregen kezde.
Toolor bytyrap talkalanat.
Alar talkalangandan ulam byryksyp zhaiylgan chan'ga ailanat.
Siler al kundo uch topko bolunosun'or.
Amal kitepterin on' taraptan algan on' tarap eeleri. Alardyn darazhasy kandai biiik zhana uluk!
Amal kitepterin sol taraptan algan sol tarap eeleri. Alardyn darazhasy kandai zhaman zhana tomon!
Duinodo zhakshylyktardy kyluuda aldyn'ky bolgondor, alar akyrette da beiishke kiruudo aldyn'ky bolushat.
Alar Allakhka zhakyn adamdar.
Alar zhyrgalchylyk beiishterinde turduu zhylgalchylyktar menen yrakhattanyshat.
Alar bul ummotton zhana murunku koomdordon bolgon zhamaattar.
Alardyn azyraagy akyr zaman adamdary. Alar aldyn'ky Allakhka zhakyn adamdar.
Alar altyn menen tokulgan sorulordo.
Alar oshol sorulorgo zholonup, biri-birine artyn salbastan, bet man'dai olturushat.
Alarga kyzmat kyluu uchun kartaibagan zhana zhok bolup ketpegen zhash zhigitter tegerenip zhurushot.
Alar karmoochsuz choichoktor, karmoochu bar kumaralar zhana beiishte toktoboi agyp turgan sharaptar kuiulgan chynylar menen ailanyp turushat.
Al duinonun sharabyna okshosh emes, anyn ichken adamdyn bashy oorubait zhana akylyn da zhogotup koiboit.
Al zhash zhigitter alar kaalagandai momo-zhemishter menen alardy tegerenip zhurushot.
Zhana alar kaalagandai kushtardyn etteri menen ailanyp zhurushot.
Beiishte alar uchun bakyran' koz suluu aialdar bar.
Alar sedepte zhashyrylgan bermetter syiaktuu.
Bul alardyn duinodo kylgan zhakshylyk ishterinin syilygy.
Alar beiishte uiat sozdordu zhana adamdy kunoogo turtkon nerselerdi ugushpait.
Alar perishtelerdin alarga aitkan salamdaryn zhana alardyn oz ara salamdashuusun gana ugushat.
Amal kitepteri on' tarabynan berilgenderdin Allakhtyn aldyndagy abaly zhana kadyry kandai uluu.
Alar tikenekteri kesilgen, zyiansyz Sidrdyn arasynda.
Ustu-ustuno tizilgen banandardyn astynda.
Uzulboston uzakka sozulgan kolokolordo.
Toktoboi akkan suulardyn boiunda.
Sansyz kop momo-zhemishter ichinde.
Alar ech kachan tugonboit, anyn mezgili da bolboit zhana alar any kaisy ubakta kaalasa, alarga ech kandai toskoolduk zharalbait.
Alar sorulorgo koiulgan biiik kotorulgon toshoktordo.
Chyndygynda Biz zhogoruda aitylgan Khur kyzdardy adattan tysh kylyp zharattyk.
Alardy buga cheiin ech bir kol tiibegen kyzdar kyldyk.
Alar kuiooloruno suiuktuu zhana zhashtary birdei.
Biz alardy baktysynyn belgisi katary on' tarap alynyp ketken on' tarap eeleri uchun zharattyk.
Alar abalky paigambarlardyn ummottorunon bolgon zhamaattar.
Zhana akyrky ummot bolgon Mukhammaddyn ummotunon bolgon zhamaattar.
Amal kitebi sol tarabynan berilgenderdin abaly zhana bara turgan zhaiy kandai zhaman.
Alar oto ysyk shamalda zhana oto ysyk suuda.
Kapkara tutundun kolokosundo.
Sokkon zheli da zhagymsyz, korunushu da zhagymsyz.
Alar azapka kelerden murun duinodo kumardan bashka ech nerseni oiloboston zhyrgap zhashashkan.
Alar Allakhka kaapyrlyk kyluudan zhana Andan bashka kudailarga syiynuudan bash tartyshkan zhok.
Alar kaira tiriluunu chetke kagyshty zhana any mumkun emes degendei shyldyn'dap myndai dep aityshty: <<Biz olup topurakka zhana chirigen sookko ailangandan kiiin kairadan tirilet bekenbiz?
Zhe bizden murun olgon abalky ata-babalarybyz kairadan tirilishet beken?>>.
Oo, paigambar! Kaira tiriluunu chetke kakkandarga ait: <<Chyndygynda adamdardyn abalkylary da, akyrkylary da,
Kyiamat kunu surak beruu zhana syilyk-zhaza aluu uchun sozsuz turdo chogultulat.
Kiiin, ei, kaira tiriluugo ishenbegen, tuura zholdon adashkandar, Kyiamat kunu zhaman, zhagymsyz momoluu "Zakkum" daragynyn momosun zheisin'er.
Kiiin, ei, kaira tiriluugo ishenbegen, tuura zholdon adashkandar, Kyiamat kunu zhaman, zhagymsyz momoluu "Zakkum" daragynyn momosun zheisin'er.
Ach kursagyn'ardy oshol achuu darak menen tolturasyn'ar.
Anyn artynan kainagan ysyk suu ichesin'er.
Too akaktap oorugan sebeptuu suunu kop ichkendei, siler dagy any kop ichesin'er>>.
Bul aitylgan achuu tamak zhana ysyk suu - alardy zhaza kunu tosup alganda korsotuluuchu syi-urmat.
Ei, zhalganchylar! Biz silerdi zhokton zharattyk. Emi silerdi olgonun'ordon kiiin kaira tiriltebiz degenge emnege ishenbei zhatasyn'ar?
Oo, adamdar! Siler aialdaryn'ardyn zhatynyna tashtagan uruktuktu korboisun'orbu?
Al uruktuktu siler zharatasyn'arby zhe Biz zharatabyzby?
Biz silerdin aran'arda olumdu belgilep koigonbuz. Ar birin'erdin azhalyn'ar bar, al aldyga da, artka da zhyldyrylbait. Biz alsyz emespiz.
Biz silerdi ozun'orgo belgiluu bolgondoi zharatylyshyn'ardy zhana kelbetin'erdi ozgortup, silerdi ozun'or bilbegendei zharatylyshta zhana kelbette zharatabyz.
Biz silerdi abalky zholu zharatkanybyzdy bildin'er. Silerdi abalky zholu zharatkan Allakh, silerdi olgondon kiiin kairadan tiriltuugo kudurettuu ekendigin oilonboisun'arby zhana bilbeisin'erbi?
Siler zherge sepken uroondu korboisun'orbu?
Al uroondu siler osturosun'orbu zhe Biz osturobuzbu?
Egerde Biz al uroondu typynga ailantuunu kaalasak, anda any byshaiyn dep kalganda typynga ailantyp koimokpuz. Oshondon kiiin siler anyn emne bolgonuna tan' kalmaksyn'ar.
Siler aitasyn'ar: <<Biz sarptagan nersebizden zyianga uchurap azap tarttyk.
Atugul yryskydan da kuru kaldyk>>.
Siler suusaganda ichken suunu korboisun'orbu?
Siler any asmandagy buluttardan tushurosun'orbu zhe Biz tushurobuzbu?

Egerde Biz al suunu ichkenge zhana sugarganga zharabai turgandai oto tuzduu kyluunu kaalaganybyzda, anda Biz any oto tuzduu kylyp koimokpuz. Silerge yraiym kylyp taza suunu tushurgon Allakhka shugur kylbaisyn'arby?
Siler paidalanuu uchun zhagyp zhatkan ottu korboisun'orbu?
Ottu tutantkan darakty siler zharattyn'arby zhe any silerge yraiym kylyp Biz zharattykpy?
Biz bul ottu silerge akyret otun estetuu uchun zhana silerdegi musapyrlar paidalanysh uchun kyldyk.
Oo, paigambar! Uluu Rabbin'di Aga ylaiyk kelbegen nerselerden aruula!
Allakh zhyldyzdardyn zhaigashkan orundary menen ant berdi.
Eger bilsen'er, bul orundar menen ant beruu oto uluk. Antkeni anda esepsiz aiat-belgiler zhana ulgu-nasaattar bar.
Oo, adamdar! Silerge okulup zhatkan Kuran - yiyk Kuran. Antkeni anda koptogon paidalar bar.
Al adamdardyn kozunon zhashyrylgan kitep bolgon Saktalgan Taktada (Laukhul' Makhfuz).
Any kunoodon zhana aiyp-kemchilikterden taza perishteler gana karmashat.
Al makuluktardyn Rabbisi taraptan paigambarga tushurulgon.
Ei, mushrikter! Siler bul sozgo ishenbei, zhalganga chygaryp zhatasyn'arby?

Siler Allakhtyn yrysky kylgan zhakshylyktaryna shugur kyluunun orduna Any zhalganga chygarasyn'arby zhana zhamgyrdyn zhaashyn zhyldyzga bailanyshtyryp: <<Balancha zhyldyz zhe tukuncho zhyldyz sebeptuu bizge zhamgyr zhaady>> - deisin'erbi?

Kachan Al kaira tiriluugo kee bir dalilderdi aitkanda, Al any kaira kaitaloogo kudurettuu ekenin eskertuunu kaalady. Buga alardyn olumdon kacha albastygyn isharat kyldy. Antkeni alardy olturgon Zat, alardy kairadan tiriltuugo kudurettuu.
Zhan kekirtekke zhetkende.
Oshol uchurda siler aldyn'ardagy zhany chygyp zhatkan adamdy karap turasyn'ar.
Biz al olukko ilimibiz, kuduretibiz zhana perishteleribiz menen silerden da zhakynbyz. Birok siler al perishtelerdi korboisun'or.
Egerde siler oilogondoi, kylgan ish-araketterin'erdin zhazasyn aluu uchun kaira tirilbegenin'erde.
Olugun'ordon chygyp zhatkan zhandy kaitargylachy, eger chynchyl bolson'or?! Siler munu kyla albaisyn'ar.
Egerde oluk zhakshylyktarga karai aldyn'kylardan bolso.
Aga myndan kiiin charchoo bolbogon yrakhat, taza yrysky, yraiymduuluk bolot zhana al uchun kon'ulu kaalagandai yrakhattarga bata turgan beiish bar.
Egerde oluk on' tarap eelerinen bolso, anda anyn abaly tuuraluu kam zhebe. Antkeni alar uchun beipildik zhana tynchtyk bar.
Egerde oluk on' tarap eelerinen bolso, anda anyn abaly tuuraluu kam zhebe. Antkeni alar uchun beipildik zhana tynchtyk bar.
Egerde oluk paigambar alyp kelgen nerseni zhalganga chygargandardan, tuura zholdon adashkandardan bolso,
Any tosup algandagy syi tamagy - oto ysyk suu bolot.
Al tozok otuna kuiot.
Oo, paigambar! Biz saga aityp bergen bul nerseler shek-kumonsuz akyikat.
Andyktan Uluu Rabbin'din ysymyn ulukta zhana Any aiyp-kemchilikterden aruula.
Asmandardagy zhana zherdegi makuluktar Allakhty uluktashat zhana aruulashat. Al ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu, Oz zharatuusunda zhana tagdyr kyluusunda Daanyshman.
Asmandar menen zherdin mulku Aga gana taandyk. Al kaalaganyn tiriltet, kaalaganyn olturot. Al bardyk nersege kudurettuu. Any ech bir nerse alsyratpait.

Al - Abalky, Andan aldyn ech nerse bolgon emes. Al - Akyrky, Andan kiiin ech nerse bolboit. Al - Zhogorku, Andan zhogoru ech nerse zhok. Al - Zhakyn, Andan tomon nerse zhok. Al butkul nerseni Biluuchu. Al ech nerseni otkorup zhiberbeit.

Al asmandar menen zherdi alty kundo zharatty. Zhekshembi kunu bashtap, zhuma kunu buttu. Al any koz irmemden az ubakytta zharatuuga kudurettuu. Andan son' Allakh Ozuno ylaiyk abalda Arshka kotoruldu zhana biiiktedi. Al zherge kirgen zhamgyrdy, dandardy zh.b. bilet zhana andan chykkanda osumduktordu, kenderdi zh.b. bilet. Oshondoi ele asmandan tushkon zhamgyrdy, vakhiidi zh.b. bilet zhana aga kotorulgon perishtelerdi, pendelerdin ish-araketterin zhana zhandaryn bilet. Oo, adamdar! Siler kaida bolson'or da, Al siler menen Oz ilimi menen birge. Silerdin ech bir nersen'er Aga zhashyruun emes. Allakh silerdin kylgan nersen'erdi Koruuchu. Aga silerdin ish-araketterin'erdin ech biri zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda Al silerge syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.
Asmandar menen zherdin mulku zhalgyz Aga taandyk. Ish-araketter zhalgyz Aga kaitat. Al kyiamat kunu makuluktardy surakka alat zhana alarga ish-araketterinin syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Al tundu kunduzgo kirgizip, tun kelet zhana adamdar uktashat. Zhana kunduzdu tungo kirgizip, kunduz kelet zhana adamdar zhumushtaryna zhonoshot. Al pendelerinin kokurogundogu nerselerdi Biluuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.

Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirgile zhana Allakh silerdin karamagyn'arga otkorup, siler any uruksat berilgen zholdo paidalangan mal-mulkton sarptagyla. Al emi aran'ardan Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn zholunda mal-mulktorun sarptagandarga Allakhtyn aldynda uluu syilyk bolgon beiish bar.

Allakhka yiman keltiruugo silerge emne toskool bolup zhatat? Paigambar silerdi Rabbin'erge yiman keltirebi degen umutto daavat kylyp zhatat. Egerde yimanduu bolson'or, Allakh silerdi atan'ardyn belinen chygargan kezde Aga yiman keltiresin'er degen ubadany algan.

Al silerdi kaapyrlyk zhana naadandyk karan'gylyktarynan yiman zhana ilim nuruna chygarysh uchun pendesi Mukhammadga achyk-aikyn aiat-belgilerdi tushurdu. Chyndygynda Allakh silerge Meerimduu zhana Yraiymduu. Antkeni Al silerge tuura zhol korgozuuchu zhana suiunchu kabar zhetkiruuchu paigambaryn zhiberdi.

Allakh zholunda sadaga chygaruudan silerdi emne tyiyp zhatat? Asmandar menen zherdin murasy Allakhka taandyk. O, yimanduular! Silerdin aran'ardagy Mekkeni bagyntuudan murda Allakh zholunda Anyn yraazylygy uchun sadaga kylgan zhana Islamdy koldoo uchun kaapyrlarga karshy sogushkandar menen, Mekkeni bagyntkandan kiiin sadaga kylgan zhana kaapyrlarga karshy sogushkandar birdei emes. Mekkeni bagyntuudan murun sadaga kylgan zhana Allakh zholunda sogushkandar, Mekkeni bagyntkandan kiiin sadaga kylgan zhana kaapyrlar menen sogushkandarga karaganda Allakhtyn aldynda ordu biiik zhana darazhasy zhogoru. (Oshentse da) Allakh eki topko ten' beiishti ubada kylgan. Allakh siler kylyp zhatkan ishterden Kabardar. Siler kylgan ish-araketterdin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Oshol ish-araketterin'erge zharasha zhakynda silerge syiyn zhe zhazasyn beret.
Kim Allakhtyn Zhuzu uchun chyn kon'ulunon mal-mulk sarptasa, anda Allakh aga sarptagan mal-mulkunun syilygyn eselep beret zhana aga kyiamatta uluu syilyk bolgon beiish bar.

Sen al kunu yimanduu erkekter menen yimanduu aialdardyn aldylarynan zhana on' kaptaldarynan nurlary aldyga zharkyrap baratkanyn korosun'. Oshol kunu alarga: <<Silerdin bugunku suiunchu kabaryn'ar - khan sarailarynyn zhana bak-daraktarynyn aldynan daryialar akkan beiishter! Al zhakta tuboluk kalasyn'ar. Bul ten'deshsiz uluu zhen'ish>> - dep aitylat.

Kachan Allakh al kundogu yimanduulardyn abalyn aitkanda, eki zhuzduulordun da abalyn aityp myndai dedi:
Al kunu eki zhuzduu erkekter menen eki zhuzduu aialdar yimanduularga: <> - deshet. Eki zhuzduulorgo shyldyn' iretinde: <> - dep aitylat. Oshondo alardyn ortosuna darbazasy bar tosmo ornotulat. Anyn ichki tarabynda yimanduular yraiymduulukta bolot, al emi syrtky tarabynda eki zhuzduulor azapta bolot.

Eki zhuzduulor yimanduularga kairylyp: <<Biz Islamdy kabyl kyluuda zhana (Allakhka) bash iiuudo siler menen birge emes belek?>> - degende, musulmandar alarga mintip zhoop berdi: <<Ooba, biz menen birge elen'er. Birok, eki zhuzduulukko berilip ozun'ordu kuruttun'ar, kaapyrlygyn'ardy achykka chygaruu uchun yimanduulardyn zhen'iluusun kuttun'or, Allakhtyn yimanduulardy koldoosuna zhana olumdon kiiin kaira tiriluugo shektendin'er zhana olum kelgenge cheiin zhalgan kyialdarga aldangan boiuncha kaldyn'ar. Allakhka ishenuudo shaitan silerdi aldap, adashtyryp koidu>>.

Ei, eki zhuzduulor! Bugun silerden Allakhtyn azabynan ech kandai kun alynbait zhana Allakhka achyk kaapyrlyk kylgandardan da kun alynbait. Siler menen kaapyrlardyn barar zhaiy tozok. Siler aga, al silerge ylaiyktuu. Al kandai zhaman zhai.

Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirgender Allakhty estegende zhana Kuranda tushkon ubadalarga zhe eskertmelerge zhuroktoru zhumsharyp, beipil bolo turgan ubakyt kelip zhetpedibi?! Alar zhuroktun merezdiginde Toorat berilgen zhoottordoi zhana Inzhil berilgen khristiandardai bolushpasyn. Alar menen paigambarlarynyn keluusunun ortosundagy ubakyt oto uzaryp ketkendikten zhuroktoru merez bolup kaldy. Alardyn kopchulugu Allakhka moiun sunbai, bash iibestik kylgandar.

Bilip koigula, Allakh zherdi kurgagandan kiiin any osturuu menen kaira tiriltet. Oo, adamdar! Biz silerge Allakhtyn kudurettuulugun zhana zhalgyzdygyn bildirgen dalilderdi baiandadyk. Balkim siler munun ustundo akyl zhugurtosun'or zhana zherdi olgondon kiiin kaira tiriltken Zat silerdi olgonun'ordon kiiin kaira tiriltuugo kudurettuu ekenin zhana zhurogun'ordu merezdikten kiiin kairadan zhumshartuuga kudurettuu ekenin bilersin'er.

Mal-mulkunon sadaka kylgan erkekterge zhana mal-mulkunon sadaka kylgan aialdarga, mildet kylbastan zhana zyian berbesten chyn kon'uldon sadaka bergenderge ish-araketterinin sooptoru eselep berilet, bir zhakshylykka on eseden zheti zhuz esege cheiin zhe andan da kop eselep berilet. Alarga munu menen birge Allakhtyn aldynda uluu syilyk bolgon beiish daiardalgan.

Allakhka yiman keltirgender zhana paigambarlardy bolboston yiman keltirgender - myna osholor chynchyldar. Zhana sheiitter uchun Rabbisinin aldynda uluu sooptor daiardalgan zhana kyiamatta alarga aldylarynan zhana on' tarabynan zharkyragan nur bar. Al emi Allakhka zhana Anyn elchilerine kaapyrlyk kylgandar zhana elchibizge tushurgon aiattarybyzdy zhalganga chygargandar - myna osholor tozok eeleri. Alar kyiamatta aga kirishet, al zhakta tuboluk kalyshat zhana al zhaktan chygyshpait.

Bilip algyla, chyndygynda duino zhashoosu - deneler oinogon oiun-zook, zhuroktor eelikken kon'ul achuu, siler suluulangan koozduk, biri-birine mal-mulk zhana dunuio menen maktanuu, bailyk zhana bala-chakanyn koptugu menen chirenuu gana. Al zhamgyr syiaktuu, andan oskon osumduktor dyikandardy suktandyrat. Anan al zhashyl osumduktor bat ele kuurap kalat. Ei, nazar saluuchu! Sen alardy zhashyldangandan kiiin sargaiganyn korosun'. Kiiin Allakh any maidalangan kuuraiga ailantat. Al emi akyrette kaapyrlar zhana eki zhuzduulor uchun katuu azap bar zhana Allakhtyn yimanduu pendeleri uchun kunooloruno kechirim zhana yraazylyk bar. Duino zhashoosu ech kandai turuktuulukka ee bolbogon, ubaktyluu yrakhattan bashka ech nerse emes. Kim anyn ubaktyluu yrakhattaryn akyret zhyrgalchylygynan artyk korso, anda al kuru zhalak kaldy.

Oo, adamdar! Toobo zhe bashka ibadattar syiaktuu kunoolorun'ordun kechirilishine zhetkirgen zhana asman menen zherdin kendigindei beiishke zhetkirgen zhakshylyk ishterde zharyshkyla! Allakh bul beiishti Aga zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirgenderge daiardap koigon. Bul Allakhtyn Ozu kaalagan pendelerine bere turgan syilygy. Allakh yimanduu pendelerine karata uluu artykchylyk Eesi.

Adamdardyn bashyna tushkon kurgakchylyk zhana bashka syiaktuu zher betindegi kyrsyktar zhana ozdorunun bashyna tushkon kyiynchylyktar makuluktardy zharatkanybyzga cheiin ele Saktalgan Taktada bekitilgen. Chyndygynda bul Allakh uchun zhen'il.

Oo, adamdar! Munu siler zhetpei kalgan nersen'erge kaigyrbashyn'ar uchun zhana silerge berilgen zhakshylyktarga suiunup koop ketpeshin'er uchun kyldy. Chyndygynda Allakh bergen nerseler menen adamdarga tebekerlik kylgandardy, maktangandardy zhakshy korboit.

Beruugo mildettuu bolgon nersege saran'dyk kylgandar zhana bashkalardy saran'dykka buirugandar - zyian tartuuchular. Allakhka moiun sunuudan bash tartkan adam, Aga ech kachan zyian keltire albait. Al ozuno gana zyian keltiret. Chyndygynda Allakh - Beimuktazh, Al pendelerinin bash iiuusuno muktazh emes, Al butkul abalda Maktoogo tatyktuu.

Biz paigambarlarybyzdy achyk-aikyn dalilder menen zhiberdik, alar menen Kitepterdi tushurduk zhana adamdar adilettikti karmanysh uchun alar menen Tarazany tushurduk. Oshondoi ele chon' kuchtu kamtygan temirdi tushurduk, andan kural zhasalat zhana anda adamdardyn ondurushu zhana onorchulugu uchun paidalar bar. Allakh pendelerge achyk bolo turgandai abalda kimisi Any korboston zhardam bereerin bilish uchun kyldy. Chyndygynda Allakh Kuchtuu, Kudurettuu. Aga ech nerse ustomduk kyla albait zhana ech kim Any alsyrata albait.

Biz Nukhtu zhana Ibrakhimdi zhiberdik zhana alardyn urpaktaryna paigambarlykty zhana tushurulgon Kitepterdi berdik. Al ekoonun urpaktarynan kee birleri iigilikke zhetip, tuura zholgo tushushtu, al emi kopchulugu Allakhka bash iibestik kylyshty.

Kiiin alardyn artynan elchileribizdi ummottoruno udaa-udaa zhiberdik. Alardyn artynan Mariiamdyn uulu Isany zhiberip, aga Inzhildi berdik zhana aga yiman keltirip, any eerchigenderdin zhuroguno boorukerlik zhana meerim saldyk. Alardyn ortosunda biri-birine bolgon suiuu zhana meerim bar ele. Zhana alar dinde ashaa chaap, zhok nerseni oilop tabyshty. Alar Allakh uruksat bergen uilonuu, yrakhattanuu syiaktuu kee bir nerselerdi Biz alardan talap kylbasak dele tashtap koiushtu. Alar dinde zhok nerseni oilop taap, any ozdoruno mildet kylyp alyshty. Chyndygynda Biz alardan Allakh yraazy bolgon nerselerdi gana eerchigile dep talap kylganbyz, birok alar munu atkaryshkan zhok. Biz alardyn arasynan yiman keltirgenderine soop-syilygyn berdik. Birok alardyn kopchulugu Allakhtyn elchisi alyp kelgen nerseni zhalganga chygaruu menen Aga bash iibestik kylyshkandar.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkula zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirgile! Oshondo Al silerge Mukhammad menen murunku elchilerge keltirgen yimanyn'ar uchun eki ese soop-syilyk beret, silerge duino zhashoosunda tuura bagyt korgozgon zhana kyiamat kunu Syratta zharyk beruuchu nurdu paida kylat zhana oshondoi ele kunoon'ordu kechirip, any zhashyrat zhana al uchun zhazalabait. Allakh taala pendelerine Kechirimduu, alarga Yraiymduu.

Oo, yimanduular! Biz silerge eselegen soop-syilyktardy daiardap koigon uluu zhakshylygybyzdy baiandadyk. Biz munu zhoottordon zhana khristiandardan bolgon murunku Kitep eeleri Allakhtyn zhakshylyktaryn ozdoru kaalaganyna berip, kaalabaganyna berbei turgandai kudurettuulukko ee emes ekenin biluuloru uchun zhana zhakshylyk Allakhtyn gana kolunda ekenin, Al any Ozu kaalagan pendelerine bererin biluuloru uchun kyldyk. Allakh uluu zhakshylyk Eesi, Al any Ozu kaalagan pendelerine gana beret.

Oo, paigambar! Allakh Khaulat bint Saalaba degen aialdyn sozun uktu. Any kuioosu Aus ibn as-Samit <<zikhar>> kylganda, al kuioosu tuuraluu seni menen suiloshkonu keldi zhana anyn kylganyn Allakhka aityp dattandy. Allakh ekoon'ordun talash sozun'ordu uktu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Chyndygynda Allakh pendelerinin sozdorun Uguuchu, ish-araketterin Koruuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.

Aialdaryn zikhar kylgandar, tagyraak aitkanda, silerden kimdir biroo aialyna: <<Sen maga apamdyn belindeisin'>> dep aitkandar - bul aitkan sozdorundo zhalganchylar. Alardyn aialdary enesi emes. Alardy torogondor gana alardyn eneleri. Alar bul sozdu aityshkanda, korkunuchtuu zhana zhalgan sozdu aityshkan bolot. Chyndygynda Allakh - Kechuuchu, Kechirimduu.

Bul korkunuchtuu sozdu aityp alyp, kiiin zikhar kylgan aialdary menen zhynystyk mamile kyluunu kaalagandar, alar menen zhynystyk katnash kyluudan murun bir kuldu azat kyluu menen kunoosun zhuush kerek. Bul aitylgan okum, silerdi zikhar kyluudan tosuu uchun buiruk kylyndy. Allakh silerdin kylganyn'ardan Kabardar. Silerdin ish-araketterin'erdin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.

Kim azat kylganga kul tappasa, anda al zikhar kylgan aialy menen zhynystyk mamile kyluudan murun eki ai ulgultuksuz orozo karmashy kerek. Al emi kim eki ai uzgultuksuz orozo karmai albasa, anda al altymysh kembagaldy tamaktandyruusu kerek. Biz bul okumdu Allakh buirudu dep ishenip, Anyn buiruguna bash iiuun'or uchun okum kyldyk. Biz silerge shariiat kylgan bul okumdor - Allakhtyn pendeleri uchun koigon chekteri. Andyktan, any buzbagyla. Al emi Allakhtyn okumdoruno zhana koigon chekterine kaapyr bolgondorgo kyinoochu azap bar.

Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine dushmandyk kylgandar, murunku dushman koomdor kor bolgon syiaktuu kordukka tush bolushtu. Biz achyk-aikyn aiat-belgileribizdi tushurgonbuz. Allakhka, anyn elchisine zhana aiat-belgilerine kaapyrlyk kylgandarga kordoochu azap bar.

Al kunu Allakh alardyn birin da kaltyrbastan, but baarysyn kaira tiriltip, alarga duinodo kylgan zhamandyk ishteri tuuraluu kabar beret. Allakh alardy eseptep koigon, alardyn ish-araketterinin ech birin otkorup zhibergen emes. Birok alar munu unutup koiushkan, kiiin alar anyn kichinesi da, chon'u da kaltyrylbastan eseptelgen amal barakchalarynda zhazylganyn korushot. Allakh bardyk nerseden kabardar. Alardyn ish-araketterinin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.

Oo, paigambar! Allakh asmandardagy zhana zherdegi nerselerdi bilet ekenin bilbeisin'bi? Al ekoosundogu ech bir nerse Aga zhashyruun emes. Uch adamdyn ortosunda zhashyruun soz bolso, Al Oz ilimi menen alardyn tortunchusu bolot. Besh adamdyn ortosunda zhashyruun soz bolso, Al Oz ilimi menen alardyn altynchysy bolot. Andan az sanda bolobu, kop sanda bolobu, alar kaida bolushpasyn, Al Ozu ilimi menen alar menen birge. Andan kiiin kyiamat kunu Al alardyn kylgandary tuuraluu kabar beret. Chyndygynda Allakh bardyk nerseni Biluuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.

Oo, paigambar! Yimanduu adamdy korgondo oz ara zhashyruun suiloshkon zhoottordu korbodun'bu? Allakh alardy zhashyruun suiloshuudon tyigan ele. Birok kiiin alar Allakhtyn tyigan nersesine kaira kaityshty zhana yimanduulardy ushaktoo, alarga dushmandyk kyluu, paigambarga bash iibestik kyluu syiaktuu kunoo ishterdi ich ara zhashyruun suiloshtu. Oo, paigambar! Kachan alar saga kelgende, alar Allakhtyn saga aitkan salamynan bashkacha salamdy aityshat. Bul alardyn <<assaamu aleika (saga olum bolsun)>> degen sozu. Zhana alar paigambardy zhalganga chygaryp: <<Allakh bizdi bul aitkan sozubuz uchun zhazalabait bele? Eger al paigambarmyn degen sozundo chynchyl bolso, anda Allakh bizdi al tuuraluu aitkan sozubuz uchun zhazalamak>> - dep aityshat. Alardyn aitkan sozdorunun zhazasyna tozok zhetishtuu. Alar anyn ysyk azabyn tartyshat. Alardyn bara turgan zhaiy kandai zhaman zhai!

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Zhoottorgo okshoboshun'ar uchun kunoonu zhe dushmandykty zhe paigambarga karata bash iibestikti kamtygan nerseler tuuraluu ich ara zhashyruun suiloshpogulo! Allakhka moiun sunuunu zhana Aga bash iibestiktikti tyiuunu kamtygan nerselerdi zhashyruun suiloshkulo! Zhana Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtoo menen Andan korkkula! Siler kyiamat kunu surak zhana syilyk-zhaza uchun zhalgyz Aga gana chogultulasyn'ar.

Chyndygynda ozuno kunoonu, dushmandykty zhana paigambarga bolgon bash iibestikti kamtygan zhashyruun sozdor - shaitandyn yimanduularga karshy zhaman ish bolot dep alardy oigo salysh uchun ozunun zhan zhokorloruno kooz kylyp korsotuusu zhana azgyrygy. Shaitan zhana anyn kooz kylyp korgozuusu Allakhtyn kaaloosu bolmoiuncha yimanduularga ech kandai zyian keltirbeit. Yimanduular bardyk ishterinde Allakhka gana taianyshat.

Kachan Allakh sozdorgo bailanyshtuu adepter tuuraluu aitkanda, oturumdarga bailanyshtuu adepter tuuraluu aityp myndai dedi:
Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Egerde silerge <> dep aitylsa, anda zhylyshkyla. Oshondo Allakh silerge duino zhashoon'ordo zhana akyrette orun beret. Eger silerge <> dep aitylsa, anda ordun'ardy boshotkula. Allakh Taala silerdin aran'ardagy yiman keltirgenderdin zhana ilim berilgenderdin darazhasyn kotorup koiot. Allakh silerdin kylgan nerselerin'erden kabardar. Silerdin ish-araketterin'erdin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda Al alardyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Paigambar (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy zhana maktoosu bolsun) menen syrdashuunu kaalagan sakhabalar koboigondo, Allakh Taala: "O, yiman keltirgender! Egerde paigambar menen zheke suiloshuunu kaalasan'ar, anda any menen suiloshuudon murda sadaka bergile. Oshentip aldyn ala sadaka beruu - siler uchun zhakshyraak zhana tazaraak. Antkeni, mynda Allakhka zhuroktordu tazartkan bash iiuu bar. Eger sadaga bergenge ech nerse tappasan'ar, anda any menen zhekeche suiloshuun'or kunoo emes. Chynynda, Allakh pendelerinin kunoolorun Kechiruuchu, alarga Yraiymduu. Al pendelerinin moiununa kuchu zhetpegen ishti zhuktogon zhok.

Paigambar menen zhekeche suiloshuun'or uchun aldyn ala bergen sadakan'ar sebeptuu kedeilikten korktun'arby? Allakhtyn bul tuuraluu bergen buirugun atkara albasan'ar zhana Allakh silerge any tashtoogo uruksat berip, toobon'ordu kabyl kylsa, anda namazdy toluk turdo atkargyla, mal-mulkun'ordon zeket bergile, Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine bash iigile. Allakh silerdin kylyp zhatkanyn'ardan Kabardar. Silerdin ish-araketterin'erdin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda Al alardyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Oo, paigambar! Kaapyrlyktary zhana kunooloru sebeptuu Allakhtyn kaaryna kalgan zhoottor menen dostoshup zhurgon eki zhuzduulorgo karabaisyn'by? Eki zhuzduulor yimanduulardan emes, zhoottordon da emes. Alar bularga da, tigilerge da tieshesi zhok ara zholdo zhurgondor. Alar musulmanbyz dep kasam ichiship, musulmandardyn kabarlaryn zhoottorgo zhetkirishet. Alar ichken kasamynda zhalganchylar.
Allakh akyrette alarga katuu azapty daiardap koigon. Alar tozoktun en' tomonku kabatyna kirishet. Alardyn duinodo kylgan kaapyrlyk ishteri kandai zhaman!

Alar bergen anttaryn kaapyrlyk sebeptuu olturulbosh uchun korgonuch kylyp alyshty. Antkeni alar oz kanyn zhana mal-mulkun korgosh maksatta any menen syrtynan Islamdy korsotushot zhana adamdardy akyikattan burushat. Antkeni bul nersede musulmandardy alsyratuu zhana alarga but tosuu bar. Alar uchun kordukka saluuchu azap daiardalgan.
Alarga Allakhtyn aldynda mal-mulktoru zhana bala-chakasy ech paida keltirbeit. Myna osholor tozok eeleri. Alar al zhakka kirip, tuboluk kalyshat. Alardyn azaby toktotulbait.

Al kunu Allakh alardy zhazaloo uchun birin da kaltyrbai kaira tiriltet. Oshondo alar kaapyrlykta zhana eki zhuzduulukto bolboston, Allakhty yraazy kylgan ishterdi atkargan yimanduulardai Allakhka kasam ichishet. Oo, yimanduular! Alar duinodo silerge <<biz musulmanbyz>> dep kasam ichkendei, akyrette da Allakhka kasam ichishet. Alar Allakh uchun ichken bul kasamdary alarga paida keltiret zhe alardy zyiandan korgoit dep oiloshot. Myna osholor duinodo zhana akyrette aitkan kasamdarynda chynygy zhalganchylar emespi!

Shaitan alardy bash iidirip, oz azgyrygy menen Allakhty estoonu unutturdu. Alar Al yraazy bolgon ishterdi kylyshkan zhok. Teskerisinche, Anyn kaaryn keltirgen ishterdi kylyshty. Myna ushundai sypattagy adamdar - Iblistin askeri zhana any eerchigender. Iblisti zhana any eerchigender, myna osholor duinodo zhana akyrette kyiroogo uchuragandar emespi! Antkeni alar akyikatty adashuuga satty zhana beiishti tozokko satty.
Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine dushmandyk kylgandar, Allakh bul duinodo zhana akyrette kor kylgandardyn zhana kordukka tush bolgon kaapyr koomdordun katarynda.

Allakh abalky iliminde: <<Men zhana Menin elchilerim dalil zhana kuch-kubattuuluk menen dushmandardyn ustunon sozsuz zhen'ishke zhetebiz>> - dep zhazyp koigon. Chyndygynda Allakh oz elchilerine zhardam beruugo Kubattuu, dushmandarynan och aluuga Kudurettuu.

Oo, paigambar! Sen Allakhka zhana kyiamat kununo yiman keltirgen adamdardy, Allakhtyn zhana Anyn elchisinin dushmandaryn dos tutkandaryn korboisun', eger al Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine dushmandyk kylgandar alardyn atalary zhe baldary zhe bir tuugandary zhe alar taandyk bolgon uruk-tuugandary bolso da. Antkeni yiman Allakhtyn zhana Anyn elchisinin dushmandary menen dostoshuudan tyiat zhana yiman bailanyshy bardyk bailanyshtardan zhogoru turat. Ekoosu birdei kelgende al birinchi atkarylat. Zhakyn tuugany bolso da, Allakhtyn zhana Anyn elchisinin dushmandaryn dos tutpagan adamdar, myna osholordun zhuroktoruno Allakh ozgorbos yimandy bekemdep koidu zhana alardy Ozunun dalili zhana nuru menen kubattady. Alar kyiamatta khan sarailary menen bak-daraktarynyn aldynan daryialar agyp turgan Adn beiishterine kirishet. Alar anyn tugonbogon zhyrgalchylyktarynda tuboluk kalyshat. Allakh alarga andan kiiin ech kachan achuulanbai turgandai yraazy boldu zhana alar Aga tugonbos zhyrgalchylyk tartuulagany uchun yraazy bolushtu. Al zhyrgalchylyktardyn biri - Any koruu. Zhogoruda aitylgan sypattagy adamdar - Allakhtyn buirugun eerchigen zhana Anyn tyiuularyn tashtagan Anyn askeri. Albette, myna oshol Allakhtyn askeri zhen'ishke zhetuuchulor emespi! Antkeni alar duinodo zhana akyrette kozdogonuno zhetishet zhana korkunuch salgan nerselerden kutushulat.

Asmandagy zhana zherdegi butkul makuluktar Allakhty uluktashty zhana Aga ylaiyk kelbegen nerselerden aruulashty. Al ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu zhana Oz zharatuusunda, shariiatynda zhana kudurettuulugundo Daanyshman.

Al Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgan zhana Anyn elchisin zhalganga chygargan Banu Nadir uruusun Medinadagy oz turak-zhailarynan Medinadan Shamga karai birinchi surgun katary chygardy. Alar Toorat eeleri bolgon zhoottor. Alar kelishimdi buzup, mushrikter menen birge aga karshy bolgondon kiiin Sham zhergesine kuuguntuktaldy. Oo, yimanduular! Siler alardyn kuch-kubattuulugu zhana korgonuusu sebeptuu alardy oz turak-zhailarynan chygyp ketet dep oilogon emessin'er. Zhana alar dagy kurgan chepteri alardy Allakhtyn kudureti menen zhazasynan korgoit dep oiloshkon. Allakh Oz elchisine alar menen sogushuunu zhana turak-zhailarynan kuup chyguunu buirugan kezde Allakhtyn kuch-kubaty alar oilobogon taraptan keldi. Allakh alardyn zhuroktoruno katuu korkunuch saldy. Alar musulmandar paidalanbasyn dep turak-zhailarynyn ichin oz kolu menen buzup talkalashty. Al emi musulmandar bolso any syrtynan talkalashty. Ei, kozu bar adamdar! Alarga kaapyrlyktary sebeptuu bashyna tushkon nerseden sabak algyla zhana alardai bolbogula! Bolboso, siler da alar zhazalangandai zhaza alasyn'ar.

Eger Allakh alarga turak-zhailaryn tashtap chygyp ketuunu buirubaganda, (anda Banu Kuraiza uruusu syiaktuu) alardy bul duinodo olturuu zhana tutkunga tushuruu menen azaptamak. A akyrette bolso, alardy azap kutup turat, alar anda tuboluk kalyshat.
Alardyn bashyna tushkon bul nersenin sebebi, alar kaapyrlyktary zhana kelishimdi buzuulary menen Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine dushmandyk kylyshty.

Oo, yimanduular zhamaaty! Egerde siler Banu Nadir sogushunda Allakhtyn dushmandarynyn kyzhyryn keltirish uchun kurmalardy kyisan'ar zhe ozun'or paidalanuu uchun any tamyrynda turgan boidon kaltyrsan'ar, demek, Allakhtyn buirugu menen boldu. Bul alar oiloshkondoi zher betinde buzukuluktu zhaiuuga zhatpait. Oshondoi ele Allakh munu menen Aga bash iibestik kylyp kelishimdi buzgan zhana ishenim zholun tashtap, kyianat zholun tandagan zhoottordu kordoit.

Allakh Oz elchisine kaitaryp bergen Banu Nadirdin mal-mulktoruno zhetish uchun siler at chaap zhe too zhortup shashylyp barbadyn'ar zhana siler kyiynchylyk da tartkan zhoksun'ar. Birok Allakh Ozu kaalaganyn elchilerine bash iidiret. Banu Nadirdi da Oz elchisine bash iidirip, alardyn mekenin sogushsuz bagyntyp berdi. Allakh bardyk nersege kudurettuu, Any ech bir nerse alsyratpait.

Allakh Oz elchisine sogushsuz tartuu kylgan aiyl elinin mal-mulku Allakhka taandyk, Al any Ozu kaalagandarga zhana paigambarga mulk kyldy, oshondoi ele anyn zhakyn tuugandary bolgon Khashim menen Abdulmuttalibdin urpaktaryna, alar sadaka albagandygynyn orduna kyldy, oshondoi ele zhetimderge, kedei-kembagaldarga, karazhaty tugongon boton zherdikterge kyldy. Al munu mal-mulk kedeilerge tiibei, bailardyn gana ortosunda ailanyp kalbashy uchun kyldy. Oo, yimanduular! Paigambar silerge olzhodon kandai mal-mulk berse, oshonu algyla, kaisydan tyisa, any tashtagyla! Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkula! Chyndygynda Allakhtyn zhazasy kataal. Anyn zhazasynan sak bolgula.

Bul mal-mulktun bir bolugu Allakh zholunda kochkon kedei mukhazhirlerge sarptalat. Alar mal-mulkun zhana bala-chakasyn tashtoogo argasyz bolushkan. Alar Allakhtan duinodo mol yryskyny zhana akyrette yraazylykty tartuu kylat dep umuttonushot zhana alar Allakh zholunda sogushuu menen Aga zhana Anyn elchisine zhardam berishet. Bul sypattarga ee bolgondor, chynygy yimanga bekem adamdar.

Kachan Allakh mukhazhirlerdi aityp maktaganda, ansarlardy da eskerdi zhana alardy maktap, myndai dep aitty:
Mukhazhirlerden murun Medinada turuktashkan ansarlar Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirishti. Alar Mekkeden kochup kelgenderdi zhakshy korushot zhana alarga berilbei, Allakh zholundagy mukhazhirlerge berilgen olzho sebeptuu kokuroktorundo alarga karata kyzhyrlanuunu zhana koro albastykty sezbeit. Ozdoru kedei zhana muktazh bolup tursa da, duino zhakshylyktaryn ozdorunon murun mukhazhirlerge yraa korushot. Allakh kimdi bailykka bolgon napsi sugalaktygynan saktap, al any Allakh zholuna sarptasa, myna osholor ozdoru kaalaganyna zhetip zhana korkkon nerselerinen aman kaluu menen zhen'ishke zhetishet.

Alardan kiiin kelip zhana alardy kyiamatka cheiin zhakshylykta eerchigender aityshat: <<Rabbibiz! Bizdi kechir zhana Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine bizden murun yiman keltirgen dindesh bir tuugandarybyzdy kechir. Bizdin zhurogubuzgo yimanduulardyn ech birine karata koro albastykty zhana zhek koruunu salba. Rabbibiz! Chyndygynda Sen pendelerin'e Boorukersin', alarga Yraiymduusun'>>.

Oo, paigambar! Ichine kaapyrlykty zhashyryp, syrtynan yimandy korgozgondordu karabaisyn'by, alar burmalangan Tooratty eerchigen kaapyr zholdogu bir tuugandary zhoottorgo: <<Uiun'ordo kalgyla, biz silerdi zhardamsyz tashtabaibyz, silerdi satyp ketpeibiz. Egerde silerdi al zhaktan kuup chyksa, biz dagy siler menen birge chygabyz. Bizdi siler menen chygyp ketuudon tyiuunu kaalagandarga bash iibeibiz. Egerde siler menen sogushsa, anda biz dagy alarga karshy silerge zhardam berebiz>> - dep aityshat. Allakh eki zhuzduulordun <<zhoottor kuup chygarylsa, biz dagy kosho chygabyz, alarga sogush achylsa, alar menen birge sogushabyz>> degen sozdorundo anyk zhalganchylar ekenine kuboluk beret.

Egerde musulmandar zhoottordu kuup chygyshsa, alar menen birge chygyshpait. Egerde alar menen sogushsa, alardy koldop zhardam berishpeit. Egerde musulmandarga karshy alardy koldop zhardam berishse, alardan kachyp zhonoshmok. Oshondon kiiin eki zhuzduulorgo koldoo bolmok emes. Teskeresinche, Allakh alardy kordukka salmak.

Oo, yimanduular! Siler eki zhuzduulordun zhana zhoottordun zhuroktoruno Allakhtan da katuuraak korkunuch saldyn'ar. Alardyn silerden katuu korkkondugu zhana Allakhtan bolgon korkunuchtarynyn azdygy tuuraluu bul aitylgandardyn sebebi, alar tushunbogon zhana an'dabagan koom. Egerde alar tushungondo, anda korkuuga zhana sestenuugo Allakh gana tatyktuu ekenin bilishmek. Oshonduktan Al silerge alardyn ustunon biilik berdi.

Oo, yimanduular! Zhoottor siler menen birge chepter menen korgolgon shaarlardyn ichinde zhe dubaldardyn art zhagynda gana sogushushat. Alar korkoktugu uchun siler menen betme-bet chyga alyshpait. Alardyn ich ara dushmandyktary sebeptuu kuch-kubattuulugu ozdorunun ortosunda gana kuchtuu. Sen alardyn sozu zhana katary bir dep oiloisun', birok akyikatta alardyn zhuroktoru bytyrandy zhana ar bashka. Bul pikir kelishpestik zhana dushmandyk alardyn akyl zhugurtpogonu sebeptuu. Egerde alar akyl zhugurtushkondo, anda akyikatty bilishmek zhana any eerchishmek, al tuuraluu talashyp-tartyshmak emes.

Bul zhoottordun kaapyrlyktagy zhana bashyna tushkon azaptagy misaly, zhakyndagy ele alardan murunku Mekke mushrikterinin misalyna okshoit. Alar kaapyrlyktyn en' zhaman akybetin tatyp, Badr kunu olturulgonu olturuldu, tutkundalgany tutkundaldy. Alar uchun akyrette kyinoochu azap bar.

Alardyn eki zhuzduulorgo kulak salgany shaitanga okshosh. Al insanga kaapyrlykty kooz kylyp korgozdu. Kachan al anyn kooz korgozgonu sebeptuu kaapyr bolgondo: <<Men senin kaapyr bolgonun'a katyshym zhok. Men makuluktardyn Rabbisinen korkomun>> - dep aitty.
Shaitandyn zhana aga bash iigen adamdyn ishinin akyry kyiamat kunu tuboluk tozok bolot. Al ekoosun kutup turgan myndai zhaza - Allakhtyn chekterinen chygyp ozdoruno zulumduk kylgandardyn zhazasy.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp zhana tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkula! Ar bir zhan kyiamat kununo kandai zhakshylyk ish daiardaganyn karasyn. Allakhtan korkkula! Chyndygynda Allakh silerdin kylgan ishin'erden Kabardar. Silerdin ish-araketterin'erdin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda silerge alardyn zhazasyn zhe syilygyn beret.

Anyn buiruktaryna bash iibei, tyigandaryn tashtabai Allakhty unutkan zhana Allakh da alarga ozdorun unutturgan adamdardai bolbogula. Alar Allakhtyn kaarynan zhana zhazasynan kutkara turgan ishterdi kylyshpady. Allakhtyn buirugun atkarbai, tyigandaryn tashtabai Allakhty unutkan myna oshol adamdar - Allakhka bash iibestik kylgandar.

Tozok eeleri menen beiish eeleri birdei emes. Teskerisinche, alar duinodo kylgan ish-araketterindegi aiyrmachylyktar syiaktuu zhaza-syilyktary da aiyrmalanat. Beiish eeleri - alar kozdogonuno zhetip, korkkonunan kutuluu menen zhen'ishke zhetkender.

Oo, paigambar! Eger Biz bul Kurandy toogo tushurgon bolsok, anda sen al toonun bekemdigine karabastan, Allakhtan bolgon katuu korkunuchtan ulam boi sunup, bolunup-zharylganyn kormoksun'. Antkeni Kuranda eskertuuchu nasaattar zhana kataal azaptar tuuraluu ubadalar bar. Biz bul misaldardy adamdar akyl zhugurtup, andagy aiattarda kamtylgan osuiattardan zhana nasaattardan sabak alsyn uchun keltirebiz.

Al - Allakh. Andan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok. Al zhashyruundu da, achykty da Biluuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Duino menen akyrettin Yraiymduusu zhana alardyn Meerimduusu. Anyn yraiymy butkul aalamdy ozuno kamtyit. Al - Padysha, butkul kemchilikterden Aruu zhana Yiyk, bardyk aiyptardan Taza, Ozunun elchilerin keremettuu aiattar menen Tastyktoochu, pendelerinin ish-araketterin Kozomoldoochu, ech kimge zhen'ilbes Kudurettuu, Ozunun kuch-kudureti menen bardyk nerseni bagyntkan Kuchtuu, Tekeber. Al mushrikterdin sherik kylgan kudailarynan zhana bashka nerselerinen Aruu zhana Yiyk.

Al - Allakh. Andan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok. Al zhashyruundu da, achykty da Biluuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Duino menen akyrettin Yraiymduusu zhana alardyn Meerimduusu. Anyn yraiymy butkul aalamdy ozuno kamtyit. Al - Padysha, butkul kemchilikterden Aruu zhana Yiyk, bardyk aiyptardan Taza, Ozunun elchilerin keremettuu aiattar menen Tastyktoochu, pendelerinin ish-araketterin Kozomoldoochu, ech kimge zhen'ilbes Kudurettuu, Ozunun kuch-kudureti menen bardyk nerseni bagyntkan Kuchtuu, Tekeber. Al mushrikterdin sherik kylgan kudailarynan zhana bashka nerselerinen Aruu zhana Yiyk.

Al - Allakh, butkul nerselerdi zharatkan Zharatuuchu, zattardy bar Kyluuchu, makuluktarga Ozu kaalagandai kelbet Beruuchu. Al uluu sypattardy kamtygan en' korkom ysymdarga ee. Any asmandar menen zherdegi nerseler butkul aiyp-kemchilikterden aruulashat. Al ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu zhana Oz zharatuusunda, shariiatynda zhana tagdyrynda Daanyshman.

Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Maga zhana silerge dushman bolgondordu zhakshy korup dos tutpagyla! Alar silerdin paigambaryn'ardyn kolu menen kelgen dinge kaapyrlyk kylyshty. Alar paigambarga koshup silerdi dagy Mekkedegi turak-zhailaryn'ardan chygaryshty. Alar silerge kelgende zhakyndykka da, tuugandykka da, degele ech nersege karashpait. Antkeni siler Rabbin'er Allakhka yiman keltirgensin'er. Egerde Menin zholumda sogushuu uchun zhana Menin yraazylygyma zhetuu uchun chyksan'ar, anda andai kylbagyla, alarga bolgon suiuudon ulam musulmandardyn kabarlaryn zhashyruun zhetkirbegile. Men silerdin al tuuraluu emneni zhashyryp, emneni zharyialaganyn'ardy bilemin. Al bolobu zhe bashkasy bolobu, alardyn ech biri Maga zhashyruun emes. Kimde-kim kaapyrlar menen oshondoi dostuk mamilede bolup, alarga zhakyndyk kylsa, anda al zholdun ortosunan chygyp ketti, akyikattan adashty zhana tuuralyktan chettedi.

Eger alarda silerge ustom kyluuga mumkunchuluk tuzulso ele, alar zhuroktorundo katkan kastykty achykka chygaryshat, korduk korsotuu zhana uruu menen silerge koldorun sozushat, sogup zhana urushup tiline ee chyga alyshpait zhana alardai bolup Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyr bolushun'ardy kaalap turushat.

Egerde kaapyrlar menen alar uchun dostoshson'or, anda silerge tuugan-urugun'ar da, bala-chakan'ar da paida keltirbeit. Kyiamat kunu Allakh silerdi bolot, aran'ardagy beiish eeleri beiishke, tozok eeleri tozokko kiret. Biri-birin'erge paida keltire albaisyn'ar. Allakh kylyp zhatkan ishin'erdi Koruuchu. Silerdin ish-araketterin'erdin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda silerge alardyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Oo, yimanduular! Siler uchun Ibrakhimde zhana any menen birge bolgon yimanduu adamdarda zhakshy ornok bar. Bir kezde alar kaapyr koomuna: <<Biz silerge zhana Allakhtan bashka syiyngan kudailaryn'arga ech tieshebiz zhok. Biz siler tutungan dinge kaapyrlyk kyldyk. Siler Allakhka shirk kylbastan, zhalgyz Aga yiman keltirmeiinche, biz menen silerdin ortobuzda dushmandyk zhana zhek koruu zharaldy>> - dep aityshty. Andyktan siler dagy alarga okshogon kaapyr koomun'ardan bash tartuun'ar kerek. Birok Ibrakhimdin atasyna karata aitkan: <<Men siz uchun Allakhtan kechirim suraimyn. Men sizdi Allakhtyn azabynan ech korgoi albaimyn>> - sozundo any ornok tutpagyla. Antkeni bul Ibrakhim atasynan umut uzgongo cheiin bolgon. Oshonduktan yimanduu adam mushrik uchun kechirim surabash kerek. Rabbibiz! Butkul ishibizde Saga taiandyk, toobo kylyp Saga kaittyk zhana kyiamat kunu kaityp baruu - Ozun'o gana.

Rabbibiz! Bizdi kaapyrlarga koz karandy kyluu menen alarga synoo kylba. Oshondo alar bizge: <<Egerde akyikatta bolson'or, bizge koz karandy bolboit elen'er>> - dep aityshpasyn. Rabbibiz, kunoolorubuzdu kechir. Chyndygynda Sen zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuusun' zhana Oz zharatuun'da, shariiatyn'da zhana kudurettuulugun'do Daanyshmansyn'.

Bul zhakshy ornoktu Allakhtan duino zhana akyret zhakshylyktaryn umut kylgandar gana eerchishet. Al emi kim myndai zhakshy ornokton bash tartsa, anda Allakh pendelerine muktazh emes, Al alardyn bash iiuusuno muktazh emes. Al bardyk abalda maktoogo tatyktuu.

Oo, yimanduular! Balkim Allakh silerge dushmandyk kylgan kaapyrlar menen silerdin orton'ordo suiuu zharatyp, Allakh alardy Islamga karai bagyttait. Oshondo alar silerdin dindesh bir tuugandaryn'ar bolot. Allakh silerdin zhurogun'ordu yimanga ozgortuugo Kudurettuu. Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerine Kechirimduu, alarga Meerimduu.

Islamga kirgenin'er sebeptuu siler menen sogushpagan zhana silerdi oz mekenin'erden chygarbagan adamdarga zhakshylyk kyluun'ardy zhana alarga tiiishtuu akylaryn berip, alardyn ortosunda adilettuu boluun'ardy Allakh silerge tyibait. Chyndygynda Allakh ozdoruno, ui-bulosuno zhana kol astyndagylarga adilettuuluk kylgandardy suiot.

Siler menen yimanyn'ar sebeptuu sogushup, silerdi oz mekenin'erden chygargan zhe chygaruuga zhardam bergen adamdar menen dostuk mamile tuzuun'ordu Allakh silerge tyidy. Aran'ardan kim alar menen dostoshso, myna osholor Allakhtyn buiruguna karshy chygyp, ozdorun kyiroogo uchuratkan zaalymdar.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Egerde silerge yimanduu aialdar kaapyrlardyn zherinen musulmandardyn zherine kochup kelishse, alardyn yimanynyn chyndygyn synap korgulo. Allakh alardyn yimanyn zhakshy bilet. Alardyn zhurogundogu katylgan nerseler Aga zhashyruun emes. Egerde alardyn chynchyldygyn tekshergenden kiiin yimanduu ekenin bilsen'er, anda alardy kaapyr kuiooloruno kaitarbagyla. Yimanduu aialdar kaapyrlarga turmushka chyguuga bolboit zhana kaapyrlar yimanduu aialdarga uilonuugo bolboit. Kuiooloruno alarga bergen kalyn'dy kaitaryp bergile. Oo, yimanduular! Siler alardyn idda moonotu butkondon kiiin alarga kalyn' berip, uilonson'or kunoo emes. Kimdin aialy kaapyr bolso zhe Islamdan bash tartsa, anda any karmabasyn. Antkeni anyn kaapyr bolushu menen alardyn nikesi toktoit. Dinden bash tartkan aialdaryn'arga bergen kalyn'dy kaapyrlardan suragyla zhana alar dagy Islamdy kabyl algan aialdarynyn kalyn'yn surashsyn. Siler taraptan zhana alar taraptan kalyn'dyn kaitarylyp beriluusu tuuraluu bul aitylgan nerse - Allakhtyn okumu. Allakh silerdin aran'arda Ozu kaalagandai okum chygarat. Allakh pendelerinin abaldaryn zhana ish-araketterin Biluuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Al pendelerine kylgan shariiatynda Daanyshman.

Egerde aialdaryn'ardyn kee birleri dinden bash tartyp, kaapyrlarga ketip kalsa zhana siler kaapyrlardan alardyn kalyn'yn talap kylyp, birok alar berbei koiushsa, kiiin siler kaapyrlardan olzhogo ee bolson'or, anda dinden bash tartyp ketip kalgan aialdardyna kuiooloru bergen kalyn'dy bergile. Zhana siler buiruguna bash iiip zhana tyigandaryn tashtap, yiman keltirgen Allakhtan korkkula!

Oo, paigambar! Egerde saga Mekkeni bagyntkan kundogudoi yimanduu aialdar kelip, Allakhka ech nerseni sherik kylbastan, zhalgyz Aga syiynuuga, uuruluk zhana zyna kylboogo, karan'gylyk doordogu adamdardyn urp-adattaryna ylaiyk baldardy olturboogo, zynadan torolgon baldaryn kuiooloruno taandyk kylboogo zhana olukko okurup yiloo, chachty kyruu, kiiimin tytuu syiaktuu tyiuu salyngan zhakshylyk ishterde saga karshy chykpoogo ant berishse, anda alardyn antyn kabyl kyl zhana alar saga ant berishkenden kiiin kunooloru uchun Allakhtan kechirim sura. Chyndygynda Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerine Kechirimduu, alarga Yraiymduu.

Bul suro Allakhtyn dushmandary menen dostoshuuga bolbostugun eskertip bashtalyp, bul eskertuunu basa belgilegendikten, kaira ushundai eskertuu menen aiaktagan. Allakh Taala mintip aitty:
Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Allakhtyn kaaryna kalgan koom menen dostuk mamilede bolbogula. Alar akyretke ishenishpeit. Teskerisinche, alar kaira tiriluugo ishenbegendik sebeptuu oluktordun kaityp keluusunon umutsuz bolgon syiaktuu andan umut uzushkondor.

Asmandar menen zherdegiler Allakhty ylaiyk kelbegen bardyk aiyp-kemchilikterden aruulashty zhana uluktashty. Al ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu zhana Oz zharatuusunda, tagdyrynda zhana shariiatynda Daanyshman.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirgender! Emnege siler anygynda ozun'or kylbagan nerseni kyldym dep aitasyn'ar? Bul aran'ardan kimdir biroo: <<Men kylychym menen salgylashtym>> dep aitkany syiaktuu, birok al kylychy menen salgalyshkan emes zhana any menen chapkan da emes.
Ozun'or kylbagan nerseni aituun'ar - Allakhtyn aldynda ushunchalyk zhek kororluk ish! Yimanduu adamga Allakh menen chynchyl boluu gana ylaiyktuu, al aitkan sozun ish zhuzundo atkarat.
Chyndygynda Allakh Anyn yraazylygyna zhetuu maksatta, biri-birine tygyz zhaigashkan imarattar syiaktuu sap-sap bolup zhanasha tizilip Anyn zholunda sogushkandardy suiot.

Kachan Allakh sogush zhonundo aityp, Anyn zholunda zhanasha turup sogushkan yimanduulardy maktagan kezde, alardy paigambaryna karshy chykpoo tuuraluu eskertuu maksatta Musa menen Isanyn zholdoochularynyn oz paigambarlaryna karshy chykkandygy tuuraluu aityp, myndai dedi:
Oo, paigambar! Estechi, bir kezde Musa koomuna kairylyp: <> - dedi. Kachan alar al alyp kelgen akyikattan chettep burulup ketishkende, Allakh dagy alardyn zhuroktorun akyikattan zhana tuuralyktan burup koidu. Allakh bash iibes koomdu akyikatka zholdoboit.

Oo, paigambar! Estechi, bir kezde Mariiamdyn uulu Isa myndai dedi: <<Oo, Israil urpaktary! Men murunku tushkon Tooratty tastyktoo uchun zhana menden kiiin kele turgan, ysymy Akhmad degen paigambar tuuraluu suiunchulosh uchun Allakh taraptan silerge zhiberilgen elchimin. Men paigambarlardan birinchisi emesmin>>. Kachan Isa alarga chynchyldygyn bildirgen dalilderdi alyp kelgende, alar: <<Bul anyk ele syikyr. Biz any eerchibeibiz>> - deshti.

Allakhka zhalgan zhalaa zhapkan adamdan otkon ech bir zaalym zhok. Antkeni al zhalgyz Allakhka syiynuu dini bolgon Islamga chakyrylganda, al Allakhka bashka sherikterdi koshup, alarga syiyndy. Allakh shirk zhana kunoolordu kylyp ozdoruno zulumduk kylgan adamdarga tuura zholgo tushuugo iigilik berbeit.

Al zhalganchylar buzuku sozdor zhana akyikatty burmaloo menen Allakhtyn nurun ochuruunu kaalashat. Allakh bolso alardyn tekeberligine karabastan, zherdin batyshy menen chygyshynda dinin achykka chygaruu zhana sozun biiik kyluu menen Ozunun nurun toluktait.

Zher betinde anyn biiligi ornoshun zhek korgon mushrikterdin tekeberligine karabastan, bardyk dinderge ustom kyluu uchun, Allakh Ozunun elchisi Mukhammaddy zhakshylykka tuura bagyt korsotuuchu zhana paidaluu ilim menen zhakshylyk ishterdin dini bolgon Islam dini menen zhiberdi.
Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Silerdi kyinoochu azaptan kutkara turgan paidaluu soodany korgozoiunbu?

Al paidaluu sooda myndai - Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltiresin'er zhana oz zhanyn'ardy zhana mal-mulkun'ordu Anyn yraazylygy uchun sarptap, Anyn zholunda sogushasyn'ar. Eger bilsen'er, bul aitylgan ish siler uchun zhakshyraak. Andyktan aga shashylgyla.

Bul soodanyn paidasy - Allakh silerdin kunoolorun'ordu kechirip, khan sarailarynyn zhana bak-daraktarynyn aldynan daryialar akkan beiishterge kirgizet zhana kochpoi turuktashyp zhashagan beiishterdegi kooz turak-zhailarga kirgizet. Bul aitylgan syilyk - ech bir zhen'ish ten' kelbegen uluu zhen'ish.

Bul soodanyn paidasynyn silerge zhakkan dagy bir ozgolugu bar, al bul duinodo ishke ashat - al Allakhtyn silerdi dushmanyn'ardyn ustunon zhen'ishke zhetkiruusu zhana zhakynda boluuchu zhen'ish, al Mekkeni zhana bashka zherlerdi bagyntuu. Oo, paigambar! Yimanduularga alardy kubantkan bul duinodogu zhen'ishti zhana akyrette beiishke kiruu zhen'ishin kabarla.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Isanyn zholdoochulary koldoo korgozgon syiaktuu siler dagy paigambaryn'ar alyp kelgen Allakhtyn dinine koldoo korgozup, Anyn koldoochulary bolgula! Kachan Isa alarga: <<Allakhtyn zholunda kim maga zhardamchy bolot?>> - degende, alar: <<Biz Allakhtyn zhardamchylary bolobuz>> - dep daroo zhoop berishti. Anan Israil urpaktarynyn bir bolugu aga yiman keltirip, bashka bir bolugu aga kaapyrlyk kylyshty. Oshentip, Biz Isaga yiman keltirgenderdi aga kaapyrlyk kylgandarga karshy koldoduk, nazhyitazha alardyn ustunon zhen'ishke zhetishti.

Asmandar menen zherdegi butkul makuluktar Allakhty ylaiyk kelbegen kemchiliktuu sypattardan aruulashat zhana Any uluktashat. Al zhalgyz Ozu biilik zhurguzuuchu Padysha, bardyk kemchilikterden Aruu, ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu zhana Oz zharatuusunda, shariiatynda zhana tagdyrynda Daanyshman.
Al okui da, zhaza da albagan arabdardyn ozunon paigambardy zhiberdi. Al ozuno tushkon aiattardy alarga okup beret, alardy kaapyrlyktan zhana zhaman sypattardan tazalait zhana Kurandy uirotot.

Oshondoi ele bul paigambardy arabdardan bashka elderge zhana kelechekte kele turgan bashka adamdarga da zhiberdi. Al ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu zhana Oz zharatuusunda, shariiatynda zhana tagdyrynda Daanyshman.

Paigambardyn arabdarga zhana bashkalarga zhiberilgeni tuuraluu bul aitylgan nerse - Allakhtyn Ozu kaalagandarga bergen artykchylygy. Allakh uluu zhakshylyk Eesi. Bul ummotton bolgon paigambardy butkul adamzatka zhiberuusu - Anyn uluu zhakshylyktarynan.

Kachan Allakh paigambar zhiberip zhana Kurandy tushurup zhakshylyk kylgany tuuraluu aitkanda, bul ummottu eerchigenderge eskertuu katarynda Musa paigambardyn kee bir zholdoochularynyn Tooratta kelgen nerselerdi atkaruudan bash tartkandary tuuraluu aityp myndai dedi:
Tooratta kelgen nerselerdi atkaruuga buirulup, kiiin al buirulgan mildetterdi atkarbai koigon zhoottor, kop kitep kotorgon eshek syiaktuu. Al ustuno kiteppi zhe bashka nersebi, emne artylganyn bilbeit. Allakhtyn aiattaryn zhalgan dep eseptegen adamdardyn salyshtyruu misaly kandai zhaman! Allakh adiletsiz koomdu tuura zholgo salbait.

Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Oo, burmalangandan kiiin iudaizmde kalgandar! Egerde siler ozun'ordu adamdardyn arasynan Allakh tandap algan Anyn suiuktuulorubuz dep oiloson'or, anda silerge zheke berilgen dep oilogon keremetti erteletish uchun olumdu tilegilechi, eger siler adamdardyn arasynan Allakhtyn suiuktuulorubuz dep aitkan sozun'ordo chynchyl bolson'or.

Alar ech kachan olumdu tileshpeit. Teskerisinche, alar kylgan kaapyrlyk, kunoolor, zulumduk zhana Tooratty ozgortup burmaloo sebeptuu duinodo tuboluk kaluunu kaalashat. Allakh zaalymdardy Biluuchu. Alardyn ish-araketterinin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda alardyn zhazasyn beret.

Oo, paigambar! Al zhoottorgo ait: <<Siler kachkan olumgo ertebi-kechpi sozsuz zholugasyn'ar. Kiiin kyiamat kunu achykty da, zhashyruundu da Biluuchu Allakhka kaitarylasyn'ar. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Oshondo Al silerge duinodo kylgan ishterin'erdin kabaryn beret zhana alardyn zhazasyn beret>>.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Egerde azanchy zhuma kunu imam minbarga chykkandan kiiin namazga azan aitsa, anda siler khutbaga zhana namazga katyshuu uchun mechitterge shashylgyla zhana silerdi ibadattan alaksytpash uchun sooda-satykty tashtagyla. Oo, yimanduular! Mechitke shashyluu zhana zhuma namazdyn azanynan kiiin sooda-satykty tashtoo tuuraluu bul aitylgan buiruk, eger bilsen'er, siler uchun zhakshy. Oshonduktan Allakh silerge buirugan nerseni atkargyla.

Al emi zhuma namazyn okugan son' adal emgek kyluu zhana muktazhdygyn'ardy kanaattandyruu uchun zher betine tarkagyla, adal emgek zhana taza kireshe arkyluu Allakhtan zhakshylyktardy suragyla zhana yrysky izdegen kezde Allakhty kop estegile. Yrysky izdoo silerge Allakhty estoonu unutturup koibosun. Balkim oshondo izdegen nersen'erge zhetip, korkkon nersen'erden kutulasyn'ar.

Egerde kee bir musulmandar soodany zhe oiun-zooktu korup kalyshsa, alar tarap oshol zhakty kozdoi zhonoshot zhana seni minbarda turgan abalda tashtap ketishet. Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Allakhtyn aldynda zhakshylyk ishtin syilygy - siler bargan sooda-satyktan zhana oiun-zookton zhakshyraak. Allakh en' zhakshy yrysky beruuchu>>.

Oo, paigambar! Egerde sen olturgan zhaiga syrtynan Islamdy korgozup, ichinde kaapyrlykty zhashyrgan eki zhuzduulor kelip: <<Biz senin chynygy Allakhtyn elchisi ekenin'e kuboluk berebiz>> - dep aityshty. Allakh sen Anyn chynygy elchisi ekenin'di bilet. Allakh eki zhuzduulordun zhurok tupkurunon <<Sen Allakhtyn elchisisin'>> dep kuboluk berip aitkan sozdorundo zhalganchy ekendigine kuboluk beret.

Alar yimanduubuz dep kasam ichip aitkan anttaryn olturuuluudon zhana tutkundaluudan korgonuch zhana kalkan kylyp alyshty zhana adamdarga shek saluu zhana zhalgan ushaktardy tarkatuu menen alardy yimandan burushtu. Alardyn kylyp zhatkan eki zhuzduulugu zhana zhalgan anttary kandai zhaman!

Munun sebebi, alar eki zhuzduuluk menen yiman keltirishti, alardyn zhuroguno yiman kirgen zhok. Kiiin zhashyruun turdo Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyshty. Oshondo Allakh alardyn kaapyrlyktary sebeptuu zhuroktoruno moor basyp, aga yiman kirgen zhok. Alar myna oshol moor basylgany sebeptuu kaisy nerse alar uchun paidaluu zhe zhakshy ekenin tushunushpoit.

Oo, nazar saluuchu! Egerde sen alardy karasan', alarda symbattuuluk zhana bakubatchylyk bolgonu sebeptuu kelbetteri zhana turpattary seni suktandyrat. Alar suilogondo, sen alardyn chechen sozdorun ugasyn'. Oo, paigambar! Alar seni menen olturganda suiolgon don'gochtorgo okshosh. Alar ech nerseni tushunboit zhana an'dashpait. Alar korkoktugu sebeptuu ar bir dobushtu alarga karai bagyttalgan dep oiloshot. Myna osholor - anyk dushmandar. Oo, paigambar! Alardan sak bol, alar senin syryn'dy zhaiyp zhe saga karshy aila-amal kylyshpasyn. Allakh alarga kargysh aitty. Alarga yimandyn dalilderi achyk-aikyn korunup tursa da, alar kantip andan burulup ketishet?

Egerde eki zhuzduulorgo: <<Allakhtyn elchisine kelip, silerden bolgon nerse uchun kechirim suragyla. Al silerdin kunoolorun'or uchun Allakhtyn kechirimin surasyn>> - dep aitylsa, alar shyldyn'dagansyp bashtaryn chaikashat. Siler alardyn akyikatty kabyl albai zhana aga bash berbei tekeberlenip, alarga buirulgan nerseden zhuz burgandaryn kordun'or.

Oo, paigambar! Sen alardyn kunooloru uchun kechirim suraganyn' menen surabaganyn' birdei. Allakh ech kachan alardyn kunoolorun kechirbeit. Chyndygynda Allakh bash iibestik kylyp, kunoodon bash tartpagan koomgo iigilik berbeit.

Myna osholor aityshat: <<Allakhtyn elchisinin aldyndagy kedei-kembagaldarga zhana Medinanyn chet zhakasyndagy arabdarga mal-mulktorun'ordu sarptabagyla, akyry alar anyn ailanasynan tarap ketishet>>. Asmandar menen zherdin kazynalary zhalgyz Allakhka taandyk. Al kaalagan pendelerine yrysky beret. Birok eki zhuzduulor yrysky kazynalary Allakhtyn kolunda ekenin bilishpeit.

Alardyn bashchysy Abdullakh ibn Ubai: <<Biz Medinaga kaitsak, men zhana elimden bolgon kuch-kudurettuu adamdar, alsyz kor bolgon Mukhammaddy zhana anyn sakhabalaryn kuup chygabyz>> - dep aitty. Kuch-kudurettuuluk Abdullakh ibn Ubaidullakh menen zhoro-zholdoshtoruna emes, zhalgyz Allakhka, Anyn elchisine zhana yimanduularga taandyk. Birok eki zhuzduulor kuch-kudurettuuluk Allakhka, Anyn elchisine zhana yimanduularga taandyk ekenin bilishpeit.

Kachan Allakh eki zhuzduulordun Anyn zholunan tosuu uchun mal-mulk sarptoogo saran'dyk kylgandaryn baiandaganda, yimanduulardy andan eskertti zhana alardy Allakh zholunda mal-mulk sarptoogo buirup, myndai dedi:
Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Mal-mulkun'or zhana bala-chakan'ar silerdi namazdan zhe bashka Islam parzdarynan alaksytyp koibosun. Kimdi mal-mulku zhana bala-chakasy namazdan zhana bashka Allakhtyn parzdarynan alaksytkan bolso, myna osholor ozdorun zhana ui-bulosun kyiamatta chyndap zyianga uchuratkandar.

Silerden kimdir-biroogo olum kelgenge cheiin Allakh yrysky kylgan mal-mulkton sartpagyla. Oshondo al Rabbisine aitat: <<Rabbim, maga bir az moonot ber, men Allakh zholuna bailygymdan sarptaiyn zhana zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgan Allakhtyn takyba pendelerinen boloiun>>.
