Allakh azhaly kelip, omuru butkon bir dagy zhanga moonot berbeit. Allakh silerdin ishterin'erden Kabardar. Ish-araketterin'erdin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda alardyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret, zhakshy bolso zhakshy, zhaman bolso zhaman.

Asmandar menen zherdegi butkul makuluktar Allakhty Aga ylaiyk kelbegen kemchilik sypattardan aruulashat zhana uluktashat. Biilik Aga gana taandyk zhana en' zhakshy maktoolor Aga gana tiiishtuu. Al bardyk nersege kuduretuu. Any ech bir nerse alsyrata albait.

Oo, adamdar! Al silerdi zharatty. Silerdin aran'arda Aga kaapyrlyk kylgandar bar, alar tozokko baryshat zhana Aga yiman keltirgenderi bar, alar beiishke baryshat. Allakh silerdin ishin'erdi Koruuchu. Ish-araketterin'erdin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda alardyn zhazasyn zhe syilygyn beret.

Al asmandar menen zherdi akyikat menen zharatty. Alardy zhondon-zhon ele zharatyp koigon zhok. Oo, adamdar! Al silerge Oz yraiymy zhana zhakshylygy menen en' suluu kelbet berdi. Eger kaalasa, any korksuz kylyp koimok. Kyiamatta Aga gana kaitasyn'ar. Oshondo Al silerdin ish-araketterin'erdin syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret, zhakshy bolso zhakshy, zhaman bolso zhaman.

Al asmandar menen zherdegi nerselerdi bilet zhana silerdin achyk zhana zhashyruun kylgan ishterin'erdi bilet. Allakh kokuroktordogu zhakshy zhe zhaman nerselerdi Biluuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.

Oo, mushrikter! Silerge Nukhtun koomu, Aad, Samud zhana bashka murunku zhalganchy kaapyr koomdordun kabary kelbedibi, alar duinodo kaapyrlyktarynyn zhazasyn tartyshty, al emi akyrette alar uchun kyinoochu azap bar? Albette! Al alarga keldi. Andyktan siler alardyn ishinin akybeti kandai bolgonunan sabak algyla zhana alardyn bashyna tushkon nerse silerge da tushposh uchun Allakhka toobo kylgyla.

Alardyn bashyna tushkon al azaptyn sebebi, alarga paigambarlary Allakh taraptan achyk-aikyn dalilderdi alyp kelgende, alar paigambarlar adamzattan bolushu mumkun emes dep tekeberlenip: <<Bizdi adam balasy akyikatka bashtait beken?>> - dep aityshty. Anan alar kaapyrlyk kylyp, alarga yiman keltiruudon bash tartyshty. Alar Allakhka ech kandai zyian keltirgen zhok. Allakh alardyn yimanyna zhana bash iiuusuno muktazh emes. Antkeni alardyn bash iiuusu Aga ech nerseni koshpoit. Allakh pendelerine beimuktazh zhana Al sozdorundo zhana ish-araketterinde maktoogo tatyktuu.

Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandar Allakh alardy olgondon kiiin kaira tiriltpeit dep oiloshtu. Oo, paigambar! Kaira tiriluunu zhokko chygargandarga ait: <<Zhok! Rabbime ant bolsun! Siler kyiamat kunu sozsuz tirilesin'er. Andan son' duinodo kylgan ishterin'erdin kabaryn sozsuz ugasyn'ar. Kaira tiriltuu Allakh uchun zhen'il. Al silerdi abalky zholu zharatkan. Demek, Al silerdi olgonun'ordon kiiin surak aluu zhana zhazaloo uchun kaira tiriltuugo kudurettuu>>.

Oo, adamdar! Allakhka, Anyn elchisine zhana Biz elchibizge tushurgon Kuranga yiman keltirgile! Allakh silerdin kylyp zhatkan ishterin'erdi bilet. Ish-araketterin'erdin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda alardyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.

Oo, paigambar! Allakh silerdi kyiamat kunu ish-araketterin'erdin syilygyn zhe zhazasyn berish uchun chogulgan kundu estechi. Al kunu kaapyrlardyn zhogotuuga zhana zhokko uchuragany achykka chygat. Antkeni yimanduular tozokko tushkondordun beiishtegi zhailaryna eelik kylyshat, al emi tozok eeleri beiishtegilerdin tozoktogu zhailaryna eelik kylyshat. Kimde-kim Allakhka yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylsa, Allakh anyn kunoolorun ochurot zhana khan sarailary menen bak-daraktarynyn aldynan daryialar agyp turgan beiishterge kirgizet. Alar al zhakta tuboluk kalyshat, ech kachan chygyshpait zhana alarga anyn zhyrgalchylygy toktotulbait. Alar zhetken bul nerse - ten'deshsiz uluu zhen'ish.
Al emi Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyp, elchibizge tushurgon aiattarybyzdy zhalgan dep eseptegender, alar tozokto tuboluk kaluuchular. Alardyn baraar zhaiy kandai zhaman!

Kimdir biroonun oz bashyna zhe mal-mulkuno zhe bala-chakasyna kelgen kyiynchylyk Allakhtyn tagdyry menen gana bolot. Kimde-kim Allakhka, Anyn tagdyryna zhana okumuno yiman keltirse, Allakh anyn zhurogun Oz buiruguna bash iiuugo zhana tagdyryna yraazy boluuga iigilik beret. Allakh butkul nerseni Biluuchu. Aga ech bir nerse zhashyruun emes.

Allakhka moiun sungula zhana paigambarga moiun sungula. Egerde piagambar alyp kelgen nerseden zhuz bursan'ar, anda anyn kunoosun ozun'or tartasyn'ar. Paigambardyn mildeti -- Biz aga zhetkir dep buirugan nerseni zhetkiruu gana. Al silerge zhetkiruugo buirulgan nerselerdi zhetkirdi.
Allakh - syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai, Andan bashka ech kim syiynuuga tatyktuu emes. Yimanduular bardyk ishterinde Allakhka gana taianyshat.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Chyndygynda silerdin aialdaryn'ar menen baldaryn'ardyn arasynda dushmandar bar. Antkeni alar silerdi Allakhty estoodon, Anyn zholunda sogushuudan alaksytat zhana toskoolduk zharatat. Alardyn silerge taasir beruusunon sak bolgula. Egerde siler alardyn katachylyktaryn kechirip zhana alarga kon'ul burbastan, alardy zhashyrsan'ar, anda Allakh silerdin kunoolorun'ordu kechiret zhana yraiym kylat. Syilyk zhe zhaza ish-araketin turuno zharasha bolot.

Chyndygynda bailygyn'ar zhana bala-chakan'ar siler uchun synoo. Keede alar silerdi aram yrysky tabuuga zhana Allakhka moiun sunuunu tashtoogo turtushu yktymal. Allakhka bash iiuunu baldarga bash iiuudon zhana mal-mulk menen alek boluudan artyk korgon adamdar uchun Allakhtyn aldynda uluu syilyktar bar. Al uluu syilyk -- beiish.

Alyn'ar zhetishinche Allakhka bash iiuu menen Anyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkula, Allakhty zhana Anyn elchisin ukkula zhana moiun sungula. Oshoidoi ele Allakh silerge yrysky kylgan mal-mulktorun'ordon zhakshylyk zholdorgo sarptagyla. Kimdi Allakh napsisinin achkozdugunon saktasa, myna osholor kozdogon nersesine zhetip, korkkon nersesinen kutuluu menen zhen'ishke zhetkender.

Egerde Allakhtyn zholunda mal-mulkun'ordon sarptap, Aga zhakshy karyz bersen'er, Al silerge bir zhakshylykty on eseden zheti zhuz esege zhe andan da kop esege cheiin koboituu menen soop-syilykty eselep beret zhana kunoolorun'ordu kechiret. Allakh yraazy Boluuchu, Al az ish-araket uchun kop soop beret zhana Al zhazaloogo shashylbagan Toktoo.
Allakh taala zhashyruundu zhana achykty Biluuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Al ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu zhana Oz zharatuusunda, shariiatynda zhana tagdyrynda Daanyshman.

Oo, paigambar! Egerde sen zhe senin ummotun'don kimdir biroo aialyna talak bermekchi bolso, aga birinchi idda moonotundo talak bersin, tagyraak aitkanda, aiyzdan tazalangandan kiiin zhynystyk katnash kylbai turup talak bersin. Egerde aialyn'ardy ozun'orgo kaitaruunu kaalasan'ar, anda alardy kaitaryp aluun'ar uchun idda moonotun estep kalgyla. Rabbin'erdin buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyiganynan tyiylyp Allakhtan korkkula. Talak bergen aialdaryn'ardy alar zhashagan uidon chygarbagyla zhana idda moonotu butmoiuncho ozdoru da chykpasyn, eger alar zyna syiaktuu achyk buzukuluk kylbagan bolso. Bul okumdor pendelerine Allakhtyn belgilep koigon chekteri. Kim Allakhtyn cheginen chyksa, anda al Rabbisine bash iibegeni uchun ozuno-ozu zyian keltirip zulumduk kyldy. Ei, azhyrashuuchu! Balkim, Allakh andan kiiin zhuroguno kaaloo kirgizip, aialyn kaira ozuno aialdykka alar, munu sen bilbeisin'.

Egerde alardyn idda moonotunun butushu zhakyndap kalsa, anda alardy chyn kon'ul zhana zhakshy mamile menen kaitaryp algyla zhe alardyn aldyndagy mildetterdi atkaruu menen birge alar ozuno-ozu eelik kylysh uchun alardy kaitarbastan iddasy butkucho kutkulo. Egerde alardy kaitaruunu zhe azhyrashuunu kaalasan'ar, anda talash-tartysh zharalbash uchun aran'ardan eki adilettuu adamdy kubo kylgyla. Ei, kubolor! Allakhtyn Zhuzun kozdop kubogo otkulo. Bul aitylgan okumdor Allakhka zhana kyiamat kununo yiman keltirgenderge eskertme. Antkeni osholor eskertmeden zhana nasaattardan paida alyshat. Kim Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkso, Allakh any bashyna tushkon bardyk kyiynchylyktardan chygarat.

Zhana aga oiuna kelbegen taraptan yrysky beret. Kim oz ishterinde Allakhka taiansa, Al aga zhetishtuu. Chyndygynda Allakh Oz buirugun ishke ashyruuchu. Any ech nerse alsyrata albait zhana Al bir dagy nerseni otkorup zhiberbeit. Allakh ar bir nersenin buto turgan olchomun belgilep koigon. Kyiynchylyktyn da olchomu bar, bakubatchylyktyn da olchomu bar. Insanda alardyn biroosu ele daiym bolo berbeit.

Talak berilgen aialdar karylyk sebeptuu aiyzy toktop kalgan bolso zhana siler alardyn idda moonotu tuuraluu shektensen'er, alardyn idda moonotu uch aiga barabar. Al emi zhashtygy sebeptuu aiyzy kelbegenderdin idda moonotu da uch aiga barabar. Kosh boiluu aialdardyn talakka zhe kuioosu olgongo bailanyshtuu idda moonotu bala torolushu menen butot. Kim Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkso, Allakh anyn ishterin zhen'ildetet zhana aga bardyk kyiynchylyktardy zhen'il kylat.

Oo, yimanduular! Talak beruugo, kaira kaitaruuga zhana idda moonotuno bailanyshtuu bul aitylgan okumdor - Allakh silerdi ish zhuzundo atkarsyn dep tushurgon okumu. Kim Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkso, Al anyn kylgan kunoolorun ochurot zhana akyrette uluu syilykty beret. Al -beiishke kiruu zhana ech kachan butpogon zhyrgalchylykka zhetuu.

Kachan Allakh talak beruu zhana kaira kaitaruu tuuraluu okumdordu baiandaganda, turak-zhai menen kamsyzdoo zhana karzhyloo tuuraluu okumdordu baiandap, myndai dedi:
Oo, kuioolor! Shartyn'arga zharasha alardy ozun'or menen chogu zhashatkyla. Allakh silerge andan bashkasyn mildettendirbeit. Alarga kysym korsotuu maksatta turak-zhai, kamsyzdoo zhana bashka boiuncha zyian keltirbegile. Egerde talak berilgen aialdar kosh boiluu bolso, alardy torogongo cheiin kamsyzdagyla. Eger balan'ardy emizse, anda alarga sut akysyn bergile zhana anyn akysy tuuraluu zhakshylap suiloshup algyla. Egerde kuioosu aialy suragan akyga saran'dyk kylsa zhana aial dagy saran'danyp, ozu suragandan bashkaga kanaattanbasa, anda atasy balasyn emizgenge bashka aial zhaldasyn.

Mal-mulku kenen adam talak bergen aialyna zhana balasyna bailygynan sarptasyn. Al emi yryskysy tartysh adam Allakh aga bergen nerseden sarptasyn. Allakh ech kimge bergen nersesinen bashkany mildet kylbait, andan ashykchasyn zhana kolunan kelbegenin mildettendirbeit. Allakh aga tarchylyk zhana kyiynchylyk abalynan kiiin kenenchilikti zhana bakubatchylykty kylat.

Kachan Allakh bir neche buiruktardy aitkanda, alardan bash tartuudan eskertti zhana anyn akybeti zhaman bolorun baiandap, myndai dedi:
Koptogon shaarlar Rabbisinin zhana Anyn elchilerinin buiruktaryna bash iibestik kylyshkanda, Biz alar menen kunoo ishteri uchun katuu esepteshtik zhana alardy duinodo zhana akyrette korkunuchtuu azapka saldyk.
Alar kunoo ishterinin zhazasyn tartyshty zhana anyn duinodogu zhana akyretteri akybeti zhogotuu boldu.

Allakh alarga katuu azapty daiardap koidu. Oo, Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirgen akyl eeleri! Alardyn bashyna kelgen nerse silerge da kelbesh uchun Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp zhana tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkula. Allakh silerge Aga bash iibestik kyluunun arty zhaman butorun zhana Aga bash iiuunun akybeti zhakshy bolorun eskertken eskertmeni tushurdu.

Al eskertme - Anyn elchisi. Al Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn elchisin chynchyl dep tastyktagandardy zhana zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandardy adashuunun karan'gylygynan tuura zholdun nuruna chygaruu uchun ech kandai budomugu zhok achyk-aikyn aiattardy okup beret. Kim Allakhka yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylsa, Allakh any khan sarailarynyn zhana bak-daraktarynyn aldynan daryialar akkan beiishterge kirgizet. Al zhakta tuboluk kalat. Allakh any zhyrgalchylygy butpogon beiishke kirgizip, anyn yryskysyn sonun kylyp koidu.

Allakh zheti kabat asmandy zharatty zhana zheti kabat asmandy zharatkan syiaktuu zheti kabat zherdi da zharatty. Siler Allakhtyn butkul nersege bolgon kudurettuulugun, Any ech bir nerse alsyrata albasyn zhana Al ilimi menen butkul nerseni kamtyp, asmandar menen zherdegi ech bir nerse Aga zhashyruun emes ekenin bilishin'er uchun Allakhtyn aalamdyk zhana shariiattyk okumdoru alardyn ortosuna tushup turat.

Oo, paigambar! Emne uchun aialdaryn'dyn Mariia kun'un'o bolgon kyzganychynan ulam alardy yraazy kylysh uchun Allakh saga andan yrakhattanuuga uruksat bergen nerseni aramga chygaryp zhatasyn'? Allakh saga Kechirimduu, Meerimduu.

Allakh silerge antyn'ardyn kunoosun ketirishtin zholun shariiatta belgiledi, egerde andan da zhakshysyn korson'or zhe any buzgan bolson'or. Allakh silerdin Koldoochun'ar. Al silerdin abalyn'ardy zhana silerge emne paidaluu ekenin Biluuchu zhana Oz shariiatynda, tagdyrynda Daanyshman.

Estechi, bir zholu paigambarybyz (aga Allakhtyn tynchtygy zhana maktoo dubasy bolsun) Khafsaga syr aitkan ele. Anda aialy Mariiaga zhakyndabaim degen bolchu. Kachan Khafsa Aishaga bul syrdy aitkanda, Allakh paigambaryna syry achylyp kalgany tuuraluu kabar berdi. Al Khafsany zhemelep, anyn aitkandarynyn kee birin ozuno aityp berdi, kee birin aitpady. Oshondo al: <<Sizge munu kim aitty?>> - dep suraganda, al: <<Maga bardyk nerseni Biluuchu, zhashyruun nerselerdin baarynan Kabardar (Allakh) bildirdi>> - dedi.

Ekoon'orgo toobo kyluu mildet boldu. Antkeni ekoon'ordun zhurogun'or Allakhtyn elchisi kun' aialynan alystap, any ozuno aram kyluu syiaktuu aga zhakpagan nerseni zhakshy koruugo yktady. Egerde ekoon'or aga karshy tukuruuga ulam kaita bersen'er, Allakh Anyn Koldoochusu zhana Zhardamchysy. Oshondoi ele Zhebreil zhana yimanduulardyn zhakshylary anyn koldoochulary zhana zhardamchylary. Al emi Allakhtyn aga bolgon koldoosunan kiiin perishteler anyn zhardamchylary zhana aga zyian bergenderge karshy koldoochulary.

Egerde paigambar silerge talak berse, anda Rabbisi aga silerden da zhakshy bolgon, anyn buiruguna bash iigen, Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine yiman keltirgen, Aga moiun sungan, kunooloruno toobo kylgan, Rabbisine ibadat kylgan zhana orozo karmagan zhubandardy zhana ech kim zhakyndyk kylbagan kyzdardy almashtyryp koiushu mumkun. Birok al alarga talak bergen zhok.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Ozun'ordu zhana ui-bulon'ordu otunu adamdar zhana tashtar bolgon uluu tozokton korgop kalgyla. Al tozoktun ustundo aga kirgen adamdarga kataal zhana kuchtuu perishteler bar. Alar Allakhtyn buiruktaryna bash iibestik kylyshpait zhana alarga buirulgan nerselerdi kechiktirbesten atkaryshat.

Kyiamatta kaapyrlarga aitylat: <<Ei, Allakhka kaapyr bolgondor! Bugun kaapyrlygyn'ar zhana kunoolorun'or uchun kechirim surabai ele koigula. Kechirimin'er kabyl kylynbait. Siler bugun duinodo Allakhka kylgan kaapyrlygyn'ardyn zhana Anyn elchilerin zhalganga chygarganyn'ardyn zhazasyn alasyn'ar>>.

Oo, Allakhka yiman keltirip, Anyn shariiatyn atkargandar! Allakhka kunoolorun'or uchun chyndap toobo kylgyla. Balkim Rabbin'er kyiamat kunu kunoolorun'ordu kechirip, khan sarailarynyn aldynan daryialar akkan beiishterge kirgizet. Al kunu Allakh paigambardy zhana any menen birge yiman keltirgenderdi tozokko kirgizip kordoboit. Alardyn nuru Syratta aldylarynan zhana on' tarabynan zharkyrap zhurot. Alar aityshat: <<Oo, Rabbibiz! Biz beiishke kirishibiz uchun zhana Syrattan nurlary ochup kalgan eki zhuzduulordoi bolup kalbashybyz uchun nurubuzdu toluk kyl zhana kunoolorubuzdu kechir. Chyndygynda Sen bardyk nersege kudurettuusun'. Sen nurubuzdu toluk kyluuga zhana kunoolorubuzdu kechiruugo alsyz emessin'>>.

Oo, paigambar! Kaapyrlarga karshy kylych menen, eki zhuzduulorgo karshy til zhana chekterdi ornotuu menen sogush. Alar senden sestenuuloru uchun kataal bol. Alardyn kyiamat kunu bara turgan zhaiy tozok. Alardyn kaityp baraar zhaiy kandai zhaman!

Allakh Aga zhana Anyn elchilerine kaapyrlyk kylgandardyn yimanduular menen bolgon bailanyshy ech kandai paida keltirbesine, Anyn paigambarlarynan bolgon Nukh menen Luttun aialdaryn misal keltirdi. Ekoosu ten' takyba pendelerdin aialdary ele. Alar Allakhtyn zholunan tosup zhana koomundagy kaapyrlarga zhardam berip, kuiooloruno kyianattyk kylyshty. Alar takyba pendelerdin aialdary bolushkany alarga ech paida keltirgen zhok. Al ekoosuno: <<Kaapyrlar zhana buzukular menen birge tozokko kirgile>> - dep aityldy.

Zhana Allakh Aga zhana Anyn elchilerine yiman keltirgenderdin kaapyrlar menen bolgon bailanyshy alarga ech zyian berbestigine zhana alar akyikatta bolgon kezde ech kandai taasir tiigizbestigine Faraondun aialynyn abalyn aityp misal keltirdi. Bir kezde al aitty: <<Oo, Rabbim! Maga beiishte Ozun'dun aldyn'da ui kurup ber, meni Faraondun zulumdugunan, biiliginen zhana zhaman ishterinen sakta zhana chekten chygyp zulumduk kyluuda any eerchip, ozdoruno zyian keltirgen adamdardan sakta>>.

Zhana Allakh Aga zhana Anyn elchilerine yiman keltirgenderge abiiirduu zherin zynadan saktagan Imrandyn kyzy Mariiamdyn abalyn misal kyldy. Allakh Zhebreildi aga uilo dep buirudu, anan Allakhtyn kudureti menen Mariiamdyn uulu Isa atasyz anyn boiuna buttu. Al Allakhtyn shariiattaryn zhana elchilerge tushkon kitepterin tastyktady. Al Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Aga moiun sunuuchulardan ele.
Mulk zhalgyz Anyn kolunda bolgon Allakhtyn zhakshylygy koboidu zhana uluk boldu. Al bardyk nersege kudurettuu. Any ech nerse alsyrata albait.
Oo, adamdar! Al silerdin kimin'er zhakshy ish-araketterdi kylaryn'ardy synash uchun olum menen zhashoonu zharatty. Al ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu, toobo kylgan pendelerine Kechirimduu.

Al zheti asmandy zharatty. Alardyn ar biri eki asman biri-birine tiiishpegendei ozunon murunku asmandan zhogoru turgan ozuncho bir katmar. Oo, nazar saluuchu! Sen Allakhtyn zharatkandarynan ech kandai aiyrmachylykty zhana kelishpestikti tappaisyn'. Dagy bir zholu karap korchu! Sen kandaidyr bir zharyluunu zhe bolunuunu korup zhatasyn'by? Andaidy ech kachan korboisun'. Akyikatta sen cheberchilik zhana taktyk menen zharatylgan nerseni gana korosun'.
Andan kiiin da ulam-ulam karap korchu! Kozun' saga asmandyn zharaluusunan ech kandai aiyp-kemchilikti korboston, kor bolgon zhana karagysy kelbei charchagan abalda ozun'o kaitat.

Zhana Biz zherge en' zhakyn asmandy zharkyragan zhyldyzdar menen koozdoduk zhana al zhyldyzdardy soz tyn'shagan zhin-shaitandarda atyluuchu chok tash kyldyk. Biz alar uchun akyrette zhalyndagan ottu daiardap koiduk.
Al emi Rabbisine kaapyrlyk kylgandarga kyiamat kunu aloolongon tozok azaby daiardalgan. Alardyn kaityp baraar zhaiy kandai zhaman!
Alar tozokko yrgytylganda, kazan burkuldap kainagan syiaktuu burkuldagan zhaman undu ugushtu.

Al aga kirgen adamdarga katuu kaardanganynan, biri-birinen bolunup-zharylyp ketchudoi bolot. Aga tozoktuk kaapyrlardyn tobu yrgytylgan saiyn, aga zhoopker bolgon perishteler alardy zhemelep: <<Silerge duinodo Allakhtyn azabyn eskertken paigambar kelgen emes bele?>> - dep surashat.

Kaapyrlar aityshty: <<Ooba, bizge Allakhtyn azabyn eskertken paigambar kelgen, birok biz any zhalganga chygaryp myndai degenbiz: <<Allakh ech kandai vakhii tushurgon zhok. Ei, elchiler! Siler akyikattan katuu adashyp ketkensin'er>>.

Kaapyrlar aityshty: <<Egerde biz paida ala turgandai den'geelde ukkanybyzda zhe chyndykty zhalgandan aiyrmalai turgandai abalda akyl zhugurtkonubuzdo, tozoktuk adamdardyn katarynda bolboit elek. Teskerisinche, paigambarlarga yiman keltirip, alardyn alyp kelgenin chyndyk dep tastyktap zhana beiishtik adamdardan bolmokpuz>>.
Oshentip alar ozdorunun kaapyrlygyn zhana zhalganga chygargandaryn moiundaryna alyp, tozokko tatyktuu bolushtu. Alys bolsun, tozok eeleri!

Allakh kaapyrlar zhana alardyn zhazasy tuuraluu aitkandan kiiin, yimanduular zhana alardyn syilygy tuuraluu aityp, myndai dedi:
Chyndygynda zhalgyz kalgan kezde Allakhtan korkkondor uchun kunooloruno kechirim zhana uluu syilyk bolgon beiish bar.
Oo, adamdar! Siler sozun'ordu zhashyrasyn'arby zhe achyk aitasyn'arby, Al pendelerinin zhurogundogu nerselerdi Biluuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.
Butkul makuluktardy Zharatuuchu syrdy zhe syrdan da zhashyruun bolgon nerselerdi bilbeit beken? Al pendelerine Booruker, alardyn ishterinen Kabardar. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.

Al silerge zherdi zhashoo uchun yn'gailuu zhana tegiz kyldy. Emi siler anyn ar tarabynda zhurup, Anyn siler uchun daiardap koigon yryskysynan zhegile. Surak beruu zhana syilyk-zhaza aluu uchun kaira tirilip Aga gana barasyn'ar.

Zher beti zhashoogo yn'gailuu bolgondon kiiin Allakh any Karundun astynan achyp zhibergendei, silerdin da astyn'ardan achyp zhiberbeit dep ishenesin'erbi? Al tynch abalynan kiiin, silerdi kutuusuzdon silkildetip bashtait.

Zhe bolboso, asmandagy Allakh Luttun koomuna asmandan tash zhaadyrgandai, silerge da zhaadyrbait dep ishenesin'erbi? Siler zhakynda Menin zhazamdy zhana eskertmemdi korgondo bilesin'er. Birok siler azapty korgondon kiiin andan ech paida albaisyn'ar.

Al mushrikterden murunku koomdor dagy zhalganga chygaryshty. Alar kaapyrlyktan zhana zhalganga chygaruudan kaitpai turup alyshkanda, alarga Allakhtyn azaby tushtu. Menin alardy chetke kakkanym kandai boldu? Al kataal chetke kaguu boldu.

Al zhalganchylar ustulorundo uchup baratkan, abada kanatyn birde zhaiyp, birde zhyigan kushka karashpaiby? Alardy Allakh gana zherge tushurboi karmap turat. Chyndygynda Al bardyk nerselerdi Koruuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.
Ei, kaapyrlar! Egerde Allakh silerdi azaptoonu kaalasa, anda silerdi Anyn azabynan korgoi turgan askerin'er zhok. Kaapyrlar aldanuuda, alar shaitanga azrygylyp aldanyshty.

Egerde Allakh silerge yryskysyn zhetkirbei toktotup koiso, ech kim silerge yrysky bere albait. Birok natyizhada alar karshylashuunu, tekeberlik kyluunu zhana akyikattan bash tartuunu toktotushkan zhok.
Kimisi en' tuura zholdo ketuuchu: zhuzun zherge salyp baskan mushrikpi, zhe tuura zholdo tuz baskan yimanduu adamby?

Oo, paigambar! Al zhalganchy mushrikterge ait: <<Allakh silerdi zharatty zhana silerge uguu uchun kulakty, koruu uchun kozdu, akyl zhugurtuu uchun zhuroktu berdi. Siler Allakhtyn bergen zhakshylyktaryna az shugur kylasyn'ar>>.

Oo, paigambar! Al zhalganchy mushrikterge ait: <<Allakh silerdi zher betine tarkatty zhana zhaiyltty. Any ech nerseni zharata albagan kudailaryn'ar kylgan zhok. Kyiamat kunu surak beruu zhana zhaza-syilyk aluu uchun kudailaryn'arga emes, Aga gana zhyinalasyn'ar>>.

Kaira tiriluunu zhalganga chygaryp, any mumkun emes degender aityshat: <<Oo, Mukhammad! Sen zhana senin sakhabalaryn' aityp zhatkan sozun'ordo chynchyl bolson'or, anda bizge any kelet dep aitkan bul ubadan'ar kachan bolot?>>.
Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Kyiamattyn ilimi Allakhtyn gana aldynda. Anyn kachan bolorun Al gana bilet. Men bolgonu silerge achyk eskertuuchumun>>.

Kachan alardyn bashyna ubada kylyngan nerse tushkondo zhana alar kyiamatta azaptyn zhakyndaganyn korushkondo, Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandardyn zhuzdoru ozgorup, karaiyp ketet. Alarga: <<Siler duinodo ushul nerseni talap kylyp shashtyrgansyn'ar>> - dep aitylat.

O, paigambar! Al zhalganchy mushrikterdi zhekirip: <<Aitkylachy, eger Allakh meni zhana meni menen birge bolgon yimanduulardy olturso, zhe bizge yraiym kylyp, azhalybyzdy kechiktirse, anda kaapyrlardy kyinoochu azaptan kim kutkarat. Alardy ech kim kutkarbait>> - degin.

Oo, paigambar! Al mushrikterge aitkyn: <<Al - Yraiymduu. Al silerdi zhalgyz Ozuno syiynuuga chakyrat. Biz bardyk ishteribizde Aga gana taianabyz. Zhakynda siler kim anyk adashuuda zhana kim tuura zholdo ekenin sozsuz bilesin'er>>.

Oo, paigambar! Al mushrikterge aitkyn: <<Aitkylachy, eger silerdin ichip zhatkan suun'ar, siler zhetpegendei abalda zherge sin'ip ketse, anda silerge akkan mol suunu kim alyp kelet? Allakhtan bashka ech kim alyp kele albait>>.
(n) Nuun. Ushuga okshogon aiattyn tushundurmosu bakara suroosunun bashynda kelgen. Allakh kalem menen ant berdi zhana adamdar kalemderi menen zhazgan nerselerge ant berdi.
Oo, paigambar! Sen Allakhtyn zhakshylyk kylyp bergen paigambarchylygy sebeptuu zhindi emessin'. Teskerisinche, sen mushrikterdin zhindi dep aitkan zhalaasynan tazasyn'.
Chyndygynda sen Kuranda kelgen uluu kulk-munozdosun' zhana andagy boiuncha en' sonun sypattasyn'.
Zhakynda sen dagy korosun', al zhalganchylar da korushot.
Oo, paigambar! Sen alyp kelgendi zhalganga chygargandarga moiun sunba!
Alar kasam ichishkende <<Allakh kaalasa>> degen sozdu aityshpady.
Anan eeleri uktap zhatkanda Allakh aga ot zhiberip, al any zhalmady. Alar any otton saktap kala alyshpady.
Oshondo al karan'gy tundoi kapkara bolup kaldy.
Anan alar tan' zaarda biri-birin chakyryshty.
<<Egerde tushumdu zhyinai turgan bolson'or, kedei-kembagaldar kelgiche, zherin'erge ertereek bargyla>> - dep aityshty.
Oshentip alar biri-biri menen akyryn suiloshup, shashylgan boidon zherlerine zhonoshtu.
Alar biri-birine: <<Bugun bakchan'arga ech bir kembagal kirbeit>> - dep zhatyshty.
Alar tan' erte momolordu berbeibiz degen oido baratyshty.
Kachan alar anyn kuiup kalganyn korushkondo, biri-birine aityshty: <<Biz zholdon adashyp kaldyk okshoit.
Zhok! Biz kedei-kembagaldarga berbeibiz dep zhatyp, ozubuz tushumdon kuru zhalak kalyptyrbyz>>.
Alardyn zhakshyraagy aitty: <<Siler andan kedei-kembagaldarga berbeibiz dep chechim kylganyn'arda men silerge: <<Allakhty aruulap, Aga toobo kylsan'ar bolboibu?>> - dep aitkan elem go>> - dedi.
Aityshty: <<Rabbibiz Aruu! Biz bakchabyzdyn momosunon kedei-kembagaldarga berbeibiz dep chechip, ozubuzgo zyian kylgandardan bolduk>>.
Anan alar biri-birine karap, zheme sozdordu aityp bashtashty.
Alar okunup myndai deshti: <<Kurugur ekenbiz go! Biz kedeilerdin akysyn berbei, chekten chygyp ketiptirbiz.
Balkim Rabbibiz bizge bakchanyn orduna andan da zhakshysyn beret. Chyndygynda biz Allakhty gana kaalaibyz, Andan kechirimdi umut kylabyz zhana zhakshylykty suraibyz>>.
Bizge bash iibestik kylgandardy myna ushintip yryskydan kuru zhalak kaltyruu menen azaptaibyz. Al emi akyret azaby myndan da chon', eger alar anyn kataaldygyn zhana uzaktygyn bilishken bolso.
Chyndygynda Allakhtyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkondor uchun Rabbisinin aldynda zhyrgalchylyk beiishteri bar. Alar al zhakta tuboluk zhyrgalchylykta yrakhattanyshat.
Biz Mekke mushrikteri oilogondoi, zhazaloodo musulmandardy kaapyrlardai kylyp koiot bekenbiz?
Ei, mushrikter! Silerge emne boldu, bul adiletsiz zhana burmalangan okum menen kantip okum chygaryp zhatasyn'ar?
Zhe silerde bash iigen adam menen kunookordu birdei dep okugan kitebin'er barby?
Al kitepte siler uchun akyrette ozun'or kaalagandy tandagan nerseler barby?
Zhe silerde ozun'or okum kylgan nerseler bolot degendei talaptagy anttar menen tastyktalgan ubadalarybyz barby?
Oo, paigambar! Bul sozdu aitkandardan: <<Kim buga kepildik bere alat?>> - dep surachy.

Zhe zhaza beruudo alardy musulmandar menen birdei kylgan alardyn Allakhtan bashka sherikteri bar beken? Egerde alar zhaza aluuda musulmandar menen birdeibiz degen sozundo chynchyl bolushsa, anda oshol sherikterin alyp kelishsin.

Kyiamat kunu korkunuch paida bolup, Rabbibiz Baltyryn achyk korgozot zhana adamdar sazhda kyluuga chakyrylganda, yimanduular sazhda kylyshat, al emi kaapyrlar menen eki zhuzduulor sazhda kyla alyshpait.
Kozdoru zher karap, alardy korduk zhana okunuch basty. Alar duinodo bugunku kundogudon sak-salamatta bolgon kezde Allakhka sazhda kyluuga chakyrylgan ele.

Oo, paigambar! Saga tushkon bul Kurandy zhalgan degenderdi Maga tashta. Biz alardy akyryndyk menen azapka alyp barabyz, alar bul aila-amal zhana az-azdan zhazaloo alarga karshy koldonulganyn bilishpeit.
Men alarga kunoolorun kylyp alganga moonot berem. Chyndygynda kaapyrlarga zhana zhalganchylarga karata Menin amalkoilugum kuchtuu. Alar Menin zhazamdan aman kalyshpait.

Oo, paigambar! Sen chakyrgan nersen' uchun alardan aky surap, alar ushundan ulam oor ishti kotorup zhatyshaby, alardyn senden bash tartuusunun sebebi ushulbu? Chynynda andai emes. Sen alardan aky suragan zhoksun'. Anda alardyn seni eerchishine emne toskool bolup zhatat?
Zhe alarda kaiyp ilimi barby zhana alar seni menen talashyp-tartyshkan ozdoruno zhakkan dalilderdi zhazyshaby?

Oo, paigambar! Rabbin'din alarga moonot berip, akyryndyk menen zhazalaim degen okumuno sabyr kyl. Koomunan tazhoodo kittin eesi Iunustai bolbo. Al den'iz karan'gylygy menen kittin kursagyndagy karan'gylykta kyiynchylyk abalda turganda Rabbisine chakyryk saldy.
Egerde aga Allakhtyn yraiymy zhetpegende, kit any zhemege kalgan abalda een zherge tashtap koimok.
Anan Rabbisi any tandap, takyba pendelerinen kyldy.

Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyp, Anyn elchisin zhalganga chygargandar, saga tushkon Kurandy ukkan kezde seni akyraia tiktep, kozdoru menen seni kotoro chaap zhibereiin deshet zhana alar oz kaaloolorun eerchip, akyikattan bash tartkan abalda: <<Chyndygynda munu alyp kelgen paigambar anyk zhindi>> - dep aityshat.
Saga tushurulgon Kuran - adamzat menen zhinder uchun gana bolgon eskertme zhana nasaat.
Allakh baaryna anyk kele turgan kaira tiriluu ubaktysyn eskerdi.
Andan son' <<Anyk Keluuchu degen emne?>> degen suroo menen anyn ordun dan'azalady.
Sen al Anyk keluuchu emne ekenin kaidan bilmek elen'?
Salikhtin koomu Samud menen Khuddun koomu Aad korkunuchtarynyn kataaaldygy menen adamdarga sokku urgan kyiamatty zhalganga chygaryshty.
Allakh Samuddu kuchtuuluk zhana korkunuch zhaktan chegine zhetken katuu kyikyryk menen zhok kyldy.
Al emi Aaddy kataaldyk zhaktan chegine zhetken yzgaarduu suuk shamal menen zhok kyldy.

Allakh any alarga zheti tun, segiz kungo zhiberip, al alardyn birin da kaltyrbai zhok kyldy. Sen alardy kyiroogo uchuragandan kiiin zherge kulap chirip kalgan kurmanyn tamyrlary syiaktuu oz turak-zhailarynda zherde sulap olup zhatkandaryn korosun'.
Sen alardyn bashyna tushkon azaptan kiiin tiruu kalgan zhandy kordun'bu?
Faraon zhana andan murunku koomdor zhana zher astyn-ustun bolup azaptalgan Luttun koomunun shaary shirk zhana kunoolordu kyluu syiaktuu tuura emes ishterdi zhasashty.
Alardyn baarysy alarga zhiberilgen paigambaryna karshy chygyshty zhana any zhalganga chygaryshty. Oshondo Allakh alardy tubuno zhete turgandai den'geelde ashykcha kuch menen karmady.
Suu kotorulup chekten ashkanda, Biz Oz buirugubuz menen silerdi belderinde kotorup zhurgon adamdardy Nukh zhasagan suzuuchu kemege saldyk, alar silerdi kotuurulor boldu.
Biz al kemeni zhana anyn okuiasyn kaapyrlardyn zhok kylynyshyna zhana yimanduulardyn kutkarylyshyna dalil bolsun dep zhana any kuima kulak adam ukkanda zhattap alsyn dep sabak kyldyk.
Surnai tartuuga zhoopker bolgon perishte bir zholu uilogondo, (al surnaidyn ekinchi zholu tartyluusu)
Zher menen toolor kotorulot zhana alar bir zholu katuu byrkyrap talkalanyp, zher menen toolordun bolukcholorun bolup salat.
Ushulardyn baary bolgon kunu kyiamat bolot.
Al kundo perishteler tushuu uchun asman achylat. Oshol kunu al alsyz bolot, aga cheiin bekem zhana kubattuu ele.
Al emi anyn chet zhakalarynda perishteler bolot. Oshol uluu kundo Rabbin'din Arshyn segiz zhakyn perishteleri kotorot.
Oo, adamdar! Oshol kundo Allakhtyn aldyna turasyn'ar. Silerde kandai gana syr bolbosun, al Allakhka zhashyruun kalbait. Teskerisinche, Allakh any Biluuchu zhana Kabardar.
Kimge ish-araketteri zhazylgan kitebi on' tarabynan berilse, al suiungonunon myndai dep aitat: <<Mynakei! Menin ish-araketter zhazylgan kitebimdi alyp okugula.
Men duinodo kaira tirilerimdi zhana syilygyma zholugarymdy anyk bilchumun>>.
Al tuboluk zhyrgalchylykty korgondo kon'uldogudoi zhashoodo bolot.
Ordu zhana darazhasy biiik beiishte bolot.
Anyn momo-zhemishteri any uzuuchugo zhakyn bolot.
Alarga syi-urmat katary: <<Duinodogu otkon kundordo kylgan zhakshylyk ishterin'er sebeptuu ech kandai zyian tartpastan zhegile zhana ichkile>> - dep aitylat.

Al emi kimge ish-araketteri zhazylgan kitebi sol tarabynan berilse, anda al katuu okunuchton myndai dep aitat: <<Attin'-ai, maga amal kitebim berilbei ele koiso eken. Al zhakta meni azapka tatyktuu kylgan zhamandyk ishterim bar.
Attin'-ai, suragym kandai bolorun bilbei kalsam eken.
Attin', men olgon olum, andan kiiin kaira tiriluu bolbogon olum bolup kalsa kana!
Mal-mulkum meni Allakhtyn azabynan ech korgoi albady.
Ech kandai dalilim kalbady zhana men taiangan kuch-kubat da, kadyr-bark da zhok boldu>>.
Aga aitylat: <<Ei, perishteler! Any karmagyla da, kolun moinuna bailagyla.
Anan any tozokko kirgizgile, al anyn ysyktyk azabyn tartsyn.
Andan son' uzundugu zhetimish chykanak bolgon chynzhyrga kirgizgile>>.
Antkeni al uluu Allakhka yiman keltirgen zhok.
Bashkalardy bei-becharaga tamak beruugo chakyrgan zhok.
Emi kyiamat kunu any azaptan korgogon zhakyny bolboit.
Al uchun tozoktogu adamdardyn denesinen chykkan irin'den bashka tamak-ash bolboit.
Al tamak-ashty kunoo zhana zhamandyk ishterdi kylgan adamdar gana zheshet.
Allakh siler korgon nerseler menen ant berdi.
Zhana siler korbogon nerseler menen ant berdi.
Chyndygynda Kuran - Allakhtyn sozu. Any uluu paigambary adamdarga okup beret.
Al akyndyn sozu emes. Antkeni al poeziianyn yrgaktaryna tuura kelbeit. Siler az yiman keltiresin'er.
Al kozu achyktyn sozu emes. Kozu achyktardyn sozu bul Kurandan aiyrmalanyp turat. Siler az eskeresin'er.
Birok al butkul makuluktardyn Rabbisi taraptan tushurulgon.
Egerde Mukhammad Biz aitpagan ele kee bir sozdordu Bizdin atybyzdan oilop chygargan bolso,
Biz andan och almakpyz zhana any Oz kuch-kuduretibiz menen karmamakpyz.
Kiiin anyn zhurogu menen bailanyshkan tamyryn kesip salmakpyz.
Oshondo aran'ardan ech kim any Bizden korgoi albait. Al siler uchun Biz atybyzdan zhalgan aituusu mumkun emes.
Chyndygynda Kuran Rabbisinin buirugun atkaryp, Anyn tyigandaryn tashtagan takyba adamdar uchun nasyiat.
Biz silerdin aran'arda bul Kuran tuuraluu zhalgan aitkan adamdar bar ekenin bilebiz.
Kurandy zhalganga chygaruu - kyiamat kunundogu chon' okunuch.
Chyndygynda Kuran - Allakh taraptan ekendiginde ech kandai shek-kumonu zhok anyk chyndyk.
Oo, paigambar! Rabbin'di Aga ylaiyk kelbegen nerselerden aruula zhana uluu Rabbin'din ysymyn esker.
Mushrikterden bir suroochu adam, eger bul azap bolo turgan bolso, maga zhana elime azap bolsunchu dep surady. Bul anyn shyldyn'y bolchu. Al kyiamat kunu bolot.
Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandarga. Al azapty ech kim kaitara albait.
Al biiiktik, darazhalar, artykchylyktar zhana zhakshylyktar Eesi Allakh taraptan.
Kyiamat kunu perishteler Aga kotorulot zhana Zhebreil da oshol darazhalarda bolot. Al uzaktygy eluu min' zhylga barabar uzak kun.
Oo, paigambar! Ech kandai korkunuch zhana aryz-mun' bolbogon sabyrduuluk menen sabyr kyl.
Alar bul azapty bolushu mumkun emestei alys dep esepteshet.
Biz bolso anyn anyk boloruna zhakyn kalganyn korup turabyz.
Al kundo asman eritilgen zhez, altyn zhe bashka syiaktuu bolot.
Toolor bolso zhundoi ulpuldok bolup kalat.
Zhakyn zhakynynyn akybalyn surabait. Antkeni ar biri ozu menen gana alek bolup kalat.
Ar bir adam oz zhakynyn korot, al aga zhashyruun bolboit. Aga karabastan al zherdegi korkunuchtan ulam ech kim ech kimdi surabait. Tozokko tatyktuu adam ozunun orduna baldaryn beruunu kaalait.
Aialyn zhana aga-inilerin sadaga chapkysy kelet.
Kyiynchylyktarda any menen birge turgan zhakyn tuugandaryn ozunun atynan sadaga chapkysy kelet.
Zher betindegi butkul adamzat zhana zhinderdi sadaga chapkysy kelet. Anan oshol sadagasyn berip, ozun tozok azabynan kutkaruunu kaalait.
Abal al kunookor en'segendei emes! Al akyrettin aloolonup zhalyndagan tozogu.
Anyn katuu ysyktygynan zhana zhalynynan bash terisi shylynyp tushot.
Al akyikattan bash tartkandardy, andan alystatkandardy, aga yiman keltirbegenderdi zhana any ish zhuzundo atkarbagandardy chakyrat.
Zhana bailyk zhyinap, andan Allakh zholuna sarptoogo saran'dyk kylgandardy chakyrat.
Chyndygynda insan oto achkoz bolup zharatylgan.
Eger al oorudan zhe kedeilikten zyian tartsa, az sabyr kylat.
Eger al tushumduuluk zhe bailyk syiaktuu aga zhakkan nersege zhetse, any Allakh zholuna sarptagysy kelbei katuuluk kylat.
Namaz okugandar gana andai emes. Alar myndai aiyptuu sypattardan taza.
Alar namazdaryn takai okushat, andan alaksyshpait zhana any belgilengen ubaktysynda atkaryshat.
Alardyn mal-mulkundo parz bolgon belgiluu olchomdogu ulush bar.
Alar any kandai sebep bolbosun, yryskydan kuru kalyp suragandarga zhana surabagandarga berishet.
Alar kyiamat kunun chyndyk dep tastyktashat. Al kunu Allakh ar bir adamga ozuno tatyktuu syilykty zhe zhazany beret.
Alar kylgan zhakshylyk ishterine karabastan, Rabbisinin azabynan korkushat.
Chyndygynda Rabbin'din azaby korkunuchtuu, andan ech bir akylduu koopsuz bolo albait.
Alar zhynys mucholorun zhabuu zhana buzukuluktan alys kyluu menen saktashat.
Aialdarynan zhe kol astyndagy kun'dorunon gana saktashpait. Alar menen zhynystyk mamile zhe bashka nerselerdi kylyp yrakhat aluuda aiyptuu emes.
Kim zhogoruda aitylgandai aialdary menen kundorunon bashkadan yrakhat aluunu kaalasa, myna osholor Allakhtyn chekterinen chykkandar.
Alar bergen kuboluktorun talaptagydai atkargandar. Kubo boluuga tuugandyk da, dushmandyk da taasir bergen emes.
Alar namazdaryn oz ubagynda okup, daarat zhana beipildik menen saktagandar. Alardy andan ech nerse alaksytpait.
Myna ushundai sypattardagy adamdar - beiishterde tuboluk zhyrgalchylykka tush bolup zhana Allakhtyn asyl Zhuzun korup syiga bolongondor.
Alar kaapyrlykta bolup turup, Allakhtan ar birin tuboluktuu zhyrgalchylykta yrakhattangan zhyrgalchylyk beiishine kirgizuunu umut kylyshaby?

Abal alar elestetkendei emes. Biz alardy ozdoru bilgen nerseden zharattyk. Alardy zhiiirkenichtuu suudan zharatkanbyz. Alar ozdoruno paida da, zyian da keltire albagandai alsyz ele. Emi kandaicha tekeberlenip zhatyshat?
Chygyshtyn, batyshtyn, Kundun, Aidyn zhana bashka planetalardyn Rabbisi bolgon Allakh Ozu menen kasam ichip: Biz Kudurettuubuz...

alardy Allakhka moiun sungandar menen almashtyryp koiuuga zhana alardy zhok kyluuga. Biz buga alsyz emespiz zhana kachan Biz alardy zhok kyluunu zhana bashkalarga almashtyruunu kaalasak, ech kim Bizge ustom kyla albait.
Oo, paigambar! Alardy oshol zhalganga zhana adashuuga batkan abaldarynda tashtap koi. Alar Kuranda ubada kylyngan kyiamat kununo zholukkanga cheiin duino zhashoolorunda oinop zhuro berishsin.
Oshol kunu alar zhelekke karai zharyshkan syiaktuu kabyrlarynan shashylyp chygyshat.
Kozdoru zher karap, alardy korduk basat. Bul alarga duinodo ubada kylyngan kun. Alar aga kon'ul burushkan emes.
Biz Nukhtu koomun chakyrysh uchun, alarga Allakhka shirk kylgandary sebeptuu kyinoochu azap kelerden murun eskertkin dep zhiberdik.
Nukh koomuna aitty: <<Oo, elim! Egerde Allakhka toobo kylbasan'ar, men silerdi kutkon azapty anyk eskertuuchumun.

Menin silerge bolgon eskertmemdin talaby myndaicha: <<Allakhka gana syiyngyla, Aga ech nerseni sherik kylbagyla, Anyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkula zhana men buirugan nerselerde maga bash iigile.
Nukh aitty: <<Oo, Rabbim! Men elimdi kunu-tunu tynbastan Saga ibadat kyluuga zhana Saga gana syiynuuga chakyrdym.

Men alardy Saga gana ibadat kyluu, Saga zhana Senin elchin'e moiun sunuu syiaktuu alardyn kunoolorunun kechirilishine sebep bolgon nerselerge chakyrgan saiyn, alar menin chakyrygymdy ukpash uchun manzhalaryn kulaktaryna tygyp, meni korbosh uchun betterin kiiimderi menen zhaap, shirk kyluunu ulanta berishti zhana men alardy chakyrgan nerseni kabyl alyp, aga bash iiuudon tekeberlenishti.
Oo, Rabbim! Kiiin men alardy achyk turdo chakyrdym.
Alarga aittym: <<Oo, elim! Rabbin'erge toobo kylyp, Andan kechirim suragyla. Chyndygynda Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerine Kechirimduu.
Egerde siler munu atkarsan'ar, Allakh siler muktazh bolgon saiyn noshorlogon zhamgyr zhaadyrat zhana silerde kurgakchylyk bolboit.
Zhana silerge kop mal-mulk zhana bala-chaka beret, siler momo-zhemishinen zhegen bakchalardy kylat zhana siler ichuu uchun zhana zherlerin'erdi, maldaryn'ardy suugaruu uchun daryialardy kylat.
Oo, elim! Emne uchun siler ech nersege karabai Allakhka bash iibestik kylyp, Anyn uluulugunan korkpoi zhatasyn'ar?
Al silerdi bel suudan, kiiin uiugan kandan, kiiin uzum etten etap-etaby menen zharatty.
Allakh zheti asmandy, asman ustuno asman kylyp kantip zharatkanyn korboi zhatasyn'arby?
Duino asmanyna Aidy zhaigashtyrdy, andan zherdin zhashoochularyna nur chachyrait. Al emi Kundu zharyk kyldy.
Andan son' silerdi olumdon kiiin kaira aga kaitarat. Kiiin andan kaira tiriltip chygarat.
Allakh siler uchun zherdi zhashoogo ylaiyktuu tegiz kyldy.
Balkim siler adal yrysky izdesh uchun andagy kenen zholdordo zhurosun'or.

Nukh aitty: <<Oo, Rabbim! Chyndygynda koomum zhalgyz Saga syiynuu zhana Ozun'o gana ibadat kyluu syiaktuu men alardy buirugan nerselerge bash iibestik kylyshty zhana arasyn'dagy tomon adamdar Sen bailyk zhana bala-chaka bergen bashchylaryn eerchip ketishti. Alar bolso Senin bergen zhakshylyktaryn' menen alardyn adashuularyn kaira kuchottu.
Alardyn chon'doru tomon adamdardy Nukhka karshy tukurup, chon' aila-amal kylyshty.
Alardy eerchigenderge aityshty: <<Kudailaryn'arga syiyngandy tashtabagyla zhana silerdin aikelderin'er Vaddy, Suvaany, Iagustu, Iauktu zhana Nasrdy tashtabagyla>>.
Alar bul aikelderi menen koptogon adamdardy adashtyrdy. Oo, Rabbim! Kaapyrlyktan zhana kunoolordon bash tartpai ozdoruno zulumduk kylgandardyn akyikattan adashuusun koboit.
Alar kylgan kunooloru sebeptuu duinodo topon suuga chokturuldu. Anan olumdon kiiin tuz tozokko kirgizilip, alardy choguudon zhana tozokton kutkarganga Allakhtan bashka ech bir zhardamchy tabyshpady.
Kachan Allakh Nukhka buga cheiin yiman keltirgenderden bashka ech kim yiman keltirbeit dep kabar bergende, al aitty: <<Oo, Rabbim! Zher betinde ailangan zhe kybyr etken bir da kaapyrdy kaltyrba.

Rabbibiz! Egerde Sen alardy tashtap, alarga moonot bersen', yimanduu pendelerin'di adashtyryshat zhana Saga moiun sunbagan, zhakshylyktaryn'a shugur kylbai, kaapyrlykty katuu karmangan buzuku adamdardy toroshot.
Rabbim! Menin kunoolorumdu kechir, ata-enemdin kunoolorun kechir, menin uiumo yimanduu bolup kirgenderdi kechir zhana yimanduu erkekter menen yimanduu aialdardy kechir>>.

Oo, paigambar! Ummotun'o ait: <<Allakh maga vakhii kyldy, zhinderdin bir zhamaaty menin Kuran okuganymdy Nakhla oroonundo ugushtu. Kachan alar oz koomuna kaityp kelishkende, alarga aityshty: <<Chyndygynda biz aikyndyk zhana chechendik menen okulup zhatkan suktanarlyk sozdu uktuk.
Biz ukkan bul soz ishenimde, sozdo zhana ish-arakette tuuralykka bagyttait eken. Oshonduktan biz aga yiman keltirdik zhana any kimdir-biroogo tushurgon Rabbibizge shirk kylbaibyz.
Oshondoi ele mushrikter aitkandai Al Ozuno ech kandai aial da, perzent da algan emes. Rabbibizdin uluulugu zhana kasiettuulugu biiik boldu.
Al emi Iblis bolso, Allakhtyn aialy bar, balasy bar dep Aga karshy burmalangan zhalaa sozdu aityp zhuruptur.
Biz adamzat menen zhinderden bolgon mushrikterdin Anyn aialy zhana balasy bar degen oilorunda zhalgan aityshpait dep oilogonbuz. Oshonduktan biz alardy eerchip, aitkan sozdoruno ishengenbiz.

Karan'gylyk doordo adamzattan bolgon kee bir erkekter korkunuchtuu zherge zhailanyshkanda airym erkek zhinderden korgoo surashyp, arasynan kee biri: <<Men bul oroondun kozhoiununan anyn koomunun akylsyzdarynyn zyianynan korgoo suraimyn>> - dep aitchy. Oshentip adamzattan bolgon erkekterdin zhinderden bolgon erkekterden bolgon korkunuchu zhana sestenuusu kuch alchy.
Ei, zhinder! Adamzat da siler oilogondoi, Allakh ech kimdi olgondon kiiin surak aluu uchun zhana syilyk-zhazasyn beruu uchun kaira tiriltpeit dep oilogon.

Biz asman kabarlaryn izdedik, birok asman biz muruntan kylyp zhurgon soz tyn'shoodon any korgogon kuchtuu kuzotchu perishtelerge tolgonun zhana al asmanga zhakyndagandardyn baaryna karshy atylgan zhalynduu ottorgo tolgonun korduk.

Biz murun asmandagy ataiyn orundarga olturup, andan perishtelerdin oz ara suiloshkon sozdorun ukchubuz. Kiiin any zher betindegi kozu achyktarga aityp beret elek. Emi abal ozgordu. Arabyzdan kim azyr soz tyn'shagan bolso, al uchun daiardalgan zhalynduu ottu korot. Eger al zhakyndachu bolso, anda any kozdoi uchup, kuiguzup zhok kylat.
Biz bul kataal kuzotchuluktun sebebin bilbei zhatabyz, munu menen zher betindegilerge zhamandyk kelgeni zhataby zhe Allakh alarga zhakshylyk kaalap zhataby. Bizge bolso asman kabarlary toktotuldu.
Zhinder zhamaaty! Bizdin arabyzda takyba zhakshylar bar zhana arabyzda kaapyrlar menen buzukular da bar. Bizdin toptorubuz ar bashka zhana kaaloolorubuz ar turduu ele.
Zhana Allakh biz uchun bir nerse kaalasa, biz Andan kutula albastygybyzdy zhana Al bizdi toluk kurchap turgany sebeptuu Andan kachyp kete albastygybyzdy anyk tushunduk.

Kachan biz tuuralykka zhol korgozgon Kurandy ukkanda, aga yiman keltirdik. Kimde-kim Rabbisine yiman keltirse, anda al zhakshylyk ishterinin azaiuusunan zhe murunku kunooloruno kunoo koshuluusunan korkpoit.

Bizdin arabyzda Allakhka syiynyp bash iigen musulmandary bar zhana tuura zholdon adashkandary da bar. Kimde-kim Allakhka syiynyp zhana zhakshylyk ishterdi kylyp moiun sungan bolso, myna osholor tuura zholdu zhana tuuralykty kozdogondor.
Al emi ortoluk zhana tuura zholdon adashkandar, adamzattagy ozdoruno okshogondor menen tozokko otun bolup kuigondor.

Al any zhinderdin bir zhamaaty uktu dep vakhii kylgan syiaktuu aga myndai dep da vakhii kyldy, egerde zhinder menen adamzat Islam zholuna tushup, andagy nerselerdi ish zhuzundo atkaryshsa, anda Allakh alardy mol suu menen kamsyzdait zhana alarga turluu zhakshylyktardy tartuulait.

Biz munu alar Allakhtyn zhakshylygyna shugur kylyshat beken zhe any tanyp ketishet beken dep synash uchun kyldyk. Kim Kurandan zhana andagy osuiattardan zhuz bursa, Rabbisi any kotoro albagan katuu azapka kirgizet.

Mechitter bashkaga taandyk emes, Allakhka gana taandyk. Andyktan al zhakta Allakh menen katar bashkalarga duba kylbagyla. Bolboso chirkoolordogu zhana sinagogalardagy zhoottor menen khristiandardai bolup kalasyn'ar.
Kachan Allakhtyn pendesi Mukhammad Nakhla oroonundo Rabbisine syiynyp zhatkan kezde, zhinder anyn Kuran okup zhatkanyn ugushkanda katuu tygylyshtan ulam birinin ustuno biri chygaiyn dep kaldy.
Oo, paigambar! Al mushrikterge ait: <<Chyndygynda men Rabbime gana duba kylam zhana kim bolbosun, syiynuuda Aga ech kimdi sherik kylbaim>>.
Alarga ait: <<Allakh silerge tagdyr kylgan zyiandy kaitaruuga kuduretim zhetpeit zhana Allakh silerge tyiyp koigon paidany keltiruugo da kuduretim zhetpeit>>.
Alarga ait: <<Eger men Aga bash iibestik kylsam, anda meni Andan ech kim kutkara albait zhana men Andan bashka bash kalkaloochu zhai tappaim>>.

Birok menin kolumdan kelgen nerse - Allakhtyn silerge zhetkir degen buirugun zhana men arkyluu silerge zhiberilgen zholdomosun zhetkiruu. Kimde-kim Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine bash iibestik kylsa, anda anyn tagdyry tuboluk tozokko kiruu bolot, al andan ech kachan chykpait>>.

Kaapyrlar alarga duinodo ubada kylyngan azapty kaiamat kunu korgongo cheiin kaapyrlyktaryn ulanta berishet. Oshol kezde alar kimdin koldoochusu alsyz ekenin zhana kimdin zhardamchylary az ekenin bilishet.
Oo, paigambar! Kaira tiriluunu zhokko chygargan mushrikterge ait: <<Silerge ubada kylyngan azap zhakyn kalganyn zhe anyn Allakh gana bilgen moonotu barby, men bilbeimin>>.
Al but kaiypty Biluuchu. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Al kaiypty ech kimge bildirbeit. Teskerisinche, any zheke Ozu gana bilgen abalda kalat.
Birok, Al Ozu yraazy bolgon paigambarlarga gana kaalaganyn bildiret. Oshondoi ele Al paigambardyn aldy-artynan sakchy perishtelerdi zhiberet, alar any bashka ech kimge bildirbei korgoit.

Paigambar tomonkulordu bilish uchun: andan murunku paigambarlar Rabbisinin alarga zhetkir dep buirugan zholdomolorun zhetkirishti. Antkeni Allakh al arkyluu alardy kamkordukka aldy zhana Allakh perishteler menen paigambarlardyn aldyndagy nerseni Oz ilimi menen kamtyp aldy.
Oo, kiiimine oronup algan (paigambar)!
Tundun bir az bolugundo namaz oku.
Kaalasan', anyn zharymyn zhe uchton birine zhetkenchelik zharymynan azyraagyn namaz oku.
Zhe uchton ekisine zhetkenchilik kosh zhana Kurandy okusan' achyk oku zhana any kyraat kylganda shashylba.
Oo, paigambar! Biz saga salmaktuu soz bolgon Kurandy tushurobuz. Antkeni anda parzdar, zhaza okumdoru, okum-buiruktar, adepter zhana bashka nerseler bar.
Chyndygynda tunku saattar kyraat kyluuda zhurokko en' ylaiyktuu zhana sozdoru en' tuura.
Sen kunduzu zhumushtaryn'dy kylyp, Kuran okuudan alaksyisyn'. Andyktan tundosu namaz oku.
Allakhty turduu zikirler menen esker zhana chyn yklastan syiynyp ozun'du Aga arna.
Al Chygysh menen Batyshtyn Rabbisi. Andan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok. Andyktan Any bardyk ishterin'de taiangan Koldoochu kylyp al.
Zhana zhalganchylardyn shyldyn' zhana sogush sozdoruno sabyr kyl zhana alardy ech kandai zyian keltirbesten tashta.
Bul duinonun zhyrgalchylygynan yrakhat algan zhalganchylardyn abalyna kon'ul burba, alardy Maga tashta zhana alardyn moonotu kelgenge cheiin bir az kut.
Chyndygynda akyrette Bizdin aldybyzda oor kishender zhana aloolongon ot bar.
Zhana oto achuulugunan kekirtekke keptelgen tamak-ash menen murunkudan da ashykcha kyinoochu azap bar.
Al azap zher zhana toolor titiregen kunu zhalganchylarga bolot. Toolor katuu korkunuchtan ulam byryksygan zhana agylgan kumdai bolup kalat.
Biz Faraongo Musany paigambar kylyp zhibergen syiaktuu kyiamat kunu silerdin ish-araketterin'erge kubo boluuchu paigambardy zhiberdik.

Faraon Rabbisi taraptan aga zhiberilgen paigambarga bash iibestik kyldy, anan Biz any duinodo suuga chokturup katuu zhazaladyk zhana akyrette tozok azaby menen zhazalaibyz. Oshonduktan siler dagy paigambaryn'arga bash iibestik kylbagyla, bolboso anyn bashyna tushkon nerse silerge da tushot.

Eger siler Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylyp, Anyn elchisin zhalganga chygargan bolson'or, anda katuu korkunuchtan zhana uzaktygynan zhash baldardyn da chachy agargan uzak kataal kundo ozun'ordu kantip korgoisun'ar?
Asman korkunuchtan bolunup zharylat. Allakhtyn ubadasy sozsuz atkaryldy.

Chyndygynda kyiamat kundogu korkunuch zhana kataaldyk tuuraluu baiandamany kamtygan bul nasyikat - yimanduular paida aluuchu eskertme. Kimde-kim Rabbisine alyp bara turgan zholdu kaalasa, oshol zholgo tushsun.

Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda Rabbin' keede senin tundun uchton ekisinen azyraagyn, keede zharymyn, keede uchton bir bolugun namaz okuganyn'dy bilet zhana yimanduulardyn tobu da seni menen birge turup namaz okushat. Allakh kun menen tundun olchomun belgileit zhana alardyn saattaryn esepteit. Al silerdi anyn saattaryn taktyk menen esebin chygara albai, al sebeptuu siler kozdogonun'orgo zhetish uchun anyn kopchuluk bolugun namaz okup, kyinalyp kaluun'ar mumkun ekenin bildi. Oshol sebepten Al silerdin toobon'ordu kabyl kyldy. Andyktan alyn'ar kelishinche tundosu namaz okugula. Oo, yimanduular! Allakh silerdin aran'arda oorudan charchagan ooruluular bolushun, kee biroolor Allakhtyn yryskysyn izdep zher kezip zhurgonun, bashkalary bolso Allakhtyn sozu biiik bolsun dep Anyn yraazylygy uchun kaapyrlar menen sogushup zhatkanyn bilet. Myna osholorgo tunku namazdy okush kyiyn. Andyktan alyn'ardyn kelishinche tundosu namaz okugula, parz namazdy talaptagydai toluk atkargyla, mal-mulkun'ordon zeket bergile zhana Allakh zholuna mal-mulkun'ordon sarptagyla. Ozun'or uchun kandai zhakshylyk kylbagyla, any en' zhakshy zhana en' sooptuu abalda tabasyn'ar. Zhana Allakhtan kechirim suragyla. Chyndygynda Allakh toobo kylgan pendelerine Kechirimduu, alarga Yraiymduu.
Oo, kiiimine oronup algan (paigambar)!
Turgun zhana Allakhtyn azabyn eskert!
Rabbin'di ulukta!
Kiiimin'di tazala!
Aikelderge syiynuudan alys bol!
Zhakshylyk ishterdi kop kyldym dep Rabbin'e mildet kylba!
Allakh uchun tartkan zyiandarga sabyr kyl!
Kachan kernei ekinchi zholu tartylganda.
Myna oshol kun - kataal kun.
Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyrlyk kylgandarga on'oi bolboit.
Oo, paigambar! Men enesinin kursagynda bailyksyz zhe balasyz zhalgyz kylyp zharatkan (Valid ibn al'-Mugiirany) Maga tashta.
Men aga kop mal-mulk berdim.
Zhana any menen birge zhurup, chogulushtarga birge katyshkan zhana bailygynyn koptugu sebeptuu saparda da andan bolunbogon uuldardy berdim.
Zhana aga zhashoonu, yryskyny zhana bala-chakany kenen kyldym.
Kiiin al Maga kylgan kaapyrlygyna karabastan, Men aga oshonun baaryn bergenden kiiin dagy koboitso eken dep kaalap zhatat.
Abal al elestetkendei emes. Chyndygynda al paigambarybyzga tushurgon aiattarybyzdy chetke kakty zhana alardy zhalganga chygardy.
Zhakynda Men aga kotoro albagan azaptyn mashakatyn tarttyram.
Men ushundai zhakshylyktardy bergen bul kaapyr Kurandy zhalganga chygaruu tuuraluu aitkanyn oilondu zhana any ichinen bolzhodu.
Kargyshka kalgyr, azapka kalgyr! Kantip bolzhodu?!
Dagy kargyshka kalgyr, azapka kalgyr! Kantip bolzhodu?!
Andan son' al aitkanyna nazar salyp oilonup kordu.
Kiiin al Kurandy zhamandaganga ech nerse tappai kalganda zhuzun tyryshtyryp, kabagyn chytydy.
Andan son' yimandan zhuz burdu zhana paigambardy eerchuudon tekeberlendi.
Anan al myndai dedi: <<Mukhammad alyp kelgen nerse Allakhtyn sozu emes. Teskerisinche, al bashkalar aga aityp bergen syikyr.
Bul Allakhtyn sozu emes, bul adamdyn sozu>>.
Men any zhakynda tozoktun katmarlaryn biri Sakarga kirgizem, al anyn ysyktygynan azap cheget.
Oo, Mukhammad! Sen Sakar emne ekenin kaidan bilmek elen'?
Al andagy azaptalgandyn ech nersesin kaltyrbait. Aga sozsuz kelet, any tashtap koiboit. Kiiin al bashtapky abalyna kaitkanda, aga kairadan kelet. Myna ushintip ailana beret.
Terini katuu kuiguzot zhana ozgortot.
Anyn ustundo on toguz kuzotchu perishteler bar.

Biz tozok sakchylaryn perishtelerden gana kyldyk. Adamzattyn alarga kuchu zhetpeit. Biz, alardyn sanyn Allakhka kaapyr bolgondordu synoo uchun ushundai kyldyk. Biz, alar aitar sozun aityp, azaptary eselep koboiuusu uchun, Toorat berilgen zhoottor menen Inzhil berilgen khristiandar, alardyn kitepterinde aitylgandy tastyktagan Kuran tushkon kezde aikyn biluuloru uchun, Kitep eelerinin (kabary yimanduulardyn ishenimine) dal kelgende yimanduulardyn yimanyn kuchotuu uchun, zhoottor da, khristiandar da, yimanduular da shektenboosu uchun, yimanga kiruudo eki anzhy bolgondor zhana kaapyrlar: <<Allakh bul tan' kalyshtuu san menen emneni kaalap zhatat?>> - dep aituulary uchun ushundai kyldyk. Bul sandy zhokko chygargandardy adashtyruu zhana aga ishengenderdi tuura zholgo salgan syiaktuu, Allakh kaalaganyn adashtyryp, kaalaganyn tuura zholgo salat. Rabbin'din askerleri kop bolgonduktan, alardyn sanyn Ozunon bashka ech kim bilbeit. Tozok adamzatka eskertuu gana, al arkyluu adamdar Allakh taalanyn uluktugun bilishet.
Kee bir mushrikter oilogondoi, any sherikteri tozokton chygaruuga tozok sakchylaryna zhetishtuu dep aitkandai emes. Allakh Ai menen ant berdi.
Zhana kaityp baratkan tungo ant berdi.
Zhana zharyk chachkan tan'ga ant berdi.
Chyndygynda tozok otu chon' baleelerdin biri.
Adamdar uchun eskertuu zhana korkutuu.
Oo, adamdar! Silerdin aran'ardagy Allakhka yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kyluuga umtuluunu zhe kaapyrlyktan zhana kunoolordon ketenchiktoonu kaalagandar uchun.
Ar bir zhan kylgan ishteri sebeptuu karmalyp turat. Zhe kylgan ishteri any zhok kylat, zhe any kyiroodon kutkaryp, saktap kalat.
Yimanduular gana kunooloru uchun karmalyshpait. Teskerisinche, alar zhakshylyk ishteri sebeptuu kunooloru kechirilet.
Alar kyiamat kunu beiishterde biri-birinen surashat.
Kunoo ishterdi kylyp ozdorun kyiroogo uchuratkan kaapyrlar tuuraluu.
Alardan: <<Silerdi tozokko emne kirgizdi?>> - dep surashat.
Kaapyrlar myndai dep zhoop berishet: <<Biz duino zhashoosunda parz namazdy okugandardan emes elek.
Zhana Allakh bizge bergen nerselerden bei-becharalardy tamaktandyrgan emespiz.
Biz zhalganchylar kaida zhurso, osholor menen chogu zhurduk zhana adashkandar menen suiloshchubuz.
Zhana surak kundu zhalgan dep aitchubuz.
Bizge olum kelgenge cheiin any zhalganga chygaruudan bash tartpadyk zhana al bizge toobo kyluuga toskoolduk kyldy>>.

Kyiamatta alarga perishtelerden, paigambarlardan zhana takyba adamdardan bolgon shapaat kyluuchulardyn ortomchulugu paidasyn tiigizbeit. Antkeni, shapaattyn kabyl boluu sharttarynyn biri - shapaat kylyna turgan adamga yraazy boluu.
Bul mushrikterdin Kurandan zhuz buruusuna emne sebep boldu?
Alar zhuz buruuda zhana andan kachuuda katuu urkup kachkan zhapaiy eshekter syiaktuu.
Arstandan korkup kachkan syiaktuu.

Teskerisinche, al mushrikter ar birinin bashynda achyk kitep bolushun zhana al <<Mukhammad - Allakh taraptan kelgen elchi>> dep kabar beruusun kaalashat. Munun sebebi dalilderdin azdygynan zhe zhoktugunan emes, chyndygynda al bash iibestikten zhana tekeberlikten.
Abal andai emes! Munun sebebi alar adashuudan bash tartpaganynda. Alar akyret azabyna ishenbesten, kaapyrlykta kalyshty.
Chyndygynda bul Kuran - nasyikat zhana eskertme emespi!
Kim Kurandy okup, nasaat algysy kelse, any okusun zhana nasaat alsyn.
Birok Allakh nasaat aluusun kaalagandar gana nasaat alyshat. Allakh taala Anyn buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtoogo tatyktuu zhana toobo kylgan pendelerinin kunoolorun kechiruugo da tatyktuu.
Allakh kyiamat kunu menen ant berdi. Al kunu adamdar aalamdardyn Rabbisi uchun turushat.

Zhana zhakshylyk ishterdi kyluuda kemchilikterdi ketirgen zhana kunoolordu kylgan adamdy zhemelegen zhakshy zhan menen ant berdi. Al adamdardy surakka aluu, syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beruu maksatta alardy kaira tiriltuu uchun bul eki nerse menen ant berdi.
Insan olgondon kiiin Biz any kaira tiriltuu uchun sooktorun chogulta albaibyz dep oilop zhataby?
Albette! Biz any chogultuu menen birge anyn manzhalarynyn uchtaryn murdagydai kemchiliksiz zharalgan kalybyna kairadan keltire alabyz.
Birok insan kaira tiriluunu chetke kaguu menen buzukulugun toktotposton ulantuunu kaalait.
Al kyiamat kun bolushu mumkun emes degendei: <<Al kachan bolot?>> - dep surait.
Kachan al zhalgan dep aitkan nerseni korgon kezde kozdoru alan'dap, nes bolup kalat.
Aidyn nuru ochot.
Kun menen Ai biriget.
Oshol kunu buzuku adam: <<Kai zhakka kacham?>> - dep aitat.
Al kunu kachyp kutuluu zhok, buzuku adam bash kalkaloochu zher zhok, al korgonuuchu zhai zhok.
Oo, paigambar! Al kunu surak beruu, zhaza zhe syilyk aluu uchun Rabbin'e gana kaituu bar.
Al kunu insanga murunku zhana kiiinki kylgan ishteri tuuraluu kabar berilet.
Birok insan ozuno karshy kubogo otot. Antkeni anyn dene mucholoru kylgan kunoo ishteri tuuraluu aga karshy kubo bolushat.
Egerde al zhamandyk ish kylbadym dep oz talamyn talashyp, ar kandai shyltoolordu aitsa da, aga paida keltirbeit.
Oo, paigambar! Kurandy esin'den chygyp ketpesin dep shashylyp tilin'di kyimyldata berbe!
Chyndygynda any kokurogun'o toptoo zhana kyraatyn tilin'e zhatyk kyluu - Bizdin mildetibiz.
Saga Bizdin elchi Zhebireiil (Kurandan) okuganda, any unchukpai uk.
Andan son' any saga chechmelep beruu da - Bizdin mildetibiz.

Zhok! Bul nerse silerdin kaira tiriluu mumkun emes dep aitkanyn'ardai emes. Antkeni siler bilesin'er, silerdi abaldatan zharatuuga kudurettuu Zat, silerdi olgondon kiiin kaira tiriltuugo alsyz emes. Birok silerdin kaira tiriluunu zhalganga chygarganyn'ardyn sebebi - tez otuuchu duino zhashoosuna bolgon suiuun'or.
Zhana akyret zhashoosun tashtoon'or. Anyn zholu - Allakh buirugan ibadattardy atkaryp, Al tyigan aram nerselerdi tashtaganyn'ar.
Al kunu yimanduu zhana baktyluu adamdardyn zhuzdoru nurduu bolup, zharkyrap turat.
Yrakhattanuu menen Rabbisine karap turat.
Al emi al kunu kaapyr zhana baktysyz adamdardyn zhuzdoru un'uroiup turat.
Alarga chon' zhaza zhana kyinoochu azap tushorun bilip turushat.
Bul zherde abal mushrikter olgondon kiiin azaptalbaibyz dep elestetkendei emes. Kachan alardyn birinin zhany kokurogunun zhogoru zhagyna zhetkende.
Adamdar biri-birine: <<Kim buga dem salat, balkim aiygyp keter>> - aityshat.
Oshol kezde zhan alaketke tushkon adam olum arkyluu duino menen kosh aityshyp zhatkanyn anyk bilet.
Duinonun butushundo zhana akyrettin bashtalyshynda kyiynchylyktar biriget.
Oshol nerse bolgondo, olgon adam Rabbisine zhetkirilet.
Kaapyr adam Anyn elchisi alyp kelgenge ishengen zhok, Allakh uchun namaz da okugan zhok.
Birok al Anyn elchisi alyp kelgendi zhalganga chygardy zhana andan zhuz burdu.
Andan son' bul kaapyr tekeberlikten boi kotorup basyp ui-bulosuno bardy.
Allakh kaapyrga azaby zhakyn kalganyn eskertti.
Andan son' tastyktoo maksatta suilomdu dagy bir iret kaitalap, myndai dedi: (thumWa 'awla~ laka fa'awla~) <<Andan son' dagy saga olum bolsun, olum bolsun!>>.
Insan Allakh aga shariiat mildetterin zhuktoboston, zhon ele tashtap koiot dep oilop zhataby?
Oshol insan bir kezderde zhatynga kuiulgan bir tamchy bel suusu emes bele?
Insandy bel suudan, kiiin koiuu kandan zharatkan Zat surak aluu, syilyk zhe zhaza beruu uchun oluktordu zhan'ydan tiriltuugo kudurettuu emes beken? Albette, kudurettuu!
Insandyn ustunon uzak zamandar otkon, al kezde anyn aty da, zaty da zhok bolchu.

Chyndygynda Biz insandy aial menen erkektin suusunun aralashmasynan turgan bel suudan zharattyk. Biz aga mildetterdi zhuktop synaibyz. Biz aga mildet kylyp zhuktogon shariiatty atkaruusu uchun any uga turgan zhana koro turgan kyldyk.

Biz aga elchileribizdin tilderinde tuura zholdu baiandap berdik. Munu menen aga adashuu zholu anyk boldu. Al oshondon kiiin tuura zholgo tushup, Allakhka shugur kylgan yimanduu pende bolot, zhe bolboso andan adashyp, Allakhtyn aiattaryn chetke kakkan kaapyr pende bolot.

Kachan Allakh tuura zholgo tushkondor menen adashkandardyn eki turun aitkanda, alardyn syilygyn zhana zhazasyn da aityp, myndai dedi:
Chyndygynda Biz Allakhka zhana Anyn elchilerine kaapyr bolgondor uchun alardy tozokko suirogon chynzhyrlardy, salynuuchu kishenderdi zhana aloolongon ottu daiardap koiduk.
Chyndygynda Allakhka moiun sungan yimanduular kyiamat kunu zhypar zhyttuu kamfora menen aralashkan sharapka tolturulgan choichoktordon ichishet.
Moiun sungandarga daiardalgan bul suusunduk!- suzup aluusu zhen'il bolgon tugongus mol bulaktan bolot. Any menen Allakhtyn pendeleri suusunun kandyryshat. Alar any kaalagan zhagyna agyza alyshat.
Any ichken pendelerdin sypattary, alar ozdoruno mildet kylgan ibadattardy atkaryshat zhana zhamandygy zhaiylgan kyiamat kundon korkushat.
Alar ozdoru tamak-ashka muktazh bolup zhana tabiti tartyp, kaalap turushsa dagy, any muktazh kedei-kembagaldarga, zhetimderge zhana tutkundarga berishet.
Alardy Allakhtyn Zhuzu uchun gana tamaktandyryp zhatyshkanyn ichterine syr kylyp zhashyryshat. Alarga bergen tamak-ashtary uchun syilyk da, maktoo da kutushpoit.
Chyndygynda biz korkunuchtan ulam baktysyzdardyn uroiun uchurgan kundogu Rabbibizden korkobuz.
Allakh alardy Oz zhakshylygy menen oshol uluu kundun zhamandygynan korgoit zhana alardyn zhuzuno suluuluk zhana nur beret, syi-urmatka boloit zhana zhuroktoruno kubanych tartuulait.
Alar ibadattarga, Allakhtyn tagdyryna zhana kunoolorgo sabyr kylyshkany sebeptuu alarga zhyrgalchylykka batyrgan beiishti zhana alar kiie turgan zhibekti tartuu kyldy.

Alar al zhakta kooz sorulorgo suionup olturushat. Alar oshol beiishte shoolasy zyianduu Kundu da, yzgaarduu suuktu da korushpoit. Teskerisinche, alar ysyk da, suuk da bolbogon tuboluk kolokolordo bolushat.
Anyn kolokoloru aga zhakyn bolot, anyn momo-zhemishteri uzuunu kaalagandarga iiilip turat. Al any kyinalbastan on'oi ele uzup alat. Any zhatkan, olturgan zhana turgan adam da uzo alat.
Alar suusunduk kaalashkanda kyzmatchylar alardy kumush idishter zhana tunuk choichoktor menen ailanyp turushat.
Al syi-urmatka bolongondorgo choichoktordo imbir koshulgan sharap berilet.
Alar beiishtegi Salsabil attuu bulaktan ichishet.
Eger oshol beiishtegi nerselerge koz salsan', anda surottoogo mumkun bolbogondoi zhyrgalchylykty zhana tendeshsiz uluu mulktu korosun'.

Alardyn ustundo tulku boilorun zhapkan zhuka zhibekten zhana kalyn' parchadan bolgon sarkech zhashyl kiiimder bolot. Alar al zhakta kumush bilerikterdi tagynyshat zhana Allakh alarga butkul bulganychtan taza suusunduk beret.
Alarga syi-urmat katary aitylat: <<Silerge berilgen bul zhyrgalchylyk - silerdin kylgan zhakshylyk ishterin'erdin syilygy boldu. Silerdin ish-araketterin'er Allakhtyn aldynda kabyl kylyndy>>.
Oo, paigambar! Biz saga Kurandy chogu bir ele tushurboston, bolup-bolup tushurduk.
Andyktan sen tagdyrga zhe shariiatka bailanyshtuu Rabbin'din okum kylgan nerselerge sabyr kyl zhana seni kunoogo chakyrgan kunookorgo, kaapyrlykka chakyrgan kaapyrga moiun sunbagyn!
Oshondoi ele Any kuugumdogu sham zhana kuptan namazdaryn okuu menen estegin zhana al ekoosunon kiiin takhazhud namazyn okugun.
Chyndygynda al mushrikter duino zhashoosun zhakshy korup, aga zhantalashyshat zhana kyiynchylyktar, synoolor menen koshtolgon oor kyiamat kunun artka tashtap koiushat.

Biz alardy zharattyk zhana alardyn dene mucholoruno zhana muundaryna kuch berip, tulku boilorun kubattuu kyldyk. Eger Biz alardy zhok kyluunu zhana ozdoruno okshogondorgo almashtyruunu kaalasak, anda alardy zhok kylyp, almashtyryp koimokpuz.
Akyikatta bul suroo - nasyikat zhana eskertme. Kim Rabbisinin yraazylygyna zhetkire turgan zholgo tushuunu kaalasa, anda munu karmansyn.

Allakh silerden ushunu kaalaganda gana siler Anyn yraazylygyna zhetkirgen zholgo tushuunu kaalaisyn'ar. Antkeni butkul ishter Aga kaitat. Chyndygynda Allakh pendelerine kaisy nerseler paidaluu, kaisylary paidasyz ekenin Biluuchu zhana Oz zharatuusunda, tagdyrynda zhana shariiatynda Daanyshman.
Allakh attyn zhalyndai ulgultuksuz shamal menen ant berdi.
Zhamgyrdy taratkan shamal menen ant berdi.
Akyikat menen zhalgandy azhyratuu uchun tushkon perishteler menen ant berdi.
Vakhii menen tushkon perishteler menen ant berdi.
Alar Allakhtyn aldynda adamdar aktanbash uchun zhana alarga Allakhtyn azabyn eskertuu maksatta vakhii menen tushushot.
Chyndygynda silerge ubada kylyngan kaira tiriluu, surak aluu zhana zhaza-syilyk beruu sozsuz turdo bolot.
Zhyldyzdardyn nuru ochup, zharygy ketkende.
Perishteler tushuu uchun asman achylganda.
Toolor oz ordularynan zhulunup, chan'dai bolgoncho maidanalyp bytyraganda.
Paigambarlar belgiluu bir ubakytka chogultulganda.
Oz ummottoruno kubo bolush uchun kechiktirilgen uluu kun uchun.
Pendelerdin ortosun azhyratuuchu kun uchun. Oshondo chynchyldar zhana zhalganchylar, baktyluular zhana baktysyzdar achyk bilinet.
Oo, paigambar! Sen azhyratuu kunu emne ekenin kaidan bilmek?
Al kundo paigambarlar Allakh taraptan alyp kelgen nerseni zhalganga chygargandar uchun kyiroo, azap zhana zhogotuu bolsun!
Biz Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgan, paigambarlaryn zhalganga chygargan murunku koomdordu zhok kylbadyk bele?
Alardyn artynan kiiinki muundardy koshup, tigilerdi zhok kylgandai zhok kylabyz.
Tigil koomdordu zhok kylgan syiaktuu Mukhammad alyp kelgendi zhalganga chygargan kunookorlordu da zhok kylabyz.
Al kunu Allakhtyn kunookorlordu zhazalaim degen ubadasyn zhalganga chygargandarga kyiroo, azap zhana zhogotuu bolsun!
Oo, adamdar! Biz silerdi zhiiirkenichtuu bolor-bolbos bel suudan zharatpadyk bele?
Anan Biz al zhiiirkenichtuu bel suunu koopsuz zhai bolgon aialdyn zhatynyna zhaigashtyrdyk.
Belgiluu moonotko cheiin - al kosh boiluuluk moonotu.
Zhana Biz zhan'y torolgon balanyn sypatyn, olchomun, on'-tusun zhana bashka nerselerin belgilep koigonbuz. Ushunun baaryn kylgan Bizdin kudurettuulugubuz kandai sonun!
Al kunu Allakhtyn kudurettuulugun zhalganga chygargandarga kyiroo, azap zhana zhogotuu bolsun!
Biz zherdi adamdardyn baarysyn ozuno syidyruuchu kylbadykpy?
Al tiruulordu ustundo zhashatuu zhana guldotuu menen, al emi oluktordu aga komduruu menen syidyrat.
Zhana any silkinuudon saktagan bekem, biiik toolordu zharatty. Oo, adamdar! Biz silerge taza suu berdik. Ushulardy zharatkan Zat silerdi kaira zharatuuga alsyz emes.
Al kunu Allakhtyn kylgan zhakshylyktaryn zhalganga chygargandarga kyiroo, azap zhana zhogotuu bolsun!
Paigambarlary alyp kelgendi zhalganga chygargandarga aitylat: <<Ei, zhalganchylar! Siler zhalgan dep eseptegen azapty kozdoi zhonogulo!
Uch bolukko bolungon tozok tutununun kolokosuno zhonogulo>>.
Anda kolokonun salkyndygy zhok zhana al tozoktun zhalyny menen ysyktygynyn silerge otuusun toktoto albait.
Chyndygynda tozok sepildei bolgon chon'duktagy uchkundardy chachyp turat.
Andan chachyragan uchkundar karalygynda zhana chon'dugunda kara toru toolorgo okshoit.
Al kunu Allakhtyn kudurettuulugun zhalganga chygargandarga kyiroo, azap zhana zhogotuu bolsun!
Bul kunu alar ech nerse tuuraluu suiloi alyshpait.
Alarga kaapyrlyktary zhana kunooloru uchun Rabbisinen kechirim suroogo uruksat berilbeit. Birok alar Andan kechirim surashat.
Al kunu Allakhtyn kylgan zhakshylyktaryn zhalganga chygargandarga kyiroo, azap zhana zhogotuu bolsun!
Bul kun - makuluktardy azhyratuuchu kun. Biz silerdi zhana murunku koomdordu bir zherge chogulttuk.
Egerde silerde Allakhtyn azabynan kutuluu uchun koldono turgan aila-amalyn'ar bolso, any Maga karshy koldongulachy!
Al kunu Allakhtyn kudurettuulugun zhalganga chygargandarga kyiroo, azap zhana zhogotuu bolsun!
Al emi Rabbisinin buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkondor beiishtin zhapzhashyl daraktarynyn kolokosundo, akkan taza suu bulaktarynda.
Zhana zhegisi kelgen momo-zhemishterde bolushat.
Alarga aitylat: <<Duinodo zhakshylyk ishterdi kylganyn'ar sebeptuu taza nerselerden zhegile zhana zyiansyz zhagymduu suusunduktardan ichkile>>.
Biz silerge bergen myndai syilykty zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandarga da berebiz.
Al kunu Allakh takybalar uchun daiardap koigon nerselerdi zhalganga chygargandarga kyiroo, azap zhana zhogotuu bolsun!

Zhalganchylarga aitylat: <<Zhegile zhana duinodo az gana ubakyt zhashoo zhyrgalchylyktaryn paidalanyp kalgyla. Siler Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylganyn'ar zhana Anyn elchilerin zhalganga chygarganyn'ar sebeptuu kunookorsun'or>>.
Surak kundogu zhazalaryn zhalganga chygargandarga al kunu kyiroo, azap zhana zhogotuu bolsun!
Al zhalganchylarga <<Allakh uchun namaz okugula>> dep aitylsa, Al uchun namaz okushpait.
Paigambarlar Allakh taraptan alyp kelgendi zhalgan degen zhalganchylarga al kunu kyiroo, azap zhana zhogotuu bolsun!
Eger alar Rabbisi taraptan tushkon bul Kuranga ishenishpese, anda myndan bashka kaisy sozgo ishenishet?
Allakh mushrikterge Oz elchisin zhibergenden kiiin alar biri-birinen emne tuuraluu surap zhatyshat?
Alar biri-birinen uluu Kabar tuuraluu surap zhatyshat. Al alardyn paigambaryna tushurulgon, ozuno kaira tiriluunu kamtygan - bul Kuran.
Alar talashyp-tartyshkan bul Kurandy syikyr zhe poeziia zhe tolgochuluk zhe baiyrkylardyn ulamyshtary dep sypattashat.
Abal alar oilogondoi emes! Kurandy zhalganga chygargandar zhakynda zhalgandarynyn akybeti zhaman bolorun bilishet.
Andan son' alarga any dagy basa belgiledi.
Biz alar uchun zherdi turuktashuuga ylaiyktuu tegiz kylyp koibodukpu?
Al silkildebesh uchun anyn ustuno toolordu kazyk kyldabykpy?
Oo, adamdar! Biz silerdi ar kandai turdo zharattyk, aran'arda erkekter zhana aialdar bar.
Siler tirichilikti toktotup es aluun'ar uchun uikun'ardy kyldyk.
Zhana siler uchun karan'gy tundu uiattuu zherin'erdi zhapkan kiiim syiaktuu tosmo kyldyk.
Al emi kunduzdu zhumush kyluu zhana yrysky izdoo uchun maidan kyldyk.
Zhana silerdin ustun'orgo bekem kurulushtagy zhana kyntyksyz zhasalyshtagy zheti asmandy kurduk.
Zhana Kundu abdan zhalyndap zharkyragan chyrak kyldyk.
Zhana zhamgyr zhaai turgan mezgili kelgen buluttardan noshorlop kuiulgan suu tushurduk.
Any menen ar kandai turdogu dandardy zhana osumduktordu chygaruu uchun.
Zhana bak-daraktarynyn butaktary biri-birine kirip chyrmalyshkan bakchalardy chygaruu uchun.

Kachan Allakh Anyn kudurettuulugun korsotkon bul zhakshylyktardy aitkanda, anyn artynan ele kaira tiriluu zhana kyiamat zhonundo aitty. Antkeni bul zhakshylyktardy zharatuuga kudurettuu Zat oluktordu da kaira tiriltuugo zhana alardy surakka aluuga kudurettuu.
Makuluktardyn ortosun azhyratuuchu kun kechikpesten kele turgan bir ubakytka belgilengen.
Al kunu perishte ekinchi zholu kerneidi tartat. Oo, adamdar! Oshondo siler top-top bolup kelesin'er.
Asman achylyp, anda achylgan eshikter syiaktuu teshikter paida bolot.
Toolor zhylyp, byryksygan chan'ga ailanat zhana zakym syiaktuu bolup kalat.
Chyndygynda tozok an'dyp kutup turuuchu.
Zhana zalymdar kaityp baruuchu zhai.
Alar al zhakta akyry zhok zamandar zhana kylymdar boiu kalyshat.
Alar al zhakta tozoktun ysygyn muzdatkan salkyn abany da, mookumdu kandyrgan suusunduktu da tatyshpait.
Alar oto ysyk suunu zhana tozoktogulardan akkan irin'di gana tatyshat.
Bul alardyn kaapyrlygyna zhana adashuusuna ylaiyktuu zhaza!

Chyndygynda alar duinodo Allakhtyn akyrettegi suragynan korkushkan emes. Antkeni alar kaira tiriluugo ishenishken zhok. Egerde alar kaira tiriluudon korkkondo, anda Allakhka yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylyshmak.
Zhana alar elchibizge tushurgon aiattarybyzdy achyk turdo zhalganga chygaryshty.
Biz alardyn ish-araketterine bailanyshtuu bardyk nerselerdi eseptep taktap koiduk. Al alardyn amal barakchalarynda zhazylgan.
Ei, zaalymdar! Bul tuboluktuu azapty tatkyla! Emi Biz azabyn'ardyn ustuno azapty koboitobuz.
Chyndygynda Rabbisinin buiruktaryn atkaryp, tyigandaryn tashtap Andan korkkondor uchun kozdogondoruno zhetkirgen zhen'ish ordu bar, al - beiish.
Bakchalar zhana zhuzumzarlar bar.
Birdei kuraktagy kokurogu tirsiigen selkiler bar.
Meltildegen sharap keseler bar.
Alar beiishte zhalgan zhana kalp sozdordu ugushpait zhana biri-birine zhalgan da aityshpait.
Myna ushulardyn baarysy Allakhtyn alarga bergen zhetishtuu belegi zhana syilygy.

Al - asmandar menen zherdin zhana alardyn ortosunda nerselerdin Rabbisi, duinonun zhana akyrettin Yraiymduusu. Al uruksat bermeiinche, zherdegilerdin zhe asmandagylardyn ech kimisi Andan surai albait.

Zhebreil zhana perishteler sap-sap bolup turgan kunu Yraiymduu shapaat kyluuga uruksat bergender gana bashka biroogo shapaat kyluu tuuraluu suiloi alat zhana Allakhka gana syiynuuga chakyrgan soz syiaktuu tuuralykty aitat.

Silerge baiandalgan bul nerse - anyn bolorunda ech kandai shek-kumonu bolbogon kun. Kim al kundo Allakhtyn azabynan kutuluunu kaalasa, anda aga karai zholdu tutunup, Rabbisin yraazy kylgan zhakshylyk ishterdi kylsyn.

Oo, adamdar! Biz silerge zhakynda boluuchu azapty eskerttik. Al kundo adam balasy duinodo kylgan ishterin korot zhana kaapyr adam azaptan kutuluunu tilep myndai deit: <<Attin'-ai! Kyiamat kunu zhanybarlarga <<topurakka ailangyla!>> dep aitylganda men dagy alarga okshop topurakka ailanyp ketsem kana!>>.
Allakh kaapyrlardyn zhandaryn kataaldyk zhana oroiluk menen zhulup aluuchu perishteler menen ant berdi.
Yimanduulardyn zhandaryn zhen'ildik menen suurup aluuchu perishteler menen ant berdi.
Allakhtyn buirugu menen asmandan zherge suzup zhuruuchu perishteler menen ant berdi.
Allakhtyn buirugun atkaruuda biri-biri menen zharyshuuchu perishteler menen ant berdi.

Pendelerdin ishterine zhoopker perishteler syiaktuu Allakhtyn tagdyryna bailanyshtuu buiruktaryn ish zhuzuno ashyruuchu perishteler menen ant berdi. Al munun baary menen alardy kairadan tiriltip, surakka aluu zhana syilyk zhe zhaza beruu uchun ant berdi.
Kernei birinchi zholu tartylgan kunu zher titireit.
Munun artynan ele ekinchi zholkusu tartylat.
Al kunu kaapyrlardyn zhana pasyk-buzukulardyn zhurogu korkunuchta bolot.
Alardyn kozdorunon korduktun belgileri korunup turat.
Alar myndai dep aityshat ele: <<Biz olgondon kiiin kaira zhashoogo kaityp kelebizbi?
Biz kurulai chirik sook bolgondon kiiin ushuga kaityp kelebizbi?>>.
Alar: <<Egerde kaityp kelsek, anda al kaituu adamdy kaigyga salgan zhogotuu bolot>> - dep aityshat.
Kaira tiriltuu ishi on'oi. Chyndygynda al uiloogo zhoopker bolgon perishterin bir gana kyikyrygy.
Anan tiruulordun baarysy zher koinunda oluk bolgon abaldan kiiin zher ustundo bolup kalyshat.
Oo, paigambar! Saga Musanyn Rabbisi menen zhana dushmany Faraon menen bolgon kabary keldibi?
Bir kezde Rabbisi aga yiyk Tuva oroonunon chakyryk saldy.
Al aga Oz sozundo myndai dedi: <<Faraongo bargyn! Chyndygynda al zulumdukta zhana tekeberlikte chekten chygyp ketti>>.
Aga ait: <<Ei, Faraon! Sen kaapyrlyktan zhana kunoolordon tazalanbaisyn'by?
Men seni zharatkan zhana saga kamkorduk kylgan Rabbin'e karai zhol korgozom, oshondo sen Andan korkosun', Al yraazy bolgon ishterdi kylasyn' zhana Anyn achuusun keltirgen ishterden alystaisyn'>>.
Musa aga Rabbisi taraptan kelgen elchi ekenine dalil bolgon uluu aiat-belgini korgozdu. Al kol zhana taian bolchu.
Oshondo Faraon bul belgini zhalgan dep, Musa buirugan nersege bash iibei koidu.
Anan Musa paigambar alyp kelgen dinge yiman keliruudon bash tartyp kunoogo zhana chyndykty chetke kaguu berildi.
Musaga ustomduk kyluu uchun koomun zhana ozuno eerchigenderin chogultup myndai dedi...
<<Men silerdin uluu Rabbin'ermin. Siler uchun menden bashkaga bash iiuu zhok>>.
Anan Allakh any karmap, duinodo den'izge chokturup, al emi akyrette en' kataal azapka kirgizip zhazalait.
Chyndygynda Faraondu duinodo zhana akyrette zhazalaganybyz - Allakhtan korkkondor uchun sabak. Osholor nasaattardan paida alyshat.
Ei, kaira tiriluunu zhalganga chygargandar! Allakh uchun silerdi zharatuu kyiynby zhe kurup koigon asmandy zharatuubu?
Al anyn shybyn zhogoru karai biiik zhana tegiz kyldy. Anda ech kandai zhylchyk, zharaka zhana kemchilik zhok.
Al anyn tunun kun batkan kezde karan'gy kyldy zhana kun chykkan kezde zharyk kyldy.
Al asmandy zharatkandan kiiin zherdi zhaiyk kyldy zhana aga paidaluu nerselerdi zhaigashtyrdy.
Al andan bulak bolup akkan suulardy chygardy zhana mal-zhandyktar ottogon osumduktordu osturdu.
Toolordu zherge bekem ornottu.
Oo, adamdar! Bul paidalardyn baarysy siler uchun zhana silerdin mal-zhandygyn'ar uchun. Munun baaryn zharatkan Zat alardy kaira zhan'ydan zharatuudan alsyz emes.
Korkunuchu menen but baarysyn ozuno kamtyp algan ekinchi zholku surnai uiloo kezi kelgende.
Al kunu insan zhakshylyk bolobu, zhamandyk bolobu kylgan ish-araketterin estep kelet.
Tozok alyp kelinet zhana al koro turgandarga achyk korunot.
Kimde-kim adashuuda chekten chyksa,
otkool duino zhashoosun tuboluktuu tigil zhashoodon artyk korso,
anda anyn bash kalkalap, turuktashkan zhaiy tozok bolot.
Al emi kim Rabbisinin aldynda turuudan korkup, Allakh aram kylgan nerselerdi kaalap zhatsa da, ozun aga eerchudon tyigan bolso, anda anyn bash kalkalap, turuktashkan zhaiy beiish bolot.
Al emi kim Rabbisinin aldynda turuudan korkup, Allakh aram kylgan nerselerdi kaalap zhatsa da, ozun aga eerchudon tyigan bolso, anda anyn bash kalkalap, turuktashkan zhaiy beiish bolot.
Oo, paigambar! Kaira tiriluunu zhalganga chygargandar senden: <<Kyiamat kachan bolot?>> - dep surashat.
Sen any alarga aitkydai al tuuraluu bilbeisin' zhana bul senin ishin' da emes. Chyndygynda senin ishin' - aga daiardyk koruu gana.
Kyiamatty biluu Rabbin'e gana kelip toktoit.
Chyndygynda sen kyiamattan korkkondordu eskertuuchusun'. Antkeni osholor senin eskertmen'den paida alyshat.
Alar kyiamatty achyk korushkon kunu, alar duino zhashoosunda bir kun zhe tushko cheiin zhashagandai ele bolup kalat.
Allakhtyn elchisi kabagyn chytyp, zhuzun burdu.
Abdullakh ibn Ummu Maktum andan tuura zhol surap kelgendigi uchun. Al sokur ele. Al kelgende Allakhtyn elchisi mushrikterdin bashchylary tuura zholgo tushobu degen umutto osholor menen alek bolchu.
Oo, paigambar! Sen kaidan bilesin'? Balkim al sokur kishi kunoolorunon tazalanmak.
Zhe bolboso senden ukkan nasyikattardan sabak alyp, al uchun paidaluu bolmok.
Al emi ozundogu mal-mulkton ulam sen alyp kelgen yimanga muktazh emesmin degen adamga
sen kon'ul burup, any karap aldyn'.
Eger al Allakhka toobo kylyp kunoolorunon tazalanbasa, anda sen emnege zhetishesin'?
Al emi zhakshylyk izdep saga shashylyp kelgen adam
al Rabbisinen korkot.
Sen anyn orduna mushrikterdin bashchylarynan bolgon bashka biroogo alaksyp turup aldyn'.
Andai emes! Chyndygynda bul kabyl algandar uchun nasyikat zhana eskertme.
Allakhty eskeruunu kaalagan adam Any eskeret zhana bul Kurandagy nerseden sabak alat.
Bul Kuran perishtelerdin aldyndagy ardaktuu barakchalarda.
Alar biiik orunga kotorulgon zhana ech kandai kir da, yplas da tiibegendei taza.
Alar perishtelerden bolgon elchilerdin kolunda.
Alar Rabbisinin aldynda kadyrluu, koptogon zhakshylyktardy zhana ibadattardy kyluuchular.
Kaapyr adamga kargysh bolsun! Anyn Allakhka bolgon kaapyrlygy kandai kuchtuu!
Al zher betinde tekeberlik zhana kaapyrlyk kylgydai Allakh any emneden zharatkan eken?
Anan any myna ushul baskychtardan kiiin enesinin kursagynan chyguusun zhen'il kyldy.
Andan son' any bul zhashoodo omur suruusun belgilegenden kiiin olturdu.
