Andan son' Ozu kaalaganda any surak aluu zhana zhaza zhe syilygyn beruu uchun kaira tiriltip alat.
Abal bul kaapyrdyn Rabbisinin aldyndagy mildetterin atkardym dep elestetkenindei emes. Al Allakhtyn aga mildet kylgan parzdaryn atkargan zhok.
Allakhka kaapyr bolgon adam zhep zhatkan tamak-ashy kaidan kelgenin karabaiby?
Anyn kelip chygyshy asmandan noshorlop zhana kuch menen tushkon zhamgyrdan.
Andan son' Biz zherdi zhardyk, al zharylyp osumduktor chykty.
Andan son' aga buudai, zhugoru zhana bashka dandardy osturduk.
Zaitundardy zhana kurmalardy osturduk.
Kop bak-daraktuu baktardy osturduk.
Momo-zhemishterdi zhana silerdin mal-zhandyktaryn'arga zhaiyttardy osturduk.
Al kunu adam oz aga-inisinen kachat.
Apasynan zhana atasynan kachat.
Oshol kundogu katuu kyiynchylyktan ulam alardyn baarysy bashkalarga kon'ul burbai kalat.
Al kunu baktyluulardyn zhuzdoru zharkyrap turat.
Allakh alarga Oz yraiymy menen daiardap koigon nerseler uchun kulup-zhainap, kubanyshyp turushat.
Al emi al kunu baktysyzdardyn zhuzdorun chan' basyp turat.
Alardy karan'gylyk kaptait.
Zhyldyzdar kubulup, zharyktary ketkende.
Zhapaiy aibanattar adamzat menen kosho bir zherge toptolup kalganda.
Den'izder ot bolup zhanganda.
Zhandar ozuno okshogondor menen birigip, buzuku buzuku menen, takyba takyba menen birge bolgondo.
Allakh tiruuloi komulgon nariste kyzdardan suraganda.
Seni olturgon adam kaisy kunoon' uchun olturdu dep.
Pendelerdin ar biri ozunun amal barakchasyn okush uchun alarga amal barakchalary tarkatylganda.
Asman koidun terisi syirylgan syiaktuu syirylganda.
Tozok zhandyrylganda.
Beiish takybalarga zhakyndatylganda.
Ushular bolgon kezde ar bir zhan bul kungo kandai ish-araketterdi daiardaganyn bilet.
Allakh tundosu zharkyraganga cheiinki zhashyruun zhyldyzdar menen ant berdi.
Alar oz orbitasynda zhurushot, tan' agarganda antilopa badaldarga zhashyngan syiaktuu korunboi kalyshat.
Zhana kirip kelgen tundun bashtalyshy zhana ketip baratkan tundun akyry menen ant berdi.
Oshondoi ele nurun chachkan tan' menen ant berdi.
Chyndygynda Mukhammadga tushkon Kuran - Allakhtyn sozu. Any aga Allakh amanat kylgan chynchyl perishte Zhebreil zhetkirgen.
Al Arshtyn Rabbisinin aldynda uluu darazhaga ee bolgon kubattuuluk eesi.
Asmandagylar aga bash iiishet zhana al vakhiidi zhetkiruugo ishenimduu.
Siler menen birge zhurgon, siler anyn akylduulugun, amanatkoilugun zhana chynchyldygyn bilgen Mukhammad, siler zhalaa zhapkandai zhindi emes.
Al dosun'ar Zhebreildi asman meikindiginde oz zharatylgan kelbetinde achyk kordu.
Al dosun'ar silerge zhetkir dep buirulgan nerseni zhetkiruudo saran' emes zhana al kozu achyktarga okshop aky da albait.
Zhana bul Kuran Allakhtyn yraiymynan kuulgan shaitandyn sozu emes.
Bul dalilderden kiiin anyn Allakhtan ekenin chetke kaguu uchun dagy kandai zholdorgo barasyn'ar?
Kuran zhinder menen adamzat uchun eskertme zhana nasyikat.
Aran'arda akyikat zholgo tushuunu kaalagandar uchun.
Butkul makuluktardyn Rabbisi silerge tuura zholdu zhe bashka nerseni kaalaganda gana siler oshonu kaalaisyn'ar.
Perishteler tushuu uchun asman zharylganda.
Zhyldyzdar kubulup tushkondo.
Den'izder biri-birine achylyp koshulganda.
Kabyrdagy oluktor kaira tiriluu uchun anyn topuragy oodarylganda.
Oshol kezde ar bir zhan kandai ish-araket daiardaganyn zhana kaisynysyn kylbastan tashtap koigondugun bilet.
Ei, Rabbisine kaapyrlyk kylgan insan! Rabbin' ken' peiildigi menen saga moonot berip, seni zhazaloogo shashylbagan kezde Anyn buiruguna karshy chyguun'a emne sebep boldu?
Al seni zhok zherden zharatty zhana dene-mucholorun'du kelishken turpatta kyldy.
Al seni Ozu kaalagan kelbette zharatty zhana saga zhakshylyk kyldy, antkeni al seni eshektin zhe maimyldyn zhe ittin zhe bashka nerselerdin kelbetinde zharatkan zhok.
Ei, aldangandar! Abal siler elestetkendei emes. Birok siler surak kunun zhalganga chygardyn'ar, al uchun araket da kylbadyn'ar.
Chyndygynda silerdin ustun'ordo ish-araketterin'erdi saktoochu perishteler bar.
Allakhtyn aldynda ardaktuular, silerdin ish-araketterin'erdi zhazuuchular.
Siler kandai ish kylbagyla, alar any bilip zhazyp turushat.
Chyndygynda zhakshylyk ishterdi zhana ibadattardy kop kylgandar kyiamat kunu tuboluk zhyrgalchylykta bolushat.
Chyndygynda kunookor adamdar zhalyndagan tozokto bolushat.
Alar aga surak kunu kirishet, anyn ysyktyk azabyn tartyshat.
Alar andan ech kachan zhok bolup ketishpeit, al zhakta tuboluk kalyshat.
Oo, paigambar! Sen surak kun emne ekenin kandai bilmek elen'?
Sen dagy surak kunu emne ekenin kaidan bilmek elen'?
Al kunu ech kim bashka biroogo paida keltire albait. Al kunu butkul ish bashkalarga emes, Allakhka gana taandyk. Al any Ozu kaalagandai kylat.
Tarazadan aldagandarga kyiroo zhana zhogotuu bolsun!
Alar bashkalardan olchotup alyp zhatkanda, oz akylaryn kemitpesten toluk kylyp alyshat.
Ozdoru adamdarga olchop zhe tarazaga tartkanda, olchomun zhana salmagyn kemitip berishet. Paigambar Medinaga kochup barganga cheiin medinalyktar ushundai abalda bolushkan.
Bul kunoo ishti kylgandar Allakhka tirilip barabyz dep ishenishpeit beken?
Uluu kundo surak beruu zhana zhaza-syilyk aluu uchun. Antkeni anda kyiynchylyktar zhana korkunuchtar bar.
Al kunu adamdar surak beruu uchun butkul makuluktardyn Rabbisinin aldynda turushat.
Abal siler olumdon kiiin kaira tiriluu bolboit dep elestetkendei emes. Chyndygynda kaapyr zhana eki zhuzduu kunookor adamdardyn kitepteri en' tomonku zherde zhogotuuda bolot.
Oo, paigambar! Sen Sizhzhin emne ekenin kandai bilmek elen'?
Alardyn kitepteri zhok kylynbastan zhazylgan, aga ech nerse koshulbait zhana kemitilbeit.
Al kunu zhalganchylarga kyiroo zhana zhogotuu bolsun!
Alar Allakh pendelerine duinodo kylgan ish-araketterine zharasha syilyk zhe zhaza bere turgan surak kundu zhalganga chygargandar.
Al kundu Allakhtyn chekterinen chygyp, kop kunoo kylgan adamdar gana zhalganga chygaryshat.
Egerde aga elchibizge tushurgon aiattarybyz okulsa: <<Bul baiyrky elderdin ulamyshtary. Al Allakh taraptan emes>> - dep aitat.
Abal al zhalganchylar elestetkendei emes. Teskerisinche, alardyn kylgan kunooloru akyldaryn eelep zhaap kaldy. Oshonduktan zhuroktoru menen akyikatty korushkon zhok.
Akyikatta alar kyiamat kunu Rabbisin koruudon kuru kalyshat.
Andan son' tozokko kiriship, anyn ysyktyk azabyn tartyshat.
Kiiin kyiamatta alardy zhemeloo maksatta myndai dep aitylat: <<Siler tush bolgon bul azap - paigambaryn'ar duinodo silerge al zhonundo aitkan kezde zhalgan degen nersen'er>>.
Abal siler oilogondoi surak beruu da zhok, syilyk zhe zhaza aluu da zhok degendei emes. Chyndygynda bash iiuuchu adamdardyn kitepteri Illiiiunda.
Oo, Mukhammad! Sen Illiiiun degen emne ekenin kaidan bilmek elen'?
Alardyn kitepteri zhok kylynbastan zhazylgan, aga ech nerse koshulbait zhana kemitilbeit.
Bul kitepke ar bir asmandagy zhakyndatylgan perishteler kelishet.
Chyndygynda ibadattardy kop kylgan adamdar kyiamat kunu tuboluk zhyrgalchylykta bolushat.
Alar koozdolgon sorulordun ustundo Rabbisine zhana alardyn zhan duinosuno kubanych tartuulagan bardyk nerselerge nazar salyp olturushat.
Alardy karai turgan bolson', suluu zhana zhyldyzduu zhuzdorunon zhyrgalchylyktyn belgilerin korosun'.
Alarga kyzmatchylary idishterine moor basylgan sharaptardy ichirishet.

Andan akyryna cheiin misktin zhyty burkurap turat. Myna ushul uluu syilyk uchun zharyshuuchular Allakhty yraazy kylgan ish-araketterdi kylyp zhana Anyn kaaryn keltirgen nerselerdi tashtoo menen zharyshyshsyn.
Bul moor basylgan ichimdik Tasnim bulagynan bolot.
Al beiishtin en' zhogorusunda zhaigashkan bulak. Any taza zhana tunuk abalda zhakyndatylgandar ichishet, al emi zhalpy yimanduular bolso any bashka aralashmasy menen ichishet.
Chyndygynda kaapyrlykta bolup, kunoo kylgan adamdar yiman keltirgenderdin ustunon shyldyn'dap kulushtu.
Yimanduulardyn zhanynan otkon kezde biri-birine koz kysyp mazaktashty.
Al emi ui-bulosuno kaityshkanda, kaapyrlyktaryna zhana yimanduulardy shyldyn'dashkanyna kubangan boidon kaityshty.
Eger musulmandardy korush kalyshsa: <<Chyndygynda bular akyikat zholdon adashkandar. Antkeni alar ata-babalardyn dininen bezishti>> - dep aityshty.
Alar bul sozdu aitkydai, Allakh alardyn ish-araketterin saktoonu alarga tapshyrgan emes.
Emi kaapyrlar duinodo alardyn ustunon kulushkondoi, yimanduular da kyiamat kunu alardyn ustunon kulushot.
Alar koozdolgon sorulordun ustundo Allakh alarga daiardagan tuboluk zhyrgalchylyktardy karap olturushat.
Kaapyrlar duinodo kylgan ishteri uchun kordoochu azap menen zhazalanyshty.
Perishteler tushuu uchun asman zharylganda.
Al Rabbisin bash iiip uktu zhana al buga mildettuu ele.
Zhana Allakh zherdi terini choigon syiaktuu zhaiyk kylyp koigondo.
Al ichindegi kenchterdi zhana oluktordu chygaryp, alardan boshondu.
Al Rabbisin bash iiip uktu zhana al buga mildettuu ele.
Ei, insan! Sen zhakshylyk zhe zhamandyk ishterdi kylasyn', kiiin kyiamatta Allakh saga alardyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn berish uchun alarga tush bolosun'.

Kachan insandyn ish-araketin zhalpy turdo aitkanda, ish-araket kyluuchulardyn abalyn ken'iri baiandap myndai dep aitty:
Kimdin ish-araketter barakchasy on' koluna berilse,
Allakh anyn suragyn oto zhen'il kylat. Aga ish-araketteri zhaza berilbesten korgozulot.
Zhana al ui-bulosuno kubangan boidon kaityp kelet.
Al emi kimdin kitebi sol zhagynan zhe arka tarabynan berilse,
al ozuno-ozu olum chakyrat.
Zhana tozok otuna kirip, anyn ysyktyk azabyn tartat.
Chyndygynda al duinodo ui-bulosu menen bolgondo kaapyrlygyna zhana kunooloruno kubanyp zhurchu.
Al olgondon kiiin kaira zhashoogo kaitam dep oilochu emes.

Zhok! Allakh any abalky zholu zharatkandai zhashoogo kaira sozsuz alyp kelet. Akyikatta Rabbisi anyn abalyn korup turgan. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda anyn ish-araketterinin zhazasyn beret.
Allakh kun batkandan kiiin meikindikte paida bolgon kyzyl shoola menen ant berdi.
Oshondoi ele tun zhana al ozuno toptogon nerseler menen ant berdi.
Zhana toluk tolgon kezdegi Ai menen ant berdi.
Oo, adamdar! Siler bel suu, kiiin koiuu kan, kiiin bir uzum et, kiiin zhashoo, kiiin olum, kiiin kaira tiriluu syiaktuu bir abaldan bashka abalga sozsuz otosun'or.
Kaapyrlarga emne boldu, alar Allakhka zhana akyret kununo yiman keltirbei zhatyshat?
Zhana alarga Kuran okulsa, Rabbisine sazhda kylbai zhatyshat?
Teskerisinche, kaapyrlyk kylgandar alarga paigambary alyp kelgen nerseni zhalganga chygaryp zhatyshat.
Allakh alardyn kokuroktorundo emne bar ekenin zhakshy bilet. Alardyn ish-araketterinin ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.
Oo, paigambar! Alardy kandai kyinoochu azap kutup turganyn ait.
Birok Allakhka yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandarga gana tugonbogon syilyk bolgon beiish bar.
Allakh Kun menen Aidyn zhana bashka nerselerdin abaldaryn ozuno kamtygan asman menen ant berdi.
Zhana butkul makuluktardy chogultuunu ubada kylgan kyiamat kunu menen ant berdi.
Ummotuno kubo bolgon paigambar zhana paigambaryna kubo bolgon ummot syiaktuu kubolor menen ant berdi.
Aiabagandai chon' chun'kur kazgandarga kargysh bolsun!
Alar aga ot zhagyshty zhana yimanduulardy aga tiruuloi yrgytyshty.
Oshol kezde alar otko tolgon al chun'kurdun zheeginde olturushtu.
Alar al zherge kelishkeni sebeptuu yimanduularga karata kylyshkan azaptoogo zhana kyinoogo kubo bolushtu.
Al kaapyrlardyn yimanduularga takkan bir gana aiyby - alar ech kimge zhen'ilbegen Kudurettuu, butkul nersede Maktaluuchu Allakhka yiman keltirishken bolchu.
Asmandar menen zherdin mulku zhalgyz Aga taandyk. Al baaryn Biluuchu. Pendelerdin ech bir ishi Aga zhashyruun emes.

Yimanduu erkekter menen yimanduu aialdardy zhalgyz Allakhka yiman keltiruudon buruu uchun ot menen azaptashyp, kiiin al kunooloru uchun Allakhka toobo kylbagandarga kyiamat kunu tozok azaby bar. Zhana alar yimanduulardy ot menen orttoshkonunun zhazasy katary alardy da kuiguzuuchu ot azaby bar.

Al emi Allakhka yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandarga khan sarailarynyn zhana bak-daraktarynyn aldynan daryialar akkan beiishter bar. Alarga daiardalgan bul syilyk - ech bir zhen'ish ten' kelbegendei uluu zhen'ish.
Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda Rabbin'din zalymga moonot bergenden kiiin any karmashy aiabai kuchtuu bolot.
Al Ozu bashynda makuluktardy zhana azapty zharatat, kiiin al ekoosun kairadan zharatat.
Al toobo kylgan pendelerinin kunoolorun Kechiruuchu zhana Al takybalardan bolgon suiuktuulorun zhakshy korot.
Uluu Arshtyn Eesi.
Al Ozu kaalagandyn kunoolorun kechirip, kaalaganyn zhazaloo menen Oz kaaloosun ishke ashyruuchu. Any ech kim mazhburbai albait.
Oo, paigambar! Saga chyndyk menen kuroshup, aga zhol berbesh uchun zhoogo attangan zhookerlerdin kabary kelbidi?
Faraon zhana Salikhtin koomu Samud tuuraluu.

Bulardyn yiman keltiruusuno toskool bolgon nerse, alarga zhalganchy koomdordun zhana alardyn kyiroosunun arty emne bolgondugu tuuraluu kabar kelbegendikten emes, teskerisinche, alar ozdorunun kaaloolorun eerchip, paigambary alyp kelgen nerseni zhalganga chygaryshty.
Allakh alardyn ish-araketterin esepke alyp kamtyp turat. Alardyn ech bir nersesin otkorup zhiberbeit. Zhakynda alardyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.
Kuran zhalganchylar aitkan syiaktuu poeziia emes, uikashkan yr saptary emes. Al - yiyk Kuran.
Ozgortuudon, burmaloodon, koshuudan zhana kemituudon saktalgan Taktada (Laukhul' Makhfuzda).
Allakh asman menen ant berdi zhana tundosu keluuchu zhyldyz menen ant berdi.
Oo, paigambar! Sen bul uluu zhyldyzdyn abaly tuuraluu kaidan bilmek elen'?
Al zharkyragan zharygy menen asmandy teship otkon zhyldyz.
Kaisy gana zhan bolbosun, Allakh kyiamat kunu surak aluu uchun anyn kylgan ish-araketterin saktoochu bir perishteni anyn ustunon zhoopker kylgan.
Emi insan aga Allakhtyn kudurettuulugu zhana insandyn alsyzdygy anyk bolush uchun Allakh any emneden zharatkandygy tuuraluu oi zhugurtup korsun.
Allakh any atylyp chygyp, zhatynga kuiuluuchu suudan zharatkan.
Bul suu erkek kishinin omurtka sooktoru menen kokurok sooktorunun ortosunan chygat.
Egerde Al any oshol zhiiirkenichtuu suudan zharatkan bolso, anda andan surak aluu zhana zhaza zhe syilyk beruu uchun olumdon kiiin kaira tiriltuugo kudurettuu.
Al kunu katylgan syrlar synalyp, zhurokto zhyshyrylgan nietter, ishenimder zhana bashka nerseler achykka chygat zhana tuz zhurgon adam menen buzuku adam aiyrmalanyp kalat.
Al kunu insan uchun Allakhtyn azabynan korgongon kuch-kubat da, aga zhardam bergen zhardamchy da bolboit.
Allakh zhamgyrluu asman menen ant berdi. Antkeni al oshol taraptan kaira-kaira tushup turat.
Oshondoi ele osumduktor, momo-zhemishter zhana bak-daraktar zharyp chykkan Zher menen ant berdi.
Chyndygynda paigambar alyp kelgen nerseni zhalganga chygargandar anyn daavatyn toktotuu zhana zhokko chygaruu maksatta koptogon aila-amaldardy zhasashat.
Men dagy dindi ustom kylyp, zhalgandy zhok kylysh uchun aila-amal kylamyn.
Oo, paigambar! Al kaapyrlardy kuto tur, alarga bir az moonot ber. Alardyn azabyn zhana kyiroosun shashtyrba.
Zharatkandarynan biiik bolgon Rabbin'di eskerip, Any uluktagan kezde Anyn ysymyn aityp aruula!
Al insandy tuz turpatta zharatty zhana tulku boiun ten' salmakta kyldy.
Al makuluktardyn turlorun, turkumdorun zhana sypattaryn belgilep, alardyn ar birin ozuno ylaiyktuu zhana shaikesh kelgen nersege bagyttady.
Al zherden silerdin mal-zhandyktaryn'ar ottogon zhaiyttardy chygardy.
Kiiin any zhapzhashyl bolgondon kiiin kurgagan bozomtuk kara chopko ailantty.
Birok Allakh kandaidyr bir daanyshmandyk sebeptuu andan unutturuunu kaalagan nerselerdi gana unutasyn'. Chyndygynda Al achykty da, zhashyruundu da bilet. Alardyn ech biri Aga zhashyruun emes.
Andyktan sen Kurandagy vakhii kylyngan nerseler menen adamdarga nasaat ait zhana eskertmege kulak saluu mumkun bolso ele alarga eskerte ber.
Allakhtan korkkon adamdar nasaattaryn'dan sabak alyshat. Antkeni osholor nasyikattan paida alyshat.
Kaapyr adam bolso nasaattan alystap, andan kachat. Antkeni al akyrette tozokko kirgeni uchun en' baktysyz adamdardan bolot.
Al ebegeisiz chon' otko kirip, anyn ysyktyk azabyn tuboluk tartat.
Kiiin al tozokto tuboluk kalat. Al zhakta tartkan azaptan es alysh uchun olboit zhana tatyktuu zhakshy zhashoodo da zhashabait.
Kim shirkten zhana kunoolordon tazalansa, anda al maksatyna iigiliktuu zhetti.
Oshondoi ele shariiatta kelgen turluu zikirler menen Rabbisin zikir kylsa zhana namazdy talaptagydai korunushto toluk atkarsa (iigilikke zhetti).
Birok siler duino zhashoosun akyretten aldyn koiosun'ar zhana al ekoosunun ortosundagy chon' aiyrmachylyktan ulam duinonu andan artyk korosun'or.
Birok akyret duinodon zhana andagy zhyrgalchylyktardan zhana yrakhattardan zhakshyraak, artygyraak zhana tuboluktuu. Antkeni andagy zhyrgalchylyktar ech kachan tugonboit.
Chynynda, Biz silerge aitkan bul buiruktar zhana kabarlar Kurandan murun tushkon barakchalarda bar.
Oo, paigambar! Saga adamdardy oz korkunuchu menen orop algan kyiamat tuuraluu kabar keldibi?
Kyiamat kunu adamdar zhe baktysyz, zhe baktyluu bolushat. Baktysyzdardyn zhuzdoru zher karap, kordukta bolot.
Alar chynzhyrlar menen suirolup, kishender salynyp, charchagan zhana zhudogon abalda bolot.
Al zhuzdor ysyktygynan azap tartkan aloolongon otko kirishet.
Alarga oto ysyk bulaktan suu ichirilet.
Alar uchun azyk katary kurgaganda uuluu bolup kalgan shibrik attuu osumdukton da zhiiirkenichtuu zhana sasyk tamak-ash gana bolot.
Al zhegen adamdy semirtpeit, kursagyn da toiguzbait.
Al kunu baktyluular tush bolgon zhakshylyktar uchun alardyn zhuzdoru zhakshylykta, shattykta zhana kubanychta bolot.
Alar duinodogu kylgan zhakshylyk ishterine yraazy bolup, ish-araketterinin soobun eselep saktalgan abalda tabyshat.
Biiish darazhaluu zhana orunduu beiishte bolushat.
Beiishte aram soz mynda tursun, zhalgan zhana paidasyz sozdordu da ugushpait.
Bul beiishte akkan bulaktar bar. Alar any kaalagandai chygaryp, kaalagandai agyza alyshat.
Al zhakta beiik sorulor bar.
Ichuugo daiardap koiulgan choichoktor bar.
Oshondoi ele al zhakta kydyrata tizilgen zhazdyktar bar.
Zhana ar kaisy zherde tosholgon kilemder bar.

Kachan Allakh akyrette baktyluular menen baktysyzdardyn abaldaryndagy aiyrmachylyktardy aitkan kezde, kaapyrlar yimanga dalil kyluu uchun zhana beiishke kirip, baktyluululardan boluulary uchun alardyn nazaryn Zharatuuchunun kudurettuuluguno zhana Anyn zharatuu cheberchiligine bagyttagan nersege burup, myndai dedi:
Alar Allakh toonu kantip zharatkanyn zhana any adam balasyna bash iidirip koigonun oi zhugurtup korushpoibu?
Alar asmanga karashpaiby, Al any alarga kulap tushpoi turgandai, alardyn ustunon korgoochu shyp kylyp kantip kotorup koidu?
Alar toolorgo karashpaiby, Al any adamdardy silkibesh uchun kantip zherge bekem kylyp ornotup koidu?
Alar zherge karashpaiby, Al any adamdardyn turuktashuusuna yn'gailuu bolush uchun kantip zhaiyk kylyp koidu?

Kachan alardy Allakh taalanyn kudurettuulugun bildirgen nerselerge koz chaptyruuga buiruganda, Oz elchisin da koz chaptyruuga buirup, myndai dedi:
Oo, paigambar! Alarga eskert zhana alardy Allakhtyn azabynan korkut. Chyndygynda sen eskertuuchusun'. Senden alarga eskertuu gana talap kylynat. Al emi alarga yimanga keluugo iigilik beruu, Allakhtyn gana kolunda.
Sen alardy yimanga mazhbur kylgydai alardyn ustunon biilik kyla albaisyn'.
Birok alardan kim yimandan zhuz bursa, Allakhka zhana Anyn elchisine kaapyrlyk kylsa,
Allakh any kyiamat kunu tuboluk tozokko kirgizuu menen chon' azap menen azaptait.
Chyndygynda alar olgondon kiiin Bizge gana kaityshat.
Andan son' alardyn ish-araketterinin suragyn aluu Bizdin moinubuzda, al senin zhana senden bashkalardyn moinunda emes.
Allakh tan' menen ant berdi.
Zul'-khizhzha aiynyn bashtapky on kunu menen ant berdi.
Tak zhana zhup zattar menen ant berdi.
Oshondoi ele kirgen, ulangan zhana butkon tun menen ant berdi. Zhana bul anttardyn maksaty - siler ish-araketterin'din zhazasyn zhe syilygyn sozsuz alasyn'ar.
Bul aitylgandardyn ichinde akyly bar adamdy ynandyruuchu ant bar beken?
Oo, paigambar! Rabbin' Khuddun koomu Aad Anyn elchisin zhalganga chygaryshkanda alardy kandai kylganyn korgon zhoksun'bu?
Chon' atasy Iramga taandyk bolgon kuch-kubattuu Aad uruusu.
Alarga okshogondordu Allakh ech bir shaarda zharatkan emes.
Rabbin' aska-zooluu toolordu oiup, alardan uilordu zhasagan Salikhtin koomu Samuddu kandai kylganyn korgon zhoksun'bu?
Rabbin' adamdar azaptaluuchu kazyktarga eelik kylgan Faraondu kandai kylganyn korgon zhoksun'bu?
Bulardyn baarysy zulumdukta zhana konkordukta chekten chygyp ketishti. Baarysy oz zherinde chekten chygyshty.
Zhana alar al zhakta kaapyrlykty zhana kunoolordu zhaiyltuu menen buzukuluktu koboitushtu.
Oshondo Allakh alarga kataal azabyn tarttyrdy zhana zher betinen typtyipyl zhok kyldy.
Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda Rabbin' adamdardyn zhakshylyk kylgandaryn beiish menen syilap, zhamandyk kylgandaryn tozok menen zhazalash uchun alardyn ish-araketterin baikap, alarga koz salyp turat.

Allakh zhok kylgan koomdorgo kuch-kubattuuluk zhana korgonuu berilip zhakshylyk kylyngan bolso, alarga bul zhakshylyktardyn berilishi Allakhtyn alarga bolgon yraazylygyn bildirbestigin baiandap, myndai dedi:
Insan tabiiatynan ushundai, egerde Rabbisi any synap, syi-urmatka boloso zhana bailyk, bala-chaka, kadyr-bark berse, anda al bul nerseler Allakhtyn aldyndagy kadyrluulugunan dep oilop: <> - dep aitat.
Al emi any synap, yryskysyn tar kylyp koiso, munu Rabbisinin aldynda tomon abalda bolgondugu uchun dep oilop: <<Rabbim meni kordodu>> - dep aitat.

Zhok, abal bul insan oilogondoi, zhakshylyktar Allakhtyn pendesine yraazy bolgondugunun dalili, al emi zhamandyktar pendenin Rabbisinin aldynda tomon ekendiginin dalili emes. Birok anygynda siler Allakhtyn bergen yryskysynan zhetimdi syilabaisyn'ar.
Zhegenge ech nerse tappagan kedei-kembagaldardy toiguzuuga biri-birin'erdi undoboisun'or.
Zhana adal zhagyna karabastan, alsyz aialdardyn zhana zhetimderdin akysyn sugalaktyk menen zheisin'er.
Mal-mulktu oto zhakshy korgonun'or uchun any ach kozdukton Allakh zholuna sarptoodon saran'dyk kylasyn'ar.
Siler myndai kylbagyla! Estegile, zher katuu silkinip titiregende.
Oo, paigambar! Rabbin' pendelerinin ortosun azhyratuu uchun kelgende zhana perishteler dagy sap-sap bolup tizilip kelgende.

Al kunu tozok alyp kelinet. Anyn zhetimish min' chylbyry bolot. Ar bir chylbyrdy zhetimish min' perishte suiroit. Oshol kunu insan Allakhka karata kylgan kaidygerligin esteit, birok al kundo estoo aga ech paida keltirbeit. Antkeni al kun ish-araket kyla turgan kun emes, syilyk zhe zhaza ala turgan kun.
Al teren' okunuchton myndai deit: <<Attin'-ai! Chynygy zhashoo bolgon akyret zhashoomo aldyn ala zhakshylyk ishterdi kylsam bolmok>>.
Al kunu Allakhtyn azabyndai ech kim azaptai albait. Antkeni Allakhtyn azaby oto kataal zhana tuboluktuu.
Al kaapyrlardy chynzhyrlar menen bailagandai ech kim bailai albait.

Allakh Taala kaapyrlardyn zhazasyn eskergende yimanduulardyn da syilygyn eskerip, myndai dedi:
Al emi yimanduu zhanga olum kelgen kezde zhana kyiamatta myndai dep aitylat: <
Sen algan uluu syilyk uchun Rabbin'e yraazy bolup zhana kylgan zhakshylyk ishterin' uchun Anyn aldynda yraazylykka zhetken abalda kaitkyn.
Menin takyba pendelerimdin kataryna koshulgun!
Zhana alar menen birge Men alar uchun daiardap koigon beiishime kirgin!>>.
Allakh tyiylgan shaar bolgon yiyk Mekke menen ant berdi.
Oo, paigambar! Sen uchun al zherde olturuluugo tatyktuunu olturuugo, tutkundaluuga tatyktuunu tutkundoogo uruksat.
Allakh adamzattyn atasy menen ant berdi zhana andan tarkagan urpaktar menen ant berdi.
Biz insandy duinodo tartkan kyiynchylyktar sebeptuu charchoodo zhana mashakatta zharattyk.
Egerde insan kunoo kylsa, anda Rabbisi any zharatkan bolso dagy aga ech kimdin kuchu zhetpeit zhana och ala albait dep oiloibu?
Al: <<Birinin ustuno biri uiulgon mal-mulk sarptadym>> -- dep aitat.
Bul maktanchaak Allakh anyn sarptaganyn korboit dep zhana mal-mulkun kaidan taap, kaida sarptagany uchun surak albait dep oilop zhataby?
Biz aga koruuchu eki koz berbedikpi?
Suiloochu til zhana eki erin berbedikpi?
Zhana Biz aga zhakshylyk zhana zhamandyk zholdu taanyttyk.
Any beiishten bolup turgan toskoolduktan otuusu talap kylynganyna karabastan, al any kesip otpoit.
Oo, paigambar! Al beiishke kiruu uchun kandai toskoolduktan otushu kerek ekenin kaidan bilesin'?
Al erkek zhe aial kuldu azat kyluu.
Zhe azyk-tuluk tartysh bolgon acharchylyk kundo tamak-ash beruu.
Tuuganchylygy bar atasy zhok balaga.
Zhe ech nersege eelik kylbagan kedeige.

Kiiin al Allakhka yiman keltirip, biri-birin ibadattarga, kunoolorgo zhana synoolorgo sabyrduu boluuga zhana oshondoi ele biri-birin Allakhtyn pendelerine meerimduu boluuga osuiat kylgandardan bolgon.
Myna ushul sypattagy adamdar on' tarap eeleri.
Al emi elchibizge tushurgon aiattarga kaapyrlyk kylgandar - alar sol tarap eeleri.
Kyiamat kunu alardyn ustunon zhabylgan ot bar. Alar al zhakta azaptalyshat.
Allakh Kun menen ant berdi zhana al chygysh taraptan chykkandan kiiin kotorulgon ubaktysy menen ant berdi.
Zhana al batkandan kiiin anyn artynan eerchigen Ai menen ant berdi.
Zher betindegi nerselerdi oz zharygy menen achyk kylyp korgozgon kunduz menen ant berdi.
Zher betin kaptap, karan'gyga ailangan tun menen ant berdi.
Asman menen zhana anyn kyldaat kurulushu menen ant berdi.
Zher menen ant berdi zhana adamdar aga zhashash uchun anyn zhaiyktygy menen ant berdi.
Ar bir zhan menen ant berdi zhana Allakh any tuz turpatta zharatkany menen ant berdi.
Aga tashtash kerek bolgon zhaman nerseni zhana atkarysh kerek bolgon zhakshy nerseni uirotposton tushundurup koidu.
Kimde-kim zhakshy sapattarga ee bolup zhana zhaman sapattardan arylyp, zhan duinosun tazalagan bolso, anda al kozdogonuno zhetti.
Kimde-kim ozun kunoolorgo zhana zhamandyk ishterge zhashyrsa, anda al zyianga uchurady.

Kachan Allakh ozun kunoolor menen zhashyrgan adamdyn zyianga uchuroosu tuuraluu aitkanda, aga Samuddu misal kylyp, myndai dep aitty:
Samud koomu kunoolordu zhana zhamandyk ishterdi kylyp chekten chygyshkany sebeptuu paigambary Salikhti zhalganga chygaryshty.
Anan alardyn en' baktysyzy elinin daiyndoosu menen ordunan turgan kezde.
Allakhtyn elchisi Salikh alarga: <<Allakhtyn toosuno zhana anyn suu ichken kununo tiiishpegile zhana aga zyian keltirbegile>> - dedi.

Alar paigambarynyn too tuuraluu aitkanyn zhalgan deship, arasyndagy en' baktysyzy alardyn yraazylygy menen any olturup saldy zhana alar kunoogo sherik bolushtu. Oshondo Allakh alarga azabyn tushurup, alardy kunooloru sebeptuu kyikyryk menen olturdu zhana alardy kyiroogo duushar kylgan zhazany baaryna birdei kyldy.
Allakh alardy kyiratyp zhok kylgan azapty kylyp, anyn kesepetterinen korkkon zhok.
Allakh asman menen zherdin ortosun karan'gylygy menen kaptagan tun menen ant berdi.
Zhana achylgan kunduz menen ant berdi.
Al eki turdo zharatkan erkek zhana aial menen ant berdi.
Oo, adamdar! Chyndygynda silerdin ish-araketterin'er ar bashka, alardyn arasynda beiishke kiruugo sebep bolgon zhakshylyk ishter bar zhana tozokko kiruugo sebep bolgon zhamandyk ishter bar.
Kimde-kim zeket beruu, karzhyloo zhana kunoolordun kechirilishine sebep bolgon talaptar syiaktuu sarptoogo mildettuu bolgon nerseni berse, Allakh tyigan nerseden korkso,
zhana Allakh aga ubada kylgan artynda kaluuchu nersege ishense,
anda Biz aga zhakshylyk ishterdi kyluunu zhana Allakh zholuna sarp kyluunu zhen'il kylabyz.
Al emi kim mal-mulkuno saran'dyk kylyp, sarptoogo mildettuu bolgon nerseni berbese, bailygy sebeptuu Allakhka muktazh emesmin dep, Anyn zhakshylyktarynan ech nerse surabasa,
Allakh aga ubada kylgan artynda kaluuchu nerseni zhana Anyn zholuna sarptagan mal-mulkunun soobun zhalgan dese,
anda Biz aga zhamandykty zhen'il kylyp, zhakshylykty oor kylyp koiobuz.
Al olup, tozokko kirgende anyn saran'dyk kylgan bailygy aga ech kandai paida keltirbeit.
Akyikat zholdu zhalgandan aiyrmalap korgozup beruu - Bizdin mildet.
Chyndygynda akyret zhashoosu da, duino zhashoosu da Bizge gana taandyk. Biz al ekoosundo kaalaganybyzdy kylabyz, bul nerse Bizden bashka ech kimge taandyk emes.
Oo, adamdar! Allakhka bash iibestik kylsan'ar, anda men silerge kuiup turgan ottu eskerttim.
Bul tozoktun ysyktyk azabyn kaapyr bolgon baktysyz gana tartat.
Al paigambar alyp kelgendi zhalganga chygaryp, Allakhtyn buiruguna bash iiuudon zhuz burdu.
Andan adamdardyn en' takybasy Abu Bakr gana alys bolot.
Al kunoolordon tazalanysh uchun mal-mulkun zhakshylyk zholdorgo zhumshait.
Al ech kim zhete albagandai syilykka zhetish uchun mal-mulkun sarptait.
Al sarptagan mal-mulku menen zharatkandarynan biiik bolgon Rabbisinin Zhuzun gana kaalait.
Al zhakynda Allakhtyn aga bergen uluu syilygyna yraazy bolot.
Allakh kundun bashtapky ubaktysy menen ant berdi.
Zhana kyimyl-araket toktop, adamdar tynchygan karan'gy tun menen ant berdi.
Oo, paigambar! Vakhii basan'dap kalganda mushrikter aitkandai Rabbin' seni tashtagan zhok zhana seni zhek korgon zhok.
Sen uchun akyret zhashoosu duinodon zhakshyraak. Antkeni anda tugonbogon tuboluk zhyrgalchylyktar bar.
Zhakynda Rabbin' saga zhana ummotun'o uluu syilykty beret, oshondo sen zhana ummotun' Anyn bergenine yraazy bolosun'ar.
Al seni atan' kaitysh bolup kalgan kichine kezin'de tapty. Anan saga chon' atan' Abdulmuttalipti, kiiin aban' Abu Talipti saga bashpaanek kyldy.
Al seni kitep emne ekenin, yiman emne ekenin bilbegen abalda taap, saga andagy bilbegen nerselerin'di uirottu.
Zhana seni kedei abalda taap, kiiin seni baiytty.
Zhash kezinde atasynan azhyragan adamga zhaman mamile kylba zhana any kordobo.
Zhana muktazhdygyn surap kelgen adamdy kuuba.
Zhana Allakhtyn saga bergen zhakshylyktaryna shugur kyl zhana alar tuuraluu ait.
Allakh senin kokurogun'du ken' kylyp zhana saga vakhii kabyl aluunu suiuktuu kyldy.
Senin murdagy kunoolorundu kechirip, zhakhiliiat uchurundagy kyiynchylyktaryn'dy moiunun'dan zhen'ildettik.
kotorulbai kalgan
Zhana senin atagyn'dy chygaruu - Bizdin mildet. Antkeni sen azanda, koomatta zhana bashka uchurlarda eskerilesin'.
Albette, kyiynchylyk zhana kysyluu menen birge zhen'ildik kenenchilik zhana kutuluu da bar.
Albette, kyiynchylyk zhana kysyluu menen birge zhen'ildik kenenchilik zhana kutuluu da bar. Eger sen munu bilsen', koomun'dun zhamandygy seni korkutpait zhana Allakhka chakyruudan tyia albait.
Egerde ishterin'di buturup, boshogon bolson', Rabbin'e ibadat kyluuga araket kyl.
Allakh anzhir zhana al oskon zher menen ant berdi. Oshondoi ele zaitun zhana al oskon Palestina zhergesi menen ant berdi. Al zherde Isa paigambar bolup zhiberilgen.
Zhana Musa paigambar Rabbisi menen munazhat kylgan Sinai toosu menen ant berdi.
Zhana kirgen adam koopsuz bolgon yiyk Mekke shaary menen ant berdi. Al zherde Mukhammad paigambar bolup zhiberilgen.
Chyndygynda Biz insandy kelishken turpatta zhana en' sonun kelbette zharattyk.
Andan kiiin Biz any duinodo karylykka zhana akyl-esten taigan abalga kaitardyk, oshondo al tabiiaty buzulgandygynan paida korbogonu syiaktuu denesinen da paida korboit zhana tozokko barat.
Birok Allakhka yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandar kaarysa da alar uchun tugonbogon tuboluktuu syilyk bolgon beiish bar. Antkeni alar tabiiattaryn tazartyshty.
Ei, insan! Anyn kudurettuulugunun koptogon belgilerin korgondon kiiin syilyk zhana zhaza kunun zhalganga chygaruuga saga emne turtku berdi?

Kyiamat kunun syilyk zhana zhaza kun kylgan Allakh - en' daanyshman zhana en' adilettuu okumdar emespi? Allakh zhakshylyk kyluuchuga syilygyn zhana zhamandyk kyluuchuga zhazasyn berbesten, pendelerinin ortosunda okum kylbastan, alardy zhon ele tashtap koigonu akylga syimak bele?
Oo, paigambar! Butkul makuluktardy zharatkan Rabbin'din ysymy menen bashtap, Allakh saga vakhii kylgan nerseni oku.
Al insandy bel suu bolgondon kiiin uiugan bir burtuk kandan zharatty.
Oo, paigambar! Allakh saga vakhii kylgan nerseni oku. Senin Rabbin' en' Zhoomart. Anyn zhoomarttygyna ech bir zhoomart ten' kelbeit, Anyn bereshendigi zhana aikoldugu cheksiz.
Al insanga kol zhazmany zhana kalem menen zhazuunu uirottu.
Al insanga bilbegenin uirottu.
Akyikatta, buzuku adam Allakhtyn chekterinen chyguuda Abu Zhakhl syiaktuu chekten chygyp ketet.
Antkeni al kolundagy mal-mulk zhana biilik sebeptuu ozun beimuktazhmyn dep korot.
Ei, insan! Kyiamat kunu Rabbin'e gana kaituu bolot. Oshondo Al ar birine ozuno zharasha syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.
Tyiyp zhatkan Abu Zhakhldyn ishinen da tan' kalyshtuu nerseni korgon belen'?!
Al Bizdin kulubuz Mukhammaddy Kaabanyn zhanynda namaz okuudan tyiyp zhatat.
Kandai oiloisun', oshol tyiylgan adam Rabbisi taraptan akyikat zholdo zhana tuura an'doodo bolsochu?!
Eger oshol tyiyp zhatkan adam paigambar alyp kelgen nerseni zhalganga chygaryp, andan bash tartsa, emne deisin'? Al Allakhtan korkpoibu?
Bul pendeni namazdan tyigan adam Allakh anyn kylganyn korup turaryn zhana Aga anyn ech bir nersesi zhashyruun emes ekenin bilbeibi?
Abal bul naadan oilogondoi emes! Eger al pendebizge zhamandyk kylganyn zhana any zhalganga chygarganyn toktotposo, Biz any kataaldyk menen tozokko man'daiynan karmap suirop barabyz.
Oshol man'daidyn eesi sozundo zhalganchy, araketi tuura emes.
Al man'daiy menen tozokko tushkondo, any azaptan kutkaruu uchun zhoro-zholdoshtorunan zhana chogu olturgandardan zhardam surap duba kylsyn.

Biz bolso Allakhtyn buiruguna bash iigen zhana buirulgan nerselerdi atkargan tozoktun sakchylary bolgon oroi perishtelerdi chakyrabyz. Emi al eki taraptyn kaisyny kuchtuu zhana kudurettuu ekenin korsun!
Abal - bul zalym saga zhamandyk kylam dep oilogondoi emes! Anyn buiruguna da, tyiuusuna da bash iibe, Allakhka sazhda kyl zhana Aga ibadattardy kylyp zhakynda. Chyndygynda alar seni Aga zhakyndatat.
Oo, paigambar! Bul tundo kandai zhakshylyktar zhana berekeler bar ekenin bilesin'bi?
Bul tun - uluu zhakshylyktar tunu. Al - yiman keltirip, soop umut kyluu menen namaz okup toskon adam uchun min' aidan artyk.

Al tunu yryskyga zhe olumgo zhe toroluugo zhe bashka ushuga okshogon Allakh tagdyr kylgan nerselerge bailanyshtuu oshol zhylga karata okum kylynuuchu butkul ishter boiuncha Allakhtyn uruksaty menen perishteler zhana Zhebreil tushot.
Bul kuttuu tun - tan' atkanga cheiin bashtan-aiak but baarysy zhakshylyk.
Zhoottordon, khristiandardan zhana mushrikterden bolgon kaapyrlarga achyk-aikyn dalil kelmeiinche, alardyn kaapyrlykka bolgon birimdigi zhana makuldashuusu ydyragan zhok.
Bul achyk-aikyn dalil - taza adamdar gana karmai turgan taza baraktardy okup beruu uchun zhiberilgen Allakhtan kelgen elchi.

Toorat berilgen zhoottor zhana Inzhil berilgen khristiandar Allakh alarga Ozunun paigambaryn zhibergenden kiiin gana talashyp-tartyshyp bashtashty. Alardyn kee birleri Islamdy kabyl aldy, kee birleri paigambardyn chynchyldygyn bilse da kaapyrlygynan bash tartkan zhok.

Zhoottor menen khristiandardyn kunoosu zhana bash iibestigi achyk korunup turat, alarga oz kitepterinde buirulgandai zhalgyz Allakhka syiynuu, shirkten alys boluu, namaz okuu zhana zeket beruu syiaktuu nerselerge bul Kuranda da buirulushkan. Alarga buirulgan nerse - ech kandai burmalanuusu zhok tuura din.

Zhoottordon, khristiandardan zhana mushrikterden bolgon kaapyrlar kyiamat kunu tozokko kirip, al zhakta tuboluk kalyshat. Myna osholor Allakhka kylgan kaapyrlyktary zhana Anyn elchisin zhalganga chygaryshkany sebeptuu zharatylgandardyn en' zhamany.
Al emi Allakhka yiman keltirip, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandar - osholor zharatylgandardyn en' zhakshysy.

Alardyn Rabbisinin aldyndagy syilyktary - khan sarailarynyn zhana bak-daraktarynyn aldynan daryialar agyp turgan beiishter. Alar al zhakta tuboluk kalyshat. Alar Allakhka yiman keltirip, moiun sunushkany sebeptuu Al alardan yraazy boldu zhana alar dagy Anyn yraiymyna zhetishkeni sebeptuu Andan yraazy bolushtu. Myndai yraiymduulukka Rabbisinen korkkondor gana zhetishet. Andyktan Anyn buirugun atkar zhana tyiganyn tashta.
Kyiamat kunu Zher katuu titiregende,
Zher oz ichindegi oluktordu zhana bashka nerselerdi syrtka chygarganda,
insan dendaroo bolup: <<Emnege Zher titirep, silkildep zhatat?>> - deit.
Oshol uluu kundo Zher anyn ustundo kylyngan zhakshylyktar zhana zhamandyktar zhonundo kabar beret.
Oshol uluu kundo zher titirep, adamdar duinodo kylgan ish-araketterin korush uchun top-top bolup surak maidanynan chygyshat.
Kimde-kim kichinekei kumurskanyn salmagyndai zhakshylyk ishterdi kylsa, any aldynan korot.
Kimde-kim kichinekei kumurskanyn salmagyndai zhamandyk kylsa, anyn da natyizhasyn korot.
Allakh katuu churkaganda dem algany ugulgan tulparlar menen ant berdi.
Zhana tuiaktary tashka katuu tiigende ot chachyragan tulparlar menen ant berdi.
Zhana tan' zaarda dushmanga chabuul koigon tulparlar menen ant berdi.
Oshondo alar zhuguruktoru menen chan'dy sapyryp zhiberishti.
Andan son' atchandar dushmandyn zhoon tobun zharyp kirishti.
Chyndygynda insan Rabbisi andan kaalagan zhakshylyktan bash tartuuchu.
Al zhakshylyktan bash tartkanyna ozu kubo. Al achyk ele korungonu uchun any tana albait.
Al bailykty ashykcha suigonu uchun saran'dyk kylat.
Bul duino zhashoosuna aldangan adam, eger Allakh oluktordu kabyrlardan tiriltip, alardy surak, syilyk zhana zhaza uchun zherden chygarganda abal al oilogondoi bolbosun bilbeibi?
Zhuroktordogu nietter, ishenimden zhana bashka nerseler achykka chykkanda.
Chyndygynda alardyn Rabbisi al kunu alardan kabardar. Pendelerinin ech bir nersesi Aga zhashyruun emes. Zhakynda alarga anyn syilygyn zhe zhazasyn beret.
Katuu korkunuchu menen adamdardyn zhurok ushun algan kyiamat saaty.
Oz korkunuchu menen adamdardyn zhurok ushun algan bul kyiamat saaty degen emne?
Oo, paigambar! Oz korkunuchu menen adamdardyn zhurok ushun algan bul kyiamat saatyn sen kaidan bilmek elen'? Chyndygynda al - kyiamat kun.
Adamdardyn zhurok ushun algan kundo alar char tarapka chachyragan kopoloktor syiaktuu bolup kalyshat.
Zhana toolor tez zhurushundo zhana kyimylynda tytylgan zhun syiaktuu bolup kalat.
Kimdin zhakshylyk ishteri zhamandyk ishterinen basymduu bolso,
anda al beiishte kon'uldogudoi zhashoodo bolot.
Al emi kimdin zhamandyk ishteri zhakshylyk ishterinen basymduu bolso,
anda anyn kyiamat kundogu turak zhaiy tozok bolot.
Oo, paigambar! Al emne ekenin sen kandai bilmek elen'?
Al - abdan ysyk tozok.
Oo, adamdar! Mal-mulk zhana bala-chaka menen maktanuu silerdi Allakhka moiun sunuudan alaksytyp koidu.
Siler olup, kabyrga kirgenge cheiin.
Any menen maktanuu Allakhka moiun sunuudan silerdi alaksytpash kerek bolchu. Siler oshol alek bolgonun'ardyn akybetin zhakynda bilesin'er.
Kiiin anyn akybetin dagy bilesin'er.

Chyndygynda siler Allakhka tirilip bararyn'ardy zhana ish-araketterin'erdin syilygyn zhe zhazasyn alaryn'ardy chyndap bilgenin'erde, anda siler mal-mulk zhana bala-chakany aityp maktanuu menen alek bolboit elen'er.
Allakhka ant bolsun! Siler kyiamat kunu tozoktu sozsuz korosun'or.
Andan son' siler any ech kandai shek-kumonu zhok anyk korosun'or.
Andan son' al kunu Allakh silerge bergen den-sooluk, bailyk zhana bashka zhakshylyktar tuuraluu sozsuz surak alat.
Allakh taala asyr ubaktysy menen ant berdi.
Chyndygynda insan kemuudo zhana kyiroodo.

Birok Allakhka zhana Anyn elchilerine yiman keltirgender, zhakshylyk ishterdi kylgandar, biri-birine akyikatty osuiat kylgandar zhana akyikatka sabyr kylgandar - ushundai sypattagy adamdar gana duino zhashoosunda zhana akyrette aman kalyshat.
Adamdardy kop ushaktagandarga zhana alardy zhamanatty kylgandarga kyiroo zhana kataal azap bolsun!
Anyn butkul oiu bailyk toptoo zhana any eseptoo, anyn andan bashka oiu zhok.
Al chogultkan bailygy any olumdon kutkaryp, duino zhashoosunda tuboluk kalam dep oiloit.
Abal bul naadan oilogondoi emes. Any tozok otuna yrgytkyla! Al andagy azaptyn kataaldygynan ulam aga tashtalgan bardyk nerselerdi maidalap, tash-talkanyn chygarat.
Oo, paigambar! Aga tashtalgandardyn baarysyn zhok kylgan bul tozok emne ekenin kaidan bilmek elen'?
Al -- Allakhtyn aloolongon tozogu.
Al adamdardyn denesinen zhuroktoruno teship kiret.
Chyndygynda al anyn ichinde azaptalgandar uchun zhabyk.
Alar al zhaktan chygyp ketpesh uchun uzun ustundar menen bekemdelgen.
Oo, paigambar! Pil eeleri bolgon Abrakha zhana anyn zhan zhokorloru Kaabany talkaloonu kaalaganda Rabbin' alardy emne kylganyn bilbedin'bi?
Allakh alardyn any talkalaibyz degen zhaman oilorun tekke ketirdi. Alar adamdardy Kaabadan burabyz degen tilekterine zhetishpedi zhana andan ech nerse ala alyshpady.
Alarga top-tobu menen kelgen kanattuulardy zhiberdi.
Alarga katkan chopo tashtardy yrgytyshty.
Allakh alardy maldar tebelep tepsep zhegen egin zhalbyraktaryndai kylyp koidu.
Kuraishtyn salty zhana yntymagy uchun!
Alardyn beipildikte Iemenge karai kyshky sapary zhana Shamga karai zhaiky sapary uchun!
Emi siler uchun bul sapardy zhen'il kylgan ushul yiyk Uidun Rabbisine gana syiyngyla zhana Aga ech kimdi sherik kylbagyla!
Al arabdardyn zhuroktoruno yiyk zherge zhana anyn zhashoochularyna karata bolgon uluktoonu salyp, silerdi achkachylykta tamaktandyrdy zhana korkunuchtan saktady.
Kyiamat kunundogu surakty kim zhokko chygararyn bilesin'bi?
Al muktazh bolup turgan zhetimdi oroiluk menen turtkon adam.
Al ozun dagy, bashkalardy dagy kedei-kembagaldardy tamaktandyruuga chakyrbait.
Namazdaryna maani berbegen, ubaktysy otup baratsa da shashylbagan namaz okuuchulardyn azaby tuuraluu (aitylgan).
Namazdaryna maani berbegen, ubaktysy otup baratsa da shashylbagan namaz okuuchulardyn azaby tuuraluu (aitylgan).
Alar namazdaryn zhana ish-araketterin korunush uchun kylyshat. Ish-araketterinde Allakhka yklastuuluk kylyshpait.
Zhana zhardam beruudo ech kandai zyian keltirbegen nerselerde da bashkalarga zhardam berishpeit.
Oo, paigambar! Chyndygynda Biz saga kop zhakshylyktardy berdik zhana alardyn arasynda beiishtegi Kausar daryiasy da bar.
Sen mushrikterdin oz kudailaryna zhakyndoo uchun kylgan kurmandygyna karshylyk maksatta zhalgyz Allakh uchun namaz okup zhana kurmandyk chaluu menen bul zhakshylyk uchun shugur kyl.
Seni zhek korgon adam - al butkul zhakshylyktardan kuru kalgan, aty atalsa da zhamandyk menen atalyp unutta kala turgan adam.
Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Ei, Allakhka kaapyrlyk kylgandar!
Men azyr da, kelechekte da siler syiyngan kudailarga syiynbaimyn.
Siler dagy men syiyngan zhalgyz Allakhka syiynbaisyn'ar.
Men dagy siler syiyngan kudailarga syiynbaimyn.
Siler dagy men syiyngan zhalgyz Allakhka syiynbaisyn'ar.
Siler oilop tapkan dinin'er - ozun'or uchun, Allakh maga tushurgon din - men uchun>>.
Oo, paigambar! Senin dinin'e Allakhtyn zhen'ishi, any kuch-kubattuu kyluusu kelse zhana Mekkeni bagyndyruu ishke ashsa
zhana adamdar birinin artynan biri top-top bolup Islamga kirip zhatkanyn korson',

anda bul sen zhiberilgen ishtin aiaktap baratkanynyn belgisi ekenin bilgin. Emi sen zhen'ish zhana bagyndyruu zhakshylygyna shugur kylyp, Rabbin'e maktoolordu aityp aruula zhana Andan kechirim sura. Chyndygynda al pendelerinin kunoolorun kechirip, toobolorun kabyl kyluuchu.
Paigambardyn agasy Abu Lakhab ibn Abdulmuttalibdin kylgan ishteri sebeptuu koldoru kurusun. Antkeni al paigambarga zyian berdi. Anyn kylgan araketi tash kapsyn.
Aga bailygy zhana bala-chakasy kaisy nersede paida berdi? Alar any azaptan korgoi albait zhana aga ech kandai yraiym da alyp kelbeit.
Al kyiamat kunu zhalyndagan tozokko kiret, anyn ysyktyk azabyn tartat.
Zhana anyn aialy Ummu Zhamil dagy tozokko kiret. Antkeni al paigambar baskan zholdorgo tikenekterdi tashtap zyian berchi.
Any moinunda bekem tuiulgon zhip bar, al any tozokko karai alyp barat.
Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Al - Allakh zhalgyz syiynuuga tatyktuu, Andan bashka kudai zhok.
Al - kemchiliksiz zhana korkom sypattardagy bashkaruu Aga taandyk bolgon, makuluktar Aga gana bet algan Bashchy.
Al ech kimdi torobogon zhana ech kimden torolbogon. Allakh taalanyn balasy da, atasy da zhok.
Zharatkandarynyn ech biri Aga okshosh emes.
Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Tan'dyn Rabbisi menen korgonom zhana Aga bash kalkalaim.
Zyianduu makuluktardyn zhamandygynan.
Tun ichinde paida bolgon aibandar zhana uurular syiaktuu zhamandyktardan Allakhtan korgoo suraimyn.
Tuiundordu dubalap uilogon syikyrchylardyn zhamandygynan korgoo suraimyn.
Koro albastykka turtkon ishti kylgan kezde koro albastyk kylgan adamdyn zhamandygynan korgoo suraimyn.
Oo, paigambar! Aitkyn: <<Adamdardyn Rabbisi menen korgonom zhana Aga bash kalkalaim.
Adamdar uchun Andan bashka Padysha bolbogon, alardy Ozu kaalagandai bashkargan alardyn Padyshasynan.
Al - alardyn chynygy kudaiy. Alar uchun Andan bashka syiynuuga tatyktuu kudai zhok.
Adam Allakhty unutkanda azgyryk salgan zhana Allakhty estegen kezde andan alystagan shaitandyn zhamandygynan.
Al adamdardyn zhuroktoruno azgyryk salat.
Al zhinderden bolgon syiaktuu adamzattan da bolot>>.
